--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/household_permissions.py
@@ -0,0 +1,514 @@
+"""
+Household roles and permissions (owner decision on audit items DB-16 and DB-18).
+
+Applies to family and roommate households alike:
+
+1. A member creates transactions and edits or deletes only their own. Only a household admin
+   edits or deletes another member's transaction. The creator (``transactions.user_id``) is the
+   verified JWT subject at insert and never changes.
+2. Only a household admin moves money out of a shared pool (enforced by
+   ``transfer_between_accounts`` in the database; the app hides the option for members).
+3. An admin promotes members to admin ("co-admins") and revokes that. The primary admin
+   (``households.owner_user_id``) cannot be demoted or removed by a co-admin, and only the
+   primary admin transfers primary ownership. The last admin of a household is never demoted.
+
+4. The household type ('family' | 'roommates', owner decision D1, migration
+   ``20261020900000``) is chosen at creation; an admin changes it (``set_household_type``) and sets
+   members' financial roles within it (``set_member_financial_role``: family -> spouse,
+   family_member, dependent; roommates -> peer). Role invites must fit the type.
+
+The service role bypasses RLS, so every check here is explicit and uses the verified JWT user.
+Role changes then go through the SECURITY DEFINER RPCs of migration
+``20261020400000_admin_permissions_and_co_admins.sql`` with that user as ``p_actor_user_id``, so
+the database re-checks every rule.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import supabase_client
+from postgrest_compat import db_error_fields, first_row
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+ADMIN = "admin"
+MEMBER = "member"
+
+
+class HouseholdPermissionError(Exception):
+    """Base class for role and permission rule violations."""
+
+
+class PermissionDeniedError(HouseholdPermissionError):
+    """The caller may not perform this action in this household (HTTP 403)."""
+
+
+class MemberNotFoundError(HouseholdPermissionError):
+    """The target user is not a member of this household (HTTP 404)."""
+
+
+class TransactionNotFoundError(HouseholdPermissionError):
+    """No such transaction in this household (HTTP 404)."""
+
+
+class InvalidRoleChangeError(HouseholdPermissionError):
+    """The change would break an invariant, e.g. demote the last admin (HTTP 409)."""
+
+
+class HouseholdConflictError(HouseholdPermissionError):
+    """A refused change with a machine-readable ``code`` (HTTP 409 ``{code, message}``)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, message: str, code: str):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.code = code
+
+
+class InvalidFinancialRoleError(HouseholdPermissionError):
+    """A financial role (or household type) that does not exist or does not fit (HTTP 422)."""
+
+    code = "financial_role_not_allowed"
+
+    def __init__(self, message: str, code: Optional[str] = None):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        if code:
+            self.code = code
+
+
+FAMILY = "family"
+ROOMMATES = "roommates"
+HOUSEHOLD_TYPES = (FAMILY, ROOMMATES)
+FINANCIAL_ROLES = ("provider", "spouse", "peer", "family_member", "dependent")
+# Roles an admin may assign with set_member_financial_role (the provider is chosen separately).
+ASSIGNABLE_FINANCIAL_ROLES = {FAMILY: ("spouse", "family_member", "dependent"), ROOMMATES: ("peer",)}
+# Roles a membership (and so a role invite) may hold in each household type.
+MEMBERSHIP_FINANCIAL_ROLES = {FAMILY: ("provider", "spouse", "family_member", "dependent"), ROOMMATES: ("peer",)}
+
+TYPE_CHANGE_BLOCKED = "type_change_blocked"
+INVITE_ROLE_MISMATCH = "invite_role_mismatch"
+
+
+TRANSACTION_FORBIDDEN = "Only household admins can edit or delete another member's transactions."
+PRIMARY_PROTECTED = "The primary admin cannot be demoted; the primary admin must transfer primary admin first."
+PRIMARY_ONLY_TRANSFER = "Only the primary admin can transfer primary admin."
+
+
+# ─── Pure rules ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def can_modify_transaction(actor_id: Optional[str], actor_role: Optional[str], creator_id: Optional[str]) -> bool:
+    """A member edits/deletes their own transactions; an admin any transaction of the household."""
+    if not actor_id or actor_role not in (ADMIN, MEMBER):
+        return False
+    if actor_role == ADMIN:
+        return True
+    return creator_id is not None and str(creator_id) == str(actor_id)
+
+
+def can_record_settlement(
+    actor_id: Optional[str], actor_role: Optional[str], payer_id: Optional[str], recipient_id: Optional[str]
+) -> bool:
+    """A settlement names who paid whom: either party records it, or an admin for anyone."""
+    if not actor_id or actor_role not in (ADMIN, MEMBER):
+        return False
+    return actor_role == ADMIN or str(actor_id) in (str(payer_id), str(recipient_id))
+
+
+# ─── Roster ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+@dataclass
+class HouseholdRoster:
+    household_id: str
+    primary_admin_id: Optional[str] = None
+    members: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    nafaqah_provider_id: Optional[str] = None
+    household_type: str = FAMILY
+
+    def role_of(self, user_id: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
+        member = self.members.get(str(user_id or ""))
+        return member["role"] if member else None
+
+    def is_member(self, user_id: Optional[str]) -> bool:
+        return str(user_id or "") in self.members
+
+    def is_admin(self, user_id: Optional[str]) -> bool:
+        return self.role_of(user_id) == ADMIN
+
+    def is_primary(self, user_id: Optional[str]) -> bool:
+        return bool(user_id) and self.primary_admin_id == str(user_id)
+
+    def admin_ids(self) -> List[str]:
+        return [uid for uid, m in self.members.items() if m["role"] == ADMIN]
+
+
+def household_owner_id(client, household_id: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """households.owner_user_id (the primary admin), or None when unset or not migrated yet."""
+    try:
+        row = first_row(client.table("households").select("owner_user_id").eq("id", household_id))
+    except Exception as exc:  # column not migrated yet: derive it like the migration backfill
+        logger.warning("Could not read households.owner_user_id: %s", exc)
+        return None
+    owner = row.get("owner_user_id") if row else None
+    return str(owner) if owner else None
+
+
+def household_nafaqah_provider_id(client, household_id: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """
+    households.nafaqah_provider_user_id (the explicit Nafaqah provider), or None when unset. Only
+    the members list (display) uses this helper; Nafaqah rules read it in load_family_context,
+    where a failure propagates.
+    """
+    try:
+        row = first_row(client.table("households").select("nafaqah_provider_user_id").eq("id", household_id))
+    except Exception as exc:
+        logger.warning("Could not read households.nafaqah_provider_user_id: %s", exc)
+        return None
+    provider = row.get("nafaqah_provider_user_id") if row else None
+    return str(provider) if provider else None
+
+
+def household_type_of(client, household_id: str, financial_roles=()) -> str:
+    """
+    households.household_type ('family' | 'roommates'); before the column exists (or on a read
+    error) the migration's backfill rule: any peer member -> roommates, else family.
+    """
+    from nafaqah_service import normalize_household_type
+
+    try:
+        row = first_row(client.table("households").select("household_type").eq("id", household_id))
+    except Exception as exc:
+        logger.warning("Could not read households.household_type: %s", exc)
+        row = None
+    return normalize_household_type((row or {}).get("household_type"), financial_roles)
+
+
+def load_roster(household_id: str) -> HouseholdRoster:
+    """Members (household_memberships is authoritative), their roles and the primary admin."""
+    client = supabase_client.get_client()
+    memberships = (
+        client.table("household_memberships")
+        .select("user_id, role, created_at, financial_role")
+        .eq("household_id", household_id)
+        .execute()
+    ).data or []
+    user_ids = [str(m["user_id"]) for m in memberships if m.get("user_id")]
+    users: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    if user_ids:
+        rows = (
+            client.table("users")
+            .select("id, display_name")
+            .in_("id", user_ids)
+            .execute()
+        ).data or []
+        users = {str(u["id"]): u for u in rows if u.get("id")}
+
+    roster = HouseholdRoster(household_id=household_id)
+    for m in memberships:
+        uid = str(m.get("user_id") or "")
+        if not uid:
+            continue
+        user = users.get(uid, {})
+        roster.members[uid] = {
+            "user_id": uid,
+            "role": ADMIN if m.get("role") == ADMIN else MEMBER,
+            "joined_at": str(m.get("created_at") or ""),
+            "display_name": user.get("display_name"),
+            # The role in THIS household (FABLE-LOGIC-01), not the per-user cache.
+            "financial_role": m.get("financial_role"),
+        }
+
+    roster.nafaqah_provider_id = household_nafaqah_provider_id(client, household_id)
+    roster.household_type = household_type_of(
+        client, household_id, [m.get("financial_role") for m in roster.members.values()]
+    )
+    owner = household_owner_id(client, household_id)
+    if owner and roster.is_admin(owner):
+        roster.primary_admin_id = owner
+    else:
+        admins = sorted(
+            (m for m in roster.members.values() if m["role"] == ADMIN),
+            key=lambda m: (m["joined_at"], m["user_id"]),
+        )
+        roster.primary_admin_id = admins[0]["user_id"] if admins else None
+    return roster
+
+
+def _require_member(roster: HouseholdRoster, user_id: str) -> None:
+    if not roster.is_member(user_id):
+        raise PermissionDeniedError("Not a member of this household.")
+
+
+def _require_admin(roster: HouseholdRoster, user_id: str) -> None:
+    _require_member(roster, user_id)
+    if not roster.is_admin(user_id):
+        raise PermissionDeniedError("Household admin privileges are required.")
+
+
+def _require_target(roster: HouseholdRoster, user_id: str) -> None:
+    if not roster.is_member(user_id):
+        raise MemberNotFoundError("That user is not a member of this household.")
+
+
+# ─── Transactions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def member_role(household_id: str, user_id: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    row = first_row(
+        supabase_client.get_client()
+        .table("household_memberships")
+        .select("role")
+        .eq("household_id", household_id)
+        .eq("user_id", user_id)
+    )
+    if not row:
+        return None
+    return ADMIN if row.get("role") == ADMIN else MEMBER
+
+
+def assert_can_modify_transaction(household_id: str, transaction_id: str, actor_user_id: Optional[str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    """
+    Load ``transaction_id`` inside ``household_id`` and check the actor may edit or delete it.
+    Raises TransactionNotFoundError (not in this household) or PermissionDeniedError.
+    """
+    if not actor_user_id:
+        raise PermissionDeniedError(TRANSACTION_FORBIDDEN)
+    tx = first_row(
+        supabase_client.get_client()
+        .table("transactions")
+        .select("id, household_id, user_id")
+        .eq("id", transaction_id)
+        .eq("household_id", household_id)
+    )
+    if not tx:
+        raise TransactionNotFoundError("Transaction not found in this household.")
+    role = member_role(household_id, actor_user_id)
+    if not can_modify_transaction(actor_user_id, role, tx.get("user_id")):
+        raise PermissionDeniedError(TRANSACTION_FORBIDDEN)
+    return tx
+
+
+# ─── Role management ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def _member_view(roster: HouseholdRoster, member: Dict[str, Any], caller_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    uid = member["user_id"]
+    return {
+        "user_id": uid,
+        "display_name": member.get("display_name"),
+        "role": member["role"],
+        "financial_role": member.get("financial_role"),
+        "is_primary": roster.is_primary(uid),
+        "is_nafaqah_provider": bool(roster.nafaqah_provider_id) and uid == roster.nafaqah_provider_id,
+        "is_self": uid == str(caller_id),
+        "joined_at": member.get("joined_at") or None,
+    }
+
+
+def list_members(household_id: str, caller_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    """Members with roles, primary admin first, plus what the caller may change."""
+    roster = load_roster(household_id)
+    _require_member(roster, caller_id)
+    ordered = sorted(
+        roster.members.values(),
+        key=lambda m: (not roster.is_primary(m["user_id"]), m["role"] != ADMIN, m["joined_at"], m["user_id"]),
+    )
+    caller_is_admin = roster.is_admin(caller_id)
+    return {
+        "household_id": household_id,
+        # 'family' | 'roommates' (D1); admins change it (PUT /households/{id}/type) and set
+        # financial roles within it (PUT /households/{id}/members/{user_id}/financial-role).
+        "household_type": roster.household_type,
+        "can_change_household_type": caller_is_admin,
+        "can_set_financial_roles": caller_is_admin,
+        "assignable_financial_roles": list(ASSIGNABLE_FINANCIAL_ROLES[roster.household_type]),
+        "primary_admin_user_id": roster.primary_admin_id,
+        "caller_role": roster.role_of(caller_id),
+        "caller_is_primary": roster.is_primary(caller_id),
+        "can_manage_admins": caller_is_admin,
+        "can_transfer_primary": roster.is_primary(caller_id),
+        # The Nafaqah provider (husband) is a separate role from the primary admin; any admin
+        # changes it (PUT /households/{id}/nafaqah/provider) to a non-spouse member.
+        "nafaqah_provider_user_id": roster.nafaqah_provider_id,
+        "can_set_nafaqah_provider": caller_is_admin and roster.household_type == FAMILY,
+        "members": [_member_view(roster, m, caller_id) for m in ordered],
+    }
+
+
+def _map_rpc_error(exc: Exception) -> Exception:
+    fields = db_error_fields(exc)
+    message, code = fields["message"], fields["code"]
+    if "sole admin" in message.lower():
+        return InvalidRoleChangeError("A household needs at least one admin.")
+    if code == "42501" or message.startswith("Forbidden") or "primary admin" in message.lower():
+        return PermissionDeniedError("Not allowed for this household member.")
+    if code == "P0002" or "not a member" in message.lower():
+        return MemberNotFoundError("That user is not a member of this household.")
+    if code in ("22023", "23514"):
+        return InvalidRoleChangeError("The database rejected the role change.")
+    return exc
+
+
+def _call_role_rpc(name: str, params: Dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
+    try:
+        res = supabase_client.get_client().rpc(name, params).execute()
+    except Exception as exc:
+        mapped = _map_rpc_error(exc)
+        if mapped is exc:
+            raise
+        raise mapped from exc
+    return getattr(res, "data", None)
+
+
+def promote_member(household_id: str, actor_id: str, target_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    """Any admin (primary or co-admin) makes another member an admin."""
+    roster = load_roster(household_id)
+    _require_admin(roster, actor_id)
+    _require_target(roster, target_id)
+    if not roster.is_admin(target_id):
+        _call_role_rpc(
+            "promote_member_to_admin",
+            {"p_household_id": household_id, "p_user_id": target_id, "p_actor_user_id": actor_id},
+        )
+    return list_members(household_id, actor_id)
+
+
+def revoke_admin(household_id: str, actor_id: str, target_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    """Any admin revokes a co-admin (themselves included); never the primary admin or the last admin."""
+    roster = load_roster(household_id)
+    _require_admin(roster, actor_id)
+    _require_target(roster, target_id)
+    if roster.is_primary(target_id):
+        raise PermissionDeniedError(PRIMARY_PROTECTED)
+    if roster.is_admin(target_id):
+        if roster.admin_ids() == [str(target_id)]:
+            raise InvalidRoleChangeError("A household needs at least one admin.")
+        _call_role_rpc(
+            "revoke_admin",
+            {"p_household_id": household_id, "p_user_id": target_id, "p_actor_user_id": actor_id},
+        )
+    return list_members(household_id, actor_id)
+
+
+def transfer_primary_admin(household_id: str, actor_id: str, new_primary_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    """Only the primary admin hands primary ownership to another member (made an admin if needed)."""
+    roster = load_roster(household_id)
+    _require_admin(roster, actor_id)
+    if not roster.is_primary(actor_id):
+        raise PermissionDeniedError(PRIMARY_ONLY_TRANSFER)
+    _require_target(roster, new_primary_id)
+    if str(new_primary_id) == str(actor_id):
+        raise InvalidRoleChangeError("Choose another member of this household.")
+    _call_role_rpc(
+        "transfer_primary_admin",
+        {"p_household_id": household_id, "p_new_primary_user_id": new_primary_id, "p_actor_user_id": actor_id},
+    )
+    return list_members(household_id, actor_id)
+
+
+# ─── Household type and financial roles (owner decision D1, FABLE2-DB-07) ─────
+
+def _rpc_hint(exc: Exception) -> str:
+    return db_error_fields(exc)["hint"]
+
+
+def set_household_type(household_id: str, actor_id: str, household_type: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    """
+    An admin switches the household between 'family' and 'roommates' (public.set_household_type
+    re-checks with the verified caller). family -> roommates is refused while a wife or any
+    Nafaqah record exists (HouseholdConflictError ``type_change_blocked``); roommates -> family
+    turns peers into family members and the primary admin into the default Nafaqah provider.
+    """
+    roster = load_roster(household_id)
+    _require_admin(roster, actor_id)
+    wanted = str(household_type or "").strip().lower()
+    if wanted not in HOUSEHOLD_TYPES:
+        raise InvalidFinancialRoleError("household_type must be 'family' or 'roommates'.", "invalid_household_type")
+    try:
+        res = supabase_client.get_client().rpc(
+            "set_household_type",
+            {"p_household_id": household_id, "p_household_type": wanted, "p_actor_user_id": actor_id},
+        ).execute()
+    except Exception as exc:
+        if _rpc_hint(exc) == TYPE_CHANGE_BLOCKED:
+            raise HouseholdConflictError(
+                "A family household with a wife or Nafaqah records cannot become a roommates household.",
+                TYPE_CHANGE_BLOCKED,
+            ) from exc
+        mapped = _map_rpc_error(exc)
+        if mapped is exc:
+            raise
+        raise mapped from exc
+    data = getattr(res, "data", None)
+    data = data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}
+    return {
+        "status": "success",
+        "household_id": household_id,
+        "household_type": data.get("household_type") or wanted,
+    }
+
+
+def set_member_financial_role(household_id: str, actor_id: str, target_id: str, financial_role: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    """
+    An admin sets a member's financial role within the household type (family: spouse,
+    family_member, dependent; roommates: peer) through public.set_member_financial_role.
+    403 not an admin, 404 not a member, 422 role not available here, 409 the Nafaqah provider
+    as a spouse (``provider_is_spouse``) or a wife with ledger records (``spouse_has_ledger``).
+    """
+    roster = load_roster(household_id)
+    _require_admin(roster, actor_id)
+    _require_target(roster, target_id)
+    role = str(financial_role or "").strip().lower()
+    if role not in ASSIGNABLE_FINANCIAL_ROLES[roster.household_type]:
+        raise InvalidFinancialRoleError(
+            f"Financial role {role!r} is not available in a {roster.household_type} household."
+        )
+    if role == "spouse" and roster.nafaqah_provider_id and str(target_id) == roster.nafaqah_provider_id:
+        raise HouseholdConflictError("The Nafaqah provider cannot be a spouse member.", "provider_is_spouse")
+    try:
+        res = supabase_client.get_client().rpc(
+            "set_member_financial_role",
+            {
+                "p_household_id": household_id,
+                "p_user_id": target_id,
+                "p_financial_role": role,
+                "p_actor_user_id": actor_id,
+            },
+        ).execute()
+    except Exception as exc:
+        hint = _rpc_hint(exc)
+        if hint == "financial_role_not_allowed":
+            raise InvalidFinancialRoleError(
+                f"Financial role {role!r} is not available in this household."
+            ) from exc
+        if hint == "provider_is_spouse":
+            raise HouseholdConflictError("The Nafaqah provider cannot be a spouse member.", hint) from exc
+        if hint == "spouse_has_ledger":
+            raise HouseholdConflictError(
+                "This wife has Nafaqah records in the household; her role cannot change.", hint
+            ) from exc
+        mapped = _map_rpc_error(exc)
+        if mapped is exc:
+            raise
+        raise mapped from exc
+    data = getattr(res, "data", None)
+    data = data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}
+    return {
+        "status": "success",
+        "household_id": household_id,
+        "user_id": str(target_id),
+        "financial_role": data.get("financial_role") or role,
+    }
+
+
+def assert_invite_role_fits(household_id: str, role: str) -> None:
+    """
+    A role invite must fit the household type (D1): no spouse/provider/family invite in a
+    roommates household, no peer invite in a family household. The claim RPCs refuse a mismatch
+    too (an invite issued before a type change); this gives the admin a clear answer up front.
+    """
+    client = supabase_client.get_client()
+    household_type = household_type_of(client, household_id)
+    norm = str(role or "").strip().lower()
+    if norm in FINANCIAL_ROLES and norm not in MEMBERSHIP_FINANCIAL_ROLES[household_type]:
+        raise HouseholdConflictError(
+            f"A {norm!r} invite does not fit a {household_type} household.", INVITE_ROLE_MISMATCH
+        )

@@ -0,0 +1,155 @@
+"""
+Idempotent replay support for transaction-committing endpoints.
+
+The mobile app replays queued chat/receipt commits after connectivity loss and tags each with
+an ``Idempotency-Key`` header. A key is scoped to (user_id, endpoint): the first request
+reserves it, its successful result is stored, and every replay of the same key returns that
+stored result instead of inserting a second transaction.
+
+Storage: Redis (``REDIS_URL``) when available so all instances share keys, otherwise an
+in-process TTL map. Durable cross-instance dedupe without Redis needs a DB table (documented
+as an owner action in docs/review/audit/ai_service.md).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import hashlib
+import json
+import logging
+import re
+import time
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional, Tuple
+
+from fastapi import HTTPException, status
+
+from utils import utc_now
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_SECONDS = 24 * 3600
+_PENDING_TTL_SECONDS = 120
+_KEY_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{8,128}$")
+_PENDING = "__pending__"
+
+# client_occurred_at bounds: small forward clock skew; offline queues are drained within days,
+# anything older than this is treated as a corrupt/forged timestamp.
+MAX_FUTURE_SKEW = timedelta(minutes=5)
+MAX_CLIENT_AGE = timedelta(days=90)
+
+
+def validate_idempotency_key(raw: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
+    if raw is None or raw == "":
+        return None
+    key = raw.strip()
+    if not _KEY_RE.match(key):
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
+            detail="Idempotency-Key must be 8-128 characters of [A-Za-z0-9._:-].",
+        )
+    return key
+
+
+def parse_client_occurred_at(raw: Optional[str]) -> Optional[datetime]:
+    """Validate the client-side event time used as the transaction timestamp on replays."""
+    if raw is None or raw == "":
+        return None
+    try:
+        dt = datetime.fromisoformat(str(raw).strip().replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+    except ValueError:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="client_occurred_at must be an ISO-8601 timestamp.")
+    if dt.tzinfo is None:
+        dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    dt = dt.astimezone(timezone.utc)
+    now = utc_now()
+    if dt > now + MAX_FUTURE_SKEW:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="client_occurred_at is in the future.")
+    if dt < now - MAX_CLIENT_AGE:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="client_occurred_at is too old.")
+    return dt
+
+
+class IdempotencyStore:
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self._memory: Dict[str, Tuple[float, str]] = {}
+        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _scoped(user_id: str, endpoint: str, key: str) -> str:
+        digest = hashlib.sha256(f"{user_id}|{endpoint}|{key}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+        return f"idem:{digest}"
+
+    async def _redis(self):
+        from rate_limiter import default_rate_limiter
+
+        return await default_rate_limiter._get_redis()
+
+    async def reserve(self, user_id: str, endpoint: str, key: str) -> Optional[Any]:
+        """
+        Reserve the key. Returns the stored result for a completed earlier request, None when the
+        caller should proceed. Raises 409 while an identical request is still in flight.
+        """
+        scoped = self._scoped(user_id, endpoint, key)
+        redis = await self._redis()
+        if redis is not None:
+            try:
+                if await redis.set(scoped, _PENDING, nx=True, ex=_PENDING_TTL_SECONDS):
+                    return None
+                existing = await redis.get(scoped)
+                return self._interpret(existing)
+            except HTTPException:
+                raise
+            except Exception as exc:
+                logger.warning("Redis idempotency store failed (%s); using in-memory store.", exc)
+        async with self._lock:
+            now = time.monotonic()
+            self._memory = {k: v for k, v in self._memory.items() if v[0] > now}
+            entry = self._memory.get(scoped)
+            if entry is None:
+                self._memory[scoped] = (now + _PENDING_TTL_SECONDS, _PENDING)
+                return None
+            return self._interpret(entry[1])
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _interpret(stored: Optional[str]) -> Optional[Any]:
+        if stored is None:
+            return None
+        if stored == _PENDING:
+            raise HTTPException(
+                status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
+                detail="A request with this Idempotency-Key is still being processed.",
+                headers={"Retry-After": "2"},
+            )
+        return json.loads(stored)
+
+    async def complete(self, user_id: str, endpoint: str, key: str, result: Any) -> None:
+        scoped = self._scoped(user_id, endpoint, key)
+        payload = json.dumps(result, default=str)
+        redis = await self._redis()
+        if redis is not None:
+            try:
+                await redis.set(scoped, payload, ex=IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_SECONDS)
+                return
+            except Exception as exc:
+                logger.warning("Redis idempotency store failed (%s); using in-memory store.", exc)
+        async with self._lock:
+            self._memory[scoped] = (time.monotonic() + IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_SECONDS, payload)
+
+    async def release(self, user_id: str, endpoint: str, key: str) -> None:
+        """Drop a reservation after a failed request so the client can retry with the same key."""
+        scoped = self._scoped(user_id, endpoint, key)
+        redis = await self._redis()
+        if redis is not None:
+            try:
+                await redis.delete(scoped)
+            except Exception as exc:
+                logger.warning("Redis idempotency release failed: %s", exc)
+        async with self._lock:
+            self._memory.pop(scoped, None)
+
+    def clear(self) -> None:
+        self._memory.clear()
+
+
+idempotency_store = IdempotencyStore()

+def _sar_half_up(value: Any) -> float:
+    """SAR amount rounded half-up to the halala (Python's round() is half-even on floats)."""
+    return float(Decimal(str(value)).quantize(_HALALA, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))

+def _halalas(value: Any) -> int:
+    """A SAR amount as an integer number of halalas, rounded half-up."""
+    return int((Decimal(str(value)) * 100).quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))

+def default_frequency_for_provider(provider: Optional[str], installment_count: int = 4) -> str:

+    if (provider or "").strip().lower() in PAY_IN_4_PROVIDERS and installment_count == 4:

+def installment_amounts(total_amount: float, installment_count: int) -> List[float]:
+    """

+    rounded half-up to the halala, and the last one absorbs the remainder so the amounts add up to
+    the total exactly (100 / 3 -> 33.33, 33.33, 33.34). When half-up rounding would leave the last
+    installment negative (tiny totals over many installments), the regular amount is rounded down.
+    """
+    count = max(1, int(installment_count))
+    total = _halalas(total_amount)
+    regular = int((Decimal(total) / count).quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
+    if total - regular * (count - 1) < 0:
+        regular = int((Decimal(total) / count).quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=ROUND_DOWN))
+    last = total - regular * (count - 1)
+    return [regular / 100.0] * (count - 1) + [last / 100.0]

+def installment_due_date(start_date: date, frequency: str, index: int) -> date:

+        """
+        One-time, idempotent backfill (NOT run automatically): creates an installment_plans row for
+        every transaction whose note carries the suffix written by ``_adjust_original_transaction``
+        ("[Financed via <provider>: Installment <n> of <m>. Full price: SAR <total>]") and that no
+        plan references yet. Before migration 20261021000000's release, list_plans re-derived such
+        plans on every load; now only rows are listed.
+
+        * ``apply=False`` (default) only reports what would be created.
+        * Idempotent: a transaction that a plan already references (``original_transaction_id``) is
+          skipped, and the plan id is derived from the transaction id (uuid5), so a re-run creates
+          nothing and a concurrent run cannot create a duplicate.
+        * Only the explicit suffix is parsed (no guessing from a bare "Tabby"/"Tamara" mention); the
+          transaction is never changed again; the frequency follows the provider default.
+
+        Run from ``ai_service/`` with the service-role environment of the target database, e.g.
+        ``python -m installment_service --backfill-legacy [--household <uuid>] [--apply]``.
+        """

+            if not tx_id or tx_id in linked or not match:

+            provider = match.group(1).strip()[:40] or "Other"
+            paid, count = int(match.group(2)), int(match.group(3))
+            if count < 1 or count > 60 or paid < 0 or paid > count:
+                continue
+            amount = _sar_half_up(tx.get("amount") or 0)
+            total = _sar_half_up(match.group(4).replace(",", "")) if match.group(4) else _sar_half_up(amount * count)

+                created += len((res.data if res is not None else None) or [])
+        logger.info("Legacy installment backfill: %d candidate(s), %d written (apply=%s)",
+                    len(candidates), created, apply)
+        return {"candidates": len(candidates), "created": created, "applied": apply,
+                "plans": [{k: r[k] for k in ("id", "household_id", "provider", "installment_count",
+                                             "paid_installments", "frequency", "original_transaction_id")}
+                          for r in candidates]}

+    parser.add_argument("--backfill-legacy", action="store_true",

+    parser.add_argument("--household", default=None, help="Limit to one household id.")

index 0000000..cc905c1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/mail_service.py
@@ -0,0 +1,181 @@
+"""
+Outbound email for contact, support and VIP early-access inquiries.
+
+Providers (picked from the environment at send time; Resend wins when both are set):
+- Resend HTTP API: RESEND_API_KEY. Works on hosts that block outbound SMTP ports, such as
+  Railway's non-Pro plans. The sender domain (fmsco.com.sa) must be verified in Resend.
+- SMTP: SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USERNAME, SMTP_PASSWORD, SMTP_SECURITY ("starttls" or
+  "ssl"; defaults to "ssl" on port 465, otherwise "starttls"). TLS is mandatory. The login must
+  be the mailbox of the sender address (fmscoinfo@fmsco.com.sa by default).
+
+Sender: MAIL_FROM, default "Budget Tracker <fmscoinfo@fmsco.com.sa>". SMTP_FROM / RESEND_FROM
+override it for one provider only.
+
+Every message goes to CONTACT_RECIPIENT_EMAIL (default abedmowafaq@gmail.com) with Reply-To
+set to the submitter. Nothing here ever reports success unless the provider accepted the
+message: a missing provider raises MailNotConfiguredError, a provider failure raises
+MailDeliveryError.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import logging
+import os
+import re
+import smtplib
+import ssl
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from email.message import EmailMessage
+from email.utils import formatdate, make_msgid, parseaddr
+from typing import Optional
+
+import httpx
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+DEFAULT_RECIPIENT = "abedmowafaq@gmail.com"
+RESEND_ENDPOINT = "https://api.resend.com/emails"
+# Every inquiry email is sent from the company mailbox unless MAIL_FROM (or the
+# provider-specific SMTP_FROM / RESEND_FROM) says otherwise.
+DEFAULT_SENDER = "Budget Tracker <fmscoinfo@fmsco.com.sa>"
+SEND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 15.0
+
+_SIMPLE_EMAIL_RE = re.compile(r"^[^@\s<>,;\"]+@[^@\s<>,;\"]+\.[^@\s<>,;\"]+$")
+_HEADER_UNSAFE_RE = re.compile(r"[\r\n\x00]")
+
+
+class MailNotConfiguredError(RuntimeError):
+    """No usable email provider (or recipient) is configured."""
+
+
+class MailDeliveryError(RuntimeError):
+    """The provider was reachable/configured but did not accept the message."""
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class OutboundEmail:
+    subject: str
+    body: str
+    reply_to: Optional[str] = None
+
+
+def _env(name: str) -> str:
+    return os.environ.get(name, "").strip()
+
+
+def recipient() -> str:
+    value = _env("CONTACT_RECIPIENT_EMAIL") or DEFAULT_RECIPIENT
+    if not _SIMPLE_EMAIL_RE.match(value):
+        raise MailNotConfiguredError("CONTACT_RECIPIENT_EMAIL is not a valid email address.")
+    return value
+
+
+def sender(provider_override_var: str) -> str:
+    """The From header: provider override, then MAIL_FROM, then DEFAULT_SENDER."""
+    value = _env(provider_override_var) or _env("MAIL_FROM") or DEFAULT_SENDER
+    if _HEADER_UNSAFE_RE.search(value) or not _SIMPLE_EMAIL_RE.match(parseaddr(value)[1] or ""):
+        raise MailNotConfiguredError("MAIL_FROM (or SMTP_FROM / RESEND_FROM) must be a valid sender address.")
+    return value
+
+
+def active_provider() -> Optional[str]:
+    """Name of the provider that send_email would use, or None when none is configured."""
+    if _env("RESEND_API_KEY"):
+        return "resend"
+    if _env("SMTP_HOST"):
+        return "smtp"
+    return None
+
+
+def _assert_header_safe(name: str, value: Optional[str]) -> None:
+    if value is not None and _HEADER_UNSAFE_RE.search(value):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} contains line breaks or NUL characters.")
+
+
+async def send_email(message: OutboundEmail) -> str:
+    """Deliver *message* to the configured recipient. Returns the provider name used."""
+    _assert_header_safe("subject", message.subject)
+    _assert_header_safe("reply_to", message.reply_to)
+
+    provider = active_provider()
+    if provider is None:
+        raise MailNotConfiguredError("No email provider configured (set RESEND_API_KEY or SMTP_HOST).")
+    to_address = recipient()
+
+    if provider == "resend":
+        await _send_via_resend(message, to_address)
+    else:
+        # smtplib is blocking; keep it off the event loop.
+        await asyncio.to_thread(_send_via_smtp, message, to_address)
+    return provider
+
+
+async def _send_via_resend(message: OutboundEmail, to_address: str) -> None:
+    payload = {
+        "from": sender("RESEND_FROM"),
+        "to": [to_address],
+        "subject": message.subject,
+        "text": message.body,
+    }
+    if message.reply_to:
+        payload["reply_to"] = message.reply_to
+    try:
+        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=SEND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) as client:
+            response = await client.post(
+                RESEND_ENDPOINT,
+                json=payload,
+                headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {_env('RESEND_API_KEY')}"},
+            )
+    except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
+        raise MailDeliveryError(f"Resend request failed ({type(exc).__name__}).") from exc
+    if response.status_code not in (200, 201, 202):
+        raise MailDeliveryError(f"Resend rejected the message (HTTP {response.status_code}).")
+
+
+def _smtp_settings() -> tuple[str, int, str, str, str, str]:
+    host = _env("SMTP_HOST")
+    raw_port = _env("SMTP_PORT")
+    security = _env("SMTP_SECURITY").lower()
+    try:
+        port = int(raw_port) if raw_port else (465 if security == "ssl" else 587)
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        raise MailNotConfiguredError("SMTP_PORT must be an integer.") from exc
+    if not security:
+        security = "ssl" if port == 465 else "starttls"
+    if security not in ("ssl", "starttls"):
+        raise MailNotConfiguredError("SMTP_SECURITY must be 'starttls' or 'ssl'.")
+    username = _env("SMTP_USERNAME")
+    password = os.environ.get("SMTP_PASSWORD", "")
+    return host, port, security, username, password, sender("SMTP_FROM")
+
+
+def _send_via_smtp(message: OutboundEmail, to_address: str) -> None:
+    host, port, security, username, password, from_header = _smtp_settings()
+
+    email = EmailMessage()
+    email["From"] = from_header
+    email["To"] = to_address
+    email["Subject"] = message.subject
+    if message.reply_to:
+        email["Reply-To"] = message.reply_to
+    email["Date"] = formatdate(usegmt=True)
+    email["Message-ID"] = make_msgid(domain=parseaddr(from_header)[1].rsplit("@", 1)[-1])
+    email.set_content(message.body)
+
+    context = ssl.create_default_context()
+    try:
+        if security == "ssl":
+            smtp = smtplib.SMTP_SSL(host, port, timeout=SEND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, context=context)
+        else:
+            smtp = smtplib.SMTP(host, port, timeout=SEND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
+        with smtp:
+            if security == "starttls":
+                smtp.ehlo()
+                smtp.starttls(context=context)
+                smtp.ehlo()
+            if username:
+                smtp.login(username, password)
+            smtp.send_message(email)
+    except (smtplib.SMTPException, OSError) as exc:
+        raise MailDeliveryError(f"SMTP delivery failed ({type(exc).__name__}).") from exc

+    Infinity, which cannot be JSON-encoded.

+    errors = [

+        for err in exc.errors()
+    ]
+    return JSONResponse(status_code=422, content={"detail": errors})

+        description="family: 'spouse' | 'family_member' | 'dependent'; roommates: 'peer'",
+    )
diff --git a/ai_service/nafaqah_service.py b/ai_service/nafaqah_service.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..4fb5505
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/nafaqah_service.py
@@ -0,0 +1,888 @@
+"""
+Islamic family Nafaqah ledger: the wife's reimbursement debt and her personal allowance.
+
+Owner decision on audit item UI-24 (family mode = married couple):
+
+1. Nafaqah is on the husband. Shared family/household expenses are his responsibility and are
+   never split between the spouses (no 50/50 or any percentage).
+2. The wife paying from her own money for something shared (household, children, dependents,
+   the husband) is a debt the husband owes her: ``wife_reimbursable``. Reimbursements reduce it,
+   partially or in full; paying back more than is outstanding is rejected.
+3. A personal purchase the wife makes for herself is not a debt: ``wife_personal`` is charged to
+   her personal allowance ("مصروفها") for the salary cycle (``cycle_key``). The husband or a
+   household admin sets the allowance; overspend is reported as a negative remainder, not blocked.
+4. The husband paying for shared things is an ordinary household expense (no class, no debt).
+
+Roommate households (and any household without a spouse member) never get a Nafaqah class.
+
+Money is handled as ``Decimal`` / integer halalas; floats only appear in API responses.
+Writes go through the SECURITY DEFINER RPCs of migration
+``20261020300000_nafaqah_wife_allowance_and_reimbursements.sql`` with the verified caller passed
+as ``p_actor_user_id``, so the database re-checks every rule (and serialises repayments).
+
+Roles are per household (migration ``20261020800000``, Fable review): who is the wife comes from
+``household_memberships.financial_role`` of THAT household (a wife who also joins a roommate flat
+stays the wife of her family), and the husband is the household's explicit Nafaqah provider
+(``households.nafaqah_provider_user_id``: the primary admin by default, changed by an admin), never
+inferred from user-level roles or admin rights.
+
+Household type (owner decision D1, migration ``20261020900000``): ``households.household_type`` is
+'family' or 'roommates', chosen at creation. Family features (Nafaqah classes, provider, ledger)
+apply only to a 'family' household that has a spouse member; a roommates household never gets them.
+Only the wife herself, the Nafaqah provider or a household admin may classify an expense (D2);
+the database enforces the same rule for client writes.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+import re
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation, ROUND_HALF_UP
+from typing import Any, Dict, Iterable, List, Optional
+
+from postgrest_compat import db_error_fields, first_row
+from supabase_client import get_client, get_household_payday
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+WIFE_REIMBURSABLE = "wife_reimbursable"
+WIFE_PERSONAL = "wife_personal"
+NAFAQAH_CLASSES = (WIFE_REIMBURSABLE, WIFE_PERSONAL)
+
+PAYMENT_METHODS = ("stc_pay", "urpay", "bank_transfer", "iban", "cash", "other")
+MAX_AMOUNT = Decimal("999999999999.99")
+_HALALA = Decimal("0.01")
+_CYCLE_KEY_RE = re.compile(r"^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$")
+
+_WIFE_ALIASES = ("wife", "spouse")
+_HUSBAND_ALIASES = ("husband", "provider")
+
+
+class NafaqahError(Exception):
+    """Base class for Nafaqah rule violations."""
+
+
+class NafaqahForbidden(NafaqahError):
+    """The caller may not perform this action in this household."""
+
+
+class NotFamilyHousehold(NafaqahError):
+    """The household has no spouse member: Nafaqah ledgers do not apply."""
+
+
+class InvalidNafaqahRequest(NafaqahError):
+    """Malformed amount, cycle key, payment method or a wife outside this household."""
+
+
+class LedgerWouldBeOverpaid(NafaqahError):
+    """An edit/delete of a wife_reimbursable advance would leave the advances below the repayments."""
+
+
+class NoProviderError(NafaqahError):
+    """The family household has no Nafaqah provider; an admin must choose one (HTTP 409)."""
+
+
+class NafaqahClassificationForbidden(NafaqahForbidden):
+    """D2: the recorder is not the wife, the Nafaqah provider or a household admin (HTTP 403)."""
+
+    code = "nafaqah_classification_forbidden"
+
+
+class OverpaymentError(NafaqahError):
+    """A reimbursement larger than the outstanding balance."""
+
+    def __init__(self, message: str, outstanding: Optional[float] = None):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.outstanding = outstanding
+
+
+# ─── Money ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def _decimal(value: Any) -> Decimal:
+    try:
+        dec = value if isinstance(value, Decimal) else Decimal(str(value if value is not None else 0))
+    except (InvalidOperation, ValueError) as exc:
+        raise InvalidNafaqahRequest(f"Invalid amount: {value!r}") from exc
+    if not dec.is_finite():
+        raise InvalidNafaqahRequest("Amount must be a finite number.")
+    return dec
+
+
+def to_halalas(value: Any) -> int:
+    """Stored SAR amount → integer halalas (half-up on the decimal value)."""
+    return int((_decimal(value) / _HALALA).quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
+
+
+def halalas_to_sar(halalas: int) -> float:
+    return float((Decimal(halalas) * _HALALA).quantize(_HALALA))
+
+
+def parse_sar_amount(value: Any, *, allow_zero: bool) -> Decimal:
+    """Validate a user-supplied SAR amount: finite, at most 2 decimals, within numeric(14,2)."""
+    dec = _decimal(value)
+    if dec != dec.quantize(_HALALA):
+        raise InvalidNafaqahRequest("Amount must have at most 2 decimal places.")
+    if dec < 0 or (dec == 0 and not allow_zero):
+        raise InvalidNafaqahRequest("Amount must be positive." if not allow_zero else "Amount cannot be negative.")
+    if dec > MAX_AMOUNT:
+        raise InvalidNafaqahRequest("Amount is too large.")
+    return dec.quantize(_HALALA)
+
+
+def compute_reimbursement_balance(advances: Iterable[Any], reimbursements: Iterable[Any]) -> Dict[str, float]:
+    """Gross wife advances vs. husband repayments, exact to the halala."""
+    gross = sum(to_halalas(a) for a in advances)
+    paid = sum(to_halalas(r) for r in reimbursements)
+    return {
+        "gross_advanced": halalas_to_sar(gross),
+        "reimbursed": halalas_to_sar(paid),
+        "outstanding": halalas_to_sar(max(gross - paid, 0)),
+        "overpaid": halalas_to_sar(max(paid - gross, 0)),
+    }
+
+
+def compute_allowance_status(allocated: Optional[Any], spent_amounts: Iterable[Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    """Allocated / spent / remaining; remaining goes negative on overspend (never blocked)."""
+    spent_list = [to_halalas(s) for s in spent_amounts]
+    allocated_h = to_halalas(allocated) if allocated is not None else 0
+    spent_h = sum(spent_list)
+    return {
+        "is_set": allocated is not None,
+        "allocated": halalas_to_sar(allocated_h),
+        "spent": halalas_to_sar(spent_h),
+        "remaining": halalas_to_sar(allocated_h - spent_h),
+        "transaction_count": len(spent_list),
+    }
+
+
+# ─── Classification ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def _norm(value: Any) -> str:
+    return str(value or "").strip().lower()
+
+
+def classify_nafaqah(
+    recorder_role: Optional[str],
+    paid_by: Optional[str],
+    beneficiary: Optional[str],
+    is_tabarru: bool = False,
+) -> Optional[str]:
+    """
+    Nafaqah class of an expense from the recorder's point of view.
+
+    ``paid_by`` / ``beneficiary`` use the app's relative vocabulary: 'me' is the recorder,
+    'partner' the other spouse, 'both'/'household'/'children' or a dependent's name are shared.
+    Only an expense the wife paid from her own money gets a class (rules 2 and 3); whatever the
+    husband pays, including things for his wife, is his Nafaqah and an ordinary expense (rule 4).
+    ``is_tabarru`` is the explicit opt-in for a voluntary gift by the wife: it is never assumed.
+    """
+    role = _norm(recorder_role)
+    pb, ben = _norm(paid_by), _norm(beneficiary)
+    if role == "wife":
+        wife_paid = pb in ("me",) + _WIFE_ALIASES
+        for_wife = ben in ("me",) + _WIFE_ALIASES
+    elif role == "husband":
+        wife_paid = pb in ("partner",) + _WIFE_ALIASES
+        for_wife = ben in ("partner",) + _WIFE_ALIASES
+    else:
+        return None
+    if not wife_paid:
+        return None
+    if for_wife:
+        return WIFE_PERSONAL
+    if is_tabarru:
+        return None
+    return WIFE_REIMBURSABLE
+
+
+# ─── Household context ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+FAMILY = "family"
+ROOMMATES = "roommates"
+HOUSEHOLD_TYPES = (FAMILY, ROOMMATES)
+
+
+def infer_household_type(financial_roles: Iterable[Any]) -> str:
+    """The migration's backfill rule, for rows read before the column exists: any peer -> roommates."""
+    return ROOMMATES if any(_norm(r) == "peer" for r in financial_roles) else FAMILY
+
+
+def normalize_household_type(value: Any, financial_roles: Iterable[Any] = ()) -> str:
+    """households.household_type as stored, or the backfill rule when it is missing/unknown."""
+    norm = _norm(value)
+    return norm if norm in HOUSEHOLD_TYPES else infer_household_type(financial_roles)
+
+
+@dataclass
+class FamilyContext:
+    household_id: str
+    members: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    # The husband: the explicit provider while the household is a family and he is still a
+    # non-spouse member; None otherwise (mirrors public.nafaqah_husband_id()).
+    husband_id: Optional[str] = None
+    wives: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
+    # households.nafaqah_provider_user_id as stored (also set in households without a wife).
+    provider_user_id: Optional[str] = None
+    primary_admin_id: Optional[str] = None
+    # households.household_type: 'family' | 'roommates' (decides the settlement mode).
+    household_type: str = FAMILY
+
+    @property
+    def is_roommates(self) -> bool:
+        return self.household_type == ROOMMATES
+
+    @property
+    def is_family(self) -> bool:
+        """A 'family' household WITH a wife: the Nafaqah rules apply (never in roommates)."""
+        return self.household_type == FAMILY and bool(self.wives)
+
+    @property
+    def settlement_mode(self) -> str:
+        """'multi_roommate' for a roommates household, else 'family_nafaqah' (spouses never split)."""
+        return "multi_roommate" if self.is_roommates else "family_nafaqah"
+
+    def can_classify(self, user_id: Optional[str]) -> bool:
+        """D2: the wife herself, the Nafaqah provider or a household admin may classify."""
+        if not self.is_member(user_id):
+            return False
+        uid = str(user_id)
+        return self.is_wife(uid) or uid == self.provider_user_id or self.is_admin(uid)
+
+    @property
+    def needs_provider(self) -> bool:
+        """A family without a (valid) provider: new classified expenses are refused until set."""
+        return self.is_family and not self.husband_id
+
+    def is_member(self, user_id: Optional[str]) -> bool:
+        return bool(user_id) and str(user_id) in self.members
+
+    def is_admin(self, user_id: Optional[str]) -> bool:
+        return self.is_member(user_id) and self.members[str(user_id)].get("role") == "admin"
+
+    def is_wife(self, user_id: Optional[str]) -> bool:
+        return bool(user_id) and any(w["id"] == str(user_id) for w in self.wives)
+
+    def role_of(self, user_id: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
+        """'wife' | 'husband' | 'member' for members of the household, else None."""
+        if not self.is_member(user_id):
+            return None
+        if self.is_wife(user_id):
+            return "wife"
+        if self.husband_id and str(user_id) == self.husband_id:
+            return "husband"
+        return "member"
+
+    def display_name(self, user_id: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
+        member = self.members.get(str(user_id or ""))
+        return member.get("display_name") if member else None
+
+
+def _household_roles_row(client, household_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    """owner_user_id (primary admin), nafaqah_provider_user_id and household_type of the household."""
+    row = first_row(
+        client.table("households")
+        .select("owner_user_id, nafaqah_provider_user_id, household_type")
+        .eq("id", household_id)
+    )
+    return row or {}
+
+
+def load_family_context(household_id: str) -> FamilyContext:
+    """
+    Members of the household (household_memberships is authoritative) with their financial role
+    IN THIS HOUSEHOLD (``household_memberships.financial_role``). The husband is the household's
+    explicit Nafaqah provider (``households.nafaqah_provider_user_id``), as long as the household
+    has a wife and he is a non-spouse member; admin rights or a user-level role never make anyone
+    the husband. ``household_type`` comes from ``households.household_type`` (the migration's
+    backfill rule when the row has none): a roommates household is never a family, whatever the
+    roles say. Errors propagate: callers must not guess "not a family".
+    """
+    client = get_client()
+    memberships = (
+        client.table("household_memberships")
+        .select("user_id, role, created_at, financial_role")
+        .eq("household_id", household_id)
+        .execute()
+    ).data or []
+    user_ids = [str(m["user_id"]) for m in memberships if m.get("user_id")]
+    users: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    if user_ids:
+        rows = (
+            client.table("users")
+            .select("id, display_name")
+            .in_("id", user_ids)
+            .execute()
+        ).data or []
+        users = {str(u["id"]): u for u in rows if u.get("id")}
+
+    ctx = FamilyContext(household_id=household_id)
+    for m in memberships:
+        uid = str(m.get("user_id") or "")
+        if not uid:
+            continue
+        user = users.get(uid, {})
+        ctx.members[uid] = {
+            "id": uid,
+            "role": m.get("role") or "member",
+            "created_at": str(m.get("created_at") or ""),
+            "display_name": user.get("display_name"),
+            # NOT NULL in the database; a missing value is never read as 'spouse' or 'provider'.
+            "financial_role": _norm(m.get("financial_role")) or "family_member",
+        }
+
+    roles = _household_roles_row(client, household_id)
+    ctx.household_type = normalize_household_type(
+        roles.get("household_type"), (m["financial_role"] for m in ctx.members.values())
+    )
+
+    ordered = sorted(ctx.members.values(), key=lambda m: (m["created_at"], m["id"]))
+    if ctx.household_type == FAMILY:
+        ctx.wives = [
+            {"id": m["id"], "display_name": m["display_name"]}
+            for m in ordered
+            if m["financial_role"] == "spouse"
+        ]
+
+    owner = str(roles.get("owner_user_id") or "") or None
+    provider = str(roles.get("nafaqah_provider_user_id") or "") or None
+    ctx.primary_admin_id = owner
+    ctx.provider_user_id = provider
+    if ctx.wives and provider and ctx.is_member(provider) and not ctx.is_wife(provider):
+        ctx.husband_id = provider
+    return ctx
+
+
+OVERRIDE_NONE = "none"
+NAFAQAH_OVERRIDE_CHOICES = NAFAQAH_CLASSES + (OVERRIDE_NONE,)
+
+
+def attribution_for_class(role: str, nafaqah_class: Optional[str], beneficiary: Optional[str]) -> tuple:
+    """
+    Recorder-relative (paid_by, beneficiary) that express a class chosen without an explicit
+    attribution, so the stored row never contradicts its class. ``nafaqah_class`` None means the
+    husband paid (rule 4).
+    """
+    wife_side, husband_side = ("me", "partner") if role == "wife" else ("partner", "me")
+    ben = beneficiary if _norm(beneficiary) else "both"
+    ben_is_wife = _norm(ben) in (wife_side,) + _WIFE_ALIASES
+    if nafaqah_class == WIFE_PERSONAL:
+        return wife_side, wife_side
+    if nafaqah_class == WIFE_REIMBURSABLE:
+        return wife_side, ("both" if ben_is_wife else ben)
+    return husband_side, ben
+
+
+def resolve_expense_nafaqah(
+    household_id: str,
+    user_id: Optional[str],
+    paid_by: str,
+    beneficiary: Optional[str],
+    *,
+    override_class: Optional[str] = None,
+    override_spouse_id: Any = None,
+    attribution_explicit: bool = False,
+    require_spouse: bool = False,
+) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    """
+    Nafaqah class (rules 2-4) of an expense entered by chat or a scanned receipt.
+
+    The class follows from who paid for whom (``classify_nafaqah``). ``override_class`` is the
+    user's confirmed choice ('wife_reimbursable' | 'wife_personal' | 'none' = the husband paid):
+    with an explicit ``paid_by``/``beneficiary`` it must agree with them (a stale class from an
+    earlier preview is rejected, never stored against the edited attribution); without one the
+    attribution is recomputed from the class. ``override_spouse_id`` names the wife in a
+    household with several wives (required on commit when the class needs her); a wife records
+    only for herself. Households without a spouse member (and roommates households) are never
+    classified. ``require_spouse`` marks a commit: then a failed household lookup raises instead
+    of degrading to "not a family".
+    D2: only the wife, the Nafaqah provider (husband) or a household admin may classify. An admin
+    who is neither spouse classifies only by an explicit ``override_class`` (no spouse-relative
+    vocabulary to derive it from); any other member choosing a class gets
+    NafaqahClassificationForbidden (HTTP 403, code ``nafaqah_classification_forbidden``).
+    Raises InvalidNafaqahRequest for an unknown or contradicting choice.
+    """
+    chosen = (_norm(override_class) or None) if override_class is not None else None
+    if chosen is not None and chosen not in NAFAQAH_OVERRIDE_CHOICES:
+        raise InvalidNafaqahRequest("nafaqah_class must be 'wife_reimbursable', 'wife_personal' or 'none'.")
+    if override_spouse_id is not None and not isinstance(override_spouse_id, str):
+        raise InvalidNafaqahRequest("nafaqah_spouse_id must be a member id.")
+    requested_spouse = _norm(override_spouse_id) or None
+
+    result: Dict[str, Any] = {
+        "household_mode": "not_family",
+        "recorder_role": None,
+        "nafaqah_class": None,
+        "nafaqah_spouse_id": None,
+        "nafaqah_spouse_required": False,
+        "wives": [],
+        "paid_by": paid_by,
+        "beneficiary": beneficiary,
+    }
+    try:
+        ctx = load_family_context(household_id)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        if require_spouse:
+            # A commit must not guess "not a family": the expense would be stored without its
+            # class and the wife's reimbursement debt silently lost (FR-B-07). Fail so the
+            # client keeps the entry queued and retries.
+            raise
+        logger.warning("Could not load family context for Nafaqah classification: %s", exc)
+        return result
+    if not ctx.is_family:
+        return result
+
+    role = ctx.role_of(user_id)
+    result.update({
+        "household_mode": "family_nafaqah",
+        "recorder_role": role,
+        "wives": [{"id": w["id"], "display_name": w["display_name"]} for w in ctx.wives],
+    })
+
+    if role in ("wife", "husband"):
+        if chosen is not None and not attribution_explicit:
+            paid_by, beneficiary = attribution_for_class(role, None if chosen == OVERRIDE_NONE else chosen, beneficiary)
+            result["paid_by"], result["beneficiary"] = paid_by, beneficiary
+        nafaqah_class = classify_nafaqah(role, paid_by, beneficiary)
+        if chosen is not None and (None if chosen == OVERRIDE_NONE else chosen) != nafaqah_class:
+            raise InvalidNafaqahRequest(
+                "nafaqah_class contradicts paid_by/beneficiary: a debt needs the wife to have paid for "
+                "something shared, the allowance a purchase she paid for herself, 'none' the husband paying."
+            )
+    elif chosen not in (None, OVERRIDE_NONE):
+        # D2: an admin may classify explicitly; any other member (e.g. an adult son) may not.
+        if not ctx.can_classify(user_id):
+            raise NafaqahClassificationForbidden(
+                "Only the wife, the Nafaqah provider or a household admin can classify a family expense."
+            )
+        nafaqah_class = chosen
+    else:
+        # Other members have no spouse-relative vocabulary to classify with.
+        nafaqah_class = None
+
+    spouse_id: Optional[str] = None
+    if role == "wife":
+        if requested_spouse and requested_spouse != str(user_id):
+            raise InvalidNafaqahRequest("A wife records Nafaqah expenses for herself only.")
+        spouse_id = str(user_id)
+    elif requested_spouse:
+        if not ctx.is_wife(requested_spouse):
+            raise InvalidNafaqahRequest("nafaqah_spouse_id is not a spouse member of this household.")
+        spouse_id = requested_spouse
+    elif len(ctx.wives) == 1:
+        spouse_id = ctx.wives[0]["id"]
+
+    if nafaqah_class and not spouse_id:
+        if require_spouse:
+            raise InvalidNafaqahRequest("This household has several wives: choose the wife (nafaqah_spouse_id).")
+        result["nafaqah_spouse_required"] = True
+    result["nafaqah_class"] = nafaqah_class
+    result["nafaqah_spouse_id"] = spouse_id if nafaqah_class else None
+    return result
+
+
+def resolve_wife_id(ctx: FamilyContext, requested: Optional[str]) -> str:
+    """The wife a request refers to: an explicit member id, an alias, or the only wife."""
+    req = _norm(requested)
+    if req and req not in _WIFE_ALIASES:
+        if not ctx.is_wife(req):
+            raise InvalidNafaqahRequest("wife_user_id is not a spouse member of this household.")
+        return req
+    if len(ctx.wives) == 1:
+        return ctx.wives[0]["id"]
+    raise InvalidNafaqahRequest("This household has several wives: pass wife_user_id.")
+
+
+def _require_family(ctx: FamilyContext) -> None:
+    if not ctx.is_family:
+        raise NotFamilyHousehold("Nafaqah ledgers apply to family households with a spouse member.")
+
+
+def _require_wife(ctx: FamilyContext, wife_id: str) -> None:
+    if not ctx.is_wife(wife_id):
+        raise InvalidNafaqahRequest("The member is not a spouse member of this household.")
+
+
+def _require_member(ctx: FamilyContext, actor_id: str) -> None:
+    if not ctx.is_member(actor_id):
+        raise NafaqahForbidden("Not a member of this household.")
+
+
+def can_set_allowance(ctx: FamilyContext, actor_id: str, wife_id: Optional[str] = None) -> bool:
+    """The husband or a household admin; never the wife herself."""
+    if not ctx.is_member(actor_id) or (wife_id and str(actor_id) == str(wife_id)):
+        return False
+    if wife_id is None and ctx.is_wife(actor_id):
+        return False
+    return str(actor_id) == ctx.husband_id or ctx.is_admin(actor_id)
+
+
+def can_record_reimbursement(ctx: FamilyContext, actor_id: str, wife_id: Optional[str] = None) -> bool:
+    """The husband, the wife concerned (confirming receipt) or a household admin."""
+    if not ctx.is_member(actor_id):
+        return False
+    if str(actor_id) == ctx.husband_id or ctx.is_admin(actor_id):
+        return True
+    return ctx.is_wife(actor_id) if wife_id is None else str(actor_id) == str(wife_id)
+
+
+# ─── Cycle ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def current_cycle_key(household_id: str) -> str:
+    """Current salary cycle (payday → day before next payday, Riyadh dates) of the household."""
+    from salary_cycle import get_cycle_for_date
+    from utils import riyadh_today
+
+    return get_cycle_for_date(riyadh_today(), payday_day=get_household_payday(household_id))["cycle_key"]
+
+
+def _resolve_cycle(ctx: FamilyContext, cycle_key: Optional[str]) -> str:
+    key = (cycle_key or "").strip() or current_cycle_key(ctx.household_id)
+    if not _CYCLE_KEY_RE.match(key):
+        raise InvalidNafaqahRequest(f"Invalid cycle_key {key!r}; expected YYYY-MM.")
+    return key
+
+
+# ─── Database error mapping ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+LEDGER_WOULD_BE_OVERPAID = "ledger_would_be_overpaid"
+
+
+def is_ledger_overpaid_error(exc: Exception) -> bool:
+    """The guard trigger of migration 20261020800000 refused a transaction edit/delete."""
+    fields = db_error_fields(exc)
+    return fields["hint"] == LEDGER_WOULD_BE_OVERPAID or (
+        fields["code"] == "22023" and "ledger overpaid" in fields["message"]
+    )
+
+
+def _map_db_error(exc: Exception) -> Exception:
+    """
+    Map a refusal of the Nafaqah RPCs to the service's errors. Every RAISE in migration
+    20261020300000 sets an SQLSTATE (42501 forbidden, 22023 invalid, 23514/23503 constraint) and
+    the overpayment refusal also sets HINT 'overpayment'; PostgREST returns them as the JSON
+    ``code`` / ``hint`` / ``message`` that postgrest-py's APIError exposes (read by
+    ``db_error_fields`` from whatever shape the exception arrives in).
+    """
+    fields = db_error_fields(exc)
+    message, code, hint = fields["message"], fields["code"], fields["hint"]
+    if hint == "overpayment" or "exceeds the outstanding balance" in message:
+        return OverpaymentError("Reimbursement exceeds the outstanding balance.")
+    if hint == LEDGER_WOULD_BE_OVERPAID or "ledger overpaid" in message:
+        return LedgerWouldBeOverpaid(
+            "This change would leave the wife's reimbursement ledger overpaid: the husband already repaid more."
+        )
+    if hint == "no_nafaqah_provider":
+        return NoProviderError("This family has no Nafaqah provider: a household admin must choose one.")
+    if hint == "provider_is_spouse":
+        return InvalidNafaqahRequest("A wife cannot be the Nafaqah provider.")
+    if hint == "nafaqah_class_not_allowed":
+        return NafaqahClassificationForbidden(
+            "Only the wife, the Nafaqah provider or a household admin can classify a family expense."
+        )
+    if hint == "not_family_household":
+        return NotFamilyHousehold("Nafaqah applies to family households only.")
+    if code == "P0002":
+        return InvalidNafaqahRequest("That user is not a member of this household.")
+    if code == "42501" or message.startswith("Forbidden"):
+        return NafaqahForbidden("Not allowed for this household member.")
+    if code in ("22023", "23514", "23503"):
+        return InvalidNafaqahRequest("The database rejected the request.")
+    return exc
+
+
+# ─── Reimbursement ledger (rule 2) ────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def get_reimbursement_ledger(ctx: FamilyContext, wife_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    """Outstanding balance plus the history of advances and repayments (newest first)."""
+    _require_family(ctx)
+    _require_wife(ctx, wife_id)
+    client = get_client()
+    advances = (
+        client.table("transactions")
+        .select("id, amount, merchant, category_code, timestamp, cycle_key")
+        .eq("household_id", ctx.household_id)
+        .eq("nafaqah_spouse_id", wife_id)
+        .eq("nafaqah_class", WIFE_REIMBURSABLE)
+        .execute()
+    ).data or []
+    repayments = (
+        client.table("spouse_reimbursements")
+        .select("id, amount, payment_method, notes, recorded_by, paid_by_user_id, created_at")
+        .eq("household_id", ctx.household_id)
+        .eq("wife_user_id", wife_id)
+        .execute()
+    ).data or []
+
+    history: List[Dict[str, Any]] = [
+        {
+            "type": "advance",
+            "id": a.get("id"),
+            "amount": halalas_to_sar(to_halalas(a.get("amount"))),
+            "merchant": a.get("merchant"),
+            "category_code": a.get("category_code"),
+            "cycle_key": a.get("cycle_key"),
+            "timestamp": a.get("timestamp"),
+        }
+        for a in advances
+    ] + [
+        {
+            "type": "reimbursement",
+            "id": r.get("id"),
+            "amount": halalas_to_sar(to_halalas(r.get("amount"))),
+            "payment_method": r.get("payment_method"),
+            "notes": r.get("notes"),
+            "recorded_by": r.get("recorded_by"),
+            "timestamp": r.get("created_at"),
+        }
+        for r in repayments
+    ]
+    history.sort(key=lambda h: str(h.get("timestamp") or ""), reverse=True)
+
+    return {
+        "household_id": ctx.household_id,
+        "wife_user_id": wife_id,
+        "husband_user_id": ctx.husband_id,
+        "balance": compute_reimbursement_balance(
+            [a.get("amount") for a in advances], [r.get("amount") for r in repayments]
+        ),
+        "history": history,
+    }
+
+
+def record_reimbursement(
+    ctx: FamilyContext,
+    actor_id: str,
+    wife_id: str,
+    amount: Any,
+    payment_method: str = "cash",
+    notes: Optional[str] = None,
+) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    """Record a (partial or full) repayment by the husband; overpayment is rejected."""
+    _require_family(ctx)
+    _require_member(ctx, actor_id)
+    if not can_record_reimbursement(ctx, actor_id):
+        raise NafaqahForbidden("Only the husband, the wife or a household admin can record a reimbursement.")
+    _require_wife(ctx, wife_id)
+    if not can_record_reimbursement(ctx, actor_id, wife_id):  # a wife records only her own
+        raise NafaqahForbidden("Only the husband, the wife or a household admin can record a reimbursement.")
+
+    value = parse_sar_amount(amount, allow_zero=False)
+    method = _norm(payment_method) or "cash"
+    if method not in PAYMENT_METHODS:
+        raise InvalidNafaqahRequest(f"Unsupported payment method {payment_method!r}.")
+    clean_notes = (notes or "").strip()[:500] or None
+
+    # Early, friendly rejection; the RPC re-checks under an advisory lock.
+    outstanding_h = to_halalas(get_reimbursement_ledger(ctx, wife_id)["balance"]["outstanding"])
+    amount_h = to_halalas(value)
+    if amount_h > outstanding_h:
+        raise OverpaymentError(
+            "Reimbursement exceeds the outstanding balance.", outstanding=halalas_to_sar(outstanding_h)
+        )
+
+    try:
+        res = get_client().rpc(
+            "record_spouse_reimbursement",
+            {
+                "p_household_id": ctx.household_id,
+                "p_wife_user_id": wife_id,
+                # Exact decimal text ("123.40"): PostgREST casts it to the numeric parameter.
+                "p_amount": format(value, "f"),
+                "p_payment_method": method,
+                "p_notes": clean_notes,
+                "p_actor_user_id": actor_id,
+            },
+        ).execute()
+    except Exception as exc:
+        mapped = _map_db_error(exc)
+        if mapped is exc:
+            raise
+        raise mapped from exc
+
+    data = res.data if isinstance(getattr(res, "data", None), dict) else {}
+    if "outstanding_after" in data and "outstanding_before" in data:
+        before_h, after_h = to_halalas(data["outstanding_before"]), to_halalas(data["outstanding_after"])
+    else:
+        before_h, after_h = outstanding_h, outstanding_h - amount_h
+    return {
+        "status": "success",
+        "reimbursement_id": data.get("reimbursement_id"),
+        "household_id": ctx.household_id,
+        "wife_user_id": wife_id,
+        "paid_by_user_id": ctx.husband_id,
+        "amount": halalas_to_sar(amount_h),
+        "payment_method": method,
+        "outstanding_before": halalas_to_sar(before_h),
+        "outstanding_after": halalas_to_sar(after_h),
+    }
+
+
+# ─── Personal allowance (rule 3) ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def get_allowance(ctx: FamilyContext, wife_id: str, cycle_key: Optional[str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    """Allocated / spent / remaining of the wife's personal allowance for a cycle."""
+    _require_family(ctx)
+    _require_wife(ctx, wife_id)
+    cycle = _resolve_cycle(ctx, cycle_key)
+    client = get_client()
+    # (household, member, cycle) is unique; limit(1) instead of maybe_single(), whose zero-row
+    # behaviour differs across postgrest-py versions (see postgrest_compat).
+    row = first_row(
+        client.table("member_allowances")
+        .select("amount")
+        .eq("household_id", ctx.household_id)
+        .eq("member_user_id", wife_id)
+        .eq("cycle_key", cycle)
+    )
+    allocated = row.get("amount") if row else None
+    spent = (
+        client.table("transactions")
+        .select("amount")
+        .eq("household_id", ctx.household_id)
+        .eq("nafaqah_spouse_id", wife_id)
+        .eq("nafaqah_class", WIFE_PERSONAL)
+        .eq("cycle_key", cycle)
+        .execute()
+    ).data or []
+    return {
+        "household_id": ctx.household_id,
+        "member_user_id": wife_id,
+        "cycle_key": cycle,
+        **compute_allowance_status(allocated, [t.get("amount") for t in spent]),
+    }
+
+
+def set_allowance(
+    ctx: FamilyContext, actor_id: str, wife_id: str, amount: Any, cycle_key: Optional[str]
+) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    """The husband (or a household admin other than the wife) sets the cycle allowance."""
+    _require_family(ctx)
+    _require_member(ctx, actor_id)
+    if not can_set_allowance(ctx, actor_id, wife_id):
+        raise NafaqahForbidden("The allowance is set by the husband or a household admin.")
+    _require_wife(ctx, wife_id)
+    value = parse_sar_amount(amount, allow_zero=True)
+    cycle = _resolve_cycle(ctx, cycle_key)
+
+    try:
+        res = get_client().rpc(
+            "set_member_allowance",
+            {
+                "p_household_id": ctx.household_id,
+                "p_member_user_id": wife_id,
+                # Exact decimal text ("123.40"): PostgREST casts it to the numeric parameter.
+                "p_amount": format(value, "f"),
+                "p_cycle_key": cycle,
+                "p_actor_user_id": actor_id,
+            },
+        ).execute()
+    except Exception as exc:
+        mapped = _map_db_error(exc)
+        if mapped is exc:
+            raise
+        raise mapped from exc
+
+    data = res.data if isinstance(getattr(res, "data", None), dict) else None
+    if data and "allocated" in data:
+        allocated_h, spent_h = to_halalas(data.get("allocated")), to_halalas(data.get("spent"))
+        return {
+            "household_id": ctx.household_id,
+            "member_user_id": wife_id,
+            "cycle_key": data.get("cycle_key") or cycle,
+            "is_set": bool(data.get("is_set", True)),
+            "allocated": halalas_to_sar(allocated_h),
+            "spent": halalas_to_sar(spent_h),
+            "remaining": halalas_to_sar(allocated_h - spent_h),
+            "transaction_count": int(data.get("transaction_count") or 0),
+        }
+    return get_allowance(ctx, wife_id, cycle)
+
+
+# ─── Summary for the app ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def build_summary(ctx: FamilyContext, caller_id: str, cycle_key: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    """Everything the family Nafaqah card needs, from the caller's point of view."""
+    role = ctx.role_of(caller_id)
+    provider_fields = {
+        "provider_user_id": ctx.provider_user_id,
+        "needs_provider": ctx.needs_provider,
+        "can_set_provider": ctx.is_admin(caller_id) and not ctx.is_roommates,
+    }
+    if not ctx.is_family:
+        return {
+            "household_id": ctx.household_id,
+            "household_type": ctx.household_type,
+            "mode": "not_family",
+            "caller_role": role,
+            "caller_user_id": caller_id,
+            "cycle_key": None,
+            "husband": None,
+            "wives": [],
+            "can_set_allowance": False,
+            "can_record_reimbursement": False,
+            **provider_fields,
+        }
+    cycle = _resolve_cycle(ctx, cycle_key)
+    wives = []
+    for wife in ctx.wives:
+        wives.append({
+            "id": wife["id"],
+            "display_name": wife["display_name"],
+            "reimbursement": get_reimbursement_ledger(ctx, wife["id"])["balance"],
+            "allowance": get_allowance(ctx, wife["id"], cycle),
+        })
+    return {
+        "household_id": ctx.household_id,
+        "household_type": ctx.household_type,
+        "mode": "family_nafaqah",
+        "caller_role": role,
+        "caller_user_id": caller_id,
+        "cycle_key": cycle,
+        "husband": (
+            {"id": ctx.husband_id, "display_name": ctx.display_name(ctx.husband_id)} if ctx.husband_id else None
+        ),
+        "wives": wives,
+        "can_set_allowance": can_set_allowance(ctx, caller_id),
+        "can_record_reimbursement": can_record_reimbursement(ctx, caller_id),
+        **provider_fields,
+    }
+
+
+# ─── Nafaqah provider (owner decision 2026-10-21) ─────────────────────────────
+
+def set_provider(ctx: FamilyContext, actor_id: str, provider_user_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    """
+    A household admin names the Nafaqah provider (husband): a non-spouse member of the household.
+    Goes through public.set_nafaqah_provider with the verified caller, so the database re-checks.
+    """
+    _require_member(ctx, actor_id)
+    if not ctx.is_admin(actor_id):
+        raise NafaqahForbidden("Only a household admin can choose the Nafaqah provider.")
+    if ctx.is_roommates:
+        raise NotFamilyHousehold("A roommates household has no Nafaqah provider.")
+    target = _norm(provider_user_id)
+    if not ctx.is_member(target):
+        raise InvalidNafaqahRequest("The provider must be a member of this household.")
+    if ctx.members[target].get("financial_role") == "spouse":
+        raise InvalidNafaqahRequest("A wife cannot be the Nafaqah provider.")
+
+    try:
+        res = get_client().rpc(
+            "set_nafaqah_provider",
+            {"p_household_id": ctx.household_id, "p_user_id": target, "p_actor_user_id": actor_id},
+        ).execute()
+    except Exception as exc:
+        mapped = _map_db_error(exc)
+        if mapped is exc:
+            raise
+        raise mapped from exc
+
+    data = res.data if isinstance(getattr(res, "data", None), dict) else {}
+    previous = data.get("previous_provider_user_id", ctx.provider_user_id)
+    return {
+        "status": "success",
+        "household_id": ctx.household_id,
+        "provider_user_id": target,
+        "previous_provider_user_id": str(previous) if previous else None,
+    }
