diff --git a/ai_service/tests/fable_world.py b/ai_service/tests/fable_world.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..438841a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/fable_world.py
@@ -0,0 +1,96 @@
+"""
+Helpers for the regression tests of the independent (Fable) review, docs/review/audit/fable_review.md.
+
+Requests carry real HS256 JWTs minted with the test secret (``test_fable_*`` modules are excluded
+from the conftest auth mock), so membership and admin checks run exactly as in production.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import base64
+import json
+import time
+import types
+import uuid
+from typing import Dict, Tuple
+
+from jose import jwt
+
+SUPABASE_URL = "https://mockproject.supabase.co"
+JWT_SECRET = "super-secret-test-jwt-key-32bytes-long!"
+
+
+def mint(sub: str, ttl: int = 3600, **overrides) -> str:
+    """GoTrue-shaped HS256 access token signed with the test secret."""
+    now = int(time.time())
+    claims = {
+        "sub": sub,
+        "aud": "authenticated",
+        "role": "authenticated",
+        "iss": f"{SUPABASE_URL}/auth/v1",
+        "iat": now,
+        "exp": now + ttl,
+        "email": f"{sub[:8]}@review.test",
+    }
+    claims.update(overrides)
+    return jwt.encode(claims, JWT_SECRET, algorithm="HS256")
+
+
+def bearer(sub: str, **kw) -> dict:
+    return {"Authorization": f"Bearer {mint(sub, **kw)}"}
+
+
+class World:
+    """One household with a configurable roster, seeded into the fake like the real tables."""
+
+    def __init__(self, fake, roles: Dict[str, Tuple[str, str]], payday: int = 27):
+        self.fake = fake
+        self.hid = str(uuid.uuid4())
+        self.users: Dict[str, str] = {}
+        memberships, users = [], []
+        owner = None
+        for i, (name, (role, fin_role)) in enumerate(roles.items()):
+            uid = str(uuid.uuid4())
+            self.users[name] = uid
+            if owner is None and role == "admin":
+                owner = uid
+            memberships.append({
+                "household_id": self.hid, "user_id": uid, "role": role,
+                # Financial role is per membership (FABLE-LOGIC-01); users.financial_role is only a cache.
+                "financial_role": fin_role,
+                "created_at": f"2026-01-0{i + 1}T00:00:00+00:00",
+            })
+            users.append({"id": uid, "display_name": name, "financial_role": fin_role, "household_id": self.hid,
+                          "role": role})
+        fake.seed("household_memberships", memberships)
+        fake.seed("users", users)
+        fake.seed("households", [{"id": self.hid, "payday_day": payday, "owner_user_id": owner,
+                                  "rollover_rule": "fresh_start"}])
+
+    def hdr(self, name: str) -> dict:
+        return bearer(self.users[name])
+
+
+def tlv(tag: int, value: str) -> bytes:
+    b = value.encode()
+    return bytes([tag, len(b)]) + b
+
+
+def zatca_qr(total: str = "300.00", seller: str = "Panda", vat: str = "39.13") -> str:
+    return base64.b64encode(
+        tlv(1, seller) + tlv(2, "300000000000003") + tlv(3, "2026-10-21T10:00:00Z") + tlv(4, total) + tlv(5, vat)
+    ).decode()
+
+
+def fake_llm(monkeypatch, payload: dict) -> None:
+    import litellm
+
+    def completion(*_a, **_k):
+        msg = types.SimpleNamespace(content=json.dumps(payload))
+        return types.SimpleNamespace(choices=[types.SimpleNamespace(message=msg)])
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(litellm, "completion", completion)
+
+
+PNG_1x1 = base64.b64decode(
+    "iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mNkYPhfDwAChwGA60e6kgAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=="
+)
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/fakes.py b/ai_service/tests/fakes.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..aaa2bbd
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/fakes.py
@@ -0,0 +1,318 @@
+"""
+In-memory fake of the supabase-py client used by the hermetic test suite.
+
+The real client talks to the network; tests must never do that (they previously
+reached whatever SUPABASE_URL a developer's .env pointed at, i.e. production).
+The fake implements just the PostgREST query-builder surface the service uses:
+select / eq / neq / in_ / gt / gte / lt / lte / is_ / contains / order / limit /
+single / maybe_single / insert / update / upsert / delete / execute, plus rpc()
+and storage.from_(bucket).upload().
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+
+from postgrest.exceptions import APIError
+import uuid
+from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional
+
+
+class FakeSchemaError(Exception):
+    """PostgREST's answer to an unknown column (PGRST204 on writes, 42703 on reads)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, message: str, code: str):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.message = message
+        self.code = code
+
+
+class FakeResponse:
+    def __init__(self, data: Any = None, count: Optional[int] = None):
+        self.data = data
+        self.count = count
+
+
+class FakeQuery:
+    def __init__(self, client: "FakeSupabaseClient", table: str):
+        self._client = client
+        self._table = table
+        self._op = "select"
+        self._payload: Any = None
+        self._filters: List[Callable[[dict], bool]] = []
+        self._order: Optional[tuple[str, bool]] = None
+        self._limit: Optional[int] = None
+        self._single = False
+        self._maybe_single = False
+        self._on_conflict: Optional[str] = None
+        self._columns: List[str] = []
+        self._filters_columns: List[str] = []
+
+    # ── verbs ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+    def select(self, *cols: str, **_kw: Any) -> "FakeQuery":
+        self._op = "select"
+        self._columns = [c.strip() for col in cols for c in str(col).split(",") if c.strip()]
+        return self
+
+    def insert(self, payload: Any, **_kw: Any) -> "FakeQuery":
+        self._op = "insert"
+        self._payload = payload
+        return self
+
+    def update(self, payload: dict, **_kw: Any) -> "FakeQuery":
+        self._op = "update"
+        self._payload = payload
+        return self
+
+    def upsert(self, payload: Any, on_conflict: Optional[str] = None, **_kw: Any) -> "FakeQuery":
+        self._op = "upsert"
+        self._payload = payload
+        self._on_conflict = on_conflict
+        return self
+
+    def delete(self, **_kw: Any) -> "FakeQuery":
+        self._op = "delete"
+        return self
+
+    # ── filters ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+    def eq(self, col: str, val: Any) -> "FakeQuery":
+        self._filters_columns.append(col)
+        self._filters.append(lambda r: r.get(col) == val)
+        return self
+
+    def neq(self, col: str, val: Any) -> "FakeQuery":
+        self._filters_columns.append(col)
+        self._filters.append(lambda r: r.get(col) != val)
+        return self
+
+    def in_(self, col: str, vals: list) -> "FakeQuery":
+        self._filters_columns.append(col)
+        allowed = list(vals)
+        self._filters.append(lambda r: r.get(col) in allowed)
+        return self
+
+    def gt(self, col: str, val: Any) -> "FakeQuery":
+        self._filters_columns.append(col)
+        self._filters.append(lambda r: r.get(col) is not None and r.get(col) > val)
+        return self
+
+    def gte(self, col: str, val: Any) -> "FakeQuery":
+        self._filters_columns.append(col)
+        self._filters.append(lambda r: r.get(col) is not None and r.get(col) >= val)
+        return self
+
+    def lt(self, col: str, val: Any) -> "FakeQuery":
+        self._filters_columns.append(col)
+        self._filters.append(lambda r: r.get(col) is not None and r.get(col) < val)
+        return self
+
+    def lte(self, col: str, val: Any) -> "FakeQuery":
+        self._filters_columns.append(col)
+        self._filters.append(lambda r: r.get(col) is not None and r.get(col) <= val)
+        return self
+
+    def is_(self, col: str, val: Any) -> "FakeQuery":
+        self._filters_columns.append(col)
+        target = None if val in (None, "null") else val
+        self._filters.append(lambda r: r.get(col) is target)
+        return self
+
+    def contains(self, col: str, vals: Any) -> "FakeQuery":
+        self._filters_columns.append(col)
+        self._filters.append(lambda r: all(v in (r.get(col) or []) for v in vals))
+        return self
+
+    def order(self, col: str, desc: bool = False, **_kw: Any) -> "FakeQuery":
+        self._order = (col, desc)
+        return self
+
+    def limit(self, n: int) -> "FakeQuery":
+        self._limit = n
+        return self
+
+    def single(self) -> "FakeQuery":
+        self._single = True
+        return self
+
+    def maybe_single(self) -> "FakeQuery":
+        self._maybe_single = True
+        return self
+
+    # ── execution ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+    def _matches(self, row: dict) -> bool:
+        return all(f(row) for f in self._filters)
+
+    def _check_schema(self) -> None:
+        """With ``client.schemas[table]`` set, unknown columns fail like they do on PostgREST."""
+        known = self._client.schemas.get(self._table)
+        if known is None:
+            return
+        if self._op == "select":
+            names = [c for c in self._columns if c != "*"]
+        elif self._op in ("insert", "upsert", "update"):
+            items = self._payload if isinstance(self._payload, list) else [self._payload]
+            names = [k for item in items for k in (item or {})]
+        else:
+            names = []
+        for col in self._filters_columns + names:
+            if col not in known:
+                code = "42703" if self._op == "select" else "PGRST204"
+                raise FakeSchemaError(f"column {self._table}.{col} does not exist", code)
+
+    def execute(self) -> FakeResponse:
+        self._check_schema()
+        rows = self._client.tables.setdefault(self._table, [])
+        if self._op == "insert":
+            items = self._payload if isinstance(self._payload, list) else [self._payload]
+            inserted = []
+            for item in items:
+                row = copy.deepcopy(item)
+                row.setdefault("id", str(uuid.uuid4()))
+                rows.append(row)
+                inserted.append(copy.deepcopy(row))
+            return FakeResponse(inserted)
+        if self._op == "upsert":
+            items = self._payload if isinstance(self._payload, list) else [self._payload]
+            keys = [k.strip() for k in (self._on_conflict or "id").split(",")]
+            out = []
+            for item in items:
+                existing = next((r for r in rows if all(r.get(k) == item.get(k) for k in keys)), None)
+                if existing is not None:
+                    existing.update(copy.deepcopy(item))
+                    out.append(copy.deepcopy(existing))
+                else:
+                    row = copy.deepcopy(item)
+                    row.setdefault("id", str(uuid.uuid4()))
+                    rows.append(row)
+                    out.append(copy.deepcopy(row))
+            return FakeResponse(out)
+        matched = [r for r in rows if self._matches(r)]
+        if self._op == "update":
+            for r in matched:
+                r.update(copy.deepcopy(self._payload))
+            return FakeResponse([copy.deepcopy(r) for r in matched])
+        if self._op == "delete":
+            self._client.tables[self._table] = [r for r in rows if not self._matches(r)]
+            return FakeResponse([copy.deepcopy(r) for r in matched])
+
+        result = [copy.deepcopy(r) for r in matched]
+        if self._table in self._client.schemas and self._columns and "*" not in self._columns:
+            # Strict tables also return only the selected columns, like PostgREST.
+            result = [{c: r.get(c) for c in self._columns} for r in result]
+        if self._order:
+            col, desc = self._order
+            result.sort(key=lambda r: (r.get(col) is None, r.get(col)), reverse=desc)
+        if self._limit is not None:
+            result = result[: self._limit]
+        if self._single:
+            if len(result) != 1:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"single() expected exactly one row from {self._table}, got {len(result)}")
+            return FakeResponse(result[0])
+        if self._maybe_single:
+            # postgrest-py (all versions this service supports) returns None, not a response,
+            # when maybe_single() matches zero rows; more than one row is an error.
+            if not result:
+                return None  # type: ignore[return-value]
+            if len(result) > 1:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"maybe_single() matched {len(result)} rows from {self._table}")
+            return FakeResponse(result[0])
+        return FakeResponse(result)
+
+
+class FakeRpc:
+    def __init__(self, client: "FakeSupabaseClient", name: str, params: dict):
+        self._client = client
+        self._name = name
+        self._params = params
+
+    def execute(self) -> FakeResponse:
+        self._client.rpc_calls.append((self._name, dict(self._params)))
+        handler = self._client.rpc_handlers.get(self._name)
+        if handler is None:
+            return FakeResponse(None)
+        return FakeResponse(handler(self._params))
+
+
+class FakeBucket:
+    def __init__(self, client: "FakeSupabaseClient", bucket: str):
+        self._client = client
+        self._bucket = bucket
+
+    def upload(self, path: str, data: bytes, file_options: Optional[dict] = None) -> dict:
+        self._client.storage_objects[(self._bucket, path)] = data
+        return {"Key": f"{self._bucket}/{path}"}
+
+
+class FakeStorage:
+    def __init__(self, client: "FakeSupabaseClient"):
+        self._client = client
+
+    def from_(self, bucket: str) -> FakeBucket:
+        return FakeBucket(self._client, bucket)
+
+
+class FakeSupabaseClient:
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.tables: Dict[str, List[dict]] = {}
+        self.rpc_handlers: Dict[str, Callable[[dict], Any]] = {
+            "consume_quota": lambda _p: True,
+            "pay_installment_plan": self._pay_installment_plan,
+            "recompute_budget_spent": self._recompute_budget_spent,
+        }
+        self.rpc_calls: List[tuple[str, dict]] = []
+        self.storage_objects: Dict[tuple[str, str], bytes] = {}
+        self.storage = FakeStorage(self)
+        # Optional {table: {column, ...}}: queries naming other columns raise FakeSchemaError.
+        self.schemas: Dict[str, set] = {}
+
+    def table(self, name: str) -> FakeQuery:
+        return FakeQuery(self, name)
+
+    def rpc(self, name: str, params: Optional[dict] = None) -> FakeRpc:
+        return FakeRpc(self, name, params or {})
+
+    def _pay_installment_plan(self, params: dict) -> List[dict]:
+        """Mirror of the SQL function (migration 20261020750000): one conditional increment."""
+        members = self.tables.get("household_memberships", [])
+        if not any(m.get("household_id") == params.get("p_household_id")
+                   and m.get("user_id") == params.get("p_actor_user_id") for m in members):
+            raise FakeSchemaError("Only a member of the household can record an installment payment", "42501")
+        for row in self.tables.get("installment_plans", []):
+            if row.get("id") == params.get("p_plan_id") and row.get("household_id") == params.get("p_household_id"):
+                status = str(row.get("status") or "ACTIVE").upper()
+                if status not in ("ACTIVE", "COMPLETED"):
+                    # 20261020900000: a non-ACTIVE plan takes no payments.
+                    raise APIError({"code": "22023", "hint": "plan_not_active", "details": None,
+                                    "message": f"This installment plan is {status} and takes no payments"})
+                if status == "ACTIVE" and int(row.get("paid_installments") or 0) < int(row.get("installment_count") or 0):
+                    row["paid_installments"] = int(row.get("paid_installments") or 0) + 1
+                    if row["paid_installments"] >= int(row["installment_count"]):
+                        row["status"] = "COMPLETED"
+                    # 20261021000000: next_due_at moves one interval (NULL once paid up).
+                    from installment_service import next_due_date
+                    row["next_due_at"] = next_due_date(row.get("start_date"), row.get("frequency") or "monthly",
+                                                       row["paid_installments"], int(row["installment_count"]),
+                                                       row["status"])
+                return [copy.deepcopy(row)]
+        return []
+
+    def _recompute_budget_spent(self, params: dict) -> int:
+        """Mirror of public.recompute_budget_spent (migration 20261020800000)."""
+        hid, keys = params.get("p_household_id"), set(params.get("p_cycle_keys") or [])
+        txs = self.tables.get("transactions", [])
+        n = 0
+        for b in self.tables.get("budgets", []):
+            if b.get("household_id") != hid or b.get("cycle_key") not in keys:
+                continue
+            total = sum(
+                float(t.get("amount") or 0) for t in txs
+                if t.get("household_id") == hid and t.get("category_code") == b.get("category_code")
+                and t.get("cycle_key") == b.get("cycle_key") and t.get("nafaqah_class") != "wife_personal"
+                and t.get("is_settlement") is not True
+            )
+            b["spent_amount"] = round(max(0.0, total), 2)
+            n += 1
+        return n
+
+    def seed(self, table: str, rows: List[dict]) -> None:
+        self.tables.setdefault(table, []).extend(copy.deepcopy(rows))
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/secret_scan.py b/ai_service/tests/secret_scan.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3140b2c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/secret_scan.py
@@ -0,0 +1,104 @@
+"""
+Working-tree secret scanner used by the security tests.
+
+Known-leaked credentials are stored ONLY as SHA-256 digests: the scanner extracts
+candidate tokens with generic patterns, hashes each one and compares the digest.
+Never paste a raw secret value into this file (the repository is public).
+
+Digest inventory (values were committed to git history and must stay rotated):
+- WEBHOOK_SECRET (64-hex)          f516a232df76...
+- legacy shared token (64-hex)      c3d7f5e65951...
+- APP_AUTH_TOKEN (bt_sec_ prefix)   34164266f633...
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import base64
+import hashlib
+import json
+import re
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Iterable, List
+
+LEAKED_SECRET_SHA256 = frozenset({
+    "f516a232df76f55242de350e7fb3c7206faebd3f61837940c8fd3f3e2010c501",
+    "c3d7f5e65951829de17a3059e324e8d7af141db025c14c38dc21b26939343571",
+    "34164266f6331cd78f94c36156999fc85bf5bd2dc96cb772d8833d88040314e5",
+})
+
+HEX64_RE = re.compile(r"(?<![0-9a-fA-F])[0-9a-fA-F]{64}(?![0-9a-fA-F])")
+BT_SEC_RE = re.compile(r"bt_sec_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}")
+SB_SECRET_RE = re.compile(r"sb_secret_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}")
+JWT_RE = re.compile(r"eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\.eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}")
+
+SCAN_EXTENSIONS = {
+    ".py", ".dart", ".ts", ".tsx", ".js", ".jsx", ".md", ".json", ".yaml", ".yml",
+    ".toml", ".sh", ".env", ".example", ".html", ".txt",
+}
+SKIP_DIRS = {"node_modules", "build", ".dart_tool", "__pycache__", ".pytest_cache", "dist", ".venv", "venv"}
+# Obvious test/placeholder values that are allowed to carry a real-looking prefix.
+PLACEHOLDER_MARKERS = ("mock", "test", "example", "dummy", "placeholder", "your")
+
+
+def sha256_hex(token: str) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(token.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _jwt_role(token: str) -> str | None:
+    try:
+        payload_b64 = token.split(".")[1]
+        payload_b64 += "=" * (-len(payload_b64) % 4)
+        payload = json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(payload_b64.encode("ascii")))
+        role = payload.get("role")
+        return str(role) if role is not None else None
+    except Exception:
+        return None
+
+
+def scan_text(text: str) -> List[str]:
+    """Return human-readable reasons (never the secret value) for every hit in text."""
+    reasons: List[str] = []
+    for pat, kind in ((HEX64_RE, "hex64"), (BT_SEC_RE, "bt_sec"), (SB_SECRET_RE, "sb_secret"), (JWT_RE, "jwt")):
+        for m in pat.finditer(text):
+            token = m.group(0)
+            digest = sha256_hex(token)
+            line = text.count("\n", 0, m.start()) + 1
+            if digest in LEAKED_SECRET_SHA256:
+                reasons.append(f"line {line}: known-leaked {kind} (sha256 {digest[:12]})")
+                continue
+            lowered = token.lower()
+            if kind == "bt_sec" and not any(mk in lowered for mk in PLACEHOLDER_MARKERS):
+                reasons.append(f"line {line}: hardcoded app token with bt_sec_ prefix (sha256 {digest[:12]})")
+            elif kind == "sb_secret" and not any(mk in lowered for mk in PLACEHOLDER_MARKERS):
+                reasons.append(f"line {line}: hardcoded Supabase secret key (sha256 {digest[:12]})")
+            elif kind == "jwt" and _jwt_role(token) == "service_role":
+                reasons.append(f"line {line}: hardcoded service_role JWT (sha256 {digest[:12]})")
+    return reasons
+
+
+def iter_files(roots: Iterable[Path]) -> Iterable[Path]:
+    for root in roots:
+        if root.is_file():
+            yield root
+            continue
+        if not root.exists():
+            continue
+        for path in root.rglob("*"):
+            if not path.is_file():
+                continue
+            if any(part in SKIP_DIRS for part in path.parts):
+                continue
+            if path.suffix in SCAN_EXTENSIONS or path.name.startswith(".env"):
+                yield path
+
+
+def scan_paths(roots: Iterable[Path], repo_root: Path) -> List[str]:
+    findings: List[str] = []
+    for path in iter_files(roots):
+        try:
+            text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
+        except OSError:
+            continue
+        for reason in scan_text(text):
+            findings.append(f"{path.relative_to(repo_root)} {reason}")
+    return findings
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_api_audit.py b/ai_service/tests/test_api_audit.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b73fd1f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_api_audit.py
@@ -0,0 +1,523 @@
+"""
+Regression tests for the 2026-10 ai_service security & logic audit (API-xx findings).
+
+This module is excluded from the conftest auth mock: requests carry real HS256
+Supabase-style JWTs verified by auth._decode_token, and household membership is
+resolved from the in-memory FakeSupabaseClient.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import time
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from jose import jwt
+
+from main import app
+
+TEST_SECRET = "super-secret-test-jwt-key-32bytes-long!"
+ISSUER = "https://mockproject.supabase.co/auth/v1"
+
+HH_A = "aaaaaaaa-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"
+HH_B = "bbbbbbbb-0000-4000-8000-000000000002"
+USER_A = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a1"
+USER_A_MEMBER = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a2"
+USER_B = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000b1"
+TX_B = "cccccccc-0000-4000-8000-0000000000b9"
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+
+
+def make_token(sub: str, **overrides) -> str:
+    now = int(time.time())
+    claims = {
+        "sub": sub,
+        "aud": "authenticated",
+        "iss": ISSUER,
+        "role": "authenticated",
+        "iat": now,
+        "exp": now + 3600,
+    }
+    claims.update(overrides)
+    claims = {k: v for k, v in claims.items() if v is not None}
+    return jwt.encode(claims, TEST_SECRET, algorithm="HS256")
+
+
+def bearer(sub: str) -> dict:
+    return {"Authorization": f"Bearer {make_token(sub)}"}
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def two_households(fake_supabase):
+    fake_supabase.seed("household_memberships", [
+        {"user_id": USER_A, "household_id": HH_A, "role": "admin"},
+        {"user_id": USER_A_MEMBER, "household_id": HH_A, "role": "member"},
+        {"user_id": USER_B, "household_id": HH_B, "role": "admin"},
+    ])
+    fake_supabase.seed("transactions", [
+        {"id": TX_B, "household_id": HH_B, "amount": 500.0, "merchant": "Jarir", "raw_sms": "manual", "items": []},
+    ])
+    return fake_supabase
+
+
+# ─── API-02: installment payment IDOR ────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def test_pay_installment_requires_authentication(two_households):
+    two_households.seed("installment_plans", [{
+        "id": "dddddddd-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", "household_id": HH_B, "merchant": "eXtra",
+        "provider": "Tamara", "total_amount": 400.0, "installment_count": 4, "monthly_amount": 100.0,
+        "paid_installments": 1, "day_of_month": 27, "start_date": "2026-10-01", "status": "ACTIVE",
+    }])
+    resp = client.post("/budgets/installments/dddddddd-0000-4000-8000-000000000001/pay")
+    assert resp.status_code == 401
+    assert two_households.tables["installment_plans"][0]["paid_installments"] == 1
+
+
+def test_pay_installment_of_foreign_household_is_forbidden(two_households):
+    two_households.seed("installment_plans", [{
+        "id": "dddddddd-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", "household_id": HH_B, "merchant": "eXtra",
+        "provider": "Tamara", "total_amount": 400.0, "installment_count": 4, "monthly_amount": 100.0,
+        "paid_installments": 1, "day_of_month": 27, "start_date": "2026-10-01", "status": "ACTIVE",
+    }])
+    resp = client.post("/budgets/installments/dddddddd-0000-4000-8000-000000000001/pay", headers=bearer(USER_A))
+    assert resp.status_code == 403
+    assert two_households.tables["installment_plans"][0]["paid_installments"] == 1
+
+    ok = client.post("/budgets/installments/dddddddd-0000-4000-8000-000000000001/pay", headers=bearer(USER_B))
+    assert ok.status_code == 200
+    assert ok.json()["paid_installments"] == 2
+
+
+# ─── API-03: global sub-category rename / read without auth ──────────────────
+
+def test_sub_category_routes_require_authentication(two_households):
+    assert client.get("/budgets/sub-categories", params={"parent_code": "OPEX-GROCERY"}).status_code == 401
+    resp = client.patch("/budgets/sub-categories", json={"parent_code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "sub_code": "meat", "name_en": "pwned"})
+    assert resp.status_code == 401
+
+
+def test_rename_of_shared_system_sub_category_is_forbidden(two_households):
+    two_households.seed("cost_control_codes", [
+        {"id": "c1", "code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "category": "Groceries", "keywords": [], "is_flexible": True, "household_id": None, "is_system": True},
+    ])
+    two_households.seed("cost_control_sub_categories", [
+        {"parent_code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "sub_code": "meat", "name_en": "Meat & Poultry", "name_ar": "اللحوم"},
+    ])
+    resp = client.patch(
+        "/budgets/sub-categories",
+        json={"parent_code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "sub_code": "meat", "name_en": "pwned"},
+        headers=bearer(USER_A),
+    )
+    assert resp.status_code == 403
+    assert two_households.tables["cost_control_sub_categories"][0]["name_en"] == "Meat & Poultry"
+
+
+def test_rename_of_own_custom_sub_category_by_admin_succeeds(two_households):
+    two_households.seed("cost_control_codes", [
+        {"id": "c2", "code": "CUSTOM-PETS", "category": "Pets", "keywords": [], "is_flexible": True, "household_id": HH_A, "is_system": False},
+    ])
+    two_households.seed("cost_control_sub_categories", [
+        {"parent_code": "CUSTOM-PETS", "sub_code": "food", "name_en": "Food", "name_ar": "Food"},
+    ])
+    member = client.patch(
+        "/budgets/sub-categories",
+        json={"parent_code": "CUSTOM-PETS", "sub_code": "food", "name_en": "Cat food"},
+        headers=bearer(USER_A_MEMBER),
+    )
+    assert member.status_code == 403
+    outsider = client.patch(
+        "/budgets/sub-categories",
+        json={"parent_code": "CUSTOM-PETS", "sub_code": "food", "name_en": "Cat food"},
+        headers=bearer(USER_B),
+    )
+    assert outsider.status_code == 403
+    admin = client.patch(
+        "/budgets/sub-categories",
+        json={"parent_code": "CUSTOM-PETS", "sub_code": "food", "name_en": "Cat food"},
+        headers=bearer(USER_A),
+    )
+    assert admin.status_code == 200
+    assert two_households.tables["cost_control_sub_categories"][0]["name_en"] == "Cat food"
+
+
+# ─── API-04: enrichment IDOR across households ───────────────────────────────
+
+def test_chat_enrichment_cannot_touch_foreign_transaction(two_households, monkeypatch):
+    from chat_parser import ParsedChatExpense, ChatLineItem, process_chat_transaction
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr("chat_parser.parse_chat_expense", lambda _msg: ParsedChatExpense(
+        merchant="Attacker", total_amount=1.0, items=[ChatLineItem(name="pwned", quantity=1, price=1.0)],
+    ))
+    res = process_chat_transaction(household_id=HH_A, message="x", user_id=USER_A, enrich_tx_id=TX_B)
+    assert res["status"] == "error"
+    assert two_households.tables["transactions"][0]["items"] == []
+
+
+def test_receipt_enrichment_cannot_touch_foreign_transaction(two_households, monkeypatch):
+    from receipt_scanner import process_receipt_scan
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr("receipt_scanner.parse_receipt_image", lambda *_a, **_k: {
+        "merchant": "Attacker", "total_amount": 10.0, "items": [{"name": "pwned", "quantity": 1, "price": 10.0}],
+    })
+    res = process_receipt_scan(household_id=HH_A, images_base64=["aGVsbG8="], user_id=USER_A,
+                               enrich_tx_id=TX_B, preview_only=True)
+    assert res["status"] == "error"
+    assert two_households.tables["transactions"][0]["items"] == []
+
+
+# ─── API-05: installment creation rewrites a foreign transaction ─────────────
+
+def test_installment_creation_cannot_adjust_foreign_transaction(two_households):
+    payload = {
+        "household_id": HH_A, "merchant": "eXtra", "provider": "Tamara", "total_amount": 400.0,
+        "installment_count": 4, "original_transaction_id": TX_B, "adjust_original_transaction": True,
+    }
+    resp = client.post("/budgets/installments", json=payload, headers=bearer(USER_A))
+    assert resp.status_code in (400, 403, 404)
+    assert two_households.tables["transactions"][0]["amount"] == 500.0
+
+
+def test_installment_creation_requires_household_and_auth(two_households):
+    payload = {"merchant": "eXtra", "total_amount": 400.0}
+    assert client.post("/budgets/installments", json=payload).status_code == 401
+    assert client.post("/budgets/installments", json=payload, headers=bearer(USER_A)).status_code in (400, 422)
+
+
+def test_installment_adjusts_own_transaction_and_recalculates(two_households):
+    tx_a = "cccccccc-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a9"
+    two_households.seed("transactions", [{"id": tx_a, "household_id": HH_A, "amount": 400.0, "raw_sms": "", "items": []}])
+    payload = {
+        "household_id": HH_A, "merchant": "eXtra", "provider": "Tamara", "total_amount": 400.0,
+        "installment_count": 4, "original_transaction_id": tx_a, "adjust_original_transaction": True,
+    }
+    resp = client.post("/budgets/installments", json=payload, headers=bearer(USER_A))
+    assert resp.status_code == 200
+    row = next(t for t in two_households.tables["transactions"] if t["id"] == tx_a)
+    assert row["amount"] == 100.0
+    assert "Financed via Tamara" in row["raw_sms"]
+
+
+# ─── API-06: cross-tenant category tampering ─────────────────────────────────
+
+def test_add_category_does_not_modify_shared_system_category(two_households):
+    two_households.seed("cost_control_codes", [
+        {"id": "c1", "code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "category": "Groceries", "keywords": ["panda"], "is_flexible": True, "household_id": None, "is_system": True},
+    ])
+    resp = client.post("/budgets/categories", headers=bearer(USER_A), json={
+        "household_id": HH_A, "code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "category": "pwned", "keywords": ["x"], "allocated_amount": 50.0,
+    })
+    assert resp.status_code == 200
+    system_row = two_households.tables["cost_control_codes"][0]
+    assert system_row["category"] == "Groceries" and system_row["keywords"] == ["panda"]
+
+
+def test_add_new_category_is_scoped_to_household(two_households):
+    resp = client.post("/budgets/categories", headers=bearer(USER_A), json={
+        "household_id": HH_A, "code": "CUSTOM-GYM", "category": "Gym", "allocated_amount": 50.0,
+    })
+    assert resp.status_code == 200
+    rows = [r for r in two_households.tables["cost_control_codes"] if r["code"] == "CUSTOM-GYM"]
+    assert len(rows) == 1 and rows[0]["household_id"] == HH_A
+
+
+def test_remove_sub_category_never_purges_shared_definition(two_households):
+    two_households.seed("cost_control_codes", [
+        {"id": "c1", "code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "category": "Groceries", "keywords": [], "is_flexible": True, "household_id": None, "is_system": True},
+    ])
+    two_households.seed("cost_control_sub_categories", [
+        {"parent_code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "sub_code": "meat", "name_en": "Meat", "name_ar": "Meat"},
+    ])
+    resp = client.delete("/budgets/sub-categories", headers=bearer(USER_A),
+                         params={"household_id": HH_A, "parent_code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "sub_code": "meat"})
+    assert resp.status_code == 200
+    assert len(two_households.tables["cost_control_sub_categories"]) == 1

+# ─── Route coverage: every non-public route rejects anonymous callers ────────
+
+PUBLIC_PATHS = {
+    "/", "/auth/confirm", "/auth/callback", "/health", "/docs", "/redoc", "/openapi.json",
+    "/docs/oauth2-redirect", "/hero_glacier.png", "/hero_glacier.jpg", "/favicon.svg",
+    "/hero-bg.webp", "/hero-bg.jpg", "/households/invites/{invite_code}",
+}
+
+
+def _fill_path(path: str) -> str:
+    return (path.replace("{household_id}", HH_A).replace("{plan_id}", "dddddddd-0000-4000-8000-000000000001")
+            .replace("{invite_code}", "ABCDEF0123456789").replace("{dependent_id}", USER_A)
+            .replace("{category_code}", "OPEX-GROCERY"))
+
+
+def test_every_non_public_route_rejects_anonymous_requests(two_households):
+    checked = 0
+    failures = []
+    for path, operations in app.openapi()["paths"].items():
+        if path in PUBLIC_PATHS:
+            continue
+        for method in operations:
+            url = _fill_path(path)
+            resp = client.request(method.upper(), url, params={"household_id": HH_A, "parent_code": "OPEX-GROCERY",
+                                                                "sub_code": "meat"}, json={"household_id": HH_A})
+            if resp.status_code not in (401, 403, 422):
+                failures.append(f"{method.upper()} {path} -> {resp.status_code}")
+            checked += 1
+    assert not failures, failures
+    assert checked > 30
+
+
+# ─── Client contract (Flutter): JWT-only auth, 401 semantics, idempotent replays ──
+
+TUNNEL = {"X-Forwarded-For": "198.51.100.23"}  # request arriving through the reverse proxy
+
+
+def test_verified_jwt_alone_passes_firewall_without_app_token(two_households):
+    resp = client.get("/budgets/installments", params={"household_id": HH_A}, headers={**TUNNEL, **bearer(USER_A)})
+    assert resp.status_code == 200
+
+
+def test_firewall_answers_401_for_missing_or_expired_jwt(two_households):
+    expired = make_token(USER_A, iat=int(time.time()) - 7200, exp=int(time.time()) - 3600)
+    for headers in (TUNNEL, {**TUNNEL, "Authorization": f"Bearer {expired}"}):
+        resp = client.get("/budgets/installments", params={"household_id": HH_A}, headers=headers)
+        assert resp.status_code == 401
+        assert resp.headers.get("WWW-Authenticate") == "Bearer"
+
+
+def _mock_chat(monkeypatch, fake):
+    from chat_parser import ParsedChatExpense
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr("chat_parser.parse_chat_expense", lambda _m: ParsedChatExpense(
+        merchant="Dunkin", total_amount=19.0, category_code="OPEX-DINING"))
+    monkeypatch.setattr("installment_service.InstallmentService.recalculate_budgets", lambda *a, **k: None)
+
+
+def test_chat_commit_needs_jwt_not_webhook_signature(two_households, monkeypatch):
+    import hashlib
+    import hmac
+    import json as _json
+    import os
+
+    _mock_chat(monkeypatch, two_households)
+    payload = {"message": "Dunkin 19", "household_id": HH_A, "allow_duplicate": True}
+    body = _json.dumps(payload).encode()
+    good_sig = "sha256=" + hmac.new(os.environ["WEBHOOK_SECRET"].encode(), body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
+
+    no_sig = client.post("/agent/chat-transaction", content=body,
+                         headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", **bearer(USER_A)})
+    assert no_sig.status_code == 200 and no_sig.json()["status"] == "success"
+    signed = client.post("/agent/chat-transaction", content=body,
+                         headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Signature": good_sig, **bearer(USER_A)})
+    assert signed.status_code == 200
+    # Installed builds sign with the pre-rotation WEBHOOK_SECRET: with a valid JWT a stale
+    # signature is logged and ignored, never rejected (the JWT is the authentication).
+    stale_sig = client.post("/agent/chat-transaction", content=body,
+                            headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Signature": "sha256=" + "0" * 64,
+                                     "Idempotency-Key": "stale-sig-0001", **bearer(USER_A)})
+    assert stale_sig.status_code == 200 and stale_sig.json()["status"] == "success"
+    sig_only = client.post("/agent/chat-transaction", content=body,
+                           headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Signature": good_sig})
+    assert sig_only.status_code == 401
+
+
+# ─── External review (Gemini) BLOCKER 2: X-Signature / X-App-Token roles ──────
+
+APP_TOKEN = {"X-App-Token": "test_token_for_ci_only"}  # tests/conftest.py APP_AUTH_TOKEN
+_ANY_PARAMS = {"household_id": HH_A, "parent_code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "sub_code": "meat"}
+
+
+def _sig(body: bytes) -> str:
+    import hashlib
+    import hmac
+    import os
+
+    return "sha256=" + hmac.new(os.environ["WEBHOOK_SECRET"].encode(), body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _router_operations():
+    for path, operations in app.openapi()["paths"].items():
+        if path in PUBLIC_PATHS - {"/households/invites/{invite_code}"}:
+            continue  # app-level pages/assets, not API routers
+        for method in operations:
+            yield method.upper(), path
+
+
+STALE = "sha256=" + "0" * 64
+
+
+def test_stale_signature_with_a_valid_jwt_is_never_rejected_on_any_api_route(two_households):
+    """Compatibility: WEBHOOK_SECRET was rotated, so every installed build sends a stale signature."""
+    failures = []
+    checked = 0
+    for method, path in _router_operations():
+        resp = client.request(method, _fill_path(path), params=_ANY_PARAMS, content=b'{"household_id": "%s"}' % HH_A.encode(),
+                              headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Signature": STALE, **bearer(USER_A)})
+        if resp.status_code == 401:
+            failures.append(f"{method} {path} -> {resp.status_code}")
+        checked += 1
+    assert not failures, failures
+    assert checked > 30
+
+
+def test_malformed_or_empty_signature_header_with_jwt_is_ignored(two_households):
+    for value in ("", "sha256=", "md5=abc", "garbage", STALE):
+        resp = client.get("/budgets/installments", params={"household_id": HH_A},
+                          headers={"X-Signature": value, **bearer(USER_A)})
+        assert resp.status_code == 200, value
+
+
+def test_invalid_signature_without_a_valid_jwt_is_rejected(two_households):
+    expired = make_token(USER_A, iat=int(time.time()) - 7200, exp=int(time.time()) - 3600)
+    for headers in ({}, {"Authorization": f"Bearer {expired}"}, {"Authorization": "Bearer not-a-jwt"}):
+        resp = client.get("/budgets/installments", params={"household_id": HH_A},
+                          headers={"X-Signature": STALE, **headers})
+        assert resp.status_code == 401
+
+
+def test_stale_signature_warning_is_rate_limited_and_leaks_nothing(two_households, caplog):
+    import hashlib
+    import logging
+    import os
+
+    import auth
+
+    auth._reset_stale_signature_log()
+    with caplog.at_level(logging.WARNING, logger="auth"):
+        for _ in range(3):
+            client.get("/budgets/installments", params={"household_id": HH_A},
+                       headers={"X-Signature": STALE, **bearer(USER_A)})
+        client.get("/budgets/installments", params={"household_id": HH_A},
+                   headers={"X-Signature": STALE, **bearer(USER_A_MEMBER)})
+    messages = [r.getMessage() for r in caplog.records if r.name == "auth" and "X-Signature" in r.getMessage()]
+    assert len(messages) == 2  # once per (route, user) per interval
+    ref_a = hashlib.sha256(USER_A.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
+    assert ref_a in messages[0] and "/budgets/installments" in messages[0]
+    for message in messages:
+        assert USER_A not in message and USER_A_MEMBER not in message
+        assert os.environ["WEBHOOK_SECRET"] not in message and STALE not in message
+
+
+def test_stale_signature_warning_repeats_after_the_interval(two_households, caplog, monkeypatch):
+    import logging
+
+    import auth
+
+    auth._reset_stale_signature_log()
+    clock = [5000.0]
+    monkeypatch.setattr(auth, "_monotonic", lambda: clock[0])
+    with caplog.at_level(logging.WARNING, logger="auth"):
+        client.get("/budgets/installments", params={"household_id": HH_A}, headers={"X-Signature": STALE, **bearer(USER_A)})
+        clock[0] += auth._STALE_SIGNATURE_LOG_INTERVAL_SECONDS + 1
+        client.get("/budgets/installments", params={"household_id": HH_A}, headers={"X-Signature": STALE, **bearer(USER_A)})
+    assert len([r for r in caplog.records if r.name == "auth" and "X-Signature" in r.getMessage()]) == 2
+
+
+def test_valid_signature_with_jwt_passes_and_body_reaches_the_route(two_households):
+    resp = client.get("/budgets/installments", params={"household_id": HH_A},
+                      headers={"X-Signature": _sig(b""), **bearer(USER_A)})
+    assert resp.status_code == 200
+
+
+def test_signed_request_in_production_without_webhook_secret_is_served_with_a_jwt(two_households, monkeypatch, caplog):
+    import logging
+
+    import auth
+
+    auth._reset_stale_signature_log()
+    monkeypatch.setenv("ENV", "production")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("WEBHOOK_SECRET", "")
+    with caplog.at_level(logging.WARNING, logger="auth"):
+        signed = client.get("/budgets/installments", params={"household_id": HH_A},
+                            headers={"X-Signature": STALE, **bearer(USER_A)})
+    assert signed.status_code == 200
+    assert any("WEBHOOK_SECRET is not set" in r.getMessage() for r in caplog.records if r.name == "auth")
+    without_jwt = client.get("/budgets/installments", params={"household_id": HH_A}, headers={"X-Signature": STALE})
+    assert without_jwt.status_code == 401
+    unsigned = client.get("/budgets/installments", params={"household_id": HH_A}, headers=bearer(USER_A))
+    assert unsigned.status_code == 200
+
+
+def test_server_to_server_signature_check_stays_strict(monkeypatch):
+    """utils.verify_signature is what a future JWT-less webhook route must use: no signature, no entry."""
+    from utils import verify_signature
+
+    body = b'{"event": "x"}'
+    assert verify_signature(body, _sig(body)) is True
+    assert verify_signature(body, None) is False
+    assert verify_signature(body, STALE) is False
+    assert verify_signature(body, "md5=" + _sig(body)[7:]) is False
+    monkeypatch.setenv("ENV", "production")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("WEBHOOK_SECRET", "")
+    assert verify_signature(body, _sig(body)) is False
+
+
+def test_valid_signature_without_jwt_never_reaches_user_data(two_households):
+    for method, path in _router_operations():
+        if path == "/households/invites/{invite_code}" or path == "/public/inquiries":
+            continue  # intentionally anonymous (rate limited, no household data)
+        body = b'{"household_id": "%s"}' % HH_A.encode()
+        resp = client.request(method, _fill_path(path), params=_ANY_PARAMS, content=body,
+                              headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Signature": _sig(body), **TUNNEL})
+        assert resp.status_code in (401, 403, 422), f"{method} {path} -> {resp.status_code}"
+
+
+def test_app_token_alone_never_grants_access_to_user_routes(two_households):
+    """X-App-Token passes the coarse firewall for old builds, but every route still needs a verified JWT."""
+    failures = []
+    for method, path in _router_operations():
+        if path == "/households/invites/{invite_code}" or path == "/public/inquiries":
+            continue
+        resp = client.request(method, _fill_path(path), params=_ANY_PARAMS, json={"household_id": HH_A},
+                              headers={**TUNNEL, **APP_TOKEN})
+        if resp.status_code not in (401, 403, 422):
+            failures.append(f"{method} {path} -> {resp.status_code}")
+    assert not failures, failures
+
+
+def test_app_token_with_invalid_or_expired_bearer_cannot_reach_user_data(two_households):
+    expired = make_token(USER_A, iat=int(time.time()) - 7200, exp=int(time.time()) - 3600)
+    forged = make_token(USER_A).rsplit(".", 1)[0] + ".forged-signature"
+    for token in (expired, forged, "not-a-jwt"):
+        headers = {**TUNNEL, **APP_TOKEN, "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}
+        resp = client.get("/budgets/installments", params={"household_id": HH_A}, headers=headers)
+        assert resp.status_code == 401
+        resp = client.get(f"/households/{HH_A}/members", headers=headers)
+        assert resp.status_code == 401
+
+
+def test_idempotency_key_dedupes_replayed_commit(two_households, monkeypatch):
+    _mock_chat(monkeypatch, two_households)
+    payload = {"message": "Dunkin 19", "household_id": HH_A, "allow_duplicate": True}
+    headers = {**bearer(USER_A), "Idempotency-Key": "replay-key-0001"}
+    first = client.post("/agent/chat-transaction", json=payload, headers=headers)
+    second = client.post("/agent/chat-transaction", json=payload, headers=headers)
+    assert first.status_code == second.status_code == 200
+    assert second.json()["transaction_id"] == first.json()["transaction_id"]
+    assert second.headers.get("Idempotent-Replayed") == "true"
+    chat_rows = [t for t in two_households.tables["transactions"] if t.get("source") == "chat"]
+    assert len(chat_rows) == 1
+
+    # Keys are scoped per user: another member reusing the string gets their own transaction.
+    other = client.post("/agent/chat-transaction", json=payload,
+                        headers={**bearer(USER_A_MEMBER), "Idempotency-Key": "replay-key-0001"})
+    assert other.json()["transaction_id"] != first.json()["transaction_id"]
+    assert client.post("/agent/chat-transaction", json=payload,
+                       headers={**bearer(USER_A), "Idempotency-Key": "bad key!"}).status_code == 400
+
+
+def test_client_occurred_at_becomes_transaction_timestamp(two_households, monkeypatch):
+    from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+
+    _mock_chat(monkeypatch, two_households)
+    occurred = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(days=2)).replace(microsecond=0)
+    payload = {"message": "Dunkin 19", "household_id": HH_A, "allow_duplicate": True,
+               "client_occurred_at": occurred.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")}
+    resp = client.post("/agent/chat-transaction", json=payload, headers=bearer(USER_A))
+    assert resp.status_code == 200
+    row = next(t for t in two_households.tables["transactions"] if t.get("source") == "chat")
+    assert datetime.fromisoformat(row["timestamp"]) == occurred
+
+    for bad in ((datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(hours=1)).isoformat(),
+                (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(days=400)).isoformat(), "yesterday"):
+        r = client.post("/agent/chat-transaction", json={**payload, "client_occurred_at": bad}, headers=bearer(USER_A))
+        assert r.status_code == 400

diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_budget_cycle_lookup.py b/ai_service/tests/test_budget_cycle_lookup.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..0de091b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_budget_cycle_lookup.py
@@ -0,0 +1,40 @@
+"""API-31: budget lookups for chat/receipt reallocation must use the salary cycle, not the calendar month."""
+
+from datetime import date
+
+from supabase_client import fetch_budget, fetch_flexible_budgets
+
+HH = "aaaaaaaa-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"
+
+
+def _budget(bid, cat, cycle_key, month, allocated, spent):
+    return {"id": bid, "household_id": HH, "category_code": cat, "cycle_key": cycle_key, "month": month,
+            "allocated_amount": allocated, "spent_amount": spent, "remaining_amount": allocated - spent}
+
+
+def test_fetch_budget_after_payday_returns_new_cycle_row(fake_supabase):
+    # Both rows carry month 2026-10-01 (ensure_household_cycle_budgets uses the date's month).
+    fake_supabase.seed("budgets", [
+        _budget("old", "OPEX-DINING", "2026-10", "2026-10-01", 500, 490),
+        _budget("new", "OPEX-DINING", "2026-11", "2026-10-01", 500, 0),
+    ])
+    assert fetch_budget(HH, "OPEX-DINING", date(2026, 10, 28)).id == "new"
+    assert fetch_budget(HH, "OPEX-DINING", date(2026, 10, 20)).id == "old"
+
+
+def test_fetch_budget_falls_back_to_month_for_rows_without_cycle_key(fake_supabase):
+    fake_supabase.seed("budgets", [_budget("legacy", "OPEX-FUEL", None, "2026-10-01", 300, 0)])
+    assert fetch_budget(HH, "OPEX-FUEL", date(2026, 10, 20)).id == "legacy"
+
+
+def test_flexible_budgets_are_taken_from_current_cycle(fake_supabase):
+    fake_supabase.seed("cost_control_codes", [
+        {"id": "c1", "code": "OPEX-SHOPPING", "category": "Shopping", "keywords": [], "is_flexible": True},
+        {"id": "c2", "code": "OPEX-DINING", "category": "Dining", "keywords": [], "is_flexible": True},
+    ])
+    fake_supabase.seed("budgets", [
+        _budget("shop-old", "OPEX-SHOPPING", "2026-10", "2026-10-01", 900, 0),
+        _budget("shop-new", "OPEX-SHOPPING", "2026-11", "2026-10-01", 200, 0),
+    ])
+    rows = fetch_flexible_budgets(HH, date(2026, 10, 28), exclude_code="OPEX-DINING")
+    assert [r.id for r in rows] == ["shop-new"]
