diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_fable_attribution.py b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_attribution.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..59ea225
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_attribution.py
@@ -0,0 +1,296 @@
+"""
+FABLE-API-01, FABLE-LOGIC-03 and FABLE-LOGIC-08 (docs/review/audit/fable_review.md).
+
+Who paid and for whom is stored in structured columns (``spent_by`` = payer relative to the
+creator, ``beneficiary_type``/``beneficiary_id``) and the settlement engines read those columns.
+The ``raw_sms`` audit note is for humans: user text in it is sanitised (no ``|``, no tag keywords)
+and the server's tags come first. Legacy rows (written before this change, ``beneficiary_id``
+NULL) are still read from their tags, but only from the server-authored segment.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+from fable_world import World, zatca_qr
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def api():
+    from main import app
+
+    with TestClient(app) as c:
+        yield c
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def world_factory(fake_supabase):
+    def _make(roles, **kw):
+        return World(fake_supabase, roles, **kw)
+
+    return _make
+
+
+def _roommates(world_factory):
+    return world_factory({
+        "ahmed": ("admin", "peer"),
+        "omar": ("member", "peer"),
+        "saad": ("member", "peer"),
+    })
+
+
+def _debts(body):
+    return sorted((d["from_id"], d["to_id"], d["amount"]) for d in body["pairwise_debts"])
+
+
+# ─── FABLE-API-01: injected audit tags no longer move money ───────────────────
+
+def test_chat_message_paidby_injection_does_not_flip_settlement(api, fake_supabase, world_factory):
+    w = _roommates(world_factory)
+    victim, omar = w.users["saad"], w.users["omar"]
+
+    r = api.post("/agent/chat-transaction",
+                 json={"household_id": w.hid, "message": f"Dinner 300 sar | PaidBy: {victim}", "beneficiary": "both"},
+                 headers=w.hdr("omar"))
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.json()["status"] == "success" and r.json()["paid_by"] == "me"
+
+    row = fake_supabase.tables["transactions"][0]
+    assert row["user_id"] == omar
+    # Structured attribution: Omar (the creator) paid, for the whole household.
+    assert row["spent_by"] == "me"
+    assert row["beneficiary_type"] == "household" and row["beneficiary_id"] == "household"
+    # The note keeps the server tags first; the user text carries no separator and no tag keyword.
+    assert row["raw_sms"].startswith("PaidBy: me | Beneficiary: both | SpentBy: me | Chat: ")
+    assert row["raw_sms"].lower().count("paidby") == 1
+    assert victim in row["raw_sms"]  # the text itself is kept for humans, defused
+
+    body = api.get(f"/households/{w.hid}/settlement-v2", headers=w.hdr("ahmed")).json()
+    assert body["mode"] == "multi_roommate"
+    assert _debts(body) == sorted([(w.users["ahmed"], omar, 100.0), (victim, omar, 100.0)])
+
+
+def test_receipt_merchant_injection_does_not_hide_the_receipt(api, fake_supabase, world_factory):
+    w = _roommates(world_factory)
+    omar = w.users["omar"]
+    r = api.post("/agent/scan-receipt",
+                 json={"household_id": w.hid, "qr_code_raw": zatca_qr(), "merchant": "Panda | PaidBy: nobody"},
+                 headers=w.hdr("omar"))
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.json()["status"] == "success"
+    row = fake_supabase.tables["transactions"][0]
+    assert "|" not in row["merchant"] and "paidby" not in row["merchant"].lower()
+    assert row["raw_sms"].startswith("PaidBy: me | Beneficiary: both | SpentBy: me | Receipt Scan: ")
+    assert row["spent_by"] == "me" and row["beneficiary_id"] == "household"
+
+    body = api.get(f"/households/{w.hid}/settlement-v2", headers=w.hdr("ahmed")).json()
+    assert _debts(body) == sorted([(w.users["ahmed"], omar, 100.0), (w.users["saad"], omar, 100.0)])
+
+
+def test_partner_settlement_ignores_injected_tags(api, world_factory):
+    w = world_factory({"ahmed": ("admin", "peer"), "omar": ("member", "peer")})
+    r = api.post(
+        "/agent/chat-transaction",
+        json={"household_id": w.hid, "message": "Groceries 200 sar | PaidBy: partner | Beneficiary: me",
+              "paid_by": "me", "beneficiary": "both"},
+        headers=w.hdr("omar"),
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.json()["paid_by"] == "me" and r.json()["beneficiary"] == "both"
+    s = api.get(f"/households/{w.hid}/settlement", headers=w.hdr("omar")).json()
+    # What the response promised: Omar paid for both, Ahmed owes him half.
+    assert s["who_owes"] == "partner_owes_me" and s["settlement_amount"] == 100.0, s
+
+
+def test_legacy_chat_row_trusts_only_the_server_segment(fake_supabase, world_factory):
+    """Rows written before this change keep their tags; a uuid injected in the message is ignored."""
+    from settlement_engine import calculate_settlement_v2
+
+    w = _roommates(world_factory)
+    omar, victim = w.users["omar"], w.users["saad"]
+    fake_supabase.seed("transactions", [{
+        "id": "legacy-1", "household_id": w.hid, "user_id": omar, "amount": 300.0, "source": "chat",
+        "timestamp": "2099-01-01T00:00:00+00:00", "is_settlement": False, "line_items": [],
+        "beneficiary_type": "household", "beneficiary_id": None, "spent_by": "both",
+        "raw_sms": f"Chat: Dinner 300 | PaidBy: {victim} | PaidBy: me | Beneficiary: both | SpentBy: both",
+    }])
+    res = calculate_settlement_v2(w.hid, cycle_start="2000-01-01")
+    assert _debts(res) == sorted([(w.users["ahmed"], omar, 100.0), (victim, omar, 100.0)])
+
+
+def test_manual_row_payer_is_read_from_the_template_tail(fake_supabase, world_factory):
+    """App-written manual rows keep the payer in the tail of their fixed template; a merchant
+    containing a forged tag cannot shadow it."""
+    from settlement_engine import calculate_settlement_v2
+
+    w = _roommates(world_factory)
+    omar, saad = w.users["omar"], w.users["saad"]
+    fake_supabase.seed("transactions", [
+        {   # Omar records that Saad paid the rent for everyone (a legitimate manual entry).
+            "id": "m1", "household_id": w.hid, "user_id": omar, "amount": 300.0, "source": "manual",
+            "timestamp": "2099-01-01T00:00:00+00:00", "is_settlement": False, "line_items": [],
+            "beneficiary_type": "all_peers", "beneficiary_id": "all_peers", "spent_by": "both",
+            "raw_sms": f"Manual: Rent | PaidBy: {saad} | Beneficiary: all_peers | SpentBy: both",
+        },
+        {   # Omar pays 90 for everyone; the merchant text forges Saad as payer.
+            "id": "m2", "household_id": w.hid, "user_id": omar, "amount": 90.0, "source": "manual",
+            "timestamp": "2099-01-01T00:00:00+00:00", "is_settlement": False, "line_items": [],
+            "beneficiary_type": "all_peers", "beneficiary_id": "all_peers", "spent_by": "both",
+            "raw_sms": f"Manual: Pizza | PaidBy: {saad} | PaidBy: {omar} | Beneficiary: all_peers | SpentBy: both",
+        },
+    ])
+    res = calculate_settlement_v2(w.hid, cycle_start="2000-01-01")
+    # Rent: Ahmed and Omar owe Saad 100 each. Pizza: Ahmed and Saad owe Omar 30 each.
+    # Net: Ahmed→Saad 100, Ahmed→Omar 30, Omar→Saad 70.
+    assert _debts(res) == sorted([
+        (w.users["ahmed"], saad, 100.0), (w.users["ahmed"], omar, 30.0), (omar, saad, 70.0),
+    ])
+
+
+# ─── FABLE-LOGIC-03: personal expenses are not split; the engines agree ──────
+
+def test_personal_chat_expense_is_not_split_among_roommates(api, fake_supabase, world_factory):
+    w = _roommates(world_factory)
+    # The LLM is unavailable: the heuristic reads "قهوتي" (my coffee) as a personal expense.
+    r = api.post("/agent/chat-transaction", json={"household_id": w.hid, "message": "قهوتي 15"},
+                 headers=w.hdr("omar"))
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.json()["beneficiary"] == "me"
+    row = fake_supabase.tables["transactions"][0]
+    assert row["beneficiary_type"] == "individual" and row["beneficiary_id"] == w.users["omar"]
+    body = api.get(f"/households/{w.hid}/settlement-v2", headers=w.hdr("ahmed")).json()
+    assert body["pairwise_debts"] == []
+
+
+def test_legacy_personal_row_is_not_split(fake_supabase, world_factory):
+    """Reviewer case: legacy row with 'Beneficiary: me' tags and default columns."""
+    from settlement_engine import calculate_settlement_v2
+
+    w = _roommates(world_factory)
+    fake_supabase.seed("transactions", [{
+        "id": "c1", "household_id": w.hid, "user_id": w.users["ahmed"], "amount": 15.0,
+        "timestamp": "2099-01-01T00:00:00+00:00", "is_settlement": False, "line_items": [],
+        "beneficiary_type": "household", "beneficiary_id": None, "spent_by": None,
+        "raw_sms": "Chat: قهوتي 15 | PaidBy: me | Beneficiary: me | SpentBy: me",
+    }])
+    assert calculate_settlement_v2(w.hid, cycle_start="2000-01-01")["pairwise_debts"] == []
+
+
+def test_settlement_and_settlement_v2_agree(api, world_factory, monkeypatch):
+    # The in-memory budgets table has no generated remaining_amount column; budgets are not under test.
+    monkeypatch.setattr("chat_parser.fetch_budget", lambda *_a, **_k: None)
+    w = world_factory({"ahmed": ("admin", "peer"), "omar": ("member", "peer")})
+    ahmed, omar = w.users["ahmed"], w.users["omar"]
+    entries = [
+        ("omar", {"message": "Dinner 300 sar", "paid_by": "me", "beneficiary": "both"}),
+        ("omar", {"message": "Coffee 15 sar", "paid_by": "me", "beneficiary": "me"}),
+        ("ahmed", {"message": "Shoes 120 sar", "paid_by": "me", "beneficiary": "partner"}),
+        ("ahmed", {"message": "Taxi 40 sar", "paid_by": "partner", "beneficiary": "both"}),
+        ("omar", {"message": "Books 60 sar", "paid_by": "me", "beneficiary": ahmed}),
+    ]
+    for who, body in entries:
+        r = api.post("/agent/chat-transaction", json={"household_id": w.hid, "allow_duplicate": True, **body},
+                     headers=w.hdr(who))
+        assert r.status_code == 200 and r.json()["status"] == "success", r.text
+
+    v2 = api.get(f"/households/{w.hid}/settlement-v2", headers=w.hdr("ahmed")).json()
+    s_omar = api.get(f"/households/{w.hid}/settlement", headers=w.hdr("omar")).json()
+    s_ahmed = api.get(f"/households/{w.hid}/settlement", headers=w.hdr("ahmed")).json()
+    # Dinner: Ahmed owes Omar 150. Shoes: Omar owes Ahmed 120. Taxi (Omar paid, for both): Ahmed owes
+    # Omar 20. Books for Ahmed: Ahmed owes Omar 60. Net: Ahmed owes Omar 110.
+    assert _debts(v2) == [(ahmed, omar, 110.0)]
+    assert s_omar["who_owes"] == "partner_owes_me" and s_omar["settlement_amount"] == 110.0
+    assert s_ahmed["who_owes"] == "me_owes_partner" and s_ahmed["settlement_amount"] == 110.0
+    assert s_omar["me_personal_total"] == 15.0
+
+
+def test_partner_beneficiary_is_refused_when_ambiguous(api, world_factory):
+    """'partner' names nobody in a three-roommate flat; an explicit choice is refused, not guessed."""
+    w = _roommates(world_factory)
+    r = api.post("/agent/chat-transaction",
+                 json={"household_id": w.hid, "message": "Lunch 30", "paid_by": "partner"},
+                 headers=w.hdr("omar"))
+    assert r.status_code == 422, r.text
+
+
+def test_family_breakdown_reads_structured_beneficiaries():
+    """Family summary: the husband's own purchase is not a child's, a dependent's is."""
+    from settlement_engine import calculate_family_nafaqah
+
+    txs = [
+        {"paid_by": "h", "amount": 50.0, "beneficiary_type": "individual", "beneficiary_id": "h"},
+        {"paid_by": "h", "amount": 30.0, "beneficiary_type": "dependent", "beneficiary_id": "children"},
+        {"paid_by": "h", "amount": 20.0, "beneficiary_type": "individual", "beneficiary_id": "w"},
+        {"paid_by": "h", "amount": 10.0, "beneficiary_type": "household", "beneficiary_id": "household"},
+    ]
+    res = calculate_family_nafaqah(txs, husband_id="h", wife_id="w")
+    assert (res["family_general_total"], res["spent_on_children"], res["spent_on_wife"]) == (60.0, 30.0, 20.0)
+
+
+# ─── FABLE-LOGIC-08: un-itemised receipt remainder is attributed ──────────────
+
+def test_pairwise_line_items_attribute_vat_pro_rata():
+    from settlement_engine import calculate_roommate_pairwise_debts
+
+    txs = [{"paid_by": "a", "amount": 115.00, "is_settlement": False,
+            "line_items": [{"amount": 100.00, "beneficiary": "all_peers"}]}]
+    assert calculate_roommate_pairwise_debts(txs, ["a", "b"]) == [{"from_id": "b", "to_id": "a", "amount": 57.5}]
+
+
+def test_pairwise_line_items_remainder_follows_item_beneficiaries():
+    from settlement_engine import calculate_roommate_pairwise_debts
+
+    # 120 receipt: 60 for b only, 40 shared by all three; 20 VAT/service split 60:40 → 12 to b, 8 shared.
+    txs = [{"paid_by": "a", "amount": 120.00, "is_settlement": False, "line_items": [
+        {"amount": 60.00, "beneficiary": "b"}, {"amount": 40.00, "beneficiary": "all_peers"}]}]
+    debts = {(d["from_id"], d["to_id"]): d["amount"] for d in calculate_roommate_pairwise_debts(txs, ["a", "b", "c"])}
+    assert debts == {("b", "a"): 88.0, ("c", "a"): 16.0}
+    assert round(sum(debts.values()) + 16.0, 2) == 120.0  # a's own third of the shared 48
+
+
+def test_pairwise_line_items_discount_reduces_shares():
+    from settlement_engine import calculate_roommate_pairwise_debts
+
+    txs = [{"paid_by": "a", "amount": 90.00, "is_settlement": False,
+            "line_items": [{"amount": 100.00, "beneficiary": "all_peers"}]}]
+    assert calculate_roommate_pairwise_debts(txs, ["a", "b"]) == [{"from_id": "b", "to_id": "a", "amount": 45.0}]
+
+
+# ─── sanitiser ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("raw,expected", [
+    ("Dinner 300 | PaidBy: abc", "Dinner 300 / abc"),
+    ("x | Beneficiary:me|SpentBy : both", "x / me/both"),
+    ("Paid By: z", "z"),
+    ("PaiPaidBy:dBy: q", "q"),
+    ("line\nbreak\tand items: [1]", "line break and [1]"),
+])
+def test_sanitize_audit_text(raw, expected):
+    from utils import sanitize_audit_text
+
+    assert sanitize_audit_text(raw) == expected
+
+
+def test_settlement_v2_mode_follows_the_stored_household_type(api, fake_supabase, world_factory):
+    """FABLE2-LOGIC-02 / owner decision D1: a flat whose members joined with the static code
+    (financial_role 'family_member', no 'peer' yet) is still settled as roommates when the
+    household is stored as type 'roommates'."""
+    w = world_factory({
+        "ahmed": ("admin", "family_member"),
+        "omar": ("member", "family_member"),
+        "saad": ("member", "family_member"),
+    })
+    fake_supabase.tables["households"][0]["household_type"] = "roommates"
+    r = api.post("/agent/chat-transaction",
+                 json={"household_id": w.hid, "message": "Rent 3000 sar", "beneficiary": "both"},
+                 headers=w.hdr("omar"))
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+
+    body = api.get(f"/households/{w.hid}/settlement-v2", headers=w.hdr("ahmed")).json()
+    assert body["mode"] == "multi_roommate"
+    omar = w.users["omar"]
+    assert _debts(body) == sorted([(w.users["ahmed"], omar, 1000.0), (w.users["saad"], omar, 1000.0)])
+
+    fake_supabase.tables["households"][0]["household_type"] = "family"
+    body = api.get(f"/households/{w.hid}/settlement-v2", headers=w.hdr("ahmed")).json()
+    assert body["mode"] == "family_nafaqah" and body["pairwise_debts"] == []
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_fable_auth_fail_closed.py b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_auth_fail_closed.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..717b47e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_auth_fail_closed.py
@@ -0,0 +1,40 @@
+"""
+Observation in docs/review/audit/fable_review.md section C: auth._get_user_membership fell back to
+the legacy users.household_id column when the household_memberships query itself errored, i.e. an
+infrastructure error widened access. It now fails closed: no membership, no access.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+from fable_world import World
+
+
+def _break_memberships(fake, monkeypatch):
+    real_table = fake.table
+
+    def table(name):
+        if name == "household_memberships":
+            raise RuntimeError("memberships query failed (simulated outage)")
+        return real_table(name)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(fake, "table", table)
+
+
+def test_membership_query_error_denies_instead_of_falling_back(fake_supabase, monkeypatch):
+    import auth
+
+    w = World(fake_supabase, {"ahmed": ("admin", "peer")})  # users.household_id == w.hid
+    assert auth._get_user_membership(w.users["ahmed"], w.hid)["role"] == "admin"
+    _break_memberships(fake_supabase, monkeypatch)
+    assert auth._get_user_membership(w.users["ahmed"], w.hid) is None
+
+
+def test_route_is_refused_during_the_outage(fake_supabase, monkeypatch):
+    from main import app
+
+    w = World(fake_supabase, {"ahmed": ("admin", "peer")})
+    _break_memberships(fake_supabase, monkeypatch)
+    with TestClient(app) as api:
+        r = api.get("/budgets/installments", params={"household_id": w.hid}, headers=w.hdr("ahmed"))
+    assert r.status_code == 403, r.text
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_fable_classifier.py b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_classifier.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..89f4f5c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_classifier.py
@@ -0,0 +1,74 @@
+"""
+FABLE-LOGIC-07 (docs/review/audit/fable_review.md): the heuristic chat parser (used when the LLM is
+unavailable) misread common Saudi phrasing; 7 of the reviewer's 15 phrases got the wrong Nafaqah
+class. The table below is the reviewer's, verbatim: (recorder role, text, expected class).
+
+Expected None means no automatic class: the husband paid, or (a gift for someone outside the
+household) the parser cannot tell and the preview asks the user (``paid_by`` 'unknown',
+``attribution_needs_confirmation``). Pronoun suffixes (لها، له، لي...) are never child names.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pytest
+
+from chat_parser import _fallback_heuristic_parse
+from nafaqah_service import classify_nafaqah
+
+PHRASES = [
+    ("wife", "دفعت مقاضي البيت من بنده بـ 300 ريال", "wife_reimbursable"),
+    ("wife", "شريت عباية لنفسي بـ 400 من نون", "wife_personal"),
+    ("wife", "حاسب زوجي العشاء في البيك بـ 90", None),
+    ("wife", "paid by my husband 200 for groceries", None),
+    ("wife", "my husband paid 200 for groceries", None),
+    ("wife", "شريت هدية لأمي بـ 150", None),
+    ("wife", "دفعت فاتورة الكهرباء 450 ريال", "wife_reimbursable"),
+    ("wife", "I paid 120 for the kids' school books", "wife_reimbursable"),
+    ("wife", "bought milk and bread 35 SAR", "wife_reimbursable"),
+    ("husband", "شريت فستان زوجتي بـ 300 ريال", None),
+    ("husband", "زوجتي دفعت المقاضي 250 ريال", "wife_reimbursable"),
+    ("husband", "my wife paid 250 for groceries", "wife_reimbursable"),
+    ("husband", "wife paid 80 for her perfume", "wife_personal"),
+    ("husband", "دفعتها زوجتي عطر لها بـ 80", "wife_personal"),
+    ("husband", "دفعت 60 بنزين", None),
+]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("role,text,expected", PHRASES)
+def test_reviewer_phrase_table(role, text, expected):
+    parsed = _fallback_heuristic_parse(text)
+    assert classify_nafaqah(role, parsed.paid_by, parsed.beneficiary) == expected, (
+        parsed.paid_by, parsed.beneficiary)
+    assert parsed.total_amount > 0
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("text", ["دفعتها زوجتي عطر لها بـ 80", "شريت له ساعة بـ 500", "اشتريت لي قهوة 15"])
+def test_pronoun_suffixes_are_not_child_names(text):
+    parsed = _fallback_heuristic_parse(text)
+    assert parsed.beneficiary not in ("ها", "ه", "ي", "هم", "نا", "ك")
+
+
+def test_named_child_is_still_detected():
+    assert _fallback_heuristic_parse("شريت حليب لسارة بـ 20").beneficiary == "سارة"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("text,ask", [
+    ("شريت هدية لأمي بـ 150", True),       # gift outside the household: undetermined
+    ("عشاء 90", True),                      # no cue about payer or beneficiary
+    ("دفعت مقاضي البيت 300", False),        # explicit payer and beneficiary
+    ("my wife paid 250 for groceries", False),
+])
+def test_undetermined_attribution_asks(text, ask):
+    assert _fallback_heuristic_parse(text).attribution_needs_confirmation is ask
+
+
+def test_preview_asks_and_suggests_no_class_for_an_undetermined_family_expense(fake_supabase):
+    """The chat preview returns the flag and no Nafaqah suggestion when the parser cannot tell."""
+    from fable_world import World
+    from chat_parser import process_chat_transaction
+
+    w = World(fake_supabase, {"husband": ("admin", "provider"), "wife": ("member", "spouse")})
+    res = process_chat_transaction(household_id=w.hid, message="شريت هدية لأمي بـ 150",
+                                   user_id=w.users["wife"], preview_only=True)
+    assert res["status"] == "pending_confirmation"
+    assert res["attribution_needs_confirmation"] is True
+    assert res["nafaqah_class"] is None
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_fable_client_ip_limits.py b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_client_ip_limits.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a43956f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_client_ip_limits.py
@@ -0,0 +1,126 @@
+"""
+FABLE-API-03 (docs/review/audit/fable_review.md): behind Railway's proxy (an address that is not in
+TRUSTED_PROXY_IPS) every visitor shared one per-IP bucket, so 5 inquiries/hour or 20 invite
+inspections/minute locked out the whole site.
+
+Now: the forwarded header is trusted when configured (TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS=1) or detected (Railway
+sets RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT), taking the client hop Railway's edge appends (right-most, or
+TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS from the right); a per-IP limit only applies to an address that really is the
+client's; and the limits are keyed per identity (e-mail, verified user) under a generous global
+ceiling.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import types
+import uuid
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+from fable_world import bearer
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def api(monkeypatch):
+    for var in ("TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS", "TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS", "RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT", "RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT_NAME"):
+        monkeypatch.delenv(var, raising=False)
+    from main import app
+
+    with TestClient(app) as c:
+        yield c
+
+
+def _req(peer, xff=None):
+    headers = {"X-Forwarded-For": xff} if xff else {}
+    return types.SimpleNamespace(client=types.SimpleNamespace(host=peer), headers=headers)
+
+
+def _inquiry(api, email, xff):
+    return api.post("/public/inquiries", json={"type": "vip_early_access", "email": email, "source": "web"},
+                    headers={"X-Forwarded-For": xff})
+
+
+# ─── client IP resolution ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def test_untrusted_peer_ignores_forwarded_header(monkeypatch):
+    from utils import client_ip_info
+
+    monkeypatch.delenv("TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS", raising=False)
+    monkeypatch.delenv("RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT", raising=False)
+    assert client_ip_info(_req("10.1.2.3", "203.0.113.9")) == ("10.1.2.3", False)  # private proxy hop
+    assert client_ip_info(_req("8.8.4.4", "203.0.113.9")) == ("8.8.4.4", True)  # direct client
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("env", [{"TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS": "1"}, {"RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT": "production"}])
+def test_railway_edge_hop_is_the_client(monkeypatch, env):
+    from utils import client_ip_info
+
+    monkeypatch.delenv("TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS", raising=False)
+    monkeypatch.delenv("RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT", raising=False)
+    for k, v in env.items():
+        monkeypatch.setenv(k, v)
+    # The client forged "1.1.1.1"; Railway's edge appended the real address on the right.
+    assert client_ip_info(_req("10.0.0.7", "1.1.1.1, 203.0.113.9")) == ("203.0.113.9", True)
+    assert client_ip_info(_req("10.0.0.7", "not-an-ip")) == ("10.0.0.7", False)
+
+
+def test_trust_can_be_disabled_on_railway_and_hops_configured(monkeypatch):
+    from utils import client_ip_info
+
+    monkeypatch.setenv("RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT", "production")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS", "0")
+    assert client_ip_info(_req("10.0.0.7", "203.0.113.9"))[1] is False
+    monkeypatch.setenv("TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS", "1")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS", "2")  # e.g. a CDN in front of Railway
+    assert client_ip_info(_req("10.0.0.7", "1.1.1.1, 203.0.113.9, 198.51.100.1")) == ("203.0.113.9", True)
+
+
+# ─── public inquiries ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def test_reviewer_case_one_proxy_address_no_longer_locks_everyone_out(api):
+    for i in range(5):
+        assert _inquiry(api, f"user{i}@example.com", f"203.0.113.{i + 1}").status_code == 503  # no mail provider
+    # A sixth, unrelated visitor is not locked out by the others.
+    assert _inquiry(api, "someone-else@example.org", "198.51.100.77").status_code == 503
+
+
+def test_per_email_limit_still_applies(api):
+    for i in range(3):
+        assert _inquiry(api, "same@example.com", f"203.0.113.{i + 1}").status_code == 503
+    r = _inquiry(api, "same@example.com", "203.0.113.50")
+    assert r.status_code == 429 and r.headers.get("Retry-After")
+
+
+def test_per_ip_limit_applies_to_real_client_addresses(api, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS", "1")
+    for i in range(5):
+        assert _inquiry(api, f"u{i}@example.com", "203.0.113.20").status_code == 503
+    assert _inquiry(api, "u9@example.com", "203.0.113.20").status_code == 429
+    # Another client behind the same proxy is unaffected.
+    assert _inquiry(api, "v1@example.com", "203.0.113.21").status_code == 503
+
+
+def test_global_ceiling_caps_the_mailbox(api, monkeypatch):
+    import routes.inquiries as inquiries
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(inquiries, "GLOBAL_LIMIT", 4)
+    for i in range(4):
+        assert _inquiry(api, f"g{i}@example.com", f"203.0.113.{i + 1}").status_code == 503
+    assert _inquiry(api, "g9@example.com", "203.0.113.99").status_code == 429
+
+
+# ─── invite inspection ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def test_invite_inspection_is_limited_per_user_not_per_proxy(api):
+    for i in range(20):
+        r = api.get("/households/invites/ABCDEF0123456789",
+                    headers={"X-Forwarded-For": f"203.0.113.{i + 1}", **bearer(str(uuid.uuid4()))})
+        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    # A 21st signed-in user behind the same proxy is still served ...
+    me = str(uuid.uuid4())
+    r = api.get("/households/invites/ABCDEF0123456789", headers={"X-Forwarded-For": "198.51.100.77", **bearer(me)})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    # ... while one user hammering the endpoint is limited.
+    for _ in range(19):
+        api.get("/households/invites/ABCDEF0123456789", headers=bearer(me))
+    assert api.get("/households/invites/ABCDEF0123456789", headers=bearer(me)).status_code == 429
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_fable_field_limits.py b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_field_limits.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..41cc88c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_field_limits.py
@@ -0,0 +1,92 @@
+"""
+FABLE-API-06 (docs/review/audit/fable_review.md): free-text overrides were stored verbatim with no
+length limit (up to ~24 MiB per row). Now merchant <= 120, sub_category / beneficiary / paid_by
+<= 60 characters (422 otherwise), and qr_code_raw (<= 4096) is persisted only when it decodes as a
+ZATCA TLV code.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import base64
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+from fable_world import PNG_1x1, World, fake_llm, zatca_qr
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def api():
+    from main import app
+
+    with TestClient(app) as c:
+        yield c
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def w(fake_supabase):
+    return World(fake_supabase, {"ahmed": ("admin", "peer"), "omar": ("member", "peer")})
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("field,size", [("merchant", 121), ("beneficiary", 61), ("sub_category", 61),
+                                        ("merchant", 400_000), ("paid_by", 61), ("category_code", 101)])
+def test_chat_overrides_are_bounded(api, fake_supabase, w, field, size):
+    r = api.post("/agent/chat-transaction",
+                 json={"household_id": w.hid, "message": "Coffee 16 sar", field: "M" * size}, headers=w.hdr("omar"))
+    assert r.status_code == 422, r.text[:300]
+    assert not fake_supabase.tables.get("transactions")
+
+
+def test_chat_overrides_must_be_text(api, w):
+    r = api.post("/agent/chat-transaction",
+                 json={"household_id": w.hid, "message": "Coffee 16 sar", "merchant": {"a": 1}}, headers=w.hdr("omar"))
+    assert r.status_code == 422
+
+
+def test_chat_overrides_at_the_limit_are_stored(api, fake_supabase, w):
+    r = api.post("/agent/chat-transaction",
+                 json={"household_id": w.hid, "message": "Coffee 16 sar", "merchant": "M" * 120,
+                       "beneficiary": "B" * 60}, headers=w.hdr("omar"))
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    row = fake_supabase.tables["transactions"][0]
+    assert len(row["merchant"]) == 120 and len(row["beneficiary_id"]) == 60
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("body", [{"merchant": "X" * 121}, {"qr_code_raw": "Q" * 4097}, {"beneficiary": "B" * 61},
+                                  {"paid_by": "P" * 61}])
+def test_receipt_overrides_are_bounded(api, fake_supabase, w, monkeypatch, body):
+    fake_llm(monkeypatch, {"merchant": "Tamimi", "total_amount": 55.5, "category_code": "OPEX-GROCERY",
+                           "items": [{"name": "milk", "quantity": 1, "price": 55.5}]})
+    r = api.post("/agent/scan-receipt",
+                 json={"household_id": w.hid, "images_base64": [base64.b64encode(PNG_1x1).decode()], **body},
+                 headers=w.hdr("omar"))
+    assert r.status_code == 422, r.text[:300]
+    assert not fake_supabase.tables.get("transactions")
+
+
+def test_receipt_qr_code_raw_is_kept_only_when_it_decodes(api, fake_supabase, w, monkeypatch):
+    # The in-memory budgets table has no generated remaining_amount column; budgets are not under test.
+    monkeypatch.setattr("receipt_scanner.fetch_budget", lambda *_a, **_k: None)
+    fake_llm(monkeypatch, {"merchant": "Tamimi", "total_amount": 55.5, "category_code": "OPEX-GROCERY",
+                           "items": [{"name": "milk", "quantity": 1, "price": 55.5}]})
+    image = base64.b64encode(PNG_1x1).decode()
+    r = api.post("/agent/scan-receipt",
+                 json={"household_id": w.hid, "images_base64": [image], "qr_code_raw": "Q" * 4000},
+                 headers=w.hdr("omar"))
+    assert r.status_code == 200 and r.json()["status"] == "success", r.text
+    assert r.json()["qr_code_raw"] is None
+    assert fake_supabase.tables["transactions"][0].get("qr_code_raw") is None
+
+    good = zatca_qr("55.50", seller="Tamimi", vat="7.24")
+    r = api.post("/agent/scan-receipt",
+                 json={"household_id": w.hid, "images_base64": [image], "qr_code_raw": good, "allow_duplicate": True},
+                 headers=w.hdr("omar"))
+    assert r.status_code == 200 and r.json()["status"] == "success", r.text
+    assert fake_supabase.tables["transactions"][-1]["qr_code_raw"] == good
+
+
+def test_model_text_is_bounded_too(monkeypatch):
+    """LLM output is not trusted either: the parsed beneficiary/sub-category are cut to 60."""
+    from chat_parser import ParsedChatExpense
+
+    parsed = ParsedChatExpense(merchant="x", total_amount=1, beneficiary="B" * 500, sub_category="S" * 500)
+    assert len(parsed.beneficiary) == 60 and len(parsed.sub_category) == 60
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_fable_household_type.py b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_household_type.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..d38dd20
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_household_type.py
@@ -0,0 +1,294 @@
+"""
+Household type, members' financial roles and who may classify (owner decisions D1/D2,
+FABLE2-DB-07; migration 20261020900000).
+
+D1: ``households.household_type`` ('family' | 'roommates') is exposed on the members list, an admin
+switches it (PUT /households/{id}/type) and sets members' financial roles within it
+(PUT /households/{id}/members/{user_id}/financial-role); role invites must fit the type; family
+features (provider, Nafaqah classes) never apply to a roommates household.
+D2: only the wife, the Nafaqah provider or a household admin classifies a chat/receipt expense.
+
+Requests carry real HS256 JWTs (the ``test_fable_`` prefix keeps the conftest auth mock away);
+membership is resolved from the in-memory FakeSupabaseClient.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import time
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from jose import jwt
+
+import nafaqah_service as ns
+from main import app
+from routes.nafaqah import nafaqah_http_error
+
+TEST_SECRET = "super-secret-test-jwt-key-32bytes-long!"
+ISSUER = "https://mockproject.supabase.co/auth/v1"
+
+FAMILY = "bbbb0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"
+FLAT = "bbbb0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002"
+LEGACY_FLAT = "bbbb0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003"
+HUSBAND = "0000bbbb-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a"
+WIFE = "0000bbbb-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b"
+SON = "0000bbbb-0000-4000-8000-00000000000c"
+COADMIN = "0000bbbb-0000-4000-8000-00000000000d"
+MATE1 = "0000bbbb-0000-4000-8000-0000000000f1"
+MATE2 = "0000bbbb-0000-4000-8000-0000000000f2"
+OUTSIDER = "0000bbbb-0000-4000-8000-0000000000e1"
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+
+
+def bearer(sub: str) -> dict:
+    now = int(time.time())
+    claims = {"sub": sub, "aud": "authenticated", "iss": ISSUER, "role": "authenticated", "iat": now, "exp": now + 3600}
+    return {"Authorization": f"Bearer {jwt.encode(claims, TEST_SECRET, algorithm='HS256')}"}
+
+
+def _m(user_id, household_id, role, financial_role, day):
+    return {"user_id": user_id, "household_id": household_id, "role": role, "financial_role": financial_role,
+            "created_at": f"2026-01-0{day}T00:00:00+00:00"}
+
+
+class FakeApiError(Exception):
+    def __init__(self, message: str, code: str, hint: str = ""):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.message, self.code, self.hint = message, code, hint
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def world(fake_supabase):
+    fake_supabase.seed("users", [
+        {"id": HUSBAND, "household_id": FAMILY, "role": "admin", "financial_role": "provider", "display_name": "Ahmed"},
+        {"id": WIFE, "household_id": FAMILY, "role": "member", "financial_role": "spouse", "display_name": "Sara"},
+        {"id": SON, "household_id": FAMILY, "role": "member", "financial_role": "family_member", "display_name": "Fahad"},
+        {"id": COADMIN, "household_id": FAMILY, "role": "admin", "financial_role": "family_member", "display_name": "Nora"},
+        {"id": MATE1, "household_id": FLAT, "role": "admin", "financial_role": "peer", "display_name": "Ali"},
+        {"id": MATE2, "household_id": FLAT, "role": "member", "financial_role": "peer", "display_name": "Saad"},
+        {"id": OUTSIDER, "household_id": None, "role": "member", "financial_role": "provider", "display_name": "Omar"},
+    ])
+    fake_supabase.seed("household_memberships", [
+        _m(HUSBAND, FAMILY, "admin", "provider", 1),
+        _m(WIFE, FAMILY, "member", "spouse", 2),
+        _m(SON, FAMILY, "member", "family_member", 3),
+        _m(COADMIN, FAMILY, "admin", "family_member", 4),
+        _m(MATE1, FLAT, "admin", "peer", 1),
+        _m(MATE2, FLAT, "member", "peer", 2),
+        _m(MATE1, LEGACY_FLAT, "admin", "peer", 1),
+    ])
+    fake_supabase.seed("households", [
+        {"id": FAMILY, "payday_day": 27, "owner_user_id": HUSBAND, "nafaqah_provider_user_id": HUSBAND,
+         "household_type": "family"},
+        {"id": FLAT, "payday_day": 27, "owner_user_id": MATE1, "nafaqah_provider_user_id": None,
+         "household_type": "roommates"},
+        # A row read before the column exists: the migration's backfill rule (any peer -> roommates).
+        {"id": LEGACY_FLAT, "payday_day": 27, "owner_user_id": MATE1, "nafaqah_provider_user_id": None},
+    ])
+
+    def set_type(params):
+        for h in fake_supabase.tables["households"]:
+            if h["id"] == params["p_household_id"]:
+                previous = h.get("household_type")
+                h["household_type"] = params["p_household_type"]
+                return {"success": True, "household_id": h["id"], "household_type": params["p_household_type"],
+                        "previous_household_type": previous, "changed": previous != params["p_household_type"]}
+        raise AssertionError("unknown household")
+
+    def set_role(params):
+        for m in fake_supabase.tables["household_memberships"]:
+            if m["household_id"] == params["p_household_id"] and m["user_id"] == params["p_user_id"]:
+                previous = m["financial_role"]
+                m["financial_role"] = params["p_financial_role"]
+                return {"success": True, "household_id": m["household_id"], "user_id": m["user_id"],
+                        "financial_role": params["p_financial_role"], "previous_financial_role": previous}
+        raise FakeApiError("Target user is not a member of this household", "P0002")
+
+    fake_supabase.rpc_handlers["set_household_type"] = set_type
+    fake_supabase.rpc_handlers["set_member_financial_role"] = set_role
+    return fake_supabase
+
+
+# ─── D1: the type on the members list and in the family context ──────────────
+
+def test_members_list_exposes_the_household_type(world):
+    family = client.get(f"/households/{FAMILY}/members", headers=bearer(SON)).json()
+    assert family["household_type"] == "family"
+    assert family["can_change_household_type"] is False and family["can_set_financial_roles"] is False
+    flat = client.get(f"/households/{FLAT}/members", headers=bearer(MATE1)).json()
+    assert flat["household_type"] == "roommates" and flat["can_change_household_type"] is True
+    assert flat["assignable_financial_roles"] == ["peer"]
+    assert flat["can_set_nafaqah_provider"] is False  # no provider in a roommates household
+    legacy = client.get(f"/households/{LEGACY_FLAT}/members", headers=bearer(MATE1)).json()
+    assert legacy["household_type"] == "roommates"
+
+
+def test_family_context_reads_the_type(world):
+    family = ns.load_family_context(FAMILY)
+    assert family.household_type == "family" and family.is_family and family.settlement_mode == "family_nafaqah"
+    flat = ns.load_family_context(FLAT)
+    assert flat.household_type == "roommates" and flat.is_roommates and not flat.is_family
+    assert flat.settlement_mode == "multi_roommate"
+    assert ns.load_family_context(LEGACY_FLAT).household_type == "roommates"
+
+
+def test_roommates_household_is_never_a_family_even_with_a_spouse_row(world):
+    # An inconsistent row (the database forbids it) must not turn the flat into a family.
+    world.tables["household_memberships"].append(_m(OUTSIDER, FLAT, "member", "spouse", 5))
+    ctx = ns.load_family_context(FLAT)
+    assert not ctx.is_family and ctx.wives == [] and ctx.husband_id is None
+    assert ns.resolve_expense_nafaqah(FLAT, MATE1, "partner", "both")["household_mode"] == "not_family"
+
+
+def test_family_without_a_wife_is_not_a_nafaqah_family(world):
+    world.tables["household_memberships"] = [
+        m for m in world.tables["household_memberships"] if not (m["household_id"] == FAMILY and m["user_id"] == WIFE)
+    ]
+    ctx = ns.load_family_context(FAMILY)
+    assert ctx.household_type == "family" and not ctx.is_family and ctx.settlement_mode == "family_nafaqah"
+
+
+def test_nafaqah_summary_carries_the_type(world):
+    body = client.get(f"/households/{FLAT}/nafaqah", headers=bearer(MATE2)).json()
+    assert body["household_type"] == "roommates" and body["mode"] == "not_family"
+    assert body["can_set_provider"] is False
+
+
+def test_provider_cannot_be_set_in_a_roommates_household(world):
+    res = client.put(f"/households/{FLAT}/nafaqah/provider", headers=bearer(MATE1), json={"user_id": MATE2})
+    assert res.status_code == 409 and res.json()["detail"]["code"] == "not_family"
+    assert not any(name == "set_nafaqah_provider" for name, _ in world.rpc_calls)
+
+
+# ─── D1: PUT /households/{id}/type ──────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def test_admin_switches_the_type(world):
+    res = client.put(f"/households/{FLAT}/type", headers=bearer(MATE1), json={"household_type": "family"})
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    assert res.json() == {"status": "success", "household_id": FLAT, "household_type": "family"}
+    assert world.rpc_calls[-1] == (
+        "set_household_type", {"p_household_id": FLAT, "p_household_type": "family", "p_actor_user_id": MATE1}
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("actor", [MATE2, OUTSIDER])
+def test_type_change_needs_an_admin_of_the_household(world, actor):
+    res = client.put(f"/households/{FLAT}/type", headers=bearer(actor), json={"household_type": "family"})
+    assert res.status_code == 403
+    assert not any(name == "set_household_type" for name, _ in world.rpc_calls)
+
+
+def test_type_value_is_validated(world):
+    res = client.put(f"/households/{FLAT}/type", headers=bearer(MATE1), json={"household_type": "hostel"})
+    assert res.status_code == 422
+
+
+def test_blocked_type_change_is_409_with_a_code(world):
+    def refuse(_params):
+        raise FakeApiError("A family household with a wife or Nafaqah records cannot become a roommates household",
+                           "22023", "type_change_blocked")
+
+    world.rpc_handlers["set_household_type"] = refuse
+    res = client.put(f"/households/{FAMILY}/type", headers=bearer(HUSBAND), json={"household_type": "roommates"})
+    assert res.status_code == 409
+    detail = res.json()["detail"]
+    assert detail["code"] == "type_change_blocked" and detail["message"]
+
+
+# ─── FABLE2-DB-07: PUT /households/{id}/members/{user_id}/financial-role ──────
+
+def test_admin_sets_a_financial_role(world):
+    res = client.put(f"/households/{FAMILY}/members/{SON}/financial-role", headers=bearer(COADMIN),
+                     json={"financial_role": "dependent"})
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    assert res.json() == {"status": "success", "household_id": FAMILY, "user_id": SON, "financial_role": "dependent"}
+    assert world.rpc_calls[-1] == ("set_member_financial_role", {
+        "p_household_id": FAMILY, "p_user_id": SON, "p_financial_role": "dependent", "p_actor_user_id": COADMIN,
+    })
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("household,actor,target,role,status,code", [
+    (FAMILY, SON, SON, "dependent", 403, None),                      # not an admin
+    (FAMILY, OUTSIDER, SON, "dependent", 403, None),                 # not a member
+    (FAMILY, HUSBAND, MATE1, "dependent", 404, None),                # target not in the household
+    (FAMILY, HUSBAND, SON, "peer", 422, "financial_role_not_allowed"),
+    (FAMILY, HUSBAND, SON, "provider", 422, "financial_role_not_allowed"),
+    (FLAT, MATE1, MATE2, "spouse", 422, "financial_role_not_allowed"),
+    (FAMILY, COADMIN, HUSBAND, "spouse", 409, "provider_is_spouse"),
+    (FAMILY, HUSBAND, SON, "boss", 422, None),                       # not a financial role at all
+])
+def test_financial_role_change_is_refused(world, household, actor, target, role, status, code):
+    calls = len(world.rpc_calls)
+    res = client.put(f"/households/{household}/members/{target}/financial-role", headers=bearer(actor),
+                     json={"financial_role": role})
+    assert res.status_code == status, res.text
+    if code:
+        assert res.json()["detail"]["code"] == code
+    assert len(world.rpc_calls) == calls
+
+
+def test_roommates_peer_role_is_accepted(world):
+    res = client.put(f"/households/{FLAT}/members/{MATE2}/financial-role", headers=bearer(MATE1),
+                     json={"financial_role": "peer"})
+    assert res.status_code == 200 and res.json()["financial_role"] == "peer"
+
+
+def test_wife_with_a_ledger_keeps_her_role(world):
+    def refuse(_params):
+        raise FakeApiError("This wife has Nafaqah records", "22023", "spouse_has_ledger")
+
+    world.rpc_handlers["set_member_financial_role"] = refuse
+    res = client.put(f"/households/{FAMILY}/members/{WIFE}/financial-role", headers=bearer(HUSBAND),
+                     json={"financial_role": "family_member"})
+    assert res.status_code == 409 and res.json()["detail"]["code"] == "spouse_has_ledger"
+
+
+# ─── D1: role invites must fit the type ─────────────────────────────────────
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("household,actor,role,status", [
+    (FLAT, MATE1, "spouse", 409),
+    (FLAT, MATE1, "family_member", 409),
+    (FAMILY, HUSBAND, "peer", 409),
+    (FLAT, MATE1, "peer", 200),
+    (FAMILY, HUSBAND, "spouse", 200),
+])
+def test_invite_role_must_fit_the_type(world, household, actor, role, status):
+    res = client.post(f"/households/{household}/invites", headers=bearer(actor), json={"role": role})
+    assert res.status_code == status, res.text
+    if status == 409:
+        assert res.json()["detail"]["code"] == "invite_role_mismatch"
+        assert not world.tables.get("household_invites")
+
+
+# ─── D2: who may classify a chat/receipt expense ────────────────────────────
+
+def test_son_cannot_classify(world):
+    with pytest.raises(ns.NafaqahClassificationForbidden):
+        ns.resolve_expense_nafaqah(FAMILY, SON, "me", "both", override_class="wife_reimbursable",
+                                   override_spouse_id=WIFE, require_spouse=True)
+    # Not choosing a class is fine: the expense is ordinary.
+    assert ns.resolve_expense_nafaqah(FAMILY, SON, "me", "both")["nafaqah_class"] is None
+    assert ns.resolve_expense_nafaqah(FAMILY, SON, "me", "both", override_class="none")["nafaqah_class"] is None
+
+
+def test_admin_who_is_not_a_spouse_classifies_explicitly(world):
+    res = ns.resolve_expense_nafaqah(FAMILY, COADMIN, "me", "both", override_class="wife_personal",
+                                     require_spouse=True)
+    assert res["nafaqah_class"] == "wife_personal" and res["nafaqah_spouse_id"] == WIFE
+
+
+def test_wife_and_provider_classify(world):
+    wife = ns.resolve_expense_nafaqah(FAMILY, WIFE, "me", "both", require_spouse=True)
+    assert wife["nafaqah_class"] == "wife_reimbursable" and wife["nafaqah_spouse_id"] == WIFE
+    husband = ns.resolve_expense_nafaqah(FAMILY, HUSBAND, "partner", "partner", require_spouse=True)
+    assert husband["nafaqah_class"] == "wife_personal"
+
+
+def test_classification_refusal_maps_to_403_with_a_code():
+    exc = ns.NafaqahClassificationForbidden("Only the wife, the Nafaqah provider or a household admin ...")
+    http = nafaqah_http_error(exc)
+    assert http.status_code == 403 and http.detail["code"] == "nafaqah_classification_forbidden"
+    mapped = ns._map_db_error(FakeApiError("Only the wife ...", "42501", "nafaqah_class_not_allowed"))
+    assert isinstance(mapped, ns.NafaqahClassificationForbidden)
+    assert isinstance(ns._map_db_error(FakeApiError("x", "22023", "not_family_household")), ns.NotFamilyHousehold)
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_fable_installments.py b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_installments.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..42e16a5
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_installments.py
@@ -0,0 +1,116 @@
+"""
+FABLE-API-09 / FABLE-API-10 (docs/review/audit/fable_review.md).
+
+- ``start_date`` must be an ISO date (422); there is no container-local JSON fallback any more
+  (a failed insert fails the request), and the original transaction is only adjusted after the
+  plan was stored.
+- A payment is one atomic conditional increment in the database (RPC pay_installment_plan,
+  migration 20261020750000), never a read-modify-write in Python.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+from fable_world import World
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def api():
+    from main import app
+
+    with TestClient(app) as c:
+        yield c
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def w(fake_supabase):
+    w = World(fake_supabase, {"ahmed": ("admin", "peer"), "omar": ("member", "peer")})
+    fake_supabase.seed("transactions", [{
+        "id": "aaaaaaaa-0000-4000-8000-0000000000aa", "household_id": w.hid, "user_id": w.users["ahmed"],
+        "amount": 1200.0, "merchant": "Jarir", "raw_sms": "Chat: Jarir 1200", "category_code": "OPEX-SHOPPING",
+    }])
+    return w
+
+
+def _plan(w, **extra):
+    return {"household_id": w.hid, "merchant": "Jarir", "provider": "Tamara", "total_amount": 1200,
+            "installment_count": 4, "original_transaction_id": "aaaaaaaa-0000-4000-8000-0000000000aa", **extra}
+
+
+def test_invalid_start_date_is_422_and_nothing_changes(api, fake_supabase, w):
+    import installment_service
+
+    r = api.post("/budgets/installments", json=_plan(w, start_date="not-a-date"), headers=w.hdr("ahmed"))
+    assert r.status_code == 422, r.text
+    assert not fake_supabase.tables.get("installment_plans")
+    assert fake_supabase.tables["transactions"][0]["amount"] == 1200.0
+    assert not hasattr(installment_service, "FALLBACK_FILE")
+
+
+def test_valid_start_date_is_stored(api, fake_supabase, w):
+    r = api.post("/budgets/installments", json=_plan(w, start_date="2026-11-01"), headers=w.hdr("ahmed"))
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert fake_supabase.tables["installment_plans"][0]["start_date"] == "2026-11-01"
+    assert fake_supabase.tables["transactions"][0]["amount"] == 300.0
+
+
+def test_failed_insert_fails_the_request_and_keeps_the_transaction(api, fake_supabase, w, monkeypatch):
+    real_table = fake_supabase.table
+
+    class _Refusing:
+        def __init__(self, query):
+            self._query = query
+
+        def insert(self, *_a, **_k):
+            raise RuntimeError("installment_plans insert refused")
+
+        def __getattr__(self, name):
+            return getattr(self._query, name)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(fake_supabase, "table",
+                        lambda name: _Refusing(real_table(name)) if name == "installment_plans" else real_table(name))
+    r = api.post("/budgets/installments", json=_plan(w), headers=w.hdr("ahmed"))
+    assert r.status_code >= 500, r.text
+    assert fake_supabase.tables["transactions"][0]["amount"] == 1200.0
+    assert "Financed via" not in fake_supabase.tables["transactions"][0]["raw_sms"]
+
+
+def test_pay_is_one_atomic_rpc_call(api, fake_supabase, w):
+    fake_supabase.seed("installment_plans", [{
+        "id": "dddddddd-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", "household_id": w.hid, "merchant": "eXtra",
+        "provider": "Tamara", "total_amount": 300.0, "installment_count": 3, "monthly_amount": 100.0,
+        "paid_installments": 1, "day_of_month": 27, "start_date": "2026-10-01", "status": "ACTIVE",
+    }])
+    url = "/budgets/installments/dddddddd-0000-4000-8000-000000000001/pay"
+    assert api.post(url, headers=w.hdr("omar")).json()["paid_installments"] == 2
+    last = api.post(url, headers=w.hdr("omar")).json()
+    assert last["paid_installments"] == 3 and last["status"] == "COMPLETED"
+    again = api.post(url, headers=w.hdr("omar")).json()
+    assert again["paid_installments"] == 3  # never beyond the plan
+    calls = [c for c in fake_supabase.rpc_calls if c[0] == "pay_installment_plan"]
+    assert len(calls) == 3
+    assert calls[0][1] == {"p_plan_id": "dddddddd-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", "p_household_id": w.hid,
+                           "p_actor_user_id": w.users["omar"]}
+    # No read-modify-write: the service never updates installment_plans itself.
+    assert all(p["paid_installments"] == 3 for p in fake_supabase.tables["installment_plans"])
+
+
+def test_pay_unknown_or_malformed_plan_is_404(api, w):
+    assert api.post("/budgets/installments/not-a-uuid/pay", headers=w.hdr("omar")).status_code == 404
+    assert api.post("/budgets/installments/dddddddd-0000-4000-8000-00000000ffff/pay",
+                    headers=w.hdr("omar")).status_code == 404
+
+
+def test_pay_on_a_cancelled_plan_is_409_not_500(api, fake_supabase, w):
+    """20261020900000: pay_installment_plan refuses non-ACTIVE plans (22023, HINT plan_not_active);
+    the API answers 409 with a code the app can show, and nothing is counted."""
+    fake_supabase.seed("installment_plans", [{
+        "id": "dddddddd-0000-4000-8000-000000000002", "household_id": w.hid, "merchant": "eXtra",
+        "provider": "Tamara", "total_amount": 300.0, "installment_count": 3, "monthly_amount": 100.0,
+        "paid_installments": 1, "day_of_month": 27, "start_date": "2026-10-01", "status": "CANCELLED",
+    }])
+    r = api.post("/budgets/installments/dddddddd-0000-4000-8000-000000000002/pay", headers=w.hdr("omar"))
+    assert r.status_code == 409, r.text
+    assert r.json()["detail"]["code"] == "plan_not_active"
+    assert fake_supabase.tables["installment_plans"][0]["paid_installments"] == 1
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_fable_product_r6_preview_token.py b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_product_r6_preview_token.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b5cd489
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_product_r6_preview_token.py
@@ -0,0 +1,452 @@
+"""
+PRODUCT-R6 / R9 (docs/review/audit/product_review.md 2.1, 3.1, "Stop doing"): one LLM call per
+expense.
+
+The chat and receipt previews return a server-signed ``preview_token`` (HMAC over the parsed
+payload, the user, the household, an expiry and the input digest). A commit that sends it back
+inserts from the signed payload without calling the model; the user's edits go through the same
+validation as before. Without a token the commit re-parses (installed apps keep working).
+A tampered token, or one issued to someone else, is 422 ``{"detail": {"code":
+"invalid_preview_token"}}``; an expired one falls back to re-parsing.
+
+Receipts: the OCR runs at temperature 0.1-0.2, and the photo is uploaded to Storage only after
+the transaction row exists (never before parsing, never for a refused insert).
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import base64
+import io
+import json
+import types
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from PIL import Image
+
+import preview_token as pt
+from fable_world import World
+from main import app
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def api():
+    return TestClient(app)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def _fresh_key(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.delenv("PREVIEW_TOKEN_SECRET", raising=False)
+    pt.reset_preview_token_key()
+    yield
+    pt.reset_preview_token_key()
+
+
+class LLM:
+    """Counts model calls; answers with the queued payload."""
+
+    def __init__(self, monkeypatch, payload: dict):
+        import litellm
+
+        self.calls = []
+        self.payload = payload
+
+        def completion(*_a, **kwargs):
+            self.calls.append(kwargs)
+            msg = types.SimpleNamespace(content=json.dumps(self.payload))
+            return types.SimpleNamespace(choices=[types.SimpleNamespace(message=msg)])
+
+        monkeypatch.setattr(litellm, "completion", completion)
+
+
+CHAT_PARSE = {
+    "is_transaction": True, "merchant": "Albaik", "total_amount": 46.0, "currency": "SAR",
+    "category_code": "OPEX-DINING", "sub_category": "restaurants_dinners", "paid_by": "me", "beneficiary": "both",
+    "items": [{"name": "Broast", "quantity": 2, "price": 46.0}],
+}
+RECEIPT_PARSE = {
+    "merchant": "Danube", "total_amount": 82.5, "vat_amount": 10.76, "currency": "SAR", "date": None,
+    "category_code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "zatca_qr_raw": None, "confidence": "high",
+    "items": [{"name": "Milk", "quantity": 2, "price": 12.5}, {"name": "Rice 5kg", "quantity": 1, "price": 70.0}],
+}
+
+
+def _codes(fake):
+    fake.seed("cost_control_codes", [
+        {"id": c, "code": c, "category": c, "keywords": [], "is_flexible": c == "OPEX-MISC", "household_id": None}
+        for c in ("OPEX-DINING", "OPEX-GROCERY", "OPEX-MISC", "OPEX-SHOPPING")
+    ])
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def flat(fake_supabase):
+    _codes(fake_supabase)
+    return World(fake_supabase, {"ahmed": ("admin", "peer"), "omar": ("member", "peer")})
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def family(fake_supabase):
+    _codes(fake_supabase)
+    w = World(fake_supabase, {"husband": ("admin", "provider"), "wife": ("member", "spouse")})
+    fake_supabase.tables["households"][0]["nafaqah_provider_user_id"] = w.users["husband"]
+    return w
+
+
+def _jpeg() -> str:
+    buf = io.BytesIO()
+    Image.new("RGB", (40, 60), (250, 250, 250)).save(buf, "JPEG")
+    return base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode()
+
+
+def _txs(fake):
+    return fake.tables.get("transactions", [])
+
+
+def _chat(api, w, who, **body):
+    payload = {"household_id": w.hid, "message": "Albaik broast 46 riyal", "allow_duplicate": True}
+    payload.update(body)
+    return api.post("/agent/chat-transaction", json=payload, headers=w.hdr(who))
+
+
+def _receipt(api, w, who, **body):
+    payload = {"household_id": w.hid, "allow_duplicate": True}
+    payload.update(body)
+    return api.post("/agent/scan-receipt", json=payload, headers=w.hdr(who))
+
+
+def _tamper(token: str) -> str:
+    version, kid, body, sig = token.split(".")
+    claims = json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(body + "=" * (-len(body) % 4)))
+    claims["p"]["total_amount"] = 1.0
+    forged = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(claims).encode()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
+    return ".".join([version, kid, forged, sig])
+
+
+# ─── token unit behaviour ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def test_token_round_trip_and_binding():
+    tok = pt.issue_preview_token("chat", "u1", "h1", {"a": 1}, {"m": "x"})
+    res = pt.verify_preview_token(tok, "chat", "u1", "h1")
+    assert res.valid and res.payload == {"a": 1} and res.binding == {"m": "x"}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("args", [("receipt", "u1", "h1"), ("chat", "u2", "h1"), ("chat", "u1", "h2")])
+def test_token_for_another_kind_user_or_household_is_invalid(args):
+    tok = pt.issue_preview_token("chat", "u1", "h1", {"a": 1})
+    with pytest.raises(pt.InvalidPreviewToken):
+        pt.verify_preview_token(tok, *args)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad", ["", "nope", "pt1.a.b", "pt2.a.b.c", None, 42, "pt1." + "x" * (pt.MAX_PREVIEW_TOKEN_LENGTH)])
+def test_malformed_tokens_are_invalid(bad):
+    with pytest.raises(pt.InvalidPreviewToken):
+        pt.verify_preview_token(bad, "chat", "u1", "h1")
+
+
+def test_tampered_payload_or_signature_is_invalid():
+    tok = pt.issue_preview_token("chat", "u1", "h1", {"total_amount": 46.0})
+    with pytest.raises(pt.InvalidPreviewToken):
+        pt.verify_preview_token(_tamper(tok), "chat", "u1", "h1")
+    with pytest.raises(pt.InvalidPreviewToken):
+        pt.verify_preview_token(tok[:-2] + ("AA" if not tok.endswith("AA") else "BB"), "chat", "u1", "h1")
+
+
+def test_expired_token_reports_expired():
+    tok = pt.issue_preview_token("chat", "u1", "h1", {"a": 1}, now=1_000)
+    assert pt.verify_preview_token(tok, "chat", "u1", "h1", now=1_000 + pt.PREVIEW_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS - 1).valid
+    assert pt.verify_preview_token(tok, "chat", "u1", "h1", now=1_000 + pt.PREVIEW_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS + 1).status == "expired"
+    assert pt.PREVIEW_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS == 15 * 60
+
+
+def test_shared_secret_verifies_across_processes_random_key_does_not(monkeypatch):
+    tok = pt.issue_preview_token("chat", "u1", "h1", {"a": 1})
+    pt.reset_preview_token_key()  # another process without PREVIEW_TOKEN_SECRET
+    assert pt.verify_preview_token(tok, "chat", "u1", "h1").status == "unverifiable"
+
+    monkeypatch.setenv("PREVIEW_TOKEN_SECRET", "s" * 40)
+    pt.reset_preview_token_key()
+    tok = pt.issue_preview_token("chat", "u1", "h1", {"a": 1})
+    pt.reset_preview_token_key()
+    assert pt.verify_preview_token(tok, "chat", "u1", "h1").valid
+
+
+def test_short_or_missing_secret_warns(monkeypatch, caplog):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("PREVIEW_TOKEN_SECRET", "tiny-value")
+    pt.reset_preview_token_key()
+    with caplog.at_level("WARNING"):
+        pt.issue_preview_token("chat", "u1", "h1", {})
+    assert "PREVIEW_TOKEN_SECRET" in caplog.text and "tiny-value" not in caplog.text
+    monkeypatch.delenv("PREVIEW_TOKEN_SECRET")
+    pt.reset_preview_token_key()
+    caplog.clear()
+    with caplog.at_level("WARNING"):
+        pt.issue_preview_token("chat", "u1", "h1", {})
+    assert "PREVIEW_TOKEN_SECRET is not set" in caplog.text

+def test_oversized_payload_gets_no_token():

+def test_chat_commit_with_token_makes_no_llm_call(api, flat, fake_supabase, monkeypatch):
