diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_fable_r2_insert_refusals.py b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_r2_insert_refusals.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a5efa70
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_r2_insert_refusals.py
@@ -0,0 +1,164 @@
+"""
+FABLE2-API-01: a database refusal of a transaction insert is final.
+
+insert_transaction used to retry every failed insert twice with a pruned payload. A constraint or
+permission refusal (SQLSTATE 23514, 22023, 23503, 42501, 23505) cannot be fixed by dropping
+optional columns: it was sent three times and then surfaced as a 500. Now it is raised at once:
+the Nafaqah triggers' hints map to NoProviderError / LedgerWouldBeOverpaid (HTTP 409
+``{"detail": {"code": "no_provider" | "ledger_would_be_overpaid", "message": ...}}``), anything
+else to TransactionRejectedError (403 / 409 / 422, never database text). A family without a
+provider is refused before any budget is touched when the expense would be classified.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from postgrest.exceptions import APIError
+
+import fakes
+import supabase_client
+from fable_world import World, zatca_qr
+from nafaqah_service import LedgerWouldBeOverpaid, NoProviderError
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def api():
+    from main import app
+
+    with TestClient(app) as c:
+        yield c
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def refuse(fake_supabase, monkeypatch):
+    """Make public.transactions inserts fail with the given database error; records attempts."""
+    state = {"error": None, "attempts": []}
+    original = fakes.FakeQuery.execute
+
+    def execute(self):
+        if self._table == "transactions" and self._op == "insert":
+            state["attempts"].append(dict(self._payload))
+            if state["error"] is not None:
+                raise state["error"]
+        return original(self)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(fakes.FakeQuery, "execute", execute)
+    return state
+
+
+def _insert(hid="aaaa0000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a1"):
+    return supabase_client.insert_transaction(
+        household_id=hid, amount=10.0, currency="SAR", merchant="Panda", category_code="OPEX-GROCERY",
+        timestamp="2026-10-21T10:00:00+00:00", raw_sms="Chat: x", source="chat", cycle_key="2026-10",
+        dedup_fingerprint="fp", qr_code_raw="qr", sub_category="groceries",
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("code, hint, message, expected", [
+    ("23514", "no_nafaqah_provider", "Household x has no Nafaqah provider", NoProviderError),
+    ("22023", "ledger_would_be_overpaid", "This change would leave ...", LedgerWouldBeOverpaid),
+    ("23514", None, "new row violates check constraint", supabase_client.TransactionRejectedError),
+    ("22023", None, "invalid parameter", supabase_client.TransactionRejectedError),
+    ("23503", None, "nafaqah_spouse_id x is not a spouse member", supabase_client.TransactionRejectedError),
+    ("42501", None, "new row violates row-level security policy", supabase_client.TransactionRejectedError),
+    ("23505", None, "duplicate key value violates unique constraint", supabase_client.TransactionRejectedError),
+])
+def test_constraint_and_permission_refusals_are_not_retried(refuse, code, hint, message, expected):
+    refuse["error"] = APIError({"code": code, "message": message, "hint": hint, "details": None})
+    with pytest.raises(expected) as info:
+        _insert()
+    assert len(refuse["attempts"]) == 1
+    assert message not in str(info.value)  # never the database text
+    if expected is supabase_client.TransactionRejectedError:
+        assert info.value.sqlstate == code
+        assert info.value.status_code == {"42501": 403, "23505": 409}.get(code, 422)
+
+
+def test_schema_mismatch_still_falls_back(refuse, fake_supabase, monkeypatch):
+    """A PostgREST schema error (unknown column) keeps the pruning fallback."""
+    calls = {"n": 0}
+    original = fakes.FakeQuery.execute
+
+    def execute(self):
+        if self._table == "transactions" and self._op == "insert" and "qr_code_raw" in self._payload:
+            calls["n"] += 1
+            raise APIError({"code": "PGRST204", "message": "Could not find the 'qr_code_raw' column",
+                            "hint": None, "details": None})
+        return original(self)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(fakes.FakeQuery, "execute", execute)
+    tx_id = _insert()
+    assert calls["n"] == 1 and tx_id
+    stored = fake_supabase.tables["transactions"][-1]
+    assert "qr_code_raw" not in stored and stored["sub_category"] == "groceries"
+
+
+# ─── Routes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def _family(fake, provider=True, son=False):
+    roles = {"husband": ("admin", "provider"), "wife": ("member", "spouse")}
+    if son:
+        roles["son"] = ("member", "family_member")
+    w = World(fake, roles)
+    fake.tables["households"][0]["nafaqah_provider_user_id"] = w.users["husband"] if provider else None
+    fake.seed("cost_control_codes", [{"id": "c-groc", "code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "category": "Groceries",
+                                      "keywords": ["panda", "groceries"], "is_flexible": False,
+                                      "household_id": None, "is_system": True}])
+    return w
+
+
+def _chat(api, w, who="wife", **extra):
+    body = {"household_id": w.hid, "message": "Groceries 300 sar", "category_code": "OPEX-GROCERY",
+            "paid_by": "me", "beneficiary": "both", **extra}
+    return api.post("/agent/chat-transaction", json=body, headers=w.hdr(who))
+
+
+def test_chat_commit_without_provider_is_409_before_any_write(api, fake_supabase, refuse):
+    w = _family(fake_supabase, provider=False)
+    r = _chat(api, w)
+    assert r.status_code == 409, r.text
+    assert r.json()["detail"]["code"] == "no_provider"
+    assert r.json()["detail"]["message"]
+    assert refuse["attempts"] == []
+
+
+def test_receipt_commit_without_provider_is_409_before_any_write(api, fake_supabase, refuse):
+    w = _family(fake_supabase, provider=False)
+    r = api.post("/agent/scan-receipt", json={"household_id": w.hid, "qr_code_raw": zatca_qr(),
+                                              "paid_by": "me", "beneficiary": "both"}, headers=w.hdr("wife"))
+    assert r.status_code == 409, r.text
+    assert r.json()["detail"]["code"] == "no_provider"
+    assert refuse["attempts"] == []
+
+
+def test_unclassified_expense_in_a_family_without_provider_is_still_recorded(api, fake_supabase, refuse):
+    """Only a class needs the provider: a son's expense (no class) is stored."""
+    w = _family(fake_supabase, provider=False, son=True)
+    r = _chat(api, w, who="son")
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.json()["nafaqah_class"] is None and len(refuse["attempts"]) == 1
+
+
+def test_database_no_provider_refusal_maps_to_409(api, fake_supabase, refuse):
+    """The provider left between the check and the insert: the trigger's hint is mapped once."""
+    w = _family(fake_supabase)
+    refuse["error"] = APIError({"code": "23514", "message": "Household has no Nafaqah provider",
+                                "hint": "no_nafaqah_provider", "details": None})
+    r = _chat(api, w)
+    assert r.status_code == 409, r.text
+    assert r.json()["detail"]["code"] == "no_provider"
+    assert len(refuse["attempts"]) == 1
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("code, status", [("42501", 403), ("23505", 409), ("23514", 422)])
+def test_other_database_refusals_are_4xx_without_database_text(api, fake_supabase, refuse, code, status):
+    w = _family(fake_supabase)
+    refuse["error"] = APIError({"code": code, "message": "secret internal detail", "hint": None, "details": None})
+    r = _chat(api, w)
+    assert r.status_code == status, r.text
+    assert "secret internal detail" not in r.text
+    assert len(refuse["attempts"]) == 1
+    r = api.post("/agent/scan-receipt", json={"household_id": w.hid, "qr_code_raw": zatca_qr()},
+                 headers=w.hdr("husband"))
+    assert r.status_code == status, r.text
+    assert "secret internal detail" not in r.text
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_fable_r2_installment_consistency.py b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_r2_installment_consistency.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..e334815
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_r2_installment_consistency.py
@@ -0,0 +1,90 @@
+"""
+FABLE2-API-05: an installment plan over a wife advance that was already (partly) repaid.
+
+Adjusting the original transaction down to the monthly amount is refused by the ledger guard
+(SQLSTATE 22023, HINT ledger_would_be_overpaid). The adjustment error used to be swallowed: the
+plan was stored, the transaction kept its full amount and the request answered 200. Now a refused
+adjustment removes the plan again and the request answers 409 ``ledger_would_be_overpaid`` (other
+refusals: their 4xx, anything else 5xx), never 200 with an inconsistent state.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from postgrest.exceptions import APIError
+
+import fakes
+from fable_world import World
+
+TX = "aaaaaaaa-0000-4000-8000-0000000000e6"
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def api():
+    from main import app
+
+    with TestClient(app) as c:
+        yield c
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def family(fake_supabase):
+    w = World(fake_supabase, {"husband": ("admin", "provider"), "wife": ("member", "spouse")})
+    fake_supabase.tables["households"][0]["nafaqah_provider_user_id"] = w.users["husband"]
+    fake_supabase.seed("transactions", [{
+        "id": TX, "household_id": w.hid, "user_id": w.users["wife"], "amount": 300.0, "merchant": "Extra",
+        "raw_sms": "PaidBy: me | Beneficiary: both | SpentBy: me | Chat: Extra 300", "category_code": "OPEX-SHOPPING",
+        "nafaqah_class": "wife_reimbursable", "nafaqah_spouse_id": w.users["wife"], "source": "chat",
+    }])
+    return w
+
+
+def _refuse_tx_updates(monkeypatch, error):
+    original = fakes.FakeQuery.execute
+
+    def execute(self):
+        if self._table == "transactions" and self._op == "update":
+            raise error
+        return original(self)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(fakes.FakeQuery, "execute", execute)
+
+
+def _plan(w):
+    return {"household_id": w.hid, "merchant": "Extra", "provider": "Tamara", "total_amount": 300,
+            "installment_count": 4, "original_transaction_id": TX}
+
+
+def test_ledger_guard_refusal_is_409_and_no_plan_is_left(api, fake_supabase, family, monkeypatch):
+    _refuse_tx_updates(monkeypatch, APIError({
+        "code": "22023", "hint": "ledger_would_be_overpaid", "details": "repaid=200.00 advances_after=75.00",
+        "message": "This change would leave the wife's reimbursement ledger overpaid",
+    }))
+    r = api.post("/budgets/installments", json=_plan(family), headers=family.hdr("wife"))
+    assert r.status_code == 409, r.text
+    assert r.json()["detail"]["code"] == "ledger_would_be_overpaid"
+    assert not fake_supabase.tables.get("installment_plans")
+    tx = fake_supabase.tables["transactions"][0]
+    assert tx["amount"] == 300.0 and "Financed via" not in tx["raw_sms"]
+
+
+def test_other_adjustment_failure_removes_the_plan_and_is_not_200(api, fake_supabase, family, monkeypatch):
+    _refuse_tx_updates(monkeypatch, RuntimeError("connection reset"))
+    r = api.post("/budgets/installments", json=_plan(family), headers=family.hdr("wife"))
+    assert r.status_code >= 500, r.text
+    assert "connection reset" not in r.text
+    assert not fake_supabase.tables.get("installment_plans")
+
+
+def test_permission_refusal_of_the_adjustment_is_403(api, fake_supabase, family, monkeypatch):
+    _refuse_tx_updates(monkeypatch, APIError({"code": "42501", "message": "rls", "hint": None, "details": None}))
+    r = api.post("/budgets/installments", json=_plan(family), headers=family.hdr("wife"))
+    assert r.status_code == 403, r.text
+    assert not fake_supabase.tables.get("installment_plans")
+
+
+def test_successful_adjustment_still_creates_the_plan(api, fake_supabase, family):
+    r = api.post("/budgets/installments", json=_plan(family), headers=family.hdr("wife"))
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert len(fake_supabase.tables["installment_plans"]) == 1
+    assert fake_supabase.tables["transactions"][0]["amount"] == 75.0
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_fable_r2_invite_target.py b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_r2_invite_target.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ade5e32
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_r2_invite_target.py
@@ -0,0 +1,102 @@
+"""
+FABLE2-API-06: POST /households/{id}/invites with ``target_member_id``.
+
+The id is checked before the insert: not a UUID → 400; not a dependent (manual member) of this
+household → 404. A database refusal of the insert (the validate_invite_target_member trigger,
+23503; RLS 42501; ...) is a 4xx, never a 500. Inspecting an invite only names a dependent of the
+invite's own household.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import uuid
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from postgrest.exceptions import APIError
+
+import fakes
+from fable_world import World
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def api():
+    from main import app
+
+    with TestClient(app) as c:
+        yield c
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def homes(fake_supabase):
+    a = World(fake_supabase, {"ahmed": ("admin", "peer")})
+    b = World(fake_supabase, {"badr": ("admin", "provider"), "huda": ("member", "spouse")})
+    own_dep, foreign_dep = str(uuid.uuid4()), str(uuid.uuid4())
+    fake_supabase.seed("household_dependents", [
+        {"id": own_dep, "household_id": a.hid, "name": "Kid A"},
+        {"id": foreign_dep, "household_id": b.hid, "name": "Secret Kid"},
+    ])
+    return a, b, own_dep, foreign_dep
+
+
+def _invite(api, w, target, who="ahmed", role="family_member"):
+    return api.post(f"/households/{w.hid}/invites", json={"role": role, "target_member_id": target},
+                    headers=w.hdr(who))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("target", ["not-a-uuid", pytest.param("x" * 5000, id="long"), "1; drop table"])
+def test_malformed_target_is_400(api, fake_supabase, homes, target):
+    a, *_ = homes
+    r = _invite(api, a, target)
+    assert r.status_code == 400, r.text
+    assert not fake_supabase.tables.get("household_invites")
+
+
+def test_foreign_or_unknown_dependent_is_404(api, fake_supabase, homes):
+    a, b, _own, foreign = homes
+    for target in (foreign, str(uuid.uuid4()), a.users["ahmed"]):
+        r = _invite(api, a, target)
+        assert r.status_code == 404, r.text
+        assert "Secret Kid" not in r.text
+    assert not fake_supabase.tables.get("household_invites")
+
+
+def test_own_dependent_is_accepted_and_named(api, fake_supabase, homes):
+    a, _b, own, _foreign = homes
+    r = _invite(api, a, own)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    code = r.json()["invite_code"]
+    ins = api.get(f"/households/invites/{code}", headers=a.hdr("ahmed")).json()
+    assert ins["target_member_name"] == "Kid A"
+
+
+def test_untargeted_invite_unchanged(api, fake_supabase, homes):
+    a, *_ = homes
+    r = api.post(f"/households/{a.hid}/invites", json={"role": "family_member"}, headers=a.hdr("ahmed"))
+    assert r.status_code == 200 and r.json()["target_member_id"] is None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("code, status", [("23503", 404), ("42501", 403), ("23514", 422), ("23505", 409)])
+def test_database_refusal_is_4xx(api, fake_supabase, homes, monkeypatch, code, status):
+    a, _b, own, _foreign = homes
+    original = fakes.FakeQuery.execute
+
+    def execute(self):
+        if self._table == "household_invites" and self._op == "insert":
+            raise APIError({"code": code, "message": "internal db text", "hint": None, "details": None})
+        return original(self)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(fakes.FakeQuery, "execute", execute)
+    r = _invite(api, a, own)
+    assert r.status_code == status, r.text
+    assert "internal db text" not in r.text
+
+
+def test_inspect_never_names_a_dependent_of_another_household(api, fake_supabase, homes):
+    """An invite row bound to a foreign dependent (written before the trigger existed)."""
+    a, _b, _own, foreign = homes
+    fake_supabase.seed("household_invites", [{
+        "household_id": a.hid, "invite_code": "ABCDEF0123456789", "role": "family_member",
+        "target_member_id": foreign, "expires_at": None,
+    }])
+    ins = api.get("/households/invites/ABCDEF0123456789", headers=a.hdr("ahmed")).json()
+    assert ins["target_member_name"] is None
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_fable_r2_legacy_edit_attribution.py b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_r2_legacy_edit_attribution.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..327225f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_r2_legacy_edit_attribution.py
@@ -0,0 +1,135 @@
+"""
+FABLE2-LOGIC-01 (backend tolerance): rows edited by old app builds.
+
+Before the edit sheet wrote structured columns, its fallback write (flutter_app/lib/screens/home/
+edit_transaction_sheet.dart at 84e264f, ``_saveChanges``) stored ``spent_by = derivedSpentBy``
+('both' whenever the beneficiary was 'both') and appended
+``" | PaidBy: <p> | Beneficiary: <b> | SubCategory: <s> | SpentBy: <derived>"`` to ``raw_sms``,
+leaving ``beneficiary_type`` / ``beneficiary_id`` as they were. The settlement engines must not
+read ``spent_by = 'both'`` as "the creator paid": the payer comes from the note's tags then. The
+trust model is unchanged otherwise (manual rows take the payer from their tail, API rows only
+accept 'me' / 'partner').
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import re
+
+import pytest
+
+from settlement_engine import transaction_attribution
+
+
+def old_edit_sheet_note(raw: str, paid_by: str, beneficiary: str, sub_category: str | None) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    """(raw_sms, spent_by) exactly as the old edit sheet's fallback wrote them."""
+    if beneficiary == "both":
+        derived = "both"
+    elif paid_by == "partner" and beneficiary == "partner":
+        derived = "partner"
+    elif paid_by == "me" and beneficiary == "me":
+        derived = "me"
+    else:
+        derived = beneficiary
+    clean = re.sub(r"\|\s*SpentBy:\s*(me|partner|both)", "", raw, flags=re.I)
+    clean = re.sub(r"\|\s*PaidBy:\s*(me|partner)", "", clean, flags=re.I)
+    clean = re.sub(r"\|\s*Beneficiary:\s*([^\s\|]+)", "", clean, flags=re.I)
+    clean = re.sub(r"\|\s*SubCategory:\s*([^\s\|]+)", "", clean, flags=re.I).strip()
+    note = f"{clean} | PaidBy: {paid_by} | Beneficiary: {beneficiary} | SubCategory: {sub_category or ''} | SpentBy: {derived}"
+    return note, derived
+
+
+CHAT_RAW = "PaidBy: partner | Beneficiary: both | SpentBy: partner | Chat: Groceries 200 | Items: [1x Groceries (200 SAR)]"
+
+
+def test_helper_reproduces_the_exact_old_sheet_strings():
+    note, spent_by = old_edit_sheet_note(CHAT_RAW, "partner", "both", None)
+    assert spent_by == "both"
+    assert note == (
+        "PaidBy: partner   | Chat: Groceries 200 | Items: [1x Groceries (200 SAR)]"
+        " | PaidBy: partner | Beneficiary: both | SubCategory:  | SpentBy: both"
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("raw_sms, expected_payer", [
+    # Chat row re-saved unchanged by the old sheet (the merchant was edited): the partner paid.
+    ("PaidBy: partner  | Chat: Groceries 200 | Items: [1x Groceries (200 SAR)]"
+     " | PaidBy: partner | Beneficiary: both | SubCategory:  | SpentBy: both", "partner"),
+    # With a sub-category chosen in the sheet.
+    ("PaidBy: me  | Chat: SEC bill | PaidBy: partner | Beneficiary: both | SubCategory: electricity_sec"
+     " | SpentBy: both", "partner"),
+    # An old row whose sheet tail says the creator paid.
+    ("PaidBy: partner | Chat: x | PaidBy: me | Beneficiary: both | SubCategory:  | SpentBy: both", "me"),
+])
+def test_api_row_with_spent_by_both_reads_the_payer_from_the_tags(raw_sms, expected_payer):
+    tx = {"source": "chat", "spent_by": "both", "raw_sms": raw_sms,
+          "beneficiary_type": "household", "beneficiary_id": "household"}
+    assert transaction_attribution(tx) == (expected_payer, "shared")
+
+
+def test_api_row_with_spent_by_both_and_no_tail_uses_the_server_head_tag():
+    tx = {"source": "receipt_scan", "spent_by": "both", "beneficiary_type": "household", "beneficiary_id": "household",
+          "raw_sms": "PaidBy: partner | Beneficiary: both | SpentBy: partner | Receipt Scan: Panda"}
+    assert transaction_attribution(tx) == ("partner", "shared")
+
+
+def test_api_row_tags_never_name_an_arbitrary_member():
+    member = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
+    tx = {"source": "chat", "spent_by": "both", "beneficiary_type": "household", "beneficiary_id": "household",
+          "raw_sms": f"PaidBy: me | Chat: x | PaidBy: {member} | Beneficiary: both | SubCategory:  | SpentBy: both"}
+    assert transaction_attribution(tx)[0] == "me"
+
+
+def test_structured_spent_by_still_wins_for_api_rows():
+    # A row written by the API (or the fixed sheet) keeps its column: a stale tail is not read.
+    tx = {"source": "chat", "spent_by": "me", "beneficiary_type": "household", "beneficiary_id": "household",
+          "raw_sms": "PaidBy: me | Chat: x | PaidBy: partner | Beneficiary: both | SubCategory:  | SpentBy: both"}
+    assert transaction_attribution(tx) == ("me", "shared")
+
+
+def test_manual_row_edited_by_the_old_sheet_keeps_the_tail_payer():
+    ahmed = "aaaaaaaa-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"
+    raw = f"Manual: Groceries | PaidBy: {ahmed} | Beneficiary: all_peers | SpentBy: both"
+    note, spent_by = old_edit_sheet_note(raw, "partner", "me", None)
+    # The UUID PaidBy is not matched by the sheet's (me|partner) regex: it stays in the text.
+    assert note == (f"Manual: Groceries | PaidBy: {ahmed} | PaidBy: partner | Beneficiary: me | SubCategory:  "
+                    f"| SpentBy: me")
+    assert spent_by == "me"
+    tx = {"source": "manual", "spent_by": spent_by, "raw_sms": note,
+          "beneficiary_type": "all_peers", "beneficiary_id": "all_peers"}
+    assert transaction_attribution(tx)[0] == "partner"
+
+
+def test_manual_tail_with_a_sub_category_value():
+    tx = {"source": "manual", "spent_by": "both", "beneficiary_type": "household", "beneficiary_id": "household",
+          "raw_sms": "Manual: SEC | PaidBy: partner | Beneficiary: both | SubCategory: electricity_sec | SpentBy: both"}
+    assert transaction_attribution(tx) == ("partner", "shared")
+
+
+def test_legacy_row_without_columns_reads_the_sheet_tail_after_the_items():
+    # No beneficiary columns (pre-structured row) and the tail sits after " | Items: [...]".
+    tx = {"source": "chat", "spent_by": "both", "beneficiary_id": None, "category_code": "OPEX-DINING",
+          "raw_sms": "PaidBy: me | Chat: dinner | Items: [1x Dinner (90 SAR)]"
+                     " | PaidBy: partner | Beneficiary: me | SubCategory:  | SpentBy: me"}
+    assert transaction_attribution(tx) == ("partner", "me")
+
+
+def test_settlement_v2_follows_the_old_sheet_edit(fake_supabase):
+    """End to end through calculate_settlement_v2 with the fake: Omar's chat row says Ahmed paid."""
+    import uuid
+
+    from fable_world import World
+    from settlement_engine import calculate_settlement_v2
+
+    w = World(fake_supabase, {"ahmed": ("admin", "peer"), "omar": ("member", "peer")})
+    raw = "PaidBy: partner | Beneficiary: both | SpentBy: partner | Chat: Groceries 200"
+    note, spent_by = old_edit_sheet_note(raw, "partner", "both", None)
+    from utils import riyadh_today
+    fake_supabase.seed("transactions", [{
+        "id": str(uuid.uuid4()), "household_id": w.hid, "user_id": w.users["omar"], "amount": 200.0,
+        "merchant": "Groceries", "category_code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "spent_by": spent_by,
+        "timestamp": f"{riyadh_today().isoformat()}T09:00:00+00:00", "raw_sms": note, "source": "chat",
+        "beneficiary_type": "household", "beneficiary_id": "household", "is_settlement": False,
+        "settlement_target_id": None, "nafaqah_class": None, "nafaqah_spouse_id": None, "line_items": [],
+    }])
+    result = calculate_settlement_v2(w.hid)
+    debts = [(d["from_id"], d["to_id"], d["amount"]) for d in result["pairwise_debts"]]
+    assert debts == [(w.users["omar"], w.users["ahmed"], 100.0)]
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_fable_r2_money_rounding.py b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_r2_money_rounding.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..f00bce3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_r2_money_rounding.py
@@ -0,0 +1,101 @@
+"""
+FABLE2-API-04 / O4: money exactness of roommate settlements.
+
+- POST /households/{id}/reimbursements refuses sub-halala amounts with 422 (like the Nafaqah
+  route) instead of rounding them half-even (10.005 -> 10.00 while the app rounds half-up).
+- Amounts quantised server-side round half-up.
+- v1 /settlement: the two shares of a shared expense always sum to the total, and a roommate
+  balance is 'settled' only below one halala (as in v2 and the family ledger).
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import uuid
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+import supabase_client
+from fable_world import World
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def api():
+    from main import app
+
+    with TestClient(app) as c:
+        yield c
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def w(fake_supabase):
+    return World(fake_supabase, {"ahmed": ("admin", "peer"), "omar": ("member", "peer")})
+
+
+def _settle(api, w, amount):
+    return api.post(f"/households/{w.hid}/reimbursements", json={
+        "household_id": w.hid, "payer_id": w.users["omar"], "recipient_id": w.users["ahmed"], "amount": amount,
+    }, headers=w.hdr("omar"))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("amount", [10.005, 10.015, 0.001, 99.999])
+def test_sub_halala_settlement_is_422(api, fake_supabase, w, amount):
+    r = _settle(api, w, amount)
+    assert r.status_code == 422, r.text
+    assert not [t for t in fake_supabase.tables.get("transactions", []) if t.get("is_settlement")]
+
+
+def test_two_decimal_settlement_is_stored_exactly(api, fake_supabase, w):
+    r = _settle(api, w, 10.01)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.json()["amount"] == 10.01
+    stored = [t for t in fake_supabase.tables["transactions"] if t.get("is_settlement")][0]
+    assert stored["amount"] == "10.01"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("amount, expected", [("10.005", "10.01"), ("10.015", "10.02"), ("0.125", "0.13")])
+def test_service_quantises_half_up(fake_supabase, w, amount, expected):
+    result = supabase_client.record_household_reimbursement(
+        w.hid, w.users["omar"], w.users["ahmed"], amount, recorded_by=w.users["omar"])
+    stored = [t for t in fake_supabase.tables["transactions"] if t["id"] == result["transaction_id"]][0]
+    assert stored["amount"] == expected and result["amount"] == float(expected)
+
+
+def _shared(fake, w, amount, who="omar"):
+    from utils import riyadh_today
+
+    fake.seed("transactions", [{
+        "id": str(uuid.uuid4()), "household_id": w.hid, "user_id": w.users[who], "amount": amount, "merchant": "x",
+        "category_code": "OPEX-MISC", "spent_by": "me", "timestamp": f"{riyadh_today().isoformat()}T09:00:00+00:00",
+        "raw_sms": "", "source": "chat", "beneficiary_type": "household", "beneficiary_id": "household",
+        "is_settlement": False, "settlement_target_id": None, "nafaqah_class": None, "nafaqah_spouse_id": None,
+        "line_items": [],
+    }])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("amount, ratio", [(0.01, 0.5), (0.03, 0.5), (100.01, 0.3), (10.0, 1 / 3)])
+def test_v1_shares_sum_to_the_total(api, fake_supabase, w, amount, ratio):
+    _shared(fake_supabase, w, amount)
+    s = api.get(f"/households/{w.hid}/settlement", params={"split_ratio": ratio}, headers=w.hdr("omar")).json()
+    assert round(s["fair_share_me"] + s["fair_share_partner"], 2) == round(amount, 2), s
+
+
+def test_v1_roommate_settled_threshold_is_one_halala(api, fake_supabase, w):
+    _shared(fake_supabase, w, 0.30)  # Ahmed owes Omar 0.15
+    s = api.get(f"/households/{w.hid}/settlement", headers=w.hdr("omar")).json()
+    assert s["who_owes"] == "partner_owes_me" and s["settlement_amount"] == 0.15, s
+    v2 = api.get(f"/households/{w.hid}/settlement-v2", headers=w.hdr("omar")).json()
+    assert [(d["from_id"], d["amount"]) for d in v2["pairwise_debts"]] == [(w.users["ahmed"], 0.15)]
+
+
+def test_installment_amounts_round_half_up():
+    from installment_service import calculate_installment_terms
+
+    terms = calculate_installment_terms(0.5, installment_count=4)  # 0.125 per month
+    assert terms["monthly_amount"] == 0.13 and terms["remaining_amount"] == 0.37
+    assert calculate_installment_terms(10.005, installment_count=1)["total_amount"] == 10.01
+
+
+def test_v1_half_halala_balance_rounds_half_up(api, fake_supabase, w):
+    _shared(fake_supabase, w, 0.01)  # Ahmed owes Omar half a halala
+    s = api.get(f"/households/{w.hid}/settlement", headers=w.hdr("omar")).json()
+    assert s["who_owes"] == "partner_owes_me" and s["settlement_amount"] == 0.01, s
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_fable_r2_receipt_memory.py b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_r2_receipt_memory.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8a70eb2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_r2_receipt_memory.py
@@ -0,0 +1,127 @@
+"""
+FABLE2-API-03: receipt stitching memory for formats without a reduced-size decode.
+
+JPEG draft mode bounds a baseline JPEG's decode, but PNG, WebP and progressive JPEG pages are
+always decoded at full size (two blank 40 MP WebP pages raised peak RSS by ~680 MiB, PNG ~380 MiB,
+progressive JPEG ~175 MiB). Those pages are capped lower (12 MP each, 24 MP together), checked
+from the headers before decoding, and at most two stitches decode at once in the process.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import base64
+import io
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import textwrap
+import threading
+import time
+
+import pytest
+from PIL import Image
+
+import receipt_scanner as rs
+
+AI_SERVICE = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+
+
+def _b64(kind: str, size) -> str:
+    img = Image.new("RGB", size, (255, 255, 255))
+    buf = io.BytesIO()
+    if kind == "webp":
+        img.save(buf, "WEBP", quality=30)
+    elif kind == "png":
+        img.save(buf, "PNG", optimize=True)
+    else:
+        img.save(buf, "JPEG", quality=30, progressive=(kind == "pjpeg"))
+    return base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode()
+
+
+def test_caps():
+    assert rs.MAX_RECEIPT_PIXELS == 40_000_000  # baseline JPEG (draft-mode decode)
+    assert rs.MAX_FULL_DECODE_PIXELS == 12_000_000
+    assert rs.MAX_COMBINED_FULL_DECODE_PIXELS == 24_000_000
+    assert rs.MAX_CONCURRENT_STITCHES == 2
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["png", "webp", "pjpeg"])
+def test_full_decode_formats_are_capped_per_page(kind):
+    with pytest.raises(rs.ReceiptImageTooLarge):
+        rs.validate_receipt_images([_b64(kind, (4000, 3001))])  # 12.004 MP
+    rs.validate_receipt_images([_b64(kind, (4000, 3000))])      # exactly 12 MP
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["png", "webp", "pjpeg"])
+def test_full_decode_formats_are_capped_together(kind):
+    page = _b64(kind, (4000, 3000))
+    rs.validate_receipt_images([page, page])                    # 24 MP
+    with pytest.raises(rs.ReceiptImageTooLarge):
+        rs.validate_receipt_images([page, page, _b64(kind, (100, 100))])
+
+
+def test_baseline_jpeg_keeps_the_draft_mode_limits():
+    big = _b64("jpeg", (6000, 6660))  # 39.96 MP
+    rs.validate_receipt_images([big, big])
+    # A baseline page does not count against the full-decode budget.
+    rs.validate_receipt_images([big, _b64("png", (4000, 3000)), _b64("webp", (4000, 3000))])
+
+
+def test_at_most_two_stitches_decode_at_once(monkeypatch):
+    active, peak, lock = [0], [0], threading.Lock()
+    real = rs._decode_page
+
+    def slow_decode(raw, target):
+        with lock:
+            active[0] += 1
+            peak[0] = max(peak[0], active[0])
+        time.sleep(0.05)
+        try:
+            return real(raw, target)
+        finally:
+            with lock:
+                active[0] -= 1
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rs, "_decode_page", slow_decode)
+    page = _b64("jpeg", (200, 300))
+    threads = [threading.Thread(target=rs.stitch_images_vertically, args=([page, page],)) for _ in range(6)]
+    for t in threads:
+        t.start()
+    for t in threads:
+        t.join()
+    assert 1 <= peak[0] <= rs.MAX_CONCURRENT_STITCHES
+
+
+def test_stitch_output_unchanged_for_full_decode_pages():
+    out = rs.stitch_images_vertically([_b64("webp", (3000, 4000)), _b64("png", (800, 600))])
+    img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(out))
+    assert img.mode == "RGB" and img.width == 1600
+    assert img.height == round(4000 * 1600 / 3000) + round(600 * 1600 / 800)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind, budget_mib", [("webp", 300), ("png", 250), ("pjpeg", 200)])
+def test_stitch_peak_memory_at_the_caps(kind, budget_mib, tmp_path):
+    """The reviewer's method: RSS high-water mark gained in a fresh interpreter while stitching
+    two pages at the per-page cap (before: 2 x 40 MP WebP +684 MiB, PNG +378, progressive +175)."""
+    if sys.platform == "win32":
+        pytest.skip("resource module is Unix-only")
+    page_file = tmp_path / "page.b64"
+    page_file.write_text(_b64(kind, (4000, 3000)))
+    script = textwrap.dedent(f"""
+        import resource, sys
+        import dotenv
+        dotenv.load_dotenv = lambda *a, **k: False
+        sys.path.insert(0, {AI_SERVICE!r})
+        import receipt_scanner
+        page = open({str(page_file)!r}).read()
+        receipt_scanner.validate_receipt_images([page, page])
+        before = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss
+        receipt_scanner.stitch_images_vertically([page, page])
+        after = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss
+        print((after - before) // 1024)
+    """)
+    env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k not in ("SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY", "SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")}
+    res = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-c", script], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120,
+                         env=env, cwd=str(tmp_path))
+    assert res.returncode == 0, res.stderr[-2000:]
+    gained = int(res.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1])
+    assert gained < budget_mib, f"{kind}: stitching raised peak RSS by {gained} MiB"
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_fable_r2_recurring_toggle_bounds.py b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_r2_recurring_toggle_bounds.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..0192e5c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_r2_recurring_toggle_bounds.py
@@ -0,0 +1,77 @@
+"""
+FABLE2-API-02: /budgets/recurring-bills/toggle wrote member-supplied keys into the admin-only
+budgets row without bounds (a 500 kB ``sub_code`` per request grew budgets.sub_allocations without
+limit). ``category_code`` / ``sub_code`` are Code fields (1-60 characters) and ``sub_code`` must be
+an allocation key of that budget or a known sub-category of that category: 422 otherwise.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+from fable_world import World
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def api():
+    from main import app
+
+    with TestClient(app) as c:
+        yield c
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def w(api, fake_supabase):
+    w = World(fake_supabase, {"ahmed": ("admin", "peer"), "omar": ("member", "peer")})
+    fake_supabase.seed("cost_control_codes", [
+        {"id": "c-util", "code": "OPEX-UTILITIES", "category": "Utilities", "keywords": ["stc"],
+         "is_flexible": False, "household_id": None, "is_system": True},
+    ])
+    fake_supabase.seed("cost_control_sub_categories", [
+        {"parent_code": "OPEX-UTILITIES", "sub_code": "water_municipal", "name_en": "Water", "name_ar": "ماء"},
+        {"parent_code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "sub_code": "meat", "name_en": "Meat", "name_ar": "لحم"},
+    ])
+    r = api.post("/budgets/sub-allocations", json={
+        "household_id": w.hid, "category_code": "OPEX-UTILITIES", "sub_allocations": {"electricity_sec": 300},
+    }, headers=w.hdr("ahmed"))
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return w
+
+
+def _toggle(api, w, who="omar", **body):
+    return api.post("/budgets/recurring-bills/toggle", json={"household_id": w.hid, "is_recurring": True, **body},
+                    headers=w.hdr(who))
+
+
+def _config(fake):
+    budget = next(b for b in fake.tables["budgets"] if b["category_code"] == "OPEX-UTILITIES")
+    return budget["sub_allocations"].get("_recurring_config") or {}
+
+
+def test_oversized_codes_are_422(api, fake_supabase, w):
+    r = _toggle(api, w, category_code="OPEX-UTILITIES", sub_code="S" * 500_000)
+    assert r.status_code == 422
+    r = _toggle(api, w, category_code="X" * 100_000, sub_code="electricity_sec")
+    assert r.status_code == 422
+    r = _toggle(api, w, category_code="OPEX-UTILITIES", sub_code="S" * 61)
+    assert r.status_code == 422
+    r = _toggle(api, w, category_code="OPEX-UTILITIES", sub_code="")
+    assert r.status_code == 422
+    assert _config(fake_supabase) == {}
+
+
+def test_unknown_sub_code_is_422_and_nothing_is_stored(api, fake_supabase, w):
+    for sub in ("not_a_sub", "meat", "_recurring_config", "_meta"):
+        r = _toggle(api, w, category_code="OPEX-UTILITIES", sub_code=sub)
+        assert r.status_code == 422, (sub, r.text)
+    assert _config(fake_supabase) == {}
+
+
+def test_allocation_key_and_known_sub_category_are_accepted(api, fake_supabase, w):
+    r = _toggle(api, w, category_code="OPEX-UTILITIES", sub_code="electricity_sec", due_day=5)
+    assert r.status_code == 200 and r.json()["status"] == "success", r.text
+    r = _toggle(api, w, category_code="OPEX-UTILITIES", sub_code="water_municipal", is_recurring=False)
+    assert r.status_code == 200 and r.json()["status"] == "success", r.text
+    cfg = _config(fake_supabase)
+    assert cfg["electricity_sec"] == {"enabled": True, "due_day": 5}
+    assert cfg["water_municipal"] == {"enabled": False}
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_fable_receipt_limits.py b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_receipt_limits.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..c365069
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_receipt_limits.py
@@ -0,0 +1,100 @@
+"""
+FABLE-API-02 (docs/review/audit/fable_review.md): receipt stitching amplified a small request
+(4 blank 6000x6660 JPEGs, 3.2 MiB) into ~1.7 GiB of RSS. Pages are now bounded in combined
+pixels and stitched-canvas height before anything is decoded (413), decoded in JPEG draft mode
+and downscaled to at most 1600 px wide one page at a time.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import base64
+import io
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import textwrap
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from PIL import Image
+
+from fable_world import World
+
+AI_SERVICE = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+
+
+def _jpeg_b64(w: int, h: int) -> str:
+    buf = io.BytesIO()
+    Image.new("RGB", (w, h), (255, 255, 255)).save(buf, format="JPEG", quality=30)
+    return base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def big_page():
+    return _jpeg_b64(6000, 6660)  # 39.96 MP, just under the per-photo limit
+
+
+def test_reviewer_case_four_huge_pages_is_rejected_before_decoding(big_page):
+    import receipt_scanner
+
+    with pytest.raises(receipt_scanner.ReceiptImageTooLarge):
+        receipt_scanner.validate_receipt_images([big_page] * 4)
+    # One such page alone is still a valid upload.
+    receipt_scanner.validate_receipt_images([big_page])
+
+
+def test_stitched_canvas_height_is_capped():
+    import receipt_scanner
+
+    tall = _jpeg_b64(800, 10000)  # becomes 1600 x 20000 when widened to the canvas: 20400 in total
+    with pytest.raises(receipt_scanner.ReceiptImageTooLarge):
+        receipt_scanner.validate_receipt_images([_jpeg_b64(1600, 400), tall])
+
+
+def test_stitched_pages_are_downscaled_to_a_bounded_width(big_page):
+    import receipt_scanner
+
+    out = receipt_scanner.stitch_images_vertically([big_page, big_page])
+    img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(out))
+    assert img.width == receipt_scanner.STITCH_MAX_WIDTH == 1600
+    assert img.height == 2 * round(6660 * 1600 / 6000)
+    assert img.height <= receipt_scanner.MAX_STITCHED_HEIGHT
+
+
+def test_stitching_peak_memory_is_bounded(big_page, tmp_path):
+    """Measured in a fresh interpreter: the RSS high-water mark gained while stitching two
+    40 MP pages (the old code needed ~0.85 GiB for two, ~1.7 GiB for four)."""
+    if sys.platform == "win32":
+        pytest.skip("resource module is Unix-only")
+    img_file = tmp_path / "page.b64"
+    img_file.write_text(big_page)
+    script = textwrap.dedent(f"""
+        import resource, sys
+        import dotenv
+        dotenv.load_dotenv = lambda *a, **k: False
+        sys.path.insert(0, {AI_SERVICE!r})
+        import receipt_scanner
+        page = open({str(img_file)!r}).read()
+        receipt_scanner.validate_receipt_images([page, page])
+        before = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss
+        receipt_scanner.stitch_images_vertically([page, page])
+        after = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss
+        print((after - before) // 1024)
+    """)
+    env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k not in ("SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY", "SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")}
+    res = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-c", script], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120,
+                         env=env, cwd=str(tmp_path))
+    assert res.returncode == 0, res.stderr[-2000:]
+    gained_mib = int(res.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1])
+    assert gained_mib < 200, f"stitching raised peak RSS by {gained_mib} MiB"
+
+
+def test_scan_route_answers_413_for_oversized_pages(fake_supabase, big_page):
+    from main import app
+
+    w = World(fake_supabase, {"ahmed": ("admin", "peer")})
+    with TestClient(app) as api:
+        r = api.post("/agent/scan-receipt", json={"household_id": w.hid, "images_base64": [big_page] * 4},
+                     headers=w.hdr("ahmed"))
+    assert r.status_code == 413, r.text
+    assert not fake_supabase.tables.get("transactions")
+    assert not fake_supabase.storage_objects
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_fable_sub_allocations_metadata.py b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_sub_allocations_metadata.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..aa07026
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_sub_allocations_metadata.py
@@ -0,0 +1,90 @@
+"""
+FABLE-API-07 (docs/review/audit/fable_review.md): the recurring-bill configuration is stored inside
+budgets.sub_allocations["_recurring_config"]; adding/removing a sub-category then failed with 500
+(float() of a dict) and saving sub-allocations erased the configuration. ``_``-prefixed keys are
+metadata: skipped by every numeric path and preserved on save (clients cannot write them).
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+from fable_world import World
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def api():
+    from main import app
+
+    with TestClient(app) as c:
+        yield c
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def w(fake_supabase, api):
+    w = World(fake_supabase, {"ahmed": ("admin", "peer"), "omar": ("member", "peer")})
+    fake_supabase.seed("cost_control_codes", [
+        {"id": "c-util", "code": "OPEX-UTILITIES", "category": "Utilities", "keywords": ["stc"],
+         "is_flexible": False, "household_id": None, "is_system": True},
+        {"id": "c-home", "code": "CUSTOM-HOME", "category": "Home", "keywords": [],
+         "is_flexible": False, "household_id": w.hid, "is_system": False},
+    ])
+    r = api.post("/budgets/sub-allocations", json={
+        "household_id": w.hid, "category_code": "OPEX-UTILITIES",
+        "sub_allocations": {"electricity_sec": 300, "fiber_internet": 250},
+    }, headers=w.hdr("ahmed"))
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    r = api.post("/budgets/recurring-bills/toggle", json={
+        "household_id": w.hid, "category_code": "OPEX-UTILITIES", "sub_code": "electricity_sec",
+        "is_recurring": True, "due_day": 5, "custom_name": "SEC bill",
+    }, headers=w.hdr("omar"))
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return w
+
+
+def _subs(fake):
+    return next(b for b in fake.tables["budgets"] if b["category_code"] == "OPEX-UTILITIES")["sub_allocations"]
+
+
+def test_add_sub_category_keeps_working_and_keeps_the_config(api, fake_supabase, w):
+    r = api.post("/budgets/sub-categories", json={
+        "household_id": w.hid, "parent_code": "OPEX-UTILITIES", "name_en": "Water", "sub_code": "water_municipal",
+        "allocated_amount": 120,
+    }, headers=w.hdr("ahmed"))
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.json()["allocated_amount"] == 670.0
+    subs = _subs(fake_supabase)
+    assert subs["water_municipal"] == 120.0
+    assert subs["_recurring_config"]["electricity_sec"]["due_day"] == 5
+
+
+def test_remove_sub_category_keeps_working_and_keeps_the_config(api, fake_supabase, w):
+    r = api.delete("/budgets/sub-categories", params={
+        "household_id": w.hid, "parent_code": "OPEX-UTILITIES", "sub_code": "fiber_internet",
+    }, headers=w.hdr("ahmed"))
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    row = next(b for b in fake_supabase.tables["budgets"] if b["category_code"] == "OPEX-UTILITIES")
+    assert row["allocated_amount"] == 300.0
+    assert "fiber_internet" not in row["sub_allocations"]
+    assert row["sub_allocations"]["_recurring_config"]["electricity_sec"]["due_day"] == 5
+
+
+def test_saving_sub_allocations_preserves_the_config(api, fake_supabase, w):
+    r = api.post("/budgets/sub-allocations", json={
+        "household_id": w.hid, "category_code": "OPEX-UTILITIES",
+        "sub_allocations": {"electricity_sec": 310, "fiber_internet": 250},
+    }, headers=w.hdr("ahmed"))
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.json()["allocated_amount"] == 560.0
+    assert _subs(fake_supabase)["_recurring_config"]["electricity_sec"]["due_day"] == 5
+    assert _subs(fake_supabase)["electricity_sec"] == 310.0
+
+
+def test_clients_cannot_write_metadata_keys(api, fake_supabase, w):
+    r = api.post("/budgets/sub-allocations", json={
+        "household_id": w.hid, "category_code": "OPEX-UTILITIES",
+        "sub_allocations": {"electricity_sec": 300, "_recurring_config": 1},
+    }, headers=w.hdr("ahmed"))
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.json()["allocated_amount"] == 300.0
+    assert isinstance(_subs(fake_supabase)["_recurring_config"], dict)
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_fable_sub_categories.py b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_sub_categories.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5e9e4fb
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_sub_categories.py
@@ -0,0 +1,168 @@
+"""
+FABLE-API-04, FABLE-API-05 and FABLE-API-08 (docs/review/audit/fable_review.md).
+
+Sub-category definitions have no household column. Households can therefore no longer create
+definitions under a SYSTEM category through the API (only allocate to the seeded ones), keywords
+shorter than 3 characters are never stored or matched, keyword matching only considers seeded
+system definitions plus definitions under a custom category the transaction's household owns
+alone, and rename/purge need the caller's household to be the sole owner of the parent code.
+Every refusal uses one message, so the answers reveal nothing about other households' codes.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+from fable_world import World, zatca_qr
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def api():
+    from main import app
+
+    with TestClient(app) as c:
+        yield c
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def seeded(fake_supabase):
+    fake_supabase.seed("cost_control_codes", [{
+        "id": "c1", "code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "category": "Groceries", "keywords": ["panda", "tamimi"],
+        "is_flexible": True, "household_id": None, "is_system": True,
+    }])
+    fake_supabase.seed("cost_control_sub_categories", [
+        {"parent_code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "sub_code": "meat", "name_en": "Meat", "name_ar": "لحوم", "keywords": ["meat", "لحم"]},
+    ])
+    return fake_supabase
+
+
+def _two_households(fake):
+    a = World(fake, {"attacker": ("admin", "peer"), "a2": ("member", "peer")})
+    b = World(fake, {"victim": ("admin", "peer"), "v2": ("member", "peer")})
+    return a, b
+
+
+# ─── FABLE-API-04 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def test_no_new_definitions_under_a_system_category(api, seeded):
+    from salary_cycle import SUB_CATEGORY_FORBIDDEN
+
+    a, _ = _two_households(seeded)
+    r = api.post("/budgets/sub-categories",
+                 json={"household_id": a.hid, "parent_code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "name_en": "e", "sub_code": "sub-planted-by-a"},
+                 headers=a.hdr("attacker"))
+    assert r.status_code == 403 and r.json()["detail"] == SUB_CATEGORY_FORBIDDEN
+    assert [s["sub_code"] for s in seeded.tables["cost_control_sub_categories"]] == ["meat"]
+    # Allocating to a seeded system sub-category is still allowed.
+    r = api.post("/budgets/sub-categories",
+                 json={"household_id": a.hid, "parent_code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "name_en": "Meat", "sub_code": "meat",
+                       "allocated_amount": 150},
+                 headers=a.hdr("attacker"))
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.json()["sub_allocations"]["meat"] == 150.0
+
+
+def test_planted_definition_no_longer_reclassifies_other_households(api, seeded):
+    """A definition planted before this fix (live data) under a system parent with a one-letter
+    keyword: B's ZATCA receipt is no longer filed under it."""
+    a, b = _two_households(seeded)
+    seeded.seed("cost_control_sub_categories", [{
+        "parent_code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "sub_code": "sub-planted-by-a", "name_en": "e", "name_ar": "e", "keywords": ["e"],
+    }])
+    r = api.post("/agent/scan-receipt", json={"household_id": b.hid, "qr_code_raw": zatca_qr("115.00", vat="15.00")},
+                 headers=b.hdr("victim"))
+    assert r.status_code == 200 and r.json()["status"] == "success", r.text
+    tx = next(t for t in seeded.tables["transactions"] if t["household_id"] == b.hid)
+    assert tx["category_code"] == "OPEX-GROCERY"
+    assert tx.get("sub_category") != "sub-planted-by-a"
+
+
+def test_match_sub_category_scope_and_keyword_length(seeded):
+    from salary_cycle import match_sub_category
+
+    a, b = _two_households(seeded)
+    seeded.seed("cost_control_codes", [
+        {"id": "c2", "code": "CUSTOM-PETS", "category": "Pets", "household_id": a.hid, "is_system": False},
+    ])
+    seeded.seed("cost_control_sub_categories", [
+        {"parent_code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "sub_code": "planted", "name_en": "x", "name_ar": "x", "keywords": ["chicken"]},
+        {"parent_code": "CUSTOM-PETS", "sub_code": "cat_food", "name_en": "Cat food", "name_ar": "x", "keywords": ["whiskas"]},
+        {"parent_code": "CUSTOM-PETS", "sub_code": "short", "name_en": "x", "name_ar": "x", "keywords": ["ab"]},
+    ])
+    # Seeded system definitions match for everyone; a planted one under a system parent never does.
+    assert match_sub_category("OPEX-GROCERY", "fresh meat", None, household_id=b.hid) == "meat"
+    assert match_sub_category("OPEX-GROCERY", "grilled chicken", None, household_id=b.hid) != "planted"
+    # A custom category's definitions only for the household that owns it.
+    assert match_sub_category("CUSTOM-PETS", "whiskas 4kg", None, household_id=a.hid) == "cat_food"
+    assert match_sub_category("CUSTOM-PETS", "whiskas 4kg", None, household_id=b.hid) is None
+    # Keywords shorter than 3 characters never match.
+    assert match_sub_category("CUSTOM-PETS", "ab ab ab", None, household_id=a.hid) is None
+
+
+def test_short_names_store_no_keyword(api, seeded):
+    a, _ = _two_households(seeded)
+    r = api.post(f"/households/{a.hid}/categories/custom", json={"code": "PETS", "category": "Pets"},
+                 headers=a.hdr("attacker"))
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    r = api.post("/budgets/sub-categories",
+                 json={"household_id": a.hid, "parent_code": "CUSTOM-PETS", "name_en": "e", "sub_code": "e1"},
+                 headers=a.hdr("attacker"))
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    row = next(s for s in seeded.tables["cost_control_sub_categories"] if s["sub_code"] == "e1")
+    assert row["keywords"] == []
+
+
+# ─── FABLE-API-05 / FABLE-API-08 ──────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def test_colliding_custom_code_cannot_rename_the_other_households_sub_category(api, seeded):
+    from salary_cycle import SUB_CATEGORY_FORBIDDEN
+
+    a, b = _two_households(seeded)
+    for w, who in ((b, "victim"), (a, "attacker")):
+        r = api.post(f"/households/{w.hid}/categories/custom", json={"code": "RENT", "category": "Rent"},
+                     headers=w.hdr(who))
+        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    seeded.seed("cost_control_sub_categories", [
+        {"parent_code": "CUSTOM-RENT", "sub_code": "villa", "name_en": "Villa Riyadh", "name_ar": "x", "keywords": ["villa"]},
+    ])
+    r = api.patch("/budgets/sub-categories",
+                  json={"parent_code": "CUSTOM-RENT", "sub_code": "villa", "name_en": "PWNED by A", "name_ar": "x"},
+                  headers=a.hdr("attacker"))
+    assert r.status_code == 403 and r.json()["detail"] == SUB_CATEGORY_FORBIDDEN
+    assert seeded.tables["cost_control_sub_categories"][-1]["name_en"] == "Villa Riyadh"
+    # Nor can either of them add definitions under the shared code.
+    r = api.post("/budgets/sub-categories",
+                 json={"household_id": a.hid, "parent_code": "CUSTOM-RENT", "name_en": "Flat"},
+                 headers=a.hdr("attacker"))
+    assert r.status_code == 403 and r.json()["detail"] == SUB_CATEGORY_FORBIDDEN
+
+
+def test_sole_owner_admin_can_still_rename(api, seeded):
+    a, _ = _two_households(seeded)
+    assert api.post(f"/households/{a.hid}/categories/custom", json={"code": "SCHOOL", "category": "School"},
+                    headers=a.hdr("attacker")).status_code == 200
+    seeded.seed("cost_control_sub_categories", [
+        {"parent_code": "CUSTOM-SCHOOL", "sub_code": "books", "name_en": "Books", "name_ar": "x", "keywords": ["books"]},
+    ])
+    r = api.patch("/budgets/sub-categories", json={"parent_code": "CUSTOM-SCHOOL", "sub_code": "books", "name_en": "Textbooks"},
+                  headers=a.hdr("attacker"))
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    # A plain member of the owning household gets the same refusal as everyone else.
+    r = api.patch("/budgets/sub-categories", json={"parent_code": "CUSTOM-SCHOOL", "sub_code": "books", "name_en": "X"},
+                  headers=a.hdr("a2"))
+    from salary_cycle import SUB_CATEGORY_FORBIDDEN
+
+    assert r.status_code == 403 and r.json()["detail"] == SUB_CATEGORY_FORBIDDEN
+
+
+def test_rename_is_not_an_existence_oracle(api, seeded):
+    a, b = _two_households(seeded)
+    assert api.post(f"/households/{b.hid}/categories/custom", json={"code": "SCHOOL", "category": "School"},
+                    headers=b.hdr("victim")).status_code == 200
+    body = {"sub_code": "x", "name_en": "y"}
+    answers = [
+        api.patch("/budgets/sub-categories", json={**body, "parent_code": code}, headers=a.hdr("attacker"))
+        for code in ("CUSTOM-NOPE", "CUSTOM-SCHOOL", "OPEX-GROCERY")
+    ]
+    assert {r.status_code for r in answers} == {403}
+    assert len({r.json()["detail"] for r in answers}) == 1, [r.text for r in answers]
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_fable_ux12_amount_edits.py b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_ux12_amount_edits.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..c191a5b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_fable_ux12_amount_edits.py
@@ -0,0 +1,155 @@
+"""
+UX-12 (docs/review/audit/ux_review.md): the user corrects the amount (and, for a receipt, the
+category) in the review card before saving. The correction travels with the preview_token
+commit as optional ``amount`` / ``category_code`` fields, validated like every other edit; the
+signed preview is not re-parsed and the model is not called again. Requests without them keep
+the parsed values (installed apps are unaffected).
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import base64
+import io
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from PIL import Image
+
+import preview_token as pt
+from fable_world import World
+from main import app
+from test_fable_product_r6_preview_token import CHAT_PARSE, LLM, RECEIPT_PARSE, _codes
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def api():
+    return TestClient(app)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def _fresh_key(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.delenv("PREVIEW_TOKEN_SECRET", raising=False)
+    pt.reset_preview_token_key()
+    yield
+    pt.reset_preview_token_key()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def flat(fake_supabase):
+    _codes(fake_supabase)
+    return World(fake_supabase, {"ahmed": ("admin", "peer"), "omar": ("member", "peer")})
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def family(fake_supabase):
+    _codes(fake_supabase)
+    w = World(fake_supabase, {"husband": ("admin", "provider"), "wife": ("member", "spouse")})
+    fake_supabase.tables["households"][0]["nafaqah_provider_user_id"] = w.users["husband"]
+    return w
+
+
+def _jpeg() -> str:
+    buf = io.BytesIO()
+    Image.new("RGB", (40, 60), (250, 250, 250)).save(buf, "JPEG")
+    return base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode()
+
+
+def _txs(fake):
+    return fake.tables.get("transactions", [])
+
+
+def _chat(api, w, who, **body):
+    payload = {"household_id": w.hid, "message": "Albaik broast 46 riyal", "allow_duplicate": True}
+    payload.update(body)
+    return api.post("/agent/chat-transaction", json=payload, headers=w.hdr(who))
+
+
+def _receipt(api, w, who, **body):
+    payload = {"household_id": w.hid, "allow_duplicate": True}
+    payload.update(body)
+    return api.post("/agent/scan-receipt", json=payload, headers=w.hdr(who))
+
+
+def test_chat_commit_stores_the_corrected_amount_without_a_second_llm_call(api, flat, fake_supabase, monkeypatch):
+    llm = LLM(monkeypatch, dict(CHAT_PARSE, total_amount=816.0, items=[{"name": "Broast", "quantity": 1, "price": 816.0}]))
+    token = _chat(api, flat, "ahmed", preview_only=True).json()["preview_token"]
+    res = _chat(api, flat, "ahmed", preview_token=token, amount=186)
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    body = res.json()
+    assert body["status"] == "success" and body["amount"] == 186.0
+    (row,) = _txs(fake_supabase)
+    assert row["amount"] == 186.0
+    # A single line item that was the whole amount follows the correction.
+    assert [i["price"] for i in row["items"]] == [186.0]
+    assert len(llm.calls) == 1
+
+
+def test_chat_amount_is_rounded_to_halalas(api, flat, fake_supabase, monkeypatch):
+    LLM(monkeypatch, CHAT_PARSE)
+    token = _chat(api, flat, "ahmed", preview_only=True).json()["preview_token"]
+    res = _chat(api, flat, "ahmed", preview_token=token, amount=12.345)
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    assert _txs(fake_supabase)[-1]["amount"] == 12.35
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad", [0, -5, "abc", True, 10_000_001, float("inf")])
+def test_chat_invalid_amount_is_422_and_nothing_is_stored(api, flat, fake_supabase, monkeypatch, bad):
+    LLM(monkeypatch, CHAT_PARSE)
+    token = _chat(api, flat, "ahmed", preview_only=True).json()["preview_token"]
+    if bad == float("inf"):
+        import json as _json
+
+        res = api.post(
+            "/agent/chat-transaction",
+            content=_json.dumps({"household_id": flat.hid, "message": "Albaik broast 46 riyal", "allow_duplicate": True,
+                                 "preview_token": token, "amount": 1e400}),
+            headers={**flat.hdr("ahmed"), "Content-Type": "application/json"},
+        )
+    else:
+        res = _chat(api, flat, "ahmed", preview_token=token, amount=bad)
+    assert res.status_code == 422, res.text
+    assert _txs(fake_supabase) == []
+
+
+def test_chat_without_amount_keeps_the_parsed_amount(api, flat, fake_supabase, monkeypatch):
+    LLM(monkeypatch, CHAT_PARSE)
+    token = _chat(api, flat, "ahmed", preview_only=True).json()["preview_token"]
+    assert _chat(api, flat, "ahmed", preview_token=token).status_code == 200
+    assert _txs(fake_supabase)[-1]["amount"] == 46.0
+
+
+def test_chat_corrected_amount_keeps_the_family_rules(api, family, fake_supabase, monkeypatch):
+    LLM(monkeypatch, CHAT_PARSE)
+    token = _chat(api, family, "wife", preview_only=True).json()["preview_token"]
+    res = _chat(api, family, "wife", preview_token=token, amount=60, nafaqah_class="wife_reimbursable")
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    row = _txs(fake_supabase)[-1]
+    assert row["amount"] == 60.0 and row["nafaqah_class"] == "wife_reimbursable"
+
+
+def test_receipt_commit_stores_the_corrected_amount_and_category(api, flat, fake_supabase, monkeypatch):
+    llm = LLM(monkeypatch, RECEIPT_PARSE)
+    token = _receipt(api, flat, "ahmed", images_base64=[_jpeg()], preview_only=True).json()["preview_token"]
+    res = _receipt(api, flat, "ahmed", preview_token=token, amount=85.25, category_code="OPEX-SHOPPING")
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    assert res.json()["amount"] == 85.25
+    (row,) = _txs(fake_supabase)
+    assert row["amount"] == 85.25 and row["category_code"] == "OPEX-SHOPPING"
+    # Several scanned lines stay as scanned.
+    assert [i["name"] for i in row["items"]] == ["Milk", "Rice 5kg"]
+    assert len(llm.calls) == 1
+
+
+def test_receipt_unknown_category_or_bad_amount_is_422(api, flat, fake_supabase, monkeypatch):
+    LLM(monkeypatch, RECEIPT_PARSE)
+    token = _receipt(api, flat, "ahmed", images_base64=[_jpeg()], preview_only=True).json()["preview_token"]
+    assert _receipt(api, flat, "ahmed", preview_token=token, category_code="OPEX-NOPE").status_code == 422
+    assert _receipt(api, flat, "ahmed", preview_token=token, amount=-1).status_code == 422
+    assert _txs(fake_supabase) == []
+
+
+def test_receipt_without_edits_keeps_the_scanned_values(api, flat, fake_supabase, monkeypatch):
+    LLM(monkeypatch, RECEIPT_PARSE)
+    token = _receipt(api, flat, "ahmed", images_base64=[_jpeg()], preview_only=True).json()["preview_token"]
+    assert _receipt(api, flat, "ahmed", preview_token=token).status_code == 200
+    row = _txs(fake_supabase)[-1]
+    assert row["amount"] == 82.5 and row["category_code"] == "OPEX-GROCERY"
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_final_review_backend.py b/ai_service/tests/test_final_review_backend.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..bf9c556
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_final_review_backend.py
@@ -0,0 +1,401 @@
+"""
+Final backend review (docs/review/audit/final_review_backend.md), FR-B findings.
+
+The in-memory fake runs with the real ``public.transactions`` column list (live and the local
+rebuild agree; see docs/review/audit/live_db_preflight.md, MOB-03: there is no ``paid_by`` /
+``beneficiary`` / ``notes`` column), so a query naming a column that does not exist fails here
+the way PostgREST fails in production instead of silently succeeding.
+
+Requests carry real HS256 JWTs (this module is excluded from the conftest auth mock), so
+membership and admin checks are real.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import time
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from decimal import Decimal
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from jose import jwt
+
+from fakes import FakeSchemaError
+from main import app
+
+TEST_SECRET = "super-secret-test-jwt-key-32bytes-long!"
+ISSUER = "https://mockproject.supabase.co/auth/v1"
+
+# public.transactions columns on live and in the local rebuild (information_schema order).
+TRANSACTION_COLUMNS = {
+    "id", "household_id", "user_id", "amount", "currency", "merchant", "category_code", "timestamp",
+    "raw_sms", "is_reallocated", "reallocated_from_budget_id", "created_at", "source", "items",
+    "receipt_url", "dedup_fingerprint", "spent_by", "sub_category", "cycle_key", "qr_code_raw",
+    "beneficiary_type", "beneficiary_id", "is_settlement", "settlement_target_id", "line_items",
+    "account_id", "nafaqah_class", "nafaqah_spouse_id",
+}
+
+ROOM = "aaaa0000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000f1"
+FAMILY = "bbbb0000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000f2"
+A = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000f1"  # roommate admin
+B = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000f2"  # roommate member
+C = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000f3"  # roommate member
+OUTSIDER = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000f9"
+HUSBAND = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000e1"
+WIFE = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000e2"
+
+NOW = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+
+
+def bearer(sub: str) -> dict:
+    now = int(time.time())
+    claims = {"sub": sub, "aud": "authenticated", "iss": ISSUER, "role": "authenticated", "iat": now, "exp": now + 3600}
+    return {"Authorization": f"Bearer {jwt.encode(claims, TEST_SECRET, algorithm='HS256')}"}
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def db(fake_supabase):
+    fake_supabase.schemas["transactions"] = set(TRANSACTION_COLUMNS)
+    fake_supabase.seed("users", [
+        {"id": A, "household_id": ROOM, "role": "admin", "financial_role": "peer", "display_name": "A"},
+        {"id": B, "household_id": ROOM, "role": "member", "financial_role": "peer", "display_name": "B"},
+        {"id": C, "household_id": ROOM, "role": "member", "financial_role": "peer", "display_name": "C"},
+        {"id": HUSBAND, "household_id": FAMILY, "role": "admin", "financial_role": "provider", "display_name": "H"},
+        {"id": WIFE, "household_id": FAMILY, "role": "member", "financial_role": "spouse", "display_name": "W"},
+    ])
+    fake_supabase.seed("household_memberships", [
+        {"household_id": ROOM, "user_id": A, "financial_role": "peer", "role": "admin", "created_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"},
+        {"household_id": ROOM, "user_id": B, "financial_role": "peer", "role": "member", "created_at": "2026-01-02T00:00:00+00:00"},
+        {"household_id": ROOM, "user_id": C, "financial_role": "peer", "role": "member", "created_at": "2026-01-03T00:00:00+00:00"},
+        {"household_id": FAMILY, "user_id": HUSBAND, "financial_role": "provider", "role": "admin", "created_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"},
+        {"household_id": FAMILY, "user_id": WIFE, "financial_role": "spouse", "role": "member", "created_at": "2026-01-02T00:00:00+00:00"},
+    ])
+    fake_supabase.seed("households", [
+        {"id": ROOM, "name": "Room", "payday_day": 27, "owner_user_id": A, "nafaqah_provider_user_id": A},
+        {"id": FAMILY, "name": "Family", "payday_day": 27, "owner_user_id": HUSBAND, "nafaqah_provider_user_id": HUSBAND},
+    ])
+    return fake_supabase
+
+
+def test_strict_fake_rejects_unknown_transaction_columns(db):
+    """Guard for the guard: the schema-aware fake really fails on a missing column."""
+    with pytest.raises(FakeSchemaError):
+        db.table("transactions").select("id, paid_by").execute()
+    with pytest.raises(FakeSchemaError):
+        db.table("transactions").insert({"household_id": ROOM, "notes": "x"}).execute()
+
+
+# ─── FR-B-01: roommate settlement recording ───────────────────────────────────
+
+def _settle(payer, recipient, amount=30.0, caller=None):
+    return client.post(
+        f"/households/{ROOM}/reimbursements",
+        headers=bearer(caller or payer),
+        json={"household_id": ROOM, "payer_id": payer, "recipient_id": recipient, "amount": amount,
+              "payment_method": "stc_pay", "notes": "B paid A"},
+    )
+
+
+def test_roommate_settlement_is_recorded_with_existing_columns(db):
+    res = _settle(B, A, 30.0)
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    body = res.json()
+    assert body["status"] == "success" and body["is_settlement"] is True
+    rows = [t for t in db.tables["transactions"] if t.get("is_settlement")]
+    assert len(rows) == 1
+    row = rows[0]
+    assert set(row) <= TRANSACTION_COLUMNS
+    assert row["user_id"] == B  # the verified caller is the creator (DB-18)
+    assert row["settlement_target_id"] == A and row["beneficiary_id"] == A
+    assert row["category_code"] is None  # a settlement is not spending in any budget category
+    assert row["source"] == "manual"
+    assert f"PaidBy: {B}" in row["raw_sms"]
+    assert Decimal(str(row["amount"])) == Decimal("30.00")
+
+
+def test_roommate_settlement_parties_must_be_members(db):
+    res = _settle(B, OUTSIDER, 10.0)
+    assert res.status_code == 400
+    assert not db.tables.get("transactions")
+
+
+def test_roommate_settlement_appears_in_settlement_v2(db):
+    # A paid 90 for everyone (chat entry by A); B then pays A back 30.
+    db.seed("transactions", [{
+        "id": "r1", "household_id": ROOM, "user_id": A, "amount": 90.0, "timestamp": NOW,
+        "raw_sms": "Chat: groceries 90 | PaidBy: me | Beneficiary: both | SpentBy: me",
+        "beneficiary_type": "household", "is_settlement": False, "line_items": [],
+    }])
+    before = client.get(f"/households/{ROOM}/settlement-v2", headers=bearer(B), params={"cycle_start": "2000-01-01"})
+    assert before.status_code == 200, before.text
+    debts = {(d["from_id"], d["to_id"]): d["amount"] for d in before.json()["pairwise_debts"]}
+    assert debts == {(B, A): 30.0, (C, A): 30.0}
+
+    assert _settle(B, A, 30.0).status_code == 200
+    after = client.get(f"/households/{ROOM}/settlement-v2", headers=bearer(B), params={"cycle_start": "2000-01-01"})
+    debts = {(d["from_id"], d["to_id"]): d["amount"] for d in after.json()["pairwise_debts"]}
+    assert debts == {(C, A): 30.0}
+
+
+# ─── FR-B-02: settlement v2 reads only existing columns ───────────────────────
+
+def test_settlement_v2_roommate_debts_use_creator_as_payer(db):

+
+    db.seed("transactions", [
+        {"id": "r1", "household_id": ROOM, "user_id": B, "amount": 60.0, "timestamp": NOW,
+         "raw_sms": "Manual entry", "beneficiary_type": "household", "is_settlement": False},
+        {"id": "r2", "household_id": ROOM, "user_id": None, "amount": 99.0, "timestamp": NOW,
+         "raw_sms": "legacy row without creator or payer", "beneficiary_type": "household"},
+    ])

+    assert res["mode"] == "multi_roommate"
+    debts = {(d["from_id"], d["to_id"]): d["amount"] for d in res["pairwise_debts"]}
+    assert debts == {(A, B): 20.0, (C, B): 20.0}
+
+
+# ─── FR-B-03: /settlement honours the Nafaqah class on the real schema ───────
+
+def test_partner_settlement_reads_nafaqah_class(db):
+    from settlement_engine import calculate_partner_settlement
+
+    db.seed("transactions", [{

+        "category_code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "raw_sms": "Chat: groceries | PaidBy: me | Beneficiary: both",

+    assert res["shared_paid_by_partner"] == 100.0
+    assert res["shared_paid_by_me"] == 0.0
+    assert res["owed_to_partner"] == 100.0

+def test_partner_settlement_counts_recorded_roommate_settlements(db):

+    }])

+    res = calculate_partner_settlement(ROOM, cycle_start="2000-01-01", caller_user_id=A)

+    assert res["who_owes"] == "settled" and res["net_balance"] == 0.0

+def test_recalculate_budgets_ignores_settlements(db):

+# ─── FR-B-05: budget and category writes are admin-only, as in RLS ──────────
+
+def _budget_writes(household_id):
+    return [
+        ("post", "/budgets/categories", "add_category_and_budget",
+         {"json": {"household_id": household_id, "code": "OPEX-REVIEW", "category": "Review", "allocated_amount": 100}}),
+        ("post", "/budgets/sub-allocations", "save_sub_allocations",
+         {"json": {"household_id": household_id, "category_code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "sub_allocations": {"sub-veg": 50}}}),
+        ("post", "/budgets/sub-categories", "add_sub_category_for_household",
+         {"json": {"household_id": household_id, "parent_code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "name_en": "Veg",
+                   "sub_code": "vegetables_fruit", "allocated_amount": 20}}),
+        ("delete", "/budgets/sub-categories", "remove_sub_category_for_household",
+         {"params": {"household_id": household_id, "parent_code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "sub_code": "sub-veg"}}),
+        ("delete", "/budgets/categories/OPEX-GROCERY", "archive_category_for_household",
+         {"params": {"household_id": household_id}}),
+    ]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("index", range(5))
+def test_members_cannot_write_budgets(db, index):
+    method, path, worker, kwargs = _budget_writes(ROOM)[index]
+    with patch(f"routes.budgets.{worker}", return_value={"status": "success"}) as work:
+        res = getattr(client, method)(path, headers=bearer(B), **kwargs)
+    assert res.status_code == 403, res.text
+    work.assert_not_called()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("index", range(5))
+def test_admins_can_write_budgets(db, index):
+    # Under a system category only the seeded sub-categories can be allocated (E2E-05, FABLE-API-04).
+    db.seed("cost_control_codes", [{"id": "c-groc", "code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "category": "Groceries",
+                                    "keywords": [], "is_flexible": False, "household_id": None, "is_system": True}])
+    method, path, worker, kwargs = _budget_writes(ROOM)[index]
+    with patch(f"routes.budgets.{worker}", return_value={"status": "success"}) as work:
+        res = getattr(client, method)(path, headers=bearer(A), **kwargs)
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    work.assert_called_once()
+
+
+# ─── FR-B-06: budget reallocation goes through the hardened RPC only ─────────
+
+class _DbError(Exception):
+    def __init__(self, message, code):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.message, self.code = message, code
+
+
+def _seed_budgets(fake):
+    fake.seed("budgets", [
+        {"id": "b-from", "household_id": ROOM, "allocated_amount": 100.0},
+        {"id": "b-to", "household_id": ROOM, "allocated_amount": 20.1},
+    ])
+
+
+def test_reallocation_sends_an_exact_two_decimal_amount(db):
+    from supabase_client import reallocate_budget
+
+    _seed_budgets(db)
+
+    def rpc(params):  # the 20261020030000 RPC refuses sub-halala amounts with 22023
+        if Decimal(str(params["p_amount"])) != Decimal(str(params["p_amount"])).quantize(Decimal("0.01")):
+            raise _DbError("Reallocation amount must be positive with at most 2 decimals", "22023")
+        return None
+
+    db.rpc_handlers["reallocate_budget"] = rpc
+    deficit = 50.3 - 20.1  # 30.199999999999996 in binary floating point
+    assert reallocate_budget("b-from", "b-to", deficit) is True
+    assert db.rpc_calls[-1] == ("reallocate_budget", {"p_from_id": "b-from", "p_to_id": "b-to", "p_amount": "30.20"})
+
+
+def test_refused_reallocation_never_falls_back_to_unchecked_updates(db):
+    from supabase_client import reallocate_budget
+
+    _seed_budgets(db)
+
+    def rpc(_params):
+        raise _DbError("Insufficient allocation: 100.00 available, 500.00 requested", "22000")
+
+    db.rpc_handlers["reallocate_budget"] = rpc
+    assert reallocate_budget("b-from", "b-to", 500.0) is False
+    assert [b["allocated_amount"] for b in db.tables["budgets"]] == [100.0, 20.1]
+
+
+def test_chat_marks_reallocation_only_when_it_happened(db):
+    from chat_parser import ChatLineItem, ParsedChatExpense, process_chat_transaction
+    from models import BudgetRow
+
+    parsed = ParsedChatExpense(merchant="Panda", total_amount=50.0, category_code="OPEX-GROCERY",
+                               items=[ChatLineItem(name="milk", price=50.0, quantity=1)], is_transaction=True)
+    budget = BudgetRow(id="b-to", household_id=ROOM, month="2026-10-01", category_code="OPEX-GROCERY",
+                       allocated_amount=20.0, spent_amount=0.0, remaining_amount=20.0)
+    flexible = BudgetRow(id="b-from", household_id=ROOM, month="2026-10-01", category_code="OPEX-DINING",
+                         allocated_amount=100.0, spent_amount=0.0, remaining_amount=100.0)
+    with patch("chat_parser.parse_chat_expense", return_value=parsed), \
+            patch("chat_parser.fetch_budget", return_value=budget), \
+            patch("chat_parser.fetch_flexible_budgets", return_value=[flexible]), \
+            patch("chat_parser.reallocate_budget", return_value=False), \
+            patch("chat_parser.insert_transaction", return_value="tx-1") as insert:
+        process_chat_transaction(household_id=ROOM, message="Panda 50", user_id=A, allow_duplicate=True)
+    assert insert.call_args.kwargs["is_reallocated"] is False
+    assert insert.call_args.kwargs["reallocated_from_budget_id"] is None
+

+def test_insert_transaction_fits_the_schema_first_time(db, caplog):

+
+    with caplog.at_level("WARNING", logger="supabase_client"):

+def test_receipt_commit_records_who_paid_in_the_audit_tags(db, monkeypatch):
+    from receipt_scanner import process_receipt_scan
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr("receipt_scanner.parse_receipt_image", lambda *_a, **_k: {
+        "merchant": "Panda", "total_amount": 60.0, "items": [{"name": "rice", "quantity": 1, "price": 60.0}],
+    })
+    monkeypatch.setattr("receipt_scanner.fetch_budget", lambda *_a, **_k: None)
+    import base64
+    import io
+
+    from PIL import Image
+
+    buf = io.BytesIO()
+    Image.new("RGB", (4, 4)).save(buf, format="PNG")
+    image = base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode()
+    # 'partner' must name someone: a two-member flat (FABLE-API-01 / FABLE-LOGIC-03).
+    db.tables["household_memberships"] = [m for m in db.tables["household_memberships"] if m["user_id"] != C]
+    res = process_receipt_scan(household_id=ROOM, images_base64=[image], user_id=B, allow_duplicate=True,
+                               paid_by="partner", beneficiary="both")
+    assert res["status"] == "success", res
+    row = next(t for t in db.tables["transactions"] if t["id"] == res["transaction_id"])
+    assert row["raw_sms"].startswith("PaidBy: partner | Beneficiary: both")
+    # Structured attribution, which the settlement engines read.
+    assert row["spent_by"] == "partner"
+    assert (row["beneficiary_type"], row["beneficiary_id"]) == ("household", "household")

+# ─── FR-B-09: one LiteLLM model default for every module ─────────────────────
+
+def test_every_llm_call_uses_the_same_default_model(monkeypatch):
+    import re
+    from pathlib import Path
+
+    import utils
+
+    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+    env_example = (root / ".env.example").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    assert f"LITELLM_MODEL={utils.DEFAULT_LITELLM_MODEL}" in env_example
+    compose = (root / "docker-compose.yml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    assert f"LITELLM_MODEL:-{utils.DEFAULT_LITELLM_MODEL}" in compose
+    for name in ("chat_parser.py", "receipt_scanner.py", "support_agent.py"):
+        source = (root / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+        # No module carries its own fallback model string any more.
+        assert not re.search(r"LITELLM_MODEL\"\s*,\s*\"", source), name
+        assert "litellm_model()" in source, name
+
+    monkeypatch.delenv("LITELLM_MODEL", raising=False)
+    assert utils.litellm_model() == utils.DEFAULT_LITELLM_MODEL
+    monkeypatch.setenv("LITELLM_MODEL", "  gemini/override  ")
+    assert utils.litellm_model() == "gemini/override"
+
+

+    b_view = calculate_partner_settlement(ROOM, cycle_start="2000-01-01", caller_user_id=B)
+    assert a_view["who_owes"] == "partner_owes_me" and a_view["settlement_amount"] == 50.0
+    assert b_view["who_owes"] == "me_owes_partner" and b_view["settlement_amount"] == 50.0
