+# ─── Chat ingestion classification ───────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def _llm_down():
+    return patch("chat_parser.litellm.completion", side_effect=RuntimeError("offline"))
+
+
+def _chat(user, message, household=HH, **extra):
+    body = {"household_id": household, "message": message, "allow_duplicate": True}
+    body.update(extra)
+    with _llm_down(), patch("chat_parser.fetch_budget", return_value=None):
+        return client.post("/agent/chat-transaction", headers=bearer(user), json=body)
+
+
+def _last_tx(fake):
+    return fake.tables["transactions"][-1]
+
+
+def test_chat_wife_personal_purchase_goes_to_allowance(family):
+    resp = _chat(WIFE, "اشتريت لنفسي عطر بـ 250 ريال")
+    assert resp.status_code == 200, resp.text
+    assert resp.json()["nafaqah_class"] == ns.WIFE_PERSONAL
+    tx = _last_tx(family)
+    assert tx["nafaqah_class"] == ns.WIFE_PERSONAL and tx["nafaqah_spouse_id"] == WIFE
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("message", [
+    "دفعت فاتورة البيت 300 ريال",
+    "اشتريت أغراض البيت من بنده بـ 180 ريال",
+    "اشتريت ملابس للعيال بـ 220 ريال",
+])
+def test_chat_wife_shared_payment_is_husband_debt(family, message):
+    resp = _chat(WIFE, message)
+    assert resp.status_code == 200, resp.text
+    tx = _last_tx(family)
+    assert tx["nafaqah_class"] == ns.WIFE_REIMBURSABLE and tx["nafaqah_spouse_id"] == WIFE
+
+
+def test_chat_husband_paying_household_is_plain_expense(family):
+    resp = _chat(HUSBAND, "دفعت فاتورة البيت 300 ريال")
+    assert resp.status_code == 200
+    tx = _last_tx(family)
+    assert tx.get("nafaqah_class") is None and tx.get("nafaqah_spouse_id") is None
+
+
+def test_chat_husband_records_wife_paid_shared(family):
+    resp = _chat(HUSBAND, "دفعت زوجتي مقاضي البيت 150 ريال")
+    assert resp.status_code == 200
+    tx = _last_tx(family)
+    assert tx["nafaqah_class"] == ns.WIFE_REIMBURSABLE and tx["nafaqah_spouse_id"] == WIFE

+# ─── External review (Gemini) HIGH 1 / HIGH 2 / MEDIUM 5: postgrest-py behaviour ────────
+
+def _postgrest_error(status_code: int, body: dict):
+    """The APIError the installed postgrest-py raises for a PostgREST error response."""
+    import httpx
+    from postgrest import SyncPostgrestClient
+    from postgrest.exceptions import APIError
+
+    transport = httpx.MockTransport(lambda _req: httpx.Response(status_code, json=body))
+    pg = SyncPostgrestClient(
+        "http://postgrest.invalid", http_client=httpx.Client(transport=transport, base_url="http://postgrest.invalid")
+    )
+    with pytest.raises(APIError) as caught:
+        pg.rpc("record_spouse_reimbursement", {"p_amount": "1.00"}).execute()
+    return caught.value
+
+
+def _missing_response_maybe_single(self):
+    """postgrest-py 0.14-1.0 (allowed by supabase>=2.5.0): 0 rows unless PostgREST's detail
+    text matches exactly, and any other error, surface as this APIError instead of None."""
+    from postgrest.exceptions import APIError
+
+    raise APIError({"message": "Missing response", "code": "204", "hint": None, "details": None})
+
+
+def test_allowance_lookup_does_not_rely_on_maybe_single(family, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(type(family.table("member_allowances")), "maybe_single", _missing_response_maybe_single)
+    st = ns.get_allowance(ns.load_family_context(HH), WIFE, "2026-11")
+    assert st["is_set"] is False and st["remaining"] == -1700.0
+    ns.set_allowance(ns.load_family_context(HH), HUSBAND, WIFE, Decimal("1500"), "2026-11")
+    assert ns.get_allowance(ns.load_family_context(HH), WIFE, "2026-11")["allocated"] == 1500.0
+    # The husband is still resolved through the primary admin lookup.
+    assert ns.load_family_context(HH).husband_id == HUSBAND
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("status_code,body,expected", [
+    (400, {"code": "22023", "details": None, "hint": "overpayment",
+           "message": "Reimbursement of 600.00 exceeds the outstanding balance of 500.50"}, ns.OverpaymentError),
+    (403, {"code": "42501", "details": None, "hint": None,
+           "message": "Forbidden: only the husband, the wife or a household admin can record a reimbursement"},
+     ns.NafaqahForbidden),
+    (403, {"code": "42501", "details": None, "hint": None, "message": "Not authenticated"}, ns.NafaqahForbidden),
+    (400, {"code": "22023", "details": None, "hint": None, "message": "Unsupported payment method x"},
+     ns.InvalidNafaqahRequest),
+    (409, {"code": "23503", "details": None, "hint": None, "message": "nafaqah_spouse_id is not a spouse member"},
+     ns.InvalidNafaqahRequest),
+])
+def test_db_errors_from_real_postgrest_exceptions_are_mapped(status_code, body, expected):
+    exc = _postgrest_error(status_code, body)
+    assert isinstance(ns._map_db_error(exc), expected)
+    # The same error re-raised as a plain exception (dict argument or its str()) still maps.
+    assert isinstance(ns._map_db_error(Exception(dict(body))), expected)
+    assert isinstance(ns._map_db_error(RuntimeError(str(exc))), expected)
+
+
+def test_unmapped_db_errors_pass_through():
+    exc = _postgrest_error(400, {"code": "P0001", "details": None, "hint": None, "message": "boom"})
+    assert ns._map_db_error(exc) is exc
+    plain = RuntimeError("connection reset")
+    assert ns._map_db_error(plain) is plain
+
+
+def test_rpc_overpayment_race_returns_409(family):
+    """The service pre-check passed but the locked RPC refused: the APIError maps to 409."""
+    def refuse(_params):
+        raise _postgrest_error(400, {"code": "22023", "hint": "overpayment", "details": None,
+                                     "message": "Reimbursement of 10.00 exceeds the outstanding balance of 0.00"})
+
+    family.rpc_handlers["record_spouse_reimbursement"] = refuse
+    resp = client.post(f"/households/{HH}/nafaqah/reimbursements", headers=bearer(HUSBAND),
+                       json={"amount": 10, "payment_method": "cash"})
+    assert resp.status_code == 409, resp.text
+
+

+    ns.set_allowance(ctx, HUSBAND, WIFE, "1234567890.10", "2026-11")
+    amounts = {name: params["p_amount"] for name, params in family.rpc_calls}
+    assert amounts == {"record_spouse_reimbursement": "123.40", "set_member_allowance": "1234567890.10"}
+

+# ─── External review (Gemini) HIGH 4: chat class vs. edited paid_by / beneficiary ───────

+SECOND_WIFE = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000aa"

+def _add_second_wife(fake):
+    fake.seed("users", [{"id": SECOND_WIFE, "household_id": HH, "role": "member", "financial_role": "spouse",
+                         "display_name": "Mona"}])

+                                         "created_at": "2026-02-01T00:00:00+00:00"}])

+def _tx_count(fake):
+    return len(fake.tables.get("transactions", []))
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("user,paid_by,beneficiary,stale_class", [
+    (WIFE, "partner", "both", "wife_reimbursable"),  # edited to "my husband paid"
+    (WIFE, "me", "both", "wife_personal"),           # edited from "for me" to shared
+    (WIFE, "me", "me", "wife_reimbursable"),         # edited from shared to "for me"
+    (WIFE, "me", "both", "none"),                    # wife paid shared: never silently a gift
+    (HUSBAND, "me", "both", "wife_reimbursable"),    # the husband paid
+])
+def test_chat_class_contradicting_explicit_attribution_is_rejected(family, user, paid_by, beneficiary, stale_class):
+    before = _tx_count(family)
+    resp = _chat(user, "دفعت فاتورة البيت 300 ريال", paid_by=paid_by, beneficiary=beneficiary, nafaqah_class=stale_class)
+    assert resp.status_code == 422, resp.text
+    assert _tx_count(family) == before
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("user,paid_by,beneficiary,cls", [
+    (WIFE, "me", "both", "wife_reimbursable"),
+    (WIFE, "me", "me", "wife_personal"),
+    (WIFE, "partner", "both", "none"),
+    (HUSBAND, "partner", "both", "wife_reimbursable"),
+    (HUSBAND, "partner", "partner", "wife_personal"),
+    (HUSBAND, "me", "partner", "none"),
+])
+def test_chat_consistent_class_and_attribution_are_stored(family, user, paid_by, beneficiary, cls):
+    resp = _chat(user, "دفعت فاتورة البيت 300 ريال", paid_by=paid_by, beneficiary=beneficiary, nafaqah_class=cls)
+    assert resp.status_code == 200, resp.text
+    tx = _last_tx(family)
+    expected = None if cls == "none" else cls
+    assert tx.get("nafaqah_class") == expected
+    assert tx.get("nafaqah_spouse_id") == (WIFE if expected else None)
+    assert _attribution(tx) == (paid_by, beneficiary)
+
+
+def _attribution(tx):
+    """(paid_by, beneficiary) as stored: raw_sms audit tags (no such columns exist)."""
+    from settlement_engine import audit_tag
+
+    assert "paid_by" not in tx and "beneficiary" not in tx
+    return audit_tag(tx["raw_sms"], "paidby"), audit_tag(tx["raw_sms"], "beneficiary")

+def test_chat_class_without_attribution_recomputes_paid_by_and_beneficiary(family):

+# ─── External review (Gemini) BLOCKER 5: Nafaqah on scanned receipts ────────────────────
+
+def _zatca_qr(total: str = "150.00") -> str:
+    import base64
+
+    def tlv(tag: int, value: str) -> bytes:
+        raw = value.encode()
+        return bytes([tag, len(raw)]) + raw
+
+    return base64.b64encode(
+        tlv(1, "Panda Supermarket") + tlv(2, "300012345600003") + tlv(3, "2026-10-04T12:00:00Z")
+        + tlv(4, total) + tlv(5, "19.57")
+    ).decode()
+
+
+def _scan(user, household=HH, **extra):
+    body = {"household_id": household, "qr_code_raw": _zatca_qr(), "allow_duplicate": True}
+    body.update(extra)
+    with patch("receipt_scanner.fetch_budget", return_value=None):
+        return client.post("/agent/scan-receipt", headers=bearer(user), json=body)
+
+
+def test_receipt_preview_carries_the_nafaqah_suggestion(family):
+    body = _scan(WIFE, preview_only=True).json()
+    assert body["status"] == "preview"
+    assert body["household_mode"] == "family_nafaqah" and body["recorder_role"] == "wife"
+    assert body["nafaqah_class"] == ns.WIFE_REIMBURSABLE and body["nafaqah_spouse_id"] == WIFE
+    assert (body["paid_by"], body["beneficiary"]) == ("me", "both")
+    assert [w["id"] for w in body["wives"]] == [WIFE]
+    assert "transactions" not in family.tables or all(t["id"] != body.get("transaction_id") for t in family.tables["transactions"])
+
+
+def test_wife_scanned_shared_receipt_is_husband_debt(family):
+    resp = _scan(WIFE)
+    assert resp.status_code == 200, resp.text
+    assert resp.json()["nafaqah_class"] == ns.WIFE_REIMBURSABLE
+    tx = _last_tx(family)
+    assert tx["source"] == "receipt_scan"
+    assert tx["nafaqah_class"] == ns.WIFE_REIMBURSABLE and tx["nafaqah_spouse_id"] == WIFE
+    ledger = ns.get_reimbursement_ledger(ns.load_family_context(HH), WIFE)
+    assert ledger["balance"]["outstanding"] == 650.5  # 500.50 seeded + 150 scanned
+
+
+def test_wife_scanned_personal_receipt_is_charged_to_her_allowance(family):
+    resp = _scan(WIFE, paid_by="me", beneficiary="me", nafaqah_class="wife_personal")
+    assert resp.status_code == 200, resp.text
+    tx = _last_tx(family)
+    assert tx["nafaqah_class"] == ns.WIFE_PERSONAL and tx["nafaqah_spouse_id"] == WIFE
+    st = ns.get_allowance(ns.load_family_context(HH), WIFE, tx["cycle_key"])
+    assert st["transaction_count"] >= 1 and tx["amount"] == 150.0
+
+
+def test_husband_scanned_receipt_is_plain_household_expense(family):
+    resp = _scan(HUSBAND)
+    assert resp.status_code == 200
+    tx = _last_tx(family)
+    assert tx.get("nafaqah_class") is None and tx.get("nafaqah_spouse_id") is None
+
+
+def test_receipt_husband_records_second_wife_payment(family):
+    _add_second_wife(family)
+    assert _scan(HUSBAND, paid_by="partner", beneficiary="both", nafaqah_class="wife_reimbursable").status_code == 422
+    resp = _scan(HUSBAND, paid_by="partner", beneficiary="both", nafaqah_class="wife_reimbursable",
+                 nafaqah_spouse_id=SECOND_WIFE)
+    assert resp.status_code == 200, resp.text
+    assert _last_tx(family)["nafaqah_spouse_id"] == SECOND_WIFE
+
+
+def test_receipt_rejects_contradicting_or_unknown_class(family):
+    before = _tx_count(family)
+    assert _scan(WIFE, paid_by="partner", beneficiary="both", nafaqah_class="wife_reimbursable").status_code == 422
+    assert _scan(WIFE, nafaqah_class="split_50_50").status_code == 422
+    assert _tx_count(family) == before
+
+
+def test_receipt_roommates_never_classified(family):
+    resp = _scan(PEER1, household=HH_ROOM, nafaqah_class="wife_reimbursable")
+    assert resp.status_code == 200
+    assert _last_tx(family).get("nafaqah_class") is None and resp.json()["nafaqah_class"] is None
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_nafaqah_household_roles.py b/ai_service/tests/test_nafaqah_household_roles.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..6794205
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_nafaqah_household_roles.py
@@ -0,0 +1,288 @@
+"""
+Household roles and the explicit Nafaqah provider (Fable review, migration 20261020800000).
+
+FABLE-LOGIC-01: the financial role is per membership. A wife who joins a roommate flat stays the
+wife of her family; a spouse who joins a flat by code is a roommate there.
+FABLE-LOGIC-04: the husband is households.nafaqah_provider_user_id (default: the primary admin;
+an admin changes it to a non-spouse member); never inferred from roles or admin rights.
+FABLE-LOGIC-02: the database guard's refusal (HINT ledger_would_be_overpaid) maps to HTTP 409,
+and the ledger balance exposes ``overpaid``.
+
+Requests carry real HS256 JWTs (the module name keeps it out of the conftest auth mock), and
+membership is resolved from the in-memory FakeSupabaseClient.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import time
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from jose import jwt
+
+import nafaqah_service as ns
+from household_permissions import list_members
+from main import app
+from routes.nafaqah import nafaqah_http_error
+from settlement_engine import calculate_settlement_v2
+
+TEST_SECRET = "super-secret-test-jwt-key-32bytes-long!"
+ISSUER = "https://mockproject.supabase.co/auth/v1"
+
+FAMILY = "aaaa0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"
+FLAT = "aaaa0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002"
+SON_HOUSE = "aaaa0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003"
+HUSBAND = "0000aaaa-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a"
+WIFE = "0000aaaa-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b"
+SON = "0000aaaa-0000-4000-8000-00000000000c"
+MATE1 = "0000aaaa-0000-4000-8000-0000000000f1"
+MATE2 = "0000aaaa-0000-4000-8000-0000000000f2"
+OTHER_WIFE = "0000aaaa-0000-4000-8000-0000000000e1"
+OUTSIDER = "0000aaaa-0000-4000-8000-0000000000d1"
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+
+
+def bearer(sub: str) -> dict:
+    now = int(time.time())
+    claims = {"sub": sub, "aud": "authenticated", "iss": ISSUER, "role": "authenticated", "iat": now, "exp": now + 3600}
+    return {"Authorization": f"Bearer {jwt.encode(claims, TEST_SECRET, algorithm='HS256')}"}
+
+
+def _m(user_id, household_id, role, financial_role, day):
+    return {"user_id": user_id, "household_id": household_id, "role": role, "financial_role": financial_role,
+            "created_at": f"2026-01-0{day}T00:00:00+00:00"}
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def homes(fake_supabase):
+    # users.financial_role is only the cache of the ACTIVE household: the wife's active household
+    # is the flat ('peer' there), the other wife's cache says 'spouse' from her own family.
+    fake_supabase.seed("users", [
+        {"id": HUSBAND, "household_id": FAMILY, "role": "admin", "financial_role": "provider", "display_name": "Ahmed"},
+        {"id": WIFE, "household_id": FLAT, "role": "member", "financial_role": "peer", "display_name": "Sara"},
+        {"id": SON, "household_id": SON_HOUSE, "role": "admin", "financial_role": "provider", "display_name": "Fahad"},
+        {"id": MATE1, "household_id": FLAT, "role": "admin", "financial_role": "peer", "display_name": "Ali"},
+        {"id": MATE2, "household_id": FLAT, "role": "member", "financial_role": "peer", "display_name": "Saad"},
+        {"id": OTHER_WIFE, "household_id": FLAT, "role": "member", "financial_role": "spouse", "display_name": "Huda"},
+        {"id": OUTSIDER, "household_id": None, "role": "member", "financial_role": "provider", "display_name": "Omar"},
+    ])
+    fake_supabase.seed("household_memberships", [
+        _m(HUSBAND, FAMILY, "admin", "provider", 1),
+        _m(WIFE, FAMILY, "member", "spouse", 2),
+        _m(SON, FAMILY, "member", "family_member", 3),
+        _m(MATE1, FLAT, "admin", "peer", 1),
+        _m(MATE2, FLAT, "member", "peer", 2),
+        _m(WIFE, FLAT, "member", "peer", 3),        # the wife also shares a flat
+        _m(OTHER_WIFE, FLAT, "member", "peer", 4),  # a spouse elsewhere, joined the flat by code
+        _m(SON, SON_HOUSE, "admin", "provider", 1),  # the son created his own household
+        _m(HUSBAND, SON_HOUSE, "member", "family_member", 2),
+        _m(WIFE, SON_HOUSE, "member", "spouse", 3),
+    ])
+    fake_supabase.seed("households", [
+        {"id": FAMILY, "payday_day": 27, "owner_user_id": HUSBAND, "nafaqah_provider_user_id": HUSBAND},
+        {"id": FLAT, "payday_day": 27, "owner_user_id": MATE1, "nafaqah_provider_user_id": MATE1},
+        {"id": SON_HOUSE, "payday_day": 27, "owner_user_id": SON, "nafaqah_provider_user_id": SON},
+    ])
+    fake_supabase.seed("transactions", [
+        {"id": "adv", "household_id": FAMILY, "amount": 100.0, "merchant": "Panda", "cycle_key": "2026-11",
+         "timestamp": "2026-11-10T09:00:00+00:00", "nafaqah_class": "wife_reimbursable", "nafaqah_spouse_id": WIFE},
+    ])
+    fake_supabase.seed("spouse_reimbursements", [
+        {"id": "r1", "household_id": FAMILY, "wife_user_id": WIFE, "amount": 130.0, "payment_method": "cash",
+         "created_at": "2026-11-12T09:00:00+00:00"},
+    ])
+
+    def set_provider(params):
+        for h in fake_supabase.tables["households"]:
+            if h["id"] == params["p_household_id"]:
+                previous = h.get("nafaqah_provider_user_id")
+                h["nafaqah_provider_user_id"] = params["p_user_id"]
+                return {"success": True, "household_id": h["id"], "nafaqah_provider_user_id": params["p_user_id"],
+                        "previous_provider_user_id": previous}
+        raise AssertionError("unknown household")
+
+    fake_supabase.rpc_handlers["set_nafaqah_provider"] = set_provider
+    return fake_supabase
+
+
+# ─── FABLE-LOGIC-01: per-household roles ──────────────────────────────────────
+
+def test_wife_in_a_flat_stays_the_wife_of_her_family(homes):
+    family = ns.load_family_context(FAMILY)
+    assert family.is_family and [w["id"] for w in family.wives] == [WIFE]
+    assert family.husband_id == HUSBAND
+
+    flat = ns.load_family_context(FLAT)
+    assert not flat.is_family and flat.husband_id is None
+    assert {m["financial_role"] for m in flat.members.values()} == {"peer"}
+
+
+def test_flat_settles_as_roommates_despite_a_spouse_member_elsewhere(homes):
+    assert calculate_settlement_v2(FLAT)["mode"] == "multi_roommate"
+    assert calculate_settlement_v2(FAMILY)["mode"] == "family_nafaqah"
+
+
+def test_members_list_shows_the_role_in_that_household(homes):
+    flat = {m["user_id"]: m["financial_role"] for m in list_members(FLAT, MATE1)["members"]}
+    assert flat[WIFE] == "peer" and flat[OTHER_WIFE] == "peer"
+    family = {m["user_id"]: m["financial_role"] for m in list_members(FAMILY, HUSBAND)["members"]}
+    assert family[WIFE] == "spouse"
+
+
+def test_missing_membership_role_is_never_read_as_spouse(homes):
+    for m in homes.tables["household_memberships"]:
+        if m["household_id"] == FAMILY and m["user_id"] == WIFE:
+            del m["financial_role"]
+    ctx = ns.load_family_context(FAMILY)
+    assert not ctx.is_family and ctx.members[WIFE]["financial_role"] == "family_member"
+
+
+# ─── FABLE-LOGIC-04: explicit provider ────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def test_son_who_created_the_household_is_the_default_provider(homes):
+    ctx = ns.load_family_context(SON_HOUSE)
+    assert ctx.husband_id == SON and ctx.role_of(SON) == "husband" and ctx.role_of(HUSBAND) == "member"
+
+
+def test_admin_changes_the_provider_through_the_rpc(homes):
+    res = client.put(f"/households/{SON_HOUSE}/nafaqah/provider", headers=bearer(SON), json={"user_id": HUSBAND})
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    body = res.json()
+    assert body["provider_user_id"] == HUSBAND and body["previous_provider_user_id"] == SON
+    assert body["summary"]["husband"]["id"] == HUSBAND and body["summary"]["provider_user_id"] == HUSBAND
+    name, params = homes.rpc_calls[-1]
+    assert name == "set_nafaqah_provider"
+    assert params == {"p_household_id": SON_HOUSE, "p_user_id": HUSBAND, "p_actor_user_id": SON}
+    assert ns.load_family_context(SON_HOUSE).husband_id == HUSBAND
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("actor,target,status", [
+    (HUSBAND, HUSBAND, 403),   # a member (not an admin) of SON_HOUSE
+    (OUTSIDER, HUSBAND, 403),  # not a member at all
+    (SON, WIFE, 422),          # a wife cannot be the provider
+    (SON, MATE1, 422),         # not a member of this household
+])
+def test_provider_change_is_refused(homes, actor, target, status):
+    calls = len(homes.rpc_calls)
+    res = client.put(f"/households/{SON_HOUSE}/nafaqah/provider", headers=bearer(actor), json={"user_id": target})
+    assert res.status_code == status, res.text
+    assert len(homes.rpc_calls) == calls
+
+
+def test_provider_body_must_be_a_uuid(homes):
+    res = client.put(f"/households/{SON_HOUSE}/nafaqah/provider", headers=bearer(SON), json={"user_id": "husband"})
+    assert res.status_code == 422
+
+
+def test_database_refusal_of_the_provider_is_mapped(homes):
+    class FakeApiError(Exception):
+        code = "22023"
+        hint = "provider_is_spouse"
+
+    def refuse(_params):
+        raise FakeApiError("A spouse member cannot be the Nafaqah provider")
+
+    homes.rpc_handlers["set_nafaqah_provider"] = refuse
+    res = client.put(f"/households/{SON_HOUSE}/nafaqah/provider", headers=bearer(SON), json={"user_id": HUSBAND})
+    assert res.status_code == 422
+
+
+def test_family_without_provider_needs_one(homes):
+    for h in homes.tables["households"]:
+        if h["id"] == FAMILY:
+            h["nafaqah_provider_user_id"] = None
+    ctx = ns.load_family_context(FAMILY)
+    assert ctx.is_family and ctx.husband_id is None and ctx.needs_provider
+    body = client.get(f"/households/{FAMILY}/nafaqah", headers=bearer(HUSBAND)).json()
+    assert body["needs_provider"] is True and body["provider_user_id"] is None and body["husband"] is None
+    assert body["can_set_provider"] is True
+    # The settlement still never splits the spouses (no husband id: nothing he paid is a debt).
+    assert calculate_settlement_v2(FAMILY)["mode"] == "family_nafaqah"
+
+
+def test_a_wife_is_never_the_husband_even_if_stored_as_provider(homes):
+    for h in homes.tables["households"]:
+        if h["id"] == FAMILY:
+            h["nafaqah_provider_user_id"] = WIFE
+    assert ns.load_family_context(FAMILY).husband_id is None
+
+
+def test_members_list_exposes_the_provider(homes):
+    body = client.get(f"/households/{SON_HOUSE}/members", headers=bearer(SON)).json()
+    assert body["nafaqah_provider_user_id"] == SON and body["can_set_nafaqah_provider"] is True
+    assert {m["user_id"] for m in body["members"] if m["is_nafaqah_provider"]} == {SON}
+    member_view = client.get(f"/households/{SON_HOUSE}/members", headers=bearer(HUSBAND)).json()
+    assert member_view["can_set_nafaqah_provider"] is False
+
+
+# ─── FABLE-LOGIC-02: overpaid ledger ──────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def test_summary_exposes_overpaid_and_provider(homes):
+    body = client.get(f"/households/{FAMILY}/nafaqah", headers=bearer(WIFE)).json()
+    assert body["provider_user_id"] == HUSBAND and body["needs_provider"] is False
+    assert body["can_set_provider"] is False
+    balance = body["wives"][0]["reimbursement"]
+    assert balance["outstanding"] == 0.0 and balance["overpaid"] == 30.0
+
+
+def test_ledger_guard_refusal_maps_to_409():
+    class FakeApiError(Exception):
+        code = "22023"
+        hint = "ledger_would_be_overpaid"
+        message = "This change would leave the wife's reimbursement ledger overpaid: 200 SAR already repaid"
+
+    exc = FakeApiError(FakeApiError.message)
+    assert ns.is_ledger_overpaid_error(exc)
+    mapped = ns._map_db_error(exc)
+    assert isinstance(mapped, ns.LedgerWouldBeOverpaid)
+    http = nafaqah_http_error(mapped)
+    assert http.status_code == 409 and http.detail["code"] == "ledger_would_be_overpaid"
+
+
+def test_no_provider_refusal_maps_to_409():
+    class FakeApiError(Exception):
+        code = "23514"
+        hint = "no_nafaqah_provider"
+        message = "Household x has no Nafaqah provider"
+
+    mapped = ns._map_db_error(FakeApiError(FakeApiError.message))
+    assert isinstance(mapped, ns.NoProviderError)
+    http = nafaqah_http_error(mapped)
+    assert http.status_code == 409 and http.detail["code"] == "no_provider"
+
+
+def test_unrelated_errors_are_not_taken_for_the_ledger_guard():
+    assert not ns.is_ledger_overpaid_error(Exception("connection reset"))
+
+
+# ─── FABLE-LOGIC-06: wife_personal stays out of the category budgets ─────────
+
+def _seed_budget_case(fake):
+    fake.seed("budgets", [{"id": "b-shop", "household_id": FAMILY, "category_code": "OPEX-SHOPPING", "cycle_key": "2026-11",
+                           "month": "2026-11-01", "allocated_amount": 1000.0, "spent_amount": 0.0, "is_active": True}])
+    fake.seed("transactions", [
+        {"id": "abaya", "household_id": FAMILY, "amount": 400.0, "category_code": "OPEX-SHOPPING", "cycle_key": "2026-11",
+         "timestamp": "2026-11-05T09:00:00+00:00", "nafaqah_class": "wife_personal", "nafaqah_spouse_id": WIFE},
+        {"id": "towels", "household_id": FAMILY, "amount": 100.0, "category_code": "OPEX-SHOPPING", "cycle_key": "2026-11",
+         "timestamp": "2026-11-06T09:00:00+00:00"},
+    ])
+
+
+def test_budget_recalculation_skips_wife_personal(homes):
+    from installment_service import InstallmentService
+
+    _seed_budget_case(homes)
+    InstallmentService.recalculate_budgets(FAMILY, "2026-11")
+    budget = next(b for b in homes.tables["budgets"] if b["id"] == "b-shop")
+    assert budget["spent_amount"] == 100.0
+
+
+def test_cycle_breakdown_skips_wife_personal(homes):
+    from salary_cycle import get_cycle_breakdown
+
+    _seed_budget_case(homes)
+    homes.tables["budgets"][0]["spent_amount"] = 100.0  # what the database triggers keep
+    breakdown = get_cycle_breakdown(FAMILY, "2026-11")
+    shopping = next(c for c in breakdown["categories"] if c["category_code"] == "OPEX-SHOPPING")
+    assert shopping["spent_amount"] == 100.0

diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_postgrest_zero_rows.py b/ai_service/tests/test_postgrest_zero_rows.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..32748d0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_postgrest_zero_rows.py
@@ -0,0 +1,142 @@
+"""
+Zero-row lookups must not depend on postgrest-py's maybe_single() behaviour.
+
+- postgrest-py 2.x (installed: 2.33) returns ``None`` instead of a response when maybe_single()
+  matches no row, so ``resp.data`` raises AttributeError.
+- postgrest-py 0.19.1-1.1.x (still allowed: supabase 2.16.0 pins ``postgrest>0.19,<1.2``) asks the
+  server for a single object and only maps the error to ``None`` when its details text says
+  "The result contains 0 rows"; otherwise it raises APIError("Missing response").
+
+These tests drive the real installed supabase/postgrest client against a mocked PostgREST
+(``respx``; no network), plus the in-memory fake for the old-client failure mode.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import httpx
+import pytest
+import respx
+
+import auth
+import salary_cycle
+import supabase_client
+
+URL = "https://mockproject.supabase.co"
+HH = "aaaaaaaa-0000-4000-8000-000000000020"
+USER = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000c1"
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def real_client(monkeypatch):
+    """A real supabase client whose REST calls are answered from ``tables`` (empty by default)."""
+    from supabase import create_client
+
+    client = create_client(URL, "sb_secret_mock_value_for_tests_only")
+    tables: dict = {}
+    seen: list = []
+
+    def handler(request: httpx.Request):
+        table = request.url.path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
+        seen.append((table, dict(request.url.params)))
+        return httpx.Response(200, json=tables.get(table, []))
+
+    router = respx.mock(assert_all_called=False)
+    router.route(url__startswith=f"{URL}/rest/v1/").mock(side_effect=handler)
+    router.start()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(supabase_client, "_client", client)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(salary_cycle, "get_client", lambda: client)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(auth, "get_client", lambda: client)
+    yield tables, seen
+    router.stop()
+
+
+def test_installed_postgrest_maybe_single_returns_none_for_zero_rows(real_client):
+    """Documents the library behaviour the fixes guard against (``res.data`` is unsafe)."""
+    import postgrest
+
+    res = supabase_client.get_client().table("budgets").select("*").eq("id", "x").maybe_single().execute()
+    if int(postgrest.__version__.split(".")[0]) >= 2:
+        assert res is None  # 2.x: no response object at all
+    else:
+        # 0.19-1.1 request a single object; a real PostgREST answers 406, which becomes None or
+        # APIError depending on the error text. This mock answers 200 [], which yields data=[].
+        assert res is None or not res.data
+
+
+def test_first_row_returns_first_match_or_none(real_client):
+    tables, seen = real_client
+    query = lambda: supabase_client.get_client().table("households").select("payday_day").eq("id", HH)  # noqa: E731
+    assert supabase_client.first_row(query()) is None
+    tables["households"] = [{"payday_day": 10}]
+    assert supabase_client.first_row(query()) == {"payday_day": 10}
+    assert seen[-1][1].get("limit") == "1"
+
+
+def test_affordability_with_no_budget_row_for_the_category_does_not_crash(real_client, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(salary_cycle, "get_salary_cycle_forecast", lambda _hid: {
+        "total_remaining": 5000.0, "daily_remaining_allowance": 250.0,
+        "cycle": {"days_remaining": 20, "payday": "2026-11-27", "cycle_key": "2026-11"},
+    })
+    monkeypatch.setattr(salary_cycle, "fetch_flexible_budgets", lambda *a, **k: [])
+    res = salary_cycle.simulate_affordability(HH, 300.0, item_name="Shoes", category_code="OPEX-SHOPPING")
+    assert res["verdict"] in ("caution", "unaffordable")
+    assert res["target_amount"] == 300.0
+
+
+def test_affordability_reads_the_category_budget_of_the_current_cycle(real_client, monkeypatch):
+    tables, seen = real_client
+    tables["budgets"] = [{"category_code": "OPEX-SHOPPING", "cycle_key": "2026-11", "remaining_amount": 2000.0}]
+    monkeypatch.setattr(salary_cycle, "get_salary_cycle_forecast", lambda _hid: {
+        "total_remaining": 5000.0, "daily_remaining_allowance": 250.0,
+        "cycle": {"days_remaining": 20, "payday": "2026-11-27", "cycle_key": "2026-11"},
+    })
+    monkeypatch.setattr(salary_cycle, "fetch_flexible_budgets", lambda *a, **k: [])
+    res = salary_cycle.simulate_affordability(HH, 1200.0, item_name="iPad", category_code="OPEX-SHOPPING")
+    assert res["verdict"] == "comfortable"
+    budget_queries = [params for table, params in seen if table == "budgets"]
+    assert budget_queries[0].get("cycle_key") == "eq.2026-11"
+
+
+def test_missing_membership_is_no_access_with_the_real_client(real_client):
+    tables, _ = real_client
+    tables["users"] = [{"household_id": HH, "role": "admin"}]  # stale cache column
+    assert auth._get_user_membership(USER, HH) is None
+    tables["household_memberships"] = [{"role": "member", "household_id": HH}]
+    assert auth._get_user_membership(USER, HH) == {"role": "member", "household_id": HH}
+
+
+def test_old_client_zero_row_error_does_not_fall_back_to_stale_users_row(fake_supabase, monkeypatch):
+    """postgrest <= 1.1 raises on a zero-row maybe_single(); that must not reach the API-13 fallback."""
+    from fakes import FakeQuery
+
+    original_execute = FakeQuery.execute
+
+    def old_client_execute(self):
+        if self._maybe_single:
+            rows = [r for r in self._client.tables.get(self._table, []) if self._matches(r)]
+            if not rows:
+                raise RuntimeError("APIError: Missing response (code 204)")
+        return original_execute(self)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(FakeQuery, "execute", old_client_execute)
+    fake_supabase.seed("users", [{"id": USER, "household_id": HH, "role": "admin"}])
+    assert auth._get_user_membership(USER, HH) is None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("getter, expected", [
+    (supabase_client.get_household_payday, 27),
+    (supabase_client.get_household_income, 0.0),
+    (supabase_client.get_household_rollover_rule, supabase_client.DEFAULT_ROLLOVER_RULE),
+])
+def test_household_setting_getters_fall_back_cleanly_when_the_row_is_missing(real_client, getter, expected, caplog):
+    assert getter(HH) == expected
+
+
+def test_household_setting_getters_read_the_row_with_the_real_client(real_client):
+    tables, _ = real_client
+    tables["households"] = [{"payday_day": 10, "monthly_income": 12000, "rollover_rule": supabase_client.DEFAULT_ROLLOVER_RULE,
+                             "accumulated_savings": 50.5, "last_rollover_surplus": 5, "last_rollover_cycle": "2026-10"}]
+    assert supabase_client.get_household_payday(HH) == 10
+    assert supabase_client.get_household_income(HH) == 12000.0
+    state = supabase_client.get_household_savings_summary(HH)
+    assert state["accumulated_savings"] == 50.5 and state["last_rollover_cycle"] == "2026-10"
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_product_budget_recalc.py b/ai_service/tests/test_product_budget_recalc.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..be58b94
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_product_budget_recalc.py
@@ -0,0 +1,109 @@
+"""
+Product review 3.3 / 4.1: no full-history scan per insert.
+
+``insert_transaction`` used to call ``InstallmentService.recalculate_budgets`` after every insert,
+which selected every transaction of the household. The database triggers (BUG-02 and the
+20261020800000 / 20261020900000 budget triggers) already keep ``budgets.spent_amount`` current,
+so the insert no longer recalculates anything.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import supabase_client
+
+HH = "f860188e-23b5-4749-b180-868c956151a6"
+
+
+def test_insert_does_not_recalculate_budgets(fake_supabase, monkeypatch):
+    import installment_service
+
+    calls = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(installment_service.InstallmentService, "recalculate_budgets",
+                        classmethod(lambda cls, *a, **k: calls.append(a)))
+    fake_supabase.seed("households", [{"id": HH, "payday_day": 27}])
+    reads = []
+    import fakes
+
+    real_execute = fakes.FakeQuery.execute
+
+    def execute(self):
+        if self._table == "transactions" and self._op == "select":
+            reads.append(self._table)
+        return real_execute(self)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(fakes.FakeQuery, "execute", execute)
+    tx_id = supabase_client.insert_transaction(
+        household_id=HH, amount=25.0, currency="SAR", merchant="Albaik", category_code="OPEX-DINING",
+        timestamp="2026-10-21T10:00:00+00:00", raw_sms="Chat: test", sub_category="restaurants_dinners",
+    )
+    assert tx_id
+    assert calls == [], "insert_transaction must not recalculate budgets"
+    assert reads == [], "the insert read the transactions table"
+
+
+# ─── explicit recalculation: one cycle, SQL first ──────────────────────────────
+
+def _seed_two_cycles(fake):
+    fake.seed("households", [{"id": HH, "payday_day": 27}])
+    fake.seed("budgets", [
+        {"id": "b-nov", "household_id": HH, "category_code": "OPEX-DINING", "cycle_key": "2026-11",
+         "month": "2026-11-01", "allocated_amount": 500.0, "spent_amount": 999.0},
+        {"id": "b-oct", "household_id": HH, "category_code": "OPEX-DINING", "cycle_key": "2026-10",
+         "month": "2026-10-01", "allocated_amount": 500.0, "spent_amount": 777.0},
+    ])
+    fake.seed("transactions", [
+        {"id": "t1", "household_id": HH, "category_code": "OPEX-DINING", "cycle_key": "2026-11", "amount": 40.0},
+        {"id": "t2", "household_id": HH, "category_code": "OPEX-DINING", "cycle_key": "2026-11", "amount": 10.5},
+        {"id": "t3", "household_id": HH, "category_code": "OPEX-DINING", "cycle_key": "2026-11", "amount": 30.0,
+         "is_settlement": True},
+        {"id": "t4", "household_id": HH, "category_code": "OPEX-DINING", "cycle_key": "2026-11", "amount": 70.0,
+         "nafaqah_class": "wife_personal"},
+        {"id": "t5", "household_id": HH, "category_code": "OPEX-DINING", "cycle_key": "2026-10", "amount": 5.0},
+    ])
+
+
+def _budget(fake, bid):
+    return next(b for b in fake.tables["budgets"] if b["id"] == bid)
+
+
+def test_recalculation_uses_the_sql_function_for_one_cycle(fake_supabase):
+    from installment_service import InstallmentService
+
+    _seed_two_cycles(fake_supabase)
+    InstallmentService.recalculate_budgets(HH, "2026-11")
+    assert ("recompute_budget_spent", {"p_household_id": HH, "p_cycle_keys": ["2026-11"]}) in fake_supabase.rpc_calls
+    assert _budget(fake_supabase, "b-nov")["spent_amount"] == 50.5
+    assert _budget(fake_supabase, "b-oct")["spent_amount"] == 777.0  # other cycles untouched
+
+
+def test_recalculation_falls_back_to_python_for_the_cycle_only(fake_supabase, monkeypatch):
+    from installment_service import InstallmentService
+    import fakes
+
+    def missing(_params):
+        raise fakes.FakeSchemaError("Could not find the function public.recompute_budget_spent", "PGRST202")
+
+    fake_supabase.rpc_handlers["recompute_budget_spent"] = missing
+    _seed_two_cycles(fake_supabase)
+    selects = []
+    real_execute = fakes.FakeQuery.execute
+
+    def execute(self):
+        if self._table == "transactions" and self._op == "select":
+            selects.append(list(getattr(self, "_filters_columns", [])))
+        return real_execute(self)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(fakes.FakeQuery, "execute", execute)
+    InstallmentService.recalculate_budgets(HH, "2026-11")
+    assert _budget(fake_supabase, "b-nov")["spent_amount"] == 50.5
+    assert _budget(fake_supabase, "b-oct")["spent_amount"] == 777.0
+    assert selects and all("cycle_key" in cols for cols in selects), selects
+
+
+def test_recalculate_endpoint_still_works(fake_supabase):
+    from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+    from main import app
+
+    _seed_two_cycles(fake_supabase)
+    res = TestClient(app).post(f"/budgets/recalculate?household_id={HH}&cycle_key=2026-11")
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    assert _budget(fake_supabase, "b-nov")["spent_amount"] == 50.5
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_product_db_only_store.py b/ai_service/tests/test_product_db_only_store.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..c5d72a9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_product_db_only_store.py
@@ -0,0 +1,135 @@
+"""
+Product review 4.1 / "Stop doing" (API-33): no container-local state.
+
+Household settings (payday, income, rollover rule, savings), invites and dependents used to fall
+back to ``ai_service/data/*.json`` or to process memory when the database call failed. On Railway
+that state was ephemeral and differed per instance: a payday "saved" to one container's file was
+invisible to the next request. The database is now the only store, and a database failure is an
+error response, never a silent local write or a stale local read.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+import dependents_service
+import supabase_client
+from main import app
+
+HID = "f860188e-23b5-4749-b180-868c956151a6"
+AI_SERVICE = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+client = TestClient(app)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def db_down(monkeypatch):
+    def unreachable():
+        raise ConnectionError("database unreachable")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(supabase_client, "get_client", unreachable)
+
+
+def test_no_file_fallbacks_remain():
+    assert not hasattr(supabase_client, "HOUSEHOLD_SETTINGS_FILE")
+    assert not hasattr(supabase_client, "HOUSEHOLD_INVITES_FILE")
+    assert not hasattr(dependents_service, "_memory_dependents")
+    for name in ("household_settings.json", "household_invites.json"):
+        assert not os.path.exists(os.path.join(AI_SERVICE, "data", name)), name
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("call", [
+    lambda: supabase_client.get_household_payday(HID),
+    lambda: supabase_client.set_household_payday(HID, 10),
+    lambda: supabase_client.get_household_income(HID),
+    lambda: supabase_client.set_household_income(HID, 9000),
+    lambda: supabase_client.get_household_rollover_rule(HID),
+    lambda: supabase_client.set_household_rollover_rule(HID, "fresh_start"),
+    lambda: supabase_client.add_household_savings_surplus(HID, 100.0, "2026-11"),
+    lambda: supabase_client.get_household_savings_summary(HID),
+])
+def test_settings_raise_when_the_database_fails(db_down, call):
+    with pytest.raises(supabase_client.HouseholdSettingsUnavailable):
+        call()
+
+
+def test_settings_routes_answer_an_error_not_a_local_success(db_down, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
+    put = client.put(f"/households/{HID}/payday", json={"payday_day": 10})
+    assert put.status_code == 500 and "Failed to update household payday" in put.json()["detail"]
+    get = client.get(f"/households/{HID}/payday")
+    assert get.status_code == 500
+    assert list(tmp_path.iterdir()) == []
+
+
+def test_settings_round_trip_through_the_database(fake_supabase):
+    fake_supabase.seed("households", [{"id": HID, "payday_day": 27}])
+    assert supabase_client.set_household_payday(HID, 10) == 10
+    assert fake_supabase.tables["households"][0]["payday_day"] == 10
+    assert supabase_client.get_household_payday(HID) == 10
+    assert supabase_client.set_household_income(HID, 12000) == 12000.0
+    assert supabase_client.get_household_income(HID) == 12000.0
+
+
+def test_missing_household_row_uses_defaults_without_files(fake_supabase):
+    assert supabase_client.get_household_payday(HID) == 27
+    assert supabase_client.get_household_income(HID) == 0.0
+    assert supabase_client.get_household_rollover_rule(HID) == "send_to_savings"
+    with pytest.raises(supabase_client.HouseholdSettingsUnavailable):
+        supabase_client.add_household_savings_surplus(HID, 50.0, "2026-11")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("call", [
+    lambda: dependents_service.get_household_dependents(HID),
+    lambda: dependents_service.create_household_dependent(HID, "Sarah"),
+    lambda: dependents_service.delete_household_dependent(HID, "d1"),
+    lambda: dependents_service.link_dependent_user(HID, "d1", "u1"),
+])
+def test_dependents_raise_when_the_database_fails(db_down, call):
+    with pytest.raises(dependents_service.DependentsUnavailable):
+        call()
+
+
+def test_dependent_created_while_the_database_is_down_is_not_listed_later(fake_supabase, monkeypatch):
+    real = supabase_client.get_client
+
+    def unreachable():
+        raise ConnectionError("database unreachable")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(supabase_client, "get_client", unreachable)
+    res = client.post(f"/households/{HID}/dependents", json={"name": "Sarah", "avatar_icon": "child"})
+    assert res.status_code == 500
+    monkeypatch.setattr(supabase_client, "get_client", real)
+    listed = client.get(f"/households/{HID}/dependents")
+    assert listed.status_code == 200 and listed.json()["dependents"] == []
+
+
+def test_dependents_round_trip_through_the_database(fake_supabase):
+    dep = dependents_service.create_household_dependent(HID, " Fahad ", relationship="child")
+    assert dep["name"] == "Fahad" and dep["household_id"] == HID
+    assert [d["id"] for d in dependents_service.get_household_dependents(HID)] == [dep["id"]]
+    assert dependents_service.link_dependent_user(HID, dep["id"], "user-1")["linked_user_id"] == "user-1"
+    assert dependents_service.link_dependent_user("another-household", dep["id"], "user-2") is None
+    assert dependents_service.delete_household_dependent(HID, dep["id"]) is True
+    assert dependents_service.get_household_dependents(HID) == []
+
+
+def test_invites_never_use_a_local_file(db_down, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
+    with pytest.raises(Exception):
+        supabase_client.create_household_role_invite(HID, "peer")
+    with pytest.raises(Exception):
+        supabase_client.inspect_household_role_invite("ABCDEF0123456789")
+    claim = supabase_client.claim_household_role_invite("ABCDEF0123456789", "u1")
+    assert claim["status"] == "error"
+    assert list(tmp_path.iterdir()) == []
+
+
+def test_invite_round_trip_through_the_database(fake_supabase):
+    inv = supabase_client.create_household_role_invite(HID, "spouse")
+    assert fake_supabase.tables["household_invites"][0]["invite_code"] == inv["invite_code"]
+    seen = supabase_client.inspect_household_role_invite(inv["invite_code"].lower())
+    assert seen["is_valid"] is True and seen["role"] == "spouse"
+    unknown = supabase_client.inspect_household_role_invite("0000000000000000")
+    assert unknown["is_valid"] is False

+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_product_support_payday.py
@@ -0,0 +1,94 @@
+"""
+Product review 3.1 / "Stop doing": the support chatbot hard-coded a 27th payday and a 400 SAR
+Iqama fee. It now reads the household's payday (households.payday_day) when the route passes a
+household (membership already verified) and otherwise speaks generically; no fee amounts.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import types
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+import supabase_client
+import support_agent
+from main import app
+
+HID = "f860188e-23b5-4749-b180-868c956151a6"
+
+
+class Capture:
+    def __init__(self, monkeypatch):
+        self.messages = None
+
+        def completion(*_a, **kwargs):
+            self.messages = kwargs["messages"]
+            msg = types.SimpleNamespace(content="[ESCALATE: FALSE]\n[SUMMARY: NONE]\nok")
+            return types.SimpleNamespace(choices=[types.SimpleNamespace(message=msg)])
+
+        monkeypatch.setattr(support_agent.litellm, "completion", completion)
+
+    @property
+    def system(self) -> str:
+        return self.messages[0]["content"]
+
+
+def test_no_hard_coded_payday_or_fee_in_the_sources():
+    for lang in ("ar", "en", "ur"):
+        for text in (support_agent.SUPPORT_SYSTEM_PROMPTS[lang], support_agent.FALLBACK_MESSAGES[lang]["general"],
+                     support_agent.PAYDAY_FACTS[lang]["generic"], support_agent.BILLS_FACTS[lang]):
+            assert "27" not in text and "400" not in text, (lang, text)
+            assert "Iqama" not in text and "اقامہ" not in text and "إقامة" not in text
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("lang", ["ar", "en", "ur"])
+async def test_without_household_the_prompt_is_generic(monkeypatch, lang):
+    llm = Capture(monkeypatch)
+    await support_agent.handle_support_query("When is payday?", household_id=None, language=lang)
+    assert "27" not in llm.system and "400" not in llm.system
+    assert support_agent.PAYDAY_FACTS[lang]["generic"] in llm.system
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("lang", ["ar", "en", "ur"])
+async def test_household_payday_is_read_from_the_database(fake_supabase, monkeypatch, lang):
+    fake_supabase.seed("households", [{"id": HID, "payday_day": 10}])
+    llm = Capture(monkeypatch)
+    await support_agent.handle_support_query("When is payday?", household_id=HID, language=lang)
+    assert support_agent.PAYDAY_FACTS[lang]["known"].format(day=10) in llm.system
+    assert "27" not in llm.system
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_database_failure_answers_generically(monkeypatch):
+    def unreachable():
+        raise ConnectionError("down")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(supabase_client, "get_client", unreachable)
+    llm = Capture(monkeypatch)
+    reply, escalate, _ = await support_agent.handle_support_query("payday?", household_id=HID, language="en")
+    assert reply == "ok" and escalate is False
+    assert support_agent.PAYDAY_FACTS["en"]["generic"] in llm.system
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_fallback_reply_uses_the_household_payday(fake_supabase, monkeypatch):
+    fake_supabase.seed("households", [{"id": HID, "payday_day": 1}])
+
+    def broken(*_a, **_k):
+        raise RuntimeError("quota")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(support_agent.litellm, "completion", broken)
+    reply, _, _ = await support_agent.handle_support_query("hello", household_id=HID, language="en")
+    assert "day 1 of each month" in reply
+    reply, _, _ = await support_agent.handle_support_query("hello", household_id=None, language="en")
+    assert "27" not in reply and "of each month" not in reply
+
+
+def test_route_passes_the_verified_household(fake_supabase, monkeypatch):
+    fake_supabase.seed("households", [{"id": HID, "payday_day": 5}])
+    llm = Capture(monkeypatch)
+    res = TestClient(app).post("/support/chat", json={"message": "payday?", "household_id": HID, "language": "en"})
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    assert "day 5 of each month" in llm.system
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_product_taxonomy.py b/ai_service/tests/test_product_taxonomy.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..622b943

+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_product_taxonomy.py
@@ -0,0 +1,225 @@
+"""
+PRODUCT-R4 (docs/review/audit/product_review.md, roadmap item 6): the chat parser knows the Saudi
+household categories that were missing (housing, education, domestic help, family support,
+charity, transport, insurance, remittance) in its LLM prompt and in the heuristic fallback, in
+Arabic, English and Urdu. The codes are system categories (household_id NULL) added by a separate
+migration; until it is applied, a new code falls back to the legacy code so no insert is refused.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pytest
+
+import chat_parser
+from chat_parser import (
+    NEW_SYSTEM_CATEGORY_CODES,
+    SYSTEM_PROMPT,
+    _fallback_heuristic_parse,
+    resolve_category_in_taxonomy,
+)
+from models import CostControlCode
+
+NEW_CODES = {
+    "OPEX-HOUSING", "OPEX-EDUCATION", "OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP", "OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT",
+    "OPEX-CHARITY", "OPEX-TRANSPORT", "OPEX-INSURANCE", "OPEX-REMITTANCE",
+}
+
+
+def test_new_codes_are_constants_and_in_the_prompt():
+    assert set(NEW_SYSTEM_CATEGORY_CODES) == NEW_CODES
+    for code in NEW_CODES:
+        assert code in SYSTEM_PROMPT, code
+    # Existing codes keep working.
+    for code in ("OPEX-GROCERY", "OPEX-DINING", "OPEX-FUEL", "OPEX-UTILITIES", "OPEX-SHOPPING",
+                 "OPEX-HEALTH", "OPEX-ENTERTAINMENT", "OPEX-MISC"):
+        assert code in SYSTEM_PROMPT, code
+
+
+def test_prompt_has_urdu_examples():
+    # Five or more Urdu example inputs (Urdu-only letters: ے ہ ی ک ٹ ڈ).
+    examples = [line for line in SYSTEM_PROMPT.splitlines() if line.startswith('"') and any(ch in line for ch in "ےہیکٹڈ")]
+    assert len(examples) >= 5, examples
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("text, code", [
+    # Housing
+    ("دفعت ايجار الشقة 3000 ريال", "OPEX-HOUSING"),
+    ("إيجار البيت 2500", "OPEX-HOUSING"),
+    ("paid rent 3500 sar", "OPEX-HOUSING"),
+    ("مکان کا کرایہ 3000 ریال دیا", "OPEX-HOUSING"),
+    # Education
+    ("رسوم مدرسية للعيال 4000 ريال", "OPEX-EDUCATION"),
+    ("school fees 5000 sar", "OPEX-EDUCATION"),
+    ("بچوں کی اسکول فیس 1500 ریال", "OPEX-EDUCATION"),
+    # Domestic help
+    ("راتب الخادمة 1500 ريال", "OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP"),
+    ("سائق 1800 ريال", "OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP"),
+    ("maid salary 1500 sar", "OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP"),
+    ("ڈرائیور کی تنخواہ 1800 ریال", "OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP"),
+    # Family support
+    ("مساعدة الأهل 1000 ريال", "OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT"),
+    ("sent my parents 500 sar", "OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT"),
+    ("والدین کو 700 ریال", "OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT"),
+    # Charity
+    ("صدقة 100 ريال", "OPEX-CHARITY"),
+    ("زكاة المال 2500", "OPEX-CHARITY"),
+    ("sadaqah 50 sar", "OPEX-CHARITY"),
+    ("خیرات 200 ریال", "OPEX-CHARITY"),
+    # Transport
+    ("اوبر للدوام 35 ريال", "OPEX-TRANSPORT"),
+    ("careem 22 sar", "OPEX-TRANSPORT"),
+    ("taxi 40 sar", "OPEX-TRANSPORT"),
+    ("قسط السيارة 1900 ريال", "OPEX-TRANSPORT"),
+    ("مواصلات 60 ريال", "OPEX-TRANSPORT"),
+    # Insurance
+    ("تأمين السيارة 1200 ريال", "OPEX-INSURANCE"),
+    ("tameeni car insurance 1100 sar", "OPEX-INSURANCE"),
+    ("گاڑی کی انشورنس 1000 ریال", "OPEX-INSURANCE"),
+    # Remittance
+    ("حوالة للهند 2000 ريال", "OPEX-REMITTANCE"),
+    ("تحويل للخارج 1500 ريال", "OPEX-REMITTANCE"),
+    ("western union 900 sar", "OPEX-REMITTANCE"),
+    ("پاکستان ترسیل زر 1200 ریال", "OPEX-REMITTANCE"),
+])
+def test_heuristic_maps_new_categories(text, code):
+    parsed = _fallback_heuristic_parse(text)
+    assert parsed.is_transaction
+    assert parsed.category_code == code, (text, parsed.category_code)
+    assert parsed.total_amount > 0
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("text, code", [
+    ("بنزين 91 بـ 60 ريال من ساسكو", "OPEX-FUEL"),
+    ("مقاضي البيت من بنده 250 ريال", "OPEX-GROCERY"),
+    ("قهوة من ستاربكس 22 ريال", "OPEX-DINING"),
+    ("فاتورة الكهرباء 300 ريال", "OPEX-UTILITIES"),
+    ("صيدلية النهدي 45 ريال", "OPEX-HEALTH"),
+    # Words that merely contain a cue are not that category.
+    ("رسوم معاملة 50 ريال", "OPEX-MISC"),
+    ("current account fee 10 sar", "OPEX-MISC"),
+])
+def test_heuristic_existing_categories_unchanged(text, code):
+    assert _fallback_heuristic_parse(text).category_code == code, text
+
+
+def _codes(*names):
+    return [CostControlCode(id=n, code=n, category=n, keywords=[], is_flexible=True) for n in names]
+
+
+def test_new_code_kept_when_in_taxonomy():
+    codes = _codes("OPEX-MISC", "OPEX-HOUSING")
+    assert resolve_category_in_taxonomy("OPEX-HOUSING", codes) == "OPEX-HOUSING"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("new, legacy", [
+    ("OPEX-HOUSING", "OPEX-UTILITIES"),
+    ("OPEX-TRANSPORT", "OPEX-FUEL"),
+    ("OPEX-CHARITY", "OPEX-MISC"),
+    ("OPEX-REMITTANCE", "OPEX-MISC"),
+])
+def test_new_code_falls_back_before_the_migration(new, legacy):
+    codes = _codes("OPEX-MISC", "OPEX-UTILITIES", "OPEX-FUEL")
+    assert resolve_category_in_taxonomy(new, codes) == legacy
+
+
+def test_unknown_model_code_falls_back_to_misc_and_empty_taxonomy_is_left_to_the_db():
+    assert resolve_category_in_taxonomy("OPEX-HALLUCINATED", _codes("OPEX-MISC")) == "OPEX-MISC"
+    assert resolve_category_in_taxonomy("OPEX-HOUSING", []) == "OPEX-HOUSING"
+
+
+def test_chat_commit_uses_legacy_code_when_new_code_is_missing(fake_supabase):
+    hh = "f860188e-23b5-4749-b180-868c956151a6"
+    fake_supabase.seed("cost_control_codes", [
+        {"id": "u", "code": "OPEX-UTILITIES", "category": "Utilities", "keywords": [], "is_flexible": False,
+         "household_id": None},
+        {"id": "m", "code": "OPEX-MISC", "category": "Misc", "keywords": [], "is_flexible": True, "household_id": None},
+    ])
+    fake_supabase.seed("households", [{"id": hh, "payday_day": 27}])
+    res = chat_parser.process_chat_transaction(hh, "دفعت ايجار الشقة 3000 ريال", user_id=None, preview_only=True)
+    assert res["category_code"] == "OPEX-UTILITIES"
+    assert res["sub_category"] != "annual_rent"  # the new code's sub-code is not kept on the legacy code
+
+
+# Sub-codes of migration 20261021000000 (cost_control_sub_categories).
+SUB_CODES = {
+    "OPEX-HOUSING": {"housing_rent", "annual_rent", "housing_services"},
+    "OPEX-EDUCATION": {"tuition_fees", "school_transport", "school_uniforms", "books_supplies"},
+    "OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP": {"maid_salary", "driver_salary", "recruitment_visa"},
+    "OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT": {"parents_support", "relatives_support"},
+    "OPEX-CHARITY": {"sadaqah", "zakat"},
+    "OPEX-TRANSPORT": {"car_installment", "ride_hailing", "public_transport", "car_maintenance"},
+    "OPEX-INSURANCE": {"car_insurance", "health_insurance", "home_insurance"},
+    "OPEX-REMITTANCE": {"family_remittance", "transfer_fees"},
+}
+
+
+def test_sub_code_table_matches_the_migration():
+    assert {code: {s for s, _ in subs} for code, subs in chat_parser.NEW_CATEGORY_SUB_CODES.items()} == SUB_CODES
+    for code, subs in SUB_CODES.items():
+        line = next(l for l in SYSTEM_PROMPT.splitlines() if l.startswith(f"- {code}:"))
+        for sub in subs:
+            assert sub in line, (code, sub)
+
+
+def test_receipt_prompt_lists_the_new_codes():
+    import receipt_scanner
+
+    for code in NEW_CODES:
+        assert f"- {code} (" in receipt_scanner.RECEIPT_PROMPT, code
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("text, code, sub", [
+    ("دفعت ايجار الشقة 3000 ريال", "OPEX-HOUSING", "housing_rent"),
+    ("الإيجار السنوي 36000 ريال", "OPEX-HOUSING", "annual_rent"),
+    ("رسوم مدرسية للعيال 4000 ريال", "OPEX-EDUCATION", "tuition_fees"),
+    ("باص المدرسة 300 ريال", "OPEX-EDUCATION", "school_transport"),
+    ("school uniforms 250 sar", "OPEX-EDUCATION", "school_uniforms"),
+    ("كتب وقرطاسية المدرسة 180 ريال", "OPEX-EDUCATION", "books_supplies"),
+    ("راتب الخادمة 1500 ريال", "OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP", "maid_salary"),
+    ("سائق 1800 ريال", "OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP", "driver_salary"),
+    ("رسوم استقدام عاملة عبر مساند 9000 ريال", "OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP", "recruitment_visa"),
+    ("مساعدة الأهل 1000 ريال", "OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT", "parents_support"),
+    ("مساعدة الاهل أخوي 500 ريال", "OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT", "relatives_support"),
+    ("صدقة 100 ريال", "OPEX-CHARITY", "sadaqah"),
+    ("زكاة المال 2500", "OPEX-CHARITY", "zakat"),
+    ("اوبر للدوام 35 ريال", "OPEX-TRANSPORT", "ride_hailing"),
+    ("قسط السيارة 1900 ريال", "OPEX-TRANSPORT", "car_installment"),
+    ("مترو الرياض مواصلات 20 ريال", "OPEX-TRANSPORT", "public_transport"),
+    ("تأمين السيارة 1200 ريال", "OPEX-INSURANCE", "car_insurance"),
+    ("تأمين طبي بوبا 3000 ريال", "OPEX-INSURANCE", "health_insurance"),
+    ("حوالة للهند 2000 ريال", "OPEX-REMITTANCE", "family_remittance"),
+    ("رسوم التحويل حوالة 25 ريال", "OPEX-REMITTANCE", "transfer_fees"),
+])
+def test_heuristic_sub_codes(text, code, sub):
+    parsed = _fallback_heuristic_parse(text)
+    assert (parsed.category_code, parsed.sub_category) == (code, sub), text
+    assert all(it.sub_category == sub for it in parsed.items)
+
+
+def test_receipt_unknown_model_code_falls_back(fake_supabase, monkeypatch):
+    import json
+    import types
+
+    import litellm
+    import receipt_scanner
+
+    hh = "f860188e-23b5-4749-b180-868c956151a6"
+    fake_supabase.seed("cost_control_codes", [
+        {"id": "f", "code": "OPEX-FUEL", "category": "Fuel", "keywords": [], "is_flexible": False, "household_id": None},
+        {"id": "m", "code": "OPEX-MISC", "category": "Misc", "keywords": [], "is_flexible": True, "household_id": None},
+    ])
+    fake_supabase.seed("households", [{"id": hh, "payday_day": 27}])
+    payload = {"merchant": "Careem", "total_amount": 30.0, "category_code": "OPEX-TRANSPORT",
+               "items": [{"name": "Ride", "quantity": 1, "price": 30.0}]}
+    msg = types.SimpleNamespace(content=json.dumps(payload))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(litellm, "completion",
+                        lambda *a, **k: types.SimpleNamespace(choices=[types.SimpleNamespace(message=msg)]))
+    import base64
+    import io
+
+    from PIL import Image
+
+    buf = io.BytesIO()
+    Image.new("RGB", (20, 20)).save(buf, "JPEG")
+    res = receipt_scanner.process_receipt_scan(hh, [base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode()], preview_only=True)
+    assert res["status"] == "preview" and res["category_code"] == "OPEX-FUEL"
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_rate_limit_and_env.py b/ai_service/tests/test_rate_limit_and_env.py
new file mode 100644

--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_rate_limit_and_env.py
@@ -0,0 +1,233 @@
+"""API-08 / 09 / 10 / 11 / 29: quota fail-mode, Redis limiter correctness, XFF trust, fail-closed ENV."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi import HTTPException
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+import rate_limiter
+from rate_limiter import SlidingWindowRateLimiter, check_api_quota
+from utils import get_client_ip, is_production, verify_signature
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def fake_redis_limiter():
+    fakeredis = pytest.importorskip("fakeredis")
+    import fakeredis.aioredis
+
+    limiter = SlidingWindowRateLimiter(redis_url="redis://fake:6379/0")
+    limiter._redis = fakeredis.aioredis.FakeRedis(decode_responses=True)
+    return limiter
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_redis_counts_concurrent_requests_with_identical_timestamps(fake_redis_limiter, monkeypatch):
+    """Members keyed by str(now) collided, so a burst within one clock tick counted as one request."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rate_limiter.time, "time", lambda: 1_700_000_000.0)
+    admitted = 0
+    for _ in range(5):
+        try:
+            await fake_redis_limiter.check_rate_limit("burst", max_requests=3, window_seconds=60)
+            admitted += 1
+        except HTTPException as exc:
+            assert exc.status_code == 429
+    assert admitted == 3
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_redis_rejected_requests_do_not_consume_window(fake_redis_limiter):
+    for _ in range(2):
+        await fake_redis_limiter.check_rate_limit("hammer", max_requests=2, window_seconds=60)
+    for _ in range(5):
+        with pytest.raises(HTTPException):
+            await fake_redis_limiter.check_rate_limit("hammer", max_requests=2, window_seconds=60)
+    assert await fake_redis_limiter._redis.zcard("rl:hammer") == 2
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_redis_outage_backs_off_instead_of_reconnecting_every_request(monkeypatch):
+    redis = pytest.importorskip("redis")
+    import redis.asyncio as aioredis
+
+    attempts = []
+
+    class Broken:
+        async def ping(self):
+            raise ConnectionError("down")
+
+    def fake_from_url(*_a, **_k):
+        attempts.append(1)
+        return Broken()
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(aioredis, "from_url", fake_from_url)
+    limiter = SlidingWindowRateLimiter(redis_url="redis://unreachable:6379/0")
+    for _ in range(5):
+        await limiter.check_rate_limit("k", max_requests=100, window_seconds=60)
+    assert len(attempts) == 1
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_quota_fails_closed_in_production_when_rpc_errors(monkeypatch, fake_supabase):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("ENV", "production")
+
+    def boom(_params):
+        raise RuntimeError("permission denied for function consume_quota")
+
+    fake_supabase.rpc_handlers["consume_quota"] = boom
+    with pytest.raises(HTTPException) as exc:
+        await check_api_quota(user_id="u1", household_id="h1", bucket="chat_transaction", max_requests=5)
+    assert exc.value.status_code == 503
+
+    monkeypatch.setenv("ENV", "development")
+    await check_api_quota(user_id="u1", household_id="h1", bucket="chat_transaction", max_requests=5)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_quota_denied_by_db_returns_429(fake_supabase):
+    fake_supabase.rpc_handlers["consume_quota"] = lambda _p: False
+    with pytest.raises(HTTPException) as exc:
+        await check_api_quota(user_id="u1", household_id="h1", bucket="scan_receipt", max_requests=5)
+    assert exc.value.status_code == 429
+
+
+# External review (Gemini) BLOCKER 3: PostgREST can hand back the boolean RPC result in several
+# shapes (scalar, single-element array, object keyed by the function name, text). Every shape that
+# clearly says "allowed" must pass and every clear "denied" must be 429 — never a 503 in production.
+_ALLOWED_SHAPES = [True, [True], {"consume_quota": True}, [{"consume_quota": True}], "true", "TRUE", " t ", ["true"]]
+_DENIED_SHAPES = [False, [False], {"consume_quota": False}, [{"consume_quota": False}], "false", "f", ["false"]]
+_UNKNOWN_SHAPES = [None, [], {}, [True, False], {"other": True}, "maybe", 1, 0, [None], {"consume_quota": None}]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("shape", _ALLOWED_SHAPES, ids=repr)
+def test_consume_quota_result_shapes_that_mean_allowed(shape):
+    assert rate_limiter._normalize_quota_result(shape) is True
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("shape", _DENIED_SHAPES, ids=repr)
+def test_consume_quota_result_shapes_that_mean_denied(shape):
+    assert rate_limiter._normalize_quota_result(shape) is False
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("shape", _UNKNOWN_SHAPES, ids=repr)
+def test_consume_quota_result_shapes_that_are_unknown(shape):
+    assert rate_limiter._normalize_quota_result(shape) is None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("shape", _ALLOWED_SHAPES, ids=repr)
+async def test_allowed_quota_shapes_pass_in_production(monkeypatch, fake_supabase, shape):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("ENV", "production")
+    fake_supabase.rpc_handlers["consume_quota"] = lambda _p, _s=shape: _s
+    await check_api_quota(user_id="u-allowed", household_id="h1", bucket="chat_transaction", max_requests=50)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("shape", _DENIED_SHAPES, ids=repr)
+async def test_denied_quota_shapes_are_429_in_production(monkeypatch, fake_supabase, shape):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("ENV", "production")
+    fake_supabase.rpc_handlers["consume_quota"] = lambda _p, _s=shape: _s
+    with pytest.raises(HTTPException) as exc:
+        await check_api_quota(user_id="u-denied", household_id="h1", bucket="chat_transaction", max_requests=50)
+    assert exc.value.status_code == 429
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("shape", _UNKNOWN_SHAPES, ids=repr)
+async def test_unknown_quota_shapes_fail_closed_only_in_production(monkeypatch, fake_supabase, shape):
+    fake_supabase.rpc_handlers["consume_quota"] = lambda _p, _s=shape: _s
+    monkeypatch.setenv("ENV", "production")
+    with pytest.raises(HTTPException) as exc:
+        await check_api_quota(user_id="u-unknown", household_id="h1", bucket="chat_transaction", max_requests=50)
+    assert exc.value.status_code == 503
+    monkeypatch.setenv("ENV", "development")
+    await check_api_quota(user_id="u-unknown", household_id="h1", bucket="chat_transaction", max_requests=50)
+
+
+def test_quota_rpc_call_matches_the_consume_quota_sql_signature(fake_supabase):
+    """The RPC parameters must be exactly the SQL function's named arguments (PostgREST matches by name)."""
+    import pathlib
+    import re
+
+    migrations = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "supabase" / "migrations"
+    definitions = []
+    for path in sorted(migrations.glob("*.sql")):
+        for match in re.finditer(
+            r"CREATE\s+(?:OR\s+REPLACE\s+)?FUNCTION\s+public\.consume_quota\s*\((.*?)\)\s*RETURNS\s+(\w+)",
+            path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
+        ):
+            definitions.append((path.name, match.group(1), match.group(2)))
+    assert definitions, "consume_quota must be defined in a migration"
+    _, args, returns = definitions[-1]  # the last definition in migration order is the live one
+    params = [tuple(a.split()[:2]) for a in (x.strip() for x in args.split(",")) if a]
+    assert [(n, t.upper()) for n, t in params] == [
+        ("p_user_id", "UUID"), ("p_bucket", "TEXT"), ("p_limit", "INT"), ("p_window_seconds", "INT"),
+    ]
+    assert returns.upper() == "BOOLEAN"
+
+    rate_limiter._consume_db_quota("00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001", "chat_transaction", 30, 600)
+    name, sent = fake_supabase.rpc_calls[-1]
+    assert name == "consume_quota"
+    assert list(sent) == [n for n, _ in params]
+    assert isinstance(sent["p_limit"], int) and isinstance(sent["p_window_seconds"], int)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_sliding_window_is_per_user_not_per_client_supplied_household():
+    for user in ("user-a", "user-b"):
+        await check_api_quota(user_id=user, household_id="shared-hh", bucket="support_chat", max_requests=1)
+    with pytest.raises(HTTPException):
+        await check_api_quota(user_id="user-a", household_id="other-hh", bucket="support_chat", max_requests=1)
+
+
+def _req(peer: str, xff: str | None):
+    headers = {"X-Forwarded-For": xff} if xff else {}
+    return SimpleNamespace(client=SimpleNamespace(host=peer), headers=headers)
+
+
+def test_xff_ignored_from_untrusted_peer(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.delenv("TRUSTED_PROXY_IPS", raising=False)
+    assert get_client_ip(_req("203.0.113.9", "1.2.3.4")) == "203.0.113.9"
+    assert get_client_ip(_req("127.0.0.1", "1.2.3.4, 198.51.100.7")) == "198.51.100.7"
+    monkeypatch.setenv("TRUSTED_PROXY_IPS", "10.0.0.5")
+    assert get_client_ip(_req("10.0.0.5", "9.9.9.9")) == "9.9.9.9"
+    assert get_client_ip(_req("127.0.0.1", "9.9.9.9")) == "127.0.0.1"
+
+
+def test_missing_env_is_treated_as_production(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.delenv("ENV", raising=False)
+    assert is_production() is True
+    monkeypatch.setenv("WEBHOOK_SECRET", "")
+    assert verify_signature(b"{}", None) is False
+    monkeypatch.setenv("ENV", "development")
+    assert is_production() is False
+    assert verify_signature(b"{}", None) is True
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_idempotency_store_is_shared_across_instances_via_redis(monkeypatch):
+    fakeredis = pytest.importorskip("fakeredis")
+    import fakeredis.aioredis
+    from idempotency import IdempotencyStore
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rate_limiter.default_rate_limiter, "_redis", fakeredis.aioredis.FakeRedis(decode_responses=True))
+    instance_a, instance_b = IdempotencyStore(), IdempotencyStore()
+    assert await instance_a.reserve("u1", "chat-transaction", "key-12345678") is None
+    with pytest.raises(HTTPException) as in_flight:
+        await instance_b.reserve("u1", "chat-transaction", "key-12345678")
+    assert in_flight.value.status_code == 409
+    await instance_a.complete("u1", "chat-transaction", "key-12345678", {"transaction_id": "t1"})
+    assert await instance_b.reserve("u1", "chat-transaction", "key-12345678") == {"transaction_id": "t1"}
+
+
+def test_api_docs_hidden_in_production(monkeypatch):
+    from main import app
+
+    client = TestClient(app)
+    monkeypatch.setenv("ENV", "production")
+    assert client.get("/docs").status_code == 404
+    assert client.get("/openapi.json").status_code == 404
+    monkeypatch.setenv("ENV", "development")
+    assert client.get("/openapi.json").status_code == 200

+    assert row["accumulated_savings"] == 150.25
+    assert row["last_rollover_cycle"] == "2026-11"
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_salary_cycle_riyadh.py b/ai_service/tests/test_salary_cycle_riyadh.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..7fcd503
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_salary_cycle_riyadh.py
@@ -0,0 +1,75 @@
+"""API-14: salary cycle parity with the DB (Asia/Riyadh dates, household payday)."""
+
+from datetime import date, datetime, timezone
+
+import pytest
+
+import utils
+from salary_cycle import get_cycle_for_date, get_cycle_info_for_key, get_salary_cycle_dates
+from utils import riyadh_date_for_timestamp
+
+
+def freeze_utc(monkeypatch, iso: str):
+    instant = datetime.fromisoformat(iso.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(utils, "utc_now", lambda: instant)
+
+
+def test_default_cycle_uses_riyadh_date_after_midnight_on_payday(monkeypatch):
+    # 2026-10-26 22:30 UTC == 2026-10-27 01:30 Riyadh → payday has arrived in Riyadh.
+    freeze_utc(monkeypatch, "2026-10-26T22:30:00Z")
+    assert get_cycle_for_date()["cycle_key"] == "2026-11"
+    assert get_salary_cycle_dates()["cycle_key"] == "2026-11"
+
+
+def test_default_cycle_before_riyadh_midnight_stays_in_previous_cycle(monkeypatch):
+    freeze_utc(monkeypatch, "2026-10-26T20:59:59Z")  # 23:59:59 Riyadh on the 26th
+    assert get_cycle_for_date()["cycle_key"] == "2026-10"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("ts,expected", [
+    ("2026-10-26T21:00:00Z", date(2026, 10, 27)),
+    ("2026-10-26T20:59:59+00:00", date(2026, 10, 26)),
+    ("2026-10-27T01:00:00+03:00", date(2026, 10, 27)),
+    ("2026-10-26T22:00:00", date(2026, 10, 27)),  # naive → UTC
+])
+def test_riyadh_date_for_timestamp(ts, expected):
+    assert riyadh_date_for_timestamp(ts) == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("d,payday,key,start,end", [
+    (date(2026, 10, 28), 27, "2026-11", "2026-10-27", "2026-11-26"),
+    (date(2026, 12, 27), 27, "2027-01", "2026-12-27", "2027-01-26"),
+    (date(2026, 12, 26), 27, "2026-12", "2026-11-27", "2026-12-26"),
+    (date(2027, 2, 28), 31, "2027-03", "2027-02-28", "2027-03-30"),
+    (date(2027, 2, 27), 31, "2027-02", "2027-01-31", "2027-02-27"),
+    (date(2028, 2, 29), 30, "2028-03", "2028-02-29", "2028-03-29"),
+    (date(2028, 2, 28), 30, "2028-02", "2028-01-30", "2028-02-28"),
+])
+def test_cycle_boundaries_match_db_function(d, payday, key, start, end):
+    info = get_cycle_for_date(d, payday_day=payday)
+    assert (info["cycle_key"], info["cycle_start"], info["cycle_end"]) == (key, start, end)
+    by_key = get_cycle_info_for_key(key, payday_day=payday)
+    assert (by_key["cycle_start"], by_key["cycle_end"]) == (start, end)
+
+
+def test_insert_transaction_derives_cycle_from_riyadh_date_and_household_payday(fake_supabase, monkeypatch):
+    from supabase_client import insert_transaction
+
+    hid = "aaaaaaaa-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"
+    fake_supabase.seed("households", [{"id": hid, "payday_day": 25}])
+    monkeypatch.setattr("installment_service.InstallmentService.recalculate_budgets", lambda *a, **k: None)
+    insert_transaction(
+        household_id=hid, amount=10.0, currency="SAR", merchant="Panda", category_code="OPEX-GROCERY",
+        timestamp="2026-10-24T21:30:00Z", raw_sms="chat",  # 00:30 on the 25th in Riyadh
+    )
+    assert fake_supabase.tables["transactions"][0]["cycle_key"] == "2026-11"
+
+
+def test_category_activation_creates_budget_in_salary_cycle_not_calendar_month(fake_supabase, monkeypatch):
+    from salary_cycle import toggle_category_status
+
+    freeze_utc(monkeypatch, "2026-10-28T09:00:00Z")
+    hid = "aaaaaaaa-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"
+    toggle_category_status(hid, "OPEX-FUEL", is_active=True)
+    budget = fake_supabase.tables["budgets"][0]
+    assert budget["cycle_key"] == "2026-11"
