diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_settlement_audit.py b/ai_service/tests/test_settlement_audit.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..2078137
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_settlement_audit.py
@@ -0,0 +1,158 @@
+"""API-16 / 17 / 18: Nafaqah rules, no 50/50 spousal split, exact halala arithmetic."""
+
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+from installment_service import InstallmentPlan
+from settlement_engine import (
+    calculate_family_nafaqah,
+    calculate_partner_settlement,
+    calculate_roommate_pairwise_debts,
+    calculate_settlement_v2,
+    simplify_debts,
+)
+
+HH = "f860188e-23b5-4749-b180-868c956151a6"
+HUSBAND = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a"
+WIFE = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b"
+CHILD_DEP = "dddddddd-0000-4000-8000-0000000000c1"
+NOW = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def family(fake_supabase):
+    fake_supabase.seed("users", [
+        {"id": HUSBAND, "household_id": HH, "role": "member", "financial_role": "provider", "display_name": "Ahmed"},
+        {"id": WIFE, "household_id": HH, "role": "admin", "financial_role": "spouse", "display_name": "Sara"},
+    ])
+    # household_memberships is authoritative (users.household_id is only the active household).
+    fake_supabase.seed("household_memberships", [
+        {"user_id": HUSBAND, "financial_role": "provider", "household_id": HH, "role": "member", "created_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"},
+        {"user_id": WIFE, "financial_role": "spouse", "household_id": HH, "role": "admin", "created_at": "2026-01-02T00:00:00+00:00"},
+    ])
+    # The wife administers the household; the husband is the explicit Nafaqah provider.
+    fake_supabase.seed("households", [{"id": HH, "payday_day": 27, "owner_user_id": WIFE, "nafaqah_provider_user_id": HUSBAND}])
+    return fake_supabase
+
+
+# ─── API-17: Nafaqah engine ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def test_wife_paying_for_dependent_referenced_by_id_is_husband_debt():
+    txs = [{"amount": 120.0, "paid_by": WIFE, "beneficiary_type": "individual", "beneficiary_id": CHILD_DEP}]
+    res = calculate_family_nafaqah(txs, husband_id=HUSBAND, wife_id=WIFE)
+    assert res["wife_reimbursement_owed"] == 120.0
+
+
+def test_wife_tabarru_contribution_is_not_debt():
+    txs = [
+        {"amount": 80.0, "paid_by": WIFE, "beneficiary_type": "household", "is_tabarru": True},
+        {"amount": 20.0, "paid_by": WIFE, "beneficiary_type": "household"},
+    ]
+    res = calculate_family_nafaqah(txs, husband_id=HUSBAND, wife_id=WIFE)
+    assert res["wife_reimbursement_owed"] == 20.0
+
+
+def test_husband_paying_for_wife_never_creates_wife_debt():
+    txs = [{"amount": 500.0, "paid_by": HUSBAND, "beneficiary_type": "individual", "beneficiary_id": WIFE}]
+    res = calculate_family_nafaqah(txs, husband_id=HUSBAND, wife_id=WIFE)
+    assert res["wife_reimbursement_owed"] == 0.0
+
+
+def test_v2_admin_wife_is_not_mistaken_for_husband(family):
+    family.seed("transactions", [
+        {"id": "t1", "household_id": HH, "amount": 100.0, "paid_by": WIFE, "beneficiary_type": "household",
+         "timestamp": NOW, "nafaqah_class": "wife_reimbursable", "nafaqah_spouse_id": WIFE},
+    ])
+    res = calculate_settlement_v2(HH, cycle_start="2000-01-01")
+    assert res["mode"] == "family_nafaqah"
+    assert res["family_summary"]["wife_reimbursement_owed"] == 100.0
+
+
+# ─── API-16: legacy /settlement must not split spousal expenses 50/50 ──────
+
+def test_partner_settlement_in_family_household_never_splits_50_50(family):
+    family.seed("transactions", [
+        {"id": "g1", "household_id": HH, "amount": 300.0, "category_code": "OPEX-GROCERY",
+         "paid_by": "me", "beneficiary": "both", "timestamp": NOW},
+    ])
+    res = calculate_partner_settlement(HH, split_ratio=0.5, caller_user_id=HUSBAND)
+    assert res["mode"] == "family_nafaqah"
+    assert res["owed_to_me"] == 0.0 and res["net_balance"] == 0.0
+    assert res["fair_share_partner"] == 0.0
+
+
+def test_partner_settlement_family_wife_paid_household_is_owed_in_full(family):
+    # The debt is the Nafaqah ledger: a wife-paid shared expense carries nafaqah_class
+    # (an unclassified row is an ordinary household expense, as the column is defined).
+    family.seed("transactions", [
+        {"id": "g2", "household_id": HH, "amount": 300.0, "category_code": "OPEX-GROCERY",
+         "paid_by": "me", "beneficiary": "both", "timestamp": NOW,
+         "nafaqah_class": "wife_reimbursable", "nafaqah_spouse_id": WIFE},
+    ])
+    res = calculate_partner_settlement(HH, split_ratio=0.5, caller_user_id=WIFE)
+    assert res["who_owes"] == "partner_owes_me"
+    assert res["settlement_amount"] == 300.0
+
+
+def test_settlement_route_rejects_out_of_range_split_ratio():
+    from main import app
+    client = TestClient(app)
+    assert client.get(f"/households/{HH}/settlement", params={"split_ratio": 7}).status_code == 422
+    assert client.get(f"/households/{HH}/settlement", params={"split_ratio": -1}).status_code == 422
+
+
+# ─── API-18: exact money arithmetic ─────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def _net(debts):
+    net = {}
+    for d in debts:
+        net[d["from_id"]] = round(net.get(d["from_id"], 0) - d["amount"], 2)
+        net[d["to_id"]] = round(net.get(d["to_id"], 0) + d["amount"], 2)
+    return net
+
+
+def test_three_way_split_conserves_every_halala():
+    debts = calculate_roommate_pairwise_debts(
+        [{"amount": 100.0, "paid_by": "a", "beneficiary_type": "all_peers"}], ["a", "b", "c"]
+    )
+    owed = sorted(d["amount"] for d in debts)
+    # 10000 halalas / 3 = 3333 r1: one participant carries the extra halala, none is lost.
+    assert owed == [33.33, 33.33]
+    a_share = round(100.0 - sum(owed), 2)
+    assert a_share == 33.34
+    assert round(a_share + sum(owed), 2) == 100.0
+    # Five-way split of 0.03 SAR: three people owe 0.01, nobody owes a fraction of a halala.
+    tiny = calculate_roommate_pairwise_debts(
+        [{"amount": 0.03, "paid_by": "e", "beneficiary_type": "all_peers"}], ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e"]
+    )
+    assert sorted(d["amount"] for d in tiny) == [0.01, 0.01, 0.01]
+
+
+def test_simplification_cancels_cycles_and_collapses_chains():
+    cycle = [{"from_id": "a", "to_id": "b", "amount": 10.0}, {"from_id": "b", "to_id": "c", "amount": 10.0},
+             {"from_id": "c", "to_id": "a", "amount": 10.0}]
+    assert simplify_debts(cycle) == []
+    chain = [{"from_id": "a", "to_id": "b", "amount": 30.0}, {"from_id": "b", "to_id": "c", "amount": 30.0}]
+    assert simplify_debts(chain) == [{"from_id": "a", "to_id": "c", "amount": 30.0}]
+
+
+def test_simplification_preserves_net_positions_exactly():
+    debts = [
+        {"from_id": "a", "to_id": "b", "amount": 0.1}, {"from_id": "a", "to_id": "b", "amount": 0.2},
+        {"from_id": "c", "to_id": "b", "amount": 33.33}, {"from_id": "d", "to_id": "a", "amount": 66.67},
+        {"from_id": "c", "to_id": "d", "amount": 0.01},
+    ]
+    simplified = simplify_debts(debts)
+    assert _net(simplified) == {k: v for k, v in _net(debts).items() if v != 0}
+    assert len(simplified) <= len({d["from_id"] for d in debts} | {d["to_id"] for d in debts}) - 1
+
+
+def test_completed_installment_plan_has_no_residual_halala():
+    plan = InstallmentPlan(id="p", household_id=HH, merchant="m", total_amount=100.0, installment_count=3,
+                           monthly_amount=33.33, paid_installments=3, status="COMPLETED")
+    assert plan.remaining_amount == 0.0
+    partial = InstallmentPlan(id="p", household_id=HH, merchant="m", total_amount=100.0, installment_count=3,
+                              monthly_amount=33.33, paid_installments=2)
+    assert partial.remaining_amount == 33.34
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_sms_removal.py b/ai_service/tests/test_sms_removal.py
index 88d31fc..4eb1ecc 100644
--- a/ai_service/tests/test_sms_removal.py
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_sms_removal.py
@@ -1,21 +1,115 @@
-"""Tests confirming the SMS webhook endpoint has been removed."""
-import os
-os.environ.setdefault("WEBHOOK_SECRET", "test_secret")
-os.environ.setdefault("APP_AUTH_TOKEN", "test_token")
+"""Zero-SMS policy guard for the AI service.
 
+The product never reads SMS: expenses come only from receipt photos, ZATCA QR codes,
+chat/voice and manual entry. These tests fail if an SMS ingestion route, SMS parsing
+module, SMS simulator or an "sms" transaction channel is reintroduced.
+"""
+import re
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
 from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
 from main import app
 
 client = TestClient(app)
 
+SERVICE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+TESTS_DIR = SERVICE_DIR / "tests"
+
+# Identifiers of the removed SMS pipeline (webhook, LangGraph graph, simulators, dedup).
+SMS_INGESTION_PATTERNS = re.compile(
+    r"webhook/sms|SMSWebhook|is_duplicate_sms|def receive_sms|def send_sms|"
+    r"raw_sms\s*:\s*str\s*=\s*Field|READ_SMS|RECEIVE_SMS|SMS_RECEIVED|langgraph",
+)
+
+
+def _service_python_files():
+    for path in SERVICE_DIR.rglob("*.py"):
+        if TESTS_DIR in path.parents or ".venv" in path.parts or "static" in path.parts:
+            continue
+        yield path
+
 
 def test_sms_webhook_endpoint_removed():

-    response = client.post("/webhook/sms", json={"raw_sms": "test", "sender": "SNB", "received_at": "2026-01-01", "household_id": "test"})

diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_sub_category_scoping.py b/ai_service/tests/test_sub_category_scoping.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5f8e90b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_sub_category_scoping.py
@@ -0,0 +1,149 @@
+"""
+E2E-05 (docs/review/audit/e2e_results.md): sub-category definitions are global
+(public.cost_control_sub_categories has no household_id). The API must only list, and only let
+an admin add, definitions whose parent is a system category or a custom category of the
+caller's household; another household's custom category behaves like an unknown code.
+
+Requests carry real HS256 JWTs (this module is excluded from the conftest auth mock), so
+membership and admin checks are real.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import time
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from jose import jwt
+
+from main import app
+
+TEST_SECRET = "super-secret-test-jwt-key-32bytes-long!"
+ISSUER = "https://mockproject.supabase.co/auth/v1"
+
+HH_A = "aaaa0000-0000-4000-8000-00000000e501"
+HH_B = "bbbb0000-0000-4000-8000-00000000e502"
+A_ADMIN = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000005a1"
+A_MEMBER = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000005a2"
+B_ADMIN = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000005b1"
+SECRET = "B private sub-category"
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+
+
+def bearer(sub: str) -> dict:
+    now = int(time.time())
+    claims = {"sub": sub, "aud": "authenticated", "iss": ISSUER, "role": "authenticated", "iat": now, "exp": now + 3600}
+    return {"Authorization": f"Bearer {jwt.encode(claims, TEST_SECRET, algorithm='HS256')}"}
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def db(fake_supabase):
+    fake_supabase.seed("users", [
+        {"id": A_ADMIN, "household_id": HH_A, "role": "admin"},
+        {"id": A_MEMBER, "household_id": HH_A, "role": "member"},
+        {"id": B_ADMIN, "household_id": HH_B, "role": "admin"},
+    ])
+    fake_supabase.seed("household_memberships", [
+        {"household_id": HH_A, "user_id": A_ADMIN, "role": "admin"},
+        {"household_id": HH_A, "user_id": A_MEMBER, "role": "member"},
+        {"household_id": HH_B, "user_id": B_ADMIN, "role": "admin"},
+    ])
+    fake_supabase.seed("cost_control_codes", [
+        {"id": "c1", "code": "OPEX-DINING", "category": "Dining", "keywords": [], "is_flexible": False,
+         "household_id": None, "is_system": True},
+        {"id": "c2", "code": "CUSTOM-A-ONLY", "category": "A only", "keywords": [], "is_flexible": False,
+         "household_id": HH_A, "is_system": False},
+        {"id": "c3", "code": "CUSTOM-B-ONLY", "category": "B only", "keywords": [], "is_flexible": False,
+         "household_id": HH_B, "is_system": False},
+    ])
+    fake_supabase.seed("cost_control_sub_categories", [
+        {"id": "s1", "parent_code": "OPEX-DINING", "sub_code": "coffee", "name_en": "Coffee", "name_ar": "قهوة"},
+        {"id": "s2", "parent_code": "CUSTOM-A-ONLY", "sub_code": "a-sub", "name_en": "A sub", "name_ar": "A"},
+        {"id": "s3", "parent_code": "CUSTOM-B-ONLY", "sub_code": "b-sub", "name_en": SECRET, "name_ar": SECRET},
+    ])
+    return fake_supabase
+
+
+def _list(user, parent_code, **params):
+    return client.get("/budgets/sub-categories", params={"parent_code": parent_code, **params},
+                      headers=bearer(user))
+
+
+def test_system_category_sub_categories_are_listed(db):
+    res = _list(A_MEMBER, "OPEX-DINING")
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    assert [s["sub_code"] for s in res.json()["sub_categories"]] == ["coffee"]
+
+
+def test_own_custom_category_sub_categories_are_listed(db):
+    assert [s["sub_code"] for s in _list(A_MEMBER, "CUSTOM-A-ONLY").json()["sub_categories"]] == ["a-sub"]
+    res = _list(A_MEMBER, "CUSTOM-A-ONLY", household_id=HH_A)
+    assert [s["sub_code"] for s in res.json()["sub_categories"]] == ["a-sub"]
+
+
+def test_other_households_custom_sub_categories_are_not_listed(db):
+    res = _list(A_MEMBER, "CUSTOM-B-ONLY")
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    assert res.json()["sub_categories"] == [] and SECRET not in res.text
+    # Naming the caller's own household does not widen it either.
+    res = _list(A_MEMBER, "CUSTOM-B-ONLY", household_id=HH_A)
+    assert res.json()["sub_categories"] == [] and SECRET not in res.text
+    # The owner still sees them.
+    assert SECRET in _list(B_ADMIN, "CUSTOM-B-ONLY").text
+
+
+def test_listing_for_a_household_the_caller_is_not_in_is_403(db):
+    res = _list(A_MEMBER, "CUSTOM-B-ONLY", household_id=HH_B)
+    assert res.status_code == 403 and SECRET not in res.text
+
+
+def test_unknown_parent_lists_nothing(db):
+    assert _list(A_MEMBER, "CUSTOM-NOPE").json()["sub_categories"] == []
+
+
+def _add(user, household_id, parent_code, sub_code=None):
+    body = {"household_id": household_id, "parent_code": parent_code, "name_en": "Planted", "allocated_amount": 0}
+    if sub_code:
+        body["sub_code"] = sub_code
+    with patch("routes.budgets.add_sub_category_for_household", return_value={"status": "success"}) as work:
+        res = client.post("/budgets/sub-categories", headers=bearer(user), json=body)
+    return res, work
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("parent,sub_code", [("OPEX-DINING", "coffee_bakeries"), ("CUSTOM-A-ONLY", None)])
+def test_admin_adds_under_system_or_own_category(db, parent, sub_code):
+    # Under a system category: an allocation to a seeded sub-category only (FABLE-API-04).
+    res, work = _add(A_ADMIN, HH_A, parent, sub_code)
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    work.assert_called_once()
+
+
+def test_admin_cannot_define_new_sub_categories_under_a_system_category(db):
+    res, work = _add(A_ADMIN, HH_A, "OPEX-DINING")
+    assert res.status_code == 403, res.text
+    work.assert_not_called()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("parent", ["CUSTOM-B-ONLY", "CUSTOM-NOPE"])
+def test_admin_cannot_add_under_foreign_or_unknown_category(db, parent):
+    res, work = _add(A_ADMIN, HH_A, parent)
+    assert res.status_code == 403, res.text
+    work.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_member_cannot_add_sub_categories(db):
+    res, work = _add(A_MEMBER, HH_A, "OPEX-DINING")
+    assert res.status_code == 403
+    work.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_get_sub_categories_for_parent_scopes_by_household(db):
+    from salary_cycle import get_sub_categories_for_parent
+
+    assert get_sub_categories_for_parent("CUSTOM-B-ONLY", [HH_A]) == []
+    assert [s["sub_code"] for s in get_sub_categories_for_parent("CUSTOM-B-ONLY", [HH_B])] == ["b-sub"]
+    assert [s["sub_code"] for s in get_sub_categories_for_parent("OPEX-DINING", [HH_A])] == ["coffee"]
+    # Internal callers without a household keep the unrestricted lookup.
+    assert [s["sub_code"] for s in get_sub_categories_for_parent("CUSTOM-B-ONLY")] == ["b-sub"]
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_supabase_key_validation.py b/ai_service/tests/test_supabase_key_validation.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1bcbf9f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_supabase_key_validation.py
@@ -0,0 +1,217 @@
+"""API-07: the service must only ever run with a privileged (service_role / sb_secret_) key."""
+
+import pytest
+from jose import jwt
+
+import supabase_client
+
+
+def _legacy_key(role: str) -> str:
+    return jwt.encode({"iss": "supabase", "ref": "mockproject", "role": role}, "k" * 32, algorithm="HS256")
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def captured(monkeypatch):
+    calls = {}
+
+    def fake_create_client(url, key):
+        calls["url"], calls["key"] = url, key
+        return object()
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(supabase_client, "_client", None)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(supabase_client, "create_client", fake_create_client)
+    monkeypatch.delenv("SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY", raising=False)
+    monkeypatch.delenv("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY", raising=False)
+    return calls
+
+
+def test_anon_jwt_in_secret_key_is_rejected_and_never_echoed(captured, monkeypatch):
+    anon = _legacy_key("anon")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY", anon)
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError) as exc:
+        supabase_client.get_client()
+    assert "anon" in str(exc.value)
+    assert anon not in str(exc.value)
+    assert "key" not in captured
+    assert supabase_client.is_supabase_configured() is False
+
+
+def test_valid_service_role_key_wins_over_anon_secret_key(captured, monkeypatch):
+    service = _legacy_key("service_role")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY", _legacy_key("anon"))
+    monkeypatch.setenv("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY", service)
+    supabase_client.get_client()
+    assert captured["key"] == service
+
+
+def test_publishable_key_is_rejected(captured, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY", "sb_publishable_abcdefghijklmnop")
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
+        supabase_client.get_client()
+
+
+def test_opaque_secret_key_is_accepted(captured, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY", "sb_secret_mock_value_for_tests_only")
+    supabase_client.get_client()
+    assert captured["key"] == "sb_secret_mock_value_for_tests_only"
+    assert supabase_client.describe_supabase_key()["role"] == "secret"
+
+
+# ─── External review (Gemini) BLOCKER 1: sb_secret_ keys in either variable, clear precedence ──
+
+SB_SECRET = "sb_secret_mock_value_for_tests_only"
+SB_SECRET_OTHER = "sb_secret_other_mock_value_for_tests"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("env_var", ["SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY", "SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY"])
+def test_opaque_secret_key_is_accepted_in_either_variable(captured, monkeypatch, env_var):
+    monkeypatch.setenv(env_var, SB_SECRET)
+    supabase_client.get_client()
+    assert captured["key"] == SB_SECRET
+    info = supabase_client.describe_supabase_key()
+    assert (info["env_var"], info["role"]) == (env_var, "secret")
+    assert info["warnings"] == []
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("env_var", ["SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY", "SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY"])
+def test_legacy_service_role_jwt_is_accepted_in_either_variable(captured, monkeypatch, env_var):
+    service = _legacy_key("service_role")
+    monkeypatch.setenv(env_var, service)
+    supabase_client.get_client()
+    assert captured["key"] == service
+    assert supabase_client.describe_supabase_key()["role"] == "service_role"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("env_var", ["SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY", "SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "value, role",
+    [
+        (_legacy_key("anon"), "anon"),
+        (_legacy_key("authenticated"), "authenticated"),
+        ("sb_publishable_abcdefghijklmnop", "publishable"),
+        ("sb_secret_", "unknown"),
+        ("not-a-supabase-key", "unknown"),
+        (_legacy_key("supabase_admin"), "unknown-jwt"),
+    ],
+    ids=["anon-jwt", "authenticated-jwt", "publishable", "bare-prefix", "garbage", "other-role-jwt"],
+)
+def test_non_privileged_key_alone_is_rejected_in_either_variable(captured, monkeypatch, env_var, value, role):
+    monkeypatch.setenv(env_var, value)
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError) as exc:
+        supabase_client.get_client()
+    if value != "sb_secret_":  # the bare prefix legitimately appears in the help text
+        assert value not in str(exc.value)
+    assert "key" not in captured
+    assert supabase_client.describe_supabase_key()["rejected"] == [(env_var, role)]
+    assert supabase_client.is_supabase_configured() is False
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "service_role_value, secret_value, expected_var",
+    [
+        (_legacy_key("service_role"), _legacy_key("anon"), "SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY"),
+        (_legacy_key("anon"), SB_SECRET, "SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY"),
+        ("sb_publishable_abcdefghijklmnop", SB_SECRET, "SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY"),
+        (SB_SECRET, "sb_publishable_abcdefghijklmnop", "SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY"),
+        (SB_SECRET, _legacy_key("anon"), "SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY"),
+    ],
+    ids=["service_jwt+anon", "anon+sb_secret", "publishable+sb_secret", "sb_secret+publishable", "sb_secret+anon"],
+)
+def test_privileged_key_wins_over_non_privileged_one_with_a_warning(
+    captured, monkeypatch, service_role_value, secret_value, expected_var
+):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY", service_role_value)
+    monkeypatch.setenv("SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY", secret_value)
+    supabase_client.get_client()
+    expected = service_role_value if expected_var == "SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY" else secret_value
+    assert captured["key"] == expected
+    info = supabase_client.describe_supabase_key()
+    assert info["env_var"] == expected_var
+    other = "SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY" if expected_var == "SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY" else "SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY"
+    assert [var for var, _ in info["rejected"]] == [other]
+    assert len(info["warnings"]) == 1 and other in info["warnings"][0]
+    assert service_role_value not in info["warnings"][0] and secret_value not in info["warnings"][0]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "service_role_value, secret_value",
+    [
+        (_legacy_key("service_role"), SB_SECRET),  # sb_secret_ beats a legacy JWT whichever variable holds it
+        (SB_SECRET, _legacy_key("service_role")),
+    ],
+    ids=["service_jwt+sb_secret", "sb_secret+service_jwt"],
+)
+def test_opaque_secret_key_is_preferred_over_legacy_service_role_jwt(captured, monkeypatch, service_role_value, secret_value):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY", service_role_value)
+    monkeypatch.setenv("SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY", secret_value)
+    supabase_client.get_client()
+    assert captured["key"] == SB_SECRET
+    info = supabase_client.describe_supabase_key()
+    assert info["role"] == "secret"
+    assert len(info["warnings"]) == 1 and "ignored" in info["warnings"][0]
+
+
+def test_two_different_opaque_secret_keys_use_supabase_secret_key_and_warn(captured, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY", SB_SECRET_OTHER)
+    monkeypatch.setenv("SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY", SB_SECRET)
+    supabase_client.get_client()
+    assert captured["key"] == SB_SECRET
+    assert len(supabase_client.describe_supabase_key()["warnings"]) == 1
+
+
+def test_same_opaque_secret_key_in_both_variables_is_silent(captured, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY", SB_SECRET)
+    monkeypatch.setenv("SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY", f"  {SB_SECRET}\n")
+    supabase_client.get_client()
+    assert captured["key"] == SB_SECRET
+    assert supabase_client.describe_supabase_key()["warnings"] == []
+
+
+def test_startup_check_warns_about_ignored_anon_key_without_echoing_it(captured, monkeypatch, caplog):
+    import logging
+
+    import main
+
+    anon = _legacy_key("anon")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY", anon)
+    monkeypatch.setenv("SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY", SB_SECRET)
+    with caplog.at_level(logging.WARNING, logger="main"):
+        main._log_security_configuration()
+    records = [r for r in caplog.records if r.name == "main"]
+    assert any(r.levelno == logging.WARNING and "SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY" in r.getMessage() for r in records)
+    assert not any(r.levelno >= logging.CRITICAL for r in records)
+    assert all(anon not in r.getMessage() and SB_SECRET not in r.getMessage() for r in records)
+
+
+def test_startup_check_is_critical_when_no_privileged_key(captured, monkeypatch, caplog):
+    import logging
+
+    import main
+
+    monkeypatch.setenv("SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY", "sb_publishable_abcdefghijklmnop")
+    with caplog.at_level(logging.WARNING, logger="main"):
+        main._log_security_configuration()
+    critical = [r.getMessage() for r in caplog.records if r.name == "main" and r.levelno >= logging.CRITICAL]
+    assert any("SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY" in m for m in critical)
+    assert any("No privileged Supabase key" in m for m in critical)
+
+
+def test_requirements_pin_a_supabase_py_that_accepts_sb_secret_keys():
+    """supabase-py <= 2.15.3 rejects non-JWT keys in create_client ("Invalid API key"); 2.16.0 removed that check."""
+    import pathlib
+    import re
+
+    text = (pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "requirements.txt").read_text()
+    match = re.search(r"^supabase>=([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)", text, re.MULTILINE)
+    assert match, "supabase must have an exact x.y.z lower bound"
+    assert tuple(int(p) for p in match.groups()) >= (2, 16, 0)
+
+
+def test_installed_supabase_py_accepts_opaque_secret_key_offline():
+    """create_client must accept the opaque key and send it as `apikey` (plus the identical Bearer supabase-js sends)."""
+    from supabase import create_client
+
+    client = create_client("https://mockproject.supabase.co", SB_SECRET)
+    headers = client.postgrest.session.headers
+    assert headers["apikey"] == SB_SECRET
+    assert headers["Authorization"] == f"Bearer {SB_SECRET}"

diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_taxonomy_and_bnpl.py b/ai_service/tests/test_taxonomy_and_bnpl.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..580b8a3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_taxonomy_and_bnpl.py
@@ -0,0 +1,258 @@
+"""
+Product review R4 (Saudi taxonomy) and R10 (BNPL schedule), migration 20261021000000.
+
+- Installment amounts are exact in halalas (the last installment absorbs the remainder) and due
+  every two weeks (Tabby / Tamara "Pay in 4", first payment at purchase) or every month (bank).
+- ``frequency`` defaults by provider; the API returns ``frequency`` and ``next_due_at``; a payment
+  advances ``next_due_at`` by one interval.
+- ``list_plans`` reads installment_plans rows only; legacy "Financed via" notes become rows only
+  through the explicit, idempotent backfill.
+- The new system sub-categories are trusted for keyword matching and the new categories are
+  "available, not budgeted" for existing households.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+import re
+from datetime import date
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+import pytest
+from pydantic import ValidationError
+from starlette.testclient import TestClient
+
+from installment_service import (
+    InstallmentPlan,
+    InstallmentPlanCreate,
+    InstallmentService,
+    calculate_installment_terms,
+    default_frequency_for_provider,
+    installment_amounts,
+    installment_due_date,
+    next_due_date,
+)
+
+HID = "f860188e-23b5-4749-b180-868c956151a6"
+CALLER = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
+HEADERS = {"X-App-Token": os.environ.get("APP_AUTH_TOKEN", "test_token_for_ci_only")}
+MIGRATION = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "..", "supabase", "migrations",
+                         "20261021000000_saudi_taxonomy_and_bnpl_schedule.sql")
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def api(fake_supabase):
+    fake_supabase.seed("household_memberships", [{"household_id": HID, "user_id": CALLER, "role": "admin"}])
+    from main import app
+
+    return TestClient(app)
+
+
+# ─── Amounts and dates ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("total,count", [
+    (100, 3), (0.5, 4), (7408, 4), (999.99, 4), (0.09, 12), (0.01, 60), (1234.56, 7), (10_000_000, 60),
+])
+def test_installment_amounts_are_exact_halalas(total, count):
+    amounts = installment_amounts(total, count)
+    assert len(amounts) == count
+    assert sum(Decimal(str(a)) for a in amounts) == Decimal(str(total)).quantize(Decimal("0.01"))
+    assert all(a >= 0 for a in amounts)
+    assert len(set(amounts[:-1])) <= 1  # every installment but the last is the same
+
+
+def test_last_installment_absorbs_the_remainder():
+    assert installment_amounts(100, 3) == [33.33, 33.33, 33.34]
+    assert installment_amounts(0.5, 4) == [0.13, 0.13, 0.13, 0.11]
+    assert installment_amounts(0.09, 12)[-1] == 0.09  # half-up would make the last one negative
+
+
+def test_due_dates_biweekly_and_monthly_from_the_anchor():
+    start = date(2026, 1, 31)
+    assert [installment_due_date(start, "biweekly", i).isoformat() for i in range(4)] == [
+        "2026-01-31", "2026-02-14", "2026-02-28", "2026-03-14"]
+    # Month arithmetic from the anchor, like PostgreSQL: no drift after February.
+    assert [installment_due_date(start, "monthly", i).isoformat() for i in range(4)] == [
+        "2026-01-31", "2026-02-28", "2026-03-31", "2026-04-30"]
+    assert installment_due_date(date(2027, 12, 31), "monthly", 2).isoformat() == "2028-02-29"
+    assert next_due_date("2026-10-01", "biweekly", 4, 4) is None
+    assert next_due_date("2026-10-01", "biweekly", 1, 4, "CANCELLED") is None
+    assert next_due_date("2026-10-01", "biweekly", 0, 4) == "2026-10-01"
+
+
+def test_terms_pay_in_4_every_two_weeks_first_at_purchase():
+    terms = calculate_installment_terms(999.99, 4, start_date=date(2026, 10, 1), frequency="biweekly")
+    assert terms["frequency"] == "biweekly"
+    assert [(s["due_date"], s["amount"], s["paid"]) for s in terms["schedule"]] == [
+        ("2026-10-01", 250.0, True), ("2026-10-15", 250.0, False),
+        ("2026-10-29", 250.0, False), ("2026-11-12", 249.99, False)]
+    assert terms["monthly_amount"] == 250.0 and terms["final_installment_amount"] == 249.99
+    assert terms["remaining_amount"] == 749.99 and terms["remaining_installments"] == 3
+    assert terms["next_due_at"] == "2026-10-15"
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        calculate_installment_terms(100, 4, frequency="weekly")
+
+
+# ─── Frequency defaults and the API contract ──────────────────────────────────
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("provider,count,want", [
+    ("Tabby", 4, "biweekly"), ("TAMARA", 4, "biweekly"), (" tamara ", 4, "biweekly"),
+    ("Tamara", 3, "monthly"), ("Tabby", 12, "monthly"), ("Bank", 4, "monthly"), ("Other", 4, "monthly"),
+])
+def test_default_frequency_by_provider(provider, count, want):
+    assert default_frequency_for_provider(provider, count) == want
+    req = InstallmentPlanCreate(household_id=HID, merchant="m", provider=provider, total_amount=400,
+                                installment_count=count)
+    assert req.frequency == want
+
+
+def test_explicit_frequency_wins_and_unknown_is_refused():
+    req = InstallmentPlanCreate(household_id=HID, merchant="m", provider="Tabby", total_amount=400,
+                                frequency="Monthly")
+    assert req.frequency == "monthly"
+    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
+        InstallmentPlanCreate(household_id=HID, merchant="m", total_amount=400, frequency="weekly")
+
+
+def test_api_tabby_plan_is_biweekly_and_payments_advance_next_due(api, fake_supabase):
+    r = api.post("/budgets/installments", headers=HEADERS, json={
+        "household_id": HID, "merchant": "Noon", "provider": "Tabby", "total_amount": 999.99,
+        "start_date": "2026-10-01", "adjust_original_transaction": False})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    plan = r.json()
+    assert plan["frequency"] == "biweekly" and plan["next_due_at"] == "2026-10-15"
+    assert plan["installment_count"] == 4 and plan["paid_installments"] == 1 and plan["monthly_amount"] == 250.0
+    stored = fake_supabase.tables["installment_plans"][0]
+    assert stored["frequency"] == "biweekly" and stored["next_due_at"] == "2026-10-15"
+
+    listed = api.get(f"/budgets/installments?household_id={HID}", headers=HEADERS).json()["plans"]
+    assert [(p["frequency"], p["next_due_at"]) for p in listed] == [("biweekly", "2026-10-15")]
+
+    dues = [api.post(f"/budgets/installments/{plan['id']}/pay", headers=HEADERS).json()["next_due_at"]
+            for _ in range(3)]
+    assert dues == ["2026-10-29", "2026-11-12", None]
+    assert fake_supabase.tables["installment_plans"][0]["status"] == "COMPLETED"
+
+
+def test_api_bank_plan_is_monthly(api):
+    r = api.post("/budgets/installments", headers=HEADERS, json={
+        "household_id": HID, "merchant": "Jarir", "provider": "Bank", "total_amount": 1000,
+        "installment_count": 3, "start_date": "2026-01-31", "adjust_original_transaction": False})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert (r.json()["frequency"], r.json()["next_due_at"], r.json()["monthly_amount"]) == (
+        "monthly", "2026-02-28", 333.33)
+
+
+def test_api_refuses_an_unknown_frequency(api, fake_supabase):
+    r = api.post("/budgets/installments", headers=HEADERS, json={
+        "household_id": HID, "merchant": "Noon", "total_amount": 100, "frequency": "weekly"})
+    assert r.status_code == 422, r.text
+    assert not fake_supabase.tables.get("installment_plans")
+
+
+def test_plan_rows_from_an_older_database_still_load():
+    plan = InstallmentPlan(id="p", household_id=HID, merchant="m", total_amount=100, monthly_amount=25,
+                           start_date="2026-10-01T00:00:00")
+    assert plan.frequency == "monthly" and plan.next_due_at is None and plan.start_date == "2026-10-01"
+
+
+# ─── No regex reconstruction; explicit legacy backfill ────────────────────────
+
+LEGACY_TX = {
+    "id": "aaaaaaaa-0000-4000-8000-0000000000aa", "household_id": HID, "merchant": "eXtra",
+    "amount": 300.0, "category_code": "OPEX-SHOPPING", "timestamp": "2026-09-10T12:00:00+03:00",
+    "raw_sms": "Chat: eXtra 1200 [Financed via Tamara: Installment 1 of 4. Full price: SAR 1,200.00]",
+}
+
+
+def test_list_plans_reads_rows_only(fake_supabase):
+    fake_supabase.seed("transactions", [LEGACY_TX, {
+        "id": "bbbbbbbb-0000-4000-8000-0000000000bb", "household_id": HID, "merchant": "Tabby",
+        "amount": 50.0, "raw_sms": "Paid Tabby", "category_code": "OPEX-SHOPPING"}])
+    assert InstallmentService.list_plans(HID) == []
+
+
+def test_legacy_backfill_is_explicit_and_idempotent(fake_supabase):
+    fake_supabase.seed("transactions", [LEGACY_TX, {
+        "id": "bbbbbbbb-0000-4000-8000-0000000000bb", "household_id": HID, "merchant": "Tabby",
+        "amount": 50.0, "raw_sms": "Paid Tabby", "category_code": "OPEX-SHOPPING"}])
+
+    dry = InstallmentService.backfill_plans_from_legacy_notes(HID)
+    assert dry["candidates"] == 1 and dry["created"] == 0 and not fake_supabase.tables.get("installment_plans")
+
+    done = InstallmentService.backfill_plans_from_legacy_notes(HID, apply=True)
+    assert done["created"] == 1
+    plans = InstallmentService.list_plans(HID)
+    assert len(plans) == 1
+    p = plans[0]
+    assert (p.provider, p.total_amount, p.installment_count, p.paid_installments, p.monthly_amount) == (
+        "Tamara", 1200.0, 4, 1, 300.0)
+    assert (p.frequency, p.start_date, p.next_due_at, p.original_transaction_id) == (
+        "biweekly", "2026-09-10", "2026-09-24", LEGACY_TX["id"])
+    assert fake_supabase.tables["transactions"][0]["amount"] == 300.0  # the transaction is not touched
+
+    again = InstallmentService.backfill_plans_from_legacy_notes(HID, apply=True)
+    assert again["candidates"] == 0 and again["created"] == 0
+    assert len(fake_supabase.tables["installment_plans"]) == 1
+
+
+def test_active_plans_are_listed_by_next_due_date(fake_supabase):
+    base = {"household_id": HID, "merchant": "m", "total_amount": 400, "installment_count": 4,
+            "monthly_amount": 100, "paid_installments": 1}
+    fake_supabase.seed("installment_plans", [
+        {**base, "id": "p-done", "status": "COMPLETED", "created_at": "2026-10-03"},
+        {**base, "id": "p-late", "status": "ACTIVE", "next_due_at": "2026-11-20", "created_at": "2026-10-01"},
+        {**base, "id": "p-soon", "status": "ACTIVE", "next_due_at": "2026-10-25", "created_at": "2026-10-02"},
+    ])
+    assert [p.id for p in InstallmentService.list_plans(HID)] == ["p-soon", "p-late", "p-done"]
+
+
+# ─── Taxonomy ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def _migration_sub_categories():
+    sql = open(MIGRATION, encoding="utf-8").read()
+    section = sql[sql.index("INSERT INTO public.cost_control_sub_categories"):sql.index("ON CONFLICT (parent_code, sub_code)")]
+    return set(re.findall(r"\('(OPEX-[A-Z-]+)', '([a-z_]+)', '", section))
+
+
+def test_system_sub_categories_match_the_migration():
+    from salary_cycle import SAUDI_TAXONOMY_CATEGORIES, SYSTEM_SUB_CATEGORIES
+
+    seeded = _migration_sub_categories()
+    assert len(seeded) == 23
+    assert {parent for parent, _ in seeded} == set(SAUDI_TAXONOMY_CATEGORIES)
+    assert {s for s in SYSTEM_SUB_CATEGORIES if s[0] in SAUDI_TAXONOMY_CATEGORIES} == seeded
+    assert ("OPEX-UTILITIES", "housing_rent") in SYSTEM_SUB_CATEGORIES  # the old row stays valid
+
+
+def test_new_system_sub_category_keywords_match(fake_supabase):
+    from salary_cycle import match_sub_category
+
+    fake_supabase.seed("cost_control_codes", [
+        {"id": "c1", "code": "OPEX-HOUSING", "category": "Housing & Rent", "keywords": ["ejar"],
+         "is_flexible": False, "is_system": True, "household_id": None}])
+    fake_supabase.seed("cost_control_sub_categories", [
+        {"parent_code": "OPEX-HOUSING", "sub_code": "housing_rent", "name_en": "Housing Rent",
+         "name_ar": "إيجار السكن", "keywords": ["rent", "إيجار"]},
+        {"parent_code": "OPEX-HOUSING", "sub_code": "annual_rent", "name_en": "Annual Rent",
+         "name_ar": "الإيجار السنوي", "keywords": ["annual rent", "عقد إيجار"]}])
+    assert match_sub_category("OPEX-HOUSING", "دفعة إيجار شهر اكتوبر") == "housing_rent"
+
+
+def test_new_categories_are_available_but_not_budgeted(fake_supabase):
+    from salary_cycle import get_household_categories
+
+    fake_supabase.seed("cost_control_codes", [
+        {"id": "c0", "code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "category": "Grocery", "keywords": ["tamimi"],
+         "is_flexible": False, "is_system": True, "household_id": None},
+        {"id": "c1", "code": "OPEX-HOUSING", "category": "Housing & Rent", "keywords": ["ejar"],
+         "is_flexible": False, "is_system": True, "household_id": None},
+        {"id": "c2", "code": "OPEX-CHARITY", "category": "Charity & Zakat", "keywords": ["zakat"],
+         "is_flexible": False, "is_system": True, "household_id": None}])
+    cats = get_household_categories(HID)
+    assert {c["code"] for c in cats["active"]} == {"OPEX-GROCERY"}
+    assert {c["code"] for c in cats["inactive"]} == {"OPEX-HOUSING", "OPEX-CHARITY"}
+
+    # Once the household adds a budget for it, the category is active.
+    fake_supabase.seed("budgets", [{"household_id": HID, "category_code": "OPEX-HOUSING", "is_active": True}])
+    cats = get_household_categories(HID)
+    assert {c["code"] for c in cats["active"]} == {"OPEX-GROCERY", "OPEX-HOUSING"}
diff --git a/ai_service/tests/test_unknown_category_code.py b/ai_service/tests/test_unknown_category_code.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b884706
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ai_service/tests/test_unknown_category_code.py
@@ -0,0 +1,173 @@
+"""
+E2E-03 (docs/review/audit/e2e_results.md): a commit whose category code is in neither the
+global taxonomy nor the household's own categories answered 500. The DB trigger
+validate_category_code_exists refuses it with SQLSTATE 23503, and the APIError escaped
+insert_transaction's fallback chain unhandled. It is the client's error: 422 with a fixed message.
+
+The fake below mimics that trigger on public.transactions inserts.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from postgrest.exceptions import APIError
+
+import fakes
+from main import app
+
+HH = "aaaa0000-0000-4000-8000-00000000e301"
+OTHER_HH = "bbbb0000-0000-4000-8000-00000000e302"
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def db(fake_supabase, monkeypatch):
+    fake_supabase.seed("cost_control_codes", [
+        {"id": "c1", "code": "OPEX-MISC", "category": "Misc", "keywords": [], "is_flexible": True,
+         "household_id": None, "is_system": True},
+        {"id": "c2", "code": "OPEX-DINING", "category": "Dining", "keywords": ["cafe"], "is_flexible": False,
+         "household_id": None, "is_system": True},
+        {"id": "c3", "code": "CUSTOM-OURS", "category": "Ours", "keywords": [], "is_flexible": False,
+         "household_id": HH, "is_system": False},
+        {"id": "c4", "code": "CUSTOM-THEIRS", "category": "Theirs", "keywords": [], "is_flexible": False,
+         "household_id": OTHER_HH, "is_system": False},
+    ])
+    fake_supabase.seed("households", [{"id": HH, "name": "H", "payday_day": 27}])
+    attempts = []
+    original = fakes.FakeQuery.execute
+
+    def execute(self):
+        if self._table == "transactions" and self._op == "insert":
+            attempts.append(dict(self._payload))
+            code = self._payload.get("category_code")
+            ok = any(
+                r["code"] == code and r.get("household_id") in (None, self._payload.get("household_id"))
+                for r in self._client.tables.get("cost_control_codes", [])
+            )
+            if code is not None and not ok:
+                raise APIError({
+                    "code": "23503",
+                    "message": f"Category code {code} does not exist in global or household taxonomy",
+                    "hint": None, "details": None,
+                })
+        return original(self)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(fakes.FakeQuery, "execute", execute)
+    fake_supabase.insert_attempts = attempts
+    return fake_supabase
+
+
+def _insert(code: str):
+    from supabase_client import insert_transaction
+
+    return insert_transaction(
+        household_id=HH, amount=12.0, currency="SAR", merchant="Mystery", category_code=code,
+        timestamp="2026-10-20T10:00:00+00:00", raw_sms="Chat: mystery 12", source="chat",
+        user_id="00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001",
+    )
+
+
+def test_insert_transaction_raises_unknown_category_without_retrying(db):
+    from supabase_client import UnknownCategoryError
+
+    with pytest.raises(UnknownCategoryError):
+        _insert("OPEX-NOPE")
+    # The refusal is not a schema mismatch: no pruned-payload retries.
+    assert len(db.insert_attempts) == 1
+    assert db.tables.get("transactions", []) == []
+
+
+def test_insert_transaction_accepts_global_and_own_codes(db):
+    assert _insert("OPEX-DINING")
+    assert _insert("CUSTOM-OURS")
+    assert len(db.tables["transactions"]) == 2
+
+
+def test_category_code_in_taxonomy_follows_the_trigger_rule(db):
+    from supabase_client import category_code_in_taxonomy
+
+    assert category_code_in_taxonomy(HH, "OPEX-DINING") is True
+    assert category_code_in_taxonomy(HH, "CUSTOM-OURS") is True
+    assert category_code_in_taxonomy(HH, "CUSTOM-THEIRS") is False  # another household's code
+    assert category_code_in_taxonomy(HH, "OPEX-NOPE") is False
+
+
+def _chat(category_code, **extra):
+    return client.post("/agent/chat-transaction", json={
+        "household_id": HH, "message": "Mystery 12 SAR", "allow_duplicate": True,
+        "category_code": category_code, **extra,
+    })
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("code", ["OPEX-NOPE", "CUSTOM-THEIRS", "   ", 42])

@@ -0,0 +1,81 @@
+"""API-15: ZATCA Phase 1/2 TLV decoder robustness."""
+
+import base64
+
+import pytest
+
+from receipt_scanner import decode_zatca_tlv
+
+
+def tlv(tag: int, value: str, ber: bool = False) -> bytes:
+    raw = value.encode("utf-8")
+    n = len(raw)
+    if ber and n >= 0x80:
+        length = bytes([0x81, n]) if n <= 0xFF else bytes([0x82, n >> 8, n & 0xFF])
+    else:
+        length = bytes([n])
+    return bytes([tag]) + length + raw
+
+
+def qr(seller="Tamimi Markets", vat="300000000000003", ts="2026-10-04T22:19:34Z", total="185.50", vat_amt="24.20", ber=False) -> bytes:
+    return tlv(1, seller, ber) + tlv(2, vat) + tlv(3, ts) + tlv(4, total) + tlv(5, vat_amt)
+
+
+def b64(raw: bytes) -> str:
+    return base64.b64encode(raw).decode()
+
+
+def test_decodes_standard_qr_with_arabic_seller():
+    res = decode_zatca_tlv(b64(qr(seller="أسواق التميمي")))
+    assert res["seller_name"] == "أسواق التميمي"
+    assert res["total_amount"] == 185.50
+    assert res["vat_amount"] == 24.20
+    assert res["vat_number"] == "300000000000003"
+
+
+def test_accepts_urlsafe_and_unpadded_base64():
+    encoded = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(qr(seller="متجر؟؟>>")).decode().rstrip("=")
+    assert decode_zatca_tlv(encoded)["seller_name"] == "متجر؟؟>>"
+
+
+def test_rejects_garbage_base64_instead_of_decoding_noise():
+    assert decode_zatca_tlv("@@@@ not base64 at all !!!!") is None
+
+
+def test_rejects_truncated_value():
+    raw = qr()
+    assert decode_zatca_tlv(b64(raw[:-3])) is None
+
+
+def test_long_seller_name_with_ber_multibyte_length():
+    name = ("شركة " * 40).strip()  # ~360 bytes in UTF-8 → 0x82 two-byte BER length
+    res = decode_zatca_tlv(b64(qr(seller=name, ber=True)))
+    assert res is not None and res["seller_name"] == name
+    short_ber = "X" * 150  # 0x81 one-byte BER length
+    assert decode_zatca_tlv(b64(qr(seller=short_ber, ber=True)))["seller_name"] == short_ber
+
+
+def test_long_seller_name_with_single_byte_length():
+    name = "Store" * 40  # 200 bytes, Phase-1 style single byte length
+    res = decode_zatca_tlv(b64(qr(seller=name)))
+    assert res is not None and res["seller_name"] == name
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("total", ["abc", "NaN", "inf", "-5.00", "1e309", ""])
+def test_rejects_non_numeric_or_invalid_totals(total):
+    assert decode_zatca_tlv(b64(qr(total=total))) is None
+
+
+def test_invalid_vat_amount_is_dropped_not_fatal():
+    res = decode_zatca_tlv(b64(qr(vat_amt="n/a")))
+    assert res is not None and res["vat_amount"] is None
+
+
+def test_phase2_extra_tags_are_ignored():
+    raw = qr() + bytes([6, 3]) + b"abc" + bytes([8, 2]) + b"\x01\x02"
+    assert decode_zatca_tlv(b64(raw))["total_amount"] == 185.50
+
+
+def test_invalid_utf8_seller_rejected():
+    raw = bytes([1, 2, 0xC3, 0x28]) + tlv(4, "10.00")
+    assert decode_zatca_tlv(b64(raw)) is None

+# Saudi Arabia is UTC+3 all year (no DST since 1979). A fixed offset avoids a runtime dependency
+# on the tzdata package in slim containers and matches Postgres' AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh'.
+RIYADH_TZ = timezone(timedelta(hours=3), "Asia/Riyadh")
+
+
+def utc_now() -> datetime:
+    """Current UTC time (single seam for tests)."""
+    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+
+
+def riyadh_today() -> date:
+    """
+    Today's calendar date in Riyadh. Salary cycles are defined on Riyadh dates (the DB function
+    get_saudi_cycle_for_timestamp converts to Asia/Riyadh); using the UTC date reported the
+    previous cycle between 00:00 and 03:00 Riyadh time on payday.
+    """
+    return utc_now().astimezone(RIYADH_TZ).date()
+
+
+def riyadh_date_for_timestamp(ts: Optional[str | datetime]) -> date:
+    """Riyadh calendar date of an ISO-8601 timestamp (naive values are treated as UTC)."""
+    if ts is None or ts == "":
+        return riyadh_today()
+    dt = ts if isinstance(ts, datetime) else datetime.fromisoformat(str(ts).replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+    if dt.tzinfo is None:
+        dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    return dt.astimezone(RIYADH_TZ).date()
+

+def bounded_text(body: dict, field: str, max_length: int) -> Optional[str]:
+    """
+    Optional free-text field of a JSON body: None when absent, else a string of at most
+    ``max_length`` characters, otherwise HTTP 422 (FABLE-API-06: overrides were stored verbatim,
+    up to ~24 MiB per row).
+    """
+    value = body.get(field)
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=f"{field} must be text.")
+    if len(value) > max_length:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=f"{field} must be at most {max_length} characters.")
+    return value
+
+
+MAX_EXPENSE_AMOUNT = Decimal("10000000")
+
+
+def optional_amount(body: dict, field: str = "amount") -> Optional[float]:
+    """
+    Optional user-corrected expense amount of a JSON body (UX-12): None when absent, else a
+    positive number of at most 10,000,000 SAR rounded to halalas, otherwise HTTP 422. Booleans,
+    text, NaN and infinities are refused.
+    """
+    value = body.get(field)
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=f"{field} must be a number.")
+    if not math.isfinite(value):
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=f"{field} must be a finite number.")
+    amount = Decimal(str(value)).quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
+    if amount <= 0 or amount > MAX_EXPENSE_AMOUNT:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=f"{field} must be more than 0 and at most 10,000,000.")
+    return float(amount)
+
+

+def _trusted_proxies() -> set[str]:

+_TRUE_ENV = {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}
+_FALSE_ENV = {"0", "false", "no", "off"}

+
+def trust_proxy_headers() -> bool:

+    decides explicitly; unset, it is on when running on Railway (RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT or
+    RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT_NAME is set), whose edge proxy is the only way into the service and
+    appends the connecting client's address to X-Forwarded-For. Railway's edge addresses are not
+    static, so TRUSTED_PROXY_IPS cannot list them.
+    """
+    explicit = os.environ.get("TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS", "").strip().lower()
+    if explicit in _TRUE_ENV:
+        return True
+    if explicit in _FALSE_ENV:
+        return False
+    return bool(os.environ.get("RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT") or os.environ.get("RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT_NAME"))
+
+
+def _trusted_proxy_hops() -> int:
+    """Proxies that append to X-Forwarded-For in front of the app (TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS, default 1)."""
+    try:
+        return min(5, max(1, int(os.environ.get("TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS", "1"))))
+    except ValueError:
+        return 1

+def _parse_ip(value: str):
+    import ipaddress
+
+    try:
+        return ipaddress.ip_address(value.strip())
+    except ValueError:

+
+
+def client_ip_info(request) -> tuple[str, bool]:
+    """
+    ``(client_ip, reliable)`` for rate limiting. X-Forwarded-For is honoured when the direct peer
+    is a configured trusted proxy (TRUSTED_PROXY_IPS, default loopback) or proxy headers are
+    trusted (trust_proxy_headers); the client is the entry the trusted proxies appended: the
+    TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS-th from the right (anything left of it is client-supplied and spoofable).
+    ``reliable`` is False when the address is not the client's own (an untrusted private or
+    loopback proxy hop, or no address at all): one such address is shared by every visitor, so
+    callers must not lock it out as if it were one person.
+    """
+    peer = request.client.host if request.client and request.client.host else ""
+    xff = request.headers.get("X-Forwarded-For")
+    if xff and (peer in _trusted_proxies() or trust_proxy_headers()):
+        parts = [p.strip() for p in xff.split(",") if p.strip()]
+        hops = _trusted_proxy_hops()
+        if parts:
+            candidate = parts[-hops] if len(parts) >= hops else parts[0]
+            if _parse_ip(candidate) is not None:
+                return candidate, True
+    ip = _parse_ip(peer)
+    if ip is not None and not (ip.is_private or ip.is_loopback or ip.is_link_local):
+        return peer, True
+    return peer or "unknown", False
+
+
+def get_client_ip(request) -> str:
+    """Client IP for rate limiting (see client_ip_info)."""
+    return client_ip_info(request)[0]

+# ─── Audit notes (transactions.raw_sms) ─────────────────────────────────────────
+# The note is for humans. Money attribution lives in structured columns (spent_by,
+# beneficiary_type, beneficiary_id); legacy rows written before that kept it in "Tag: value"
+# parts of the note, so user text placed in a note must never look like a tag (FABLE-API-01).
+AUDIT_TAG_KEYWORDS = ("paid by", "beneficiary", "spent by", "recipient", "items", "method", "note")
+_AUDIT_TAG_RE = re.compile(
+    r"(?:paid\s*by|beneficiary|spent\s*by|recipient|items|method|note)\s*:\s*", re.IGNORECASE
+)
+
+
+def sanitize_audit_text(value: object, limit: int = 500) -> str:
+    """
+    User text made safe for an audit note: no control characters, no ``|`` separator (becomes
+    ``/``) and no ``<tag>:`` keyword (removed until none is left, so nested spellings such as
+    ``PaiPaidBy:dBy:`` cannot reassemble one), whitespace collapsed, at most ``limit`` characters.
+    """
+    text = "".join(ch if ch.isprintable() else " " for ch in str(value or ""))
+    text = text.replace("|", "/")
+    while True:
+        cleaned = _AUDIT_TAG_RE.sub("", text)
+        if cleaned == text:
+            break
+        text = cleaned
+    return " ".join(text.split())[:limit]
+
+
+def build_audit_note(paid_by: str, beneficiary: str, spent_by: str, *parts: str) -> str:
+    """
+    ``PaidBy: … | Beneficiary: … | SpentBy: … | <parts>``: the server's tags first, then the
+    caller's (already sanitised) descriptive parts. Tag values are sanitised too.
+    """
+    head = (
+        f"PaidBy: {sanitize_audit_text(paid_by, 60)} | Beneficiary: {sanitize_audit_text(beneficiary, 60)} "
+        f"| SpentBy: {sanitize_audit_text(spent_by, 20)}"
+    )
+    tail = [p for p in parts if p]
+    return " | ".join([head, *tail])

 ## 1. Executive Summary & Vision
 
-**Budget Tracker** is an enterprise-grade, culturally tailored household financial operating system engineered specifically for Saudi households, expat families, and shared roommate communities in the GCC.
+**Budget Tracker** is a household finance app built for Saudi households, expat families and shared
+roommate homes in the GCC. It addresses realities that generic budgeting tools ignore:
 
-Unlike Western budgeting tools that assume generic calendar-month paydays, arbitrary 50/50 couple splits, and Western merchant categorization, Budget Tracker addresses the distinct cultural, legal, and financial realities of the Saudi market:
-- **The 27th Payday Cycle:** Public and private sector payrolls in Saudi Arabia align with the 27th of each Gregorian month.
-- **Islamic Family Finance (*Nafaqah*):** Under Islamic law, the husband carries legal financial responsibility for household maintenance. Personal spending by the wife is tracked as reimbursable debt owed to her rather than arbitrarily splitting costs.
-- **ZATCA Phase 2 E-Invoicing:** Automated camera scanning extracts Base64 TLV data (seller, VAT ID, timestamp, VAT totals) in milliseconds without cloud delay.
-- **Multi-Source Liquid Accounts:** Modern Saudi consumers split liquid wealth between traditional banks (Al Rajhi, SNB), e-wallets (STC Pay, Urpay), crypto exchanges (Binance), and physical cash. Budget Tracker links budgets directly to account balances to guarantee spending capacity.
-- **Zero SMS Interception:** Maximum privacy without requesting intrusive SMS permissions or running background listeners.
+- **Payday cycles:** budgets follow the household's payday (default the 27th, the common Saudi
+  payroll date), not the calendar month.
+- **Islamic Family Finance (*Nafaqah*):** the husband carries the household's maintenance. There is
+  no percentage split between spouses; what the wife pays for shared needs is tracked as a debt owed
+  to her, and her personal spending comes from an allowance he sets.
+- **ZATCA Phase 2 E-Invoicing:** QR codes on Saudi receipts are decoded (seller, VAT number,
+  timestamp, totals) on the device.
+- **Multi-Source Accounts:** banks, e-wallets, crypto and cash are tracked as accounts and budgets
+  are linked to the account that funds them.
+- **Zero SMS Interception:** no SMS permissions, listeners or SMS ingestion.

-## 3. Current Applied Features (100% Implemented)

 ### 3.1 Multi-Source Income, Accounts & Balances Ledger
-- **Account Types:** Supports Traditional Banks (`bank`), E-Wallets (`e_wallet`), Crypto (`crypto`), Physical Cash (`cash`), and Shared Household Pools (`shared_pool`).
-- **Liquid Asset Dashboard Card:** Summarizes total household liquidity with a discreet privacy eye toggle for public use.
-- **Inter-Account Transfers:** Atomic funds transfers with fee recording (e.g. gas fees or transfer charges) and automatic balance updates.
-- **Multi-Source Income Logging:** Itemizes incoming cash flow by source (Base Salary, Overtime, Bonus, Side Gig, Roommate Share, Other) with deduction/GOSI subtractions.
-- **Account Reconciliation:** 1-tap reconcile dialog compares app balance with actual banking apps and records adjustment records with variance calculations.
-
-### 3.2 Saudi Payday (27th) Cycle Engine & Automation
-- **27th Payday Alignment:** Cycles automatically transition on the 27th of each month (e.g. `2026-10` covers Oct 27 to Nov 26).
-- **Payday Check-in Modal:** On payday arrival, a contextual check-in banner prompts the user to enter their net salary deposit and overtime/bonuses.
-- **Salary Distribution Assistant:** 1-tap distribution assistant identifies deficits across secondary wallets (e.g. STC Pay grocery allowance) and executes batch transfers from the primary salary bank.
-- **Cycle Rollover Invariant:** Offers explicit user choice:
-  - **Option A (Category Cushion):** Rollover unspent category budget as an additional cushion in the next cycle (`previous_cycle_delta`).
-  - **Option C (Sweep to Savings):** Sweep all leftover category funds into an emergency savings account and reset category caps.
+- **Account Types:** `bank`, `e_wallet`, `crypto`, `cash`, `shared_pool`.
+- **Liquid Asset Dashboard Card:** total household liquidity with a privacy eye toggle.
+- **Inter-Account Transfers:** atomic `transfer_between_accounts` RPC with fee recording. Only
+  admins move money out of a shared pool; a personal account is debited only by its owner.
+- **Multi-Source Income Logging:** `income_records.source_type` is `salary`, `overtime`, `bonus`,
+  `side_gig`, `roommate_share` or `other`, with deductions; income records are append-only.
+- **Account Reconciliation:** compares the app balance with the bank and records an adjustment.
+
+### 3.2 Household Payday Cycle Engine
+- **Payday per household:** `households.payday_day` (1–31, default 27; admins change it via
+  `PUT /households/{id}/payday`). Dates are Asia/Riyadh; a payday past the month's end is clamped.
+- **Cycle key:** with payday 27 the cycle 27 Oct → 26 Nov 2026 is `2026-11` (payday > 15 names the
+  month the cycle ends in; payday ≤ 15 the month it starts in; payday 1 is the calendar month).
+  SQL, Python and Dart produce the same key and triggers keep `transactions.cycle_key` consistent.
+- **Payday Check-in:** on payday the app prompts for the net salary, overtime and bonuses.
+- **Salary Distribution Assistant:** proposes transfers from the salary account to under-funded accounts.
+- **Rollover rule** (`households.rollover_rule`, `GET|PUT /households/{id}/rollover-rule`):
+  `send_to_savings` (default), `rollover_to_categories` (adds `previous_cycle_delta`) or `fresh_start`.
 
 ### 3.3 Account-Linked Budget Capacity & Deficit Engine
-- **Account-to-Budget Linkage:** Each spending category is explicitly mapped to a funding account (e.g., Groceries $\to$ STC Pay; Utilities $\to$ Al Rajhi Bank).
+- **Account-to-Budget Linkage:** each category budget can name its funding account (`budgets.account_id`).
 - **Capacity Formula:** $\text{Capacity Margin} = \text{Account Balance} - \sum \text{Allocated Category Budgets}$.
-- **Status Indicators:**
-  - `🟢 Zero-Based (100% Allocated)`: Balance exactly equals allocated budget.
-  - `🔵 Surplus Buffer (+SAR X.XX)`: Available liquidity exceeds commitments.
-  - `🔴 Deficit Shortfall (-SAR X.XX)`: Account balance is lower than budgeted spending.
-- **1-Tap Quick Transfer:** Tapping a deficit alert pre-populates an account transfer sheet with the exact shortage amount from the account with the largest surplus.
+- **Status Indicators:** `🟢 Zero-Based (100% Allocated)`, `🔵 Surplus Buffer (+SAR X.XX)`,
+  `🔴 Deficit Shortfall (-SAR X.XX)`.
+- **1-Tap Quick Transfer:** a deficit alert pre-fills a transfer of the shortage from the account
+  with the largest surplus.
 
 ### 3.4 ZATCA Phase 2 QR Decoder & Vision OCR Scanner
-- **Base64 TLV Hardware Decoding:** Instant on-device parsing of Saudi ZATCA QR codes using mobile camera or gallery pickers:
-  - Tag 1 (Seller Name), Tag 2 (15-digit VAT ID), Tag 3 (Timestamp), Tag 4 (Total Amount), Tag 5 (15% VAT Amount).
-- **Gemini 2.5 Flash Vision OCR:** Multi-page receipt scanner analyzes paper invoices, extracts merchant names, purchase date, payment method, and line items with unit prices.
-- **Receipt Storage & Viewer:** Images stored securely in Supabase Storage (`receipts` bucket) with thumbnail strips and zoomable full-screen preview.
-- **Duplicate Prevention:** Heuristic duplicate candidate detection alerts users if a receipt with identical merchant, total, and timestamp was previously ingested.
+- **TLV decoding** on the device (`flutter_app/lib/services/zatca_decoder.dart`) and as a hint on the
+  server (`receipt_scanner.decode_zatca_tlv`): Tag 1 seller, 2 VAT number, 3 timestamp, 4 total,
+  5 VAT amount.
+- **Vision OCR:** `POST /agent/scan-receipt` sends receipt pages to the model configured in
+  `LITELLM_MODEL` (Gemini by default) and extracts merchant, date, payment method and line items.
+- **Receipt Storage & Viewer:** images in the **private** `receipts` bucket under the household's
+  folder (size and MIME limits), photo strips and a zoomable viewer. The server uploads a photo
+  only after the transaction row exists (never for a preview, a duplicate prompt or a refused insert).
+- **One model call per expense:** the preview of a chat message or receipt returns a server-signed
+  `preview_token` (HMAC with `PREVIEW_TOKEN_SECRET`, 15 minutes, bound to the user, household and
+  input). A commit that sends it back is saved from the signed result without a second model call;
+  edits go through the same validation. Tampered: 422 `invalid_preview_token`; expired: parsed again
+  (a receipt commit without photos then answers 422 `preview_token_expired`). OCR runs at temperature 0.1.
+- **Duplicate Prevention:** `dedup_engine.py` flags candidates (QR fingerprint, merchant, total, time).

 ### 3.6 Islamic Family Nafaqah & Multi-Roommate Settlements
-- **Islamic Nafaqah Enforcement:**
-  - Strict prohibition against arbitrary 50/50 spousal splits.
-  - Tracks wife's household out-of-pocket expenses as **Wife Reimbursement Debt** owed by the husband.
-  - Visual metrics display total debt balance and single-tap payment logging.
-- **Multi-Roommate Settlement Engine:**
-  - Solves multi-way debts between flatmates (Rent, Cleaning, Fiber Internet, Utilities).
-  - Graph-based debt simplification minimizes transaction count (e.g. 5 debts simplified into 2 direct payments).
-  - Shared Pool accounts (`is_shared_pool = true`) allow roommates to pool monthly contributions and view real-time pool health.
+- **Family mode, rules 1–4 in [`.agents/rules/02-…`](../.agents/rules/02-saudi-fintech-and-islamic-compliance.md):**
+  - No 50/50 or any percentage split between the spouses: shared family expenses are the husband's Nafaqah.
+  - The wife paying for something shared from her own money is tagged `transactions.nafaqah_class = 'wife_reimbursable'` and becomes a debt the husband owes her; the app shows the outstanding balance and history and records partial or full repayments (overpayment rejected).
+  - Her personal purchases are tagged `wife_personal` and charged to her **personal allowance ("مصروفها")** per salary cycle, set by the husband or an admin (never by her); allocated / spent / remaining is shown, overspend goes negative and is never blocked.
+  - Expense entry (manual, chat review, edit) offers "Husband paid", "Shared for family (husband reimburses)" or "Personal (from my/her allowance)".
+  - API: see [§5](#5-api-endpoints) (`/households/{id}/nafaqah…`). All require the caller's JWT and household membership; `POST /households/{id}/reimbursements` writes the Nafaqah ledger in family households.
+- **Multi-Roommate Settlement Engine:** equal splits between roommates, graph-based debt
+  simplification (`settlement_engine.simplify_debts`), shared pool accounts (`is_shared_pool = true`),
+  and a settle message that can be copied for WhatsApp.

+### 3.8 Households, Roles & Targeted Claim-on-Join
+- **Roles:** `household_memberships.role` is `admin` or `member`. The **primary admin**
+  (`households.owner_user_id`) and any number of **co-admins** share admin rights; co-admins cannot
+  demote or remove the primary admin. Members edit only their own transactions; admins any
+  transaction of the household. Role changes go only through RPCs
+  (`promote_member_to_admin`, `revoke_admin`, `transfer_primary_admin`); details in
+  [`.agents/rules/04-security-and-privacy.md`](../.agents/rules/04-security-and-privacy.md) §4.
+- **Dependents** (children, elderly) are `household_dependents` profiles with allowances, not app users.
+- **Placeholder members & claim-on-join:** an invite with `target_member_id` lets the person who joins
+  claim the placeholder's history and allowance.
+- **Multiple households:** a user can belong to several households and switch the active one
+  (`switch_active_household`).

-### 3.14 Security Hardening & Zero SMS Interception Policy
-- **Zero SMS Interception:** Completely standalone without background SMS listeners or invasive SMS permissions.
-- **Key Segregation:** `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` is strictly confined to the backend server; client uses the restricted `SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`.
-- **Row Level Security (RLS):** All 19 database tables enforce household tenancy isolation.
-- **Webhook & Firewall Protection:** HMAC-SHA256 signature verification and firewall token middleware on backend API endpoints.
+- **RTL Primary:** Arabic typography with RTL mirroring.
+- **Dictionary:** `flutter_app/lib/l10n/app_localizations.dart` (`ar`, `en`, `ur`), used via `context.tr('key')`.
+- **Zero Hardcoded Strings** in the UI.
+
+### 3.14 Security Hardening & Zero SMS Policy
+- **Zero SMS:** no SMS permissions, listeners, parsers, routes or `sms` transaction source
+  (`ai_service/tests/test_sms_removal.py`, `supabase/tests/18_remove_sms_artifacts.sql`).
+- **Key Segregation:** `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY` / `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` only on the backend; the
+  app uses `SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` and rejects privileged keys at startup.
+- **Row Level Security:** enabled on every `public` table (guardrail test `14_audit_catalog_guardrails.sql`).
+- **Authentication:** every user route verifies the caller's Supabase JWT. `X-Signature`
+  (HMAC-SHA256, `WEBHOOK_SECRET`) is optional defense in depth: with a valid JWT a bad signature is
+  logged and ignored. `X-App-Token` is only a legacy firewall pass for old builds.
+- **Rate limits and quotas:** per-user API quota in the database (`api_quota`), sliding-window limits
+  (Redis when `REDIS_URL` is set).
+

+- `POST /support/chat` and `POST /agent/support-chat` answer in-app questions with the support agent.

+| recurring & installments | `GET /budgets/recurring-bills`, `POST /budgets/recurring-bills/toggle`, `GET /budgets/recurring-bills/candidates`, `GET\|POST /budgets/installments`, `POST /budgets/installments/{plan_id}/pay` |
+| households | `GET\|PUT /households/{id}/payday`, `GET\|PUT /households/{id}/income`, `GET\|PUT /households/{id}/rollover-rule`, `GET /households/{id}/savings-summary`, `POST /households/{id}/invites`, `GET /households/invites/{invite_code}`, `POST /households/invites/{invite_code}/claim` |
+| members & admins | `GET /households/{id}/members`, `POST\|DELETE /households/{id}/members/{member_user_id}/admin`, `POST /households/{id}/primary-admin` |
+| dependents & categories | `GET\|POST /households/{id}/dependents`, `DELETE /households/{id}/dependents/{dependent_id}`, `GET /households/{id}/categories`, `POST /households/{id}/categories/toggle`, `POST /households/{id}/categories/custom` |
+| settlement | `GET /households/{id}/settlement`, `GET /households/{id}/settlement-v2`, `POST /households/{id}/reimbursements` |
+| nafaqah | `GET /households/{id}/nafaqah`, `GET\|POST /households/{id}/nafaqah/reimbursements`, `GET\|PUT /households/{id}/nafaqah/allowance` |
+| AI | `POST /agent/scan-receipt`, `POST /agent/chat-transaction` |
+| analytics & reports | `GET /analytics/price-history`, `POST /analytics/shopping-basket-optimize`, `GET /reports/statement-pdf` |
+| support & inquiries | `POST /support/chat`, `POST /agent/support-chat`, `POST /support/inquiries`, `POST /public/inquiries` (anonymous) |
+
+There is no SMS or webhook ingestion route.

-## 6. Test Suite & Quality Verification
-
-### 6.1 Flutter Mobile Test Suite
-- **Result:** `128 passed` across unit, model, and widget integration tests.
-- **Coverage Areas:**
-  - Account capacity status calculations (Zero-Based, Surplus Buffer, Deficit).
-  - Inter-account transfer balances and fee handling.
-  - Payday income logging and salary breakdown.
-  - Rollover settings (Option A cushion vs Option C savings sweep).
-  - Targeted member claim-on-join welcome banners.
-  - Nafaqah spousal reimbursement metrics and debt display.
-  - Multi-roommate debt simplification calculations.
-  - ZATCA TLV barcode parsing and status badge rendering.
-  - Offline sync queue behavior and SQLite persistence.
-- **Static Analysis:** `flutter analyze` runs with **0 issues found**.
-
-### 6.2 Python AI Service Test Suite
-- **Pytest Suite:** 121 collected tests covering OCR parsing, ZATCA TLV validation, salary cycle date math, duplicate candidate heuristics, and Arabic dialect chat parsing.

+## Final backend review (2026-10-20)
+
+- **Apply `supabase/migrations/20261020500000_review_lock_financial_role.sql (✅ applied to live 2026-10-20 and recorded in schema_migrations; authenticated can no longer UPDATE users.financial_role, service_role still can)` to live** (SQL editor, one statement, idempotent, no data change). It stops members from rewriting their own `users.financial_role`, which drives Nafaqah (FR-B-04 in `docs/review/audit/final_review_backend.md`). Deploy the backend from this branch afterwards; the order does not matter for this file.
+
+## Real-stack e2e follow-ups (2026-10-20)
+
+- **Apply `supabase/migrations/20261020600000_e2e_helper_rpcs_and_sub_category_visibility.sql (✅ applied to live 2026-10-21 and recorded)` to live** (SQL editor, one transaction, idempotent, no data or schema change). Not applied yet. It (a) revokes client EXECUTE on the internal helpers `household_primary_admin_id`, `nafaqah_husband_id`, `nafaqah_is_spouse_member` (E2E-04; their SECURITY DEFINER callers keep working, and a guard block aborts the migration if any policy or invoker function on live depends on them), and (b) limits `cost_control_sub_categories` reads to rows whose parent category the caller can see, revoking client writes and anon access (E2E-05). The deployed app keeps working: it reads that table only for its own categories and never writes it. Deploy the backend from this branch for the API half (E2E-03 422 and E2E-05 listing); the order does not matter. Rollback statements are at the end of the migration file.
+- Residual (product decision, not a bug fix): sub-category definitions under **system** categories stay shared by every household, so an admin who adds one under e.g. `OPEX-DINING` makes it visible to all households, and two households that create the same custom code share its definitions. Removing that needs a `household_id` on `cost_control_sub_categories` (breaking schema change).

+# Master Audit & Engineering Report — Budget Tracker
+
+Branch: `audit/claude-comprehensive-review` (base `main` @ `f17eb2b`) · Date: 2026-10-19 (updated 2026-10-20)
+Detailed reports: [`db.md`](db.md) · [`ai_service.md`](ai_service.md) · [`flutter_logic.md`](flutter_logic.md) · [`ui_web.md`](ui_web.md) · Fix log: [`../FIX_LOG.md`](../FIX_LOG.md)
+
+---
+
+## ملخص تنفيذي (بالعربي)
+
+**شو عملنا:** فحصنا المشروع كامل: قاعدة البيانات، وسيرفر الذكاء الاصطناعي، وتطبيق Flutter، وموقع الويب. لقينا حوالي **120 مشكلة**، منها **4 حرجة** وحوالي **30 عالية الخطورة**، وصلّحنا الأغلبية الكبيرة منها، وكل إصلاح معه اختبار بيثبت إنه انحلّ. كل الشغل على فرع منفصل اسمه `audit/claude-comprehensive-review`، وما انلمس `main` ولا قاعدة البيانات الحقيقية ولا السيرفر الحقيقي.
+
+**أخطر الأشياء اللي انحلّت:**
+1. **أسرار السيرفر الحقيقية كانت منشورة بالمستودع العام.** انشالت من الكود، بس **لازم تتغير** لأن تاريخ git بيحتفظ فيها.
+2. **أكواد دعوات العائلات كانت مكشوفة،** وأي حدا كان بيقدر ينضم لأي عائلة أو يعدّل ميزانياتها.
+3. **في أماكن بالسيرفر كانت بتسمح لمستخدم يعدّل بيانات عائلة تانية** (الأقساط، التصنيفات، المصاريف).
+4. **المصاريف المسجّلة بدون إنترنت كانت تضيع،** والحفظ اليدوي كان يفشل دايماً، فمعلومة مين دفع، يعني ديون النفقة، كانت تضيع.
+5. **تقسيم المصاريف بين الزوجين كان 50/50** بالسيرفر، وهاد عكس قواعد النفقة.
+6. **حوالي 760 نص بالتطبيق كانوا مكتوبين مباشرة** (أغلبهم إنجليزي)، وهلق صاروا مترجمين للعربي والإنجليزي والأوردو.
+
+**الجولة التانية (بطلب صاحب المشروع):**
+- **الإيميلات:** كل طلب دعم أو تسجيل VIP بينبعت فعلياً من `fmscoinfo@fmsco.com.sa` (لـ `CONTACT_RECIPIENT_EMAIL`)، وكل إيميل ظاهر للمستخدم صار `fmscoinfo@fmsco.com.sa`.
+- **الرسائل النصية:** انحذف كل شي له علاقة بقراءة SMS أو رسائل البنك، وضلت بس جملة "التطبيق ما بيقرأ رسائلك".
+- **النفقة:** ما في 50/50 بين الزوجين؛ الزوجة لما تدفع على شي مشترك بينسجّل دين على الزوج، ولما تشتري لنفسها بينخصم من ميزانية مصروفها.
+- **تشفير رموز الدخول** بالتطبيق، وإصلاح رسائل "تم الحفظ" الوهمية والتراجع عن الحذف.
+
+**الصلاحيات (قرار صاحب المشروع، للعائلة والسكن المشترك):** العضو بيعدّل أو بيحذف مصاريفه هو بس، والمسؤول (admin) بيعدّل أو بيحذف مصاريف الكل. السحب من الصندوق المشترك للمسؤولين بس. المسؤول بيقدر يعيّن أعضاء كمسؤولين إضافيين ويشيلهم، بس ما حدا منهم بيقدر يشيل المسؤول الرئيسي (صاحب البيت)، والمسؤول الرئيسي بس هو اللي بينقل الملكية.
+
+**الاختبارات:** كلها ناجحة. Flutter: 492 اختبار (كانوا 141). Python: 419 (كان في 11 فاشلين). قاعدة البيانات: 20 من 20 (كانوا 2 بس ناجحين).
+
+**المطلوب من صاحب المشروع قبل النشر** (التفاصيل بالقسم 6):
+1. ✅ `sb_secret` و`WEBHOOK_SECRET` الجديد صاروا على Railway (حسب صاحب المشروع). **باقي يتأكد إنه `APP_AUTH_TOKEN` تغيّر.**
+2. يضيف إعدادات إرسال الإيميل على Railway (Resend أو SMTP، القسم 6.1).
+3. ينشر بالترتيب: قاعدة البيانات، بعدين السيرفر، بعدين نسخة التطبيق الجديدة.
+4. ✅ قرار السؤالين عن طريقة عمل المنتج (DB-16 وDB-18) اتاخد وانطبّق (القسم 6.3).
+5. **خمس ملفات قاعدة بيانات لسا ما انطبّقت على القاعدة الحية**، بالترتيب: `20261020700000` ← `20261020750000` ← `20261020800000` ← `20261020900000` ← `20261021000000` (التصنيفات السعودية وجدولة أقساط تابي وتمارا). الطريقة والرسائل المتوقعة بـ [`live_db_preflight_round3.md`](live_db_preflight_round3.md) (القسم 6 والقسم 3b). السيرفر الجديد بيحتاجهم كلهم قبل ما ينزل.
+6. يضيف على Railway متغيّر `PREVIEW_TOKEN_SECRET` (قيمة عشوائية 32 حرف أو أكثر، مثلاً من `openssl rand -hex 32`)، نفس القيمة على كل نسخ السيرفر. هيك تسجيل المصروف من المحادثة أو الفاتورة بياخد طلب واحد للذكاء الاصطناعي بدل اثنين.
+7. **النسخ الاحتياطي اليومي مأجّل** بقرار صاحب المشروع (بيحتاج خطة Supabase Pro). بس قبل تطبيق الملفات الخمسة لازم ياخد نسخة يدوية وحدة، وهاي مجانية (`pg_dump`، القسم 6.1).
+
+---
+
+## 1. Executive Summary & Health Scorecard
+
+Four parallel reviews (DB, AI service, Flutter logic/security, UI/localization/web) produced ~120 findings, of which 4 were Critical and ~30 High. All Critical findings and the large majority of High findings are fixed on this branch with regression tests; the remainder need owner decisions, owner-side actions on live infrastructure, or tooling not available in the audit sandbox (Android SDK).
+
+Scores are the auditors' qualitative assessment (0–10) of the code as found vs. as left on this branch, assuming the owner actions in §6 are completed.
+
+| Dimension | Before | After | Main drivers |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| **Security** | 3 | 8 | Live secrets in a public repo; RLS disabled on invites; unauthenticated/IDOR API routes; quota failing open; anon key used as service key. |
+| **Reliability / data integrity** | 4 | 8 | Offline chat expenses lost; manual saves always failing; money created by rounding; tests that could not fail; non-hermetic test suite hitting live. |
+| **Architecture** | 5 | 7 | Blocking LLM calls in async server; float money; cycle logic duplicated three times with divergence; migration chain not replayable. |
+| **UI / UX & i18n** | 5 | 8 | ~760 hardcoded strings; Urdu treated as Arabic/English; RTL mirroring gaps; light-mode contrast failures; web form loses signups. |

+## 2. Critical & High Severity Findings

The repo's own secret-scanner test only globbed `*.dart` and so never inspected those files. | Anyone can forge server-to-server webhook calls. | Values purged from the tree; scanner now stores SHA-256 digests only and scans py/dart/ts/js/md/json/yaml. **Owner must rotate** (history retains values). |

Only admins move money out of a shared pool. Admins promote/revoke co-admins; the primary admin (`households.owner_user_id`) cannot be demoted or removed by a co-admin and alone transfers primary admin; last-admin protections unchanged. Roommate mode unchanged.

+- **Web:** hardcoded Arabic in English mode, a11y (labels, skip link, focus, reduced motion), multi-MB icon font trimmed, meta/SEO.
