+
+## 4. Architecture & operations for the stage (4 households live)
+
+### 4.1 Over-engineered
+- **Three implementations of the cycle logic** (SQL, Python, Dart) with a 109-vector parity suite — necessary only because the app computes cycles offline. Acceptable, but freeze it.
+- **Container-local state**: `household_settings.json`, `household_invites.json`, in-memory dependents (`supabase_client.py` lines 740–1041, `dependents_service.py` `_memory_dependents`). On Railway the filesystem is ephemeral and multiple instances diverge (API-33 open). Delete every file/in-memory fallback; the DB columns exist now.
+- **Legacy text-note parsing**: `raw_sms` audit notes with `| PaidBy:` tags still read for legacy rows (`settlement_engine.py` `_legacy_tags`, `installment_service.list_plans`). Run a one-time backfill into the structured columns and delete the parsers (owner applies; never from here).
+- **Dual membership and role caches**: `users.household_id` + `household_memberships`, `users.financial_role` cache, `budgets.month` + `cycle_key`. Each duplication has already produced a bug class. Schedule a consolidation migration after the DB-15 re-baseline.
+- **Three landing pages**: `web_app/` (React, committed build in `ai_service/static/`), `landing_page/index.html` + `mobile.html`, and `ai_service/_build_landing.py` (1,309 lines) as a fallback generator. Keep one.
+- **Settings screen** (`ingestion_settings_screen.dart`, 1,844 lines): "Expense ingestion channels" toggles write `channel_chat_enabled` / `channel_scanner_enabled` to SharedPreferences and **nothing reads them** elsewhere; "Duplicate resolution policy" (auto-enrich / prompt / strict) is an SMS-era concept. Remove both sections; rename the screen.
+- **FastAPI re-implements authorization** that RLS already enforces (the master audit's own recommendation #1). For deterministic reads (settlement, cycles, breakdown) a Postgres function + RLS would remove a hop and a whole bug class; keep FastAPI for LLM, PDF and e-mail.
+
+### 4.2 Under-engineered
+- **Backups**: none (the live project had none). Minimum: Supabase Pro ($25/mo, daily backups 7 days) **or** a weekly `pg_dump` from a Railway cron / GitHub Action to private object storage, tested restore once. Effort S (owner). Risk of not doing it: total data loss.
+- **Observability**: `logging.basicConfig` only; `safe_error_response` emits a reference id but nothing collects it. Add Sentry (FastAPI + Flutter SDKs, free tier), an uptime ping on `/health`, and a daily "LLM calls / failures / p95" log line. Effort S.
+- **CI**: no `.github/workflows` (owner declined). Even without Actions, a pre-push hook running `flutter analyze`, `flutter test`, `pytest -q` is cheap. The rule-06 bundle assumes Windows PowerShell + clipboard.
+- **Migrations**: 48 files applied by copy-paste into the SQL editor, with one documented order exception and DB-15 (not replayable by CLI) still open. **R13:** re-baseline from live (`supabase db pull` into one baseline), keep new migrations CLI-applied against a free **staging** project first, then live. Effort M. Risk: medium (do once, carefully, with the existing preflight scripts).
+- **Scaling cliffs (later, not now)**: the app downloads the entire transaction history per load (`transaction_provider.dart` line 177, no range); `recalculate_budgets` and `list_plans` scan all transactions; `getSettlementV2` is re-fetched on every dashboard rebuild (`dashboard_screen.dart` line 853, `FutureBuilder` with the future created in `build`). Fine at 4 households; paginate and cache before ~50.
+
+### 4.3 Release process (rule 06 Argon loop)
+Two-stage external audit per PR with a full unified diff in a Markdown bundle is appropriate for schema/money/permission changes and heavy for copy, UI and docs changes. Suggest: tiered gate — "money/schema/auth" → full audit; everything else → analyzer + tests + self-review. Effort S (rule text). Risk: none.
+
+### 4.4 Test strategy cost — keep vs. slim
+Counts: pytest 611 tests (~11.9k lines), Flutter 505 (~11.6k lines), e2e 67 (~2.9k lines + PostgREST download), SQL 26 files (~6.5k lines), migrations ~9.9k lines.
+- **Keep**: SQL proof tests (money invariants, RLS, roles) — they are the product's safety net; hermetic pytest for parsers, cycles, settlement, Nafaqah; the l10n guard test; the 109-vector cycle parity fixture.
+- **Slim**: e2e suite → run only before a release (it duplicates many pytest assertions); Flutter widget tests that assert copy strings (brittle); pytest files that re-test the same regression from three angles (`test_fable_*`, `test_fable_r2_*`, e2e `test_08/09`) — consolidate per feature.
+- **Add**: one golden-path UI test (sign up → household → first expense → hero shows a number) — the thing the current suites do not cover.
+

+
+## 5. Growth & retention
+
+- **Onboarding friction**: email + password + confirmation mail (`login_screen.dart`); no Google/Apple sign-in, no phone OTP (Saudi users expect Nafath-style or OTP flows; Apple sign-in is mandatory on iOS if any third-party login is added). Add Google + Apple via Supabase Auth. Effort S/M.
+- **Invitations**: 8–16-char code typed by hand (`household_screen.dart`); `share_plus` exists but is only used for the PDF. Add "Share invite" (WhatsApp text with a `https://budget.fmsco.com.sa/join/<code>` link + QR in the household card) and handle the link on open. Effort S/M. Impact: the household's second member is the whole value proposition in family/roommate mode.
+- **Retention hooks**: none today (no notifications, no weekly summary, no streaks). R11 covers the basics; add a Friday weekly summary notification and a payday "cycle closed: you saved X" moment that feeds a savings goal (R5).
+- **Monetization fit**: the "VIP early access" form (`/public/inquiries`) is a waitlist, not a plan. Right for the stage. Natural paid tiers later: receipts beyond N/month, multi-household, exports, shared-roommate groups above 3. Do not gate anything before notifications and onboarding are fixed.
+- **Localization reach / Urdu users**: in Saudi, Urdu speakers are mostly Pakistani expatriates — a large share are drivers, domestic workers, construction and shop staff, plus a professional class (doctors, engineers, accountants) and families. Their realities: cash salary, bachelor shared housing (roommate mode fits well), monthly **remittances** home (no category), Iqama/visa fees (exists), WhatsApp as the only channel. The UI is translated (1,206 keys × 3), speech locale `ur_PK` is wired, but the chat system prompt has **no Urdu examples** and the heuristic parser has **no Urdu cues**, so Urdu input quality is untested; the Urdu support prompt is machine-flavoured. Recommendation: add 5–6 Urdu examples to `SYSTEM_PROMPT`, Urdu amount words/cues to the heuristic, a remittance category, and a WhatsApp-first invite — but do not invest further in Urdu until a real cohort exists.
+- **Landing page**: jargon-heavy ("12 Pillars of Financial Governance", "Telemetry HUD", "Sovereign Access Seat") with invented metrics. Replace with three plain benefits in Arabic, real screenshots, and the Nafaqah story, which is the genuinely differentiated feature.
+

+## Prioritised roadmap
+
+**Next 2 weeks (small, high leverage)**
+1. Backups + Sentry + uptime ping (R-ops; owner action). S.
+2. Local notifications: payday check-in, bill due, installment due, cycle-ends-in-3-days (R11). M.
+3. Fix BNPL schedule (bi-weekly Tabby/Tamara, `frequency` + `next_due_at`) (R10). S/M.
+4. Single LLM call per expense; OCR temperature 0.2; parse before upload (R6, R9). S/M.
+5. Remove: mock offline OCR draft, dead "ingestion channels" and "duplicate policy" settings, duplicated dashboard shortcuts, `SalaryCycleWidget` (R3, R8). S.
+6. Taxonomy refresh (housing, education, domestic help, family support/charity, transport, insurance, remittance) (R4). S.
+7. Share invite via share sheet + join link (R-growth). S/M.
+
+**Next 2 months**
+8. Starter wizard + income-based "left until payday" hero (R1, R2). M.
+9. Dashboard to 5 cards; Tools screen for simulator/accounts/exports; park price intelligence (R3). M.
+10. Savings goals / sinking funds fed by the rollover sweep; Ramadan/Eid seasonal override (R5). M.
+11. Screenshot import via Android share intent reusing `/agent/scan-receipt` (fast capture without SMS). M.
+12. Nafaqah polish: optional allowance wording for working wives, "her own money" option, child allowance tracking card, allowance-transfer type (2.3). M.
+13. Roommates: weighted shares, join/leave cutoffs with a frozen final statement (2.4). M.
+14. Reallocation becomes a prompt, not automatic; cycles labelled by dates; delete the "copy previous" dialog (2.2). S/M.
+15. Migrations re-baseline + staging project + CLI apply; pre-push gate; tiered audit rule (R13, 4.3). M.
+16. Google/Apple sign-in. S/M.
+17. Privacy notice naming the LLM processor; move to Vertex/paid tier (R12). S/M.
+
+**Later (when > ~100 households or a partner appears)**
+18. Open Banking read-only via a licensed TPP (Lean/Tarabut); FCM push; WhatsApp deep links; Zakat helper on account balances.
+19. Consolidate schema (drop `budgets.month`, `users.household_id`/`financial_role` caches, legacy note parsing after backfill); move deterministic reads into Postgres functions behind RLS; integer money end to end.
+20. Pagination and caching (feed, settlement, installments).
+21. Drop the wearable roadmap item.
+
+## Stop doing / remove
+- The offline receipt "draft" that always produces "Al Othaim, 85 SAR" (`flutter_app/lib/services/ocr/local_ocr_service.dart`).
+- Calling the LLM twice per expense/receipt (`chat_parser.py` line 588; `receipt_scanner.py` lines 605–615).
+- Three landing-page implementations (`web_app/`, `landing_page/`, `ai_service/_build_landing.py`); the "12 pillars / 99.4% / AES-256 / Sovereign" copy.
+- JSON-file and in-memory fallbacks in the API container (`supabase_client.py` `HOUSEHOLD_SETTINGS_FILE`, `HOUSEHOLD_INVITES_FILE`; `dependents_service._memory_dependents`).
+- Regex reconstruction of installment plans and attribution from `raw_sms` notes (one-time backfill, then delete).
+- Silent flexible-budget raiding on insert.
+- "Expense ingestion channels" and "Duplicate resolution policy" sections in settings; the 7-item speed dial (keep 3).
+- Price Tracker / Smart Basket on the dashboard until there is data.
+- Full-diff external audit for non-money, non-schema changes.
+- The support chatbot's hard-coded "27th payday / Iqama 400 SAR" facts (make it read household settings or drop the bot).
+- Adding roadmap features (wearables, FX feeds) before notifications, onboarding and backups exist.

@@ -0,0 +1,679 @@
+# Arabic and Urdu translation QA
+
+Branch `audit/claude-comprehensive-review`, base commit `952098d`. This is a report only; no app code was changed.
+
+## What was reviewed
+
+| Source | Locales | Size |
+|---|---|---|
+| `flutter_app/lib/l10n/app_localizations.dart` (`_localizedValues`, `_categoryCodes`, `_subCategoryValues`) | en / ar / ur | 1,283 keys × 3, plus 48 category and sub-category entries |
+| `web_app/src/i18n/translations.ts` | en / ar (no Urdu) | about 200 strings per locale |
+| `ai_service/_build_landing.py` (the `T.ar` / `T.en` dictionary and the `data-i18n` HTML defaults) | en / ar | about 190 keys |
+| `landing_page/index.html` | ar only (the `عربي \| EN` button has no English strings behind it) | static page |
+
+**Which landing copy is live.** `ai_service/landing_page.py` serves `ai_service/static/index.html` when that file exists, and that file is the built `web_app`. So the copy visitors see at budget.fmsco.com.sa comes from **`web_app/src/i18n/translations.ts`**. The `LANDING_HTML` in `_build_landing.py` is only used when the static build is missing, and `landing_page/index.html` is a separate older page. All three were reviewed because all three are public-facing or can become so.
+
+**How the review was done.** Every key was read in all three locales against the English. On top of that, automated checks covered:
+
+- placeholder parity (`{amount}`, `{name}` and so on are all present in ar/ur);
+- Arabic-only letters (ي ك ى ة) in Urdu values;
+- Urdu-only letters in Arabic values;
+- currency labels;
+- Latin-script leftovers;
+- button-length outliers (ar/ur over about 30 characters where the English is short);
+- how the code actually builds each string. Concatenations that break right-to-left word order were traced in the `.dart` call sites.
+
+**Placeholders and keys are clean.** All placeholders are present in every ar and ur value; there are no missing or extra keys between locales.
+
+## Totals
+
+| Severity | Count | Meaning |
+|---|---|---|
+| High | 53 | Wrong meaning, offensive or alarming wording, or text that can cause a legal, financial or Islamic-compliance misunderstanding |
+| Medium | 186 | Unnatural wording, inconsistent terms, wrong grammar, false technical claims |
+| Low | 150 | Polish: spelling, word choice, length, English typos |
+| **Total** | **389** | ar 159 · ur 207 · en (source) 23 |
+
+The machine-readable list is `docs/review/audit/translation_fixes.json`: `[{file, key, locale, current, suggested, severity}]`.
+
+- `current` is the decoded string value (real newlines, unescaped quotes).
+- For `.dart` and `.ts` files, `key` is the map key or object path, for example `ar.simulator.zatcaGrand` or `ar.faq.items[3].a`.
+- For `_build_landing.py`, `key` is `T.<locale>.<key>`. The same Arabic text also appears as the `data-i18n` default in the HTML part of the file; update both.
+- For `landing_page/index.html` there are no keys. `key` is a label (`html:...`) and `current` is an exact substring of the file to replace.
+- For category maps, `key` is `_subCategoryValues.<code>`.
+
+## The 10 most important fixes
+
+1. **About 40 Urdu strings are still in Arabic** (High). Every `nafaqah_*` and `allowance_*` key, `psc_family_household`, `pay_method_urpay/iban/other`. An Urdu-speaking wife or husband sees the whole Nafaqah and allowance flow in Arabic. Urdu versions are given for every key.
+2. **`web_app` `ar.simulator.zatcaGrand` = "الإجمالي الصافي للفاتورة"** (High). "Net" is used for the gross total including VAT, on the live landing tax-invoice demo. The fix is `إجمالي الفاتورة (شامل الضريبة):`.
+3. **Family-mode copy describes a spousal cost split, against the app's Nafaqah rule** (High):
+   - web `en/ar.faq.items[3].a` ("proportional income allocation", "تكامل ميزانية الأب والأم");
+   - web `en.simulator.splitDesc` ("salary-weighted contributions");
+   - landing builder `T.ar.t4/spt/spy/spp`, a 60/40 "partner" split under the "توزيع الأسرة" tab;
+   - `landing_page` pillar 4 ("بنسب مئوية عادلة" for families).
+4. **The Arabic privacy policy contradicts the English** (High). `_build_landing.py` `T.ar.lp2p`: "ولا تُستخدم لتدريب نماذج عامة دون موافقة" implies training is allowed with consent, while the English says the data is never kept for training. "تُعالج الرسائل النصية" also reads as "your SMS messages are processed", which contradicts the no-SMS promise.
+5. **`landing_page` FAQ 5 makes a false security claim** (High): "ولا يستطيع حتى مسؤولو النظام فك تشفير ميزانياتك". Row-level security is access control, not encryption, and the backend service role can read the data.
+6. **Urdu `leave_household` / `leave_household_confirm` = "خاندان چھوڑیں"** (High). It literally means "abandon your family". Use گھرانہ (household), which the rest of the app already uses.
+7. **Urdu financial status words are wrong** (High):
+   - `overdue` = "واجب الادا" means *due*, not *overdue*;
+   - `allowable_daily` = "روزانہ کی اجازت" means *daily permission*, not *daily spendable amount*.
+8. **`monthly_allowance_masroof` (ar) = "المصروف الشهري / النفقة"** (High). It treats a member's pocket money as النفقة. Nafaqah is the husband's whole maintenance duty, and roommates have no Nafaqah at all. The sister key `ahm_allowance_caps` already says just "المصروف الشهري".
+9. **"سيادي / السيادية" across the Arabic web landing** (High for `ar.hero.badge` and `ar.brand.sovereignBadge`, Medium for the rest). In Saudi usage "سيادي" means state or sovereign (as in الصندوق السيادي), so a finance product calling itself "نظام سيادي" or "الحوكمة المالية السيادية" suggests government backing.
+10. **"تعويض" for paying the wife back** (Medium, but it reaches bank records). Keys: `reimburse_wife`, `settle_reimbursement_owed`, `settle_nafaqah_note` (pasted into STC Pay transfer notes), `settle_wife_desc`, `rid_spouse_desc`. تعويض means compensation for harm or damages; paying back what she advanced is **سداد / استرداد**, which `husband_owes_wife` already uses.
+
+## Problems that repeat across many keys
+
+1. **Arabic copied into Urdu.** Fix item 1 above. Add a unit test that fails when a `ur` value contains ي، ك، ى or ة; the only exception is the deliberate Arabic sample sentence in `chat_welcome`.
+2. **Several words for one concept.** The canonical choice is in the glossary below. Main offenders:
+   - transaction: العملية vs المعاملة in about 20 Arabic keys; ٹرانزیکشن vs لین دین in about 20 Urdu keys;
+   - admin: مسؤول vs مشرف;
+   - household: المنزل / الأسرة / منزل; گھرانہ / گھر / خاندان;
+   - cycle in Urdu: چکر / سائیکل / ادوار. چکر is colloquial and can read as "runaround/trick";
+   - category in Urdu: کیٹیگری vs زمرہ (about 30 keys);
+   - wife in Urdu: اہلیہ vs بیوی;
+   - allowance in Urdu: جیب خرچ / الاؤنس / مصروف;
+   - sync in Urdu: ہم آہنگ (which means "harmonise") vs سنک;
+   - settings in Urdu: ترتیبات vs سیٹنگز;
+   - QR in Arabic: الرمز المربع vs رمز QR;
+   - ZATCA: four different Arabic names, two of them outdated (هيئة الزكاة والدخل, هيئة الزكاة والضريبة). In Urdu, زکوٰۃ و ٹیکس / زکوٰۃ کیو آر reads as a zakat-payment QR code.
+3. **Currency labels.**
+   - Arabic puts ر.س after the number (correct), but `enter_amount` uses "ريال".
+   - Urdu uses ریال, but `amount`, `initial_allocation` and `total_price` use the Arabic ر.س.
+   - No rupee wording anywhere (good).
+   - Digits are Western everywhere, matching `sar()` and Saudi banking apps (good; keep it).
+4. **Arabic plurals.** Many strings put a number next to a fixed noun form (`{days} يوم`, `{count} أشهر`, `{count} بند`, `{count} أعضاء نشطين`, `عبر {count} حسابات`), which is wrong grammar for 1, 2, 3–10 or 11+. The table suggests count-label rewordings ("الأيام المتبقية: {days}") that are always correct. The proper fix is ICU plurals (`Intl.plural` with zero/one/two/few/many/other for ar; one/other for ur).
+5. **Code that glues strings together breaks right-to-left word order.** These need a code change, not only a translation change. The table gives interim wording that reads correctly with today's code.
+
+   | Key | Call site | Problem |
+   |---|---|---|
+   | `take_shot_n` | `multi_page_receipt_scanner_screen.dart:449` | `tr('take_shot_n') + n` turns into "تصویر نمبر لیں2" in Urdu |
+   | `allocations_exceed_salary` | `budget_management_screen.dart:1058` | `"$text $amount."`; Urdu verb ends up before the number |
+   | `no_allocations_for_cycle` | `dashboard_screen.dart:702` | cycle key appended after a full Urdu sentence |
+   | `queued_offline`, `transactions_count`/`transaction_singular`, `items` | `dashboard_screen.dart:478`, `sub_budget_breakdown_sheet.dart:483`, `transaction_item_breakdown_card.dart:387` | number + noun without plural rules |
+   | `cycle_alert_burn_high` with `before_payday` fallback | `salary_cycle_widget.dart:260` | produces "يُتوقع نفاد الميزانية حوالي قبل الراتب" |
+
+   Recommendation: switch to `{n}` / `{amount}` / `{cycle}` placeholders and `trArgs`.
+6. **Arabic register.** Saudi dialect (تبي، بيتم، عشان، ما فيه) is fine and pleasant in chat, onboarding and FAQ. It reads as careless in destructive confirmations, validation errors and money decisions (`tx_delete_confirm_long`, `sba_remove_confirm`, `set_are_sure_want_remove_from`, `scan_duplicate_found_msg`, `isc_negative`, `ats_same_account`). Recommendation: standard Arabic for UI chrome, errors, confirmations and legal text; light dialect only in conversational surfaces. Only the money-affecting cases are listed as fixes.
+7. **Gender.**
+   - Arabic follows the accepted masculine-default form of address. The wife-facing Nafaqah strings correctly use the feminine (المستحق لكِ، تستطيع).
+   - Urdu "کیا میں یہ خرید سکتا ہوں؟" is masculine only; a neutral rewording is given.
+   - Arabic "ابن" (son) is used where "child/dependent" is meant.
+8. **Factual problem in the English source, carried into ar and ur.** "400 SAR monthly Iqama fee" is really the **dependants' levy** (المقابل المالي للمرافقين / رسوم المرافقين). Iqama renewal is a separate yearly fee. Affected keys: `support_chip_iqama`, `faq_bills_q2`, `faq_bills_a2`.
+9. **False or overstated technical claims on the public sites** (Medium): "end-to-end encrypted", "تشفير RLS 256-BIT", "cryptographic row-level security", "مشفّر محلياً". RLS is access control and the server reads data for AI processing.
+10. **No Urdu on the web.** `web_app` and both landing pages are Arabic and English only, while the mobile app is trilingual and many Saudi residents read Urdu. That is a product gap rather than a translation fix, so it has no row.
+11. **Leftover English in ar and ur.** Brand names and standard acronyms (STC Pay, BNPL, Base64, TLV, VAT, PDF, CSV) are acceptable. Real leftovers fixed in the table: `hero_tag` (ur "سوورن HUD"), `language_ur` (ar "(Urdu)"), "الاؤنس", "فیملی ممبر", "فلیگ کریں".
+12. **Strings too long for buttons** (Low): `bnpl_convert_title` (ar, 45 characters), `bm_option_rollover` (ur, 41), `caution_reallocation` (ur, 40), `daily_allowance_impact` (ar, 37), `rollover_send_to_savings_title` (ur, 36), `set_join_create_household` (ur, 33), `invite_linked_profile` (ur, 31). Lengths are character counts, not measured on a device.

+## Glossary of recommended terms
+
+| English | Arabic (Saudi) | Urdu | Notes |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Household (the shared group) | المنزل | گھرانہ | Neutral for family and roommates; majority usage in both locales. Not منزل جديد/الأسرة for actions, not گھر/خاندان |
+| Family (mode) | الأسرة (النفقة الشرعية) | خاندان (اسلامی نفقہ) | Only for the family-mode label, never for "household" actions |
+| Roommate | شريك السكن | روم میٹ | |
+| Wife / Husband | الزوجة / الزوج | اہلیہ / شوہر | Not "الشريك" for a spouse; not بیوی |
+| Dependent / Child | مُعال / طفل | زیرِ کفالت / بچہ | Not ابن (son only) |
+| Member | عضو | رکن | Not ممبر |
+| Admin / Primary admin | مشرف / المشرف الرئيسي | ایڈمن / مرکزی ایڈمن | مسؤول clashes with مسؤولية النفقة and suggests guardianship |
+| Nafaqah | النفقة (النفقة الشرعية) | نفقہ | The husband's maintenance duty, never a member's allowance |
+| Advance (wife paid for the household) | دفعته الزوجة مقدماً | پیشگی ادائیگی | |
+| Reimburse / reimbursement | سداد / استرداد | واپس ادائیگی / واپسی | Not تعويض (compensation for harm) |
+| Personal allowance | المصروف الشخصي | ذاتی جیب خرچ | Not الاؤنس / مصروف in Urdu |
+| Allowable daily / daily allowance | المتاح يومياً / المصروف اليومي | روزانہ قابلِ خرچ رقم / یومیہ خرچ کی حد | |
+| Settlement / settle up | تسوية | تصفیہ / حساب چکائیں | Not تسویہ (not an Urdu word); not التسوية for reconciliation |
+| Debt simplification | تبسيط الديون | قرضوں کو آسان بنانا | |
+| Salary cycle / cycle | دورة الراتب / الدورة | تنخواہ کا سائیکل / سائیکل | Not چکر or ادوار |
+| Payday | يوم الراتب (يوم نزول الراتب) | تنخواہ کا دن | 27th = government payday only |
+| Transaction | معاملة / المعاملات | لین دین | Not العملية / ٹرانزیکشن |
+| Expense | مصروف / مصاريف | خرچ / اخراجات | |
+| Category / Sub-category | تصنيف / تصنيف فرعي | کیٹیگری / ذیلی کیٹیگری | The landing page's "فئة" should also move to تصنيف |
+| Allocation | المخصص / المخصصات | تخصیص / مختص رقم | |
+| Rollover | ترحيل | رول اوور (منتقلی) | |
+| Surplus / Deficit | فائض / عجز | فاضل / خسارہ | |
+| Savings reserve | احتياطي الادخار | بچت کا ذخیرہ | |
+| Shared pool (joint balance) | الصندوق المشترك | مشترکہ فنڈ | |
+| Reconcile / reconciliation difference | مطابقة الرصيد / فرق المطابقة | بیلنس کی مطابقت / ایڈجسٹمنٹ | |
+| Installments / BNPL | الأقساط / الشراء الآجل | اقساط / BNPL | |
+| Interest-free | بدون فوائد | بغیر سود | Keep it in Urdu too (riba sensitivity) |
+| Overdue / Due / Pending | متأخر / مستحق / معلق | تاریخ گزر چکی / واجب الادا / زیرِ التوا | |
+| Recurring bills | الفواتير المتكررة | باقاعدہ بل | Not "بار بار آنے والے" or "ماہانہ" |
+| ZATCA | هيئة الزكاة والضريبة والجمارك (زاتكا) | زاتکا | Never هيئة الزكاة والدخل / زکوٰۃ و ٹیکس |
+| QR code | رمز QR | کیو آر کوڈ / QR کوڈ | Not الرمز المربع |
+| VAT / Tax invoice | ضريبة القيمة المضافة / فاتورة ضريبية | VAT / ٹیکس انوائس | |
+| Dependants' levy | رسوم المرافقين (المقابل المالي للمرافقين) | مرافقین فیس | The 400 SAR monthly charge; not "Iqama fee" |
+| Sync | مزامنة | سنک | Not ہم آہنگ |
+| Settings | الإعدادات | ترتیبات | Not سیٹنگز |
+| Edit | تعديل | ترمیم کریں | |
+| SAR amount | `1,250.00 ر.س` (unit after the number) | `1,250.00 ریال` | Never روپے; Western digits |
+| Tabarru' / Takaful | تبرّع / تكافل | تبرع / تکافل | The app has no Takaful feature, so do not use تكافلي for bill-splitting (landing_page does). The "Gifts & Donations" category (هدايا وتبرعات / تحائف اور عطیات) is correct |
+| Zakat | الزكاة | زکوٰۃ | Only for zakat itself, never as shorthand for ZATCA |

+## Applied
+
+Branch `audit/translation-qa-apply` (based on `6afa789`), commits `debf4e9` (app), `80fa3ca` (web landing and `ai_service/static`), `0239984` (fallback landing builder), `a1f422a` (`landing_page/index.html`).
+
+Before applying, every row's `current` was compared with the file as it stands now. All 389 still matched exactly, so no row was obsolete and none needed re-evaluation against changed text.
+
+| Severity | Rows | Applied | Skipped |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| High | 53 | 53 | 0 |
+| Medium | 186 | 186 | 0 |
+| Low | 150 | 150 | 0 |
+| **Total** | **389** | **389** | **0** |
+
+By file: `app_localizations.dart` 325/325, `translations.ts` 29/29, `_build_landing.py` 20/20 (Arabic rows also update their `data-i18n` HTML default), `landing_page/index.html` 15/15. Every Low row was a clear win (spelling, glossary term, calque or length), so none was left out.
+
+**Skipped: none.**
+
+**Rows applied with a different value than `suggested`:**
+
+- `en` `support_chip_iqama`, `faq_bills_q2`, `faq_bills_a2`: "dependants' levy (Murafiq fee)" rather than "dependant fee", matching the glossary (رسوم المرافقين / مرافقین فیس).
+- `T.ar.b4d`: keeps the typo fix and "الزوجة", but replaces "حصة كل فرد في ميزانية الأسرة" (a per-member share of the family budget) with the Nafaqah rule.
+- `html:faq-5-answer`: per-household isolation with row-level security, visible only to authorised members, and encrypted in transit and at rest by the platform. The QA wording left out the encryption sentence.
+- 17 rows that only gave interim wording for a code problem were done properly in code: `across_accounts`, `days_to_payday_badge`, `dcc_attach` (ar, ur), `hmc_active_members`, `hmc_one_active_member`, `n_months`, `scan_confirm_save_items`, `scan_items_logged`, `scan_reading_items`, `set_transaction_s_pending_sync` (ar, ur), `sync_complete_msg` (ar, ur), `take_shot_n`, `allocations_exceed_salary`, `no_allocations_for_cycle`. Their glossary terms (المعاملة، لدى، جارٍ، لین دین، سنک) are carried into the new forms.
+
+**Code changes (the table under "Code that glues strings together"):**
+
+- `AppLocalizations.plural()` / `context.trPlural()` and `AppLocalizations.pluralCategory()`: a CLDR plural helper. Arabic uses zero (0), one (1), two (2), few (n % 100 in 3–10), many (11–99) and other (100+ and fractions); English and Urdu use one/other, with an optional zero form. 13 count strings moved out of `_localizedValues` into `_pluralValues`: `days_to_payday_badge`, `across_accounts`, `hmc_active_members` (absorbs `hmc_one_active_member`), `n_months`, `set_transaction_s_pending_sync`, `dcc_attach`, `scan_confirm_save_items`, `scan_items_logged`, `scan_reading_items`, `sync_complete_msg`, `queued_offline`, `transactions_count` (absorbs `transaction_singular`) and `items_count` (replaces `items`).
+- Full-sentence keys with placeholders instead of concatenation:
+  - `take_shot_n` (`{n}`; `take_shot_1` removed);
+  - `allocations_exceed_salary` (`{amount}` via `sar()`);
+  - `no_allocations_for_cycle` (`{cycle}`, now the localized month instead of the raw `2026-11` key);
+  - new `cycle_alert_burn_high_no_date` instead of pushing "before payday" into the `{date}` slot (`before_payday` removed).
+- Web: `simulator.countdownDays` is a set of plural forms chosen with `Intl.PluralRules`. `landing_page` uses a small `arabicDays()` for its days-left counter.
+- Tests in `flutter_app/test/ui_l10n_guard_test.dart`:
+  - no Arabic-only letters (ي ك ى ة) in Urdu, except `language_ar` and the Arabic sample sentence in `chat_welcome`;
+  - the plural table has every required form, matching placeholders, and Arabic script in ar/ur;
+  - every `trPlural` key exists;
+  - CLDR categories and the Arabic forms for 0, 1, 2, 3, 10, 11 and 100.
+- Tests in `ai_service/tests/test_landing_page.py`: the served bundle and the fallback page contain no spousal split, "سيادي", SMS processing or false encryption claims; the family demo shows the husband owing the wife.
+
+**Content changes the owner had already decided (beyond the rows):**
+
+- **Nafaqah.** Family mode has no spousal split: the husband carries shared costs, the wife's household payments are a debt he owes her, and her personal purchases come from her allowance. This is now what the following say:
+  - app walkthrough step 5 (`wt5_title` / `wt5_desc`, en/ar/ur);
+  - web: split-tab title, description and ledger title, FAQ sub-title, pillar 4;
+  - web family demo: husband's Nafaqah, "owed back by husband", wife's personal allowance row, and a family resolution box "Abu Fahad owes Umm Fahad SAR 1,600 · Record repayment";
+  - fallback landing: hero, meta description, attribution card (`b4t/b4d/b4c3`), household card (`b10*`), FAQ 3; its 60/40 demo is now roommates only, with translatable roommate chips in place of hard-coded children chips;
+  - `landing_page`: family demo cards and the split panel description.
+- **Privacy.**
+  - Arabic `lp2p` now says text and voice *inputs* (not SMS) and "not retained for training", like the English.
+  - The web AI pillar no longer says it parses "الرسائل النصية" (text messages).
+  - `landing_page` no longer says SMS "stays encrypted on your device".
+- **Claims.**
+  - The "even admins can't decrypt" claim is gone.
+  - Data is described as isolated per household with row-level security and encrypted in transit and at rest by the platform. This covers web `metric4Desc` / `security.title`, builder `b8d/b8sl/p2p/p5h`, and `landing_page` pillar 8, the privacy section heading and the metric card.
+  - No "سيادي/السيادية/سيادة" anywhere in the Arabic web, builder or landing copy.
+- **Glossary sweep** for leftovers that had no row: Urdu `total_price` ریال, `rid_admin_only` and `settle_wife_desc` گھرانہ/گھریلو. Afterwards there was no مسؤول (admin), تعويض, old ZATCA name or الرمز المربع in ar, and no چکر, ٹرانزیکشن, زمرہ, الاؤنس, بیوی or ر.س in ur.
+

+- `flutter test`: all passed (538).
+- `web_app`: `npm ci && npm run build && npm run lint` green.
+- `ai_service`: `pytest`, 614 passed.

+# UI/UX, Localization & Web Audit
+
+Scope: `flutter_app/lib/screens`, `lib/widgets`, `lib/theme`, `lib/l10n`, `web_app/`, `landing_page/`.
+Branch: `worktree-agent-a6e22181f4544ee4c` (base `f17eb2b`). Date: 2026-10-19.
+
+## Results: baseline vs final
+
+| Gate | Baseline (`f17eb2b`) | Final (`3fdb8cd`) |
+|---|---|---|
+| `flutter analyze` | No issues found | No issues found |
+| `flutter test` | 141 passed | 168 passed (27 new) |
+| `web_app` `npm run build` (tsc + vite) | pass; JS 462.6 kB, CSS 37.6 kB | pass; JS 466.5 kB, CSS 39.1 kB |
+| `web_app` `npm run lint` (oxlint) | 1 warning (`react(purity)` in Simulator) | 0 warnings |
+| Web at 360 px (ar + en, Playwright) | not measured | no horizontal scroll; 0 unnamed controls; 0 page errors |
+| Translation keys (en / ar / ur) | 508 / 504 / 504 | 1206 / 1206 / 1206 |
+| Hardcoded UI string literals | ~760 replaced (scanner flagged 1,172 candidate lines, which include data and sentinel strings) | 0 in user-facing parameters, enforced by `test/ui_l10n_guard_test.dart` |
+| Directional layout fixes | n/a | 32 (`EdgeInsetsDirectional`, `AlignmentDirectional`, `PositionedDirectional`, `BorderRadiusDirectional`) |
+| Hardcoded `Color(0x...)` in screens/widgets | 848 | 290 (553 replaced by `AppThemes` tokens) |
+| Icon-only buttons with no tooltip or label | 22 | 0 |
+
+New tests:
+- `test/ui_l10n_guard_test.dart`: key parity, placeholder parity, ar/ur values written in Arabic script, no rupees in Urdu, every `tr()` key defined, and no hardcoded literals in screens/widgets. Also covers the `format`, `sar` and `cycleMonth` helpers.
+- `test/screens/ui_rtl_locale_test.dart`: login screen in ar (RTL), ur (RTL) and en (LTR); "forgot password" placed at the logical end; payday card without English ordinals; no overflow at 2x text scale on a 360 dp phone.
+- `test/screens/ui_light_mode_test.dart`: forgot-password step 2 is readable in light mode; WCAG contrast check for the new text tokens.
+- `test/widgets/ui_payday_checkin_banner_test.dart`: column name, payday window, shown/hidden states, lookup failure, dismiss.
+- `test/widgets/ui_settlement_failure_test.dart`: a failed settlement is reported and not confirmed; Arabic RTL roommate card.
+

+

+## Details
+
+### UI-01: Urdu currency was rupees
+- **Root cause:** the Urdu map translated `sar` as "روپے" (Pakistani rupees), and three labels reused it.
+- **Impact:** every amount and sort label in Urdu named the wrong currency. Urdu speakers are a large share of the expat audience.
+- **Fix:** changed to "ریال". A regression guard test fails on "روپے/روپیہ" in any Urdu value.
+
+### UI-02: hardcoded strings
+- **Root cause:** most widgets added after the first localization pass used English literals in `Text`, snackbars, dialogs, hints and tooltips. A few used Arabic-only literals instead.
+- **Impact:** the Arabic-first app was mostly English after login (auth, onboarding, settings, scanners, chat, budgets, settlements, accounts). Urdu fell back to English.
+- **Fix:**
+  - Extracted about 760 literals into 698 new keys, with Saudi-dialect Arabic and Urdu translations. English values stay byte-identical, so existing English tests still pass.
+  - Added `context.trArgs`/`AppLocalizations.format` for `{placeholder}` substitution, and `context.sar`, `context.fmtDate` and `context.cycleMonth` helpers.
+  - FAQ, walkthrough steps and role cards are now stored as translation keys.
+- **Kept as data on purpose:** strings persisted to the database or parsed by the server stay English. These are `raw_sms` audit tags, BNPL notes and the offline chat payloads.
+- **Kept as data on purpose:** chat quick-chip example inputs, grocery search terms, brand names (Tamara, Tabby, STC Pay) and endonyms (العربية / English / اردو) are not translated.
+
+### UI-09: payday banner never showed (reported by the DB agent)
+- **Root cause:** the banner filtered `.eq('income_type', 'salary')`, but the column is `income_records.source_type` (migration `20261018_multi_source_income_and_accounts.sql:58`; `IncomeRecord.toMap`). PostgREST rejected the query, and `catch (_)` hid the error.
+- **Fix:**
+  - Filter on `source_type` using `IncomeSourceType.salary.value`.
+  - Log failures with `debugPrint` and a stack trace instead of swallowing them.
+  - Make the lookup and clock injectable, and add 7 tests.
+
+### UI-10: false "Settlement Recorded"
+- **Root cause:** `catch (_) {}` around `recordReimbursementPayment`, followed by unconditional success UI. The family card comment said "In tests or offline mode, continue gracefully".
+- **Impact:** a failed request (offline, 4xx/5xx) closed the sheet, showed success and refreshed. The user believed the debt was settled when nothing was recorded.
+- **Fix:** errors now show an error snackbar and the sheet stays open. The recorder is injectable; existing tests use a fake recorder, and new tests cover the failure path.
+
+### UI-11: Arabic category names
+- **Root cause:** `name.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9]'), '')` returns an empty string for Arabic and Urdu names, which produced the code `OPEX-`.
+- **Fix:** if the name has no ASCII letters, use a generated `OPEX-CUSTOM<base36 timestamp>` code instead. The server should still reject an empty slug (handed off to the services/DB owner).
+
+### UI-12 / UI-13: light-mode legibility and contrast
+- **Root cause:** many widgets were written for dark mode with `Colors.white` text, and the brand teal (#00E5BF) and emerald (#00C896) were used for text on white.
+- **Fix:**
+  - The invisible texts now use `textPrimary`.
+  - New tokens `context.accentText` (#00796B, 5.1:1) and `context.successText` (#047857), plus `AppThemes.success` / `accentTextLight` / `successTextLight`. These keep the bright brand colors in dark mode.
+  - Text on surfaces that are always dark (snackbar, modal barrier, camera overlay) keeps the bright color.
+
+### UI-15: RTL
+- **Fix:**
+  - Chat bubbles now sit at the logical start/end, with a mirrored tail corner.
+  - The Dismissible delete background and "forgot password" link use directional alignment.
+  - Badges, overlay positions (photo strip, multi-page and batch scanners, filter badge), the speed-dial anchor, the deficit pill and header paddings are directional.
+- **Verified, no change needed:** the directional Material icons used (`chevron_*`, `arrow_back*`, `arrow_forward*`, `send`, `trending_*`) have `matchTextDirection: true`, so they already mirror.
+- **Kept on purpose:** decorative gradients (`Alignment.topLeft` → `bottomRight`) and the price-chart padding stay LTR.
+
+### UI-18: async lifecycle
+- **Fix:** a `_safeSetState` helper (setState only while mounted) in the three scanner screens; `if (!mounted) return` guards before post-await `setState`, snackbars and navigation; `ctx.mounted` checks before `setDialogState`; and no parent `context` across async gaps in bottom sheets.
+
+### UI-20: fixed (follow-up, 29b83f6)
+- **Constraint:** disposing a controller right after `await showDialog` can throw "used after disposed", because the exit animation still rebuilds the `TextField`.
+- **Fix:** a small `StatefulWidget`, `widgets/dispose_on_unmount.dart`, wraps each dialog's content and disposes the controllers in `State.dispose`. That runs after the route is removed and after its `TextField`s have detached. Values read synchronously after the `await` still work.
+- **Sites (14):** ingestion settings ×2, edit sheet ×1, budget management ×4, receipt scanner ×1, ZATCA scanner ×1, installment plans ×2, sub-budget add/rename ×3.
+- **Sub-budget list controllers (the other 3 of the 17):** these were already disposed in `State.dispose`. Controllers replaced by a reload, or created after the dialog closed, are now disposed too. The clipboard paste checks `ctx.mounted` before writing.
+- **Tests:** `test/widgets/dispose_on_unmount_test.dart` checks that the controller stays alive through the exit animation and is disposed afterwards. It also scans `lib/` so that every local dialog controller is passed to `disposables:`.
+
+### UI-22: not fixed
+- Using Cairo/Tajawal for Arabic needs a font decision: either a `GoogleFonts` fallback, which is fetched at runtime and also affects tests, or bundled assets. It also needs a change to `main.dart`, which is outside this agent's ownership.
+- Today Arabic glyphs fall back to the platform font (Noto Naskh Arabic on Android), which is legible.
+
+### UI-24: resolved (owner decision)
+- **Decision:** in family mode the husband carries shared expenses (Nafaqah); nothing is split between the spouses. A wife-paid shared expense is a debt the husband owes her; her personal purchases come out of her per-cycle allowance; husband-paid shared expenses are plain household expenses. Roommate mode keeps its splits. Rules 1–4 are in `.agents/rules/02-saudi-fintech-and-islamic-compliance.md`.
+- **Fix:**
+  - `edit_transaction_sheet.dart`: in family mode the 50/50 banners (`settle_shared_partner_owes` / `settle_shared_you_owe`) are replaced by Nafaqah banners, and a `NafaqahClassSelector` offers "Husband paid", "Shared for family (husband reimburses)" or "Personal (from my/her allowance)". The stored `nafaqah_class` wins over the recorder-relative payer, so the husband editing his wife's advance never erases her claim.
+  - `partner_settlement_card.dart`: in family mode `psc_shared` ("Shared 50/50") is replaced by `psc_family_household`.
+  - `family_reimbursement_card.dart`: reads `GET /households/{id}/nafaqah`; husband-owes-wife balance, partial/full repayment (overpayment rejected client- and server-side), ledger history; the "Half" chip was removed. New `wife_allowance_card.dart`: allocated / spent / remaining, negative on overspend, editable by the husband/admin only.
+  - The manual expense sheet and the chat confirmation card use the same selector and send `nafaqah_class`.
+- **Tests:** `family_reimbursement_card_test.dart` (EN + AR RTL), `edit_transaction_sheet_test.dart`, `pending_expense_confirmation_card_test.dart`, `partner_settlement_card_test.dart`, `ui_settlement_failure_test.dart`, `nafaqah_test.dart`, `nafaqah_api_client_test.dart`, `manual_expense_row_test.dart`.
+
+### UI-25: fixed
+- **UI-25:** the undo re-insert in `transaction_feed_screen.dart` copies only a subset of transaction columns, so undo drops the payer/beneficiary/account attribution. This belongs with the data-layer owner.
+  - **Fixed later in ad26480:** `TransactionProvider.deleteTransaction` deletes with `delete().select()` and keeps the returned row. If no row comes back, it falls back to the full `Transaction.toMap()`. `restoreDeletedTransaction` re-inserts that row unchanged: same id and every column, including `paid_by`, `beneficiary*`, `account_id`, `sub_category`, `user_id`, `qr_code_raw` and `receipt_url`. DB triggers recompute `cycle_key`, budget spend and account balance.
+  - **Receipt image:** it used to be deleted from storage before the DB delete, even when that delete failed. It is now deleted only after a 10 s undo window with no undo.
+  - **Other changes:** undo snapshots are dropped on sign-out or household switch. A failed undo shows a localized error.
+  - **Limit:** foreign-key side effects of the delete are not reversed. The only reference is `installment_plans.original_transaction_id` (`ON DELETE SET NULL`), which stays null after an undo. Line items live in the row's own `items`/`line_items` columns and are restored.
+  - **Tests:** `test/providers/transaction_undo_restore_test.dart`.
+
+### WEB-01: language leaks on the web
+- **Fix:**
+  - Added `hero.settled*`, simulator unit/label keys and the AI category keys.
+  - Added `familyRows`/`roommateRows` arrays (an English ledger now exists).
+  - Added `a11y.*` and `pageTitle` keys.
+  - The simulator renders the ledgers from the dictionary and formats every amount through one locale-aware formatter.
+
+### WEB-03 / WEB-04: motion and canvas
+- **Fix:**
+  - A global reduced-motion CSS block, `<MotionConfig reducedMotion="user">`, and `confetti({ disableForReducedMotion: true })`.
+  - The SVG river calls `pauseAnimations()` when reduced motion is on.
+  - The canvas draws one static frame under reduced motion and pauses when off-screen (IntersectionObserver) or when the tab is hidden.
+  - The canvas renders at DPR (capped at 2x), uses 32 particles under 640 px, and guards the `dist === 0` NaN.
+
+### WEB-09: fixed (High)
+- **Was:** the early-access form called `preventDefault`, set `submitted=true` and fired confetti. Nothing was sent or stored, so every signup was lost while the user saw a success message.
+- **Fix:**
+  - Backend (b5a5347, b3e1227): `POST /public/inquiries` (anonymous web and landing forms) and `POST /support/inquiries` (in-app; the sender identity comes only from the verified Supabase JWT) email each request to `CONTACT_RECIPIENT_EMAIL` (default `abedmowafaq@gmail.com`) from `MAIL_FROM` (default `Budget Tracker <fmscoinfo@fmsco.com.sa>`), with Reply-To set to the submitter. Delivery is through SMTP or Resend. The endpoints have strict validation, a honeypot field, and per-IP, per-email, per-user and global rate limits that fail closed. A header-injection guard is in place. With no provider configured they answer 503 and log an error; they never report success without delivery.
+  - Web app (ee53e2b): `EarlyAccess.tsx` posts to the endpoint, shows a sending state, and shows success and confetti only on a 2xx answer. Errors are localized (AR/EN). The build served at `/` (`ai_service/static`) was refreshed so the live form posts to the same origin.
+  - Landing pages (3e7d84e): the generated fallback landing has a compact VIP form in the Contact section (AR/EN), and the mailto link is still there. `landing_page/index.html` posts to the same endpoint.
+  - App (f6c78ad): the help center's "Contact Developer" button and the escalation card send through `/support/inquiries` and show an honest success or failure message.
+- **Owner action:** set `RESEND_API_KEY` (with `fmsco.com.sa` verified) or the `SMTP_*` credentials of the `fmscoinfo@fmsco.com.sa` mailbox on the deployment. Until then every form shows an error instead of a fake success.
+
+### WEB-13: landing_page
+- These look like design prototypes (Stitch exports) that the Vite app has superseded.
+- Tailwind Play CDN compiles CSS at runtime in the browser and is documented as not for production use. If these pages are deployed, move them into the Vite build or pre-compile the CSS.
+
+## Screenshots
+- `docs/review/audit/screens/web_phone_ar_360.jpg` and `web_phone_en_360.jpg`: the web app at 360 px after the fixes, Arabic RTL and English LTR.

+# UI/UX review: mobile app and web landing (with screenshots)
+
+Branch `audit/claude-comprehensive-review`, base commit `10a96cf`. Date: 2026-10-21. This is a report only; no app code was changed.
+
+## ملخص لصاحب المشروع
+
+**الخلاصة:** التطبيق غني بالمزايا، وفكرته مناسبة جداً للأسر السعودية. شرح النفقة عند إنشاء المنزل واضح، ومراجعة المصروف قبل حفظه فكرة ممتازة. لكن الاستخدام اليومي فيه أربع مشاكل رئيسية:
+
+1. **الشاشة الرئيسية طويلة ومتناقضة.** طولها نحو أربع شاشات. فيها رقمان مختلفان للصرف اليومي (208 و202.4). في نفس اللحظة تقول بطاقة إن الصرف "مرتفع وتجاوز للميزانية"، وتقول بطاقة أخرى "ضمن الميزانية". ما تحتاجه الأسرة أولاً هو: كم بقي حتى الراتب، وكم على الزوج لزوجته، وأي بند تجاوز. هذا موزّع في أماكن متفرقة.
+2. **الأخطاء تظهر كأنها أخبار جيدة.** إذا تعذّر الاتصال بالخادم تختفي بطاقة "المستحق للزوجة" بلا تنبيه. وتظهر رسالة "تم سداد كافة الأقساط"، ويظهر قسم الفواتير فارغاً. قد يظن المستخدم أن لا شيء عليه، والحقيقة أن البيانات لم تُحمَّل.
+3. **لغة النفقة تُربك في أهم لحظة، أي عند تسجيل المصروف.** يسأل التطبيق ثلاثة أسئلة متداخلة: "مين دفع؟ أنا / الشريك"، و"لمين؟"، و"من دفع ولأي غرض؟". ويسمّي الزوجة "الشريك" مع أيقونة قلب. وفي قائمة المعاملات يظهر كل مصروف بكلمة "مشترك"، حتى ما دفعته الزوجة من مالها، فلا ترى الأسرة من يستحق ماذا. ولا يوجد في مركز المساعدة أي سؤال عن النفقة. بل يشرح السؤال الموجود "تسوية صافية بيني وبين الشريك"، وهذا يخالف قاعدة الأسرة.
+4. **الوضوح البصري في الوضع الفاتح.** مبلغ المستحق للزوجة بالذهبي على أبيض، وأزرار بيضاء النص على أخضر فاتح، وروابط سماوية. كلها تقريباً بنصف التباين المطلوب، فيصعب قراءتها في الشمس. الوضع الداكن ممتاز.
+
+**الموقع الإلكتروني:** شكله جميل، لكن الحروف العربية في بطاقات أعلى الصفحة **مقطّعة**: "الـيـومـي"، "دا ئن". سبب ذلك تباعد الأحرف في التصميم. وفيه أرقام لا يمكن إثباتها، مثل "دقة 99.4%" و"أكثر من 1,500 أسرة" و"معالجة محلية". هذا يضر بالثقة في منتج مالي. والزر الرئيسي يفتح المحاكي بدل الدعوة للتسجيل.
+
+**أهم ما أنصح به بالترتيب:**
+1. بطاقة رئيسية واحدة: "المتبقي حتى الراتب" مع حكم واحد، وسطر "المستحق لسارة" للأسر.
+2. رسائل خطأ صادقة لكل بطاقة: "تعذّر التحميل — إعادة المحاولة".
+3. سؤال واحد للنفقة بأسماء حقيقية بدل "الشريك".
+4. شارة النفقة في قائمة المعاملات.
+5. خطوات إعداد للمنزل الجديد.
+6. إصلاح ألوان الوضع الفاتح.
+7. تمكين تعديل المبلغ والتاريخ قبل الحفظ.
+8. إبراز البنود المتجاوزة بمقدار التجاوز.
+9. توحيد شكل المبالغ والتواريخ بالعربي.
+10. إصلاح الحروف المقطّعة والادعاءات في الموقع.
+
+أغلبها تعديلات صغيرة إلى متوسطة.
+
+**العدد:** 36 ملاحظة. منها 9 عالية الأهمية و15 متوسطة و12 تحسينات شكلية.
+
+---
+
+## How the screenshots were produced
+
+**Mobile.** I made a scratch copy of `flutter_app` and wrote a throwaway widget-test harness (`test/ux/` in the copy, not committed). The harness pumps the **real screens** (`DashboardScreen`, `HouseholdScreen`, `LoginScreen`, sheets and tabs) at 390×844 logical, DPR 2. It writes PNGs with `RepaintBoundary.toImage`. Two runs are not covered here: the web build in Playwright was run separately, and the accessibility sweep is described in the Accessibility section.
+
+**Fakes, no network.** Supabase was initialised against an in-memory fake through an `http` `MockClient`, with a silent realtime transport and a fake session. The FastAPI client ran inside `http.runWithClient` with the same fake. Platform channels were mocked, and sqflite used FFI.
+
+**Fixture data:**
+- *Family household:* husband Ahmed (admin and Nafaqah provider) and wife Sara, plus two child dependents.
+  - Six budgets in the October cycle; Shopping is at 131% and Dining at 115%.
+  - Ten transactions, including one wife advance and one wife-personal purchase.
+  - Three accounts.
+  - Nafaqah ledger: owed 386.40, advanced 686.40, repaid 300.
+  - Wife's allowance: 1,000 allocated, 645 spent.
+- *Roommates household:* three peers, with simplified debts.
+- *Empty household.*
+- *"API down" variant:* Supabase answers but FastAPI is unreachable, and three items sit in the offline queue.
+- **The clock was real:** 2026-10-21, payday 27, so 6 days to payday.
+
+**Fonts and rendering limits:**
+- The app's `google_fonts` families (Outfit, Inter, JetBrains Mono) were bundled as local static instances taken from the OFL sources in google/fonts. Runtime fetching was off.
+- Outfit has no Arabic glyphs. To match an Android phone, Arabic-script text falls back to **Noto Naskh Arabic** (the Android system Arabic font).
+- **Urdu is therefore shown in Naskh, not Nastaliq.**
+- **Emoji are not rendered.** Category emoji and language flags show as boxes; on a phone they render normally.
+- The test engine draws text that has no font family with a box font. A scratch-only patch therefore added `fontFamily: 'Roboto'` to 32 family-less `TextStyle(color: …)` dropdown styles. That family is registered as Roboto + Naskh, as on Android.
+- Layout overflows were measured only after this patch, so the overflows listed below are real, not test-font artefacts.
+- Material shadows were turned on.
+- Artefact: the language selector in Settings shows "English" as selected because the harness sets the locale directly. Ignore it.
+
+**Web.** I made a scratch copy of `web_app` and ran `npm ci`, then `VITE_API_BASE_URL= npm run build`, then `vite preview`. Playwright Chromium (preinstalled) captured 390 px and 1280 px, Arabic and English. Reduced motion was on, and the page was scrolled through so that scroll-reveal sections render. Google Fonts loaded.
+

+## Totals
+
+| Severity | Mobile | Web | Total |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| High: blocks or confuses core use | 7 | 2 | **9** |
+| Medium: noticeable friction | 13 | 2 | **15** |
+| Low: polish | 9 | 3 | **12** |
+| **Total** | 29 | 7 | **36** |
+
+## The 10 highest-leverage improvements (priority order)
+
+Effort: S is up to about 1 day, M is 2–4 days, L is a week or more.
+
+| # | Improvement | Fixes | Effort |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| 1 | **One "until payday" hero** (described below the table). | UX-07, UX-09 | M |
+| 2 | **Honest per-card error and stale states** (described below the table). | UX-01 | S–M |
+| 3 | **One Nafaqah question in family mode** (described below the table). | UX-03, UX-05 | M |
+| 4 | **Nafaqah and date context in the feed** (described below the table). | UX-04, UX-11 | S |
+| 5 | **Guided first-run setup** (described below the table). | UX-02, UX-17 | M |
+| 6 | **Light-mode contrast token pass** (described below the table). | UX-06, UX-27 | S |
+| 7 | **Correctable, faster entry** (described below the table). | UX-12, UX-13 | M |
+| 8 | **Over-budget made visible** (described below the table). | UX-08 | S |
+| 9 | **Money, date and font localisation sweep** (described below the table). | UX-10, UX-20, UX-21 | S–M |
+| 10 | **Web landing: legibility and trust** (described below the table). | WEB-UX-01–04 | S–M |
+
+1. **One "until payday" hero.**
+   - Show one number, "المتبقي حتى الراتب", with the days left.
+   - Give one verdict, computed once (server forecast or client, not both).
+   - In family mode add one line, "مستحق لسارة: 386.40 ر.س ←", that links to the ledger.
+   - Drop the separate salary-cycle card, or merge its ring into the hero.
+2. **Honest per-card error and stale states.**
+   - Never render a failed request as an empty or positive state.
+   - Show "تعذّر التحميل" with a retry button, and a "آخر تحديث" time when offline.
+3. **One Nafaqah question in family mode.**
+   - Hide "مين دفع / لمين" and show the three cards with real names.
+   - Replace "الشريك" with the spouse's name everywhere in family mode.
+   - Add a Nafaqah FAQ entry.
+4. **Nafaqah and date context in the feed.**
+   - Add badges "مستحق لسارة" and "من مصروف سارة".
+   - Group rows by "اليوم / أمس / تاريخ".
+   - Show amounts as `ر.س` in a neutral colour.
+5. **Guided first-run setup.** After a household is created, show a checklist:
+   - payday;
+   - salary or income;
+   - starter budgets (one tap from a template);
+   - invite spouse or roommates;
+   - choose the Nafaqah provider.
+
+   The empty state also needs real buttons.
+6. **Light-mode contrast token pass.**
+   - Gold text → `#7A5C00`.
+   - Text on `#00C896` → dark ink, or use a `#047857` fill with white text.
+   - Cyan text → `#0369A1`.
+   - Accounts hero text → white.
+7. **Correctable, faster entry.**
+   - Put the amount field first, with focus on open and a numeric keypad.
+   - Make amount and category editable in the chat confirmation and the receipt review.
+   - Add a date chip: "اليوم / أمس / اختيار".
+   - Reduce the speed dial to 3 actions.
+8. **Over-budget made visible.**
+   - Show percent beyond 100% and the overspend amount ("تجاوز بـ 310 ر.س").
+   - Sort categories by risk.
+   - Lift the list above the secondary cards.
+9. **Money, date and font localisation sweep.**
+   - Route every amount through `context.sar`.
+   - Use Arabic month names for cycle ranges.
+   - Remove "(27th)", "ADMIN" and "SAR x.x".
+   - Bundle Cairo or Tajawal (UI-22).
+10. **Web landing: legibility and trust.**
+    - Remove `tracking-*` and `font-mono` from Arabic text.
+    - Write a concrete headline and add real app screenshots.
+    - Make one primary CTA, "انضم لقائمة الانتظار".
+    - Remove unverifiable numbers and claims.
+

+## Mobile findings
+
+### UX-01 (High). API failures look like empty or positive states. Screens: dashboard ([06](ux_screens/06_dashboard_api_down_ar.png)).
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- With FastAPI unreachable, the hero and accounts still render from Supabase. But:
+  - the **Nafaqah card and the wife-allowance card disappear without a word**;
+  - the salary-cycle card disappears;
+  - Recurring Bills shows its first-time "إعداد" set-up state;
+  - Installments says **"تم سداد كافة الأقساط"**.
+- A husband checking whether he owes his wife sees nothing. That reads as "nothing owed".
+- `FamilyReimbursementCard` "renders nothing outside family mode", and an error is treated the same way. The bills and installments providers fall back to empty lists.
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- Give every API-backed card three explicit states: loading (skeleton), **error** and empty.
+- Error state: a compact card that keeps the card's title and says "تعذّر تحميل مستحقات الزوجة — تحقق من الاتصال". Give it a "إعادة المحاولة" button and the last known value, greyed, with "آخر تحديث 9:40 م".
+- Installments: "لا توجد خطط تقسيط" when the list is empty; "تم سداد كافة الأقساط" only when plans exist and all are paid.
+
+### UX-02 (High). A new household lands on a dead end. Screens: dashboard ([05](ux_screens/05_dashboard_new_household_ar.png)), onboarding ([01](ux_screens/01_onboarding_type_ar.png)).
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- After "إنشاء منزل" the user arrives at a hero showing **0.00 ر.س remaining**, "الصرف 0 (ضمن الخطة)" and a progress bar.
+- The only guidance is at the very bottom, four screens down: "لا توجد مخصصات لدورة أكتوبر 2026 … يمكنك نسخ مخصصات الشهر السابق أو إضافة تصنيفات جديدة **أدناه**". There is nothing below it and no button.
+- Payday, income, inviting the spouse and choosing the provider live deep in Settings.
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- Replace the hero for a household with no budgets with a setup card: "جهّز منزلك في دقيقتين", with a five-step checklist (✓ يوم الراتب ✓ الدخل ✓ الميزانيات ✓ دعوة الزوجة/الشركاء ✓ المكلّف بالنفقة).
+- Each step opens the existing sheet.
+- Add a "ميزانية مقترحة" button that pre-fills categories from income: groceries, bills, fuel and so on, editable.
+
+### UX-03 (High). Family entry asks three overlapping questions and calls the wife "الشريك". Screens: chat ([10](ux_screens/10_chat_confirmation_ar.png)), Urdu ([11](ux_screens/11_chat_confirmation_ur.png)), edit ([12](ux_screens/12_edit_sheet_nafaqah_ar.png)), scanner ([14](ux_screens/14_receipt_review_ar.png)).
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- The chat confirmation shows three questions in a row:
+  - "مين دفع؟ أنا / **للشريك**" ("للشريك" means *for* the partner, under a *who paid* question);
+  - "لمين؟ كلانا / أنا / للشريك";
+  - the Nafaqah cards "من دفع ولأي غرض؟".
+- The edit sheet adds a fourth question (child) and uses a heart icon for "الشريك دفع".
+- In Urdu, the "who paid" choice reads "**پارٹنر کے لیے**" ("for the partner").
+- The choices are coupled: picking a Nafaqah card silently flips "who paid". A non-technical user cannot predict the result.
+- The glossary in `translation_qa.md` says not to use "الشريك" for a spouse.
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- In family mode, show only the Nafaqah cards (plus the optional child chip), worded from the recorder's point of view:
+  - husband viewing: "أنا دفعت (مصروف البيت)", "سارة دفعت للبيت — أردّها لها", "مشتريات سارة الشخصية — من مصروفها";
+  - wife viewing: "زوجي دفع", "دفعتُ للبيت — يردّها لي", "لي شخصياً — من مصروفي".
+- Keep "مين دفع / لمين" for roommates only.
+- Fix the "who paid" option key so it is a payer label ("دفع الطرف الآخر"), not a beneficiary label.
+
+### UX-04 (High). The feed hides who owes whom. Screen: feed ([09](ux_screens/09_transaction_feed_ar.png)).
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- Every row carries a green "**مشترك**" badge. That includes Sara's advance at الدانوب (a debt the husband owes) and her personal ساكو purchase (charged to her allowance).
+- The feed is where a family checks "what did she pay for", and the Nafaqah class is invisible there.
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- In family mode, swap the badge by class: "مستحق لسارة" (gold), "من مصروف سارة" (cyan), "مصروف البيت" (neutral).
+- Add a filter chip "مستحقات سارة".
+
+### UX-05 (High). The help centre has no Nafaqah explanation, and its family answer contradicts the rule. Screen: help (`80_help_ar_light.png`, scratch).
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- The FAQ topics are salary, receipts, bills, BNPL and household. There is no Nafaqah or wife-allowance entry.
+- `faq_household_a1` explains "لكل مصروف تحدد مين دفع (أنا أو الشريك) ولمين … ويحسب صافي التسوية المستحقة". That is the roommate model, presented to families. Rule 02 forbids splits between spouses.
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- Add a "النفقة ومصروف الزوجة" topic with three short Q&As:
+  - "من يتحمل مصاريف البيت؟"
+  - "دفعتُ من مالي للبيت، كيف أستردّه؟"
+  - "ما هو مصروفي الشخصي ومن يحدده؟"
+- Reword household Q1 to talk about roommates only.
+- Add a "؟" link next to the Nafaqah card title that opens the topic.
+
+### UX-06 (High). Light-mode contrast is too low on the key money figures and actions. Screens: [03](ux_screens/03_dashboard_cycle_nafaqah_ar.png), [15](ux_screens/15_accounts_ar.png), [17](ux_screens/17_roommates_settlement_ar.png), [01](ux_screens/01_onboarding_type_ar.png).
+
+**What's wrong.** Measured against the theme tokens (WCAG, 4.5:1 needed):
+
+| Element | Ratio |
+|---|---|
+| Owed-to-wife amount and badge, gold `#D4AF37` on white | 2.1:1 |
+| White label on `#00C896` buttons ("إنشاء منزل", "الانضمام لمنزل") | 2.16:1 |
+| "تعديل المصروف" and "هل أقدر أشتري؟", ice-cyan/sky on white or light cyan | 1.5–2.1:1 |
+| Roommate debt amounts, teal on grey tile | 1.3:1 |
+| Accounts hero: navy total on dark teal/blue gradient | 3.0–3.3:1 |
+| Accounts hero: green caption on the same gradient | 2.5:1 |
+| Pending-profile amber text | 2.1:1 |
+
+- Flutter's `textContrastGuideline` flags 100 lines on the light dashboard and 60 on the dark one.
+- The dark theme reads well ([19](ux_screens/19_dashboard_top_ar_dark.png)).
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- Add light-mode text tokens and use them: `goldText` `#7A5C00`, `infoText` `#0369A1`, `warnText` `#9A5B00`.
+- Buttons filled with `#00C896` get dark ink `#0A0F1D` (≥8:1); or switch the fill to `#047857` with white.
+- Make the accounts-hero text white (it is always on the dark gradient).
+
+### UX-07 (High). Two engines give two verdicts on the same screen. Screens: [02](ux_screens/02_dashboard_top_ar.png), [03](ux_screens/03_dashboard_cycle_nafaqah_ar.png), budgets (`30_budgets_ar_light.png`, scratch).
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- The hero (client-side) says "الصرف 208 ر.س/يوم (**مرتفع**)" and "المتوقع: 7,102 ر.س (**تجاوز الميزانية**)".
+- Two cards later, the salary-cycle card (server forecast) says "معدل الصرف اليومي: SAR **202.4**" with the badge "**ضمن الميزانية**".
+- In this run the server figures come from fixtures, but the structure is real: two computations of the same metric, each with its own verdict badge.
+- The budgets screen shows "عجز −859.50" (the account cannot fund its linked budgets) and "احتياطي الادخار (الفائض) +7,400" at the same time.
+- "6 أيام على الراتب" appears twice.
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- Compute pace once (the server forecast, with a client fallback), and give it one verdict and one place.
+- On the budgets screen, explain the relation in one line: "الدخل يغطي الميزانيات، لكن حساب الراجحي ناقص 859.50 — حوّل من STC Pay".
+
+### UX-08 (Medium). Overspend is hidden. Screen: categories ([04](ux_screens/04_dashboard_categories_ar.png)).
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- Shopping spent 1,310 of 1,000, but shows "**100%**", because `Budget.usagePercent` clamps to 0..1 (`models.dart:408-409`).
+- No "over by" amount is shown.
+- The order is not by risk: Dining (115%) is last, below Fuel.
+- The list starts about 3,000 px down the page.
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- Show "131%" and a red line, "تجاوز بـ 310.00 ر.س". Clamp only the bar.
+- Sort by over first, then by % used.
+- Show the top 3 at-risk categories right under the hero, with "عرض الكل".
+
+### UX-09 (Medium). The dashboard is long and the hierarchy is flat. Screens: [02](ux_screens/02_dashboard_top_ar.png), full page `11_dash_family_full_ar_light.png` (scratch).
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- About 3,300 px (four phone screens) and 12 blocks:
+  - cycle selector, hero;
+  - quick-action dock (duplicates the FAB, bottom nav and AI tab);
+  - accounts, salary cycle, Nafaqah, allowance;
+  - bills, BNPL;
+  - price/simulator links (a third time);
+  - categories.
+- For a family, the owed-to-wife card starts at about 1,550 px.
+- "لوحة القيادة" / "SOVEREIGN HUD" is jargon used as a label.
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- Order: hero (remaining until payday, with the Nafaqah line) → alerts (overspent categories, bills due before payday) → categories → accounts → bills/BNPL → tools.
+- Remove the quick-action dock, or keep only "مسح فاتورة" and "صوت".
+- Drop the duplicate simulator and price tiles.
+
+### UX-10 (Medium). Amount and date formatting is inconsistent in Arabic and Urdu. Screens: [03](ux_screens/03_dashboard_cycle_nafaqah_ar.png), [09](ux_screens/09_transaction_feed_ar.png), [14](ux_screens/14_receipt_review_ar.png), [15](ux_screens/15_accounts_ar.png), [16](ux_screens/16_settings_members_ar.png).
+
+**What's wrong:**
+
+| Where | Shows | Cause |
+|---|---|---|
+| Feed, scanner line items | "SAR 342.75" | `transaction_item_breakdown_card.dart:210,441,468` use `'$currency ${amount.toStringAsFixed(2)}'` |
+| Salary card | "SAR 202.4" (one decimal) | `salary_cycle_widget.dart:226,235` |
+| Account dropdown | "(SAR 6240.50)", no grouping | `manual_expense_sheet.dart` |
+| Accounts deficit | "-SAR 859.50" | — |

+| Household member badge | "**ADMIN**" in English, next to "مشرف" | — |
+| Cycle range | "10-26 - 09-27" (MM-DD, reads backwards in RTL) | — |
+
+The rest of the app correctly uses `context.sar` → "1,040.00 ر.س".
+
+**Recommendation:**

+- Use "دورة 27 سبتمبر – 26 أكتوبر" with Arabic month names.

+### UX-11 (Medium). The feed is hard to scan. Screen: [09](ux_screens/09_transaction_feed_ar.png).
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- No date or time on rows and no date grouping.
+- Every amount is red (alarm fatigue).
+- The PDF/CSV export chips take the prime slot under the filters; their tap targets are 27 dp tall.
+- The header count "10 مصاريف …" is truncated.
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- Use section headers "اليوم / أمس / الأحد 19 أكتوبر" and show the time on each row.
+- Use neutral ink for amounts; use red only for over-budget or flagged rows.
+- Move export into the ⋯ menu.
