+### UX-12 (Medium). Entry cannot be corrected, and entry is slow. Screens: [10](ux_screens/10_chat_confirmation_ar.png), [13](ux_screens/13_manual_expense_ar.png), [14](ux_screens/14_receipt_review_ar.png).
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- *Chat confirmation:* the amount is a read-only chip (`pending_expense_confirmation_card.dart:241`). If voice heard 816 instead of 186, the user must cancel and retype.
+- *Receipt review:* no amount or category field. Only the merchant and "مين صرف" can be changed before saving.
+- *Manual sheet:*
+  - the merchant comes before the amount;
+  - the amount field has a **"$"** icon;
+  - there is **no date field**, and neither in the edit sheet (`occurredAt: DateTime.now()`), so yesterday's cash purchase cannot be backdated.
+- Tap counts:
+  - manual entry: FAB → speed dial → manual → merchant → amount → category → save = **7 taps** plus typing;
+  - chat: AI tab → type/speak → send → confirm = **4 taps**.
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- Make the amount editable in both review cards (tap the chip to edit) and add a category dropdown to the scan review.
+- Manual sheet:
+  - put the amount first, with focus on open and a decimal keypad;
+  - remove the "$" icon (the label already says ر.س);
+  - add a date row "اليوم ▾" with chips "اليوم / أمس / تاريخ…".
+- Remember the last category and account.
+
+### UX-13 (Medium). The speed dial has 7 actions and no scrim. Screen: [08](ux_screens/08_speed_dial_ar.png).
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- "إضافة مصروف" opens 7 options:
+  - batch scan, scan, voice/AI;
+  - income, transfer, simulator, manual.
+- The labels sit on top of the dashboard text with no dimming.
+- Rule 03 specifies 3 primary actions.
+- The FAB label says "add expense", but the button opens a menu.
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- Three actions: "مصروف" (opens a sheet that offers manual / مسح / صوت at the top), "دخل" and "تحويل".
+- Add a 40% scrim.
+- Move the simulator and batch scan elsewhere.
+
+### UX-14 (Medium). Large system text breaks the dashboard. Screen: [07](ux_screens/07_dashboard_textscale160_ar.png).
+
+**What's wrong** at 160% text size (common among older users):
+- The quick-action row overflows by 51 px (`dashboard_screen.dart:540`).
+- The floating nav overflows (`dashboard_screen.dart:161`, `:210`, `:252`).
+- The hero's three stat tiles truncate the **values** to "…7,100" and "208 ر…".
+- An installments row overflows (`installment_plans_card.dart:596`).
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- Above a 1.3× text scale, stack the stat tiles vertically.
+- Let the quick actions wrap onto two rows, or scroll horizontally.
+- Hide the nav labels and keep the icons.
+- Use `FittedBox` only for the big hero amount.
+
+### UX-15 (Medium). Settings are long, duplicated and technical. Screen: [16](ux_screens/16_settings_members_ar.png).
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- The household card says "عضو نشط واحد" and lists Ahmed plus the children as "ملف مسبق (بانتظار الانضمام)". A child does not "join".
+- The next card, "الأعضاء والمشرفون", lists Ahmed, Sara and Abdullah. Two member lists disagree.
+- Member rows overflow by 26–40 px and clip the names (`household_management_card.dart:379`, a `Row` without `Flexible`).
+- The settings page is about 4.5 screens long, with **three separate save buttons**: payday, rollover and the payday dropdown.
+- Technical items: the household UUID with a copy button, the "معالجة المعاملات المكررة" strategy and ingestion-channel toggles.
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- One "أفراد المنزل" list: adults with role badges, then "المُعالون" (children) with their allowance and no "waiting to join".
+- Split Settings into sub-pages: المنزل والأفراد / الراتب والدخل / الميزانيات والترحيل / الحسابات / المظهر واللغة / الخصوصية والصلاحيات / المساعدة.
+- Save on change, with a toast.
+- Hide the UUID and the dedup strategy under "متقدم".
+
+### UX-16 (Medium). The roommates flow does not centre on "me". Screen: [17](ux_screens/17_roommates_settlement_ar.png).
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- Settlement lines say "أحمد مدين لـ فيصل" while Ahmed is the viewer. There is also a stray space after "لـ".
+- The "تبسيط الديون" toggle is jargon.
+- The amounts are teal on grey (1.3:1).
+- The roommate dashboard still opens with the family-style budget hero; the settlement card is about 2,000 px down.
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- In roommate mode, the hero becomes "صافي حسابك: عليك 198.67 ر.س لفيصل" with "سدّد" / "أرسل تذكير".
+- Rows read "أنت مدين لفيصل" / "عمران مدين لفيصل".
+- Rename the toggle "أقل عدد تحويلات" with a one-line hint.
+
+### UX-17 (Low). Onboarding: the empty name is ignored silently. Screen: [01](ux_screens/01_onboarding_type_ar.png).
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- `_createHousehold` returns silently when the name is empty (`household_screen.dart:99`). The type is validated with a message; the name is not.
+- The family description itself is clear and correct.
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- Show an inline error, "اكتب اسم المنزل".
+- Optionally pre-fill "بيت {اسم المستخدم}".
+
+### UX-18 (Medium). Chat copy mixes languages. Screens: [10](ux_screens/10_chat_confirmation_ar.png), [11](ux_screens/11_chat_confirmation_ur.png).
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- The Arabic welcome message embeds the English example "'Dunkin 19 SAR: 16 latte and 3 donut'". The bidi algorithm scrambles the quotes and order. Urdu has the same problem.
+- The suggestion chips include "Can I buy a 1200 SAR iPad?" in the Arabic UI.
+- An in-chat ع/EN/اردو switch duplicates the app language and has 25–27 dp targets.
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- Use locale-matched examples only, each wrapped in its own bubble or chip.
+- Remove the chat-level language switch; the assistant already understands both languages.
+
+### UX-19 (Medium). Tap targets below 48 dp. Screens: feed, chat, settings.
+
+**What's wrong.** `androidTapTargetGuideline` fails on:
+- the feed's "الأحدث أولاً", "تصدير CSV" and "تصدير PDF" (27 dp tall);
+- the chat language pills (25–27 dp);
+- "+ إضافة عضو / مُعال" (21 dp).
+
+The labelled-tap-target check passes everywhere except the modal barrier.
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- Raise the minimum height to 48 dp with `MaterialTapTargetSize.padded`, or add vertical padding.
+
+### UX-20 (Medium). Typography: Arabic font and small sizes. Screens: all.
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- The theme uses Outfit, which has no Arabic glyphs. Arabic falls back to the system font, Noto Naskh on Android, which is a book face. Rule 03 asks for Cairo or Tajawal (still open as UI-22).
+- Dropdown items use a plain `TextStyle(color: …)` and therefore the system font, a third typeface.
+- Many labels are 10–11 px (hero tile captions, nav labels at 10 px, badges). Arabic at 10 px is hard to read.
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- Bundle Cairo (400/600/700) as assets, with `fontFamilyFallback: ['Cairo']` on the text theme.
+- Merge dropdown styles with the theme (`Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyLarge!.copyWith(...)`).
+- Set a 12 px floor for Arabic and Urdu labels.
+
+### UX-21 (Medium). Affordability verdicts are hard-coded in English and Arabic. Screen: simulator sheet.
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- `affordability_simulator_sheet.dart:196-213` builds the advice from inline English and Arabic strings ("SAR x.x", one decimal). There is no Urdu.
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- Move the advice to `trArgs` keys in all three locales and format with `context.sar`.
+
+### UX-22 (Low). Accounts hero and quick transfer. Screen: [15](ux_screens/15_accounts_ar.png).
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- The "تحويل سريع 859.50" button is a full-width solid red, which reads as a destructive action.
+- The amounts are "SAR".
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- An amber outlined button, "تغطية العجز (859.50 ر.س)".
+
+### UX-23 (Low). The edit sheet shows a default Nafaqah class until the stored class loads. Screen: [12](ux_screens/12_edit_sheet_nafaqah_ar.png).
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- Until the extra `transactions` select returns, the cards show "دفعه الزوج".
+- If the select fails, they keep showing it. The payload is guarded, so data is safe, but the UI is wrong.
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- Show a small skeleton over the Nafaqah section until it has loaded.
+- On failure, show "تعذّر قراءة التصنيف".
+- Better: select `nafaqah_class` with the feed query.
+
+### UX-24 (Low). Doubled "+".
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- "+ إضافة خطة تقسيط" and "+ إضافة عضو / مُعال" show a + icon and a "+" character.
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- Drop the "+" from the strings.
+
+### UX-25 (Low). Installments header when there are no plans. Screen: [05](ux_screens/05_dashboard_new_household_ar.png).
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- "تم سداد كافة الأقساط" when no plan exists.
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- "لا توجد أقساط".
+
+### UX-26 (Low). All tabs load at launch.
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- `DashboardScreen` uses an `IndexedStack` of 5 screens, so chat, budgets and settings all build and fetch on start. That costs extra requests and battery on every launch.
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- Build tabs lazily: create each on first visit and keep it alive afterwards.
+
+### UX-27 (Low). Dark/light parity.
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- Dark mode is the reference look and is consistent ([19](ux_screens/19_dashboard_top_ar_dark.png)).
+- Light mode inherits the accent colours unchanged (see UX-06).
+- The active bottom-nav colour `#008F7A` is hard-coded (4.0:1 for 10 px labels).
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- Use `context.accentText` for the nav label.
+
+### UX-28 (Low). The walkthrough leads with the ZATCA scanner. Screen: `04_walkthrough_ar_light.png` (scratch).
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- Step 1 of 5 is "ماسح الفواتير الذكي وزاتكا", not the core promise.
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- Step 1: "اعرف كم بقي حتى الراتب".
+- Step 2, family: "النفقة ومصروف الزوجة"; roommates: "التسوية".
+- Then the entry methods.
+
+### UX-29 (Low). Budget management row overflow and the archive icon. Screen: budgets (`30_budgets_ar_light.png`, scratch).
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- The allocated/spent row overflows by 8 px (`budget_management_screen.dart:1118`).
+- The archive icon (gold) sits unlabelled next to the edit icon, one tap from hiding a category.
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- Wrap the row in `Flexible`.
+- Move archive into a ⋯ menu with a confirmation.
+
+---
+
+## Web landing findings
+
+### WEB-UX-01 (High). Arabic letters break apart in the hero cards. Screens: [20](ux_screens/20_web_mobile_ar.png), [21](ux_screens/21_web_desktop_ar.png).
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- The stat-card labels and captions in the first viewport render as "معدل الصرف الـيـومـي الآمن", "الـيـوم 12 من 30" and "دا ئن مستحق".
+- `Hero.tsx:124,149,186` apply `font-mono uppercase tracking-wider` (and `Hero.tsx:70` the badge) to Arabic text. Letter-spacing breaks Arabic joining, and the monospace stack has no Arabic face.
+- This is the first thing a Saudi visitor sees.
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- Apply tracking and mono only to Latin: `[dir=ltr]` / `:lang(en)`, or use `tracking-normal font-sans` when `lang === 'ar'`.
+
+### WEB-UX-02 (Medium). Message and CTA. Screens: [20](ux_screens/20_web_mobile_ar.png), full page `90_web_ar_390_full.png` (scratch).
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- The headline "صفاء وانسيابية مالية تامة لأسرتك وشركاء سكنك." is abstract.
+- The primary button "ابدأ المحاكي التفاعلي" scrolls to a demo.
+- On mobile the VIP CTA is hidden in the hamburger menu. The only sign-up form is at about 10,500 px of an 11,261 px page (13 phone screens).
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- Headline: "اعرف كم بقي على راتبك، ومن يستحق ماذا في البيت".
+- Sub-line: النفقة، مصروف الزوجة، تسوية شركاء السكن، مسح فواتير ZATCA.
+- Primary CTA "انضم لقائمة الانتظار" with the email field inline in the hero. The simulator becomes the secondary button.
+- Add a sticky bottom CTA bar on mobile.
+- Show 2–3 real app screenshots, for example from `ux_screens/`.
+
+### WEB-UX-03 (High). Unverifiable claims weaken trust. Screens: [21](ux_screens/21_web_desktop_ar.png), full page (scratch).
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- Figures presented as facts:
+  - "دقة المعالجة الذكية 99.4%", "0.28 ث زمن المعالجة";
+  - "100% خصوصية تامة", "انضم إلى أكثر من 1,500 أسرة";
+  - a footer pill "النظام متصل ويعمل بكفاءة • تشفير AES-256".
+- Privacy cards claim "معالجة محلية لحسابات الصرف" and "سجل تدقيق غير قابل للتعديل". Chat and receipt OCR are processed on the server by an LLM, and transactions are editable.
+- The legal links (privacy, terms) go nowhere (WEB-10 is still open).
+- For a finance app aimed at families, this reads as marketing filler and can backfire with careful buyers.
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- Remove the numbers that cannot be measured yet.
+- Replace them with concrete, true statements: "لا نطلب كلمات مرور البنك", "لا نقرأ رسائلك النصية", "بياناتك على خوادم Supabase بصلاحيات منفصلة لكل منزل", "الفواتير تُحلَّل بالذكاء الاصطناعي على خوادمنا".
+- Publish real privacy and terms pages before launch.
+
+### WEB-UX-04 (Medium). Jargon. Screens: [20](ux_screens/20_web_mobile_ar.png), [21](ux_screens/21_web_desktop_ar.png).
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- "نظام مالي مستقل / SOVEREIGN OS", "الحوكمة المالية الذكية", "الركائز الـ 12", "ARCH // 01" and "أمان على مستوى الصف RLS".
+- These speak to engineers, not to a Saudi family. `translation_qa.md` already flags "سيادي".
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- Use plain benefit language and 4–6 features at most: الراتب، النفقة، الفواتير، الشركاء، الخصوصية.
+- Drop the ARCH codes.
+
+### WEB-UX-05 (Low). Brand naming.
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- "BUDGET Tracker" on the web, "ميزانية وأكثر" in the footer and title, "ميزانية الأسرة" as the app title.
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- One Arabic name and one Latin name, used everywhere.
+
+### WEB-UX-06 (Low). Page weight. Measured with Playwright, first load.
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- About 1.23 MB transferred:
+  - JS 471 KB (144 KB gzip);
+  - CSS 40 KB;
+  - hero PNG 135 KB;
+  - three Google Font families and a Material Symbols subset.
+- Acceptable, but the hero is a PNG photo, and the particle canvas runs on mobile.
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- Serve the hero as WebP or AVIF with `srcset`.
+- Load Inter only on the English page.
+- Drop the canvas below 640 px.
+
+### WEB-UX-07 (Low). Language.
+
+**What's wrong:**
+- Always Arabic on load (`useState('ar')`). The browser language is not detected and the choice is not remembered.
+- There is no Urdu (known: WEB-11).
+
+**Recommendation:**
+- Use `navigator.language` on first visit and persist the choice in `localStorage`.
+
+---
+
+## What works well
+
+- **The family type explanation at creation is clear and Islamically correct:** "الزوج يتكفل بالنفقة، وما تدفعه الزوجة للبيت من مالها يُسجَّل لها مستحقاً على الزوج". The Urdu version is equally clear ([01](ux_screens/01_onboarding_type_ar.png)).
+- **The Nafaqah card shows the right three numbers:** owed, advanced and repaid. The wife-allowance card shows allocated, spent and remaining, with a clear "سداد مستحقات الزوجة" action ([03](ux_screens/03_dashboard_cycle_nafaqah_ar.png)).
+- **Preview before save** for chat and receipts, and the one-line Nafaqah explainers under the cards.
+- **RTL mirroring is correct overall:** chevrons, the send arrow, progress-bar fill direction, sheet layouts.
+- **Dark mode is polished and consistent.**
+- **The offline queue banner is clear:** "3 معاملات مسجلة دون اتصال — مزامنة الآن".
+- **Web:** no horizontal scroll at 390 px; skip link, reduced-motion support and a localized title.
+
+## Accessibility sweep (automated, report only)
+
+The Flutter `meetsGuideline` checks were run with semantics on, in Arabic:
+
+| Screen | 48 dp targets | Labelled targets | Text contrast (lines flagged) |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Dashboard (light) | pass | pass | fail (100) |
+| Dashboard (dark) | pass | pass | fail (60) |
+| Feed | fail (3 chips, 27 dp) | pass | fail (45) |
+| Settings | fail ("+ إضافة عضو", 21 dp) | pass | fail (55) |
+| Chat | fail (3 language pills) | pass | fail (35) |
+| Manual sheet | pass | modal barrier only | fail (25) |
+| Onboarding | pass | pass | fail (15) |
+
+The contrast guideline samples rendered pixels, so the counts are indicative. The token ratios in UX-06 are exact.
+
+## Reproducing
+
+The harness is throwaway and was not committed. To recreate it:
+1. Copy `flutter_app` to a scratch folder.
+2. Add local static font files for Outfit, Inter and JetBrains Mono (OFL, from google/fonts) under a `google_fonts/` asset folder.
+3. Register Noto Naskh Arabic as the fallback family.
+4. Initialise Supabase with a `MockClient` `httpClient` and a no-op realtime `transport`.
+5. Run the screens inside `http.runWithClient`.
+6. Alternate `tester.runAsync` and `pump` so that Supabase's isolate JSON decode completes.
+7. Capture with `RenderRepaintBoundary.toImage(pixelRatio: 2)`.
+
+Run with `--dart-define=FASTAPI_BASE_URL=http://api.fake --dart-define=SUPABASE_URL=http://supabase.fake`. Nothing contacts a live service.

+-- ============================================================================
+-- Rollback snapshot for the 20261020 audit batch
+--   20261020005000_preflight_live_alignment.sql ... 20261020400000_admin_permissions_and_co_admins.sql
+-- Snapshot date: 2026-10-20. Generated from a read-only catalog inventory of the
+-- live project, taken before the batch (definitions and privileges only, no row
+-- data). See docs/review/audit/live_db_preflight.md.
+--
+-- Run ONLY to undo the whole batch, in the SQL editor as `postgres`, after review.
+-- It returns the schema, policies, functions, triggers, grants and bucket settings
+-- to the pre-batch live state. It was verified on the local replica: batch ->
+-- this script -> catalog identical to live -> batch re-applied -> 20/20 DB tests.
+--
+-- What it cannot undo:
+--   * it drops member_allowances, spouse_reimbursements, households.owner_user_id
+--     and transactions.nafaqah_class / nafaqah_spouse_id, so allowances,
+--     reimbursements and Nafaqah classes recorded after the batch are lost
+--     (export them first if any exist);
+--   * the 'sms' -> chat / receipt_scan / manual relabel of transactions.source
+--     stays (label only; the app already displayed those rows that way);
+--   * membership rows backfilled by 20261020020000 stay (0 on live at snapshot time).
+-- To roll back a single later migration instead, re-run the matching sections
+-- by hand (function definitions are grouped in section 5).
+-- ============================================================================
+
+BEGIN;
+
+-- 1. Triggers added or changed by the batch
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS "trg_validate_invite_target_member" ON public.household_invites;
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS "trg_maintain_primary_admin" ON public.household_memberships;
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS "trg_protect_primary_admin" ON public.household_memberships;
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS "trg_bind_transaction_creator" ON public.transactions;
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS "trg_enforce_transaction_write_permission" ON public.transactions;
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS "trg_populate_transaction_cycle_key" ON public.transactions;
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS "trg_validate_transaction_nafaqah_class" ON public.transactions;
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS "trg_handover_households_on_user_delete" ON public.users;
+
+-- 2. Policies added or changed by the batch
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "transfers_select_household" ON public."account_transfers";
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "accounts_delete_admin_or_owner" ON public."accounts";
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "accounts_insert_personal" ON public."accounts";
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "accounts_insert_shared" ON public."accounts";
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "accounts_select" ON public."accounts";
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "accounts_update_personal" ON public."accounts";
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "accounts_update_shared" ON public."accounts";
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "budgets_insert_admin" ON public."budgets";
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "budgets_select_household" ON public."budgets";
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "budgets_update_admin" ON public."budgets";
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "cost_control_codes_insert" ON public."cost_control_codes";
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "cost_control_codes_select" ON public."cost_control_codes";
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "cost_control_codes_update" ON public."cost_control_codes";
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "household_category_settings_all" ON public."household_category_settings";
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "dependents_delete_household" ON public."household_dependents";

+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_household_role_invite(p_invite_code text, p_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+    v_uid uuid;
+    v_clean_code text := upper(trim(p_invite_code));
+    v_invite public.household_invites%ROWTYPE;
+    v_hh public.households%ROWTYPE;
+BEGIN
+    IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND p_user_id IS NOT NULL AND p_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid() THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: cannot claim an invite on behalf of another user' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    v_uid := COALESCE(auth.uid(), p_user_id);
+
+    IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    UPDATE public.household_invites
+    SET used_by = v_uid
+    WHERE upper(trim(invite_code)) = v_clean_code
+      AND used_by IS NULL
+      AND expires_at > now()
+    RETURNING * INTO v_invite;
+
+    IF v_invite.id IS NULL THEN
+        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invalid, expired, or already used invite code');
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT * INTO v_hh FROM public.households WHERE id = v_invite.household_id;
+
+    IF v_invite.target_member_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+        UPDATE public.household_dependents
+        SET claimed_user_id = v_uid
+        WHERE id = v_invite.target_member_id;
+    END IF;
+
+    UPDATE public.users
+    SET household_id = v_hh.id,
+        role = 'member',
+        financial_role = CASE
+            WHEN v_invite.role IN ('provider', 'spouse', 'peer', 'family_member', 'dependent') THEN v_invite.role
+            ELSE financial_role
+        END
+    WHERE id = v_uid;
+
+    INSERT INTO public.household_memberships (household_id, user_id, role, is_default)
+    VALUES (v_hh.id, v_uid, 'member', false)
+    ON CONFLICT (household_id, user_id) 
+    DO UPDATE SET role = COALESCE(public.household_memberships.role, 'member');
+
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+        'success', true,
+        'household_id', v_hh.id,
+        'household_name', v_hh.name,
+        'role', v_invite.role,
+        'target_member_id', v_invite.target_member_id
+    );
+END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_auth_user_household_id()

+$function$;

+ RETURNS text

+$function$;

+DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public."get_user_households"();
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_households()
+ RETURNS TABLE(household_id uuid, household_name text, invite_code text, role text, is_active boolean)
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+    RETURN QUERY
+    SELECT 
+        h.id AS household_id,
+        h.name::text AS household_name,
+        CASE WHEN m.role = 'admin' THEN h.invite_code::text ELSE NULL END AS invite_code,
+        m.role::text,
+        (h.id = u.household_id) AS is_active
+    FROM public.household_memberships m
+    JOIN public.households h ON h.id = m.household_id
+    JOIN public.users u ON u.id = m.user_id
+    WHERE m.user_id = auth.uid()
+    ORDER BY is_active DESC, m.created_at ASC;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.join_household_by_code(p_invite_code text)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+    v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+    v_clean_code text := upper(trim(p_invite_code));
+    v_fail_count int;
+    v_invite public.household_invites%ROWTYPE;
+    v_hh public.households%ROWTYPE;
+    v_claimed_id uuid;
+BEGIN
+    IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Rate limiting check
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_fail_count
+    FROM public.invite_attempt_log
+    WHERE user_id = v_uid 
+      AND success = false 
+      AND attempted_at > (now() - interval '15 minutes');
+
+    IF v_fail_count >= 5 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Too many failed join attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- 1. Check household_invites table
+    SELECT * INTO v_invite
+    FROM public.household_invites
+    WHERE upper(trim(invite_code)) = v_clean_code;
+
+    IF v_invite.id IS NOT NULL THEN
+        IF v_invite.expires_at < now() THEN
+            INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, false);
+            RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invite code has expired');
+        END IF;
+
+        -- Atomic update with RETURNING to prevent race conditions
+        IF v_invite.used_by = v_uid THEN
+            -- Already claimed by the same authenticated caller (idempotent / targeted claim flow)
+            v_claimed_id := v_invite.id;
+        ELSIF v_invite.used_by IS NULL THEN
+            UPDATE public.household_invites
+            SET used_by = v_uid
+            WHERE id = v_invite.id AND used_by IS NULL
+            RETURNING id INTO v_claimed_id;
+
+            IF v_claimed_id IS NULL THEN
+                INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, false);
+                RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invite code has already been used');
+            END IF;
+        ELSE
+            -- Used by another user
+            INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, false);
+            RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invite code has already been used');
+        END IF;
+
+        SELECT * INTO v_hh FROM public.households WHERE id = v_invite.household_id;
+
+        -- Link target member if present
+        IF v_invite.target_member_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+            UPDATE public.household_dependents
+            SET claimed_user_id = v_uid
+            WHERE id = v_invite.target_member_id;
+        END IF;
+
+        UPDATE public.users
+        SET household_id = v_hh.id,
+            role = 'member',
+            financial_role = CASE
+                WHEN v_invite.role IN ('provider', 'spouse', 'peer', 'family_member', 'dependent') THEN v_invite.role
+                ELSE financial_role
+            END
+        WHERE id = v_uid;
+
+        INSERT INTO public.household_memberships (household_id, user_id, role, is_default)
+        VALUES (v_hh.id, v_uid, 'member', false)
+        ON CONFLICT (household_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET role = COALESCE(public.household_memberships.role, 'member');
+
+        INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, true);
+        RETURN to_jsonb(v_hh);
+    END IF;
+
+    -- 2. Fallback to households.invite_code (static master code)
+    SELECT * INTO v_hh
+    FROM public.households
+    WHERE upper(trim(invite_code)) = v_clean_code;
+
+    IF v_hh.id IS NOT NULL THEN
+        UPDATE public.users
+        SET household_id = v_hh.id,
+            role = 'member'
+        WHERE id = v_uid;
+
+        INSERT INTO public.household_memberships (household_id, user_id, role, is_default)
+        VALUES (v_hh.id, v_uid, 'member', false)
+        ON CONFLICT (household_id, user_id) DO NOTHING;
+
+        INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, true);
+        RETURN to_jsonb(v_hh);
+    END IF;
+
+    INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, false);
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invalid invite code');
+END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_income(p_household_id uuid, p_account_id uuid, p_cycle_key text, p_source_type text, p_title text, p_base_amount numeric, p_overtime numeric DEFAULT 0.0, p_bonus numeric DEFAULT 0.0, p_deductions numeric DEFAULT 0.0, p_received_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+    v_caller_uid UUID;
+    v_acc RECORD;
+    v_net_amount NUMERIC;
+    v_income_id UUID;
+    v_received_at TIMESTAMPTZ := COALESCE(p_received_at, now());
+    v_result jsonb;
+BEGIN
+    v_caller_uid := auth.uid();
+    IF v_caller_uid IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Strict NULL-safe membership check
+    IF p_household_id IS NULL OR public.get_auth_user_household_id() IS NULL OR p_household_id IS DISTINCT FROM public.get_auth_user_household_id() THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: caller does not belong to specified household' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    v_net_amount := COALESCE(p_base_amount, 0.0) + COALESCE(p_overtime, 0.0) + COALESCE(p_bonus, 0.0) - COALESCE(p_deductions, 0.0);
+    IF v_net_amount <= 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Net income amount must be positive' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT * INTO v_acc FROM public.accounts WHERE id = p_account_id FOR UPDATE;
+    IF v_acc.id IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Target account not found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_acc.household_id <> p_household_id THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Target account belongs to another household' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_acc.is_shared_pool = false AND v_acc.owner_user_id <> v_caller_uid THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: cannot record income into an account owned by another user' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    UPDATE public.accounts
+    SET balance = balance + v_net_amount,
+        updated_at = now()
+    WHERE id = p_account_id;
+
+    INSERT INTO public.income_records (
+        household_id,
+        user_id,
+        account_id,
+        cycle_key,
+        source_type,
+        title,
+        base_amount,
+        overtime,
+        bonus,
+        deductions,
+        net_amount,
+        received_at,
+        notes,
+        created_at
+    ) VALUES (
+        p_household_id,
+        v_caller_uid,
+        p_account_id,
+        p_cycle_key,
+        p_source_type,
+        p_title,
+        COALESCE(p_base_amount, 0.0),
+        COALESCE(p_overtime, 0.0),
+        COALESCE(p_bonus, 0.0),
+        COALESCE(p_deductions, 0.0),
+        v_net_amount,
+        v_received_at,
+        p_notes,
+        now()
+    ) RETURNING id INTO v_income_id;
+
+    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
+        'id', v_income_id,
+        'household_id', p_household_id,
+        'user_id', v_caller_uid,
+        'account_id', p_account_id,
+        'cycle_key', p_cycle_key,
+        'source_type', p_source_type,
+        'title', p_title,
+        'base_amount', p_base_amount,
+        'overtime', p_overtime,
+        'bonus', p_bonus,
+        'deductions', p_deductions,
+        'net_amount', v_net_amount,
+        'received_at', v_received_at,
+        'notes', p_notes,
+        'created_at', now()
+    ) INTO v_result;
+
+    RETURN v_result;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.remove_member(p_user_id uuid)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+    v_caller_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+    v_caller_hh_id uuid;
+    v_caller_role text;
+    v_target_role text;
+    v_other_admins int;
+    v_other_members int;
+BEGIN
+    IF v_caller_uid IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT household_id, role INTO v_caller_hh_id, v_caller_role
+    FROM public.users
+    WHERE id = v_caller_uid;
+
+    IF v_caller_hh_id IS NULL OR v_caller_role <> 'admin' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: Admin privileges required';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT role INTO v_target_role
+    FROM public.household_memberships
+    WHERE household_id = v_caller_hh_id AND user_id = p_user_id;
+
+    IF v_target_role IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Target user is not a member of this household';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_user_id = v_caller_uid THEN
+        SELECT count(*) INTO v_other_admins
+        FROM public.household_memberships
+        WHERE household_id = v_caller_hh_id AND role = 'admin' AND user_id <> p_user_id;
+
+        SELECT count(*) INTO v_other_members
+        FROM public.household_memberships
+        WHERE household_id = v_caller_hh_id AND user_id <> p_user_id;
+
+        IF v_other_admins = 0 AND v_other_members > 0 THEN
+            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sole admin cannot be removed while other members remain. Promote another member first.';
+        END IF;
+    END IF;
+
+    DELETE FROM public.household_memberships
+    WHERE household_id = v_caller_hh_id AND user_id = p_user_id;
+
+    UPDATE public.users
+    SET household_id = NULL,
+        role = 'member'
+    WHERE id = p_user_id AND household_id = v_caller_hh_id;
+
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+        'success', true,
+        'removed_user_id', p_user_id
+    );
+END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_member_role(p_user_id uuid, p_role text)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+    v_caller_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+    v_caller_hh_id uuid;
+    v_caller_role text;
+    v_target_role text;
+    v_other_admins int;
+BEGIN
+    IF v_caller_uid IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT household_id, role INTO v_caller_hh_id, v_caller_role
+    FROM public.users
+    WHERE id = v_caller_uid;
+
+    IF v_caller_hh_id IS NULL OR v_caller_role <> 'admin' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: Admin privileges required';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_role NOT IN ('admin', 'member') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid role: must be admin or member';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT role INTO v_target_role
+    FROM public.household_memberships
+    WHERE household_id = v_caller_hh_id AND user_id = p_user_id;
+
+    IF v_target_role IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Target user is not a member of this household';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Sole admin demotion protection
+    IF v_target_role = 'admin' AND p_role = 'member' THEN
+        SELECT count(*) INTO v_other_admins
+        FROM public.household_memberships
+        WHERE household_id = v_caller_hh_id AND role = 'admin' AND user_id <> p_user_id;
+
+        IF v_other_admins = 0 THEN
+            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot demote the sole administrator of the household';
+        END IF;
+    END IF;
+
+    UPDATE public.household_memberships
+    SET role = p_role
+    WHERE household_id = v_caller_hh_id AND user_id = p_user_id;
+
+    UPDATE public.users
+    SET role = p_role
+    WHERE id = p_user_id AND household_id = v_caller_hh_id;
+
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+        'success', true,
+        'user_id', p_user_id,
+        'new_role', p_role
+    );
+END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_user_household_membership()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+    IF NEW.household_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+        INSERT INTO public.household_memberships (household_id, user_id, role, is_default)
+        VALUES (
+            NEW.household_id, 
+            NEW.id, 
+            COALESCE(NEW.role, 'member'), 
+            NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships WHERE user_id = NEW.id)
+        )
+        ON CONFLICT (household_id, user_id) 
+        DO UPDATE SET role = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.role, public.household_memberships.role);
+    END IF;
+    RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.transfer_between_accounts(p_household_id uuid, p_from_account_id uuid, p_to_account_id uuid, p_amount numeric, p_fee numeric DEFAULT 0.0, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+    v_caller_uid UUID;
+    v_from_acc RECORD;
+    v_to_acc RECORD;
+    v_total_deduction NUMERIC;
+    v_transfer_id UUID;
+    v_created_at TIMESTAMPTZ := now();
+    v_result jsonb;
+BEGIN
+    v_caller_uid := auth.uid();
+    IF v_caller_uid IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_amount IS NULL OR p_amount <= 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Transfer amount must be positive' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_fee IS NULL OR p_fee < 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Transfer fee cannot be negative' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_from_account_id = p_to_account_id THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot transfer between the same account' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Strict NULL-safe membership check
+    IF p_household_id IS NULL OR public.get_auth_user_household_id() IS NULL OR p_household_id IS DISTINCT FROM public.get_auth_user_household_id() THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: caller does not belong to specified household' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Lock accounts in deterministic UUID order to prevent deadlocks
+    IF p_from_account_id < p_to_account_id THEN
+        SELECT * INTO v_from_acc FROM public.accounts WHERE id = p_from_account_id FOR UPDATE;
+        SELECT * INTO v_to_acc FROM public.accounts WHERE id = p_to_account_id FOR UPDATE;
+    ELSE
+        SELECT * INTO v_to_acc FROM public.accounts WHERE id = p_to_account_id FOR UPDATE;
+        SELECT * INTO v_from_acc FROM public.accounts WHERE id = p_from_account_id FOR UPDATE;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_from_acc.id IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Source account not found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+    END IF;
+    IF v_to_acc.id IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Destination account not found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_from_acc.household_id <> p_household_id OR v_to_acc.household_id <> p_household_id THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Both accounts must belong to the household' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Caller must own source account OR source account is shared pool
+    IF v_from_acc.is_shared_pool = false AND v_from_acc.owner_user_id <> v_caller_uid THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: cannot transfer from an account owned by another user' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    v_total_deduction := p_amount + p_fee;
+    IF v_from_acc.balance < v_total_deduction THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Insufficient funds: balance (%) is less than transfer plus fee (%)', v_from_acc.balance, v_total_deduction USING ERRCODE = '22000';
+    END IF;
+
+    UPDATE public.accounts
+    SET balance = balance - v_total_deduction,
+        updated_at = v_created_at
+    WHERE id = p_from_account_id;
+
+    UPDATE public.accounts
+    SET balance = balance + p_amount,
+        updated_at = v_created_at
+    WHERE id = p_to_account_id;
+
+    INSERT INTO public.account_transfers (
+        household_id,
+        user_id,
+        from_account_id,
+        to_account_id,
+        amount,
+        fee,
+        timestamp,
+        notes,
+        created_at
+    ) VALUES (
+        p_household_id,
+        v_caller_uid,
+        p_from_account_id,
+        p_to_account_id,
+        p_amount,
+        p_fee,
+        v_created_at,
+        p_notes,
+        v_created_at
+    ) RETURNING id INTO v_transfer_id;
+
+    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
+        'id', v_transfer_id,
+        'household_id', p_household_id,
+        'user_id', v_caller_uid,
+        'from_account_id', p_from_account_id,
+        'to_account_id', p_to_account_id,
+        'amount', p_amount,
+        'fee', p_fee,
+        'timestamp', v_created_at,
+        'notes', p_notes,
+        'created_at', v_created_at
+    ) INTO v_result;
+
+    RETURN v_result;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_account_balance_on_transaction()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+    v_acc RECORD;
+    v_caller_uid UUID;
+BEGIN
+    BEGIN
+        v_caller_uid := auth.uid();
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+        v_caller_uid := NULL;
+    END;
+    IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
+        IF NEW.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+            SELECT * INTO v_acc FROM public.accounts WHERE id = NEW.account_id FOR UPDATE;
+            IF v_acc.id IS NULL THEN
+                RAISE EXCEPTION 'Target account % not found', NEW.account_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+            END IF;
+            IF v_acc.household_id <> NEW.household_id THEN
+                RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account % does not belong to transaction household %', NEW.account_id, NEW.household_id USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+            END IF;
+            IF v_caller_uid IS NOT NULL AND v_acc.is_shared_pool = false AND v_acc.owner_user_id <> v_caller_uid THEN
+                RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: cannot debit personal account owned by another user' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+            END IF;
+
+            UPDATE public.accounts
+            SET balance = balance - NEW.amount,
+                updated_at = now()
+            WHERE id = NEW.account_id;
+        END IF;
+        RETURN NEW;
+
+    ELSIF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
+        IF OLD.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+            SELECT * INTO v_acc FROM public.accounts WHERE id = OLD.account_id FOR UPDATE;
+            IF v_acc.id IS NOT NULL THEN
+                IF v_acc.household_id <> OLD.household_id THEN
+                    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account % does not belong to transaction household %', OLD.account_id, OLD.household_id USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+                END IF;
+                IF v_caller_uid IS NOT NULL AND v_acc.is_shared_pool = false AND v_acc.owner_user_id <> v_caller_uid THEN
+                    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: cannot credit personal account owned by another user' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+                END IF;
+
+                UPDATE public.accounts
+                SET balance = balance + OLD.amount,
+                    updated_at = now()
+                WHERE id = OLD.account_id;
+            END IF;
+        END IF;
+        RETURN OLD;
+
+    ELSIF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
+        IF OLD.account_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.account_id OR OLD.amount <> NEW.amount THEN
+            -- Revert old account debit
+            IF OLD.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+                SELECT * INTO v_acc FROM public.accounts WHERE id = OLD.account_id FOR UPDATE;
+                IF v_acc.id IS NOT NULL THEN
+                    IF v_acc.household_id <> OLD.household_id THEN
+                        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account % does not belong to transaction household %', OLD.account_id, OLD.household_id USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+                    END IF;
+                    IF v_caller_uid IS NOT NULL AND v_acc.is_shared_pool = false AND v_acc.owner_user_id <> v_caller_uid THEN
+                        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: cannot credit personal account owned by another user' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+                    END IF;
+
+                    UPDATE public.accounts
+                    SET balance = balance + OLD.amount,
+                        updated_at = now()
+                    WHERE id = OLD.account_id;
+                END IF;
+            END IF;
+
+            -- Apply new account debit
+            IF NEW.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+                SELECT * INTO v_acc FROM public.accounts WHERE id = NEW.account_id FOR UPDATE;
+                IF v_acc.id IS NULL THEN
+                    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Target account % not found', NEW.account_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+                END IF;
+                IF v_acc.household_id <> NEW.household_id THEN
+                    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account % does not belong to transaction household %', NEW.account_id, NEW.household_id USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+                END IF;
+                IF v_caller_uid IS NOT NULL AND v_acc.is_shared_pool = false AND v_acc.owner_user_id <> v_caller_uid THEN
+                    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: cannot debit personal account owned by another user' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+                END IF;
+
+                UPDATE public.accounts
+                SET balance = balance - NEW.amount,
+                    updated_at = now()
+                WHERE id = NEW.account_id;
+            END IF;
+        END IF;
+        RETURN NEW;
+    END IF;
+    RETURN NULL;
+END;
+$function$;
+

+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public."transfer_between_accounts"(p_household_id uuid, p_from_account_id uuid, p_to_account_id uuid, p_amount numeric, p_fee numeric, p_notes text) TO authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public."transfer_between_accounts"(p_household_id uuid, p_from_account_id uuid, p_to_account_id uuid, p_amount numeric, p_fee numeric, p_notes text) TO service_role;

+-- 6. Column defaults, comments, RLS flags
+COMMENT ON COLUMN public."transactions"."raw_sms" IS 'Original SMS text for audit trail.';

+-- 7. Pre-batch policies and triggers
+CREATE POLICY "transfers_select_household" ON public."account_transfers" AS PERMISSIVE FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING ((household_id = get_auth_user_household_id()));
+CREATE POLICY "accounts_delete_admin_or_owner" ON public."accounts" AS PERMISSIVE FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING ((((owner_user_id = auth.uid()) AND (is_shared_pool = false)) OR ((is_shared_pool = true) AND (household_id = get_auth_user_household_id()) AND (get_auth_user_role() = 'admin'::text))));
+CREATE POLICY "accounts_insert_personal" ON public."accounts" AS PERMISSIVE FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (((owner_user_id = auth.uid()) AND (household_id = get_auth_user_household_id()) AND (is_shared_pool = false)));
+CREATE POLICY "accounts_insert_shared" ON public."accounts" AS PERMISSIVE FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (((household_id = get_auth_user_household_id()) AND (is_shared_pool = true) AND (get_auth_user_role() = 'admin'::text)));
+CREATE POLICY "accounts_select" ON public."accounts" AS PERMISSIVE FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (((owner_user_id = auth.uid()) OR ((is_shared_pool = true) AND (household_id = get_auth_user_household_id()))));
+CREATE POLICY "accounts_update_personal" ON public."accounts" AS PERMISSIVE FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (((owner_user_id = auth.uid()) AND (household_id = get_auth_user_household_id()))) WITH CHECK (((owner_user_id = auth.uid()) AND (household_id = get_auth_user_household_id()) AND (is_shared_pool = false)));
+CREATE POLICY "accounts_update_shared" ON public."accounts" AS PERMISSIVE FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (((is_shared_pool = true) AND (household_id = get_auth_user_household_id()) AND (get_auth_user_role() = 'admin'::text))) WITH CHECK (((is_shared_pool = true) AND (household_id = get_auth_user_household_id()) AND (get_auth_user_role() = 'admin'::text)));
+CREATE POLICY "budgets_insert_admin" ON public."budgets" AS PERMISSIVE FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (((household_id = get_auth_user_household_id()) AND (get_auth_user_role() = 'admin'::text)));
+CREATE POLICY "budgets_select_household" ON public."budgets" AS PERMISSIVE FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING ((household_id = get_auth_user_household_id()));
+CREATE POLICY "budgets_update_admin" ON public."budgets" AS PERMISSIVE FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (((household_id = get_auth_user_household_id()) AND (get_auth_user_role() = 'admin'::text))) WITH CHECK (((household_id = get_auth_user_household_id()) AND (get_auth_user_role() = 'admin'::text)));
+CREATE POLICY "cost_control_codes_select" ON public."cost_control_codes" AS PERMISSIVE FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (((household_id IS NULL) OR (household_id IN ( SELECT users.household_id
+   FROM users
+  WHERE (users.id = auth.uid())))));
+CREATE POLICY "household_category_settings_all" ON public."household_category_settings" AS PERMISSIVE FOR ALL TO authenticated USING ((household_id IN ( SELECT users.household_id
+   FROM users
+  WHERE (users.id = auth.uid())))) WITH CHECK ((household_id IN ( SELECT users.household_id
+   FROM users
+  WHERE (users.id = auth.uid()))));
+CREATE POLICY "dependents_delete_household" ON public."household_dependents" AS PERMISSIVE FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING ((household_id IN ( SELECT users.household_id
+   FROM users
+  WHERE (users.id = auth.uid()))));
+CREATE POLICY "dependents_insert_household" ON public."household_dependents" AS PERMISSIVE FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK ((household_id IN ( SELECT users.household_id
+   FROM users
+  WHERE (users.id = auth.uid()))));
+CREATE POLICY "dependents_select_household" ON public."household_dependents" AS PERMISSIVE FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING ((household_id IN ( SELECT users.household_id
+   FROM users
+  WHERE (users.id = auth.uid()))));

+   FROM users
+  WHERE (users.id = auth.uid())))) WITH CHECK ((household_id IN ( SELECT users.household_id
+   FROM users
+  WHERE (users.id = auth.uid()))));
+CREATE POLICY "invites_delete_admin" ON public."household_invites" AS PERMISSIVE FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING (((household_id = get_auth_user_household_id()) AND (get_auth_user_role() = 'admin'::text)));
+CREATE POLICY "invites_insert_household" ON public."household_invites" AS PERMISSIVE FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (((household_id = get_auth_user_household_id()) AND (get_auth_user_role() = 'admin'::text)));
+CREATE POLICY "invites_select_household" ON public."household_invites" AS PERMISSIVE FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING ((household_id = get_auth_user_household_id()));

+   FROM users
+  WHERE (users.id = auth.uid())))) WITH CHECK ((household_id IN ( SELECT users.household_id
+   FROM users
+  WHERE (users.id = auth.uid()))));
