diff --git a/docs/review/rollback/20261020_round3_rollback_snapshot.sql b/docs/review/rollback/20261020_round3_rollback_snapshot.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..55ba07b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/review/rollback/20261020_round3_rollback_snapshot.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,873 @@
+-- ============================================================================
+-- Rollback snapshot for 20261020900000_household_type_and_round2_fixes.sql
+-- Snapshot date: 2026-10-21. Generated from catalog inventories of a local
+-- database rebuilt from the repository up to 20261020800000 (the state live will
+-- have once 20261020700000 / 750000 / 800000 are applied) and the same database
+-- after 20261020900000; definitions and privileges only, no row data.
+--
+-- Run ONLY to undo 20261020900000, in the SQL editor as `postgres`, after review.
+-- It drops the household_type column and the new functions/trigger, restores the
+-- 20261020800000 definitions (claim / join / create RPCs, provider rules, ledger
+-- guard, budget triggers, pay_installment_plan, ...), the households provider
+-- trigger, the installment_plans UPDATE grant, and removes the paid_installments
+-- CHECK. Verified locally: 900000 -> this script -> catalog identical to the
+-- pre-900000 state -> 900000 re-applied -> DB suite green (also on a database
+-- the test suite had already run on).
+--
+-- What it cannot undo / data impact:
+--   * households.household_type is dropped: the chosen types are lost (export
+--     them first if admins have used set_household_type);
+--   * membership financial roles changed by set_household_type /
+--     set_member_financial_role stay as they are (valid 800000 values);
+--   * D3 removals are permanent: wife ledgers (spouse_reimbursements,
+--     member_allowances) deleted when a wife's membership ended, and the
+--     classification cleared on her expenses, are not recreated;
+--   * a provider left NULL after owner succession stays NULL (an admin can set it).
+-- To undo the round-2 files as well, run this first, then
+-- 20261020_round2_rollback_snapshot.sql.
+-- ============================================================================
+
+BEGIN;
+
+-- 0. Refuse to run unless 20261020900000 is applied
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
+                   WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'households'
+                     AND column_name = 'household_type') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'rollback: 20261020900000 does not look applied (households.household_type missing); nothing to undo';
+    END IF;
+END $$;
+
+-- 1. Triggers added or changed by the batch
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS "trg_remove_nafaqah_ledger_on_membership_end" ON public.household_memberships;
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS "trg_households_nafaqah_provider" ON public.households;
+
+-- 2. Policies added or changed by the batch
+
+-- 3. Constraints and indexes added by the batch
+ALTER TABLE public."households" DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS "households_household_type_check";
+ALTER TABLE public."installment_plans" DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS "installment_plans_paid_installments_range";
+
+-- 4. Tables and columns added by the batch (drops only data created after the batch)
+ALTER TABLE public."households" DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS "household_type";
+
+-- 5. Functions: drop the ones the batch added, restore the pre-batch definitions
+DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public."create_household_and_claim"(p_name text, p_household_type text);
+DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public."household_financial_role_allowed"(p_household_type text, p_financial_role text);
+DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public."remove_nafaqah_ledger_on_membership_end"();
+DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public."set_household_type"(p_household_id uuid, p_household_type text, p_actor_user_id uuid);
+DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public."set_member_financial_role"(p_household_id uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_financial_role text, p_actor_user_id uuid);
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_household_role_invite(p_invite_code text, p_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+    v_uid uuid;
+    v_clean_code text := upper(trim(p_invite_code));
+    v_fail_count int;
+    v_invite public.household_invites%ROWTYPE;
+    v_hh public.households%ROWTYPE;
+    v_role text;
+    v_financial_role text;
+    v_is_default boolean;
+BEGIN
+    IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND p_user_id IS NOT NULL AND p_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid() THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: cannot claim an invite on behalf of another user' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    v_uid := COALESCE(auth.uid(), p_user_id);
+
+    IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_fail_count
+    FROM public.invite_attempt_log
+    WHERE user_id = v_uid
+      AND success = false
+      AND attempted_at > (now() - interval '15 minutes');
+
+    IF v_fail_count >= 5 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Too many failed join attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT * INTO v_invite
+    FROM public.household_invites
+    WHERE upper(trim(invite_code)) = v_clean_code
+      AND expires_at > now()
+    FOR UPDATE;
+
+    IF v_invite.id IS NULL OR (v_invite.used_by IS NOT NULL AND v_invite.used_by IS DISTINCT FROM v_uid) THEN
+        INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, false);
+        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invalid, expired, or already used invite code');
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT * INTO v_hh FROM public.households WHERE id = v_invite.household_id;
+
+    SELECT role, financial_role INTO v_role, v_financial_role
+    FROM public.household_memberships
+    WHERE household_id = v_invite.household_id AND user_id = v_uid;
+
+    IF v_role IS NOT NULL THEN
+        IF v_invite.used_by IS DISTINCT FROM v_uid THEN
+            -- FABLE-DB-01: a member cannot take the spouse/provider invite meant for
+            -- someone else; the invite stays open for the real invitee.
+            RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'You are already a member of this household',
+                                      'code', 'already_member');
+        END IF;
+        -- Idempotent retry by the claimer: nothing changes.
+        RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+            'success', true,
+            'household_id', v_hh.id,
+            'household_name', v_hh.name,
+            'role', v_financial_role,
+            'target_member_id', v_invite.target_member_id
+        );
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_invite.used_by IS NOT NULL THEN
+        -- Used by this user, who has since left: same answer as any used invite.
+        INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, false);
+        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invalid, expired, or already used invite code');
+    END IF;
+
+    UPDATE public.household_invites SET used_by = v_uid WHERE id = v_invite.id;
+
+    IF v_invite.target_member_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+        UPDATE public.household_dependents
+        SET linked_user_id = v_uid
+        WHERE id = v_invite.target_member_id
+          AND household_id = v_invite.household_id;
+    END IF;
+
+    v_is_default := NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships WHERE user_id = v_uid);
+    INSERT INTO public.household_memberships (household_id, user_id, role, is_default, financial_role)
+    VALUES (
+        v_hh.id, v_uid, 'member', v_is_default,
+        CASE WHEN v_invite.role IN ('provider', 'spouse', 'peer', 'family_member', 'dependent')
+             THEN v_invite.role
+             ELSE public.household_default_financial_role(v_hh.id, v_uid) END
+    )
+    ON CONFLICT (household_id, user_id) DO NOTHING;
+
+    SELECT role, financial_role INTO v_role, v_financial_role
+    FROM public.household_memberships
+    WHERE household_id = v_hh.id AND user_id = v_uid;
+
+    UPDATE public.users
+    SET household_id = v_hh.id, role = v_role, financial_role = v_financial_role
+    WHERE id = v_uid;
+
+    INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, true);
+
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+        'success', true,
+        'household_id', v_hh.id,
+        'household_name', v_hh.name,
+        'role', v_financial_role,
+        'target_member_id', v_invite.target_member_id
+    );
+END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_household_and_claim(p_name text)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+    v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+    v_hh public.households%ROWTYPE;
+    v_count int;
+    v_invite_code text;
+BEGIN
+    IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_count
+    FROM public.household_memberships
+    WHERE user_id = v_uid AND role = 'admin';
+
+    IF v_count >= 5 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Household creation limit reached (maximum 5 households per user)';
+    END IF;
+
+    v_invite_code := upper(encode(extensions.gen_random_bytes(8), 'hex'));
+
+    INSERT INTO public.households (name, invite_code)
+    VALUES (trim(p_name), v_invite_code)
+    RETURNING * INTO v_hh;
+
+    -- Membership first: it makes the creator the primary admin, which makes
+    -- them the default Nafaqah provider.
+    INSERT INTO public.household_memberships (household_id, user_id, role, is_default, financial_role)
+    VALUES (v_hh.id, v_uid, 'admin', true, 'provider')
+    ON CONFLICT (household_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET role = 'admin';
+
+    UPDATE public.users
+    SET household_id = v_hh.id,
+        role = 'admin',
+        financial_role = 'provider'
+    WHERE id = v_uid;
+
+    SELECT * INTO v_hh FROM public.households WHERE id = v_hh.id;
+    RETURN to_jsonb(v_hh);
+END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_wife_reimbursable_ledger()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+    v_kept numeric(14, 2) := 0;
+    v_advanced numeric(14, 2);
+    v_repaid numeric(14, 2);
+    v_after numeric(14, 2);
+BEGIN
+    IF pg_trigger_depth() > 1 THEN
+        RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
+    END IF;
+    IF OLD.nafaqah_class IS DISTINCT FROM 'wife_reimbursable' OR OLD.nafaqah_spouse_id IS NULL THEN
+        RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
+    END IF;
+
+    IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE'
+       AND NEW.nafaqah_class IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'wife_reimbursable'
+       AND NEW.nafaqah_spouse_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.nafaqah_spouse_id
+       AND NEW.household_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.household_id THEN
+        v_kept := COALESCE(NEW.amount, 0);
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_kept >= COALESCE(OLD.amount, 0) THEN
+        RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);  -- the advance does not shrink
+    END IF;
+
+    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(
+        'spouse_reimbursement:' || OLD.household_id::text || ':' || OLD.nafaqah_spouse_id::text, 0));
+
+    SELECT COALESCE(sum(t.amount), 0) INTO v_advanced
+    FROM public.transactions t
+    WHERE t.household_id = OLD.household_id
+      AND t.nafaqah_spouse_id = OLD.nafaqah_spouse_id
+      AND t.nafaqah_class = 'wife_reimbursable';
+
+    SELECT COALESCE(sum(r.amount), 0) INTO v_repaid
+    FROM public.spouse_reimbursements r
+    WHERE r.household_id = OLD.household_id AND r.wife_user_id = OLD.nafaqah_spouse_id;
+
+    v_after := v_advanced - COALESCE(OLD.amount, 0) + v_kept;
+    IF v_after < v_repaid THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'This change would leave the wife''s reimbursement ledger overpaid: % SAR already repaid, only % SAR of advances would remain', v_repaid, v_after
+            USING ERRCODE = '22023',
+                  HINT = 'ledger_would_be_overpaid',
+                  DETAIL = format('repaid=%s advances_after=%s', v_repaid, v_after);
+    END IF;
+
+    RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
+END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.household_default_financial_role(p_household_id uuid, p_user_id uuid)
+ RETURNS text
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+    SELECT CASE
+        WHEN (SELECT h.owner_user_id FROM public.households h WHERE h.id = p_household_id) = p_user_id
+             OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships o
+                            WHERE o.household_id = p_household_id AND o.user_id <> p_user_id)
+            THEN 'provider'
+        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships o
+                     WHERE o.household_id = p_household_id AND o.user_id <> p_user_id AND o.financial_role = 'spouse')
+            THEN 'family_member'
+        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships o
+                     WHERE o.household_id = p_household_id AND o.user_id <> p_user_id AND o.financial_role = 'peer')
+            THEN 'peer'
+        ELSE 'family_member'
+    END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.households_nafaqah_provider_rules()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+    v_role text;
+BEGIN
+    IF NEW.nafaqah_provider_user_id IS NULL
+       AND NEW.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
+       AND (TG_OP = 'INSERT' OR OLD.owner_user_id IS NULL) THEN
+        v_role := public.household_member_financial_role(NEW.id, NEW.owner_user_id);
+        IF v_role IS NOT NULL AND v_role <> 'spouse' THEN
+            NEW.nafaqah_provider_user_id := NEW.owner_user_id;
+        END IF;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF NEW.nafaqah_provider_user_id IS NOT NULL
+       AND (TG_OP = 'INSERT' OR NEW.nafaqah_provider_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.nafaqah_provider_user_id) THEN
+        v_role := public.household_member_financial_role(NEW.id, NEW.nafaqah_provider_user_id);
+        IF v_role IS NULL THEN
+            RAISE EXCEPTION 'The Nafaqah provider must be a member of the household'
+                USING ERRCODE = '23514', HINT = 'provider_not_member';
+        END IF;
+        IF v_role = 'spouse' THEN
+            RAISE EXCEPTION 'A spouse member cannot be the Nafaqah provider'
+                USING ERRCODE = '23514', HINT = 'provider_is_spouse';
+        END IF;
+    END IF;
+    RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.join_household_by_code(p_invite_code text)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+    v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+    v_clean_code text := upper(trim(p_invite_code));
+    v_fail_count int;
+    v_invite public.household_invites%ROWTYPE;
+    v_hh public.households%ROWTYPE;
+    v_claimed_id uuid;
+    v_role text;
+    v_financial_role text;
+    v_is_default boolean;
+BEGIN
+    IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_fail_count
+    FROM public.invite_attempt_log
+    WHERE user_id = v_uid
+      AND success = false
+      AND attempted_at > (now() - interval '15 minutes');
+
+    IF v_fail_count >= 5 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Too many failed join attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT * INTO v_invite
+    FROM public.household_invites
+    WHERE upper(trim(invite_code)) = v_clean_code
+    FOR UPDATE;
+
+    IF v_invite.id IS NOT NULL THEN
+        IF v_invite.expires_at < now() THEN
+            INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, false);
+            RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invite code has expired');
+        END IF;
+
+        SELECT role, financial_role INTO v_role, v_financial_role
+        FROM public.household_memberships
+        WHERE household_id = v_invite.household_id AND user_id = v_uid;
+
+        IF v_role IS NOT NULL THEN
+            IF v_invite.used_by IS DISTINCT FROM v_uid THEN
+                -- An existing member never consumes an invite meant for someone else
+                -- (and never re-roles themselves through it).
+                RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'You are already a member of this household',
+                                          'code', 'already_member');
+            END IF;
+            -- Retry by the claimer: switch to the household, nothing else changes.
+            SELECT * INTO v_hh FROM public.households WHERE id = v_invite.household_id;
+            UPDATE public.users
+            SET household_id = v_hh.id, role = v_role, financial_role = v_financial_role
+            WHERE id = v_uid;
+            INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, true);
+            RETURN to_jsonb(v_hh);
+        END IF;
+
+        IF v_invite.used_by = v_uid THEN
+            v_claimed_id := v_invite.id;  -- re-joining with the invite this user claimed earlier
+        ELSIF v_invite.used_by IS NULL THEN
+            UPDATE public.household_invites
+            SET used_by = v_uid
+            WHERE id = v_invite.id AND used_by IS NULL
+            RETURNING id INTO v_claimed_id;
+
+            IF v_claimed_id IS NULL THEN
+                INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, false);
+                RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invite code has already been used');
+            END IF;
+        ELSE
+            INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, false);
+            RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invite code has already been used');
+        END IF;
+
+        SELECT * INTO v_hh FROM public.households WHERE id = v_invite.household_id;
+
+        IF v_invite.target_member_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+            UPDATE public.household_dependents
+            SET linked_user_id = v_uid
+            WHERE id = v_invite.target_member_id
+              AND household_id = v_invite.household_id;
+        END IF;
+
+        v_is_default := NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships WHERE user_id = v_uid);
+        INSERT INTO public.household_memberships (household_id, user_id, role, is_default, financial_role)
+        VALUES (
+            v_hh.id, v_uid, 'member', v_is_default,
+            CASE WHEN v_invite.role IN ('provider', 'spouse', 'peer', 'family_member', 'dependent')
+                 THEN v_invite.role
+                 ELSE public.household_default_financial_role(v_hh.id, v_uid) END
+        )
+        ON CONFLICT (household_id, user_id) DO NOTHING;
+
+        SELECT role, financial_role INTO v_role, v_financial_role
+        FROM public.household_memberships
+        WHERE household_id = v_hh.id AND user_id = v_uid;
+
+        UPDATE public.users
+        SET household_id = v_hh.id, role = v_role, financial_role = v_financial_role
+        WHERE id = v_uid;
+
+        INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, true);
+        RETURN to_jsonb(v_hh);
+    END IF;
+
+    -- The household's permanent join code.
+    SELECT * INTO v_hh
+    FROM public.households
+    WHERE upper(trim(invite_code)) = v_clean_code;
+
+    IF v_hh.id IS NOT NULL THEN
+        v_is_default := NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships WHERE user_id = v_uid);
+        INSERT INTO public.household_memberships (household_id, user_id, role, is_default, financial_role)
+        VALUES (v_hh.id, v_uid, 'member', v_is_default, public.household_default_financial_role(v_hh.id, v_uid))
+        ON CONFLICT (household_id, user_id) DO NOTHING;
+
+        -- Existing members keep their role and financial role (never demoted).
+        SELECT role, financial_role INTO v_role, v_financial_role
+        FROM public.household_memberships
+        WHERE household_id = v_hh.id AND user_id = v_uid;
+
+        UPDATE public.users
+        SET household_id = v_hh.id, role = v_role, financial_role = v_financial_role
+        WHERE id = v_uid;
+
+        INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, true);
+        RETURN to_jsonb(v_hh);
+    END IF;
+
+    INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, false);
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invalid invite code');
+END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.maintain_household_primary_admin()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+    IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
+        UPDATE public.households h
+        SET owner_user_id = (
+            SELECT m.user_id
+            FROM public.household_memberships m
+            WHERE m.household_id = OLD.household_id
+              AND m.user_id <> OLD.user_id
+              AND m.role = 'admin'
+            ORDER BY m.created_at ASC, m.user_id ASC
+            LIMIT 1
+        )
+        WHERE h.id = OLD.household_id
+          AND (h.owner_user_id IS NULL OR h.owner_user_id = OLD.user_id);
+        RETURN OLD;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF NEW.role = 'admin' THEN
+        UPDATE public.households
+        SET owner_user_id = NEW.user_id
+        WHERE id = NEW.household_id AND owner_user_id IS NULL;
+    END IF;
+    RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.membership_financial_role_rules()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+    IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' AND NEW.financial_role IS NULL THEN
+        NEW.financial_role := public.household_default_financial_role(NEW.household_id, NEW.user_id);
+    END IF;
+    IF NEW.financial_role = 'spouse'
+       AND (TG_OP = 'INSERT' OR OLD.financial_role IS DISTINCT FROM 'spouse')
+       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.households h
+                   WHERE h.id = NEW.household_id AND h.nafaqah_provider_user_id = NEW.user_id) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'The Nafaqah provider of a household cannot be a spouse member'
+            USING ERRCODE = '23514', HINT = 'provider_is_spouse';
+    END IF;
+    RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nafaqah_husband_id(p_household_id uuid)
+ RETURNS uuid
+ LANGUAGE sql
+ STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+    SELECT h.nafaqah_provider_user_id
+    FROM public.households h
+    WHERE h.id = p_household_id
+      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships sm
+                  WHERE sm.household_id = h.id AND sm.financial_role = 'spouse')
+      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships pm
+                  WHERE pm.household_id = h.id
+                    AND pm.user_id = h.nafaqah_provider_user_id
+                    AND pm.financial_role <> 'spouse');
+$function$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pay_installment_plan(p_plan_id uuid, p_household_id uuid, p_actor_user_id uuid)
+ RETURNS SETOF installment_plans
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+    v_row public.installment_plans;
+BEGIN
+    IF p_plan_id IS NULL OR p_household_id IS NULL OR p_actor_user_id IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'plan, household and actor are required' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF NOT EXISTS (
+        SELECT 1
+        FROM public.household_memberships m
+        WHERE m.household_id = p_household_id
+          AND m.user_id = p_actor_user_id
+    ) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only a member of the household can record an installment payment'
+            USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    UPDATE public.installment_plans AS p
+       SET paid_installments = p.paid_installments + 1,
+           status = CASE WHEN p.paid_installments + 1 >= p.installment_count THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE p.status END
+     WHERE p.id = p_plan_id
+       AND p.household_id = p_household_id
+       AND p.paid_installments < p.installment_count
+    RETURNING p.* INTO v_row;
+
+    IF FOUND THEN
+        RETURN NEXT v_row;
+        RETURN;
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Already paid up (or not in this household): the current row, unchanged, if any.
+    RETURN QUERY
+        SELECT p.*
+        FROM public.installment_plans AS p
+        WHERE p.id = p_plan_id
+          AND p.household_id = p_household_id;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_nafaqah_provider(p_household_id uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_actor_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+    v_actor uuid := public.household_resolve_actor(p_actor_user_id);
+    v_previous uuid;
+    v_role text;
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM public.household_require_admin(p_household_id, v_actor);
+
+    SELECT nafaqah_provider_user_id INTO v_previous
+    FROM public.households
+    WHERE id = p_household_id
+    FOR UPDATE;
+
+    IF p_user_id IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Choose a member of this household as the Nafaqah provider' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    v_role := public.household_member_financial_role(p_household_id, p_user_id);
+    IF v_role IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Target user is not a member of this household' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+    END IF;
+    IF v_role = 'spouse' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'A spouse member cannot be the Nafaqah provider'
+            USING ERRCODE = '22023', HINT = 'provider_is_spouse';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_previous IS DISTINCT FROM p_user_id THEN
+        UPDATE public.households SET nafaqah_provider_user_id = p_user_id WHERE id = p_household_id;
+    END IF;
+
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+        'success', true,
+        'household_id', p_household_id,
+        'nafaqah_provider_user_id', p_user_id,
+        'previous_provider_user_id', v_previous
+    );
+END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.transfer_primary_admin(p_household_id uuid, p_new_primary_user_id uuid, p_actor_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
+ RETURNS jsonb
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+    v_actor uuid := public.household_resolve_actor(p_actor_user_id);
+    v_owner uuid;
+    v_target_role text;
+    v_provider uuid;
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM public.household_require_admin(p_household_id, v_actor);
+
+    SELECT owner_user_id INTO v_owner
+    FROM public.households
+    WHERE id = p_household_id
+    FOR UPDATE;
+
+    IF v_owner IS DISTINCT FROM v_actor THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: only the primary admin can transfer primary admin' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_new_primary_user_id IS NULL OR p_new_primary_user_id = v_actor THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Choose another member of this household' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    v_target_role := public.household_member_role(p_household_id, p_new_primary_user_id);
+    IF v_target_role IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Target user is not a member of this household' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_target_role <> 'admin' THEN
+        PERFORM public.household_apply_role(p_household_id, p_new_primary_user_id, 'admin');
+    END IF;
+
+    UPDATE public.households
+    SET owner_user_id = p_new_primary_user_id,
+        nafaqah_provider_user_id = COALESCE(
+            nafaqah_provider_user_id,
+            CASE WHEN public.household_member_financial_role(p_household_id, p_new_primary_user_id) <> 'spouse'
+                 THEN p_new_primary_user_id END
+        )
+    WHERE id = p_household_id
+    RETURNING nafaqah_provider_user_id INTO v_provider;
+
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+        'success', true,
+        'household_id', p_household_id,
+        'primary_admin_user_id', p_new_primary_user_id,
+        'previous_primary_admin_user_id', v_actor,
+        'nafaqah_provider_user_id', v_provider
+    );
+END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_budget_on_transaction()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+    IF NEW.nafaqah_class IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'wife_personal' THEN
+        RETURN NEW;  -- charged to the wife's allowance only
+    END IF;
+
+    UPDATE public.budgets
+    SET spent_amount = spent_amount + NEW.amount
+    WHERE household_id  = NEW.household_id
+      AND category_code = NEW.category_code
+      AND (
+          (NEW.cycle_key IS NOT NULL AND cycle_key = NEW.cycle_key)
+          OR (NEW.cycle_key IS NULL AND month = date_trunc('month', NEW.timestamp)::DATE)
+      );
+
+    RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_budget_on_transaction_delete()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+    IF OLD.nafaqah_class IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'wife_personal' THEN
+        RETURN OLD;
+    END IF;
+
+    UPDATE public.budgets
+    SET spent_amount = GREATEST(0, spent_amount - OLD.amount)
+    WHERE household_id  = OLD.household_id
+      AND category_code = OLD.category_code
+      AND (
+          (OLD.cycle_key IS NOT NULL AND cycle_key = OLD.cycle_key)
+          OR (OLD.cycle_key IS NULL AND month = date_trunc('month', OLD.timestamp)::DATE)
+      );
+
+    RETURN OLD;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_budget_on_transaction_update()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+DECLARE
+    v_old_counted boolean := OLD.nafaqah_class IS DISTINCT FROM 'wife_personal';
+    v_new_counted boolean := NEW.nafaqah_class IS DISTINCT FROM 'wife_personal';
+BEGIN
+    IF OLD.amount <> NEW.amount
+       OR OLD.category_code IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.category_code
+       OR OLD.cycle_key IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.cycle_key
+       OR date_trunc('month', OLD.timestamp) IS DISTINCT FROM date_trunc('month', NEW.timestamp)
+       OR v_old_counted IS DISTINCT FROM v_new_counted THEN
+
+        IF v_old_counted THEN
+            UPDATE public.budgets
+            SET spent_amount = GREATEST(0, spent_amount - OLD.amount)
+            WHERE household_id  = OLD.household_id
+              AND category_code = OLD.category_code
+              AND (
+                  (OLD.cycle_key IS NOT NULL AND cycle_key = OLD.cycle_key)
+                  OR (OLD.cycle_key IS NULL AND month = date_trunc('month', OLD.timestamp)::DATE)
+              );
+        END IF;
+
+        IF v_new_counted THEN
+            UPDATE public.budgets
+            SET spent_amount = spent_amount + NEW.amount
+            WHERE household_id  = NEW.household_id
+              AND category_code = NEW.category_code
+              AND (
+                  (NEW.cycle_key IS NOT NULL AND cycle_key = NEW.cycle_key)
+                  OR (NEW.cycle_key IS NULL AND month = date_trunc('month', NEW.timestamp)::DATE)
+              );
+        END IF;
+    END IF;
+    RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_transaction_nafaqah_class()
+ RETURNS trigger
+ LANGUAGE plpgsql
+ SECURITY DEFINER
+ SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
+AS $function$
+BEGIN
+    -- ON DELETE SET NULL of the spouse's account: keep the expense, drop the class.
+    IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND NEW.nafaqah_spouse_id IS NULL AND OLD.nafaqah_spouse_id IS NOT NULL
+       AND NEW.nafaqah_class IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.nafaqah_class THEN
+        NEW.nafaqah_class := NULL;
+        RETURN NEW;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF NEW.nafaqah_class IS NULL AND NEW.nafaqah_spouse_id IS NULL THEN
+        RETURN NEW;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF NEW.nafaqah_class IS NULL OR NEW.nafaqah_spouse_id IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'nafaqah_class and nafaqah_spouse_id must be set together'
+            USING ERRCODE = '23514';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- An unchanged classification stays editable (e.g. after the provider left).
+    IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE'
+       AND NEW.nafaqah_class IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.nafaqah_class
+       AND NEW.nafaqah_spouse_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.nafaqah_spouse_id
+       AND NEW.household_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.household_id THEN
+        RETURN NEW;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF NOT public.nafaqah_is_spouse_member(NEW.household_id, NEW.nafaqah_spouse_id) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'nafaqah_spouse_id % is not a spouse member of household %', NEW.nafaqah_spouse_id, NEW.household_id
+            USING ERRCODE = '23503';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF public.nafaqah_husband_id(NEW.household_id) IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Household % has no Nafaqah provider: a household admin must choose one before family expenses are classified', NEW.household_id
+            USING ERRCODE = '23514', HINT = 'no_nafaqah_provider';
+    END IF;
+
+    RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$function$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public."claim_household_role_invite"(p_invite_code text, p_user_id uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public."claim_household_role_invite"(p_invite_code text, p_user_id uuid) TO authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public."claim_household_role_invite"(p_invite_code text, p_user_id uuid) TO service_role;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public."create_household_and_claim"(p_name text) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public."create_household_and_claim"(p_name text) TO authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public."create_household_and_claim"(p_name text) TO service_role;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public."guard_wife_reimbursable_ledger"() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public."guard_wife_reimbursable_ledger"() TO service_role;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public."household_default_financial_role"(p_household_id uuid, p_user_id uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public."household_default_financial_role"(p_household_id uuid, p_user_id uuid) TO service_role;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public."households_nafaqah_provider_rules"() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public."households_nafaqah_provider_rules"() TO service_role;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public."join_household_by_code"(p_invite_code text) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public."join_household_by_code"(p_invite_code text) TO authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public."join_household_by_code"(p_invite_code text) TO service_role;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public."maintain_household_primary_admin"() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public."maintain_household_primary_admin"() TO service_role;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public."membership_financial_role_rules"() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public."membership_financial_role_rules"() TO service_role;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public."nafaqah_husband_id"(p_household_id uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public."nafaqah_husband_id"(p_household_id uuid) TO service_role;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public."pay_installment_plan"(p_plan_id uuid, p_household_id uuid, p_actor_user_id uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public."pay_installment_plan"(p_plan_id uuid, p_household_id uuid, p_actor_user_id uuid) TO service_role;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public."set_nafaqah_provider"(p_household_id uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_actor_user_id uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public."set_nafaqah_provider"(p_household_id uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_actor_user_id uuid) TO authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public."set_nafaqah_provider"(p_household_id uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_actor_user_id uuid) TO service_role;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public."transfer_primary_admin"(p_household_id uuid, p_new_primary_user_id uuid, p_actor_user_id uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public."transfer_primary_admin"(p_household_id uuid, p_new_primary_user_id uuid, p_actor_user_id uuid) TO authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public."transfer_primary_admin"(p_household_id uuid, p_new_primary_user_id uuid, p_actor_user_id uuid) TO service_role;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public."update_budget_on_transaction"() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public."update_budget_on_transaction"() TO service_role;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public."update_budget_on_transaction_delete"() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public."update_budget_on_transaction_delete"() TO service_role;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public."update_budget_on_transaction_update"() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public."update_budget_on_transaction_update"() TO service_role;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public."validate_transaction_nafaqah_class"() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public."validate_transaction_nafaqah_class"() TO service_role;
+
+-- 6. Column defaults, comments, RLS flags
+
+-- 7. Pre-batch policies and triggers
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_households_nafaqah_provider BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF owner_user_id, nafaqah_provider_user_id ON public.households FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION households_nafaqah_provider_rules();
+
+-- 8. Table and column privileges (installment_plans: back to the table-level UPDATE grant;
+--    only authenticated changed, so service_role / anon privileges, PG17 MAINTAIN included,
+--    are left exactly as they are)
+REVOKE UPDATE (category_code, day_of_month, installment_count, merchant, monthly_amount, notes,
+               original_transaction_id, provider, start_date, total_amount)
+    ON public."installment_plans" FROM authenticated;
+GRANT UPDATE ON public."installment_plans" TO authenticated;
+
+COMMIT;
diff --git a/docs/review/rollback/20261021_taxonomy_bnpl_rollback.sql b/docs/review/rollback/20261021_taxonomy_bnpl_rollback.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..dd3abf4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/review/rollback/20261021_taxonomy_bnpl_rollback.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,174 @@
+-- ============================================================================
+-- Rollback snapshot for 20261021000000_saudi_taxonomy_and_bnpl_schedule.sql
+-- Snapshot date: 2026-10-21. Written against a local database rebuilt from the
+-- repository up to 20261020900000 (the state live has once 700000 / 750000 /
+-- 800000 / 900000 are applied) and the same database after 20261021000000.
+--
+-- Run ONLY to undo 20261021000000, in the SQL editor as `postgres`, after review.
+-- It restores the 20261020900000 pay_installment_plan, drops the schedule
+-- trigger, its two functions, the next-due index, the frequency CHECK and the
+-- installment_plans.frequency / next_due_at columns, and deletes the 23 system
+-- sub-categories and 8 system categories the migration added.
+-- Verified locally: 20261021000000 -> this script -> schema and data identical
+-- to the pre-migration database (pg_dump diff) -> 20261021000000 re-applied ->
+-- DB suite green. It refuses to run twice, before the migration, or while any
+-- household data uses the new categories.
+--
+-- What it cannot undo / data impact:
+--   * installment_plans.frequency and next_due_at are dropped: bi-weekly plans
+--     lose their frequency (export `SELECT id, frequency FROM installment_plans
+--     WHERE frequency <> 'monthly'` first if needed). Payments recorded meanwhile
+--     stay recorded (paid_installments / status are not touched).
+--   * The new categories are removed only when nothing references them
+--     (transactions, budgets, household settings, installment plans); otherwise
+--     the script aborts and lists the counts: move those rows to another
+--     category first, or keep the taxonomy and roll back nothing.
+-- ============================================================================
+
+BEGIN;
+
+-- 0. Guards
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_codes text[] := ARRAY['OPEX-HOUSING', 'OPEX-EDUCATION', 'OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP', 'OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT',
+                            'OPEX-CHARITY', 'OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'OPEX-INSURANCE', 'OPEX-REMITTANCE'];
+    v_tx int;
+    v_budgets int;
+    v_settings int;
+    v_plans int;
+    v_custom int;
+BEGIN
+    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
+                   WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'installment_plans'
+                     AND column_name = 'frequency') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'rollback: 20261021000000 does not look applied (installment_plans.frequency missing); nothing to undo';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_tx FROM public.transactions WHERE category_code = ANY (v_codes);
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_budgets FROM public.budgets WHERE category_code = ANY (v_codes);
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_settings FROM public.household_category_settings WHERE category_code = ANY (v_codes);
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_plans FROM public.installment_plans WHERE category_code = ANY (v_codes);
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_custom FROM public.cost_control_codes
+    WHERE household_id IS NOT NULL AND code = ANY (v_codes);
+    IF v_tx + v_budgets + v_settings + v_plans + v_custom > 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'rollback: the new categories are in use (transactions %, budgets %, household settings %, installment plans %, household codes %); re-categorise those rows first',
+            v_tx, v_budgets, v_settings, v_plans, v_custom;
+    END IF;
+
+    RAISE NOTICE 'rollback: % bi-weekly installment plan(s) lose their frequency',
+        (SELECT count(*) FROM public.installment_plans WHERE frequency = 'biweekly');
+END $$;
+
+-- 1. pay_installment_plan: the 20261020900000 definition (grants and comment are kept by CREATE OR REPLACE)
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pay_installment_plan(
+    p_plan_id uuid,
+    p_household_id uuid,
+    p_actor_user_id uuid
+)
+RETURNS SETOF public.installment_plans
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_row public.installment_plans;
+BEGIN
+    IF p_plan_id IS NULL OR p_household_id IS NULL OR p_actor_user_id IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'plan, household and actor are required' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF NOT EXISTS (
+        SELECT 1
+        FROM public.household_memberships m
+        WHERE m.household_id = p_household_id
+          AND m.user_id = p_actor_user_id
+    ) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only a member of the household can record an installment payment'
+            USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    UPDATE public.installment_plans AS p
+       SET paid_installments = p.paid_installments + 1,
+           status = CASE WHEN p.paid_installments + 1 >= p.installment_count THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE p.status END
+     WHERE p.id = p_plan_id
+       AND p.household_id = p_household_id
+       AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
+       AND p.paid_installments < p.installment_count
+    RETURNING p.* INTO v_row;
+
+    IF FOUND THEN
+        RETURN NEXT v_row;
+        RETURN;
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT p.* INTO v_row
+    FROM public.installment_plans AS p
+    WHERE p.id = p_plan_id
+      AND p.household_id = p_household_id;
+
+    IF NOT FOUND THEN
+        RETURN;  -- not in this household: no row
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_row.status NOT IN ('ACTIVE', 'COMPLETED') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'This installment plan is % and takes no payments', v_row.status
+            USING ERRCODE = '22023', HINT = 'plan_not_active';
+    END IF;
+
+    RETURN NEXT v_row;  -- already paid up: unchanged
+END;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.pay_installment_plan(uuid, uuid, uuid) FROM PUBLIC;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.pay_installment_plan(uuid, uuid, uuid) FROM anon, authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.pay_installment_plan(uuid, uuid, uuid) TO service_role;
+
+-- 2. Schedule trigger, functions, index, constraint, columns
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_installment_plans_schedule ON public.installment_plans;
+DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.installment_plans_schedule();
+DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.installment_next_due_at(date, text, integer, integer, text);
+DROP INDEX IF EXISTS public.idx_installment_plans_next_due;
+ALTER TABLE public.installment_plans DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS installment_plans_frequency_check;
+ALTER TABLE public.installment_plans DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS next_due_at;
+ALTER TABLE public.installment_plans DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS frequency;
+
+-- 3. Taxonomy rows added by the migration (exact rows only)
+DELETE FROM public.cost_control_sub_categories s
+WHERE (s.parent_code, s.sub_code) IN (VALUES
+    ('OPEX-HOUSING', 'housing_rent'), ('OPEX-HOUSING', 'annual_rent'), ('OPEX-HOUSING', 'housing_services'),
+    ('OPEX-EDUCATION', 'tuition_fees'), ('OPEX-EDUCATION', 'school_transport'),
+    ('OPEX-EDUCATION', 'school_uniforms'), ('OPEX-EDUCATION', 'books_supplies'),
+    ('OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP', 'maid_salary'), ('OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP', 'driver_salary'),
+    ('OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP', 'recruitment_visa'),
+    ('OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT', 'parents_support'), ('OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT', 'relatives_support'),
+    ('OPEX-CHARITY', 'sadaqah'), ('OPEX-CHARITY', 'zakat'),
+    ('OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'car_installment'), ('OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'ride_hailing'),
+    ('OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'public_transport'), ('OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'car_maintenance'),
+    ('OPEX-INSURANCE', 'car_insurance'), ('OPEX-INSURANCE', 'health_insurance'),
+    ('OPEX-INSURANCE', 'home_insurance'),
+    ('OPEX-REMITTANCE', 'family_remittance'), ('OPEX-REMITTANCE', 'transfer_fees'));
+
+DELETE FROM public.cost_control_codes c
+WHERE c.household_id IS NULL
+  AND c.code IN ('OPEX-HOUSING', 'OPEX-EDUCATION', 'OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP', 'OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT',
+                 'OPEX-CHARITY', 'OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'OPEX-INSURANCE', 'OPEX-REMITTANCE');
+
+-- 4. Post-check
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
+               WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'installment_plans'
+                 AND column_name IN ('frequency', 'next_due_at'))
+       OR to_regprocedure('public.installment_next_due_at(date, text, integer, integer, text)') IS NOT NULL
+       OR to_regprocedure('public.installment_plans_schedule()') IS NOT NULL
+       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.cost_control_codes WHERE household_id IS NULL
+                  AND code IN ('OPEX-HOUSING', 'OPEX-EDUCATION', 'OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP', 'OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT',
+                               'OPEX-CHARITY', 'OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'OPEX-INSURANCE', 'OPEX-REMITTANCE'))
+       OR has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.pay_installment_plan(uuid, uuid, uuid)', 'EXECUTE')
+       OR NOT has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.pay_installment_plan(uuid, uuid, uuid)', 'EXECUTE') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'rollback post-check failed';
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'rollback: 20261021000000 undone';
+END $$;
+
+COMMIT;

 ## 2. Generating New Secrets
@@ -14,29 +14,35 @@ python -c "import secrets; print('APP_AUTH_TOKEN=bt_sec_' + secrets.token_hex(16
 ```
 
 ## 3. Server Deployment Update
-1. Update `.env` on your deployment host (e.g. VPS / Cloud Run / Coolify):
+1. Update the environment of the deployment host (Railway today; or a VPS / container host with `ai_service/.env`):
    ```bash
    WEBHOOK_SECRET=<new-generated-hex-64>
-   APP_AUTH_TOKEN=<new-generated-bt-sec-token>
-   SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET=<supabase-project-jwt-secret>
-   REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379/0
-   ENV=production
-   ```
-2. Restart the AI service container:
-   ```bash
-   docker compose down && docker compose up -d --build
+   APP_AUTH_TOKEN=<new-generated-bt-sec-token>   # legacy firewall pass for old app builds only
+   ENV=production                                # unset also counts as production
+   # optional:
+   # SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET=<legacy-hs256-jwt-secret>  # only if the project still issues HS256 user tokens
+   # REDIS_URL=redis://<your-redis-host>:6379/0     # docker-compose.yml starts no Redis service
    ```
+2. Redeploy / restart the service (with Docker Compose: `cd ai_service && docker compose down && docker compose up -d --build`).
+3. Rotating the Supabase secret key or the Google/Gemini key follows the same pattern; step-by-step
+   owner procedures are in [`../review/OWNER_ACTIONS.md`](../review/OWNER_ACTIONS.md).
 
 ## 4. Mobile Client Build Update
-When building the Flutter APK/iOS bundle, supply the new values strictly via `--dart-define`:
+When building the Flutter APK/iOS bundle, supply the values strictly via `--dart-define`.
+The app authenticates with the user's Supabase JWT; it does not read `APP_AUTH_TOKEN`, and
+`WEBHOOK_SECRET` is optional (omit it and requests are sent unsigned; the app starts either way):
 ```bash
 flutter build apk --release \
   --dart-define=SUPABASE_URL=https://<your-project>.supabase.co \
   --dart-define=SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=<your-anon-key> \
-  --dart-define=FASTAPI_BASE_URL=https://<your-api-domain> \
-  --dart-define=APP_AUTH_TOKEN=<new-generated-bt-sec-token> \
-  --dart-define=WEBHOOK_SECRET=<new-generated-hex-64>
+  --dart-define=FASTAPI_BASE_URL=https://<your-api-domain>
+# optional request signing (must equal the server's current WEBHOOK_SECRET):
+#   --dart-define=WEBHOOK_SECRET=<new-generated-hex-64>
 ```
+After rotating `WEBHOOK_SECRET` on the server, builds that still sign with the old value keep
+working: their signature no longer verifies, but the request is authenticated by the user's JWT, so
+the backend logs a rate-limited warning ("Ignoring X-Signature header ...") and serves it. Those
+warnings show how many old builds are still in use; new builds can drop the define.
 
 ## 5. Git History Cleansing (Optional/Recommended for Public Repos)
 If this repository is or will become public, run `git filter-repo` or BFG Repo-Cleaner to scrub the historical commit blobs containing the compromised strings.

-# budget_tracker
+# Budget Tracker — Flutter App
 
-A new Flutter project.
+Android / iOS client. It talks to Supabase directly (publishable key, Row Level Security, Realtime)
+and to the FastAPI service (`ai_service/`) with the user's Supabase JWT.
 
-## Getting Started
+## Run
 
-This project is a starting point for a Flutter application.
+```bash
+flutter pub get
+flutter run \
+  --dart-define=SUPABASE_URL=https://<id>.supabase.co \
+  --dart-define=SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=<publishable-or-anon-key> \
+  --dart-define=FASTAPI_BASE_URL=http://<your-machine-ip>:8000
+```
 
-A few resources to get you started if this is your first Flutter project:
+All flags (required and optional) are documented in the root
+[`README.md`](../README.md#flutter-app---dart-define-flags) and defined in
+[`lib/supabase_config.dart`](lib/supabase_config.dart). There are no built-in defaults: a missing
+required flag stops the app at startup, and service-role / `sb_secret_` keys are rejected.
 
-- [Learn Flutter](https://docs.flutter.dev/get-started/learn-flutter)
-- [Write your first Flutter app](https://docs.flutter.dev/get-started/codelab)
-- [Flutter learning resources](https://docs.flutter.dev/reference/learning-resources)
+## Test
 
-For help getting started with Flutter development, view the
-[online documentation](https://docs.flutter.dev/), which offers tutorials,
-samples, guidance on mobile development, and a full API reference.
+```bash
+flutter test      # unit and widget tests in test/
+flutter analyze   # must report "No issues found!"
+```
+
+## Release
+
+`flutter build apk --release` with the same `--dart-define` values (`https://` URLs). Signing reads
+`android/key.properties` (git-ignored: `storeFile`, `storePassword`, `keyAlias`, `keyPassword`);
+without it the release build falls back to the debug key with a warning.
+
+## Layout
+
+`lib/l10n` (ar / en / ur strings, `context.tr`), `models`, `providers`, `screens`, `services`
+(API clients, Supabase, offline SQLite queue), `theme`, `widgets`. Project rules:
+[`../.agents/rules/`](../.agents/rules/).

diff --git a/flutter_app/android/app/src/main/res/xml/data_extraction_rules.xml b/flutter_app/android/app/src/main/res/xml/data_extraction_rules.xml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1cdd294
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/android/app/src/main/res/xml/data_extraction_rules.xml
@@ -0,0 +1,21 @@
+<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
+<!-- Android 12+ backup / device-transfer rules. Nothing is exported: the app
+     stores Supabase session tokens (shared preferences), the offline expense
+     queue and receipt images (databases / files). A restored or transferred
+     session must come from a fresh sign-in, never from a copied token. -->
+<data-extraction-rules>
+    <cloud-backup>
+        <exclude domain="root" path="." />
+        <exclude domain="file" path="." />
+        <exclude domain="database" path="." />
+        <exclude domain="sharedpref" path="." />
+        <exclude domain="external" path="." />
+    </cloud-backup>
+    <device-transfer>
+        <exclude domain="root" path="." />
+        <exclude domain="file" path="." />
+        <exclude domain="database" path="." />
+        <exclude domain="sharedpref" path="." />
+        <exclude domain="external" path="." />
+    </device-transfer>
+</data-extraction-rules>

+      'faq_cat_salary': 'Salary Cycle & Payday (27th)',
+      'faq_salary_q1': 'How does the salary cycle work in this app?',
+      'faq_salary_a1': 'The budget cycle is automatically synced with the standard Saudi 27th payday. A monthly cycle starts on the 27th and concludes on the 26th of the following month, preventing mid-month budget misalignment.',
+      'faq_salary_q2': 'What happens to unspent funds at the end of the cycle?',
+      'faq_salary_a2': 'Any unspent discretionary funds automatically roll over into the next cycle as surplus carryover or can be credited towards household savings reserves.',
+      'faq_salary_q3': 'How is the daily allowance pacing calculated?',
+      'faq_salary_a3': 'Your remaining discretionary budget is divided by the exact number of days remaining until the 27th, providing a safe daily spending limit.',
+      'faq_cat_receipts': 'Receipt & ZATCA Scanning',
+      'faq_receipts_q1': 'How do I scan printed paper receipts?',
+      'faq_receipts_a1': 'Tap the green camera scanner button. You can capture multiple receipt pages or pick an invoice image from your photo gallery. Our Gemini Vision model automatically extracts line items, VAT, and merchant details.',
+      'faq_receipts_q2': 'How does Saudi ZATCA QR code verification work?',
+      'faq_receipts_a2': 'Our scanner decodes official Saudi ZATCA Base64 TLV barcodes in real time to verify seller tax identification, invoice timestamps, VAT amounts, and total values.',
+      'faq_receipts_q3': 'What happens when a duplicate invoice is scanned?',
+      'faq_receipts_a3': 'If an invoice matches an existing transaction, you will see a Duplicate Defense card allowing you to Enrich the existing transaction, Log as a separate expense, or Discard.',
+      'faq_cat_bills': 'Recurring Bills & Iqama Reserves',
+      'faq_bills_q1': 'How do I add recurring bills (Rent, Utilities, Fiber)?',
+      'faq_bills_a1': 'In the Dashboard Recurring Bills card, tap "Manage Bills" to toggle any sub-budget as recurring and configure its monthly due day.',
+      'faq_bills_q2': 'Where is the 400 SAR monthly dependants\' levy tracked?',
+      'faq_bills_a2': 'The 400 SAR monthly dependants\' levy (Murafiq fee) is tracked under the Government (OPEX-GOV) category as a dedicated sub-budget reserve, protecting your essential funds from being spent on general shopping.',
+      'faq_bills_q3': 'How do I mark a recurring bill as paid?',
+      'faq_bills_a3': 'Tap the green "Pay" button directly on any pending bill in the Dashboard card to record payment and adjust your reserved funds.',
+      'faq_cat_bnpl': 'BNPL Installment Plans',
+      'faq_bnpl_q1': 'How do Tabby and Tamara installment plans work?',
+      'faq_bnpl_a1': 'When you log a BNPL purchase, you can view remaining installment payments, due dates, and total payoff progress directly on your dashboard card.',
+      'faq_cat_household': 'Household & roommates',
+      'faq_household_q1': 'How are shared costs between roommates settled?',
+      'faq_household_a1': 'In a roommate household, each expense records who paid and who it was for (one person or everyone). At the end of each cycle the app works out who owes whom, with as few transfers as possible. A family household is different: expenses are never split between husband and wife (see "Nafaqah & the wife\'s allowance").',
+      'faq_household_q2': 'How do I invite my spouse or roommates?',
+      'faq_household_a2': 'An admin opens Settings → Household and shares the household code, or creates an invite for a role (wife, family member or roommate). The other person enters the code after signing in.',

+  /// The plural table, exposed read-only for the localization guard tests.
+  static Map<String, Map<String, Map<String, String>>> get pluralTable => _pluralValues;
+
+  /// CLDR plural category of [count] for [languageCode].
+  ///
+  /// Arabic: zero (0), one (1), two (2), few (n % 100 in 3–10),
+  /// many (n % 100 in 11–99), other (100, 101, 102, … and fractions).
+  /// English and Urdu: one (exactly 1), other.
+  static String pluralCategory(String languageCode, num count) {
+    if (count != count.truncate()) return 'other';
+    final n = count.abs().toInt();
+    if (languageCode == 'ar') {
+      if (n == 0) return 'zero';
+      if (n == 1) return 'one';
+      if (n == 2) return 'two';
+      final mod100 = n % 100;
+      if (mod100 >= 3 && mod100 <= 10) return 'few';
+      if (mod100 >= 11) return 'many';
+      return 'other';
+    }
+    return n == 1 ? 'one' : 'other';
+  }
+
+  /// Looks up the plural form of [key] for [count] and substitutes {count}
+  /// and each entry of [args], e.g. `plural('items_count', 3)` → "3 بنود".
+  String plural(String key, num count, [Map<String, Object?> args = const {}]) {
+    final lang = locale.languageCode;
+    final table = _pluralValues[key];
+    if (table == null) return key;
+    final forms = table[lang] ?? table['en']!;
+    final category = pluralCategory(lang, count);
+    var value = (count == 0 ? forms['zero'] : null) ?? forms[category] ?? forms['other'] ?? key;
+    final values = <String, Object?>{'count': count, ...args};
+    values.forEach((name, arg) {
+      value = value.replaceAll('{$name}', '${arg ?? ''}');
+    });
+    return value;
+  }

+  /// Formats a Saudi Riyal amount for the active locale.
+  ///
+  /// English puts the currency code first ("SAR 1,250.00"); Arabic and Urdu
+  /// put the localized unit after the number ("1,250.00 ر.س" / "1,250.00 ریال"),
+  /// which reads naturally inside right-to-left text. Digits stay Western
+  /// (the convention used by Saudi banking apps and receipts).
+  String sar(num amount, {int decimals = 2}) {
+    final pattern = decimals <= 0 ? '#,##0' : '#,##0.${'0' * decimals}';
+    final unit = get('sar');
+    if (locale.languageCode == 'en') {
+      // "-SAR 859.50", not "SAR -859.50".
+      final sign = amount < 0 ? '-' : '';
+      return '$sign$unit ${NumberFormat(pattern, 'en_US').format(amount.abs())}';
+    }
+    return '${NumberFormat(pattern, 'en_US').format(amount)} $unit';
+  }
+
+  /// Formats an amount in any account currency: SAR (or a blank code) goes
+  /// through [sar]; another currency keeps its ISO code, before the number in
+  /// English and after it in Arabic and Urdu. [signed] adds "+" to positive
+  /// amounts (negative ones always carry "-").
+  String money(num amount, String? currency, {int decimals = 2, bool signed = false}) {
+    final code = (currency ?? '').trim().toUpperCase();
+    final plus = signed && amount > 0 ? '+' : '';
+    if (code.isEmpty || code == 'SAR') return '$plus${sar(amount, decimals: decimals)}';
+    final pattern = decimals <= 0 ? '#,##0' : '#,##0.${'0' * decimals}';
+    if (locale.languageCode == 'en') {
+      final sign = amount < 0 ? '-' : plus;
+      return '$sign$code ${NumberFormat(pattern, 'en_US').format(amount.abs())}';
+    }
+    return '$plus${NumberFormat(pattern, 'en_US').format(amount)} $code';
+  }

+      return formatter.format(date);
+    } catch (_) {
+      return DateFormat(pattern, 'en_US').format(date);
+    }

+  String cycleMonth(String cycleKey, {String fallback = ''}) {
+    final m = RegExp(r'^(\d{4})-(\d{2})').firstMatch(cycleKey);
+    if (m == null) return fallback.isNotEmpty ? fallback : cycleKey;
+    return date(DateTime(int.parse(m.group(1)!), int.parse(m.group(2)!)), 'MMMM yyyy');

+  /// A salary cycle shown by its dates, e.g. "27 Oct – 26 Nov" (Arabic and

+  String cycleRange(DateTime start, DateTime end, {DateTime? now}) {

+  /// [cycleRange] for server ISO dates (`cycle_start` / `cycle_end`).

+    });

+  }

+  String merchant(String? raw) {
+    if (raw == null || raw.trim().isEmpty) {
+      return get('unknown_merchant');
+    }
+    final clean = raw.trim();
+    final lower = clean.toLowerCase();
+
+    // 1. Exact match handling for generic placeholders
+    if (lower == 'unknown' || lower == 'unknown merchant') {
+      return get('unknown_merchant');
+    }
+    if (lower == 'direct' || lower == 'direct entry') {
+      final lang = locale.languageCode;
+      return _merchantDictionary['direct']?[lang] ?? _merchantDictionary['direct']?['en'] ?? clean;
+    }
+    if (lower == 'manual' || lower == 'manual expense') {
+      final lang = locale.languageCode;
+      return _merchantDictionary['manual']?[lang] ?? _merchantDictionary['manual']?['en'] ?? clean;
+    }
+    if (lower == 'installment purchase') {
+      final lang = locale.languageCode;
+      return _merchantDictionary['installment purchase']?[lang] ?? _merchantDictionary['installment purchase']?['en'] ?? clean;
+    }
+
+    // 2. Explicit exclusions to prevent false positive compound phrases
+    // e.g., 'Panda Express' is a Chinese fast-food chain, not Panda Supermarket
+    if (lower.contains('panda express')) {
+      return clean;
+    }
+
+    // 3. Word-boundary regex matching across registered merchants
+    for (final entry in _merchantDictionary.entries) {
+      if (entry.key == 'unknown' ||
+          entry.key == 'direct' ||
+          entry.key == 'manual' ||
+          entry.key == 'installment purchase') {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      // Word boundary matching ensures short tokens like 'stc' or 'extra' do not
+      // greedily match inside words like 'Fastcare', 'Postcard', or 'Extraordinary'
+      final pattern = RegExp(
+        r'(?:^|[\s\b.,_\-/])' + RegExp.escape(entry.key) + r'(?:[\s\b.,_\-/]|$)',
+        caseSensitive: false,
+      );
+      if (pattern.hasMatch(lower)) {
+        final lang = locale.languageCode;
+        return entry.value[lang] ?? entry.value['en'] ?? clean;
+      }
+    }
+    return clean;
+  }

index 0000000..6914500
--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,92 @@
+/// System expense categories: the codes the pickers offer and how each one
+/// looks (emoji used in chip labels, an icon and an accent colour).
+///
+/// Names live in `AppLocalizations.category` (en / ar / ur); this file only
+/// holds the visual side so every picker and card shows the same thing.
+library;
+
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+
+class CategoryVisual {
+  final String emoji;
+  final IconData icon;
+  final Color color;
+
+  const CategoryVisual(this.emoji, this.icon, this.color);
+}
+
+class CategoryCatalog {
+  CategoryCatalog._();
+
+  /// Codes offered when the user picks a category, most common first.
+  static const List<String> pickerCodes = [
+    'OPEX-GROCERY',
+    'OPEX-DINING',
+    'OPEX-HOUSING',
+    'OPEX-UTILITIES',
+    'OPEX-TRANSPORT',
+    'OPEX-FUEL',
+    'OPEX-EDUCATION',
+    'OPEX-HEALTH',
+    'OPEX-SHOPPING',
+    'OPEX-ENTERTAINMENT',
+    'OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP',
+    'OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT',
+    'OPEX-CHARITY',
+    'OPEX-INSURANCE',
+    'OPEX-REMITTANCE',
+    'OPEX-GOV',
+    'OPEX-MISC',
+  ];
+
+  static const CategoryVisual _fallback = CategoryVisual('📦 ', Icons.category_outlined, Color(0xFF94A3B8));
+
+  static const Map<String, CategoryVisual> _visuals = {
+    'OPEX-GROCERY': CategoryVisual('🛒 ', Icons.shopping_cart_outlined, Color(0xFF10B981)),
+    'OPEX-DINING': CategoryVisual('☕ ', Icons.local_cafe_outlined, Color(0xFFF59E0B)),
+    'OPEX-HOUSING': CategoryVisual('🏠 ', Icons.home_outlined, Color(0xFF6366F1)),
+    'OPEX-UTILITIES': CategoryVisual('⚡ ', Icons.bolt_outlined, Color(0xFFEAB308)),
+    'OPEX-TRANSPORT': CategoryVisual('🚗 ', Icons.directions_car_outlined, Color(0xFF0EA5E9)),
+    'OPEX-FUEL': CategoryVisual('⛽ ', Icons.local_gas_station_outlined, Color(0xFF38BDF8)),
+    'OPEX-EDUCATION': CategoryVisual('🎒 ', Icons.school_outlined, Color(0xFF8B5CF6)),
+    'CAPEX-EDUCATION': CategoryVisual('🎓 ', Icons.history_edu_outlined, Color(0xFFA78BFA)),
+    'OPEX-HEALTH': CategoryVisual('💊 ', Icons.medication_outlined, Color(0xFFF43F5E)),
+    'OPEX-SHOPPING': CategoryVisual('🛍️ ', Icons.shopping_bag_outlined, Color(0xFFEC4899)),
+    'OPEX-ENTERTAINMENT': CategoryVisual('🎮 ', Icons.sports_esports_outlined, Color(0xFFD946EF)),
+    'OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP': CategoryVisual('🧹 ', Icons.cleaning_services_outlined, Color(0xFF14B8A6)),
+    'OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT': CategoryVisual('👪 ', Icons.family_restroom, Color(0xFFFB923C)),
+    'OPEX-CHARITY': CategoryVisual('🤲 ', Icons.volunteer_activism_outlined, Color(0xFF22C55E)),
+    'OPEX-INSURANCE': CategoryVisual('🛡️ ', Icons.shield_outlined, Color(0xFF64748B)),
+    'OPEX-REMITTANCE': CategoryVisual('💸 ', Icons.currency_exchange, Color(0xFF00E5BF)),
+    'OPEX-GOV': CategoryVisual('🏛️ ', Icons.account_balance_outlined, Color(0xFF78716C)),
+    'OPEX-MISC': _fallback,
+  };
+
+  static const Map<String, String> _aliases = {
+    'OPEX-GROCERIES': 'OPEX-GROCERY',
+    'OPEX-HEALTHCARE': 'OPEX-HEALTH',
+    'OPEX-DOMESTIC_HELP': 'OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP',
+    'OPEX-FAMILY_SUPPORT': 'OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT',
+  };
+
+  /// Upper-cased code with known aliases resolved; null/blank → OPEX-MISC.
+  static String normalize(String? code) {
+    final c = (code ?? '').trim().toUpperCase();
+    if (c.isEmpty) return 'OPEX-MISC';
+    return _aliases[c] ?? c;
+  }
+
+  static CategoryVisual visual(String? code) => _visuals[normalize(code)] ?? _fallback;
+
+  static String emoji(String? code) => visual(code).emoji;
+
+  /// [pickerCodes] plus [current] when it is a valid code the list does not
+  /// offer (a legacy or household category), so a dropdown never silently
+  /// swaps an existing transaction's category.
+  static List<String> pickerCodesIncluding(String? current) {
+    if (current == null || current.trim().isEmpty) return pickerCodes;
+    final code = normalize(current);
+    if (pickerCodes.contains(code)) return pickerCodes;
+    return [...pickerCodes, code];
+  }
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/models/household_dues.dart b/flutter_app/lib/models/household_dues.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..55cfde6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/models/household_dues.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,88 @@
+/// Who owes whom, from the viewer's point of view, for the dashboard hero
+/// (UX-07: "Owed to Sara" in family mode; UX-16: "You owe Faisal" for
+/// roommates).
+library;
+
+import 'models.dart';
+import 'nafaqah.dart';
+
+enum DueKind {
+  /// Family mode, husband (or admin) viewing: the provider owes this wife.
+  owedToWife,
+
+  /// Family mode, the wife viewing: her husband owes her.
+  owedToMe,
+
+  /// Roommates: the viewer owes this roommate.
+  iOwe,
+
+  /// Roommates: this roommate owes the viewer.
+  owedByRoommate,
+}
+
+class DueLine {
+  final DueKind kind;
+
+  /// The other person's name (the wife, the roommate), when known.
+  final String? name;
+  final double amount;
+
+  const DueLine({required this.kind, required this.amount, this.name});
+}
+
+/// What the provider owes each wife for shared things she paid from her own
+/// money (Nafaqah rule 2), as the viewer should see it. A wife sees only her
+/// own balance; nothing outside family mode or when nothing is owed.
+List<DueLine> nafaqahDueLines(NafaqahSummary summary) {
+  if (!summary.isFamily) return const [];
+  final lines = <DueLine>[];
+  for (final wife in summary.wives) {
+    final owed = wife.reimbursement.outstanding;
+    if (owed < 0.005) continue;
+    if (summary.callerIsWife) {
+      if (wife.id == summary.callerUserId) lines.add(DueLine(kind: DueKind.owedToMe, amount: owed));
+    } else {
+      final name = (wife.displayName ?? '').trim();
+      lines.add(DueLine(kind: DueKind.owedToWife, amount: owed, name: name.isEmpty ? null : name));
+    }
+  }
+  return lines;
+}
+
+/// The viewer's net with each roommate from the simplified debts: what I owe
+/// first, then what I am owed, each largest first. Empty without a viewer.
+List<DueLine> roommateDueLines(SettlementV2Summary summary, String? meId) {
+  if (meId == null || meId.isEmpty) return const [];
+  final net = <String, double>{}; // > 0: they owe me; < 0: I owe them
+  final names = <String, String>{};
+  for (final d in summary.simplifiedDebts) {
+    if (d.fromId == meId) {
+      net[d.toId] = (net[d.toId] ?? 0) - d.amount;
+      names[d.toId] = d.toName;
+    } else if (d.toId == meId) {
+      net[d.fromId] = (net[d.fromId] ?? 0) + d.amount;
+      names[d.fromId] = d.fromName;
+    }
+  }
+  final lines = <DueLine>[
+    for (final e in net.entries)
+      if (e.value <= -0.005)
+        DueLine(kind: DueKind.iOwe, amount: -e.value, name: names[e.key])
+      else if (e.value >= 0.005)
+        DueLine(kind: DueKind.owedByRoommate, amount: e.value, name: names[e.key]),
+  ];
+  return stableSorted(lines, (a, b) {
+    if (a.kind != b.kind) return a.kind == DueKind.iOwe ? -1 : 1;
+    return b.amount.compareTo(a.amount);
+  });
+}
+
+/// [items] sorted by [compare], equal items keeping their order.
+List<T> stableSorted<T>(List<T> items, int Function(T a, T b) compare) {
+  final indexed = [for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) (i, items[i])];
+  indexed.sort((a, b) {
+    final c = compare(a.$2, b.$2);
+    return c != 0 ? c : a.$1.compareTo(b.$1);
+  });
+  return [for (final e in indexed) e.$2];
+}

+/// A member of a household with their role, as served by
+/// `GET /households/{id}/members` (primary admin first).
+class HouseholdMember {
+  final String userId;
+  final String? displayName;
+  final String role;

+  const HouseholdMember({

+    this.role = 'member',

+    this.isNafaqahProvider = false,
+  });

+  bool get isAdmin => role.toLowerCase() == 'admin';
+
+  /// A wife in this household (she can never be the Nafaqah provider).
+  bool get isSpouse => (financialRole ?? '').toLowerCase() == 'spouse';
+
+  bool get isPeer => (financialRole ?? '').toLowerCase() == 'peer';
+
+  factory HouseholdMember.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) => HouseholdMember(
+        userId: map['user_id'] as String? ?? '',
+        displayName: map['display_name'] as String?,
+        role: map['role'] as String? ?? 'member',
+        financialRole: map['financial_role'] as String?,
+        isPrimary: map['is_primary'] as bool? ?? false,
+        isSelf: map['is_self'] as bool? ?? false,
+        isNafaqahProvider: map['is_nafaqah_provider'] as bool? ?? false,
+      );
+}
+
+/// Household types chosen at creation (`households.household_type`).
+const String kHouseholdTypeFamily = 'family';
+const String kHouseholdTypeRoommates = 'roommates';
+
+/// Financial roles an admin may assign (`PUT .../members/{id}/financial-role`).
+const String kFinancialRoleSpouse = 'spouse';
+const String kFinancialRoleFamilyMember = 'family_member';
+const String kFinancialRoleDependent = 'dependent';
+const String kFinancialRolePeer = 'peer';
+
+/// Members of a household and what the signed-in user may change.
+class HouseholdRoster {
+  final String householdId;
+
+  /// 'family' | 'roommates' as served by `GET /households/{id}/members`;
+  /// null from a server that does not send it yet.
+  final String? householdType;
+
+  /// The caller may change the household type (`can_change_household_type`);
+  /// null from a server that does not send it (then: admins).
+  final bool? canChangeHouseholdType;
+
+  /// The caller may change members' financial roles (`can_set_financial_roles`);
+  /// null from a server that does not send it (then: admins).
+  final bool? canSetFinancialRoles;
+
+  /// Financial roles valid for this household type (`assignable_financial_roles`),
+  /// as the server decides; null from a server that does not send it.
+  final List<String>? assignableFinancialRoles;
+  final String? primaryAdminUserId;
+  final String? callerRole;
+  final bool callerIsPrimary;
+  final bool canManageAdmins;
+  final bool canTransferPrimary;
+
+  /// `households.nafaqah_provider_user_id` as stored (the husband).
+  final String? nafaqahProviderUserId;
+
+  /// Any admin may choose the Nafaqah provider (`PUT .../nafaqah/provider`).
+  final bool canSetNafaqahProvider;
+  final List<HouseholdMember> members;
+
+  const HouseholdRoster({
+    required this.householdId,
+    this.householdType,
+    this.canChangeHouseholdType,
+    this.canSetFinancialRoles,
+    this.assignableFinancialRoles,
+    this.primaryAdminUserId,
+    this.callerRole,
+    this.callerIsPrimary = false,
+    this.canManageAdmins = false,
+    this.canTransferPrimary = false,
+    this.nafaqahProviderUserId,
+    this.canSetNafaqahProvider = false,
+    this.members = const [],
+  });
+
+  factory HouseholdRoster.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) => HouseholdRoster(
+        householdId: map['household_id'] as String? ?? '',
+        householdType: (map['household_type'] as String?)?.toLowerCase(),
+        canChangeHouseholdType: map['can_change_household_type'] as bool?,
+        canSetFinancialRoles: map['can_set_financial_roles'] as bool?,
+        assignableFinancialRoles: (map['assignable_financial_roles'] as List?)
+            ?.map((r) => r.toString().toLowerCase())
+            .toList(),
+        primaryAdminUserId: map['primary_admin_user_id'] as String?,
+        callerRole: map['caller_role'] as String?,
+        callerIsPrimary: map['caller_is_primary'] as bool? ?? false,
+        canManageAdmins: map['can_manage_admins'] as bool? ?? false,
+        canTransferPrimary: map['can_transfer_primary'] as bool? ?? false,

+
+  /// Role actions the caller may take on [member].
