+
+  /// Family (Nafaqah) household: a member is a wife.
+  bool get isFamily => members.any((m) => m.isSpouse);
+
+  /// Roommates (peers, no wife): the Nafaqah provider does not apply.
+  bool get isRoommateHousehold => !isFamily && members.any((m) => m.isPeer);
+
+  /// The signed-in user is an admin of this household.
+  bool get callerIsAdmin => (callerRole ?? '').toLowerCase() == 'admin' || canManageAdmins;
+
+  /// The household type: as served, else inferred from the members (a wife
+  /// makes a family, peers without a wife roommates).
+  String get effectiveHouseholdType =>
+      householdType ?? (isRoommateHousehold ? kHouseholdTypeRoommates : kHouseholdTypeFamily);
+
+  /// The caller may change the household type.
+  bool get mayChangeHouseholdType => canChangeHouseholdType ?? callerIsAdmin;
+
+  /// The caller may change members' financial roles.
+  bool get maySetFinancialRoles => canSetFinancialRoles ?? callerIsAdmin;
+
+  /// Financial roles an admin may give [member]: the server's
+  /// `assignable_financial_roles` for this household type (else the owner
+  /// rules: a family offers wife / family member / dependent, roommates only
+  /// roommate), and the Nafaqah provider (husband) is never offered "wife".
+  List<String> financialRoleOptions(HouseholdMember member) {
+    final base = assignableFinancialRoles ??
+        (effectiveHouseholdType == kHouseholdTypeRoommates
+            ? const [kFinancialRolePeer]
+            : const [kFinancialRoleSpouse, kFinancialRoleFamilyMember, kFinancialRoleDependent]);
+    final isProvider = member.isNafaqahProvider || nafaqahProvider?.userId == member.userId;
+    return [
+      for (final role in base)
+        if (const {kFinancialRoleSpouse, kFinancialRoleFamilyMember, kFinancialRoleDependent, kFinancialRolePeer}
+                .contains(role) &&
+            !(isProvider && role == kFinancialRoleSpouse))
+          role,
+    ];
+  }
+
+  /// The provider while he is still a non-spouse member (mirrors the server's
+  /// `nafaqah_husband_id`); null when none is set or he left.
+  HouseholdMember? get nafaqahProvider {
+    for (final m in members) {
+      final isProvider = m.isNafaqahProvider || (nafaqahProviderUserId != null && m.userId == nafaqahProviderUserId);
+      if (isProvider && !m.isSpouse) return m;
+    }
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  /// A family without a valid provider: wife-paid expenses are refused until
+  /// an admin chooses one.
+  bool get needsNafaqahProvider => isFamily && nafaqahProvider == null;
+
+  /// Members an admin may choose as the provider: everyone but the wives.
+  List<HouseholdMember> get nafaqahProviderCandidates => members.where((m) => !m.isSpouse).toList();
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/models/household_setup.dart b/flutter_app/lib/models/household_setup.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..378d447
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/models/household_setup.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,111 @@
+/// First-run setup of a household (UX-02): what is still to do, from data the
+/// app already loads (payday, income, roster, budgets). No new endpoint.
+library;
+
+import 'household_membership.dart';
+
+enum SetupStep { payday, income, budgets, invite, provider }
+
+class HouseholdSetupData {
+  /// The household's payday (null when it could not be read).
+  final int? paydayDay;
+
+  /// The payday was confirmed on this device or differs from the default.
+  final bool paydayConfirmed;
+
+  /// Monthly income; 0 = not set; null = could not be read.
+  final double? monthlyIncome;
+
+  /// Members and the caller's rights; null when they could not be read.
+  final HouseholdRoster? roster;
+
+  /// The checklist was hidden on this device (only once budgets exist).
+  final bool hidden;
+
+  const HouseholdSetupData({
+    this.paydayDay,
+    this.paydayConfirmed = false,
+    this.monthlyIncome,
+    this.roster,
+    this.hidden = false,
+  });
+
+  /// Only admins set the payday, income, budgets, invites and the provider.
+  bool get isAdmin => roster?.callerIsAdmin ?? false;
+
+  bool get isFamily => roster?.effectiveHouseholdType == kHouseholdTypeFamily;
+
+  /// The steps for this household: the Nafaqah provider only in family mode.
+  List<SetupStep> get steps => [
+        SetupStep.payday,
+        SetupStep.income,
+        SetupStep.budgets,
+        SetupStep.invite,
+        if (isFamily) SetupStep.provider,
+      ];
+
+  bool isDone(SetupStep step, {required bool hasBudgets}) {
+    switch (step) {
+      case SetupStep.payday:
+        return paydayConfirmed;
+      case SetupStep.income:
+        return (monthlyIncome ?? 0) > 0;
+      case SetupStep.budgets:
+        return hasBudgets;
+      case SetupStep.invite:
+        return (roster?.members.length ?? 0) > 1;
+      case SetupStep.provider:
+        return roster?.nafaqahProvider != null;
+    }
+  }
+
+  int doneCount({required bool hasBudgets}) => steps.where((s) => isDone(s, hasBudgets: hasBudgets)).length;
+
+  bool isComplete({required bool hasBudgets}) => doneCount(hasBudgets: hasBudgets) == steps.length;
+
+  HouseholdSetupData copyWith({bool? paydayConfirmed, bool? hidden, double? monthlyIncome, int? paydayDay}) =>
+      HouseholdSetupData(
+        paydayDay: paydayDay ?? this.paydayDay,
+        paydayConfirmed: paydayConfirmed ?? this.paydayConfirmed,
+        monthlyIncome: monthlyIncome ?? this.monthlyIncome,
+        roster: roster,
+        hidden: hidden ?? this.hidden,
+      );
+}
+
+/// One row of the suggested starter budget.
+class StarterBudgetRow {
+  final String categoryCode;
+
+  /// Share of the monthly income.
+  final double share;
+  final double amount;
+
+  const StarterBudgetRow({required this.categoryCode, required this.share, required this.amount});
+}
+
+/// The suggested shares of income for a new household, on the seeded system
+/// categories only (they exist in every database). About a quarter of the
+/// income is left unbudgeted for savings and the unexpected.
+const List<(String, double)> kStarterBudgetShares = [
+  ('OPEX-UTILITIES', 0.25),
+  ('OPEX-GROCERY', 0.20),
+  ('OPEX-FUEL', 0.08),
+  ('OPEX-SHOPPING', 0.06),
+  ('OPEX-DINING', 0.05),
+  ('OPEX-MISC', 0.05),
+  ('OPEX-HEALTH', 0.04),
+];
+
+/// Starter amounts from [monthlyIncome], rounded to 50 SAR; 0 without an income.
+List<StarterBudgetRow> starterBudgetTemplate(double? monthlyIncome) {
+  final income = monthlyIncome ?? 0;
+  return [
+    for (final (code, share) in kStarterBudgetShares)
+      StarterBudgetRow(
+        categoryCode: code,
+        share: share,
+        amount: income > 0 ? ((income * share) / 50).round() * 50.0 : 0.0,
+      ),
+  ];
+}

+
+  /// Dates of the remaining installments, first one first (it may be in the
+  /// past when overdue), at most [max]. Uses `next_due_at` when the API sent
+  /// it; otherwise a biweekly plan counts 14 days per paid installment from
+  /// the start date and a monthly plan uses `day_of_month` from [today].
+  /// [today] is a calendar date (UTC midnight).
+  List<DateTime> dueDates({required DateTime today, int max = 6}) {
+    final remaining = remainingInstallments;
+    if (isCompleted || remaining <= 0) return const [];
+    final day0 = DateTime.utc(today.year, today.month, today.day);
+    DateTime first;
+    int anchorDay;
+    if (nextDueAt != null) {
+      first = nextDueAt!;
+      anchorDay = first.day;
+    } else if (isBiweekly) {
+      final start = DateTime.tryParse(startDate);
+      if (start == null) return const [];
+      first = DateTime.utc(start.year, start.month, start.day).add(Duration(days: 14 * paidInstallments));
+      anchorDay = first.day;
+    } else {
+      anchorDay = dayOfMonth.clamp(1, 31);
+      first = _monthDay(day0.year, day0.month, anchorDay);
+      if (first.isBefore(day0)) first = _monthDay(day0.year, day0.month + 1, anchorDay);
+    }
+    final out = <DateTime>[];
+    for (var i = 0; i < remaining && out.length < max; i++) {
+      out.add(isBiweekly
+          ? first.add(Duration(days: 14 * i))
+          : _monthDay(first.year, first.month + i, anchorDay));
+    }
+    return out;
+  }
+
+  /// The next installment's date (see [dueDates]), or null when none is due.
+  DateTime? nextDueDate({required DateTime today}) {
+    final dates = dueDates(today: today, max: 1);
+    return dates.isEmpty ? null : dates.first;
+  }
+
+  static DateTime _monthDay(int year, int month, int day) {
+    final y = year + (month - 1) ~/ 12;
+    final m = (month - 1) % 12 + 1;
+    final last = DateTime.utc(y, m + 1, 0).day;
+    return DateTime.utc(y, m, day < last ? day : last);
+  }
+
+  static DateTime? _parseDate(Object? raw) {
+    if (raw is! String || raw.isEmpty) return null;
+    final d = DateTime.tryParse(raw);
+    return d == null ? null : DateTime.utc(d.year, d.month, d.day);
+  }

   int get remainingInstallments => (installmentCount - paidInstallments).clamp(0, installmentCount);

diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/models/manual_expense_row.dart b/flutter_app/lib/models/manual_expense_row.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..9056854
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/models/manual_expense_row.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,74 @@
+/// Builds the `public.transactions` row for a manually entered expense.
+///
+/// The same row is used for the online insert and, unchanged, for the offline
+/// queue replay (`transaction_insert`), so both paths store identical data:
+/// * `id` is generated on the device, which makes a replay after a timed-out
+///   insert collide on the primary key instead of booking the expense twice;
+/// * `timestamp` is an explicit UTC instant (a bare local ISO string would be
+///   read by Postgres as UTC and shift Riyadh evenings into the next day and,
+///   on the 26th, into the next salary cycle);
+/// * the payer is kept in the `raw_sms` audit trail (`PaidBy:` tag) that the
+///   app and the settlement engine already parse, because `transactions` has
+///   no `paid_by` column. The tail format is shared with the edit sheet
+///   ([manualAuditNote]) so both write exactly what the server parses.
+library;
+
+import 'transaction_attribution.dart';
+
+Map<String, dynamic> buildManualExpenseRow({
+  required String id,
+  required String householdId,
+  required String? userId,
+  required double amount,
+  required String merchant,
+  required String? categoryCode,
+  required String spentBy,
+  required String paidBy,
+  required String beneficiaryType,
+  required String beneficiaryId,
+  required String? accountId,
+  required DateTime occurredAt,
+  String? nafaqahClass,
+  String? nafaqahSpouseId,
+}) {
+  final auditPayer = manualPayerAuditTag(paidBy);
+  return {
+    'id': id,
+    'household_id': householdId,
+    if (userId != null && userId.isNotEmpty) 'user_id': userId,
+    'amount': amount,
+    'currency': 'SAR',
+    'merchant': merchant,
+    'category_code': categoryCode,
+    'spent_by': spentBy,
+    'beneficiary_type': beneficiaryType,
+    'beneficiary_id': beneficiaryId,
+    'account_id': accountId,
+    'source': 'manual',
+    'timestamp': occurredAt.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
+    'raw_sms': manualAuditNote(
+      head: 'Manual: $merchant',
+      payer: auditPayer,
+      beneficiaryId: beneficiaryId,
+      spentBy: spentBy,
+    ),
+    'items': [
+      {'name': merchant, 'price': amount, 'quantity': 1}
+    ],
+    // Family (Nafaqah): wife_reimbursable = the husband owes her, wife_personal
+    // = charged to her allowance. Both columns are set together or not at all.
+    if (nafaqahClass != null && nafaqahSpouseId != null && nafaqahSpouseId.isNotEmpty) ...{
+      'nafaqah_class': nafaqahClass,
+      'nafaqah_spouse_id': nafaqahSpouseId,
+    },
+  };
+}
+
+/// Maps the manual-entry payer to the `PaidBy:` vocabulary (`me`/`partner`)
+/// understood by [Transaction.fromMap] and the settlement engine. In family
+/// mode the wife is the partner; a roommate payer keeps their member id.
+String manualPayerAuditTag(String paidBy) {
+  final v = paidBy.trim().toLowerCase();
+  if (v == 'wife' || v == 'husband') return 'partner';
+  return paidBy.trim();
+}

+          if (byOver != 0) return byOver;
+          return b.overspentAmount.compareTo(a.overspentAmount);
+        }
+        return b.usageRatio.compareTo(a.usageRatio);
+      });
+  }
 }

diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/models/money.dart b/flutter_app/lib/models/money.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..6647655
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/models/money.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,143 @@
+/// Parsing of user-typed SAR amounts.
+///
+/// Arabic and Urdu keyboards (and iOS/Android numeric pads under an Arabic
+/// locale) emit Arabic-Indic digits `٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩`, Extended Arabic-Indic
+/// (Persian/Urdu) digits `۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹`, the Arabic decimal separator `٫` and
+/// the Arabic thousands separator `٬`. `double.tryParse` rejects all of them,
+/// which silently turned an entered "١٥٠" into 0 (or "keep old balance").
+library;
+
+const int _arabicIndicZero = 0x0660;
+const int _extendedArabicIndicZero = 0x06F0;
+
+/// Converts Arabic-Indic / Extended Arabic-Indic digits to ASCII digits and
+/// the Arabic decimal separator to '.'. Other characters are kept.
+String normalizeDigits(String input) {
+  final out = StringBuffer();
+  for (final rune in input.runes) {
+    if (rune >= _arabicIndicZero && rune <= _arabicIndicZero + 9) {
+      out.writeCharCode(0x30 + rune - _arabicIndicZero);
+    } else if (rune >= _extendedArabicIndicZero && rune <= _extendedArabicIndicZero + 9) {
+      out.writeCharCode(0x30 + rune - _extendedArabicIndicZero);
+    } else if (rune == 0x066B) {
+      out.write('.');
+    } else {
+      out.writeCharCode(rune);
+    }
+  }
+  return out.toString();
+}
+
+final RegExp _currencyTokens = RegExp(r'(sar|ر\.س\.?|ريال|﷼|riyals?)', caseSensitive: false);
+// Spaces (incl. NBSP / narrow NBSP) and the bidi control marks that Arabic
+// text fields insert around numbers; always dropped.
+final RegExp _ignorable = RegExp('[\\s\u00A0\u202F\u200E\u200F\u061C]');
+// Sign, integer part with optional separators (',' '٬' '،'), optional fraction.
+final RegExp _plainNumber = RegExp(r'^([+-]?)([0-9,٬،]*)(?:\.([0-9]*))?$');
+final RegExp _separator = RegExp('[,٬،]');
+
+/// Largest integer part accepted: the database stores amounts as numeric(14,2).
+const int _maxIntegerDigits = 12;
+
+/// Largest amount numeric(14,2) holds, in halalas (999,999,999,999.99 SAR).
+const int _maxHalalas = 99999999999999;
+
+/// Sign, integer digits and fraction digits of a typed amount, or null when
+/// the text is not a plain number.
+///
+/// Separators (FABLE2-APP-04): a lone comma (',' or '،') followed by one or
+/// two digits, with no '.' anywhere, is a decimal comma ("1,5" is 1.50,
+/// ",5" is 0.50). Every other comma, and the Arabic thousands mark '٬', is a
+/// thousands separator and must be followed by exactly three digits
+/// ("1,234" is 1234, "1,234,567.8" is 1234567.80); anything else ("1,,2",
+/// "1,2,3", "12,5.3") is ambiguous and rejected instead of guessed.
+({String sign, String whole, String fraction})? _splitAmount(String input) {
+  final cleaned = normalizeDigits(input).replaceAll(_currencyTokens, '').replaceAll(_ignorable, '');
+  final match = _plainNumber.firstMatch(cleaned);
+  if (match == null) return null;
+  final sign = match.group(1) ?? '';
+  final integerPart = match.group(2) ?? '';
+  final dotFraction = match.group(3);
+  var whole = integerPart;
+  var fraction = dotFraction ?? '';
+  if (integerPart.contains(_separator)) {
+    final groups = integerPart.split(_separator);
+    final lone = groups.length == 2 && !integerPart.contains('٬');
+    if (dotFraction == null && !cleaned.contains('.') && lone && RegExp(r'^\d{1,2}$').hasMatch(groups[1])) {
+      whole = groups[0];
+      fraction = groups[1];
+    } else {
+      final first = groups.first;
+      if (first.isEmpty || first.length > 3) return null;
+      for (final g in groups.skip(1)) {
+        if (g.length != 3) return null;
+      }
+      whole = groups.join();
+    }
+  }
+  if (whole.isEmpty && fraction.isEmpty) return null;
+  return (sign: sign, whole: whole, fraction: fraction);
+}
+
+/// Parses a typed money amount into integer halalas (1 SAR = 100 halalas),
+/// working on the decimal string itself: the third decimal decides, half-up
+/// (away from zero), so "1.005" is 101 and "0.285" is 29. Going through a
+/// binary double made them 1.00 and 0.28 (FABLE-LOGIC-09).
+///
+/// Accepts Arabic-Indic / Urdu digits, the Arabic decimal and thousands
+/// separators, a decimal comma, grouping commas and spaces, and a currency
+/// token (see [_splitAmount] for the comma rules). Returns null when the text
+/// is not a plain number, exceeds numeric(14,2) after rounding, or is
+/// negative while [allowNegative] is false.
+int? parseMoneyToHalalas(String? input, {bool allowNegative = true}) {
+  if (input == null) return null;
+  final parts = _splitAmount(input);
+  if (parts == null) return null;
+
+  final integerDigits = parts.whole.replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^0+'), '');
+  if (integerDigits.length > _maxIntegerDigits) return null;
+
+  final padded = parts.fraction.padRight(3, '0');
+  var halalas = int.parse(integerDigits.isEmpty ? '0' : integerDigits) * 100 + int.parse(padded.substring(0, 2));
+  if (padded.codeUnitAt(2) >= 0x35) halalas += 1; // third decimal >= 5: half-up
+  // The cap applies to the stored (rounded) value: "999999999999.995" rounds
+  // to 1,000,000,000,000.00, which numeric(14,2) cannot hold.
+  if (halalas > _maxHalalas) return null;
+  if (halalas == 0) return 0;
+  final negative = parts.sign == '-';
+  if (negative && !allowNegative) return null;
+  return negative ? -halalas : halalas;
+}
+
+/// Parses a typed money amount, rounded half-up to halalas (2 decimals) from
+/// the decimal string (see [parseMoneyToHalalas]). Returns null when the text
+/// is not a number (or is negative while [allowNegative] is false).
+double? parseMoneyInput(String? input, {bool allowNegative = true}) {
+  final halalas = parseMoneyToHalalas(input, allowNegative: allowNegative);
+  return halalas == null ? null : halalas / 100;
+}
+
+/// Halalas as a plain two-decimal SAR string ("1.01", "-0.29").
+String formatHalalas(int halalas) {
+  final negative = halalas < 0;
+  final abs = halalas.abs();
+  final text = '${abs ~/ 100}.${(abs % 100).toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
+  return negative ? '-$text' : text;
+}
+
+/// The value [input] is actually stored as, to show the rounded amount back
+/// to the user ("1.005" → "1.01"); null when it is not a number.
+String? roundedMoneyText(String? input, {bool allowNegative = true}) {
+  final halalas = parseMoneyToHalalas(input, allowNegative: allowNegative);
+  return halalas == null ? null : formatHalalas(halalas);
+}
+
+/// The rounded value to show in place of [input] when the user typed more
+/// than two decimals ("1.005" → "1.01"); null when nothing was rounded away
+/// or the text is not a number, so the field is left as typed.
+String? roundedMoneyTextIfRounded(String? input) {
+  if (input == null) return null;
+  final fraction = _splitAmount(input)?.fraction ?? '';
+  if (fraction.length <= 2) return null;
+  return roundedMoneyText(input);
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/models/nafaqah.dart b/flutter_app/lib/models/nafaqah.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..15dabf9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/models/nafaqah.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,476 @@
+/// Islamic family Nafaqah models (family mode = married couple).
+///
+/// Owner rules (see `.agents/rules/02-saudi-fintech-and-islamic-compliance.md`):
+/// 1. Shared family expenses are the husband's Nafaqah: never split between
+///    the spouses (no 50/50 or any percentage).
+/// 2. The wife paying from her own money for something shared is a debt the
+///    husband owes her ([kWifeReimbursable]); reimbursements reduce it.
+/// 3. A personal purchase by the wife is charged to her per-cycle allowance
+///    ([kWifePersonal]); overspend shows as a negative remainder.
+/// 4. Whatever the husband pays is an ordinary household expense (no class).
+library;
+
+const String kWifeReimbursable = 'wife_reimbursable';
+const String kWifePersonal = 'wife_personal';
+
+double _num(Object? v) => (v as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0;
+
+/// Nafaqah class of an expense from the recorder's point of view (mirrors
+/// `nafaqah_service.classify_nafaqah`). `paidBy`/`beneficiary` use the app's
+/// relative vocabulary: 'me' is the recorder, 'partner' the other spouse.
+/// Only an expense the wife paid from her own money gets a class.
+String? classifyNafaqah(String? recorderRole, String paidBy, String beneficiary) {
+  final role = (recorderRole ?? '').toLowerCase();
+  final pb = paidBy.trim().toLowerCase();
+  final ben = beneficiary.trim().toLowerCase();
+  const wifeAliases = {'wife', 'spouse'};
+  final bool wifePaid;
+  final bool forWife;
+  if (role == 'wife') {
+    wifePaid = pb == 'me' || wifeAliases.contains(pb);
+    forWife = ben == 'me' || wifeAliases.contains(ben);
+  } else if (role == 'husband') {
+    wifePaid = pb == 'partner' || wifeAliases.contains(pb);
+    forWife = ben == 'partner' || wifeAliases.contains(ben);
+  } else {
+    return null;
+  }
+  if (!wifePaid) return null;
+  return forWife ? kWifePersonal : kWifeReimbursable;
+}
+
+/// What the expense endpoints take for "no class": the husband paid (rule 4).
+const String kNafaqahNone = 'none';
+
+/// Recorder-relative `paid_by` / `beneficiary` that express a Nafaqah choice
+/// (mirrors `nafaqah_service.attribution_for_class`), so the server never sees
+/// a class that contradicts who paid for whom. `null` = the husband paid.
+({String paidBy, String beneficiary}) nafaqahAttribution(String? recorderRole, String? nafaqahClass) {
+  final isWife = (recorderRole ?? '').toLowerCase() == 'wife';
+  final wifeSide = isWife ? 'me' : 'partner';
+  final husbandSide = isWife ? 'partner' : 'me';
+  switch (nafaqahClass) {
+    case kWifePersonal:
+      return (paidBy: wifeSide, beneficiary: wifeSide);
+    case kWifeReimbursable:
+      return (paidBy: wifeSide, beneficiary: 'both');
+    default:
+      return (paidBy: husbandSide, beneficiary: 'both');
+  }
+}
+
+/// Family-mode context of an expense preview from `/agent/chat-transaction`
+/// or `/agent/scan-receipt` (`household_mode`, `recorder_role`,
+/// `nafaqah_class`, `nafaqah_spouse_id`, `wives`).
+class NafaqahPreview {
+  final bool isFamily;
+  final String? recorderRole; // 'wife' | 'husband' | 'member'
+  final String? suggestedClass;
+  final String? suggestedSpouseId;
+  final List<NafaqahWife> wives;
+
+  /// The husband's (provider's) display name when known, so a family entry
+  /// says "Ahmed paid" instead of "the husband" (UX-03). Optional: the chat
+  /// and receipt previews may not carry it.
+  final String? husbandName;
+
+  /// The recorder is a household admin. Owner rule: only the wife, the
+  /// Nafaqah provider (husband) or an admin may classify a family expense as
+  /// wife_reimbursable / wife_personal.
+  final bool callerIsAdmin;
+
+  const NafaqahPreview({
+    this.isFamily = false,
+    this.recorderRole,
+    this.suggestedClass,
+    this.suggestedSpouseId,
+    this.wives = const [],
+    this.callerIsAdmin = false,
+    this.husbandName,
+  });
+
+  bool get _isSpouse => recorderRole == 'wife' || recorderRole == 'husband';
+
+  /// Only the wife, the husband (provider) or an admin records a Nafaqah class.
+  bool get canClassify => isFamily && (_isSpouse || callerIsAdmin);
+
+  /// An admin who is neither spouse: classifies on the wife's behalf, naming her.
+  bool get isAdminClassifier => canClassify && !_isSpouse;
+
+  bool get viewerIsWife => recorderRole == 'wife';
+
+  /// 'wife', 'husband' or 'admin': whose point of view the Nafaqah question takes.
+  String get viewerRole => viewerIsWife ? 'wife' : (recorderRole == 'husband' ? 'husband' : 'admin');
+
+  /// The display name of the wife [wifeId] names (else the only wife), or null.
+  String? wifeNameFor(String? wifeId) {
+    NafaqahWife? wife;
+    for (final w in wives) {
+      if (wifeId != null && w.id == wifeId) wife = w;
+    }
+    wife ??= wives.length == 1 ? wives.first : null;
+    final name = (wife?.displayName ?? '').trim();
+    return name.isEmpty ? null : name;
+  }
+
+  /// The husband (or an admin) in a family with several wives says which wife paid.
+  bool get needsWifeChoice => canClassify && !viewerIsWife && wives.length > 1;
+
+  /// The wife preselected for the husband or an admin (the only one, or the server's pick).
+  String? get defaultSpouseId {
+    if (!canClassify || viewerIsWife) return null;
+    if (wives.length == 1) return wives.first.id;
+    return suggestedSpouseId;
+  }
+
+  /// The same context with the viewer's admin flag (the preview of
+  /// `/agent/chat-transaction` and `/agent/scan-receipt` may not carry it).
+  NafaqahPreview withAdmin(bool isAdmin) => NafaqahPreview(
+        isFamily: isFamily,
+        recorderRole: recorderRole,
+        suggestedClass: suggestedClass,
+        suggestedSpouseId: suggestedSpouseId,
+        wives: wives,
+        callerIsAdmin: callerIsAdmin || isAdmin,
+        husbandName: husbandName,
+      );
+
+  /// Fields for `/agent/scan-receipt` or `/agent/chat-transaction`: who paid
+  /// for whom and the confirmed class, consistent with each other (empty
+  /// outside family mode). A wife never names a spouse: she is the spouse.
+  Map<String, String> requestFields(String? nafaqahClass, {String? chosenWifeId}) {
+    if (!canClassify) return const {};
+    if (isAdminClassifier) {
+      // An admin who is neither spouse: no class leaves the attribution as
+      // entered; a class names the wife who paid ('partner' resolved by the
+      // server with nafaqah_spouse_id).
+      if (nafaqahClass == null) return const {'nafaqah_class': kNafaqahNone};
+      return {
+        'paid_by': 'partner',
+        'beneficiary': nafaqahClass == kWifePersonal ? 'partner' : 'both',
+        'nafaqah_class': nafaqahClass,
+        if (chosenWifeId != null && chosenWifeId.isNotEmpty) 'nafaqah_spouse_id': chosenWifeId,
+      };
+    }
+    final attribution = nafaqahAttribution(recorderRole, nafaqahClass);
+    final spouse = viewerIsWife || nafaqahClass == null ? null : chosenWifeId;
+    return {
+      'paid_by': attribution.paidBy,
+      'beneficiary': attribution.beneficiary,
+      'nafaqah_class': nafaqahClass ?? kNafaqahNone,
+      if (spouse != null && spouse.isNotEmpty) 'nafaqah_spouse_id': spouse,
+    };
+  }
+
+  /// `nafaqah_class` / `nafaqah_spouse_id` for a direct `transactions` insert
+  /// (the database requires both together; empty when there is no class).
+  Map<String, String> transactionColumns(String? nafaqahClass, {String? chosenWifeId, String? currentUserId}) {
+    if (!canClassify || nafaqahClass == null) return const {};
+    final spouse = viewerIsWife ? currentUserId : chosenWifeId;
+    if (spouse == null || spouse.isEmpty) return const {};
+    return {'nafaqah_class': nafaqahClass, 'nafaqah_spouse_id': spouse};
+  }
+
+  /// Where nothing is previewed (the multi-page scanner saves directly): the
+  /// caller's role from `GET /households/{id}/nafaqah`. The suggestion mirrors
+  /// the server default (the recorder paid for the household).
+  factory NafaqahPreview.fromSummary(NafaqahSummary summary) {
+    if (!summary.isFamily) return const NafaqahPreview();
+    final role = summary.callerRole;
+    return NafaqahPreview(
+      isFamily: true,
+      recorderRole: role,
+      suggestedClass: role == 'wife' ? kWifeReimbursable : null,
+      wives: summary.wives,
+      // `can_set_provider` is true for household admins.
+      callerIsAdmin: summary.canSetProvider,
+      husbandName: summary.husbandName,
+    );
+  }
+
+  factory NafaqahPreview.fromPreview(Map<String, dynamic>? data) {
+    if (data == null || data['household_mode'] != 'family_nafaqah') return const NafaqahPreview();
+    final cls = data['nafaqah_class'] as String?;
+    return NafaqahPreview(
+      isFamily: true,
+      recorderRole: data['recorder_role'] as String?,
+      suggestedClass: (cls == kWifeReimbursable || cls == kWifePersonal) ? cls : null,
+      suggestedSpouseId: data['nafaqah_spouse_id'] as String?,
+      callerIsAdmin: data['caller_is_admin'] == true || data['can_classify'] == true,
+      husbandName: (data['husband'] is Map ? (data['husband'] as Map)['display_name'] : data['husband_name']) as String?,
+      wives: (data['wives'] as List? ?? const [])
+          .whereType<Map>()
+          .map((w) => NafaqahWife.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic>.from(w)))
+          .where((w) => w.id.isNotEmpty)
+          .toList(),
+    );
+  }
+}
+
+/// What the husband owes his wife for her advances (rule 2).
+class ReimbursementBalance {
+  final double grossAdvanced;
+  final double reimbursed;
+  final double outstanding;
+
+  /// Repaid more than advanced (an advance was cut or removed after a
+  /// repayment, before the ledger guard existed). Never negative.
+  final double overpaid;
+
+  const ReimbursementBalance({
+    this.grossAdvanced = 0.0,
+    this.reimbursed = 0.0,
+    this.outstanding = 0.0,
+    this.overpaid = 0.0,
+  });
+
+  bool get isSettled => outstanding < 0.005;
+
+  bool get isOverpaid => overpaid >= 0.005;
+
+  factory ReimbursementBalance.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) => ReimbursementBalance(
+        grossAdvanced: _num(map['gross_advanced']),
+        reimbursed: _num(map['reimbursed']),
+        outstanding: _num(map['outstanding']),
+        overpaid: _num(map['overpaid']),
+      );
+}
+
+/// The wife's personal allowance (مصروفها) for one salary cycle (rule 3).
+class AllowanceStatus {
+  final String cycleKey;
+  final bool isSet;
+  final double allocated;
+  final double spent;
+  final double remaining;
+  final int transactionCount;
+
+  const AllowanceStatus({
+    this.cycleKey = '',
+    this.isSet = false,
+    this.allocated = 0.0,
+    this.spent = 0.0,
+    this.remaining = 0.0,
+    this.transactionCount = 0,
+  });
+
+  /// An allowance was set for the cycle. A working wife may have none: her
+  /// personal purchases are then shown as plain spending, never "overspent".
+  bool get hasAllowance => isSet || allocated > 0;
+
+  bool get isOverspent => hasAllowance && remaining < 0;
+
+  /// Share of the allowance used, clamped to [0, 1] for progress bars.
+  double get usedFraction {
+    if (allocated <= 0) return spent > 0 ? 1.0 : 0.0;
+    return (spent / allocated).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
+  }
+
+  factory AllowanceStatus.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) => AllowanceStatus(
+        cycleKey: map['cycle_key'] as String? ?? '',
+        isSet: map['is_set'] as bool? ?? false,
+        allocated: _num(map['allocated']),
+        spent: _num(map['spent']),
+        remaining: _num(map['remaining']),
+        transactionCount: (map['transaction_count'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
+      );
+}
+
+class NafaqahWife {
+  final String id;
+  final String? displayName;
+  final ReimbursementBalance reimbursement;
+  final AllowanceStatus allowance;
+
+  const NafaqahWife({
+    required this.id,
+    this.displayName,
+    this.reimbursement = const ReimbursementBalance(),
+    this.allowance = const AllowanceStatus(),
+  });
+
+  factory NafaqahWife.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) => NafaqahWife(
+        id: map['id'] as String? ?? '',
+        displayName: map['display_name'] as String?,
+        reimbursement: ReimbursementBalance.fromMap(
+          Map<String, dynamic>.from(map['reimbursement'] as Map? ?? const {}),
+        ),
+        allowance: AllowanceStatus.fromMap(
+          Map<String, dynamic>.from(map['allowance'] as Map? ?? const {}),
+        ),
+      );
+}
+
+/// `GET /households/{id}/nafaqah` from the caller's point of view.
+class NafaqahSummary {
+  final String mode; // 'family_nafaqah' | 'not_family'
+  final String? callerRole; // 'husband' | 'wife' | 'member'
+  final String? callerUserId;
+  final String? cycleKey;
+  final String? husbandId;
+  final String? husbandName;
+  final List<NafaqahWife> wives;
+  final bool canSetAllowance;
+  final bool canRecordReimbursement;
+
+  /// `households.nafaqah_provider_user_id` (the husband), as stored.
+  final String? providerUserId;
+
+  /// A family without a valid provider: classified expenses are refused until
+  /// a household admin chooses one.
+  final bool needsProvider;
+
+  /// The caller is a household admin and may choose the provider.
+  final bool canSetProvider;
+
+  /// 'family' | 'roommates' (`household_type`), when the server sends it.
+  final String? householdType;
+
+  const NafaqahSummary({
+    this.mode = 'not_family',
+    this.callerRole,
+    this.callerUserId,
+    this.cycleKey,
+    this.husbandId,
+    this.husbandName,
+    this.wives = const [],
+    this.canSetAllowance = false,
+    this.canRecordReimbursement = false,
+    this.providerUserId,
+    this.needsProvider = false,
+    this.canSetProvider = false,
+    this.householdType,
+  });
+
+  bool get isFamily => mode == 'family_nafaqah' && wives.isNotEmpty;
+  bool get callerIsWife => callerRole == 'wife';
+
+  /// The wife the caller is concerned with: herself, or the first wife.
+  NafaqahWife? get primaryWife {
+    if (wives.isEmpty) return null;
+    if (callerIsWife) {
+      return wives.firstWhere((w) => w.id == callerUserId, orElse: () => wives.first);
+    }
+    return wives.first;
+  }
+
+  factory NafaqahSummary.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
+    final husband = map['husband'] is Map ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(map['husband'] as Map) : null;
+    return NafaqahSummary(
+      mode: map['mode'] as String? ?? 'not_family',
+      callerRole: map['caller_role'] as String?,
+      callerUserId: map['caller_user_id'] as String?,
+      cycleKey: map['cycle_key'] as String?,
+      husbandId: husband?['id'] as String?,
+      husbandName: husband?['display_name'] as String?,
+      wives: (map['wives'] as List? ?? const [])
+          .whereType<Map>()
+          .map((w) => NafaqahWife.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic>.from(w)))
+          .toList(),
+      canSetAllowance: map['can_set_allowance'] as bool? ?? false,
+      canRecordReimbursement: map['can_record_reimbursement'] as bool? ?? false,
+      providerUserId: map['provider_user_id'] as String?,
+      needsProvider: map['needs_provider'] as bool? ?? false,
+      canSetProvider: map['can_set_provider'] as bool? ?? false,
+      householdType: map['household_type'] as String?,
+    );
+  }
+}
+
+/// `PUT /households/{id}/nafaqah/provider`: the new provider and the
+/// refreshed Nafaqah summary from the caller's point of view.
+class NafaqahProviderChange {
+  final String? providerUserId;
+  final String? previousProviderUserId;
+  final NafaqahSummary? summary;
+
+  const NafaqahProviderChange({this.providerUserId, this.previousProviderUserId, this.summary});
+
+  factory NafaqahProviderChange.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) => NafaqahProviderChange(
+        providerUserId: map['provider_user_id'] as String?,
+        previousProviderUserId: map['previous_provider_user_id'] as String?,
+        summary: map['summary'] is Map ? NafaqahSummary.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic>.from(map['summary'] as Map)) : null,
+      );
+}
+
+/// One line of the wife's ledger: an advance she made or a repayment to her.
+class NafaqahLedgerEntry {
+  final String type; // 'advance' | 'reimbursement'
+  final String id;
+  final double amount;
+  final DateTime? timestamp;
+  final String? merchant;
+  final String? paymentMethod;
+  final String? notes;
+
+  const NafaqahLedgerEntry({
+    required this.type,
+    required this.id,
+    required this.amount,
+    this.timestamp,
+    this.merchant,
+    this.paymentMethod,
+    this.notes,
+  });
+
+  bool get isAdvance => type == 'advance';
+
+  factory NafaqahLedgerEntry.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) => NafaqahLedgerEntry(
+        type: map['type'] as String? ?? 'advance',
+        id: map['id']?.toString() ?? '',
+        amount: _num(map['amount']),
+        timestamp: DateTime.tryParse(map['timestamp']?.toString() ?? '')?.toLocal(),
+        merchant: map['merchant'] as String?,
+        paymentMethod: map['payment_method'] as String?,
+        notes: map['notes'] as String?,
+      );
+}
+
+class NafaqahLedger {
+  final ReimbursementBalance balance;
+  final List<NafaqahLedgerEntry> history;
+
+  const NafaqahLedger({this.balance = const ReimbursementBalance(), this.history = const []});
+
+  factory NafaqahLedger.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) => NafaqahLedger(
+        balance: ReimbursementBalance.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic>.from(map['balance'] as Map? ?? const {})),
+        history: (map['history'] as List? ?? const [])
+            .whereType<Map>()
+            .map((e) => NafaqahLedgerEntry.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic>.from(e)))
+            .toList(),
+      );
+}
+
+/// A rejected Nafaqah request. [code] is 'overpayment', 'forbidden',
+/// 'not_family', 'ledger_would_be_overpaid' (an edit would leave the wife's
+/// ledger repaid beyond her advances), 'no_provider' (the family has no
+/// Nafaqah provider yet), 'invalid' or 'network'.
+class NafaqahApiException implements Exception {
+  final String code;
+  final String message;
+  final int? statusCode;
+
+  const NafaqahApiException(this.code, this.message, {this.statusCode});
+
+  factory NafaqahApiException.fromResponse(Map<String, dynamic> res) {
+    final status = (res['status_code'] as num?)?.toInt();
+    final detail = res['detail'];
+    final detailCode = detail is Map ? detail['code'] as String? : null;
+    final message = res['message']?.toString() ?? '';
+    final String code;
+    const stateCodes = {'overpayment', 'not_family', 'ledger_would_be_overpaid', 'no_provider'};
+    if (stateCodes.contains(detailCode)) {
+      code = detailCode!;
+    } else if (status == 403) {
+      code = 'forbidden';
+    } else if (status == 422 || status == 400) {
+      code = 'invalid';
+    } else {
+      code = 'network';
+    }
+    return NafaqahApiException(code, message, statusCode: status);
+  }
+
+  @override
+  String toString() => 'NafaqahApiException($code, $statusCode): $message';
+}

diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/models/payday_outlook.dart b/flutter_app/lib/models/payday_outlook.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..4104c76
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/models/payday_outlook.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,143 @@
+/// "Left until payday": the dashboard's one figure, one daily amount and one
+/// verdict (UX-07). Every number in the hero comes from here; nothing else on
+/// the dashboard computes a second pace or verdict.
+library;
+
+import 'models.dart';
+
+/// The single verdict of the hero.
+enum PaydayVerdict {
+  /// The money lasts until payday at the current pace.
+  onTrack,
+
+  /// At the current pace the money runs out before payday ([PaydayOutlook.runOutDate]).
+  runsOut,
+
+  /// More was spent than the income (or the budgets, without an income).
+  overspent,
+}
+
+/// Fixed lump-sum categories (rent, utilities): they do not set the daily
+/// pace, and what is still to pay of them is not available for daily spending.
+const Set<String> kFixedCostCategoryCodes = {
+  'HOUSING-RENT',
+  'HOUSING',
+  'OPEX-HOUSING',
+  'OPEX-UTILITIES',
+  'UTILITIES-BILLS',
+};
+
+class PaydayOutlook {
+  /// The base is the household's monthly income (else the cycle's budgets).
+  final bool incomeBased;
+
+  /// Income for the cycle, or the total budgeted without an income.
+  final double base;
+  final double totalAllocated;
+  final double totalSpent;
+
+  /// [base] − [totalSpent]; negative when overspent.
+  final double left;
+
+  /// Days from today to the last day of the cycle, both included; 0 once the
+  /// cycle is over.
+  final int daysLeft;
+
+  /// What can be spent per day until payday: what is left, minus what is still
+  /// to pay of fixed costs, over [daysLeft]. 0 when nothing is left.
+  final double safeDaily;
+
+  final PaydayVerdict verdict;
+
+  /// When the money runs out at the current pace ([PaydayVerdict.runsOut]).
+  final DateTime? runOutDate;
+
+  const PaydayOutlook({
+    required this.incomeBased,
+    required this.base,
+    required this.totalAllocated,
+    required this.totalSpent,
+    required this.left,
+    required this.daysLeft,
+    required this.safeDaily,
+    required this.verdict,
+    this.runOutDate,
+  });
+
+  /// The selected cycle is over (a past cycle).
+  bool get isClosed => daysLeft == 0;
+
+  /// Spent ÷ base, not clamped (1.31 = 131%).
+  double get spentShare => base > 0 ? totalSpent / base : (totalSpent > 0 ? 1.0 : 0.0);
+
+  /// [today], [cycleStart] and [cycleEnd] are calendar dates (Riyadh). A
+  /// [monthlyIncome] of null or 0 falls back to the budgets as the base.
+  factory PaydayOutlook.compute({
+    required List<Budget> budgets,
+    double? monthlyIncome,
+    required DateTime today,
+    required DateTime cycleStart,
+    required DateTime cycleEnd,
+  }) {
+    DateTime day(DateTime d) => DateTime.utc(d.year, d.month, d.day);
+    final t = day(today);
+    final start = day(cycleStart);
+    final end = day(cycleEnd);
+
+    final totalAllocated = budgets.fold(0.0, (s, b) => s + b.allocatedAmount);
+    final totalSpent = budgets.fold(0.0, (s, b) => s + b.spentAmount);
+    final incomeBased = (monthlyIncome ?? 0) > 0;
+    final base = incomeBased ? monthlyIncome! : totalAllocated;
+    final left = base - totalSpent;
+
+    double variableSpent = 0;
+    double fixedStillDue = 0;
+    for (final b in budgets) {
+      if (kFixedCostCategoryCodes.contains(b.categoryCode)) {
+        final due = b.allocatedAmount - b.spentAmount;
+        if (due > 0) fixedStillDue += due;
+      } else {
+        variableSpent += b.spentAmount;
+      }
+    }
+
+    final cycleDays = end.difference(start).inDays + 1;
+    final daysLeft = t.isAfter(end) ? 0 : (end.difference(t).inDays + 1).clamp(0, cycleDays);
+    final daysElapsed = (t.difference(start).inDays + 1).clamp(1, cycleDays);
+
+    final available = left - fixedStillDue;
+    final safeDaily = daysLeft > 0 && available > 0 ? available / daysLeft : 0.0;
+
+    // Halala precision: spending exactly the base is not "over".
+    if (left <= -0.005) {
+      return PaydayOutlook(
+        incomeBased: incomeBased,
+        base: base,
+        totalAllocated: totalAllocated,
+        totalSpent: totalSpent,
+        left: left,
+        daysLeft: daysLeft,
+        safeDaily: 0,
+        verdict: PaydayVerdict.overspent,
+      );
+    }
+
+    DateTime? runOut;
+    final pace = variableSpent / daysElapsed;
+    if (daysLeft > 0 && pace > 0) {
+      final daysOfMoney = (left / pace).floor();
+      if (daysOfMoney < daysLeft) runOut = t.add(Duration(days: daysOfMoney));
+    }
+    return PaydayOutlook(
+      incomeBased: incomeBased,
+      base: base,
+      totalAllocated: totalAllocated,
+      totalSpent: totalSpent,
+      left: left,
+      daysLeft: daysLeft,
+      safeDaily: safeDaily,
+      verdict: runOut != null ? PaydayVerdict.runsOut : PaydayVerdict.onTrack,
+      runOutDate: runOut,
+    );
+  }
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/models/transaction_attribution.dart b/flutter_app/lib/models/transaction_attribution.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5f53a55
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/models/transaction_attribution.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,208 @@
+/// Who paid for an expense and for whom, exactly as the settlement engine
+/// reads it (`ai_service/settlement_engine.py`: `transaction_attribution`,
+/// `structured_attribution`). `public.transactions` has no `paid_by` or
+/// `beneficiary` column:
+/// * `spent_by` is the payer relative to the creator (`user_id`): 'me' or
+///   'partner' (never 'both' or a name);
+/// * `beneficiary_type` / `beneficiary_id` say for whom: 'household'/'household'
+///   (everyone), 'individual'/<member id> or 'dependent'/<name>;
+/// * a row from the manual sheet (`source` 'manual') carries its payer in the
+///   fixed tail of `raw_sms` ("… | PaidBy: <x> | Beneficiary: <y> | SpentBy: <z>"),
+///   read right-anchored by the server.
+library;
+
+/// Beneficiary ids meaning "the whole household" (server `_SHARED_IDS`).
+const Set<String> kSharedBeneficiaryIds = {
+  '', 'household', 'all_peers', 'all', 'both', 'shared', 'family', 'everyone',
+};
+
+const Set<String> _householdWords = {'us', 'we', 'home', 'house'};
+const Set<String> _childrenWords = {'children', 'kids', 'child', 'dependents'};
+const Set<String> _relativeTokens = {'me', 'partner', 'wife', 'spouse', 'husband', 'provider'};
+
+/// The manual-row tail the server reads the payer from (server `_MANUAL_TAIL_RE`).
+final RegExp manualTailPattern = RegExp(
+  r'\|\s*PaidBy:\s*([^|]*?)\s*\|\s*Beneficiary:\s*([^|]*?)\s*\|\s*SpentBy:\s*([^|]*?)\s*$',
+  caseSensitive: false,
+);
+
+final RegExp _uuidPattern =
+    RegExp(r'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$', caseSensitive: false);
+
+bool isMemberUuid(String value) => _uuidPattern.hasMatch(value.trim());
+
+/// A tail field: no separator or line break can shift the right-anchored match.
+String _tailField(String value) => value.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[|\r\n]'), ' ').trim();
+
+/// The `raw_sms` note of a manual row: the human-readable [head] followed by
+/// the fixed tail the server reads the payer from.
+String manualAuditNote({
+  required String head,
+  required String payer,
+  required String beneficiaryId,
+  required String spentBy,
+}) =>
+    '$head | PaidBy: ${_tailField(payer)} | Beneficiary: ${_tailField(beneficiaryId)} | SpentBy: ${_tailField(spentBy)}';
+
+/// The human-readable part of an existing note: every segment except the
+/// attribution tags (`PaidBy`, `Beneficiary`, `SpentBy`, `SubCategory`), so a
+/// rebuilt tail is never shadowed by an older one.
+String auditNoteHead(String? rawSms, {required String fallback}) {
+  final parts = (rawSms ?? '')
+      .split('|')
+      .map((p) => p.trim())
+      .where((p) => p.isNotEmpty)
+      .where((p) => !RegExp(r'^(paidby|beneficiary|spentby|subcategory)\s*:', caseSensitive: false).hasMatch(p))
+      .toList();
+  return parts.isEmpty ? fallback : parts.join(' | ');
+}
+
+/// Structured attribution columns of an expense.
+class AttributionColumns {
+  final String spentBy;
+  final String beneficiaryType;
+  final String beneficiaryId;
+
+  const AttributionColumns({required this.spentBy, required this.beneficiaryType, required this.beneficiaryId});
+
+  Map<String, String> toColumns() => {
+        'spent_by': spentBy,
+        'beneficiary_type': beneficiaryType,
+        'beneficiary_id': beneficiaryId,
+      };
+
+  @override
+  String toString() => 'AttributionColumns($spentBy, $beneficiaryType/$beneficiaryId)';
+}
+
+/// `beneficiary_type` / `beneficiary_id` for a beneficiary (server
+/// `structured_attribution`): 'both'/'household' and other shared words are
+/// the household, 'me' the creator, 'partner' [partnerId] (or the relative
+/// token, resolved by the server), 'children' the dependents, a member id an
+/// individual, anything else a dependent's name.
+({String type, String id}) beneficiaryColumns(String beneficiary, {String? creatorId, String? partnerId}) {
+  final raw = beneficiary.trim();
+  final ben = raw.toLowerCase();
+  if (kSharedBeneficiaryIds.contains(ben) || _householdWords.contains(ben)) {
+    return (type: 'household', id: 'household');
+  }
+  if (ben == 'me') {
+    final me = (creatorId ?? '').trim();
+    return (type: 'individual', id: me.isEmpty ? 'me' : me.toLowerCase());
+  }
+  if (_childrenWords.contains(ben)) return (type: 'dependent', id: 'children');
+  if (ben == 'partner') {
+    final p = (partnerId ?? '').trim();
+    return (type: 'individual', id: p.isEmpty ? 'partner' : p.toLowerCase());
+  }
+  if (_relativeTokens.contains(ben) || isMemberUuid(ben)) return (type: 'individual', id: ben);
+  final name = _tailField(raw);
+  return (type: 'dependent', id: name.length > 60 ? name.substring(0, 60) : name);
+}
+
+/// Structured columns for an expense whose [payer] ('me' | 'partner') and
+/// [beneficiary] are relative to the creator.
+AttributionColumns attributionColumns({
+  required String payer,
+  required String beneficiary,
+  String? creatorId,
+  String? partnerId,
+}) {
+  final p = payer.trim().toLowerCase();
+  if (p != 'me' && p != 'partner') {
+    throw ArgumentError.value(payer, 'payer', "must be 'me' or 'partner'");
+  }
+  final ben = beneficiaryColumns(beneficiary, creatorId: creatorId, partnerId: partnerId);
+  return AttributionColumns(spentBy: p, beneficiaryType: ben.type, beneficiaryId: ben.id);
+}
+
+/// `spent_by` / `beneficiary_type` / `beneficiary_id` for an expense the
+/// signed-in user inserts directly when the API is unreachable, exactly as
+/// the API would store it (chat and receipts: the recorder paid for the
+/// household unless the Nafaqah choice's `paid_by` / `beneficiary` say
+/// otherwise; a legacy client `spent_by` is ignored by the server too).
+Map<String, String> directInsertAttribution({String? paidBy, String? beneficiary, String? creatorId}) {
+  var payer = (paidBy ?? 'me').trim().toLowerCase();
+  if (payer != 'me' && payer != 'partner') payer = 'me';
+  final ben = (beneficiary ?? '').trim();
+  return attributionColumns(payer: payer, beneficiary: ben.isEmpty ? 'both' : ben, creatorId: creatorId).toColumns();
+}
+
+/// Tags of a note written before the structured columns: the server-authored
+/// segment (last occurrence, before the trailing item summary).
+Map<String, String> legacyAuditTags(String? rawSms) {
+  var text = rawSms ?? '';
+  final cut = text.lastIndexOf(' | Items: [');
+  if (cut != -1) text = text.substring(0, cut);
+  final tags = <String, String>{};
+  for (final part in text.split('|')) {
+    final trimmed = part.trim();
+    final low = trimmed.toLowerCase();
+    for (final tag in const ['paidby', 'beneficiary', 'spentby']) {
+      if (low.startsWith('$tag:')) tags[tag] = trimmed.substring(tag.length + 1).trim();
+    }
+  }
+  return tags;
+}
+
+/// The stored payer of a non-settlement row as the server reads it: 'me',
+/// 'partner' (relative to the creator) or, for a manual roommate row, a
+/// member id.
+String storedPayerRef(Map<String, dynamic> row) {
+  final source = (row['source'] as String? ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
+  final raw = row['raw_sms'] as String? ?? '';
+  final spentBy = (row['spent_by'] as String? ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
+  if ((row['beneficiary_id']?.toString() ?? '').trim().isNotEmpty) {
+    if (source == 'manual') {
+      final tail = manualTailPattern.firstMatch(raw);
+      final payer = tail?.group(1)?.trim().toLowerCase() ?? '';
+      return payer.isEmpty ? 'me' : payer;
+    }
+    return spentBy == 'partner' ? 'partner' : 'me';
+  }
+  var payer = (legacyAuditTags(raw)['paidby'] ?? '').toLowerCase();
+  final apiRow = source == 'chat' ||
+      source == 'receipt_scan' ||
+      raw.trimLeft().startsWith('Chat:') ||
+      raw.trimLeft().startsWith('Receipt Scan:');
+  if (apiRow && payer.isNotEmpty && payer != 'me' && payer != 'partner') payer = 'me';
+  if (payer.isEmpty) payer = (spentBy == 'me' || spentBy == 'partner') ? spentBy : 'me';
+  return payer;
+}
+
+/// Who 'partner' is for a member, from what the app knows of the household:
+/// the other member of a two-member household, or in a family the spouse
+/// (the husband and his only wife). Mirrors the server's `counterpart_id`.
+class HouseholdRelations {
+  final List<String> memberIds;
+  final String? husbandId;
+  final List<String> wifeIds;
+
+  /// Whether [memberIds] is the complete roster (the two-member rule applies).
+  final bool rosterComplete;
+
+  HouseholdRelations({
+    List<String> memberIds = const [],
+    this.husbandId,
+    List<String> wifeIds = const [],
+    this.rosterComplete = false,
+  })  : memberIds = memberIds.map((m) => m.toLowerCase()).toList(),
+        wifeIds = wifeIds.map((w) => w.toLowerCase()).toList();
+
+  bool get isFamily => wifeIds.isNotEmpty;
+
+  /// The member 'partner' names for [member], or null when it names nobody.
+  String? counterpartOf(String? member) {
+    final me = (member ?? '').toLowerCase();
+    if (me.isEmpty) return null;
+    if (rosterComplete && memberIds.length == 2 && memberIds.contains(me)) {
+      return memberIds.firstWhere((m) => m != me);
+    }
+    final husband = (husbandId ?? '').toLowerCase();
+    if (isFamily && husband.isNotEmpty) {
+      if (me == husband && wifeIds.length == 1) return wifeIds.single;
+      if (wifeIds.contains(me)) return husband;
+    }
+    return null;
+  }
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/providers/budget_provider.dart b/flutter_app/lib/providers/budget_provider.dart
index cd3e1b9..8395b14 100644
--- a/flutter_app/lib/providers/budget_provider.dart
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/providers/budget_provider.dart
@@ -2,16 +2,25 @@ import 'dart:async';
 import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
 import '../models/models.dart';
 import '../services/api_service.dart';
+import '../services/salary_cycle_service.dart';
 
-/// Centralized reactive state provider for salary cycle budgets, forecasts, and sub-budget allocations.
+/// Centralized reactive state provider for salary cycle budgets and sub-budget allocations.
+///
+/// The pace and verdict shown on the dashboard come from one place only,
+/// [PaydayOutlook] (UX-07); the server burn-rate forecast is not fetched.
 class BudgetProvider extends ChangeNotifier {
   String? _householdId;
   List<SalaryCycleInfo> _cycles = [];
   int _selectedCycleIndex = 0;
   List<CategoryBreakdownItem> _categories = [];
-  Map<String, dynamic> _forecast = {};
   bool _isLoading = false;
   String? _error;
+  int _breakdownGeneration = 0;
+  final ApiService? _apiOverride;
+
+  BudgetProvider({ApiService? api}) : _apiOverride = api;
+

diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/providers/household_role_provider.dart b/flutter_app/lib/providers/household_role_provider.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a547785
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/providers/household_role_provider.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,112 @@
+import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
+import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
+import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
+
+import '../models/models.dart';
+import '../services/api_service.dart';
+import '../services/household_permissions.dart';
+
+typedef MembershipsLoader = Future<List<HouseholdMembership>> Function();
+typedef CurrentUserIdReader = String? Function();
+
+/// Whether the signed-in user is an admin of [householdId] according to the
+/// [HouseholdRoleProvider] above [context]; false without one, while it is
+/// loading, or for another household. Never subscribes (safe in initState).
+bool viewerIsAdminOf(BuildContext context, String? householdId) {
+  try {
+    final roles = Provider.of<HouseholdRoleProvider>(context, listen: false);
+    if (!roles.isLoaded) return false;
+    if (householdId != null && householdId.isNotEmpty && roles.householdId != householdId) return false;
+    return roles.isAdmin;
+  } on ProviderNotFoundException {
+    return false;
+  }
+}
+
+/// The signed-in user's role in the active household (admin / member, and
+/// whether they are the primary admin), used to show only the actions the
+/// server will accept: editing or deleting other members' transactions and
+/// moving money out of shared pools are admin-only (DB-16 / DB-18).
+class HouseholdRoleProvider extends ChangeNotifier {
+  HouseholdRoleProvider({MembershipsLoader? loadMemberships, CurrentUserIdReader? currentUserId})
+      : _loadMemberships = loadMemberships ?? (() => ApiService.instance.budget.getUserHouseholds()),
+        _currentUserId = currentUserId ?? _supabaseUserId;
+
+  final MembershipsLoader _loadMemberships;
+  final CurrentUserIdReader _currentUserId;
+
+  String? _householdId;
+  String _role = 'member';
+  bool _isPrimary = false;
+  bool _isLoaded = false;
+  int _generation = 0;
+
+  String? get householdId => _householdId;
+  String get role => _role;
+  bool get isAdmin => _role == 'admin';
+  bool get isPrimary => _isPrimary;
+  bool get isLoaded => _isLoaded;
+  String? get currentUserId => _currentUserId();
+
+  static String? _supabaseUserId() {
+    try {
+      return Supabase.instance.client.auth.currentUser?.id;
+    } catch (_) {
+      return null;
+    }
+  }
+
+  /// Loads the role for [householdId] (the active household).
+  Future<void> load(String householdId) async {
+    if (_householdId != householdId) {
+      _householdId = householdId;
+      _role = 'member';
+      _isPrimary = false;
+      _isLoaded = false;
+      notifyListeners();
+    }
+    await refresh();
+  }
+
+  /// Re-reads the role from the server; keeps the last known role when offline.
+  Future<void> refresh() async {
+    final generation = ++_generation;
+    List<HouseholdMembership> memberships;
+    try {
+      memberships = await _loadMemberships();
+    } catch (_) {
+      return;
+    }
+    if (generation != _generation || memberships.isEmpty) return;
+
+    HouseholdMembership? match;
+    for (final m in memberships) {
+      if (_householdId != null ? m.householdId == _householdId : m.isActive) {
+        match = m;
+        break;
+      }
+    }
+    if (match == null) return;
+    _householdId = match.householdId;
+    _role = match.isAdmin ? 'admin' : 'member';
+    _isPrimary = match.isPrimary;
+    _isLoaded = true;
+    notifyListeners();
+  }
+
+  void reset() {
+    _generation++;
+    _householdId = null;
+    _role = 'member';
+    _isPrimary = false;
+    _isLoaded = false;
+    notifyListeners();
+  }
+
+  /// Whether the signed-in user may edit or delete [tx].
+  bool canModify(Transaction tx) => HouseholdPermissions.canModifyTransaction(
+        currentUserId: currentUserId,
+        creatorUserId: tx.userId,
+        isAdmin: isAdmin && (_householdId == null || tx.householdId == _householdId),
+      );
+}

+  /// The wife a Nafaqah class refers to.
+  String? get _classSpouseId => _spouseRole == 'wife'
+      ? _nafaqah?.callerUserId
+      : (_storedSpouseId ?? _nafaqah?.primaryWife?.id);
+
+  /// Payer to write: the `raw_sms` tail value (a manual row may name a member)
+  /// and `spent_by` ('me' | 'partner', relative to the creator). Null when it
+  /// cannot be expressed for the creator.
+  ({String tail, String spentBy})? _resolvedPayer() {
+    if (!_payerTouched) {
+      final stored = (widget.transaction.payerRef ?? widget.transaction.paidBy).toLowerCase();
+      if (stored == 'me' || stored == 'partner') return (tail: stored, spentBy: stored);
+      return (tail: stored, spentBy: _creatorRelative(stored) ?? (stored == _creatorId ? 'me' : 'partner'));
+    }
+    String? member;
+    final cls = _nafaqahClass;
+    if (_canClassify && cls != null) {
+      member = _classSpouseId; // the wife paid (rules 2 and 3)
+    } else if (_canClassify && _spouseRole != null) {
+      member = _relations.husbandId; // the husband paid (rule 4)
+    }
+    if (member == null && _viewerIsCreator) {
+      return (tail: _selectedPaidBy, spentBy: _selectedPaidBy);
+    }
+    member ??= _memberOfViewerToken(_selectedPaidBy);
+    final relative = _creatorRelative(member, spouseId: cls != null ? _classSpouseId : null);
+    if (relative != null) return (tail: relative, spentBy: relative);
+    // A manual row's note may name the paying member; spent_by stays relative.
+    if (member != null && _isStoredManual) return (tail: member, spentBy: 'partner');
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  /// `beneficiary_type` / `beneficiary_id` to write, or null when the
+  /// beneficiary cannot be named.
+  ({String type, String id})? _resolvedBeneficiary() {
+    final tx = widget.transaction;
+    if (!_beneficiaryTouched && (tx.beneficiaryId ?? '').trim().isNotEmpty) {
+      return (type: tx.beneficiaryType ?? 'household', id: tx.beneficiaryId!.trim());
+    }
+    final cls = _nafaqahClass;
+    if (_canClassify && cls == kWifeReimbursable) return (type: 'household', id: 'household');
+    final wife = _classSpouseId;
+    if (_canClassify && cls == kWifePersonal && wife != null) return (type: 'individual', id: wife.toLowerCase());
+    final ben = _selectedBeneficiary;
+    if (ben != 'me' && ben != 'partner') return beneficiaryColumns(ben, creatorId: _creatorId);
+    if (_viewerIsCreator) {
+      return beneficiaryColumns(ben, creatorId: _creatorId, partnerId: _relations.counterpartOf(_creatorId));
+    }
+    final member = _memberOfViewerToken(ben);
+    return member == null ? null : (type: 'individual', id: member);
+  }
+
+  /// The structured columns (and, for a manual row, the rebuilt note tail)
+  /// for a changed attribution; null when it cannot be expressed.
+  Map<String, dynamic>? _attributionPayload(String merchant) {
+    final payer = _resolvedPayer();
+    final ben = _resolvedBeneficiary();
+    if (payer == null || ben == null) return null;
+    return {
+      'spent_by': payer.spentBy,
+      'beneficiary_type': ben.type,
+      'beneficiary_id': ben.id,
+      // The server reads a manual row's payer from the end of its note.
+      if (_isStoredManual)

+          head: auditNoteHead(widget.transaction.rawSms, fallback: 'Manual: $merchant'),
+          payer: payer.tail,
+          beneficiaryId: ben.id,
+          spentBy: payer.spentBy,
+        ),
+    };
+  }
+
+  // ── Family mode (Islamic Nafaqah: no spousal split) ────────────────────────
+
+  bool get _isFamily => _nafaqah?.isFamily ?? false;
+
+  /// 'wife' | 'husband' when the viewer is one of the spouses of a family household.
+  String? get _spouseRole {
+    final role = _isFamily ? _nafaqah!.callerRole : null;
+    return (role == 'wife' || role == 'husband') ? role : null;
+  }
+
+  /// Only the wife, the Nafaqah provider (husband) or an admin classifies.
+  bool get _canClassify => _isFamily && (_spouseRole != null || _isAdmin);
+
+  String? get _nafaqahClass {
+    if (!_canClassify) return null;
+    if (_spouseRole == null) return _adminClass;
+    return classifyNafaqah(_spouseRole, _selectedPaidBy, _selectedBeneficiary);
+  }
+
+  /// Maps the Nafaqah choice onto the viewer-relative payer / beneficiary.
+  void _applyNafaqahChoice(String? nafaqahClass) {
+    if (_spouseRole == null) {
+      _adminClass = nafaqahClass;
+      if (nafaqahClass == kWifeReimbursable) _selectedBeneficiary = 'both';
+      return;
+    }
+    final wifeSide = _spouseRole == 'wife' ? 'me' : 'partner';
+    final husbandSide = _spouseRole == 'wife' ? 'partner' : 'me';
+    if (nafaqahClass == kWifeReimbursable) {
+      _selectedPaidBy = wifeSide;
+      _selectedBeneficiary = 'both';
+    } else if (nafaqahClass == kWifePersonal) {
+      _selectedPaidBy = wifeSide;
+      _selectedBeneficiary = wifeSide;
+    } else {
+      _selectedPaidBy = husbandSide;
+      if (classifyNafaqah(_spouseRole, _selectedPaidBy, _selectedBeneficiary) != null) {
+        _selectedBeneficiary = 'both';
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  Future<void> _loadNafaqah() async {
+    try {
+      final loader = widget.loadNafaqah ?? ApiService.instance.getNafaqahSummary;
+      final summary = await loader(widget.transaction.householdId);
+      if (!mounted) return;
+      setState(() => _nafaqah = summary);
+      await _loadStoredNafaqah();
+    } catch (_) {}
+  }
+
+  /// The stored class is authoritative in family mode. `paid_by` /
+  /// `beneficiary` are relative to whoever recorded the row ('me' is the
+  /// recorder), so on another spouse's phone they cannot tell who paid: a
+  /// stored "no class" is the husband's household expense (FR-A-01), and a
+  /// stored class keeps the wife's claim when the husband edits it.
+  Future<void> _loadStoredNafaqah() async {
+    if (!_canClassify) return;
+    final tx = widget.transaction;
+    try {
+      // The feed row already carries the class (UX-23): no second read.
+      final Map<String, dynamic>? fields;
+      if (tx.hasNafaqahFields) {
+        fields = {'nafaqah_class': tx.nafaqahClass, 'nafaqah_spouse_id': tx.nafaqahSpouseId};
+      } else {
+        final loader = widget.loadNafaqahFields ??
+            (String id) => supabase.from('transactions').select('nafaqah_class, nafaqah_spouse_id').eq('id', id).maybeSingle();
+        fields = await loader(tx.id);
+      }
+      if (!mounted) return;
+      if (fields == null) {
+        // No readable row: nothing stored to keep; the choice follows the entry.
+        setState(() {
+          _storedNafaqahLoaded = true;
+          _storedNafaqahFailed = false;
+        });
+        return;
+      }
+      final stored = fields['nafaqah_class'] as String?;
+      setState(() {
+        _storedSpouseId = fields!['nafaqah_spouse_id'] as String?;
+        _applyNafaqahChoice(stored == kWifeReimbursable || stored == kWifePersonal ? stored : null);
+        _storedNafaqahLoaded = true;
+        _storedNafaqahFailed = false;
+      });
+    } catch (_) {
+      if (mounted) setState(() => _storedNafaqahFailed = true);
+    }
+  }
+
+  /// The wife the Nafaqah choice names, by display name (UX-03).
+  String? get _classWifeName {
+    final id = _classSpouseId?.toLowerCase();
+    for (final w in _nafaqah?.wives ?? const <NafaqahWife>[]) {
+      if (w.id.toLowerCase() == id) {
+        final n = (w.displayName ?? '').trim();
+        return n.isEmpty ? null : n;
+      }
+    }
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  /// The Nafaqah question, or a placeholder until the stored class is known
+  /// (UX-23: never a default class that may be wrong).
+  Widget _buildNafaqahChoice() {
+    if (_storedNafaqahFailed) {
+      return Container(
+        key: const ValueKey('nafaqah_class_failed'),
+        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
+        decoration: BoxDecoration(
+          color: context.subtleCardBg,
+          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
+          border: Border.all(color: context.borderColor),
+        ),
+        child: Row(
+          children: [
+            Icon(Icons.error_outline_rounded, size: 18, color: context.warnText),
+            const SizedBox(width: 8),
+            Expanded(
+              child: Text(
+                context.tr('nafaqah_class_load_failed'),
+                style: TextStyle(color: context.textPrimary, fontSize: 13),
+              ),
+            ),
+            TextButton(
+              key: const ValueKey('nafaqah_class_retry'),
+              onPressed: () {
+                setState(() => _storedNafaqahFailed = false);
+                _loadStoredNafaqah();
+              },
+              child: Text(context.tr('try_again')),

+      );
+    }
+    if (!_storedNafaqahLoaded) {
+      return Semantics(
+        label: context.tr('nafaqah_class_loading'),
+        child: Container(
+          key: const ValueKey('nafaqah_class_loading'),
+          height: 160,
+          decoration: BoxDecoration(
+            color: context.subtleCardBg,
+            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
+            border: Border.all(color: context.borderColor),
+          ),
+        ),
+      );
+    }
+    return NafaqahClassSelector(
+      value: _nafaqahClass,
+      viewerRole: _spouseRole ?? 'admin',
+      wifeName: _spouseRole == 'wife' ? null : _classWifeName,
+      husbandName: _nafaqah?.husbandName,
+      onChanged: (cls) {

+        setState(() {

+          _payerTouched = true;
+          _beneficiaryTouched = true;
+        });
+      },
+    );
+  }

+  Map<String, dynamic> _nafaqahPayload() {

+      return const {'nafaqah_class': null, 'nafaqah_spouse_id': null};
+    }
+    return {'nafaqah_class': cls, 'nafaqah_spouse_id': spouseId};

+  void _exportCsv(BuildContext context) {
+    final rows = context.read<TransactionProvider>().transactions;
+    if (rows.isEmpty) return;
+    final exportList = rows
+        .map((t) => {
+              'id': t.id,
+              'amount': t.amount,
+              'currency': t.currency,
+              'merchant': t.merchant,
+              'category_code': t.categoryCode,
+              'timestamp': t.timestamp.toIso8601String(),
+              'source': t.source,
+              'spent_by': t.spentBy,
+              'raw_sms': t.rawSms,
+            })
+        .toList();
+    CsvExportService.showExportDialog(context, exportList, monthLabel: 'All Records');
+  }
+
+  /// MOB-26: downloads the statement with the user's JWT and opens the system
+  /// share sheet (open in a PDF viewer, save to Files/Drive, send). The old
+  /// flow showed a bare URL that the backend firewall rejected without auth.
+  Future<void> _exportStatementPdf(BuildContext context) async {
+    final user = supabase.auth.currentUser;
+    if (user == null || _exportingPdf) return;
+
+    final confirmed = await showDialog<bool>(
+      context: context,
+      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
+        backgroundColor: context.cardBg,
+        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16)),
+        title: Row(
+          children: [
+            const Icon(Icons.picture_as_pdf_rounded, color: Color(0xFFE24A4A), size: 22),
+            const SizedBox(width: 10),
+            Expanded(
+              child: Text(
+                context.tr('monthly_statement_pdf'),
+                style: GoogleFonts.outfit(color: context.textPrimary, fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
+              ),
+            ),
+          ],
+        ),
+        content: Text(
+          context.tr('pdf_statement_desc'),
+          style: TextStyle(color: context.textSecondary, fontSize: 13),
+        ),
+        actions: [
+          TextButton(
+            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
+            child: Text(context.tr('close'), style: TextStyle(color: context.textSecondary)),
+          ),
+          ElevatedButton.icon(
+            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
+              backgroundColor: AppThemes.success,
+              foregroundColor: Colors.black,
+            ),
+            icon: const Icon(Icons.ios_share_rounded, size: 16),
+            label: Text(context.tr('pdf_download_share'), style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
+            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
+          ),
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+    if (confirmed != true || !context.mounted) return;
+
+    setState(() => _exportingPdf = true);
+    AppSnackBar.showInfo(
+      context,
+      context.tr('pdf_preparing_msg'),
+      title: context.tr('pdf_preparing'),
+      icon: Icons.picture_as_pdf_rounded,
+      duration: const Duration(seconds: 20),
+    );
+    try {
+      final prof = await supabase.from('users').select('household_id').eq('id', user.id).single();
+      final hid = prof['household_id'] as String?;
+      if (hid == null) {
+        throw const ApiDownloadException('No active household');
+      }
+      await StatementPdfService().downloadAndShare(hid);
+      if (context.mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.maybeOf(context)?.hideCurrentSnackBar();
+    } catch (e) {
+      debugPrint('[TransactionFeed] Statement PDF export failed: $e');
+      if (context.mounted) {
+        AppSnackBar.showError(
+          context,
+          context.tr('pdf_download_failed_msg'),
+          title: context.tr('pdf_download_failed'),
+        );
+      }
+    } finally {
+      if (mounted) setState(() => _exportingPdf = false);
+    }
+  }

+  /// Language toggle used by the support assistant. Language names are shown
+  /// as endonyms (each in its own script) so they are recognisable in any UI
+  /// language; the pill exposes button/selected semantics for screen readers.
+  Widget _buildLanguagePill(String code, String text, String semanticLabel) {
+    final selected = _selectedLanguage == code;
+    return Semantics(
+      button: true,
+      selected: selected,
+      label: semanticLabel,
+      excludeSemantics: true,
+      child: InkWell(
+        onTap: () => _onLanguageChanged(code),
+        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
+        child: Container(
+          constraints: const BoxConstraints(minHeight: 32),
+          alignment: Alignment.center,
+          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
+          decoration: BoxDecoration(
+            color: selected ? AppThemes.success : Colors.transparent,
+            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
+          ),
+          child: Text(
+            text,
+            style: TextStyle(
+              color: selected ? Colors.black : context.textSecondary,
+              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
+              fontSize: 11,
+            ),
+          ),
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+  }

+
+/// Composer that emails the developer via POST /support/inquiries. It reports
+/// success only when the server confirms delivery; on failure it keeps the
+/// text and offers the manual email fallback.
+class _DeveloperInquiryDialog extends StatefulWidget {
+  final String initialMessage;
+  final String locale;
+  final String? householdId;
+  final SupportApiClient client;
+  final String developerEmail;
+  final String Function(String issueSummary) diagnostics;
+
+  const _DeveloperInquiryDialog({
+    required this.initialMessage,
+    required this.locale,
+    required this.householdId,
+    required this.client,
+    required this.developerEmail,
+    required this.diagnostics,
   });
+
+  @override
+  State<_DeveloperInquiryDialog> createState() => _DeveloperInquiryDialogState();
+}
+
+class _DeveloperInquiryDialogState extends State<_DeveloperInquiryDialog> {
+  late final TextEditingController _controller =
+      TextEditingController(text: widget.initialMessage);
+  bool _sending = false;
+  String? _error;
+  bool _offerFallback = false;
+
+  @override
+  void dispose() {
+    _controller.dispose();
+    super.dispose();
+  }
+
+  Future<void> _send() async {
+    final text = _controller.text.trim();
+    if (_sending) return;
+    if (text.isEmpty) {
+      setState(() {
+        _error = context.tr('support_inquiry_empty');
+        _offerFallback = false;
+      });
+      return;
+    }
+    setState(() {
+      _sending = true;
+      _error = null;
+    });
+    final result = await widget.client.sendSupportInquiry(
+      message: text,
+      locale: widget.locale,
+      householdId: widget.householdId,
+    );
+    if (!mounted) return;
+    if (result.isSent) {
+      Navigator.of(context).pop(result);
+      return;
+    }
+    setState(() {
+      _sending = false;
+      _offerFallback = result.outcome == SupportInquiryOutcome.unavailable ||
+          result.outcome == SupportInquiryOutcome.network;
+      _error = switch (result.outcome) {
+        SupportInquiryOutcome.unauthorized => context.tr('support_inquiry_err_auth'),
+        SupportInquiryOutcome.rateLimited => context.tr('support_inquiry_err_rate'),
+        SupportInquiryOutcome.network => context.tr('support_inquiry_err_network'),
+        _ => context.trArgs('support_inquiry_err_unavailable', {'email': widget.developerEmail}),
+      };
+    });
+  }
+
+  void _copyDiagnostics() {
+    final text = _controller.text.trim();
+    Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(
+      text: widget.diagnostics(text.isEmpty ? widget.initialMessage : text),
+    ));
+    AppSnackBar.showSuccess(
+      context,
+      context.tr('support_diag_copied'),
+      title: context.tr('set_copied'),
+      icon: Icons.copy_rounded,
+    );
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    return AlertDialog(
+      backgroundColor: context.cardBg,
+      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
+        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
+        side: BorderSide(color: context.borderColor),
+      ),
+      title: Row(
+        children: [
+          const Icon(Icons.mail_rounded, color: AppThemes.success, size: 24),
+          const SizedBox(width: 10),
+          Expanded(
+            child: Text(context.tr('support_inquiry_title'),
+                style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
+                    color: context.textPrimary, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
+          ),
+        ],
+      ),
+      content: SingleChildScrollView(
+        child: Column(
+          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
+          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
+          children: [
+            Text(
+              context.tr('support_inquiry_desc'),
+              style: GoogleFonts.outfit(color: context.textSecondary, fontSize: 12.5),
+            ),
+            const SizedBox(height: 12),
+            TextField(
+              key: const ValueKey('support-inquiry-message'),
+              controller: _controller,
+              enabled: !_sending,
+              minLines: 4,
+              maxLines: 8,
+              maxLength: SupportApiClient.maxInquiryLength,
+              textInputAction: TextInputAction.newline,
+              style: GoogleFonts.outfit(color: context.textPrimary, fontSize: 13.5),
+              decoration: InputDecoration(
+                hintText: context.tr('support_inquiry_hint'),
+                filled: true,
+                fillColor: context.subtleCardBg,
+                border: OutlineInputBorder(
+                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
+                  borderSide: BorderSide(color: context.borderColor),
+                ),
+              ),
+            ),
+            if (_error != null) ...[
+              const SizedBox(height: 4),
+              Semantics(
+                liveRegion: true,
+                child: Container(
+                  width: double.infinity,
+                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
+                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
+                    color: context.dangerColor.withValues(alpha: 0.08),
+                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
+                    border: Border.all(color: context.dangerColor.withValues(alpha: 0.4)),
+                  ),
+                  child: Text(
+                    _error!,
+                    style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
+                        color: context.textPrimary, fontSize: 12.5, height: 1.4),
+                  ),
+                ),
+              ),
+            ],
+          ],
+        ),
+      ),
+      actions: [
+        if (_offerFallback)
+          TextButton(
+            onPressed: _copyDiagnostics,
+            child: Text(context.tr('support_copy_diag'),
+                style: TextStyle(color: context.successText)),
+          ),
+        TextButton(
+          onPressed: _sending ? null : () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
+          child: Text(context.tr('cancel'),
+              style: TextStyle(color: context.textSecondary)),
+        ),
+        ElevatedButton.icon(
+          key: const ValueKey('support-inquiry-send'),
+          style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
+            backgroundColor: AppThemes.success,
+            foregroundColor: Colors.black,
+          ),
+          onPressed: _sending ? null : _send,
+          icon: _sending
+              ? const SizedBox(
+                  width: 14,
+                  height: 14,
+                  child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: Colors.black),
+                )
+              : const Icon(Icons.send_rounded, size: 16),
+          label: Text(
+            _sending ? context.tr('support_inquiry_sending') : context.tr('support_inquiry_send'),
+            style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
+          ),
+        ),
+      ],
+    );
+  }
 }
