diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/screens/tools/tools_screen.dart b/flutter_app/lib/screens/tools/tools_screen.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..60b629e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/screens/tools/tools_screen.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,206 @@
+/// Tools: the secondary features that used to crowd the dashboard and the
+/// speed dial (R3). Each one has exactly one entry point here.
+library;
+
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';
+
+import '../../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import '../../theme/app_themes.dart';
+import '../../widgets/accounts/account_transfer_sheet.dart';
+import '../../widgets/accounts/record_income_sheet.dart';
+import '../../widgets/analytics/smart_shopping_basket_sheet.dart';
+import '../../widgets/dashboard/accounts_summary_card.dart';
+import '../../widgets/simulator/affordability_simulator_sheet.dart';
+import '../accounts/accounts_overview_screen.dart';
+import '../analytics/grocery_price_intelligence_screen.dart';
+import '../scanner/batch_receipt_scanner_screen.dart';
+
+class ToolsScreen extends StatelessWidget {
+  final String householdId;
+
+  const ToolsScreen({super.key, required this.householdId});
+
+  static Future<void> open(BuildContext context, {required String householdId}) {
+    return Navigator.push(
+      context,
+      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => ToolsScreen(householdId: householdId)),
+    );
+  }
+
+  void _push(BuildContext context, Widget screen) {
+    Navigator.push(context, MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => screen));
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final tools = <_Tool>[
+      _Tool(
+        key: 'tool_affordability',
+        icon: Icons.calculate_outlined,
+        color: AppThemes.champagneGold,
+        title: context.tr('affordability_simulator'),
+        subtitle: context.tr('tool_affordability_desc'),
+        onTap: () => AffordabilitySimulatorSheet.show(context, householdId: householdId),
+      ),
+      _Tool(
+        key: 'tool_accounts',
+        icon: Icons.account_balance_wallet_outlined,
+        color: AppThemes.iceCyan,
+        title: context.tr('accounts_balances'),
+        subtitle: context.tr('tool_accounts_desc'),
+        onTap: () => _push(context, AccountsOverviewScreen(householdId: householdId)),
+      ),
+      _Tool(
+        key: 'tool_record_income',
+        icon: Icons.savings_rounded,
+        color: AppThemes.success,
+        title: context.tr('record_income'),
+        subtitle: context.tr('tool_record_income_desc'),
+        onTap: () => RecordIncomeSheet.show(context, householdId: householdId),
+      ),
+      _Tool(
+        key: 'tool_transfer',
+        icon: Icons.swap_horiz_rounded,
+        color: AppThemes.iceCyan,
+        title: context.tr('transfer_funds'),
+        subtitle: context.tr('tool_transfer_desc'),
+        onTap: () => AccountTransferSheet.show(context, householdId: householdId),
+      ),
+      _Tool(
+        key: 'tool_batch_scan',
+        icon: Icons.dynamic_feed_rounded,
+        color: AppThemes.electricTeal,
+        title: context.tr('batch_scan_receipts'),
+        subtitle: context.tr('tool_batch_scan_desc'),
+        onTap: () => _push(context, BatchReceiptScannerScreen(householdId: householdId)),
+      ),
+      _Tool(
+        key: 'tool_price_tracker',
+        icon: Icons.trending_up_rounded,
+        color: AppThemes.mintNeon,
+        title: context.tr('price_tracker'),
+        subtitle: context.tr('tool_price_tracker_desc'),
+        onTap: () => _push(context, GroceryPriceIntelligenceScreen(householdId: householdId)),
+      ),
+      _Tool(
+        key: 'tool_smart_basket',
+        icon: Icons.shopping_basket_outlined,
+        color: AppThemes.mintNeon,
+        title: context.tr('smart_basket_optimizer'),
+        subtitle: context.tr('tool_smart_basket_desc'),
+        onTap: () => SmartShoppingBasketSheet.show(context, householdId: householdId),
+      ),
+    ];
+
+    return Scaffold(
+      backgroundColor: context.scaffoldBg,
+      appBar: AppBar(
+        title: Text(
+          context.tr('tools_title'),
+          style: GoogleFonts.outfit(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: context.textPrimary),
+        ),
+      ),
+      body: ListView(
+        padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(16, 8, 16, 32),
+        children: [
+          Text(
+            context.tr('tools_desc'),
+            style: GoogleFonts.outfit(fontSize: 12.5, color: context.textSecondary),
+          ),
+          const SizedBox(height: 12),
+          // The balances summary (on the dashboard only with 2+ accounts).
+          AccountsSummaryCard(householdId: householdId),
+          const SizedBox(height: 12),
+          for (final tool in tools) ...[
+            _ToolTile(tool: tool),
+            const SizedBox(height: 10),
+          ],
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}
+
+class _Tool {
+  final String key;
+  final IconData icon;
+  final Color color;
+  final String title;
+  final String subtitle;
+  final VoidCallback onTap;
+
+  const _Tool({
+    required this.key,
+    required this.icon,
+    required this.color,
+    required this.title,
+    required this.subtitle,
+    required this.onTap,
+  });
+}
+
+class _ToolTile extends StatelessWidget {
+  final _Tool tool;
+
+  const _ToolTile({required this.tool});
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    return Material(
+      color: context.cardBg,
+      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
+      child: InkWell(
+        key: ValueKey(tool.key),
+        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
+        onTap: tool.onTap,
+        child: Container(
+          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
+          decoration: BoxDecoration(
+            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
+            border: Border.all(color: context.borderColor),
+          ),
+          child: Row(
+            children: [
+              Container(
+                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(9),
+                decoration: BoxDecoration(
+                  color: tool.color.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
+                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
+                ),
+                child: Icon(tool.icon, color: tool.color, size: 20),
+              ),
+              const SizedBox(width: 12),
+              Expanded(
+                child: Column(
+                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
+                  children: [
+                    Text(
+                      tool.title,
+                      style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
+                        color: context.textPrimary,
+                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
+                        fontSize: 14,
+                      ),
+                    ),
+                    const SizedBox(height: 2),
+                    Text(
+                      tool.subtitle,
+                      style: TextStyle(color: context.textSecondary, fontSize: 11.5),
+                    ),
+                  ],
+                ),
+              ),
+              Icon(
+                Directionality.of(context) == TextDirection.rtl
+                    ? Icons.chevron_left_rounded
+                    : Icons.chevron_right_rounded,
+                color: context.textSecondary,
+              ),
+            ],
+          ),
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,105 @@
+import '../../models/household_membership.dart';
+import 'base_api_client.dart';
+
+/// Members, co-admins and the primary admin of a household.
+///
+/// Every write is checked by the backend with the caller's JWT (admins only;
+/// transferring primary admin is for the primary admin only) and re-checked
+/// by the database RPCs. Each call throws [HouseholdRolesApiException] when the
+/// server refuses, so the UI never shows a role change that did not happen.
+class HouseholdRolesApiClient {
+  final BaseApiClient baseClient;
+
+  HouseholdRolesApiClient({BaseApiClient? baseClient}) : baseClient = baseClient ?? BaseApiClient();
+
+  static Map<String, dynamic> _ok(Map<String, dynamic> res) {
+    if (res['status'] == 'error') throw HouseholdRolesApiException.fromResponse(res);
+    return res;
+  }
+
+  Future<HouseholdRoster> fetchMembers(String householdId) async {
+    final res = await baseClient.get('/households/$householdId/members');
+    return HouseholdRoster.fromMap(_ok(res));
+  }
+
+  Future<HouseholdRoster> promoteToAdmin(String householdId, String userId) async {
+    final res = await baseClient.post('/households/$householdId/members/$userId/admin', const {}, shouldSign: false);
+    return HouseholdRoster.fromMap(_ok(res));
+  }
+
+  Future<HouseholdRoster> revokeAdmin(String householdId, String userId) async {
+    final res = await baseClient.delete('/households/$householdId/members/$userId/admin');
+    return HouseholdRoster.fromMap(_ok(res));
+  }
+
+  /// `PUT /households/{id}/type`: an admin changes the household type
+  /// ('family' | 'roommates'). Returns the type the server stored.
+  Future<String> setHouseholdType(String householdId, String householdType) async {
+    final res = await baseClient.put('/households/$householdId/type', body: {'household_type': householdType});
+    return (_ok(res)['household_type'] as String?) ?? householdType;
+  }
+
+  /// `PUT /households/{id}/members/{user_id}/financial-role`: an admin changes
+  /// a member's financial role. Returns the role the server stored.
+  Future<String> setFinancialRole(String householdId, String userId, String financialRole) async {
+    final res = await baseClient.put(
+      '/households/$householdId/members/$userId/financial-role',
+      body: {'financial_role': financialRole},
+    );
+    return (_ok(res)['financial_role'] as String?) ?? financialRole;
+  }
+
+  Future<HouseholdRoster> transferPrimaryAdmin(String householdId, String newPrimaryUserId) async {
+    final res = await baseClient.post(
+      '/households/$householdId/primary-admin',
+      {'new_primary_user_id': newPrimaryUserId},
+      shouldSign: false,
+    );
+    return HouseholdRoster.fromMap(_ok(res));
+  }
+}
+
+/// A refused or failed role request. [code] is `forbidden` (403),
+/// `not_found` (404), the server's `detail.code` for a 409 (e.g.
+/// `type_change_blocked`), else `last_admin` (409), `invalid` (422 / 400) or
+/// `network` (anything else). [serverMessage] is the server's own
+/// explanation from `detail.message`, when it sent one.
+class HouseholdRolesApiException implements Exception {
+  final String code;
+  final String message;
+  final int? statusCode;
+  final String? serverMessage;
+
+  const HouseholdRolesApiException(this.code, this.message, {this.statusCode, this.serverMessage});
+
+  factory HouseholdRolesApiException.fromResponse(Map<String, dynamic> res) {
+    final status = (res['status_code'] as num?)?.toInt();
+    final message = res['message']?.toString() ?? '';
+    final detail = res['detail'];
+    final detailCode = detail is Map ? detail['code']?.toString() : null;
+    final detailMessage = detail is Map ? detail['message']?.toString() : (detail is String ? detail : null);
+    final String code;
+    switch (status) {
+      case 403:
+        code = 'forbidden';
+      case 404:
+        code = 'not_found';
+      case 409:
+        code = (detailCode != null && detailCode.isNotEmpty) ? detailCode : 'last_admin';
+      case 400:
+      case 422:
+        code = 'invalid';
+      default:
+        code = 'network';
+    }
+    return HouseholdRolesApiException(
+      code,
+      message,
+      statusCode: status,
+      serverMessage: (detailMessage != null && detailMessage.trim().isNotEmpty) ? detailMessage.trim() : null,
+    );
+  }
+
+  @override
+  String toString() => message.isEmpty ? code : message;
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/services/api/nafaqah_api_client.dart b/flutter_app/lib/services/api/nafaqah_api_client.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..66b5bff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/services/api/nafaqah_api_client.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,81 @@
+import '../../models/nafaqah.dart';
+import 'base_api_client.dart';
+
+/// Family Nafaqah endpoints: the husband-owes-wife ledger and the wife's
+/// personal allowance. Every call throws [NafaqahApiException] when the
+/// server rejects it, so the UI never reports a write that did not happen.
+class NafaqahApiClient {
+  final BaseApiClient baseClient;
+
+  NafaqahApiClient({BaseApiClient? baseClient}) : baseClient = baseClient ?? BaseApiClient();
+
+  static Map<String, dynamic> _ok(Map<String, dynamic> res) {
+    if (res['status'] == 'error') throw NafaqahApiException.fromResponse(res);
+    return res;
+  }
+
+  Future<NafaqahSummary> fetchSummary({required String householdId, String? cycleKey}) async {
+    final res = await baseClient.get(
+      '/households/$householdId/nafaqah',
+      queryParams: {if (cycleKey != null && cycleKey.isNotEmpty) 'cycle_key': cycleKey},
+    );
+    return NafaqahSummary.fromMap(_ok(res));
+  }
+
+  Future<NafaqahLedger> fetchLedger({required String householdId, String? wifeUserId}) async {
+    final res = await baseClient.get(
+      '/households/$householdId/nafaqah/reimbursements',
+      queryParams: {if (wifeUserId != null && wifeUserId.isNotEmpty) 'wife_user_id': wifeUserId},
+    );
+    return NafaqahLedger.fromMap(_ok(res));
+  }
+
+  /// Records a partial or full repayment; returns the outstanding balance after it.
+  Future<double> recordReimbursement({
+    required String householdId,
+    required double amount,
+    required String paymentMethod,
+    String? wifeUserId,
+    String? notes,
+  }) async {
+    final res = await baseClient.post(
+      '/households/$householdId/nafaqah/reimbursements',
+      {
+        'amount': double.parse(amount.toStringAsFixed(2)),
+        'payment_method': paymentMethod,
+        if (wifeUserId != null && wifeUserId.isNotEmpty) 'wife_user_id': wifeUserId,
+        if (notes != null && notes.trim().isNotEmpty) 'notes': notes.trim(),
+      },
+      shouldSign: false,
+    );
+    return (_ok(res)['outstanding_after'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0;
+  }
+
+  /// Chooses the household's Nafaqah provider (husband): a non-spouse member.
+  /// Household admins only; the server answers 403 for anyone else and 422
+  /// for a wife or a non-member.
+  Future<NafaqahProviderChange> setProvider({required String householdId, required String userId}) async {
+    final res = await baseClient.put(
+      '/households/$householdId/nafaqah/provider',
+      body: {'user_id': userId},
+    );
+    return NafaqahProviderChange.fromMap(_ok(res));
+  }
+
+  Future<AllowanceStatus> setAllowance({
+    required String householdId,
+    required double amount,
+    String? wifeUserId,
+    String? cycleKey,
+  }) async {
+    final res = await baseClient.put(
+      '/households/$householdId/nafaqah/allowance',
+      body: {
+        'amount': double.parse(amount.toStringAsFixed(2)),
+        if (wifeUserId != null && wifeUserId.isNotEmpty) 'wife_user_id': wifeUserId,
+        if (cycleKey != null && cycleKey.isNotEmpty) 'cycle_key': cycleKey,
+      },
+    );
+    return AllowanceStatus.fromMap(_ok(res));
+  }
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/services/api/preview_token.dart b/flutter_app/lib/services/api/preview_token.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5e63a69
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/services/api/preview_token.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@
+/// Preview → commit binding for chat and receipt expenses.
+///
+/// The API may return a `preview_token` with a chat or receipt preview. The
+/// app sends it back unchanged in the commit request (chat: with the same
+/// message text; receipt: with the same photos) so the server can commit what
+/// the user reviewed instead of parsing again. Duplicate-candidate responses
+/// carry a token too. A token the server no longer accepts is refused with
+/// 422 `{"detail": {"code": "invalid_preview_token"}}` (or
+/// `preview_token_expired` for a receipt sent without photos): the preview is
+/// then run once more and the commit retried with the fresh token. Servers that send no token keep
+/// working: the commit simply carries none.
+library;
+
+const String previewTokenField = 'preview_token';
+
+/// The token of a preview response, or null when the server sent none.
+String? previewTokenOf(Map<String, dynamic>? preview) {
+  final token = preview?[previewTokenField];
+  return token is String && token.isNotEmpty ? token : null;
+}
+
+/// Whether [res] is the server refusing the preview token: tampered, for
+/// another user / household / endpoint (`invalid_preview_token`), or a
+/// receipt preview whose photos the server no longer holds
+/// (`preview_token_expired`). Either way the preview is run again and the
+/// commit resent (with the photos, which the app always sends).
+bool isInvalidPreviewToken(Map<String, dynamic> res) {
+  if ((res['status_code'] as num?)?.toInt() != 422) return false;
+  final detail = res['detail'];
+  final code = detail is Map ? detail['code'] : res['code'];
+  return code == 'invalid_preview_token' || code == 'preview_token_expired';
+}
+
+/// Commits with [token]; on an invalid-token refusal re-runs the preview once
+/// ([rePreview]) and commits again with its token. Never retries twice.
+Future<Map<String, dynamic>> commitWithPreviewToken({
+  required String? token,
+  required Future<Map<String, dynamic>> Function(String? token) commit,
+  required Future<Map<String, dynamic>> Function() rePreview,
+}) async {
+  final first = await commit(token);
+  if (!isInvalidPreviewToken(first)) return first;
+  final fresh = await rePreview();
+  if (fresh['status'] == 'error') return first;
+  return commit(previewTokenOf(fresh));
+}

diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/services/api/support_api_client.dart b/flutter_app/lib/services/api/support_api_client.dart
index a3f9ac0..b9906f8 100644
--- a/flutter_app/lib/services/api/support_api_client.dart
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/services/api/support_api_client.dart
@@ -1,12 +1,47 @@
 import '../../supabase_config.dart';
 import 'base_api_client.dart';
 
+/// Outcome of [SupportApiClient.sendSupportInquiry].
+enum SupportInquiryOutcome {
+  /// The backend's email provider accepted the message.
+  sent,
+
+  /// The message was rejected as invalid (empty or too long).
+  invalid,
+
+  /// The session is missing or expired; the user must sign in again.
+  unauthorized,
+
+  /// Too many messages from this account in the last hour.
+  rateLimited,
+
+  /// The server could not deliver it (no email provider, provider failure, ...).
+  unavailable,
+
+  /// The server could not be reached at all.
+  network,
+}
+
+class SupportInquiryResult {
+  final SupportInquiryOutcome outcome;
+
+  /// Server reference id of a delivered (or failed, when reported) message.
+  final String? reference;
+
+  const SupportInquiryResult(this.outcome, {this.reference});
+
+  bool get isSent => outcome == SupportInquiryOutcome.sent;
+}
+
 class SupportApiClient {
   final BaseApiClient baseClient;
 
   SupportApiClient({BaseApiClient? baseClient})
       : baseClient = baseClient ?? BaseApiClient();
 
+  /// Longest message the backend accepts (POST /support/inquiries).
+  static const int maxInquiryLength = 4000;
+
   Future<Map<String, dynamic>> postSupportChat({
     required String message,
     String? householdId,
@@ -28,4 +63,54 @@ class SupportApiClient {
       timeout: const Duration(seconds: 20),
     );
   }
+
+  /// Emails [message] to the developer through POST /support/inquiries.
+  ///
+  /// The sender is identified by the server from the caller's Supabase JWT
+  /// (user id and account email, used as Reply-To); the body cannot name a
+  /// user. Reports [SupportInquiryOutcome.sent] only when the server answered
+  /// `{"status": "sent"}`, i.e. after the email provider accepted the message.
+  Future<SupportInquiryResult> sendSupportInquiry({
+    required String message,
+    String? locale,
+    String? householdId,
+  }) async {
+    final trimmed = message.trim();
+    if (trimmed.isEmpty || trimmed.length > maxInquiryLength) {
+      return const SupportInquiryResult(SupportInquiryOutcome.invalid);
+    }
+    const url = '$fastapiBaseUrl/support/inquiries';
+    final res = await baseClient.post(
+      url,
+      {
+        'message': trimmed,
+        if (locale != null && locale.isNotEmpty) 'locale': locale,
+        if (householdId != null && householdId.isNotEmpty) 'household_id': householdId,
+      },
+      shouldSign: false,
+      timeout: const Duration(seconds: 30),
+    );
+    final reference = res['reference'] is String ? res['reference'] as String : null;
+    if (res['status'] == 'sent') {
+      return SupportInquiryResult(SupportInquiryOutcome.sent, reference: reference);
+    }
+    final code = res['status_code'];
+    if (code is! int) {
+      // BaseApiClient reports transport failures (timeout, no connection) as an
+      // error without a status code; any other unexpected answer is not a send.
+      return SupportInquiryResult(res['status'] == 'error'
+          ? SupportInquiryOutcome.network
+          : SupportInquiryOutcome.unavailable);
+    }
+    if (code == 401 || code == 403) {
+      return const SupportInquiryResult(SupportInquiryOutcome.unauthorized);
+    }
+    if (code == 422) {
+      return const SupportInquiryResult(SupportInquiryOutcome.invalid);
+    }
+    if (code == 429) {
+      return const SupportInquiryResult(SupportInquiryOutcome.rateLimited);
+    }
+    return SupportInquiryResult(SupportInquiryOutcome.unavailable, reference: reference);
+  }
 }

diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/services/household_invite_share.dart b/flutter_app/lib/services/household_invite_share.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..c99c480
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/services/household_invite_share.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,72 @@
+/// "Share invite": a message in the user's language with the household name,
+/// the join code and how to use it, handed to the system share sheet
+/// (WhatsApp, SMS, e-mail...). The second member is the whole point of a
+/// family or roommate household, so inviting must not require retyping.
+library;
+
+import 'package:share_plus/share_plus.dart';
+
+import '../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+
+/// Whether [code] is a real join code (8–16 letters/digits), not the
+/// placeholder shown to members who cannot read it.
+bool isShareableInviteCode(String? code) =>
+    code != null && RegExp(r'^[A-Za-z0-9]{8,16}$').hasMatch(code.trim());
+
+/// The invite message: household name, the code and the steps to join.
+String inviteShareText(AppLocalizations l, {required String householdName, required String code}) {
+  final name = householdName.trim().isEmpty ? l.get('set_my_household') : householdName.trim();
+  return l.format('invite_share_text', {'household': name, 'code': code.trim()});
+}
+
+typedef ShareTextLauncher = Future<void> Function(String text, String subject);
+
+Future<void> _systemShare(String text, String subject) async {
+  await SharePlus.instance.share(ShareParams(text: text, subject: subject));
+}
+
+/// Opens the share sheet with the invite (injectable for tests).
+Future<void> shareHouseholdInvite(
+  AppLocalizations l, {
+  required String householdName,
+  required String code,
+  ShareTextLauncher launcher = _systemShare,
+}) {
+  return launcher(
+    inviteShareText(l, householdName: householdName, code: code),
+    l.get('invite_share_subject'),
+  );
+}
+
+/// The role a role-bound invite joins as ("الزوجة", "Roommate / Flatmate", ...).
+String roleInviteLabel(AppLocalizations l, String role) => l.get(switch (role) {
+      'spouse' || 'wife' => 'wife_spouse_title',
+      'peer' || 'roommate' => 'invite_role_peer',
+      _ => 'invite_role_family',
+    });
+
+/// The message of a role-bound invite: household, the role the code joins
+/// as, the code and the steps to join.
+String roleInviteShareText(
+  AppLocalizations l, {
+  required String householdName,
+  required String code,
+  required String role,
+}) {
+  final name = householdName.trim().isEmpty ? l.get('set_my_household') : householdName.trim();
+  return l.format('role_invite_share_text', {'household': name, 'code': code.trim(), 'role': roleInviteLabel(l, role)});
+}
+
+/// Opens the share sheet with a role-bound invite (injectable for tests).
+Future<void> shareRoleInvite(
+  AppLocalizations l, {
+  required String householdName,
+  required String code,
+  required String role,
+  ShareTextLauncher launcher = _systemShare,
+}) {
+  return launcher(
+    roleInviteShareText(l, householdName: householdName, code: code, role: role),
+    l.get('invite_share_subject'),
+  );
+}

new file mode 100644

--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/services/household_join.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,101 @@
+import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
+import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart' show PostgrestException;
+
+import '../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+
+/// The server refused to join or claim a household invite. [code] is the
+/// RPC's machine code when it sent one (`already_member`: the user is already
+/// a member of that household and may not take an invite meant for someone
+/// else, FABLE-DB-01); [message] is the server's own explanation.
+class HouseholdJoinException implements Exception {
+  final String message;
+  final String? code;
+
+  const HouseholdJoinException(this.message, {this.code});
+
+  /// The invite's role does not fit the household type (a roommates
+  /// household takes only roommate invites; a family refuses them).
+  bool get isRoleMismatch => code == 'invite_role_mismatch';
+
+  bool get isAlreadyMember =>
+      code == 'already_member' || message.toLowerCase().contains('already a member of this household');
+
+  @override
+  String toString() => message;
+}
+
+/// Checks the JSON result of `join_household_by_code` /
+/// `create_household_and_claim` (`{success: false, error, code}` on refusal)
+/// and returns the household map.
+Map<String, dynamic> checkHouseholdJoinResult(Object? result) {
+  if (result is! Map) throw const HouseholdJoinException('');
+  final map = Map<String, dynamic>.from(result);
+  if (map['success'] == false || map['error'] != null) {
+    throw HouseholdJoinException(map['error']?.toString() ?? '', code: map['code']?.toString());
+  }
+  return map;
+}
+
+/// Calls a database RPC (defaults to `supabase.rpc`); a seam for tests.
+typedef HouseholdRpc = Future<dynamic> Function(String function, Map<String, dynamic> params);
+
+/// The database has no function with these named parameters: an older schema
+/// whose `create_household_and_claim` does not take `p_household_type`
+/// (PostgREST `PGRST202`, or Postgres `42883` undefined_function).
+bool isUnknownFunctionSignature(Object error) {
+  if (error is! PostgrestException) return false;
+  final message = error.message.toLowerCase();
+  return error.code == 'PGRST202' ||
+      error.code == '42883' ||
+      message.contains('could not find the function') ||
+      (message.contains('function') && message.contains('does not exist'));
+}
+
+/// Creates a household of [householdType] ('family' | 'roommates') and makes
+/// the caller its admin (`create_household_and_claim(p_name, p_household_type)`).
+/// Against an older database that does not know `p_household_type` the RPC is
+/// called again without it, so creating a household keeps working while the
+/// migration is not deployed. Returns the household map, or throws a
+/// [HouseholdJoinException] / [PostgrestException] for a refusal.
+Future<Map<String, dynamic>> createHouseholdAndClaim({
+  required String name,
+  required HouseholdRpc rpc,
+  String? householdType,
+}) async {
+  Object? result;
+  try {
+    result = await rpc('create_household_and_claim', {
+      'p_name': name,
+      if (householdType != null) 'p_household_type': householdType,
+    });
+  } on PostgrestException catch (e) {
+    if (householdType == null || !isUnknownFunctionSignature(e)) rethrow;
+    result = await rpc('create_household_and_claim', {'p_name': name});
+  }
+  return checkHouseholdJoinResult(result);
+}
+
+/// Checks the response of `POST /households/invites/{code}/claim`: a 400 is
+/// the server refusing the claim (already a member, invalid or used invite)
+/// and is thrown with the server's message. Network failures and other
+/// statuses are left to the join call that follows.
+void checkInviteClaimResponse(Map<String, dynamic> response) {
+  if (response['status'] == 'error' && response['status_code'] == 400) {
+    final detail = response['detail'];
+    final message = detail is String && detail.isNotEmpty ? detail : response['message']?.toString() ?? '';
+    throw HouseholdJoinException(message, code: response['code']?.toString());
+  }
+}
+
+/// What to tell the user when joining failed: a localized message for
+/// `already_member`, otherwise the server's own error text.
+String householdJoinErrorText(BuildContext context, Object error) {
+  if (error is HouseholdJoinException) {
+    if (error.isAlreadyMember) return context.tr('hh_already_member');
+    if (error.isRoleMismatch) return context.tr('hh_invite_role_mismatch');
+    if (error.message.isNotEmpty) return error.message;
+    return context.tr('action_failed');
+  }
+  if (error is PostgrestException) return error.message;
+  return error.toString();
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/services/household_permissions.dart b/flutter_app/lib/services/household_permissions.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..27f7977
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/services/household_permissions.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
+
+import '../models/account.dart';
+import 'api/household_roles_api_client.dart';
+
+/// Client-side mirror of the household permission rules (owner decision on
+/// audit items DB-16 / DB-18, family and roommate households alike).
+///
+/// The database (RLS, triggers, RPCs) and the API enforce these rules; the app
+/// only hides actions the user cannot take and explains a refusal.
+class HouseholdPermissions {
+  const HouseholdPermissions._();
+
+  /// A member edits or deletes their own transactions; an admin any
+  /// transaction of the household. Legacy rows without a creator are admin-only.
+  static bool canModifyTransaction({
+    required String? currentUserId,
+    required String? creatorUserId,
+    required bool isAdmin,
+  }) {
+    if (currentUserId == null || currentUserId.isEmpty) return false;
+    if (isAdmin) return true;
+    return creatorUserId != null && creatorUserId == currentUserId;
+  }
+
+  static bool isSharedPool(Account account) =>
+      account.isSharedPool || account.accountType == AccountType.sharedPool;
+
+  /// Money leaves a shared pool only by an admin; a personal account only by its owner.
+  static bool canWithdrawFrom(Account account, {required String? currentUserId, required bool isAdmin}) {
+    if (isSharedPool(account)) return isAdmin;
+    return currentUserId != null && account.ownerUserId == currentUserId;
+  }
+
+  /// Source accounts the user may move money out of.
+  static List<Account> withdrawableAccounts(
+    List<Account> accounts, {
+    required String? currentUserId,
+    required bool isAdmin,
+  }) =>
+      accounts.where((a) => canWithdrawFrom(a, currentUserId: currentUserId, isAdmin: isAdmin)).toList();
+
+  /// True when [error] is the server refusing the action for lack of rights
+  /// (PostgREST 42501 / HTTP 403), as opposed to a network or validation error.
+  static bool isPermissionDenied(Object error) {
+    if (error is PostgrestException) {
+      return error.code == '42501' || error.message.startsWith('Forbidden');
+    }
+    if (error is HouseholdRolesApiException) return error.code == 'forbidden';
+    return false;
+  }
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/services/household_resolver.dart b/flutter_app/lib/services/household_resolver.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a651a68
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/services/household_resolver.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,44 @@
+import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
+
+/// Fetches the signed-in user's `users.household_id` from the server.
+/// Returns null when the user has no household yet; throws on network errors.
+typedef RemoteHouseholdFetcher = Future<String?> Function(String userId);
+
+/// Resolves the active household for a user, offline-first.
+///
+/// The last household confirmed by the server is cached per user so that an
+/// app start without connectivity opens the user's dashboard (with its offline
+/// queue) instead of the "create or join a household" onboarding screen.
+class HouseholdResolver {
+  final RemoteHouseholdFetcher fetchRemote;
+
+  const HouseholdResolver({required this.fetchRemote});
+
+  static String cacheKeyFor(String userId) => 'last_household_id_$userId';
+
+  /// Returns the household id, or null when the server says the user has none.
+  /// Rethrows the network error only when there is no cached household.
+  Future<String?> resolve(String userId) async {
+    SharedPreferences? prefs;
+    try {
+      prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
+    } catch (_) {
+      prefs = null;
+    }
+    final key = cacheKeyFor(userId);
+
+    try {
+      final householdId = await fetchRemote(userId);
+      if (householdId == null || householdId.isEmpty) {
+        await prefs?.remove(key);
+        return null;
+      }
+      await prefs?.setString(key, householdId);
+      return householdId;
+    } catch (_) {
+      final cached = prefs?.getString(key);
+      if (cached != null && cached.isNotEmpty) return cached;
+      rethrow;
+    }
+  }
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/services/household_setting_saver.dart b/flutter_app/lib/services/household_setting_saver.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8cb3966
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/services/household_setting_saver.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+/// Raised when a household setting change was not confirmed by the server.
+class HouseholdSettingNotSavedException implements Exception {
+  const HouseholdSettingNotSavedException(this.reason);
+
+  final String reason;
+
+  @override
+  String toString() => 'HouseholdSettingNotSavedException: $reason';
+}
+
+/// Saves a household-wide setting (payday, monthly income, rollover rule)
+/// server-first (MOB-27).
+///
+/// The previous screen code wrote the local cache and in-memory state first
+/// and ignored the `false` returned when the API rejected the change, so the
+/// user saw "saved" while the device and the database used different values
+/// (e.g. different salary-cycle boundaries).
+///
+/// Here the local side ([applyLocal]) runs only after the server confirmed the
+/// change. Otherwise [HouseholdSettingNotSavedException] is thrown and nothing
+/// local changes, so the previous value stays in effect everywhere.
+Future<void> saveHouseholdSetting<T>({
+  required String? householdId,
+  required T value,
+  required Future<bool> Function(String householdId, T value) saveRemote,
+  required Future<void> Function(T value) applyLocal,
+}) async {
+  if (householdId == null || householdId.isEmpty) {
+    throw const HouseholdSettingNotSavedException('no active household');
+  }
+  final confirmed = await saveRemote(householdId, value);
+  if (!confirmed) {
+    throw const HouseholdSettingNotSavedException('server did not confirm the change');
+  }
+  await applyLocal(value);
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/services/nafaqah_write_errors.dart b/flutter_app/lib/services/nafaqah_write_errors.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..41ff7a5
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/services/nafaqah_write_errors.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,116 @@
+import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
+import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart' show PostgrestException;
+
+import '../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import '../models/nafaqah.dart';
+import 'api/base_api_client.dart' show ApiRequestException;
+
+/// A transaction write the database (or API) refused for a Nafaqah rule.
+enum NafaqahWriteRefusal {
+  /// Editing/deleting/declassifying a wife advance would leave her ledger
+  /// repaid beyond her advances (guard trigger of migration 20261020800000:
+  /// SQLSTATE 22023, hint `ledger_would_be_overpaid`; API 409
+  /// `ledger_would_be_overpaid`).
+  ledgerWouldBeOverpaid,
+
+  /// A wife-paid (classified) expense in a family that has no Nafaqah provider
+  /// (SQLSTATE 23514, hint `no_nafaqah_provider`; API 409 `no_provider`).
+  noProvider,
+
+  /// Only the wife, the Nafaqah provider (husband) or an admin may classify a
+  /// family expense as wife_reimbursable / wife_personal. Recognised by the
+  /// codes `not_classifier` / `nafaqah_classifier_only` (API `detail.code` or
+  /// PostgREST hint) and by the API's current message "... can classify a
+  /// family expense".
+  notClassifier,
+}
+
+const String _ledgerHint = 'ledger_would_be_overpaid';
+const String _noProviderHint = 'no_nafaqah_provider';
+// API 403 `nafaqah_classification_forbidden`; PostgREST hint `nafaqah_class_not_allowed`
+// (the others are accepted for robustness).
+const Set<String> _notClassifierCodes = {
+  'nafaqah_classification_forbidden',
+  'nafaqah_class_not_allowed',
+  'not_classifier',
+  'nafaqah_classifier_only',
+  'nafaqah_classifier_forbidden',
+};
+
+bool _isClassifierMessage(String? message) => (message ?? '').toLowerCase().contains('classify a family expense');
+
+/// Which Nafaqah rule refused [error], or null for any other failure
+/// (network, permissions, validation). Understands a [PostgrestException]
+/// from a direct table write, a [NafaqahApiException], and the error map the
+/// API clients return (`status: 'error'`, `detail: {code: ...}`).
+NafaqahWriteRefusal? nafaqahWriteRefusalOf(Object? error) {
+  if (error is PostgrestException) {
+    final hint = error.hint ?? '';
+    final message = error.message.toLowerCase();
+    if (hint == _ledgerHint || (error.code == '22023' && message.contains('ledger overpaid'))) {
+      return NafaqahWriteRefusal.ledgerWouldBeOverpaid;
+    }
+    if (hint == _noProviderHint) return NafaqahWriteRefusal.noProvider;
+    if (_notClassifierCodes.contains(hint) || _isClassifierMessage(error.message)) {
+      return NafaqahWriteRefusal.notClassifier;
+    }
+    return null;
+  }
+  if (error is ApiRequestException) return _fromCode(error.code);
+  if (error is NafaqahApiException) {
+    return _fromCode(error.code) ?? (_isClassifierMessage(error.message) ? NafaqahWriteRefusal.notClassifier : null);
+  }
+  if (error is Map) {
+    if (error['status'] != 'error') return null;
+    final detail = error['detail'];
+    final code = detail is Map ? detail['code']?.toString() : error['code']?.toString();
+    final message = detail is Map ? detail['message']?.toString() : (detail ?? error['message'])?.toString();
+    return _fromCode(code) ?? (_isClassifierMessage(message) ? NafaqahWriteRefusal.notClassifier : null);
+  }
+  return null;
+}
+
+NafaqahWriteRefusal? _fromCode(String? code) {
+  switch (code) {
+    case _ledgerHint:
+      return NafaqahWriteRefusal.ledgerWouldBeOverpaid;
+    case 'no_provider':
+    case _noProviderHint:
+      return NafaqahWriteRefusal.noProvider;
+  }
+  if (_notClassifierCodes.contains(code)) return NafaqahWriteRefusal.notClassifier;
+  return null;
+}
+
+/// The localized explanation of [refusal].
+String nafaqahWriteRefusalText(BuildContext context, NafaqahWriteRefusal refusal) {
+  switch (refusal) {
+    case NafaqahWriteRefusal.ledgerWouldBeOverpaid:
+      return context.tr('nafaqah_err_ledger_overpaid');
+    case NafaqahWriteRefusal.noProvider:
+      return context.tr('nafaqah_err_no_provider');
+    case NafaqahWriteRefusal.notClassifier:
+      return context.tr('nafaqah_err_not_classifier');
+  }
+}
+
+/// The localized explanation when [error] is a Nafaqah refusal, else null.
+String? nafaqahWriteErrorText(BuildContext context, Object? error) {
+  final refusal = nafaqahWriteRefusalOf(error);
+  return refusal == null ? null : nafaqahWriteRefusalText(context, refusal);
+}
+
+/// Localized explanation of a refused chat / receipt request (the API error
+/// map): a Nafaqah refusal, or receipt photos too large for the server
+/// (413: more than 12 MP per page or 24 MP in total). Null otherwise, so the
+/// caller falls back to the server's own message.
+String? expenseApiErrorText(BuildContext context, Object? response) {
+  final nafaqah = nafaqahWriteErrorText(context, response);
+  if (nafaqah != null) return nafaqah;
+  if (response is Map && response['status'] == 'error') {
+    final raw = response['status_code'];
+    final status = raw is num ? raw.toInt() : int.tryParse('${raw ?? ''}');
+    if (status == 413) return context.tr('scan_images_too_large');
+  }
+  return null;
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/services/notifications/reminder_notification_backend.dart b/flutter_app/lib/services/notifications/reminder_notification_backend.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..af95a0c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/services/notifications/reminder_notification_backend.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,85 @@
+/// The device side of reminders: flutter_local_notifications with inexact
+/// scheduling (no exact-alarm permission) on the Asia/Riyadh time zone.
+library;
+
+import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_local_notifications/flutter_local_notifications.dart';
+import 'package:timezone/data/latest_10y.dart' as tzdata;
+import 'package:timezone/timezone.dart' as tz;
+
+import 'reminder_planner.dart';
+
+/// What the reminder service needs from the platform (faked in tests).
+abstract class ReminderNotificationBackend {
+  Future<void> initialize();
+  Future<void> cancelAll();
+  Future<void> schedule(PlannedReminder reminder, {required String channelName, required String channelDescription});
+}
+
+class LocalNotificationsBackend implements ReminderNotificationBackend {
+  LocalNotificationsBackend({FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin? plugin})
+      : _plugin = plugin ?? FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin();
+
+  static const String channelId = 'budget_reminders';
+
+  /// res/drawable/ic_stat_reminder.xml (monochrome small icon).
+  static const String smallIcon = 'ic_stat_reminder';
+
+  final FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin _plugin;
+  tz.Location? _riyadh;
+  bool _initialized = false;
+
+  @override
+  Future<void> initialize() async {
+    if (_initialized) return;
+    tzdata.initializeTimeZones();
+    _riyadh = tz.getLocation('Asia/Riyadh');
+    await _plugin.initialize(
+      const InitializationSettings(
+        android: AndroidInitializationSettings(smallIcon),
+        // Permission is asked from the settings screen, never at launch.
+        iOS: DarwinInitializationSettings(
+          requestAlertPermission: false,
+          requestBadgePermission: false,
+          requestSoundPermission: false,
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+    _initialized = true;
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Future<void> cancelAll() async {
+    if (!_initialized) await initialize();
+    await _plugin.cancelAll();
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Future<void> schedule(PlannedReminder reminder, {required String channelName, required String channelDescription}) async {
+    if (!_initialized) await initialize();
+    final when = tz.TZDateTime.from(reminder.fireAtUtc, _riyadh!);
+    await _plugin.zonedSchedule(
+      reminder.id,
+      reminder.title,
+      reminder.body,
+      when,
+      NotificationDetails(
+        android: AndroidNotificationDetails(
+          channelId,
+          channelName,
+          channelDescription: channelDescription,
+          icon: smallIcon,
+          importance: Importance.defaultImportance,
+          priority: Priority.defaultPriority,
+          styleInformation: BigTextStyleInformation(reminder.body),
+        ),
+        iOS: const DarwinNotificationDetails(),
+      ),
+      // Inexact: no SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM permission; a few minutes late is fine.
+      androidScheduleMode: AndroidScheduleMode.inexactAllowWhileIdle,
+      uiLocalNotificationDateInterpretation: UILocalNotificationDateInterpretation.absoluteTime,
+      payload: reminder.type.name,
+    );
+    debugPrint('[Reminders] scheduled ${reminder.type.name} #${reminder.id} at $when');
+  }
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/services/notifications/reminder_planner.dart b/flutter_app/lib/services/notifications/reminder_planner.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..33a4c0e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/services/notifications/reminder_planner.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,141 @@
+/// Which local reminders to schedule, computed on the device from data the
+/// app already has (R11): the household payday, the recurring bills and the
+/// installment plans. Pure: the clock, data and texts are passed in.
+///
+/// Every reminder fires at 09:00 Asia/Riyadh (UTC+3, no DST) on its day.
+/// Reminders are rebuilt whenever the inputs change, so only the next
+/// [horizonDays] are scheduled, at most [maxReminders] (iOS keeps 64).
+library;
+
+import '../../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import '../../models/installment_plan.dart';
+import '../../models/recurring_bill.dart';
+import '../salary_cycle_service.dart';
+
+enum ReminderType { payday, cycleEnd, bill, installment }
+
+class PlannedReminder {
+  final int id;
+  final ReminderType type;
+  final DateTime fireAtUtc;
+  final String title;
+  final String body;
+
+  const PlannedReminder({
+    required this.id,
+    required this.type,
+    required this.fireAtUtc,
+    required this.title,
+    required this.body,
+  });
+
+  @override
+  String toString() => 'PlannedReminder($id, ${type.name}, ${fireAtUtc.toIso8601String()}, $title)';
+}
+
+class ReminderPlanner {
+  const ReminderPlanner();
+
+  static const int fireHourRiyadh = 9;
+  static const int horizonDays = 62;
+  static const int maxReminders = 48;
+
+  /// Bill occurrences scheduled per bill (this month's and the next one).
+  static const int occurrencesPerBill = 2;
+
+  /// The UTC instant of 09:00 in Riyadh on calendar [date].
+  static DateTime fireAt(DateTime date) => DateTime.utc(date.year, date.month, date.day, fireHourRiyadh)
+      .subtract(SalaryCycleService.riyadhOffset);
+
+  List<PlannedReminder> plan({
+    required DateTime now,
+    required int paydayDay,
+    required List<RecurringBillItem> bills,
+    required List<InstallmentPlan> plans,
+    required Set<ReminderType> enabled,
+    required AppLocalizations l,
+  }) {
+    final today = SalaryCycleService.riyadhToday(now: now);
+    final last = today.add(const Duration(days: horizonDays));
+    final nowUtc = now.toUtc();
+    bool inWindow(DateTime date) => !date.isAfter(last) && fireAt(date).isAfter(nowUtc);
+
+    final drafts = <({ReminderType type, DateTime date, String title, String body})>[];
+    void add(ReminderType type, DateTime date, String title, String body) {
+      if (enabled.contains(type) && inWindow(date)) drafts.add((type: type, date: date, title: title, body: body));
+    }
+
+    // Payday and the nudge three days before it, for the current and the next
+    // cycles inside the window.
+    final current = SalaryCycleService.cycleForInstant(now, paydayDay: paydayDay);
+    var cycle = current;
+    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
+      final payday = cycle.start;
+      add(ReminderType.payday, payday, l.get('notif_payday_title'), l.get('notif_payday_body'));
+      final next = cycle.end.add(const Duration(days: 1));
+      add(
+        ReminderType.cycleEnd,
+        next.subtract(const Duration(days: 3)),
+        l.get('notif_cycle_end_title'),
+        l.format('notif_cycle_end_body', {'date': l.date(cycle.end, 'd MMM')}),
+      );
+      cycle = SalaryCycleService.cycleForDate(next.year, next.month, next.day, paydayDay: paydayDay);
+    }
+
+    // Recurring bills on their expected day of the month. A bill already
+    // paid in the current cycle is reminded at its next occurrence only.
+    for (final bill in bills) {
+      if (bill.cadence != 'monthly') continue;
+      var found = 0;
+      for (var offset = 0; offset < 4 && found < occurrencesPerBill; offset++) {
+        final date = _monthDay(today.year, today.month + offset, bill.expectedDayOfMonth);
+        if (date.isBefore(today)) continue;
+        if (bill.isPaid && current.containsDate(date)) continue;
+        if (!inWindow(date)) continue;
+        found++;
+        add(
+          ReminderType.bill,
+          date,
+          l.format('notif_bill_title', {'merchant': l.merchant(bill.merchant)}),
+          l.format('notif_bill_body', {'amount': l.sar(bill.averageAmount)}),
+        );
+      }
+    }
+
+    // Installments: next_due_at and the plan's frequency, or day_of_month.
+    for (final p in plans) {
+      for (final date in p.dueDates(today: today, max: 4)) {
+        add(
+          ReminderType.installment,
+          date,
+          l.format('notif_installment_title', {'provider': p.provider == 'Bank' ? l.get('bnpl_provider_bank_other') : p.provider}),
+          l.format('notif_installment_body', {'amount': l.sar(p.installmentAmount), 'merchant': l.merchant(p.merchant)}),
+        );
+      }
+    }
+
+    drafts.sort((a, b) {
+      final byDate = a.date.compareTo(b.date);
+      return byDate != 0 ? byDate : a.type.index.compareTo(b.type.index);
+    });
+    final counters = <ReminderType, int>{};
+    return [
+      for (final d in drafts.take(maxReminders))
+        PlannedReminder(
+          id: (d.type.index + 1) * 1000 + (counters[d.type] = (counters[d.type] ?? 0) + 1),
+          type: d.type,
+          fireAtUtc: fireAt(d.date),
+          title: d.title,
+          body: d.body,
+        ),
+    ];
+  }
+
+  static DateTime _monthDay(int year, int month, int day) {
+    final y = year + (month - 1) ~/ 12;
+    final m = (month - 1) % 12 + 1;
+    final lastDay = DateTime.utc(y, m + 1, 0).day;
+    final d = day.clamp(1, 31);
+    return DateTime.utc(y, m, d < lastDay ? d : lastDay);
+  }
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/services/notifications/reminder_preferences.dart b/flutter_app/lib/services/notifications/reminder_preferences.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..c84a3ef
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/services/notifications/reminder_preferences.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+/// Per-type reminder switches, stored on this device (SharedPreferences).
+/// All types are on by default; the settings card turns them off.
+library;
+
+import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
+import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
+
+import 'reminder_planner.dart';
+
+class ReminderPreferences extends ChangeNotifier {
+  ReminderPreferences({Future<SharedPreferences> Function()? prefs})
+      : _prefs = prefs ?? SharedPreferences.getInstance;
+
+  static final ReminderPreferences instance = ReminderPreferences();
+
+  final Future<SharedPreferences> Function() _prefs;
+  final Map<ReminderType, bool> _enabled = {for (final t in ReminderType.values) t: true};
+  bool _loaded = false;
+
+  static String prefKey(ReminderType type) => 'reminder_${type.name}_enabled';
+
+  bool get isLoaded => _loaded;
+
+  bool isEnabled(ReminderType type) => _enabled[type] ?? true;
+
+  Set<ReminderType> get enabledTypes => {for (final t in ReminderType.values) if (isEnabled(t)) t};
+
+  Future<void> load() async {
+    try {
+      final p = await _prefs();
+      for (final t in ReminderType.values) {
+        _enabled[t] = p.getBool(prefKey(t)) ?? true;
+      }
+    } catch (_) {
+      // Preferences unavailable: keep the defaults.
+    }
+    _loaded = true;
+    notifyListeners();
+  }
+
+  Future<void> setEnabled(ReminderType type, bool value) async {
+    if (isEnabled(type) == value) return;
+    _enabled[type] = value;
+    notifyListeners();
+    try {
+      final p = await _prefs();
+      await p.setBool(prefKey(type), value);
+    } catch (_) {
+      // The in-memory choice still applies for this session.
+    }
+  }
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/services/notifications/reminder_service.dart b/flutter_app/lib/services/notifications/reminder_service.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5ad7d7a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/services/notifications/reminder_service.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,90 @@
+/// Rebuilds the scheduled reminders from the household's data (R11).
+///
+/// [reschedule] is cheap to call often: it plans the reminders and touches
+/// the platform only when the plan differs from the last one scheduled
+/// (cancel all, then schedule the new set). [cancelAll] runs on sign-out.
+library;
+
+import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
+
+import '../../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import '../../models/installment_plan.dart';
+import '../../models/recurring_bill.dart';
+import 'reminder_notification_backend.dart';
+import 'reminder_planner.dart';
+
+class ReminderService {
+  ReminderService({
+    ReminderNotificationBackend? backend,
+    DateTime Function()? clock,
+    ReminderPlanner planner = const ReminderPlanner(),
+  })  : _backend = backend ?? LocalNotificationsBackend(),
+        _clock = clock ?? DateTime.now,
+        _planner = planner;
+
+  static ReminderService instance = ReminderService();
+
+  final ReminderNotificationBackend _backend;
+  final DateTime Function() _clock;
+  final ReminderPlanner _planner;
+
+  String? _scheduledSignature;
+  List<PlannedReminder> _scheduled = const [];
+
+  /// The reminders currently scheduled (for diagnostics and tests).
+  List<PlannedReminder> get scheduled => _scheduled;
+
+  /// Plans and, when anything changed, replaces the scheduled reminders.
+  /// Returns the number of reminders scheduled. Never throws.
+  Future<int> reschedule({
+    required String householdId,
+    required int paydayDay,
+    required List<RecurringBillItem> bills,
+    required List<InstallmentPlan> plans,
+    required Set<ReminderType> enabled,
+    required Locale locale,
+  }) async {
+    final l = AppLocalizations(locale);
+    final plan = _planner.plan(
+      now: _clock(),
+      paydayDay: paydayDay,
+      bills: bills,
+      plans: plans,
+      enabled: enabled,
+      l: l,
+    );
+    final signature = [
+      householdId,
+      locale.languageCode,
+      for (final r in plan) '${r.id}|${r.fireAtUtc.toIso8601String()}|${r.title}|${r.body}',
+    ].join('\n');
+    if (signature == _scheduledSignature) return plan.length;
+    try {
+      await _backend.initialize();
+      await _backend.cancelAll();
+      final channelName = l.get('notif_channel_name');
+      final channelDescription = l.get('notif_channel_desc');
+      for (final r in plan) {
+        await _backend.schedule(r, channelName: channelName, channelDescription: channelDescription);
+      }
+      _scheduledSignature = signature;
+      _scheduled = plan;
+      return plan.length;
+    } catch (e) {
+      debugPrint('[Reminders] scheduling failed: $e');
+      _scheduledSignature = null;
+      return 0;
+    }
+  }
+
+  /// Removes every scheduled reminder (sign-out, or all types switched off).
+  Future<void> cancelAll() async {
+    _scheduledSignature = null;
+    _scheduled = const [];
+    try {
+      await _backend.cancelAll();
+    } catch (e) {
+      debugPrint('[Reminders] cancel failed: $e');
+    }
+  }
+}

diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/services/offline_receipt_draft.dart b/flutter_app/lib/services/offline_receipt_draft.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..228cf69
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/services/offline_receipt_draft.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+/// Payload of a receipt captured while offline (`receipt_offline_draft`).
+///
+/// The photo is stored as it is and read by the server when the device is
+/// back online (the sync worker replays it through `/agent/scan-receipt`).
+/// Nothing is guessed on the device: merchant and amount are included only
+/// when the user typed them, and no category is assumed (R8).
+library;
+
+Map<String, dynamic> offlineReceiptDraftPayload({
+  required List<String> imagesBase64,
+  String? merchant,
+  double? amount,
+  String? qrCodeRaw,
+  String? userId,
+  Map<String, String> nafaqahFields = const {},
+}) {
+  final typedMerchant = merchant?.trim() ?? '';
+  return {
+    'images_base64': imagesBase64,
+    if (typedMerchant.isNotEmpty) 'merchant': typedMerchant,
+    if (amount != null && amount > 0) 'amount': amount,
+    if (qrCodeRaw != null && qrCodeRaw.isNotEmpty) 'qr_code_raw': qrCodeRaw,
+    if (userId != null) 'user_id': userId,
+    'needs_cloud_enrichment': true,
+    ...nafaqahFields,
+  };
+}

@@ -4,13 +4,18 @@ import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
 import 'offline_queue_manager.dart';

+export 'offline_queue_manager.dart' show OfflineQueueWriteException;

diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/services/salary_cycle_service.dart b/flutter_app/lib/services/salary_cycle_service.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1419538
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/services/salary_cycle_service.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,188 @@
+/// Saudi salary-cycle arithmetic, bit-for-bit compatible with the Postgres
+/// function `public.get_saudi_cycle_for_timestamp(timestamptz, int)` that
+/// stamps `transactions.cycle_key` and drives the budget triggers.
+///
+/// Rules (mirrored from the SQL):
+/// * The instant is converted to the Asia/Riyadh calendar date (UTC+3, no
+///   DST) regardless of the device time zone.
+/// * The payday is clamped to 1..31 (null → 27) and, per month, to the last
+///   day of that month (payday 30 in February starts on Feb 28/29).
+/// * A cycle runs from the payday of month M to the day before the payday of
+///   month M+1.
+/// * Payday 1 is the plain calendar month.
+/// * For payday ≤ 15 the cycle is labelled by the month it starts in; for
+///   payday ≥ 16 it is labelled by the following month (27 Oct → '2026-11').
+library;
+
+import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
+import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
+
+/// A salary cycle: inclusive [start] and [end] calendar dates (UTC-midnight
+/// `DateTime`s used purely as dates) and its `YYYY-MM` [key].
+class SaudiCycle {
+  final String key;
+  final DateTime start;
+  final DateTime end;
+
+  const SaudiCycle({required this.key, required this.start, required this.end});
+
+  String get startIso => _isoDate(start);
+  String get endIso => _isoDate(end);
+
+  /// Number of days in the cycle, inclusive of both ends.
+  int get lengthInDays => end.difference(start).inDays + 1;
+
+  bool containsDate(DateTime date) {
+    final d = DateTime.utc(date.year, date.month, date.day);
+    return !d.isBefore(start) && !d.isAfter(end);
+  }
+
+  @override
+  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
+      other is SaudiCycle && other.key == key && other.start == start && other.end == end;
+
+  @override
+  int get hashCode => Object.hash(key, start, end);
+
+  @override
+  String toString() => 'SaudiCycle($key, $startIso..$endIso)';
+}
+
+String _isoDate(DateTime d) =>
+    '${d.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}-${d.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${d.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
+
+String _key(int year, int month) => '${year.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}-${month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
+
+class SalaryCycleService {
+  SalaryCycleService._();
+
+  /// Saudi Arabia observes UTC+3 all year (no daylight saving time).
+  static const Duration riyadhOffset = Duration(hours: 3);
+  static const int defaultPaydayDay = 27;
+
+  /// SharedPreferences key the settings screen already uses for the payday.
+  static const String paydayPrefKey = 'payday_day';
+
+  /// Last known household payday; updated from the server/settings so that
+  /// synchronous callers use the household's real payday, not a hardcoded 27.
+  static int _paydayDay = defaultPaydayDay;
+  static int get paydayDay => _paydayDay;
+  static set paydayDay(int value) {
+    _paydayDay = normalizePayday(value);
+    paydayListenable.value = _paydayDay;
+  }
+
+  /// Notifies when the household payday changes (reminders reschedule).
+  static final ValueNotifier<int> paydayListenable = ValueNotifier<int>(defaultPaydayDay);
+
+  /// Loads the cached household payday (written by the payday settings card).
+  static Future<int> loadCachedPayday() async {
+    try {
+      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
+      final cached = prefs.getInt(paydayPrefKey);
+      if (cached != null) paydayDay = cached;
+    } catch (_) {
+      // Preferences unavailable (tests, first launch): keep the current value.
+    }
+    return _paydayDay;
+  }
+
+  /// Persists and applies a household payday fetched from the server.
+  static Future<void> cachePayday(int value) async {
+    paydayDay = value;
+    try {
+      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
+      await prefs.setInt(paydayPrefKey, _paydayDay);
+    } catch (_) {
+      // Non-fatal: the in-memory value is still applied.
+    }
+  }
+
+  /// `GREATEST(1, LEAST(31, COALESCE(p_payday_day, 27)))`.
+  static int normalizePayday(int? payday) => (payday ?? defaultPaydayDay).clamp(1, 31);
+
+  static int daysInMonth(int year, int month) => DateTime.utc(year, month + 1, 0).day;
+
+  /// The Asia/Riyadh calendar date of [instant] (any time zone in, date out).
+  static DateTime riyadhDate(DateTime instant) {
+    final r = instant.toUtc().add(riyadhOffset);
+    return DateTime.utc(r.year, r.month, r.day);
+  }
+
+  /// Today's date in Riyadh.
+  static DateTime riyadhToday({DateTime? now}) => riyadhDate(now ?? DateTime.now());
+
+  /// Cycle containing [instant] (a point in time, e.g. a transaction timestamp).
+  static SaudiCycle cycleForInstant(DateTime instant, {int? paydayDay}) {
+    final d = riyadhDate(instant);
+    return cycleForDate(d.year, d.month, d.day, paydayDay: paydayDay ?? _paydayDay);
+  }
+
+  /// Cycle containing the Riyadh calendar date [year]-[month]-[day]
+  /// (use for user-picked dates, which have no time-of-day meaning).
+  static SaudiCycle cycleForDate(int year, int month, int day, {int? paydayDay}) {
+    final payday = normalizePayday(paydayDay ?? _paydayDay);
+
+    if (payday == 1) {
+      return SaudiCycle(
+        key: _key(year, month),
+        start: DateTime.utc(year, month, 1),
+        end: DateTime.utc(year, month, daysInMonth(year, month)),
+      );
+    }
+
+    final clampedToday = payday < daysInMonth(year, month) ? payday : daysInMonth(year, month);
+
+    if (day >= clampedToday) {
+      final nextYear = month == 12 ? year + 1 : year;
+      final nextMonth = month == 12 ? 1 : month + 1;
+      final nextDays = daysInMonth(nextYear, nextMonth);
+      final clampedNext = payday < nextDays ? payday : nextDays;
+      return SaudiCycle(
+        key: payday <= 15 ? _key(year, month) : _key(nextYear, nextMonth),
+        start: DateTime.utc(year, month, clampedToday),
+        end: DateTime.utc(nextYear, nextMonth, clampedNext).subtract(const Duration(days: 1)),
+      );
+    }
+
+    final prevYear = month == 1 ? year - 1 : year;
+    final prevMonth = month == 1 ? 12 : month - 1;
+    final prevDays = daysInMonth(prevYear, prevMonth);
+    final clampedPrev = payday < prevDays ? payday : prevDays;
+    return SaudiCycle(
+      key: payday <= 15 ? _key(prevYear, prevMonth) : _key(year, month),
+      start: DateTime.utc(prevYear, prevMonth, clampedPrev),
+      end: DateTime.utc(year, month, clampedToday).subtract(const Duration(days: 1)),
+    );
+  }
+
+  /// The cycle named by a `YYYY-MM` [cycleKey] (a longer `YYYY-MM-DD` value
+  /// uses its month), or null when the key is not in that format.
+  static SaudiCycle? cycleForKey(String cycleKey, {int? paydayDay}) {
+    final m = RegExp(r'^(\d{4})-(\d{2})').firstMatch(cycleKey.trim());
+    if (m == null) return null;
+    final year = int.parse(m.group(1)!);
+    final month = int.parse(m.group(2)!);
+    if (month < 1 || month > 12) return null;
+    final payday = normalizePayday(paydayDay ?? _paydayDay);
+    // payday ≤ 15 names the month the cycle starts in (its payday is in it);
+    // payday ≥ 16 names the month it ends in (its 1st is inside the cycle).
+    final day = payday <= 15 ? (payday < daysInMonth(year, month) ? payday : daysInMonth(year, month)) : 1;
+    return cycleForDate(year, month, day, paydayDay: payday);
+  }
+
+  /// `cycle_key` for [instant] (defaults to now).
+  static String cycleKeyForInstant(DateTime? instant, {int? paydayDay}) =>
+      cycleForInstant(instant ?? DateTime.now(), paydayDay: paydayDay).key;
+
+  /// The current cycle in Riyadh.
+  static SaudiCycle currentCycle({DateTime? now, int? paydayDay}) =>
+      cycleForInstant(now ?? DateTime.now(), paydayDay: paydayDay);
+
+  /// Whole days from today (Riyadh) until the next cycle starts.
+  static int daysUntilNextPayday({DateTime? now, int? paydayDay}) {
+    final today = riyadhToday(now: now);
+    final cycle = cycleForInstant(now ?? DateTime.now(), paydayDay: paydayDay);
+    return cycle.end.difference(today).inDays + 1;
+  }
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/services/secure_session_storage.dart b/flutter_app/lib/services/secure_session_storage.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..0b3ea0d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/services/secure_session_storage.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,172 @@
+import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_secure_storage/flutter_secure_storage.dart';
+import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
+import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
+
+/// Minimal string key-value store, so the session storage can be unit tested
+/// with in-memory fakes instead of the platform Keystore / Keychain.
+abstract class SessionKeyValueStore {
+  Future<String?> read(String key);
+  Future<void> write(String key, String value);
+  Future<void> delete(String key);
+}
+
+/// Android Keystore / iOS Keychain backed store.
+///
+/// * Android: `AndroidOptions()` is the plugin's default since v10: an AES-GCM
+///   data key wrapped with a Keystore RSA-OAEP key (plugin minSdk 24; the app's is 26).
+///   The older `encryptedSharedPreferences` flag relied on the deprecated
+///   Jetpack Security library and no longer exists in flutter_secure_storage 11;
+///   data written by it is migrated by the plugin (`migrateOnAlgorithmChange`).
+///   `resetOnError` drops an undecryptable value (e.g. after a device restore)
+///   instead of crashing; the user simply signs in again.
+/// * iOS: `first_unlock_this_device` keeps the token out of iCloud Keychain and
+///   device-to-device backups while allowing background token refreshes.
+class FlutterSecureKeyValueStore implements SessionKeyValueStore {
+  FlutterSecureKeyValueStore([FlutterSecureStorage? storage]) : _storage = storage ?? defaultStorage;
+
+  static const FlutterSecureStorage defaultStorage = FlutterSecureStorage(
+    aOptions: AndroidOptions(resetOnError: true, migrateOnAlgorithmChange: true),
+    iOptions: IOSOptions(accessibility: KeychainAccessibility.first_unlock_this_device),
+  );
+
+  final FlutterSecureStorage _storage;
+
+  @override
+  Future<String?> read(String key) => _storage.read(key: key);
+
+  @override
+  Future<void> write(String key, String value) => _storage.write(key: key, value: value);
+
+  @override
+  Future<void> delete(String key) => _storage.delete(key: key);
+}
+
+/// The plaintext SharedPreferences store used by supabase_flutter's default
+/// `SharedPreferencesLocalStorage`. Only read to migrate and then delete.
+class SharedPreferencesKeyValueStore implements SessionKeyValueStore {
+  Future<SharedPreferences> _prefs() => SharedPreferences.getInstance();
+
+  @override
+  Future<String?> read(String key) async => (await _prefs()).getString(key);
+
+  @override
+  Future<void> write(String key, String value) async => (await _prefs()).setString(key, value);
+
+  @override
+  Future<void> delete(String key) async => (await _prefs()).remove(key);
+}
+
+/// Supabase session persistence in the platform secure store (MOB-19).
+///
+/// supabase_flutter's default keeps the session JSON, including the long-lived
+/// refresh token, in plaintext SharedPreferences. This storage keeps it in the
+/// Keystore/Keychain instead and, on first start after the update, moves an
+/// existing plaintext session across and deletes the plaintext copy, so users
+/// stay signed in.
+///
+/// Failure policy: if the secure store cannot be written during migration the
+/// plaintext copy is left in place (the user stays signed in and the move is
+/// retried on the next start). Once a session is written or removed through
+/// this storage the plaintext copy is always deleted, so it is never written
+/// to SharedPreferences again.
+class SecureSessionLocalStorage extends LocalStorage {
+  SecureSessionLocalStorage({
+    required this.persistSessionKey,
+    SessionKeyValueStore? secureStore,
+    SessionKeyValueStore? legacyStore,
+  })  : _secure = secureStore ?? FlutterSecureKeyValueStore(),
+        _legacy = legacyStore ?? SharedPreferencesKeyValueStore();
+
+  /// Same key supabase_flutter uses for its SharedPreferences storage, so the
+  /// existing session can be found and migrated.
+  static String sessionKeyFor(String supabaseUrl) =>
+      'sb-${Uri.parse(supabaseUrl).host.split('.').first}-auth-token';
+
+  final String persistSessionKey;
+  final SessionKeyValueStore _secure;
+  final SessionKeyValueStore _legacy;
+
+  /// Latest session JSON for this run. supabase_flutter only reads the stored
+  /// session at start-up; later reads are served from here.
+  String? _session;
+
+  @override
+  Future<void> initialize() async {
+    WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
+    _session = await _readSecure();
+
+    final String? legacy;
+    try {
+      legacy = await _legacy.read(persistSessionKey);
+    } catch (e) {
+      debugPrint('[SecureSessionLocalStorage] Could not read legacy session: $e');
+      return;
+    }
+    if (legacy == null) return;
+
+    if (_session != null) {
+      // Already migrated; the plaintext copy is stale.
+      await _deleteLegacy();
+      return;
+    }
+
+    try {
+      await _secure.write(persistSessionKey, legacy);
+      if (await _secure.read(persistSessionKey) == legacy) {
+        await _deleteLegacy();
+      } else {
+        debugPrint('[SecureSessionLocalStorage] Secure write did not verify; keeping legacy copy for retry.');
+      }
+    } catch (e) {
+      debugPrint('[SecureSessionLocalStorage] Secure write failed; keeping legacy copy for retry: $e');
+    }
+    _session = legacy;
+  }
+
+  Future<String?> _readSecure() async {
+    try {
+      return await _secure.read(persistSessionKey);
+    } catch (e) {
+      debugPrint('[SecureSessionLocalStorage] Could not read secure session: $e');
+      return null;
+    }
+  }
+
+  Future<void> _deleteLegacy() async {
+    try {
+      await _legacy.delete(persistSessionKey);
+    } catch (e) {
+      debugPrint('[SecureSessionLocalStorage] Could not delete legacy session: $e');
+    }
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Future<bool> hasAccessToken() async => _session != null;
+
+  @override
+  Future<String?> accessToken() async => _session;
+
+  @override
+  Future<void> persistSession(String persistSessionString) async {
+    _session = persistSessionString;
+    try {
+      await _secure.write(persistSessionKey, persistSessionString);
+    } catch (e) {
+      // The session stays usable for this run; it is never written in plaintext.
+      debugPrint('[SecureSessionLocalStorage] Could not persist session securely: $e');
+    }
+    await _deleteLegacy();
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Future<void> removePersistedSession() async {
+    _session = null;
+    try {
+      await _secure.delete(persistSessionKey);
+    } catch (e) {
+      debugPrint('[SecureSessionLocalStorage] Could not delete secure session: $e');
+    }
+    await _deleteLegacy();
+  }
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/services/statement_pdf_service.dart b/flutter_app/lib/services/statement_pdf_service.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..50fedd7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/services/statement_pdf_service.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,92 @@
+import 'dart:io';
+
+import 'package:path/path.dart' as p;
+import 'package:path_provider/path_provider.dart';
+import 'package:share_plus/share_plus.dart';
+
+import 'api/base_api_client.dart';
+import 'api_service.dart';
+
+typedef StatementDownloader = Future<ApiBinaryResponse> Function(String householdId, {String? cycleKey});
+typedef StatementDirectoryProvider = Future<Directory> Function();
+typedef StatementFileSharer = Future<void> Function(String path, String fileName);
+
+/// Downloads the monthly statement PDF with the user's JWT and hands the file
+/// to the system share sheet, from which it can be opened in a PDF viewer,
+/// saved to Files/Drive or sent (MOB-26).
+///
+/// The previous flow showed a bare backend URL to copy into a browser, which
+/// carries no `Authorization` header and was rejected by the firewall (403).
+///
+/// The file is written to an app-private cache folder; earlier statements in
+/// that folder are deleted first so financial documents do not pile up.
+class StatementPdfService {
+  StatementPdfService({
+    StatementDownloader? download,
+    StatementDirectoryProvider? directory,
+    StatementFileSharer? share,
+  })  : _download = download ?? ApiService.instance.downloadStatementPdf,
+        _directory = directory ?? _defaultDirectory,
+        _share = share ?? _shareWithSystemSheet;
+
+  final StatementDownloader _download;
+  final StatementDirectoryProvider _directory;
+  final StatementFileSharer _share;
+
+  static const String folderName = 'statements';
+
+  static Future<Directory> _defaultDirectory() async {
+    final tmp = await getTemporaryDirectory();
+    return Directory(p.join(tmp.path, folderName));
+  }
+
+  static Future<void> _shareWithSystemSheet(String path, String fileName) async {
+    await SharePlus.instance.share(
+      ShareParams(
+        files: [XFile(path, mimeType: 'application/pdf', name: fileName)],
+        fileNameOverrides: [fileName],
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+
+  /// Returns a file name safe for the file system, always ending in `.pdf`.
+  static String safeFileName(String? serverName, {String? cycleKey}) {
+    var name = (serverName ?? '').replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_.\-]'), '');
+    name = name.replaceAll(RegExp(r'^\.+'), '');
+    if (name.isEmpty || name == '.pdf') {
+      final cycle = (cycleKey ?? 'current').replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_\-]'), '');
+      name = 'statement_${cycle.isEmpty ? 'current' : cycle}.pdf';
+    }
+    if (!name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.pdf')) name = '$name.pdf';
+    return name;
+  }
+
+  /// Downloads, saves and shares the statement. Returns the saved file.
+  ///
+  /// Throws [ApiDownloadException] when the download fails, and the platform
+  /// exception when the file cannot be written or shared.
+  Future<File> downloadAndShare(String householdId, {String? cycleKey}) async {
+    final res = await _download(householdId, cycleKey: cycleKey);
+    final fileName = safeFileName(res.fileName, cycleKey: cycleKey);
+
+    final dir = await _directory();
+    if (await dir.exists()) {
+      await for (final entity in dir.list()) {
+        if (entity is File) {
+          try {
+            await entity.delete();
+          } catch (_) {
+            // A file still held by a viewer is removed on a later download.
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    } else {
+      await dir.create(recursive: true);
+    }
+
+    final file = File(p.join(dir.path, fileName));
+    await file.writeAsBytes(res.bytes, flush: true);
+    await _share(file.path, fileName);
+    return file;
+  }
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/services/sync_worker.dart b/flutter_app/lib/services/sync_worker.dart
index a3b8804..f4c4b93 100644
--- a/flutter_app/lib/services/sync_worker.dart
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/services/sync_worker.dart
@@ -1,29 +1,105 @@
 import 'dart:async';
+import 'dart:io';
+
 import 'package:connectivity_plus/connectivity_plus.dart';
 import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
+import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;

+/// Optional HMAC key for the `X-Signature` header. When provided with
+/// `--dart-define=WEBHOOK_SECRET=...` POST requests are signed; when it is
+/// missing they are sent unsigned and the app still starts normally.
+///
+/// Requests are authenticated by the user's Supabase JWT. The backend treats a
+/// signature as defense in depth: it is not required, and a signature that does
+/// not match the backend's current WEBHOOK_SECRET (e.g. after a rotation) is
+/// logged and ignored while the JWT is valid. The key is extractable from the
+/// binary, so it is never an authentication secret.
+const webhookSecret = String.fromEnvironment('WEBHOOK_SECRET');

+/// Returns every configuration problem (empty when the configuration is usable).
+List<String> validateClientConfig({
+  required String supabaseUrl,
+  required String supabaseKey,
+  required String fastapiBaseUrl,
+  required bool isRelease,
+}) {
+  final problems = <String>[];
+
+  if (supabaseUrl.isEmpty) {
+    problems.add('Missing --dart-define=SUPABASE_URL');
+  } else if (isRelease && !supabaseUrl.startsWith('https://')) {
+    problems.add('SUPABASE_URL must use https:// in release builds');
+  }
+
+  if (supabaseKey.isEmpty) {
+    problems.add('Missing --dart-define=SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY (or SUPABASE_ANON_KEY)');
+  } else if (isPrivilegedSupabaseKey(supabaseKey)) {
+    problems.add(
+      'The Supabase key is a service-role/secret key. Only the publishable (anon) key may be compiled into the app.',
+    );
+  }
+
+  if (fastapiBaseUrl.isEmpty) {
+    problems.add('Missing --dart-define=FASTAPI_BASE_URL');
+  } else if (isRelease && !fastapiBaseUrl.startsWith('https://')) {
+    problems.add('FASTAPI_BASE_URL must use https:// in release builds');
+  }
+
+  return problems;
+}

+/// True for keys that bypass Row Level Security: new-style `sb_secret_...`
+/// keys and legacy JWT keys whose `role` claim is `service_role`.
+bool isPrivilegedSupabaseKey(String key) {
+  final k = key.trim();
+  if (k.startsWith('sb_secret_')) return true;
+  final parts = k.split('.');
+  if (parts.length != 3) return false;
+  try {
+    final payload = utf8.decode(base64Url.decode(base64Url.normalize(parts[1])));
+    final claims = jsonDecode(payload);
+    return claims is Map && claims['role'] == 'service_role';
+  } catch (_) {
+    return false;
+  }
+}
+
+/// Throws a [StateError] listing every problem with the compiled-in configuration.
+void ensureValidClientConfig({required bool isRelease}) {
+  final problems = validateClientConfig(
+    supabaseUrl: supabaseUrl,
+    supabaseKey: supabasePublishableKey,
+    fastapiBaseUrl: fastapiBaseUrl,
+    isRelease: isRelease,
+  );
+  if (problems.isNotEmpty) {
+    throw StateError('Invalid Budget Tracker build configuration:\n- ${problems.join('\n- ')}');
+  }
+}
