diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/widgets/card_error_state.dart b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/card_error_state.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..445e143
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/card_error_state.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,111 @@
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';
+
+import '../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import '../theme/app_themes.dart';
+
+/// The error state of a card whose data could not be loaded (UX-01). It keeps
+/// the card's [title], says what failed and offers a retry, so a failed
+/// request never reads as "nothing owed" or "all paid".
+class CardErrorState extends StatelessWidget {
+  final String title;
+  final String message;
+  final VoidCallback onRetry;
+  final IconData icon;
+
+  const CardErrorState({
+    super.key,
+    required this.title,
+    required this.message,
+    required this.onRetry,
+    this.icon = Icons.cloud_off_rounded,
+  });
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final danger = context.dangerColor;
+    return Container(
+      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
+      decoration: BoxDecoration(
+        color: context.cardBg,
+        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
+        border: Border.all(color: danger.withValues(alpha: 0.35)),
+      ),
+      child: Column(
+        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
+        children: [
+          Row(
+            children: [
+              Icon(icon, color: danger, size: 20),
+              const SizedBox(width: 10),
+              Expanded(
+                child: Text(
+                  title,
+                  style: GoogleFonts.outfit(fontSize: 15, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: context.textPrimary),
+                ),
+              ),
+            ],
+          ),
+          const SizedBox(height: 8),
+          Text(message, style: TextStyle(color: context.textSecondary, fontSize: 12)),
+          const SizedBox(height: 10),
+          Align(
+            alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerEnd,
+            child: OutlinedButton.icon(
+              key: const Key('card_error_retry'),
+              onPressed: onRetry,
+              icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded, size: 18),
+              label: Text(context.tr('try_again')),
+            ),
+          ),
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}
+
+/// A one-line notice above data that is still shown from the last successful
+/// load when a refresh failed: "Couldn't refresh. Last updated 9:40 PM".
+class CardErrorBanner extends StatelessWidget {
+  final DateTime? lastUpdated;
+  final VoidCallback onRetry;
+
+  const CardErrorBanner({super.key, required this.lastUpdated, required this.onRetry});
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final time = lastUpdated == null ? '' : context.fmtDate(lastUpdated!, 'h:mm a');
+    return Container(
+      padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(12, 4, 4, 4),
+      decoration: BoxDecoration(
+        color: context.dangerColor.withValues(alpha: context.isDarkMode ? 0.12 : 0.06),
+        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
+      ),
+      // Wrap: under large text the retry button moves under the message.
+      child: Wrap(
+        crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
+        alignment: WrapAlignment.spaceBetween,
+        children: [
+          Row(
+            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
+            children: [
+              Icon(Icons.cloud_off_rounded, size: 16, color: context.dangerColor),
+              const SizedBox(width: 8),
+              Flexible(
+                child: Text(
+                  context.trArgs('load_error_stale', {'time': time}),
+                  style: TextStyle(color: context.textSecondary, fontSize: 11),
+                ),
+              ),
+            ],
+          ),
+          TextButton(
+            key: const Key('card_error_banner_retry'),
+            onPressed: onRetry,
+            child: Text(context.tr('try_again')),
+          ),
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}

diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/widgets/chat/voice_language_button.dart b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/chat/voice_language_button.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b2ebadc
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/chat/voice_language_button.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,58 @@
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+
+import '../../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import '../../theme/app_themes.dart';
+
+/// Example messages offered as chips in the chat, in the app language (UX-18).
+const List<String> chatExampleKeys = ['chat_example_1', 'chat_example_2', 'chat_example_3', 'chat_example_4'];
+
+/// The language the microphone listens in. One 48 dp control (UX-19) instead
+/// of three small pills; the assistant itself reads any of the three
+/// languages, so this only matters for dictation.
+class VoiceLanguageButton extends StatelessWidget {
+  /// Speech recognition locale: 'ar_SA', 'en_US' or 'ur_PK'.
+  final String localeId;
+  final ValueChanged<String> onChanged;
+
+  const VoiceLanguageButton({super.key, required this.localeId, required this.onChanged});
+
+  static const _options = [('ar_SA', 'ar'), ('en_US', 'en'), ('ur_PK', 'ur')];
+
+  /// A language's own name ("العربية", "English", "اردو").
+  static String _selfName(String lang) => AppLocalizations(Locale(lang)).get('language_$lang');
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final current = _options.firstWhere((o) => o.$1 == localeId, orElse: () => _options.first);
+    return PopupMenuButton<String>(
+      tooltip: context.tr('chat_voice_language'),
+      initialValue: current.$1,
+      onSelected: onChanged,
+      itemBuilder: (_) => [
+        for (final o in _options)
+          PopupMenuItem<String>(
+            value: o.$1,
+            child: Text(_selfName(o.$2)),
+          ),
+      ],
+      child: ConstrainedBox(
+        constraints: const BoxConstraints(minHeight: 48, minWidth: 48),
+        child: Padding(
+          padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(start: 8, end: 12),
+          child: Row(
+            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
+            children: [
+              Icon(Icons.record_voice_over_outlined, size: 20, color: context.accentText),
+              const SizedBox(width: 6),
+              Text(
+                _selfName(current.$2),
+                style: TextStyle(color: context.textPrimary, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
+              ),
+              Icon(Icons.arrow_drop_down_rounded, color: context.textSecondary),
+            ],
+          ),
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}

diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/widgets/dashboard/app_bottom_nav_bar.dart b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/dashboard/app_bottom_nav_bar.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a91b7fb
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/dashboard/app_bottom_nav_bar.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,171 @@
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';
+
+import '../../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import '../../theme/app_themes.dart';
+
+/// The floating bottom navigation of the home screen: dashboard, feed, the
+/// AI assistant in the middle, budgets and settings. Above
+/// [hideLabelsAboveTextScale] the labels give way to icons (with tooltips and
+/// semantic labels) so large system text cannot overflow the bar (UX-14).
+class AppBottomNavBar extends StatelessWidget {
+  final int selectedIndex;
+  final ValueChanged<int> onSelected;
+
+  static const double hideLabelsAboveTextScale = 1.3;
+
+  const AppBottomNavBar({super.key, required this.selectedIndex, required this.onSelected});
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final isDark = context.isDark;
+    final showLabels = MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context).scale(10) / 10 <= hideLabelsAboveTextScale;
+    return Container(
+      margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 0, 16, 16),
+      height: 68,
+      decoration: BoxDecoration(
+        color: isDark ? AppThemes.deepGlacial.withValues(alpha: 0.94) : Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.96),
+        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(28),
+        border: Border.all(
+          color: isDark
+              ? AppThemes.iceCyan.withValues(alpha: 0.22)
+              : AppThemes.electricTeal.withValues(alpha: 0.35),
+          width: 1.2,
+        ),
+        boxShadow: [
+          BoxShadow(
+            color: isDark ? Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.45) : AppThemes.electricTeal.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
+            blurRadius: 24,
+            offset: const Offset(0, 8),
+          ),
+          if (!isDark)
+            BoxShadow(
+              color: const Color(0xFF0F172A).withValues(alpha: 0.05),
+              blurRadius: 10,
+              offset: const Offset(0, 2),
+            ),
+        ],
+      ),
+      child: Row(
+        children: [
+          _item(context, 0, Icons.home_outlined, Icons.home_rounded, context.tr('nav_dashboard'), showLabels),
+          _item(context, 1, Icons.receipt_long_outlined, Icons.receipt_long_rounded, context.tr('nav_transactions'), showLabels),
+          _centerAi(context, showLabels),
+          _item(context, 3, Icons.pie_chart_outline_rounded, Icons.pie_chart_rounded, context.tr('nav_budgets'), showLabels),
+          _item(context, 4, Icons.person_outline_rounded, Icons.person_rounded, context.tr('nav_settings'), showLabels),
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+
+  // UX-27: contrast-safe tokens (the hard-coded #008F7A was 4.0:1 in light mode).
+  Color _active(BuildContext context) => context.accentText;
+  Color _inactive(BuildContext context) => context.textMuted;
+
+  Widget _label(BuildContext context, String label, bool isSelected, double size, {bool bold = false}) => Text(
+        label,
+        maxLines: 1,
+        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
+        style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
+          fontSize: size,
+          fontWeight: isSelected || bold ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w500,
+          color: isSelected ? _active(context) : _inactive(context),
+        ),
+      );
+
+  Widget _item(BuildContext context, int index, IconData icon, IconData selectedIcon, String label, bool showLabels) {
+    final isSelected = selectedIndex == index;
+    final isDark = context.isDark;
+    return Expanded(
+      child: Semantics(
+        label: label,
+        selected: isSelected,
+        button: true,
+        excludeSemantics: true,
+        child: Tooltip(
+          message: label,
+          child: InkWell(
+            key: Key('nav_item_$index'),
+            onTap: () => onSelected(index),
+            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
+            child: Column(
+              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
+              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
+              children: [
+                AnimatedContainer(
+                  duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 250),
+                  padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: isSelected ? 12 : 6, vertical: 4),
+                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
+                    color: isSelected
+                        ? AppThemes.electricTeal.withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.16 : 0.18)
+                        : Colors.transparent,
+                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
+                  ),
+                  child: Icon(
+                    isSelected ? selectedIcon : icon,
+                    color: isSelected ? _active(context) : _inactive(context),
+                    size: 22,
+                  ),
+                ),
+                if (showLabels) ...[
+                  const SizedBox(height: 2),
+                  _label(context, label, isSelected, 10),
+                ],
+              ],
+            ),
+          ),
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+
+  Widget _centerAi(BuildContext context, bool showLabels) {
+    final isSelected = selectedIndex == 2;
+    final label = context.tr('nav_ai');
+    return Expanded(
+      child: Semantics(
+        label: label,
+        selected: isSelected,
+        button: true,
+        excludeSemantics: true,
+        child: Tooltip(
+          message: label,
+          child: GestureDetector(
+            key: const Key('nav_item_2'),
+            onTap: () => onSelected(2),
+            child: Column(
+              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
+              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
+              children: [
+                Container(
+                  width: 44,
+                  height: 44,
+                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
+                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
+                    gradient: const LinearGradient(
+                      begin: Alignment.topLeft,
+                      end: Alignment.bottomRight,
+                      colors: [AppThemes.electricTeal, AppThemes.iceCyan],
+                    ),
+                    boxShadow: [
+                      BoxShadow(
+                        color: AppThemes.electricTeal.withValues(alpha: isSelected ? 0.65 : 0.4),
+                        blurRadius: isSelected ? 16 : 10,
+                        spreadRadius: isSelected ? 2 : 0,
+                      ),
+                    ],
+                  ),
+                  child: const Icon(Icons.auto_awesome, color: AppThemes.brandDarkBg, size: 22),
+                ),
+                if (showLabels) ...[
+                  const SizedBox(height: 2),
+                  _label(context, label, isSelected, 9.5, bold: true),
+                ],
+              ],
+            ),
+          ),
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}

diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/widgets/dashboard/household_balances_section.dart b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/dashboard/household_balances_section.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..966a6b2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/dashboard/household_balances_section.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,115 @@
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+
+import '../../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import '../../models/models.dart';
+import '../../models/nafaqah.dart';
+import '../../services/api_service.dart';
+import '../../theme/app_themes.dart';
+import '../card_error_state.dart';
+import 'family_reimbursement_card.dart';
+import 'multi_roommate_settlement_card.dart';
+
+/// Loads the household's settlement summary (`GET /households/{id}/settlement-v2`).
+typedef SettlementLoader = Future<SettlementV2Summary> Function(String householdId);
+
+/// Who owes whom in the household: the roommate settlement card for a
+/// roommates household, otherwise the family Nafaqah card. A failed load is
+/// an error card with a retry (UX-01): it used to fall through to the family
+/// card, so a roommates household silently lost its balances.
+class HouseholdBalancesSection extends StatefulWidget {
+  final String householdId;
+  final SettlementLoader? loadSettlement;
+  final NafaqahSummaryLoader? loadNafaqah;
+
+  /// The settlement summary after each successful load.
+  final ValueChanged<SettlementV2Summary>? onSettlementLoaded;
+
+  /// The Nafaqah summary after each load of the family card.
+  final ValueChanged<NafaqahSummary>? onNafaqahLoaded;
+
+  const HouseholdBalancesSection({
+    super.key,
+    required this.householdId,
+    this.loadSettlement,
+    this.loadNafaqah,
+    this.onSettlementLoaded,
+    this.onNafaqahLoaded,
+  });
+
+  @override
+  State<HouseholdBalancesSection> createState() => _HouseholdBalancesSectionState();
+}
+
+class _HouseholdBalancesSectionState extends State<HouseholdBalancesSection> {
+  late Future<SettlementV2Summary> _future;
+
+  @override
+  void initState() {
+    super.initState();
+    _future = _load();
+  }
+
+  @override
+  void didUpdateWidget(covariant HouseholdBalancesSection oldWidget) {
+    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
+    if (oldWidget.householdId != widget.householdId) _future = _load();
+  }
+
+  void _reload() {
+    setState(() {
+      _future = _load();
+    });
+  }
+
+  Future<SettlementV2Summary> _load() async {
+    final loader = widget.loadSettlement ?? ApiService.instance.getSettlementV2;
+    final summary = await loader(widget.householdId);
+    if (mounted) widget.onSettlementLoaded?.call(summary);
+    return summary;
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    return FutureBuilder<SettlementV2Summary>(
+      future: _future,
+      builder: (context, snap) {
+        if (snap.hasError) {
+          return CardErrorState(
+            title: context.tr('household_balances_title'),
+            message: context.tr('load_error_balances'),
+            icon: Icons.account_balance_wallet_outlined,
+            onRetry: _reload,
+          );
+        }
+        // A reload keeps showing the previous summary (FutureBuilder keeps its data).
+        if (!snap.hasData) {
+          return Container(
+            key: const Key('household_balances_loading'),
+            height: 110,
+            decoration: BoxDecoration(
+              color: context.cardBg,
+              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
+              border: Border.all(color: context.borderColor),
+            ),
+            child: const Center(
+              child: SizedBox(width: 24, height: 24, child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2)),
+            ),
+          );
+        }
+        final summary = snap.data!;
+        if (summary.isRoommateMode) {
+          return MultiRoommateSettlementCard(
+            householdId: widget.householdId,
+            summary: summary,
+            onSettled: _reload,
+          );
+        }
+        return FamilyReimbursementCard(
+          householdId: widget.householdId,
+          loadSummary: widget.loadNafaqah,
+          onSummaryLoaded: widget.onNafaqahLoaded,
+        );
+      },
+    );
+  }
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/widgets/dashboard/household_setup_card.dart b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/dashboard/household_setup_card.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..02ad2fc
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/dashboard/household_setup_card.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,558 @@
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';
+import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
+
+import '../../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import '../../models/household_membership.dart';
+import '../../models/household_setup.dart';
+import '../../models/money.dart';
+import '../../services/api_service.dart';
+import '../../services/household_setting_saver.dart';
+import '../../services/salary_cycle_service.dart';
+import '../../theme/app_themes.dart';
+import '../app_snackbar.dart';
+import '../settings/household_roles_card.dart';
+import '../settings/income_settings_card.dart';
+import '../settings/payday_settings_card.dart';
+import '../settings/role_invite_dialog.dart';
+
+/// Creates one category budget for the current cycle; true when the server
+/// confirmed it (`POST /budgets/categories`).
+typedef StarterBudgetCreator = Future<bool> Function(String categoryCode, String categoryName, double amount);
+
+/// Device-local flags of the checklist (SharedPreferences).
+class HouseholdSetupPrefs {
+  static String paydayConfirmedKey(String householdId) => 'setup_payday_confirmed_$householdId';
+  static String hiddenKey(String householdId) => 'setup_hidden_$householdId';
+
+  static Future<void> setPaydayConfirmed(String householdId) async {
+    try {
+      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
+      await prefs.setBool(paydayConfirmedKey(householdId), true);
+    } catch (_) {}
+  }
+
+  static Future<void> setHidden(String householdId) async {
+    try {
+      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
+      await prefs.setBool(hiddenKey(householdId), true);
+    } catch (_) {}
+  }
+
+  /// Loads the checklist's data from the existing endpoints (payday, income,
+  /// members). A value that cannot be read stays null.
+  static Future<HouseholdSetupData> load(String householdId, {ApiService? api}) async {
+    final service = api ?? ApiService.instance;
+    Future<T?> attempt<T>(Future<T> Function() call) async {
+      try {
+        return await call();
+      } catch (_) {
+        return null;
+      }
+    }
+
+    final results = await Future.wait<Object?>([
+      attempt(() => service.getHouseholdPayday(householdId)),
+      attempt(() => service.getHouseholdIncome(householdId)),
+      attempt(() => service.getHouseholdMembers(householdId)),
+    ]);
+    var confirmed = false;
+    var hidden = false;
+    try {
+      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
+      confirmed = prefs.getBool(paydayConfirmedKey(householdId)) ?? false;
+      hidden = prefs.getBool(hiddenKey(householdId)) ?? false;
+    } catch (_) {}
+    final payday = results[0] as int?;
+    return HouseholdSetupData(
+      paydayDay: payday,
+      // A payday other than the default was chosen on purpose.
+      paydayConfirmed: confirmed || (payday != null && payday != SalaryCycleService.defaultPaydayDay),
+      monthlyIncome: results[1] as double?,
+      roster: results[2] as HouseholdRoster?,
+      hidden: hidden,
+    );
+  }
+}
+
+/// "Set up your household in two minutes" (UX-02): the first-run checklist
+/// for a household admin, each step opening the existing editor. A member who
+/// is not an admin is told that the admin sets things up.
+class HouseholdSetupCard extends StatelessWidget {
+  final String householdId;
+  final HouseholdSetupData data;
+
+  /// The current cycle has budgets.
+  final bool hasBudgets;
+
+  /// A step changed something: reload [data].
+  final VoidCallback onChanged;
+
+  /// Hides the checklist (offered only once budgets exist).
+  final VoidCallback? onHide;
+
+  // Seams for tests; default to the API and SharedPreferences.
+  final StarterBudgetCreator? createBudget;
+  final Future<bool> Function(int day)? savePayday;
+  final Future<bool> Function(double income)? saveIncome;
+  final Future<void> Function()? confirmPayday;
+
+  const HouseholdSetupCard({
+    super.key,
+    required this.householdId,
+    required this.data,
+    required this.hasBudgets,
+    required this.onChanged,
+    this.onHide,
+    this.createBudget,
+    this.savePayday,
+    this.saveIncome,
+    this.confirmPayday,
+  });
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    if (!data.isAdmin) return _waitingForAdmin(context);
+
+    final steps = data.steps;
+    final done = data.doneCount(hasBudgets: hasBudgets);
+    return Container(
+      key: const Key('household_setup_card'),
+      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 8),
+      decoration: BoxDecoration(
+        color: context.cardBg,
+        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
+        border: Border.all(color: AppThemes.electricTeal.withValues(alpha: 0.4), width: 1.2),
+      ),
+      child: Column(
+        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
+        children: [
+          Row(
+            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
+            children: [
+              Expanded(
+                child: Column(
+                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
+                  children: [
+                    Text(
+                      context.tr('setup_title'),
+                      style: GoogleFonts.outfit(fontSize: 17, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, color: context.textPrimary),
+                    ),
+                    const SizedBox(height: 2),
+                    Text(
+                      context.trArgs('setup_progress', {'done': done, 'total': steps.length}),
+                      style: TextStyle(color: context.textSecondary, fontSize: 12),
+                    ),
+                  ],
+                ),
+              ),
+              if (hasBudgets && onHide != null)
+                TextButton(onPressed: onHide, child: Text(context.tr('setup_hide'))),
+            ],
+          ),
+          const SizedBox(height: 8),
+          ClipRRect(
+            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
+            child: LinearProgressIndicator(
+              value: steps.isEmpty ? 0 : done / steps.length,
+              minHeight: 5,
+              backgroundColor: context.chipBg,
+              valueColor: const AlwaysStoppedAnimation(AppThemes.success),
+            ),
+          ),
+          const SizedBox(height: 6),
+          for (final step in steps) _stepRow(context, step),
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+
+  Widget _waitingForAdmin(BuildContext context) => Container(
+        key: const Key('household_setup_waiting'),
+        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
+        decoration: BoxDecoration(
+          color: context.cardBg,
+          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
+          border: Border.all(color: context.borderColor),
+        ),
+        child: Row(
+          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
+          children: [
+            Icon(Icons.hourglass_top_rounded, color: context.textSecondary),
+            const SizedBox(width: 12),
+            Expanded(
+              child: Column(
+                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
+                children: [
+                  Text(
+                    context.tr('setup_waiting_admin_title'),
+                    style: GoogleFonts.outfit(fontSize: 15, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: context.textPrimary),
+                  ),
+                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
+                  Text(context.tr('setup_waiting_admin_desc'), style: TextStyle(color: context.textSecondary, fontSize: 12)),
+                ],
+              ),
+            ),
+          ],
+        ),
+      );
+
+  String _stepLabel(BuildContext context, SetupStep step) {
+    switch (step) {
+      case SetupStep.payday:
+        return context.trArgs('setup_step_payday', {'day': data.paydayDay ?? SalaryCycleService.paydayDay});
+      case SetupStep.income:
+        final income = data.monthlyIncome ?? 0;
+        return income > 0
+            ? context.trArgs('setup_step_income_done', {'amount': context.sar(income, decimals: 0)})
+            : context.tr('setup_step_income');
+      case SetupStep.budgets:
+        return context.tr('setup_step_budgets');
+      case SetupStep.invite:
+        return context.tr(data.isFamily ? 'setup_step_invite_family' : 'setup_step_invite_roommates');
+      case SetupStep.provider:
+        return context.tr('setup_step_provider');
+    }
+  }
+
+  IconData _stepIcon(SetupStep step) {
+    switch (step) {
+      case SetupStep.payday:
+        return Icons.event_rounded;
+      case SetupStep.income:
+        return Icons.payments_outlined;
+      case SetupStep.budgets:
+        return Icons.pie_chart_outline_rounded;
+      case SetupStep.invite:
+        return Icons.person_add_alt_1_rounded;
+      case SetupStep.provider:
+        return Icons.family_restroom_rounded;
+    }
+  }
+
+  Widget _stepRow(BuildContext context, SetupStep step) {
+    final isDone = data.isDone(step, hasBudgets: hasBudgets);
+    return InkWell(
+      key: Key('setup_step_${step.name}'),
+      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
+      onTap: () => _open(context, step),
+      child: ConstrainedBox(
+        constraints: const BoxConstraints(minHeight: 48),
+        child: Row(
+          children: [
+            Icon(
+              isDone ? Icons.check_circle_rounded : Icons.radio_button_unchecked_rounded,
+              color: isDone ? AppThemes.success : context.textSecondary,
+              size: 22,
+            ),
+            const SizedBox(width: 10),
+            Icon(_stepIcon(step), size: 18, color: context.textSecondary),
+            const SizedBox(width: 8),
+            Expanded(
+              child: Text(
+                _stepLabel(context, step),
+                style: TextStyle(
+                  color: context.textPrimary,
+                  fontSize: 13.5,
+                  fontWeight: isDone ? FontWeight.w500 : FontWeight.w700,
+                ),
+              ),
+            ),
+            if (step == SetupStep.payday && !isDone)
+              TextButton(
+                key: const Key('setup_confirm_payday'),
+                onPressed: () async {
+                  await (confirmPayday ?? () => HouseholdSetupPrefs.setPaydayConfirmed(householdId))();
+                  onChanged();
+                },
+                child: Text(context.tr('setup_confirm')),
+              )
+            else
+              Icon(
+                context.isRtl ? Icons.chevron_left_rounded : Icons.chevron_right_rounded,
+                color: context.textSecondary,
+              ),
+          ],
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+
+  Future<void> _open(BuildContext context, SetupStep step) async {
+    switch (step) {
+      case SetupStep.payday:
+        await _sheet(
+          context,
+          PaydaySettingsCard(
+            initialPayday: data.paydayDay ?? SalaryCycleService.paydayDay,
+            onSavePayday: (day) async {
+              final ok = await (savePayday ?? (d) => _defaultSavePayday(context, d))(day);
+              if (ok) {
+                await (confirmPayday ?? () => HouseholdSetupPrefs.setPaydayConfirmed(householdId))();
+                onChanged();
+              }
+              return ok;
+            },
+          ),
+        );
+      case SetupStep.income:
+        await _sheet(
+          context,
+          IncomeSettingsCard(
+            initialIncome: data.monthlyIncome ?? 0,
+            onSaveIncome: (income) async {
+              final ok = await (saveIncome ?? (v) => _defaultSaveIncome(context, v))(income);
+              if (ok) onChanged();
+              return ok;
+            },
+          ),
+        );
+      case SetupStep.budgets:
+        await _sheet(
+          context,
+          StarterBudgetSheet(
+            monthlyIncome: data.monthlyIncome,
+            createBudget: createBudget ?? _defaultCreateBudget,
+            onCreated: onChanged,
+          ),
+        );
+      case SetupStep.invite:
+        await showDialog<void>(
+          context: context,
+          builder: (_) => RoleInviteDialog(
+            householdId: householdId,
+            initialRole: data.isFamily ? 'spouse' : 'peer',
+          ),
+        );
+        onChanged();
+      case SetupStep.provider:
+        await _sheet(
+          context,
+          HouseholdRolesCard(
+            householdId: householdId,
+            onNafaqahProviderChanged: (_) => onChanged(),
+          ),
+        );
+    }
+  }
+
+  Future<void> _sheet(BuildContext context, Widget child) => showModalBottomSheet<void>(
+        context: context,
+        isScrollControlled: true,
+        // The settings editors reused here are laid out for a full-width card.
+        constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 720),
+        backgroundColor: context.scaffoldBg,
+        shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(24))),
+        builder: (ctx) => Padding(
+          padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: MediaQuery.of(ctx).viewInsets.bottom),
+          child: SafeArea(
+            child: SingleChildScrollView(
+              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 20, 16, 16),
+              child: child,
+            ),
+          ),
+        ),
+      );
+
+  /// Server first (MOB-27): the local cycle arithmetic changes only once the
+  /// API confirmed the payday.
+  Future<bool> _defaultSavePayday(BuildContext context, int day) async {
+    try {
+      await saveHouseholdSetting<int>(
+        householdId: householdId,
+        value: day,
+        saveRemote: (hid, d) => ApiService.instance.setHouseholdPayday(hid, d),
+        applyLocal: (d) async {
+          SalaryCycleService.paydayDay = d;
+          await SalaryCycleService.cachePayday(d);
+        },
+      );
+      return true;
+    } catch (e) {
+      if (context.mounted) {
+        AppSnackBar.showError(
+          context,
+          context.trArgs('set_failed_save_payday', {'error': _saveError(context, e)}),
+          title: context.tr('set_payday_error'),
+        );
+      }
+      return false;
+    }
+  }
+
+  Future<bool> _defaultSaveIncome(BuildContext context, double income) async {
+    try {
+      await saveHouseholdSetting<double>(
+        householdId: householdId,
+        value: income,
+        saveRemote: (hid, v) => ApiService.instance.setHouseholdIncome(hid, v),
+        applyLocal: (v) async {
+          try {
+            final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
+            await prefs.setDouble('household_monthly_income', v);
+          } catch (_) {}
+        },
+      );
+      return true;
+    } catch (e) {
+      if (context.mounted) {
+        AppSnackBar.showError(
+          context,
+          context.trArgs('set_failed_save_income', {'error': _saveError(context, e)}),
+          title: context.tr('set_income_error'),
+        );
+      }
+      return false;
+    }
+  }
+
+  String _saveError(BuildContext context, Object e) =>
+      e is HouseholdSettingNotSavedException ? context.tr('setting_not_saved_server') : e.toString();
+
+  Future<bool> _defaultCreateBudget(String code, String name, double amount) async {
+    try {
+      final res = await ApiService.instance.addBudgetCategory(
+        householdId: householdId,
+        code: code,
+        category: name,
+        allocatedAmount: amount,
+      );
+      return res['status'] == 'success';
+    } catch (_) {
+      return false;
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+/// The suggested starter budget: one amount per category, pre-filled from the
+/// income (editable, 0 skips), created for the current cycle.
+class StarterBudgetSheet extends StatefulWidget {
+  final double? monthlyIncome;
+  final StarterBudgetCreator createBudget;
+  final VoidCallback onCreated;
+
+  const StarterBudgetSheet({
+    super.key,
+    required this.monthlyIncome,
+    required this.createBudget,
+    required this.onCreated,
+  });
+
+  @override
+  State<StarterBudgetSheet> createState() => _StarterBudgetSheetState();
+}
+
+class _StarterBudgetSheetState extends State<StarterBudgetSheet> {
+  late final List<StarterBudgetRow> _rows = starterBudgetTemplate(widget.monthlyIncome);
+  late final Map<String, TextEditingController> _controllers = {
+    for (final r in _rows) r.categoryCode: TextEditingController(text: r.amount > 0 ? r.amount.toStringAsFixed(0) : ''),
+  };
+  bool _saving = false;
+  String? _error;
+
+  @override
+  void dispose() {
+    for (final c in _controllers.values) {
+      c.dispose();
+    }
+    super.dispose();
+  }
+
+  Future<void> _create() async {
+    final amounts = <String, double>{};
+    for (final r in _rows) {
+      final text = _controllers[r.categoryCode]!.text.trim();
+      if (text.isEmpty) continue;
+      final value = parseMoneyInput(text, allowNegative: false);
+      if (value == null) {
+        setState(() => _error = context.tr('starter_budgets_invalid'));
+        return;
+      }
+      if (value > 0) amounts[r.categoryCode] = value;
+    }
+    if (amounts.isEmpty) {
+      setState(() => _error = context.tr('starter_budgets_none'));
+      return;
+    }
+    setState(() {
+      _saving = true;
+      _error = null;
+    });
+    final failed = <String>[];
+    var created = 0;
+    for (final entry in amounts.entries) {
+      final ok = await widget.createBudget(entry.key, context.trCat(entry.key), entry.value);
+      if (!mounted) return;
+      if (ok) {
+        created++;
+      } else {
+        failed.add(context.trCat(entry.key));
+      }
+    }
+    if (!mounted) return;
+    if (created > 0) widget.onCreated();
+    if (failed.isEmpty) {
+      AppSnackBar.showSuccess(context, context.tr('starter_budgets_created'));
+      Navigator.of(context).pop();
+      return;
+    }
+    setState(() {
+      _saving = false;
+      _error = context.trArgs('starter_budgets_partial', {'categories': failed.join(context.isArabic ? '، ' : ', ')});
+    });
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final income = widget.monthlyIncome ?? 0;
+    return Column(
+      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
+      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
+      children: [
+        Text(
+          context.tr('starter_budgets_title'),
+          style: GoogleFonts.outfit(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, color: context.textPrimary),
+        ),
+        const SizedBox(height: 4),
+        Text(
+          income > 0
+              ? context.trArgs('starter_budgets_desc_income', {'amount': context.sar(income, decimals: 0)})
+              : context.tr('starter_budgets_desc_no_income'),
+          style: TextStyle(color: context.textSecondary, fontSize: 12),
+        ),
+        const SizedBox(height: 12),
+        for (final r in _rows)
+          Padding(
+            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
+            child: TextField(
+              key: Key('starter_amount_${r.categoryCode}'),
+              controller: _controllers[r.categoryCode],
+              keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal: true),
+              decoration: InputDecoration(
+                labelText: context.trCat(r.categoryCode),
+                suffixText: context.tr('sar'),
+                border: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
+                isDense: true,
+              ),
+            ),
+          ),
+        if (_error != null) ...[
+          Text(_error!, style: TextStyle(color: context.dangerColor, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
+          const SizedBox(height: 8),
+        ],
+        ElevatedButton(
+          onPressed: _saving ? null : _create,
+          style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
+            backgroundColor: AppThemes.success,
+            foregroundColor: AppThemes.deepGlacial,
+            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
+            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
+          ),
+          child: _saving
+              ? const SizedBox(width: 18, height: 18, child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2))
+              : Text(context.tr('starter_budgets_create'), style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
+        ),
+      ],
+    );
+  }
+}

diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/widgets/dashboard/over_budget_alerts.dart b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/dashboard/over_budget_alerts.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..963c02b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/dashboard/over_budget_alerts.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,65 @@
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';
+
+import '../../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import '../../models/models.dart';
+import '../../theme/app_themes.dart';
+
+/// The overspent categories right under the hero (UX-08): the three furthest
+/// over budget with the amount over, and "Show all" to the category list.
+/// Renders nothing while every category is within budget.
+class OverBudgetAlerts extends StatelessWidget {
+  final List<Budget> budgets;
+  final VoidCallback onShowAll;
+
+  /// How many categories to list.
+  final int limit;
+
+  const OverBudgetAlerts({super.key, required this.budgets, required this.onShowAll, this.limit = 3});
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final over = Budget.sortByRisk(budgets.where((b) => b.isOverspent));
+    if (over.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();
+    final danger = context.dangerColor;
+    return Container(
+      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
+      padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(14, 10, 6, 6),
+      decoration: BoxDecoration(
+        color: danger.withValues(alpha: context.isDarkMode ? 0.12 : 0.06),
+        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
+        border: Border.all(color: danger.withValues(alpha: 0.35)),
+      ),
+      child: Column(
+        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
+        children: [
+          Row(
+            children: [
+              Icon(Icons.warning_amber_rounded, size: 18, color: danger),
+              const SizedBox(width: 6),
+              Expanded(
+                child: Text(
+                  context.trArgs('over_budget_count', {'count': over.length}),
+                  style: GoogleFonts.outfit(color: danger, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 13),
+                ),
+              ),
+              TextButton(onPressed: onShowAll, child: Text(context.tr('show_all'))),
+            ],
+          ),
+          for (final b in over.take(limit))
+            Padding(
+              padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(start: 24, bottom: 6, end: 8),
+              child: Text(
+                context.trArgs('over_budget_row', {
+                  'category': context.trCat(b.categoryCode),
+                  'amount': context.sar(b.overspentAmount),
+                }),
+                key: const Key('over_budget_row'),
+                style: TextStyle(color: context.textPrimary, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
+              ),
+            ),
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}

+/// Looks up whether a salary income record was received for [householdId]
+/// on or after [since].
+typedef RecentSalaryLookup = Future<bool> Function(String householdId, DateTime since);
+
 /// Dismissible banner shown around payday (e.g. 25th-31st or 1st-3rd)
 /// if no salary has been logged yet for the current cycle.
 class PaydayCheckinBanner extends StatefulWidget {
   final String householdId;

+
+  const PaydayCheckinBanner({
+    super.key,
+    required this.householdId,
+    this.salaryLookup,
+    this.clock,
+  });
+
+  /// Column of `income_records` holding the income kind ('salary', 'bonus', ...).
+  /// It is `source_type` (see IncomeRecord.toMap); an earlier version queried a
+  /// non-existent `income_type` column, so the query always failed and the
+  /// banner never appeared.
+  static const String sourceTypeColumn = 'source_type';
+
+  /// Whether [now] falls in the typical Saudi payday window (25th to 3rd).
+  static bool isPaydayWindow(DateTime now) => now.day >= 25 || now.day <= 3;
+
+  /// Default lookup against Supabase.
+  static Future<bool> supabaseSalaryLookup(String householdId, DateTime since) async {
+    final records = await supabase
+        .from('income_records')
+        .select('id')
+        .eq('household_id', householdId)
+        .eq(sourceTypeColumn, IncomeSourceType.salary.value)
+        .gte('received_at', since.toIso8601String())
+        .limit(1);
+    return records.isNotEmpty;
+  }
 
   @override
   State<PaydayCheckinBanner> createState() => _PaydayCheckinBannerState();

diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/widgets/dispose_on_unmount.dart b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/dispose_on_unmount.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..88cfdf7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/dispose_on_unmount.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,45 @@
+import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
+
+/// Owns [ChangeNotifier]s (typically `TextEditingController`s) created for a
+/// dialog or bottom sheet and disposes them when that route's widgets are
+/// unmounted (UI-20).
+///
+/// Disposing right after `await showDialog(...)` is too early: the future
+/// completes when the route is popped, but its exit animation still rebuilds
+/// the `TextField`s, which then use a disposed controller. Wrapping the route
+/// content in this widget disposes the controllers in `State.dispose`, which
+/// Flutter calls after the route is removed and after the `TextField`s (its
+/// descendants) have detached their listeners.
+///
+/// ```dart
+/// final nameCtrl = TextEditingController();
+/// await showDialog(
+///   context: context,
+///   builder: (ctx) => DisposeOnUnmount(
+///     disposables: [nameCtrl],
+///     child: AlertDialog(content: TextField(controller: nameCtrl)),
+///   ),
+/// );
+/// ```
+class DisposeOnUnmount extends StatefulWidget {
+  const DisposeOnUnmount({super.key, required this.disposables, required this.child});
+
+  final List<ChangeNotifier> disposables;
+  final Widget child;
+
+  @override
+  State<DisposeOnUnmount> createState() => _DisposeOnUnmountState();
+}
+
+class _DisposeOnUnmountState extends State<DisposeOnUnmount> {
+  @override
+  void dispose() {
+    for (final notifier in widget.disposables) {
+      notifier.dispose();
+    }
+    super.dispose();
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) => widget.child;
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/widgets/lazy_indexed_stack.dart b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/lazy_indexed_stack.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b9f4cf3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/lazy_indexed_stack.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
+
+/// An [IndexedStack] whose children are built the first time they are shown
+/// and kept alive afterwards (UX-26): the home screen no longer builds — and
+/// fetches for — every tab at launch.
+class LazyIndexedStack extends StatefulWidget {
+  final int index;
+  final int itemCount;
+  final IndexedWidgetBuilder itemBuilder;
+
+  const LazyIndexedStack({
+    super.key,
+    required this.index,
+    required this.itemCount,
+    required this.itemBuilder,
+  });
+
+  @override
+  State<LazyIndexedStack> createState() => _LazyIndexedStackState();
+}
+
+class _LazyIndexedStackState extends State<LazyIndexedStack> {
+  final Set<int> _visited = {};
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    _visited.add(widget.index);
+    return IndexedStack(
+      index: widget.index,
+      children: [
+        for (var i = 0; i < widget.itemCount; i++)
+          _visited.contains(i)
+              ? KeyedSubtree(key: ValueKey('lazy_tab_$i'), child: widget.itemBuilder(context, i))
+              : const SizedBox.shrink(),
+      ],
+    );
+  }
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/widgets/nafaqah/nafaqah_class_selector.dart b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/nafaqah/nafaqah_class_selector.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3a2f10b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/nafaqah/nafaqah_class_selector.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,219 @@
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';
+
+import '../../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import '../../models/nafaqah.dart';
+import '../../theme/app_themes.dart';
+
+/// Family-mode choice for an expense (Islamic Nafaqah, no spousal split), the
+/// single "who paid, and for whom?" question of a family household (UX-03):
+/// * `null` – the husband paid: ordinary household expense, no debt;
+/// * [kWifeReimbursable] – the wife paid for something shared: the husband
+///   owes it back to her;
+/// * [kWifePersonal] – the wife's personal purchase: charged to her allowance.
+///
+/// Options are worded from the recorder's point of view with real names:
+/// the husband sees "Sara paid for the home — I pay her back", the wife
+/// "I paid for the home — he pays me back", an admin who is neither spouse
+/// "Sara paid for the home — owed to her".
+class NafaqahClassSelector extends StatelessWidget {
+  final String? value;
+  final ValueChanged<String?> onChanged;
+
+  /// Labels speak to the wife ("my allowance") when she is the one recording.
+  /// Ignored when [viewerRole] is given.
+  final bool viewerIsWife;
+
+  /// 'wife', 'husband' or 'admin' (an admin who is neither spouse). Defaults
+  /// to 'wife' when [viewerIsWife], else 'husband'.
+  final String? viewerRole;
+
+  /// The wife the class refers to and the husband (provider), by name; generic
+  /// words ("my wife", "my husband") are used when a name is unknown.
+  final String? wifeName;
+  final String? husbandName;
+
+  /// Hide the husband option when the wife already said she paid.
+  final bool showHusbandOption;
+
+  const NafaqahClassSelector({
+    super.key,
+    required this.value,
+    required this.onChanged,
+    this.viewerIsWife = false,
+    this.viewerRole,
+    this.wifeName,
+    this.husbandName,
+    this.showHusbandOption = true,
+  });
+
+  static Color colorFor(String? nafaqahClass) {
+    switch (nafaqahClass) {
+      case kWifeReimbursable:
+        return AppThemes.champagneGold;
+      case kWifePersonal:
+        return AppThemes.iceCyan;
+      default:
+        return AppThemes.success;
+    }
+  }
+
+  String get _role => viewerRole ?? (viewerIsWife ? 'wife' : 'husband');
+
+  static String? _clean(String? name) {
+    final n = (name ?? '').trim();
+    return n.isEmpty ? null : n;
+  }
+
+  /// The label of option [nafaqahClass] for [role] ('wife' | 'husband' | 'admin').
+  static String optionLabel(
+    BuildContext context,
+    String? nafaqahClass, {
+    required String role,
+    String? wifeName,
+    String? husbandName,
+  }) {
+    final wife = _clean(wifeName) ??
+        context.tr(role == 'husband' ? 'nafaqah_wife_generic_mine' : 'nafaqah_wife_generic');
+    final husband = _clean(husbandName) ?? context.tr('nafaqah_husband_generic_mine');
+    switch (role) {
+      case 'wife':
+        return switch (nafaqahClass) {
+          kWifeReimbursable => context.tr('nafaqah_w_opt_shared'),
+          kWifePersonal => context.tr('nafaqah_w_opt_personal'),
+          _ => context.trArgs('nafaqah_w_opt_husband', {'husband': husband}),
+        };
+      case 'admin':
+        return switch (nafaqahClass) {
+          kWifeReimbursable => context.trArgs('nafaqah_a_opt_shared', {'wife': wife}),
+          kWifePersonal => context.trArgs('nafaqah_h_opt_personal', {'wife': wife}),
+          _ => context.tr('nafaqah_a_opt_household'),
+        };
+      default:
+        return switch (nafaqahClass) {
+          kWifeReimbursable => context.trArgs('nafaqah_h_opt_shared', {'wife': wife}),
+          kWifePersonal => context.trArgs('nafaqah_h_opt_personal', {'wife': wife}),
+          _ => context.tr('nafaqah_h_opt_me'),
+        };
+    }
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final options = <(String?, IconData)>[
+      if (showHusbandOption) (null, Icons.shield_outlined),
+      (kWifeReimbursable, Icons.currency_exchange_rounded),
+      (kWifePersonal, Icons.shopping_bag_outlined),
+    ];
+    final hintKey = switch (value) {
+      kWifeReimbursable => 'nafaqah_wife_reimbursable_hint',
+      kWifePersonal => 'nafaqah_wife_personal_hint',
+      _ => 'nafaqah_me_hint',
+    };
+    final activeColor = colorFor(value);
+
+    return Column(
+      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
+      children: [
+        Text(
+          context.tr('nafaqah_q_title'),
+          style: TextStyle(color: context.textSecondary, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
+        ),
+        const SizedBox(height: 6),
+        for (var i = 0; i < options.length; i++) ...[
+          if (i > 0) const SizedBox(height: 6),
+          _Option(
+            key: ValueKey('nafaqah_option_${options[i].$1 ?? 'husband'}'),
+            label: optionLabel(context, options[i].$1, role: _role, wifeName: wifeName, husbandName: husbandName),
+            icon: options[i].$2,
+            color: colorFor(options[i].$1),
+            selected: value == options[i].$1,
+            onTap: () => onChanged(options[i].$1),
+          ),
+        ],
+        const SizedBox(height: 8),
+        Container(
+          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
+          decoration: BoxDecoration(
+            color: activeColor.withValues(alpha: context.isDark ? 0.12 : 0.08),
+            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
+            border: Border.all(color: activeColor.withValues(alpha: context.isDark ? 0.35 : 0.25)),
+          ),
+          child: Row(
+            children: [
+              Icon(Icons.info_outline_rounded, size: 15, color: activeColor),
+              const SizedBox(width: 8),
+              Expanded(
+                child: Text(
+                  context.tr(hintKey),
+                  style: GoogleFonts.outfit(color: context.textPrimary, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500),
+                ),
+              ),
+            ],
+          ),
+        ),
+      ],
+    );
+  }
+}
+
+class _Option extends StatelessWidget {
+  final String label;
+  final IconData icon;
+  final Color color;
+  final bool selected;
+  final VoidCallback onTap;
+
+  const _Option({
+    super.key,
+    required this.label,
+    required this.icon,
+    required this.color,
+    required this.selected,
+    required this.onTap,
+  });
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    return Semantics(
+      button: true,
+      selected: selected,
+      inMutuallyExclusiveGroup: true,
+      child: InkWell(
+        onTap: onTap,
+        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
+        child: Container(
+          constraints: const BoxConstraints(minHeight: 48),
+          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10, horizontal: 12),
+          decoration: BoxDecoration(
+            color: selected ? color.withValues(alpha: 0.16) : context.subtleCardBg,
+            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
+            border: Border.all(color: selected ? color : context.borderColor, width: selected ? 1.5 : 1.0),
+          ),
+          child: Row(
+            children: [
+              Icon(
+                selected ? Icons.radio_button_checked_rounded : Icons.radio_button_off_rounded,
+                size: 18,
+                color: selected ? color : context.textSecondary,
+              ),
+              const SizedBox(width: 10),
+              Icon(icon, size: 18, color: selected ? color : context.textSecondary),
+              const SizedBox(width: 8),
+              Expanded(
+                child: Text(
+                  label,
+                  style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
+                    fontSize: 13,
+                    fontWeight: selected ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w500,
+                    color: selected ? context.textPrimary : context.textSecondary,
+                  ),
+                ),
+              ),
+            ],
+          ),
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/widgets/nafaqah/nafaqah_review_section.dart b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/nafaqah/nafaqah_review_section.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..fe2e944
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/nafaqah/nafaqah_review_section.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,88 @@
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+
+import '../../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import '../../models/nafaqah.dart';
+import '../../theme/app_themes.dart';
+import 'nafaqah_class_selector.dart';
+
+/// Family-mode review of a scanned or chat expense: the [NafaqahClassSelector]
+/// plus, for a husband with several wives, which wife paid. Shown only when
+/// [preview] says the recorder can classify (the husband or a wife).
+class NafaqahReviewSection extends StatelessWidget {
+  final NafaqahPreview preview;
+  final String? value;
+  final String? wifeId;
+  final ValueChanged<String?> onChanged;
+  final ValueChanged<String> onWifeChanged;
+
+  /// Hide the "husband paid" option when the chips already say the wife paid.
+  final bool showHusbandOption;
+
+  /// Highlights the wife choice after a save attempt without one.
+  final bool showWifeRequired;
+
+  const NafaqahReviewSection({
+    super.key,
+    required this.preview,
+    required this.value,
+    required this.onChanged,
+    required this.onWifeChanged,
+    this.wifeId,
+    this.showHusbandOption = true,
+    this.showWifeRequired = false,
+  });
+
+  /// A save may proceed: no wife is needed, or one is chosen.
+  static bool hasRequiredWife(NafaqahPreview preview, String? value, String? wifeId) =>
+      !preview.needsWifeChoice || value == null || (wifeId != null && wifeId.isNotEmpty);
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    if (!preview.canClassify) return const SizedBox.shrink();
+    final showWives = preview.needsWifeChoice && value != null;
+    return Column(
+      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
+      children: [
+        NafaqahClassSelector(
+          value: value,
+          viewerRole: preview.viewerRole,
+          // The wife is the one recording, or the wife chosen (the only one).
+          wifeName: preview.viewerIsWife ? null : preview.wifeNameFor(wifeId),
+          husbandName: preview.husbandName,
+          showHusbandOption: showHusbandOption,
+          onChanged: onChanged,
+        ),
+        if (showWives) ...[
+          const SizedBox(height: 8),
+          Text(
+            context.tr('nafaqah_choose_wife'),
+            style: TextStyle(color: context.textSecondary, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
+          ),
+          const SizedBox(height: 4),
+          Wrap(
+            spacing: 8,
+            runSpacing: 4,
+            children: preview.wives.map((w) {
+              final name = (w.displayName ?? '').trim().isNotEmpty ? w.displayName!.trim() : context.tr('wife_spouse_title');
+              return ChoiceChip(
+                key: ValueKey('nafaqah_wife_${w.id}'),
+                label: Text(name),
+                selected: wifeId == w.id,
+                onSelected: (selected) {
+                  if (selected) onWifeChanged(w.id);
+                },
+              );
+            }).toList(),
+          ),
+          if (showWifeRequired && !hasRequiredWife(preview, value, wifeId)) ...[
+            const SizedBox(height: 4),
+            Text(
+              context.tr('nafaqah_choose_wife_required'),
+              style: TextStyle(color: context.dangerColor, fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
+            ),
+          ],
+        ],
+      ],
+    );
+  }
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/widgets/nafaqah/wife_allowance_card.dart b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/nafaqah/wife_allowance_card.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..17a2758
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/nafaqah/wife_allowance_card.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,345 @@
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';
+
+import '../../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import '../../models/money.dart';
+import '../../models/nafaqah.dart';
+import '../../services/api_service.dart';
+import '../../theme/app_themes.dart';
+import '../app_snackbar.dart';
+
+/// Saves the wife's allowance for a cycle. Defaults to the API; injectable for tests.
+typedef AllowanceSetter = Future<AllowanceStatus> Function({
+  required double amount,
+  required String wifeUserId,
+  String? cycleKey,
+});
+
+/// The wife's personal allowance ("مصروفها") for the salary cycle: allocated,
+/// spent on her personal purchases and remaining. Overspend is shown as a
+/// negative remainder, never blocked. Only the husband or a household admin
+/// (never the wife herself) can set it.
+class WifeAllowanceCard extends StatelessWidget {
+  final String householdId;
+  final NafaqahWife wife;
+  final String? cycleKey;
+  final bool viewerIsWife;
+  final bool canSet;
+  final bool showWifeName;
+  final AllowanceSetter? setAllowance;
+  final VoidCallback? onChanged;
+
+  const WifeAllowanceCard({
+    super.key,
+    required this.householdId,
+    required this.wife,
+    this.cycleKey,
+    this.viewerIsWife = false,
+    this.canSet = false,
+    this.showWifeName = false,
+    this.setAllowance,
+    this.onChanged,
+  });
+
+  Future<void> _openEditor(BuildContext context) async {
+    final saved = await showModalBottomSheet<bool>(
+      context: context,
+      isScrollControlled: true,
+      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
+      builder: (_) => _AllowanceEditorSheet(
+        householdId: householdId,
+        wifeUserId: wife.id,
+        cycleKey: cycleKey ?? wife.allowance.cycleKey,
+        initialAmount: wife.allowance.isSet ? wife.allowance.allocated : null,
+        setAllowance: setAllowance,
+      ),
+    );
+    if (saved == true) onChanged?.call();
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final st = wife.allowance;
+    final key = cycleKey ?? st.cycleKey;
+    final cycle = AppLocalizations.of(context).cycleLabel(key, fallback: key);
+    final remainingColor = st.isOverspent ? context.dangerColor : context.successText;
+    final barColor = st.isOverspent ? context.dangerColor : AppThemes.iceCyan;
+    final title = viewerIsWife ? context.tr('allowance_title_mine') : context.tr('allowance_title');
+
+    return Container(
+      key: ValueKey('wife_allowance_${wife.id}'),
+      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
+      decoration: BoxDecoration(
+        color: context.cardBg,
+        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
+        border: Border.all(
+          color: st.isOverspent ? context.dangerColor.withValues(alpha: 0.4) : context.borderColor,
+          width: 1.2,
+        ),
+      ),
+      child: Column(
+        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
+        children: [
+          Row(
+            children: [
+              Container(
+                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
+                decoration: BoxDecoration(
+                  color: AppThemes.iceCyan.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
+                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
+                ),
+                child: const Icon(Icons.account_balance_wallet_outlined, color: AppThemes.iceCyan, size: 20),
+              ),
+              const SizedBox(width: 10),
+              Expanded(
+                child: Column(
+                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
+                  children: [
+                    Text(
+                      showWifeName && (wife.displayName ?? '').isNotEmpty ? '$title · ${wife.displayName}' : title,
+                      style: GoogleFonts.outfit(color: context.textPrimary, fontSize: 15, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
+                    ),
+                    Text(
+                      context.trArgs('allowance_subtitle', {'cycle': cycle}),
+                      style: TextStyle(color: context.textSecondary, fontSize: 11),
+                    ),
+                  ],
+                ),
+              ),
+            ],
+          ),
+          const SizedBox(height: 14),
+          if (!st.hasAllowance) ...[
+            Text(
+              context.trArgs(
+                viewerIsWife ? 'allowance_personal_spending_mine' : 'allowance_personal_spending_her',
+                {'amount': context.sar(st.spent)},
+              ),
+              key: const ValueKey('allowance_personal_spending'),
+              style: GoogleFonts.outfit(color: context.textPrimary, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
+            ),
+          ] else ...[
+            Row(
+              children: [
+                _Stat(label: context.tr('allowance_allocated'), value: context.sar(st.allocated), color: context.textPrimary),
+                _Stat(label: context.tr('allowance_spent'), value: context.sar(st.spent), color: context.textPrimary),
+                _Stat(
+                  key: const ValueKey('allowance_remaining_value'),
+                  label: context.tr('allowance_remaining'),
+                  value: context.sar(st.remaining),
+                  color: remainingColor,
+                ),
+              ],
+            ),
+            const SizedBox(height: 10),
+            ClipRRect(
+              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
+              child: LinearProgressIndicator(
+                value: st.usedFraction,
+                minHeight: 6,
+                backgroundColor: context.subtleCardBg,
+                valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(barColor),
+              ),
+            ),
+          ],
+          if (st.isOverspent) ...[
+            const SizedBox(height: 8),
+            Row(
+              children: [
+                Icon(Icons.warning_amber_rounded, size: 14, color: context.dangerColor),
+                const SizedBox(width: 6),
+                Expanded(
+                  child: Text(
+                    context.trArgs('allowance_overspent', {'amount': context.sar(-st.remaining)}),
+                    style: TextStyle(color: context.dangerColor, fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
+                  ),
+                ),
+              ],
+            ),
+          ],
+          if (!st.hasAllowance) ...[
+            const SizedBox(height: 8),
+            Text(context.tr('allowance_not_set'), style: TextStyle(color: context.textSecondary, fontSize: 11.5)),
+          ],
+          if (canSet) ...[
+            const SizedBox(height: 12),
+            SizedBox(
+              width: double.infinity,
+              child: OutlinedButton.icon(
+                style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
+                  foregroundColor: AppThemes.iceCyan,
+                  side: BorderSide(color: AppThemes.iceCyan.withValues(alpha: 0.5)),
+                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10),
+                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
+                ),
+                icon: const Icon(Icons.tune_rounded, size: 18),
+                label: Text(st.isSet ? context.tr('allowance_edit') : context.tr('allowance_set')),
+                onPressed: () => _openEditor(context),
+              ),
+            ),
+          ] else if (viewerIsWife) ...[
+            const SizedBox(height: 8),
+            Text(context.tr('allowance_set_by_husband'), style: TextStyle(color: context.textSecondary, fontSize: 11)),
+          ],
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}
+
+class _Stat extends StatelessWidget {
+  final String label;
+  final String value;
+  final Color color;
+
+  const _Stat({super.key, required this.label, required this.value, required this.color});
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    return Expanded(
+      child: Column(
+        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
+        children: [
+          Text(label, style: TextStyle(color: context.textSecondary, fontSize: 11)),
+          const SizedBox(height: 2),
+          FittedBox(
+            fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
+            alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerStart,
+            child: Text(
+              value,
+              style: GoogleFonts.outfit(color: color, fontSize: 15, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
+            ),
+          ),
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}
+
+class _AllowanceEditorSheet extends StatefulWidget {
+  final String householdId;
+  final String wifeUserId;
+  final String cycleKey;
+  final double? initialAmount;
+  final AllowanceSetter? setAllowance;
+
+  const _AllowanceEditorSheet({
+    required this.householdId,
+    required this.wifeUserId,
+    required this.cycleKey,
+    this.initialAmount,
+    this.setAllowance,
+  });
+
+  @override
+  State<_AllowanceEditorSheet> createState() => _AllowanceEditorSheetState();
+}
+
+class _AllowanceEditorSheetState extends State<_AllowanceEditorSheet> {
+  late final TextEditingController _ctrl;
+  bool _saving = false;
+
+  @override
+  void initState() {
+    super.initState();
+    _ctrl = TextEditingController(text: widget.initialAmount?.toStringAsFixed(2) ?? '');
+  }
+
+  @override
+  void dispose() {
+    _ctrl.dispose();
+    super.dispose();
+  }
+
+  Future<void> _save() async {
+    final amount = parseMoneyInput(_ctrl.text.trim());
+    if (amount == null || amount < 0) {
+      AppSnackBar.showError(context, context.tr('settle_invalid_amount'));
+      return;
+    }
+    setState(() => _saving = true);
+    try {
+      final setter = widget.setAllowance ??
+          ({required double amount, required String wifeUserId, String? cycleKey}) => ApiService.instance
+              .setWifeAllowance(widget.householdId, amount: amount, wifeUserId: wifeUserId, cycleKey: cycleKey);
+      await setter(
+        amount: amount,
+        wifeUserId: widget.wifeUserId,
+        cycleKey: widget.cycleKey.isEmpty ? null : widget.cycleKey,
+      );
+    } catch (e) {
+      if (!mounted) return;
+      setState(() => _saving = false);
+      final forbidden = e is NafaqahApiException && e.code == 'forbidden';
+      AppSnackBar.showError(
+        context,
+        forbidden ? context.tr('nafaqah_err_forbidden') : e.toString(),
+        title: context.tr('allowance_save_failed'),
+      );
+      return;
+    }
+    if (!mounted) return;
+    AppSnackBar.showSuccess(context, context.sar(amount), title: context.tr('allowance_saved'));
+    Navigator.of(context).pop(true);
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    return Container(
+      padding: EdgeInsets.only(
+        left: 20,
+        right: 20,
+        top: 20,
+        bottom: MediaQuery.of(context).viewInsets.bottom + 20,
+      ),
+      decoration: BoxDecoration(
+        color: context.cardBg,
+        borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(24)),
+        border: Border.all(color: context.borderColor),
+      ),
+      child: Column(
+        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
+        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
+        children: [
+          Text(
+            context.trArgs('allowance_set_title', {
+              'cycle': AppLocalizations.of(context).cycleLabel(widget.cycleKey, fallback: widget.cycleKey),
+            }),
+            style: GoogleFonts.outfit(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: context.textPrimary),
+          ),
+          const SizedBox(height: 4),
+          Text(context.tr('allowance_set_by_husband'), style: TextStyle(color: context.textSecondary, fontSize: 12)),
+          const SizedBox(height: 16),
+          TextField(
+            key: const ValueKey('allowance_amount_field'),
+            controller: _ctrl,
+            keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal: true),
+            decoration: InputDecoration(
+              labelText: context.tr('allowance_amount_label'),
+              prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.account_balance_wallet_outlined),
+              border: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
+            ),
+          ),
+          const SizedBox(height: 16),
+          ElevatedButton.icon(
+            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
+              backgroundColor: AppThemes.iceCyan,
+              foregroundColor: AppThemes.deepGlacial,
+              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
+              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
+            ),
+            icon: _saving
+                ? const SizedBox(
+                    width: 16,
+                    height: 16,
+                    child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: AppThemes.deepGlacial),
+                  )
+                : const Icon(Icons.check_rounded, size: 18),
+            label: Text(context.tr('allowance_save'), style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
+            onPressed: _saving ? null : _save,
+          ),
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}

diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/widgets/reminder_sync.dart b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/reminder_sync.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3f3c512
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/reminder_sync.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,129 @@
+/// Keeps the scheduled reminders in step with the signed-in household.
+///
+/// Placed around the home screen: it reschedules on login (first build),
+/// household switch, payday change, language change, reminder switches and
+/// whenever the recurring bills or installment plans change. Sign-out
+/// cancels everything (AuthGate).
+library;
+
+import 'dart:async';
+
+import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
+import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
+
+import '../models/installment_plan.dart';
+import '../models/recurring_bill.dart';
+import '../providers/installment_provider.dart';
+import '../providers/locale_provider.dart';
+import '../providers/recurring_bills_provider.dart';
+import '../services/api_service.dart';
+import '../services/notifications/reminder_preferences.dart';
+import '../services/notifications/reminder_service.dart';
+import '../services/salary_cycle_service.dart';
+
+typedef PaydayFetcher = Future<int?> Function(String householdId);
+
+Future<int?> _fetchPaydayFromApi(String householdId) async {
+  final day = await ApiService.instance.getHouseholdPayday(householdId);
+  return day >= 1 && day <= 31 ? day : null;
+}
+
+class ReminderSync extends StatefulWidget {
+  final Widget child;
+  final ReminderService? service;
+  final ReminderPreferences? preferences;
+  final PaydayFetcher fetchPayday;
+  final Duration debounce;
+
+  const ReminderSync({
+    super.key,
+    required this.child,
+    this.service,
+    this.preferences,
+    this.fetchPayday = _fetchPaydayFromApi,
+    this.debounce = const Duration(milliseconds: 800),
+  });
+
+  @override
+  State<ReminderSync> createState() => _ReminderSyncState();
+}
+
+class _ReminderSyncState extends State<ReminderSync> {
+  Timer? _debounce;
+  String? _paydayHousehold;
+
+  ReminderService get _service => widget.service ?? ReminderService.instance;
+  ReminderPreferences get _prefs => widget.preferences ?? ReminderPreferences.instance;
+
+  @override
+  void initState() {
+    super.initState();
+    _prefs.addListener(_schedule);
+    SalaryCycleService.paydayListenable.addListener(_schedule);
+  }
+
+  @override
+  void dispose() {
+    _debounce?.cancel();
+    _prefs.removeListener(_schedule);
+    SalaryCycleService.paydayListenable.removeListener(_schedule);
+    super.dispose();
+  }
+
+  void _schedule() {
+    _debounce?.cancel();
+    _debounce = Timer(widget.debounce, _sync);
+  }
+
+  Future<void> _sync() async {
+    if (!mounted) return;
+    final installments = context.read<InstallmentProvider>();
+    final billsProvider = context.read<RecurringBillsProvider>();
+    final hid = installments.householdId ?? billsProvider.householdId;
+    if (hid == null || hid.isEmpty) return;
+
+    // The payday of this household (a switch may change it).
+    if (_paydayHousehold != hid) {
+      _paydayHousehold = hid;
+      try {
+        final day = await widget.fetchPayday(hid);
+        // Listeners re-run this sync with the new payday.
+        if (day != null && day != SalaryCycleService.paydayDay) {
+          await SalaryCycleService.cachePayday(day);
+          return;
+        }
+      } catch (_) {
+        // Offline: the cached payday is used.
+      }
+      if (!mounted) return;
+    }
+
+    // Only data that belongs to this household.
+    final List<RecurringBillItem> bills =
+        billsProvider.householdId == hid ? (billsProvider.summary?.bills ?? const []) : const [];
+    final List<InstallmentPlan> plans = installments.householdId == hid ? installments.plans : const [];
+    final enabled = _prefs.enabledTypes;
+    if (enabled.isEmpty) {
+      await _service.cancelAll();
+      return;
+    }
+    await _service.reschedule(
+      householdId: hid,
+      paydayDay: SalaryCycleService.paydayDay,
+      bills: bills,
+      plans: plans,
+      enabled: enabled,
+      locale: context.read<LocaleProvider>().currentLocale,
+    );
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    // Depend on everything the reminders are built from.
+    context.watch<RecurringBillsProvider>();
+    context.watch<InstallmentProvider>();
+    context.watch<LocaleProvider>();
+    _schedule();
+    return widget.child;
+  }
+}

diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/widgets/scanner/receipt_review_editor.dart b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/scanner/receipt_review_editor.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..9cce5af
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/scanner/receipt_review_editor.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,104 @@
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';
+
+import '../../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import '../../models/category_catalog.dart';
+import '../../models/money.dart';
+import '../../theme/app_themes.dart';
+
+/// What the user corrected in a receipt review (UX-12): the total when it
+/// differs from the scan and the category when another one was chosen (null =
+/// keep the scanned value). [invalid] when the typed total is not a positive amount.
+class ReceiptReviewEdits {
+  final double? amount;
+  final String? categoryCode;
+  final bool invalid;
+  const ReceiptReviewEdits({this.amount, this.categoryCode, this.invalid = false});
+
+  static ReceiptReviewEdits from({
+    required double scannedAmount,
+    String? scannedCategory,
+    required String amountText,
+    String? chosenCategory,
+  }) {
+    final typed = parseMoneyInput(amountText, allowNegative: false);
+    if (typed == null || typed <= 0) return const ReceiptReviewEdits(invalid: true);
+    final category = (chosenCategory ?? '').trim();
+    return ReceiptReviewEdits(
+      amount: (typed - scannedAmount).abs() < 0.005 ? null : typed,
+      categoryCode: category.isEmpty || category == (scannedCategory ?? '').trim() ? null : category,
+    );
+  }
+}
+
+/// The editable total and category of a scanned receipt.
+class ReceiptReviewEditor extends StatelessWidget {
+  final TextEditingController amountController;
+  final String categoryCode;
+  final ValueChanged<String> onCategoryChanged;
+  final VoidCallback? onAmountChanged;
+  final bool amountInvalid;
+
+  const ReceiptReviewEditor({
+    super.key,
+    required this.amountController,
+    required this.categoryCode,
+    required this.onCategoryChanged,
+    this.onAmountChanged,
+    this.amountInvalid = false,
+  });
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final border = OutlineInputBorder(
+      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
+      borderSide: BorderSide(color: context.borderColor),
+    );
+    return Padding(
+      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
+      child: Column(
+        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
+        children: [
+          TextField(
+            key: const ValueKey('receipt_review_amount'),
+            controller: amountController,
+            keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal: true),
+            onChanged: (_) => onAmountChanged?.call(),
+            style: GoogleFonts.outfit(color: context.textPrimary, fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
+            decoration: InputDecoration(
+              labelText: context.tr('scan_review_amount_label'),
+              suffixText: context.tr('sar'),
+              errorText: amountInvalid ? context.tr('pec_amount_invalid') : null,
+              filled: true,
+              fillColor: context.inputBg,
+              border: border,
+              enabledBorder: border,
+              focusedBorder: border.copyWith(borderSide: const BorderSide(color: AppThemes.success)),
+            ),
+          ),
+          const SizedBox(height: 10),
+          DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
+            key: const ValueKey('receipt_review_category'),
+            initialValue: categoryCode,
+            isExpanded: true,
+            dropdownColor: context.cardBg,
+            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyLarge?.copyWith(color: context.textPrimary, fontSize: 14),
+            decoration: InputDecoration(
+              labelText: context.tr('category'),
+              filled: true,
+              fillColor: context.inputBg,
+              border: border,
+              enabledBorder: border,
+            ),
+            items: CategoryCatalog.pickerCodesIncluding(categoryCode)
+                .map((code) => DropdownMenuItem(value: code, child: Text(context.trCat(code))))
+                .toList(),
+            onChanged: (v) {
+              if (v != null) onCategoryChanged(v);
+            },
+          ),
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}
