diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/widgets/settings/household_roles_card.dart b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/settings/household_roles_card.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..4f1d69b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/settings/household_roles_card.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,697 @@
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';
+
+import '../../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import '../../models/household_membership.dart';
+import '../../models/nafaqah.dart';
+import '../../services/api/household_roles_api_client.dart';
+import '../../services/api_service.dart';
+import '../../theme/app_themes.dart';
+import '../app_snackbar.dart';
+import 'household_type_chooser.dart';
+
+typedef RosterLoader = Future<HouseholdRoster> Function(String householdId);
+typedef RosterAction = Future<HouseholdRoster> Function(String householdId, String userId);
+typedef NafaqahProviderSetter = Future<NafaqahProviderChange> Function(String householdId, String userId);
+typedef HouseholdTypeSetter = Future<String> Function(String householdId, String householdType);
+typedef FinancialRoleSetter = Future<String> Function(String householdId, String userId, String financialRole);
+
+enum _RoleAction { promote, revoke, makePrimary, financialRole }
+
+/// Members of the household with their roles. Admins promote members to
+/// co-admin and revoke co-admins; the primary admin also transfers primary
+/// admin. Co-admins never see an action against the primary admin. Every
+/// change is enforced by the server (DB-16 / DB-18); a refusal is explained.
+///
+/// In a family household the Nafaqah provider (husband) is marked, and any
+/// admin chooses him among the non-spouse members (FABLE-LOGIC-04); a family
+/// without a provider is prompted to set one.
+///
+/// The household type (Family / Roommates) is shown; admins change it
+/// (`PUT /households/{id}/type`) and change a member's financial role
+/// (`PUT .../members/{user_id}/financial-role`), offered only among the roles
+/// valid for the household type and never "wife" for the Nafaqah provider.
+class HouseholdRolesCard extends StatefulWidget {
+  final String householdId;
+  final RosterLoader? loadRoster;
+  final RosterAction? promote;
+  final RosterAction? revoke;
+  final RosterAction? transferPrimary;
+  final NafaqahProviderSetter? setNafaqahProvider;
+  final HouseholdTypeSetter? setHouseholdType;
+  final FinancialRoleSetter? setFinancialRole;
+
+  /// Called after the server confirmed a new household type.
+  final ValueChanged<String>? onHouseholdTypeChanged;
+
+  /// Called after the server confirmed a new Nafaqah provider, with the
+  /// refreshed Nafaqah summary when the server returned one (so the family
+  /// card can reload).
+  final ValueChanged<NafaqahSummary?>? onNafaqahProviderChanged;
+
+  /// Called after a role change the server confirmed (e.g. to refresh the
+  /// signed-in user's own role).
+  final VoidCallback? onRolesChanged;
+
+  const HouseholdRolesCard({
+    super.key,
+    required this.householdId,
+    this.loadRoster,
+    this.promote,
+    this.revoke,
+    this.transferPrimary,
+    this.setNafaqahProvider,
+    this.setHouseholdType,
+    this.setFinancialRole,
+    this.onHouseholdTypeChanged,
+    this.onNafaqahProviderChanged,
+    this.onRolesChanged,
+  });
+
+  @override
+  State<HouseholdRolesCard> createState() => _HouseholdRolesCardState();
+}
+
+class _HouseholdRolesCardState extends State<HouseholdRolesCard> {
+  HouseholdRoster? _roster;
+  bool _loading = true;
+  bool _failed = false;
+  String? _busyUserId;
+  bool _settingProvider = false;
+  bool _settingType = false;
+
+  RosterLoader get _load => widget.loadRoster ?? ApiService.instance.getHouseholdMembers;
+  RosterAction get _promote => widget.promote ?? ApiService.instance.promoteHouseholdAdmin;
+  RosterAction get _revoke => widget.revoke ?? ApiService.instance.revokeHouseholdAdmin;
+  RosterAction get _transfer => widget.transferPrimary ?? ApiService.instance.transferPrimaryAdmin;
+  NafaqahProviderSetter get _setProvider => widget.setNafaqahProvider ?? ApiService.instance.setNafaqahProvider;
+  HouseholdTypeSetter get _setType => widget.setHouseholdType ?? ApiService.instance.setHouseholdType;
+  FinancialRoleSetter get _setFinancialRole => widget.setFinancialRole ?? ApiService.instance.setMemberFinancialRole;
+
+  @override
+  void initState() {
+    super.initState();
+    _fetch();
+  }
+
+  @override
+  void didUpdateWidget(covariant HouseholdRolesCard oldWidget) {
+    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
+    if (oldWidget.householdId != widget.householdId) _fetch();
+  }
+
+  Future<void> _fetch() async {
+    setState(() {
+      _loading = true;
+      _failed = false;
+    });
+    try {
+      final roster = await _load(widget.householdId);
+      if (!mounted) return;
+      setState(() {
+        _roster = roster;
+        _loading = false;
+      });
+    } catch (_) {
+      if (!mounted) return;
+      setState(() {
+        _loading = false;
+        _failed = true;
+      });
+    }
+  }
+
+  String _nameOf(HouseholdMember m) {
+    final name = (m.displayName ?? '').trim();
+    return name.isEmpty ? context.tr('member') : name;
+  }
+
+  String _errorText(Object e) {
+    if (e is HouseholdRolesApiException) {
+      if (e.code == 'forbidden') return context.tr('roles_forbidden');
+      if (e.code == 'last_admin') return context.tr('roles_last_admin');
+    }
+    return context.trArgs('roles_update_failed', {'error': e});
+  }
+
+  Future<void> _run(_RoleAction action, HouseholdMember member) async {
+    if (action == _RoleAction.financialRole) return _changeFinancialRole(member);
+    if (action == _RoleAction.makePrimary) {
+      final name = _nameOf(member);
+      final confirmed = await showDialog<bool>(
+        context: context,
+        builder: (dCtx) => AlertDialog(
+          backgroundColor: context.cardBg,
+          title: Text(context.tr('roles_transfer_title'), style: TextStyle(color: context.textPrimary)),
+          content: Text(
+            context.trArgs('roles_transfer_msg', {'name': name}),
+            style: TextStyle(color: context.textSecondary),
+          ),
+          actions: [
+            TextButton(
+              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dCtx, false),
+              child: Text(context.tr('cancel'), style: TextStyle(color: context.textSecondary)),
+            ),
+            ElevatedButton(
+              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: AppThemes.success, foregroundColor: Colors.black),
+              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dCtx, true),
+              child: Text(context.tr('roles_transfer_confirm')),
+            ),
+          ],
+        ),
+      );
+      if (confirmed != true || !mounted) return;
+    }
+
+    final RosterAction call = switch (action) {
+      _RoleAction.promote => _promote,
+      _RoleAction.revoke => _revoke,
+      _RoleAction.makePrimary || _RoleAction.financialRole => _transfer,
+    };
+    setState(() => _busyUserId = member.userId);
+    try {
+      final roster = await call(widget.householdId, member.userId);
+      if (!mounted) return;
+      setState(() {
+        _roster = roster;
+        _busyUserId = null;
+      });
+      widget.onRolesChanged?.call();
+      AppSnackBar.showSuccess(context, context.tr('roles_updated'));
+    } catch (e) {
+      if (!mounted) return;
+      setState(() => _busyUserId = null);
+      AppSnackBar.showError(context, _errorText(e));
+    }
+  }
+
+  // ── Household type and financial roles ──────────────────────────────────────
+
+  /// l10n key of a financial role, or null when it has no label of its own
+  /// (the provider is marked by his badge).
+  static String? _financialRoleKey(String? role) => switch ((role ?? '').toLowerCase()) {
+        kFinancialRoleSpouse => 'wife_spouse_title',
+        kFinancialRoleFamilyMember => 'role_family_member',
+        kFinancialRoleDependent => 'fin_role_dependent',
+        kFinancialRolePeer => 'role_roommate',
+        _ => null,
+      };
+
+  String _typeErrorText(Object e) {
+    if (e is HouseholdRolesApiException) {
+      if (e.code == 'forbidden') return context.tr('hh_type_forbidden');
+      if (e.code == 'type_change_blocked') return e.serverMessage ?? context.tr('hh_type_blocked');
+      if (e.code == 'invalid') return context.tr('hh_type_invalid');
+    }
+    return context.trArgs('hh_type_failed', {'error': e});
+  }
+
+  String _financialRoleErrorText(Object e) {
+    if (e is HouseholdRolesApiException) {
+      if (e.code == 'forbidden') return context.tr('fin_role_forbidden');
+      if (e.code == 'not_found') return context.tr('fin_role_not_found');
+      if (e.code == 'invalid' || e.code == 'financial_role_not_allowed') return context.tr('fin_role_invalid');
+      if (e.code == 'provider_is_spouse') return context.tr('fin_role_provider_is_spouse');
+      if (e.code == 'spouse_has_ledger') return context.tr('fin_role_spouse_has_ledger');
+      if (e.statusCode == 409) return context.tr('fin_role_conflict');
+    }
+    return context.trArgs('fin_role_failed', {'error': e});
+  }
+
+  Future<void> _changeHouseholdType(HouseholdRoster roster) async {
+    final current = roster.effectiveHouseholdType;
+    String? picked = current;
+    final chosen = await showDialog<String>(
+      context: context,
+      builder: (dCtx) => StatefulBuilder(
+        builder: (dCtx, setDialogState) => AlertDialog(
+          backgroundColor: context.cardBg,
+          title: Text(context.tr('hh_type_change_title'), style: TextStyle(color: context.textPrimary)),
+          content: SingleChildScrollView(
+            child: Column(
+              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
+              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
+              children: [
+                Text(context.tr('hh_type_change_hint'), style: TextStyle(color: context.textSecondary, fontSize: 12)),
+                const SizedBox(height: 10),
+                HouseholdTypeChooser(value: picked, onChanged: (t) => setDialogState(() => picked = t)),
+              ],
+            ),
+          ),
+          actions: [
+            TextButton(
+              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dCtx),
+              child: Text(context.tr('cancel'), style: TextStyle(color: context.textSecondary)),
+            ),
+            ElevatedButton(
+              key: const ValueKey('household_type_save'),
+              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: AppThemes.success, foregroundColor: Colors.black),
+              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dCtx, picked),
+              child: Text(context.tr('hh_type_save')),
+            ),
+          ],
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+    if (chosen == null || chosen == current || !mounted) return;
+
+    setState(() => _settingType = true);
+    try {
+      final stored = await _setType(widget.householdId, chosen);
+      HouseholdRoster? refreshed;
+      try {
+        refreshed = await _load(widget.householdId);
+      } catch (_) {
+        refreshed = null; // the change is confirmed; the next load shows it
+      }
+      if (!mounted) return;
+      setState(() {
+        if (refreshed != null) _roster = refreshed;
+        _settingType = false;
+      });
+      widget.onHouseholdTypeChanged?.call(stored);
+      widget.onRolesChanged?.call();
+      AppSnackBar.showSuccess(
+        context,
+        context.trArgs('hh_type_changed', {'type': context.tr(HouseholdTypeChooser.labelKey(stored))}),
+      );
+    } catch (e) {
+      if (!mounted) return;
+      setState(() => _settingType = false);
+      AppSnackBar.showError(context, _typeErrorText(e));
+    }
+  }
+
+  Future<void> _changeFinancialRole(HouseholdMember member) async {
+    final roster = _roster;
+    if (roster == null) return;
+    final options = roster.financialRoleOptions(member);
+    final current = (member.financialRole ?? '').toLowerCase();
+    final name = _nameOf(member);
+    final chosen = await showDialog<String>(
+      context: context,
+      builder: (dCtx) => AlertDialog(
+        backgroundColor: context.cardBg,
+        title: Text(context.trArgs('fin_role_pick_title', {'name': name}), style: TextStyle(color: context.textPrimary)),
+        content: SingleChildScrollView(
+          child: Column(
+            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
+            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
+            children: [
+              Text(context.tr('fin_role_pick_desc'), style: TextStyle(color: context.textSecondary, fontSize: 12)),
+              const SizedBox(height: 8),
+              for (final role in options)
+                ListTile(
+                  key: ValueKey('fin-role-option-$role'),
+                  contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
+                  leading: Icon(
+                    role == current ? Icons.radio_button_checked_rounded : Icons.radio_button_off_rounded,
+                    color: role == current ? context.iceCyan : context.textSecondary,
+                  ),
+                  title: Text(context.tr(_financialRoleKey(role)!), style: TextStyle(color: context.textPrimary, fontSize: 14)),
+                  onTap: () => Navigator.pop(dCtx, role),
+                ),
+            ],
+          ),
+        ),
+        actions: [
+          TextButton(
+            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dCtx),
+            child: Text(context.tr('cancel'), style: TextStyle(color: context.textSecondary)),
+          ),
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+    if (chosen == null || chosen == current || !mounted) return;
+
+    setState(() => _busyUserId = member.userId);
+    try {
+      final stored = await _setFinancialRole(widget.householdId, member.userId, chosen);
+      HouseholdRoster? refreshed;
+      try {
+        refreshed = await _load(widget.householdId);
+      } catch (_) {
+        refreshed = null;
+      }
+      if (!mounted) return;
+      setState(() {
+        if (refreshed != null) _roster = refreshed;
+        _busyUserId = null;
+      });
+      widget.onRolesChanged?.call();
+      final key = _financialRoleKey(stored) ?? _financialRoleKey(chosen)!;
+      AppSnackBar.showSuccess(context, context.trArgs('fin_role_changed', {'name': name, 'role': context.tr(key)}));
+    } catch (e) {
+      if (!mounted) return;
+      setState(() => _busyUserId = null);
+      AppSnackBar.showError(context, _financialRoleErrorText(e));
+    }
+  }
+
+  /// The household type and, for admins, a way to change it.
+  Widget _typeSection(HouseholdRoster roster) {
+    final type = roster.effectiveHouseholdType;
+    final isFamily = type == kHouseholdTypeFamily;
+    return Row(
+      key: const ValueKey('roles_household_type'),
+      children: [
+        Icon(
+          isFamily ? Icons.family_restroom_rounded : Icons.group_outlined,
+          color: isFamily ? context.champagneGold : context.successText,
+          size: 18,
+        ),
+        const SizedBox(width: 8),
+        Expanded(
+          child: Text(
+            context.trArgs('hh_type_label', {'type': context.tr(HouseholdTypeChooser.labelKey(type))}),
+            style: TextStyle(color: context.textPrimary, fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
+          ),
+        ),
+        if (roster.mayChangeHouseholdType)
+          _settingType
+              ? const Padding(
+                  padding: EdgeInsets.all(8),
+                  child: SizedBox(width: 16, height: 16, child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2)),
+                )
+              : TextButton(
+                  key: const ValueKey('household_type_change'),
+                  onPressed: _busyUserId == null ? () => _changeHouseholdType(roster) : null,
+                  child: Text(context.tr('hh_type_change')),
+                ),
+      ],
+    );
+  }
+
+
+  String _providerErrorText(Object e) {
+    if (e is NafaqahApiException) {
+      if (e.code == 'forbidden') return context.tr('nafaqah_provider_forbidden');
+      if (e.code == 'invalid') return context.tr('nafaqah_provider_invalid');
+      if (e.code == 'not_family') return context.tr('nafaqah_provider_not_family');
+    }
+    return context.trArgs('nafaqah_provider_failed', {'error': e});
+  }
+
+  Future<void> _chooseProvider(HouseholdRoster roster) async {
+    final current = roster.nafaqahProvider?.userId;
+    final candidates = roster.nafaqahProviderCandidates;
+    final chosen = await showDialog<String>(
+      context: context,
+      builder: (dCtx) => AlertDialog(
+        backgroundColor: context.cardBg,
+        title: Text(context.tr('nafaqah_provider_pick_title'), style: TextStyle(color: context.textPrimary)),
+        content: SingleChildScrollView(
+          child: Column(
+            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
+            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
+            children: [
+              Text(
+                context.tr('nafaqah_provider_pick_desc'),
+                style: TextStyle(color: context.textSecondary, fontSize: 12),
+              ),
+              const SizedBox(height: 8),
+              for (final m in candidates)
+                ListTile(
+                  key: ValueKey('provider-option-${m.userId}'),
+                  contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
+                  leading: Icon(
+                    m.userId == current ? Icons.radio_button_checked_rounded : Icons.radio_button_off_rounded,
+                    color: m.userId == current ? context.champagneGold : context.textSecondary,
+                  ),
+                  title: Text(
+                    m.isSelf ? '${_nameOf(m)} (${context.tr('roles_you')})' : _nameOf(m),
+                    style: TextStyle(color: context.textPrimary, fontSize: 14),
+                  ),
+                  onTap: () => Navigator.pop(dCtx, m.userId),
+                ),
+            ],
+          ),
+        ),
+        actions: [
+          TextButton(
+            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dCtx),
+            child: Text(context.tr('cancel'), style: TextStyle(color: context.textSecondary)),
+          ),
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+    if (chosen == null || chosen == current || !mounted) return;
+
+    setState(() => _settingProvider = true);
+    try {
+      final change = await _setProvider(widget.householdId, chosen);
+      HouseholdRoster? refreshed;
+      try {
+        refreshed = await _load(widget.householdId);
+      } catch (_) {
+        refreshed = null; // the change is confirmed; the next load shows it
+      }
+      if (!mounted) return;
+      setState(() {
+        if (refreshed != null) _roster = refreshed;
+        _settingProvider = false;
+      });
+      widget.onNafaqahProviderChanged?.call(change.summary);
+      AppSnackBar.showSuccess(context, context.tr('nafaqah_provider_updated'));
+    } catch (e) {
+      if (!mounted) return;
+      setState(() => _settingProvider = false);
+      AppSnackBar.showError(context, _providerErrorText(e));
+    }
+  }
+
+  Widget _providerAction(HouseholdRoster roster, String labelKey) {
+    if (_settingProvider) {
+      return const Padding(
+        padding: EdgeInsets.all(8),
+        child: SizedBox(width: 16, height: 16, child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2)),
+      );
+    }
+    return TextButton(
+      onPressed: _busyUserId == null ? () => _chooseProvider(roster) : null,
+      child: Text(context.tr(labelKey)),
+    );
+  }
+
+  /// The Nafaqah provider line (family households only): who he is and, for
+  /// admins, a way to change him; or a prompt when the family has none.
+  Widget? _providerSection(HouseholdRoster roster) {
+    if (roster.isRoommateHousehold) return null;
+    if (roster.needsNafaqahProvider) {
+      final color = context.dangerColor;
+      return Container(
+        key: const ValueKey('roles_needs_provider'),
+        padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(12, 10, 4, 10),
+        decoration: BoxDecoration(
+          color: color.withValues(alpha: context.isDarkMode ? 0.12 : 0.06),
+          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
+          border: Border.all(color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.35)),
+        ),
+        child: Row(
+          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
+          children: [
+            Icon(Icons.person_search_rounded, color: color, size: 18),
+            const SizedBox(width: 8),
+            Expanded(
+              child: Column(
+                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
+                children: [
+                  Text(
+                    context.tr('nafaqah_provider_missing_title'),
+                    style: TextStyle(color: color, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
+                  ),
+                  const SizedBox(height: 2),
+                  Text(
+                    context.tr(roster.canSetNafaqahProvider
+                        ? 'nafaqah_provider_missing_admin'
+                        : 'nafaqah_provider_missing_member'),
+                    style: TextStyle(color: context.textSecondary, fontSize: 11),
+                  ),
+                ],
+              ),
+            ),
+            if (roster.canSetNafaqahProvider) _providerAction(roster, 'nafaqah_provider_choose'),
+          ],
+        ),
+      );
+    }
+    final provider = roster.nafaqahProvider;
+    if (provider == null || !roster.canSetNafaqahProvider) return null;
+    return Row(
+      key: const ValueKey('roles_provider_row'),
+      children: [
+        Icon(Icons.family_restroom_rounded, color: context.champagneGold, size: 18),
+        const SizedBox(width: 8),
+        Expanded(
+          child: Text(
+            context.trArgs('nafaqah_provider_current', {'name': _nameOf(provider)}),
+            style: TextStyle(color: context.textPrimary, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
+          ),
+        ),
+        _providerAction(roster, 'nafaqah_provider_change'),
+      ],
+    );
+  }
+
+  List<PopupMenuEntry<_RoleAction>> _actionsFor(HouseholdRoster roster, HouseholdMember m) => [
+        if (roster.canPromote(m))
+          PopupMenuItem(value: _RoleAction.promote, child: Text(context.tr('roles_make_admin'))),
+        if (roster.canRevoke(m))
+          PopupMenuItem(value: _RoleAction.revoke, child: Text(context.tr('roles_remove_admin'))),
+        if (roster.canMakePrimary(m))
+          PopupMenuItem(value: _RoleAction.makePrimary, child: Text(context.tr('roles_make_primary'))),
+        // Co-admins never get an action against the primary admin.
+        if (roster.maySetFinancialRoles &&
+            (!m.isPrimary || roster.callerIsPrimary) &&
+            roster.financialRoleOptions(m).isNotEmpty)
+          PopupMenuItem(value: _RoleAction.financialRole, child: Text(context.tr('fin_role_change'))),
+      ];
+
+  Widget _badge(HouseholdMember m) {
+    final String label;
+    final Color color;
+    if (m.isPrimary) {
+      label = context.tr('roles_primary_admin');
+      color = context.champagneGold;
+    } else if (m.isAdmin) {
+      label = context.tr('admin');
+      color = context.successText;
+    } else {
+      label = context.tr('member');
+      color = context.textSecondary;
+    }
+    return _chip(label, color);
+  }
+
+  Widget _chip(String label, Color color) {
+    return Container(
+      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
+      decoration: BoxDecoration(
+        color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
+        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
+      ),
+      child: Text(label, style: TextStyle(color: color, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
+    );
+  }
+
+  Widget _memberRow(HouseholdRoster roster, HouseholdMember m) {
+    final actions = _actionsFor(roster, m);
+    final name = _nameOf(m);
+    return Container(
+      key: ValueKey('role-member-${m.userId}'),
+      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
+      padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(12, 8, 4, 8),
+      decoration: BoxDecoration(
+        color: context.scaffoldBg,
+        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
+        border: Border.all(color: context.borderColor),
+      ),
+      child: Row(
+        children: [
+          Icon(
+            m.isPrimary ? Icons.workspace_premium_rounded : (m.isAdmin ? Icons.shield_outlined : Icons.person_outline_rounded),
+            size: 18,
+            color: m.isPrimary ? context.champagneGold : (m.isAdmin ? context.successText : context.textSecondary),
+          ),
+          const SizedBox(width: 10),
+          Expanded(
+            child: Column(
+              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
+              children: [
+                Text(
+                  m.isSelf ? '$name (${context.tr('roles_you')})' : name,
+                  style: TextStyle(color: context.textPrimary, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
+                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
+                ),
+                const SizedBox(height: 4),
+                Wrap(
+                  spacing: 6,
+                  runSpacing: 4,
+                  children: [
+                    _badge(m),
+                    if (!roster.isRoommateHousehold && roster.nafaqahProvider?.userId == m.userId)
+                      _chip(context.tr('nafaqah_provider_badge'), context.champagneGold),
+                    if (_financialRoleKey(m.financialRole) != null)
+                      _chip(context.tr(_financialRoleKey(m.financialRole)!), context.iceCyan),
+                  ],
+                ),
+              ],
+            ),
+          ),
+          if (_busyUserId == m.userId)
+            const Padding(
+              padding: EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(end: 12),
+              child: SizedBox(width: 16, height: 16, child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2)),
+            )
+          else if (actions.isNotEmpty)
+            PopupMenuButton<_RoleAction>(
+              tooltip: context.trArgs('roles_actions_for', {'name': name}),
+              icon: Icon(Icons.more_vert_rounded, color: context.textSecondary),
+              color: context.cardBg,
+              enabled: _busyUserId == null,
+              onSelected: (action) => _run(action, m),
+              itemBuilder: (_) => actions,
+            ),
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final roster = _roster;
+    return Container(
+      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
+      decoration: BoxDecoration(
+        color: context.cardBg,
+        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
+        border: Border.all(color: context.borderColor),
+      ),
+      child: Column(
+        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
+        children: [
+          Row(
+            children: [
+              const Icon(Icons.admin_panel_settings_outlined, color: AppThemes.success, size: 20),
+              const SizedBox(width: 8),
+              Expanded(
+                child: Text(
+                  context.tr('roles_title'),
+                  style: GoogleFonts.outfit(fontSize: 15, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: context.textPrimary),
+                ),
+              ),
+            ],
+          ),
+          const SizedBox(height: 6),
+          Text(
+            context.tr('roles_subtitle'),
+            style: TextStyle(color: context.textSecondary, fontSize: 12),
+          ),
+          const SizedBox(height: 12),
+          if (_loading)
+            const Center(
+              child: Padding(
+                padding: EdgeInsets.all(12),
+                child: SizedBox(width: 20, height: 20, child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2)),
+              ),
+            )
+          else if (_failed || roster == null)
+            Row(
+              children: [
+                Expanded(
+                  child: Text(context.tr('roles_load_failed'), style: TextStyle(color: context.dangerColor, fontSize: 12)),
+                ),
+                TextButton(onPressed: _fetch, child: Text(context.tr('roles_retry'))),
+              ],
+            )
+          else ...[
+            _typeSection(roster),
+            const SizedBox(height: 10),
+            ...roster.members.map((m) => _memberRow(roster, m)),
+            ...[_providerSection(roster)].nonNulls.expand((section) => [const SizedBox(height: 4), section]),
+          ],
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}

diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/widgets/settings/household_type_chooser.dart b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/settings/household_type_chooser.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..29920c5
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/settings/household_type_chooser.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,121 @@
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';
+
+import '../../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import '../../models/household_membership.dart';
+import '../../theme/app_themes.dart';
+
+/// Family (Islamic Nafaqah) or Roommates, chosen when a household is created
+/// and changed later by an admin. Two selectable cards; RTL-safe.
+class HouseholdTypeChooser extends StatelessWidget {
+  /// 'family' | 'roommates', or null while nothing is chosen.
+  final String? value;
+  final ValueChanged<String> onChanged;
+
+  /// Highlights the choice after an attempt to continue without one.
+  final bool showRequired;
+
+  const HouseholdTypeChooser({
+    super.key,
+    required this.value,
+    required this.onChanged,
+    this.showRequired = false,
+  });
+
+  static String labelKey(String householdType) =>
+      householdType == kHouseholdTypeRoommates ? 'household_model_roommates' : 'household_model_family';
+
+  Widget _option(
+    BuildContext context, {
+    required String type,
+    required IconData icon,
+    required String descKey,
+    required Color color,
+  }) {
+    final selected = value == type;
+    return Semantics(
+      selected: selected,
+      button: true,
+      child: InkWell(
+        key: ValueKey('household_type_$type'),
+        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
+        onTap: () => onChanged(type),
+        child: Container(
+          padding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(12, 12, 12, 12),
+          decoration: BoxDecoration(
+            color: selected ? color.withValues(alpha: 0.12) : context.subtleCardBg,
+            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
+            border: Border.all(color: selected ? color : context.borderColor, width: selected ? 1.5 : 1),
+          ),
+          child: Row(
+            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
+            children: [
+              Icon(icon, color: selected ? color : context.textSecondary, size: 22),
+              const SizedBox(width: 10),
+              Expanded(
+                child: Column(
+                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
+                  children: [
+                    Text(
+                      context.tr(labelKey(type)),
+                      style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
+                        fontSize: 14,
+                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
+                        color: context.textPrimary,
+                      ),
+                    ),
+                    const SizedBox(height: 2),
+                    Text(context.tr(descKey), style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: context.textSecondary)),
+                  ],
+                ),
+              ),
+              const SizedBox(width: 6),
+              Icon(
+                selected ? Icons.radio_button_checked_rounded : Icons.radio_button_off_rounded,
+                color: selected ? color : context.textSecondary,
+                size: 18,
+              ),
+            ],
+          ),
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    return Column(
+      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
+      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
+      children: [
+        Text(
+          context.tr('hh_type_question'),
+          style: TextStyle(color: context.textSecondary, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
+        ),
+        const SizedBox(height: 8),
+        _option(
+          context,
+          type: kHouseholdTypeFamily,
+          icon: Icons.family_restroom_rounded,
+          descKey: 'hh_type_family_desc',
+          color: context.champagneGold,
+        ),
+        const SizedBox(height: 8),
+        _option(
+          context,
+          type: kHouseholdTypeRoommates,
+          icon: Icons.group_outlined,
+          descKey: 'hh_type_roommates_desc',
+          color: AppThemes.success,
+        ),
+        if (showRequired && value == null) ...[
+          const SizedBox(height: 6),
+          Text(
+            context.tr('hh_type_required'),
+            style: TextStyle(color: context.dangerColor, fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
+          ),
+        ],
+      ],
+    );
+  }
+}

diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/widgets/settings/reminder_settings_card.dart b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/settings/reminder_settings_card.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..fb0aaba
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/settings/reminder_settings_card.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,87 @@
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';
+import 'package:permission_handler/permission_handler.dart';
+
+import '../../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import '../../services/notifications/reminder_planner.dart';
+import '../../services/notifications/reminder_preferences.dart';
+import '../../theme/app_themes.dart';
+import '../app_snackbar.dart';
+
+/// Asks for the notification permission; true when granted.
+typedef NotificationPermissionRequest = Future<bool> Function();
+
+Future<bool> _requestNotificationPermission() async {
+  final status = await Permission.notification.status;
+  if (status.isGranted) return true;
+  return (await Permission.notification.request()).isGranted;
+}
+
+/// One switch per reminder type (payday, 3 days before payday, bills,
+/// installments), stored on this device.
+class ReminderSettingsCard extends StatelessWidget {
+  final ReminderPreferences? preferences;
+  final NotificationPermissionRequest requestPermission;
+
+  const ReminderSettingsCard({
+    super.key,
+    this.preferences,
+    this.requestPermission = _requestNotificationPermission,
+  });
+
+  static const _items = <(ReminderType, IconData, String, String)>[
+    (ReminderType.payday, Icons.payments_outlined, 'reminder_payday', 'reminder_payday_desc'),
+    (ReminderType.cycleEnd, Icons.hourglass_bottom_rounded, 'reminder_cycle_end', 'reminder_cycle_end_desc'),
+    (ReminderType.bill, Icons.receipt_long_outlined, 'reminder_bills', 'reminder_bills_desc'),
+    (ReminderType.installment, Icons.credit_score_rounded, 'reminder_installments', 'reminder_installments_desc'),
+  ];
+
+  Future<void> _toggle(BuildContext context, ReminderPreferences prefs, ReminderType type, bool value) async {
+    await prefs.setEnabled(type, value);
+    if (!value) return;
+    bool granted;
+    try {
+      granted = await requestPermission();
+    } catch (_) {
+      granted = false;
+    }
+    if (!granted && context.mounted) {
+      AppSnackBar.showInfo(context, context.tr('reminders_permission_denied'), title: context.tr('reminders_title'));
+    }
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final prefs = preferences ?? ReminderPreferences.instance;
+    return ListenableBuilder(
+      listenable: prefs,
+      builder: (context, _) => Material(
+        color: context.cardBg,
+        clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
+        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
+          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
+          side: BorderSide(color: context.borderColor),
+        ),
+        child: Column(
+          children: [
+            for (var i = 0; i < _items.length; i++) ...[
+              if (i > 0) Divider(color: context.borderColor, height: 1),
+              SwitchListTile(
+                key: ValueKey('reminder_switch_${_items[i].$1.name}'),
+                secondary: Icon(_items[i].$2, color: AppThemes.electricTeal),
+                title: Text(
+                  context.tr(_items[i].$3),
+                  style: GoogleFonts.outfit(color: context.textPrimary, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, fontSize: 14),
+                ),
+                subtitle: Text(context.tr(_items[i].$4), style: TextStyle(color: context.textSecondary, fontSize: 11.5)),
+                value: prefs.isEnabled(_items[i].$1),
+                activeThumbColor: AppThemes.electricTeal,
+                onChanged: (v) => _toggle(context, prefs, _items[i].$1, v),
+              ),
+            ],
+          ],
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}

diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/widgets/settings/settings_section.dart b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/settings/settings_section.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..d894f8d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/settings/settings_section.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,60 @@
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';
+
+import '../../theme/app_themes.dart';
+
+/// A foldable group of Settings (UX-15): the title (and an optional one-line
+/// summary) is always visible; the cards inside show when it is opened. The
+/// open / closed state survives scrolling via a [PageStorageKey].
+class SettingsSection extends StatelessWidget {
+  final String title;
+  final String? subtitle;
+  final IconData icon;
+  final bool initiallyExpanded;
+  final List<Widget> children;
+
+  const SettingsSection({
+    super.key,
+    required this.title,
+    required this.icon,
+    required this.children,
+    this.subtitle,
+    this.initiallyExpanded = false,
+  });
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    return Padding(
+      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
+      child: Theme(
+        data: Theme.of(context).copyWith(dividerColor: Colors.transparent),
+        child: ExpansionTile(
+          key: PageStorageKey<String>('settings_section_$title'),
+          initiallyExpanded: initiallyExpanded,
+          tilePadding: const EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(start: 4, end: 8),
+          childrenPadding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
+          minTileHeight: 48,
+          shape: const Border(),
+          collapsedShape: const Border(),
+          iconColor: context.accentText,
+          collapsedIconColor: context.textSecondary,
+          leading: Icon(icon, size: 20, color: context.accentText),
+          title: Text(
+            title,
+            style: GoogleFonts.outfit(
+              fontSize: 13,
+              letterSpacing: 0.6,
+              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
+              color: context.textSecondary,
+            ),
+          ),
+          subtitle: subtitle == null
+              ? null
+              : Text(subtitle!, style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: context.textSecondary)),
+          expandedCrossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
+          children: children,
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/widgets/simulator/affordability_simulator_sheet.dart b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/simulator/affordability_simulator_sheet.dart
index a3acd09..e7f1994 100644
--- a/flutter_app/lib/widgets/simulator/affordability_simulator_sheet.dart
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/simulator/affordability_simulator_sheet.dart
@@ -8,10 +8,40 @@ import '../../providers/budget_provider.dart';
 import '../../services/api_service.dart';
 import '../../theme/app_themes.dart';
 import '../transactions/manual_expense_sheet.dart';
+import '../../models/money.dart';
+import '../../models/category_catalog.dart';
+import '../../services/salary_cycle_service.dart';
+
+/// The advice under an affordability verdict, in the user's language (UX-21),
+/// built from the numbers of the API answer or the offline estimate
+/// (`verdict`, `post_purchase_remaining`, `current_daily_allowance`,
+/// `post_purchase_daily_allowance`, `days_to_payday`), never from the
+/// server's own English/Arabic sentences; amounts use the riyal formatter.
+String affordabilityAdvice(AppLocalizations l, Map<String, dynamic> res) {
+  double n(String key) => (res[key] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0;
+  final days = (res['days_to_payday'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
+  final daysText = l.plural('sim_days_left', days);
+  switch (res['verdict']) {
+    case 'invalid':
+      return l.get('sim_detail_invalid');
+    case 'caution':
+      return l.format('sim_detail_caution', {
+        'from': l.sar(n('current_daily_allowance')),
+        'to': l.sar(n('post_purchase_daily_allowance')),
+      });
+    case 'unaffordable':
+      return l.format('sim_detail_unaffordable', {'days': daysText});
+    default:
+      return l.format('sim_detail_comfortable', {
+        'remaining': l.sar(n('post_purchase_remaining')),
+        'days': daysText,
+      });
+  }
+}

+  /// Swaps in a freshly loaded list (UI-20). The replaced controllers are
+  /// disposed after the next frame, once their TextFields use the new ones;
+  /// if the dialog is already gone, the new controllers are disposed instead.
+  void _replaceSubItems(List<_SubCategoryItemDef> list) {
+    if (!mounted) {
+      for (final item in list) {
+        item.controller.dispose();
       }
+      return;
     }
+    final replaced = List<_SubCategoryItemDef>.of(_subItems);
+    setState(() {
+      _subItems
+        ..clear()
+        ..addAll(list);
+      _isLoading = false;
+    });
+    _recomputeTotal();
+    if (replaced.isEmpty) return;
+    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
+      for (final item in replaced) {
+        item.controller.removeListener(_recomputeTotal);
+        item.controller.dispose();
+      }
+    });
   }

diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/widgets/transactions/expense_date_chips.dart b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/transactions/expense_date_chips.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..af6aab9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/transactions/expense_date_chips.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,86 @@
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+
+import '../../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import '../../theme/app_themes.dart';
+
+/// "Today / Yesterday / Pick a date…" for an expense (UX-12), so yesterday's
+/// cash purchase is not booked today. Today keeps the current time; another
+/// day keeps the current time of day on that date.
+class ExpenseDateChips extends StatelessWidget {
+  final DateTime value;
+  final ValueChanged<DateTime> onChanged;
+
+  /// How far back a date may be picked (the server accepts 90 days for chat).
+  final int maxDaysBack;
+
+  /// The clock (tests).
+  final DateTime Function() now;
+
+  const ExpenseDateChips({
+    super.key,
+    required this.value,
+    required this.onChanged,
+    this.maxDaysBack = 89,
+    this.now = DateTime.now,
+  });
+
+  static DateTime _day(DateTime d) => DateTime(d.year, d.month, d.day);
+
+  static DateTime _onDay(DateTime day, DateTime clock) =>
+      DateTime(day.year, day.month, day.day, clock.hour, clock.minute, clock.second);
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final clock = now();
+    final today = _day(clock);
+    final yesterday = today.subtract(const Duration(days: 1));
+    final chosen = _day(value);
+    final isToday = chosen == today;
+    final isYesterday = chosen == yesterday;
+    final isOther = !isToday && !isYesterday;
+
+    Widget chip(String key, String label, bool selected, VoidCallback onTap, {IconData? icon}) => ChoiceChip(
+          key: ValueKey(key),
+          avatar: icon == null ? null : Icon(icon, size: 16, color: selected ? AppThemes.onSuccessFill : context.textSecondary),
+          label: Text(label),
+          selected: selected,
+          showCheckmark: false,
+          selectedColor: AppThemes.success,
+          labelStyle: TextStyle(
+            fontSize: 13,
+            fontWeight: selected ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w500,
+            color: selected ? AppThemes.onSuccessFill : context.textPrimary,
+          ),
+          onSelected: (_) => onTap(),
+        );
+
+    return Semantics(
+      label: context.tr('expense_date_label'),
+      child: Wrap(
+        spacing: 8,
+        runSpacing: 4,
+        crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
+        children: [
+          Icon(Icons.event_rounded, size: 18, color: context.textSecondary),
+          chip('expense_date_today', context.tr('feed_today'), isToday, () => onChanged(clock)),
+          chip('expense_date_yesterday', context.tr('feed_yesterday'), isYesterday, () => onChanged(_onDay(yesterday, clock))),
+          chip(
+            'expense_date_pick',
+            isOther ? context.fmtDate(chosen, 'd MMMM') : context.tr('expense_date_pick'),
+            isOther,
+            () async {
+              final picked = await showDatePicker(
+                context: context,
+                initialDate: chosen.isAfter(today) ? today : chosen,
+                firstDate: today.subtract(Duration(days: maxDaysBack)),
+                lastDate: today,
+              );
+              if (picked != null) onChanged(_day(picked) == today ? clock : _onDay(picked, clock));
+            },
+            icon: Icons.calendar_month_rounded,
+          ),
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}

diff --git a/flutter_app/lib/widgets/transactions/nafaqah_feed_badge.dart b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/transactions/nafaqah_feed_badge.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..c2d930a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/lib/widgets/transactions/nafaqah_feed_badge.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,148 @@
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';
+
+import '../../l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import '../../models/models.dart';
+import '../../models/nafaqah.dart';
+import '../../theme/app_themes.dart';
+
+/// What a transaction is in a family household (UX-04), shown in the feed
+/// instead of the roommate "shared / me / partner" badge.
+enum NafaqahBadgeKind { household, owedToWife, wifeAllowance, settlement }
+
+/// The badge of [tx]: a settlement anywhere; in a family household its
+/// Nafaqah class (no class = the husband's household expense). Null for an
+/// ordinary roommate / partner expense.
+NafaqahBadgeKind? nafaqahBadgeKind(Transaction tx, {required bool isFamily}) {
+  if (tx.isSettlement) return NafaqahBadgeKind.settlement;
+  if (!isFamily) return null;
+  return nafaqahBadgeKindForClass(tx.nafaqahClass);
+}
+
+NafaqahBadgeKind nafaqahBadgeKindForClass(String? nafaqahClass) => switch (nafaqahClass) {
+      kWifeReimbursable => NafaqahBadgeKind.owedToWife,
+      kWifePersonal => NafaqahBadgeKind.wifeAllowance,
+      _ => NafaqahBadgeKind.household,
+    };
+
+/// The family context the feed needs to word its badges: whether the
+/// household is a family, whether the viewer is the wife, and the wives' names.
+class FeedFamilyContext {
+  final bool isFamily;
+  final bool viewerIsWife;
+  final Map<String, String> wifeNames;
+
+  const FeedFamilyContext({this.isFamily = false, this.viewerIsWife = false, this.wifeNames = const {}});
+
+  factory FeedFamilyContext.fromSummary(NafaqahSummary summary) => FeedFamilyContext(
+        isFamily: summary.isFamily,
+        viewerIsWife: summary.callerIsWife,
+        wifeNames: {
+          for (final w in summary.wives)
+            if ((w.displayName ?? '').trim().isNotEmpty) w.id.toLowerCase(): w.displayName!.trim(),
+        },
+      );
+
+  /// The wife [tx] names (or the only wife), or null.
+  String? wifeNameFor(Transaction tx) {
+    final id = tx.nafaqahSpouseId?.toLowerCase();
+    if (id != null && wifeNames.containsKey(id)) return wifeNames[id];
+    return wifeNames.length == 1 ? wifeNames.values.first : null;
+  }
+}
+
+class NafaqahFeedBadge extends StatelessWidget {
+  final NafaqahBadgeKind kind;
+  final String? wifeName;
+  final bool viewerIsWife;
+  final bool detailed;
+
+  const NafaqahFeedBadge({
+    super.key,
+    required this.kind,
+    this.wifeName,
+    this.viewerIsWife = false,
+    this.detailed = false,
+  });
+
+  static String label(BuildContext context, NafaqahBadgeKind kind, {String? wifeName, bool viewerIsWife = false}) {
+    final name = (wifeName ?? '').trim().isEmpty ? context.tr('nafaqah_wife_generic') : wifeName!.trim();
+    switch (kind) {
+      case NafaqahBadgeKind.owedToWife:
+        return viewerIsWife ? context.tr('feed_badge_owed_to_me') : context.trArgs('feed_badge_owed_to_wife', {'wife': name});
+      case NafaqahBadgeKind.wifeAllowance:
+        return viewerIsWife ? context.tr('feed_badge_my_allowance') : context.trArgs('feed_badge_wife_allowance', {'wife': name});
+      case NafaqahBadgeKind.settlement:
+        return context.tr('feed_badge_settlement');
+      case NafaqahBadgeKind.household:
+        return context.tr('feed_badge_household');
+    }
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
+    final (Color fg, Color tint, IconData icon) = switch (kind) {
+      NafaqahBadgeKind.owedToWife => (context.goldText, AppThemes.champagneGold, Icons.currency_exchange_rounded),
+      NafaqahBadgeKind.wifeAllowance => (context.infoText, AppThemes.iceCyan, Icons.shopping_bag_outlined),
+      NafaqahBadgeKind.settlement => (context.accentText, AppThemes.success, Icons.swap_horiz_rounded),
+      NafaqahBadgeKind.household => (context.textSecondary, context.textSecondary, Icons.home_outlined),
+    };
+    return Container(
+      key: ValueKey('feed_badge_${kind.name}'),
+      padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: detailed ? 10 : 6, vertical: detailed ? 4 : 2),
+      decoration: BoxDecoration(
+        color: tint.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
+        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
+        border: Border.all(color: tint.withValues(alpha: 0.4), width: 0.8),
+      ),
+      child: Row(
+        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
+        children: [
+          Icon(icon, size: detailed ? 14 : 12, color: fg),
+          const SizedBox(width: 4),
+          Flexible(
+            child: Text(
+              label(context, kind, wifeName: wifeName, viewerIsWife: viewerIsWife),
+              style: GoogleFonts.outfit(color: fg, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
+            ),
+          ),
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+}
+
+/// Transactions of one calendar day (device-local), in feed order.
+class TransactionDayGroup {
+  final DateTime day;
+  final List<Transaction> transactions;
+  const TransactionDayGroup(this.day, this.transactions);
+}
+
+/// Groups consecutive transactions of the same local day (UX-11). The input
+/// order is kept, so it works for newest-first and oldest-first lists.
+List<TransactionDayGroup> groupTransactionsByDay(List<Transaction> ordered) {
+  final groups = <TransactionDayGroup>[];
+  for (final tx in ordered) {
+    final local = tx.timestamp.toLocal();
+    final day = DateTime(local.year, local.month, local.day);
+    if (groups.isNotEmpty && groups.last.day == day) {
+      groups.last.transactions.add(tx);
+    } else {
+      groups.add(TransactionDayGroup(day, [tx]));
+    }
+  }
+  return groups;
+}
+
+/// "Today", "Yesterday" or the weekday and date ("الأحد 19 أكتوبر"); the year
+/// is added outside the current year.
+String feedDayLabel(BuildContext context, DateTime day, {DateTime? now}) {
+  final n = (now ?? DateTime.now());
+  final today = DateTime(n.year, n.month, n.day);
+  final d = DateTime(day.year, day.month, day.day);
+  final diff = today.difference(d).inDays;
+  if (diff == 0) return context.tr('feed_today');
+  if (diff == 1) return context.tr('feed_yesterday');
+  return context.fmtDate(d, d.year == today.year ? 'EEEE d MMMM' : 'EEEE d MMMM y');
+}

diff --git a/flutter_app/test/l10n/cycle_label_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/l10n/cycle_label_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..20e5abb
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/l10n/cycle_label_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,60 @@
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:intl/date_symbol_data_local.dart';
+
+void main() {
+  setUpAll(() async {
+    await initializeDateFormatting('ar');
+    await initializeDateFormatting('ur');
+  });
+
+  final now = DateTime.utc(2026, 10, 21);
+
+  group('cycle labels by dates (§2.2.1)', () {
+    test('English: day + short month, no year inside the current year', () {
+      final en = AppLocalizations(const Locale('en'));
+      expect(en.cycleRange(DateTime.utc(2026, 10, 27), DateTime.utc(2026, 11, 26), now: now), '27 Oct – 26 Nov');
+      expect(en.cycleLabel('2026-11', paydayDay: 27, now: now), '27 Oct – 26 Nov');
+    });
+
+    test('a cycle crossing into another year shows both years', () {
+      final en = AppLocalizations(const Locale('en'));
+      expect(en.cycleLabel('2027-01', paydayDay: 27, now: now), '27 Dec 2026 – 26 Jan 2027');
+    });
+
+    test('a past year shows its year', () {
+      final en = AppLocalizations(const Locale('en'));
+      expect(en.cycleLabel('2025-11', paydayDay: 27, now: now), '27 Oct 2025 – 26 Nov 2025');
+    });
+
+    test('Arabic month names with Western digits (app convention)', () {
+      final ar = AppLocalizations(const Locale('ar'));
+      final label = ar.cycleLabel('2026-11', paydayDay: 27, now: now);
+      expect(label, contains('أكتوبر'));
+      expect(label, contains('نوفمبر'));
+      expect(label, startsWith('27 '));
+      expect(label, contains('26 '));
+      expect(RegExp('[٠-٩]').hasMatch(label), isFalse);
+    });
+
+    test('never a bare month name or YYYY-MM', () {
+      final en = AppLocalizations(const Locale('en'));
+      final label = en.cycleLabel('2026-11', paydayDay: 27, now: now);
+      expect(label, isNot(contains('November')));
+      expect(label, isNot(contains('2026-11')));
+    });
+
+    test('unparseable keys fall back to the given text', () {
+      final en = AppLocalizations(const Locale('en'));
+      expect(en.cycleLabel('bad', fallback: 'Current cycle'), 'Current cycle');
+      expect(en.cycleLabel('bad'), 'bad');
+    });
+
+    test('cycleRangeIso reads server ISO dates', () {
+      final en = AppLocalizations(const Locale('en'));
+      expect(en.cycleRangeIso('2026-10-27', '2026-11-26', now: now), '27 Oct – 26 Nov');
+      expect(en.cycleRangeIso('', '2026-11-26', fallback: 'x', now: now), 'x');
+    });
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/l10n/merchant_localization_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/l10n/merchant_localization_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..0f68a71
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/l10n/merchant_localization_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,107 @@
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+
+void main() {
+  group('Merchant Name Localization & Normalization', () {
+    test('Translates standard merchants correctly in Arabic', () {
+      final l10n = AppLocalizations(const Locale('ar'));
+
+      expect(l10n.merchant('Panda'), equals('أسواق بندة'));
+      expect(l10n.merchant('Hyper Panda'), equals('أسواق بندة'));
+      expect(l10n.merchant('Al Othaim'), equals('أسواق العثيم'));
+      expect(l10n.merchant('STC'), equals('شركة الاتصالات السعودية (stc)'));
+      expect(l10n.merchant('STC-Pay'), equals('شركة الاتصالات السعودية (stc)'));
+      expect(l10n.merchant('AlBaik'), equals('البيك'));
+      expect(l10n.merchant('Jarir Bookstore'), equals('مكتبة جرير'));
+      expect(l10n.merchant('eXtra'), equals('معارض إكسترا'));
+    });
+
+    test('Translates standard merchants correctly in Urdu', () {
+      final l10n = AppLocalizations(const Locale('ur'));
+
+      expect(l10n.merchant('Panda'), equals('پانڈا سپر مارکیٹ'));
+      expect(l10n.merchant('Al Othaim'), equals('العثیم مارکیٹس'));
+      expect(l10n.merchant('STC'), equals('ایس ٹی سی ٹیلی کام'));
+    });
+
+    test('Translates standard merchants correctly in English', () {
+      final l10n = AppLocalizations(const Locale('en'));
+
+      expect(l10n.merchant('panda'), equals('Panda Supermarket'));
+      expect(l10n.merchant('othaim'), equals('Al Othaim Markets'));
+      expect(l10n.merchant('stc'), equals('stc Telecom'));
+    });
+
+    test('Prevents greedy substring false positives on unrelated words', () {
+      final l10nAr = AppLocalizations(const Locale('ar'));
+      final l10nEn = AppLocalizations(const Locale('en'));
+
+      // "Fastcare Pharmacy" contains 'stc' but should NOT match stc Telecom
+      expect(l10nAr.merchant('Fastcare Pharmacy'), equals('Fastcare Pharmacy'));
+      expect(l10nEn.merchant('Fastcare Pharmacy'), equals('Fastcare Pharmacy'));
+
+      // "Postcard Shop" contains 'stc' but should NOT match stc Telecom
+      expect(l10nAr.merchant('Postcard Shop'), equals('Postcard Shop'));
+      expect(l10nEn.merchant('Postcard Shop'), equals('Postcard Shop'));
+
+      // "Extraordinary Cafe" contains 'extra' but should NOT match eXtra Stores
+      expect(l10nAr.merchant('Extraordinary Cafe'), equals('Extraordinary Cafe'));
+      expect(l10nEn.merchant('Extraordinary Cafe'), equals('Extraordinary Cafe'));
+
+      // "Panda Express" is a restaurant chain and should NOT match Panda Supermarket
+      expect(l10nAr.merchant('Panda Express'), equals('Panda Express'));
+      expect(l10nEn.merchant('Panda Express'), equals('Panda Express'));
+    });
+
+    test('Handles generic entries, null, and empty merchant names', () {
+      final l10n = AppLocalizations(const Locale('ar'));
+
+      expect(l10n.merchant(null), equals('تاجر غير محدد'));
+      expect(l10n.merchant(''), equals('تاجر غير محدد'));
+      expect(l10n.merchant('   '), equals('تاجر غير محدد'));
+      expect(l10n.merchant('direct'), equals('إدخال مباشر'));
+      expect(l10n.merchant('Direct Entry'), equals('إدخال مباشر'));
+      expect(l10n.merchant('manual'), equals('مصروف يدوي'));
+      expect(l10n.merchant('Manual Expense'), equals('مصروف يدوي'));
+    });
+
+    test('Verifies copy, sync count, and note keys across all three languages', () {
+      final en = AppLocalizations(const Locale('en'));
+      final ar = AppLocalizations(const Locale('ar'));
+      final ur = AppLocalizations(const Locale('ur'));
+
+      // copy_btn
+      expect(en.get('copy_btn'), equals('Copy'));
+      expect(ar.get('copy_btn'), equals('نسخ'));
+      expect(ur.get('copy_btn'), equals('کاپی'));
+
+      // pending_sync_count
+      expect(en.get('pending_sync_count'), contains('{count}'));
+      expect(ar.get('pending_sync_count'), contains('{count}'));
+      expect(ur.get('pending_sync_count'), contains('{count}'));
+
+      // developer_email_copied
+      expect(en.get('developer_email_copied'), contains('{email}'));
+      expect(ar.get('developer_email_copied'), contains('{email}'));
+      expect(ur.get('developer_email_copied'), contains('{email}'));
+
+      // household_id_copied
+      expect(en.get('household_id_copied'), equals('Household ID copied to clipboard'));
+      expect(ar.get('household_id_copied'), equals('تم نسخ معرف المنزل إلى الحافظة'));
+      expect(ur.get('household_id_copied'), equals('گھرانے کا شناختی کوڈ کلپ بورڈ پر کاپی ہو گیا'));
+
+      // nafaqah & roommate settlement note templates
+      expect(en.get('nafaqah_reimbursement_note'), contains('{amount}'));
+      expect(ar.get('nafaqah_reimbursement_note'), contains('{amount}'));
+      expect(ur.get('nafaqah_reimbursement_note'), contains('{amount}'));
+
+      expect(en.get('roommate_settlement_note'), contains('{amount}'));
+      expect(en.get('roommate_settlement_note'), contains('{name}'));
+      expect(ar.get('roommate_settlement_note'), contains('{amount}'));
+      expect(ar.get('roommate_settlement_note'), contains('{name}'));
+      expect(ur.get('roommate_settlement_note'), contains('{amount}'));
+      expect(ur.get('roommate_settlement_note'), contains('{name}'));
+    });
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/l10n/money_format_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/l10n/money_format_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..6684a3c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/l10n/money_format_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,66 @@
+// UX-10: one formatter for every amount ("1,040.00 ر.س" in Arabic, never
+// "SAR 342.75" or "SAR 202.4" next to Arabic text).
+import 'dart:io';
+
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/transaction_item_breakdown_card.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+import '../support/localized_app.dart';
+
+void main() {
+  final ar = AppLocalizations(const Locale('ar'));
+  final ur = AppLocalizations(const Locale('ur'));
+  final en = AppLocalizations(const Locale('en'));
+
+  test('money(): SAR goes through sar(), other currencies keep their code', () {
+    expect(ar.money(6240.5, 'SAR'), '6,240.50 ر.س');
+    expect(ur.money(6240.5, 'SAR'), '6,240.50 ریال');
+    expect(en.money(6240.5, 'SAR'), 'SAR 6,240.50');
+    expect(ar.money(12, 'USD'), '12.00 USD');
+    expect(en.money(12, 'USD'), 'USD 12.00');
+    expect(ar.money(-859.5, 'SAR'), '-859.50 ر.س');
+    // English puts the sign before the code: "-SAR 859.50", not "SAR -859.50".
+    expect(en.money(-859.5, 'SAR'), '-SAR 859.50');
+    expect(en.sar(-859.5), '-SAR 859.50');
+    expect(en.money(-3, 'USD'), '-USD 3.00');
+    expect(en.money(859.5, 'SAR', signed: true), '+SAR 859.50');
+    expect(ar.money(859.5, 'SAR', signed: true), '+859.50 ر.س');
+    expect(ar.money(1000, 'SAR', decimals: 0), '1,000 ر.س');
+    // Lower-case / blank currency codes are SAR.
+    expect(ar.money(1, ''), '1.00 ر.س');
+    expect(ar.money(1, 'sar'), '1.00 ر.س');
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('feed card shows Arabic amounts with grouping, no "SAR 342.75"', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(localizedApp(const TransactionItemBreakdownCard(
+      merchant: 'Danube',
+      amount: 1342.75,
+      initiallyExpanded: true,
+      items: [
+        {'name': 'Rice', 'quantity': 1, 'price': 1202.4},
+        {'name': 'Milk', 'quantity': 1, 'price': 140.35},
+      ],
+    )));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.textContaining('SAR'), findsNothing);
+    expect(find.text('1,342.75 ر.س'), findsWidgets);
+    expect(find.text('1,202.40 ر.س'), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+
+  test('screens and widgets never format money as "<currency> <toStringAsFixed>"', () {
+    final pattern = RegExp(r"""(currency|'SAR'|"SAR"|tr\(['"]sar['"]\))\}? \$\{[^}]*(toStringAsFixed|fmt\.format)""");
+    final offenders = <String>[];
+    for (final dir in ['lib/screens', 'lib/widgets']) {
+      for (final f in Directory(dir).listSync(recursive: true).whereType<File>()) {
+        if (!f.path.endsWith('.dart')) continue;
+        final lines = f.readAsLinesSync();
+        for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
+          if (pattern.hasMatch(lines[i])) offenders.add('${f.path}:${i + 1}');
+        }
+      }
+    }
+    expect(offenders, isEmpty);
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/models/category_catalog_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/models/category_catalog_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..56fe001
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/models/category_catalog_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,100 @@
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/category_catalog.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+const _newCodes = [
+  'OPEX-HOUSING',
+  'OPEX-EDUCATION',
+  'OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP',
+  'OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT',
+  'OPEX-CHARITY',
+  'OPEX-TRANSPORT',
+  'OPEX-INSURANCE',
+  'OPEX-REMITTANCE',
+];
+
+void main() {
+  group('CategoryCatalog (R4 taxonomy refresh)', () {
+    test('every new system code has its own icon, colour and emoji', () {
+      final fallback = CategoryCatalog.visual('NOT-A-CODE');
+      final icons = <IconData>{};
+      for (final code in _newCodes) {
+        final v = CategoryCatalog.visual(code);
+        expect(v.icon, isNot(fallback.icon), reason: code);
+        expect(v.emoji.trim(), isNotEmpty, reason: code);
+        icons.add(v.icon);
+      }
+      expect(icons.length, _newCodes.length, reason: 'icons are distinct');
+    });
+
+    test('pickers offer the new codes and keep a current legacy code selectable', () {
+      for (final code in _newCodes) {
+        expect(CategoryCatalog.pickerCodes, contains(code));
+      }
+      expect(CategoryCatalog.pickerCodes.toSet().length, CategoryCatalog.pickerCodes.length);
+      expect(CategoryCatalog.pickerCodesIncluding('CAPEX-EDUCATION'), contains('CAPEX-EDUCATION'));
+      expect(CategoryCatalog.pickerCodesIncluding('OPEX-MISC'), CategoryCatalog.pickerCodes);
+      expect(CategoryCatalog.pickerCodesIncluding(null), CategoryCatalog.pickerCodes);
+    });
+
+    test('normalize maps known aliases and underscore spellings', () {
+      expect(CategoryCatalog.normalize('opex-groceries'), 'OPEX-GROCERY');
+      expect(CategoryCatalog.normalize('OPEX-HEALTHCARE'), 'OPEX-HEALTH');
+      expect(CategoryCatalog.normalize('OPEX-DOMESTIC_HELP'), 'OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP');
+      expect(CategoryCatalog.normalize('OPEX-FAMILY_SUPPORT'), 'OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT');
+      expect(CategoryCatalog.normalize(' OPEX-HOUSING '), 'OPEX-HOUSING');
+      expect(CategoryCatalog.normalize(null), 'OPEX-MISC');
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('category names', () {
+    test('new codes have en / ar / ur names (no code-like fallback)', () {
+      for (final lang in ['en', 'ar', 'ur']) {
+        final l = AppLocalizations(Locale(lang));
+        for (final code in _newCodes) {
+          final name = l.category(code);
+          expect(name, isNot(code), reason: '$lang $code');
+          expect(name.contains('-'), isFalse, reason: '$lang $code -> $name');
+          if (lang != 'en') expect(RegExp('[؀-ۿ]').hasMatch(name), isTrue, reason: '$lang $code');
+          if (lang == 'ur') expect(RegExp('[يكىة]').hasMatch(name), isFalse, reason: 'ur $code');
+        }
+      }
+    });
+
+    test('fuel no longer claims transport now that transport is its own category', () {
+      final en = AppLocalizations(const Locale('en'));
+      expect(en.category('OPEX-FUEL'), isNot(en.category('OPEX-TRANSPORT')));
+      expect(en.category('OPEX-FUEL').toLowerCase().contains('transport'), isFalse);
+    });
+
+    test('new sub-codes have Urdu labels (en/ar fall back when the DB sends none)', () {
+      const subCodes = [
+        'housing_rent', 'annual_rent', 'housing_services', 'tuition_fees', 'school_transport',
+        'school_uniforms', 'books_supplies', 'maid_salary', 'driver_salary', 'recruitment_visa',
+        'parents_support', 'relatives_support', 'sadaqah', 'zakat', 'car_installment', 'ride_hailing',
+        'public_transport', 'car_maintenance', 'car_insurance', 'health_insurance', 'home_insurance',
+        'family_remittance', 'transfer_fees',
+      ];
+      for (final lang in ['en', 'ar', 'ur']) {
+        final l = AppLocalizations(Locale(lang));
+        for (final code in subCodes) {
+          final name = l.subCategory(code);
+          expect(name, isNot(code), reason: '$lang $code');
+          if (lang == 'ur') expect(RegExp('[يكىة]').hasMatch(name), isFalse, reason: 'ur $code');
+        }
+      }
+      // A DB Arabic name still wins in Arabic.
+      expect(AppLocalizations(const Locale('ar')).subCategory('zakat', nameAr: 'زكاة المال'), 'زكاة المال');
+    });
+
+    test('labels match the DB contract', () {
+      final en = AppLocalizations(const Locale('en'));
+      final ar = AppLocalizations(const Locale('ar'));
+      expect(en.category('OPEX-EDUCATION'), 'School Costs');
+      expect(en.category('OPEX-CHARITY'), 'Charity & Zakat');
+      expect(ar.category('OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT'), 'بر الوالدين ودعم الأسرة');
+      expect(ar.category('OPEX-REMITTANCE'), 'الحوالات الخارجية');
+    });
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/models/household_roster_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/models/household_roster_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..70ef53b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/models/household_roster_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,89 @@
+// GET /households/{id}/members: financial role per membership and the
+// explicit Nafaqah provider (FABLE-LOGIC-01 / -04).
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/household_membership.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+Map<String, dynamic> _member(String id, String role, String financialRole, {bool provider = false, bool primary = false}) => {
+      'user_id': id,
+      'display_name': id.toUpperCase(),
+      'role': role,
+      'financial_role': financialRole,
+      'is_primary': primary,
+      'is_nafaqah_provider': provider,
+      'is_self': false,
+    };
+
+void main() {
+  test('parses the provider flag, the provider id and who may change it', () {
+    final roster = HouseholdRoster.fromMap({
+      'household_id': 'hh',
+      'primary_admin_user_id': 'son',
+      'nafaqah_provider_user_id': 'husband',
+      'can_set_nafaqah_provider': true,
+      'members': [
+        _member('son', 'admin', 'provider', primary: true),
+        _member('husband', 'member', 'provider', provider: true),
+        _member('wife', 'member', 'spouse'),
+      ],
+    });
+
+    expect(roster.nafaqahProviderUserId, 'husband');
+    expect(roster.canSetNafaqahProvider, isTrue);
+    expect(roster.members[1].isNafaqahProvider, isTrue);
+    expect(roster.members[0].isNafaqahProvider, isFalse);
+    expect(roster.members[2].isSpouse, isTrue);
+    expect(roster.isFamily, isTrue);
+    expect(roster.nafaqahProvider?.userId, 'husband');
+    expect(roster.needsNafaqahProvider, isFalse);
+    expect(roster.nafaqahProviderCandidates.map((m) => m.userId), ['son', 'husband'],
+        reason: 'a wife is never offered as the provider');
+  });
+
+  test('a family whose provider is missing (or left) needs one', () {
+    final roster = HouseholdRoster.fromMap({
+      'household_id': 'hh',
+      'nafaqah_provider_user_id': null,
+      'members': [
+        _member('a', 'admin', 'family_member', primary: true),
+        _member('wife', 'member', 'spouse'),
+      ],
+    });
+    expect(roster.isFamily, isTrue);
+    expect(roster.needsNafaqahProvider, isTrue);
+    expect(roster.canSetNafaqahProvider, isFalse);
+
+    final gone = HouseholdRoster.fromMap({
+      'household_id': 'hh',
+      'nafaqah_provider_user_id': 'left-already',
+      'members': [_member('wife', 'admin', 'spouse', primary: true)],
+    });
+    expect(gone.needsNafaqahProvider, isTrue);
+  });
+
+  test('roommates are neither a family nor in need of a provider', () {
+    final roster = HouseholdRoster.fromMap({
+      'household_id': 'hh',
+      'nafaqah_provider_user_id': 'a',
+      'members': [
+        _member('a', 'admin', 'peer', primary: true, provider: true),
+        _member('b', 'member', 'peer'),
+      ],
+    });
+    expect(roster.isFamily, isFalse);
+    expect(roster.isRoommateHousehold, isTrue);
+    expect(roster.needsNafaqahProvider, isFalse);
+  });
+
+  test('older servers without provider fields parse safely', () {
+    final roster = HouseholdRoster.fromMap({
+      'household_id': 'hh',
+      'members': [
+        {'user_id': 'a', 'role': 'admin'},
+      ],
+    });
+    expect(roster.nafaqahProviderUserId, isNull);
+    expect(roster.canSetNafaqahProvider, isFalse);
+    expect(roster.members.single.isNafaqahProvider, isFalse);
+    expect(roster.isFamily, isFalse);
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/models/installment_plan_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/models/installment_plan_test.dart

@@ -59,5 +59,75 @@ void main() {
       expect(json['status'], 'COMPLETED');
       expect(json['total_amount'], 7408.0);
     });
+
+    group('BNPL schedule (frequency + next_due_at)', () {
+      InstallmentPlan plan({
+        String frequency = 'monthly',
+        String? nextDueAt,
+        int paid = 1,
+        int count = 4,
+        int day = 27,
+        String start = '2026-10-01',
+        String status = 'ACTIVE',
+      }) =>
+          InstallmentPlan.fromJson({
+            'id': 'p',
+            'household_id': 'h',
+            'merchant': 'Jarir',
+            'provider': 'Tabby',
+            'total_amount': 400,
+            'installment_count': count,
+            'monthly_amount': 100,
+            'paid_installments': paid,
+            'day_of_month': day,
+            'start_date': start,
+            'status': status,
+            'frequency': frequency,
+            'next_due_at': nextDueAt,
+          });
+      final today = DateTime.utc(2026, 10, 21);
+      String iso(DateTime d) => d.toIso8601String().substring(0, 10);
+
+      test('parses frequency and next_due_at; absent means monthly and null', () {
+        final p = plan(frequency: 'biweekly', nextDueAt: '2026-10-29');
+        expect(p.frequency, 'biweekly');
+        expect(p.isBiweekly, isTrue);
+        expect(p.nextDueAt, DateTime.utc(2026, 10, 29));
+        final legacy = InstallmentPlan.fromJson({'id': 'x', 'total_amount': 10, 'start_date': '2026-10-01'});
+        expect(legacy.frequency, 'monthly');
+        expect(legacy.nextDueAt, isNull);
+        expect(plan(frequency: 'weird').frequency, 'monthly');
+        expect(p.toJson()['frequency'], 'biweekly');
+        expect(p.toJson()['next_due_at'], '2026-10-29');
+      });
+
+      test('biweekly from next_due_at: every 14 days, only the remaining installments', () {
+        final dates = plan(frequency: 'biweekly', nextDueAt: '2026-10-29', paid: 1).dueDates(today: today);
+        expect(dates.map(iso), ['2026-10-29', '2026-11-12', '2026-11-26']);
+      });
+
+      test('monthly from next_due_at keeps the day, clamped to short months', () {
+        final dates = plan(nextDueAt: '2027-01-31', paid: 1).dueDates(today: today);
+        expect(dates.map(iso), ['2027-01-31', '2027-02-28', '2027-03-31']);
+      });
+
+      test('without next_due_at: monthly falls back to day_of_month from today', () {
+        expect(plan(day: 27, paid: 2).dueDates(today: today).map(iso), ['2026-10-27', '2026-11-27']);
+        expect(plan(day: 5, paid: 3).dueDates(today: today).map(iso), ['2026-11-05']);
+        expect(plan(day: 21, paid: 3).dueDates(today: today).map(iso), ['2026-10-21']);
+      });
+
+      test('without next_due_at: biweekly counts from the start date', () {
+        // Paid at purchase (1 of 4) on 1 Oct: next is 15 Oct (past), then 29 Oct, 12 Nov.
+        final dates = plan(frequency: 'biweekly', paid: 1, start: '2026-10-01').dueDates(today: today);
+        expect(dates.map(iso), ['2026-10-15', '2026-10-29', '2026-11-12']);
+        expect(iso(plan(frequency: 'biweekly', paid: 1, start: '2026-10-01').nextDueDate(today: today)!), '2026-10-15');
+      });
+
+      test('completed plans have nothing due', () {
+        expect(plan(paid: 4).dueDates(today: today), isEmpty);
+        expect(plan(status: 'COMPLETED', paid: 2).nextDueDate(today: today), isNull);
+      });
+    });
   });
 }

@@ -0,0 +1,87 @@
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/manual_expense_row.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/models.dart';
+
+/// Columns of public.transactions as created by supabase/migrations
+/// (verified against the migrated local audit database).
+const _transactionColumns = {
+  'id', 'household_id', 'user_id', 'amount', 'currency', 'merchant', 'category_code',
+  'timestamp', 'raw_sms', 'is_reallocated', 'reallocated_from_budget_id', 'created_at',
+  'source', 'items', 'receipt_url', 'dedup_fingerprint', 'spent_by', 'sub_category',
+  'cycle_key', 'qr_code_raw', 'beneficiary_type', 'beneficiary_id', 'is_settlement',
+  'settlement_target_id', 'line_items', 'account_id',
+  // 20261020300000_nafaqah_wife_allowance_and_reimbursements.sql
+  'nafaqah_class', 'nafaqah_spouse_id',
+};
+
+void main() {
+  Map<String, dynamic> wifeReimbursable() => buildManualExpenseRow(
+        id: '6f1c2a3e-0000-4000-8000-000000000001',
+        householdId: 'h-1',
+        userId: 'u-1',
+        amount: 87.5,
+        merchant: 'Tamimi',
+        categoryCode: 'OPEX-GROCERY',
+        spentBy: 'partner',
+        paidBy: 'wife',
+        beneficiaryType: 'household',
+        beneficiaryId: 'household',
+        accountId: null,
+        // 23:30 in Riyadh on the 26th = 20:30 UTC.
+        occurredAt: DateTime.utc(2026, 10, 26, 20, 30),
+      );
+
+  test('MOB-03: only real transactions columns are written (no paid_by column)', () {
+    final row = wifeReimbursable();
+    expect(row.keys.toSet().difference(_transactionColumns), isEmpty);
+  });
+
+  test('MOB-03: the wife-paid attribution survives as the PaidBy audit tag', () {
+    final row = wifeReimbursable();
+    final tx = Transaction.fromMap({
+      ...row,
+      'created_at': '2026-10-26T20:30:01Z',
+    });
+    expect(tx.paidBy, 'partner');
+    expect(tx.spentBy, 'partner');
+  });
+
+  test('MOB-24: the timestamp is an explicit UTC instant', () {
+    final row = wifeReimbursable();
+    expect(row['timestamp'], '2026-10-26T20:30:00.000Z');
+  });
+
+  test('manualPayerAuditTag keeps me/partner and roommate ids', () {
+    expect(manualPayerAuditTag('me'), 'me');
+    expect(manualPayerAuditTag('wife'), 'partner');
+    expect(manualPayerAuditTag('3b0f-roommate'), '3b0f-roommate');
+  });
+
+  test('family Nafaqah class and wife are written together', () {
+    Map<String, dynamic> build({String? cls, String? spouse}) => buildManualExpenseRow(
+          id: 'id-1',
+          householdId: 'h-1',
+          userId: 'u-wife',
+          amount: 120,
+          merchant: 'Panda',
+          categoryCode: 'OPEX-GROCERY',
+          spentBy: 'me',
+          paidBy: 'me',
+          beneficiaryType: 'household',
+          beneficiaryId: 'household',
+          accountId: null,
+          occurredAt: DateTime.utc(2026, 11, 2),
+          nafaqahClass: cls,
+          nafaqahSpouseId: spouse,
+        );
+
+    final shared = build(cls: 'wife_reimbursable', spouse: 'u-wife');
+    expect(shared['nafaqah_class'], 'wife_reimbursable');
+    expect(shared['nafaqah_spouse_id'], 'u-wife');
+    expect(shared.keys.toSet().difference(_transactionColumns), isEmpty);
+
+    // Without a resolvable wife the class is not written (the DB trigger would reject it).
+    expect(build(cls: 'wife_personal').containsKey('nafaqah_class'), isFalse);
+    expect(build().containsKey('nafaqah_class'), isFalse);
+  });
+}
