diff --git a/flutter_app/test/models/money_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/models/money_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ec68c28
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/models/money_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,137 @@
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/money.dart';
+
+void main() {
+  group('MOB-14 parseMoneyInput', () {
+    const cases = <String, double?>{
+      '150': 150.0,
+      '150.5': 150.5,
+      ' 1,250.75 ': 1250.75,
+      '١٥٠': 150.0, // Arabic-Indic
+      '١٥٠٫٥٠': 150.5, // Arabic decimal separator
+      '١٬٢٥٠٫٧٥': 1250.75, // Arabic thousands separator
+      '۱۵۰': 150.0, // Extended Arabic-Indic (Urdu/Persian keyboards)
+      '‏١٥٠ ر.س': 150.0, // RTL mark + Saudi riyal symbol
+      'SAR 99.99': 99.99,
+      '12.346': 12.35, // rounded to halalas
+      '0.1': 0.1,
+      '.5': 0.5,
+      '-20': -20.0,
+      '': null,
+      'abc': null,
+      '1.2.3': null,
+      '12abc': null,
+    };
+    cases.forEach((input, expected) {
+      test('"$input" -> $expected', () {
+        expect(parseMoneyInput(input), expected);
+      });
+    });
+
+    test('legacy double.tryParse silently rejected Arabic digits (the bug)', () {
+      expect(double.tryParse('١٥٠'), isNull);
+    });
+
+    test('normalizeDigits keeps non-digit text', () {
+      expect(normalizeDigits('فاتورة ١٢'), 'فاتورة 12');
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('FABLE-LOGIC-09 exact halala rounding (no binary doubles)', () {
+    const halalas = <String, int?>{
+      '1.005': 101, // 1.005 is 1.00499999... as a double: must still round up
+      '0.285': 29, // 0.28499999... as a double
+      '2.675': 268,
+      '1.004': 100,
+      '1.0049': 100, // only the 3rd decimal decides (half-up), no double rounding
+      '0.995': 100,
+      '٠٫٢٨٥': 29,
+      '١٥٠٫٥': 15050,
+      '١٬٢٥٠٫٧٥': 125075,
+      '1,234,567.891': 123456789,
+      '10.': 1000,
+      '.005': 1,
+      '-1.005': -101,
+      '999999999999.99': 99999999999999,
+      '1234567890123456': null, // beyond numeric(14,2): rejected, never wrapped
+      '1e3': null,
+      'NaN': null,
+      'Infinity': null,
+    };
+    halalas.forEach((input, expected) {
+      test('"$input" -> $expected halalas', () {
+        expect(parseMoneyToHalalas(input), expected);
+      });
+    });
+
+    test('parseMoneyInput returns the rounded SAR value', () {
+      expect(parseMoneyInput('1.005'), 1.01);
+      expect(parseMoneyInput('0.285'), 0.29);
+      expect(parseMoneyInput('١٥٠٫٥'), 150.50);
+      expect(parseMoneyInput('1,250.755'), 1250.76);
+    });
+
+    test('negatives are rejected where a positive amount is required', () {
+      expect(parseMoneyInput('-20', allowNegative: false), isNull);
+      expect(parseMoneyToHalalas('-0.01', allowNegative: false), isNull);
+      expect(parseMoneyInput('20', allowNegative: false), 20.0);
+      expect(parseMoneyInput('-20'), -20.0, reason: 'balances may be negative');
+    });
+
+    test('formatHalalas shows the rounded value with two decimals', () {
+      expect(formatHalalas(101), '1.01');
+      expect(formatHalalas(29), '0.29');
+      expect(formatHalalas(-101), '-1.01');
+      expect(formatHalalas(15050), '150.50');
+      expect(roundedMoneyText('1.005'), '1.01');
+      expect(roundedMoneyText('abc'), isNull);
+      expect(roundedMoneyTextIfRounded('1.005'), '1.01');
+      expect(roundedMoneyTextIfRounded('٠٫٢٨٥'), '0.29');
+      expect(roundedMoneyTextIfRounded('150.5'), isNull, reason: 'nothing rounded away: keep what was typed');
+      expect(roundedMoneyTextIfRounded('150'), isNull);
+      expect(roundedMoneyTextIfRounded('abc'), isNull);
+    });
+  });
+
+  // FABLE2-APP-04: "0,5" was read as 5 SAR (the comma dropped as a grouping
+  // mark), and "999999999999.995" passed the digit check but rounds to an
+  // amount numeric(14,2) cannot hold.
+  group('FABLE2-APP-04 decimal comma, strict grouping, cap after rounding', () {
+    const cases = <String, double?>{
+      '0,5': 0.50,
+      '1,5': 1.50,
+      '12,5': 12.50,
+      '12,50': 12.50,
+      '١,٥': 1.50,
+      '١٢،٥': 12.50, // Arabic comma as the decimal mark
+      ',5': 0.50,
+      '1,234': 1234.0,
+      '12,345': 12345.0,
+      '1,234,567.8': 1234567.80,
+      '1,234.56': 1234.56,
+      '١٬٢٣٤٫٥٦': 1234.56,
+      '١٬٥': null, // the Arabic thousands mark is never a decimal mark
+      '1,,2': null,
+      '1,2,3': null,
+      '12,5.3': null,
+      '1234,567': null, // a first group has at most three digits
+      ',500': null,
+      '1,2345': null,
+      '١٢٣٬٫٥': null,
+      '999999999999.99': 999999999999.99,
+      '999999999999.995': null,
+      '999,999,999,999.994': 999999999999.99,
+    };
+    cases.forEach((input, expected) {
+      test('"$input" -> $expected', () {
+        expect(parseMoneyInput(input), expected);
+      });
+    });
+
+    test('a decimal comma is shown back rounded like a decimal point', () {
+      expect(roundedMoneyTextIfRounded('1,5'), isNull);
+      expect(roundedMoneyTextIfRounded('1,234'), isNull, reason: 'thousands group, nothing rounded');
+      expect(roundedMoneyText('0,5'), '0.50');
+    });
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/models/nafaqah_preview_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/models/nafaqah_preview_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..d8b8630
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/models/nafaqah_preview_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,136 @@
+// External review (Gemini) BLOCKER 5 / HIGH 4: scanned receipts and chat send
+// a Nafaqah choice that never contradicts who paid for whom, and name the wife
+// when a husband with several wives records what one of them paid.
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/nafaqah.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api/base_api_client.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api/chat_api_client.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api/receipt_api_client.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+class _RecordingBase extends BaseApiClient {
+  Map<String, dynamic>? body;
+  String? path;
+
+  @override
+  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> post(String path, Map<String, dynamic> body,
+      {bool shouldSign = true, Duration timeout = const Duration(seconds: 20), Map<String, String>? extraHeaders}) async {
+    this.path = path;
+    this.body = body;
+    return {'status': 'success'};
+  }
+}
+
+Map<String, dynamic> _preview({String role = 'wife', String? cls, List<Map<String, dynamic>>? wives, String? spouse}) => {
+      'status': 'preview',
+      'household_mode': 'family_nafaqah',
+      'recorder_role': role,
+      'nafaqah_class': cls,
+      'nafaqah_spouse_id': spouse,
+      'wives': wives ?? [
+        {'id': 'wife-1', 'display_name': 'Sara'},
+      ],
+    };
+
+void main() {
+  test('every choice maps to an attribution that classifies back to it', () {
+    for (final role in ['wife', 'husband']) {
+      for (final cls in [kWifeReimbursable, kWifePersonal, null]) {
+        final a = nafaqahAttribution(role, cls);
+        expect(classifyNafaqah(role, a.paidBy, a.beneficiary), cls, reason: '$role / $cls');
+      }
+    }
+  });
+
+  test('preview context: wife, husband, roommates', () {
+    final wife = NafaqahPreview.fromPreview(_preview(cls: kWifeReimbursable, spouse: 'wife-1'));
+    expect(wife.canClassify, isTrue);
+    expect(wife.viewerIsWife, isTrue);
+    expect(wife.suggestedClass, kWifeReimbursable);
+    expect(wife.needsWifeChoice, isFalse);
+
+    final husband = NafaqahPreview.fromPreview(_preview(role: 'husband'));
+    expect(husband.defaultSpouseId, 'wife-1');
+
+    expect(NafaqahPreview.fromPreview({'household_mode': 'not_family'}).canClassify, isFalse);
+    expect(NafaqahPreview.fromPreview(_preview(role: 'member')).canClassify, isFalse);
+    expect(NafaqahPreview.fromPreview(null).canClassify, isFalse);
+  });
+
+  test('wife request fields never name a spouse; columns carry her own id', () {
+    final p = NafaqahPreview.fromPreview(_preview());
+    expect(p.requestFields(kWifePersonal), {'paid_by': 'me', 'beneficiary': 'me', 'nafaqah_class': kWifePersonal});
+    expect(p.requestFields(null), {'paid_by': 'partner', 'beneficiary': 'both', 'nafaqah_class': kNafaqahNone});
+    expect(p.transactionColumns(kWifeReimbursable, currentUserId: 'wife-1'),
+        {'nafaqah_class': kWifeReimbursable, 'nafaqah_spouse_id': 'wife-1'});
+    expect(p.transactionColumns(null, currentUserId: 'wife-1'), isEmpty);
+  });
+
+  test('husband with several wives: the chosen wife is sent, nothing without a choice', () {
+    final p = NafaqahPreview.fromPreview(_preview(role: 'husband', wives: [
+      {'id': 'wife-1', 'display_name': 'Sara'},
+      {'id': 'wife-2', 'display_name': 'Mona'},
+    ]));
+    expect(p.needsWifeChoice, isTrue);
+    expect(p.defaultSpouseId, isNull);
+    expect(p.requestFields(kWifeReimbursable, chosenWifeId: 'wife-2'), {
+      'paid_by': 'partner',
+      'beneficiary': 'both',
+      'nafaqah_class': kWifeReimbursable,
+      'nafaqah_spouse_id': 'wife-2',
+    });
+    expect(p.transactionColumns(kWifeReimbursable), isEmpty);
+    expect(p.transactionColumns(kWifePersonal, chosenWifeId: 'wife-2'),
+        {'nafaqah_class': kWifePersonal, 'nafaqah_spouse_id': 'wife-2'});
+  });
+
+  test('roommates send no Nafaqah fields', () {
+    final p = NafaqahPreview.fromPreview({'household_mode': 'not_family', 'nafaqah_class': kWifeReimbursable});
+    expect(p.requestFields(kWifeReimbursable), isEmpty);
+    expect(p.transactionColumns(kWifeReimbursable, currentUserId: 'x'), isEmpty);
+  });
+
+  test('summary context (multi-page scanner) defaults a wife to her shared advance', () {
+    final summary = NafaqahSummary.fromMap({
+      'mode': 'family_nafaqah',
+      'caller_role': 'wife',
+      'caller_user_id': 'wife-1',
+      'wives': [
+        {'id': 'wife-1', 'display_name': 'Sara'},
+      ],
+    });
+    final p = NafaqahPreview.fromSummary(summary);
+    expect(p.canClassify, isTrue);
+    expect(p.suggestedClass, kWifeReimbursable);
+    expect(NafaqahPreview.fromSummary(const NafaqahSummary()).canClassify, isFalse);
+  });
+
+  test('receipt client sends paid_by, beneficiary, class and spouse', () async {
+    final base = _RecordingBase();
+    await ReceiptApiClient(baseClient: base).scanReceipt(
+      imagesBase64: const [],
+      qrCodeRaw: 'qr',
+      householdId: 'hh',
+      paidBy: 'partner',
+      beneficiary: 'both',
+      nafaqahClass: kWifeReimbursable,
+      nafaqahSpouseId: 'wife-2',
+    );
+    expect(base.path, '/agent/scan-receipt');
+    expect(base.body, containsPair('paid_by', 'partner'));
+    expect(base.body, containsPair('beneficiary', 'both'));
+    expect(base.body, containsPair('nafaqah_class', kWifeReimbursable));
+    expect(base.body, containsPair('nafaqah_spouse_id', 'wife-2'));
+  });
+
+  test('chat client sends the chosen wife', () async {
+    final base = _RecordingBase();
+    await ChatApiClient(baseClient: base).postChatTransaction(
+      message: 'm',
+      householdId: 'hh',
+      previewOnly: false,
+      nafaqahClass: kWifeReimbursable,
+      nafaqahSpouseId: 'wife-2',
+    );
+    expect(base.body, containsPair('nafaqah_spouse_id', 'wife-2'));
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/models/nafaqah_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/models/nafaqah_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b196c29
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/models/nafaqah_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,161 @@
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/nafaqah.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+void main() {
+  group('classifyNafaqah (no spousal split; only the wife\'s own money is classified)', () {
+    final cases = <(String?, String, String, String?)>[
+      ('wife', 'me', 'me', kWifePersonal),
+      ('wife', 'me', 'both', kWifeReimbursable),
+      ('wife', 'me', 'sarah', kWifeReimbursable),
+      ('wife', 'me', 'partner', kWifeReimbursable),
+      ('wife', 'partner', 'both', null),
+      ('wife', 'partner', 'me', null),
+      ('husband', 'me', 'both', null),
+      ('husband', 'me', 'partner', null),
+      ('husband', 'partner', 'both', kWifeReimbursable),
+      ('husband', 'partner', 'partner', kWifePersonal),
+      ('member', 'me', 'both', null),
+      (null, 'me', 'me', null),
+    ];
+    for (final c in cases) {
+      test('${c.$1}/${c.$2}/${c.$3} -> ${c.$4}', () {
+        expect(classifyNafaqah(c.$1, c.$2, c.$3), c.$4);
+      });
+    }
+  });
+
+  test('NafaqahSummary parses the family summary', () {
+    final s = NafaqahSummary.fromMap({
+      'mode': 'family_nafaqah',
+      'caller_role': 'wife',
+      'caller_user_id': 'w2',
+      'cycle_key': '2026-11',
+      'husband': {'id': 'h', 'display_name': 'Ahmed'},
+      'wives': [
+        {'id': 'w1', 'reimbursement': {'outstanding': 10}, 'allowance': {'allocated': 100, 'spent': 150, 'remaining': -50}},
+        {'id': 'w2', 'reimbursement': {'outstanding': 20.5}, 'allowance': {'is_set': true, 'allocated': 300}},
+      ],
+      'can_set_allowance': false,
+      'can_record_reimbursement': true,
+    });
+    expect(s.isFamily, isTrue);
+    expect(s.husbandName, 'Ahmed');
+    expect(s.primaryWife!.id, 'w2');
+    expect(s.primaryWife!.reimbursement.outstanding, 20.5);
+    expect(s.wives.first.allowance.isOverspent, isTrue);
+    expect(s.wives.first.allowance.usedFraction, 1.0);
+  });
+
+  test('a household without wives is not family mode', () {
+    expect(NafaqahSummary.fromMap({'mode': 'not_family', 'wives': []}).isFamily, isFalse);
+    expect(const NafaqahSummary().primaryWife, isNull);
+  });
+
+  test('NafaqahApiException maps API errors', () {
+    expect(
+      NafaqahApiException.fromResponse({
+        'status': 'error',
+        'status_code': 409,
+        'detail': {'code': 'overpayment', 'message': 'x'},
+      }).code,
+      'overpayment',
+    );
+    expect(NafaqahApiException.fromResponse({'status': 'error', 'status_code': 403}).code, 'forbidden');
+    expect(NafaqahApiException.fromResponse({'status': 'error', 'status_code': 422}).code, 'invalid');
+    expect(NafaqahApiException.fromResponse({'status': 'error', 'message': 'offline'}).code, 'network');
+  });
+
+  test('NafaqahSummary parses the explicit provider fields', () {
+    final s = NafaqahSummary.fromMap({
+      'mode': 'family_nafaqah',
+      'caller_role': 'member',
+      'husband': null,
+      'wives': [
+        {'id': 'w1'},
+      ],
+      'provider_user_id': null,
+      'needs_provider': true,
+      'can_set_provider': true,
+    });
+    expect(s.providerUserId, isNull);
+    expect(s.needsProvider, isTrue);
+    expect(s.canSetProvider, isTrue);
+    expect(s.isFamily, isTrue, reason: 'still a family: the card explains the missing provider');
+
+    final legacy = NafaqahSummary.fromMap({'mode': 'family_nafaqah', 'wives': [{'id': 'w1'}]});
+    expect(legacy.needsProvider, isFalse);
+    expect(legacy.canSetProvider, isFalse);
+
+    final set = NafaqahSummary.fromMap({
+      'mode': 'family_nafaqah',
+      'husband': {'id': 'h'},
+      'wives': [{'id': 'w1'}],
+      'provider_user_id': 'h',
+      'needs_provider': false,
+    });
+    expect(set.providerUserId, 'h');
+  });
+
+  test('ReimbursementBalance parses overpaid (repaid more than advanced)', () {
+    final b = ReimbursementBalance.fromMap({'gross_advanced': 100, 'reimbursed': 200, 'outstanding': 0, 'overpaid': 100});
+    expect(b.overpaid, 100);
+    expect(b.isOverpaid, isTrue);
+    expect(b.isSettled, isTrue);
+    final ok = ReimbursementBalance.fromMap({'gross_advanced': 300, 'reimbursed': 100, 'outstanding': 200});
+    expect(ok.overpaid, 0);
+    expect(ok.isOverpaid, isFalse);
+  });
+
+  test('NafaqahApiException maps the ledger guard and missing provider refusals', () {
+    expect(
+      NafaqahApiException.fromResponse({
+        'status': 'error',
+        'status_code': 409,
+        'detail': {'code': 'ledger_would_be_overpaid', 'message': 'x'},
+      }).code,
+      'ledger_would_be_overpaid',
+    );
+    expect(
+      NafaqahApiException.fromResponse({
+        'status': 'error',
+        'status_code': 409,
+        'detail': {'code': 'no_provider', 'message': 'x'},
+      }).code,
+      'no_provider',
+    );
+  });
+
+  test('NafaqahProviderChange parses the PUT provider response', () {
+    final c = NafaqahProviderChange.fromMap({
+      'status': 'success',
+      'household_id': 'hh',
+      'provider_user_id': 'u2',
+      'previous_provider_user_id': 'u1',
+      'summary': {
+        'mode': 'family_nafaqah',
+        'husband': {'id': 'u2'},
+        'wives': [{'id': 'w'}],
+        'provider_user_id': 'u2',
+        'needs_provider': false,
+      },
+    });
+    expect(c.providerUserId, 'u2');
+    expect(c.previousProviderUserId, 'u1');
+    expect(c.summary!.husbandId, 'u2');
+    expect(NafaqahProviderChange.fromMap({'provider_user_id': 'u2'}).summary, isNull);
+  });
+
+  test('NafaqahLedger parses history', () {
+    final l = NafaqahLedger.fromMap({
+      'balance': {'gross_advanced': 300, 'reimbursed': 100, 'outstanding': 200},
+      'history': [
+        {'type': 'advance', 'id': 't1', 'amount': 300, 'merchant': 'Panda', 'timestamp': '2026-11-10T09:00:00Z'},
+        {'type': 'reimbursement', 'id': 'r1', 'amount': 100, 'payment_method': 'cash'},
+      ],
+    });
+    expect(l.balance.outstanding, 200);
+    expect(l.history.first.isAdvance, isTrue);
+    expect(l.history.last.paymentMethod, 'cash');
+    expect(l.history.last.timestamp, isNull);
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/models/payday_outlook_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/models/payday_outlook_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..810a097
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/models/payday_outlook_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,127 @@
+// UX-07: one computation of "left until payday", one daily figure, one verdict.
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/household_dues.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/models.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/nafaqah.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/payday_outlook.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+Budget _b(String code, double allocated, double spent) => Budget.fromMap({
+      'id': code,
+      'household_id': 'hh',
+      'month': '2026-11-01',
+      'category_code': code,
+      'allocated_amount': allocated,
+      'spent_amount': spent,
+      'remaining_amount': allocated - spent,
+      'cycle_key': '2026-11',
+    });
+
+// Cycle 27 Oct – 26 Nov 2026 (payday 27).
+final _start = DateTime.utc(2026, 10, 27);
+final _end = DateTime.utc(2026, 11, 26);
+
+PaydayOutlook _outlook(List<Budget> budgets, DateTime today, {double? income}) => PaydayOutlook.compute(
+      budgets: budgets,
+      monthlyIncome: income,
+      today: today,
+      cycleStart: _start,
+      cycleEnd: _end,
+    );
+
+void main() {
+  group('PaydayOutlook', () {
+    test('income-based when the income is known: income minus spending', () {
+      final o = _outlook([_b('OPEX-DINING', 3000, 2200)], DateTime.utc(2026, 11, 6), income: 12000);
+      expect(o.incomeBased, isTrue);
+      expect(o.base, 12000);
+      expect(o.left, 9800);
+      expect(o.daysLeft, 21, reason: '6 Nov to 26 Nov inclusive');
+      expect(o.safeDaily, closeTo(9800 / 21, 1e-9));
+      expect(o.verdict, PaydayVerdict.onTrack);
+    });
+
+    test('budget-based fallback without an income', () {
+      final o = _outlook([_b('OPEX-DINING', 3000, 2200)], DateTime.utc(2026, 11, 6));
+      expect(o.incomeBased, isFalse);
+      expect(o.base, 3000);
+      expect(o.left, 800);
+    });
+
+    test('a pace that runs out before payday is the one verdict, with the date', () {
+      // Day 11; 2,200 spent → 200/day; 800 left lasts 4 days → ~10 Nov.
+      final o = _outlook([_b('OPEX-DINING', 3000, 2200)], DateTime.utc(2026, 11, 6));
+      expect(o.verdict, PaydayVerdict.runsOut);
+      expect(o.runOutDate, DateTime.utc(2026, 11, 10));
+    });
+
+    test('spent more than the base: overspent, no daily figure', () {
+      final o = _outlook([_b('OPEX-SHOPPING', 1000, 1310)], DateTime.utc(2026, 11, 6));
+      expect(o.verdict, PaydayVerdict.overspent);
+      expect(o.left, -310);
+      expect(o.safeDaily, 0);
+    });
+
+    test('unspent rent and bills are kept out of the daily figure', () {
+      final o = _outlook(
+        [_b('OPEX-UTILITIES', 4000, 0), _b('OPEX-GROCERY', 2000, 500)],
+        DateTime.utc(2026, 11, 6),
+        income: 10000,
+      );
+      expect(o.left, 9500);
+      // 9,500 left minus the 4,000 still due for bills, over 21 days.
+      expect(o.safeDaily, closeTo(5500 / 21, 1e-9));
+    });
+
+    test('a closed cycle has no days left and no daily figure', () {
+      final o = PaydayOutlook.compute(
+        budgets: [_b('OPEX-GROCERY', 2000, 1500)],
+        today: DateTime.utc(2026, 12, 5),
+        cycleStart: _start,
+        cycleEnd: _end,
+      );
+      expect(o.isClosed, isTrue);
+      expect(o.daysLeft, 0);
+      expect(o.safeDaily, 0);
+      expect(o.verdict, PaydayVerdict.onTrack);
+    });
+
+    test('spent share is not clamped', () {
+      final o = _outlook([_b('OPEX-SHOPPING', 1000, 1310)], DateTime.utc(2026, 11, 6));
+      expect(o.spentShare, closeTo(1.31, 1e-9));
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('dues for the hero', () {
+    NafaqahSummary family({String role = 'husband', double outstanding = 386.4, String? name = 'Sara'}) =>
+        NafaqahSummary.fromMap({
+          'mode': 'family_nafaqah',
+          'caller_role': role,
+          'caller_user_id': role == 'wife' ? 'u-w' : 'u-h',
+          'wives': [
+            {
+              'id': 'u-w',
+              'display_name': name,
+              'reimbursement': {'outstanding': outstanding},
+            }
+          ],
+        });
+
+    test('the husband sees what he owes his wife, by name', () {
+      final lines = nafaqahDueLines(family());
+      expect(lines, hasLength(1));
+      expect(lines.single.kind, DueKind.owedToWife);
+      expect(lines.single.name, 'Sara');
+      expect(lines.single.amount, 386.4);
+    });
+
+    test('the wife sees what is owed to her', () {
+      final lines = nafaqahDueLines(family(role: 'wife'));
+      expect(lines.single.kind, DueKind.owedToMe);
+    });
+
+    test('nothing owed: no line', () {
+      expect(nafaqahDueLines(family(outstanding: 0)), isEmpty);
+      expect(nafaqahDueLines(const NafaqahSummary()), isEmpty);
+    });
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/models/transaction_attribution_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/models/transaction_attribution_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..4313f39
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/models/transaction_attribution_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,120 @@
+// FABLE2-APP-01: the app writes and reads attribution exactly like the
+// settlement engine. Expected values were produced by running
+// ai_service/settlement_engine.py (structured_attribution and
+// transaction_attribution) on the same inputs.
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/transaction_attribution.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+const _a = 'aaaaaaaa-2222-3333-4444-555555555555';
+const _b = '11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555';
+
+void main() {
+  group('attributionColumns mirrors structured_attribution (no roster)', () {
+    final cases = <List<String>, List<String>>{
+      ['me', 'both']: ['me', 'household', 'household'],
+      ['me', 'me']: ['me', 'individual', _a],
+      ['partner', 'partner']: ['partner', 'individual', 'partner'],
+      ['me', 'Sarah']: ['me', 'dependent', 'Sarah'],
+      ['me', 'children']: ['me', 'dependent', 'children'],
+      ['partner', _b]: ['partner', 'individual', _b],
+      ['me', 'household']: ['me', 'household', 'household'],
+      ['me', 'all_peers']: ['me', 'household', 'household'],
+    };
+    cases.forEach((input, expected) {
+      test('${input[0]} / ${input[1]}', () {
+        final cols = attributionColumns(payer: input[0], beneficiary: input[1], creatorId: _a);
+        expect([cols.spentBy, cols.beneficiaryType, cols.beneficiaryId], expected);
+      });
+    });
+
+    test('a known partner is stored as the member id', () {
+      final cols = attributionColumns(payer: 'me', beneficiary: 'partner', creatorId: _a, partnerId: _b);
+      expect(cols.beneficiaryId, _b);
+    });
+
+    test('spent_by is never both or a name', () {
+      expect(() => attributionColumns(payer: 'both', beneficiary: 'both'), throwsArgumentError);
+      expect(() => attributionColumns(payer: 'Sarah', beneficiary: 'both'), throwsArgumentError);
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('storedPayerRef mirrors transaction_attribution', () {
+    final rows = <String, (Map<String, dynamic>, String)>{
+      'manual structured row: payer from the tail': ({
+        'source': 'manual', 'spent_by': 'partner', 'beneficiary_type': 'household', 'beneficiary_id': 'household',
+        'user_id': _a, 'raw_sms': 'Manual: Dinner | PaidBy: $_b | Beneficiary: household | SpentBy: partner',
+      }, _b),
+      'manual dependent row': ({
+        'source': 'manual', 'spent_by': 'me', 'beneficiary_type': 'dependent', 'beneficiary_id': 'Sarah',
+        'user_id': _a, 'raw_sms': 'Manual: Jarir | PaidBy: me | Beneficiary: Sarah | SpentBy: me',
+      }, 'me'),
+      'chat structured row: payer from spent_by': ({
+        'source': 'chat', 'spent_by': 'partner', 'beneficiary_type': 'individual', 'beneficiary_id': _a,
+        'raw_sms': 'Chat: X | PaidBy: me | Beneficiary: me',
+      }, 'partner'),
+      'legacy chat row: the server-authored tag': ({
+        'source': 'chat', 'spent_by': 'me', 'beneficiary_id': null,
+        'raw_sms': 'Chat: Jarir | PaidBy: me | Beneficiary: me | Items: [1x Jarir (50 SAR)]',
+      }, 'me'),
+      'legacy chat row naming a member: me': ({
+        'source': 'chat', 'spent_by': 'me', 'beneficiary_id': null, 'raw_sms': 'Chat: X | PaidBy: $_b | Beneficiary: both',
+      }, 'me'),
+      'untagged legacy row: spent_by': ({
+        'source': 'manual', 'spent_by': 'partner', 'beneficiary_id': null, 'raw_sms': '',
+      }, 'partner'),
+    };
+    rows.forEach((name, c) {
+      test(name, () => expect(storedPayerRef(c.$1), c.$2));
+    });
+  });
+
+  test('manualAuditNote ends with the tail the server parses, right-anchored', () {
+    final note = manualAuditNote(head: 'Manual: A | PaidBy: x | Beneficiary: y | SpentBy: z', payer: _b, beneficiaryId: 'household', spentBy: 'partner');
+    final tail = manualTailPattern.firstMatch(note)!;
+    expect(tail.group(1), _b);
+    expect(tail.group(2), 'household');
+    expect(tail.group(3), 'partner');
+    // A separator in a dependent name cannot shift the tail.
+    final forged = manualAuditNote(head: 'Manual: A', payer: 'me', beneficiaryId: 'Sa|rah', spentBy: 'me');
+    expect(manualTailPattern.firstMatch(forged)!.group(2), 'Sa rah');
+  });
+
+  test('auditNoteHead drops every attribution tag of an older note', () {
+    expect(
+      auditNoteHead('Manual: Dinner | PaidBy: $_b | PaidBy: me | Beneficiary: both | SubCategory:  | SpentBy: both', fallback: 'x'),
+      'Manual: Dinner',
+    );
+    expect(auditNoteHead(null, fallback: 'Manual: Panda'), 'Manual: Panda');
+  });
+
+  test('HouseholdRelations mirrors counterpart_id', () {
+    final pair = HouseholdRelations(memberIds: [_a, _b], rosterComplete: true);
+    expect(pair.counterpartOf(_a), _b);
+    final three = HouseholdRelations(memberIds: [_a, _b, 'c'], rosterComplete: true);
+    expect(three.counterpartOf(_a), isNull);
+    final family = HouseholdRelations(memberIds: ['h', 'w', 'son'], husbandId: 'h', wifeIds: ['w'], rosterComplete: true);
+    expect(family.counterpartOf('h'), 'w');
+    expect(family.counterpartOf('w'), 'h');
+    expect(family.counterpartOf('son'), isNull);
+    final twoWives = HouseholdRelations(husbandId: 'h', wifeIds: ['w1', 'w2']);
+    expect(twoWives.counterpartOf('h'), isNull);
+    expect(twoWives.counterpartOf('w2'), 'h');
+  });
+
+  // FABLE2-APP-06: direct fallback inserts store what the API would.
+  group('directInsertAttribution', () {
+    test('defaults to the recorder paying for the household', () {
+      expect(directInsertAttribution(creatorId: _a),
+          {'spent_by': 'me', 'beneficiary_type': 'household', 'beneficiary_id': 'household'});
+    });
+    test('follows a Nafaqah choice (husband recording a wife advance)', () {
+      expect(directInsertAttribution(paidBy: 'partner', beneficiary: 'both', creatorId: _a),
+          {'spent_by': 'partner', 'beneficiary_type': 'household', 'beneficiary_id': 'household'});
+      expect(directInsertAttribution(paidBy: 'me', beneficiary: 'me', creatorId: _a),
+          {'spent_by': 'me', 'beneficiary_type': 'individual', 'beneficiary_id': _a});
+    });
+    test("a legacy 'both' payer is never stored in spent_by", () {
+      expect(directInsertAttribution(paidBy: 'both')['spent_by'], 'me');
+    });
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/models/transaction_source_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/models/transaction_source_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..2f96bd5
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/models/transaction_source_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/models.dart';
+
+Map<String, dynamic> _row(String? source, String? note) => {
+      'id': 'tx-1',
+      'household_id': 'hh-1',
+      'amount': 10.0,
+      'currency': 'SAR',
+      'timestamp': '2026-10-20T12:00:00Z',
+      'created_at': '2026-10-20T12:00:00Z',
+      'source': source,
+      'raw_sms': note,
+    };
+
+void main() {
+  test('only chat, receipt_scan and manual channels exist (zero-SMS policy)', () {
+    expect(Transaction.sources, equals({'chat', 'receipt_scan', 'manual'}));
+  });
+
+  test('known channels are kept as stored', () {
+    expect(Transaction.fromMap(_row('chat', 'x')).source, 'chat');
+    expect(Transaction.fromMap(_row('receipt_scan', 'x')).source, 'receipt_scan');
+    expect(Transaction.fromMap(_row('manual', 'Manual: x')).source, 'manual');
+  });
+
+  test('unknown or legacy labels are shown by audit-note prefix, never as a new channel', () {
+    expect(Transaction.fromMap(_row('legacy', 'Chat: panda 10')).source, 'chat');
+    expect(Transaction.fromMap(_row('legacy', 'Receipt Scan: Tamimi')).source, 'receipt_scan');
+    expect(Transaction.fromMap(_row('legacy', 'note')).source, 'manual');
+    expect(Transaction.fromMap(_row(null, null)).source, 'manual');
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/providers/budget_provider_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/providers/budget_provider_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a3114e2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/providers/budget_provider_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,109 @@
+import 'dart:async';
+
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
+
+import 'package:budget_tracker/providers/budget_provider.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api/budget_api_client.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api_service.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/salary_cycle_service.dart';
+
+class _FakeBudgetApi extends BudgetApiClient {
+  final Map<String, Completer<Map<String, dynamic>>> breakdowns = {};
+  int payday = 25;
+
+  @override
+  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> fetchSalaryCycles({required String householdId, int? paydayDay}) async => [
+        {'cycle_key': '2026-10', 'cycle_start': '2026-09-25', 'cycle_end': '2026-10-24', 'is_current': false},
+        {'cycle_key': '2026-11', 'cycle_start': '2026-10-25', 'cycle_end': '2026-11-24', 'is_current': true},
+      ];
+
+  @override
+  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> fetchSalaryCycleForecast({required String householdId, int? paydayDay}) async =>
+      {'status': 'success'};
+
+  @override
+  Future<int> fetchHouseholdPayday({required String householdId}) async => payday;
+
+  @override
+  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> fetchBudgetBreakdown({required String householdId, String? cycleKey}) {
+    final key = '$householdId/$cycleKey';
+    return (breakdowns[key] ??= Completer<Map<String, dynamic>>()).future;
+  }
+
+  void answer(String householdId, String cycleKey, String categoryCode) {
+    (breakdowns['$householdId/$cycleKey'] ??= Completer<Map<String, dynamic>>()).complete({
+      'categories': [
+        {'category_code': categoryCode, 'category': categoryCode, 'allocated_amount': 100, 'spent_amount': 10, 'remaining_amount': 90},
+      ],
+    });
+  }
+}
+
+void main() {
+  setUp(() {
+    SharedPreferences.setMockInitialValues({});
+    SalaryCycleService.paydayDay = SalaryCycleService.defaultPaydayDay;
+  });
+
+  tearDown(() {
+    SalaryCycleService.paydayDay = SalaryCycleService.defaultPaydayDay;
+  });
+
+  test('MOB-17: a slow breakdown for a previously selected cycle cannot overwrite the newer one', () async {
+    final fake = _FakeBudgetApi();
+    final provider = BudgetProvider(api: ApiService(budget: fake));
+
+    final initFuture = provider.init('h-1');
+    await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);
+    fake.answer('h-1', '2026-11', 'CURRENT');
+    await initFuture;
+    expect(provider.categories.single.categoryCode, 'CURRENT');
+
+    fake.breakdowns.remove('h-1/2026-11');
+    final older = provider.selectCycle(0); // user taps the October cycle...
+    final newer = provider.selectCycle(1); // ...then quickly back to November
+    fake.answer('h-1', '2026-11', 'NOVEMBER');
+    await newer;
+    fake.answer('h-1', '2026-10', 'OCTOBER'); // the stale October answer arrives last
+    await older;
+
+    expect(provider.activeCycle!.cycleKey, '2026-11');
+    expect(provider.categories.single.categoryCode, 'NOVEMBER');
+  });
+
+  test('MOB-13: refresh applies the household payday to client cycle arithmetic', () async {
+    final fake = _FakeBudgetApi()..payday = 25;
+    final provider = BudgetProvider(api: ApiService(budget: fake));
+    final f = provider.init('h-1');
+    await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);
+    fake.answer('h-1', '2026-11', 'X');
+    await f;
+
+    expect(SalaryCycleService.paydayDay, 25);
+    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 10));
+    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
+    expect(prefs.getInt(SalaryCycleService.paydayPrefKey), 25);
+  });
+
+  test('MOB-16: switching household clears the previous household budgets immediately', () async {
+    final fake = _FakeBudgetApi();
+    final provider = BudgetProvider(api: ApiService(budget: fake));
+    final f = provider.init('h-1');
+    await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);
+    fake.answer('h-1', '2026-11', 'H1-ONLY');
+    await f;
+    expect(provider.categories, isNotEmpty);
+
+    final g = provider.init('h-2');
+    expect(provider.categories, isEmpty);
+    expect(provider.cycles, isEmpty);
+    await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);
+    fake.answer('h-2', '2026-11', 'H2');
+    await g;
+    expect(provider.categories.single.categoryCode, 'H2');
+
+    provider.reset();
+    expect(provider.categories, isEmpty);
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/providers/household_role_provider_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/providers/household_role_provider_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b33e7ab
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/providers/household_role_provider_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,95 @@
+// The signed-in user's household role drives which edit/delete and transfer
+// actions the app offers (DB-16 / DB-18).
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/models.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/providers/household_role_provider.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/providers/transaction_provider.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
+
+Transaction _tx(String id, {String? userId, String householdId = 'hh'}) => Transaction(
+      id: id,
+      householdId: householdId,
+      amount: 10,
+      currency: 'SAR',
+      timestamp: DateTime.utc(2026, 10, 20),
+      isReallocated: false,
+      createdAt: DateTime.utc(2026, 10, 20),
+      userId: userId,
+    );
+
+void main() {
+  group('HouseholdRoleProvider', () {
+    test('a member may change only their own transactions', () async {
+      final roles = HouseholdRoleProvider(
+        loadMemberships: () async => const [
+          HouseholdMembership(householdId: 'hh', householdName: 'Flat', inviteCode: '', role: 'member', isActive: true),
+        ],
+        currentUserId: () => 'm',
+      );
+      await roles.load('hh');
+      expect(roles.isLoaded, isTrue);
+      expect(roles.isAdmin, isFalse);
+      expect(roles.canModify(_tx('own', userId: 'm')), isTrue);
+      expect(roles.canModify(_tx('other', userId: 'p')), isFalse);
+      expect(roles.canModify(_tx('legacy')), isFalse);
+    });
+
+    test('an admin of the active household may change any of its transactions', () async {
+      final roles = HouseholdRoleProvider(
+        loadMemberships: () async => const [
+          HouseholdMembership(householdId: 'other', householdName: 'Other', inviteCode: '', role: 'member'),
+          HouseholdMembership(householdId: 'hh', householdName: 'Family', inviteCode: 'X', role: 'admin', isActive: true, isPrimary: true),
+        ],
+        currentUserId: () => 'h',
+      );
+      await roles.load('hh');
+      expect(roles.isAdmin, isTrue);
+      expect(roles.isPrimary, isTrue);
+      expect(roles.canModify(_tx('wife', userId: 'w')), isTrue);
+      expect(roles.canModify(_tx('elsewhere', userId: 'w', householdId: 'other')), isFalse);
+    });
+
+    test('keeps the last known role when the server cannot be reached', () async {
+      var online = true;
+      final roles = HouseholdRoleProvider(
+        loadMemberships: () async {
+          if (!online) throw Exception('offline');
+          return const [HouseholdMembership(householdId: 'hh', householdName: 'H', inviteCode: '', role: 'admin', isActive: true)];
+        },
+        currentUserId: () => 'a',
+      );
+      await roles.load('hh');
+      online = false;
+      await roles.refresh();
+      expect(roles.isAdmin, isTrue);
+
+      roles.reset();
+      expect(roles.isAdmin, isFalse);
+      expect(roles.isLoaded, isFalse);
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('TransactionProvider permission refusals', () {
+    test('a refused delete rolls back and is reported as a permission refusal', () async {
+      final provider = TransactionProvider(
+        deleteRow: (_) async => throw const PostgrestException(
+          message: "Forbidden: only household admins can edit or delete another member's transactions",
+          code: '42501',
+        ),
+      );
+      provider.addTransaction(_tx('t1', userId: 'p'));
+
+      final ok = await provider.deleteTransaction('t1');
+      expect(ok, isFalse);
+      expect(provider.lastWriteDenied, isTrue);
+      expect(provider.transactions.map((t) => t.id), ['t1']);
+    });
+
+    test('a network failure is not reported as a permission refusal', () async {
+      final provider = TransactionProvider(deleteRow: (_) async => throw Exception('offline'));
+      provider.addTransaction(_tx('t1', userId: 'm'));
+      expect(await provider.deleteTransaction('t1'), isFalse);
+      expect(provider.lastWriteDenied, isFalse);
+    });
+  });
+}

diff --git a/flutter_app/test/providers/transaction_undo_restore_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/providers/transaction_undo_restore_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..f3f4535
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/providers/transaction_undo_restore_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,190 @@
+// UI-25: undo after delete must restore the full original row (same id,
+// payer/beneficiary/account/sub-category attribution, receipt), not a subset.
+import 'dart:io';
+
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/models.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/providers/transaction_provider.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/nafaqah_write_errors.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart' show PostgrestException;
+
+const _id = '11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111';
+const _receipt = 'https://x.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/sign/receipts/h1/r.jpg?token=t';
+
+/// The row exactly as PostgREST returns it from `delete().select()`,
+/// including columns the Transaction model does not know about.
+final Map<String, dynamic> _dbRow = {
+  'id': _id,
+  'household_id': 'h1',
+  'user_id': 'u-wife',
+  'amount': 120.5,
+  'currency': 'SAR',
+  'merchant': 'Danube',
+  'category_code': 'OPEX-GROCERY',
+  'sub_category': 'sub-produce',
+  'timestamp': '2026-10-19T09:00:00.000Z',
+  'created_at': '2026-10-19T09:00:05.000Z',
+  'is_reallocated': false,
+  'reallocated_from_budget_id': null,
+  'source': 'receipt_scan',
+  'spent_by': 'partner',
+  'paid_by': 'partner',
+  'beneficiary': 'both',
+  'beneficiary_type': 'household',
+  'beneficiary_id': null,
+  'account_id': 'acc-wife-wallet',
+  'items': [
+    {'name': 'Tomatoes', 'quantity': 2, 'price': 10.0},
+  ],
+  'receipt_url': _receipt,
+  'qr_code_raw': 'AQ...',
+  'cycle_key': '2026-09',
+  'raw_sms': null,
+};
+
+Transaction _tx() => Transaction.fromMap(_dbRow);
+
+void main() {
+  late List<Map<String, dynamic>> inserted;
+  late List<String> deletedReceipts;
+  late bool failInsert;
+
+  TransactionProvider build({
+    List<Map<String, dynamic>>? deleteResult,
+    Duration undoWindow = const Duration(seconds: 10),
+  }) {
+    final provider = TransactionProvider(
+      deleteRow: (id) async => deleteResult ?? [Map<String, dynamic>.from(_dbRow)],
+      insertRow: (row) async {
+        if (failInsert) throw Exception('insert rejected');
+        inserted.add(row);
+      },
+      deleteReceipt: (url) async => deletedReceipts.add(url),
+      undoWindow: undoWindow,
+    );
+    provider.addTransaction(_tx());
+    return provider;
+  }
+
+  setUp(() {
+    inserted = [];
+    deletedReceipts = [];
+    failInsert = false;
+  });
+
+  test('undo re-inserts every original column with the same id', () async {
+    final provider = build();
+
+    expect(await provider.deleteTransaction(_id), isTrue);
+    expect(provider.transactions, isEmpty);
+
+    expect(await provider.restoreDeletedTransaction(_id), isTrue);
+
+    expect(inserted, hasLength(1));
+    expect(inserted.single, equals(_dbRow));
+    for (final key in ['id', 'paid_by', 'beneficiary', 'account_id', 'sub_category', 'user_id', 'beneficiary_type', 'receipt_url']) {
+      expect(inserted.single[key], _dbRow[key], reason: key);
+    }
+    expect(provider.transactions.single.id, _id);
+    expect(provider.transactions.single.accountId, 'acc-wife-wallet');
+  });
+
+  test('falls back to the full model map when the delete returned no row', () async {
+    final provider = build(deleteResult: const []);
+    await provider.deleteTransaction(_id);
+    await provider.restoreDeletedTransaction(_id);
+
+    final row = inserted.single;
+    expect(row['id'], _id);
+    // Only real columns: an insert naming paid_by / beneficiary is refused
+    // by PostgREST (PGRST204), so the undo would fail (FABLE2-APP-05).
+    expect(row.containsKey('paid_by'), isFalse);
+    expect(row.containsKey('beneficiary'), isFalse);
+    expect(row['spent_by'], 'partner');
+    expect(row['beneficiary_type'], 'household');
+    expect(row['account_id'], 'acc-wife-wallet');
+    expect(row['sub_category'], 'sub-produce');
+  });
+
+  test('receipt image survives the undo window and is kept when undone', () async {
+    final provider = build(undoWindow: const Duration(milliseconds: 80));
+    await provider.deleteTransaction(_id);
+    expect(deletedReceipts, isEmpty, reason: 'not deleted up front any more');
+
+    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 20));
+    await provider.restoreDeletedTransaction(_id);
+    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 200));
+
+    expect(deletedReceipts, isEmpty);
+    expect(inserted.single['receipt_url'], _receipt);
+  });
+
+  test('receipt image is deleted once the undo window passes', () async {
+    final provider = build(undoWindow: const Duration(milliseconds: 30));
+    await provider.deleteTransaction(_id);
+    expect(deletedReceipts, isEmpty);
+
+    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 120));
+    expect(deletedReceipts, [_receipt]);
+  });
+
+  test('a failed restore reports false and cleans up the receipt', () async {
+    final provider = build();
+    await provider.deleteTransaction(_id);
+    failInsert = true;
+
+    expect(await provider.restoreDeletedTransaction(_id), isFalse);
+    expect(deletedReceipts, [_receipt]);
+    expect(await provider.restoreDeletedTransaction(_id), isFalse, reason: 'snapshot consumed');
+  });
+
+  test('undo snapshots do not survive a sign-out', () async {
+    final provider = build();
+    await provider.deleteTransaction(_id);
+
+    provider.reset();
+
+    expect(await provider.restoreDeletedTransaction(_id), isFalse);
+    expect(inserted, isEmpty);
+    expect(deletedReceipts, [_receipt], reason: 'pending cleanup flushed');
+  });
+
+  test('the feed undo uses the provider snapshot, not a hand-built subset', () {
+    final src = File('lib/screens/home/transaction_feed_screen.dart').readAsStringSync();
+    expect(src, contains('restoreDeletedTransaction(tx.id)'));
+    expect(src, isNot(contains("from('transactions').insert(")));
+  });
+
+  test('a failed delete rolls back and keeps the receipt', () async {
+    final provider = TransactionProvider(
+      deleteRow: (_) async => throw Exception('rls'),
+      insertRow: (row) async => inserted.add(row),
+      deleteReceipt: (url) async => deletedReceipts.add(url),
+    )..addTransaction(_tx());
+
+    expect(await provider.deleteTransaction(_id), isFalse);
+    expect(provider.transactions.single.id, _id);
+    expect(deletedReceipts, isEmpty);
+  });
+
+  // FABLE-LOGIC-02: deleting a wife advance that was already repaid is refused
+  // by the ledger guard; the row comes back and the feed can explain why.
+  test('a delete refused by the Nafaqah ledger guard rolls back and is identified', () async {
+    final provider = TransactionProvider(
+      deleteRow: (id) async => throw const PostgrestException(
+        message: 'Nafaqah ledger overpaid',
+        code: '22023',
+        hint: 'ledger_would_be_overpaid',
+      ),
+      insertRow: (row) async {},
+      deleteReceipt: (url) async => deletedReceipts.add(url),
+    );
+    provider.addTransaction(_tx());
+
+    expect(await provider.deleteTransaction(_id), isFalse);
+    expect(provider.transactions.single.id, _id);
+    expect(provider.lastNafaqahRefusal, NafaqahWriteRefusal.ledgerWouldBeOverpaid);
+    expect(provider.lastWriteDenied, isFalse);
+    expect(deletedReceipts, isEmpty);
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/screens/auth_gate_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/screens/auth_gate_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..98be24c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/screens/auth_gate_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,198 @@
+import 'dart:async';
+import 'dart:io';
+
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
+import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
+
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/main.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/models.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/providers/transaction_provider.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/household_resolver.dart';
+
+Session _session(String userId) => Session(
+      accessToken: 'jwt-$userId',
+      tokenType: 'bearer',
+      user: User(
+        id: userId,
+        appMetadata: const {},
+        userMetadata: const {},
+        aud: 'authenticated',
+        createdAt: '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z',
+      ),
+    );
+
+Widget _app(Widget home) => MaterialApp(
+      localizationsDelegates: const [AppLocalizationsDelegate()],
+      home: home,
+    );
+
+void main() {
+  setUp(() => SharedPreferences.setMockInitialValues({}));
+
+  group('MOB-15 AuthGate', () {
+    testWidgets('token refresh events do not re-query the household or rebuild the dashboard', (tester) async {
+      final auth = StreamController<AuthState>();
+      var lookups = 0;
+      var readyCalls = 0;
+      var homeBuilds = 0;
+
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_app(AuthGate(
+        authStates: auth.stream,
+        resolver: HouseholdResolver(fetchRemote: (uid) async {
+          lookups++;
+          return 'h-1';
+        }),
+        loginBuilder: (_) => const Text('login'),
+        onboardingBuilder: (_) => const Text('onboarding'),
+        homeBuilder: (_) {
+          homeBuilds++;
+          return const Text('home');
+        },
+        onHouseholdReady: (_, __) => readyCalls++,
+        onSignedOut: (_) {},
+      )));
+
+      auth.add(AuthState(AuthChangeEvent.initialSession, _session('u-1')));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      expect(find.text('home'), findsOneWidget);
+      final buildsAfterStart = homeBuilds;
+
+      for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
+        auth.add(AuthState(AuthChangeEvent.tokenRefreshed, _session('u-1')));
+        await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+        expect(find.byType(CircularProgressIndicator), findsNothing);
+      }
+
+      expect(lookups, 1);
+      expect(readyCalls, 1);
+      expect(find.text('home'), findsOneWidget);
+      // The dashboard subtree is rebuilt in place, never replaced by a spinner.
+      expect(homeBuilds - buildsAfterStart, lessThanOrEqualTo(3));
+      await auth.close();
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('offline start with a cached household opens the dashboard, not onboarding', (tester) async {
+      SharedPreferences.setMockInitialValues({HouseholdResolver.cacheKeyFor('u-1'): 'h-cached'});
+      final auth = StreamController<AuthState>();
+      String? readyFor;
+
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_app(AuthGate(
+        authStates: auth.stream,
+        resolver: HouseholdResolver(fetchRemote: (uid) async => throw const SocketException('offline')),
+        loginBuilder: (_) => const Text('login'),
+        onboardingBuilder: (_) => const Text('onboarding'),
+        homeBuilder: (_) => const Text('home'),
+        onHouseholdReady: (_, hid) => readyFor = hid,
+        onSignedOut: (_) {},
+      )));
+      auth.add(AuthState(AuthChangeEvent.initialSession, _session('u-1')));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+      expect(find.text('home'), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(find.text('onboarding'), findsNothing);
+      expect(readyFor, 'h-cached');
+      await auth.close();
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('offline start without cache shows retry instead of onboarding', (tester) async {
+      final auth = StreamController<AuthState>();
+      var online = false;
+
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_app(AuthGate(
+        authStates: auth.stream,
+        resolver: HouseholdResolver(fetchRemote: (uid) async {
+          if (!online) throw const SocketException('offline');
+          return 'h-1';
+        }),
+        loginBuilder: (_) => const Text('login'),
+        onboardingBuilder: (_) => const Text('onboarding'),
+        homeBuilder: (_) => const Text('home'),
+        onHouseholdReady: (_, __) {},
+        onSignedOut: (_) {},
+      )));
+      auth.add(AuthState(AuthChangeEvent.initialSession, _session('u-1')));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+      expect(find.text('onboarding'), findsNothing);
+      expect(find.byIcon(Icons.refresh_rounded), findsOneWidget);
+
+      online = true;
+      await tester.tap(find.byIcon(Icons.refresh_rounded));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      expect(find.text('home'), findsOneWidget);
+      await auth.close();
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('a user without a household is sent to onboarding', (tester) async {
+      final auth = StreamController<AuthState>();
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_app(AuthGate(
+        authStates: auth.stream,
+        resolver: HouseholdResolver(fetchRemote: (uid) async => null),
+        loginBuilder: (_) => const Text('login'),
+        onboardingBuilder: (_) => const Text('onboarding'),
+        homeBuilder: (_) => const Text('home'),
+        onHouseholdReady: (_, __) {},
+        onSignedOut: (_) {},
+      )));
+      auth.add(AuthState(AuthChangeEvent.initialSession, _session('u-1')));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      expect(find.text('onboarding'), findsOneWidget);
+      await auth.close();
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('MOB-16: signing out resets household state; the next account re-resolves', (tester) async {
+      final auth = StreamController<AuthState>();
+      final lookups = <String>[];
+      var signedOutCalls = 0;
+      final ready = <String>[];
+
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_app(AuthGate(
+        authStates: auth.stream,
+        resolver: HouseholdResolver(fetchRemote: (uid) async {
+          lookups.add(uid);
+          return uid == 'u-1' ? 'h-1' : 'h-2';
+        }),
+        loginBuilder: (_) => const Text('login'),
+        onboardingBuilder: (_) => const Text('onboarding'),
+        homeBuilder: (_) => const Text('home'),
+        onHouseholdReady: (_, hid) => ready.add(hid),
+        onSignedOut: (_) => signedOutCalls++,
+      )));
+
+      auth.add(AuthState(AuthChangeEvent.initialSession, _session('u-1')));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      auth.add(const AuthState(AuthChangeEvent.signedOut, null));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      expect(find.text('login'), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(signedOutCalls, 1);
+
+      auth.add(AuthState(AuthChangeEvent.signedIn, _session('u-2')));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      expect(lookups, ['u-1', 'u-2']);
+      expect(ready, ['h-1', 'h-2']);
+      await auth.close();
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('MOB-16 TransactionProvider.reset', () {
+    test('drops the previous account transactions', () {
+      final provider = TransactionProvider();
+      provider.addTransaction(Transaction.fromMap({
+        'id': 't-1',
+        'household_id': 'h-1',
+        'amount': 10,
+        'timestamp': '2026-10-01T10:00:00Z',
+        'created_at': '2026-10-01T10:00:00Z',
+      }));
+      expect(provider.transactions, hasLength(1));
+
+      provider.reset();
+
+      expect(provider.transactions, isEmpty);
+      expect(provider.filteredTransactions, isEmpty);
+    });
+  });
+}

diff --git a/flutter_app/test/screens/budget_management_layout_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/screens/budget_management_layout_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..20889a2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/screens/budget_management_layout_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+// UX-29: the budgets list wraps its allocated / spent line instead of
+// overflowing, and "deactivate" lives in a menu (with the existing
+// confirmation) instead of an unlabelled gold icon next to "edit".
+import 'dart:io';
+
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+void main() {
+  final src = File('lib/screens/home/budget_management_screen.dart').readAsStringSync();
+
+  test('no bare archive icon button next to edit', () {
+    expect(src.contains('icon: const Icon(Icons.archive_outlined'), isFalse);
+    expect(src.contains("key: const ValueKey('budget_row_menu')"), isTrue);
+  });
+
+  test('the allocated / spent line wraps', () {
+    final i = src.indexOf("context.tr('not_set')");
+    expect(i, greaterThan(0));
+    final before = src.substring(i - 400, i);
+    expect(before.contains('Wrap('), isTrue);
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/screens/help_nafaqah_faq_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/screens/help_nafaqah_faq_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a204dc4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/screens/help_nafaqah_faq_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+// UX-05: the help centre explains Nafaqah and the wife's allowance, and its
+// household answer no longer presents the roommate split to families.
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/screens/settings/help_support_screen.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+import '../support/localized_app.dart';
+
+void main() {
+  testWidgets('a Nafaqah topic with three questions is listed (Arabic)', (tester) async {
+    tester.view.physicalSize = const Size(1080, 2400);
+    tester.view.devicePixelRatio = 2.0;
+    addTearDown(tester.view.reset);
+    await tester.pumpWidget(localizedApp(const HelpSupportScreen(), lang: 'ar', scaffold: false));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+    final topic = find.text('النفقة ومصروف الزوجة');
+    expect(topic, findsOneWidget);
+    await tester.tap(topic);
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('من يتحمل مصاريف البيت؟'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('دفعتُ من مالي للبيت، كيف أستردّه؟'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('ما هو مصروفي الشخصي ومن يحدده؟'), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+
+  test('the Nafaqah answers follow the family rules in every language', () {
+    for (final lang in ['en', 'ar', 'ur']) {
+      final l = AppLocalizations(Locale(lang));
+      for (final key in ['faq_nafaqah_a1', 'faq_nafaqah_a2', 'faq_nafaqah_a3']) {
+        final v = l.get(key);
+        expect(v, isNot(key), reason: '$lang $key missing');
+        expect(v.contains('50/50') || v.contains('%'), isFalse, reason: '$lang $key mentions a split');
+      }
+    }
+  });
+
+  test('the household answer speaks about roommates, not splitting between spouses', () {
+    final ar = AppLocalizations(const Locale('ar'));
+    final en = AppLocalizations(const Locale('en'));
+    final ur = AppLocalizations(const Locale('ur'));
+    expect(ar.get('faq_household_a1'), isNot(contains('الشريك')));
+    expect(ar.get('faq_household_a1'), contains('شركاء السكن'));
+    expect(en.get('faq_household_a1').toLowerCase(), contains('roommate'));
+    expect(ur.get('faq_household_a1'), contains('روم میٹ'));
+    // Families are pointed to the Nafaqah rule: no split between spouses.
+    expect(en.get('faq_household_a1'), contains('never split'));
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/screens/help_support_screen_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/screens/help_support_screen_test.dart
index b9c64de..7cffe5e 100644
--- a/flutter_app/test/screens/help_support_screen_test.dart

@@ -1,6 +1,42 @@
+import 'dart:convert';
+
+import 'package:budget_tracker/screens/settings/help_support_screen.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api/base_api_client.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api/support_api_client.dart';
 import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
 import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
-import 'package:budget_tracker/screens/settings/help_support_screen.dart';
+import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
+import 'package:http/testing.dart';
+
+class _Recorder {
+  final List<http.Request> requests = [];
+  http.Response response = http.Response(jsonEncode({'status': 'sent', 'reference': 'ref42abc'}), 200);
+
+  SupportApiClient client() => SupportApiClient(
+        baseClient: BaseApiClient(
+          client: MockClient((request) async {
+            requests.add(request);
+            return response;
+          }),
+          authTokenProvider: () => 'user-jwt',
+          sessionRefresher: () async => null,
+        ),
+      );
+}
+
+Future<void> _openComposer(WidgetTester tester, _Recorder recorder) async {
+  tester.view.physicalSize = const Size(1080, 2400);
+  tester.view.devicePixelRatio = 2.0;
+  addTearDown(tester.view.reset);
+  await tester.pumpWidget(MaterialApp(
+    home: HelpSupportScreen(householdId: '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', supportClient: recorder.client()),
+  ));

 void main() {
   testWidgets('HelpSupportScreen renders FAQ tab and AI Chat tab', (tester) async {
@@ -17,4 +53,70 @@ void main() {
     // Verify FAQ items appear

   });
+
+  group('Contact developer', () {

+    testWidgets('shows an honest error and the manual fallback when delivery fails', (tester) async {

+      expect(find.textContaining('could not be sent'), findsOneWidget);

+      expect(find.text('Copy Full Diagnostic Info'), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(find.text('Message sent'), findsNothing);

+      expect(find.text('Need help'), findsOneWidget);

+    testWidgets('asks to sign in again when the session is rejected', (tester) async {
+      final recorder = _Recorder()..response = http.Response(jsonEncode({'detail': 'expired'}), 401);
+      await _openComposer(tester, recorder);
+
+      await tester.enterText(find.byKey(const ValueKey('support-inquiry-message')), 'Need help');
+      await tester.tap(find.byKey(const ValueKey('support-inquiry-send')));

+
+      expect(find.textContaining('sign in again'), findsOneWidget);

+    });
+
+    testWidgets('an empty message is not sent', (tester) async {
+      final recorder = _Recorder();
+      await _openComposer(tester, recorder);
+

+      expect(find.text('Please write your message first.'), findsOneWidget);

+  });
 }
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/screens/settings_sections_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/screens/settings_sections_test.dart
new file mode 100644

+++ b/flutter_app/test/screens/settings_sections_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,63 @@
+// UX-15: Settings is grouped into sections; the rarely used ones start
+// collapsed (nothing is removed, only folded away).
+import 'package:budget_tracker/providers/locale_provider.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/providers/theme_provider.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/screens/settings/settings_screen.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/settings/settings_section.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
+import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
+
+void main() {
+  testWidgets('a section shows its title, hides its body until opened', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(const MaterialApp(
+      home: Scaffold(
+        body: SettingsSection(
+          title: 'SECTION',
+          subtitle: 'Summary line',
+          icon: Icons.tune,
+          children: [Text('Body')],
+        ),
+      ),
+    ));
+    expect(find.text('SECTION'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('Summary line'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('Body'), findsNothing);
+    await tester.tap(find.text('SECTION'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('Body'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(tester.getSize(find.byType(ListTile)).height, greaterThanOrEqualTo(48));
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('settings: permissions and reports are folded; help stays open', (tester) async {
+    SharedPreferences.setMockInitialValues({});
+    tester.view.physicalSize = const Size(1170, 2532);
+    tester.view.devicePixelRatio = 3.0;
+    addTearDown(tester.view.reset);
+    await tester.pumpWidget(MultiProvider(
+      providers: [
+        ChangeNotifierProvider(create: (_) => ThemeProvider()),
+        ChangeNotifierProvider(create: (_) => LocaleProvider()),
+      ],
+      child: const MaterialApp(home: SettingsScreen()),
+    ));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+    expect(find.byType(SettingsSection), findsWidgets);
+    final permissions = find.text('HARDWARE & APP PERMISSIONS');
+    await tester.scrollUntilVisible(permissions, 200, scrollable: find.byType(Scrollable).first);
+    expect(find.text('Camera Access'), findsNothing);
+    await tester.tap(permissions);
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('Camera Access'), findsOneWidget);
+
+    final reports = find.text('REPORTS & OFFLINE QUEUE');
+    await tester.scrollUntilVisible(reports, 200, scrollable: find.byType(Scrollable).first);
+    expect(find.text('Export Monthly Report'), findsNothing);
+
+    final help = find.text('App Guide & Tutorial');
+    await tester.scrollUntilVisible(help, 200, scrollable: find.byType(Scrollable).first);
+    expect(help, findsOneWidget);
+  });
+}

diff --git a/flutter_app/test/screens/tools_screen_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/screens/tools_screen_test.dart
