+import 'dart:async';
+import 'dart:io';
+
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/account.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/screens/tools/tools_screen.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/account_service.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_localizations/flutter_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+class _FakeAccountService extends AccountService {
+  final controller = StreamController<List<Account>>.broadcast();
+
+  @override
+  Stream<List<Account>> streamAccounts(String householdId) => controller.stream;
+
+  @override
+  Future<List<Account>> getAccounts(String householdId) async => [];
+}
+
+void main() {
+  late _FakeAccountService fake;
+  setUp(() {
+    fake = _FakeAccountService();
+    AccountService.instance = fake;
+  });
+  tearDown(() {
+    fake.controller.close();
+    AccountService.instance = AccountService();
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('Tools lists every secondary feature once (R3)', (tester) async {
+    tester.view.physicalSize = const Size(1080, 2600);
+    tester.view.devicePixelRatio = 1.0;
+    addTearDown(tester.view.reset);
+
+    await tester.pumpWidget(const MaterialApp(
+      localizationsDelegates: [AppLocalizationsDelegate()],
+      supportedLocales: [Locale('en'), Locale('ar'), Locale('ur')],
+      locale: Locale('en'),
+      home: ToolsScreen(householdId: 'hh'),
+    ));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+    for (final key in [
+      'tool_affordability',
+      'tool_price_tracker',
+      'tool_smart_basket',
+      'tool_batch_scan',
+      'tool_record_income',
+      'tool_transfer',
+      'tool_accounts',
+    ]) {
+      expect(find.byKey(ValueKey(key)), findsOneWidget, reason: key);
+    }
+    expect(find.text('Can I Afford This?'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('Price Tracker'), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('Tools renders right-to-left in Arabic', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(const MaterialApp(
+      localizationsDelegates: [
+        AppLocalizationsDelegate(),
+        GlobalMaterialLocalizations.delegate,
+        GlobalWidgetsLocalizations.delegate,
+        GlobalCupertinoLocalizations.delegate,
+      ],
+      supportedLocales: [Locale('en'), Locale('ar'), Locale('ur')],
+      locale: Locale('ar'),
+      home: ToolsScreen(householdId: 'hh'),
+    ));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.byKey(const ValueKey('tool_affordability')), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('الأدوات'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.byIcon(Icons.chevron_left_rounded), findsWidgets);
+    expect(tester.takeException(), isNull);
+  });
+
+  test('dashboard keeps one entry per feature (R3)', () {
+    final src = File('lib/screens/home/dashboard_screen.dart').readAsStringSync();
+    expect(src, isNot(contains('SalaryCycleWidget')));
+    expect(src, isNot(contains('GroceryPriceIntelligenceScreen')));
+    expect(src, isNot(contains('AffordabilitySimulatorSheet')));
+    expect(src, isNot(contains('_QuickActionButton')));
+    expect(src, contains('ToolsScreen'));
+    expect(src, contains('minAccounts: 2'));
+    expect(File('lib/widgets/salary_cycle_widget.dart').existsSync(), isFalse);
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/screens/transaction_feed_nafaqah_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/screens/transaction_feed_nafaqah_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5fab54d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/screens/transaction_feed_nafaqah_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,149 @@
+// UX-04 / UX-11 / UX-19: the feed shows who owes whom in a family, groups
+// rows by day, keeps amounts neutral and gives every control a 48 dp target.
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/models.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/nafaqah.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/providers/budget_provider.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/providers/recurring_bills_provider.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/providers/transaction_provider.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/screens/home/transaction_feed_screen.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/theme/app_themes.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/transactions/nafaqah_feed_badge.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
+
+import '../support/localized_app.dart';
+
+class _FakeTransactions extends TransactionProvider {
+  _FakeTransactions(this._rows);
+  final List<Transaction> _rows;
+  @override
+  List<Transaction> get transactions => _rows;
+  @override
+  bool get isLoading => false;
+}
+
+Transaction _tx(String id, double amount, DateTime at, {String? cls, String? spouse, bool settlement = false}) =>
+    Transaction.fromMap({
+      'id': id,
+      'household_id': 'h1',
+      'amount': amount,
+      'currency': 'SAR',
+      'merchant': 'Store $id',
+      'category_code': 'OPEX-GROCERY',
+      'timestamp': at.toIso8601String(),
+      'created_at': at.toIso8601String(),
+      'spent_by': 'both',
+      'nafaqah_class': cls,
+      'nafaqah_spouse_id': spouse,
+      'is_settlement': settlement,
+    });
+
+const _family = NafaqahSummary(
+  mode: 'family_nafaqah',
+  callerRole: 'husband',
+  callerUserId: 'u-husband',
+  husbandId: 'u-husband',
+  wives: [NafaqahWife(id: 'u-wife', displayName: 'سارة')],
+);
+
+void main() {
+  final now = DateTime.now();
+  final today = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day, 10, 30);
+  final yesterday = today.subtract(const Duration(days: 1));
+  final older = today.subtract(const Duration(days: 5));
+
+  Future<void> pumpFeed(WidgetTester tester, List<Transaction> rows,
+      {NafaqahSummary summary = _family, String lang = 'ar'}) async {
+    tester.view.physicalSize = const Size(1170, 2532);
+    tester.view.devicePixelRatio = 3.0;
+    addTearDown(tester.view.reset);
+    await tester.pumpWidget(MultiProvider(
+      providers: [
+        ChangeNotifierProvider<TransactionProvider>(create: (_) => _FakeTransactions(rows)),
+        ChangeNotifierProvider<BudgetProvider>(create: (_) => BudgetProvider()),
+        ChangeNotifierProvider<RecurringBillsProvider>(create: (_) => RecurringBillsProvider()),
+      ],
+      child: localizedApp(
+        TransactionFeedScreen(householdId: 'h1', loadNafaqah: (_) async => summary),
+        lang: lang,
+        scaffold: false,
+      ),
+    ));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+  }
+
+  testWidgets('family: Nafaqah badges replace "shared" on every row', (tester) async {
+    await pumpFeed(tester, [
+      _tx('a', 342.75, today, cls: kWifeReimbursable, spouse: 'u-wife'),
+      _tx('b', 120, today, cls: kWifePersonal, spouse: 'u-wife'),
+      _tx('c', 80, yesterday),
+      _tx('d', 200, older, settlement: true),
+    ]);
+    expect(find.text('مستحق لـسارة'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('من مصروف سارة'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('مصروف البيت'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('تسوية'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('مشترك'), findsNothing);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('rows are grouped under Today / Yesterday / the date', (tester) async {
+    await pumpFeed(tester, [
+      _tx('a', 10, today),
+      _tx('b', 20, yesterday),
+      _tx('c', 30, older),
+    ]);
+    expect(find.text('اليوم'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('أمس'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.byKey(const ValueKey('feed_day_header')), findsNWidgets(3));
+    final todayY = tester.getTopLeft(find.text('اليوم')).dy;
+    final yesterdayY = tester.getTopLeft(find.text('أمس')).dy;
+    expect(todayY, lessThan(yesterdayY));
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('amounts are neutral ink, not alarm red', (tester) async {
+    await pumpFeed(tester, [_tx('a', 342.75, today)]);
+    final amount = tester.widget<Text>(find.text('342.75 ر.س'));
+    expect(amount.style?.color, AppThemes.brandLightText);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('export lives in the overflow menu; the sort control is 48 dp tall', (tester) async {
+    await pumpFeed(tester, [_tx('a', 10, today)]);
+    expect(find.text('تصدير CSV'), findsNothing);
+    final sort = find.byKey(const ValueKey('feed_sort_button'));
+    expect(tester.getSize(sort).height, greaterThanOrEqualTo(48));
+    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const ValueKey('feed_more_menu')));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('تصدير CSV'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('تصدير PDF'), findsOneWidget);
+    await expectLater(tester, meetsGuideline(androidTapTargetGuideline));
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('roommates keep the shared badge and get no Nafaqah wording', (tester) async {
+    await pumpFeed(tester, [_tx('a', 10, today)], summary: const NafaqahSummary(mode: 'not_family'));
+    expect(find.text('مصروف البيت'), findsNothing);
+    expect(find.byKey(const ValueKey('feed_badge_household')), findsNothing);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('family filter: only what is owed to the wife', (tester) async {
+    await pumpFeed(tester, [
+      _tx('a', 342.75, today, cls: kWifeReimbursable, spouse: 'u-wife'),
+      _tx('c', 80, today),
+    ]);
+    await tester.tap(find.byTooltip('تصفية وترتيب'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    final owed = find.text('مستحق لـسارة').last;
+    await tester.ensureVisible(owed);
+    await tester.tap(owed);
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    await tester.tap(find.text('تطبيق التصفية'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('Store a'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('Store c'), findsNothing);
+  });
+
+  test('grouping keeps the order and splits on local days', () {
+    final groups = groupTransactionsByDay([_tx('a', 1, today), _tx('b', 1, today), _tx('c', 1, older)]);
+    expect(groups.map((g) => g.transactions.length), [2, 1]);
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/screens/ui_light_mode_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/screens/ui_light_mode_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..14e2f16
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/screens/ui_light_mode_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,44 @@
+// Light-mode regressions: text that was hardcoded white rendered invisibly on
+// the light canvas/cards.
+import 'package:budget_tracker/screens/auth/forgot_password_screen.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/theme/app_themes.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+void main() {
+  testWidgets('forgot-password verification step is readable in light mode', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(MaterialApp(
+      theme: AppThemes.lightTheme,
+      home: ForgotPasswordScreen(
+        initialEmail: 'user@example.com',
+        onSendResetCode: (_) async {},
+        onVerifyAndResetPassword: (_, __, ___) async {},
+      ),
+    ));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    await tester.tap(find.text('Send Reset Code'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+    final title = tester.widget<Text>(find.text('Enter Verification Code'));
+    expect(title.style?.color, AppThemes.brandLightText);
+    expect(title.style?.color, isNot(Colors.white));
+  });
+
+  test('light-mode text tokens meet WCAG AA (4.5:1) on the light canvas', () {
+    double contrast(Color a, Color b) {
+      final la = a.computeLuminance();
+      final lb = b.computeLuminance();
+      final hi = la > lb ? la : lb;
+      final lo = la > lb ? lb : la;
+      return (hi + 0.05) / (lo + 0.05);
+    }
+
+    for (final bg in [AppThemes.brandLightBg, AppThemes.brandLightCard]) {
+      expect(contrast(AppThemes.accentTextLight, bg), greaterThanOrEqualTo(4.5));
+      expect(contrast(AppThemes.successTextLight, bg), greaterThanOrEqualTo(4.5));
+      // The raw brand colours are what the tokens replace for text:
+      expect(contrast(AppThemes.electricTeal, bg), lessThan(3));
+      expect(contrast(AppThemes.success, bg), lessThan(3));
+    }
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/screens/ui_rtl_locale_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/screens/ui_rtl_locale_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..dc00f7d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/screens/ui_rtl_locale_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,87 @@
+// Renders key screens under the Arabic (primary, RTL), Urdu (RTL) and English
+// locales and checks direction, translated text and absence of English UI text.
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/screens/auth/login_screen.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/settings/payday_settings_card.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_localizations/flutter_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+Widget _localized(Widget home, String lang) => MaterialApp(
+      locale: Locale(lang),
+      supportedLocales: const [Locale('en'), Locale('ar'), Locale('ur')],
+      localizationsDelegates: const [
+        AppLocalizationsDelegate(),
+        GlobalMaterialLocalizations.delegate,
+        GlobalWidgetsLocalizations.delegate,
+        GlobalCupertinoLocalizations.delegate,
+      ],
+      home: home,
+    );
+
+void main() {
+  testWidgets('login screen is RTL and fully Arabic in ar', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_localized(const LoginScreen(), 'ar'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+    final ctx = tester.element(find.byType(LoginScreen));
+    expect(Directionality.of(ctx), TextDirection.rtl);
+    expect(find.text('تسجيل الدخول'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('نسيت كلمة المرور؟'), findsOneWidget);
+    for (final english in ['Sign In', 'Welcome back', 'Forgot password?', 'Password']) {
+      expect(find.text(english), findsNothing, reason: english);
+    }
+    // "Forgot password?" sits at the logical end (left edge in RTL).
+    final forgot = tester.getRect(find.text('نسيت كلمة المرور؟'));
+    final signIn = tester.getRect(find.text('تسجيل الدخول'));
+    expect(forgot.center.dx, lessThan(signIn.center.dx));
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('login screen is RTL and Urdu in ur', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_localized(const LoginScreen(), 'ur'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+    final ctx = tester.element(find.byType(LoginScreen));
+    expect(Directionality.of(ctx), TextDirection.rtl);
+    expect(find.text('سائن ان'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('Sign In'), findsNothing);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('login screen stays LTR English in en', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_localized(const LoginScreen(), 'en'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+    final ctx = tester.element(find.byType(LoginScreen));
+    expect(Directionality.of(ctx), TextDirection.ltr);
+    expect(find.text('Sign In'), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('payday settings uses plain day numbers (no English ordinals) in ar', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_localized(
+      Scaffold(
+        body: SingleChildScrollView(
+          child: PaydaySettingsCard(initialPayday: 27, onSavePayday: (_) async => true),
+        ),
+      ),
+      'ar',
+    ));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+    expect(find.text('يوم 27 من الشهر'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.textContaining('27th'), findsNothing);
+    expect(find.text('يوم الراتب ودورة الراتب'), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('login screen survives 2x text scale on a 360dp phone', (tester) async {
+    tester.view.physicalSize = const Size(360 * 3, 740 * 3);
+    tester.view.devicePixelRatio = 3;
+    addTearDown(tester.view.reset);
+
+    await tester.pumpWidget(MediaQuery(
+      data: const MediaQueryData(size: Size(360, 740), textScaler: TextScaler.linear(2)),
+      child: _localized(const LoginScreen(), 'ar'),
+    ));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(tester.takeException(), isNull);
+  });
+}

+  test('Non-object JSON success bodies do not throw', () async {

+
+  group('Optional X-Signature (WEBHOOK_SECRET)', () {
+    test('without a webhook secret requests are sent unsigned (JWT only)', () async {
+      final seen = <http.Request>[];
+      final mockClient = MockClient((request) async {
+        seen.add(request);
+        return http.Response('{"status": "ok"}', 200);
+      });
+      final client = BaseApiClient(client: mockClient, authTokenProvider: () => 'jwt', signingSecret: '');
+
+      await client.post('/agent/chat-transaction', {'message': 'x'});
+      await client.put('/budgets/x', body: {'a': 1}, shouldSign: true);
+
+      expect(seen.map((r) => r.headers.containsKey('X-Signature')), everyElement(isFalse));
+      expect(seen.map((r) => r.headers['Authorization']), everyElement('Bearer jwt'));
+    });
+
+    test('with a webhook secret the exact body bytes are signed with HMAC-SHA256', () async {
+      late http.Request seen;
+      final mockClient = MockClient((request) async {
+        seen = request;
+        return http.Response('{"status": "ok"}', 200);
+      });
+      const secret = 'unit-test-signing-key';
+      final client = BaseApiClient(client: mockClient, authTokenProvider: () => 'jwt', signingSecret: secret);
+
+      await client.post('/agent/chat-transaction', {'message': 'قهوة 19', 'household_id': 'h'});
+
+      final expected = Hmac(sha256, utf8.encode(secret)).convert(utf8.encode(seen.body)).toString();
+      expect(seen.headers['X-Signature'], equals('sha256=$expected'));
+      expect(seen.headers['Authorization'], equals('Bearer jwt'));
+    });
+
+    test('shouldSign: false never signs even with a secret', () async {
+      late http.Request seen;
+      final mockClient = MockClient((request) async {
+        seen = request;
+        return http.Response('{"status": "ok"}', 200);
+      });
+      final client = BaseApiClient(client: mockClient, authTokenProvider: () => 'jwt', signingSecret: 'k');
+
+      await client.post('/x', {'a': 1}, shouldSign: false);
+
+      expect(seen.headers.containsKey('X-Signature'), isFalse);
+    });
   });
 }

diff --git a/flutter_app/test/services/client_config_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/services/client_config_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..7b304b3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/services/client_config_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,164 @@
+import 'dart:convert';
+import 'dart:io';
+
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/supabase_config.dart';
+
+String _jwt(Map<String, dynamic> claims) {
+  String seg(Map<String, dynamic> m) => base64Url.encode(utf8.encode(jsonEncode(m))).replaceAll('=', '');
+  return '${seg({'alg': 'HS256', 'typ': 'JWT'})}.${seg(claims)}.signature';
+}
+
+void main() {
+  group('MOB-02 client configuration', () {
+    test('no production URL or key is compiled in as a default', () {
+      final source = File('lib/supabase_config.dart').readAsStringSync();
+      expect(source, isNot(contains('supabase.co')));
+      expect(source, isNot(contains('sb_publishable_')));
+      expect(source, isNot(contains('fmsco.com.sa')));
+      expect(source, isNot(contains("defaultValue: 'http")));
+    });
+
+    test('no static app token or other shared secret is read by the client', () {
+      final libDir = Directory('lib');
+      final offenders = <String>[];
+      for (final f in libDir.listSync(recursive: true).whereType<File>().where((f) => f.path.endsWith('.dart'))) {
+        final text = f.readAsStringSync();
+        if (text.contains("'APP_AUTH_TOKEN'") || text.contains('X-App-Token') || text.contains('SERVICE_ROLE')) {
+          offenders.add(f.path);
+        }
+      }
+      expect(offenders, isEmpty);
+    });
+
+    test('a build without defines fails with every missing flag named', () {
+      final problems = validateClientConfig(
+        supabaseUrl: '',
+        supabaseKey: '',
+        fastapiBaseUrl: '',
+        isRelease: true,
+      );
+      expect(problems.join('\n'), contains('SUPABASE_URL'));
+      expect(problems.join('\n'), contains('SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY'));
+      expect(problems.join('\n'), contains('FASTAPI_BASE_URL'));
+      // WEBHOOK_SECRET is optional: requests are authenticated by the user's JWT.
+      expect(problems.join('\n'), isNot(contains('WEBHOOK_SECRET')));
+    });
+
+    test('a release build without WEBHOOK_SECRET is valid (signing is optional)', () {
+      final problems = validateClientConfig(
+        supabaseUrl: 'https://x.supabase.co',
+        supabaseKey: 'sb_publishable_example',
+        fastapiBaseUrl: 'https://api.example.com',
+        isRelease: true,
+      );
+      expect(problems, isEmpty);
+    });
+
+    test('the client config no longer requires WEBHOOK_SECRET at startup', () {
+      final source = File('lib/supabase_config.dart').readAsStringSync();
+      expect(source, isNot(contains('Missing --dart-define=WEBHOOK_SECRET')));
+    });
+
+    test('ensureValidClientConfig throws for the (empty) test build configuration', () {
+      expect(() => ensureValidClientConfig(isRelease: true), throwsStateError);
+    });
+
+    test('debug builds accept cleartext local endpoints', () {
+      final problems = validateClientConfig(
+        supabaseUrl: 'http://10.0.2.2:54321',
+        supabaseKey: 'sb_publishable_example',
+        fastapiBaseUrl: 'http://10.0.2.2:8000',
+        isRelease: false,
+      );
+      expect(problems, isEmpty);
+    });
+
+    test('release builds reject cleartext endpoints', () {
+      final problems = validateClientConfig(
+        supabaseUrl: 'http://example.supabase.co',
+        supabaseKey: 'sb_publishable_example',
+        fastapiBaseUrl: 'http://api.example.com',
+        isRelease: true,
+      );
+      expect(problems, hasLength(2));
+    });
+
+    test('service-role keys are rejected, publishable/anon keys accepted', () {
+      expect(isPrivilegedSupabaseKey('sb_secret_abc'), isTrue);
+      expect(isPrivilegedSupabaseKey(_jwt({'role': 'service_role', 'iss': 'supabase'})), isTrue);
+      expect(isPrivilegedSupabaseKey(_jwt({'role': 'anon', 'iss': 'supabase'})), isFalse);
+      expect(isPrivilegedSupabaseKey('sb_publishable_abc'), isFalse);
+
+      final problems = validateClientConfig(
+        supabaseUrl: 'https://x.supabase.co',
+        supabaseKey: _jwt({'role': 'service_role'}),
+        fastapiBaseUrl: 'https://api.example.com',
+        isRelease: true,
+      );
+      expect(problems.single, contains('service-role'));
+    });
+  });
+
+  test('MOB-25 / DB-17: the invite code is never selected directly from a table', () {
+    final offenders = <String>[];
+    for (final f in Directory('lib').listSync(recursive: true).whereType<File>().where((f) => f.path.endsWith('.dart'))) {
+      final lines = f.readAsLinesSync();
+      for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
+        if (lines[i].contains('.select(') && lines[i].contains('invite_code')) {
+          offenders.add('${f.path}:${i + 1}');
+        }
+      }
+    }
+    expect(offenders, isEmpty);
+  });
+
+  group('MOB-18 Android hardening', () {
+    final manifest = File('android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml').readAsStringSync();
+
+    test('zero SMS policy: no SMS permissions or receivers', () {
+      expect(manifest, isNot(contains('READ_SMS')));
+      expect(manifest, isNot(contains('RECEIVE_SMS')));
+      expect(manifest, isNot(contains('SMS_RECEIVED')));
+      final pubspec = File('pubspec.yaml').readAsStringSync().toLowerCase();
+      expect(pubspec, isNot(contains('telephony')));
+      expect(pubspec, isNot(contains('sms')));
+    });
+
+    test('zero SMS policy: no SMS reading, parsing or SMS channel in app code', () {
+      // `raw_sms` is the historical name of the transactions audit-note column, not SMS data.
+      final smsCode = RegExp(
+        r"webhook/sms|telephony|SmsMessage|SmsQuery|readSms|sms_advanced|flutter_sms|'sms'|" r'"sms"',
+        caseSensitive: false,
+      );
+      final offenders = <String>[];
+      for (final f in Directory('lib').listSync(recursive: true).whereType<File>()) {
+        if (!f.path.endsWith('.dart')) continue;
+        final lines = f.readAsLinesSync();
+        for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
+          if (smsCode.hasMatch(lines[i])) offenders.add('${f.path}:${i + 1}');
+        }
+      }
+      expect(offenders, isEmpty);
+    });
+
+    test('app data (session tokens, offline queue, receipts) is excluded from backups', () {
+      expect(manifest, contains('android:allowBackup="false"'));
+      expect(manifest, contains('android:fullBackupContent="false"'));
+      expect(manifest, contains('android:dataExtractionRules="@xml/data_extraction_rules"'));
+      expect(File('android/app/src/main/res/xml/data_extraction_rules.xml').existsSync(), isTrue);
+    });
+
+    test('cleartext traffic is disabled explicitly', () {
+      expect(manifest, contains('android:usesCleartextTraffic="false"'));
+    });
+
+    test('release builds are not signed with the debug key when a release keystore is configured', () {
+      final gradle = File('android/app/build.gradle.kts').readAsStringSync();
+      expect(gradle, contains('key.properties'));
+      expect(gradle, contains('create("release")'));
+      expect(gradle, contains('signingConfigs.getByName("release")'));
+      expect(gradle, isNot(contains('TODO')));
+    });
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/services/household_invite_share_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/services/household_invite_share_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1207f92
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/services/household_invite_share_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,70 @@
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/household_invite_share.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+void main() {
+  group('household invite share text', () {
+    test('contains the household name, the code and the join steps in each language', () {
+      for (final lang in ['en', 'ar', 'ur']) {
+        final l = AppLocalizations(Locale(lang));
+        final text = inviteShareText(l, householdName: 'Villa 7', code: 'ABCD1234');
+        expect(text, contains('Villa 7'), reason: lang);
+        expect(text, contains('ABCD1234'), reason: lang);
+        expect(text, contains(l.get('join_household')), reason: '$lang names the Join household step');
+        expect(text, isNot(contains('{')), reason: '$lang placeholders filled');
+      }
+      expect(
+        inviteShareText(AppLocalizations(const Locale('en')), householdName: 'Villa 7', code: 'ABCD1234'),
+        contains('Open Budget Tracker'),
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('a role invite names the role, the household, the code and the steps', () {
+      for (final lang in ['en', 'ar', 'ur']) {
+        final l = AppLocalizations(Locale(lang));
+        for (final role in ['spouse', 'peer', 'family_member']) {
+          final text = roleInviteShareText(l, householdName: 'Villa 7', code: 'ABCD1234', role: role);
+          expect(text, contains('Villa 7'), reason: '$lang $role');
+          expect(text, contains('ABCD1234'), reason: '$lang $role');
+          expect(text, contains(roleInviteLabel(l, role)), reason: '$lang $role');
+          expect(text, contains(l.get('join_household')), reason: '$lang $role');
+          expect(text, isNot(contains('{')), reason: '$lang $role');
+        }
+      }
+      expect(roleInviteLabel(AppLocalizations(const Locale('ar')), 'spouse'), 'الزوجة');
+    });
+
+    test('a blank household name falls back to a generic one', () {
+      final l = AppLocalizations(const Locale('en'));
+      expect(inviteShareText(l, householdName: '  ', code: 'ABCD1234'), contains(l.get('set_my_household')));
+    });
+
+    test('only real 8-16 character codes are shareable', () {
+      expect(isShareableInviteCode('ABCD1234'), isTrue);
+      expect(isShareableInviteCode('ABCDEFGH12345678'), isTrue);
+      expect(isShareableInviteCode('--------'), isFalse);
+      expect(isShareableInviteCode('ABC'), isFalse);
+      expect(isShareableInviteCode('ABCDEFGH123456789'), isFalse);
+      expect(isShareableInviteCode(null), isFalse);
+    });
+
+    test('shareHouseholdInvite hands text and subject to the share sheet', () async {
+      final l = AppLocalizations(const Locale('ar'));
+      String? sharedText;
+      String? sharedSubject;
+      await shareHouseholdInvite(
+        l,
+        householdName: 'بيتنا',
+        code: 'ZXCV5678',
+        launcher: (text, subject) async {
+          sharedText = text;
+          sharedSubject = subject;
+        },
+      );
+      expect(sharedText, contains('ZXCV5678'));
+      expect(sharedText, contains('بيتنا'));
+      expect(sharedSubject, l.get('invite_share_subject'));
+    });
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/services/household_join_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/services/household_join_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..37c52f0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/services/household_join_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,43 @@
+// Join/claim refusals keep the server's reason (FABLE-DB-01: an existing
+// member cannot take an invite of their own household).
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/household_join.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+void main() {
+  test('checkHouseholdJoinResult returns the household or throws the refusal', () {
+    expect(checkHouseholdJoinResult({'id': 'hh', 'name': 'Home', 'success': true})['id'], 'hh');
+
+    expect(
+      () => checkHouseholdJoinResult({
+        'success': false,
+        'error': 'You are already a member of this household',
+        'code': 'already_member',
+      }),
+      throwsA(isA<HouseholdJoinException>()
+          .having((e) => e.code, 'code', 'already_member')
+          .having((e) => e.isAlreadyMember, 'isAlreadyMember', isTrue)
+          .having((e) => e.message, 'message', 'You are already a member of this household')),
+    );
+    expect(
+      () => checkHouseholdJoinResult({'success': false, 'error': 'Invite code has expired'}),
+      throwsA(isA<HouseholdJoinException>().having((e) => e.isAlreadyMember, 'isAlreadyMember', isFalse)),
+    );
+    expect(() => checkHouseholdJoinResult(null), throwsA(isA<HouseholdJoinException>()));
+  });
+
+  test('checkInviteClaimResponse throws only for a 400 refusal', () {
+    expect(
+      () => checkInviteClaimResponse({
+        'status': 'error',
+        'status_code': 400,
+        'detail': 'You are already a member of this household',
+        'message': 'You are already a member of this household',
+      }),
+      throwsA(isA<HouseholdJoinException>().having((e) => e.isAlreadyMember, 'isAlreadyMember', isTrue)),
+    );
+    // Network failures and server errors fall through to the join call.
+    checkInviteClaimResponse({'status': 'error', 'message': 'offline', 'network_error': true});
+    checkInviteClaimResponse({'status': 'error', 'status_code': 500, 'message': 'boom'});
+    checkInviteClaimResponse({'status': 'success'});
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/services/household_permissions_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/services/household_permissions_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..936c65a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/services/household_permissions_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,120 @@
+// Client mirror of the household permission rules (DB-16 / DB-18).
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/account.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/models.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api/household_roles_api_client.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/household_permissions.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
+
+Account _account(String id, String owner, {bool pool = false}) => Account(
+      id: id,
+      householdId: 'hh',
+      ownerUserId: owner,
+      name: id,
+      accountType: pool ? AccountType.sharedPool : AccountType.bank,
+      balance: 100,
+      isSharedPool: pool,
+    );
+
+void main() {
+  group('canModifyTransaction', () {
+    test('a member edits only their own transactions', () {
+      expect(HouseholdPermissions.canModifyTransaction(currentUserId: 'm', creatorUserId: 'm', isAdmin: false), isTrue);
+      expect(HouseholdPermissions.canModifyTransaction(currentUserId: 'm', creatorUserId: 'p', isAdmin: false), isFalse);
+    });
+
+    test('legacy rows without a creator are admin-only', () {
+      expect(HouseholdPermissions.canModifyTransaction(currentUserId: 'm', creatorUserId: null, isAdmin: false), isFalse);
+      expect(HouseholdPermissions.canModifyTransaction(currentUserId: 'a', creatorUserId: null, isAdmin: true), isTrue);
+    });
+
+    test('admins (primary or co-admin) edit any transaction; signed-out users none', () {
+      expect(HouseholdPermissions.canModifyTransaction(currentUserId: 'a', creatorUserId: 'm', isAdmin: true), isTrue);
+      expect(HouseholdPermissions.canModifyTransaction(currentUserId: null, creatorUserId: 'm', isAdmin: true), isFalse);
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('shared pool withdrawals', () {
+    final accounts = [
+      _account('pool', 'p', pool: true),
+      _account('mine', 'm'),
+      _account('mine2', 'm'),
+    ];
+
+    test('members withdraw from their own accounts only, never from a pool', () {
+      final ids = HouseholdPermissions.withdrawableAccounts(accounts, currentUserId: 'm', isAdmin: false).map((a) => a.id);
+      expect(ids, ['mine', 'mine2']);
+    });
+
+    test('admins may also move pool money', () {
+      final ids = HouseholdPermissions.withdrawableAccounts(accounts, currentUserId: 'p', isAdmin: true).map((a) => a.id);
+      expect(ids, ['pool']);
+    });
+
+    test('an account typed shared_pool counts as a pool', () {
+      const typed = Account(
+        id: 'typed',
+        householdId: 'hh',
+        ownerUserId: 'm',
+        name: 'typed',
+        accountType: AccountType.sharedPool,
+      );
+      expect(HouseholdPermissions.canWithdrawFrom(typed, currentUserId: 'm', isAdmin: false), isFalse);
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('isPermissionDenied', () {
+    test('recognises PostgREST 42501 and API 403', () {
+      expect(HouseholdPermissions.isPermissionDenied(const PostgrestException(message: 'Forbidden: x', code: '42501')), isTrue);
+      expect(HouseholdPermissions.isPermissionDenied(const HouseholdRolesApiException('forbidden', 'no', statusCode: 403)), isTrue);
+    });
+
+    test('other failures are not permission refusals', () {
+      expect(HouseholdPermissions.isPermissionDenied(const PostgrestException(message: 'timeout', code: '57014')), isFalse);
+      expect(HouseholdPermissions.isPermissionDenied(Exception('network')), isFalse);
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('models', () {
+    test('Transaction keeps its creator through fromMap / toMap / copyWith', () {
+      final tx = Transaction.fromMap({
+        'id': 't1',
+        'household_id': 'hh',
+        'user_id': 'm',
+        'amount': 10,
+        'timestamp': '2026-10-20T10:00:00Z',
+        'created_at': '2026-10-20T10:00:00Z',
+      });
+      expect(tx.userId, 'm');
+      expect(tx.toMap()['user_id'], 'm');
+      expect(tx.copyWith(amount: 12).userId, 'm');
+    });
+
+    test('HouseholdMembership reads is_primary', () {
+      final m = HouseholdMembership.fromMap({'household_id': 'hh', 'role': 'admin', 'is_primary': true});
+      expect(m.isAdmin, isTrue);
+      expect(m.isPrimary, isTrue);
+    });
+
+    test('HouseholdRoster exposes only the actions the server accepts', () {
+      const primary = HouseholdMember(userId: 'p', role: 'admin', isPrimary: true);
+      const co = HouseholdMember(userId: 'c', role: 'admin', isSelf: true);
+      const member = HouseholdMember(userId: 'm');
+
+      const coAdminView = HouseholdRoster(householdId: 'hh', canManageAdmins: true);
+      expect(coAdminView.canRevoke(primary), isFalse);
+      expect(coAdminView.canMakePrimary(member), isFalse);
+      expect(coAdminView.canPromote(member), isTrue);
+      expect(coAdminView.canRevoke(co), isTrue);
+
+      const primaryView = HouseholdRoster(householdId: 'hh', canManageAdmins: true, canTransferPrimary: true);
+      expect(primaryView.canMakePrimary(member), isTrue);
+      expect(primaryView.canMakePrimary(co), isFalse, reason: 'not to oneself');
+      expect(primaryView.canMakePrimary(primary), isFalse);
+
+      const memberView = HouseholdRoster(householdId: 'hh');
+      expect(memberView.canPromote(member), isFalse);
+      expect(memberView.canRevoke(co), isFalse);
+    });
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/services/household_resolver_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/services/household_resolver_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..af4b5cb
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/services/household_resolver_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,37 @@
+import 'dart:io';
+
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
+
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/household_resolver.dart';
+
+void main() {
+  setUp(() => SharedPreferences.setMockInitialValues({}));
+
+  test('caches the server answer per user', () async {
+    final resolver = HouseholdResolver(fetchRemote: (_) async => 'h-1');
+    expect(await resolver.resolve('u-1'), 'h-1');
+    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
+    expect(prefs.getString(HouseholdResolver.cacheKeyFor('u-1')), 'h-1');
+  });
+
+  test('falls back to the cached household when offline', () async {
+    SharedPreferences.setMockInitialValues({HouseholdResolver.cacheKeyFor('u-1'): 'h-1'});
+    final resolver = HouseholdResolver(fetchRemote: (_) async => throw const SocketException('offline'));
+    expect(await resolver.resolve('u-1'), 'h-1');
+  });
+
+  test('never uses another user\'s cached household', () async {
+    SharedPreferences.setMockInitialValues({HouseholdResolver.cacheKeyFor('u-1'): 'h-1'});
+    final resolver = HouseholdResolver(fetchRemote: (_) async => throw const SocketException('offline'));
+    expect(() => resolver.resolve('u-2'), throwsA(isA<SocketException>()));
+  });
+
+  test('a confirmed "no household" clears the cache (left household)', () async {
+    SharedPreferences.setMockInitialValues({HouseholdResolver.cacheKeyFor('u-1'): 'h-1'});
+    final resolver = HouseholdResolver(fetchRemote: (_) async => null);
+    expect(await resolver.resolve('u-1'), isNull);
+    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
+    expect(prefs.getString(HouseholdResolver.cacheKeyFor('u-1')), isNull);
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/services/household_setting_saver_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/services/household_setting_saver_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..208ab7d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/services/household_setting_saver_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,103 @@
+// MOB-27: a household setting (payday, income, rollover) must only change
+// locally after the server confirmed it; a rejection must surface as a failure.
+import 'dart:io';
+
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/household_setting_saver.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/settings/payday_settings_card.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+void main() {
+  group('saveHouseholdSetting', () {
+    test('applies the value locally after the server confirmed it', () async {
+      int? local;
+      String? sentFor;
+      await saveHouseholdSetting<int>(
+        householdId: 'h1',
+        value: 25,
+        saveRemote: (hid, day) async {
+          sentFor = hid;
+          return true;
+        },
+        applyLocal: (day) async => local = day,
+      );
+      expect(sentFor, 'h1');
+      expect(local, 25);
+    });
+
+    test('a server rejection throws and leaves the local value untouched', () async {
+      int? local;
+      await expectLater(
+        saveHouseholdSetting<int>(
+          householdId: 'h1',
+          value: 25,
+          saveRemote: (_, __) async => false,
+          applyLocal: (day) async => local = day,
+        ),
+        throwsA(isA<HouseholdSettingNotSavedException>()),
+      );
+      expect(local, isNull);
+    });
+
+    test('a network error propagates and leaves the local value untouched', () async {
+      int? local;
+      await expectLater(
+        saveHouseholdSetting<int>(
+          householdId: 'h1',
+          value: 25,
+          saveRemote: (_, __) async => throw const SocketException('offline'),
+          applyLocal: (day) async => local = day,
+        ),
+        throwsA(isA<SocketException>()),
+      );
+      expect(local, isNull);
+    });
+
+    test('without a household nothing is saved', () async {
+      var remoteCalled = false;
+      await expectLater(
+        saveHouseholdSetting<int>(
+          householdId: null,
+          value: 25,
+          saveRemote: (_, __) async => remoteCalled = true,
+          applyLocal: (_) async {},
+        ),
+        throwsA(isA<HouseholdSettingNotSavedException>()),
+      );
+      expect(remoteCalled, isFalse);
+    });
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('PaydaySettingsCard reverts to the payday in effect when the save is rejected', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(
+      MaterialApp(
+        home: Scaffold(
+          body: SingleChildScrollView(
+            child: PaydaySettingsCard(initialPayday: 27, onSavePayday: (_) async => false),
+          ),
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+    await tester.tap(find.text('1st (Calendar Month)'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('1st of month'), findsOneWidget);
+
+    await tester.tap(find.widgetWithText(ElevatedButton, 'Save Payday'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+    expect(find.text('27th of month'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('Payday Saved'), findsNothing, reason: 'no success toast on failure');
+  });
+
+  test('settings screen saves payday/income/rollover server-first', () {
+    final src = File('lib/screens/settings/settings_screen.dart').readAsStringSync();
+    for (final setting in ['saveHouseholdSetting<int>', 'saveHouseholdSetting<double>', 'saveHouseholdSetting<String>']) {
+      expect(src, contains(setting));
+    }
+    // The old code wrote the cache before the server call.
+    final savePayday = src.substring(src.indexOf('Future<bool> _savePayday'), src.indexOf('Future<bool> _saveIncome'));
+    expect(savePayday.indexOf('setState(() => _paydayDay'), greaterThan(savePayday.indexOf('saveHouseholdSetting')));
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/services/household_type_and_roles_api_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/services/household_type_and_roles_api_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..cbbad7c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/services/household_type_and_roles_api_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,225 @@
+// Household type (chosen at creation, changed by an admin) and members'
+// financial roles: the app side of the owner decisions, against the backend
+// contract (create_household_and_claim(p_name, p_household_type),
+// PUT /households/{id}/type, PUT .../members/{user_id}/financial-role).
+import 'dart:convert';
+
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/household_membership.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/nafaqah.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api/base_api_client.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api/household_roles_api_client.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/household_join.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/nafaqah_write_errors.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
+import 'package:http/testing.dart';
+import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart' show PostgrestException;
+
+void main() {
+  group('createHouseholdAndClaim', () {
+    test('sends the chosen type', () async {
+      final calls = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
+      final hh = await createHouseholdAndClaim(
+        name: 'Home',
+        householdType: kHouseholdTypeRoommates,
+        rpc: (fn, params) async {
+          expect(fn, 'create_household_and_claim');
+          calls.add(params);
+          return {'id': 'hh-1', 'name': 'Home', 'invite_code': 'ABCD1234'};
+        },
+      );
+      expect(hh['id'], 'hh-1');
+      expect(calls, [
+        {'p_name': 'Home', 'p_household_type': 'roommates'},
+      ]);
+    });
+
+    test('an older database without p_household_type is called again without it', () async {
+      final calls = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
+      final hh = await createHouseholdAndClaim(
+        name: 'Home',
+        householdType: kHouseholdTypeFamily,
+        rpc: (fn, params) async {
+          calls.add(params);
+          if (params.containsKey('p_household_type')) {
+            throw const PostgrestException(
+              message: 'Could not find the function public.create_household_and_claim(p_household_type, p_name) in the schema cache',
+              code: 'PGRST202',
+            );
+          }
+          return {'id': 'hh-2', 'name': 'Home'};
+        },
+      );
+      expect(hh['id'], 'hh-2');
+      expect(calls.last, {'p_name': 'Home'});
+    });
+
+    test('other refusals are not retried', () async {
+      var count = 0;
+      await expectLater(
+        createHouseholdAndClaim(
+          name: 'Home',
+          householdType: kHouseholdTypeFamily,
+          rpc: (fn, params) async {
+            count++;
+            throw const PostgrestException(message: 'permission denied', code: '42501');
+          },
+        ),
+        throwsA(isA<PostgrestException>()),
+      );
+      expect(count, 1);
+    });
+
+    test('a role mismatch from the join/claim RPCs is recognised', () {
+      expect(
+        () => checkHouseholdJoinResult({'success': false, 'error': 'x', 'code': 'invite_role_mismatch'}),
+        throwsA(isA<HouseholdJoinException>().having((e) => e.isRoleMismatch, 'isRoleMismatch', isTrue)),
+      );
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('roster contract', () {
+    test('parses household_type, permissions and assignable roles', () {
+      final roster = HouseholdRoster.fromMap({
+        'household_id': 'hh',
+        'household_type': 'family',
+        'caller_role': 'admin',
+        'can_change_household_type': true,
+        'can_set_financial_roles': true,
+        'assignable_financial_roles': ['spouse', 'family_member', 'dependent'],
+        'nafaqah_provider_user_id': 'h',
+        'members': [
+          {'user_id': 'h', 'financial_role': 'provider', 'is_nafaqah_provider': true},
+          {'user_id': 's', 'financial_role': 'family_member'},
+        ],
+      });
+      expect(roster.householdType, 'family');
+      expect(roster.mayChangeHouseholdType, isTrue);
+      expect(roster.maySetFinancialRoles, isTrue);
+      expect(roster.financialRoleOptions(roster.members[1]), ['spouse', 'family_member', 'dependent']);
+      expect(roster.financialRoleOptions(roster.members[0]), ['family_member', 'dependent'],
+          reason: 'never offer "wife" for the Nafaqah provider');
+    });
+
+    test('a roommates household offers only roommate; the server flags win', () {
+      final roster = HouseholdRoster.fromMap({
+        'household_id': 'hh',
+        'household_type': 'roommates',
+        'caller_role': 'admin',
+        'can_change_household_type': false,
+        'members': [
+          {'user_id': 'a', 'financial_role': 'peer'},
+        ],
+      });
+      expect(roster.financialRoleOptions(roster.members.single), ['peer']);
+      expect(roster.mayChangeHouseholdType, isFalse);
+      expect(roster.maySetFinancialRoles, isTrue, reason: 'not sent: admins');
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('HouseholdRolesApiClient', () {
+    late http.Request last;
+    HouseholdRolesApiClient client(int status, Object body) => HouseholdRolesApiClient(
+          baseClient: BaseApiClient(
+            authTokenProvider: () => 'jwt',
+            client: MockClient((request) async {
+              last = request;
+              return http.Response(jsonEncode(body), status, headers: {'content-type': 'application/json'});
+            }),
+          ),
+        );
+
+    test('PUT /households/{id}/type', () async {
+      final stored = await client(200, {'status': 'success', 'household_id': 'hh', 'household_type': 'roommates'})
+          .setHouseholdType('hh', 'roommates');
+      expect(stored, 'roommates');
+      expect(last.method, 'PUT');
+      expect(last.url.path, '/households/hh/type');
+      expect(jsonDecode(last.body), {'household_type': 'roommates'});
+    });
+
+    test('a blocked type change carries the server code and message', () async {
+      await expectLater(
+        client(409, {
+          'detail': {'code': 'type_change_blocked', 'message': 'A wife is a member: remove her first.'},
+        }).setHouseholdType('hh', 'roommates'),
+        throwsA(isA<HouseholdRolesApiException>()
+            .having((e) => e.code, 'code', 'type_change_blocked')
+            .having((e) => e.serverMessage, 'serverMessage', 'A wife is a member: remove her first.')),
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('PUT .../members/{user_id}/financial-role', () async {
+      final stored = await client(200, {
+        'status': 'success',
+        'household_id': 'hh',
+        'user_id': 'u1',
+        'financial_role': 'dependent',
+      }).setFinancialRole('hh', 'u1', 'dependent');
+      expect(stored, 'dependent');
+      expect(last.url.path, '/households/hh/members/u1/financial-role');
+      expect(jsonDecode(last.body), {'financial_role': 'dependent'});
+    });
+
+    test('financial role refusals map to codes', () async {
+      Future<String> codeOf(int status, Object body) async {
+        try {
+          await client(status, body).setFinancialRole('hh', 'u1', 'spouse');
+        } on HouseholdRolesApiException catch (e) {
+          return e.code;
+        }
+        return 'none';
+      }
+
+      expect(await codeOf(403, {'detail': 'Not an admin'}), 'forbidden');
+      expect(await codeOf(404, {'detail': 'Not a member'}), 'not_found');
+      expect(await codeOf(422, {'detail': {'code': 'financial_role_not_allowed'}}), 'invalid');
+      expect(await codeOf(409, {'detail': {'code': 'provider_is_spouse'}}), 'provider_is_spouse');
+      expect(await codeOf(409, {'detail': {'code': 'spouse_has_ledger'}}), 'spouse_has_ledger');
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('classification refusals use the implemented codes', () {
+    test('API 403 nafaqah_classification_forbidden and PostgREST hint nafaqah_class_not_allowed', () {
+      expect(
+        nafaqahWriteRefusalOf({
+          'status': 'error',
+          'status_code': 403,
+          'detail': {'code': 'nafaqah_classification_forbidden', 'message': 'x'},
+        }),
+        NafaqahWriteRefusal.notClassifier,
+      );
+      expect(
+        nafaqahWriteRefusalOf(const PostgrestException(message: 'x', code: '42501', hint: 'nafaqah_class_not_allowed')),
+        NafaqahWriteRefusal.notClassifier,
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('an installment refused by the ledger guard (ApiRequestException 409)', () {
+      expect(
+        nafaqahWriteRefusalOf(const ApiRequestException('x', statusCode: 409, code: 'ledger_would_be_overpaid')),
+        NafaqahWriteRefusal.ledgerWouldBeOverpaid,
+      );
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('oversized receipt photos (413) are explained', (tester) async {
+      String? text;
+      await tester.pumpWidget(Localizations(
+        locale: const Locale('en'),
+        delegates: const [AppLocalizationsDelegate(), DefaultWidgetsLocalizations.delegate],
+        child: Builder(builder: (context) {
+          text = expenseApiErrorText(context, {'status': 'error', 'status_code': 413, 'message': 'Payload Too Large'});
+          return const SizedBox();
+        }),
+      ));
+      await tester.pump();
+      expect(text, contains('12 MP'));
+    });
+  });
+
+  test('the Nafaqah summary carries household_type', () {
+    expect(NafaqahSummary.fromMap({'mode': 'not_family', 'household_type': 'roommates'}).householdType, 'roommates');
+  });
+}

diff --git a/flutter_app/test/services/nafaqah_api_client_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/services/nafaqah_api_client_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..e256fc4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/services/nafaqah_api_client_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,117 @@
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/nafaqah.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api/base_api_client.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api/nafaqah_api_client.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+class _FakeBase extends BaseApiClient {
+  Map<String, dynamic> response = {};
+  String? method;
+  String? path;
+  Map<String, dynamic>? body;
+  Map<String, dynamic>? query;
+
+  @override
+  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> get(String path, {Map<String, dynamic>? queryParams, Duration timeout = const Duration(seconds: 15)}) async {
+    method = 'GET';
+    this.path = path;
+    query = queryParams;
+    return response;
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> post(String path, Map<String, dynamic> body,
+      {bool shouldSign = true, Duration timeout = const Duration(seconds: 20), Map<String, String>? extraHeaders}) async {
+    method = 'POST';
+    this.path = path;
+    this.body = body;
+    return response;
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> put(String path,
+      {Map<String, dynamic>? body, bool shouldSign = false, Duration timeout = const Duration(seconds: 15)}) async {
+    method = 'PUT';
+    this.path = path;
+    this.body = body;
+    return response;
+  }
+}
+
+void main() {
+  test('fetchSummary hits the household Nafaqah summary', () async {
+    final base = _FakeBase()..response = {'mode': 'family_nafaqah', 'wives': [{'id': 'w'}]};
+    final s = await NafaqahApiClient(baseClient: base).fetchSummary(householdId: 'hh', cycleKey: '2026-11');
+    expect(base.path, '/households/hh/nafaqah');
+    expect(base.query, {'cycle_key': '2026-11'});
+    expect(s.isFamily, isTrue);
+  });
+
+  test('recordReimbursement posts a 2-decimal amount and returns the new balance', () async {
+    final base = _FakeBase()..response = {'status': 'success', 'outstanding_after': 300.5};
+    final after = await NafaqahApiClient(baseClient: base)
+        .recordReimbursement(householdId: 'hh', amount: 200, paymentMethod: 'cash', wifeUserId: 'w');
+    expect(base.method, 'POST');
+    expect(base.path, '/households/hh/nafaqah/reimbursements');
+    expect(base.body, {'amount': 200.0, 'payment_method': 'cash', 'wife_user_id': 'w'});
+    expect(after, 300.5);
+  });
+
+  test('a rejected reimbursement throws instead of looking recorded', () async {
+    final base = _FakeBase()
+      ..response = {'status': 'error', 'status_code': 409, 'detail': {'code': 'overpayment'}};
+    expect(
+      () => NafaqahApiClient(baseClient: base).recordReimbursement(householdId: 'hh', amount: 999, paymentMethod: 'cash'),
+      throwsA(isA<NafaqahApiException>().having((e) => e.code, 'code', 'overpayment')),
+    );
+  });
+
+  test('setAllowance PUTs the cycle amount', () async {
+    final base = _FakeBase()
+      ..response = {'cycle_key': '2026-11', 'is_set': true, 'allocated': 1500, 'spent': 1700, 'remaining': -200};
+    final st = await NafaqahApiClient(baseClient: base)
+        .setAllowance(householdId: 'hh', amount: 1500, wifeUserId: 'w', cycleKey: '2026-11');
+    expect(base.method, 'PUT');
+    expect(base.path, '/households/hh/nafaqah/allowance');
+    expect(base.body, {'amount': 1500.0, 'wife_user_id': 'w', 'cycle_key': '2026-11'});
+    expect(st.remaining, -200);
+    expect(st.isOverspent, isTrue);
+  });
+
+  test('setProvider PUTs the chosen member and returns the new summary', () async {
+    final base = _FakeBase()
+      ..response = {
+        'status': 'success',
+        'provider_user_id': 'u2',
+        'previous_provider_user_id': 'u1',
+        'summary': {'mode': 'family_nafaqah', 'husband': {'id': 'u2'}, 'wives': [{'id': 'w'}]},
+      };
+    final change = await NafaqahApiClient(baseClient: base).setProvider(householdId: 'hh', userId: 'u2');
+    expect(base.method, 'PUT');
+    expect(base.path, '/households/hh/nafaqah/provider');
+    expect(base.body, {'user_id': 'u2'});
+    expect(change.providerUserId, 'u2');
+    expect(change.summary!.husbandId, 'u2');
+  });
+
+  test('a refused provider change throws (403 forbidden, 422 invalid)', () async {
+    final base = _FakeBase()..response = {'status': 'error', 'status_code': 403, 'message': 'Household admin required'};
+    final client = NafaqahApiClient(baseClient: base);
+    await expectLater(
+      client.setProvider(householdId: 'hh', userId: 'u2'),
+      throwsA(isA<NafaqahApiException>().having((e) => e.code, 'code', 'forbidden')),
+    );
+    base.response = {'status': 'error', 'status_code': 422, 'message': 'A wife cannot be the Nafaqah provider.'};
+    await expectLater(
+      client.setProvider(householdId: 'hh', userId: 'w'),
+      throwsA(isA<NafaqahApiException>().having((e) => e.code, 'code', 'invalid')),
+    );
+  });
+
+  test('fetchLedger forwards the wife id', () async {
+    final base = _FakeBase()..response = {'balance': {'outstanding': 1}, 'history': []};
+    final l = await NafaqahApiClient(baseClient: base).fetchLedger(householdId: 'hh', wifeUserId: 'w');
+    expect(base.path, '/households/hh/nafaqah/reimbursements');
+    expect(base.query, {'wife_user_id': 'w'});
+    expect(l.balance.outstanding, 1);
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/services/nafaqah_write_errors_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/services/nafaqah_write_errors_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a353c12
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/services/nafaqah_write_errors_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,186 @@
+// FABLE-LOGIC-02 / -04: the app explains a transaction write the database or
+// API refused for a Nafaqah rule instead of a raw error.
+import 'dart:convert';
+
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api/base_api_client.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api/chat_api_client.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api/receipt_api_client.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/sync_worker.dart' show SyncWorker;
+import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
+import 'package:http/testing.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/nafaqah.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/nafaqah_write_errors.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart' show PostgrestException;
+
+void main() {
+  group('nafaqahWriteRefusalOf', () {
+    test('the ledger guard (PostgREST 22023 + hint, or its message)', () {
+      expect(
+        nafaqahWriteRefusalOf(const PostgrestException(
+          message: 'Nafaqah ledger overpaid: advances 100.00 < repayments 200.00',
+          code: '22023',
+          hint: 'ledger_would_be_overpaid',
+        )),
+        NafaqahWriteRefusal.ledgerWouldBeOverpaid,
+      );
+      expect(
+        nafaqahWriteRefusalOf(const PostgrestException(message: 'Nafaqah ledger overpaid', code: '22023')),
+        NafaqahWriteRefusal.ledgerWouldBeOverpaid,
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('the missing provider (PostgREST 23514 + hint)', () {
+      expect(
+        nafaqahWriteRefusalOf(const PostgrestException(
+          message: 'This family has no Nafaqah provider',
+          code: '23514',
+          hint: 'no_nafaqah_provider',
+        )),
+        NafaqahWriteRefusal.noProvider,
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('API 409 codes, as an exception or as the client error map', () {
+      expect(
+        nafaqahWriteRefusalOf(const NafaqahApiException('ledger_would_be_overpaid', '', statusCode: 409)),
+        NafaqahWriteRefusal.ledgerWouldBeOverpaid,
+      );
+      expect(
+        nafaqahWriteRefusalOf(const NafaqahApiException('no_provider', '', statusCode: 409)),
+        NafaqahWriteRefusal.noProvider,
+      );
+      expect(
+        nafaqahWriteRefusalOf({
+          'status': 'error',
+          'status_code': 409,
+          'detail': {'code': 'no_provider', 'message': 'x'},
+        }),
+        NafaqahWriteRefusal.noProvider,
+      );
+      expect(
+        nafaqahWriteRefusalOf({
+          'status': 'error',
+          'status_code': 409,
+          'detail': {'code': 'ledger_would_be_overpaid'},
+        }),
+        NafaqahWriteRefusal.ledgerWouldBeOverpaid,
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('anything else is not a Nafaqah refusal', () {
+      expect(nafaqahWriteRefusalOf(const PostgrestException(message: 'Forbidden', code: '42501')), isNull);
+      expect(nafaqahWriteRefusalOf(const PostgrestException(message: 'bad', code: '22023')), isNull);
+      expect(nafaqahWriteRefusalOf(const NafaqahApiException('overpayment', '')), isNull);
+      expect(nafaqahWriteRefusalOf({'status': 'success', 'detail': {'code': 'no_provider'}}), isNull);
+      expect(nafaqahWriteRefusalOf(Exception('offline')), isNull);
+      expect(nafaqahWriteRefusalOf(null), isNull);
+    });
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('explanations are localized in en, ar and ur', (tester) async {
+    final texts = <String, List<String?>>{};
+    for (final lang in ['en', 'ar', 'ur']) {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(Localizations(
+        locale: Locale(lang),
+        delegates: const [AppLocalizationsDelegate(), DefaultWidgetsLocalizations.delegate],
+        child: Builder(builder: (context) {
+          texts[lang] = [
+            nafaqahWriteErrorText(context, const NafaqahApiException('ledger_would_be_overpaid', '')),
+            nafaqahWriteErrorText(context, const NafaqahApiException('no_provider', '')),
+            nafaqahWriteErrorText(context, Exception('offline')),
+          ];
+          return const SizedBox();
+        }),
+      ));
+      await tester.pump();
+    }
+    expect(texts['en']![0], startsWith('Not saved: the husband has already repaid'));
+    expect(texts['en']![1], contains('no Nafaqah provider'));
+    expect(texts['en']![2], isNull);
+    expect(texts['ar']![0], startsWith('لم يُحفظ'));
+    expect(texts['ur']![1], contains('نفقہ دینے والا'));
+  });
+
+  // FABLE2-APP-03 (app side): a 409 {"detail": {"code": ...}} from the chat or
+  // receipt commit reaches the screens as a localized Nafaqah refusal and is
+  // not queued for a replay that would be refused again.
+  group('chat and receipt commits refused with 409', () {
+    BaseApiClient refusing(String code) => BaseApiClient(
+          client: MockClient((request) async => http.Response(
+                jsonEncode({'detail': {'code': code, 'message': 'refused'}}),
+                409,
+                headers: {'content-type': 'application/json'},
+              )),
+          authTokenProvider: () => 'jwt',
+        );
+
+    for (final entry in {
+      'no_provider': NafaqahWriteRefusal.noProvider,
+      'ledger_would_be_overpaid': NafaqahWriteRefusal.ledgerWouldBeOverpaid,
+    }.entries) {
+      test('chat commit: ${entry.key}', () async {
+        final res = await ChatApiClient(baseClient: refusing(entry.key)).postChatTransaction(
+          message: 'groceries 120',
+          householdId: 'h1',
+          previewOnly: false,
+          nafaqahClass: 'wife_reimbursable',
+        );
+        expect(nafaqahWriteRefusalOf(res), entry.value);
+        expect(SyncWorker.shouldQueueAfterOnlineFailure(res), isFalse);
+      });
+
+      test('receipt commit: ${entry.key}', () async {
+        final res = await ReceiptApiClient(baseClient: refusing(entry.key)).scanReceipt(
+          imagesBase64: const ['aGk='],
+          householdId: 'h1',
+          previewOnly: false,
+        );
+        expect(nafaqahWriteRefusalOf(res), entry.value);
+        expect(SyncWorker.shouldQueueAfterOnlineFailure(res), isFalse);
+      });
+    }
+  });
+
+  group('only the wife, the provider or an admin classifies', () {
+    test('API code, current API message and database hint are recognised', () {
+      expect(
+        nafaqahWriteRefusalOf({'status': 'error', 'status_code': 403, 'detail': {'code': 'not_classifier'}}),
+        NafaqahWriteRefusal.notClassifier,
+      );
+      expect(
+        nafaqahWriteRefusalOf({
+          'status': 'error',
+          'status_code': 422,
+          'detail': 'Only the husband or a wife can classify a family expense.',
+          'message': 'Only the husband or a wife can classify a family expense.',
+        }),
+        NafaqahWriteRefusal.notClassifier,
+      );
+      expect(
+        nafaqahWriteRefusalOf(const PostgrestException(message: 'refused', code: '42501', hint: 'nafaqah_classifier_only')),
+        NafaqahWriteRefusal.notClassifier,
+      );
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('the refusal is explained in en, ar and ur', (tester) async {
+      final texts = <String, String?>{};
+      for (final lang in ['en', 'ar', 'ur']) {
+        await tester.pumpWidget(Localizations(
+          locale: Locale(lang),
+          delegates: const [AppLocalizationsDelegate(), DefaultWidgetsLocalizations.delegate],
+          child: Builder(builder: (context) {
+            texts[lang] = nafaqahWriteErrorText(context, const NafaqahApiException('not_classifier', ''));
+            return const SizedBox();
+          }),
+        ));
+        await tester.pump();
+      }
+      expect(texts['en'], contains('only the wife, the Nafaqah provider (husband) or an admin'));
+      expect(texts['ar'], contains('المشرف'));
+      expect(texts['ur'], contains('ایڈمن'));
+    });
+  });
+}

diff --git a/flutter_app/test/services/offline_queue_write_failure_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/services/offline_queue_write_failure_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..e4974cf
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/services/offline_queue_write_failure_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,92 @@
+// MOB-28: a failed write to the offline queue must surface as an error, never
+// as a silent null that screens turn into "Saved offline".
+import 'dart:io';
+
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/offline_queue_manager.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/offline_sync_service.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:sqflite_common_ffi/sqflite_ffi.dart';
+
+void main() {
+  sqfliteFfiInit();
+  databaseFactory = databaseFactoryFfi;
+
+  Future<Database> openQueueDb() async {
+    final db = await databaseFactory.openDatabase(inMemoryDatabasePath);
+    await OfflineQueueManager.createSchema(db);
+    return db;
+  }
+
+  test('enqueueOrThrow throws when SQLite rejects the write', () async {
+    final db = await openQueueDb();
+    await db.close(); // every statement on a closed database fails
+    final queue = OfflineQueueManager(customDb: db);
+
+    expect(await queue.enqueue(operationType: 'chat', payload: {'message': 'x'}, householdId: 'h-1'), isNull,
+        reason: 'legacy API still returns null');
+    await expectLater(
+      queue.enqueueOrThrow(operationType: 'chat', payload: {'message': 'x'}, householdId: 'h-1'),
+      throwsA(isA<OfflineQueueWriteException>()),
+    );
+  });
+
+  test('enqueueOrThrow throws when the receipt image blob cannot be written', () async {
+    final db = await openQueueDb();
+    final tmp = await Directory.systemTemp.createTemp('mob28');
+    addTearDown(() => tmp.delete(recursive: true));
+    final blocker = File('${tmp.path}/not_a_dir');
+    await blocker.writeAsString('file in the way');
+    final queue = OfflineQueueManager(customDb: db, blobDirectoryProvider: () async => Directory(blocker.path));
+
+    await expectLater(
+      queue.enqueueOrThrow(
+        operationType: 'receipt',
+        payload: {OfflineQueueManager.inlineImagesKey: ['aGVsbG8=']},
+        householdId: 'h-1',
+      ),
+      throwsA(isA<OfflineQueueWriteException>()),
+    );
+    expect(await queue.getPendingCount(), 0);
+    await db.close();
+  });
+
+  test('OfflineSyncService.enqueue returns the id on success', () async {
+    final db = await openQueueDb();
+    final service = OfflineSyncService.withQueue(OfflineQueueManager(customDb: db));
+
+    final id = await service.enqueue(endpoint: 'chat', payload: {'message': 'Coffee 15'}, householdId: 'h-1');
+
+    expect(id, isNotEmpty);
+    expect(service.pendingCountNotifier.value, 1);
+    await db.close();
+  });
+
+  test('OfflineSyncService.enqueue throws instead of returning null on failure', () async {
+    final db = await openQueueDb();
+    await db.close();
+    final service = OfflineSyncService.withQueue(OfflineQueueManager(customDb: db));
+
+    await expectLater(
+      service.enqueue(endpoint: 'chat', payload: {'message': 'Coffee 15'}, householdId: 'h-1'),
+      throwsA(isA<OfflineQueueWriteException>()),
+    );
+  });
+
+  group('screens only report "saved offline" after a successful queue write', () {
+    String read(String path) => File(path).readAsStringSync();
+
+    test('chat awaits the queue write before replying', () {
+      final src = read('lib/screens/chat/chat_entry_screen.dart');
+      final enqueue = src.indexOf('OfflineSyncService.instance.enqueue');
+      expect(src.substring(enqueue - 20, enqueue), contains('await'));
+      expect(src.indexOf("context.tr('chat_offline_queued')"), greaterThan(enqueue));
+      expect(src, contains("context.tr('offline_queue_failed')"));
+    });
+
+    test('receipt scanners use the throwing queue API', () {
+      expect(read('lib/screens/scanner/receipt_scanner_sheet.dart'), isNot(contains('OfflineQueueManager().enqueue(')));
+      expect(read('lib/widgets/scanner/batch_item_review_sheet.dart'), isNot(contains('OfflineQueueManager().enqueue(')));
+      expect(read('lib/widgets/scanner/batch_item_review_sheet.dart'), isNot(contains('count as saved')));
+    });
+  });
+}
