+import 'dart:io';
+
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/offline_receipt_draft.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+void main() {
+  group('offlineReceiptDraftPayload (R8: no invented offline drafts)', () {
+    test('a photo-only draft carries the photos and no merchant, amount or category', () {
+      final payload = offlineReceiptDraftPayload(imagesBase64: ['aGVsbG8='], userId: 'u1');
+      expect(payload['images_base64'], ['aGVsbG8=']);
+      expect(payload['needs_cloud_enrichment'], isTrue);
+      expect(payload['user_id'], 'u1');
+      expect(payload.containsKey('merchant'), isFalse);
+      expect(payload.containsKey('amount'), isFalse);
+      expect(payload.containsKey('vat_amount'), isFalse);
+      expect(payload.containsKey('category_code'), isFalse);
+    });
+
+    test('keeps only what the user typed (trimmed) and the Nafaqah choice', () {
+      final payload = offlineReceiptDraftPayload(
+        imagesBase64: const [],
+        merchant: '  Panda  ',
+        amount: 42.5,
+        qrCodeRaw: 'QR',
+        nafaqahFields: const {'paid_by': 'partner', 'nafaqah_class': 'wife_personal'},
+      );
+      expect(payload['merchant'], 'Panda');
+      expect(payload['amount'], 42.5);
+      expect(payload['qr_code_raw'], 'QR');
+      expect(payload['paid_by'], 'partner');
+      expect(payload['nafaqah_class'], 'wife_personal');
+    });
+
+    test('blank merchant and zero amount are omitted, never defaulted', () {
+      final payload = offlineReceiptDraftPayload(imagesBase64: const ['x'], merchant: '   ', amount: 0);
+      expect(payload.containsKey('merchant'), isFalse);
+      expect(payload.containsKey('amount'), isFalse);
+    });
+  });
+
+  test('lib/ ships no mock OCR recognizer or invented receipt text', () {
+    expect(File('lib/services/ocr/local_ocr_service.dart').existsSync(), isFalse);
+    final offenders = <String>[];
+    for (final f in Directory('lib').listSync(recursive: true).whereType<File>()) {
+      if (!f.path.endsWith('.dart')) continue;
+      final src = f.readAsStringSync();
+      if (RegExp(r'\bMock[A-Z]\w*|\bmock[A-Z]\w*').hasMatch(src) || src.contains('Total: 85.00')) {
+        offenders.add(f.path);
+      }
+    }
+    expect(offenders, isEmpty, reason: offenders.join('\n'));
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/services/offline_sync_regression_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/services/offline_sync_regression_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5e2d242
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/services/offline_sync_regression_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,376 @@
+import 'dart:async';
+import 'dart:convert';
+import 'dart:io';
+
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
+import 'package:http/testing.dart';
+import 'package:sqflite_common_ffi/sqflite_ffi.dart';
+import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart' show PostgrestException;
+
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api/base_api_client.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api_service.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/offline_queue_manager.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/sync_worker.dart';
+
+/// Records every backend request made through a real [ApiService] stack.
+class _Backend {
+  final requests = <http.Request>[];
+  final List<http.Response Function(http.Request)> script;
+  _Backend(this.script);
+
+  late final ApiService api = ApiService(
+    base: BaseApiClient(
+      client: MockClient((request) async {
+        requests.add(request);
+        final i = requests.length - 1;
+        final responder = i < script.length ? script[i] : script.last;
+        return responder(request);
+      }),
+      authTokenProvider: () => 'jwt',
+    ),
+  );
+
+  Map<String, dynamic> body(int i) => jsonDecode(requests[i].body) as Map<String, dynamic>;
+}
+
+http.Response _json(Map<String, dynamic> body, [int code = 200]) => http.Response(jsonEncode(body), code);
+
+void main() {
+  sqfliteFfiInit();
+  databaseFactory = databaseFactoryFfi;
+
+  late Database db;
+  late Directory blobDir;
+  late OfflineQueueManager queue;
+
+  setUp(() async {
+    db = await databaseFactory.openDatabase(inMemoryDatabasePath);
+    await OfflineQueueManager.createSchema(db);
+    blobDir = await Directory.systemTemp.createTemp('offline_blobs_test');
+    queue = OfflineQueueManager(customDb: db, blobDirectoryProvider: () async => blobDir);
+  });
+
+  tearDown(() async {
+    await db.close();
+    if (await blobDir.exists()) await blobDir.delete(recursive: true);
+  });
+
+  SyncWorker worker(_Backend backend, {TransactionInserter? inserter}) => SyncWorker(
+        queueManager: queue,
+        api: backend.api,
+        transactionInserter: inserter,
+        interItemDelay: Duration.zero,
+      );
+
+  group('MOB-01 offline chat replay must commit, not preview', () {
+    test('replay sends preview_only=false and deletes the row only after a committed success', () async {
+      await queue.enqueue(operationType: 'chat', payload: {'message': 'Coffee 15 SAR'}, householdId: 'h-1');
+      final backend = _Backend([(_) => _json({'status': 'success', 'transaction_id': 't-1'})]);
+
+      final committed = await worker(backend).drainQueue();
+
+      expect(committed, 1);
+      expect(backend.body(0)['preview_only'], isFalse);
+      expect(backend.body(0)['allow_duplicate'], isTrue);
+      expect(await queue.getPendingCount(), 0);
+    });
+
+    test('a pending_confirmation answer is NOT treated as synced', () async {
+      await queue.enqueue(operationType: 'chat', payload: {'message': 'Coffee 15 SAR'}, householdId: 'h-1');
+      final backend = _Backend([(_) => _json({'status': 'pending_confirmation', 'amount': 15})]);
+
+      final committed = await worker(backend).drainQueue();
+
+      expect(committed, 0);
+      final pending = await queue.getPendingItems();
+      expect(pending, hasLength(1));
+      expect(pending.single.retryCount, 1);
+    });
+
+    test('the local offline "preview" parse is a network failure, never a success', () {
+      final result = SyncWorker.classifyResponse({'status': 'preview', 'amount': 15.0}, 'chat');
+      expect(result.outcome, ReplayOutcome.transient);
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('MOB-03 manual expense attribution survives offline replay', () {
+    test('transaction_insert replays the exact row with client id and original timestamp', () async {
+      final inserted = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
+      final id = await queue.enqueue(
+        operationType: kTransactionInsertOperation,
+        householdId: 'h-1',
+        payload: {
+          'amount': 87.5,
+          'merchant': 'Tamimi',
+          'category_code': 'OPEX-GROCERY',
+          'spent_by': 'partner',
+          'paid_by': 'wife',
+          'beneficiary_type': 'household',
+          'beneficiary_id': 'household',
+          'timestamp': '2026-10-26T20:30:00.000Z',
+        },
+      );
+
+      final committed = await worker(_Backend([(_) => _json({})]), inserter: (row) async => inserted.add(row)).drainQueue();
+
+      expect(committed, 1);
+      expect(inserted.single['paid_by'], 'wife');
+      expect(inserted.single['beneficiary_type'], 'household');
+      expect(inserted.single['household_id'], 'h-1');
+      expect(inserted.single['id'], id);
+      expect(inserted.single['timestamp'], '2026-10-26T20:30:00.000Z');
+    });
+
+    test('a unique violation on replay means the earlier attempt already committed', () async {
+      await queue.enqueue(operationType: kTransactionInsertOperation, householdId: 'h-1', payload: {'amount': 10});
+
+      final committed = await worker(
+        _Backend([(_) => _json({})]),
+        inserter: (row) async => throw const PostgrestException(message: 'duplicate key', code: '23505'),
+      ).drainQueue();
+
+      expect(committed, 1);
+      expect(await queue.getPendingCount(), 0);
+    });
+
+    test('legacy chat rows forward spent_by / paid_by / category overrides', () async {
+      await queue.enqueue(
+        operationType: 'chat',
+        householdId: 'h-1',
+        payload: {
+          'message': 'Tamimi SAR 87.50 in OPEX-GROCERY',
+          'spent_by': 'partner',
+          'paid_by': 'wife',
+          'category_code': 'OPEX-GROCERY',
+        },
+      );
+      final backend = _Backend([(_) => _json({'status': 'success'})]);
+
+      await worker(backend).drainQueue();
+
+      expect(backend.body(0)['spent_by'], 'partner');
+      expect(backend.body(0)['paid_by'], 'partner');
+      expect(backend.body(0)['category_code'], 'OPEX-GROCERY');
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('MOB-04 rows orphaned in syncing by an app kill are replayed', () {
+    test('drain recovers syncing rows left by a killed process', () async {
+      final id = await queue.enqueue(operationType: 'chat', payload: {'message': 'Fuel 90'}, householdId: 'h-1');
+      await queue.markSyncing(id!); // process killed here, before markSuccess/markFailed
+      final backend = _Backend([(_) => _json({'status': 'success'})]);
+
+      final committed = await worker(backend).drainQueue();
+
+      expect(committed, 1);
+      expect(backend.requests, hasLength(1));
+      expect(await queue.getPendingCount(), 0);
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('MOB-05 identical offline expenses are not silently merged', () {
+    test('two identical purchases produce two queue rows', () async {
+      final a = await queue.enqueue(operationType: 'chat', payload: {'message': 'Coffee 15'}, householdId: 'h-1');
+      final b = await queue.enqueue(operationType: 'chat', payload: {'message': 'Coffee 15'}, householdId: 'h-1');
+
+      expect(a, isNot(equals(b)));
+      expect(await queue.getPendingCount(), 2);
+    });
+
+    test('an explicit idempotency key still collapses a double-submit of one action', () async {
+      final a = await queue.enqueue(
+          operationType: 'chat', payload: {'message': 'Coffee 15'}, householdId: 'h-1', idempotencyKey: 'form-1');
+      final b = await queue.enqueue(
+          operationType: 'chat', payload: {'message': 'Coffee 15'}, householdId: 'h-1', idempotencyKey: 'form-1');
+
+      expect(a, equals(b));
+      expect(await queue.getPendingCount(), 1);
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('MOB-06 replay carries a stable idempotency key', () {
+    test('a retried replay after a timeout reuses the same Idempotency-Key', () async {
+      await queue.enqueue(operationType: 'chat', payload: {'message': 'Shawarma 22'}, householdId: 'h-1');
+      final backend = _Backend([
+        (_) => throw TimeoutException('server slow'),
+        (_) => _json({'status': 'success'}),
+      ]);
+      final w = worker(backend);
+
+      expect(await w.drainQueue(), 0);
+      expect(await w.drainQueue(), 1);
+
+      final k1 = backend.requests[0].headers['Idempotency-Key'];
+      final k2 = backend.requests[1].headers['Idempotency-Key'];
+      expect(k1, isNotNull);
+      expect(k1, equals(k2));
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('MOB-09 retry classification, poison messages and FIFO', () {
+    test('network failures never exhaust the retry budget', () async {
+      await queue.enqueue(operationType: 'chat', payload: {'message': 'Water 5'}, householdId: 'h-1');
+      final backend = _Backend([(_) => throw const SocketException('Failed host lookup')]);
+      final w = worker(backend);
+
+      for (var i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
+        await w.drainQueue();
+      }
+
+      final pending = await queue.getPendingItems();
+      expect(pending, hasLength(1));
+      expect(pending.single.retryCount, 0);
+      expect(pending.single.lastError, contains('Failed host lookup'));
+      expect(await queue.getFailedCount(), 0);
+    });
+
+    test('a transient failure halts the drain so later items do not overtake it', () async {
+      await queue.enqueue(operationType: 'chat', payload: {'message': 'first'}, householdId: 'h-1');
+      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 2));
+      await queue.enqueue(operationType: 'chat', payload: {'message': 'second'}, householdId: 'h-1');
+      final backend = _Backend([(_) => _json({'detail': 'Bad gateway'}, 503)]);
+
+      await worker(backend).drainQueue();
+
+      expect(backend.requests, hasLength(1));
+      expect(backend.body(0)['message'], 'first');
+      expect(await queue.getPendingCount(), 2);
+    });
+
+    test('a permanently rejected item is parked as failed after maxRetries and stops blocking', () async {
+      await queue.enqueue(operationType: 'chat', payload: {'message': 'bad'}, householdId: 'h-1');
+      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 2));
+      await queue.enqueue(operationType: 'chat', payload: {'message': 'good'}, householdId: 'h-1');
+      final backend = _Backend([
+        (r) => (jsonDecode(r.body) as Map)['message'] == 'bad'
+            ? _json({'detail': 'message and household_id are required.'}, 400)
+            : _json({'status': 'success'}),
+      ]);
+      final w = SyncWorker(queueManager: queue, api: backend.api, maxPermanentRetries: 2, interItemDelay: Duration.zero);
+
+      expect(await w.drainQueue(), 1); // good one commits, bad one burns 1/2
+      expect(await w.drainQueue(), 0); // bad one burns 2/2 -> failed
+      expect(await queue.getPendingCount(), 0);
+      expect(await queue.getFailedCount(), 1);
+
+      await queue.requeueFailed();
+      expect(await queue.getPendingCount(), 1);
+    });
+
+    // FR-A-12: /agent/scan-receipt answers HTTP 200 {"status": "error"} when it
+    // cannot read the receipt (or the total is 0). That is the server's answer,
+    // not a lost connection; classified as transient it sat at the head of
+    // the FIFO queue and nothing after it ever synced.
+    test('a 200 {"status": "error"} answer is a rejection, not a lost connection', () async {
+      await queue.enqueue(
+        operationType: 'receipt',
+        payload: {'images_base64': ['dW5yZWFkYWJsZQ==']},
+        householdId: 'h-1',
+      );
+      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 2));
+      await queue.enqueue(operationType: 'chat', payload: {'message': 'Coffee 15'}, householdId: 'h-1');
+      final backend = _Backend([
+        (r) => r.url.path.endsWith('/agent/scan-receipt')
+            ? _json({'status': 'error', 'message': 'Could not parse the receipt image(s).'})
+            : _json({'status': 'success'}),
+      ]);
+
+      expect(await worker(backend).drainQueue(), 1, reason: 'the chat item behind it still syncs');
+      final pending = await queue.getPendingItems();
+      expect(pending.single.operationType, 'receipt');
+      expect(pending.single.retryCount, 1);
+    });
+
+    test('401 after a failed refresh keeps the item pending without burning retries', () {
+      final r = SyncWorker.classifyResponse({'status': 'error', 'status_code': 401}, 'chat');
+      expect(r.outcome, ReplayOutcome.transient);
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('MOB-10 concurrent drains and large queues', () {
+    test('a concurrent flush awaits the in-flight drain instead of returning 0', () async {
+      await queue.enqueue(operationType: 'chat', payload: {'message': 'a'}, householdId: 'h-1');
+      final gate = Completer<void>();
+      final backend = _Backend([(_) => _json({'status': 'success'})]);
+      final w = SyncWorker(
+        queueManager: queue,
+        interItemDelay: Duration.zero,
+        customDispatcher: (item) async {
+          await gate.future;
+          return backend.api.postChatTransaction(message: 'a', householdId: 'h-1', previewOnly: false);
+        },
+      );
+
+      final first = w.drainQueue();
+      final second = w.drainQueue();
+      gate.complete();
+
+      expect(await first, 1);
+      expect(await second, 1);
+      expect(backend.requests, hasLength(1));
+    });
+
+    test('more than one batch (50) is drained in a single pass', () async {
+      for (var i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
+        await queue.enqueue(operationType: 'chat', payload: {'message': 'item $i'}, householdId: 'h-1');
+      }
+      final backend = _Backend([(_) => _json({'status': 'success'})]);
+
+      expect(await worker(backend).drainQueue(), 60);
+      expect(await queue.getPendingCount(), 0);
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('MOB-11 receipt images are stored out of the SQLite row', () {
+    test('images are offloaded to blob files, replayed, then deleted', () async {
+      final big = base64Encode(List<int>.filled(3 * 1024 * 1024, 7)); // ~4 MB string
+      final id = await queue.enqueue(
+        operationType: 'receipt',
+        householdId: 'h-1',
+        payload: {'images_base64': [big], 'user_id': 'u-1'},
+      );
+
+      final raw = await db.query(OfflineQueueManager.tableName, where: 'id = ?', whereArgs: [id]);
+      expect((raw.single['payload'] as String).length, lessThan(1024));
+      expect(blobDir.listSync(), hasLength(1));
+
+      final backend = _Backend([(_) => _json({'status': 'success'})]);
+      expect(await worker(backend).drainQueue(), 1);
+      expect((backend.body(0)['images_base64'] as List).single, equals(big));
+      expect(blobDir.listSync(), isEmpty);
+    });
+
+    test('an unreadable row is quarantined instead of blocking the queue', () async {
+      await db.insert(OfflineQueueManager.tableName, {
+        'id': 'corrupt',
+        'operation_type': 'chat',
+        'payload': '{}',
+        'household_id': 'h-1',
+        'idempotency_key': 'k-corrupt',
+        'status': 'pending',
+        'retry_count': 'not-a-number',
+        'created_at': '2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',
+      });
+      await queue.enqueue(operationType: 'chat', payload: {'message': 'ok'}, householdId: 'h-1');
+      final backend = _Backend([(_) => _json({'status': 'success'})]);
+
+      final committed = await worker(backend).drainQueue();
+
+      expect(committed, 1);
+      expect(await queue.getFailedCount(), 1);
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('MOB-12 replay reports when the expense really happened', () {
+    test('client_occurred_at carries the enqueue time, not the replay time', () async {
+      await queue.enqueue(operationType: 'chat', payload: {'message': 'Dinner 120'}, householdId: 'h-1');
+      final item = (await queue.getPendingItems()).single;
+      final backend = _Backend([(_) => _json({'status': 'success'})]);
+
+      await worker(backend).drainQueue();
+
+      expect(backend.body(0)['client_occurred_at'], item.createdAt.toUtc().toIso8601String());
+    });
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/services/preview_token_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/services/preview_token_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..2a9adc4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/services/preview_token_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,172 @@
+import 'dart:convert';
+
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api/base_api_client.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api/chat_api_client.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api/preview_token.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api/receipt_api_client.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
+import 'package:http/testing.dart';
+
+/// Records request bodies; answers with [responses] in order (last repeats).
+class _Server {
+  final List<(int, Map<String, dynamic>)> responses;
+  final bodies = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
+  _Server(this.responses);
+
+  BaseApiClient get client => BaseApiClient(
+        client: MockClient((request) async {
+          bodies.add(Map<String, dynamic>.from(jsonDecode(request.body) as Map));
+          final r = responses[(bodies.length - 1).clamp(0, responses.length - 1)];
+          return http.Response(jsonEncode(r.$2), r.$1, headers: {'content-type': 'application/json'});
+        }),
+        authTokenProvider: () => 'jwt',
+      );
+}
+
+const _invalid = (422, {'detail': {'code': 'invalid_preview_token', 'message': 'expired'}});
+
+void main() {
+  group('preview_token helpers', () {
+    test('previewTokenOf reads a non-empty string only', () {
+      expect(previewTokenOf({'preview_token': 'abc'}), 'abc');
+      expect(previewTokenOf({'preview_token': ''}), isNull);
+      expect(previewTokenOf({'preview_token': 12}), isNull);
+      expect(previewTokenOf({}), isNull);
+      expect(previewTokenOf(null), isNull);
+    });
+
+    test('isInvalidPreviewToken matches only 422 invalid_preview_token', () {
+      expect(isInvalidPreviewToken({'status': 'error', 'status_code': 422, 'detail': {'code': 'invalid_preview_token'}}), isTrue);
+      expect(isInvalidPreviewToken({'status': 'error', 'status_code': 422, 'detail': {'code': 'other'}}), isFalse);
+      expect(isInvalidPreviewToken({'status': 'error', 'status_code': 409, 'detail': {'code': 'invalid_preview_token'}}), isFalse);
+      expect(isInvalidPreviewToken({'status': 'success'}), isFalse);
+      expect(isInvalidPreviewToken({'status': 'error', 'status_code': 422, 'detail': {'code': 'preview_token_expired'}}), isTrue);
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('commitWithPreviewToken', () {
+    test('commits once with the token when it is accepted', () async {
+      final tokens = <String?>[];
+      var previews = 0;
+      final res = await commitWithPreviewToken(
+        token: 't1',
+        commit: (t) async {
+          tokens.add(t);
+          return {'status': 'success'};
+        },
+        rePreview: () async {
+          previews++;
+          return {'status': 'pending_confirmation', 'preview_token': 't2'};
+        },
+      );
+      expect(res['status'], 'success');
+      expect(tokens, ['t1']);
+      expect(previews, 0);
+    });
+
+    test('re-runs the preview once and retries with the fresh token', () async {
+      final tokens = <String?>[];
+      var previews = 0;
+      final res = await commitWithPreviewToken(
+        token: 'stale',
+        commit: (t) async {
+          tokens.add(t);
+          return t == 'fresh'
+              ? {'status': 'success'}
+              : {'status': 'error', 'status_code': 422, 'detail': {'code': 'invalid_preview_token'}};
+        },
+        rePreview: () async {
+          previews++;
+          return {'status': 'pending_confirmation', 'preview_token': 'fresh'};
+        },
+      );
+      expect(res['status'], 'success');
+      expect(tokens, ['stale', 'fresh']);
+      expect(previews, 1);
+    });
+
+    test('never loops: a second refusal is returned as is', () async {
+      var commits = 0;
+      var previews = 0;
+      final res = await commitWithPreviewToken(
+        token: 'a',
+        commit: (_) async {
+          commits++;
+          return {'status': 'error', 'status_code': 422, 'detail': {'code': 'invalid_preview_token'}};
+        },
+        rePreview: () async {
+          previews++;
+          return {'status': 'pending_confirmation', 'preview_token': 'b'};
+        },
+      );
+      expect(isInvalidPreviewToken(res), isTrue);
+      expect(commits, 2);
+      expect(previews, 1);
+    });
+
+    test('a failed re-preview returns the original refusal', () async {
+      var commits = 0;
+      final res = await commitWithPreviewToken(
+        token: 'a',
+        commit: (_) async {
+          commits++;
+          return {'status': 'error', 'status_code': 422, 'detail': {'code': 'invalid_preview_token'}};
+        },
+        rePreview: () async => {'status': 'error', 'status_code': 503},
+      );
+      expect(commits, 1);
+      expect(isInvalidPreviewToken(res), isTrue);
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('API clients send preview_token back unchanged', () {
+    test('chat commit includes it; absent token sends no field', () async {
+      final server = _Server([(200, {'status': 'success'})]);
+      final chat = ChatApiClient(baseClient: server.client);
+      await chat.postChatTransaction(message: 'm', householdId: 'h', previewOnly: false, previewToken: 'tok-1');
+      await chat.postChatTransaction(message: 'm', householdId: 'h', previewOnly: false);
+      expect(server.bodies[0]['preview_token'], 'tok-1');
+      expect(server.bodies[1].containsKey('preview_token'), isFalse);
+    });
+
+    test('receipt commit includes it; absent token sends no field', () async {
+      final server = _Server([(200, {'status': 'success'})]);
+      final receipt = ReceiptApiClient(baseClient: server.client);
+      await receipt.scanReceipt(imagesBase64: const ['aGk='], householdId: 'h', previewToken: 'tok-2');
+      await receipt.scanReceipt(imagesBase64: const ['aGk='], householdId: 'h');
+      expect(server.bodies[0]['preview_token'], 'tok-2');
+      expect(server.bodies[1].containsKey('preview_token'), isFalse);
+    });
+
+    // UX-12: a corrected amount (and receipt category) travels with the token.
+    test('chat commit sends a corrected amount with the token; no amount, no field', () async {
+      final server = _Server([(200, {'status': 'success'})]);
+      final chat = ChatApiClient(baseClient: server.client);
+      await chat.postChatTransaction(message: 'm', householdId: 'h', previewOnly: false, previewToken: 'tok', amount: 186);
+      await chat.postChatTransaction(message: 'm', householdId: 'h', previewOnly: false, previewToken: 'tok');
+      expect(server.bodies[0]['amount'], 186);
+      expect(server.bodies[0]['preview_token'], 'tok');
+      expect(server.bodies[1].containsKey('amount'), isFalse);
+    });
+
+    test('receipt commit sends a corrected amount and category with the token', () async {
+      final server = _Server([(200, {'status': 'success'})]);
+      final receipt = ReceiptApiClient(baseClient: server.client);
+      await receipt.scanReceipt(
+          imagesBase64: const ['aGk='], householdId: 'h', previewToken: 'tok', amount: 85.25, categoryCode: 'OPEX-SHOPPING');
+      await receipt.scanReceipt(imagesBase64: const ['aGk='], householdId: 'h', previewToken: 'tok');
+      expect(server.bodies[0]['amount'], 85.25);
+      expect(server.bodies[0]['category_code'], 'OPEX-SHOPPING');
+      expect(server.bodies[1].containsKey('amount'), isFalse);
+      expect(server.bodies[1].containsKey('category_code'), isFalse);
+    });
+
+    test('a 422 invalid_preview_token reaches the caller recognisably', () async {
+      final server = _Server([_invalid]);
+      final res = await ChatApiClient(baseClient: server.client)
+          .postChatTransaction(message: 'm', householdId: 'h', previewOnly: false, previewToken: 'old');
+      expect(isInvalidPreviewToken(res), isTrue);
+    });
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/services/receipt_signed_url_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/services/receipt_signed_url_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b8d9158
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/services/receipt_signed_url_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,68 @@
+import 'dart:convert';
+
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
+import 'package:http/testing.dart';
+import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
+
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/receipt_storage_service.dart';
+
+void main() {
+  late List<http.Request> requests;
+  late int signStatus;
+
+  SupabaseClient fakeClient() => SupabaseClient(
+        'https://unit-test.invalid',
+        'sb_publishable_unit_test',
+        httpClient: MockClient((request) async {
+          requests.add(request);
+          if (signStatus != 200) {
+            return http.Response(jsonEncode({'statusCode': '$signStatus', 'error': 'x', 'message': 'denied'}), signStatus);
+          }
+          final path = request.url.path.split('/object/sign/').last;
+          return http.Response(jsonEncode({'signedURL': '/object/sign/$path?token=fresh-${requests.length}'}), 200);
+        }),
+      );
+
+  setUp(() {
+    requests = [];
+    signStatus = 200;
+    ReceiptStorageService.clearSignedUrlCache();
+  });
+
+  test('MOB-22: a stored (expiring) signed URL is re-signed from its storage path', () async {
+    final service = ReceiptStorageService(client: fakeClient());
+    const stored =
+        'https://unit-test.invalid/storage/v1/object/sign/receipts/hh-1/old.jpg?token=expired-token';
+
+    final url = await service.getSignedReceiptUrl(stored);
+
+    expect(requests, hasLength(1));
+    expect(requests.single.url.path, contains('/object/sign/receipts/hh-1/old.jpg'));
+    expect(url, contains('token=fresh-1'));
+    expect(url, isNot(contains('expired-token')));
+  });
+
+  test('MOB-22: signed URLs are cached until near expiry, then cleared on sign-out', () async {
+    final service = ReceiptStorageService(client: fakeClient());
+    final a = await service.getSignedReceiptUrl('hh-1/a.jpg');
+    final b = await service.getSignedReceiptUrl('hh-1/a.jpg');
+    expect(a, b);
+    expect(requests, hasLength(1));
+    expect(ReceiptStorageService.cachedSignedUrlCount, 1);
+
+    ReceiptStorageService.clearSignedUrlCache();
+    expect(ReceiptStorageService.cachedSignedUrlCount, 0);
+  });
+
+  test('MOB-22: when signing is denied no unusable URL is returned', () async {
+    signStatus = 403;
+    final service = ReceiptStorageService(client: fakeClient());
+
+    expect(await service.getSignedReceiptUrl('hh-other/a.jpg'), isNull);
+    expect(
+      await service.getSignedReceiptUrl('https://unit-test.invalid/storage/v1/object/public/receipts/hh-1/a.jpg'),
+      isNull,
+    );
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/services/reminder_planner_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/services/reminder_planner_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..abb8be0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/services/reminder_planner_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,157 @@
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/installment_plan.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/recurring_bill.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/notifications/reminder_planner.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+RecurringBillItem _bill(String merchant, int day, {String status = 'UPCOMING', String cadence = 'monthly'}) =>
+    RecurringBillItem(
+      merchant: merchant,
+      normalizedMerchant: merchant,
+      categoryCode: 'OPEX-UTILITIES',
+      averageAmount: 230,
+      expectedDayOfMonth: day,
+      status: status,
+      cadence: cadence,
+    );
+
+InstallmentPlan _plan({String frequency = 'monthly', String? nextDueAt, int paid = 1, int day = 27}) =>
+    InstallmentPlan.fromJson({
+      'id': 'p1',
+      'household_id': 'h',
+      'merchant': 'Jarir',
+      'provider': 'Tabby',
+      'total_amount': 400,
+      'installment_count': 4,
+      'monthly_amount': 100,
+      'paid_installments': paid,
+      'day_of_month': day,
+      'start_date': '2026-10-01',
+      'status': 'ACTIVE',
+      'frequency': frequency,
+      'next_due_at': nextDueAt,
+    });
+
+String _riyadh(DateTime utc) {
+  final r = utc.add(const Duration(hours: 3));
+  return '${r.year}-${r.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${r.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')} ${r.hour}:${r.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
+}
+
+void main() {
+  final en = AppLocalizations(const Locale('en'));
+  // 21 Oct 2026, 10:00 in Riyadh (07:00 UTC).
+  final now = DateTime.utc(2026, 10, 21, 7);
+
+  List<PlannedReminder> plan({
+    DateTime? at,
+    int payday = 27,
+    List<RecurringBillItem> bills = const [],
+    List<InstallmentPlan> plans = const [],
+    Set<ReminderType> enabled = const {...ReminderType.values},
+    AppLocalizations? l,
+  }) =>
+      const ReminderPlanner().plan(
+        now: at ?? now,
+        paydayDay: payday,
+        bills: bills,
+        plans: plans,
+        enabled: enabled,
+        l: l ?? en,
+      );
+
+  group('payday check-in', () {
+    test('fires at 09:00 Riyadh on each upcoming household payday', () {
+      final r = plan(enabled: {ReminderType.payday});
+      expect(r.map((e) => _riyadh(e.fireAtUtc)).take(2), ['2026-10-27 9:00', '2026-11-27 9:00']);
+      expect(r.first.title, "It's payday");
+      expect(r.every((e) => e.type == ReminderType.payday), isTrue);
+    });
+
+    test('uses the household payday, clamped to short months, never a hard-coded 27th', () {
+      final r = plan(enabled: {ReminderType.payday}, payday: 30, at: DateTime.utc(2027, 1, 31, 7));
+      expect(r.map((e) => _riyadh(e.fireAtUtc)).take(2), ['2027-02-28 9:00', '2027-03-30 9:00']);
+    });
+
+    test('on payday before 09:00 today is included; after 09:00 it is not', () {
+      final early = plan(enabled: {ReminderType.payday}, at: DateTime.utc(2026, 10, 27, 4)); // 07:00 Riyadh
+      expect(_riyadh(early.first.fireAtUtc), '2026-10-27 9:00');
+      final late = plan(enabled: {ReminderType.payday}, at: DateTime.utc(2026, 10, 27, 8)); // 11:00 Riyadh
+      expect(_riyadh(late.first.fireAtUtc), '2026-11-27 9:00');
+    });
+  });
+
+  test('"cycle ends in 3 days" fires three days before each payday', () {
+    final r = plan(enabled: {ReminderType.cycleEnd});
+    expect(r.map((e) => _riyadh(e.fireAtUtc)).take(2), ['2026-10-24 9:00', '2026-11-24 9:00']);
+    expect(r.first.title, '3 days until payday');
+    expect(r.first.body, contains('26 Oct'));
+  });
+
+  group('recurring bills', () {
+    test('each bill on its expected day, this month and next', () {
+      final r = plan(enabled: {ReminderType.bill}, bills: [_bill('STC', 25), _bill('SEC', 5)]);
+      expect(r.map((e) => '${_riyadh(e.fireAtUtc)} ${e.title}'), [
+        '2026-10-25 9:00 stc Telecom is due today',
+        '2026-11-05 9:00 SEC is due today',
+        '2026-11-25 9:00 stc Telecom is due today',
+        '2026-12-05 9:00 SEC is due today',
+      ]);
+      expect(r.first.body, contains('SAR 230.00'));
+    });
+
+    test('a bill already paid this cycle is reminded next time only', () {
+      final r = plan(enabled: {ReminderType.bill}, bills: [_bill('STC', 25, status: 'PAID_THIS_CYCLE')]);
+      expect(_riyadh(r.first.fireAtUtc), '2026-11-25 9:00');
+    });
+
+    test('day 31 is clamped to the end of short months', () {
+      final r = plan(enabled: {ReminderType.bill}, bills: [_bill('Rent', 31)], at: DateTime.utc(2026, 11, 2, 7));
+      expect(r.map((e) => _riyadh(e.fireAtUtc)), ['2026-11-30 9:00', '2026-12-31 9:00']);
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('installments', () {
+    test('bi-weekly from next_due_at', () {
+      final r = plan(enabled: {ReminderType.installment}, plans: [_plan(frequency: 'biweekly', nextDueAt: '2026-10-29')]);
+      expect(r.map((e) => _riyadh(e.fireAtUtc)), ['2026-10-29 9:00', '2026-11-12 9:00', '2026-11-26 9:00']);
+      expect(r.first.title, 'Tabby installment due today');
+      expect(r.first.body, contains('SAR 100.00'));
+      expect(r.first.body, contains('Jarir'));
+    });
+
+    test('falls back to day_of_month monthly when next_due_at is absent', () {
+      final r = plan(enabled: {ReminderType.installment}, plans: [_plan(day: 27, paid: 2)]);
+      expect(r.map((e) => _riyadh(e.fireAtUtc)), ['2026-10-27 9:00', '2026-11-27 9:00']);
+    });
+
+    test('a completed plan is not reminded', () {
+      expect(plan(enabled: {ReminderType.installment}, plans: [_plan(paid: 4)]), isEmpty);
+    });
+  });
+
+  test('disabled types are skipped, ids are unique and the list is time-ordered', () {
+    final all = plan(bills: [_bill('STC', 25)], plans: [_plan(frequency: 'biweekly', nextDueAt: '2026-10-29')]);
+    expect(all.map((e) => e.type).toSet(), {...ReminderType.values});
+    expect(all.map((e) => e.id).toSet().length, all.length);
+    for (var i = 1; i < all.length; i++) {
+      expect(all[i].fireAtUtc.isBefore(all[i - 1].fireAtUtc), isFalse);
+    }
+    expect(all.every((e) => e.fireAtUtc.isAfter(now)), isTrue);
+    expect(all.every((e) => e.fireAtUtc.isBefore(now.add(const Duration(days: ReminderPlanner.horizonDays + 1)))), isTrue);
+    expect(plan(enabled: const {}, bills: [_bill('STC', 25)]), isEmpty);
+    expect(all.length, lessThanOrEqualTo(ReminderPlanner.maxReminders));
+  });
+
+  test('texts come from AppLocalizations (Arabic and Urdu)', () {
+    for (final lang in ['ar', 'ur']) {
+      final l = AppLocalizations(Locale(lang));
+      final r = plan(l: l, bills: [_bill('STC', 25)], plans: [_plan(nextDueAt: '2026-10-29')]);
+      for (final e in r) {
+        expect(RegExp('[؀-ۿ]').hasMatch(e.title), isTrue, reason: '$lang ${e.type}');
+        expect(e.title.contains('{'), isFalse);
+        expect(e.body.contains('{'), isFalse);
+      }
+    }
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/services/reminder_service_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/services/reminder_service_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b2ae78b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/services/reminder_service_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,319 @@
+import 'dart:io';
+
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/installment_plan.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/recurring_bill.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/providers/installment_provider.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/providers/locale_provider.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/providers/recurring_bills_provider.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/notifications/reminder_notification_backend.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/notifications/reminder_planner.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/notifications/reminder_preferences.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/notifications/reminder_service.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/salary_cycle_service.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/reminder_sync.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/settings/reminder_settings_card.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
+import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
+
+/// Records what would reach flutter_local_notifications.
+class FakeBackend implements ReminderNotificationBackend {
+  int initializeCalls = 0;
+  int cancelAllCalls = 0;
+  final scheduled = <PlannedReminder>[];
+  String? channelName;
+
+  @override
+  Future<void> initialize() async => initializeCalls++;
+
+  @override
+  Future<void> cancelAll() async {
+    cancelAllCalls++;
+    scheduled.clear();
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Future<void> schedule(PlannedReminder reminder, {required String channelName, required String channelDescription}) async {
+    this.channelName = channelName;
+    scheduled.add(reminder);
+  }
+}
+
+RecurringBillItem _bill(String merchant, int day) => RecurringBillItem(
+      merchant: merchant,
+      normalizedMerchant: merchant,
+      categoryCode: 'OPEX-UTILITIES',
+      averageAmount: 99,
+      expectedDayOfMonth: day,
+      status: 'UPCOMING',
+    );
+
+RecurringBillsSummary _summary(List<RecurringBillItem> bills) => RecurringBillsSummary(
+      cycleKey: '2026-11',
+      cycleLabel: '',
+      totalRecurringMonthly: 0,
+      paidThisCycle: 0,
+      reservedAmount: 0,
+      bills: bills,
+    );
+
+void main() {
+  // 21 Oct 2026, 10:00 Riyadh.
+  DateTime clock() => DateTime.utc(2026, 10, 21, 7);
+
+  group('ReminderService', () {
+    test('schedules the plan once and skips identical reschedules', () async {
+      final backend = FakeBackend();
+      final service = ReminderService(backend: backend, clock: clock);
+      Future<int> run() => service.reschedule(
+            householdId: 'h1',
+            paydayDay: 27,
+            bills: [_bill('SEC', 25)],
+            plans: const [],
+            enabled: {...ReminderType.values},
+            locale: const Locale('en'),
+          );
+
+      final n = await run();
+      expect(n, greaterThan(0));
+      expect(backend.scheduled.length, n);
+      expect(backend.cancelAllCalls, 1);
+      expect(backend.channelName, 'Reminders');
+      expect(backend.scheduled.map((r) => r.type).toSet(), {...ReminderType.values}..remove(ReminderType.installment));
+
+      await run();
+      expect(backend.cancelAllCalls, 1, reason: 'same plan: platform untouched');
+    });
+
+    test('a household switch, payday change or language change reschedules', () async {
+      final backend = FakeBackend();
+      final service = ReminderService(backend: backend, clock: clock);
+      Future<void> run({String hid = 'h1', int payday = 27, String lang = 'en'}) => service.reschedule(
+            householdId: hid,
+            paydayDay: payday,
+            bills: const [],
+            plans: const [],
+            enabled: {ReminderType.payday},
+            locale: Locale(lang),
+          );
+      await run();
+      await run(hid: 'h2');
+      await run(hid: 'h2', payday: 25);
+      expect(backend.scheduled.first.fireAtUtc, DateTime.utc(2026, 10, 25, 6));
+      await run(hid: 'h2', payday: 25, lang: 'ar');
+      expect(backend.cancelAllCalls, 4);
+      expect(backend.scheduled.first.title, AppLocalizations(const Locale('ar')).get('notif_payday_title'));
+    });
+
+    test('cancelAll clears everything and forgets the last plan', () async {
+      final backend = FakeBackend();
+      final service = ReminderService(backend: backend, clock: clock);
+      Future<void> run() => service.reschedule(
+            householdId: 'h1',
+            paydayDay: 27,
+            bills: const [],
+            plans: const [],
+            enabled: {ReminderType.payday},
+            locale: const Locale('en'),
+          );
+      await run();
+      await service.cancelAll();
+      expect(backend.scheduled, isEmpty);
+      expect(service.scheduled, isEmpty);
+      await run();
+      expect(backend.scheduled, isNotEmpty, reason: 'next login schedules again');
+    });
+
+    test('a failing plugin never throws to the caller', () async {
+      final service = ReminderService(backend: _ThrowingBackend(), clock: clock);
+      final n = await service.reschedule(
+        householdId: 'h1',
+        paydayDay: 27,
+        bills: const [],
+        plans: const [],
+        enabled: {ReminderType.payday},
+        locale: const Locale('en'),
+      );
+      expect(n, 0);
+      await service.cancelAll();
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('ReminderPreferences', () {
+    test('all types default on; a switch is persisted locally', () async {
+      SharedPreferences.setMockInitialValues({});
+      final prefs = ReminderPreferences();
+      await prefs.load();
+      expect(prefs.enabledTypes, {...ReminderType.values});
+      await prefs.setEnabled(ReminderType.bill, false);
+      final reloaded = ReminderPreferences();
+      await reloaded.load();
+      expect(reloaded.isEnabled(ReminderType.bill), isFalse);
+      expect(reloaded.isEnabled(ReminderType.payday), isTrue);
+      final raw = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
+      expect(raw.getBool('reminder_bill_enabled'), isFalse);
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('ReminderSync', () {
+    late FakeBackend backend;
+    late ReminderService service;
+    late ReminderPreferences prefs;
+    late RecurringBillsProvider bills;
+    late InstallmentProvider installments;
+
+    setUp(() {
+      SharedPreferences.setMockInitialValues({});
+      SalaryCycleService.paydayDay = 27;
+      backend = FakeBackend();
+      service = ReminderService(backend: backend, clock: clock);
+      prefs = ReminderPreferences();
+      bills = RecurringBillsProvider();
+      installments = InstallmentProvider();
+    });
+
+    Widget host({PaydayFetcher? fetchPayday}) => MultiProvider(
+          providers: [
+            ChangeNotifierProvider.value(value: bills),
+            ChangeNotifierProvider.value(value: installments),
+            ChangeNotifierProvider(create: (_) => LocaleProvider()),
+          ],
+          child: MaterialApp(
+            home: ReminderSync(
+              service: service,
+              preferences: prefs,
+              fetchPayday: fetchPayday ?? (_) async => 27,
+              debounce: const Duration(milliseconds: 10),
+              child: const SizedBox(),
+            ),
+          ),
+        );
+
+    testWidgets('schedules on login and again when bills or plans change', (tester) async {
+      installments.setPlansForTesting(const [], householdId: 'h1');
+      await tester.pumpWidget(host());
+      await _settle(tester);
+      expect(backend.scheduled.where((r) => r.type == ReminderType.payday), isNotEmpty);
+      expect(backend.scheduled.where((r) => r.type == ReminderType.bill), isEmpty);
+
+      bills.setSummaryForTesting(_summary([_bill('SEC', 25)]), householdId: 'h1');
+      await _settle(tester);
+      expect(backend.scheduled.where((r) => r.type == ReminderType.bill), isNotEmpty);
+
+      installments.setPlansForTesting([
+        InstallmentPlan.fromJson({
+          'id': 'p',
+          'household_id': 'h1',
+          'merchant': 'Jarir',
+          'provider': 'Tabby',
+          'total_amount': 400,
+          'installment_count': 4,
+          'monthly_amount': 100,
+          'paid_installments': 1,
+          'start_date': '2026-10-15',
+          'status': 'ACTIVE',
+          'frequency': 'biweekly',
+          'next_due_at': '2026-10-29',
+        }),
+      ], householdId: 'h1');
+      await _settle(tester);
+      expect(backend.scheduled.where((r) => r.type == ReminderType.installment).length, 3);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets("ignores another household's bills and follows the household payday", (tester) async {
+      installments.setPlansForTesting(const [], householdId: 'h2');
+      bills.setSummaryForTesting(_summary([_bill('SEC', 25)]), householdId: 'h1');
+      await tester.pumpWidget(host(fetchPayday: (_) async => 25));
+      await _settle(tester);
+      await _settle(tester);
+      expect(SalaryCycleService.paydayDay, 25);
+      expect(backend.scheduled.where((r) => r.type == ReminderType.bill), isEmpty);
+      expect(backend.scheduled.firstWhere((r) => r.type == ReminderType.payday).fireAtUtc, DateTime.utc(2026, 10, 25, 6));
+      SalaryCycleService.paydayDay = 27;
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('switching every type off cancels all reminders', (tester) async {
+      installments.setPlansForTesting(const [], householdId: 'h1');
+      await tester.pumpWidget(host());
+      await _settle(tester);
+      expect(backend.scheduled, isNotEmpty);
+      for (final t in ReminderType.values) {
+        await prefs.setEnabled(t, false);
+      }
+      await _settle(tester);
+      expect(backend.scheduled, isEmpty);
+    });
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('settings card: one switch per type, persisted, permission asked when turned on', (tester) async {
+    SharedPreferences.setMockInitialValues({});
+    final prefs = ReminderPreferences();
+    await prefs.load();
+    var asked = 0;
+    await tester.pumpWidget(MaterialApp(
+      localizationsDelegates: const [AppLocalizationsDelegate()],
+      supportedLocales: const [Locale('en')],
+      home: Scaffold(
+        body: SingleChildScrollView(
+          child: ReminderSettingsCard(
+            preferences: prefs,
+            requestPermission: () async {
+              asked++;
+              return true;
+            },
+          ),
+        ),
+      ),
+    ));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    for (final t in ReminderType.values) {
+      expect(find.byKey(ValueKey('reminder_switch_${t.name}')), findsOneWidget);
+    }
+    expect(find.text('Payday check-in'), findsOneWidget);
+
+    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const ValueKey('reminder_switch_bill')));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(prefs.isEnabled(ReminderType.bill), isFalse);
+    expect(asked, 0);
+
+    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const ValueKey('reminder_switch_bill')));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(prefs.isEnabled(ReminderType.bill), isTrue);
+    expect(asked, 1);
+  });
+
+  test('Android: small icon, boot receivers and no exact-alarm permission', () {
+    final manifest = File('android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml').readAsStringSync();
+    expect(manifest, contains('android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS'));
+    expect(manifest, contains('android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED'));
+    expect(manifest, contains('ScheduledNotificationReceiver'));
+    expect(manifest, contains('ScheduledNotificationBootReceiver'));
+    expect(manifest, isNot(contains('SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM')));
+    expect(manifest, isNot(contains('USE_EXACT_ALARM')));
+    expect(File('android/app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_stat_reminder.xml').existsSync(), isTrue);
+    final backendSrc = File('lib/services/notifications/reminder_notification_backend.dart').readAsStringSync();
+    expect(backendSrc, contains('AndroidScheduleMode.inexactAllowWhileIdle'));
+    expect(backendSrc, contains("'Asia/Riyadh'"));
+  });
+}
+
+/// Rebuild (timers start during the frame), then let the debounce fire.
+Future<void> _settle(WidgetTester tester) async {
+  await tester.pump();
+  await tester.pump(const Duration(milliseconds: 50));
+  await tester.pump(const Duration(milliseconds: 50));
+}
+
+class _ThrowingBackend implements ReminderNotificationBackend {
+  @override
+  Future<void> initialize() async => throw StateError('no plugin');
+
+  @override
+  Future<void> cancelAll() async => throw StateError('no plugin');
+
+  @override
+  Future<void> schedule(PlannedReminder reminder, {required String channelName, required String channelDescription}) async =>
+      throw StateError('no plugin');
+}

+];
+
+void main() {
+  group('MOB-13 SalaryCycleService parity with get_saudi_cycle_for_timestamp', () {
+    for (final c in _cases) {
+      test('${c.timestamptz} payday=${c.payday} -> ${c.key} (${c.note})', () {
+        final cycle = SalaryCycleService.cycleForInstant(
+          DateTime.parse(c.timestamptz),
+          paydayDay: SalaryCycleService.normalizePayday(c.payday),
+        );
+        expect(cycle.key, c.key);
+        expect(cycle.startIso, c.start);
+        expect(cycle.endIso, c.end);
+      });
+    }
+  });
+
+  group('MOB-13 cycle invariants for every day 2026-2030', () {
+    for (final payday in [1, 5, 15, 16, 25, 27, 28, 29, 30, 31]) {
+      test('payday $payday: cycles tile the calendar without gaps and keys advance monthly', () {
+        var day = DateTime.utc(2026, 1, 1);
+        SaudiCycle? previous;
+        while (day.isBefore(DateTime.utc(2031, 1, 1))) {
+          final cycle = SalaryCycleService.cycleForDate(day.year, day.month, day.day, paydayDay: payday);
+          expect(cycle.containsDate(day), isTrue, reason: '$day not inside $cycle');
+          expect(cycle.lengthInDays, inInclusiveRange(28, 31), reason: '$cycle');
+          if (previous != null && previous != cycle) {
+            expect(cycle.start, previous.end.add(const Duration(days: 1)), reason: 'gap after $previous');
+            final prevMonth = DateTime.utc(
+              int.parse(previous.key.substring(0, 4)),
+              int.parse(previous.key.substring(5)) + 1,
+            );
+            expect(cycle.key, '${prevMonth.year}-${prevMonth.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}');
+          }
+          previous = cycle;
+          day = day.add(const Duration(days: 1));
+        }
+      });
+    }
+  });
+
+  group('SalaryCycleService helpers', () {
+    test('riyadhDate ignores the device zone of the instant', () {
+      expect(SalaryCycleService.riyadhDate(DateTime.parse('2026-10-26T21:00:00Z')), DateTime.utc(2026, 10, 27));
+      expect(SalaryCycleService.riyadhDate(DateTime.parse('2026-10-27T01:00:00+05:00')), DateTime.utc(2026, 10, 26));
+    });
+
+    test('default payday is 27 and payday setter clamps', () {
+      final saved = SalaryCycleService.paydayDay;
+      SalaryCycleService.paydayDay = 99;
+      expect(SalaryCycleService.paydayDay, 31);
+      SalaryCycleService.paydayDay = saved;
+      expect(SalaryCycleService.normalizePayday(null), 27);
+    });
+
+    test('cycleKeyForInstant uses the household payday when set', () {
+      final saved = SalaryCycleService.paydayDay;
+      SalaryCycleService.paydayDay = 25;
+      expect(SalaryCycleService.cycleKeyForInstant(DateTime.parse('2026-10-25T12:00:00+03:00')), '2026-11');
+      SalaryCycleService.paydayDay = 27;
+      expect(SalaryCycleService.cycleKeyForInstant(DateTime.parse('2026-10-25T12:00:00+03:00')), '2026-10');
+      SalaryCycleService.paydayDay = saved;
+    });
+
+    test('daysUntilNextPayday counts Riyadh days to the next cycle start', () {
+      expect(
+        SalaryCycleService.daysUntilNextPayday(now: DateTime.parse('2026-10-26T12:00:00+03:00'), paydayDay: 27),
+        1,
+      );
+      expect(
+        SalaryCycleService.daysUntilNextPayday(now: DateTime.parse('2026-10-20T12:00:00+03:00'), paydayDay: 27),
+        7,
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('cycleForKey returns the dates of a cycle key for any payday', () {
+      final nov = SalaryCycleService.cycleForKey('2026-11', paydayDay: 27)!;
+      expect(nov.startIso, '2026-10-27');
+      expect(nov.endIso, '2026-11-26');
+      final jan = SalaryCycleService.cycleForKey('2027-01', paydayDay: 27)!;
+      expect(jan.startIso, '2026-12-27');
+      expect(jan.endIso, '2027-01-26');
+      final early = SalaryCycleService.cycleForKey('2026-10', paydayDay: 10)!;
+      expect(early.startIso, '2026-10-10');
+      expect(early.endIso, '2026-11-09');
+      final calendar = SalaryCycleService.cycleForKey('2027-02', paydayDay: 1)!;
+      expect(calendar.startIso, '2027-02-01');
+      expect(calendar.endIso, '2027-02-28');
+      expect(SalaryCycleService.cycleForKey('2026-11-01', paydayDay: 27)!.key, '2026-11');
+      expect(SalaryCycleService.cycleForKey('bad'), isNull);
+      // Round trip over every payday and month of a year.
+      for (var payday = 1; payday <= 31; payday++) {
+        for (var month = 1; month <= 12; month++) {
+          final key = '2027-${month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
+          expect(SalaryCycleService.cycleForKey(key, paydayDay: payday)!.key, key, reason: 'payday $payday $key');
+        }
+      }
+    });
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/services/secure_session_storage_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/services/secure_session_storage_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..bec6c28
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/services/secure_session_storage_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,151 @@
+// MOB-19: the Supabase session must live in the platform secure store, with a
+// one-time migration out of plaintext SharedPreferences.
+import 'dart:io';
+
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/secure_session_storage.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+class _MemoryStore implements SessionKeyValueStore {
+  final Map<String, String> values = {};
+  bool failWrites = false;
+  bool failReads = false;
+  bool failDeletes = false;
+  int writes = 0;
+
+  @override
+  Future<String?> read(String key) async {
+    if (failReads) throw StateError('keystore unavailable');
+    return values[key];
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Future<void> write(String key, String value) async {
+    if (failWrites) throw StateError('keystore unavailable');
+    writes++;
+    values[key] = value;
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Future<void> delete(String key) async {
+    if (failDeletes) throw StateError('keystore unavailable');
+    values.remove(key);
+  }
+}
+
+void main() {
+  TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
+
+  const key = 'sb-abcd-auth-token';
+  const sessionJson = '{"access_token":"a","refresh_token":"r"}';
+
+  late _MemoryStore secure;
+  late _MemoryStore legacy;
+  late SecureSessionLocalStorage storage;
+
+  setUp(() {
+    secure = _MemoryStore();
+    legacy = _MemoryStore();
+    storage = SecureSessionLocalStorage(
+      persistSessionKey: key,
+      secureStore: secure,
+      legacyStore: legacy,
+    );
+  });
+
+  test('uses the same key as supabase_flutter so the old session is found', () {
+    expect(
+      SecureSessionLocalStorage.sessionKeyFor('https://abcd.supabase.co'),
+      key,
+    );
+  });
+
+  test('migrates a plaintext session into secure storage and deletes it', () async {
+    legacy.values[key] = sessionJson;
+
+    await storage.initialize();
+
+    expect(secure.values[key], sessionJson);
+    expect(legacy.values.containsKey(key), isFalse);
+    expect(await storage.hasAccessToken(), isTrue);
+    expect(await storage.accessToken(), sessionJson);
+  });
+
+  test('keeps the plaintext copy when the secure write fails, so the user stays signed in', () async {
+    legacy.values[key] = sessionJson;
+    secure.failWrites = true;
+
+    await storage.initialize();
+
+    expect(legacy.values[key], sessionJson, reason: 'retry migration next start');
+    expect(await storage.accessToken(), sessionJson);
+  });
+
+  test('a stale plaintext copy is deleted when a secure session already exists', () async {
+    secure.values[key] = 'new';
+    legacy.values[key] = 'old';
+
+    await storage.initialize();
+
+    expect(await storage.accessToken(), 'new');
+    expect(legacy.values.containsKey(key), isFalse);
+    expect(secure.values[key], 'new');
+  });
+
+  test('without any stored session there is no access token', () async {
+    await storage.initialize();
+    expect(await storage.hasAccessToken(), isFalse);
+    expect(await storage.accessToken(), isNull);
+  });
+
+  test('an unreadable secure store does not crash start-up', () async {
+    secure.failReads = true;
+    await storage.initialize();
+    expect(await storage.hasAccessToken(), isFalse);
+  });
+
+  test('persistSession writes only to secure storage and clears plaintext', () async {
+    legacy.values[key] = 'old';
+    await storage.initialize();
+
+    await storage.persistSession('refreshed');
+
+    expect(secure.values[key], 'refreshed');
+    expect(legacy.values.containsKey(key), isFalse);
+    expect(await storage.accessToken(), 'refreshed');
+  });
+
+  test('persistSession never falls back to plaintext when the secure write fails', () async {
+    await storage.initialize();
+    secure.failWrites = true;
+
+    await storage.persistSession('fresh');
+
+    expect(legacy.values, isEmpty);
+    expect(await storage.accessToken(), 'fresh', reason: 'session usable for this run');
+  });
+
+  test('removePersistedSession clears both stores', () async {
+    secure.values[key] = sessionJson;
+    legacy.values[key] = sessionJson;
+    await storage.initialize();
+
+    await storage.removePersistedSession();
+
+    expect(secure.values, isEmpty);
+    expect(legacy.values, isEmpty);
+    expect(await storage.hasAccessToken(), isFalse);
+  });
+
+  test('main.dart wires the secure storage into Supabase.initialize', () {
+    final main = File('lib/main.dart').readAsStringSync();
+    expect(main, contains('localStorage: SecureSessionLocalStorage('));
+  });
+
+  test('Android minSdk satisfies flutter_secure_storage (plugin minSdk 24) and backups stay off', () {
+    final gradle = File('android/app/build.gradle.kts').readAsStringSync();
+    final minSdk = int.parse(RegExp(r'minSdk\s*=\s*(\d+)').firstMatch(gradle)!.group(1)!);
+    expect(minSdk, greaterThanOrEqualTo(24));
+    final manifest = File('android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml').readAsStringSync();
+    expect(manifest, contains('android:allowBackup="false"'));
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/services/statement_pdf_download_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/services/statement_pdf_download_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1a6bc1e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/services/statement_pdf_download_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,179 @@
+// MOB-26: the statement PDF must be fetched with the user's JWT (the firewall
+// rejects a bare URL) and handed to the OS as a file, not shown as a link.
+import 'dart:convert';
+import 'dart:io';
+import 'dart:typed_data';
+
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api/base_api_client.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api/budget_api_client.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/statement_pdf_service.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
+import 'package:http/testing.dart';
+
+final _pdfBytes = Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode('%PDF-1.4\n%fake statement\n%%EOF'));
+
+void main() {
+  group('BaseApiClient.getBinary', () {
+    test('sends the bearer token and returns the raw bytes and file name', () async {
+      http.Request? captured;
+      final client = BaseApiClient(
+        client: MockClient((request) async {
+          captured = request;
+          return http.Response.bytes(_pdfBytes, 200, headers: {
+            'content-type': 'application/pdf',
+            'content-disposition': 'attachment; filename="statement_2026-10_abcd1234.pdf"',
+          });
+        }),
+        authTokenProvider: () => 'user-jwt',
+      );
+
+      final res = await client.getBinary('/reports/statement-pdf', queryParams: {'household_id': 'h1'}, accept: 'application/pdf');
+
+      expect(captured!.headers['Authorization'], 'Bearer user-jwt');
+      expect(captured!.headers['Accept'], 'application/pdf');
+      expect(captured!.url.queryParameters['household_id'], 'h1');
+      expect(res.bytes, _pdfBytes);
+      expect(res.fileName, 'statement_2026-10_abcd1234.pdf');
+    });
+
+    test('refreshes an expired token once and replays the download', () async {
+      final tokens = <String?>[];
+      final client = BaseApiClient(
+        client: MockClient((request) async {
+          tokens.add(request.headers['Authorization']);
+          if (tokens.length == 1) return http.Response('{"detail":"expired"}', 401);
+          return http.Response.bytes(_pdfBytes, 200);
+        }),
+        authTokenProvider: () => 'old',
+        sessionRefresher: () async => 'new',
+      );
+
+      final res = await client.getBinary('/reports/statement-pdf');
+
+      expect(tokens, ['Bearer old', 'Bearer new']);
+      expect(res.bytes, _pdfBytes);
+    });
+
+    test('throws with the status code instead of returning the error body as a file', () async {
+      final client = BaseApiClient(
+        client: MockClient((_) async => http.Response('{"detail":"Untrusted endpoint access"}', 403)),
+        authTokenProvider: () => 'jwt',
+        sessionRefresher: () async => null,
+      );
+
+      expect(
+        () => client.getBinary('/reports/statement-pdf'),
+        throwsA(isA<ApiDownloadException>().having((e) => e.statusCode, 'statusCode', 403)),
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('wraps network failures', () async {
+      final client = BaseApiClient(
+        client: MockClient((_) async => throw const SocketException('offline')),
+        authTokenProvider: () => 'jwt',
+      );
+
+      expect(
+        () => client.getBinary('/reports/statement-pdf'),
+        throwsA(isA<ApiDownloadException>().having((e) => e.statusCode, 'statusCode', isNull)),
+      );
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('BudgetApiClient.downloadStatementPdf', () {
+    test('requests the household and cycle through the authenticated client', () async {
+      Uri? url;
+      final api = BudgetApiClient(
+        baseClient: BaseApiClient(
+          client: MockClient((request) async {
+            url = request.url;
+            return http.Response.bytes(_pdfBytes, 200);
+          }),
+          authTokenProvider: () => 'jwt',
+        ),
+      );
+
+      final res = await api.downloadStatementPdf('h1', cycleKey: '2026-10');
+
+      expect(url!.path, endsWith('/reports/statement-pdf'));
+      expect(url!.queryParameters, {'household_id': 'h1', 'cycle_key': '2026-10'});
+      expect(res.bytes, _pdfBytes);
+    });
+
+    test('rejects a 200 response that is not a PDF (e.g. an HTML proxy page)', () async {
+      final api = BudgetApiClient(
+        baseClient: BaseApiClient(
+          client: MockClient((_) async => http.Response('<html>login</html>', 200)),
+          authTokenProvider: () => 'jwt',
+        ),
+      );
+
+      expect(() => api.downloadStatementPdf('h1'), throwsA(isA<ApiDownloadException>()));
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('StatementPdfService', () {
+    late Directory tmp;
+
+    setUp(() async {
+      tmp = await Directory.systemTemp.createTemp('statement_pdf_test');
+    });
+
+    tearDown(() async {
+      if (await tmp.exists()) await tmp.delete(recursive: true);
+    });
+
+    test('saves the downloaded PDF, removes older statements and shares the file', () async {
+      final dir = Directory('${tmp.path}/statements');
+      await dir.create();
+      final stale = File('${dir.path}/statement_2026-09_old.pdf');
+      await stale.writeAsString('old');
+
+      String? sharedPath;
+      String? sharedName;
+      final service = StatementPdfService(
+        download: (hid, {cycleKey}) async => ApiBinaryResponse(
+          bytes: _pdfBytes,
+          contentDisposition: 'attachment; filename="statement_current_h1.pdf"',
+        ),
+        directory: () async => dir,
+        share: (path, name) async {
+          sharedPath = path;
+          sharedName = name;
+        },
+      );
+
+      final file = await service.downloadAndShare('h1');
+
+      expect(await file.readAsBytes(), _pdfBytes);
+      expect(sharedPath, file.path);
+      expect(sharedName, 'statement_current_h1.pdf');
+      expect(await stale.exists(), isFalse);
+    });
+
+    test('does not share anything when the download fails', () async {
+      var shared = false;
+      final service = StatementPdfService(
+        download: (hid, {cycleKey}) async => throw const ApiDownloadException('Forbidden', statusCode: 403),
+        directory: () async => tmp,
+        share: (path, name) async => shared = true,
+      );
+
+      await expectLater(service.downloadAndShare('h1'), throwsA(isA<ApiDownloadException>()));
+      expect(shared, isFalse);
+    });
+
+    test('sanitises the server file name', () {
+      expect(StatementPdfService.safeFileName('../../etc/passwd'), 'etcpasswd.pdf');
+      expect(StatementPdfService.safeFileName(null, cycleKey: '2026-10'), 'statement_2026-10.pdf');
+      expect(StatementPdfService.safeFileName('statement.PDF'), 'statement.PDF');
+    });
+  });
+
+  test('the transactions screen no longer exposes a bare statement URL', () {
+    final src = File('lib/screens/home/transaction_feed_screen.dart').readAsStringSync();
+    expect(src.contains('getStatementPdfUrl'), isFalse);
+    expect(src.contains('StatementPdfService'), isTrue);
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/services/support_api_client_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/services/support_api_client_test.dart

 void main() {
   test('SupportApiClient exposes postSupportChat and ApiService facade', () {
@@ -8,4 +33,83 @@ void main() {
     expect(client, isNotNull);
     expect(ApiService.instance.support, isNotNull);
   });
+
+  group('sendSupportInquiry', () {
+    test('posts the message with the user JWT and reports sent only on {"status":"sent"}', () async {
+      late http.Request captured;
+      final client = _client((request) async {

+
+    test('empty or oversized messages are rejected without a request', () async {

+      expect((await client.sendSupportInquiry(message: '   ')).outcome, SupportInquiryOutcome.invalid);

+    test('a 2xx answer without status "sent" is not a success', () async {
+      final client = _client((request) async => _json(200, {'status': 'queued'}));
+      final result = await client.sendSupportInquiry(message: 'Help');
+      expect(result.outcome, SupportInquiryOutcome.unavailable);
+    });
+
+    test('transport failures map to network', () async {
+      final client = _client((request) async => throw TimeoutException('offline'));
+      final result = await client.sendSupportInquiry(message: 'Help');
+      expect(result.outcome, SupportInquiryOutcome.network);
+    });
+  });
 }
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/services/sync_worker_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/services/sync_worker_test.dart
index 9018f6d..d86961e 100644
--- a/flutter_app/test/services/sync_worker_test.dart

 import 'package:sqflite_common_ffi/sqflite_ffi.dart';
 import 'package:budget_tracker/services/offline_queue_manager.dart';
 import 'package:budget_tracker/services/sync_worker.dart';
+import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart' show PostgrestException;
 
 void main() {

       final count = await worker.drainQueue();
       expect(count, equals(0));
 
-      // Item should still be in queue with retry_count = 1

+      expect(SyncWorker.shouldQueueAfterOnlineFailure({...err(null), 'network_error': true}), isTrue); // offline / timeout
+      expect(SyncWorker.shouldQueueAfterOnlineFailure(err(null)), isFalse); // 200 {"status": "error"}

+
+    test("the legacy firewall's 403 for an unverifiable token stays transient", () {
+      final r = SyncWorker.classifyResponse(
+        {'status': 'error', 'status_code': 403, 'message': 'Untrusted endpoint access'},
