+      );
+      expect(r.outcome, ReplayOutcome.transient);
+    });
+
+    test("another account's queued items wait for that account", () async {
+      final mine = await queueManager.enqueue(
+        operationType: 'chat',
+        payload: {'message': 'Mine 5 SAR', 'user_id': 'u-me'},
+        householdId: 'h-1',
+      );
+      final theirs = await queueManager.enqueue(
+        operationType: 'chat',
+        payload: {'message': 'Theirs 7 SAR', 'user_id': 'u-other'},
+        householdId: 'h-2',
+      );
+      final replayed = <String>[];
+      worker = SyncWorker(
+        queueManager: queueManager,
+        interItemDelay: Duration.zero,
+        currentUserId: () => 'u-me',
+        customDispatcher: (item) async {
+          replayed.add(item.id);
+          return {'status': 'success'};
+        },
+      );
+
+      expect(await worker.drainQueue(), 1);
+      expect(replayed, [mine]);
+      final pending = await queueManager.getPendingItems();
+      expect(pending.single.id, theirs);
+      expect(pending.single.retryCount, 0);
+    });
+
+    test('isPermanentInsertError separates rejections from transport failures', () {
+      PostgrestException pg(String? code) => PostgrestException(message: 'x', code: code);
+      expect(SyncWorker.isPermanentInsertError(pg('42501')), isTrue); // creator / permission trigger
+      expect(SyncWorker.isPermanentInsertError(pg('23514')), isTrue); // nafaqah pair check
+      expect(SyncWorker.isPermanentInsertError(pg('PGRST204')), isTrue); // unknown column
+      expect(SyncWorker.isPermanentInsertError(pg('23505')), isFalse); // already stored
+      expect(SyncWorker.isPermanentInsertError(pg('PGRST301')), isFalse); // expired JWT
+      expect(SyncWorker.isPermanentInsertError(pg('503')), isFalse);
+      expect(SyncWorker.isPermanentInsertError(pg(null)), isFalse);
+      expect(SyncWorker.isPermanentInsertError(Exception('socket')), isFalse);
+    });
+
+    test('a queued receipt replays with the key of the online attempt', () async {
+      String? sentKey;
+      await queueManager.enqueue(
+        operationType: 'receipt',
+        payload: {'images_base64': ['aGk=']},
+        householdId: 'h-1',
+        idempotencyKey: 'online-attempt-key',
+      );
+      worker = SyncWorker(
+        queueManager: queueManager,
+        interItemDelay: Duration.zero,
+        customDispatcher: (item) async {
+          sentKey = item.idempotencyKey;
+          return {'status': 'success'};
+        },
+      );
+      expect(await worker.drainQueue(), 1);
+      expect(sentKey, 'online-attempt-key');
+    });
   });
 }
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/support/localized_app.dart b/flutter_app/test/support/localized_app.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8b69084
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/support/localized_app.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/theme/app_themes.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_localizations/flutter_localizations.dart';
+
+/// [home] inside a MaterialApp with the app's localizations for [lang].
+Widget localizedApp(Widget home, {String lang = 'ar', bool dark = false, bool scaffold = true}) => MaterialApp(
+      locale: Locale(lang),
+      theme: dark ? AppThemes.darkTheme : AppThemes.lightTheme,
+      supportedLocales: const [Locale('en'), Locale('ar'), Locale('ur')],
+      localizationsDelegates: const [
+        AppLocalizationsDelegate(),
+        GlobalMaterialLocalizations.delegate,
+        GlobalWidgetsLocalizations.delegate,
+        GlobalCupertinoLocalizations.delegate,
+      ],
+      home: scaffold ? Scaffold(body: SingleChildScrollView(child: home)) : home,
+    );
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/theme/cairo_font_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/theme/cairo_font_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..07e04a0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/theme/cairo_font_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@
+// UX-20: Arabic and Urdu text falls back to the bundled Cairo (OFL), not to
+// the phone's book face, in both themes.
+import 'dart:io';
+
+import 'package:budget_tracker/theme/app_themes.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+void main() {
+  TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
+
+  test('Cairo 400/600/700 and its licence are bundled and declared', () {
+    final pubspec = File('pubspec.yaml').readAsStringSync();
+    expect(pubspec, contains('family: Cairo'));
+    for (final f in ['Cairo-Regular.ttf', 'Cairo-SemiBold.ttf', 'Cairo-Bold.ttf']) {
+      expect(pubspec, contains('assets/fonts/cairo/$f'));
+      expect(File('assets/fonts/cairo/$f').lengthSync(), greaterThan(50000), reason: f);
+    }
+    expect(File('assets/fonts/cairo/OFL.txt').readAsStringSync(), contains('SIL Open Font License'));
+  });
+
+  for (final mode in ['light', 'dark']) {
+    testWidgets('$mode theme: every text style falls back to Cairo', (tester) async {
+      final theme = mode == 'light' ? AppThemes.lightTheme : AppThemes.darkTheme;
+      final t = theme.textTheme;
+      for (final style in [t.bodySmall, t.bodyMedium, t.bodyLarge, t.titleMedium, t.labelLarge, t.headlineSmall]) {
+        expect(style?.fontFamilyFallback, contains('Cairo'));
+      }
+      expect(theme.appBarTheme.titleTextStyle?.fontFamilyFallback, contains('Cairo'));
+      expect(theme.navigationBarTheme.labelTextStyle?.resolve(<WidgetState>{})?.fontFamilyFallback, contains('Cairo'));
+    });
+  }
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/theme/contrast_tokens_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/theme/contrast_tokens_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..6dc234c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/theme/contrast_tokens_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,103 @@
+// UX-06 / UX-27: every text colour the theme hands out must reach WCAG AA
+// (4.5:1) on the surfaces it is drawn on, in light mode and in dark mode.
+import 'dart:io';
+
+import 'package:budget_tracker/theme/app_themes.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+double contrast(Color a, Color b) {
+  final la = a.computeLuminance();
+  final lb = b.computeLuminance();
+  final hi = la > lb ? la : lb;
+  final lo = la > lb ? lb : la;
+  return (hi + 0.05) / (lo + 0.05);
+}
+
+Future<BuildContext> _contextFor(WidgetTester tester, ThemeData theme) async {
+  late BuildContext captured;
+  await tester.pumpWidget(MaterialApp(
+    theme: theme,
+    home: Builder(builder: (context) {
+      captured = context;
+      return const SizedBox.shrink();
+    }),
+  ));
+  return captured;
+}
+
+void main() {
+  for (final mode in ['light', 'dark']) {
+    testWidgets('$mode mode: text tokens reach 4.5:1 on card, canvas and subtle surfaces', (tester) async {
+      final context = await _contextFor(tester, mode == 'light' ? AppThemes.lightTheme : AppThemes.darkTheme);
+      final surfaces = <String, Color>{
+        'card': context.cardBg,
+        'canvas': context.scaffoldBg,
+        'subtle': context.subtleCardBg,
+      };
+      final texts = <String, Color>{
+        'textPrimary': context.textPrimary,
+        'textSecondary': context.textSecondary,
+        'textMuted': context.textMuted,
+        'accentText': context.accentText,
+        'successText': context.successText,
+        'goldText': context.goldText,
+        'infoText': context.infoText,
+        'warnText': context.warnText,
+        'dangerColor': context.dangerColor,
+        // Getters that many widgets still use for text.
+        'champagneGold': context.champagneGold,
+        'iceCyan': context.iceCyan,
+        'mintNeon': context.mintNeon,
+        'electricTeal': context.electricTeal,
+        'primaryAccent': context.primaryAccent,
+      };
+      final failures = <String>[];
+      texts.forEach((name, fg) {
+        surfaces.forEach((surface, bg) {
+          final ratio = contrast(fg, bg);
+          if (ratio < 4.5) failures.add('$name on $surface: ${ratio.toStringAsFixed(2)}');
+        });
+      });
+      expect(failures, isEmpty);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('$mode mode: ink on the green fill and text on the hero gradient reach 4.5:1', (tester) async {
+      final context = await _contextFor(tester, mode == 'light' ? AppThemes.lightTheme : AppThemes.darkTheme);
+      expect(contrast(context.onAccentFill, AppThemes.success), greaterThanOrEqualTo(4.5));
+      for (final stop in context.icedHeroGradient.colors) {
+        expect(contrast(context.heroText, stop), greaterThanOrEqualTo(4.5), reason: 'hero text on $stop');
+        expect(contrast(context.heroCaption, stop), greaterThanOrEqualTo(4.5), reason: 'hero caption on $stop');
+      }
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('$mode mode: selected bottom-navigation labels reach 4.5:1', (tester) async {
+      final theme = mode == 'light' ? AppThemes.lightTheme : AppThemes.darkTheme;
+      final style = theme.navigationBarTheme.labelTextStyle!.resolve({WidgetState.selected})!;
+      final idle = theme.navigationBarTheme.labelTextStyle!.resolve(<WidgetState>{})!;
+      final bg = theme.navigationBarTheme.backgroundColor!;
+      expect(contrast(style.color!, bg), greaterThanOrEqualTo(4.5));
+      expect(contrast(idle.color!, bg), greaterThanOrEqualTo(4.5));
+    });
+  }
+
+  test('no filled green button paints white text (2.2:1 on #00C896)', () {
+    final offenders = <String>[];
+    final pattern = RegExp(
+      r'backgroundColor:\s*AppThemes\.success,\s*\n\s*foregroundColor:\s*Colors\.white',
+    );
+    for (final dir in ['lib/screens', 'lib/widgets']) {
+      for (final f in Directory(dir).listSync(recursive: true).whereType<File>()) {
+        if (!f.path.endsWith('.dart')) continue;
+        if (pattern.hasMatch(f.readAsStringSync())) offenders.add(f.path);
+      }
+    }
+    expect(offenders, isEmpty);
+  });
+
+  test('the bottom navigation does not hard-code the 4.0:1 teal', () {
+    for (final path in ['lib/screens/home/dashboard_screen.dart', 'lib/widgets/dashboard/app_bottom_nav_bar.dart']) {
+      expect(File(path).readAsStringSync().contains('0xFF008F7A'), isFalse, reason: path);
+    }
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/ui_l10n_guard_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/ui_l10n_guard_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..59d3fa9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/ui_l10n_guard_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,347 @@
+// Regression guards for localization (en / ar / ur) and hardcoded UI strings.
+//
+// 1. The three language maps in lib/l10n/app_localizations.dart must declare
+//    exactly the same keys, with the same {placeholders}.
+// 2. Arabic and Urdu values must actually be written in Arabic script
+//    (catches English text pasted into the wrong map).
+// 3. Screens and widgets must not pass string literals to user-facing text
+//    parameters (Text(...), hintText:, labelText:, tooltip:, ...).
+// 4. Every key referenced with tr('...') / trArgs('...') / trPlural('...')
+//    must exist.
+// 5. Urdu values must not contain Arabic-only letters (ي ك ى ة).
+// 6. The plural table has every CLDR form each language needs.
+import 'dart:io';
+
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+final _l10nSource = File('lib/l10n/app_localizations.dart').readAsStringSync();
+
+/// Parses `'lang': { 'key': 'value', ... }` blocks of `_localizedValues`.
+Map<String, Map<String, String>> _parseMaps() {
+  final start = _l10nSource.indexOf('_localizedValues = <String');
+  if (start < 0) throw StateError('_localizedValues map not found');
+  final lines = _l10nSource.substring(start).split('\n');
+  final maps = <String, Map<String, String>>{};
+  String? current;
+  final header = RegExp(r"^\s*'(en|ar|ur)': \{\s*$");
+  final entry = RegExp(r"^\s*'([a-z0-9_]+)'\s*:\s*'((?:[^'\\]|\\.)*)',\s*$");
+  for (final line in lines.skip(1)) {
+    if (RegExp(r'^  \};').hasMatch(line)) break;
+    final h = header.firstMatch(line);
+    if (h != null) {
+      current = h.group(1);
+      maps[current!] = {};
+      continue;
+    }
+    final e = entry.firstMatch(line);
+    if (current != null && e != null) {
+      if (maps[current]!.containsKey(e.group(1))) {
+        throw StateError('duplicate key ${e.group(1)} in $current');
+      }
+      maps[current]![e.group(1)!] = e.group(2)!;
+    }
+  }
+  return maps;
+}
+
+Set<String> _placeholders(String s) =>
+    RegExp(r'\{[a-zA-Z_]+\}').allMatches(s).map((m) => m.group(0)!).toSet();
+
+/// Reads a Dart string literal whose opening quote is at [start], honouring
+/// escapes and `${...}` interpolations (which may contain nested quotes).
+/// Returns the literal body, or null if there is no single-line literal.
+String? _readLiteral(String line, int start) {
+  if (start >= line.length) return null;
+  final quote = line[start];
+  if (quote != "'" && quote != '"') return null;
+  final buf = StringBuffer();
+  var i = start + 1;
+  while (i < line.length) {
+    final c = line[i];
+    if (c == r'\') {
+      i += 2;
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (c == r'$' && i + 1 < line.length && line[i + 1] == '{') {
+      var depth = 0;
+      while (i < line.length) {
+        if (line[i] == '{') depth++;
+        if (line[i] == '}' && --depth == 0) break;
+        i++;
+      }
+      i++;
+      continue; // interpolation content is not literal text
+    }
+    if (c == quote) return buf.toString();
+    if (c == r'$') {
+      // simple $identifier interpolation
+      i++;
+      while (i < line.length && RegExp(r'\w').hasMatch(line[i])) {
+        i++;
+      }
+      continue;
+    }
+    buf.write(c);
+    i++;
+  }
+  return null;
+}
+
+Iterable<File> _uiDartFiles() sync* {
+  for (final dir in ['lib/screens', 'lib/widgets']) {
+    yield* Directory(dir)
+        .listSync(recursive: true)
+        .whereType<File>()
+        .where((f) => f.path.endsWith('.dart'));
+  }
+}
+
+void main() {
+  late Map<String, Map<String, String>> maps;
+  setUpAll(() => maps = _parseMaps());
+
+  test('en, ar and ur maps exist and have identical key sets', () {
+    expect(maps.keys.toSet(), {'en', 'ar', 'ur'});
+    final en = maps['en']!.keys.toSet();
+    for (final lang in ['ar', 'ur']) {
+      final other = maps[lang]!.keys.toSet();
+      expect(en.difference(other), isEmpty, reason: 'keys missing in $lang');
+      expect(other.difference(en), isEmpty, reason: 'keys only in $lang');
+    }
+    expect(en.length, greaterThan(1000));
+  });
+
+  test('placeholders match across languages', () {
+    final mismatches = <String>[];
+    maps['en']!.forEach((key, enValue) {
+      for (final lang in ['ar', 'ur']) {
+        final other = maps[lang]![key]!;
+        if (!_placeholders(enValue).containsAll(_placeholders(other)) ||
+            !_placeholders(other).containsAll(_placeholders(enValue))) {
+          mismatches.add('$lang:$key');
+        }
+      }
+    });
+    expect(mismatches, isEmpty);
+  });
+
+  test('Arabic and Urdu values are written in Arabic script', () {
+    // Brand names / abbreviations that are legitimately Latin in ar/ur.
+    const allowLatin = {'pay_method_stc_pay', 'language_en', 'tib_total_vat', 'bir_vat'};
+    final arabicScript = RegExp('[؀-ۿ]');
+    final offenders = <String>[];
+    for (final lang in ['ar', 'ur']) {
+      maps[lang]!.forEach((key, value) {
+        if (!allowLatin.contains(key) && !arabicScript.hasMatch(value)) {
+          offenders.add('$lang:$key=$value');
+        }
+      });
+    }
+    expect(offenders, isEmpty);
+  });
+
+  test('Urdu values contain no Arabic-only letters (ي ك ى ة)', () {
+    // Deliberate exceptions: the Arabic endonym and the Arabic sample sentence.
+    const allowArabic = {'language_ar', 'chat_welcome'};
+    final arabicOnly = RegExp('[يكىة]');
+    final offenders = <String>[];
+    maps['ur']!.forEach((key, value) {
+      if (!allowArabic.contains(key) && arabicOnly.hasMatch(value)) {
+        offenders.add('ur:$key=$value');
+      }
+    });
+    AppLocalizations.pluralTable.forEach((key, langs) {
+      langs['ur']!.forEach((form, value) {
+        if (arabicOnly.hasMatch(value)) offenders.add('ur:$key.$form=$value');
+      });
+    });
+    expect(offenders, isEmpty, reason: offenders.join('\n'));
+  });
+
+  test('Urdu currency is riyal, never rupees', () {
+    for (final value in maps['ur']!.values) {
+      expect(RegExp('روپ(ے|یہ|ئے)').hasMatch(value), isFalse, reason: value);
+    }
+  });
+
+  test('every tr()/trArgs() key used in lib/ is defined', () {
+    final used = <String>{};
+    final keyRef = RegExp(r'''\btr(?:Args)?\(\s*['"]([a-z0-9_]+)['"]''');
+    for (final f in Directory('lib').listSync(recursive: true).whereType<File>()) {
+      if (!f.path.endsWith('.dart')) continue;
+      for (final m in keyRef.allMatches(f.readAsStringSync())) {
+        used.add(m.group(1)!);
+      }
+    }
+    final missing = used.difference(maps['en']!.keys.toSet());
+    expect(missing, isEmpty);
+  });
+
+  test('every trPlural() key used in lib/ is in the plural table', () {
+    final used = <String>{};
+    final keyRef = RegExp(r'''\btrPlural\(\s*['"]([a-z0-9_]+)['"]''');
+    for (final f in Directory('lib').listSync(recursive: true).whereType<File>()) {
+      if (!f.path.endsWith('.dart')) continue;
+      for (final m in keyRef.allMatches(f.readAsStringSync())) {
+        used.add(m.group(1)!);
+      }
+    }
+    expect(used, isNotEmpty);
+    expect(used.difference(AppLocalizations.pluralTable.keys.toSet()), isEmpty);
+  });
+
+  test('plural table: every key has the CLDR forms each language needs', () {
+    const required = {
+      'en': {'one', 'other'},
+      'ur': {'one', 'other'},
+      'ar': {'zero', 'one', 'two', 'few', 'many', 'other'},
+    };
+    final problems = <String>[];
+    AppLocalizations.pluralTable.forEach((key, langs) {
+      if (maps['en']!.containsKey(key)) problems.add('$key is also a plain key');
+      if (!langs.keys.toSet().containsAll(required.keys)) problems.add('$key lacks a language');
+      // Placeholders other than {count} must be the same in every form.
+      final extra = _placeholders(langs['en']!['other']!)..remove('{count}');
+      langs.forEach((lang, forms) {
+        final need = required[lang]!;
+        if (!forms.keys.toSet().containsAll(need)) {
+          problems.add('$lang:$key is missing forms ${need.difference(forms.keys.toSet())}');
+        }
+        if (!{...need, 'zero'}.containsAll(forms.keys)) problems.add('$lang:$key has unknown forms');
+        forms.forEach((form, value) {
+          final ph = _placeholders(value)..remove('{count}');
+          if (!ph.containsAll(extra) || !extra.containsAll(ph)) {
+            problems.add('$lang:$key.$form placeholders $ph != $extra');
+          }
+          if (lang != 'en' && !RegExp('[؀-ۿ]').hasMatch(value)) {
+            problems.add('$lang:$key.$form is not in Arabic script');
+          }
+        });
+        if (!(forms['other'] ?? '').contains('{count}')) problems.add('$lang:$key.other has no {count}');
+      });
+    });
+    expect(problems, isEmpty, reason: problems.join('\n'));
+  });
+
+  test('screens and widgets contain no hardcoded user-facing literals', () {
+    // A string literal containing letters passed straight to a user-facing
+    // text parameter. Interpolations of tr() results are fine because the
+    // literal itself then contains no letters outside `${...}`.
+    final prefixes = [
+      RegExp(r'\b(?:Text|SelectableText|Tooltip)\(\s*'),
+      RegExp(r'\b(?:hintText|labelText|helperText|errorText|tooltip|semanticLabel|semanticsLabel|suffixText|prefixText)\s*:\s*'),
+      RegExp(r'\bTab\(\s*(?:icon:[^,]*,\s*)?text:\s*'),
+      RegExp(r'\btitle:\s*'),
+    ];
+    // Endonyms (language names shown in their own script) and sample data.
+    const allowed = {'English', 'AQ5UYW1pbWkgTWFya2V0cw...'};
+    final letters = RegExp('[A-Za-z؀-ۿ]{2,}');
+    final snakeCaseKey = RegExp(r'^[a-z0-9_]+$');
+    final offenders = <String>[];
+    for (final file in _uiDartFiles()) {
+      final lines = file.readAsLinesSync();
+      for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
+        final line = lines[i];
+        if (line.trimLeft().startsWith('//')) continue;
+        for (final p in prefixes) {
+          for (final m in p.allMatches(line)) {
+            final literal = _readLiteral(line, m.end);
+            if (literal == null || allowed.contains(literal.trim())) continue;
+            // Sample ZATCA Base64 payloads shown as input hints are data.
+            if (RegExp(r'^[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{24,}\.*$').hasMatch(literal.trim())) continue;
+            // Translation keys (snake_case) used as data are fine.
+            if (snakeCaseKey.hasMatch(literal)) continue;
+            if (letters.hasMatch(literal)) offenders.add('${file.path}:${i + 1}: $literal');
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    }
+    expect(offenders, isEmpty, reason: offenders.join('\n'));
+  });
+
+  group('AppLocalizations helpers', () {
+    test('format substitutes placeholders', () {
+      final en = AppLocalizations(const Locale('en'));
+      expect(en.format('take_shot_n', {'n': 3}), 'Take Shot 3');
+      expect(en.format('no_allocations_for_cycle', {'cycle': 'November 2026'}), 'No allocations for November 2026');
+    });
+
+    test('Arabic plural categories follow CLDR (0 / 1 / 2 / 3-10 / 11-99 / 100+)', () {
+      String ar(num n) => AppLocalizations.pluralCategory('ar', n);
+      expect(ar(0), 'zero');
+      expect(ar(1), 'one');
+      expect(ar(2), 'two');
+      for (final n in [3, 7, 10, 103, 110, 1005]) {
+        expect(ar(n), 'few', reason: '$n');
+      }
+      for (final n in [11, 25, 99, 111, 1099]) {
+        expect(ar(n), 'many', reason: '$n');
+      }
+      for (final n in [100, 101, 102, 200, 1000]) {
+        expect(ar(n), 'other', reason: '$n');
+      }
+      expect(ar(2.5), 'other');
+    });
+
+    test('English and Urdu plural categories are one / other', () {
+      for (final lang in ['en', 'ur']) {
+        expect(AppLocalizations.pluralCategory(lang, 1), 'one');
+        for (final n in [0, 2, 3, 11, 100]) {
+          expect(AppLocalizations.pluralCategory(lang, n), 'other', reason: '$lang $n');
+        }
+      }
+    });
+
+    test('plural picks the right Arabic noun form for each count', () {
+      final ar = AppLocalizations(const Locale('ar'));
+      expect(ar.plural('items_count', 0), 'لا توجد بنود');
+      expect(ar.plural('items_count', 1), 'بند واحد');
+      expect(ar.plural('items_count', 2), 'بندان');
+      expect(ar.plural('items_count', 3), '3 بنود');
+      expect(ar.plural('items_count', 10), '10 بنود');
+      expect(ar.plural('items_count', 11), '11 بنداً');
+      expect(ar.plural('items_count', 100), '100 بند');
+      expect(ar.plural('days_to_payday_badge', 5), '5 أيام على الراتب');
+      expect(ar.plural('days_to_payday_badge', 12), '12 يوماً على الراتب');
+      expect(ar.plural('n_months', 2), 'شهران');
+      expect(ar.plural('n_months', 12), '12 شهراً');
+      expect(
+        ar.plural('scan_items_logged', 4, {'merchant': 'بنده', 'amount': '20.00 ر.س'}),
+        'تم تسجيل 4 بنود لدى بنده (20.00 ر.س)',
+      );
+    });
+
+    test('plural works for English and Urdu, including optional zero forms', () {
+      final en = AppLocalizations(const Locale('en'));
+      expect(en.plural('across_accounts', 1), 'across 1 account');
+      expect(en.plural('across_accounts', 3), 'across 3 accounts');
+      expect(en.plural('across_accounts', 0), 'across 0 accounts');
+      expect(en.plural('days_to_payday_badge', 0), 'PAYDAY TODAY');
+      expect(en.plural('transactions_count', 1), '1 transaction');
+      expect(en.plural('transactions_count', 4), '4 transactions');
+      final ur = AppLocalizations(const Locale('ur'));
+      expect(ur.plural('queued_offline', 1), '1 لین دین آف لائن محفوظ ہے');
+      expect(ur.plural('queued_offline', 5), '5 لین دین آف لائن محفوظ ہیں');
+      expect(ur.plural('no_such_plural_key', 2), 'no_such_plural_key');
+    });
+
+    test('sar puts the unit on the locale-appropriate side', () {
+      expect(AppLocalizations(const Locale('en')).sar(1250), 'SAR 1,250.00');
+      expect(AppLocalizations(const Locale('ar')).sar(1250), '1,250.00 ر.س');
+      expect(AppLocalizations(const Locale('ur')).sar(1250.5, decimals: 0), '1,251 ریال');
+    });
+
+    test('cycleMonth formats cycle keys and falls back gracefully', () {
+      final en = AppLocalizations(const Locale('en'));
+      expect(en.cycleMonth('2026-11'), 'November 2026');
+      expect(en.cycleMonth('bad', fallback: 'Fallback'), 'Fallback');
+    });
+
+    test('missing keys fall back to English, then to the key', () {
+      expect(AppLocalizations(const Locale('ur')).get('nav_dashboard'), isNot('nav_dashboard'));
+      expect(AppLocalizations(const Locale('ar')).get('no_such_key_xyz'), 'no_such_key_xyz');
+    });
+  });
+}

diff --git a/flutter_app/test/widgets/account_deficit_action_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/widgets/account_deficit_action_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ac23581
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/widgets/account_deficit_action_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,72 @@
+// UX-22: the deficit action is an amber outlined "cover the shortfall" button
+// (not a full-width solid red, destructive-looking one), and riyal amounts go
+// through the riyal formatter ("700.00 ر.س", not "SAR 700.00" in Arabic).
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/account.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/accounts/account_card.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_localizations/flutter_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+Widget _app(Account account, double committed, Locale locale) => MaterialApp(
+      localizationsDelegates: const [
+        AppLocalizationsDelegate(),
+        GlobalMaterialLocalizations.delegate,
+        GlobalWidgetsLocalizations.delegate,
+        GlobalCupertinoLocalizations.delegate,
+      ],
+      supportedLocales: const [Locale('en'), Locale('ar'), Locale('ur')],
+      locale: locale,
+      home: Scaffold(
+        body: SingleChildScrollView(
+          child: AccountCard(account: account, committedBudgets: committed, householdId: 'hh-1'),
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+
+const _stc = Account(
+  id: 'acc-2',
+  householdId: 'hh-1',
+  ownerUserId: 'u-1',
+  name: 'STC Pay',
+  accountType: AccountType.eWallet,
+  balance: 500.0,
+);
+
+void main() {
+  testWidgets('Arabic deficit: amber outlined cover action, riyal amounts', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_app(_stc, 1200, const Locale('ar')));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+    final action = find.byKey(const Key('account_cover_deficit'));
+    expect(action, findsOneWidget);
+    expect(tester.widget(action), isA<OutlinedButton>());
+    expect(find.text('تحويل سريع لتغطية العجز (700.00 ر.س)'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('500.00 ر.س'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.textContaining('SAR'), findsNothing);
+    expect(find.byType(ElevatedButton), findsNothing, reason: 'no solid red button');
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('English deficit keeps the quick-transfer wording', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_app(_stc, 1200, const Locale('en')));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('Quick transfer to cover the shortfall (SAR 700.00)'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.textContaining('Deficit: -SAR 700.00'), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('a crypto account keeps its own currency', (tester) async {
+    const binance = Account(
+      id: 'acc-3',
+      householdId: 'hh-1',
+      ownerUserId: 'u-1',
+      name: 'Binance',
+      accountType: AccountType.crypto,
+      currency: 'USDT',
+      balance: 100.0,
+    );
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_app(binance, 0, const Locale('ar')));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    // The shared formatter (UX-10): the code after the number in Arabic, like "ر.س".
+    expect(find.text('100.00 USDT'), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/widgets/account_transfer_permissions_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/widgets/account_transfer_permissions_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..4738782
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/widgets/account_transfer_permissions_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,85 @@
+// Shared-pool withdrawals are admin-only (DB-16); members' transactions by
+// others show as read-only (DB-18).
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/account.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/accounts/account_transfer_sheet.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/transaction_item_breakdown_card.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+const _accounts = [
+  Account(id: 'pool', householdId: 'hh', ownerUserId: 'p', name: 'Flat Pool', accountType: AccountType.sharedPool, balance: 900, isSharedPool: true),
+  Account(id: 'bank', householdId: 'hh', ownerUserId: 'm', name: 'My Bank', accountType: AccountType.bank, balance: 300),
+  Account(id: 'cash', householdId: 'hh', ownerUserId: 'm', name: 'My Cash', accountType: AccountType.cash, balance: 50),
+];
+
+Future<void> _pumpSheet(WidgetTester tester, {required bool isAdmin, required String userId}) async {
+  await tester.binding.setSurfaceSize(const Size(1200, 1600));
+  addTearDown(() => tester.binding.setSurfaceSize(null));
+  await tester.pumpWidget(MaterialApp(
+    home: Scaffold(
+      body: AccountTransferSheet(
+        householdId: 'hh',
+        isAdmin: isAdmin,
+        currentUserId: userId,
+        loadAccounts: (_) async => _accounts,
+      ),
+    ),
+  ));
+  await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+}
+
+List<String?> _sourceIds(WidgetTester tester) {
+  final source = tester.widgetList<DropdownButton<String>>(find.byType(DropdownButton<String>)).first;
+  return source.items!.map((i) => i.value).toList();
+}
+
+void main() {
+  testWidgets('a member cannot pick the shared pool as the source', (tester) async {
+    await _pumpSheet(tester, isAdmin: false, userId: 'm');
+    expect(_sourceIds(tester), ['bank', 'cash']);
+    expect(find.text('Shared pools are hidden: only admins can move money out of them.'), findsOneWidget);
+
+    // The pool stays available as a destination (paying dues into it).
+    final destination = tester.widgetList<DropdownButton<String>>(find.byType(DropdownButton<String>)).last;
+    expect(destination.items!.map((i) => i.value), contains('pool'));
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('an admin may move money out of the shared pool', (tester) async {
+    await _pumpSheet(tester, isAdmin: true, userId: 'p');
+    expect(_sourceIds(tester), contains('pool'));
+    expect(find.text('Shared pools are hidden: only admins can move money out of them.'), findsNothing);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets("another member's transaction shows a lock note instead of edit/delete", (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(const MaterialApp(
+      home: Scaffold(
+        body: SingleChildScrollView(
+          child: TransactionItemBreakdownCard(
+            merchant: 'Panda',
+            amount: 40,
+            initiallyExpanded: true,
+            lockedNote: 'Added by another member · only admins can change it',
+          ),
+        ),
+      ),
+    ));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('Added by another member · only admins can change it'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.byIcon(Icons.lock_outline_rounded), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.byIcon(Icons.edit_outlined), findsNothing);
+    expect(find.byIcon(Icons.delete_outline), findsNothing);
+  });
+
+  // FABLE2-APP-07: a negative fee was accepted and credited the source account.
+  testWidgets('a negative transfer fee is refused with a message', (tester) async {
+    await _pumpSheet(tester, isAdmin: true, userId: 'p');
+    await tester.enterText(find.widgetWithText(TextField, 'Transfer Amount'), '100');
+    await tester.enterText(find.widgetWithText(TextField, 'Transfer Fee (Optional)'), '-5');
+    await tester.pump();
+    await tester.ensureVisible(find.text('Confirm & Transfer'));
+    await tester.tap(find.text('Confirm & Transfer'));
+    await tester.pump();
+    expect(find.text('The transfer fee must be zero or a positive amount.'), findsOneWidget);
+    await tester.pump(const Duration(seconds: 5));
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/widgets/accounts_summary_card_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/widgets/accounts_summary_card_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..058e4cb
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/widgets/accounts_summary_card_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,103 @@
+import 'dart:async';
+
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/account.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/account_service.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/dashboard/accounts_summary_card.dart';
+
+class FakeAccountService extends AccountService {
+  final StreamController<List<Account>> _controller = StreamController<List<Account>>.broadcast();
+
+  @override
+  Stream<List<Account>> streamAccounts(String householdId) => _controller.stream;
+
+  @override
+  Future<List<Account>> getAccounts(String householdId) async => [];
+
+  void emit(List<Account> accounts) {
+    _controller.add(accounts);
+  }
+
+  void close() {
+    _controller.close();
+  }
+}
+
+void main() {
+  group('AccountsSummaryCard Widget Tests', () {
+    late FakeAccountService fakeService;
+
+    setUp(() {
+      fakeService = FakeAccountService();
+      AccountService.instance = fakeService;
+    });
+
+    tearDown(() {
+      fakeService.close();
+      AccountService.instance = AccountService();
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('Initializes with subscription, renders data on emit, and disposes cleanly', (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(
+        const MaterialApp(
+          localizationsDelegates: [AppLocalizationsDelegate()],
+          home: Scaffold(
+            body: AccountsSummaryCard(householdId: 'test-household-id'),
+          ),
+        ),
+      );
+      await tester.pump();
+
+      // Initially empty accounts list returns SizedBox.shrink()
+      expect(find.byType(AccountsSummaryCard), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(find.text('Accounts & Liquidity'), findsNothing);
+
+      // Emit account data from the stream
+      fakeService.emit([
+        const Account(
+          id: 'acc-1',
+          householdId: 'test-household-id',
+          ownerUserId: 'u-1',
+          name: 'Al Rajhi Main',
+          accountType: AccountType.bank,
+          balance: 15400.0,
+        ),
+      ]);
+      await tester.pump();
+
+      // Card is now rendered with total liquidity
+      expect(find.text('Accounts & Balances'), findsOneWidget);
+      // Shown twice: the total-liquidity headline (one Text.rich so the
+      // unit can sit on the locale-appropriate side) and the account pill.
+      expect(find.text('SAR 15,400.00'), findsNWidgets(2));
+      expect(find.text('Al Rajhi Main'), findsOneWidget);
+
+      // Verify clean unmount / cancellation of StreamSubscription without throwing
+      await tester.pumpWidget(const MaterialApp(home: Scaffold(body: SizedBox())));
+      await tester.pump();
+      expect(find.byType(AccountsSummaryCard), findsNothing);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('minAccounts hides the card on the dashboard until there are two accounts', (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(
+        const MaterialApp(
+          localizationsDelegates: [AppLocalizationsDelegate()],
+          home: Scaffold(body: AccountsSummaryCard(householdId: 'h', minAccounts: 2)),
+        ),
+      );
+      await tester.pump();
+      const one = Account(id: 'a1', householdId: 'h', ownerUserId: 'u', name: 'Cash', accountType: AccountType.cash, balance: 100);
+      const two = Account(id: 'a2', householdId: 'h', ownerUserId: 'u', name: 'STC Pay', accountType: AccountType.eWallet, balance: 50);
+      fakeService.emit([one]);
+      await tester.pump();
+      expect(find.text('Accounts & Balances'), findsNothing);
+      fakeService.emit([one, two]);
+      await tester.pump();
+      await tester.pump();
+      expect(find.text('Accounts & Balances'), findsOneWidget);
+    });
+  });
+}
+
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/widgets/affordability_advice_l10n_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/widgets/affordability_advice_l10n_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..480b79f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/widgets/affordability_advice_l10n_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,63 @@
+// UX-21: affordability verdicts come from AppLocalizations in en / ar / ur and
+// amounts go through the riyal formatter, never inline "SAR x.x" strings.
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/simulator/affordability_simulator_sheet.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+String _advice(String lang, Map<String, dynamic> res) =>
+    affordabilityAdvice(AppLocalizations(Locale(lang)), res);
+
+const _comfortable = {
+  'verdict': 'comfortable',
+  'post_purchase_remaining': 7400.0,
+  'days_to_payday': 6,
+  'current_daily_allowance': 1300.0,
+  'post_purchase_daily_allowance': 1233.333,
+  // The server's own en/ar sentences are not shown any more.
+  'advice_en': '✅ Yes! You have SAR 400.0 remaining',
+  'advice_ar': '✅ نعم، بكل أريحية!',
+};
+
+void main() {
+  test('comfortable: remaining and days, in all three languages', () {
+    expect(_advice('en', _comfortable), "Fits your budget. You'll still have SAR 7,400.00 until payday (6 days).");
+    expect(_advice('ar', _comfortable), 'ضمن ميزانيتك. سيبقى لديك 7,400.00 ر.س حتى الراتب (6 أيام).');
+    expect(_advice('ur', _comfortable), contains('7,400.00'));
+    expect(_advice('ur', _comfortable), isNot(contains('SAR')));
+  });
+
+  test('caution: the daily amount before and after, through the formatter', () {
+    final res = {..._comfortable, 'verdict': 'caution'};
+    expect(
+      _advice('en', res),
+      'Affordable only by moving money from flexible budgets: your daily amount until payday drops from SAR 1,300.00 to SAR 1,233.33.',
+    );
+    expect(_advice('ar', res), contains('من 1,300.00 ر.س إلى 1,233.33 ر.س'));
+  });
+
+  test('unaffordable: wait for payday or pay in installments', () {
+    final res = {..._comfortable, 'verdict': 'unaffordable', 'days_to_payday': 1};
+    expect(_advice('en', res), 'More than your flexible budgets can cover. Consider waiting 1 day until payday or paying in installments.');
+    expect(_advice('ar', res), 'أكثر مما تغطيه ميزانياتك المرنة. يُفضّل الانتظار يوم واحد حتى الراتب أو التقسيط.');
+  });
+
+  test('invalid price', () {
+    expect(_advice('en', {'verdict': 'invalid'}), 'Enter a price above zero.');
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('the offline estimate shows the localized advice', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(const MaterialApp(
+      localizationsDelegates: [AppLocalizationsDelegate()],
+      supportedLocales: [Locale('en'), Locale('ar'), Locale('ur')],
+      locale: Locale('en'),
+      home: Scaffold(body: AffordabilitySimulatorSheet(defaultItem: 'iPad', defaultAmount: 1200, defaultCategory: 'OPEX-SHOPPING')),
+    ));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    await tester.tap(find.text('Simulate Purchase'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    // No budgets loaded: the offline estimate cannot cover it.
+    expect(find.textContaining('More than your flexible budgets can cover'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.textContaining('SAR 0.0 '), findsNothing);
+  });
+}

diff --git a/flutter_app/test/widgets/budget_hero_card_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/widgets/budget_hero_card_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..7be4d35
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/widgets/budget_hero_card_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,148 @@
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/household_dues.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/models.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/salary_cycle_service.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/dashboard/budget_hero_card.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_localizations/flutter_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+Budget _budget(String code, double allocated, double spent) => Budget.fromMap({
+      'id': code,
+      'household_id': 'hh',
+      'month': '2026-11-01',
+      'category_code': code,
+      'allocated_amount': allocated,
+      'spent_amount': spent,
+      'remaining_amount': allocated - spent,
+      'cycle_key': '2026-11',
+    });
+
+Widget _host(
+  List<Budget> budgets,
+  DateTime now, {
+  double? income,
+  List<DueLine> dues = const [],
+  VoidCallback? onDueTap,
+  Locale locale = const Locale('en'),
+}) =>
+    MaterialApp(
+      localizationsDelegates: const [
+        AppLocalizationsDelegate(),
+        GlobalMaterialLocalizations.delegate,
+        GlobalWidgetsLocalizations.delegate,
+        GlobalCupertinoLocalizations.delegate,
+      ],
+      supportedLocales: const [Locale('en'), Locale('ar'), Locale('ur')],
+      locale: locale,
+      home: Scaffold(
+        body: SingleChildScrollView(
+          child: BudgetHeroCard(
+            budgets: budgets,
+            now: now,
+            monthlyIncome: income,
+            dueLines: dues,
+            onDueTap: onDueTap,
+          ),
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+
+/// Every verdict the hero can give; exactly one is ever on screen.
+const _verdictPrefixes = ['On track for payday', 'At this pace the money runs out', 'Over by'];
+
+int _verdictCount(WidgetTester tester) =>
+    _verdictPrefixes.fold(0, (n, p) => n + tester.widgetList(find.textContaining(p)).length);
+
+void main() {
+  setUp(() => SalaryCycleService.paydayDay = 27);
+
+  testWidgets('UX-07: one verdict, one daily figure — the run-out forecast', (tester) async {
+    // 6 Nov (Riyadh): day 11 of the 27 Oct – 26 Nov cycle; 2,200 spent → 200/day;
+    // 800 left lasts 4 more days → runs out around 10 Nov, before payday.
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_host([_budget('OPEX-DINING', 3000, 2200)], DateTime.utc(2026, 11, 6, 9)));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('At this pace the money runs out around 10 Nov'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(_verdictCount(tester), 1);
+    // The only daily figure: 800 over the 21 days left.
+    expect(find.text('SAR 38 a day until payday'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.textContaining('/d'), findsNothing, reason: 'no second (burn-rate) daily figure');
+    expect(find.textContaining('Projected'), findsNothing, reason: 'no second verdict');
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('on track while the money lasts until payday', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_host([_budget('OPEX-DINING', 3000, 500)], DateTime.utc(2026, 11, 6, 9)));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('On track for payday'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(_verdictCount(tester), 1);
+    expect(find.textContaining('run out'), findsNothing);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('income-based: left until payday is income minus spending', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_host(
+      [_budget('OPEX-DINING', 3000, 2200)],
+      DateTime.utc(2026, 11, 6, 9),
+      income: 12000,
+    ));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('Left until payday'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('9,800.00'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('of SAR 12,000 income'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('On track for payday'), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('overspent: one "over by" verdict and no daily figure', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_host([_budget('OPEX-SHOPPING', 1000, 1310)], DateTime.utc(2026, 11, 6, 9)));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('Over by SAR 310.00 this cycle'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(_verdictCount(tester), 1);
+    expect(find.textContaining('a day until payday'), findsNothing);
+    expect(find.text('131% Spent'), findsOneWidget, reason: 'not clamped to 100%');
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('family mode: "Owed to Sara" line, tappable', (tester) async {
+    var taps = 0;
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_host(
+      [_budget('OPEX-GROCERY', 3000, 500)],
+      DateTime.utc(2026, 11, 6, 9),
+      dues: const [DueLine(kind: DueKind.owedToWife, name: 'Sara', amount: 386.4)],
+      onDueTap: () => taps++,
+    ));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('Owed to Sara: SAR 386.40'), findsOneWidget);
+    await tester.tap(find.text('Owed to Sara: SAR 386.40'));
+    expect(taps, 1);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('family mode in Arabic: مستحق لـسارة', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_host(
+      [_budget('OPEX-GROCERY', 3000, 500)],
+      DateTime.utc(2026, 11, 6, 9),
+      dues: const [DueLine(kind: DueKind.owedToWife, name: 'سارة', amount: 386.4)],
+      locale: const Locale('ar'),
+    ));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('مستحق لـسارة: 386.40 ر.س'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('المتبقي حتى الراتب'), findsNothing, reason: 'no income: budget-based label');
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('roommates: my balance with each roommate (UX-16)', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_host(
+      [_budget('OPEX-GROCERY', 3000, 500)],
+      DateTime.utc(2026, 11, 6, 9),
+      dues: const [
+        DueLine(kind: DueKind.iOwe, name: 'Faisal', amount: 198.67),
+        DueLine(kind: DueKind.owedByRoommate, name: 'Imran', amount: 50),
+      ],
+    ));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('You owe Faisal SAR 198.67'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('Imran owes you SAR 50.00'), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('no dues line when nothing is owed', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_host([_budget('OPEX-GROCERY', 3000, 500)], DateTime.utc(2026, 11, 6, 9)));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.textContaining('Owed to'), findsNothing);
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/widgets/card_error_states_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/widgets/card_error_states_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..49b491b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/widgets/card_error_states_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,288 @@
+// UX-01 / UX-25: an API failure is an error with a retry, never an empty or
+// positive state ("all installments paid", a vanished Nafaqah card, the
+// first-time bills set-up). Loading, empty and error are distinct.
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/installment_plan.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/models.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/nafaqah.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/recurring_bill.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/providers/budget_provider.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/providers/installment_provider.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/providers/recurring_bills_provider.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/providers/transaction_provider.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api/base_api_client.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api/budget_api_client.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api_service.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/card_error_state.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/dashboard/family_reimbursement_card.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/dashboard/household_balances_section.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/dashboard/installment_plans_card.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/dashboard/recurring_bills_card.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
+
+const _networkError = {'status': 'error', 'message': 'Connection refused', 'network_error': true};
+
+class _FakeBase extends BaseApiClient {
+  Map<String, dynamic> response = _networkError;
+
+  @override
+  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> get(String path,
+          {Map<String, dynamic>? queryParams, Duration timeout = const Duration(seconds: 15)}) async =>
+      response;
+}
+
+/// A budget client whose list calls fail until [failing] is cleared.
+class _FakeBudgetApi extends BudgetApiClient {
+  bool failing = true;
+  int billCalls = 0;
+  int planCalls = 0;
+  List<InstallmentPlan> plans = const [];
+
+  @override
+  Future<RecurringBillsSummary> fetchRecurringBills({required String householdId, String? asOfDate}) async {
+    billCalls++;
+    if (failing) throw const ApiRequestException('Connection refused');
+    return const RecurringBillsSummary(
+      cycleKey: '2026-11',
+      cycleLabel: '',
+      totalRecurringMonthly: 350,
+      paidThisCycle: 0,
+      reservedAmount: 350,
+      bills: [
+        RecurringBillItem(
+          merchant: 'Saudi Electricity Co.',
+          normalizedMerchant: 'saudi electricity co.',
+          categoryCode: 'OPEX-UTILITIES',
+          subCode: 'electricity',
+          averageAmount: 350,
+          expectedDayOfMonth: 28,
+          status: 'UPCOMING',
+        ),
+      ],
+    );
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Future<List<InstallmentPlan>> fetchInstallments({required String householdId}) async {
+    planCalls++;
+    if (failing) throw const ApiRequestException('Connection refused');
+    return plans;
+  }
+}
+
+InstallmentPlan _plan({String status = 'ACTIVE', int paid = 1}) => InstallmentPlan(
+      id: 'p1',
+      householdId: 'hh',
+      merchant: 'eXtra',
+      provider: 'Tamara',
+      totalAmount: 1200,
+      installmentCount: 4,
+      monthlyAmount: 300,
+      paidInstallments: paid,
+      dayOfMonth: 27,
+      startDate: '2026-10-01',
+      status: status,
+    );
+
+Widget _app(Widget child, {List<ChangeNotifierProvider> providers = const []}) {
+  final app = MaterialApp(
+    localizationsDelegates: const [AppLocalizationsDelegate()],
+    supportedLocales: const [Locale('en'), Locale('ar'), Locale('ur')],
+    locale: const Locale('en'),
+    home: Scaffold(body: SingleChildScrollView(child: child)),
+  );
+  return providers.isEmpty ? app : MultiProvider(providers: providers, child: app);
+}
+
+void main() {
+  group('API clients report failures instead of empty results', () {
+    test('recurring bills: an error answer throws', () async {
+      final client = BudgetApiClient(baseClient: _FakeBase());
+      expect(() => client.fetchRecurringBills(householdId: 'hh'), throwsA(isA<ApiRequestException>()));
+    });
+
+    test('installments: an error answer throws; an empty answer is an empty list', () async {
+      final base = _FakeBase();
+      final client = BudgetApiClient(baseClient: base);
+      expect(() => client.fetchInstallments(householdId: 'hh'), throwsA(isA<ApiRequestException>()));
+      base.response = {'status': 'success', 'plans': []};
+      expect(await client.fetchInstallments(householdId: 'hh'), isEmpty);
+    });
+
+    test('settlement v2: an error answer throws instead of a "standard" summary', () async {
+      final client = BudgetApiClient(baseClient: _FakeBase());
+      expect(() => client.fetchSettlementV2(householdId: 'hh'), throwsA(isA<ApiRequestException>()));
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('providers keep the error', () {
+    test('installments: a failure is an error, not an empty list from a fallback', () async {
+      final fake = _FakeBudgetApi();
+      final provider = InstallmentProvider(api: ApiService(budget: fake));
+      await provider.init('hh');
+      expect(provider.error, isNotNull);
+      expect(provider.hasLoaded, isFalse);
+
+      fake
+        ..failing = false
+        ..plans = [_plan()];
+      await provider.fetchPlans();
+      expect(provider.error, isNull);
+      expect(provider.hasLoaded, isTrue);
+      expect(provider.plans, hasLength(1));
+
+      // A later failure keeps the last plans and says they are stale.
+      fake.failing = true;
+      await provider.fetchPlans(silent: true);
+      expect(provider.error, isNotNull);
+      expect(provider.plans, hasLength(1));
+      expect(provider.lastUpdated, isNotNull);
+    });
+
+    test('recurring bills: a failure keeps no summary and an error', () async {
+      final fake = _FakeBudgetApi();
+      final provider = RecurringBillsProvider(api: ApiService(budget: fake));
+      await provider.init('hh');
+      expect(provider.error, isNotNull);
+      expect(provider.summary, isNull);
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('cards', () {
+    testWidgets('recurring bills: error with retry, not the first-time set-up', (tester) async {
+      final fake = _FakeBudgetApi();
+      final bills = RecurringBillsProvider(api: ApiService(budget: fake));
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_app(
+        const RecurringBillsCard(householdId: 'hh'),
+        providers: [
+          ChangeNotifierProvider<RecurringBillsProvider>.value(value: bills),
+          ChangeNotifierProvider<TransactionProvider>.value(value: TransactionProvider()),
+          ChangeNotifierProvider<BudgetProvider>.value(value: BudgetProvider()),
+        ],
+      ));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+      expect(find.byType(CardErrorState), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(find.text("Couldn't load your recurring bills. Check your connection."), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(find.text('Configure'), findsNothing, reason: 'the set-up state is for a household without bills');
+
+      fake.failing = false;
+      await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('card_error_retry')));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      expect(find.byType(CardErrorState), findsNothing);
+      expect(find.text('Saudi Electricity Co.'), findsOneWidget);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('installments: error with retry, never "all installments cleared"', (tester) async {
+      final fake = _FakeBudgetApi();
+      final plans = InstallmentProvider(api: ApiService(budget: fake));
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_app(
+        InstallmentPlansCard(householdId: 'hh', now: DateTime.utc(2026, 10, 21, 9)),
+        providers: [
+          ChangeNotifierProvider<InstallmentProvider>.value(value: plans),
+          ChangeNotifierProvider<TransactionProvider>.value(value: TransactionProvider()),
+        ],
+      ));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+      expect(find.byType(CardErrorState), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(find.text("Couldn't load your installments. Check your connection."), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(find.text('All installments cleared'), findsNothing);
+      expect(find.text('No Active BNPL Installments'), findsNothing);
+
+      fake
+        ..failing = false
+        ..plans = [_plan()];
+      await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('card_error_retry')));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      expect(find.byType(CardErrorState), findsNothing);
+      expect(find.text('eXtra'), findsOneWidget);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('UX-25: no plans reads "No installments"; all paid reads "all cleared"', (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_app(const InstallmentPlansCard(plans: [])));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      expect(find.text('No installments'), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(find.text('All installments cleared'), findsNothing);
+
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_app(InstallmentPlansCard(plans: [_plan(status: 'COMPLETED', paid: 4)])));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      expect(find.text('All installments cleared'), findsOneWidget);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('Nafaqah card: a failed load shows the card title, the error and a retry', (tester) async {
+      var fail = true;
+      NafaqahSummary? reported;
+      Future<NafaqahSummary> loader(String hid) async {
+        if (fail) throw const NafaqahApiException('network', 'down');
+        return NafaqahSummary.fromMap({
+          'mode': 'family_nafaqah',
+          'caller_role': 'husband',
+          'caller_user_id': 'u-h',
+          'cycle_key': '2026-11',
+          'wives': [
+            {
+              'id': 'u-w',
+              'display_name': 'Sara',
+              'reimbursement': {'gross_advanced': 686.4, 'reimbursed': 300, 'outstanding': 386.4},
+              'allowance': {'is_set': true, 'allocated': 1000, 'spent': 645, 'remaining': 355},
+            }
+          ],
+        });
+      }
+
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_app(FamilyReimbursementCard(
+        householdId: 'hh',
+        loadSummary: loader,
+        onSummaryLoaded: (s) => reported = s,
+      )));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      expect(find.byType(CardErrorState), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(find.text('Family Expenses & Nafaqah'), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(find.text("Couldn't load what is owed to the wife. Check your connection."), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(reported, isNull);
+
+      fail = false;
+      await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('card_error_retry')));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      expect(find.byType(CardErrorState), findsNothing);
+      expect(find.text('SAR 386.40'), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(reported?.wives.single.reimbursement.outstanding, 386.4);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('balances: a failed settlement load is an error card, not a silent family card', (tester) async {
+      var fail = true;
+      Future<SettlementV2Summary> loadSettlement(String hid) async {
+        if (fail) throw const ApiRequestException('down');
+        return const SettlementV2Summary(mode: 'multi_roommate');
+      }
+
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_app(HouseholdBalancesSection(
+        householdId: 'hh',
+        loadSettlement: loadSettlement,
+      )));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      expect(find.byType(CardErrorState), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(find.text("Couldn't load household balances. Check your connection."), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(find.byType(FamilyReimbursementCard), findsNothing);
+
+      fail = false;
+      await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('card_error_retry')));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      expect(find.byType(CardErrorState), findsNothing);
+      expect(find.text('All Settled'), findsWidgets);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('error state shows the last update time when stale data exists', (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_app(CardErrorBanner(
+        lastUpdated: DateTime(2026, 10, 21, 21, 40),
+        onRetry: () {},
+      )));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      expect(find.textContaining("Couldn't refresh"), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(find.textContaining('9:40 PM'), findsOneWidget);
+    });
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/widgets/chat_language_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/widgets/chat_language_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..12557c2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/widgets/chat_language_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,58 @@
+// UX-18 / UX-19: chat copy in the app language only, and one 48 dp voice
+// language control instead of three 25 dp pills.
+import 'dart:io';
+
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/chat/voice_language_button.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+import '../support/localized_app.dart';
+
+final _latin = RegExp('[A-Za-z]');
+
+void main() {
+  test('the welcome text and examples match the language (no English inside Arabic or Urdu)', () {
+    for (final lang in ['ar', 'ur']) {
+      final l = AppLocalizations(Locale(lang));
+      expect(_latin.hasMatch(l.get('chat_welcome')), isFalse, reason: '$lang welcome');
+      for (final key in chatExampleKeys) {
+        expect(_latin.hasMatch(l.get(key)), isFalse, reason: '$lang $key: ${l.get(key)}');
+      }
+    }
+    final en = AppLocalizations(const Locale('en'));
+    for (final key in chatExampleKeys) {
+      expect(RegExp('[؀-ۿ]').hasMatch(en.get(key)), isFalse, reason: 'en $key');
+    }
+  });
+
+  test('the chat screen has no hard-coded example messages', () {
+    final src = File('lib/screens/chat/chat_entry_screen.dart').readAsStringSync();
+    expect(src.contains('Can I buy a 1200 SAR iPad?'), isFalse);
+    expect(src.contains('Dunkin 19 SAR'), isFalse);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('one voice-language control, 48 dp, offering the three languages', (tester) async {
+    var chosen = 'ar_SA';
+    await tester.pumpWidget(localizedApp(
+      StatefulBuilder(
+        builder: (context, setState) => VoiceLanguageButton(
+          localeId: chosen,
+          onChanged: (v) => setState(() => chosen = v),
+        ),
+      ),
+      lang: 'ar',
+    ));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    final button = find.byType(VoiceLanguageButton);
+    expect(tester.getSize(button).height, greaterThanOrEqualTo(48));
+    await expectLater(tester, meetsGuideline(androidTapTargetGuideline));
+    await tester.tap(button);
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('English'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('اردو'), findsOneWidget);
+    await tester.tap(find.text('English'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(chosen, 'en_US');
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/widgets/dashboard_text_scale_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/widgets/dashboard_text_scale_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b268820
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/widgets/dashboard_text_scale_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,270 @@
+// UX-14: the dashboard survives 160% system text (common among older users):
+// no overflow, values never truncated to "…7,100".
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/household_dues.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/household_setup.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/installment_plan.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/models.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/nafaqah.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/recurring_bill.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/providers/budget_provider.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/providers/recurring_bills_provider.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/providers/transaction_provider.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/salary_cycle_service.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/dashboard/app_bottom_nav_bar.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/card_error_state.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/dashboard/budget_hero_card.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/dashboard/family_reimbursement_card.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/dashboard/category_budget_card.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/dashboard/household_setup_card.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/dashboard/installment_plans_card.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/dashboard/multi_roommate_settlement_card.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/dashboard/over_budget_alerts.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/dashboard/recurring_bills_card.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_localizations/flutter_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
+
+Budget _b(String code, double allocated, double spent) => Budget.fromMap({
+      'id': code,
+      'household_id': 'hh',
+      'month': '2026-11-01',
+      'category_code': code,
+      'allocated_amount': allocated,
+      'spent_amount': spent,
+      'remaining_amount': allocated - spent,
+      'cycle_key': '2026-11',
+    });
+
+final _budgets = [
+  _b('OPEX-GROCERY', 12000, 7100),
+  _b('OPEX-SHOPPING', 1000, 1310),
+  _b('OPEX-DINING', 800, 920),

+
+Widget _phone(Widget child, {Locale locale = const Locale('ar'), double scale = 1.6}) {
+  final bills = RecurringBillsProvider()
+    ..setSummaryForTesting(
+      const RecurringBillsSummary(
+        cycleKey: '2026-11',
+        cycleLabel: '',
+        totalRecurringMonthly: 4350,
+        paidThisCycle: 350,

+            averageAmount: 4000,
+            expectedDayOfMonth: 1,
+            status: 'UPCOMING',
+          ),

+      ),
+      householdId: 'hh',
+    );
+  return MultiProvider(
+    providers: [
+      ChangeNotifierProvider<RecurringBillsProvider>.value(value: bills),
+      ChangeNotifierProvider<TransactionProvider>.value(value: TransactionProvider()),
+      ChangeNotifierProvider<BudgetProvider>.value(value: BudgetProvider()),
+    ],
+    child: MaterialApp(
+      localizationsDelegates: const [
+        AppLocalizationsDelegate(),
+        GlobalMaterialLocalizations.delegate,
+        GlobalWidgetsLocalizations.delegate,
+        GlobalCupertinoLocalizations.delegate,
+      ],
+      supportedLocales: const [Locale('en'), Locale('ar'), Locale('ur')],
+      locale: locale,
+      builder: (context, app) => MediaQuery(
+        data: MediaQuery.of(context).copyWith(textScaler: TextScaler.linear(scale)),
+        child: app!,
+      ),
+      home: Scaffold(
+        body: SingleChildScrollView(
+          child: Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20), child: child),
+        ),
+      ),
+    ),
+  );
+}
+
+void main() {
+  setUp(() => SalaryCycleService.paydayDay = 27);
+
+  Future<void> pumpPhone(WidgetTester tester, Widget child, {Locale locale = const Locale('ar')}) async {
+    tester.view.physicalSize = const Size(390 * 2, 844 * 2);
+    tester.view.devicePixelRatio = 2;
+    addTearDown(tester.view.reset);
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_phone(child, locale: locale));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+  }
+
+  for (final locale in const [Locale('ar'), Locale('en'), Locale('ur')]) {
+    testWidgets('hero at 160% text (${locale.languageCode}): no overflow, tiles stacked, values whole', (tester) async {
+      await pumpPhone(
+        tester,
+        BudgetHeroCard(
+          budgets: _budgets,
+          monthlyIncome: 18000,
+          now: DateTime.utc(2026, 11, 6, 9),
+          dueLines: const [DueLine(kind: DueKind.owedToWife, name: 'سارة', amount: 386.4)],
+          onDueTap: () {},
+        ),
+        locale: locale,
+      );
+      expect(tester.takeException(), isNull);
+      // Stacked: the two tiles share no row.
+      final tiles = find.byWidgetPredicate((w) => w.runtimeType.toString() == '_StatCapsule');
+      expect(tiles, findsNWidgets(2));
+      expect(tester.getTopLeft(tiles.at(0)).dy, lessThan(tester.getTopLeft(tiles.at(1)).dy));

+
+  testWidgets('hero at normal text keeps the tiles side by side', (tester) async {
+    tester.view.physicalSize = const Size(390 * 2, 844 * 2);

+    addTearDown(tester.view.reset);
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_phone(BudgetHeroCard(budgets: _budgets, now: DateTime.utc(2026, 11, 6, 9)), scale: 1.0));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    final tiles = find.byWidgetPredicate((w) => w.runtimeType.toString() == '_StatCapsule');
+    expect(tester.getTopLeft(tiles.at(0)).dy, tester.getTopLeft(tiles.at(1)).dy);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('category card, over-budget alerts and installments at 160% text', (tester) async {
+    await pumpPhone(
+      tester,
+      Column(
+        children: [
+          OverBudgetAlerts(budgets: _budgets, onShowAll: () {}),
+          CategoryBudgetCard(budget: _budgets[1], householdId: 'hh'),
+          InstallmentPlansCard(
+            now: DateTime.utc(2026, 10, 21, 9),
+            plans: [
+              InstallmentPlan(
+                id: 'p',
+                householdId: 'hh',
+                merchant: 'United Electronics Co. eXtra',
+                provider: 'Tamara',
+                totalAmount: 7408,
+                installmentCount: 4,
+                monthlyAmount: 1852,
+                paidInstallments: 1,
+                dayOfMonth: 27,
+                startDate: '2026-10-01',
+                status: 'ACTIVE',
+              ),
+            ],
+          ),
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+    expect(tester.takeException(), isNull);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('recurring bills, roommates and setup cards at 160% text', (tester) async {
+    await pumpPhone(
+      tester,
+      Column(
+        children: [
+          const RecurringBillsCard(householdId: 'hh'),
+          const MultiRoommateSettlementCard(
+            householdId: 'hh',
+            currentUserId: 'a',
+            summary: SettlementV2Summary(
+              mode: 'multi_roommate',
+              simplifiedDebts: [
+                SimplifiedDebt(fromId: 'a', toId: 'b', fromName: 'أحمد', toName: 'فيصل', amount: 198.67),
+              ],
+            ),
+          ),
+          HouseholdSetupCard(
+            householdId: 'hh',
+            data: HouseholdSetupData(
+              paydayDay: 27,
+              monthlyIncome: 0,
+              roster: HouseholdRoster.fromMap({
+                'household_id': 'hh',
+                'household_type': 'family',
+                'caller_role': 'admin',
+                'members': [
+                  {'user_id': 'u', 'role': 'admin', 'is_self': true},
+                ],
+              }),
+            ),
+            hasBudgets: false,
+            onChanged: () {},
+          ),
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+    expect(tester.takeException(), isNull);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('Nafaqah card and an error card at 160% text', (tester) async {
+    await pumpPhone(
+      tester,
+      Column(
+        children: [
+          FamilyReimbursementCard(
+            householdId: 'hh',
+            summary: NafaqahSummary.fromMap({
+              'mode': 'family_nafaqah',
+              'caller_role': 'husband',
+              'caller_user_id': 'u-h',
+              'can_record_reimbursement': true,
+              'can_set_allowance': true,
+              'cycle_key': '2026-11',
+              'wives': [
+                {
+                  'id': 'u-w',
+                  'display_name': 'سارة',
+                  'reimbursement': {'gross_advanced': 686.4, 'reimbursed': 300, 'outstanding': 386.4},
+                  'allowance': {'is_set': true, 'allocated': 1000, 'spent': 645, 'remaining': 355},
+                }
+              ],
+            }),
+          ),
+          CardErrorState(title: 'x', message: 'y', onRetry: () {}),
+          CardErrorBanner(lastUpdated: DateTime(2026, 10, 21, 21, 40), onRetry: () {}),
+        ],
+      ),
+    );
+    expect(tester.takeException(), isNull);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('bottom navigation at 160% text: icons only, no overflow', (tester) async {
+    tester.view.physicalSize = const Size(390 * 2, 844 * 2);
+    tester.view.devicePixelRatio = 2;
+    addTearDown(tester.view.reset);
+    var selected = 0;
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_phone(
+      StatefulBuilder(
+        builder: (context, setState) => AppBottomNavBar(
+          selectedIndex: selected,
+          onSelected: (i) => setState(() => selected = i),
+        ),
+      ),
+    ));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(tester.takeException(), isNull);
+    expect(find.text('الرئيسية'), findsNothing, reason: 'labels hidden above 1.3×');
+    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('nav_item_3')));
+    await tester.pump();
+    expect(selected, 3);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('bottom navigation at normal text shows the labels', (tester) async {
+    tester.view.physicalSize = const Size(390 * 2, 844 * 2);
+    tester.view.devicePixelRatio = 2;
+    addTearDown(tester.view.reset);
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_phone(AppBottomNavBar(selectedIndex: 0, onSelected: (_) {}), scale: 1.0, locale: const Locale('en')));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('Dashboard'), findsOneWidget);
