+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/widgets/dispose_on_unmount_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/widgets/dispose_on_unmount_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..987877e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/widgets/dispose_on_unmount_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,88 @@
+// UI-20: TextEditingControllers created for dialogs must be disposed, but only
+// after the dialog's exit animation (disposing right after `await showDialog`
+// makes the still-animating TextField use a disposed controller).
+import 'dart:io';
+
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/dispose_on_unmount.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+bool _isDisposed(ChangeNotifier n) {
+  try {
+    n.addListener(() {});
+    return false;
+  } on FlutterError {
+    return true;
+  }
+}
+
+void main() {
+  testWidgets('controllers outlive the exit animation and are disposed afterwards', (tester) async {
+    final ctrl = TextEditingController();
+    String? submitted;
+
+    await tester.pumpWidget(
+      MaterialApp(
+        home: Builder(
+          builder: (context) => Scaffold(
+            body: TextButton(
+              onPressed: () async {
+                final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
+                  context: context,
+                  builder: (ctx) => DisposeOnUnmount(
+                    disposables: [ctrl],
+                    child: AlertDialog(
+                      content: TextField(controller: ctrl),
+                      actions: [
+                        TextButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true), child: const Text('OK')),
+                      ],
+                    ),
+                  ),
+                );
+                // Reading right after the pop, as several call sites do.
+                if (ok == true) submitted = ctrl.text;
+              },
+              child: const Text('open'),
+            ),
+          ),
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+
+    await tester.tap(find.text('open'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    await tester.enterText(find.byType(TextField), 'Groceries');
+    await tester.tap(find.text('OK'));
+
+    // Mid exit animation: the TextField still renders and the controller is alive.
+    await tester.pump();
+    await tester.pump(const Duration(milliseconds: 50));
+    expect(submitted, 'Groceries');
+    expect(_isDisposed(ctrl), isFalse);
+    expect(tester.takeException(), isNull);
+
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.byType(AlertDialog), findsNothing);
+    expect(_isDisposed(ctrl), isTrue);
+    expect(tester.takeException(), isNull);
+  });
+
+  test('dialog controllers in screens and widgets are handed to DisposeOnUnmount', () {
+    // Controllers stored in State lists and disposed in State.dispose.
+    const ownedByState = {'lib/widgets/sub_budget_allocation_dialog.dart:ctrl'};
+    final local = RegExp(r'^    final (\w+) = TextEditingController\(', multiLine: true);
+    final offenders = <String>[];
+    for (final entity in Directory('lib').listSync(recursive: true)) {
+      if (entity is! File || !entity.path.endsWith('.dart')) continue;
+      final src = entity.readAsStringSync();
+      for (final m in local.allMatches(src)) {
+        final name = m.group(1)!;
+        final path = entity.path.replaceAll(r'\', '/');
+        if (ownedByState.contains('$path:$name')) continue;
+        final handedOver = RegExp(r'disposables: \[[^\]]*\b' + name + r'\b').hasMatch(src);
+        if (!handedOver) offenders.add('$path: $name');
+      }
+    }
+    expect(offenders, isEmpty);
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/widgets/doubled_plus_guard_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/widgets/doubled_plus_guard_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..2472637
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/widgets/doubled_plus_guard_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+// UX-24: a "+" icon next to a label that starts with "+" shows the plus twice.
+import 'dart:io';
+
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+void main() {
+  test('no label is built as "+ <translated text>"', () {
+    final offenders = <String>[];
+    for (final dir in ['lib/screens', 'lib/widgets']) {
+      for (final f in Directory(dir).listSync(recursive: true).whereType<File>()) {
+        if (!f.path.endsWith('.dart')) continue;
+        final lines = f.readAsLinesSync();
+        for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
+          if (RegExp(r"""['"]\+ \$\{context\.tr""").hasMatch(lines[i])) offenders.add('${f.path}:${i + 1}');
+        }
+      }
+    }
+    expect(offenders, isEmpty);
+  });
+
+  test('no translated button label starts with "+"', () {
+    for (final lang in ['en', 'ar', 'ur']) {
+      final l = AppLocalizations(Locale(lang));
+      for (final key in ['hmc_add_member', 'add_installment_plan']) {
+        expect(l.get(key).trimLeft().startsWith('+'), isFalse, reason: '$lang $key');
+      }
+    }
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/widgets/edit_transaction_attribution_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/widgets/edit_transaction_attribution_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1f4864d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/widgets/edit_transaction_attribution_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,229 @@
+// FABLE2-APP-01 / FABLE2-APP-02: the edit sheet writes who paid and for whom
+// in the columns the settlement engine reads (spent_by relative to the
+// creator, beneficiary_type / beneficiary_id, and a manual row's note tail),
+// never the non-existent paid_by / beneficiary columns, and never rewrites an
+// attribution the user did not change. Ported from the reviewer's probe
+// (fable2/edit_sheet_attribution_probe_test.dart); each case checks the row
+// the server would read after the update.
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/models.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/nafaqah.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/transaction_attribution.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/screens/home/edit_transaction_sheet.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+const _a = 'aaaaaaaa-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a';
+const _b = 'bbbbbbbb-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b';
+const _c = 'cccccccc-0000-4000-8000-00000000000c';
+
+Map<String, dynamic> _row(Map<String, dynamic> fields) => {
+      'id': 'tx-1',
+      'household_id': 'h1',
+      'amount': 300.0,
+      'currency': 'SAR',
+      'merchant': 'Dinner',
+      'category_code': 'OPEX-DINING',
+      'timestamp': '2026-10-20T18:00:00Z',
+      'created_at': '2026-10-20T18:00:01Z',
+      'user_id': _a,
+      ...fields,
+    };
+
+HouseholdRoster _roster(List<String> ids, {String? provider, List<String> wives = const []}) => HouseholdRoster(
+      householdId: 'h1',
+      nafaqahProviderUserId: provider,
+      members: [
+        for (final id in ids)
+          HouseholdMember(userId: id, financialRole: wives.contains(id) ? 'spouse' : (provider == null ? 'peer' : 'family_member')),
+      ],
+    );
+
+/// Pumps the sheet, optionally taps [taps] (in order), saves and returns the
+/// values written plus the row as the server reads it afterwards.
+Future<({List<Map<String, dynamic>> writes, Map<String, dynamic> after})> _editAndSave(
+  WidgetTester tester,
+  Map<String, dynamic> row, {
+  String viewer = _a,
+  HouseholdRoster? roster,
+  List<String> deps = const [],
+  List<String> taps = const [],
+  String? merchant,
+  NafaqahSummary nafaqah = const NafaqahSummary(mode: 'not_family'),
+}) async {
+  final writes = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
+  await tester.binding.setSurfaceSize(const Size(900, 2400));
+  addTearDown(() => tester.binding.setSurfaceSize(null));
+  await tester.pumpWidget(MaterialApp(
+    home: Scaffold(
+      body: SingleChildScrollView(
+        child: EditTransactionSheet(
+          transaction: Transaction.fromMap(row),
+          householdDependents: deps,
+          nafaqah: nafaqah,
+          loadNafaqahFields: (_) async => {'nafaqah_class': null, 'nafaqah_spouse_id': null},
+          currentUserId: () => viewer,
+          loadRoster: roster == null ? null : (_) async => roster,
+          updateRow: (id, values) async => writes.add(Map<String, dynamic>.from(values)),
+        ),
+      ),
+    ),
+  ));
+  await tester.pump();
+  await tester.pump();
+  if (merchant != null) await tester.enterText(find.byType(TextField).first, merchant);
+  for (final label in taps) {
+    await tester.ensureVisible(find.text(label).first);
+    await tester.tap(find.text(label).first);
+    await tester.pump();
+  }
+  await tester.ensureVisible(find.text('Save Changes'));
+  await tester.tap(find.text('Save Changes'));
+  await tester.pump();
+  await tester.pump(const Duration(milliseconds: 100));
+  return (writes: writes, after: {...row, if (writes.isNotEmpty) ...writes.last});
+}
+
+void main() {
+  void expectNoFakeColumns(List<Map<String, dynamic>> writes) {
+    for (final w in writes) {
+      expect(w.containsKey('paid_by'), isFalse);
+      expect(w.containsKey('beneficiary'), isFalse);
+    }
+  }
+
+  testWidgets('case 1: a merchant-only edit keeps a manual roommate row paid by another member', (tester) async {
+    final row = _row({
+      'source': 'manual', 'spent_by': 'both', 'beneficiary_type': 'all_peers', 'beneficiary_id': 'all_peers',
+      'raw_sms': 'Manual: Dinner | PaidBy: $_b | Beneficiary: all_peers | SpentBy: both',
+    });
+    final r = await _editAndSave(tester, row, merchant: 'Dinner at Najd');
+
+    expect(r.writes, hasLength(1), reason: 'one update, no note-only retry');
+    expectNoFakeColumns(r.writes);
+    expect(r.writes.single['merchant'], 'Dinner at Najd');
+    expect(r.writes.single.containsKey('spent_by'), isFalse);
+    expect(r.writes.single.containsKey('raw_sms'), isFalse);
+    expect(storedPayerRef(r.after), _b, reason: 'B still paid');
+    expect(r.after['beneficiary_id'], 'all_peers');
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('case 2: a manual personal row (B for B) changed to shared keeps B as payer', (tester) async {
+    final row = _row({
+      'source': 'manual', 'spent_by': 'me', 'beneficiary_type': 'individual', 'beneficiary_id': _b,
+      'raw_sms': 'Manual: Coffee | PaidBy: $_b | Beneficiary: $_b | SpentBy: me',
+    });
+    final r = await _editAndSave(tester, row, taps: ['Both (Shared)'],
+        roster: _roster([_a, _b, _c]));
+
+    expectNoFakeColumns(r.writes);
+    final w = r.writes.single;
+    expect(w['beneficiary_type'], 'household');
+    expect(w['beneficiary_id'], 'household');
+    expect(w['spent_by'], 'partner');
+    expect(storedPayerRef(r.after), _b);
+    final tail = manualTailPattern.firstMatch(w['raw_sms'] as String)!;
+    expect(tail.group(1), _b);
+    expect(tail.group(2), 'household');
+    expect((w['raw_sms'] as String).startsWith('Manual: Coffee | PaidBy:'), isTrue);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('case 3: a legacy chat row edited without touching attribution is still read the same way', (tester) async {
+    final row = _row({
+      'source': 'chat', 'spent_by': 'me', 'beneficiary_type': 'household', 'beneficiary_id': null,
+      'category_code': 'OPEX-GROCERY', 'merchant': 'Panda',
+      'raw_sms': 'Chat: Panda | PaidBy: me | Beneficiary: me | Items: [1x Panda (50 SAR)]',
+    });
+    final r = await _editAndSave(tester, row, merchant: 'Panda Hyper');
+
+    expectNoFakeColumns(r.writes);
+    expect(r.writes.single.keys, isNot(contains('raw_sms')), reason: 'tags appended after Items were dropped by the server');
+    expect(r.writes.single.keys, isNot(contains('beneficiary_id')));
+    expect(storedPayerRef(r.after), 'me');
+    expect(legacyAuditTags(r.after['raw_sms'] as String)['beneficiary'], 'me');
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('case 3b: confirming the same choices on a legacy row writes them structurally', (tester) async {
+    final row = _row({
+      'source': 'chat', 'spent_by': 'me', 'beneficiary_id': null, 'category_code': 'OPEX-GROCERY', 'merchant': 'Panda',
+      'raw_sms': 'Chat: Panda | PaidBy: me | Beneficiary: me | Items: [1x Panda (50 SAR)]',
+    });
+    final r = await _editAndSave(tester, row, taps: ['I Paid', 'Me (Solo)']);
+
+    final w = r.writes.single;
+    expect(w['spent_by'], 'me');
+    expect(w['beneficiary_type'], 'individual');
+    expect(w['beneficiary_id'], _a);
+    expect(w.containsKey('raw_sms'), isFalse, reason: 'API rows: attribution lives in the columns only');
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('case 4: a structured chat row changed to "partner" updates beneficiary_id', (tester) async {
+    final row = _row({
+      'source': 'chat', 'spent_by': 'me', 'beneficiary_type': 'individual', 'beneficiary_id': _a,
+      'raw_sms': 'Chat: X | PaidBy: me | Beneficiary: me',
+    });
+    final r = await _editAndSave(tester, row, taps: ['Partner'], roster: _roster([_a, _b]));
+
+    final w = r.writes.single;
+    expect(w['spent_by'], 'me');
+    expect(w['beneficiary_type'], 'individual');
+    expect(w['beneficiary_id'], _b, reason: 'the other member of a two-member household');
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('FABLE2-APP-02: a dependent beneficiary saves with a valid spent_by', (tester) async {
+    final row = _row({
+      'source': 'chat', 'spent_by': 'me', 'merchant': 'Jarir', 'category_code': 'OPEX-SHOPPING', 'amount': 50.0,
+      'raw_sms': 'Chat: Jarir | PaidBy: me | Beneficiary: both | Items: [1x Jarir (50 SAR)]',
+    });
+    final r = await _editAndSave(tester, row, deps: const ['Sarah'], taps: ['Sarah']);
+
+    expect(r.writes, hasLength(1));
+    expectNoFakeColumns(r.writes);
+    final w = r.writes.single;
+    expect(w['spent_by'], 'me', reason: "spent_by is 'me' | 'partner', never a name (CHECK constraint)");
+    expect(w['beneficiary_type'], 'dependent');
+    expect(w['beneficiary_id'], 'Sarah');
+    expect(find.text('Save Changes'), findsNothing, reason: 'saved and closed');
+  });
+
+  testWidgets("the partner editing the creator's row: 'I paid' is stored relative to the creator", (tester) async {
+    final row = _row({
+      'source': 'chat', 'spent_by': 'me', 'beneficiary_type': 'household', 'beneficiary_id': 'household',
+      'raw_sms': 'Chat: Dinner | PaidBy: me | Beneficiary: both',
+    });
+    final r = await _editAndSave(tester, row, viewer: _b, taps: ['I Paid'], roster: _roster([_a, _b]));
+
+    final w = r.writes.single;
+    expect(w['spent_by'], 'partner', reason: 'B paid, and B is the partner of the creator A');
+    expect(w['beneficiary_id'], 'household');
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('a third member cannot re-attribute a row whose "partner" is unknown', (tester) async {
+    final row = _row({
+      'source': 'chat', 'spent_by': 'me', 'beneficiary_type': 'household', 'beneficiary_id': 'household',
+      'raw_sms': 'Chat: Dinner | PaidBy: me | Beneficiary: both',
+    });
+    final r = await _editAndSave(tester, row, viewer: _c, taps: ['The other person paid'], roster: _roster([_a, _b, _c]));
+
+    expect(r.writes, isEmpty);
+    expect(find.textContaining('another member recorded this expense'), findsOneWidget);
+    await tester.pump(const Duration(seconds: 5));
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('family: the husband marking the wife as payer stores her as the creator\'s partner', (tester) async {
+    final row = _row({
+      'source': 'chat', 'spent_by': 'me', 'beneficiary_type': 'household', 'beneficiary_id': 'household',
+      'category_code': 'OPEX-GROCERY', 'raw_sms': 'Chat: Panda | PaidBy: me | Beneficiary: both',
+    });
+    const summary = NafaqahSummary(
+      mode: 'family_nafaqah', callerRole: 'husband', callerUserId: _a, husbandId: _a,
+      wives: [NafaqahWife(id: _b)],
+    );
+    final r = await _editAndSave(tester, row, nafaqah: summary, taps: ['My wife paid for the home — I pay her back']);
+
+    final w = r.writes.single;
+    expect(w['nafaqah_class'], kWifeReimbursable);
+    expect(w['nafaqah_spouse_id'], _b);
+    expect(w['spent_by'], 'partner');
+    expect(w['beneficiary_type'], 'household');
+  });
+}

+    Future<void> pumpWithSeams(

+        home: Scaffold(
+          body: SingleChildScrollView(

+    testWidgets('an edit refused by the guard is explained and not retried another way', (tester) async {

+      await tester.enterText(find.byType(TextField).at(1), '100');
+      await tester.ensureVisible(find.text('Save Changes'));

+      expect(writes, hasLength(1), reason: 'the raw_sms fallback would be refused the same way');

+      await tester.pump(const Duration(seconds: 5));
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('a delete refused by the guard is explained', (tester) async {
+      var deletes = 0;

+      });
+
+      await tester.tap(find.byTooltip('Delete Transaction'));

+
+      expect(deletes, 1);
+      expect(find.textContaining('the husband has already repaid part of the wife'), findsOneWidget);
+      await tester.pump(const Duration(seconds: 5));
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('a classification refused for a missing provider is explained', (tester) async {

+      });

+      await tester.ensureVisible(find.text('Save Changes'));
+      await tester.tap(find.text('Save Changes'));
+      await tester.pump();
+      await tester.pump(const Duration(milliseconds: 100));
+
+      expect(find.textContaining('no Nafaqah provider (husband) yet'), findsOneWidget);
+      await tester.pump(const Duration(seconds: 5));
+    });
+  });

+  testWidgets('roommate/partner households keep the shared-split preview', (tester) async {
+    await pumpSheet(tester, groceries(), const NafaqahSummary(mode: 'not_family'));

+    expect(find.text('Who paid, and for whom?'), findsNothing);

+    expect(find.text('Shared 50/50: Partner will owe you SAR 150.00'), findsOneWidget);
+  });
 }

diff --git a/flutter_app/test/widgets/household_roles_card_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/widgets/household_roles_card_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..7445364
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/widgets/household_roles_card_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,391 @@
+// Members & admins section of household settings (DB-16 / DB-18): admins
+// promote/revoke co-admins, only the primary admin transfers primary admin,
+// co-admins get no action against the primary admin, refusals are explained.
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/household_membership.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/nafaqah.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api/base_api_client.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api/household_roles_api_client.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/settings/household_roles_card.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_localizations/flutter_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+Widget _app(Widget child, {String lang = 'en'}) => MaterialApp(
+      locale: Locale(lang),
+      supportedLocales: const [Locale('en'), Locale('ar'), Locale('ur')],
+      localizationsDelegates: const [
+        AppLocalizationsDelegate(),
+        GlobalMaterialLocalizations.delegate,
+        GlobalWidgetsLocalizations.delegate,
+        GlobalCupertinoLocalizations.delegate,
+      ],
+      home: Scaffold(body: SingleChildScrollView(child: child)),
+    );
+
+HouseholdRoster _roster({required String self, bool canManage = false, bool canTransfer = false, String? coAdmin}) {
+  HouseholdMember m(String id, String name, String role, {bool primary = false}) =>
+      HouseholdMember(userId: id, displayName: name, role: role, isPrimary: primary, isSelf: id == self);
+  return HouseholdRoster(
+    householdId: 'hh',
+    primaryAdminUserId: 'p',
+    canManageAdmins: canManage,
+    canTransferPrimary: canTransfer,
+    members: [
+      m('p', 'Ali', 'admin', primary: true),
+      m('c', 'Saad', coAdmin == 'c' ? 'admin' : 'member'),
+      m('m', 'Majed', 'member'),
+    ],
+  );
+}
+
+/// A family: primary admin (adult son), the husband, the wife.
+HouseholdRoster _family({
+  required String self,
+  String? provider = 'h',
+  bool canSet = false,
+}) {
+  HouseholdMember m(String id, String name, String role, String fin, {bool primary = false}) => HouseholdMember(
+        userId: id,
+        displayName: name,
+        role: role,
+        financialRole: fin,
+        isPrimary: primary,
+        isSelf: id == self,
+        isNafaqahProvider: id == provider,
+      );
+  return HouseholdRoster(
+    householdId: 'hh',
+    primaryAdminUserId: 's',
+    canManageAdmins: canSet,
+    nafaqahProviderUserId: provider,
+    canSetNafaqahProvider: canSet,
+    members: [
+      m('s', 'Fahad', 'admin', 'family_member', primary: true),
+      m('h', 'Ahmed', 'member', 'provider'),
+      m('w', 'Sara', 'member', 'spouse'),
+    ],
+  );
+}
+
+Finder _menuOf(String userId) => find.descendant(
+      of: find.byKey(ValueKey('role-member-$userId')),
+      matching: find.byIcon(Icons.more_vert_rounded),
+    );
+
+void main() {
+  testWidgets('a member sees the roles but no actions', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_app(HouseholdRolesCard(
+      householdId: 'hh',
+      loadRoster: (_) async => _roster(self: 'm'),
+    )));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+    expect(find.text('Members & Admins'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('Primary admin'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('Majed (You)'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.byIcon(Icons.more_vert_rounded), findsNothing);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('a co-admin manages members but has no action on the primary admin', (tester) async {
+    final calls = <String>[];
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_app(HouseholdRolesCard(
+      householdId: 'hh',
+      loadRoster: (_) async => _roster(self: 'c', canManage: true, coAdmin: 'c'),
+      promote: (hh, uid) async {
+        calls.add('promote:$uid');
+        return _roster(self: 'c', canManage: true, coAdmin: 'c');
+      },
+    )));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+    expect(_menuOf('p'), findsNothing);
+    await tester.tap(_menuOf('m'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('Make admin'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('Make primary admin'), findsNothing);
+    await tester.tap(find.text('Make admin'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(calls, ['promote:m']);
+    expect(find.text('Roles updated'), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('the primary admin transfers primary admin after confirming', (tester) async {
+    final calls = <String>[];
+    var changed = 0;
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_app(HouseholdRolesCard(
+      householdId: 'hh',
+      loadRoster: (_) async => _roster(self: 'p', canManage: true, canTransfer: true),
+      transferPrimary: (hh, uid) async {
+        calls.add('transfer:$uid');
+        return _roster(self: 'p', canManage: true);
+      },
+      onRolesChanged: () => changed++,
+    )));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+    expect(_menuOf('p'), findsNothing, reason: 'no action on oneself as primary');
+    await tester.tap(_menuOf('m'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    await tester.tap(find.text('Make primary admin'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('Transfer primary admin?'), findsOneWidget);
+    await tester.tap(find.text('Transfer'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(calls, ['transfer:m']);
+    expect(changed, 1);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('a server refusal is explained and nothing changes', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_app(HouseholdRolesCard(
+      householdId: 'hh',
+      loadRoster: (_) async => _roster(self: 'p', canManage: true, canTransfer: true, coAdmin: 'c'),
+      revoke: (hh, uid) async => throw const HouseholdRolesApiException('forbidden', 'Forbidden', statusCode: 403),
+    )));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+    await tester.tap(_menuOf('c'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    await tester.tap(find.text('Remove admin'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text("You don't have permission to change this role."), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('Admin'), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('load failure offers a retry', (tester) async {
+    var attempts = 0;
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_app(HouseholdRolesCard(
+      householdId: 'hh',
+      loadRoster: (_) async {
+        attempts++;
+        if (attempts == 1) throw Exception('offline');
+        return _roster(self: 'm');
+      },
+    )));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('Could not load members.'), findsOneWidget);
+    await tester.tap(find.text('Retry'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('Majed (You)'), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('renders right-to-left and translated in Arabic and Urdu', (tester) async {
+    for (final lang in ['ar', 'ur']) {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_app(
+        HouseholdRolesCard(householdId: 'hh', loadRoster: (_) async => _roster(self: 'm')),
+        lang: lang,
+      ));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      final ctx = tester.element(find.byType(HouseholdRolesCard));
+      expect(Directionality.of(ctx), TextDirection.rtl);
+      expect(find.text('Members & Admins'), findsNothing);
+      expect(find.text('Primary admin'), findsNothing);
+    }
+    expect(find.text('مرکزی ایڈمن'), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+
+  group('Nafaqah provider (FABLE-LOGIC-04)', () {
+    testWidgets('the provider carries a "Nafaqah provider (husband)" badge; members cannot change it',
+        (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_app(HouseholdRolesCard(
+        householdId: 'hh',
+        loadRoster: (_) async => _family(self: 'w'),
+      )));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+      final husbandRow = find.byKey(const ValueKey('role-member-h'));
+      expect(
+        find.descendant(of: husbandRow, matching: find.text('Nafaqah provider (husband)')),
+        findsOneWidget,
+      );
+      expect(find.text('Nafaqah provider (husband)'), findsOneWidget, reason: 'only on the provider');
+      expect(find.text('Change provider'), findsNothing);
+      expect(find.byKey(const ValueKey('roles_needs_provider')), findsNothing);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('roommates never see the Nafaqah provider', (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_app(HouseholdRolesCard(
+        householdId: 'hh',
+        loadRoster: (_) async => const HouseholdRoster(
+          householdId: 'hh',
+          nafaqahProviderUserId: 'a',
+          canSetNafaqahProvider: true,
+          members: [
+            HouseholdMember(userId: 'a', role: 'admin', financialRole: 'peer', isPrimary: true, isNafaqahProvider: true, isSelf: true),
+            HouseholdMember(userId: 'b', financialRole: 'peer'),
+          ],
+        ),
+      )));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      expect(find.text('Nafaqah provider (husband)'), findsNothing);
+      expect(find.text('Change provider'), findsNothing);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('an admin chooses another provider among non-spouse members; roster and summary refresh',
+        (tester) async {
+      final calls = <String>[];
+      var loads = 0;
+      NafaqahSummary? notified;
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_app(HouseholdRolesCard(
+        householdId: 'hh',
+        loadRoster: (_) async {
+          loads++;
+          return _family(self: 's', canSet: true, provider: calls.isEmpty ? 'h' : 's');
+        },
+        setNafaqahProvider: (hh, uid) async {
+          calls.add('$hh:$uid');
+          return const NafaqahProviderChange(
+            providerUserId: 's',
+            previousProviderUserId: 'h',
+            summary: NafaqahSummary(mode: 'family_nafaqah', husbandId: 's', wives: [NafaqahWife(id: 'w')]),
+          );
+        },
+        onNafaqahProviderChanged: (summary) => notified = summary,
+      )));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+      expect(find.text('Nafaqah provider (husband): Ahmed'), findsOneWidget);
+      await tester.tap(find.text('Change provider'));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      expect(find.text('Who is the Nafaqah provider (husband)?'), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(find.byKey(const ValueKey('provider-option-w')), findsNothing, reason: 'a wife is never offered');
+      expect(find.byKey(const ValueKey('provider-option-h')), findsOneWidget);
+      await tester.tap(find.byKey(const ValueKey('provider-option-s')));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+      expect(calls, ['hh:s']);
+      expect(loads, 2, reason: 'the roster is reloaded after the change');
+      expect(notified?.husbandId, 's');
+      expect(find.text('Nafaqah provider updated'), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(
+        find.descendant(of: find.byKey(const ValueKey('role-member-s')), matching: find.text('Nafaqah provider (husband)')),
+        findsOneWidget,
+      );
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('refusals are explained: 403 forbidden and 422 invalid', (tester) async {
+      var attempt = 0;
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_app(HouseholdRolesCard(
+        householdId: 'hh',
+        loadRoster: (_) async => _family(self: 's', canSet: true),
+        setNafaqahProvider: (hh, uid) async {
+          attempt++;
+          if (attempt == 1) throw const NafaqahApiException('forbidden', 'Forbidden', statusCode: 403);
+          throw const NafaqahApiException('invalid', 'A wife cannot be the Nafaqah provider.', statusCode: 422);
+        },
+      )));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+      await tester.tap(find.text('Change provider'));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      await tester.tap(find.byKey(const ValueKey('provider-option-s')));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      expect(find.text('Only a household admin can choose the Nafaqah provider.'), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(find.text('Nafaqah provider (husband): Ahmed'), findsOneWidget, reason: 'nothing changed');
+
+      await tester.pump(const Duration(seconds: 5));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      await tester.tap(find.text('Change provider'));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      await tester.tap(find.byKey(const ValueKey('provider-option-s')));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      expect(
+        find.text('That member cannot be the Nafaqah provider (a wife, or no longer in the household).'),
+        findsOneWidget,
+      );
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('a family without a provider prompts an admin to choose one', (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_app(HouseholdRolesCard(
+        householdId: 'hh',
+        loadRoster: (_) async => _family(self: 's', canSet: true, provider: null),
+        setNafaqahProvider: (hh, uid) async => const NafaqahProviderChange(providerUserId: 'h'),
+      )));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+      expect(find.byKey(const ValueKey('roles_needs_provider')), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(
+        find.text('This family has no Nafaqah provider (husband). Choose one so that expenses the wife pays can be recorded.'),
+        findsOneWidget,
+      );
+      expect(find.text('Choose provider'), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(find.text('Nafaqah provider (husband)'), findsNothing);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('a member of a family without a provider is told to ask an admin', (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_app(HouseholdRolesCard(
+        householdId: 'hh',
+        loadRoster: (_) async => _family(self: 'w', provider: null),
+      )));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+      expect(find.text('This family has no Nafaqah provider (husband). Ask an admin to set one.'), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(find.text('Choose provider'), findsNothing);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('the provider section is translated and right-to-left', (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_app(
+        HouseholdRolesCard(householdId: 'hh', loadRoster: (_) async => _family(self: 's', canSet: true)),
+        lang: 'ar',
+      ));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      expect(Directionality.of(tester.element(find.byType(HouseholdRolesCard))), TextDirection.rtl);
+      expect(find.text('المكلّف بالنفقة (الزوج)'), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(find.text('تغيير المكلّف بالنفقة'), findsOneWidget);
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('HouseholdRolesApiClient', () {
+    test('calls the role endpoints and maps refusals', () async {
+      final base = _FakeBase();
+      final client = HouseholdRolesApiClient(baseClient: base);
+
+      base.response = {'household_id': 'hh', 'members': [{'user_id': 'p', 'role': 'admin', 'is_primary': true}]};
+      final roster = await client.fetchMembers('hh');
+      expect(base.calls.last, 'GET /households/hh/members');
+      expect(roster.members.single.isPrimary, isTrue);
+
+      await client.promoteToAdmin('hh', 'm');
+      expect(base.calls.last, 'POST /households/hh/members/m/admin');
+      await client.revokeAdmin('hh', 'c');
+      expect(base.calls.last, 'DELETE /households/hh/members/c/admin');
+      await client.transferPrimaryAdmin('hh', 'm');
+      expect(base.calls.last, 'POST /households/hh/primary-admin {new_primary_user_id: m}');
+
+      base.response = {'status': 'error', 'status_code': 409, 'message': 'A household needs at least one admin.'};
+      expect(
+        () => client.revokeAdmin('hh', 'p'),
+        throwsA(isA<HouseholdRolesApiException>().having((e) => e.code, 'code', 'last_admin')),
+      );
+      base.response = {'status': 'error', 'status_code': 403, 'message': 'Forbidden'};
+      expect(
+        () => client.promoteToAdmin('hh', 'm'),
+        throwsA(isA<HouseholdRolesApiException>().having((e) => e.code, 'code', 'forbidden')),
+      );
+    });
+  });
+}
+
+class _FakeBase extends BaseApiClient {
+  Map<String, dynamic> response = const {};
+  final calls = <String>[];
+
+  @override
+  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> get(String path, {Map<String, dynamic>? queryParams, Duration timeout = const Duration(seconds: 15)}) async {
+    calls.add('GET $path');
+    return response;
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> post(String path, Map<String, dynamic> body,
+      {bool shouldSign = true, Duration timeout = const Duration(seconds: 20), Map<String, String>? extraHeaders}) async {
+    calls.add(body.isEmpty ? 'POST $path' : 'POST $path $body');
+    return response;
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> delete(String path, {Map<String, dynamic>? queryParams, Duration timeout = const Duration(seconds: 15)}) async {
+    calls.add('DELETE $path');
+    return response;
+  }
+}

+
+    MockClient inviteClient({http.Response Function(http.Request request)? onClaim, bool targeted = true}) =>
+        MockClient((request) async {

+            return onClaim?.call(request) ?? http.Response(jsonEncode({'status': 'success'}), 200);

+          if (request.url.path.endsWith('/FATIMA01')) {
+            return http.Response(
+              jsonEncode({

+                'role': 'spouse',
+                'target_member_id': targeted ? 'dep-fatima' : null,

+        });
+
+    testWidgets('join_household_by_code already_member is shown, nothing is joined', (tester) async {

+      expect(find.text('You are already a member of this household.'), findsOneWidget);

+
+    testWidgets('a claim refused with 400 shows the server reason and stops before joining', (tester) async {
+      var joinCalls = 0;

+
+    testWidgets('a claim refused because the user is already a member is localized', (tester) async {

+      expect(find.text('You are already a member of this household.'), findsOneWidget);

+
+    testWidgets('a claim that never reached the server still lets the join decide', (tester) async {

+
+      expect(find.text('Joined Dashboard Test'), findsOneWidget);

+
+  // UX-17: an empty household name says so instead of doing nothing.

+        providers: [

+              calls++;

+    expect(find.text('اكتب اسم المنزل'), findsOneWidget);

+    await tester.enterText(find.byType(TextField).first, 'بيت أحمد');

 }

diff --git a/flutter_app/test/widgets/household_setup_card_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/widgets/household_setup_card_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3bb508c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/widgets/household_setup_card_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,195 @@
+// UX-02: a new household gets a guided setup (payday, income, starter budgets,
+// invite, Nafaqah provider in family mode) instead of a 0.00 hero that points
+// "below" at nothing.
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/household_membership.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/household_setup.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/dashboard/household_setup_card.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/settings/income_settings_card.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_localizations/flutter_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+HouseholdRoster _roster({String type = 'family', bool admin = true, int members = 1, bool provider = true}) =>
+    HouseholdRoster.fromMap({
+      'household_id': 'hh',
+      'household_type': type,
+      'caller_role': admin ? 'admin' : 'member',
+      'nafaqah_provider_user_id': provider ? 'u-1' : null,
+      'members': [
+        {'user_id': 'u-1', 'display_name': 'Ahmed', 'role': admin ? 'admin' : 'member', 'is_self': true, 'financial_role': 'provider'},
+        for (var i = 1; i < members; i++) {'user_id': 'u-${i + 1}', 'display_name': 'M$i', 'role': 'member'},
+      ],
+    });
+
+Widget _app(Widget child, {Locale locale = const Locale('en')}) => MaterialApp(
+      localizationsDelegates: const [
+        AppLocalizationsDelegate(),
+        GlobalMaterialLocalizations.delegate,
+        GlobalWidgetsLocalizations.delegate,
+        GlobalCupertinoLocalizations.delegate,
+      ],
+      supportedLocales: const [Locale('en'), Locale('ar'), Locale('ur')],
+      locale: locale,
+      home: Scaffold(body: SingleChildScrollView(child: child)),
+    );
+
+void main() {
+  group('HouseholdSetupData', () {
+    test('family household: five steps, provider included', () {
+      final d = HouseholdSetupData(paydayDay: 27, monthlyIncome: 0, roster: _roster());
+      expect(d.steps, SetupStep.values);
+      expect(d.isDone(SetupStep.payday, hasBudgets: false), isFalse);
+      expect(d.isDone(SetupStep.income, hasBudgets: false), isFalse);
+      expect(d.isDone(SetupStep.budgets, hasBudgets: false), isFalse);
+      expect(d.isDone(SetupStep.invite, hasBudgets: false), isFalse);
+      expect(d.isDone(SetupStep.provider, hasBudgets: false), isTrue);
+      expect(d.doneCount(hasBudgets: false), 1);
+    });
+
+    test('roommates: no Nafaqah provider step', () {
+      final d = HouseholdSetupData(roster: _roster(type: 'roommates'));
+      expect(d.steps, isNot(contains(SetupStep.provider)));
+    });
+
+    test('complete once every step is done', () {
+      final d = HouseholdSetupData(paydayConfirmed: true, monthlyIncome: 12000, roster: _roster(members: 2));
+      expect(d.isComplete(hasBudgets: true), isTrue);
+      expect(d.isComplete(hasBudgets: false), isFalse);
+    });
+
+    test('starter budgets follow the income, rounded to 50', () {
+      final rows = starterBudgetTemplate(10000);
+      final byCode = {for (final r in rows) r.categoryCode: r.amount};
+      expect(byCode['OPEX-UTILITIES'], 2500);
+      expect(byCode['OPEX-GROCERY'], 2000);
+      expect(byCode['OPEX-FUEL'], 800);
+      expect(byCode['OPEX-HEALTH'], 400);
+      expect(rows.fold<double>(0, (s, r) => s + r.amount), lessThan(10000), reason: 'leaves room for savings');
+      expect(starterBudgetTemplate(null).every((r) => r.amount == 0), isTrue);
+    });
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('admin of a new household sees the checklist, not a dead end', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_app(HouseholdSetupCard(
+      householdId: 'hh',
+      data: HouseholdSetupData(paydayDay: 27, monthlyIncome: 0, roster: _roster()),
+      hasBudgets: false,
+      onChanged: () {},
+    )));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('Set up your household in two minutes'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('1 of 5 done'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('Payday: day 27 of the month'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('Monthly income'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('Starter budgets'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('Invite your wife'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('Choose who provides (Nafaqah)'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('Hide'), findsNothing, reason: 'cannot be hidden before budgets exist');
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('confirming the payday marks the step done', (tester) async {
+    var confirmed = 0;
+    var changed = 0;
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_app(HouseholdSetupCard(
+      householdId: 'hh',
+      data: HouseholdSetupData(paydayDay: 27, monthlyIncome: 0, roster: _roster()),
+      hasBudgets: false,
+      onChanged: () => changed++,
+      confirmPayday: () async => confirmed++,
+    )));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const Key('setup_confirm_payday')));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(confirmed, 1);
+    expect(changed, 1);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('the income step opens the income editor', (tester) async {
+    // The settings card's display row needs more than the default test width
+    // with the test font (its layout belongs to the settings screen).
+    tester.view.physicalSize = const Size(1400, 1600);
+    tester.view.devicePixelRatio = 1;
+    addTearDown(tester.view.reset);
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_app(HouseholdSetupCard(
+      householdId: 'hh',
+      data: HouseholdSetupData(paydayDay: 27, monthlyIncome: 0, roster: _roster()),
+      hasBudgets: false,
+      onChanged: () {},
+      saveIncome: (_) async => true,
+    )));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    await tester.tap(find.text('Monthly income'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.byType(IncomeSettingsCard), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('starter budgets: amounts from the income, created through the API seam', (tester) async {
+    final created = <String, double>{};
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_app(HouseholdSetupCard(
+      householdId: 'hh',
+      data: HouseholdSetupData(paydayDay: 27, paydayConfirmed: true, monthlyIncome: 10000, roster: _roster()),
+      hasBudgets: false,
+      onChanged: () {},
+      createBudget: (code, name, amount) async {
+        created[code] = amount;
+        return code != 'OPEX-MISC'; // one category refused
+      },
+    )));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    await tester.tap(find.text('Starter budgets'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('Suggested budgets'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.widgetWithText(TextField, '2500'), findsOneWidget);
+
+    // Skip fuel.
+    await tester.enterText(find.byKey(const Key('starter_amount_OPEX-FUEL')), '0');
+    await tester.tap(find.text('Create budgets'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(created.keys, isNot(contains('OPEX-FUEL')));
+    expect(created['OPEX-GROCERY'], 2000);
+    expect(find.textContaining('Some budgets could not be created'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.textContaining('Miscellaneous'), findsWidgets);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('a member who is not an admin is told the admin sets things up', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_app(HouseholdSetupCard(
+      householdId: 'hh',
+      data: HouseholdSetupData(paydayDay: 27, monthlyIncome: 0, roster: _roster(admin: false)),
+      hasBudgets: false,
+      onChanged: () {},
+    )));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('Budgets not set up yet'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('Starter budgets'), findsNothing);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('with budgets the checklist can be hidden', (tester) async {
+    var hidden = 0;
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_app(HouseholdSetupCard(
+      householdId: 'hh',
+      data: HouseholdSetupData(paydayDay: 27, monthlyIncome: 0, roster: _roster()),
+      hasBudgets: true,
+      onChanged: () {},
+      onHide: () => hidden++,
+    )));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    await tester.tap(find.text('Hide'));
+    expect(hidden, 1);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('Arabic checklist', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_app(
+      HouseholdSetupCard(
+        householdId: 'hh',
+        data: HouseholdSetupData(paydayDay: 27, monthlyIncome: 0, roster: _roster()),
+        hasBudgets: false,
+        onChanged: () {},
+      ),
+      locale: const Locale('ar'),
+    ));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('جهّز منزلك في دقيقتين'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('اختيار المكلّف بالنفقة'), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/widgets/household_type_and_roles_card_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/widgets/household_type_and_roles_card_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..54b69b1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/widgets/household_type_and_roles_card_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,253 @@
+// Household settings: the household type is shown; admins change it and
+// change members' financial roles (only roles the server lists as assignable,
+// never "wife" for the Nafaqah provider); refusals are explained. Onboarding
+// asks Family vs Roommates when creating a household.
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/household_membership.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/providers/budget_provider.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/providers/transaction_provider.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/screens/onboarding/household_screen.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/services/api/household_roles_api_client.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/settings/household_roles_card.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_localizations/flutter_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
+
+Widget _app(Widget child, {String lang = 'en'}) => MaterialApp(
+      locale: Locale(lang),
+      supportedLocales: const [Locale('en'), Locale('ar'), Locale('ur')],
+      localizationsDelegates: const [
+        AppLocalizationsDelegate(),
+        GlobalMaterialLocalizations.delegate,
+        GlobalWidgetsLocalizations.delegate,
+        GlobalCupertinoLocalizations.delegate,
+      ],
+      home: Scaffold(body: SingleChildScrollView(child: child)),
+    );
+
+HouseholdRoster _family({bool admin = true, String type = 'family', List<String>? assignable}) => HouseholdRoster(
+      householdId: 'hh',
+      householdType: type,
+      callerRole: admin ? 'admin' : 'member',
+      canManageAdmins: admin,
+      canChangeHouseholdType: admin,
+      canSetFinancialRoles: admin,
+      assignableFinancialRoles: assignable ?? const ['spouse', 'family_member', 'dependent'],
+      nafaqahProviderUserId: 'h',
+      canSetNafaqahProvider: admin,
+      members: const [
+        HouseholdMember(userId: 's', displayName: 'Fahad', role: 'admin', financialRole: 'family_member', isPrimary: true, isSelf: true),
+        HouseholdMember(userId: 'h', displayName: 'Ahmed', financialRole: 'provider', isNafaqahProvider: true),
+        HouseholdMember(userId: 'w', displayName: 'Sara', financialRole: 'spouse'),
+      ],
+    );
+
+class _QuietTransactions extends TransactionProvider {
+  @override
+  Future<void> init(String householdId) async {}
+}
+
+class _QuietBudgets extends BudgetProvider {
+  @override
+  Future<void> init(String householdId) async {}
+}
+
+Finder _menuOf(String userId) => find.descendant(
+      of: find.byKey(ValueKey('role-member-$userId')),
+      matching: find.byIcon(Icons.more_vert_rounded),
+    );
+
+void main() {
+  group('household type', () {
+    testWidgets('everyone sees the type; a member has no Change button', (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_app(HouseholdRolesCard(householdId: 'hh', loadRoster: (_) async => _family(admin: false))));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      expect(find.text('Household type: Family (Nafaqah)'), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(find.byKey(const ValueKey('household_type_change')), findsNothing);
+      expect(find.text('Wife / Spouse'), findsOneWidget, reason: "Sara's financial role chip");
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('an admin changes the type; the roster is reloaded', (tester) async {
+      final calls = <String>[];
+      var roster = _family();
+      String? changedTo;
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_app(HouseholdRolesCard(
+        householdId: 'hh',
+        loadRoster: (_) async => roster,
+        setHouseholdType: (hh, type) async {
+          calls.add('$hh:$type');
+          roster = _family(type: type, assignable: const ['peer']);
+          return type;
+        },
+        onHouseholdTypeChanged: (t) => changedTo = t,
+      )));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+      await tester.tap(find.byKey(const ValueKey('household_type_change')));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      await tester.tap(find.byKey(const ValueKey('household_type_roommates')).last);
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      await tester.tap(find.byKey(const ValueKey('household_type_save')));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+      expect(calls, ['hh:roommates']);
+      expect(changedTo, 'roommates');
+      expect(find.text('Household type: Roommates'), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(find.text('Household type changed to Roommates.'), findsOneWidget);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('a blocked change shows the server message', (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_app(HouseholdRolesCard(
+        householdId: 'hh',
+        loadRoster: (_) async => _family(),
+        setHouseholdType: (hh, type) async => throw const HouseholdRolesApiException(
+          'type_change_blocked',
+          'Server response error (409)',
+          statusCode: 409,
+          serverMessage: 'This family has a wife and Nafaqah records.',
+        ),
+      )));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      await tester.tap(find.byKey(const ValueKey('household_type_change')));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      await tester.tap(find.byKey(const ValueKey('household_type_roommates')).last);
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      await tester.tap(find.byKey(const ValueKey('household_type_save')));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      expect(find.text('This family has a wife and Nafaqah records.'), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(find.text('Household type: Family (Nafaqah)'), findsOneWidget);
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('financial roles', () {
+    testWidgets('the provider is never offered "wife"; a change reloads the roster', (tester) async {
+      final calls = <String>[];
+      var loads = 0;
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_app(HouseholdRolesCard(
+        householdId: 'hh',
+        loadRoster: (_) async {
+          loads++;
+          return _family();
+        },
+        setFinancialRole: (hh, uid, role) async {
+          calls.add('$uid:$role');
+          return role;
+        },
+      )));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+      await tester.tap(_menuOf('h'));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      await tester.tap(find.text('Change financial role'));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      expect(find.byKey(const ValueKey('fin-role-option-spouse')), findsNothing);
+      expect(find.byKey(const ValueKey('fin-role-option-family_member')), findsOneWidget);
+      await tester.tap(find.byKey(const ValueKey('fin-role-option-dependent')));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+      expect(calls, ['h:dependent']);
+      expect(loads, 2);
+      expect(find.text('Ahmed is now: Dependent.'), findsOneWidget);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('only the roles the server lists are offered (roommates: roommate)', (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_app(HouseholdRolesCard(
+        householdId: 'hh',
+        loadRoster: (_) async => _family(type: 'roommates', assignable: const ['peer']),
+      )));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      await tester.tap(_menuOf('w'));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      await tester.tap(find.text('Change financial role'));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      expect(find.byKey(const ValueKey('fin-role-option-peer')), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(find.byKey(const ValueKey('fin-role-option-spouse')), findsNothing);
+    });
+
+    for (final c in [
+      (const HouseholdRolesApiException('forbidden', '', statusCode: 403), "Only an admin can change a member's financial role."),
+      (const HouseholdRolesApiException('not_found', '', statusCode: 404), 'This member is no longer in the household.'),
+      (const HouseholdRolesApiException('invalid', '', statusCode: 422), 'This role is not valid for this household type.'),
+      (const HouseholdRolesApiException('spouse_has_ledger', '', statusCode: 409), 'so her role cannot be changed'),
+    ]) {
+      testWidgets('refusal ${c.$1.code} is explained', (tester) async {
+        await tester.pumpWidget(_app(HouseholdRolesCard(
+          householdId: 'hh',
+          loadRoster: (_) async => _family(),
+          setFinancialRole: (hh, uid, role) async => throw c.$1,
+        )));
+        await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+        await tester.tap(_menuOf('w'));
+        await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+        await tester.tap(find.text('Change financial role'));
+        await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+        await tester.tap(find.byKey(const ValueKey('fin-role-option-family_member')));
+        await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+        expect(find.textContaining(c.$2), findsOneWidget);
+      });
+    }
+
+    testWidgets('a member has no financial-role action', (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_app(HouseholdRolesCard(householdId: 'hh', loadRoster: (_) async => _family(admin: false))));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      expect(find.byIcon(Icons.more_vert_rounded), findsNothing);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('Arabic: the type row is localized and RTL renders', (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_app(HouseholdRolesCard(householdId: 'hh', loadRoster: (_) async => _family()), lang: 'ar'));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      expect(find.text('نوع المنزل: الأسرة (النفقة الشرعية)'), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(tester.takeException(), isNull);
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('onboarding: create asks Family vs Roommates', () {
+    Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> create(WidgetTester tester, {String? type}) async {
+      final calls = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
+      await tester.binding.setSurfaceSize(const Size(800, 1600));
+      addTearDown(() => tester.binding.setSurfaceSize(null));
+      await tester.pumpWidget(MultiProvider(
+        providers: [
+          ChangeNotifierProvider<BudgetProvider>.value(value: _QuietBudgets()),
+          ChangeNotifierProvider<TransactionProvider>.value(value: _QuietTransactions()),
+        ],
+        child: MaterialApp(
+          localizationsDelegates: const [AppLocalizationsDelegate()],
+          supportedLocales: const [Locale('en'), Locale('ar'), Locale('ur')],
+          locale: const Locale('en'),
+          home: HouseholdScreen(
+            destinationBuilder: (_) => const Text('home-screen'),
+            createRpc: (fn, params) async {
+              calls.add(params);
+              return {'id': 'hh-new', 'name': params['p_name'], 'invite_code': 'ABCD1234'};
+            },
+          ),
+        ),
+      ));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      await tester.enterText(find.byType(TextField).first, 'Al Noor');
+      if (type != null) {
+        await tester.tap(find.byKey(ValueKey('household_type_$type')));
+        await tester.pump();
+      }
+      await tester.tap(find.text('Create Household'));
+      await tester.pump();
+      return calls;
+    }
+
+    testWidgets('without a choice nothing is created and the user is asked', (tester) async {
+      final calls = await create(tester);
+      expect(calls, isEmpty);
+      expect(find.text('Choose Family or Roommates first.'), findsOneWidget);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('the chosen type is sent with the name', (tester) async {
+      final calls = await create(tester, type: 'roommates');
+      expect(calls, [
+        {'p_name': 'Al Noor', 'p_household_type': 'roommates'},
+      ]);
+      await tester.pump(const Duration(seconds: 5));
+    });
+  });
+}

diff --git a/flutter_app/test/widgets/lazy_indexed_stack_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/widgets/lazy_indexed_stack_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..fda99fa
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/widgets/lazy_indexed_stack_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,66 @@
+// UX-26: home tabs are built on first visit and kept alive afterwards, so
+// chat, budgets and settings no longer build and fetch at launch.
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/lazy_indexed_stack.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+class _Probe extends StatefulWidget {
+  final String name;
+  final Map<String, int> inits;
+  const _Probe(this.name, this.inits);
+
+  @override
+  State<_Probe> createState() => _ProbeState();
+}
+
+class _ProbeState extends State<_Probe> {
+  int taps = 0;
+
+  @override
+  void initState() {
+    super.initState();
+    widget.inits[widget.name] = (widget.inits[widget.name] ?? 0) + 1;
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Widget build(BuildContext context) => TextButton(
+        onPressed: () => setState(() => taps++),
+        child: Text('${widget.name} $taps'),
+      );
+}
+
+void main() {
+  testWidgets('only the visible tab is built at start; visited tabs keep their state', (tester) async {
+    final inits = <String, int>{};
+    var index = 0;
+    late StateSetter setOuter;
+    await tester.pumpWidget(MaterialApp(
+      home: Scaffold(
+        body: StatefulBuilder(builder: (context, setState) {
+          setOuter = setState;
+          return LazyIndexedStack(
+            index: index,
+            itemCount: 3,
+            itemBuilder: (context, i) => _Probe('tab$i', inits),
+          );
+        }),
+      ),
+    ));
+
+    expect(inits, {'tab0': 1}, reason: 'tabs 1 and 2 are not built at launch');
+
+    await tester.tap(find.text('tab0 0'));
+    await tester.pump();
+
+    setOuter(() => index = 2);
+    await tester.pump();
+    expect(inits, {'tab0': 1, 'tab2': 1});
+    expect(find.text('tab2 0'), findsOneWidget);
+
+    setOuter(() => index = 0);
+    await tester.pump();
+    expect(inits, {'tab0': 1, 'tab2': 1}, reason: 'kept alive, not rebuilt from scratch');
+    expect(find.text('tab0 1'), findsOneWidget, reason: 'state survived the switch');
+    expect(inits.containsKey('tab1'), isFalse);
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/widgets/manual_expense_sheet_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/widgets/manual_expense_sheet_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b11d7c1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/widgets/manual_expense_sheet_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,323 @@
+import 'dart:io';
+
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/household_membership.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/nafaqah.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/nafaqah/nafaqah_class_selector.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/transactions/manual_expense_sheet.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart' show PostgrestException;
+
+const _husband = {'id': 'u-husband', 'display_name': 'Abu Fahad', 'financial_role': 'provider'};
+const _wife = {'id': 'u-wife', 'display_name': 'Umm Fahad', 'financial_role': 'spouse'};
+const _peerA = {'id': 'u-a', 'display_name': 'Majed', 'financial_role': 'peer'};
+const _peerB = {'id': 'u-b', 'display_name': 'Salman', 'financial_role': 'peer'};
+
+void main() {
+  Future<void> openSheet(
+    WidgetTester tester, {
+    List<Map<String, dynamic>>? members,
+    Future<HouseholdRoster> Function(String householdId)? loadRoster,
+    Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> Function(String householdId)? loadOwnMemberships,
+    String currentUser = 'u-husband',
+    Future<void> Function(Map<String, dynamic> row)? insertRow,
+    Future<void> Function(Map<String, dynamic> row, String householdId)? enqueueRow,
+    NafaqahSummary? nafaqah,
+  }) async {
+    await tester.binding.setSurfaceSize(const Size(800, 1400));
+    addTearDown(() => tester.binding.setSurfaceSize(null));
+    await tester.pumpWidget(MaterialApp(
+      home: Builder(
+        builder: (context) => Scaffold(
+          body: Center(
+            child: ElevatedButton(
+              onPressed: () => showModalBottomSheet<void>(
+                context: context,
+                isScrollControlled: true,
+                builder: (_) => ManualExpenseSheet(
+                  householdId: 'h1',
+                  initialMerchant: 'Panda',
+                  initialAmount: 120,
+                  loadMembers: members == null ? null : (_) async => members,
+                  loadRoster: loadRoster,
+                  loadOwnMemberships: loadOwnMemberships,
+                  currentUserId: () => currentUser,
+                  insertRow: insertRow ?? (_) async {},
+                  enqueueRow: enqueueRow ?? (_, __) async {},
+                  loadNafaqah: (_) async => nafaqah ?? (throw Exception('offline')),
+                ),
+              ),
+              child: const Text('open'),
+            ),
+          ),
+        ),
+      ),
+    ));
+    await tester.tap(find.text('open'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+  }
+
+  Future<void> tapSave(WidgetTester tester) async {
+    final save = find.byIcon(Icons.check_rounded);
+    await tester.ensureVisible(save);
+    await tester.tap(save);
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+  }
+
+  // UX-12: amount first (focused, decimal keypad, no "\$" icon) and a date row.
+  testWidgets('the amount comes first, is focused and has no dollar icon', (tester) async {
+    await openSheet(tester, members: [_peerA, _peerB], currentUser: 'u-a');
+    final amount = find.byKey(const ValueKey('manual_amount'));
+    final merchant = find.byKey(const ValueKey('manual_merchant'));
+    expect(tester.getTopLeft(amount).dy, lessThan(tester.getTopLeft(merchant).dy));
+    expect(tester.widget<TextField>(amount).autofocus, isTrue);
+    expect(tester.widget<TextField>(amount).keyboardType, const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal: true));
+    expect(find.byIcon(Icons.attach_money_rounded), findsNothing);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets("yesterday's purchase is booked yesterday", (tester) async {
+    Map<String, dynamic>? saved;
+    await openSheet(tester, members: [_peerA, _peerB], currentUser: 'u-a', insertRow: (row) async => saved = row);
+    await tester.ensureVisible(find.byKey(const ValueKey('expense_date_yesterday')));
+    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const ValueKey('expense_date_yesterday')));
+    await tester.pump();
+    await tapSave(tester);
+    final at = DateTime.parse(saved!['timestamp'] as String).toLocal();
+    final yesterday = DateTime.now().subtract(const Duration(days: 1));
+    expect([at.year, at.month, at.day], [yesterday.year, yesterday.month, yesterday.day]);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('without a date choice the expense is booked now', (tester) async {
+    Map<String, dynamic>? saved;
+    await openSheet(tester, members: [_peerA, _peerB], currentUser: 'u-a', insertRow: (row) async => saved = row);
+    await tapSave(tester);
+    final at = DateTime.parse(saved!['timestamp'] as String);
+    expect(DateTime.now().toUtc().difference(at).inMinutes.abs(), lessThan(2));
+  });
+
+  // FR-A-05: a family household (spouse member) never offers the roommate
+  // equal split between the spouses.
+  testWidgets('family household: Nafaqah choice only, no roommate split toggle', (tester) async {
+    await openSheet(tester, members: [_husband, _wife]);
+
+    expect(find.byKey(const ValueKey('manual_mode_toggle')), findsNothing);
+    expect(find.byType(NafaqahClassSelector), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('roommate household keeps the mode toggle and has no Nafaqah choice', (tester) async {
+    await openSheet(tester, members: [_peerA, _peerB], currentUser: 'u-a');
+
+    expect(find.byKey(const ValueKey('manual_mode_toggle')), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.byType(NafaqahClassSelector), findsNothing);
+  });
+
+  // FR-A-08: a row the database rejects is not reported as "saved offline".
+  testWidgets('a database rejection is shown and never queued offline', (tester) async {
+    var queued = 0;
+    await openSheet(
+      tester,
+      members: [_husband, _wife],
+      insertRow: (_) async => throw const PostgrestException(
+        message: 'nafaqah_spouse_id is not a spouse member of household',
+        code: '23503',
+      ),
+      enqueueRow: (_, __) async => queued++,
+    );
+
+    await tapSave(tester);
+
+    expect(queued, 0);
+    expect(find.byType(ManualExpenseSheet), findsOneWidget, reason: 'the sheet stays open to retry');
+    expect(find.textContaining('not a spouse member'), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+
+  // FABLE-LOGIC-04: a family without a Nafaqah provider refuses classified
+  // expenses; the user is told to ask an admin, nothing is queued.
+  testWidgets('a classification refused for a missing provider is explained', (tester) async {
+    var queued = 0;
+    await openSheet(
+      tester,
+      members: [_husband, _wife],
+      currentUser: 'u-wife',
+      insertRow: (_) async => throw const PostgrestException(
+        message: 'This family has no Nafaqah provider',
+        code: '23514',
+        hint: 'no_nafaqah_provider',
+      ),
+      enqueueRow: (_, __) async => queued++,
+    );
+
+    await tapSave(tester);
+
+    expect(queued, 0);
+    expect(find.byType(ManualExpenseSheet), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.textContaining('Ask an admin to choose one'), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('a network failure is queued offline with the same row', (tester) async {
+    Map<String, dynamic>? queuedRow;
+    Map<String, dynamic>? triedRow;
+    await openSheet(
+      tester,
+      members: [_husband, _wife],
+      insertRow: (row) async {
+        triedRow = row;
+        throw const SocketException('offline');
+      },
+      enqueueRow: (row, _) async => queuedRow = row,
+    );
+
+    await tapSave(tester);
+
+    expect(queuedRow, isNotNull);
+    expect(queuedRow!['id'], triedRow!['id']);
+    expect(find.byType(ManualExpenseSheet), findsNothing);
+  });
+
+  // FR-A-07: the family context comes from the household memberships (the
+  // Nafaqah summary), not from each member's active household.
+  testWidgets("the wife is found even when her active household is another one", (tester) async {
+    Map<String, dynamic>? saved;
+    await openSheet(
+      tester,
+      members: [_husband], // users.household_id: the wife is active elsewhere
+      nafaqah: const NafaqahSummary(
+        mode: 'family_nafaqah',
+        callerRole: 'husband',
+        callerUserId: 'u-husband',
+        wives: [NafaqahWife(id: 'u-wife', displayName: 'Umm Fahad')],
+      ),
+      insertRow: (row) async => saved = row,
+    );
+
+    expect(find.byKey(const ValueKey('manual_mode_toggle')), findsNothing);
+    expect(find.byType(NafaqahClassSelector), findsOneWidget);
+
+    await tester.ensureVisible(find.byKey(const ValueKey('nafaqah_option_wife_reimbursable')));
+    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const ValueKey('nafaqah_option_wife_reimbursable')));
+    await tester.pump();
+    await tapSave(tester);
+
+    expect(saved?['nafaqah_class'], kWifeReimbursable);
+    expect(saved?['nafaqah_spouse_id'], 'u-wife');
+  });
+
+  // UX-03: the one Nafaqah question names the spouses.
+  testWidgets('the family question names the wife for the husband and the husband for the wife', (tester) async {
+    await openSheet(
+      tester,
+      members: [_husband, _wife],
+      nafaqah: const NafaqahSummary(
+        mode: 'family_nafaqah',
+        callerRole: 'husband',
+        callerUserId: 'u-husband',
+        husbandName: 'Abu Fahad',
+        wives: [NafaqahWife(id: 'u-wife', displayName: 'Umm Fahad')],
+      ),
+    );
+    expect(find.text('Umm Fahad paid for the home — I pay her back'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text("Umm Fahad's personal purchase — from her allowance"), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('the wife sees her husband by name', (tester) async {
+    await openSheet(
+      tester,
+      members: [_husband, _wife],
+      currentUser: 'u-wife',
+      nafaqah: const NafaqahSummary(
+        mode: 'family_nafaqah',
+        callerRole: 'wife',
+        callerUserId: 'u-wife',
+        husbandName: 'Abu Fahad',
+        wives: [NafaqahWife(id: 'u-wife', displayName: 'Umm Fahad')],
+      ),
+    );
+    expect(find.text('Abu Fahad paid'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('For me personally — from my allowance'), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+
+  // Roles come from GET /households/{id}/members (the role in THIS household),
+  // not users.financial_role filtered by each member's active household.
+  group('members and roles per household', () {
+    HouseholdMember member(String id, String fin) => HouseholdMember(userId: id, displayName: id, financialRole: fin);
+
+    testWidgets('a wife whose active household is elsewhere is still the wife here', (tester) async {
+      await openSheet(
+        tester,
+        loadRoster: (hid) async => HouseholdRoster(
+          householdId: hid,
+          members: [member('u-husband', 'provider'), member('u-wife', 'spouse')],
+        ),
+        loadOwnMemberships: (_) async => fail('the API answered: no fallback'),
+      );
+
+      expect(find.byKey(const ValueKey('manual_mode_toggle')), findsNothing);
+      expect(find.byType(NafaqahClassSelector), findsOneWidget);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('roommates per household get the split toggle and no Nafaqah choice', (tester) async {
+      await openSheet(
+        tester,
+        currentUser: 'u-a',
+        loadRoster: (hid) async => HouseholdRoster(
+          householdId: hid,
+          members: [member('u-a', 'peer'), member('u-b', 'peer')],
+        ),
+      );
+
+      expect(find.byKey(const ValueKey('manual_mode_toggle')), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(find.byType(NafaqahClassSelector), findsNothing);
+      expect(find.text('u-b'), findsOneWidget);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('when the members API fails, only the own membership row is used: no spouse is invented',
+        (tester) async {
+      var fallbackFor = '';
+      await openSheet(
+        tester,
+        currentUser: 'u-son',
+        loadRoster: (_) async => throw Exception('API unavailable'),
+        loadOwnMemberships: (hid) async {
+          fallbackFor = hid;
+          return [
+            {'user_id': 'u-son', 'role': 'member', 'financial_role': 'family_member'},
+          ];
+        },
+      );
+
+      expect(fallbackFor, 'h1');
+      expect(find.byType(NafaqahClassSelector), findsNothing);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('offline (both loads fail): no spouse, the expense is still recordable', (tester) async {
+      Map<String, dynamic>? saved;
+      await openSheet(
+        tester,
+        loadRoster: (_) async => throw Exception('offline'),
+        loadOwnMemberships: (_) async => throw Exception('offline'),
+        insertRow: (row) async => saved = row,
+      );
+
+      expect(find.byType(NafaqahClassSelector), findsNothing);
+      await tapSave(tester);
+      expect(saved?['nafaqah_class'], isNull);
+    });
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('another family member (not a spouse) records without a Nafaqah class', (tester) async {
+    await openSheet(
+      tester,
+      members: [_husband, _wife],
+      currentUser: 'u-son',
+      nafaqah: const NafaqahSummary(
+        mode: 'family_nafaqah',
+        callerRole: 'member',
+        callerUserId: 'u-son',
+        wives: [NafaqahWife(id: 'u-wife')],
+      ),
+    );
+
+    expect(find.byKey(const ValueKey('manual_mode_toggle')), findsNothing);
+    expect(find.byType(NafaqahClassSelector), findsNothing);
+  });
+}
