diff --git a/flutter_app/test/widgets/nafaqah_classifier_rule_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/widgets/nafaqah_classifier_rule_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..64bd4a5
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/widgets/nafaqah_classifier_rule_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,245 @@
+// Owner rule: only the wife, the Nafaqah provider (husband) or an admin may
+// classify a family expense as wife_reimbursable / wife_personal. The selector
+// is hidden for every other member (chat confirmation card, receipt review,
+// manual sheet, edit sheet), and an admin who is neither spouse names the wife
+// who paid.
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/models.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/nafaqah.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/screens/home/edit_transaction_sheet.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/chat/pending_expense_confirmation_card.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/nafaqah/nafaqah_class_selector.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/transactions/manual_expense_sheet.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+Map<String, dynamic> _preview({String role = 'member', List<Map<String, dynamic>>? wives}) => {
+      'status': 'preview',
+      'merchant': 'Panda',
+      'amount': 180.0,
+      'category_code': 'OPEX-GROCERY',
+      'paid_by': 'me',
+      'beneficiary': 'both',
+      'available_sub_categories': [
+        {'sub_code': 'pantry_staples', 'name_en': 'Pantry Staples', 'name_ar': 'المؤن'},
+      ],
+      'dependents': <String>[],
+      'household_mode': 'family_nafaqah',
+      'recorder_role': role,
+      'wives': wives ??
+          [
+            {'id': 'u-wife', 'display_name': 'Umm Fahad'},
+          ],
+    };
+
+void main() {
+  group('NafaqahPreview', () {
+    test('a member who is not an admin cannot classify', () {
+      final p = NafaqahPreview.fromPreview(_preview());
+      expect(p.canClassify, isFalse);
+      expect(p.requestFields(kWifeReimbursable), isEmpty);
+    });
+
+    test('an admin classifies and names the wife who paid', () {
+      final p = NafaqahPreview.fromPreview(_preview()).withAdmin(true);
+      expect(p.canClassify, isTrue);
+      expect(p.isAdminClassifier, isTrue);
+      expect(p.defaultSpouseId, 'u-wife');
+      expect(p.requestFields(kWifeReimbursable, chosenWifeId: 'u-wife'), {
+        'paid_by': 'partner',
+        'beneficiary': 'both',
+        'nafaqah_class': kWifeReimbursable,
+        'nafaqah_spouse_id': 'u-wife',
+      });
+      expect(p.requestFields(kWifePersonal, chosenWifeId: 'u-wife')['beneficiary'], 'partner');
+      expect(p.requestFields(null), {'nafaqah_class': kNafaqahNone});
+      expect(p.transactionColumns(kWifePersonal, chosenWifeId: 'u-wife'),
+          {'nafaqah_class': kWifePersonal, 'nafaqah_spouse_id': 'u-wife'});
+    });
+
+    test('an admin in a family with several wives must choose one', () {
+      final p = NafaqahPreview.fromPreview(_preview(wives: [
+        {'id': 'w1'},
+        {'id': 'w2'},
+      ])).withAdmin(true);
+      expect(p.needsWifeChoice, isTrue);
+      expect(p.defaultSpouseId, isNull);
+    });
+
+    test('the server may say so itself (can_classify), and the summary marks admins', () {
+      expect(NafaqahPreview.fromPreview({..._preview(), 'can_classify': true}).canClassify, isTrue);
+      final summary = NafaqahSummary.fromMap({
+        'mode': 'family_nafaqah',
+        'caller_role': 'member',
+        'can_set_provider': true,
+        'wives': [
+          {'id': 'u-wife'},
+        ],
+      });
+      expect(NafaqahPreview.fromSummary(summary).canClassify, isTrue);
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('chat confirmation card', () {
+    Future<List<Object?>> confirm(WidgetTester tester, {required bool isAdmin, String? tap}) async {
+      List<Object?> result = const [];
+      await tester.pumpWidget(MaterialApp(
+        home: Scaffold(
+          body: SingleChildScrollView(
+            child: PendingExpenseConfirmationCard(
+              pendingData: _preview(),
+              isAdmin: isAdmin,
+              onConfirm: (store, cat, sub, paidBy, beneficiary, cls, spouse, edits) =>
+                  result = [paidBy, beneficiary, cls, spouse],
+              onCancel: () {},
+            ),
+          ),
+        ),
+      ));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      if (tap != null) {
+        await tester.ensureVisible(find.text(tap));
+        await tester.tap(find.text(tap));
+        await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      }
+      await tester.ensureVisible(find.text('Confirm & Add Expense'));
+      await tester.tap(find.text('Confirm & Add Expense'));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      return result;
+    }
+
+    testWidgets('a family member who is not an admin sees no Nafaqah choice', (tester) async {
+      final r = await confirm(tester, isAdmin: false);
+      expect(find.byType(NafaqahClassSelector), findsNothing);
+      expect(r[2], kNafaqahNone);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('an admin records a wife advance naming her', (tester) async {
+      final r = await confirm(tester, isAdmin: true, tap: 'Umm Fahad paid for the home — owed to her');
+      expect(r, ['partner', 'both', kWifeReimbursable, 'u-wife']);
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('manual sheet', () {
+    Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> save(WidgetTester tester, {required String role, bool tapShared = false}) async {
+      Map<String, dynamic>? saved;
+      await tester.binding.setSurfaceSize(const Size(800, 1400));
+      addTearDown(() => tester.binding.setSurfaceSize(null));
+      await tester.pumpWidget(MaterialApp(
+        home: Builder(
+          builder: (context) => Scaffold(
+            body: Center(
+              child: ElevatedButton(
+                onPressed: () => showModalBottomSheet<void>(
+                  context: context,
+                  isScrollControlled: true,
+                  builder: (_) => ManualExpenseSheet(
+                    householdId: 'h1',
+                    initialMerchant: 'Panda',
+                    initialAmount: 120,
+                    loadMembers: (_) async => [
+                      {'id': 'u-husband', 'financial_role': 'provider', 'role': 'member'},
+                      {'id': 'u-wife', 'financial_role': 'spouse', 'role': 'member'},
+                      {'id': 'u-son', 'financial_role': 'family_member', 'role': role},
+                    ],
+                    currentUserId: () => 'u-son',
+                    insertRow: (row) async => saved = row,
+                    enqueueRow: (_, __) async {},
+                    loadNafaqah: (_) async => NafaqahSummary(
+                      mode: 'family_nafaqah',
+                      callerRole: 'member',
+                      callerUserId: 'u-son',
+                      husbandId: 'u-husband',
+                      canSetProvider: role == 'admin',
+                      wives: const [NafaqahWife(id: 'u-wife')],
+                    ),
+                  ),
+                ),
+                child: const Text('open'),
+              ),
+            ),
+          ),
+        ),
+      ));
+      await tester.tap(find.text('open'));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      if (tapShared) {
+        await tester.ensureVisible(find.byKey(const ValueKey('nafaqah_option_wife_reimbursable')));
+        await tester.tap(find.byKey(const ValueKey('nafaqah_option_wife_reimbursable')));
+        await tester.pump();
+      }
+      if (role != 'admin') expect(find.byType(NafaqahClassSelector), findsNothing);
+      final saveBtn = find.byIcon(Icons.check_rounded);
+      await tester.ensureVisible(saveBtn);
+      await tester.tap(saveBtn);
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      return saved;
+    }
+
+    testWidgets('a son who is not an admin records without a class', (tester) async {
+      final row = await save(tester, role: 'member');
+      expect(row?['nafaqah_class'], isNull);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('an admin son records the wife\'s advance with her member id as payer', (tester) async {
+      final row = await save(tester, role: 'admin', tapShared: true);
+      expect(row?['nafaqah_class'], kWifeReimbursable);
+      expect(row?['nafaqah_spouse_id'], 'u-wife');
+      expect(row?['raw_sms'], endsWith('| PaidBy: u-wife | Beneficiary: household | SpentBy: partner'));
+    });
+  });
+
+  group('edit sheet', () {
+    Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> edit(WidgetTester tester, {required bool isAdmin, bool tapShared = false}) async {
+      final writes = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
+      await tester.binding.setSurfaceSize(const Size(900, 2400));
+      addTearDown(() => tester.binding.setSurfaceSize(null));
+      await tester.pumpWidget(MaterialApp(
+        home: Scaffold(
+          body: SingleChildScrollView(
+            child: EditTransactionSheet(
+              transaction: Transaction.fromMap({
+                'id': 'tx-1', 'household_id': 'h1', 'amount': 90.0, 'merchant': 'Panda', 'category_code': 'OPEX-GROCERY',
+                'timestamp': '2026-10-20T10:00:00Z', 'created_at': '2026-10-20T10:00:00Z', 'user_id': 'u-son',
+                'source': 'chat', 'spent_by': 'me', 'beneficiary_type': 'household', 'beneficiary_id': 'household',
+              }),
+              nafaqah: const NafaqahSummary(
+                mode: 'family_nafaqah', callerRole: 'member', callerUserId: 'u-son', husbandId: 'u-husband',
+                wives: [NafaqahWife(id: 'u-wife')],
+              ),
+              isAdmin: isAdmin,
+              currentUserId: () => 'u-son',
+              loadNafaqahFields: (_) async => {'nafaqah_class': null, 'nafaqah_spouse_id': null},
+              updateRow: (id, values) async => writes.add(values),
+            ),
+          ),
+        ),
+      ));
+      await tester.pump();
+      await tester.pump();
+      if (!isAdmin) expect(find.byType(NafaqahClassSelector), findsNothing);
+      if (tapShared) {
+        await tester.ensureVisible(find.text('The wife paid for the home — owed to her'));
+        await tester.tap(find.text('The wife paid for the home — owed to her'));
+        await tester.pump();
+      }
+      await tester.ensureVisible(find.text('Save Changes'));
+      await tester.tap(find.text('Save Changes'));
+      await tester.pump();
+      await tester.pump(const Duration(milliseconds: 100));
+      return writes;
+    }
+
+    testWidgets('a member who is not an admin never writes a class', (tester) async {
+      final writes = await edit(tester, isAdmin: false);
+      expect(writes.single.containsKey('nafaqah_class'), isFalse);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('an admin classifies a wife advance (the son recorded it, the wife paid)', (tester) async {
+      final writes = await edit(tester, isAdmin: true, tapShared: true);
+      final w = writes.single;
+      expect(w['nafaqah_class'], kWifeReimbursable);
+      expect(w['nafaqah_spouse_id'], 'u-wife');
+      expect(w['beneficiary_type'], 'household');
+    });
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/widgets/overspend_visibility_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/widgets/overspend_visibility_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..7e5530e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/widgets/overspend_visibility_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,128 @@
+// UX-08: overspend is visible. 131% reads 131% (only the bar is clamped),
+// the overspend amount is shown, and categories are sorted by risk.
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/models.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/dashboard/category_budget_card.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/dashboard/over_budget_alerts.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_localizations/flutter_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+Budget _b(String code, double allocated, double spent) => Budget.fromMap({
+      'id': code,
+      'household_id': 'hh',
+      'month': '2026-10-01',
+      'category_code': code,
+      'allocated_amount': allocated,
+      'spent_amount': spent,
+      'remaining_amount': allocated - spent,
+      'cycle_key': '2026-10',
+    });
+
+Widget _app(Widget child, {Locale locale = const Locale('en')}) => MaterialApp(
+      localizationsDelegates: const [
+        AppLocalizationsDelegate(),
+        GlobalMaterialLocalizations.delegate,
+        GlobalWidgetsLocalizations.delegate,
+        GlobalCupertinoLocalizations.delegate,
+      ],
+      supportedLocales: const [Locale('en'), Locale('ar'), Locale('ur')],
+      locale: locale,
+      home: Scaffold(body: SingleChildScrollView(child: child)),
+    );
+
+void main() {
+  group('Budget usage', () {
+    test('the ratio is not clamped; the bar value is', () {
+      final shopping = _b('OPEX-SHOPPING', 1000, 1310);
+      expect(shopping.usageRatio, closeTo(1.31, 1e-9));
+      expect(shopping.usagePercent, 1.0, reason: 'progress bars stay within 0..1');
+      expect(shopping.isOverspent, isTrue);
+      expect(shopping.overspentAmount, closeTo(310, 1e-9));
+    });
+
+    test('spending with no allocation is overspent by the whole amount', () {
+      final b = _b('OPEX-MISC', 0, 50);
+      expect(b.isOverspent, isTrue);
+      expect(b.overspentAmount, 50);
+    });
+
+    test('within budget: not overspent', () {
+      final b = _b('OPEX-FUEL', 500, 499.995);
+      expect(b.isOverspent, isFalse);
+      expect(b.overspentAmount, 0);
+    });
+
+    test('sorted by risk: overspent first (most over first), then by share used', () {
+      final sorted = Budget.sortByRisk([
+        _b('OPEX-FUEL', 500, 100), // 20%
+        _b('OPEX-DINING', 800, 920), // 115%
+        _b('OPEX-GROCERY', 2000, 1700), // 85%
+        _b('OPEX-SHOPPING', 1000, 1310), // 131%
+        _b('OPEX-HEALTH', 300, 0), // 0%
+      ]);
+      expect(sorted.map((b) => b.categoryCode), [
+        'OPEX-SHOPPING',
+        'OPEX-DINING',
+        'OPEX-GROCERY',
+        'OPEX-FUEL',
+        'OPEX-HEALTH',
+      ]);
+    });
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('category card reads 131% and the overspend amount', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_app(CategoryBudgetCard(budget: _b('OPEX-SHOPPING', 1000, 1310), householdId: 'hh')));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('131%'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('100%'), findsNothing);
+    expect(find.text('Over by SAR 310.00'), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('category card within budget has no overspend line', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_app(CategoryBudgetCard(budget: _b('OPEX-FUEL', 500, 250), householdId: 'hh')));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('50%'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.textContaining('Over by'), findsNothing);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('Arabic overspend line uses the riyal formatter', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_app(
+      CategoryBudgetCard(budget: _b('OPEX-SHOPPING', 1000, 1310), householdId: 'hh'),
+      locale: const Locale('ar'),
+    ));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('تجاوز بـ 310.00 ر.س'), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('over-budget alerts list the top 3 overspent categories, most over first', (tester) async {
+    var showAll = 0;
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_app(OverBudgetAlerts(
+      budgets: [
+        _b('OPEX-FUEL', 500, 100),
+        _b('OPEX-DINING', 800, 920),
+        _b('OPEX-SHOPPING', 1000, 1310),
+        _b('OPEX-GROCERY', 1000, 1050),
+        _b('OPEX-HEALTH', 100, 200),
+      ],
+      onShowAll: () => showAll++,
+    )));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('Over budget (4)'), findsOneWidget);
+    // Health is 200% (most over), then Shopping 131%, Dining 115%; Grocery is the 4th.
+    final rows = tester.widgetList<Text>(find.byKey(const Key('over_budget_row'))).map((t) => t.data).toList();
+    expect(rows, [
+      'Health & Pharmacy: over by SAR 100.00',
+      'Shopping & Retail: over by SAR 310.00',
+      'Dining & Cafes: over by SAR 120.00',
+    ]);
+    await tester.tap(find.text('Show all'));
+    expect(showAll, 1);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('no over-budget alerts when nothing is overspent', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_app(OverBudgetAlerts(budgets: [_b('OPEX-FUEL', 500, 100)], onShowAll: () {})));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.byType(Container), findsNothing);
+  });
+}

diff --git a/flutter_app/test/widgets/receipt_review_editor_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/widgets/receipt_review_editor_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..f0f12e0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/widgets/receipt_review_editor_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,61 @@
+// UX-12: the scanned total and category can be corrected before saving.
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/scanner/receipt_review_editor.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+import '../support/localized_app.dart';
+
+void main() {
+  group('ReceiptReviewEdits', () {
+    test('unchanged values send nothing', () {
+      final e = ReceiptReviewEdits.from(scannedAmount: 82.5, scannedCategory: 'OPEX-GROCERY', amountText: '82.50', chosenCategory: 'OPEX-GROCERY');
+      expect(e.invalid, isFalse);
+      expect(e.amount, isNull);
+      expect(e.categoryCode, isNull);
+    });
+
+    test('a corrected total and category are sent', () {
+      final e = ReceiptReviewEdits.from(scannedAmount: 82.5, scannedCategory: 'OPEX-GROCERY', amountText: '85.25', chosenCategory: 'OPEX-SHOPPING');
+      expect(e.amount, 85.25);
+      expect(e.categoryCode, 'OPEX-SHOPPING');
+    });
+
+    test('Arabic digits are read; zero or text is invalid', () {
+      expect(ReceiptReviewEdits.from(scannedAmount: 1, amountText: '٨٥٫٢٥').amount, 85.25);
+      expect(ReceiptReviewEdits.from(scannedAmount: 1, amountText: '0').invalid, isTrue);
+      expect(ReceiptReviewEdits.from(scannedAmount: 1, amountText: 'abc').invalid, isTrue);
+    });
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('the editor shows the total and lets the category change (Arabic)', (tester) async {
+    final ctrl = TextEditingController(text: '82.50');
+    String? chosen;
+    await tester.pumpWidget(localizedApp(
+      ReceiptReviewEditor(amountController: ctrl, categoryCode: 'OPEX-GROCERY', onCategoryChanged: (c) => chosen = c),
+    ));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('الإجمالي'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('البقالة والتموينات'), findsOneWidget);
+    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const ValueKey('receipt_review_category')));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    await tester.tap(find.text('التسوق والمشتريات').last);
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(chosen, 'OPEX-SHOPPING');
+    await tester.enterText(find.byKey(const ValueKey('receipt_review_amount')), '85.25');
+    expect(ctrl.text, '85.25');
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('an invalid total says so', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(localizedApp(
+      ReceiptReviewEditor(
+        amountController: TextEditingController(text: '0'),
+        categoryCode: 'OPEX-GROCERY',
+        onCategoryChanged: (_) {},
+        amountInvalid: true,
+      ),
+      lang: 'en',
+    ));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('Enter an amount greater than 0.'), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+}

     expect(created, isNotNull);
     expect(created!.role, equals('spouse'));
   });
+
+  // FR-A-11: a refused or failed request must not show an invented code that
+  // can never be redeemed.
+  testWidgets('RoleInviteDialog shows an error and no code when the server refuses', (tester) async {
+    HouseholdInvite? created;
+
+    await tester.pumpWidget(
+      MaterialApp(
+        home: Scaffold(
+          body: RoleInviteDialog(
+            householdId: 'hh-role-123',
+            createInvite: (hid, role, {targetMemberId}) async =>
+                throw const ApiRequestException('Forbidden: Admin access required for this household.', statusCode: 403),
+            onInviteGenerated: (inv) => created = inv,
+          ),
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+
+    await tester.tap(find.text('Generate Invite Code'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+    expect(created, isNull);
+    expect(find.text('Copy Code'), findsNothing);
+    expect(find.textContaining('INV'), findsNothing);
+    expect(find.text('Generate Invite Code'), findsOneWidget, reason: 'the user can retry');
+  });
+
+  // Backend: an invite whose role does not fit the household type is refused
+  // with 409 {"detail": {"code": "invite_role_mismatch"}}.
+  testWidgets('an invite role that does not fit the household type is explained', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(
+      MaterialApp(
+        home: Scaffold(
+          body: RoleInviteDialog(
+            householdId: 'hh-role-123',
+            createInvite: (hid, role, {targetMemberId}) async =>
+                throw const ApiRequestException('Server response error (409)', statusCode: 409, code: 'invite_role_mismatch'),
+          ),
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+    await tester.tap(find.text('Generate Invite Code'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.textContaining('does not fit the household type'), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+
+  // Coordinator item: share a role-bound invite, naming the role.
+  Future<void> generate(WidgetTester tester, {ShareTextLauncher? share, String lang = 'en'}) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(localizedApp(
+      RoleInviteDialog(
+        householdId: 'hh-role-123',
+        householdName: 'Villa 7',
+        createInvite: (hid, role, {targetMemberId}) async => HouseholdInvite(householdId: hid, inviteCode: 'ABCD1234', role: role),
+        shareInvite: share,
+      ),
+      lang: lang,
+    ));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const ValueKey('rid_generate')));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+  }
+
+  testWidgets('the generated role invite can be shared, naming the role and household', (tester) async {
+    String? text;
+    String? subject;
+    await generate(tester, lang: 'ar', share: (t, s) async {
+      text = t;
+      subject = s;
+    });
+    final share = find.byKey(const ValueKey('rid_share_invite'));
+    expect(share, findsOneWidget);
+    await tester.tap(share);
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(text, contains('ABCD1234'));
+    expect(text, contains('Villa 7'));
+    expect(text, contains('الزوجة'));
+    expect(text, contains('الانضمام لمنزل'));
+    expect(subject, isNotEmpty);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('without a share target the message is copied instead', (tester) async {
+    String? clip;
+    tester.binding.defaultBinaryMessenger.setMockMethodCallHandler(SystemChannels.platform, (call) async {
+      if (call.method == 'Clipboard.setData') clip = (call.arguments as Map)['text'] as String?;
+      return null;
+    });
+    addTearDown(() => tester.binding.defaultBinaryMessenger.setMockMethodCallHandler(SystemChannels.platform, null));
+    await generate(tester, share: (t, s) async => throw Exception('no share target'));
+    await tester.tap(find.byKey(const ValueKey('rid_share_invite')));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(clip, contains('ABCD1234'));
+    expect(clip, contains('Wife / Spouse'));
+    await tester.pump(const Duration(seconds: 5));
+  });
 }
+
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/widgets/roommates_me_first_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/widgets/roommates_me_first_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..91b5473
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/widgets/roommates_me_first_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,95 @@
+// UX-16: the roommates flow is centred on "me": what I owe / am owed first.
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/household_dues.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/models.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/dashboard/multi_roommate_settlement_card.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_localizations/flutter_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+const _summary = SettlementV2Summary(
+  mode: 'multi_roommate',
+  pairwiseDebts: [
+    PairwiseDebt(fromId: 'omar', toId: 'ahmed', fromName: 'Omar', toName: 'Ahmed', amount: 100),
+    PairwiseDebt(fromId: 'ibrahim', toId: 'ahmed', fromName: 'Ibrahim', toName: 'Ahmed', amount: 200),
+    PairwiseDebt(fromId: 'tariq', toId: 'omar', fromName: 'Tariq', toName: 'Omar', amount: 200),
+  ],
+  simplifiedDebts: [
+    SimplifiedDebt(fromId: 'tariq', toId: 'omar', fromName: 'Tariq', toName: 'Omar', amount: 100),
+    SimplifiedDebt(fromId: 'tariq', toId: 'ahmed', fromName: 'Tariq', toName: 'Ahmed', amount: 100),
+    SimplifiedDebt(fromId: 'ibrahim', toId: 'ahmed', fromName: 'Ibrahim', toName: 'Ahmed', amount: 200),
+  ],
+);
+
+Widget _app(Widget child, {Locale locale = const Locale('en')}) => MaterialApp(
+      localizationsDelegates: const [
+        AppLocalizationsDelegate(),
+        GlobalMaterialLocalizations.delegate,
+        GlobalWidgetsLocalizations.delegate,
+        GlobalCupertinoLocalizations.delegate,
+      ],
+      supportedLocales: const [Locale('en'), Locale('ar'), Locale('ur')],
+      locale: locale,
+      home: Scaffold(body: SingleChildScrollView(child: child)),
+    );
+
+List<String?> _rowTitles(WidgetTester tester) =>
+    tester.widgetList<Text>(find.byKey(const Key('roommate_debt_title'))).map((t) => t.data).toList();
+
+void main() {
+  test('dues for the hero: my net per roommate', () {
+    final mine = roommateDueLines(_summary, 'tariq');
+    expect(mine.map((d) => (d.kind, d.name, d.amount)), [
+      (DueKind.iOwe, 'Omar', 100.0),
+      (DueKind.iOwe, 'Ahmed', 100.0),
+    ]);
+    final ahmed = roommateDueLines(_summary, 'ahmed');
+    expect(ahmed.map((d) => (d.kind, d.name, d.amount)), [
+      (DueKind.owedByRoommate, 'Ibrahim', 200.0),
+      (DueKind.owedByRoommate, 'Tariq', 100.0),
+    ]);
+    expect(roommateDueLines(_summary, 'nobody'), isEmpty);
+    expect(roommateDueLines(_summary, null), isEmpty);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('my debts first, in my words, with my net balance on top', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_app(const MultiRoommateSettlementCard(
+      householdId: 'hh',
+      summary: _summary,
+      currentUserId: 'tariq',
+    )));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('Your balance: you owe SAR 200.00'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(_rowTitles(tester), ['You owe Omar', 'You owe Ahmed', 'Ibrahim owes Ahmed']);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('money owed to me reads "owes you"', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_app(const MultiRoommateSettlementCard(
+      householdId: 'hh',
+      summary: _summary,
+      currentUserId: 'ahmed',
+    )));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('Your balance: you are owed SAR 300.00'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(_rowTitles(tester), ['Ibrahim owes you', 'Tariq owes you', 'Tariq owes Omar']);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('Arabic: "أنت مدين لـعمر", no stray space after لـ, plain toggle name', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_app(
+      const MultiRoommateSettlementCard(householdId: 'hh', summary: _summary, currentUserId: 'tariq'),
+      locale: const Locale('ar'),
+    ));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('أنت مدين لـOmar'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('Ibrahim مدين لـAhmed'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('أقل عدد تحويلات'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('تبسيط الديون'), findsNothing);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('the toggle has a one-line hint', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_app(const MultiRoommateSettlementCard(householdId: 'hh', summary: _summary)));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    expect(find.text('Fewest transfers'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('Combines debts so fewer payments are needed.'), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+}

+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/store_attribution_card.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+void main() {
+  Widget card({bool showSpentBy = true}) => MaterialApp(
+        home: Scaffold(
+          body: StoreAttributionCard(
+            merchantController: TextEditingController(text: 'Panda'),
+            selectedSpentBy: 'both',
+            onSpentByChanged: (_) {},
+            showSpentBy: showSpentBy,
+          ),
+        ),
+      );
+
+  testWidgets('roommates: "spent by whom" is asked', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(card());
+    expect(find.text('SPENT BY WHOM?'), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+
+  // UX-03: a family receipt answers the one Nafaqah question instead.
+  testWidgets('family: no "spent by whom" row next to the Nafaqah question', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(card(showSpentBy: false));
+    expect(find.text('SPENT BY WHOM?'), findsNothing);
+    expect(find.text('Partner'), findsNothing);
+    expect(find.text('Panda'), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/widgets/ui_payday_checkin_banner_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/widgets/ui_payday_checkin_banner_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..4abc2f2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/widgets/ui_payday_checkin_banner_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,103 @@
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/account.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/dashboard/payday_checkin_banner.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+Widget _wrap(Widget child) => MaterialApp(home: Scaffold(body: child));
+
+void main() {
+  group('PaydayCheckinBanner', () {
+    test('queries the real income_records column (source_type)', () {
+      // Regression: the banner filtered on a non-existent `income_type`
+      // column, so the query always threw and the banner never showed.
+      final record = IncomeRecord(
+        id: 'r1',
+        householdId: 'h1',
+        userId: 'u1',
+        accountId: 'a1',
+        cycleKey: '2026-11',
+        sourceType: IncomeSourceType.salary,
+        title: 'Salary',
+        receivedAt: DateTime(2026, 10, 27),
+      );
+      expect(record.toMap().containsKey(PaydayCheckinBanner.sourceTypeColumn), isTrue);
+      expect(record.toMap()[PaydayCheckinBanner.sourceTypeColumn], 'salary');
+    });
+
+    test('payday window covers 25th..31st and 1st..3rd only', () {
+      expect(PaydayCheckinBanner.isPaydayWindow(DateTime(2026, 10, 25)), isTrue);
+      expect(PaydayCheckinBanner.isPaydayWindow(DateTime(2026, 10, 31)), isTrue);
+      expect(PaydayCheckinBanner.isPaydayWindow(DateTime(2026, 11, 3)), isTrue);
+      expect(PaydayCheckinBanner.isPaydayWindow(DateTime(2026, 11, 4)), isFalse);
+      expect(PaydayCheckinBanner.isPaydayWindow(DateTime(2026, 11, 24)), isFalse);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('shows in payday window when no salary was logged', (tester) async {
+      DateTime? requestedSince;
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_wrap(PaydayCheckinBanner(
+        householdId: 'h1',
+        clock: () => DateTime(2026, 10, 27, 9),
+        salaryLookup: (hid, since) async {
+          requestedSince = since;
+          return false;
+        },
+      )));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+      expect(find.byIcon(Icons.celebration_rounded), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(requestedSince, DateTime(2026, 10, 7, 9));
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('stays hidden when a salary was already logged', (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_wrap(PaydayCheckinBanner(
+        householdId: 'h1',
+        clock: () => DateTime(2026, 10, 27),
+        salaryLookup: (_, __) async => true,
+      )));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+      expect(find.byIcon(Icons.celebration_rounded), findsNothing);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('stays hidden outside the payday window without querying', (tester) async {
+      var called = false;
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_wrap(PaydayCheckinBanner(
+        householdId: 'h1',
+        clock: () => DateTime(2026, 10, 15),
+        salaryLookup: (_, __) async {
+          called = true;
+          return false;
+        },
+      )));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+      expect(called, isFalse);
+      expect(find.byIcon(Icons.celebration_rounded), findsNothing);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('lookup failure hides the banner without crashing', (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_wrap(PaydayCheckinBanner(
+        householdId: 'h1',
+        clock: () => DateTime(2026, 10, 27),
+        salaryLookup: (_, __) async => throw Exception('column does not exist'),
+      )));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+      expect(find.byIcon(Icons.celebration_rounded), findsNothing);
+      expect(tester.takeException(), isNull);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('dismiss button hides the banner', (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_wrap(PaydayCheckinBanner(
+        householdId: 'h1',
+        clock: () => DateTime(2026, 10, 28),
+        salaryLookup: (_, __) async => false,
+      )));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      await tester.tap(find.byIcon(Icons.close));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+      expect(find.byIcon(Icons.celebration_rounded), findsNothing);
+    });
+  });
+}
diff --git a/flutter_app/test/widgets/ui_settlement_failure_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/widgets/ui_settlement_failure_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..2a46a11
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/widgets/ui_settlement_failure_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,103 @@
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/models.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/nafaqah.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/dashboard/family_reimbursement_card.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/dashboard/multi_roommate_settlement_card.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_localizations/flutter_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+Widget _app(Widget child, {Locale locale = const Locale('en')}) => MaterialApp(
+      locale: locale,
+      supportedLocales: const [Locale('en'), Locale('ar'), Locale('ur')],
+      localizationsDelegates: const [
+        AppLocalizationsDelegate(),
+        GlobalMaterialLocalizations.delegate,
+        GlobalWidgetsLocalizations.delegate,
+        GlobalCupertinoLocalizations.delegate,
+      ],
+      home: Scaffold(body: SingleChildScrollView(child: child)),
+    );
+
+void main() {
+  // Regression: both settlement sheets swallowed API errors and still showed
+  // "Settlement Recorded" and fired the confirmation callback.
+  testWidgets('family reimbursement failure is reported, sheet stays open', (tester) async {
+    var confirmed = false;
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_app(FamilyReimbursementCard(
+      householdId: 'hh-1',
+      summary: const NafaqahSummary(
+        mode: 'family_nafaqah',
+        callerRole: 'husband',
+        callerUserId: 'u-h',
+        wives: [NafaqahWife(id: 'u-w', reimbursement: ReimbursementBalance(grossAdvanced: 350, outstanding: 350))],
+        canRecordReimbursement: true,
+      ),
+      onReimbursed: () => confirmed = true,
+      recordReimbursement: ({required double amount, required String paymentMethod, required String wifeUserId}) async =>
+          throw Exception('HTTP 500'),
+    )));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+    await tester.tap(find.text('Reimburse Wife'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    await tester.tap(find.text('Record Settlement Payment'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+    expect(confirmed, isFalse);
+    expect(find.text('Settlement Failed'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('Settlement Recorded'), findsNothing);
+    expect(find.text('Settle Wife Reimbursement'), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('roommate settlement failure is reported, callback not fired', (tester) async {
+    var settled = false;
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_app(MultiRoommateSettlementCard(
+      householdId: 'hh-2',
+      summary: const SettlementV2Summary(
+        mode: 'multi_roommate',
+        pairwiseDebts: [],
+        simplifiedDebts: [
+          SimplifiedDebt(fromId: 'a', toId: 'b', fromName: 'Omar', toName: 'Ahmed', amount: 120.0),
+        ],
+        roommateBalances: {'a': -120.0, 'b': 120.0},
+      ),
+      onSettled: () => settled = true,
+      recordPayment: (_) async => throw Exception('offline'),
+    )));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+    await tester.tap(find.widgetWithText(ElevatedButton, 'Settle').first);
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+    await tester.tap(find.text('Record Settlement Payment'));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+    expect(settled, isFalse);
+    expect(find.text('Settlement Failed'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.text('Record Roommate Settlement'), findsOneWidget);
+  });
+
+  testWidgets('roommate card renders Arabic labels and riyal amounts in RTL', (tester) async {
+    await tester.pumpWidget(_app(
+      const MultiRoommateSettlementCard(
+        householdId: 'hh-3',
+        summary: SettlementV2Summary(
+          mode: 'multi_roommate',
+          pairwiseDebts: [],
+          simplifiedDebts: [
+            SimplifiedDebt(fromId: 'a', toId: 'b', fromName: 'عمر', toName: 'أحمد', amount: 50.0),
+          ],
+          roommateBalances: {'a': -50.0, 'b': 50.0},
+        ),
+      ),
+      locale: const Locale('ar'),
+    ));
+    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+    final dir = Directionality.of(tester.element(find.byType(MultiRoommateSettlementCard)));
+    expect(dir, TextDirection.rtl);
+    expect(find.text('عمر مدين لـأحمد'), findsOneWidget, reason: 'UX-16: no stray space after لـ');
+    expect(find.text('50.00 ر.س'), findsOneWidget);
+    expect(find.textContaining('SAR'), findsNothing);
+  });
+}

diff --git a/flutter_app/test/widgets/wife_allowance_card_test.dart b/flutter_app/test/widgets/wife_allowance_card_test.dart
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3064331
--- /dev/null
+++ b/flutter_app/test/widgets/wife_allowance_card_test.dart
@@ -0,0 +1,61 @@
+import 'package:budget_tracker/l10n/app_localizations.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/models/nafaqah.dart';
+import 'package:budget_tracker/widgets/nafaqah/wife_allowance_card.dart';
+import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
+import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
+
+Widget _host(AllowanceStatus allowance, {bool viewerIsWife = false}) => MaterialApp(
+      localizationsDelegates: const [AppLocalizationsDelegate()],
+      supportedLocales: const [Locale('en'), Locale('ar'), Locale('ur')],
+      locale: const Locale('en'),
+      home: Scaffold(
+        body: SingleChildScrollView(
+          child: WifeAllowanceCard(
+            householdId: 'hh',
+            wife: NafaqahWife(id: 'w1', displayName: 'Sara', allowance: allowance),
+            cycleKey: '2026-11',
+            viewerIsWife: viewerIsWife,
+          ),
+        ),
+      ),
+    );
+
+void main() {
+  group('working wife without an allowance (§2.3)', () {
+    testWidgets('shows her personal spending neutrally, never "overspent"', (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(_host(const AllowanceStatus(cycleKey: '2026-11', spent: 200, remaining: -200)));
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+
+      expect(find.byKey(const ValueKey('allowance_personal_spending')), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(find.textContaining('SAR 200.00'), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(find.textContaining('Over the allowance'), findsNothing);
+      expect(find.byKey(const ValueKey('allowance_remaining_value')), findsNothing);
+      expect(find.byType(LinearProgressIndicator), findsNothing);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('the wife herself reads "your" personal spending', (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(
+        _host(const AllowanceStatus(cycleKey: '2026-11', spent: 75, remaining: -75), viewerIsWife: true),
+      );
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      expect(find.textContaining('Your personal spending'), findsOneWidget);
+    });
+
+    testWidgets('"overspent" appears only when an allowance exists', (tester) async {
+      await tester.pumpWidget(
+        _host(const AllowanceStatus(cycleKey: '2026-11', isSet: true, allocated: 100, spent: 150, remaining: -50)),
+      );
+      await tester.pumpAndSettle();
+      expect(find.textContaining('Over the allowance'), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(find.byKey(const ValueKey('allowance_remaining_value')), findsOneWidget);
+      expect(find.byKey(const ValueKey('allowance_personal_spending')), findsNothing);
+    });
+  });
+
+  test('AllowanceStatus: no allowance means never overspent', () {
+    expect(const AllowanceStatus(spent: 200, remaining: -200).isOverspent, isFalse);
+    expect(const AllowanceStatus(spent: 200, remaining: -200).hasAllowance, isFalse);
+    expect(const AllowanceStatus(allocated: 100, spent: 150, remaining: -50).isOverspent, isTrue);
+    expect(const AllowanceStatus(isSet: true, allocated: 100, spent: 50, remaining: 50).isOverspent, isFalse);
+  });
+}

-    // Tab switcher
-    function switchSimulatorTab(tabNumber) {
-      for (let i = 1; i <= 4; i++) {
-        const panel = document.getElementById('sim-panel-' + i);
-        const btn = document.getElementById('tab-btn-' + i);
-        if (panel && btn) {
-          panel.classList.add('hidden');
-          btn.classList.remove('bg-gradient-to-r', 'from-primary', 'to-primary-container', 'text-white', 'shadow-md');
-          btn.classList.add('text-slate-700');
-        }
-      }
-      const activePanel = document.getElementById('sim-panel-' + tabNumber);
-      const activeBtn = document.getElementById('tab-btn-' + tabNumber);
-      if (activePanel && activeBtn) {
-        activePanel.classList.remove('hidden');
-        activeBtn.classList.remove('text-slate-700');
-        activeBtn.classList.add('bg-gradient-to-r', 'from-primary', 'to-primary-container', 'text-white', 'shadow-md');
-      }
-    }
-
-    // Dynamic slider logic for flexible salary cycle
-    function updateSalarySimulation(dayVal) {
-      const dayDisplay = document.getElementById('salary-day-display');
-      const daysLeftVal = document.getElementById('days-left-val');
-      const safeSpendVal = document.getElementById('safe-spend-val');
-      const reserveVal = document.getElementById('reserve-val');
-
-      if (dayDisplay) {
-        dayDisplay.textContent = dayVal + ' من كل شهر';
-      }
-
-      const num = parseInt(dayVal, 10);
-      const calculatedDaysLeft = ((num + 14) % 28) + 2;
-      const pool = 4500;
-      const reserve = Math.round(pool * 0.25);
-      const spendable = pool - reserve;
-      const dailySafe = (spendable / calculatedDaysLeft).toFixed(2);
-
-      if (daysLeftVal) daysLeftVal.textContent = calculatedDaysLeft + ' يوماً';
-      if (safeSpendVal) safeSpendVal.textContent = dailySafe + ' ر.س';
-      if (reserveVal) reserveVal.textContent = reserve.toLocaleString('ar-SA') + ' ر.س';
-    }
-

-          roommatesBtn.classList.remove('text-slate-600', 'font-semibold');

-    // FAQ Accordion Toggle
-    function toggleFaq(id) {

diff --git a/supabase/migrations/20261020005000_preflight_live_alignment.sql b/supabase/migrations/20261020005000_preflight_live_alignment.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ae4275e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/migrations/20261020005000_preflight_live_alignment.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- Migration: 20261020005000_preflight_live_alignment.sql
+-- Pre-flight for the 20261020* audit migrations. Captures the live-only
+-- objects found by the read-only catalog comparison
+-- (docs/review/audit/live_db_preflight.md) so a rebuild from the repository
+-- matches the live project. Idempotent, and it loses no data: it only adds a
+-- column when it is missing and revokes one function privilege.
+--
+--   1. households.rollover_rule exists on live (text, DEFAULT 'accumulate') but
+--      no migration creates it. ai_service reads and writes it
+--      (get_/set_household_rollover_rule) and falls back to 'send_to_savings'
+--      for values it does not recognise, such as the live default. Captured
+--      as it is on live; changing the default is a product decision.
+--   2. public.rls_auto_enable() is the function behind the platform's
+--      `ensure_rls` event trigger (it enables RLS on every new public table).
+--      Live has it in public with the default EXECUTE grant to PUBLIC, so anon
+--      holds EXECUTE on it (guardrail test 14). An event-trigger function
+--      cannot be called directly, and the event trigger still fires after the
+--      revoke (verified on the replica). The function exists only on hosted
+--      projects that have the feature, so the revoke is guarded.
+-- Proof: supabase/tests/14_audit_catalog_guardrails.sql (replica and rebuild)
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+BEGIN;
+
+ALTER TABLE public.households
+    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS rollover_rule text DEFAULT 'accumulate';
+
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    IF to_regprocedure('public.rls_auto_enable()') IS NOT NULL THEN
+        REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.rls_auto_enable() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+    END IF;
+END $$;
+
+COMMIT;
diff --git a/supabase/migrations/20261020010000_audit_invites_rls_and_targeted_claims.sql b/supabase/migrations/20261020010000_audit_invites_rls_and_targeted_claims.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1601307
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/migrations/20261020010000_audit_invites_rls_and_targeted_claims.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,245 @@
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- Migration: 20261020010000_audit_invites_rls_and_targeted_claims.sql
+-- Audit DB-01 (Critical): household_invites had policies but RLS was never
+--   enabled, so with Supabase's default table grants anon could list every
+--   invite code and any authenticated user could insert an invite for any
+--   household (then join it), or re-open used/expired invites via UPDATE.
+-- Audit DB-05 (High): join_household_by_code / claim_household_role_invite
+--   updated household_dependents.claimed_user_id, a column that does not exist
+--   (the schema column is linked_user_id), so every targeted invite failed; the
+--   target member was also never checked against the invite's household.
+--   claim_household_role_invite additionally had no failed-attempt lockout.
+-- Proof test: supabase/tests/08_audit_invites_rls_and_targeted_claims.sql
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+BEGIN;
+
+-- 1. Enforce RLS on household_invites (policies from 20261019030000 become live)
+ALTER TABLE public.household_invites ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+REVOKE ALL ON public.household_invites FROM anon;
+
+-- 2. target_member_id must reference a manual member of the same household.
+--    Enforced by trigger so it also binds service-role inserts (ai_service).
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_invite_target_member()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+    IF NEW.target_member_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
+        SELECT 1
+        FROM public.household_dependents d
+        WHERE d.id = NEW.target_member_id
+          AND d.household_id = NEW.household_id
+    ) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invite target member % does not belong to household %', NEW.target_member_id, NEW.household_id
+            USING ERRCODE = '23503';
+    END IF;
+    RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.validate_invite_target_member() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_validate_invite_target_member ON public.household_invites;
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_validate_invite_target_member
+BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF target_member_id, household_id ON public.household_invites
+FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.validate_invite_target_member();
+
+-- 3. join_household_by_code: link manual member via linked_user_id (household-scoped)
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.join_household_by_code(p_invite_code text)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+    v_clean_code text := upper(trim(p_invite_code));
+    v_fail_count int;
+    v_invite public.household_invites%ROWTYPE;
+    v_hh public.households%ROWTYPE;
+    v_claimed_id uuid;
+BEGIN
+    IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_fail_count
+    FROM public.invite_attempt_log
+    WHERE user_id = v_uid
+      AND success = false
+      AND attempted_at > (now() - interval '15 minutes');
+
+    IF v_fail_count >= 5 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Too many failed join attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT * INTO v_invite
+    FROM public.household_invites
+    WHERE upper(trim(invite_code)) = v_clean_code;
+
+    IF v_invite.id IS NOT NULL THEN
+        IF v_invite.expires_at < now() THEN
+            INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, false);
+            RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invite code has expired');
+        END IF;
+
+        IF v_invite.used_by = v_uid THEN
+            v_claimed_id := v_invite.id;
+        ELSIF v_invite.used_by IS NULL THEN
+            UPDATE public.household_invites
+            SET used_by = v_uid
+            WHERE id = v_invite.id AND used_by IS NULL
+            RETURNING id INTO v_claimed_id;
+
+            IF v_claimed_id IS NULL THEN
+                INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, false);
+                RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invite code has already been used');
+            END IF;
+        ELSE
+            INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, false);
+            RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invite code has already been used');
+        END IF;
+
+        SELECT * INTO v_hh FROM public.households WHERE id = v_invite.household_id;
+
+        IF v_invite.target_member_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+            UPDATE public.household_dependents
+            SET linked_user_id = v_uid
+            WHERE id = v_invite.target_member_id
+              AND household_id = v_invite.household_id;
+        END IF;
+
+        UPDATE public.users
+        SET household_id = v_hh.id,
+            role = 'member',
+            financial_role = CASE
+                WHEN v_invite.role IN ('provider', 'spouse', 'peer', 'family_member', 'dependent') THEN v_invite.role
+                ELSE financial_role
+            END
+        WHERE id = v_uid;
+
+        INSERT INTO public.household_memberships (household_id, user_id, role, is_default)
+        VALUES (v_hh.id, v_uid, 'member', false)
+        ON CONFLICT (household_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET role = COALESCE(public.household_memberships.role, 'member');
+
+        INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, true);
+        RETURN to_jsonb(v_hh);
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT * INTO v_hh
+    FROM public.households
+    WHERE upper(trim(invite_code)) = v_clean_code;
+
+    IF v_hh.id IS NOT NULL THEN
+        UPDATE public.users
+        SET household_id = v_hh.id,
+            role = 'member'
+        WHERE id = v_uid;
+
+        INSERT INTO public.household_memberships (household_id, user_id, role, is_default)
+        VALUES (v_hh.id, v_uid, 'member', false)
+        ON CONFLICT (household_id, user_id) DO NOTHING;
+
+        INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, true);
+        RETURN to_jsonb(v_hh);
+    END IF;
+
+    INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, false);
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invalid invite code');
+END;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.join_household_by_code(text) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.join_household_by_code(text) TO authenticated;
+
+-- 4. claim_household_role_invite: linked_user_id, household-scoped link, lockout
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_household_role_invite(
+    p_invite_code text,
+    p_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_uid uuid;
+    v_clean_code text := upper(trim(p_invite_code));
+    v_fail_count int;
+    v_invite public.household_invites%ROWTYPE;
+    v_hh public.households%ROWTYPE;
+BEGIN
+    IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND p_user_id IS NOT NULL AND p_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid() THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: cannot claim an invite on behalf of another user' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    v_uid := COALESCE(auth.uid(), p_user_id);
+
+    IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_fail_count
+    FROM public.invite_attempt_log
+    WHERE user_id = v_uid
+      AND success = false
+      AND attempted_at > (now() - interval '15 minutes');
+
+    IF v_fail_count >= 5 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Too many failed join attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.';
+    END IF;
+
+    UPDATE public.household_invites
+    SET used_by = v_uid
+    WHERE upper(trim(invite_code)) = v_clean_code
+      AND used_by IS NULL
+      AND expires_at > now()
+    RETURNING * INTO v_invite;
+
+    IF v_invite.id IS NULL THEN
+        INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, false);
+        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invalid, expired, or already used invite code');
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT * INTO v_hh FROM public.households WHERE id = v_invite.household_id;
+
+    IF v_invite.target_member_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+        UPDATE public.household_dependents
+        SET linked_user_id = v_uid
+        WHERE id = v_invite.target_member_id
+          AND household_id = v_invite.household_id;
+    END IF;
+
+    UPDATE public.users
+    SET household_id = v_hh.id,
+        role = 'member',
+        financial_role = CASE
+            WHEN v_invite.role IN ('provider', 'spouse', 'peer', 'family_member', 'dependent') THEN v_invite.role
+            ELSE financial_role
+        END
+    WHERE id = v_uid;
+
+    INSERT INTO public.household_memberships (household_id, user_id, role, is_default)
+    VALUES (v_hh.id, v_uid, 'member', false)
+    ON CONFLICT (household_id, user_id)
+    DO UPDATE SET role = COALESCE(public.household_memberships.role, 'member');
+
+    INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, true);
+
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+        'success', true,
+        'household_id', v_hh.id,
+        'household_name', v_hh.name,
+        'role', v_invite.role,
+        'target_member_id', v_invite.target_member_id
+    );
+END;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.claim_household_role_invite(text, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.claim_household_role_invite(text, uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+COMMIT;
diff --git a/supabase/migrations/20261020020000_audit_membership_policy_recursion.sql b/supabase/migrations/20261020020000_audit_membership_policy_recursion.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8d97abf
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/migrations/20261020020000_audit_membership_policy_recursion.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,107 @@
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- Migration: 20261020020000_audit_membership_policy_recursion.sql
+-- Audit DB-02 (High): memberships_admin_manage (FOR ALL, role PUBLIC, from
+--   20261018_household_memberships_and_switching.sql) selects from
+--   household_memberships inside its own USING clause. Every authenticated read
+--   of household_memberships, and every storage.objects receipts policy (which
+--   consults the table), raised "infinite recursion detected in policy", i.e.
+--   receipt upload/view was broken for all users. Had it evaluated, it would also
+--   have let admins INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE membership rows directly, bypassing the
+--   RPCs (remove_member, set_member_role, leave_household) that keep
+--   users.household_id consistent.
+-- Fix: drop it; expose read-only access through a SECURITY DEFINER helper
+--   (no recursion); all writes stay in the SECURITY DEFINER RPCs.
+-- Hardening: RLS helpers now require a live membership row for the active
+--   household, so a stale users.household_id can never grant access.
+-- Proof test: supabase/tests/09_audit_membership_policies.sql
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+BEGIN;
+
+-- 1. Non-recursive admin check
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_household_admin(p_household_id uuid)
+RETURNS boolean
+LANGUAGE sql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+    SELECT EXISTS (
+        SELECT 1
+        FROM public.household_memberships m
+        WHERE m.household_id = p_household_id
+          AND m.user_id = auth.uid()
+          AND m.role = 'admin'
+    );
+$$;
+
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.is_household_admin(uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.is_household_admin(uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+-- 2. Replace recursive / write-enabling policies with a single read policy
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS memberships_admin_manage ON public.household_memberships;
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS memberships_view_own ON public.household_memberships;
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS memberships_select_own_or_admin ON public.household_memberships;
+
+CREATE POLICY memberships_select_own_or_admin ON public.household_memberships
+    FOR SELECT
+    TO authenticated
+    USING (
+        user_id = (SELECT auth.uid())
+        OR public.is_household_admin(household_id)
+    );
+
+REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE ON public.household_memberships FROM anon, authenticated;
+REVOKE ALL ON public.household_memberships FROM anon;
+
+-- 3. Backfill: every active household pointer must be backed by a membership
+INSERT INTO public.household_memberships (household_id, user_id, role, is_default)
+SELECT u.household_id,
+       u.id,
+       COALESCE(u.role, 'member'),
+       NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships m2 WHERE m2.user_id = u.id)
+FROM public.users u
+WHERE u.household_id IS NOT NULL
+  AND NOT EXISTS (
+      SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships m
+      WHERE m.user_id = u.id AND m.household_id = u.household_id
+  )
+ON CONFLICT (household_id, user_id) DO NOTHING;
+
+-- 4. Membership-backed RLS helpers (signatures unchanged; policies keep working)
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_auth_user_household_id()
+RETURNS uuid
+LANGUAGE sql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+    SELECT u.household_id
+    FROM public.users u
+    JOIN public.household_memberships m
+      ON m.user_id = u.id
+     AND m.household_id = u.household_id
+    WHERE u.id = auth.uid();
+$$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_auth_user_role()
+RETURNS text
+LANGUAGE sql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+    SELECT m.role
+    FROM public.users u
+    JOIN public.household_memberships m
+      ON m.user_id = u.id
+     AND m.household_id = u.household_id
+    WHERE u.id = auth.uid();
+$$;
+
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_auth_user_household_id() FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_auth_user_role() FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_auth_user_household_id() TO authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_auth_user_role() TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+COMMIT;
diff --git a/supabase/migrations/20261020030000_audit_reallocate_budget_authz.sql b/supabase/migrations/20261020030000_audit_reallocate_budget_authz.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8b8764e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/migrations/20261020030000_audit_reallocate_budget_authz.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,86 @@
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- Migration: 20261020030000_audit_reallocate_budget_authz.sql
+-- Audit DB-03 (Critical): public.reallocate_budget (schema.sql) is SECURITY
+--   DEFINER, performs no caller/household checks, accepts any amount (negative,
+--   sub-halala) and kept the default EXECUTE grant to PUBLIC. Anyone holding the
+--   public anon key could rewrite any household's budget allocations by UUID.
+-- Fix: EXECUTE only for authenticated + service_role; JWT callers must be an
+--   admin of the household owning BOTH budget rows; amounts must be positive,
+--   at most 2 decimals and covered by the source allocation; rows are locked in
+--   deterministic id order. Service-role callers (ai_service auto-reallocation)
+--   keep working without a user JWT.
+-- Proof test: supabase/tests/10_audit_reallocate_budget_authz.sql
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+BEGIN;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reallocate_budget(
+    p_from_id uuid,
+    p_to_id uuid,
+    p_amount numeric
+)
+RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+    v_jwt_role text := auth.role();
+    v_from public.budgets%ROWTYPE;
+    v_to public.budgets%ROWTYPE;
+BEGIN
+    IF v_uid IS NULL AND v_jwt_role IS DISTINCT FROM 'service_role' AND v_jwt_role IS NOT NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_from_id IS NULL OR p_to_id IS NULL OR p_from_id = p_to_id THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Two distinct budget ids are required' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_amount IS NULL OR p_amount <= 0 OR p_amount <> round(p_amount, 2) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Reallocation amount must be positive with at most 2 decimals' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_from_id < p_to_id THEN
+        SELECT * INTO v_from FROM public.budgets WHERE id = p_from_id FOR UPDATE;
+        SELECT * INTO v_to FROM public.budgets WHERE id = p_to_id FOR UPDATE;
+    ELSE
+        SELECT * INTO v_to FROM public.budgets WHERE id = p_to_id FOR UPDATE;
+        SELECT * INTO v_from FROM public.budgets WHERE id = p_from_id FOR UPDATE;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_from.id IS NULL OR v_to.id IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Budget not found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_from.household_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_to.household_id THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Budgets belong to different households' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_uid IS NOT NULL THEN
+        IF public.get_auth_user_household_id() IS DISTINCT FROM v_from.household_id
+           OR public.get_auth_user_role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'admin' THEN
+            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: household admin required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+        END IF;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_from.allocated_amount < p_amount THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Insufficient allocation: % available, % requested', v_from.allocated_amount, p_amount
+            USING ERRCODE = '22000';
+    END IF;
+
+    UPDATE public.budgets
+    SET allocated_amount = allocated_amount - p_amount
+    WHERE id = v_from.id;
+
+    UPDATE public.budgets
+    SET allocated_amount = allocated_amount + p_amount
+    WHERE id = v_to.id;
+END;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.reallocate_budget(uuid, uuid, numeric) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.reallocate_budget(uuid, uuid, numeric) TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+COMMIT;
diff --git a/supabase/migrations/20261020040000_audit_cost_control_codes_policies.sql b/supabase/migrations/20261020040000_audit_cost_control_codes_policies.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..96f284e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/migrations/20261020040000_audit_cost_control_codes_policies.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- Migration: 20261020040000_audit_cost_control_codes_policies.sql
+-- Audit DB-04 (High): cost_control_codes_insert / _update (role PUBLIC, from
+--   20261011_hybrid_category_lifecycle.sql) only required
+--   "household_id IS NOT NULL AND is_system = false". anon and any authenticated
+--   user could insert categories into any household's taxonomy (UI pollution and
+--   squatting on (household_id, code) so the victim cannot create that code),
+--   and move their own custom categories into another household. SEC-01/02 only
+--   fixed the SELECT policy.
+-- Fix: writes restricted to admins of the caller's active household, for
+--   non-system rows of that household; no client DELETE (taxonomy rows are
+--   deactivated via household_category_settings); anon loses all privileges.
+--   ai_service writes with the service role and is unaffected.
+-- Proof test: supabase/tests/11_audit_cost_control_codes_policies.sql
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+BEGIN;
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS cost_control_codes_insert ON public.cost_control_codes;
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS cost_control_codes_update ON public.cost_control_codes;
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS cost_control_codes_delete ON public.cost_control_codes;
+
+CREATE POLICY cost_control_codes_insert ON public.cost_control_codes
+    FOR INSERT
+    TO authenticated
+    WITH CHECK (
+        is_system = false
+        AND household_id IS NOT NULL
+        AND household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id())
+        AND (SELECT public.get_auth_user_role()) = 'admin'
+    );
+
+CREATE POLICY cost_control_codes_update ON public.cost_control_codes
+    FOR UPDATE
+    TO authenticated
+    USING (
+        is_system = false
+        AND household_id IS NOT NULL
+        AND household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id())
+        AND (SELECT public.get_auth_user_role()) = 'admin'
+    )
+    WITH CHECK (
+        is_system = false
+        AND household_id IS NOT NULL
+        AND household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id())
+        AND (SELECT public.get_auth_user_role()) = 'admin'
+    );
+
+REVOKE ALL ON public.cost_control_codes FROM anon;
+REVOKE DELETE, TRUNCATE ON public.cost_control_codes FROM authenticated;
+
+COMMIT;
diff --git a/supabase/migrations/20261020050000_audit_ledger_precision_and_income_append_only.sql b/supabase/migrations/20261020050000_audit_ledger_precision_and_income_append_only.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..e52457a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/migrations/20261020050000_audit_ledger_precision_and_income_append_only.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,305 @@
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- Migration: 20261020050000_audit_ledger_precision_and_income_append_only.sql
+-- Audit DB-06 (Medium): transfer_between_accounts / record_income accept
+--   unconstrained NUMERIC while the ledger columns are NUMERIC(14,2)/(10,2).
+--   A 3-decimal amount is rounded independently on each side (1.005 debits 1.00
+--   from the source, credits 1.01 to the destination and logs 1.01), so a user
+--   can mint 0.01 SAR per call between two own accounts. record_income also
+--   accepted negative components (negative deductions inflate net income) and
+--   any cycle_key string.
+-- Audit DB-07 (Medium): income_insert_household (20261019090000) still lets a
+--   client INSERT income_records directly - bypassing record_income's account
+--   ownership check and balance update - with any sign and any account of the
+--   household, forging the income ledger the budgets/rollover read.
+-- Fix: precision/sign/format validation inside both RPCs (cycle_key derived
+--   from received_at + household payday when NULL); income_records and
+--   account_transfers become client read-only (RPCs are SECURITY DEFINER).
+-- Proof test: supabase/tests/12_audit_ledger_integrity.sql
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+BEGIN;
+
+-- 1. transfer_between_accounts: reject amounts/fees with more than 2 decimals
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.transfer_between_accounts(
+    p_household_id UUID,
+    p_from_account_id UUID,
+    p_to_account_id UUID,
+    p_amount NUMERIC,
+    p_fee NUMERIC DEFAULT 0.0,
+    p_notes TEXT DEFAULT NULL
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_caller_uid UUID;
+    v_from_acc RECORD;
+    v_to_acc RECORD;
+    v_total_deduction NUMERIC;
+    v_transfer_id UUID;
+    v_created_at TIMESTAMPTZ := now();
+    v_result jsonb;
+BEGIN
+    v_caller_uid := auth.uid();
+    IF v_caller_uid IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_amount IS NULL OR p_amount <= 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Transfer amount must be positive' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_fee IS NULL OR p_fee < 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Transfer fee cannot be negative' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Columns are NUMERIC(14,2)/(10,2): a third decimal would be rounded
+    -- independently on each side of the transfer and mint or burn money.
+    IF p_amount <> round(p_amount, 2) OR p_fee <> round(p_fee, 2) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Transfer amount and fee must have at most 2 decimal places' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_from_account_id = p_to_account_id THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot transfer between the same account' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Strict NULL-safe membership check
+    IF p_household_id IS NULL OR public.get_auth_user_household_id() IS NULL OR p_household_id IS DISTINCT FROM public.get_auth_user_household_id() THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: caller does not belong to specified household' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Lock accounts in deterministic UUID order to prevent deadlocks
+    IF p_from_account_id < p_to_account_id THEN
+        SELECT * INTO v_from_acc FROM public.accounts WHERE id = p_from_account_id FOR UPDATE;
+        SELECT * INTO v_to_acc FROM public.accounts WHERE id = p_to_account_id FOR UPDATE;
+    ELSE
+        SELECT * INTO v_to_acc FROM public.accounts WHERE id = p_to_account_id FOR UPDATE;
+        SELECT * INTO v_from_acc FROM public.accounts WHERE id = p_from_account_id FOR UPDATE;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_from_acc.id IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Source account not found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+    END IF;
+    IF v_to_acc.id IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Destination account not found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_from_acc.household_id <> p_household_id OR v_to_acc.household_id <> p_household_id THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Both accounts must belong to the household' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Caller must own source account OR source account is shared pool
+    IF v_from_acc.is_shared_pool = false AND v_from_acc.owner_user_id <> v_caller_uid THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: cannot transfer from an account owned by another user' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    v_total_deduction := p_amount + p_fee;
+    IF v_from_acc.balance < v_total_deduction THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Insufficient funds: balance (%) is less than transfer plus fee (%)', v_from_acc.balance, v_total_deduction USING ERRCODE = '22000';
+    END IF;
+
+    UPDATE public.accounts
+    SET balance = balance - v_total_deduction,
+        updated_at = v_created_at
+    WHERE id = p_from_account_id;
+
+    UPDATE public.accounts
+    SET balance = balance + p_amount,
+        updated_at = v_created_at
+    WHERE id = p_to_account_id;
+
+    INSERT INTO public.account_transfers (
+        household_id,
+        user_id,
+        from_account_id,
+        to_account_id,
+        amount,
+        fee,
+        timestamp,
+        notes,
+        created_at
+    ) VALUES (
+        p_household_id,
+        v_caller_uid,
+        p_from_account_id,
+        p_to_account_id,
+        p_amount,
+        p_fee,
+        v_created_at,
+        p_notes,
+        v_created_at
+    ) RETURNING id INTO v_transfer_id;
+
+    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
+        'id', v_transfer_id,
+        'household_id', p_household_id,
+        'user_id', v_caller_uid,
+        'from_account_id', p_from_account_id,
+        'to_account_id', p_to_account_id,
+        'amount', p_amount,
+        'fee', p_fee,
+        'timestamp', v_created_at,
+        'notes', p_notes,
+        'created_at', v_created_at
+    ) INTO v_result;
+
+    RETURN v_result;
+END;
+$$;
+
+-- 2. record_income: precision, non-negative components, cycle_key format/derivation
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_income(
+    p_household_id UUID,
+    p_account_id UUID,
+    p_cycle_key TEXT,
+    p_source_type TEXT,
+    p_title TEXT,
+    p_base_amount NUMERIC,
+    p_overtime NUMERIC DEFAULT 0.0,
+    p_bonus NUMERIC DEFAULT 0.0,
+    p_deductions NUMERIC DEFAULT 0.0,
+    p_received_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
+    p_notes TEXT DEFAULT NULL
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_caller_uid UUID;
+    v_acc RECORD;
+    v_net_amount NUMERIC;
+    v_income_id UUID;
+    v_received_at TIMESTAMPTZ := COALESCE(p_received_at, now());
+    v_cycle_key TEXT;
+    v_result jsonb;
+BEGIN
+    v_caller_uid := auth.uid();
+    IF v_caller_uid IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Strict NULL-safe membership check
+    IF p_household_id IS NULL OR public.get_auth_user_household_id() IS NULL OR p_household_id IS DISTINCT FROM public.get_auth_user_household_id() THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: caller does not belong to specified household' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF COALESCE(p_base_amount, 0.0) < 0 OR COALESCE(p_overtime, 0.0) < 0
+       OR COALESCE(p_bonus, 0.0) < 0 OR COALESCE(p_deductions, 0.0) < 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Income components cannot be negative' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF COALESCE(p_base_amount, 0.0) <> round(COALESCE(p_base_amount, 0.0), 2)
+       OR COALESCE(p_overtime, 0.0) <> round(COALESCE(p_overtime, 0.0), 2)
+       OR COALESCE(p_bonus, 0.0) <> round(COALESCE(p_bonus, 0.0), 2)
+       OR COALESCE(p_deductions, 0.0) <> round(COALESCE(p_deductions, 0.0), 2) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Income amounts must have at most 2 decimal places' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_title IS NULL OR btrim(p_title) = '' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Income title is required' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_cycle_key IS NULL THEN
+        SELECT c.cycle_key INTO v_cycle_key
+        FROM public.get_saudi_cycle_for_timestamp(
+            v_received_at,
+            COALESCE((SELECT h.payday_day FROM public.households h WHERE h.id = p_household_id), 27)
+        ) c;
+    ELSIF p_cycle_key ~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' THEN
+        v_cycle_key := p_cycle_key;
+    ELSE
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'cycle_key must be formatted YYYY-MM' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    v_net_amount := COALESCE(p_base_amount, 0.0) + COALESCE(p_overtime, 0.0) + COALESCE(p_bonus, 0.0) - COALESCE(p_deductions, 0.0);
+    IF v_net_amount <= 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Net income amount must be positive' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT * INTO v_acc FROM public.accounts WHERE id = p_account_id FOR UPDATE;
+    IF v_acc.id IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Target account not found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_acc.household_id <> p_household_id THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Target account belongs to another household' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_acc.is_shared_pool = false AND v_acc.owner_user_id <> v_caller_uid THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: cannot record income into an account owned by another user' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    UPDATE public.accounts
+    SET balance = balance + v_net_amount,
+        updated_at = now()
+    WHERE id = p_account_id;
+
+    INSERT INTO public.income_records (
+        household_id,
+        user_id,
+        account_id,
+        cycle_key,
+        source_type,
+        title,
+        base_amount,
+        overtime,
+        bonus,
+        deductions,
+        net_amount,
+        received_at,
+        notes,
+        created_at
+    ) VALUES (
+        p_household_id,
+        v_caller_uid,
+        p_account_id,
+        v_cycle_key,
+        p_source_type,
+        p_title,
+        COALESCE(p_base_amount, 0.0),
+        COALESCE(p_overtime, 0.0),
+        COALESCE(p_bonus, 0.0),
+        COALESCE(p_deductions, 0.0),
+        v_net_amount,
+        v_received_at,
+        p_notes,
+        now()
+    ) RETURNING id INTO v_income_id;
+
+    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
+        'id', v_income_id,
+        'household_id', p_household_id,
+        'user_id', v_caller_uid,
+        'account_id', p_account_id,
+        'cycle_key', v_cycle_key,
+        'source_type', p_source_type,
+        'title', p_title,
+        'base_amount', p_base_amount,
+        'overtime', p_overtime,
+        'bonus', p_bonus,
+        'deductions', p_deductions,
+        'net_amount', v_net_amount,
+        'received_at', v_received_at,
+        'notes', p_notes,
+        'created_at', now()
+    ) INTO v_result;
+
+    RETURN v_result;
+END;
+$$;
+
+-- 3. Append-only ledgers: clients read, RPCs write
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS income_insert_household ON public.income_records;
+REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE ON public.income_records FROM anon, authenticated;
+REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE ON public.account_transfers FROM anon, authenticated;
+
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.transfer_between_accounts(UUID, UUID, UUID, NUMERIC, NUMERIC, TEXT) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.transfer_between_accounts(UUID, UUID, UUID, NUMERIC, NUMERIC, TEXT) TO authenticated, service_role;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.record_income(UUID, UUID, TEXT, TEXT, TEXT, NUMERIC, NUMERIC, NUMERIC, NUMERIC, TIMESTAMPTZ, TEXT) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.record_income(UUID, UUID, TEXT, TEXT, TEXT, NUMERIC, NUMERIC, NUMERIC, NUMERIC, TIMESTAMPTZ, TEXT) TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+COMMIT;
diff --git a/supabase/migrations/20261020060000_audit_transaction_cycle_key_integrity.sql b/supabase/migrations/20261020060000_audit_transaction_cycle_key_integrity.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..d694bff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/migrations/20261020060000_audit_transaction_cycle_key_integrity.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- Migration: 20261020060000_audit_transaction_cycle_key_integrity.sql
+-- Audit DB-08 (Medium): trg_populate_transaction_cycle_key (20261019080000)
+--   fires only on UPDATE OF timestamp, household_id. A household member can
+--   UPDATE transactions SET cycle_key = '<any>' and the forged key is kept;
+--   update_budget_on_transaction_update then removes the amount from the real
+--   cycle budget (spent_amount drops, overspending is hidden from the household).
+-- Fix: also fire when cycle_key is assigned, so the server-derived value
+--   (timestamp in Asia/Riyadh + household payday) always wins.
+-- Proof test: supabase/tests/13_audit_cycle_key_integrity.sql
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+BEGIN;
+
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_populate_transaction_cycle_key ON public.transactions;
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_populate_transaction_cycle_key
