+BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF timestamp, household_id, cycle_key ON public.transactions
+FOR EACH ROW
+EXECUTE FUNCTION public.populate_transaction_cycle_key();
+
+-- No data backfill here on purpose: a stored key that differs from today's
+-- derivation can also stem from a legitimate households.payday_day change, and
+-- silently re-keying history would move spending between past budgets. The
+-- detection query for tampered rows is in docs/review/audit/db.md (DB-08).
+
+COMMIT;
diff --git a/supabase/migrations/20261020070000_audit_definer_search_path_and_household_insert.sql b/supabase/migrations/20261020070000_audit_definer_search_path_and_household_insert.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..74a594e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/migrations/20261020070000_audit_definer_search_path_and_household_insert.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,24 @@
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- Migration: 20261020070000_audit_definer_search_path_and_household_insert.sql
+-- Audit DB-09 (Low): sync_user_household_membership() (20261018) is SECURITY
+--   DEFINER without a pinned search_path, so it resolves unqualified objects
+--   (operators, casts, functions) through the caller's search_path.
+-- Audit DB-10 (Low): households_insert_authenticated allows any authenticated
+--   client to INSERT households directly, bypassing create_household_and_claim
+--   (5-household quota, server-generated 16-hex invite code). The invite_code
+--   UNIQUE violation doubles as an un-rate-limited existence oracle for other
+--   households' static join codes. No client inserts households directly
+--   (Flutter/ai_service use the RPC or the service role).
+-- Proof test: supabase/tests/14_audit_catalog_guardrails.sql
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+BEGIN;
+
+ALTER FUNCTION public.sync_user_household_membership() SET search_path = public, pg_temp;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.sync_user_household_membership() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS households_insert_authenticated ON public.households;
+REVOKE INSERT, DELETE, TRUNCATE ON public.households FROM anon, authenticated;
+REVOKE ALL ON public.households FROM anon;
+
+COMMIT;
diff --git a/supabase/migrations/20261020080000_audit_receipts_bucket_limits.sql b/supabase/migrations/20261020080000_audit_receipts_bucket_limits.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..6731204
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/migrations/20261020080000_audit_receipts_bucket_limits.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- Migration: 20261020080000_audit_receipts_bucket_limits.sql
+-- Audit DB-11 (Low): the private receipts bucket had no file_size_limit and no
+--   allowed_mime_types; storage.objects policies only check the name's
+--   extension, so members could upload arbitrarily large / non-image content
+--   named *.jpg. Storage API enforces these bucket columns on every upload
+--   (client JWT and service role).
+-- Limits: 20 MiB covers ai_service's stitched multi-shot receipts (request body
+--   cap 25 MB base64 ~= 18.75 MB binary); Flutter uploads <= 1600px JPEGs.
+--   MIME list matches the extension allow-list in receipts_insert_household.
+-- Proof test: supabase/tests/15_audit_receipts_bucket_limits.sql
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+UPDATE storage.buckets
+SET file_size_limit = 20 * 1024 * 1024,
+    allowed_mime_types = ARRAY['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'],
+    public = false
+WHERE id = 'receipts';
diff --git a/supabase/migrations/20261020090000_audit_sole_admin_account_deletion.sql b/supabase/migrations/20261020090000_audit_sole_admin_account_deletion.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a1b2825
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/migrations/20261020090000_audit_sole_admin_account_deletion.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,94 @@
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- Migration: 20261020090000_audit_sole_admin_account_deletion.sql
+-- Audit DB-12 (Medium): deleting the auth user of a household's sole admin
+--   (Supabase Auth admin API / in-app "delete my account") cascades
+--   auth.users -> public.users -> household_memberships, where
+--   check_last_admin_membership() raises "Cannot remove the sole admin while
+--   other household members remain". The account can therefore never be
+--   deleted (account-deletion obligations under PDPL / app-store policy).
+--   The same cascade would delete every shared-pool account that admin created
+--   (accounts.owner_user_id ON DELETE CASCADE), wiping the household's shared
+--   funds and nulling account_id on its transactions.
+-- Fix: BEFORE DELETE on public.users hands each household over first: if the
+--   user is the only admin and other members remain, the longest-standing
+--   member is promoted; shared-pool accounts the user owns are re-owned by an
+--   admin of that household. Direct demotion/removal of a sole admin stays
+--   blocked by check_last_admin_membership() (BUG-03 unchanged).
+-- Proof test: supabase/tests/16_audit_account_deletion.sql
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+BEGIN;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handover_households_on_user_delete()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_hh record;
+    v_successor uuid;
+    v_new_owner uuid;
+BEGIN
+    FOR v_hh IN
+        SELECT m.household_id, m.role
+        FROM public.household_memberships m
+        WHERE m.user_id = OLD.id
+    LOOP
+        IF v_hh.role = 'admin'
+           AND NOT EXISTS (
+               SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships o
+               WHERE o.household_id = v_hh.household_id
+                 AND o.user_id <> OLD.id
+                 AND o.role = 'admin'
+           ) THEN
+            SELECT o.user_id INTO v_successor
+            FROM public.household_memberships o
+            WHERE o.household_id = v_hh.household_id
+              AND o.user_id <> OLD.id
+            ORDER BY o.created_at ASC, o.user_id ASC
+            LIMIT 1;
+
+            IF v_successor IS NOT NULL THEN
+                UPDATE public.household_memberships
+                SET role = 'admin'
+                WHERE household_id = v_hh.household_id
+                  AND user_id = v_successor;
+
+                UPDATE public.users
+                SET role = 'admin'
+                WHERE id = v_successor
+                  AND household_id = v_hh.household_id;
+            END IF;
+        END IF;
+
+        SELECT o.user_id INTO v_new_owner
+        FROM public.household_memberships o
+        WHERE o.household_id = v_hh.household_id
+          AND o.user_id <> OLD.id
+          AND o.role = 'admin'
+        ORDER BY o.created_at ASC, o.user_id ASC
+        LIMIT 1;
+
+        IF v_new_owner IS NOT NULL THEN
+            UPDATE public.accounts
+            SET owner_user_id = v_new_owner,
+                updated_at = now()
+            WHERE household_id = v_hh.household_id
+              AND owner_user_id = OLD.id
+              AND is_shared_pool = true;
+        END IF;
+    END LOOP;
+
+    RETURN OLD;
+END;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.handover_households_on_user_delete() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_handover_households_on_user_delete ON public.users;
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_handover_households_on_user_delete
+BEFORE DELETE ON public.users
+FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handover_households_on_user_delete();
+
+COMMIT;
diff --git a/supabase/migrations/20261020100000_audit_rls_initplan_and_fk_indexes.sql b/supabase/migrations/20261020100000_audit_rls_initplan_and_fk_indexes.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..2779355
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/migrations/20261020100000_audit_rls_initplan_and_fk_indexes.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,291 @@
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- Migration: 20261020100000_audit_rls_initplan_and_fk_indexes.sql
+-- Audit DB-13 (Low, performance): RLS policies call auth.uid(),
+--   get_auth_user_household_id() and get_auth_user_role() directly, so they are
+--   evaluated per row (transactions_select_household also re-parses the JWT
+--   claims per row via "auth.uid() IS NOT NULL"; 50k rows ~= 50 ms of pure
+--   policy overhead). Wrapping each call in a scalar sub-select makes it a
+--   one-off InitPlan (Supabase linter: auth_rls_initplan). Policy semantics are
+--   unchanged except that the legacy "household_id IN (SELECT household_id FROM
+--   users WHERE id = auth.uid())" form now goes through the membership-backed
+--   helper (20261020020000), and the receipts storage policies no longer accept
+--   a stale users.household_id without a membership row.
+--   Missing indexes: 6 foreign keys (incl. user_id columns scanned by the
+--   account-deletion cascade) and the invite lockout lookup.
+-- Proof test: supabase/tests/17_audit_rls_performance.sql
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+BEGIN;
+
+-- transactions
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "transactions_select_household" ON public.transactions;
+CREATE POLICY "transactions_select_household" ON public.transactions
+    FOR SELECT
+    TO authenticated
+    USING (household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()));
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "transactions_insert_household" ON public.transactions;
+CREATE POLICY "transactions_insert_household" ON public.transactions
+    FOR INSERT
+    TO authenticated
+    WITH CHECK (household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id())
+        AND (
+            account_id IS NULL
+            OR EXISTS (
+                SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts a
+                WHERE a.id = transactions.account_id
+                  AND a.household_id = transactions.household_id
+                  AND (a.is_shared_pool = true OR a.owner_user_id = (SELECT auth.uid()))
+            )
+        ));
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "transactions_update_household" ON public.transactions;
+CREATE POLICY "transactions_update_household" ON public.transactions
+    FOR UPDATE
+    TO authenticated
+    USING (household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()))
+    WITH CHECK (household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id())
+        AND (
+            account_id IS NULL
+            OR EXISTS (
+                SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts a
+                WHERE a.id = transactions.account_id
+                  AND a.household_id = transactions.household_id
+                  AND (a.is_shared_pool = true OR a.owner_user_id = (SELECT auth.uid()))
+            )
+        ));
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "transactions_delete_household" ON public.transactions;
+CREATE POLICY "transactions_delete_household" ON public.transactions
+    FOR DELETE
+    TO authenticated
+    USING (household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()));
+
+-- budgets
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "budgets_select_household" ON public.budgets;
+CREATE POLICY "budgets_select_household" ON public.budgets
+    FOR SELECT
+    TO authenticated
+    USING (household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()));
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "budgets_insert_admin" ON public.budgets;
+CREATE POLICY "budgets_insert_admin" ON public.budgets
+    FOR INSERT
+    TO authenticated
+    WITH CHECK (household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()) AND (SELECT public.get_auth_user_role()) = 'admin');
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "budgets_update_admin" ON public.budgets;
+CREATE POLICY "budgets_update_admin" ON public.budgets
+    FOR UPDATE
+    TO authenticated
+    USING (household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()) AND (SELECT public.get_auth_user_role()) = 'admin')
+    WITH CHECK (household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()) AND (SELECT public.get_auth_user_role()) = 'admin');
+
+-- accounts
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "accounts_select" ON public.accounts;
+CREATE POLICY "accounts_select" ON public.accounts
+    FOR SELECT
+    TO authenticated
+    USING (owner_user_id = (SELECT auth.uid())
+        OR (is_shared_pool = true AND household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id())));
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "accounts_insert_personal" ON public.accounts;
+CREATE POLICY "accounts_insert_personal" ON public.accounts
+    FOR INSERT
+    TO authenticated
+    WITH CHECK (owner_user_id = (SELECT auth.uid()) AND household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()) AND is_shared_pool = false);
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "accounts_insert_shared" ON public.accounts;
+CREATE POLICY "accounts_insert_shared" ON public.accounts
+    FOR INSERT
+    TO authenticated
+    WITH CHECK (household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()) AND is_shared_pool = true AND (SELECT public.get_auth_user_role()) = 'admin');
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "accounts_update_personal" ON public.accounts;
+CREATE POLICY "accounts_update_personal" ON public.accounts
+    FOR UPDATE
+    TO authenticated
+    USING (owner_user_id = (SELECT auth.uid()) AND household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()))
+    WITH CHECK (owner_user_id = (SELECT auth.uid()) AND household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()) AND is_shared_pool = false);
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "accounts_update_shared" ON public.accounts;
+CREATE POLICY "accounts_update_shared" ON public.accounts
+    FOR UPDATE
+    TO authenticated
+    USING (is_shared_pool = true AND household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()) AND (SELECT public.get_auth_user_role()) = 'admin')
+    WITH CHECK (is_shared_pool = true AND household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()) AND (SELECT public.get_auth_user_role()) = 'admin');
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "accounts_delete_admin_or_owner" ON public.accounts;
+CREATE POLICY "accounts_delete_admin_or_owner" ON public.accounts
+    FOR DELETE
+    TO authenticated
+    USING ((owner_user_id = (SELECT auth.uid()) AND is_shared_pool = false)
+        OR (is_shared_pool = true AND household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()) AND (SELECT public.get_auth_user_role()) = 'admin'));
+
+-- ledgers
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "transfers_select_household" ON public.account_transfers;
+CREATE POLICY "transfers_select_household" ON public.account_transfers
+    FOR SELECT
+    TO authenticated
+    USING (household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()));
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "income_select_household" ON public.income_records;
+CREATE POLICY "income_select_household" ON public.income_records
+    FOR SELECT
+    TO authenticated
+    USING (household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()));
+
+-- households / users / invites
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "households_select_own" ON public.households;
+CREATE POLICY "households_select_own" ON public.households
+    FOR SELECT
+    TO authenticated
+    USING (id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()));
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "households_update_admin" ON public.households;
+CREATE POLICY "households_update_admin" ON public.households
+    FOR UPDATE
+    TO authenticated
+    USING (id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()) AND (SELECT public.get_auth_user_role()) = 'admin')
+    WITH CHECK (id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()) AND (SELECT public.get_auth_user_role()) = 'admin');
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "users_select_household" ON public.users;
+CREATE POLICY "users_select_household" ON public.users
+    FOR SELECT
+    TO authenticated
+    USING (id = (SELECT auth.uid())
+        OR (household_id IS NOT NULL AND household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id())));
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "users_insert_own" ON public.users;
+CREATE POLICY "users_insert_own" ON public.users
+    FOR INSERT
+    TO authenticated
+    WITH CHECK (id = (SELECT auth.uid()) AND household_id IS NULL AND role = 'member');
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "users_update_own_profile" ON public.users;
+CREATE POLICY "users_update_own_profile" ON public.users
+    FOR UPDATE
+    TO authenticated
+    USING (id = (SELECT auth.uid()))
+    WITH CHECK (id = (SELECT auth.uid()));
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "invites_select_household" ON public.household_invites;
+CREATE POLICY "invites_select_household" ON public.household_invites
+    FOR SELECT
+    TO authenticated
+    USING (household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()));
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "invites_insert_household" ON public.household_invites;
+CREATE POLICY "invites_insert_household" ON public.household_invites
+    FOR INSERT
+    TO authenticated
+    WITH CHECK (household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()) AND (SELECT public.get_auth_user_role()) = 'admin');
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "invites_delete_admin" ON public.household_invites;
+CREATE POLICY "invites_delete_admin" ON public.household_invites
+    FOR DELETE
+    TO authenticated
+    USING (household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()) AND (SELECT public.get_auth_user_role()) = 'admin');
+
+-- taxonomy / settings / dependents / installments
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "cost_control_codes_select" ON public.cost_control_codes;
+CREATE POLICY "cost_control_codes_select" ON public.cost_control_codes
+    FOR SELECT
+    TO authenticated
+    USING (household_id IS NULL OR household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()));
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "household_category_settings_all" ON public.household_category_settings;
+CREATE POLICY "household_category_settings_all" ON public.household_category_settings
+    FOR ALL
+    TO authenticated
+    USING (household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()))
+    WITH CHECK (household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()));
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "dependents_select_household" ON public.household_dependents;
+CREATE POLICY "dependents_select_household" ON public.household_dependents
+    FOR SELECT
+    TO authenticated
+    USING (household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()));
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "dependents_delete_household" ON public.household_dependents;
+CREATE POLICY "dependents_delete_household" ON public.household_dependents
+    FOR DELETE
+    TO authenticated
+    USING (household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()));
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "dependents_insert_household" ON public.household_dependents;
+CREATE POLICY "dependents_insert_household" ON public.household_dependents
+    FOR INSERT
+    TO authenticated
+    WITH CHECK (household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()));
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "dependents_update_household" ON public.household_dependents;
+CREATE POLICY "dependents_update_household" ON public.household_dependents
+    FOR UPDATE
+    TO authenticated
+    USING (household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()))
+    WITH CHECK (household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()));
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow household members full access to installment_plans" ON public.installment_plans;
+CREATE POLICY "Allow household members full access to installment_plans" ON public.installment_plans
+    FOR ALL
+    TO authenticated
+    USING (household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()))
+    WITH CHECK (household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()));
+
+-- storage.objects (receipts): membership-scoped, no stale users.household_id branch
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "receipts_insert_household" ON storage.objects;
+CREATE POLICY "receipts_insert_household" ON storage.objects
+    FOR INSERT
+    TO authenticated
+    WITH CHECK (bucket_id = 'receipts'
+        AND (SELECT auth.uid()) IS NOT NULL
+        AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] IN (
+            SELECT m.household_id::text
+            FROM public.household_memberships m
+            WHERE m.user_id = (SELECT auth.uid())
+        )
+        AND lower(storage.extension(name)) = ANY (ARRAY['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'webp'])
+        AND name !~ '\.\.');
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "receipts_select_household" ON storage.objects;
+CREATE POLICY "receipts_select_household" ON storage.objects
+    FOR SELECT
+    TO authenticated
+    USING (bucket_id = 'receipts'
+        AND (SELECT auth.uid()) IS NOT NULL
+        AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] IN (
+            SELECT m.household_id::text
+            FROM public.household_memberships m
+            WHERE m.user_id = (SELECT auth.uid())
+        ));
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "receipts_delete_household" ON storage.objects;
+CREATE POLICY "receipts_delete_household" ON storage.objects
+    FOR DELETE
+    TO authenticated
+    USING (bucket_id = 'receipts'
+        AND (SELECT auth.uid()) IS NOT NULL
+        AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] IN (
+            SELECT m.household_id::text
+            FROM public.household_memberships m
+            WHERE m.user_id = (SELECT auth.uid())
+        ));
+
+-- Foreign-key / lookup indexes
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_transactions_reallocated_from_budget ON public.transactions (reallocated_from_budget_id) WHERE reallocated_from_budget_id IS NOT NULL;
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_household_invites_household ON public.household_invites (household_id);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_household_invites_created_by ON public.household_invites (created_by);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_household_invites_used_by ON public.household_invites (used_by);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_account_transfers_user ON public.account_transfers (user_id);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_income_records_user ON public.income_records (user_id);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_invite_attempt_log_user_time ON public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, attempted_at DESC);
+
+COMMIT;
diff --git a/supabase/migrations/20261020200000_remove_sms_artifacts.sql b/supabase/migrations/20261020200000_remove_sms_artifacts.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..7af9eff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/migrations/20261020200000_remove_sms_artifacts.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,84 @@
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- Migration: 20261020200000_remove_sms_artifacts.sql
+-- Audit API-25 / zero-SMS policy: the app never reads SMS. Expenses come only
+-- from receipt photos, ZATCA QR codes, chat/voice and manual entry.
+--
+-- SMS leftovers in the schema (inventory of a full replay of every migration):
+--   * transactions.source  DEFAULT 'sms' and CHECK (... 'sms' ...), from
+--     20260925_add_line_items_and_sources.sql / 20260930_fix_transactions_rls_and_columns.sql.
+--     Because 'sms' was the column DEFAULT, every insert that did not name a
+--     source (Flutter manual entries before they sent one, SQL/RPC inserts) was
+--     stored as 'sms' although no SMS was ever involved.
+--   * comments: transactions ("Every SMS-derived expense transaction"),
+--     transactions.raw_sms ("Original SMS text for audit trail") and
+--     cost_control_codes ("keyword mapping for SMS merchant matching").
+--   No SMS-only table, function, trigger or column exists, so nothing is dropped.
+--
+-- Changes:
+--   1. Historical rows labelled 'sms' are relabelled (no row is deleted, no
+--      amount/category/cycle/account column is touched, so no budget or ledger
+--      trigger does any work). `source` is a pure display label: no function,
+--      trigger, policy or index reads it. The mapping is exactly the one the
+--      Flutter client already applies when it displays such rows
+--      (Transaction.fromMap): audit note starting 'Chat:' -> 'chat',
+--      'Receipt Scan:' -> 'receipt_scan', anything else -> 'manual'. What
+--      users see in the app therefore does not change.
+--   2. DEFAULT becomes 'manual' and the CHECK no longer allows 'sms', so no
+--      code path (old app builds, API, SQL) can create a new SMS-sourced row.
+--   3. transactions.raw_sms is KEPT and only re-documented: despite its
+--      historical name it is the free-text audit note written by chat,
+--      receipt scans, manual entry, installments and settlement tags, and
+--      installed app builds write it directly through PostgREST, so renaming
+--      or dropping it would break them and lose user notes.
+-- Proof test: supabase/tests/18_remove_sms_artifacts.sql
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+BEGIN;
+
+-- Drop every CHECK constraint on transactions that constrains `source`
+-- (the inline constraint is auto-named; look it up instead of guessing).
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_con record;
+BEGIN
+    FOR v_con IN
+        SELECT c.conname
+        FROM pg_constraint c
+        JOIN pg_attribute a
+          ON a.attrelid = c.conrelid AND a.attnum = ANY (c.conkey)
+        WHERE c.conrelid = 'public.transactions'::regclass
+          AND c.contype = 'c'
+          AND a.attname = 'source'
+    LOOP
+        EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE public.transactions DROP CONSTRAINT %I', v_con.conname);
+    END LOOP;
+END $$;
+
+-- 1. Relabel historical 'sms' rows (label only; see header).
+UPDATE public.transactions
+SET source = CASE
+        WHEN raw_sms LIKE 'Chat:%' THEN 'chat'
+        WHEN raw_sms LIKE 'Receipt Scan:%' THEN 'receipt_scan'
+        ELSE 'manual'
+    END
+WHERE source = 'sms';
+
+-- 2. No SMS channel for new rows.
+ALTER TABLE public.transactions ALTER COLUMN source SET DEFAULT 'manual';
+ALTER TABLE public.transactions
+    ADD CONSTRAINT transactions_source_check
+    CHECK (source IN ('chat', 'receipt_scan', 'manual'));
+
+COMMENT ON COLUMN public.transactions.source IS
+    'Ingestion channel: chat (chat/voice), receipt_scan (receipt photo or ZATCA QR), or manual. The app never reads SMS.';
+
+-- 3. Re-document the audit note column (name kept for installed clients) and
+--    the tables whose comments described an SMS pipeline.
+COMMENT ON COLUMN public.transactions.raw_sms IS
+    'Free-text audit note (chat text, receipt summary, manual/installment/settlement tags). Historical column name; the app never reads SMS.';
+COMMENT ON TABLE public.transactions IS
+    'Every household expense transaction (chat/voice, receipt or QR scan, manual entry).';
+COMMENT ON TABLE public.cost_control_codes IS
+    'Category taxonomy + keyword mapping for merchant matching (chat, receipt and manual entries).';
+
+COMMIT;
diff --git a/supabase/migrations/20261020300000_nafaqah_wife_allowance_and_reimbursements.sql b/supabase/migrations/20261020300000_nafaqah_wife_allowance_and_reimbursements.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5990bea
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/migrations/20261020300000_nafaqah_wife_allowance_and_reimbursements.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,500 @@
+-- ============================================================================
+-- Migration: 20261020300000_nafaqah_wife_allowance_and_reimbursements.sql
+--
+-- Owner decision on audit item UI-24 (family mode = married couple, Islamic
+-- marriage rules; see .agents/rules/02-saudi-fintech-and-islamic-compliance.md):
+--   1. Nafaqah is on the husband: shared family/household expenses are his
+--      responsibility. There is no 50/50 (or any percentage) spousal split.
+--   2. The wife paying from her own money for something shared (household,
+--      children, dependents) is a debt the husband owes her. She collects it
+--      back through recorded reimbursements (partial or full).
+--   3. A personal purchase for the wife is not a debt: it is charged to her
+--      personal allowance ("مصروفها") for the salary cycle (cycle_key).
+--   4. Husband-paid shared expenses are ordinary household expenses.
+--
+-- Schema:
+--   * transactions.nafaqah_class ('wife_reimbursable' | 'wife_personal') and
+--     transactions.nafaqah_spouse_id (the wife concerned). NULL = ordinary
+--     expense (rule 4). Validated by trigger: the spouse must be a member of the
+--     transaction's household with financial_role = 'spouse' (so roommate
+--     households can never carry a Nafaqah class).
+--   * member_allowances: per-wife allowance per (household, cycle_key). Written
+--     only by set_member_allowance (husband or a household admin other than the
+--     wife). "Spent" is derived from wife_personal transactions of the cycle.
+--   * spouse_reimbursements: append-only repayments from the husband to the
+--     wife. Written only by record_spouse_reimbursement, which locks the
+--     (household, wife) pair and rejects overpayment.
+--
+-- RPCs follow the claim_household_role_invite pattern: authenticated callers
+-- act as auth.uid(); the ai_service (service_role, no JWT subject) must pass
+-- the verified caller as p_actor_user_id. Money is numeric(14,2).
+-- Proof test: supabase/tests/19_nafaqah_allowance_and_reimbursements.sql
+-- ============================================================================
+
+BEGIN;
+
+-- 1. Transaction classification ---------------------------------------------
+ALTER TABLE public.transactions
+    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS nafaqah_class text,
+    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS nafaqah_spouse_id uuid REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;
+
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'transactions_nafaqah_class_check') THEN
+        ALTER TABLE public.transactions
+            ADD CONSTRAINT transactions_nafaqah_class_check
+            CHECK (nafaqah_class IS NULL OR nafaqah_class IN ('wife_reimbursable', 'wife_personal'));
+    END IF;
+END $$;
+
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_transactions_nafaqah_spouse
+    ON public.transactions (nafaqah_spouse_id, household_id, nafaqah_class, cycle_key)
+    WHERE nafaqah_spouse_id IS NOT NULL;
+
+COMMENT ON COLUMN public.transactions.nafaqah_class IS
+    'Family (Nafaqah) classification: wife_reimbursable = wife paid for something shared, husband owes her; '
+    'wife_personal = personal purchase for the wife, charged to her allowance. NULL = ordinary household expense.';
+COMMENT ON COLUMN public.transactions.nafaqah_spouse_id IS
+    'The wife (users.financial_role = spouse, member of the household) the Nafaqah class refers to.';
+
+-- Is p_user_id a spouse member of p_household_id?
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nafaqah_is_spouse_member(p_household_id uuid, p_user_id uuid)
+RETURNS boolean
+LANGUAGE sql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+    SELECT EXISTS (
+        SELECT 1
+        FROM public.household_memberships m
+        JOIN public.users u ON u.id = m.user_id
+        WHERE m.household_id = p_household_id
+          AND m.user_id = p_user_id
+          AND u.financial_role = 'spouse'
+    );
+$$;
+
+-- The husband (Nafaqah provider) of a family household: a provider member,
+-- preferring a household admin, then the longest-standing membership.
+-- NULL when the household has no spouse member (not a family household).
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nafaqah_husband_id(p_household_id uuid)
+RETURNS uuid
+LANGUAGE sql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+    SELECT m.user_id
+    FROM public.household_memberships m
+    JOIN public.users u ON u.id = m.user_id
+    WHERE m.household_id = p_household_id
+      AND COALESCE(u.financial_role, 'provider') = 'provider'
+      AND EXISTS (
+          SELECT 1
+          FROM public.household_memberships sm
+          JOIN public.users su ON su.id = sm.user_id
+          WHERE sm.household_id = p_household_id AND su.financial_role = 'spouse'
+      )
+    ORDER BY (m.role = 'admin') DESC, m.created_at, m.user_id
+    LIMIT 1;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.nafaqah_is_spouse_member(uuid, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.nafaqah_husband_id(uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.nafaqah_is_spouse_member(uuid, uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.nafaqah_husband_id(uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_transaction_nafaqah_class()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+    -- ON DELETE SET NULL of the spouse's account: keep the expense, drop the class.
+    IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND NEW.nafaqah_spouse_id IS NULL AND OLD.nafaqah_spouse_id IS NOT NULL
+       AND NEW.nafaqah_class IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.nafaqah_class THEN
+        NEW.nafaqah_class := NULL;
+        RETURN NEW;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF NEW.nafaqah_class IS NULL AND NEW.nafaqah_spouse_id IS NULL THEN
+        RETURN NEW;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF NEW.nafaqah_class IS NULL OR NEW.nafaqah_spouse_id IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'nafaqah_class and nafaqah_spouse_id must be set together'
+            USING ERRCODE = '23514';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF NOT public.nafaqah_is_spouse_member(NEW.household_id, NEW.nafaqah_spouse_id) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'nafaqah_spouse_id % is not a spouse member of household %', NEW.nafaqah_spouse_id, NEW.household_id
+            USING ERRCODE = '23503';
+    END IF;
+
+    RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.validate_transaction_nafaqah_class() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_validate_transaction_nafaqah_class ON public.transactions;
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_validate_transaction_nafaqah_class
+BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF nafaqah_class, nafaqah_spouse_id, household_id ON public.transactions
+FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.validate_transaction_nafaqah_class();
+
+-- 2. Personal allowance per wife per salary cycle -----------------------------
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.member_allowances (
+    id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+    household_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.households(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+    member_user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+    cycle_key varchar(7) NOT NULL CHECK (cycle_key ~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$'),
+    amount numeric(14, 2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount >= 0),
+    set_by uuid REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
+    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+    CONSTRAINT uq_member_allowance_cycle UNIQUE (household_id, member_user_id, cycle_key)
+);
+
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_member_allowances_member ON public.member_allowances (member_user_id);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_member_allowances_set_by ON public.member_allowances (set_by);
+
+ALTER TABLE public.member_allowances ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+REVOKE ALL ON public.member_allowances FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+GRANT SELECT ON public.member_allowances TO authenticated;
+GRANT ALL ON public.member_allowances TO service_role;
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS member_allowances_select_household ON public.member_allowances;
+CREATE POLICY member_allowances_select_household ON public.member_allowances
+    FOR SELECT TO authenticated
+    USING (household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()));
+
+COMMENT ON TABLE public.member_allowances IS
+    'Wife personal allowance (مصروفها) per salary cycle, set by the husband/admin. Spent = wife_personal transactions of the cycle.';
+
+-- 3. Husband -> wife reimbursements (append-only) -----------------------------
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.spouse_reimbursements (
+    id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+    household_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.households(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+    wife_user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+    paid_by_user_id uuid REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
+    amount numeric(14, 2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
+    payment_method text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cash'
+        CHECK (payment_method IN ('stc_pay', 'urpay', 'bank_transfer', 'iban', 'cash', 'other')),
+    notes text CHECK (notes IS NULL OR char_length(notes) <= 500),
+    recorded_by uuid REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
+    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_spouse_reimbursements_household_wife
+    ON public.spouse_reimbursements (household_id, wife_user_id, created_at DESC);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_spouse_reimbursements_wife ON public.spouse_reimbursements (wife_user_id);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_spouse_reimbursements_paid_by ON public.spouse_reimbursements (paid_by_user_id);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_spouse_reimbursements_recorded_by ON public.spouse_reimbursements (recorded_by);
+
+ALTER TABLE public.spouse_reimbursements ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+REVOKE ALL ON public.spouse_reimbursements FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+GRANT SELECT ON public.spouse_reimbursements TO authenticated;
+GRANT ALL ON public.spouse_reimbursements TO service_role;
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS spouse_reimbursements_select_household ON public.spouse_reimbursements;
+CREATE POLICY spouse_reimbursements_select_household ON public.spouse_reimbursements
+    FOR SELECT TO authenticated
+    USING (household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()));
+
+COMMENT ON TABLE public.spouse_reimbursements IS
+    'Repayments by the husband of the wife''s Nafaqah advances (wife_reimbursable transactions). Append-only; via record_spouse_reimbursement.';
+
+-- 4. Internal helpers -----------------------------------------------------------
+-- Resolve the acting user: the JWT subject, or (service_role only) p_actor_user_id.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nafaqah_resolve_actor(p_actor_user_id uuid)
+RETURNS uuid
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+BEGIN
+    IF v_uid IS NOT NULL AND p_actor_user_id IS NOT NULL AND p_actor_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_uid THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: cannot act on behalf of another user' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+    v_uid := COALESCE(v_uid, p_actor_user_id);
+    IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+    RETURN v_uid;
+END;
+$$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nafaqah_require_member(p_household_id uuid, p_user_id uuid)
+RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+    IF p_household_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
+        SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships m
+        WHERE m.household_id = p_household_id AND m.user_id = p_user_id
+    ) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: not a member of this household' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+END;
+$$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nafaqah_current_cycle_key(p_household_id uuid)
+RETURNS text
+LANGUAGE sql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+    SELECT c.cycle_key
+    FROM public.get_saudi_cycle_for_timestamp(
+        now(),
+        COALESCE((SELECT h.payday_day FROM public.households h WHERE h.id = p_household_id), 27)
+    ) c;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.nafaqah_resolve_actor(uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.nafaqah_require_member(uuid, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.nafaqah_current_cycle_key(uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.nafaqah_current_cycle_key(uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+-- 5. Allowance RPCs -------------------------------------------------------------
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_member_allowance_status(
+    p_household_id uuid,
+    p_member_user_id uuid,
+    p_cycle_key text DEFAULT NULL,
+    p_actor_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_actor uuid := public.nafaqah_resolve_actor(p_actor_user_id);
+    v_cycle text;
+    v_allocated numeric(14, 2);
+    v_spent numeric(14, 2);
+    v_count int;
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM public.nafaqah_require_member(p_household_id, v_actor);
+    IF NOT public.nafaqah_is_spouse_member(p_household_id, p_member_user_id) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Allowances apply to a spouse member of this household' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    v_cycle := COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(p_cycle_key), ''), public.nafaqah_current_cycle_key(p_household_id));
+    IF v_cycle !~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid cycle_key %', v_cycle USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT a.amount INTO v_allocated
+    FROM public.member_allowances a
+    WHERE a.household_id = p_household_id AND a.member_user_id = p_member_user_id AND a.cycle_key = v_cycle;
+
+    SELECT COALESCE(sum(t.amount), 0), count(*) INTO v_spent, v_count
+    FROM public.transactions t
+    WHERE t.household_id = p_household_id
+      AND t.nafaqah_spouse_id = p_member_user_id
+      AND t.nafaqah_class = 'wife_personal'
+      AND t.cycle_key = v_cycle;
+
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+        'household_id', p_household_id,
+        'member_user_id', p_member_user_id,
+        'cycle_key', v_cycle,
+        'is_set', v_allocated IS NOT NULL,
+        'allocated', COALESCE(v_allocated, 0),
+        'spent', v_spent,
+        'remaining', COALESCE(v_allocated, 0) - v_spent,
+        'transaction_count', v_count
+    );
+END;
+$$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_member_allowance(
+    p_household_id uuid,
+    p_member_user_id uuid,
+    p_amount numeric,
+    p_cycle_key text DEFAULT NULL,
+    p_actor_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+VOLATILE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_actor uuid := public.nafaqah_resolve_actor(p_actor_user_id);
+    v_cycle text;
+    v_is_admin boolean;
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM public.nafaqah_require_member(p_household_id, v_actor);
+    IF NOT public.nafaqah_is_spouse_member(p_household_id, p_member_user_id) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Allowances apply to a spouse member of this household' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+    IF v_actor = p_member_user_id THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: the allowance is set by the husband or a household admin' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT EXISTS (
+        SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships m
+        WHERE m.household_id = p_household_id AND m.user_id = v_actor AND m.role = 'admin'
+    ) INTO v_is_admin;
+    IF NOT v_is_admin AND v_actor IS DISTINCT FROM public.nafaqah_husband_id(p_household_id) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: the allowance is set by the husband or a household admin' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_amount IS NULL OR p_amount < 0 OR p_amount <> round(p_amount, 2) OR p_amount > 999999999999.99 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Allowance must be a non-negative SAR amount with at most 2 decimals' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    v_cycle := COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(p_cycle_key), ''), public.nafaqah_current_cycle_key(p_household_id));
+    IF v_cycle !~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid cycle_key %', v_cycle USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    INSERT INTO public.member_allowances (household_id, member_user_id, cycle_key, amount, set_by)
+    VALUES (p_household_id, p_member_user_id, v_cycle, p_amount, v_actor)
+    ON CONFLICT (household_id, member_user_id, cycle_key)
+    DO UPDATE SET amount = EXCLUDED.amount, set_by = EXCLUDED.set_by, updated_at = now();
+
+    RETURN public.get_member_allowance_status(p_household_id, p_member_user_id, v_cycle, v_actor);
+END;
+$$;
+
+-- 6. Reimbursement RPCs ----------------------------------------------------------
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_spouse_reimbursement_balance(
+    p_household_id uuid,
+    p_wife_user_id uuid,
+    p_actor_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_actor uuid := public.nafaqah_resolve_actor(p_actor_user_id);
+    v_gross numeric(14, 2);
+    v_paid numeric(14, 2);
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM public.nafaqah_require_member(p_household_id, v_actor);
+    IF NOT public.nafaqah_is_spouse_member(p_household_id, p_wife_user_id) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Reimbursements apply to a spouse member of this household' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT COALESCE(sum(t.amount), 0) INTO v_gross
+    FROM public.transactions t
+    WHERE t.household_id = p_household_id
+      AND t.nafaqah_spouse_id = p_wife_user_id
+      AND t.nafaqah_class = 'wife_reimbursable';
+
+    SELECT COALESCE(sum(r.amount), 0) INTO v_paid
+    FROM public.spouse_reimbursements r
+    WHERE r.household_id = p_household_id AND r.wife_user_id = p_wife_user_id;
+
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+        'household_id', p_household_id,
+        'wife_user_id', p_wife_user_id,
+        'husband_user_id', public.nafaqah_husband_id(p_household_id),
+        'gross_advanced', v_gross,
+        'reimbursed', v_paid,
+        'outstanding', GREATEST(v_gross - v_paid, 0),
+        'overpaid', GREATEST(v_paid - v_gross, 0)
+    );
+END;
+$$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_spouse_reimbursement(
+    p_household_id uuid,
+    p_wife_user_id uuid,
+    p_amount numeric,
+    p_payment_method text DEFAULT 'cash',
+    p_notes text DEFAULT NULL,
+    p_actor_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+VOLATILE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_actor uuid := public.nafaqah_resolve_actor(p_actor_user_id);
+    v_husband uuid;
+    v_is_admin boolean;
+    v_balance jsonb;
+    v_outstanding numeric(14, 2);
+    v_id uuid;
+    v_method text := lower(COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(p_payment_method), ''), 'cash'));
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM public.nafaqah_require_member(p_household_id, v_actor);
+    IF NOT public.nafaqah_is_spouse_member(p_household_id, p_wife_user_id) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Reimbursements apply to a spouse member of this household' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    v_husband := public.nafaqah_husband_id(p_household_id);
+    SELECT EXISTS (
+        SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships m
+        WHERE m.household_id = p_household_id AND m.user_id = v_actor AND m.role = 'admin'
+    ) INTO v_is_admin;
+    IF v_actor <> p_wife_user_id AND v_actor IS DISTINCT FROM v_husband AND NOT v_is_admin THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: only the husband, the wife or a household admin can record a reimbursement'
+            USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_amount IS NULL OR p_amount <= 0 OR p_amount <> round(p_amount, 2) OR p_amount > 999999999999.99 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Reimbursement must be a positive SAR amount with at most 2 decimals' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+    IF v_method NOT IN ('stc_pay', 'urpay', 'bank_transfer', 'iban', 'cash', 'other') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unsupported payment method %', v_method USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Serialise repayments of one wife's debt so two concurrent calls cannot both pass the check.
+    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('spouse_reimbursement:' || p_household_id::text || ':' || p_wife_user_id::text, 0));
+
+    v_balance := public.get_spouse_reimbursement_balance(p_household_id, p_wife_user_id, v_actor);
+    v_outstanding := (v_balance->>'outstanding')::numeric;
+    IF p_amount > v_outstanding THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Reimbursement of % exceeds the outstanding balance of %', p_amount, v_outstanding
+            USING ERRCODE = '22023', HINT = 'overpayment';
+    END IF;
+
+    INSERT INTO public.spouse_reimbursements (household_id, wife_user_id, paid_by_user_id, amount, payment_method, notes, recorded_by)
+    VALUES (p_household_id, p_wife_user_id, v_husband, p_amount, v_method, NULLIF(left(trim(p_notes), 500), ''), v_actor)
+    RETURNING id INTO v_id;
+
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+        'success', true,
+        'reimbursement_id', v_id,
+        'household_id', p_household_id,
+        'wife_user_id', p_wife_user_id,
+        'paid_by_user_id', v_husband,
+        'amount', p_amount,
+        'payment_method', v_method,
+        'outstanding_before', v_outstanding,
+        'outstanding_after', v_outstanding - p_amount
+    );
+END;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_member_allowance_status(uuid, uuid, text, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.set_member_allowance(uuid, uuid, numeric, text, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_spouse_reimbursement_balance(uuid, uuid, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.record_spouse_reimbursement(uuid, uuid, numeric, text, text, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_member_allowance_status(uuid, uuid, text, uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.set_member_allowance(uuid, uuid, numeric, text, uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_spouse_reimbursement_balance(uuid, uuid, uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.record_spouse_reimbursement(uuid, uuid, numeric, text, text, uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+COMMIT;
diff --git a/supabase/migrations/20261020400000_admin_permissions_and_co_admins.sql b/supabase/migrations/20261020400000_admin_permissions_and_co_admins.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..c7d4070
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/migrations/20261020400000_admin_permissions_and_co_admins.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,1000 @@
+-- =============================================================================
+-- Admin permissions, co-admins and the household's primary admin
+-- (owner decision on audit items DB-16 and DB-18; applies to family and
+-- roommate households alike).
+--
+--   1. Transactions (DB-18). A member creates transactions and edits or deletes
+--      only their own. Only a household admin edits or deletes another
+--      member's transaction. The creator is bound at insert:
+--      transactions.user_id = auth.uid() for client writes (filled in when an
+--      older app build omits it, rejected when it names someone else) and it
+--      can never be changed afterwards.
+--   2. Shared pools (DB-16). Only a household admin moves money out of a shared
+--      pool (transfer_between_accounts). Members still move money between
+--      their own personal accounts and pay into the pool.
+--   3. Co-admins. An admin promotes members to admin ("second admins") and
+--      revokes that. The household's primary admin (households.owner_user_id,
+--      backfilled from the longest-standing admin) cannot be demoted or removed
+--      by a co-admin; only the primary admin transfers primary ownership. The
+--      last-admin protections (BUG-03 / DB-12) are unchanged.
+--   4. Family Nafaqah keeps its rules: the husband or any household admin
+--      (co-admins included, never the wife herself) sets the wife's allowance.
+--      The husband is now resolved preferring the primary admin.
+--
+-- Role changes happen only through the SECURITY DEFINER RPCs below (clients
+-- hold no write privilege on household_memberships, users.role or
+-- households.owner_user_id). Every RPC pins search_path, checks the caller and
+-- scopes to the household. The service role acts for a verified user by
+-- passing p_actor_user_id; an authenticated caller can never act for anyone
+-- else.
+--
+-- Not changed here: DB-17 (households.invite_code column revoke). Column
+-- privileges cannot be limited to non-admins, and released app builds read
+-- households.name, invite_code directly to render the whole household settings
+-- section, so the revoke would break that screen for every user of an older
+-- build. It ships once those builds are retired (see docs/review/audit/db.md).
+--
+-- Wrapped in one transaction so a failure leaves nothing half-applied (also
+-- when the file is run with plain psql, which autocommits per statement).
+-- =============================================================================
+
+BEGIN;
+
+-- 1. Primary admin -------------------------------------------------------------
+ALTER TABLE public.households
+    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS owner_user_id uuid REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;
+
+COMMENT ON COLUMN public.households.owner_user_id IS
+    'Primary admin: always an admin member. Co-admins cannot demote or remove them; only they transfer it (transfer_primary_admin).';
+
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_households_owner_user_id
+    ON public.households (owner_user_id) WHERE owner_user_id IS NOT NULL;
+
+-- Backfill: the longest-standing admin of each household.
+UPDATE public.households h
+SET owner_user_id = (
+    SELECT m.user_id
+    FROM public.household_memberships m
+    WHERE m.household_id = h.id AND m.role = 'admin'
+    ORDER BY m.created_at ASC, m.user_id ASC
+    LIMIT 1
+)
+WHERE h.owner_user_id IS NULL;
+
+-- Clients may keep updating household settings (admins only, via RLS) but never
+-- the primary admin: replace the table-wide UPDATE grant by a column list.
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_cols text;
+BEGIN
+    SELECT string_agg(quote_ident(attname), ', ' ORDER BY attnum) INTO v_cols
+    FROM pg_attribute
+    WHERE attrelid = 'public.households'::regclass
+      AND attnum > 0
+      AND NOT attisdropped
+      AND attname <> 'owner_user_id';
+
+    REVOKE UPDATE ON public.households FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+    EXECUTE format('GRANT UPDATE (%s) ON public.households TO authenticated', v_cols);
+END $$;
+
+-- 2. Helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- Acting user: the JWT subject, or (service role only, no JWT subject) p_actor_user_id.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.household_resolve_actor(p_actor_user_id uuid)
+RETURNS uuid
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+BEGIN
+    IF v_uid IS NOT NULL AND p_actor_user_id IS NOT NULL AND p_actor_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_uid THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: cannot act on behalf of another user' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+    v_uid := COALESCE(v_uid, p_actor_user_id);
+    IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+    RETURN v_uid;
+END;
+$$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.household_member_role(p_household_id uuid, p_user_id uuid)
+RETURNS text
+LANGUAGE sql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+    SELECT m.role
+    FROM public.household_memberships m
+    WHERE m.household_id = p_household_id AND m.user_id = p_user_id;
+$$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.household_primary_admin_id(p_household_id uuid)
+RETURNS uuid
+LANGUAGE sql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+    SELECT h.owner_user_id FROM public.households h WHERE h.id = p_household_id;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.household_resolve_actor(uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.household_member_role(uuid, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.household_primary_admin_id(uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.household_primary_admin_id(uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+-- 3. Primary-admin invariants on memberships --------------------------------------
+-- The primary admin is never demoted (transfer first), and only they can end
+-- their own membership (leave / remove themselves / delete their account).
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_primary_admin_membership()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_owner uuid := public.household_primary_admin_id(OLD.household_id);
+    v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+BEGIN
+    IF v_owner IS NULL OR OLD.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_owner THEN
+        RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
+    END IF;
+
+    IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
+        IF OLD.role = 'admin' AND NEW.role IS DISTINCT FROM 'admin' THEN
+            RAISE EXCEPTION 'The primary admin cannot be demoted; transfer primary admin to another member first'
+                USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+        END IF;
+        RETURN NEW;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_uid IS NOT NULL AND v_uid IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.user_id THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only the primary admin can remove themselves from the household'
+            USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+    RETURN OLD;
+END;
+$$;
+
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_protect_primary_admin ON public.household_memberships;
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_protect_primary_admin
+BEFORE UPDATE OF role OR DELETE ON public.household_memberships
+FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.protect_primary_admin_membership();
+
+-- The first admin of a household becomes its primary admin; when the primary
+-- admin's membership ends, the longest-standing remaining admin takes over
+-- (DB-12 handover already promotes one when they were the sole admin).
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.maintain_household_primary_admin()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+    IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
+        UPDATE public.households h
+        SET owner_user_id = (
+            SELECT m.user_id
+            FROM public.household_memberships m
+            WHERE m.household_id = OLD.household_id
+              AND m.user_id <> OLD.user_id
+              AND m.role = 'admin'
+            ORDER BY m.created_at ASC, m.user_id ASC
+            LIMIT 1
+        )
+        WHERE h.id = OLD.household_id
+          AND (h.owner_user_id IS NULL OR h.owner_user_id = OLD.user_id);
+        RETURN OLD;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF NEW.role = 'admin' THEN
+        UPDATE public.households
+        SET owner_user_id = NEW.user_id
+        WHERE id = NEW.household_id AND owner_user_id IS NULL;
+    END IF;
+    RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$$;
+
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_maintain_primary_admin ON public.household_memberships;
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_maintain_primary_admin
+AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF role OR DELETE ON public.household_memberships
+FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.maintain_household_primary_admin();
+
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.protect_primary_admin_membership() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.maintain_household_primary_admin() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+
+-- 4. Role management RPCs -----------------------------------------------------------
+-- Members of a household with their roles (any member may read; same data the
+-- users_select_household policy already exposes, plus the membership role).
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_household_members(
+    p_household_id uuid,
+    p_actor_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL
+)
+RETURNS TABLE (
+    user_id uuid,
+    display_name text,
+    role text,
+    financial_role text,
+    is_primary boolean,
+    joined_at timestamptz
+)
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_actor uuid := public.household_resolve_actor(p_actor_user_id);
+    v_owner uuid;
+BEGIN
+    IF p_household_id IS NULL OR public.household_member_role(p_household_id, v_actor) IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: not a member of this household' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+    v_owner := public.household_primary_admin_id(p_household_id);
+
+    RETURN QUERY
+    SELECT m.user_id,
+           u.display_name,
+           m.role,
+           u.financial_role,
+           (m.user_id = v_owner) AS is_primary,
+           m.created_at AS joined_at
+    FROM public.household_memberships m
+    JOIN public.users u ON u.id = m.user_id
+    WHERE m.household_id = p_household_id
+    ORDER BY (m.user_id = v_owner) DESC, (m.role = 'admin') DESC, m.created_at ASC, m.user_id ASC;
+END;
+$$;
+
+-- Internal: set a member's role in one household (membership + cached users.role).
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.household_apply_role(p_household_id uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_role text)
+RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+    UPDATE public.household_memberships
+    SET role = p_role
+    WHERE household_id = p_household_id AND user_id = p_user_id;
+
+    UPDATE public.users
+    SET role = p_role
+    WHERE id = p_user_id AND household_id = p_household_id;
+END;
+$$;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.household_apply_role(uuid, uuid, text) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.household_require_admin(p_household_id uuid, p_actor uuid)
+RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_role text := public.household_member_role(p_household_id, p_actor);
+BEGIN
+    IF v_role IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: not a member of this household' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+    IF v_role <> 'admin' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: household admin privileges required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+END;
+$$;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.household_require_admin(uuid, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+
+-- Any admin (primary or co-admin) makes another member an admin.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.promote_member_to_admin(
+    p_household_id uuid,
+    p_user_id uuid,
+    p_actor_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+VOLATILE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_actor uuid := public.household_resolve_actor(p_actor_user_id);
+    v_target_role text;
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM public.household_require_admin(p_household_id, v_actor);
+
+    SELECT m.role INTO v_target_role
+    FROM public.household_memberships m
+    WHERE m.household_id = p_household_id AND m.user_id = p_user_id
+    FOR UPDATE;
+
+    IF v_target_role IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Target user is not a member of this household' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_target_role <> 'admin' THEN
+        PERFORM public.household_apply_role(p_household_id, p_user_id, 'admin');
+    END IF;
+
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+        'success', true,
+        'household_id', p_household_id,
+        'user_id', p_user_id,
+        'role', 'admin',
+        'is_primary', p_user_id = public.household_primary_admin_id(p_household_id)
+    );
+END;
+$$;
+
+-- Any admin revokes a co-admin (themselves included), never the primary admin;
+-- the last remaining admin cannot be demoted (BUG-03 trigger).
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.revoke_admin(
+    p_household_id uuid,
+    p_user_id uuid,
+    p_actor_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+VOLATILE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_actor uuid := public.household_resolve_actor(p_actor_user_id);
+    v_target_role text;
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM public.household_require_admin(p_household_id, v_actor);
+
+    -- Serialise concurrent role changes in this household.
+    PERFORM 1 FROM public.households WHERE id = p_household_id FOR UPDATE;
+
+    SELECT m.role INTO v_target_role
+    FROM public.household_memberships m
+    WHERE m.household_id = p_household_id AND m.user_id = p_user_id;
+
+    IF v_target_role IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Target user is not a member of this household' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_user_id = public.household_primary_admin_id(p_household_id) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'The primary admin cannot be demoted; transfer primary admin to another member first'
+            USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_target_role = 'admin' THEN
+        PERFORM public.household_apply_role(p_household_id, p_user_id, 'member');
+    END IF;
+
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+        'success', true,
+        'household_id', p_household_id,
+        'user_id', p_user_id,
+        'role', 'member',
+        'is_primary', false
+    );
+END;
+$$;
+
+-- Only the primary admin hands primary ownership to another member (who is
+-- made an admin if needed). The previous primary admin stays a co-admin.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.transfer_primary_admin(
+    p_household_id uuid,
+    p_new_primary_user_id uuid,
+    p_actor_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+VOLATILE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_actor uuid := public.household_resolve_actor(p_actor_user_id);
+    v_owner uuid;
+    v_target_role text;
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM public.household_require_admin(p_household_id, v_actor);
+
+    SELECT owner_user_id INTO v_owner
+    FROM public.households
+    WHERE id = p_household_id
+    FOR UPDATE;
+
+    IF v_owner IS DISTINCT FROM v_actor THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: only the primary admin can transfer primary admin' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_new_primary_user_id IS NULL OR p_new_primary_user_id = v_actor THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Choose another member of this household' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    v_target_role := public.household_member_role(p_household_id, p_new_primary_user_id);
+    IF v_target_role IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Target user is not a member of this household' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_target_role <> 'admin' THEN
+        PERFORM public.household_apply_role(p_household_id, p_new_primary_user_id, 'admin');
+    END IF;
+
+    UPDATE public.households
+    SET owner_user_id = p_new_primary_user_id
+    WHERE id = p_household_id;
+
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+        'success', true,
+        'household_id', p_household_id,
+        'primary_admin_user_id', p_new_primary_user_id,
+        'previous_primary_admin_user_id', v_actor
+    );
+END;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_household_members(uuid, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.promote_member_to_admin(uuid, uuid, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.revoke_admin(uuid, uuid, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.transfer_primary_admin(uuid, uuid, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_household_members(uuid, uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.promote_member_to_admin(uuid, uuid, uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.revoke_admin(uuid, uuid, uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.transfer_primary_admin(uuid, uuid, uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+-- Existing role RPCs (active household) keep working and respect the primary admin.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_member_role(p_user_id uuid, p_role text)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_caller_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+    v_caller_hh_id uuid;
+BEGIN
+    IF v_caller_uid IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT household_id INTO v_caller_hh_id
+    FROM public.users
+    WHERE id = v_caller_uid;
+
+    IF v_caller_hh_id IS NULL OR public.household_member_role(v_caller_hh_id, v_caller_uid) IS DISTINCT FROM 'admin' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: Admin privileges required';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_role NOT IN ('admin', 'member') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid role: must be admin or member';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_role = 'admin' THEN
+        RETURN public.promote_member_to_admin(v_caller_hh_id, p_user_id, NULL)
+            || jsonb_build_object('new_role', 'admin');
+    END IF;
+    RETURN public.revoke_admin(v_caller_hh_id, p_user_id, NULL)
+        || jsonb_build_object('new_role', 'member');
+END;
+$$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.remove_member(p_user_id uuid)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_caller_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+    v_caller_hh_id uuid;
+    v_target_role text;
+    v_other_admins int;
+    v_other_members int;
+BEGIN
+    IF v_caller_uid IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT household_id INTO v_caller_hh_id
+    FROM public.users
+    WHERE id = v_caller_uid;
+
+    IF v_caller_hh_id IS NULL OR public.household_member_role(v_caller_hh_id, v_caller_uid) IS DISTINCT FROM 'admin' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: Admin privileges required';
+    END IF;
+
+    v_target_role := public.household_member_role(v_caller_hh_id, p_user_id);
+    IF v_target_role IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Target user is not a member of this household';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_user_id <> v_caller_uid AND p_user_id = public.household_primary_admin_id(v_caller_hh_id) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only the primary admin can remove themselves from the household' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_user_id = v_caller_uid THEN
+        SELECT count(*) INTO v_other_admins
+        FROM public.household_memberships
+        WHERE household_id = v_caller_hh_id AND role = 'admin' AND user_id <> p_user_id;
+
+        SELECT count(*) INTO v_other_members
+        FROM public.household_memberships
+        WHERE household_id = v_caller_hh_id AND user_id <> p_user_id;
+
+        IF v_other_admins = 0 AND v_other_members > 0 THEN
+            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sole admin cannot be removed while other members remain. Promote another member first.';
+        END IF;
+    END IF;
+
+    DELETE FROM public.household_memberships
+    WHERE household_id = v_caller_hh_id AND user_id = p_user_id;
+
+    UPDATE public.users
+    SET household_id = NULL,
+        role = 'member'
+    WHERE id = p_user_id AND household_id = v_caller_hh_id;
+
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+        'success', true,
+        'removed_user_id', p_user_id
+    );
+END;
+$$;
+
+-- get_user_households(): also reports whether the caller is the primary admin.
+-- (Return type changes, so the function is re-created; the invite code is still
+-- served to admins only.)
+DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.get_user_households();
+CREATE FUNCTION public.get_user_households()
+RETURNS TABLE (
+    household_id uuid,
+    household_name text,
+    invite_code text,
+    role text,
+    is_active boolean,
+    is_primary boolean
+)
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+    RETURN QUERY
+    SELECT
+        h.id AS household_id,
+        h.name::text AS household_name,
+        CASE WHEN m.role = 'admin' THEN h.invite_code::text ELSE NULL END AS invite_code,
+        m.role::text,
+        (h.id = u.household_id) AS is_active,
+        (h.owner_user_id = m.user_id) AS is_primary
+    FROM public.household_memberships m
+    JOIN public.households h ON h.id = m.household_id
+    JOIN public.users u ON u.id = m.user_id
+    WHERE m.user_id = auth.uid()
+    ORDER BY is_active DESC, m.created_at ASC;
+END;
+$$;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_user_households() FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_user_households() TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+-- 5. Transactions: creator binding and owner-or-admin writes (DB-18) ------------------
+-- Older app builds insert without user_id: the creator is filled in from the
+-- JWT. Naming anyone else is rejected. Service-role writes (no JWT subject)
+-- are checked by ai_service, which passes the verified user.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bind_transaction_creator()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+BEGIN
+    IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
+        RETURN NEW;
+    END IF;
+    IF NEW.user_id IS NULL THEN
+        NEW.user_id := v_uid;
+    ELSIF NEW.user_id <> v_uid THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: a transaction cannot be created on behalf of another member'
+            USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+    RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$$;
+
+-- Edits and deletes of another member's transaction need a household admin.
+-- Raised (HTTP 403) rather than filtered out by RLS so that clients, including
+-- older builds, report the refusal instead of a silent no-op. Writes issued by
+-- other triggers (pg_trigger_depth() > 1: foreign-key ON DELETE SET NULL /
+-- CASCADE when an account, spouse or household is deleted) are system-driven
+-- and pass; the service role (no JWT subject) is checked by ai_service.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_transaction_write_permission()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+BEGIN
+    IF v_uid IS NULL OR pg_trigger_depth() > 1 THEN
+        RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
+    END IF;
+
+    IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND NEW.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.user_id THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: the creator of a transaction cannot be changed' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF OLD.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_uid
+       AND public.household_member_role(OLD.household_id, v_uid) IS DISTINCT FROM 'admin' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: only household admins can edit or delete another member''s transactions'
+            USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+    RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
+END;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.bind_transaction_creator() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.enforce_transaction_write_permission() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_bind_transaction_creator ON public.transactions;
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_bind_transaction_creator
+BEFORE INSERT ON public.transactions
+FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.bind_transaction_creator();
+
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_enforce_transaction_write_permission ON public.transactions;
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_enforce_transaction_write_permission
+BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON public.transactions
+FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.enforce_transaction_write_permission();
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "transactions_insert_household" ON public.transactions;
+CREATE POLICY "transactions_insert_household" ON public.transactions
+    FOR INSERT TO authenticated
+    WITH CHECK (
+        household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id())
+        AND user_id = (SELECT auth.uid())
+        AND (
+            account_id IS NULL
+            OR EXISTS (
+                SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts a
+                WHERE a.id = transactions.account_id
+                  AND a.household_id = transactions.household_id
+                  AND (a.is_shared_pool = true OR a.owner_user_id = (SELECT auth.uid()))
+            )
+        )
+    );
+
+-- A transaction's account is a shared pool of its household or a personal
+-- account of the transaction's creator. Definer: an admin editing a member's
+-- transaction cannot read that member's personal account under RLS.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.transaction_account_matches(
+    p_account_id uuid,
+    p_household_id uuid,
+    p_creator_user_id uuid
+)
+RETURNS boolean
+LANGUAGE sql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+    SELECT EXISTS (
+        SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts a
+        WHERE a.id = p_account_id
+          AND a.household_id = p_household_id
+          AND (a.is_shared_pool = true OR a.owner_user_id = p_creator_user_id)
+    );
+$$;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.transaction_account_matches(uuid, uuid, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.transaction_account_matches(uuid, uuid, uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+-- USING keeps household scoping (the row is visible to the trigger, which
+-- raises for a non-admin); WITH CHECK repeats the owner-or-admin rule and keeps
+-- a personal account attached only to its owner's transactions.
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "transactions_update_household" ON public.transactions;
+CREATE POLICY "transactions_update_household" ON public.transactions
+    FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
+    USING (household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()))
+    WITH CHECK (
+        household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id())
+        AND (user_id = (SELECT auth.uid()) OR (SELECT public.get_auth_user_role()) = 'admin')
+        AND (
+            account_id IS NULL
+            OR public.transaction_account_matches(account_id, household_id, user_id)
+        )
+    );
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "transactions_delete_household" ON public.transactions;
+CREATE POLICY "transactions_delete_household" ON public.transactions
+    FOR DELETE TO authenticated
+    USING (household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()));
+
+-- Account balances follow a transaction's edits and deletes. A personal
+-- account is touched only by its owner, or - for that owner's own transaction -
+-- by a household admin exercising the edit/delete right above. Nobody can
+-- attach a transaction to someone else's personal account.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.transaction_personal_account_writable(
+    p_account public.accounts,
+    p_creator_user_id uuid,
+    p_caller_uid uuid
+)
+RETURNS boolean
+LANGUAGE sql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+    SELECT p_caller_uid IS NULL
+        OR p_account.is_shared_pool
+        OR p_account.owner_user_id = p_caller_uid
+        OR (
+            p_account.owner_user_id = p_creator_user_id
+            AND public.household_member_role(p_account.household_id, p_caller_uid) = 'admin'
+        );
+$$;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.transaction_personal_account_writable(public.accounts, uuid, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_account_balance_on_transaction()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_acc public.accounts%ROWTYPE;
+    v_caller_uid UUID;
+BEGIN
+    BEGIN
+        v_caller_uid := auth.uid();
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+        v_caller_uid := NULL;
+    END;
+    IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
+        IF NEW.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+            SELECT * INTO v_acc FROM public.accounts WHERE id = NEW.account_id FOR UPDATE;
+            IF v_acc.id IS NULL THEN
+                RAISE EXCEPTION 'Target account % not found', NEW.account_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+            END IF;
+            IF v_acc.household_id <> NEW.household_id THEN
+                RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account % does not belong to transaction household %', NEW.account_id, NEW.household_id USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+            END IF;
+            IF v_caller_uid IS NOT NULL AND v_acc.is_shared_pool = false AND v_acc.owner_user_id <> v_caller_uid THEN
+                RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: cannot debit personal account owned by another user' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+            END IF;
+
+            UPDATE public.accounts
+            SET balance = balance - NEW.amount,
+                updated_at = now()
+            WHERE id = NEW.account_id;
+        END IF;
+        RETURN NEW;
+
+    ELSIF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
+        IF OLD.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+            SELECT * INTO v_acc FROM public.accounts WHERE id = OLD.account_id FOR UPDATE;
+            IF v_acc.id IS NOT NULL THEN
+                IF v_acc.household_id <> OLD.household_id THEN
+                    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account % does not belong to transaction household %', OLD.account_id, OLD.household_id USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+                END IF;
+                IF NOT public.transaction_personal_account_writable(v_acc, OLD.user_id, v_caller_uid) THEN
+                    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: cannot credit personal account owned by another user' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+                END IF;
+
+                UPDATE public.accounts
+                SET balance = balance + OLD.amount,
