+                    updated_at = now()
+                WHERE id = OLD.account_id;
+            END IF;
+        END IF;
+        RETURN OLD;
+
+    ELSIF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
+        IF OLD.account_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.account_id OR OLD.amount <> NEW.amount THEN
+            -- Revert old account debit
+            IF OLD.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+                SELECT * INTO v_acc FROM public.accounts WHERE id = OLD.account_id FOR UPDATE;
+                IF v_acc.id IS NOT NULL THEN
+                    IF v_acc.household_id <> OLD.household_id THEN
+                        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account % does not belong to transaction household %', OLD.account_id, OLD.household_id USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+                    END IF;
+                    IF NOT public.transaction_personal_account_writable(v_acc, OLD.user_id, v_caller_uid) THEN
+                        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: cannot credit personal account owned by another user' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+                    END IF;
+
+                    UPDATE public.accounts
+                    SET balance = balance + OLD.amount,
+                        updated_at = now()
+                    WHERE id = OLD.account_id;
+                END IF;
+            END IF;
+
+            -- Apply new account debit
+            IF NEW.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+                SELECT * INTO v_acc FROM public.accounts WHERE id = NEW.account_id FOR UPDATE;
+                IF v_acc.id IS NULL THEN
+                    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Target account % not found', NEW.account_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+                END IF;
+                IF v_acc.household_id <> NEW.household_id THEN
+                    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account % does not belong to transaction household %', NEW.account_id, NEW.household_id USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+                END IF;
+                IF NOT public.transaction_personal_account_writable(v_acc, NEW.user_id, v_caller_uid) THEN
+                    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: cannot debit personal account owned by another user' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+                END IF;
+
+                UPDATE public.accounts
+                SET balance = balance - NEW.amount,
+                    updated_at = now()
+                WHERE id = NEW.account_id;
+            END IF;
+        END IF;
+        RETURN NEW;
+    END IF;
+    RETURN NULL;
+END;
+$$;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.update_account_balance_on_transaction() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+
+-- 6. Shared pools: only admins move money out (DB-16) --------------------------------
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.transfer_between_accounts(
+    p_household_id uuid,
+    p_from_account_id uuid,
+    p_to_account_id uuid,
+    p_amount numeric,
+    p_fee numeric DEFAULT 0.0,
+    p_notes text DEFAULT NULL
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_caller_uid UUID;
+    v_from_acc RECORD;
+    v_to_acc RECORD;
+    v_total_deduction NUMERIC;
+    v_transfer_id UUID;
+    v_created_at TIMESTAMPTZ := now();
+    v_result jsonb;
+BEGIN
+    v_caller_uid := auth.uid();
+    IF v_caller_uid IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_amount IS NULL OR p_amount <= 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Transfer amount must be positive' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_fee IS NULL OR p_fee < 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Transfer fee cannot be negative' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Columns are NUMERIC(14,2)/(10,2): a third decimal would be rounded
+    -- independently on each side of the transfer and mint or burn money.
+    IF p_amount <> round(p_amount, 2) OR p_fee <> round(p_fee, 2) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Transfer amount and fee must have at most 2 decimal places' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_from_account_id = p_to_account_id THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot transfer between the same account' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Strict NULL-safe membership check
+    IF p_household_id IS NULL OR public.get_auth_user_household_id() IS NULL OR p_household_id IS DISTINCT FROM public.get_auth_user_household_id() THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: caller does not belong to specified household' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Lock accounts in deterministic UUID order to prevent deadlocks
+    IF p_from_account_id < p_to_account_id THEN
+        SELECT * INTO v_from_acc FROM public.accounts WHERE id = p_from_account_id FOR UPDATE;
+        SELECT * INTO v_to_acc FROM public.accounts WHERE id = p_to_account_id FOR UPDATE;
+    ELSE
+        SELECT * INTO v_to_acc FROM public.accounts WHERE id = p_to_account_id FOR UPDATE;
+        SELECT * INTO v_from_acc FROM public.accounts WHERE id = p_from_account_id FOR UPDATE;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_from_acc.id IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Source account not found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+    END IF;
+    IF v_to_acc.id IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Destination account not found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_from_acc.household_id <> p_household_id OR v_to_acc.household_id <> p_household_id THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Both accounts must belong to the household' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Personal source: only its owner. Shared pool source: only a household admin (DB-16).
+    IF v_from_acc.is_shared_pool = false AND v_from_acc.owner_user_id <> v_caller_uid THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: cannot transfer from an account owned by another user' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+    IF v_from_acc.is_shared_pool = true
+       AND public.household_member_role(p_household_id, v_caller_uid) IS DISTINCT FROM 'admin' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: only household admins can move money out of a shared pool' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    v_total_deduction := p_amount + p_fee;
+    IF v_from_acc.balance < v_total_deduction THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Insufficient funds: balance (%) is less than transfer plus fee (%)', v_from_acc.balance, v_total_deduction USING ERRCODE = '22000';
+    END IF;
+
+    UPDATE public.accounts
+    SET balance = balance - v_total_deduction,
+        updated_at = v_created_at
+    WHERE id = p_from_account_id;
+
+    UPDATE public.accounts
+    SET balance = balance + p_amount,
+        updated_at = v_created_at
+    WHERE id = p_to_account_id;
+
+    INSERT INTO public.account_transfers (
+        household_id,
+        user_id,
+        from_account_id,
+        to_account_id,
+        amount,
+        fee,
+        timestamp,
+        notes,
+        created_at
+    ) VALUES (
+        p_household_id,
+        v_caller_uid,
+        p_from_account_id,
+        p_to_account_id,
+        p_amount,
+        p_fee,
+        v_created_at,
+        p_notes,
+        v_created_at
+    ) RETURNING id INTO v_transfer_id;
+
+    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
+        'id', v_transfer_id,
+        'household_id', p_household_id,
+        'user_id', v_caller_uid,
+        'from_account_id', p_from_account_id,
+        'to_account_id', p_to_account_id,
+        'amount', p_amount,
+        'fee', p_fee,
+        'timestamp', v_created_at,
+        'notes', p_notes,
+        'created_at', v_created_at
+    ) INTO v_result;
+
+    RETURN v_result;
+END;
+$$;
+
+-- 7. Family Nafaqah: the husband is the provider member, preferring the primary
+--    admin, then any admin, then the longest-standing membership.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nafaqah_husband_id(p_household_id uuid)
+RETURNS uuid
+LANGUAGE sql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+    SELECT m.user_id
+    FROM public.household_memberships m
+    JOIN public.users u ON u.id = m.user_id
+    JOIN public.households h ON h.id = m.household_id
+    WHERE m.household_id = p_household_id
+      AND COALESCE(u.financial_role, 'provider') = 'provider'
+      AND EXISTS (
+          SELECT 1
+          FROM public.household_memberships sm
+          JOIN public.users su ON su.id = sm.user_id
+          WHERE sm.household_id = p_household_id AND su.financial_role = 'spouse'
+      )
+    ORDER BY (m.user_id = h.owner_user_id) DESC NULLS LAST, (m.role = 'admin') DESC, m.created_at, m.user_id
+    LIMIT 1;
+$$;
+
+COMMIT;
diff --git a/supabase/migrations/20261020500000_review_lock_financial_role.sql b/supabase/migrations/20261020500000_review_lock_financial_role.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5739d8f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/migrations/20261020500000_review_lock_financial_role.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- Migration: 20261020500000_review_lock_financial_role.sql
+-- Final backend review FR-B-04 (High): users.financial_role became
+--   security-relevant with 20261020300000 / 20261020400000: it decides who is
+--   the wife (creditor of the Nafaqah reimbursement debt), who is the husband
+--   (provider, sets the allowance) and whether a household is a family at all
+--   (settlement mode, /reimbursements routing). 20261019030000 left it in the
+--   client-writable column list of public.users, so any member could set their
+--   own row to 'spouse' (turning a roommate household into a "family" and
+--   raising debts against the provider), or a wife could drop out of her own
+--   ledger.
+-- Fix: clients keep updating display_name and payday_day only. financial_role
+--   is set by the invite RPCs (SECURITY DEFINER, unaffected) and the service
+--   role. No released app build (or the web app) writes financial_role, and
+--   live has no family household yet (live_db_preflight.md §4), so nothing that
+--   works today stops working.
+-- Idempotent (REVOKE of a privilege that is not held is a no-op) and safe on
+--   live: one column privilege, no data change.
+-- Proof test: supabase/tests/21_review_backend_contracts.sql
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+BEGIN;
+
+REVOKE UPDATE (financial_role) ON public.users FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+
+COMMENT ON COLUMN public.users.financial_role IS
+    'Household financial role (provider, spouse, peer, family_member, dependent). Set by the invite RPCs / service role only; drives Nafaqah (spouse = wife) and the settlement mode.';
+
+COMMIT;
diff --git a/supabase/migrations/20261020600000_e2e_helper_rpcs_and_sub_category_visibility.sql b/supabase/migrations/20261020600000_e2e_helper_rpcs_and_sub_category_visibility.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..79774b7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/migrations/20261020600000_e2e_helper_rpcs_and_sub_category_visibility.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,150 @@
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- Migration: 20261020600000_e2e_helper_rpcs_and_sub_category_visibility.sql
+--
+-- E2E-04 (Low, docs/review/audit/e2e_results.md): the SECURITY DEFINER helpers
+--   household_primary_admin_id(uuid)          (20261020400000)
+--   nafaqah_husband_id(uuid)                  (20261020300000, replaced in 20261020400000)
+--   nafaqah_is_spouse_member(uuid, uuid)      (20261020300000)
+-- were EXECUTE-able by every authenticated user through PostgREST
+-- (POST /rest/v1/rpc/...). They take any household id and have no membership
+-- check, so any signed-in user could read another household's primary-admin
+-- or husband user id, and probe whether a user is the wife of a household.
+--
+-- Fix: EXECUTE is revoked from PUBLIC, anon and authenticated; service_role
+-- keeps it. Every caller is internal and runs as the function owner:
+--   * household_primary_admin_id: protect_primary_admin_membership() (trigger),
+--     get_household_members, promote_member_to_admin, revoke_admin, remove_member
+--   * nafaqah_husband_id: set_member_allowance, get_spouse_reimbursement_balance,
+--     record_spouse_reimbursement
+--   * nafaqah_is_spouse_member: validate_transaction_nafaqah_class() (trigger),
+--     get_member_allowance_status, set_member_allowance,
+--     get_spouse_reimbursement_balance, record_spouse_reimbursement
+-- All of them are SECURITY DEFINER functions owned by postgres (the helpers'
+-- owner), so they keep working for authenticated callers. No RLS policy, view,
+-- column default or CHECK constraint references the helpers, and no client
+-- calls them: ai_service, the Flutter app and the web app (current branch and
+-- origin/main) never .rpc() them. The guard below re-checks this on the target
+-- database and aborts the migration (rolling everything back) if it is wrong.
+--
+-- E2E-05 (Medium, listing half): cost_control_sub_categories has no
+-- household_id, and its SELECT policy was USING (true): any signed-in user
+-- could read another household's custom sub-categories (custom parent codes are
+-- guessable CUSTOM-...). Sub-category rows are now readable only when their
+-- parent category is readable, i.e. the same rule as cost_control_codes_select:
+-- a global/system code, or a code of the caller's active household. The deployed
+-- app (origin/main, sub_budget_allocation_dialog.dart) reads this table directly
+-- only by parent_code of a category of its own active household, which stays
+-- visible; it never writes it (writes go through ai_service with the service
+-- role, which bypasses RLS). Client write privileges, never usable under RLS
+-- (no write policy), and every anon privilege are revoked.
+--
+-- Idempotent (REVOKE/GRANT, DROP POLICY IF EXISTS + CREATE POLICY), no data
+-- change, no schema change. Rollback: see the end of this file.
+-- Proof test: supabase/tests/22_e2e_helper_rpcs_and_sub_category_visibility.sql
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+BEGIN;
+
+-- A. E2E-04: internal helpers are not client-callable --------------------------
+
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_bad text;
+BEGIN
+    -- No policy may depend on the helpers: policies run as the invoking role.
+    SELECT string_agg(format('%I.%I.%I', schemaname, tablename, policyname), ', ') INTO v_bad
+    FROM pg_policies
+    WHERE coalesce(qual, '') || ' ' || coalesce(with_check, '')
+          ~ '(household_primary_admin_id|nafaqah_husband_id|nafaqah_is_spouse_member)';
+    IF v_bad IS NOT NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'E2E-04 guard: policies call the helpers (%); revoking EXECUTE would break RLS', v_bad;
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Every function calling a helper must be SECURITY DEFINER and owned by a role
+    -- that keeps EXECUTE on it (the owner of the helpers).
+    SELECT string_agg(p.oid::regprocedure::text, ', ') INTO v_bad
+    FROM pg_proc p
+    WHERE p.prosrc ~ '(household_primary_admin_id|nafaqah_husband_id|nafaqah_is_spouse_member)'
+      AND p.oid NOT IN ('public.household_primary_admin_id(uuid)'::regprocedure,
+                        'public.nafaqah_husband_id(uuid)'::regprocedure,
+                        'public.nafaqah_is_spouse_member(uuid, uuid)'::regprocedure)
+      AND (NOT p.prosecdef
+           OR p.proowner IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT proowner FROM pg_proc
+                                           WHERE oid = 'public.nafaqah_is_spouse_member(uuid, uuid)'::regprocedure)
+           OR p.proowner IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT proowner FROM pg_proc
+                                           WHERE oid = 'public.nafaqah_husband_id(uuid)'::regprocedure)
+           OR p.proowner IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT proowner FROM pg_proc
+                                           WHERE oid = 'public.household_primary_admin_id(uuid)'::regprocedure));
+    IF v_bad IS NOT NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'E2E-04 guard: invoker or foreign-owned callers of the helpers (%)', v_bad;
+    END IF;
+
+    -- No view or constraint may depend on them either.
+    SELECT string_agg(format('%I.%I', schemaname, viewname), ', ') INTO v_bad
+    FROM pg_views
+    WHERE definition ~ '(household_primary_admin_id|nafaqah_husband_id|nafaqah_is_spouse_member)';
+    IF v_bad IS NOT NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'E2E-04 guard: views call the helpers (%)', v_bad;
+    END IF;
+    SELECT string_agg(conname, ', ') INTO v_bad
+    FROM pg_constraint
+    WHERE contype = 'c'
+      AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) ~ '(household_primary_admin_id|nafaqah_husband_id|nafaqah_is_spouse_member)';
+    IF v_bad IS NOT NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'E2E-04 guard: CHECK constraints call the helpers (%)', v_bad;
+    END IF;
+END;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.household_primary_admin_id(uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.nafaqah_husband_id(uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.nafaqah_is_spouse_member(uuid, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.household_primary_admin_id(uuid) TO service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.nafaqah_husband_id(uuid) TO service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.nafaqah_is_spouse_member(uuid, uuid) TO service_role;
+
+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.household_primary_admin_id(uuid) IS
+    'Internal: primary admin of a household. Not client-callable (E2E-04); used by SECURITY DEFINER functions.';
+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.nafaqah_husband_id(uuid) IS
+    'Internal: Nafaqah provider of a family household. Not client-callable (E2E-04); used by SECURITY DEFINER functions.';
+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.nafaqah_is_spouse_member(uuid, uuid) IS
+    'Internal: is the user a spouse member of the household. Not client-callable (E2E-04); used by SECURITY DEFINER functions.';
+
+-- B. E2E-05: sub-category rows follow their parent category's visibility --------
+
+ALTER TABLE public.cost_control_sub_categories ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS cost_control_sub_categories_select_all ON public.cost_control_sub_categories;
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS cost_control_sub_categories_select_visible_parent ON public.cost_control_sub_categories;
+
+CREATE POLICY cost_control_sub_categories_select_visible_parent ON public.cost_control_sub_categories
+    FOR SELECT
+    TO authenticated
+    USING (
+        EXISTS (
+            SELECT 1
+            FROM public.cost_control_codes c
+            WHERE c.code = cost_control_sub_categories.parent_code
+              AND (c.household_id IS NULL
+                   OR c.household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id()))
+        )
+    );
+
+REVOKE ALL ON public.cost_control_sub_categories FROM anon;
+REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE, REFERENCES, TRIGGER ON public.cost_control_sub_categories FROM authenticated;
+GRANT SELECT ON public.cost_control_sub_categories TO authenticated;
+GRANT ALL ON public.cost_control_sub_categories TO service_role;
+
+COMMIT;
+
+-- Rollback (restores the previous, leaky behaviour; run only if this migration
+-- must be undone):
+--   BEGIN;
+--   GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.household_primary_admin_id(uuid) TO authenticated;
+--   GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.nafaqah_husband_id(uuid) TO authenticated;
+--   GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.nafaqah_is_spouse_member(uuid, uuid) TO authenticated;
+--   DROP POLICY IF EXISTS cost_control_sub_categories_select_visible_parent ON public.cost_control_sub_categories;
+--   CREATE POLICY cost_control_sub_categories_select_all ON public.cost_control_sub_categories
+--       FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
+--   GRANT ALL ON public.cost_control_sub_categories TO anon, authenticated;
+--   COMMIT;
diff --git a/supabase/migrations/20261020700000_fable_db_hardening.sql b/supabase/migrations/20261020700000_fable_db_hardening.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..04f381d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/migrations/20261020700000_fable_db_hardening.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,332 @@
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- Migration: 20261020700000_fable_db_hardening.sql
+-- Independent (Fable) review, docs/review/audit/fable_review.md section B:
+-- FABLE-DB-02, -04, -05, -06, -07, -08, -09. (DB-01 and DB-03 are fixed
+-- separately, together with the invite-claim / roles redesign.)
+--
+-- FABLE-DB-02 (Medium, confirmed on live): household_invites.created_by and
+--   .used_by reference public.users with ON DELETE NO ACTION (the SEC-01
+--   "ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ... ON DELETE SET NULL" was a no-op because the
+--   columns already existed), so deleting the account of anyone who ever
+--   created or claimed an invite fails with a FK violation.
+--   Fix:
+--     created_by -> ON DELETE SET NULL: the invite (open or used) belongs to the
+--       household, not to the admin who issued it; the household survives the
+--       admin's departure (primary-admin handover), so its invites stay.
+--     used_by    -> ON DELETE CASCADE: a used invite is deleted with its
+--       claimer. SET NULL is deliberately NOT used: used_by IS NULL is what
+--       makes an invite claimable (claim_household_role_invite,
+--       join_household_by_code, ai_service inspect_household_role_invite), so
+--       SET NULL would silently re-open a spent spouse/provider invite for
+--       anyone holding the code. Nothing references household_invites (no FK
+--       points at it) and nothing reads a used invite afterwards: the claimer's
+--       membership and the manual-member link (household_dependents
+--       .linked_user_id, already ON DELETE SET NULL) are separate rows, and an
+--       admin can issue a fresh invite for the unlinked manual member.
+--   The constraints are matched by column (any name) so this is idempotent and
+--   independent of the constraint names on the target database.
+--
+-- FABLE-DB-04 (Low): reallocate_budget accepted callers with neither a JWT
+--   subject nor a JWT role (auth.uid() and auth.role() both NULL). It now fails
+--   closed unless the caller is the service role (ai_service) or an
+--   authenticated user with a subject (who must still be an admin of the
+--   household owning both rows). Body otherwise unchanged from 20261020030000.
+--
+-- FABLE-DB-05 (Low): nafaqah_current_cycle_key(uuid) (any household's payday
+--   bracket) and generate_secure_invite_code() stay EXECUTE-able by
+--   authenticated. Revoked from PUBLIC, anon, authenticated; service_role keeps
+--   them. Internal callers are SECURITY DEFINER functions owned by the same
+--   owner (get_member_allowance_status, set_member_allowance) and keep working;
+--   generate_secure_invite_code has no caller. No RLS policy, view, column
+--   default or client (.rpc in ai_service / flutter_app / web_app, this branch
+--   and origin/main) references either; the guard in section 7 re-checks.
+--
+-- FABLE-DB-06 (Low): the households UPDATE grant (built in 20261020400000
+--   from every column but owner_user_id) covers id, created_at, invite_code
+--   (join-code existence oracle via the UNIQUE violation, weak admin-chosen
+--   codes) and the rollover ledger (accumulated_savings, last_rollover_*).
+--   Now: UPDATE (name, payday_day, monthly_income, rollover_rule) only. RLS
+--   (households_update_admin) still restricts the rows to admins of their own
+--   active household.
+--   Client writes to public.households (user JWT), all within the new list:
+--     deployed app, origin/main flutter_app/lib/screens/settings/ingestion_settings_screen.dart
+--       :225 update({'payday_day'}), :250 update({'monthly_income'}),
+--       :275 update({'rollover_rule'})
+--     this branch, flutter_app/lib/screens/settings/ingestion_settings_screen.dart
+--       :235 _confirmAndMirror(... update(column)) with column = {'payday_day'} (:253),
+--       {'monthly_income'} (:279), {'rollover_rule'} (:304)
+--     name: no client write today; kept per the review's fix direction.
+--   invite_code / rollover ledger / owner_user_id are written only by SECURITY
+--   DEFINER RPCs and ai_service (service role), which are unaffected. No client
+--   inserts into households (create_household RPC).
+--
+-- FABLE-DB-07 (Low): any member could re-point household_dependents
+--   .linked_user_id (the manual member <-> real user link that the targeted
+--   invite claim sets) to any user. Client privileges become:
+--     INSERT (id, household_id, name, avatar_icon, relationship, monthly_allowance, created_at)
+--     UPDATE (name, avatar_icon, relationship, monthly_allowance)
+--   i.e. never linked_user_id (set only by claim_household_role_invite, a
+--   SECURITY DEFINER RPC), and no re-keying of id/household_id/created_at.
+--   Client writes to household_dependents: none, in either app version
+--   (git grep of flutter_app/lib and web_app/src on this branch and
+--   origin/main: no from('household_dependents') write; manual members are
+--   managed through ai_service with the service role).
+--
+-- FABLE-DB-08 (Low): Supabase's default grants left TRUNCATE (ignores RLS),
+--   TRIGGER and REFERENCES on public tables to anon/authenticated, and
+--   INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE to anon. None is reachable through PostgREST (it never
+--   issues TRUNCATE/CREATE TRIGGER, and no RLS policy targets anon or PUBLIC),
+--   so nothing that works today stops working. Revoked on every table of the
+--   public schema (including tables that exist only on live, e.g.
+--   budgets_spent_backup_20261019), plus MAINTAIN (LOCK TABLE / VACUUM) on
+--   PostgreSQL 17+. service_role is not touched. anon keeps SELECT where it
+--   has it (RLS returns nothing without a policy).
+--
+-- FABLE-DB-09 (Low, suspected -> confirmed): the users INSERT privilege was
+--   table-wide, so it covered financial_role (FR-B-04 only revoked UPDATE).
+--   The users_insert_own policy pins id = auth.uid(), household_id IS NULL and
+--   role = 'member', but not financial_role. Now column-level:
+--     INSERT (id, household_id, display_name, role, payday_day, created_at)
+--   (household_id/role stay listed so a client sending the policy's own safe
+--   values explicitly keeps working.) Rows are normally created by
+--   handle_new_auth_user() (SECURITY DEFINER trigger on auth.users); no client
+--   inserts into public.users in either app version (git grep, as above: only
+--   selects of users in flutter_app/lib). anon loses INSERT/DELETE (section 6).
+--
+-- RLS: policies run as the invoking role, so a revoked EXECUTE would break a
+--   policy that calls the function; none of the revoked functions appears in
+--   any policy (checked by the guard in section 7).
+--
+-- Live safety: idempotent (DROP/ADD constraint by column, CREATE OR REPLACE,
+--   REVOKE/GRANT), one transaction, no row is changed or deleted (adding the FKs
+--   re-validates the existing rows, which already satisfy the same reference).
+--   The final guard verifies the resulting privileges/FKs and aborts (rolling
+--   everything back) if anything differs, e.g. a grant made by another grantor.
+-- Proof tests: supabase/tests/23_fable_db_hardening.sql,
+--   supabase/tests/16_audit_account_deletion.sql (invite creator / claimer).
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+BEGIN;
+
+-- 1. FABLE-DB-02: invite creator / claimer FKs ------------------------------------
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    r record;
+BEGIN
+    FOR r IN
+        SELECT c.conname
+        FROM pg_constraint c
+        WHERE c.conrelid = 'public.household_invites'::regclass
+          AND c.contype = 'f'
+          AND array_length(c.conkey, 1) = 1
+          AND (SELECT a.attname FROM pg_attribute a
+               WHERE a.attrelid = c.conrelid AND a.attnum = c.conkey[1]) IN ('created_by', 'used_by')
+    LOOP
+        EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE public.household_invites DROP CONSTRAINT %I', r.conname);
+    END LOOP;
+END $$;
+
+ALTER TABLE public.household_invites
+    ADD CONSTRAINT household_invites_created_by_fkey
+    FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;
+
+ALTER TABLE public.household_invites
+    ADD CONSTRAINT household_invites_used_by_fkey
+    FOREIGN KEY (used_by) REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;
+
+-- 2. FABLE-DB-04: reallocate_budget fails closed -----------------------------------
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reallocate_budget(
+    p_from_id uuid,
+    p_to_id uuid,
+    p_amount numeric
+)
+RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+    v_jwt_role text := auth.role();
+    v_from public.budgets%ROWTYPE;
+    v_to public.budgets%ROWTYPE;
+BEGIN
+    -- Only the service role (ai_service) or an authenticated user with a JWT
+    -- subject; no claims at all (or any other role without a subject) is refused.
+    IF v_uid IS NULL AND v_jwt_role IS DISTINCT FROM 'service_role' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_from_id IS NULL OR p_to_id IS NULL OR p_from_id = p_to_id THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Two distinct budget ids are required' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_amount IS NULL OR p_amount <= 0 OR p_amount <> round(p_amount, 2) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Reallocation amount must be positive with at most 2 decimals' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF p_from_id < p_to_id THEN
+        SELECT * INTO v_from FROM public.budgets WHERE id = p_from_id FOR UPDATE;
+        SELECT * INTO v_to FROM public.budgets WHERE id = p_to_id FOR UPDATE;
+    ELSE
+        SELECT * INTO v_to FROM public.budgets WHERE id = p_to_id FOR UPDATE;
+        SELECT * INTO v_from FROM public.budgets WHERE id = p_from_id FOR UPDATE;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_from.id IS NULL OR v_to.id IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Budget not found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_from.household_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_to.household_id THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Budgets belong to different households' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_uid IS NOT NULL THEN
+        IF public.get_auth_user_household_id() IS DISTINCT FROM v_from.household_id
+           OR public.get_auth_user_role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'admin' THEN
+            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: household admin required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+        END IF;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_from.allocated_amount < p_amount THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Insufficient allocation: % available, % requested', v_from.allocated_amount, p_amount
+            USING ERRCODE = '22000';
+    END IF;
+
+    UPDATE public.budgets
+    SET allocated_amount = allocated_amount - p_amount
+    WHERE id = v_from.id;
+
+    UPDATE public.budgets
+    SET allocated_amount = allocated_amount + p_amount
+    WHERE id = v_to.id;
+END;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.reallocate_budget(uuid, uuid, numeric) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.reallocate_budget(uuid, uuid, numeric) TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+-- 3. FABLE-DB-05: internal helpers are not client RPCs -----------------------------
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_fn text;
+BEGIN
+    FOREACH v_fn IN ARRAY ARRAY[
+        'public.nafaqah_current_cycle_key(uuid)',
+        'public.generate_secure_invite_code()'
+    ]
+    LOOP
+        IF to_regprocedure(v_fn) IS NOT NULL THEN
+            EXECUTE format('REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION %s FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated', v_fn);
+            EXECUTE format('GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION %s TO service_role', v_fn);
+        END IF;
+    END LOOP;
+END $$;
+
+-- 4. FABLE-DB-06: households client-updatable columns ------------------------------
+-- (REVOKE of the table privilege also revokes every column privilege.)
+REVOKE UPDATE ON public.households FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+GRANT UPDATE (name, payday_day, monthly_income, rollover_rule) ON public.households TO authenticated;
+
+-- 5. FABLE-DB-07 / FABLE-DB-09: column-level INSERT/UPDATE --------------------------
+REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE ON public.household_dependents FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+GRANT INSERT (id, household_id, name, avatar_icon, relationship, monthly_allowance, created_at)
+    ON public.household_dependents TO authenticated;
+GRANT UPDATE (name, avatar_icon, relationship, monthly_allowance)
+    ON public.household_dependents TO authenticated;
+
+REVOKE INSERT ON public.users FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+GRANT INSERT (id, household_id, display_name, role, payday_day, created_at)
+    ON public.users TO authenticated;
+
+-- 6. FABLE-DB-08: privileges PostgREST never needs ---------------------------------
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    r record;
+    v_pg17 boolean := current_setting('server_version_num')::int >= 170000;
+BEGIN
+    FOR r IN
+        SELECT c.oid::regclass AS tbl
+        FROM pg_class c
+        WHERE c.relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace
+          AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p')
+          AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_depend d
+                          WHERE d.classid = 'pg_class'::regclass AND d.objid = c.oid AND d.deptype = 'e')
+    LOOP
+        EXECUTE format('REVOKE TRUNCATE, TRIGGER, REFERENCES ON TABLE %s FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated', r.tbl);
+        EXECUTE format('REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLE %s FROM PUBLIC, anon', r.tbl);
+        IF v_pg17 THEN
+            EXECUTE format('REVOKE MAINTAIN ON TABLE %s FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated', r.tbl);
+        END IF;
+    END LOOP;
+END $$;
+
+-- 7. Guard: verify the result on the target database; abort otherwise ---------------
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_bad text;
+    v_cols text;
+BEGIN
+    -- DB-02
+    IF (SELECT string_agg(a.attname || ':' || c.confdeltype::text, ',' ORDER BY a.attname)
+        FROM pg_constraint c
+        JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.conrelid AND a.attnum = c.conkey[1]
+        WHERE c.conrelid = 'public.household_invites'::regclass AND c.contype = 'f'
+          AND a.attname IN ('created_by', 'used_by')) IS DISTINCT FROM 'created_by:n,used_by:c' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'fable_db_hardening guard: household_invites created_by/used_by FKs not as expected';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- DB-05: no client EXECUTE, and no policy relies on the helpers
+    IF has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.nafaqah_current_cycle_key(uuid)', 'EXECUTE')
+       OR has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.nafaqah_current_cycle_key(uuid)', 'EXECUTE')
+       OR (to_regprocedure('public.generate_secure_invite_code()') IS NOT NULL
+           AND (has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.generate_secure_invite_code()', 'EXECUTE')
+                OR has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.generate_secure_invite_code()', 'EXECUTE'))) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'fable_db_hardening guard: helper still client-executable';
+    END IF;
+    SELECT string_agg(schemaname || '.' || tablename || '.' || policyname, ', ') INTO v_bad
+    FROM pg_policies
+    WHERE coalesce(qual, '') || coalesce(with_check, '') ~* '(nafaqah_current_cycle_key|generate_secure_invite_code)';
+    IF v_bad IS NOT NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'fable_db_hardening guard: policies call a revoked helper: %', v_bad;
+    END IF;
+
+    -- DB-06 / DB-07 / DB-09: exact client column lists
+    SELECT string_agg(a.attname, ',' ORDER BY a.attname) INTO v_cols
+    FROM pg_attribute a
+    WHERE a.attrelid = 'public.households'::regclass AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
+      AND has_column_privilege('authenticated', a.attrelid, a.attnum, 'UPDATE');
+    IF v_cols IS DISTINCT FROM 'monthly_income,name,payday_day,rollover_rule' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'fable_db_hardening guard: households UPDATE columns are %', v_cols;
+    END IF;
+    SELECT string_agg(a.attname, ',' ORDER BY a.attname) INTO v_cols
+    FROM pg_attribute a
+    WHERE a.attrelid = 'public.household_dependents'::regclass AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
+      AND has_column_privilege('authenticated', a.attrelid, a.attnum, 'UPDATE');
+    IF v_cols IS DISTINCT FROM 'avatar_icon,monthly_allowance,name,relationship' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'fable_db_hardening guard: household_dependents UPDATE columns are %', v_cols;
+    END IF;
+    IF has_column_privilege('authenticated', 'public.household_dependents', 'linked_user_id', 'INSERT')
+       OR has_column_privilege('authenticated', 'public.users', 'financial_role', 'INSERT')
+       OR has_column_privilege('authenticated', 'public.users', 'financial_role', 'UPDATE') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'fable_db_hardening guard: linked_user_id / financial_role still client-writable';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- DB-08 (tables this role can manage)
+    SELECT string_agg(c.relname, ', ' ORDER BY c.relname) INTO v_bad
+    FROM pg_class c
+    WHERE c.relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace
+      AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p')
+      AND pg_has_role(current_user, c.relowner, 'MEMBER')
+      AND (has_table_privilege('anon', c.oid, 'TRUNCATE')
+           OR has_table_privilege('authenticated', c.oid, 'TRUNCATE')
+           OR has_any_column_privilege('anon', c.oid, 'INSERT')
+           OR has_any_column_privilege('anon', c.oid, 'UPDATE')
+           OR has_table_privilege('anon', c.oid, 'DELETE')
+           OR has_table_privilege('authenticated', c.oid, 'TRIGGER'));
+    IF v_bad IS NOT NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'fable_db_hardening guard: TRUNCATE/TRIGGER/anon DML still granted on %', v_bad;
+    END IF;
+END $$;
+
+COMMIT;
diff --git a/supabase/migrations/20261020750000_installment_pay_atomic.sql b/supabase/migrations/20261020750000_installment_pay_atomic.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..4067631
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/migrations/20261020750000_installment_pay_atomic.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,83 @@
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- Migration: 20261020750000_installment_pay_atomic.sql
+-- Independent review FABLE-API-10 (Low, suspected; docs/review/audit/fable_review.md):
+--   POST /budgets/installments/{id}/pay read the plan, added one in Python and
+--   wrote paid_installments back. Two concurrent payments both read the same
+--   value, so one payment was lost (and nothing stopped a paid-up plan from
+--   being "paid" again through a stale read).
+-- Fix: pay_installment_plan() performs one conditional increment
+--     UPDATE ... SET paid_installments = paid_installments + 1
+--      WHERE id = $plan AND household_id = $household AND paid_installments < installment_count
+--   (row lock taken by the UPDATE, so concurrent calls serialise and each one
+--   counts exactly once, never beyond installment_count). A plan that is
+--   already complete is returned unchanged; a plan outside the household
+--   returns no row.
+-- Security: SECURITY DEFINER with a pinned search_path; the verified caller
+--   (p_actor_user_id, from the API's JWT check) must be a member of the
+--   household (household_memberships). EXECUTE for service_role only (the
+--   ai_service); anon/authenticated cannot call it.
+-- Live safety: adds one function, changes no table, no data. Idempotent
+--   (CREATE OR REPLACE, REVOKE/GRANT). Deploy before the ai_service build that
+--   calls it (README deployment order: migrations -> ai_service -> app).
+-- Proof test: supabase/tests/24_installment_pay_atomic.sql
+-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+BEGIN;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pay_installment_plan(
+    p_plan_id uuid,
+    p_household_id uuid,
+    p_actor_user_id uuid
+)
+RETURNS SETOF public.installment_plans
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_row public.installment_plans;
+BEGIN
+    IF p_plan_id IS NULL OR p_household_id IS NULL OR p_actor_user_id IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'plan, household and actor are required' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF NOT EXISTS (
+        SELECT 1
+        FROM public.household_memberships m
+        WHERE m.household_id = p_household_id
+          AND m.user_id = p_actor_user_id
+    ) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only a member of the household can record an installment payment'
+            USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    UPDATE public.installment_plans AS p
+       SET paid_installments = p.paid_installments + 1,
+           status = CASE WHEN p.paid_installments + 1 >= p.installment_count THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE p.status END
+     WHERE p.id = p_plan_id
+       AND p.household_id = p_household_id
+       AND p.paid_installments < p.installment_count
+    RETURNING p.* INTO v_row;
+
+    IF FOUND THEN
+        RETURN NEXT v_row;
+        RETURN;
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Already paid up (or not in this household): the current row, unchanged, if any.
+    RETURN QUERY
+        SELECT p.*
+        FROM public.installment_plans AS p
+        WHERE p.id = p_plan_id
+          AND p.household_id = p_household_id;
+END;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.pay_installment_plan(uuid, uuid, uuid) FROM PUBLIC;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.pay_installment_plan(uuid, uuid, uuid) FROM anon, authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.pay_installment_plan(uuid, uuid, uuid) TO service_role;
+
+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.pay_installment_plan(uuid, uuid, uuid) IS
+    'Records one installment payment atomically (conditional increment, never beyond installment_count). service_role only; p_actor_user_id must be a household member.';
+
+COMMIT;
diff --git a/supabase/migrations/20261020800000_household_roles_and_nafaqah_integrity.sql b/supabase/migrations/20261020800000_household_roles_and_nafaqah_integrity.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..d5c5dde
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/migrations/20261020800000_household_roles_and_nafaqah_integrity.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,1391 @@
+-- ============================================================================
+-- Migration: 20261020800000_household_roles_and_nafaqah_integrity.sql
+--
+-- Independent review (Fable, docs/review/audit/fable_review.md) sections A + B,
+-- with the owner decisions of 2026-10-21:
+--   * The Nafaqah provider (husband) of a family household is stored
+--     explicitly per household. Default: the household's primary admin
+--     (households.owner_user_id). An admin can change it to another
+--     (non-spouse) member. It is never inferred from user-level roles.
+--   * Wife personal purchases (nafaqah_class = 'wife_personal') count against
+--     her allowance only, never against the household category budgets.
+--
+-- Items:
+--   FABLE-LOGIC-01  Financial role per membership: household_memberships
+--                   .financial_role (same values as users.financial_role),
+--                   backfilled from users.financial_role. Every Nafaqah helper
+--                   reads the membership of THAT household; users.financial_role
+--                   is only a cache of the active household's membership role
+--                   (create / join / claim / switch_active_household keep it).
+--   FABLE-LOGIC-04  households.nafaqah_provider_user_id (ON DELETE SET NULL),
+--                   backfilled = owner_user_id; set_nafaqah_provider() RPC
+--                   (admins); cleared when the provider's membership ends; new
+--                   classified rows are refused while it is NULL. Non-spouse
+--                   joiners of a family household default to 'family_member'.
+--   FABLE-DB-01/03  Invites readable by admins only; the claim RPCs never let an
+--                   existing member consume an invite of their own household
+--                   (no-op switch for idempotent retries / the static code);
+--                   the users -> memberships sync trigger never demotes an admin
+--                   and never rewrites another household's membership.
+--   FABLE-LOGIC-02  BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE guard on wife_reimbursable rows: a
+--                   change that would leave advances below the recorded
+--                   repayments is refused (22023, HINT ledger_would_be_overpaid),
+--                   under the advisory lock of record_spouse_reimbursement.
+--   FABLE-LOGIC-06  Budget triggers ignore wife_personal rows (class changes on
+--                   UPDATE move the amount in/out of the category budget).
+--   FABLE-LOGIC-05  Changing households.payday_day re-stamps cycle_key from the
+--                   open cycle onward and moves the open cycle's budgets and
+--                   allowances to the new key (never overwriting a row that
+--                   already exists for that key), then recomputes the affected
+--                   budgets' spent_amount.
+--
+-- Live safety: one transaction, idempotent (re-running changes nothing), no row
+-- is deleted. Compatible with the deployed backend (origin/main, service role:
+-- reads users.financial_role, which stays a correct cache of the active
+-- household; sets payday through households.payday_day, now re-keyed by the
+-- trigger) and with released app builds (join_household_by_code /
+-- create_household_and_claim keep their return shapes; the app never reads
+-- household_invites, household_memberships.financial_role or the provider
+-- column directly; a direct households.payday_day update is re-keyed too).
+-- Applies after 20261020700000 (grants / FK hardening); the provider column is
+-- not client-writable whichever households UPDATE column list is in force.
+--
+-- Proof test: supabase/tests/25_household_roles_and_nafaqah_integrity.sql
+-- ============================================================================
+
+BEGIN;
+
+-- 0. Guard: the assumptions this file relies on ------------------------------
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_n int;
+BEGIN
+    IF to_regclass('public.household_memberships') IS NULL
+       OR to_regclass('public.member_allowances') IS NULL
+       OR to_regclass('public.spouse_reimbursements') IS NULL
+       OR to_regclass('public.household_invites') IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'guard: household_memberships / member_allowances / spouse_reimbursements / household_invites missing (apply 20261020300000 first)';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_n
+    FROM (VALUES ('households', 'owner_user_id'), ('households', 'payday_day'),
+                 ('transactions', 'nafaqah_class'), ('transactions', 'nafaqah_spouse_id'),
+                 ('transactions', 'cycle_key'), ('budgets', 'cycle_key'),
+                 ('users', 'financial_role')) AS req(t, c)
+    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
+                      WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = req.t AND column_name = req.c);
+    IF v_n > 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'guard: % required column(s) missing (apply 20261020300000 / 20261020400000 first)', v_n;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF to_regprocedure('public.get_saudi_cycle_for_timestamp(timestamptz, integer)') IS NULL
+       OR to_regprocedure('public.household_resolve_actor(uuid)') IS NULL
+       OR to_regprocedure('public.household_require_admin(uuid, uuid)') IS NULL
+       OR to_regprocedure('public.household_member_role(uuid, uuid)') IS NULL
+       OR to_regprocedure('public.populate_transaction_cycle_key()') IS NULL
+       OR to_regprocedure('public.record_spouse_reimbursement(uuid, uuid, numeric, text, text, uuid)') IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'guard: required functions missing (apply the 20261020 batch first)';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_n
+    FROM public.users
+    WHERE financial_role IS NOT NULL
+      AND financial_role NOT IN ('provider', 'spouse', 'peer', 'family_member', 'dependent');
+    IF v_n > 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'guard: % users.financial_role value(s) outside the known set', v_n;
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM (
+        SELECT user_id FROM public.household_memberships GROUP BY user_id HAVING count(*) > 1
+    ) multi;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'guard: % user(s) belong to more than one household (their memberships are backfilled from users.financial_role)', v_n;
+
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.transactions WHERE nafaqah_class IS NOT NULL;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'guard: % classified (Nafaqah) transaction(s)', v_n;
+END;
+$$;
+
+-- 1. Financial role per membership (FABLE-LOGIC-01) ---------------------------
+ALTER TABLE public.household_memberships ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS financial_role text;
+
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    IF NOT EXISTS (
+        SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
+        WHERE conname = 'household_memberships_financial_role_check'
+          AND conrelid = 'public.household_memberships'::regclass
+    ) THEN
+        ALTER TABLE public.household_memberships
+            ADD CONSTRAINT household_memberships_financial_role_check
+            CHECK (financial_role IN ('provider', 'spouse', 'peer', 'family_member', 'dependent'));
+    END IF;
+END $$;
+
+-- Backfill: the per-user role applied to every household until now (live: one
+-- membership per user, so this is exact). Only rows not yet backfilled.
+UPDATE public.household_memberships m
+SET financial_role = COALESCE(u.financial_role, 'provider')
+FROM public.users u
+WHERE u.id = m.user_id
+  AND m.financial_role IS NULL;
+
+UPDATE public.household_memberships SET financial_role = 'family_member' WHERE financial_role IS NULL;
+ALTER TABLE public.household_memberships ALTER COLUMN financial_role SET NOT NULL;
+
+COMMENT ON COLUMN public.household_memberships.financial_role IS
+    'Financial role of the user IN THIS household (provider, spouse, peer, family_member, dependent). Decides family '
+    '(spouse member) vs roommate mode. Set by the invite RPCs; users.financial_role caches the active household''s value.';
+
+-- Clients never write memberships (20261020020000); keep it explicit for the new column.
+REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE ON public.household_memberships FROM anon, authenticated;
+
+-- 2. Explicit Nafaqah provider (FABLE-LOGIC-04) --------------------------------
+-- Added and backfilled in one step so a re-run never re-defaults a provider an
+-- admin cleared or changed. Backfill = the primary admin of EVERY household
+-- whose primary admin is a non-spouse member: in households without a spouse
+-- member the provider is inert (nafaqah_husband_id() is NULL there), and a
+-- household that later gains a wife works at once with the owner's default.
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
+                   WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'households'
+                     AND column_name = 'nafaqah_provider_user_id') THEN
+        ALTER TABLE public.households
+            ADD COLUMN nafaqah_provider_user_id uuid REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;
+
+        UPDATE public.households h
+        SET nafaqah_provider_user_id = h.owner_user_id
+        WHERE h.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
+          AND EXISTS (
+              SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships m
+              WHERE m.household_id = h.id
+                AND m.user_id = h.owner_user_id
+                AND m.financial_role <> 'spouse'
+          );
+    END IF;
+END $$;
+
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_households_nafaqah_provider
+    ON public.households (nafaqah_provider_user_id) WHERE nafaqah_provider_user_id IS NOT NULL;
+
+-- Changed only through set_nafaqah_provider (no column privilege for clients,
+-- whatever households UPDATE column list 20261020400000 / 20261020700000 left).
+REVOKE UPDATE (nafaqah_provider_user_id) ON public.households FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+
+COMMENT ON COLUMN public.households.nafaqah_provider_user_id IS
+    'Nafaqah provider (husband) of a family household: a non-spouse member. Defaults to the primary admin; changed by an '
+    'admin through set_nafaqah_provider; NULL after the provider leaves (new classified expenses are refused until set).';
+
+-- 3. Helpers -----------------------------------------------------------------------
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.household_member_financial_role(p_household_id uuid, p_user_id uuid)
+RETURNS text
+LANGUAGE sql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+    SELECT m.financial_role
+    FROM public.household_memberships m
+    WHERE m.household_id = p_household_id AND m.user_id = p_user_id;
+$$;
+
+-- Role of a user joining without a role-tagged invite: the owner / first member
+-- is the provider; in a family (a spouse member) everyone else is family; in a
+-- roommate household (a peer member) a peer; otherwise family. Never 'spouse'.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.household_default_financial_role(p_household_id uuid, p_user_id uuid)
+RETURNS text
+LANGUAGE sql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+    SELECT CASE
+        WHEN (SELECT h.owner_user_id FROM public.households h WHERE h.id = p_household_id) = p_user_id
+             OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships o
+                            WHERE o.household_id = p_household_id AND o.user_id <> p_user_id)
+            THEN 'provider'
+        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships o
+                     WHERE o.household_id = p_household_id AND o.user_id <> p_user_id AND o.financial_role = 'spouse')
+            THEN 'family_member'
+        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships o
+                     WHERE o.household_id = p_household_id AND o.user_id <> p_user_id AND o.financial_role = 'peer')
+            THEN 'peer'
+        ELSE 'family_member'
+    END;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.household_member_financial_role(uuid, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.household_default_financial_role(uuid, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+
+-- Membership rows: default role on insert; a provider can never become a spouse.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.membership_financial_role_rules()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+    IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' AND NEW.financial_role IS NULL THEN
+        NEW.financial_role := public.household_default_financial_role(NEW.household_id, NEW.user_id);
+    END IF;
+    IF NEW.financial_role = 'spouse'
+       AND (TG_OP = 'INSERT' OR OLD.financial_role IS DISTINCT FROM 'spouse')
+       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.households h
+                   WHERE h.id = NEW.household_id AND h.nafaqah_provider_user_id = NEW.user_id) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'The Nafaqah provider of a household cannot be a spouse member'
+            USING ERRCODE = '23514', HINT = 'provider_is_spouse';
+    END IF;
+    RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$$;
+
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_membership_financial_role_rules ON public.household_memberships;
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_membership_financial_role_rules
+BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF financial_role ON public.household_memberships
+FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.membership_financial_role_rules();
+
+-- users.financial_role caches the active household's membership role.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.membership_financial_role_cache()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+    UPDATE public.users
+    SET financial_role = NEW.financial_role
+    WHERE id = NEW.user_id
+      AND household_id = NEW.household_id
+      AND financial_role IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.financial_role;
+    RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$$;
+
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_membership_financial_role_cache ON public.household_memberships;
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_membership_financial_role_cache
+AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF financial_role ON public.household_memberships
+FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.membership_financial_role_cache();
+
+-- The provider leaves (or is removed / deletes the account): cleared, never
+-- re-inferred. Family features then refuse new classified rows until an admin
+-- chooses a provider.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.clear_nafaqah_provider_on_membership_end()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+    UPDATE public.households
+    SET nafaqah_provider_user_id = NULL
+    WHERE id = OLD.household_id
+      AND nafaqah_provider_user_id = OLD.user_id;
+    RETURN OLD;
+END;
+$$;
+
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_clear_nafaqah_provider ON public.household_memberships;
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_clear_nafaqah_provider
+AFTER DELETE ON public.household_memberships
+FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.clear_nafaqah_provider_on_membership_end();
+
+-- households: the first primary admin becomes the default provider; any
+-- provider must be a non-spouse member (binds service-role writes too).
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.households_nafaqah_provider_rules()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_role text;
+BEGIN
+    IF NEW.nafaqah_provider_user_id IS NULL
+       AND NEW.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
+       AND (TG_OP = 'INSERT' OR OLD.owner_user_id IS NULL) THEN
+        v_role := public.household_member_financial_role(NEW.id, NEW.owner_user_id);
+        IF v_role IS NOT NULL AND v_role <> 'spouse' THEN
+            NEW.nafaqah_provider_user_id := NEW.owner_user_id;
+        END IF;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF NEW.nafaqah_provider_user_id IS NOT NULL
+       AND (TG_OP = 'INSERT' OR NEW.nafaqah_provider_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.nafaqah_provider_user_id) THEN
+        v_role := public.household_member_financial_role(NEW.id, NEW.nafaqah_provider_user_id);
+        IF v_role IS NULL THEN
+            RAISE EXCEPTION 'The Nafaqah provider must be a member of the household'
+                USING ERRCODE = '23514', HINT = 'provider_not_member';
+        END IF;
+        IF v_role = 'spouse' THEN
+            RAISE EXCEPTION 'A spouse member cannot be the Nafaqah provider'
+                USING ERRCODE = '23514', HINT = 'provider_is_spouse';
+        END IF;
+    END IF;
+    RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$$;
+
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_households_nafaqah_provider ON public.households;
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_households_nafaqah_provider
+BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF owner_user_id, nafaqah_provider_user_id ON public.households
+FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.households_nafaqah_provider_rules();
+
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.membership_financial_role_rules() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.membership_financial_role_cache() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.clear_nafaqah_provider_on_membership_end() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.households_nafaqah_provider_rules() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+
+-- 4. Nafaqah helpers read the membership of THAT household --------------------
+-- (CREATE OR REPLACE keeps the E2E-04 grants: service_role only.)
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nafaqah_is_spouse_member(p_household_id uuid, p_user_id uuid)
+RETURNS boolean
+LANGUAGE sql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+    SELECT EXISTS (
+        SELECT 1
+        FROM public.household_memberships m
+        WHERE m.household_id = p_household_id
+          AND m.user_id = p_user_id
+          AND m.financial_role = 'spouse'
+    );
+$$;
+
+-- The explicit provider, when the household is a family (has a spouse member)
+-- and the provider is still a non-spouse member; NULL otherwise.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nafaqah_husband_id(p_household_id uuid)
+RETURNS uuid
+LANGUAGE sql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+    SELECT h.nafaqah_provider_user_id
+    FROM public.households h
+    WHERE h.id = p_household_id
+      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships sm
+                  WHERE sm.household_id = h.id AND sm.financial_role = 'spouse')
+      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships pm
+                  WHERE pm.household_id = h.id
+                    AND pm.user_id = h.nafaqah_provider_user_id
+                    AND pm.financial_role <> 'spouse');
+$$;
+
+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.nafaqah_husband_id(uuid) IS
+    'Internal: households.nafaqah_provider_user_id of a family household (never inferred). Not client-callable (E2E-04).';
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_transaction_nafaqah_class()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+    -- ON DELETE SET NULL of the spouse's account: keep the expense, drop the class.
+    IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND NEW.nafaqah_spouse_id IS NULL AND OLD.nafaqah_spouse_id IS NOT NULL
+       AND NEW.nafaqah_class IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.nafaqah_class THEN
+        NEW.nafaqah_class := NULL;
+        RETURN NEW;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF NEW.nafaqah_class IS NULL AND NEW.nafaqah_spouse_id IS NULL THEN
+        RETURN NEW;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF NEW.nafaqah_class IS NULL OR NEW.nafaqah_spouse_id IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'nafaqah_class and nafaqah_spouse_id must be set together'
+            USING ERRCODE = '23514';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- An unchanged classification stays editable (e.g. after the provider left).
+    IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE'
+       AND NEW.nafaqah_class IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.nafaqah_class
+       AND NEW.nafaqah_spouse_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.nafaqah_spouse_id
+       AND NEW.household_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.household_id THEN
+        RETURN NEW;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF NOT public.nafaqah_is_spouse_member(NEW.household_id, NEW.nafaqah_spouse_id) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'nafaqah_spouse_id % is not a spouse member of household %', NEW.nafaqah_spouse_id, NEW.household_id
+            USING ERRCODE = '23503';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF public.nafaqah_husband_id(NEW.household_id) IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Household % has no Nafaqah provider: a household admin must choose one before family expenses are classified', NEW.household_id
+            USING ERRCODE = '23514', HINT = 'no_nafaqah_provider';
+    END IF;
+
+    RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$$;
+
+-- Members with their roles: the financial role is the membership's.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_household_members(
+    p_household_id uuid,
+    p_actor_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL
+)
+RETURNS TABLE (
+    user_id uuid,
+    display_name text,
+    role text,
+    financial_role text,
+    is_primary boolean,
+    joined_at timestamptz
+)
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+STABLE
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_actor uuid := public.household_resolve_actor(p_actor_user_id);
+    v_owner uuid;
+BEGIN
+    IF p_household_id IS NULL OR public.household_member_role(p_household_id, v_actor) IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: not a member of this household' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+    v_owner := public.household_primary_admin_id(p_household_id);
+
+    RETURN QUERY
+    SELECT m.user_id,
+           u.display_name,
+           m.role,
+           m.financial_role,
+           (m.user_id = v_owner) AS is_primary,
+           m.created_at AS joined_at
+    FROM public.household_memberships m
+    JOIN public.users u ON u.id = m.user_id
+    WHERE m.household_id = p_household_id
+    ORDER BY (m.user_id = v_owner) DESC, (m.role = 'admin') DESC, m.created_at ASC, m.user_id ASC;
+END;
+$$;
+
+-- 5. users -> memberships sync (FABLE-DB-03) -----------------------------------
+-- Creates the active household's membership when missing (copying the role and
+-- financial role being written); an existing membership is never demoted from
+-- admin and its financial role is never rewritten from the per-user cache.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_user_household_membership()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+    IF NEW.household_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+        INSERT INTO public.household_memberships (household_id, user_id, role, is_default, financial_role)
+        VALUES (
+            NEW.household_id,
+            NEW.id,
+            COALESCE(NEW.role, 'member'),
+            NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships WHERE user_id = NEW.id),
+            NEW.financial_role
+        )
+        ON CONFLICT (household_id, user_id)
+        DO UPDATE SET role = CASE
+            WHEN public.household_memberships.role = 'admin' THEN 'admin'
+            ELSE COALESCE(EXCLUDED.role, public.household_memberships.role)
+        END;
+    END IF;
+    RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$$;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.sync_user_household_membership() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+
+-- 6. Household context RPCs keep the cache in step ---------------------------------
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.switch_active_household(p_household_id uuid)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_role text;
+    v_financial_role text;
+    v_name text;
+BEGIN
+    SELECT role, financial_role INTO v_role, v_financial_role
+    FROM public.household_memberships
+    WHERE household_id = p_household_id AND user_id = auth.uid();
+
+    IF v_role IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: Not a member of household %', p_household_id;
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT name INTO v_name
+    FROM public.households
+    WHERE id = p_household_id;
+
+    UPDATE public.users
+    SET household_id = p_household_id,
+        role = v_role,
+        financial_role = v_financial_role
+    WHERE id = auth.uid();
+
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+        'success', true,
+        'household_id', p_household_id,
+        'household_name', v_name,
+        'role', v_role,
+        'financial_role', v_financial_role
+    );
+END;
+$$;
+
+-- The creator is the primary admin and the default Nafaqah provider.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_household_and_claim(p_name text)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, extensions, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+    v_hh public.households%ROWTYPE;
+    v_count int;
+    v_invite_code text;
+BEGIN
+    IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_count
+    FROM public.household_memberships
+    WHERE user_id = v_uid AND role = 'admin';
+
+    IF v_count >= 5 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Household creation limit reached (maximum 5 households per user)';
+    END IF;
+
+    v_invite_code := upper(encode(extensions.gen_random_bytes(8), 'hex'));
+
+    INSERT INTO public.households (name, invite_code)
+    VALUES (trim(p_name), v_invite_code)
+    RETURNING * INTO v_hh;
+
+    -- Membership first: it makes the creator the primary admin, which makes
+    -- them the default Nafaqah provider.
+    INSERT INTO public.household_memberships (household_id, user_id, role, is_default, financial_role)
+    VALUES (v_hh.id, v_uid, 'admin', true, 'provider')
+    ON CONFLICT (household_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET role = 'admin';
+
+    UPDATE public.users
+    SET household_id = v_hh.id,
+        role = 'admin',
+        financial_role = 'provider'
+    WHERE id = v_uid;
+
+    SELECT * INTO v_hh FROM public.households WHERE id = v_hh.id;
+    RETURN to_jsonb(v_hh);
+END;
+$$;
+
+-- 7. Invite claims (FABLE-DB-01 / DB-03, FABLE-LOGIC-01) ---------------------------
+-- Older app builds call the API claim and then join_household_by_code with the
+-- same code: a retry by the user who already used the invite is a no-op switch.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.join_household_by_code(p_invite_code text)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
+    v_clean_code text := upper(trim(p_invite_code));
+    v_fail_count int;
+    v_invite public.household_invites%ROWTYPE;
+    v_hh public.households%ROWTYPE;
+    v_claimed_id uuid;
+    v_role text;
+    v_financial_role text;
+    v_is_default boolean;
+BEGIN
+    IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_fail_count
+    FROM public.invite_attempt_log
+    WHERE user_id = v_uid
+      AND success = false
+      AND attempted_at > (now() - interval '15 minutes');
+
+    IF v_fail_count >= 5 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Too many failed join attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT * INTO v_invite
+    FROM public.household_invites
+    WHERE upper(trim(invite_code)) = v_clean_code
+    FOR UPDATE;
+
+    IF v_invite.id IS NOT NULL THEN
+        IF v_invite.expires_at < now() THEN
+            INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, false);
+            RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invite code has expired');
+        END IF;
+
+        SELECT role, financial_role INTO v_role, v_financial_role
+        FROM public.household_memberships
+        WHERE household_id = v_invite.household_id AND user_id = v_uid;
+
+        IF v_role IS NOT NULL THEN
+            IF v_invite.used_by IS DISTINCT FROM v_uid THEN
+                -- An existing member never consumes an invite meant for someone else
+                -- (and never re-roles themselves through it).
+                RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'You are already a member of this household',
+                                          'code', 'already_member');
+            END IF;
+            -- Retry by the claimer: switch to the household, nothing else changes.
+            SELECT * INTO v_hh FROM public.households WHERE id = v_invite.household_id;
+            UPDATE public.users
+            SET household_id = v_hh.id, role = v_role, financial_role = v_financial_role
+            WHERE id = v_uid;
+            INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, true);
+            RETURN to_jsonb(v_hh);
+        END IF;
+
+        IF v_invite.used_by = v_uid THEN
+            v_claimed_id := v_invite.id;  -- re-joining with the invite this user claimed earlier
+        ELSIF v_invite.used_by IS NULL THEN
+            UPDATE public.household_invites
+            SET used_by = v_uid
+            WHERE id = v_invite.id AND used_by IS NULL
+            RETURNING id INTO v_claimed_id;
+
+            IF v_claimed_id IS NULL THEN
+                INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, false);
+                RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invite code has already been used');
+            END IF;
+        ELSE
+            INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, false);
+            RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invite code has already been used');
+        END IF;
+
+        SELECT * INTO v_hh FROM public.households WHERE id = v_invite.household_id;
+
+        IF v_invite.target_member_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+            UPDATE public.household_dependents
+            SET linked_user_id = v_uid
+            WHERE id = v_invite.target_member_id
+              AND household_id = v_invite.household_id;
+        END IF;
+
+        v_is_default := NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships WHERE user_id = v_uid);
+        INSERT INTO public.household_memberships (household_id, user_id, role, is_default, financial_role)
+        VALUES (
+            v_hh.id, v_uid, 'member', v_is_default,
+            CASE WHEN v_invite.role IN ('provider', 'spouse', 'peer', 'family_member', 'dependent')
+                 THEN v_invite.role
+                 ELSE public.household_default_financial_role(v_hh.id, v_uid) END
+        )
+        ON CONFLICT (household_id, user_id) DO NOTHING;
+
+        SELECT role, financial_role INTO v_role, v_financial_role
+        FROM public.household_memberships
+        WHERE household_id = v_hh.id AND user_id = v_uid;
+
+        UPDATE public.users
+        SET household_id = v_hh.id, role = v_role, financial_role = v_financial_role
+        WHERE id = v_uid;
+
+        INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, true);
+        RETURN to_jsonb(v_hh);
+    END IF;
+
+    -- The household's permanent join code.
+    SELECT * INTO v_hh
+    FROM public.households
+    WHERE upper(trim(invite_code)) = v_clean_code;
+
+    IF v_hh.id IS NOT NULL THEN
+        v_is_default := NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships WHERE user_id = v_uid);
+        INSERT INTO public.household_memberships (household_id, user_id, role, is_default, financial_role)
+        VALUES (v_hh.id, v_uid, 'member', v_is_default, public.household_default_financial_role(v_hh.id, v_uid))
+        ON CONFLICT (household_id, user_id) DO NOTHING;
+
+        -- Existing members keep their role and financial role (never demoted).
+        SELECT role, financial_role INTO v_role, v_financial_role
+        FROM public.household_memberships
+        WHERE household_id = v_hh.id AND user_id = v_uid;
+
+        UPDATE public.users
+        SET household_id = v_hh.id, role = v_role, financial_role = v_financial_role
+        WHERE id = v_uid;
+
+        INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, true);
+        RETURN to_jsonb(v_hh);
+    END IF;
+
+    INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, false);
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invalid invite code');
+END;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.join_household_by_code(text) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.join_household_by_code(text) TO authenticated;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_household_role_invite(
+    p_invite_code text,
+    p_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL
+)
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_uid uuid;
+    v_clean_code text := upper(trim(p_invite_code));
+    v_fail_count int;
+    v_invite public.household_invites%ROWTYPE;
+    v_hh public.households%ROWTYPE;
+    v_role text;
+    v_financial_role text;
+    v_is_default boolean;
+BEGIN
+    IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND p_user_id IS NOT NULL AND p_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid() THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: cannot claim an invite on behalf of another user' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    v_uid := COALESCE(auth.uid(), p_user_id);
+
+    IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_fail_count
+    FROM public.invite_attempt_log
+    WHERE user_id = v_uid
+      AND success = false
+      AND attempted_at > (now() - interval '15 minutes');
+
+    IF v_fail_count >= 5 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Too many failed join attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT * INTO v_invite
+    FROM public.household_invites
+    WHERE upper(trim(invite_code)) = v_clean_code
+      AND expires_at > now()
+    FOR UPDATE;
+
+    IF v_invite.id IS NULL OR (v_invite.used_by IS NOT NULL AND v_invite.used_by IS DISTINCT FROM v_uid) THEN
+        INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, false);
+        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invalid, expired, or already used invite code');
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT * INTO v_hh FROM public.households WHERE id = v_invite.household_id;
+
+    SELECT role, financial_role INTO v_role, v_financial_role
+    FROM public.household_memberships
+    WHERE household_id = v_invite.household_id AND user_id = v_uid;
+
+    IF v_role IS NOT NULL THEN
+        IF v_invite.used_by IS DISTINCT FROM v_uid THEN
+            -- FABLE-DB-01: a member cannot take the spouse/provider invite meant for
+            -- someone else; the invite stays open for the real invitee.
+            RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'You are already a member of this household',
+                                      'code', 'already_member');
+        END IF;
+        -- Idempotent retry by the claimer: nothing changes.
+        RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+            'success', true,
+            'household_id', v_hh.id,
+            'household_name', v_hh.name,
+            'role', v_financial_role,
+            'target_member_id', v_invite.target_member_id
+        );
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_invite.used_by IS NOT NULL THEN
+        -- Used by this user, who has since left: same answer as any used invite.
+        INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, false);
+        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Invalid, expired, or already used invite code');
+    END IF;
+
+    UPDATE public.household_invites SET used_by = v_uid WHERE id = v_invite.id;
+
+    IF v_invite.target_member_id IS NOT NULL THEN
+        UPDATE public.household_dependents
+        SET linked_user_id = v_uid
+        WHERE id = v_invite.target_member_id
+          AND household_id = v_invite.household_id;
+    END IF;
+
+    v_is_default := NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships WHERE user_id = v_uid);
+    INSERT INTO public.household_memberships (household_id, user_id, role, is_default, financial_role)
+    VALUES (
+        v_hh.id, v_uid, 'member', v_is_default,
+        CASE WHEN v_invite.role IN ('provider', 'spouse', 'peer', 'family_member', 'dependent')
+             THEN v_invite.role
+             ELSE public.household_default_financial_role(v_hh.id, v_uid) END
+    )
+    ON CONFLICT (household_id, user_id) DO NOTHING;
+
+    SELECT role, financial_role INTO v_role, v_financial_role
+    FROM public.household_memberships
+    WHERE household_id = v_hh.id AND user_id = v_uid;
+
+    UPDATE public.users
+    SET household_id = v_hh.id, role = v_role, financial_role = v_financial_role
+    WHERE id = v_uid;
+
+    INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log (user_id, success) VALUES (v_uid, true);
+
+    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
+        'success', true,
+        'household_id', v_hh.id,
+        'household_name', v_hh.name,
+        'role', v_financial_role,
+        'target_member_id', v_invite.target_member_id
+    );
+END;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.claim_household_role_invite(text, uuid) FROM PUBLIC, anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.claim_household_role_invite(text, uuid) TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+-- Defense in depth (also binds service-role writes): an invite is never marked
+-- used by an existing member of its household.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refuse_invite_claim_by_member()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+    IF NEW.used_by IS NOT NULL
+       AND OLD.used_by IS NULL
+       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships m
+                   WHERE m.household_id = NEW.household_id AND m.user_id = NEW.used_by) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: an existing member cannot claim an invite of their own household'
+            USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+    RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$$;
+REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.refuse_invite_claim_by_member() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
+
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_refuse_invite_claim_by_member ON public.household_invites;
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_refuse_invite_claim_by_member
+BEFORE UPDATE OF used_by ON public.household_invites
+FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.refuse_invite_claim_by_member();
+
+-- Invite codes are readable by admins only (any member could read and claim
+-- the spouse invite before). No released app reads this table directly.
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "invites_select_household" ON public.household_invites;
+DROP POLICY IF EXISTS invites_select_admin ON public.household_invites;
+CREATE POLICY invites_select_admin ON public.household_invites
+    FOR SELECT
+    TO authenticated
+    USING (
+        household_id = (SELECT public.get_auth_user_household_id())
+        AND (SELECT public.get_auth_user_role()) = 'admin'
+    );
+
+-- 8. Provider management (FABLE-LOGIC-04) --------------------------------------
