+    IF FOUND THEN
+        RETURN NEXT v_row;
+        RETURN;
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT p.* INTO v_row
+    FROM public.installment_plans AS p
+    WHERE p.id = p_plan_id
+      AND p.household_id = p_household_id;
+
+    IF NOT FOUND THEN
+        RETURN;  -- not in this household: no row
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_row.status NOT IN ('ACTIVE', 'COMPLETED') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'This installment plan is % and takes no payments', v_row.status
+            USING ERRCODE = '22023', HINT = 'plan_not_active';
+    END IF;
+
+    RETURN NEXT v_row;  -- already paid up: unchanged
+END;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.pay_installment_plan(uuid, uuid, uuid) FROM PUBLIC;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.pay_installment_plan(uuid, uuid, uuid) FROM anon, authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.pay_installment_plan(uuid, uuid, uuid) TO service_role;
+
+-- 12. D3 for ledgers orphaned before this migration (a wife who left under 800000) ---
+DELETE FROM public.spouse_reimbursements r
+WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships m
+                  WHERE m.household_id = r.household_id AND m.user_id = r.wife_user_id);
+DELETE FROM public.member_allowances a
+WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships m
+                  WHERE m.household_id = a.household_id AND m.user_id = a.member_user_id);
+UPDATE public.transactions t
+SET nafaqah_class = NULL, nafaqah_spouse_id = NULL
+WHERE t.nafaqah_spouse_id IS NOT NULL
+  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships m
+                  WHERE m.household_id = t.household_id AND m.user_id = t.nafaqah_spouse_id);
+
+-- 13. Post-checks -----------------------------------------------------------------------
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_n int;
+BEGIN
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.households WHERE household_type NOT IN ('family', 'roommates');
+    IF v_n > 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'post-check: % household(s) without a valid household_type', v_n;
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_n
+    FROM public.household_memberships m JOIN public.households h ON h.id = m.household_id
+    WHERE NOT public.household_financial_role_allowed(h.household_type, m.financial_role);
+    IF v_n > 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'post-check: % membership(s) whose financial role does not fit the household type', v_n;
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.households
+    WHERE household_type <> 'family' AND nafaqah_provider_user_id IS NOT NULL;
+    IF v_n > 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'post-check: % roommates household(s) with a Nafaqah provider', v_n;
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.transactions t
+    WHERE t.nafaqah_spouse_id IS NOT NULL
+      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships m
+                      WHERE m.household_id = t.household_id AND m.user_id = t.nafaqah_spouse_id);
+    IF v_n > 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'post-check: % classified row(s) of a wife who is not a member', v_n;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF has_column_privilege('authenticated', 'public.households', 'household_type', 'UPDATE')
+       OR has_column_privilege('anon', 'public.households', 'household_type', 'UPDATE')
+       OR has_column_privilege('authenticated', 'public.installment_plans', 'paid_installments', 'UPDATE')
+       OR has_column_privilege('authenticated', 'public.installment_plans', 'status', 'UPDATE')
+       OR has_column_privilege('anon', 'public.installment_plans', 'paid_installments', 'UPDATE') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'post-check: clients can write household_type or the installment counter/status';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF to_regprocedure('public.create_household_and_claim(text)') IS NOT NULL
+       OR NOT has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.create_household_and_claim(text, text)', 'EXECUTE')
+       OR has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.create_household_and_claim(text, text)', 'EXECUTE')
+       OR NOT has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.set_household_type(uuid, text, uuid)', 'EXECUTE')
+       OR has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.set_household_type(uuid, text, uuid)', 'EXECUTE')
+       OR NOT has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.set_member_financial_role(uuid, uuid, text, uuid)', 'EXECUTE')
+       OR has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.set_member_financial_role(uuid, uuid, text, uuid)', 'EXECUTE')
+       OR has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.household_default_financial_role(uuid, uuid)', 'EXECUTE')
+       OR has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.remove_nafaqah_ledger_on_membership_end()', 'EXECUTE')
+       OR has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.pay_installment_plan(uuid, uuid, uuid)', 'EXECUTE') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'post-check: function privileges are wrong';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.households WHERE household_type = 'roommates';
+    RAISE NOTICE 'post-check: % roommates household(s), % family household(s)',
+        v_n, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.households WHERE household_type = 'family');
+END;
+$$;
+
+COMMIT;
diff --git a/supabase/migrations/20261021000000_saudi_taxonomy_and_bnpl_schedule.sql b/supabase/migrations/20261021000000_saudi_taxonomy_and_bnpl_schedule.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..03c61b5
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/migrations/20261021000000_saudi_taxonomy_and_bnpl_schedule.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,432 @@
+-- ============================================================================
+-- Migration: 20261021000000_saudi_taxonomy_and_bnpl_schedule.sql
+--
+-- Product review R4 + R10 (docs/review/audit/product_review.md §1.3, §2.5).
+--
+-- A. Saudi household taxonomy (R4). Eight new SYSTEM categories in
+--    public.cost_control_codes (household_id NULL, is_system true, the same
+--    columns as the seeded codes: code, category, keywords, is_flexible), each
+--    with system sub-categories in public.cost_control_sub_categories:
+--      OPEX-HOUSING         housing_rent, annual_rent, housing_services
+--      OPEX-EDUCATION       tuition_fees, school_transport, school_uniforms, books_supplies
+--      OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP   maid_salary, driver_salary, recruitment_visa
+--      OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT  parents_support, relatives_support
+--      OPEX-CHARITY         sadaqah, zakat
+--      OPEX-TRANSPORT       car_installment, ride_hailing, public_transport, car_maintenance
+--      OPEX-INSURANCE       car_insurance, health_insurance, home_insurance
+--      OPEX-REMITTANCE      family_remittance, transfer_fees
+--    * Nothing existing is moved, renamed or deleted. OPEX-FUEL keeps its
+--      sub-categories; OPEX-UTILITIES keeps `housing_rent` (transactions and
+--      sub-allocations reference it, and sub-categories have no lifecycle
+--      column to deprecate it). A new `housing_rent` is added under
+--      OPEX-HOUSING with the same names, so new rent goes there and old rows
+--      stay valid. CAPEX-EDUCATION stays (university / courses); the new
+--      OPEX-EDUCATION is the recurring school cost.
+--    * Top-level keywords of the new codes never overlap a keyword of the ten
+--      seeded codes (merchant matching is substring/word based and iterates
+--      codes in table order): no existing merchant changes category. Proof:
+--      supabase/tests/27_taxonomy_and_bnpl.sql.
+--    * Existing households: no household_category_settings and no budget rows
+--      are written. The API (salary_cycle.get_household_categories) lists a
+--      system category without a setting or budget row as inactive unless it
+--      is one of the ten original core codes, so the new categories appear in
+--      every household's category library ("available") and are budgeted only
+--      when the household activates them / adds a budget.
+--    * Guard: aborts when a household already owns a custom code with one of
+--      the eight codes (a system row with the same code would make that
+--      household's own sub-categories globally visible), or when
+--      sub-categories already hang under one of the eight codes other than
+--      the ones this file adds.
+--
+-- B. BNPL schedule (R10). public.installment_plans gains
+--      frequency   text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'monthly'
+--                  CHECK (frequency IN ('monthly', 'biweekly'))
+--      next_due_at date NULL
+--    Schedule: installment k (0-based) is due on start_date + k * 14 days
+--    (biweekly: Tabby / Tamara "Pay in 4") or start_date + k months (monthly:
+--    bank plans, Tamara 3 monthly; PostgreSQL month arithmetic from the anchor,
+--    so 31 Jan -> 28/29 Feb -> 31 Mar, no drift). next_due_at is the due date
+--    of the first unpaid installment while the plan is ACTIVE, NULL otherwise.
+--    * public.installment_next_due_at(start, frequency, paid, count, status):
+--      IMMUTABLE helper (EXECUTE: authenticated, service_role).
+--    * Trigger trg_installment_plans_schedule keeps next_due_at derived on every
+--      INSERT / schedule-relevant UPDATE (clients may INSERT this table; the
+--      value can never be forged or go stale).
+--    * pay_installment_plan (20261020900000 version, CREATE OR REPLACE): same
+--      signature, grants (service_role only) and ACTIVE-only rule; it now also
+--      advances next_due_at by one interval (14 days / 1 month).
+--    * Clients get no UPDATE on frequency / next_due_at (the 10-column client
+--      UPDATE list of 900000 is unchanged).
+--    * Backfill: existing rows become 'monthly' (the column default); ACTIVE
+--      rows get their next_due_at. Live has 0 plans.
+--
+-- Live safety: one transaction, idempotent (a re-run inserts nothing, changes
+-- no row and re-creates the same functions / trigger). Applies AFTER
+-- 20261020700000, 750000, 800000 and 900000 (guard checks 900000's ACTIVE-only
+-- pay_installment_plan and its paid_installments CHECK). No existing row of
+-- any table changes except installment_plans gaining the two columns (0 rows
+-- on live). Locks: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on installment_plans for the ALTER
+-- (metadata only: constant default) and ROW EXCLUSIVE on the two category
+-- tables for the inserts.
+-- Compatibility: the deployed backend keeps working (it never names the new
+-- columns; inserts get the default 'monthly' and a derived next_due_at); the
+-- deployed app reads categories by code and shows unknown codes by stripping
+-- the OPEX- prefix until its l10n map has them.
+--
+-- Proof test: supabase/tests/27_taxonomy_and_bnpl.sql
+-- Rollback: docs/review/rollback/20261021_taxonomy_bnpl_rollback.sql
+-- ============================================================================
+
+BEGIN;
+
+-- 0. Guard ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_bad text;
+    v_n int;
+BEGIN
+    -- Prerequisites: 20261020900000 (ACTIVE-only payments, paid_installments CHECK).
+    IF to_regprocedure('public.pay_installment_plan(uuid, uuid, uuid)') IS NULL
+       OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
+                      WHERE conrelid = 'public.installment_plans'::regclass
+                        AND conname = 'installment_plans_paid_installments_range')
+       OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
+                      WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'households'
+                        AND column_name = 'household_type') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'guard: apply 20261020700000, 750000, 800000 and 900000 first';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- A household-owned custom code that equals one of the new system codes.
+    SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT c.code, ', ') INTO v_bad
+    FROM public.cost_control_codes c
+    WHERE c.household_id IS NOT NULL
+      AND c.code IN ('OPEX-HOUSING', 'OPEX-EDUCATION', 'OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP', 'OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT',
+                     'OPEX-CHARITY', 'OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'OPEX-INSURANCE', 'OPEX-REMITTANCE');
+    IF v_bad IS NOT NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'guard: household custom categories already use the code(s) %; rename them before adding the system categories', v_bad;
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Sub-categories already under one of the new parents, other than the ones added here.
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_n
+    FROM public.cost_control_sub_categories s
+    WHERE s.parent_code IN ('OPEX-HOUSING', 'OPEX-EDUCATION', 'OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP', 'OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT',
+                            'OPEX-CHARITY', 'OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'OPEX-INSURANCE', 'OPEX-REMITTANCE')
+      AND (s.parent_code, s.sub_code) NOT IN (VALUES
+            ('OPEX-HOUSING', 'housing_rent'), ('OPEX-HOUSING', 'annual_rent'), ('OPEX-HOUSING', 'housing_services'),
+            ('OPEX-EDUCATION', 'tuition_fees'), ('OPEX-EDUCATION', 'school_transport'),
+            ('OPEX-EDUCATION', 'school_uniforms'), ('OPEX-EDUCATION', 'books_supplies'),
+            ('OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP', 'maid_salary'), ('OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP', 'driver_salary'),
+            ('OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP', 'recruitment_visa'),
+            ('OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT', 'parents_support'), ('OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT', 'relatives_support'),
+            ('OPEX-CHARITY', 'sadaqah'), ('OPEX-CHARITY', 'zakat'),
+            ('OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'car_installment'), ('OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'ride_hailing'),
+            ('OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'public_transport'), ('OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'car_maintenance'),
+            ('OPEX-INSURANCE', 'car_insurance'), ('OPEX-INSURANCE', 'health_insurance'),
+            ('OPEX-INSURANCE', 'home_insurance'),
+            ('OPEX-REMITTANCE', 'family_remittance'), ('OPEX-REMITTANCE', 'transfer_fees'));
+    IF v_n > 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'guard: % sub-categor(y/ies) already exist under the new parent codes; they would become visible to every household', v_n;
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.installment_plans;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'guard: % installment plan(s) get frequency monthly', v_n;
+END;
+$$;
+
+-- 1. System categories (A) --------------------------------------------------------------
+INSERT INTO public.cost_control_codes (code, category, keywords, is_flexible, is_system, household_id)
+SELECT v.code, v.category, v.keywords, false, true, NULL
+FROM (VALUES
+    ('OPEX-HOUSING', 'Housing & Rent',
+     ARRAY['ejar', 'إيجار', 'ايجار', 'apartment rent', 'house rent', 'إيجار شقة', 'سكن']),
+    ('OPEX-EDUCATION', 'School Costs',
+     ARRAY['stationery', 'قرطاسية', 'uniforms', 'زي مدرسي', 'مريول', 'نقل مدرسي', 'madrasati', 'مدرستي']),
+    ('OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP', 'Domestic Help',
+     ARRAY['musaned', 'مساند', 'housemaid', 'خادمة', 'شغالة', 'عاملة منزلية', 'استقدام', 'private driver', 'سائق خاص']),
+    ('OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT', 'Family Support',
+     ARRAY['family support', 'parents support', 'الوالدين', 'بر الوالدين', 'مصروف الوالدة', 'مصروف الوالد']),
+    ('OPEX-CHARITY', 'Charity & Zakat',
+     ARRAY['zakat', 'zakah', 'زكاة', 'sadaqah', 'sadaqa', 'صدقة', 'donation', 'تبرع', 'ehsan', 'إحسان', 'جود الإسكان']),
+    ('OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'Car & Transport',
+     ARRAY['car installment', 'قسط السيارة', 'jeeny', 'bolt', 'riyadh metro', 'مترو الرياض', 'petromin', 'بترومين']),
+    ('OPEX-INSURANCE', 'Insurance',
+     ARRAY['insurance', 'تأمين', 'tawuniya', 'التعاونية للتأمين', 'bupa', 'بوبا', 'medgulf', 'ميدغلف', 'najm']),
+    ('OPEX-REMITTANCE', 'Remittances Abroad',
+     ARRAY['remittance', 'remit', 'حوالة دولية', 'حوالة خارجية', 'enjaz', 'western union', 'ويسترن يونيون',
+           'moneygram', 'ترسیلات'])
+) AS v(code, category, keywords)
+WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.cost_control_codes c
+                  WHERE c.code = v.code AND c.household_id IS NULL);
+
+-- 2. System sub-categories (A) ------------------------------------------------------
+INSERT INTO public.cost_control_sub_categories (parent_code, sub_code, name_en, name_ar, keywords)
+VALUES
+    -- Housing
+    ('OPEX-HOUSING', 'housing_rent', 'Housing Rent', 'إيجار السكن',
+     ARRAY['rent', 'apartment', 'housing', 'lease', 'ejar', 'إيجار', 'ايجار', 'شقة', 'سكن']),
+    ('OPEX-HOUSING', 'annual_rent', 'Annual / Semi-annual Rent', 'الإيجار السنوي ونصف السنوي',
+     ARRAY['annual rent', 'yearly rent', 'semi-annual', 'rent contract', 'إيجار سنوي', 'عقد إيجار', 'دفعة الإيجار']),
+    ('OPEX-HOUSING', 'housing_services', 'Building Services & Home Repairs', 'خدمات السكن والصيانة',
+     ARRAY['building services', 'maintenance fee', 'plumber', 'electrician', 'خدمات العمارة', 'حارس', 'سباك', 'كهربائي', 'صيانة المنزل']),
+    -- Education
+    ('OPEX-EDUCATION', 'tuition_fees', 'School Fees', 'الرسوم المدرسية',
+     ARRAY['tuition', 'school fees', 'رسوم مدرسية', 'رسوم دراسية', 'قسط المدرسة']),
+    ('OPEX-EDUCATION', 'school_transport', 'School Transport', 'النقل المدرسي',
+     ARRAY['school bus', 'school transport', 'باص المدرسة', 'نقل مدرسي', 'توصيل المدرسة']),
+    ('OPEX-EDUCATION', 'school_uniforms', 'School Uniforms', 'الزي المدرسي',
+     ARRAY['uniform', 'school uniform', 'زي مدرسي', 'مريول']),
+    ('OPEX-EDUCATION', 'books_supplies', 'Books & School Supplies', 'الكتب والقرطاسية',
+     ARRAY['books', 'stationery', 'school supplies', 'كتب', 'قرطاسية', 'دفاتر', 'أدوات مدرسية']),
+    -- Domestic help
+    ('OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP', 'maid_salary', 'Housemaid Salary', 'راتب العاملة المنزلية',
+     ARRAY['maid', 'housemaid', 'nanny', 'عاملة', 'خادمة', 'شغالة', 'مربية']),
+    ('OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP', 'driver_salary', 'Driver Salary', 'راتب السائق',
+     ARRAY['driver salary', 'private driver', 'راتب السائق', 'سائق خاص']),
+    ('OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP', 'recruitment_visa', 'Recruitment & Visa Fees', 'رسوم الاستقدام والتأشيرات',
+     ARRAY['musaned', 'recruitment', 'work visa', 'مساند', 'استقدام', 'تأشيرة عمالة', 'نقل كفالة']),
+    -- Family support
+    ('OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT', 'parents_support', 'Support for Parents', 'مصروف الوالدين',
+     ARRAY['parents', 'mother', 'father', 'الوالدين', 'الوالدة', 'الوالد', 'أمي', 'ابوي']),
+    ('OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT', 'relatives_support', 'Support for Relatives', 'مساعدة الأقارب',
+     ARRAY['relatives', 'brother', 'sister', 'الأقارب', 'اخوي', 'اختي', 'أخي', 'أختي']),
+    -- Charity
+    ('OPEX-CHARITY', 'sadaqah', 'Sadaqah & Donations', 'الصدقات والتبرعات',
+     ARRAY['sadaqah', 'sadaqa', 'charity', 'donation', 'ehsan', 'صدقة', 'تبرع', 'إحسان']),
+    ('OPEX-CHARITY', 'zakat', 'Zakat', 'الزكاة',
+     ARRAY['zakat', 'zakah', 'زكاة', 'زكاه']),
+    -- Transport (OPEX-FUEL keeps gas_fuel / car_maintenance / ride_hailing; shared sub-codes keep their names)
+    ('OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'car_installment', 'Car Installment & Lease', 'قسط السيارة والتأجير التمويلي',
+     ARRAY['car installment', 'car loan', 'car lease', 'قسط السيارة', 'تمويل سيارة', 'تأجير منتهي بالتمليك']),
+    ('OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'ride_hailing', 'Ride Hailing (Uber/Bolt)', 'تطبيقات النقل والتوصيل',
+     ARRAY['uber', 'careem', 'bolt', 'jeeny', 'أوبر', 'كريم', 'جيني']),
+    ('OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'public_transport', 'Public Transport', 'النقل العام',
+     ARRAY['metro', 'train', 'saptco', 'hafilat', 'مترو', 'قطار', 'حافلة', 'سابتكو']),
+    ('OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'car_maintenance', 'Car Maintenance & Oil', 'صيانة وتغيير الزيت',
+     ARRAY['oil change', 'mechanic', 'tires', 'workshop', 'petromin', 'صيانة', 'ورشة', 'كفرات', 'زيت']),
+    -- Insurance
+    ('OPEX-INSURANCE', 'car_insurance', 'Car Insurance', 'تأمين السيارة',
+     ARRAY['car insurance', 'motor insurance', 'najm', 'تأمين سيارة', 'تأمين المركبة', 'تأمين السيارة']),
+    ('OPEX-INSURANCE', 'health_insurance', 'Health Insurance', 'التأمين الصحي',
+     ARRAY['health insurance', 'medical insurance', 'bupa', 'تأمين طبي', 'تأمين صحي', 'بوبا']),
+    ('OPEX-INSURANCE', 'home_insurance', 'Home Insurance', 'تأمين المنزل',
+     ARRAY['home insurance', 'property insurance', 'تأمين المنزل', 'تأمين منزل']),
+    -- Remittances
+    ('OPEX-REMITTANCE', 'family_remittance', 'Money Sent Home', 'حوالات للأهل',
+     ARRAY['remittance', 'send money', 'western union', 'enjaz', 'حوالة', 'حوالات', 'انجاز', 'ترسیلات']),
+    ('OPEX-REMITTANCE', 'transfer_fees', 'Transfer Fees', 'رسوم التحويل',
+     ARRAY['transfer fee', 'remittance fee', 'رسوم تحويل', 'رسوم الحوالة'])
+ON CONFLICT (parent_code, sub_code) DO NOTHING;
+
+-- 3. installment_plans.frequency / next_due_at (B) ---------------------------------------
+ALTER TABLE public.installment_plans
+    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS frequency text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'monthly',
+    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS next_due_at date;
+
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
+                   WHERE conrelid = 'public.installment_plans'::regclass
+                     AND conname = 'installment_plans_frequency_check') THEN
+        ALTER TABLE public.installment_plans
+            ADD CONSTRAINT installment_plans_frequency_check CHECK (frequency IN ('monthly', 'biweekly'));
+    END IF;
+END $$;
+
+COMMENT ON COLUMN public.installment_plans.frequency IS
+    'Payment interval: biweekly (Tabby/Tamara Pay in 4, every 14 days) or monthly (bank plans). Installment k (0-based) is due on start_date + k intervals.';
+COMMENT ON COLUMN public.installment_plans.next_due_at IS
+    'Due date of the first unpaid installment while ACTIVE, NULL otherwise. Derived (trg_installment_plans_schedule); not client-writable.';
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.installment_next_due_at(
+    p_start_date date,
+    p_frequency text,
+    p_paid_installments integer,
+    p_installment_count integer,
+    p_status text
+)
+RETURNS date
+LANGUAGE sql
+IMMUTABLE
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+    SELECT CASE
+        WHEN p_start_date IS NULL OR p_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'ACTIVE'
+             OR coalesce(p_paid_installments, 0) >= coalesce(p_installment_count, 0) THEN NULL
+        WHEN p_frequency = 'biweekly' THEN p_start_date + 14 * greatest(coalesce(p_paid_installments, 0), 0)
+        ELSE (p_start_date + make_interval(months => greatest(coalesce(p_paid_installments, 0), 0)))::date
+    END;
+$$;
+
+COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.installment_next_due_at(date, text, integer, integer, text) IS
+    'Due date of installment number p_paid_installments (0-based) of an ACTIVE plan: start + n*14 days (biweekly) or start + n months (monthly); NULL when not ACTIVE or paid up.';
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.installment_next_due_at(date, text, integer, integer, text) FROM PUBLIC;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.installment_next_due_at(date, text, integer, integer, text) FROM anon;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.installment_next_due_at(date, text, integer, integer, text) TO authenticated, service_role;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.installment_plans_schedule()
+RETURNS trigger
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+    NEW.next_due_at := public.installment_next_due_at(
+        NEW.start_date, NEW.frequency, NEW.paid_installments, NEW.installment_count, NEW.status);
+    RETURN NEW;
+END;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.installment_plans_schedule() FROM PUBLIC;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.installment_plans_schedule() FROM anon, authenticated;
+
+DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_installment_plans_schedule ON public.installment_plans;
+CREATE TRIGGER trg_installment_plans_schedule
+    BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF start_date, frequency, paid_installments, installment_count, status, next_due_at
+    ON public.installment_plans
+    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.installment_plans_schedule();
+
+-- Backfill (existing rows are 'monthly' through the column default; 0 rows on live).
+UPDATE public.installment_plans p
+SET next_due_at = public.installment_next_due_at(p.start_date, p.frequency, p.paid_installments,
+                                                 p.installment_count, p.status)
+WHERE p.next_due_at IS DISTINCT FROM public.installment_next_due_at(p.start_date, p.frequency, p.paid_installments,
+                                                                    p.installment_count, p.status);
+
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_installment_plans_next_due
+    ON public.installment_plans (next_due_at)
+    WHERE status = 'ACTIVE';
+
+-- 4. pay_installment_plan: 20261020900000 rules + next_due_at advance (B) ---------------
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pay_installment_plan(
+    p_plan_id uuid,
+    p_household_id uuid,
+    p_actor_user_id uuid
+)
+RETURNS SETOF public.installment_plans
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+SECURITY DEFINER
+SET search_path = public, pg_temp
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_row public.installment_plans;
+BEGIN
+    IF p_plan_id IS NULL OR p_household_id IS NULL OR p_actor_user_id IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'plan, household and actor are required' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF NOT EXISTS (
+        SELECT 1
+        FROM public.household_memberships m
+        WHERE m.household_id = p_household_id
+          AND m.user_id = p_actor_user_id
+    ) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only a member of the household can record an installment payment'
+            USING ERRCODE = '42501';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- One conditional increment; next_due_at moves one interval (14 days / 1 month from
+    -- the start_date anchor), NULL once the plan is paid up.
+    UPDATE public.installment_plans AS p
+       SET paid_installments = p.paid_installments + 1,
+           status = CASE WHEN p.paid_installments + 1 >= p.installment_count THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE p.status END,
+           next_due_at = public.installment_next_due_at(
+               p.start_date, p.frequency, p.paid_installments + 1, p.installment_count,
+               CASE WHEN p.paid_installments + 1 >= p.installment_count THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE p.status END)
+     WHERE p.id = p_plan_id
+       AND p.household_id = p_household_id
+       AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
+       AND p.paid_installments < p.installment_count
+    RETURNING p.* INTO v_row;
+
+    IF FOUND THEN
+        RETURN NEXT v_row;
+        RETURN;
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT p.* INTO v_row
+    FROM public.installment_plans AS p
+    WHERE p.id = p_plan_id
+      AND p.household_id = p_household_id;
+
+    IF NOT FOUND THEN
+        RETURN;  -- not in this household: no row
+    END IF;
+
+    IF v_row.status NOT IN ('ACTIVE', 'COMPLETED') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'This installment plan is % and takes no payments', v_row.status
+            USING ERRCODE = '22023', HINT = 'plan_not_active';
+    END IF;
+
+    RETURN NEXT v_row;  -- already paid up: unchanged
+END;
+$$;
+
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.pay_installment_plan(uuid, uuid, uuid) FROM PUBLIC;
+REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.pay_installment_plan(uuid, uuid, uuid) FROM anon, authenticated;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.pay_installment_plan(uuid, uuid, uuid) TO service_role;
+
+-- 5. Post-checks ------------------------------------------------------------------------
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_n int;
+BEGIN
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_n
+    FROM public.cost_control_codes c
+    WHERE c.household_id IS NULL AND c.is_system
+      AND c.code IN ('OPEX-HOUSING', 'OPEX-EDUCATION', 'OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP', 'OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT',
+                     'OPEX-CHARITY', 'OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'OPEX-INSURANCE', 'OPEX-REMITTANCE');
+    IF v_n <> 8 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'post-check: % of 8 new system categories present', v_n;
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_n
+    FROM public.cost_control_sub_categories s
+    WHERE s.parent_code IN ('OPEX-HOUSING', 'OPEX-EDUCATION', 'OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP', 'OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT',
+                            'OPEX-CHARITY', 'OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'OPEX-INSURANCE', 'OPEX-REMITTANCE');
+    IF v_n <> 23 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'post-check: % of 23 new system sub-categories present', v_n;
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_n
+    FROM public.cost_control_codes c, unnest(c.keywords) k
+    WHERE c.household_id IS NULL
+      AND c.code IN ('OPEX-HOUSING', 'OPEX-EDUCATION', 'OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP', 'OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT',
+                     'OPEX-CHARITY', 'OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'OPEX-INSURANCE', 'OPEX-REMITTANCE')
+      AND char_length(btrim(k)) < 3;
+    IF v_n > 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'post-check: % keyword(s) shorter than 3 characters', v_n;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.cost_control_sub_categories
+                   WHERE parent_code = 'OPEX-UTILITIES' AND sub_code = 'housing_rent') THEN
+        RAISE NOTICE 'post-check: OPEX-UTILITIES/housing_rent is absent (it was not removed by this migration)';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.installment_plans
+    WHERE frequency NOT IN ('monthly', 'biweekly')
+       OR next_due_at IS DISTINCT FROM public.installment_next_due_at(start_date, frequency, paid_installments,
+                                                                      installment_count, status);
+    IF v_n > 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'post-check: % installment plan(s) with an invalid frequency or a stale next_due_at', v_n;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF has_column_privilege('authenticated', 'public.installment_plans', 'frequency', 'UPDATE')
+       OR has_column_privilege('authenticated', 'public.installment_plans', 'next_due_at', 'UPDATE')
+       OR has_column_privilege('authenticated', 'public.installment_plans', 'paid_installments', 'UPDATE')
+       OR has_column_privilege('anon', 'public.installment_plans', 'next_due_at', 'UPDATE')
+       OR has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.pay_installment_plan(uuid, uuid, uuid)', 'EXECUTE')
+       OR has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.pay_installment_plan(uuid, uuid, uuid)', 'EXECUTE')
+       OR NOT has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.pay_installment_plan(uuid, uuid, uuid)', 'EXECUTE')
+       OR has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.installment_next_due_at(date, text, integer, integer, text)', 'EXECUTE')
+       OR has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.installment_plans_schedule()', 'EXECUTE') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'post-check: installment privileges are wrong';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.household_category_settings
+    WHERE category_code IN ('OPEX-HOUSING', 'OPEX-EDUCATION', 'OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP', 'OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT',
+                            'OPEX-CHARITY', 'OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'OPEX-INSURANCE', 'OPEX-REMITTANCE');
+    RAISE NOTICE 'post-check: 8 system categories, 23 sub-categories; % household setting(s) for them', v_n;
+END;
+$$;
+
+COMMIT;

diff --git a/supabase/tests/00_local_supabase_stubs.sql b/supabase/tests/00_local_supabase_stubs.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..c65100e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/tests/00_local_supabase_stubs.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,212 @@
+-- =============================================================================
+-- Local Supabase platform stubs for plain PostgreSQL (16+) test databases.
+--
+-- Supabase-managed objects (auth schema, storage schema, client roles,
+-- extensions schema, realtime publication, default grants) do not exist in a
+-- vanilla Postgres cluster. This bootstrap recreates the minimal, behaviourally
+-- faithful subset that supabase/schema.sql, supabase/migrations/*.sql and
+-- supabase/tests/*.sql depend on, so the full schema can be rebuilt and tested
+-- locally without Docker or the hosted project.
+--
+-- This file is applied by `supabase/tests/run_tests.py --rebuild` BEFORE
+-- schema.sql. It is idempotent and is skipped by the test-file glob (it is not a
+-- test). Never apply it to a real Supabase project: the platform already owns
+-- these objects there.
+-- =============================================================================
+
+\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
+
+-- ── Client roles (same names and RLS posture as Supabase) ───────────────────
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'anon') THEN
+        CREATE ROLE anon NOLOGIN NOINHERIT;
+    END IF;
+    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'authenticated') THEN
+        CREATE ROLE authenticated NOLOGIN NOINHERIT;
+    END IF;
+    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'service_role') THEN
+        CREATE ROLE service_role NOLOGIN NOINHERIT BYPASSRLS;
+    END IF;
+    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'authenticator') THEN
+        CREATE ROLE authenticator NOLOGIN NOINHERIT;
+    END IF;
+END $$;
+
+GRANT anon, authenticated, service_role TO authenticator;
+
+-- ── Schemas ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS extensions;
+CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS auth;
+CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS storage;
+
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA extensions TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA auth TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA storage TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+
+-- Supabase installs extensions into the `extensions` schema and puts it on the
+-- database search_path.
+CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto WITH SCHEMA extensions;
+CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp" WITH SCHEMA extensions;
+CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS unaccent WITH SCHEMA extensions;
+
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    EXECUTE format('ALTER DATABASE %I SET search_path = "$user", public, extensions', current_database());
+END $$;
+SET search_path = "$user", public, extensions;
+
+-- ── auth schema ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS auth.users (
+    id                 uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+    email              text,
+    raw_user_meta_data jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
+    created_at         timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
+);
+
+-- Same definitions as Supabase GoTrue's auth helpers (claims come from the
+-- PostgREST GUC `request.jwt.claims`; the legacy per-claim GUC is honoured too).
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.uid()
+RETURNS uuid
+LANGUAGE sql
+STABLE
+AS $$
+    SELECT nullif(
+        coalesce(
+            current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true),
+            (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub')
+        ),
+        ''
+    )::uuid;
+$$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.role()
+RETURNS text
+LANGUAGE sql
+STABLE
+AS $$
+    SELECT nullif(
+        coalesce(
+            current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true),
+            (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'role')
+        ),
+        ''
+    )::text;
+$$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.email()
+RETURNS text
+LANGUAGE sql
+STABLE
+AS $$
+    SELECT nullif(
+        coalesce(
+            current_setting('request.jwt.claim.email', true),
+            (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'email')
+        ),
+        ''
+    )::text;
+$$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.jwt()
+RETURNS jsonb
+LANGUAGE sql
+STABLE
+AS $$
+    SELECT coalesce(
+        nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim', true), ''),
+        nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')
+    )::jsonb;
+$$;
+
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION auth.uid(), auth.role(), auth.email(), auth.jwt()
+    TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT SELECT ON auth.users TO service_role;
+
+-- ── storage schema ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS storage.buckets (
+    id                 text PRIMARY KEY,
+    name               text NOT NULL,
+    owner              uuid,
+    public             boolean DEFAULT false,
+    file_size_limit    bigint,
+    allowed_mime_types text[],
+    created_at         timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
+    updated_at         timestamptz DEFAULT now()
+);
+
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS storage.objects (
+    id         uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
+    bucket_id  text REFERENCES storage.buckets(id),
+    name       text,
+    owner      uuid,
+    metadata   jsonb,
+    created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
+    updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
+);
+
+ALTER TABLE storage.objects ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+ALTER TABLE storage.buckets ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+
+-- Same bodies as supabase/storage-api's SQL helpers.
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.foldername(name text)
+RETURNS text[]
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+IMMUTABLE
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    _parts text[];
+BEGIN
+    SELECT string_to_array(name, '/') INTO _parts;
+    RETURN _parts[1:array_length(_parts, 1) - 1];
+END
+$$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.filename(name text)
+RETURNS text
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+IMMUTABLE
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    _parts text[];
+BEGIN
+    SELECT string_to_array(name, '/') INTO _parts;
+    RETURN _parts[array_length(_parts, 1)];
+END
+$$;
+
+CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.extension(name text)
+RETURNS text
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+IMMUTABLE
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    _parts text[];
+    _filename text;
+BEGIN
+    SELECT string_to_array(name, '/') INTO _parts;
+    SELECT _parts[array_length(_parts, 1)] INTO _filename;
+    RETURN reverse(split_part(reverse(_filename), '.', 1));
+END
+$$;
+
+GRANT ALL ON storage.objects, storage.buckets TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION storage.foldername(text), storage.filename(text), storage.extension(text)
+    TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+
+-- ── Realtime publication ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_publication WHERE pubname = 'supabase_realtime') THEN
+        CREATE PUBLICATION supabase_realtime;
+    END IF;
+END $$;
+
+-- ── Supabase default privileges on the public schema ────────────────────────
+-- Supabase grants table/sequence/function privileges in `public` to the API
+-- roles by default and relies on RLS (plus explicit REVOKEs) for isolation.
+-- Reproducing this is essential: a table without RLS is world-readable there.
+ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT ALL ON TABLES    TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT ALL ON SEQUENCES TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
+ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT ALL ON FUNCTIONS TO anon, authenticated, service_role;

diff --git a/supabase/tests/08_audit_invites_rls_and_targeted_claims.sql b/supabase/tests/08_audit_invites_rls_and_targeted_claims.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..2969c4e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/tests/08_audit_invites_rls_and_targeted_claims.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,226 @@
+-- ============================================================================
+-- Test 08 (audit DB-01, DB-05): household_invites RLS + targeted invite claims
+--
+-- DB-01: household_invites was created without ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, so
+--        its policies were inert and Supabase's default grants let anon read
+--        every invite code and any authenticated user forge an invite for any
+--        household and then join it.
+-- DB-05: join_household_by_code / claim_household_role_invite wrote to the
+--        non-existent column household_dependents.claimed_user_id, so every
+--        targeted (manual-member) invite failed; the target member was also not
+--        checked against the invite's household.
+-- ============================================================================
+\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
+
+BEGIN;
+
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    INSERT INTO auth.users (id, email) VALUES
+        ('d1000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'db01-victim-admin@test.local'),
+        ('d1000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', 'db01-attacker@test.local'),
+        ('d1000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003', 'db01-newcomer@test.local');
+
+    INSERT INTO public.households (id, name, invite_code) VALUES
+        ('d1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'DB01 Victim', 'DB01VICTIMSTATIC'),
+        ('d1bb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'DB01 Attacker', 'DB01ATTACKSTATIC');
+
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'd1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'admin'
+    WHERE id = 'd1000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'd1bb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'admin'
+    WHERE id = 'd1000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002';
+
+    INSERT INTO public.household_dependents (id, household_id, name) VALUES
+        ('d1de0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'd1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Victim manual member'),
+        ('d1de0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', 'd1bb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Attacker manual member');
+
+    INSERT INTO public.household_invites (household_id, invite_code, role, expires_at) VALUES
+        ('d1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'DB01REALINVITE01', 'peer', now() + interval '1 day');
+END $$;
+
+-- 1. RLS must be enabled on household_invites
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    IF NOT (SELECT relrowsecurity FROM pg_class WHERE oid = 'public.household_invites'::regclass) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (DB-01): RLS is not enabled on public.household_invites';
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: RLS enabled on household_invites.';
+END $$;
+
+-- 2. anon must not read invite codes
+SET ROLE anon;
+SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{"role": "anon"}', true);
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_cnt int := 0;
+BEGIN
+    BEGIN
+        SELECT count(*) INTO v_cnt FROM public.household_invites;
+    EXCEPTION WHEN insufficient_privilege THEN
+        v_cnt := 0;
+    END;
+    IF v_cnt > 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (DB-01): anon can read % invite code(s)', v_cnt;
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: anon cannot read household_invites.';
+END $$;
+RESET ROLE;
+
+-- 3. A user from another household must neither see nor forge invites for the victim household
+SET ROLE authenticated;
+SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{"sub": "d1000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002", "role": "authenticated"}', true);
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_cnt int;
+    v_forged boolean := false;
+BEGIN
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_cnt FROM public.household_invites
+    WHERE household_id = 'd1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+    IF v_cnt > 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (DB-01): attacker can read % victim invite(s)', v_cnt;
+    END IF;
+
+    BEGIN
+        INSERT INTO public.household_invites (household_id, invite_code, role, expires_at)
+        VALUES ('d1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'DB01FORGEDCODE01', 'peer', now() + interval '1 day');
+        v_forged := true;
+    EXCEPTION WHEN insufficient_privilege THEN
+        NULL;
+    END;
+    IF v_forged THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (DB-01): attacker forged an invite for a foreign household';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Re-opening a used/expired invite must not be possible either
+    UPDATE public.household_invites SET used_by = NULL, expires_at = now() + interval '1 year'
+    WHERE invite_code = 'DB01REALINVITE01';
+    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_cnt = ROW_COUNT;
+    IF v_cnt > 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (DB-01): attacker updated a foreign invite';
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: attacker cannot read, forge or modify foreign invites.';
+END $$;
+RESET ROLE;
+
+-- 4. Invites must not target a manual member of a different household (even via service role)
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_blocked boolean := false;
+BEGIN
+    BEGIN
+        INSERT INTO public.household_invites (household_id, invite_code, role, expires_at, target_member_id)
+        VALUES ('d1bb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'DB05CROSSTARGET1', 'spouse', now() + interval '1 day',
+                'd1de0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001');
+    EXCEPTION WHEN foreign_key_violation OR check_violation OR insufficient_privilege THEN
+        v_blocked := true;
+    END;
+    IF NOT v_blocked THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (DB-05): invite may target a manual member of another household';
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: cross-household target_member_id rejected.';
+END $$;
+
+-- 5. Targeted invite via join_household_by_code links the manual member to the claimer
+INSERT INTO public.household_invites (household_id, invite_code, role, expires_at, target_member_id)
+VALUES ('d1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'DB05TARGETED0001', 'spouse', now() + interval '1 day',
+        'd1de0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001');
+
+SET ROLE authenticated;
+SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{"sub": "d1000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003", "role": "authenticated"}', true);
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_res jsonb;
+BEGIN
+    v_res := public.join_household_by_code('db05targeted0001');
+    IF v_res ? 'error' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (DB-05): targeted join failed: %', v_res;
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: targeted invite accepted by join_household_by_code.';
+END $$;
+RESET ROLE;
+
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_linked uuid;
+    v_hh uuid;
+BEGIN
+    SELECT linked_user_id INTO v_linked FROM public.household_dependents WHERE id = 'd1de0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+    IF v_linked IS DISTINCT FROM 'd1000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003'::uuid THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (DB-05): manual member not linked to claimer (linked_user_id=%)', v_linked;
+    END IF;
+    SELECT household_id INTO v_hh FROM public.users WHERE id = 'd1000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003';
+    IF v_hh IS DISTINCT FROM 'd1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (DB-05): claimer not moved into invite household';
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: manual member linked to claiming user.';
+END $$;
+
+-- 6. Targeted invite via claim_household_role_invite (service-role path used by ai_service)
+UPDATE public.household_dependents SET linked_user_id = NULL WHERE id = 'd1de0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+-- The newcomer leaves again first: an existing member may not claim another
+-- invite of their own household (FABLE-DB-01, test 25).
+DELETE FROM public.household_memberships
+WHERE user_id = 'd1000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003' AND household_id = 'd1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+UPDATE public.users SET household_id = NULL, role = 'member' WHERE id = 'd1000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003';
+INSERT INTO public.household_invites (household_id, invite_code, role, expires_at, target_member_id)
+VALUES ('d1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'DB05TARGETED0002', 'spouse', now() + interval '1 day',
+        'd1de0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001');
+
+SET ROLE service_role;
+SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{"role": "service_role"}', true);
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_res jsonb;
+BEGIN
+    v_res := public.claim_household_role_invite('DB05TARGETED0002', 'd1000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003');
+    IF (v_res->>'success')::boolean IS NOT TRUE THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (DB-05): targeted claim failed: %', v_res;
+    END IF;
+    IF NOT EXISTS (
+        SELECT 1 FROM public.household_dependents
+        WHERE id = 'd1de0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
+          AND linked_user_id = 'd1000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003'
+    ) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (DB-05): claim_household_role_invite did not link the manual member';
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: claim_household_role_invite links the manual member.';
+END $$;
+RESET ROLE;
+
+-- 7. claim_household_role_invite must share the failed-attempt lockout of join_household_by_code
+SET ROLE authenticated;
+SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{"sub": "d1000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002", "role": "authenticated"}', true);
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_res jsonb;
+    v_locked boolean := false;
+    i int;
+BEGIN
+    FOR i IN 1..5 LOOP
+        v_res := public.claim_household_role_invite('DB01WRONGCODE00' || i);
+        IF (v_res->>'success')::boolean IS TRUE THEN
+            RAISE EXCEPTION 'unexpected success for wrong code';
+        END IF;
+    END LOOP;
+
+    BEGIN
+        v_res := public.claim_household_role_invite('DB01WRONGCODE006');
+        IF coalesce(v_res->>'error', '') LIKE '%Too many failed%' THEN
+            v_locked := true;
+        END IF;
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+        IF SQLERRM LIKE '%Too many failed%' THEN
+            v_locked := true;
+        ELSE
+            RAISE;
+        END IF;
+    END;
+
+    IF NOT v_locked THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (DB-01): claim_household_role_invite has no brute-force lockout';
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: claim_household_role_invite enforces the failed-attempt lockout.';
+END $$;
+RESET ROLE;
+
+ROLLBACK;
diff --git a/supabase/tests/09_audit_membership_policies.sql b/supabase/tests/09_audit_membership_policies.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..01c84e9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/tests/09_audit_membership_policies.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,148 @@
+-- ============================================================================
+-- Test 09 (audit DB-02): household_memberships policy recursion & write surface
+--
+-- memberships_admin_manage (FOR ALL, role PUBLIC) queried household_memberships
+-- from inside its own policy, so every authenticated read of the table - and
+-- every storage.objects receipts policy that consults it - failed with
+-- "infinite recursion detected in policy". The same policy (had it evaluated)
+-- let admins write membership rows directly, bypassing the RPCs that keep
+-- users.household_id in sync, and the RLS helpers trusted users.household_id
+-- without checking that a membership still exists.
+-- ============================================================================
+\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
+
+BEGIN;
+
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    INSERT INTO auth.users (id, email) VALUES
+        ('d2000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'db02-admin@test.local'),
+        ('d2000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', 'db02-member@test.local'),
+        ('d2000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003', 'db02-outsider@test.local');
+
+    INSERT INTO public.households (id, name, invite_code) VALUES
+        ('d2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'DB02 Home', 'DB02HOMECODE0001'),
+        ('d2bb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'DB02 Other', 'DB02OTHERCODE001');
+
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'd2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'admin'
+    WHERE id = 'd2000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'd2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'member'
+    WHERE id = 'd2000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002';
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'd2bb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'admin'
+    WHERE id = 'd2000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003';
+
+    INSERT INTO public.transactions (household_id, user_id, amount, category_code, timestamp)
+    VALUES ('d2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'd2000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 25, 'OPEX-GROCERY', now());
+
+    INSERT INTO storage.objects (bucket_id, name, owner)
+    VALUES ('receipts', 'd2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001/db02_receipt.jpg', 'd2000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001');
+END $$;
+
+-- 1. Members can read their own memberships without a recursion error
+SET ROLE authenticated;
+SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{"sub": "d2000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002", "role": "authenticated"}', true);
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_cnt int;
+BEGIN
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_cnt FROM public.household_memberships;
+    IF v_cnt <> 1 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Member expected to see exactly own membership, saw %', v_cnt;
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: member reads own membership (no policy recursion).';
+
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_cnt FROM storage.objects WHERE bucket_id = 'receipts'
+      AND name LIKE 'd2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001/%';
+    IF v_cnt <> 1 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Member expected to see household receipt, saw %', v_cnt;
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: storage receipts policy evaluates for members.';
+END $$;
+RESET ROLE;
+
+-- 2. Admin sees the household roster; outsider sees nothing of it
+SET ROLE authenticated;
+SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{"sub": "d2000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001", "role": "authenticated"}', true);
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_cnt int;
+BEGIN
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_cnt FROM public.household_memberships
+    WHERE household_id = 'd2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+    IF v_cnt <> 2 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Admin expected to see 2 memberships, saw %', v_cnt;
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: admin sees household roster.';
+END $$;
+RESET ROLE;
+
+SET ROLE authenticated;
+SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{"sub": "d2000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003", "role": "authenticated"}', true);
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_cnt int;
+BEGIN
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_cnt FROM public.household_memberships
+    WHERE household_id = 'd2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+    IF v_cnt <> 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: outsider sees % foreign memberships', v_cnt;
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: outsider cannot see foreign memberships.';
+END $$;
+RESET ROLE;
+
+-- 3. Membership rows are written only through the SECURITY DEFINER RPCs
+SET ROLE authenticated;
+SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{"sub": "d2000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001", "role": "authenticated"}', true);
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_cnt int := 0;
+    v_inserted boolean := false;
+BEGIN
+    BEGIN
+        INSERT INTO public.household_memberships (household_id, user_id, role)
+        VALUES ('d2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'd2000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003', 'admin');
+        v_inserted := true;
+    EXCEPTION WHEN insufficient_privilege THEN
+        NULL;
+    END;
+    IF v_inserted THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: admin inserted a membership for a user who never accepted an invite';
+    END IF;
+
+    BEGIN
+        DELETE FROM public.household_memberships
+        WHERE household_id = 'd2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
+          AND user_id = 'd2000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002';
+        GET DIAGNOSTICS v_cnt = ROW_COUNT;
+    EXCEPTION WHEN insufficient_privilege THEN
+        v_cnt := 0;
+    END;
+    IF v_cnt > 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: direct membership DELETE bypasses remove_member (users.household_id left stale)';
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: direct membership writes are rejected; RPCs are the only write path.';
+END $$;
+RESET ROLE;
+
+-- 4. Defence in depth: a stale users.household_id without a membership grants nothing
+DELETE FROM public.household_memberships
+WHERE household_id = 'd2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
+  AND user_id = 'd2000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002';
+
+SET ROLE authenticated;
+SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{"sub": "d2000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002", "role": "authenticated"}', true);
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_cnt int;
+BEGIN
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_cnt FROM public.transactions
+    WHERE household_id = 'd2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+    IF v_cnt <> 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: user without membership still reads % household transaction(s)', v_cnt;
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: household access requires a live membership row.';
+END $$;
+RESET ROLE;
+
+ROLLBACK;
diff --git a/supabase/tests/10_audit_reallocate_budget_authz.sql b/supabase/tests/10_audit_reallocate_budget_authz.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..c768873
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/tests/10_audit_reallocate_budget_authz.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,144 @@
+-- ============================================================================
+-- Test 10 (audit DB-03): reallocate_budget authorization & validation
+--
+-- schema.sql defines reallocate_budget(p_from_id, p_to_id, p_amount) as
+-- SECURITY DEFINER with no caller checks and the default EXECUTE grant to
+-- PUBLIC, so anon (and any authenticated user) could move allocated budget
+-- between any two budget rows of any household, with negative or fractional
+-- amounts.
+-- ============================================================================
+\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
+
+BEGIN;
+
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    INSERT INTO auth.users (id, email) VALUES
+        ('d3000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'db03-admin@test.local'),
+        ('d3000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', 'db03-member@test.local'),
+        ('d3000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003', 'db03-attacker@test.local');
+
+    INSERT INTO public.households (id, name, invite_code) VALUES
+        ('d3aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'DB03 Victim', 'DB03VICTIMCODE01'),
+        ('d3bb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'DB03 Attacker', 'DB03ATTACKCODE01');
+
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'd3aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'admin'
+    WHERE id = 'd3000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'd3aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'member'
+    WHERE id = 'd3000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002';
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'd3bb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'admin'
+    WHERE id = 'd3000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003';
+
+    INSERT INTO public.budgets (id, household_id, month, category_code, allocated_amount, cycle_key) VALUES
+        ('d3b00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'd3aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', '2026-11-01', 'OPEX-GROCERY', 1000, '2026-11'),
+        ('d3b00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', 'd3aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', '2026-11-01', 'OPEX-DINING', 500, '2026-11'),
+        ('d3b00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003', 'd3bb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', '2026-11-01', 'OPEX-DINING', 10, '2026-11');
+END $$;
+
+-- 1. anon must not be able to execute it at all
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    IF has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.reallocate_budget(uuid, uuid, numeric)', 'EXECUTE') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (DB-03): anon can EXECUTE reallocate_budget';
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: anon cannot execute reallocate_budget.';
+END $$;
+
+-- Helper: run a reallocation as a given user and return the SQLSTATE ('00000' on success)
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.try_reallocate(p_sub text, p_from uuid, p_to uuid, p_amount numeric)
+RETURNS text
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', p_sub, 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+    EXECUTE 'SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated';
+    BEGIN
+        PERFORM public.reallocate_budget(p_from, p_to, p_amount);
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+        EXECUTE 'RESET ROLE';
+        RETURN SQLSTATE;
+    END;
+    EXECUTE 'RESET ROLE';
+    RETURN '00000';
+END;
+$$;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION pg_temp.try_reallocate(text, uuid, uuid, numeric) TO authenticated;
+
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_state text;
+    v_from numeric;
+    v_to numeric;
+BEGIN
+    -- 2. Attacker (admin of another household) cannot move the victim's budget
+    v_state := pg_temp.try_reallocate('d3000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003',
+        'd3b00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'd3b00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', 900);
+    IF v_state = '00000' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (DB-03): foreign user reallocated victim budget';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- 3. Attacker cannot siphon allocation into their own household's budget row
+    v_state := pg_temp.try_reallocate('d3000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003',
+        'd3b00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'd3b00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003', 500);
+    IF v_state = '00000' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (DB-03): cross-household reallocation succeeded';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- 4. Non-admin member of the household cannot reallocate (budgets are admin-managed)
+    v_state := pg_temp.try_reallocate('d3000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002',
+        'd3b00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'd3b00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', 100);
+    IF v_state = '00000' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (DB-03): non-admin member reallocated budget';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- 5. Admin cannot pass negative / zero / sub-halala amounts
+    v_state := pg_temp.try_reallocate('d3000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
+        'd3b00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'd3b00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', -100);
+    IF v_state = '00000' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (DB-03): negative reallocation accepted';
+    END IF;
+    v_state := pg_temp.try_reallocate('d3000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
+        'd3b00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'd3b00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', 0.005);
+    IF v_state = '00000' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (DB-03): sub-halala reallocation accepted';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT allocated_amount INTO v_from FROM public.budgets WHERE id = 'd3b00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+    SELECT allocated_amount INTO v_to FROM public.budgets WHERE id = 'd3b00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002';
+    IF v_from <> 1000 OR v_to <> 500 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (DB-03): budgets changed by rejected calls (% / %)', v_from, v_to;
+    END IF;
+
+    -- 6. Admin of the household can reallocate a valid amount
+    v_state := pg_temp.try_reallocate('d3000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
+        'd3b00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'd3b00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', 250.50);
+    IF v_state <> '00000' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Admin reallocation failed with SQLSTATE %', v_state;
+    END IF;
+    SELECT allocated_amount INTO v_from FROM public.budgets WHERE id = 'd3b00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+    SELECT allocated_amount INTO v_to FROM public.budgets WHERE id = 'd3b00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002';
+    IF v_from <> 749.50 OR v_to <> 750.50 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Admin reallocation produced wrong balances (% / %)', v_from, v_to;
+    END IF;
+
+    -- 7. Cannot over-draw the source allocation
+    v_state := pg_temp.try_reallocate('d3000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
+        'd3b00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'd3b00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', 10000);
+    IF v_state = '00000' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (DB-03): reallocation larger than source allocation accepted';
+    END IF;
+
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: reallocate_budget enforces household admin, same-household rows and amount validation.';
+END $$;
+
+-- 8. Service role (ai_service) keeps working without a user JWT
+SET ROLE service_role;
+SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{"role": "service_role"}', true);
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM public.reallocate_budget('d3b00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', 'd3b00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 0.50);
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: service_role reallocation still allowed.';
+END $$;
+RESET ROLE;
+
+ROLLBACK;
diff --git a/supabase/tests/11_audit_cost_control_codes_policies.sql b/supabase/tests/11_audit_cost_control_codes_policies.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8de48f6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/tests/11_audit_cost_control_codes_policies.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,129 @@
+-- ============================================================================
+-- Test 11 (audit DB-04): cost_control_codes write policies
+--
+-- 20261011_hybrid_category_lifecycle.sql created cost_control_codes_insert /
+-- _update for role PUBLIC with only "household_id IS NOT NULL AND
+-- is_system = false". Any caller - including anon - could plant categories in
+-- any household's taxonomy (and squat on its future codes), and move their own
+-- custom codes into another household.
+-- ============================================================================
+\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
+
+BEGIN;
+
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    INSERT INTO auth.users (id, email) VALUES
+        ('d4000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'db04-admin@test.local'),
+        ('d4000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', 'db04-member@test.local'),
+        ('d4000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003', 'db04-attacker@test.local');
+
+    INSERT INTO public.households (id, name, invite_code) VALUES
+        ('d4aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'DB04 Victim', 'DB04VICTIMCODE01'),
+        ('d4bb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'DB04 Attacker', 'DB04ATTACKCODE01');
+
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'd4aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'admin'
+    WHERE id = 'd4000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'd4aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'member'
+    WHERE id = 'd4000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002';
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'd4bb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'admin'
+    WHERE id = 'd4000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003';
+
+    INSERT INTO public.cost_control_codes (id, code, category, keywords, household_id, is_system) VALUES
+        ('d4cc0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'DB04-ATTACKER-OWN', 'Attacker own', '{}', 'd4bb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', false);
+END $$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.try_sql(p_role text, p_sub text, p_sql text)
+RETURNS text
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_rows int;
+BEGIN
+    IF p_sub IS NULL THEN
+        PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('role', p_role)::text, true);
+    ELSE
+        PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', p_sub, 'role', p_role)::text, true);
+    END IF;
+    EXECUTE format('SET LOCAL ROLE %I', p_role);
+    BEGIN
+        EXECUTE p_sql;
+        GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows = ROW_COUNT;
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+        EXECUTE 'RESET ROLE';
+        RETURN SQLSTATE;
+    END;
+    EXECUTE 'RESET ROLE';
+    RETURN 'rows=' || v_rows;
+END;
+$$;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION pg_temp.try_sql(text, text, text) TO anon, authenticated;
+
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_res text;
+BEGIN
+    -- 1. anon cannot plant a category in any household
+    v_res := pg_temp.try_sql('anon', NULL,
+        $q$INSERT INTO public.cost_control_codes (code, category, keywords, household_id, is_system)
+           VALUES ('DB04-ANON', 'anon planted', '{}', 'd4aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', false)$q$);
+    IF v_res = 'rows=1' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (DB-04): anon inserted a category into a household';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- 2. authenticated outsider cannot plant a category in the victim household
+    v_res := pg_temp.try_sql('authenticated', 'd4000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003',
+        $q$INSERT INTO public.cost_control_codes (code, category, keywords, household_id, is_system)
+           VALUES ('DB04-PLANTED', 'planted', '{}', 'd4aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', false)$q$);
+    IF v_res = 'rows=1' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (DB-04): outsider inserted a category into the victim household';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- 3. outsider cannot move their own custom category into the victim household
+    v_res := pg_temp.try_sql('authenticated', 'd4000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003',
+        $q$UPDATE public.cost_control_codes SET household_id = 'd4aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
+           WHERE id = 'd4cc0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'$q$);
+    IF v_res = 'rows=1' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (DB-04): category moved into a foreign household via UPDATE';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- 4. non-admin member cannot create household categories
+    v_res := pg_temp.try_sql('authenticated', 'd4000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002',
+        $q$INSERT INTO public.cost_control_codes (code, category, keywords, household_id, is_system)
+           VALUES ('DB04-MEMBER', 'member cat', '{}', 'd4aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', false)$q$);
+    IF v_res = 'rows=1' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (DB-04): non-admin member created a household category';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- 5. nobody can create a system / global category from the client
+    v_res := pg_temp.try_sql('authenticated', 'd4000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
+        $q$INSERT INTO public.cost_control_codes (code, category, keywords, household_id, is_system)
+           VALUES ('DB04-GLOBAL', 'global', '{}', NULL, true)$q$);
+    IF v_res = 'rows=1' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (DB-04): client created a global/system category';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.cost_control_codes
+               WHERE code IN ('DB04-ANON', 'DB04-PLANTED', 'DB04-MEMBER', 'DB04-GLOBAL')
+                  OR (id = 'd4cc0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND household_id <> 'd4bb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001')) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (DB-04): forbidden category rows were written';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- 6. household admin can still add and rename a custom category in their own household
+    v_res := pg_temp.try_sql('authenticated', 'd4000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
+        $q$INSERT INTO public.cost_control_codes (code, category, keywords, household_id, is_system)
+           VALUES ('DB04-ADMIN-OWN', 'admin cat', '{}', 'd4aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', false)$q$);
+    IF v_res <> 'rows=1' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Admin could not create own household category: %', v_res;
+    END IF;
+    v_res := pg_temp.try_sql('authenticated', 'd4000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
+        $q$UPDATE public.cost_control_codes SET category = 'admin cat renamed'
+           WHERE code = 'DB04-ADMIN-OWN' AND household_id = 'd4aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'$q$);
+    IF v_res <> 'rows=1' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Admin could not rename own household category: %', v_res;
+    END IF;
+
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: cost_control_codes writes are scoped to the caller''s household admins.';
+END $$;
+
+ROLLBACK;
diff --git a/supabase/tests/12_audit_ledger_integrity.sql b/supabase/tests/12_audit_ledger_integrity.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ceeaaf1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/tests/12_audit_ledger_integrity.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,164 @@
+-- ============================================================================
+-- Test 12 (audit DB-06, DB-07): ledger amount precision and income_records
+-- append-only enforcement
+--
+-- DB-06: transfer_between_accounts / record_income take unconstrained NUMERIC
+--        and write NUMERIC(14,2) columns. Amounts with a third decimal are
+--        rounded independently on each side, so 1.005 debits 1.00 and credits
+--        1.01: repeated transfers mint money. record_income also accepted
+--        negative components and malformed cycle keys.
+-- DB-07: income_insert_household still allowed direct client INSERTs into the
+--        income ledger, bypassing record_income (no balance update, any account
+--        in the household, any sign).
+-- ============================================================================
+\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
+
+BEGIN;
+
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    INSERT INTO auth.users (id, email) VALUES
+        ('d6000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'db06-owner@test.local'),
+        ('d6000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', 'db06-member@test.local');
+
+    INSERT INTO public.households (id, name, invite_code) VALUES
+        ('d6aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'DB06 Home', 'DB06HOMECODE0001');
+
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'd6aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'admin'
+    WHERE id = 'd6000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'd6aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'member'
+    WHERE id = 'd6000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002';
+
+    INSERT INTO public.accounts (id, household_id, owner_user_id, name, account_type, balance, is_shared_pool) VALUES
+        ('d6ac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'd6aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'd6000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Owner A', 'bank', 100.00, false),
+        ('d6ac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', 'd6aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'd6000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Owner B', 'bank', 0.00, false);
+END $$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.as_user(p_sub text, p_sql text)
+RETURNS text
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_rows int;
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', p_sub, 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+    EXECUTE 'SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated';
+    BEGIN
+        EXECUTE p_sql;
+        GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows = ROW_COUNT;
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+        EXECUTE 'RESET ROLE';
+        RETURN SQLSTATE;
+    END;
+    EXECUTE 'RESET ROLE';
+    RETURN 'ok';
+END;
+$$;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION pg_temp.as_user(text, text) TO authenticated;
+
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_res text;
+    v_a numeric;
+    v_b numeric;
+    v_owner text := 'd6000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+BEGIN
+    -- 1. Sub-halala transfer amounts must be rejected (no rounding mint)
+    v_res := pg_temp.as_user(v_owner, $q$SELECT public.transfer_between_accounts(
+        'd6aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'd6ac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
+        'd6ac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', 1.005, 0)$q$);
+    v_res := v_res || '/' || pg_temp.as_user(v_owner, $q$SELECT public.transfer_between_accounts(
+        'd6aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'd6ac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002',
+        'd6ac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 1.005, 0)$q$);
+
+    SELECT balance INTO v_a FROM public.accounts WHERE id = 'd6ac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+    SELECT balance INTO v_b FROM public.accounts WHERE id = 'd6ac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002';
+    IF v_a + v_b <> 100.00 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (DB-06): transfers with 3-decimal amounts changed total money from 100.00 to % (A=%, B=%, results %)',
+            v_a + v_b, v_a, v_b, v_res;
+    END IF;
+    IF v_res <> '22023/22023' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (DB-06): sub-halala transfer not rejected with 22023 (got %)', v_res;
+    END IF;
+
+    v_res := pg_temp.as_user(v_owner, $q$SELECT public.transfer_between_accounts(
+        'd6aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'd6ac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
+        'd6ac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', 10.00, 0.001)$q$);
+    IF v_res <> '22023' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (DB-06): sub-halala transfer fee not rejected (got %)', v_res;
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: transfers reject amounts/fees with more than 2 decimals.';
+
+    -- 2. Valid 2-decimal transfer still conserves money exactly
+    v_res := pg_temp.as_user(v_owner, $q$SELECT public.transfer_between_accounts(
+        'd6aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'd6ac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
+        'd6ac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', 10.25, 0.50)$q$);
+    IF v_res <> 'ok' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Valid transfer failed: %', v_res;
+    END IF;
+    SELECT balance INTO v_a FROM public.accounts WHERE id = 'd6ac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+    SELECT balance INTO v_b FROM public.accounts WHERE id = 'd6ac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002';
+    IF v_a <> 89.25 OR v_b <> 10.25 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Valid transfer produced wrong balances (A=%, B=%)', v_a, v_b;
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: valid transfer debits amount+fee and credits amount exactly.';
+
+    -- 3. record_income validation
+    v_res := pg_temp.as_user(v_owner, $q$SELECT public.record_income(
+        'd6aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'd6ac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
+        '2026-11', 'salary', 'Salary', 1000.005)$q$);
+    IF v_res <> '22023' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (DB-06): record_income accepted a 3-decimal amount (got %)', v_res;
+    END IF;
+
+    v_res := pg_temp.as_user(v_owner, $q$SELECT public.record_income(
+        'd6aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'd6ac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
+        '2026-11', 'salary', 'Salary', 1000, -200, 0, 0)$q$);
+    IF v_res <> '22023' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (DB-06): record_income accepted a negative overtime component (got %)', v_res;
+    END IF;
+
+    v_res := pg_temp.as_user(v_owner, $q$SELECT public.record_income(
+        'd6aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'd6ac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
+        '2026-11', 'salary', 'Salary', 1000, 0, 0, -300)$q$);
+    IF v_res <> '22023' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (DB-06): record_income accepted negative deductions (net inflated) (got %)', v_res;
+    END IF;
+
+    v_res := pg_temp.as_user(v_owner, $q$SELECT public.record_income(
+        'd6aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'd6ac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
+        '2026-13', 'salary', 'Salary', 1000)$q$);
+    IF v_res <> '22023' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (DB-06): record_income accepted malformed cycle_key 2026-13 (got %)', v_res;
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT balance INTO v_a FROM public.accounts WHERE id = 'd6ac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+    IF v_a <> 89.25 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (DB-06): rejected record_income calls changed the balance to %', v_a;
+    END IF;
+
+    -- NULL cycle_key is derived from received_at and the household payday
+    v_res := pg_temp.as_user(v_owner, $q$SELECT public.record_income(
+        'd6aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'd6ac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
+        NULL, 'salary', 'Salary', 1000, 0, 0, 0, '2026-10-27 09:00:00+03')$q$);
+    IF v_res <> 'ok' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'record_income with derived cycle_key failed: %', v_res;
+    END IF;
+    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.income_records
+                   WHERE account_id = 'd6ac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND cycle_key = '2026-11') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (DB-06): cycle_key not derived from received_at (expected 2026-11)';
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: record_income validates precision, component signs and cycle_key.';
+
+    -- 4. Direct client INSERT into the income ledger must be blocked (DB-07)
+    v_res := pg_temp.as_user('d6000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', $q$INSERT INTO public.income_records (
+        household_id, user_id, account_id, cycle_key, source_type, title, net_amount)
+        VALUES ('d6aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'd6000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002',
+                'd6ac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', '2026-11', 'salary', 'forged', -5000)$q$);
+    IF v_res = 'ok' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (DB-07): client inserted a forged income record directly';
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: income_records accepts writes only through record_income.';
+END $$;
+
+ROLLBACK;
diff --git a/supabase/tests/13_audit_cycle_key_integrity.sql b/supabase/tests/13_audit_cycle_key_integrity.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..533f5b0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/tests/13_audit_cycle_key_integrity.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,115 @@
+-- ============================================================================
+-- Test 13 (audit DB-08 + cycle regression): transactions.cycle_key integrity
+--
+-- DB-08: trg_populate_transaction_cycle_key fires only on
+--        UPDATE OF timestamp, household_id, so a client UPDATE that sets only
+--        cycle_key keeps the forged value; update_budget_on_transaction_update
+--        then moves the amount out of the real budget cycle (spent_amount drops
+--        to 0 - overspending hidden).
+-- Regression: exhaustive invariants for get_saudi_cycle_for_timestamp over
+--        2026-2029 for every payday 1..31 (contiguous cycles, no gaps/overlap,
+--        keys advance one month at a time), Asia/Riyadh midnight boundary,
+--        leap years, Dec->Jan rollover, payday 29-31 clamping.
+-- ============================================================================
+\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
+
+BEGIN;
+
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    INSERT INTO auth.users (id, email) VALUES ('d8000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'db08-member@test.local');
+    INSERT INTO public.households (id, name, invite_code, payday_day)
+    VALUES ('d8aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'DB08 Home', 'DB08HOMECODE0001', 27);
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'd8aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'member'
+    WHERE id = 'd8000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+
+    INSERT INTO public.budgets (household_id, month, category_code, allocated_amount, cycle_key) VALUES
+        ('d8aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', '2026-11-01', 'OPEX-GROCERY', 1000, '2026-11');
+END $$;
+
+-- 1. A client cannot relabel a transaction's cycle to hide spending
+SET ROLE authenticated;
+SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{"sub": "d8000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001", "role": "authenticated"}', true);
+INSERT INTO public.transactions (id, household_id, user_id, amount, category_code, timestamp)
