+VALUES ('d8e00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'd8aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
+        'd8000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 200, 'OPEX-GROCERY', '2026-11-05 12:00:00+03');
+UPDATE public.transactions SET cycle_key = '1999-01' WHERE id = 'd8e00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+RESET ROLE;
+
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_key text;
+    v_spent numeric;
+BEGIN
+    SELECT cycle_key INTO v_key FROM public.transactions WHERE id = 'd8e00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+    SELECT spent_amount INTO v_spent FROM public.budgets
+    WHERE household_id = 'd8aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND cycle_key = '2026-11';
+    IF v_key IS DISTINCT FROM '2026-11' OR v_spent <> 200 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (DB-08): client relabelled cycle_key to % (budget spent now %)', v_key, v_spent;
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: cycle_key is always recomputed from timestamp + household payday.';
+END $$;
+
+-- 2. Exhaustive cycle invariants (every payday 1..31, every day 2026-2029)
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_bad int;
+BEGIN
+    WITH days AS (
+        SELECT d::date AS d, p
+        FROM generate_series('2026-01-01'::date, '2029-12-31'::date, interval '1 day') d,
+             generate_series(1, 31) p
+    ), c AS (
+        SELECT d, p, (public.get_saudi_cycle_for_timestamp((d + time '12:00') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh', p)).*
+        FROM days
+    ), l AS (
+        SELECT *, lag(cycle_key) OVER w AS pk, lag(cycle_start) OVER w AS ps, lag(cycle_end) OVER w AS pe
+        FROM c WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY p ORDER BY d)
+    )
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_bad
+    FROM l
+    WHERE NOT (cycle_start <= d AND d <= cycle_end)
+       OR cycle_key IS NULL
+       OR (pk = cycle_key AND (ps <> cycle_start OR pe <> cycle_end))
+       OR (pk <> cycle_key AND (cycle_start <> pe + 1
+                                OR to_char((pk || '-01')::date + interval '1 month', 'YYYY-MM') <> cycle_key));
+    IF v_bad > 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG: % day/payday combinations violate cycle invariants', v_bad;
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: cycles are contiguous, non-overlapping and advance one key per month (payday 1..31, 2026-2029).';
+END $$;
+
+-- 3. Boundary cases
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    r record;
+BEGIN
+    FOR r IN
+        SELECT * FROM (VALUES
+            ('2026-10-26 20:59:59+00'::timestamptz, 27, '2026-10', '2026-09-27'::date, '2026-10-26'::date), -- 23:59:59 Riyadh on the 26th
+            ('2026-10-26 21:00:00+00'::timestamptz, 27, '2026-11', '2026-10-27'::date, '2026-11-26'::date), -- 00:00 Riyadh on the 27th
+            ('2026-10-28 12:00:00+03'::timestamptz, 27, '2026-11', '2026-10-27'::date, '2026-11-26'::date),
+            ('2026-12-26 21:00:00+00'::timestamptz, 27, '2027-01', '2026-12-27'::date, '2027-01-26'::date), -- Dec -> Jan rollover
+            ('2027-01-26 12:00:00+03'::timestamptz, 27, '2027-01', '2026-12-27'::date, '2027-01-26'::date),
+            ('2027-02-28 12:00:00+03'::timestamptz, 31, '2027-03', '2027-02-28'::date, '2027-03-30'::date), -- payday 31 in Feb
+            ('2027-02-27 12:00:00+03'::timestamptz, 31, '2027-02', '2027-01-31'::date, '2027-02-27'::date),
+            ('2028-02-29 12:00:00+03'::timestamptz, 30, '2028-03', '2028-02-29'::date, '2028-03-29'::date), -- leap year
+            ('2028-02-28 12:00:00+03'::timestamptz, 30, '2028-02', '2028-01-30'::date, '2028-02-28'::date),
+            ('2026-04-30 12:00:00+03'::timestamptz, 31, '2026-05', '2026-04-30'::date, '2026-05-30'::date), -- 30-day month
+            ('2026-10-01 00:30:00+03'::timestamptz, 1,  '2026-10', '2026-10-01'::date, '2026-10-31'::date),
+            ('2026-09-30 21:30:00+00'::timestamptz, 1,  '2026-10', '2026-10-01'::date, '2026-10-31'::date)  -- UTC Sep 30, Riyadh Oct 1
+        ) AS t(ts, payday, exp_key, exp_start, exp_end)
+    LOOP
+        IF NOT EXISTS (
+            SELECT 1 FROM public.get_saudi_cycle_for_timestamp(r.ts, r.payday) c
+            WHERE c.cycle_key = r.exp_key AND c.cycle_start = r.exp_start AND c.cycle_end = r.exp_end
+        ) THEN
+            RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG: cycle for % payday % expected % [% .. %], got %',
+                r.ts, r.payday, r.exp_key, r.exp_start, r.exp_end,
+                (SELECT row_to_json(c) FROM public.get_saudi_cycle_for_timestamp(r.ts, r.payday) c);
+        END IF;
+    END LOOP;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: Riyadh midnight, Dec->Jan, Feb/leap-year and payday 29-31 boundaries.';
+END $$;
+
+ROLLBACK;
diff --git a/supabase/tests/14_audit_catalog_guardrails.sql b/supabase/tests/14_audit_catalog_guardrails.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5a35eaf
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/tests/14_audit_catalog_guardrails.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,102 @@
+-- ============================================================================
+-- Test 14 (audit DB-09, DB-10 + catalog guardrails)
+--
+-- DB-09: sync_user_household_membership() is SECURITY DEFINER without a pinned
+--        search_path (it runs with the invoking session's search_path).
+-- DB-10: households_insert_authenticated lets any authenticated client INSERT
+--        households rows directly (bypassing create_household_and_claim's
+--        5-household quota and server-generated invite code). The UNIQUE
+--        violation on a chosen invite_code is also an existence oracle for
+--        other households' static join codes that is not rate limited.
+-- Guardrails (regressions of SEC-01/02/05/08 and DB-01..04 class bugs):
+--   * every public table has RLS enabled;
+--   * no public/storage policy targets PUBLIC or anon;
+--   * every SECURITY DEFINER function in public pins search_path;
+--   * anon can execute no function in public.
+-- ============================================================================
+\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
+
+BEGIN;
+
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_list text;
+BEGIN
+    SELECT string_agg(c.relname, ', ') INTO v_list
+    FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
+    WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p') AND NOT c.relrowsecurity;
+    IF v_list IS NOT NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'GUARDRAIL: tables without RLS: %', v_list;
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT string_agg(schemaname || '.' || tablename || ':' || policyname, ', ') INTO v_list
+    FROM pg_policies
+    WHERE schemaname IN ('public', 'storage')
+      AND NOT (roles <@ ARRAY['authenticated', 'service_role']::name[]);
+    IF v_list IS NOT NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'GUARDRAIL: policies granted to PUBLIC/anon: %', v_list;
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT string_agg(p.proname, ', ') INTO v_list
+    FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
+    WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND p.prosecdef
+      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(coalesce(p.proconfig, '{}')) cfg WHERE cfg LIKE 'search_path=%');
+    IF v_list IS NOT NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'GUARDRAIL (DB-09): SECURITY DEFINER functions without pinned search_path: %', v_list;
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Extension members are skipped: live installs `unaccent` into public, its
+    -- functions are owned by the platform superuser, and they are not app RPCs.
+    SELECT string_agg(p.proname, ', ') INTO v_list
+    FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
+    WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND has_function_privilege('anon', p.oid, 'EXECUTE')
+      AND NOT EXISTS (
+          SELECT 1 FROM pg_depend d
+          WHERE d.classid = 'pg_proc'::regclass AND d.objid = p.oid AND d.deptype = 'e'
+      );
+    IF v_list IS NOT NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'GUARDRAIL: functions executable by anon: %', v_list;
+    END IF;
+
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: RLS on all tables, no PUBLIC/anon policies, definer search_path pinned, nothing anon-executable.';
+END $$;
+
+-- DB-10: no direct household creation from clients
+INSERT INTO auth.users (id, email) VALUES ('d9000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'db10-user@test.local');
+INSERT INTO public.households (id, name, invite_code) VALUES ('d9aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'DB10 Existing', 'DB10EXISTINGCODE');
+
+SET ROLE authenticated;
+SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{"sub": "d9000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001", "role": "authenticated"}', true);
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_state text := 'inserted';
+BEGIN
+    BEGIN
+        INSERT INTO public.households (name, invite_code) VALUES ('Direct insert', 'DB10EXISTINGCODE');
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+        v_state := SQLSTATE;
+    END;
+    IF v_state = '23505' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (DB-10): direct INSERT reached the invite_code UNIQUE check (existence oracle)';
+    END IF;
+
+    v_state := 'inserted';
+    BEGIN
+        INSERT INTO public.households (name) VALUES ('Direct insert');
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+        v_state := SQLSTATE;
+    END;
+    IF v_state = 'inserted' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (DB-10): authenticated client inserted a household directly';
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: households are created only through create_household_and_claim.';
+
+    -- The RPC path keeps working
+    IF (public.create_household_and_claim('DB10 via RPC')->>'id') IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'create_household_and_claim failed';
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: create_household_and_claim still creates households.';
+END $$;
+RESET ROLE;
+
+ROLLBACK;
diff --git a/supabase/tests/15_audit_receipts_bucket_limits.sql b/supabase/tests/15_audit_receipts_bucket_limits.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..903b3d0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/tests/15_audit_receipts_bucket_limits.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+-- ============================================================================
+-- Test 15 (audit DB-11): receipts bucket upload limits
+--
+-- The receipts bucket was created (20261008) and made private (20261019060000)
+-- but never given file_size_limit or allowed_mime_types. The storage.objects
+-- INSERT policy only checks the file *name* extension, so any household member
+-- can store arbitrarily large files of any content type (e.g. HTML/SVG/APK
+-- renamed to .jpg) up to the project-wide limit.
+-- ============================================================================
+\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
+
+BEGIN;
+
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_bucket storage.buckets%ROWTYPE;
+BEGIN
+    SELECT * INTO v_bucket FROM storage.buckets WHERE id = 'receipts';
+    IF v_bucket.id IS NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'receipts bucket missing';
+    END IF;
+    IF v_bucket.public IS DISTINCT FROM false THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: receipts bucket is public';
+    END IF;
+    IF v_bucket.file_size_limit IS NULL OR v_bucket.file_size_limit > 20 * 1024 * 1024 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (DB-11): receipts bucket file_size_limit is % (expected <= 20 MiB)', v_bucket.file_size_limit;
+    END IF;
+    IF v_bucket.allowed_mime_types IS NULL
+       OR NOT (v_bucket.allowed_mime_types <@ ARRAY['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'])
+       OR NOT ('image/jpeg' = ANY (v_bucket.allowed_mime_types)) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (DB-11): receipts bucket allowed_mime_types is %', v_bucket.allowed_mime_types;
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: receipts bucket is private, size-limited and image-only.';
+END $$;
+
+ROLLBACK;
diff --git a/supabase/tests/16_audit_account_deletion.sql b/supabase/tests/16_audit_account_deletion.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..f6a66ad
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/tests/16_audit_account_deletion.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,153 @@
+-- ============================================================================
+-- Test 16 (audit DB-12): account deletion of a household's sole admin
+--
+-- check_last_admin_membership() (BUG-03) raises when the sole admin's
+-- membership is deleted while other members remain - including when the
+-- delete is the ON DELETE CASCADE from auth.users -> public.users. Deleting
+-- such a user's account (Supabase Auth admin API / "delete my account") fails,
+-- so the app cannot honour account-deletion requests. The same cascade would
+-- also delete the household's shared-pool accounts the admin created
+-- (accounts.owner_user_id ON DELETE CASCADE), destroying shared funds history.
+--
+-- FABLE-DB-02 (20261020700000): household_invites.created_by / used_by were
+-- ON DELETE NO ACTION, so the account of anyone who created or claimed an
+-- invite could not be deleted either. Here the sole admin created two invites
+-- and a fourth user claimed one of them through the RPC.
+-- ============================================================================
+\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
+
+BEGIN;
+
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    INSERT INTO auth.users (id, email) VALUES
+        ('da000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'db12-admin@test.local'),
+        ('da000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', 'db12-first-member@test.local'),
+        ('da000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003', 'db12-second-member@test.local'),
+        ('da000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'db12-invitee@test.local');
+
+    INSERT INTO public.households (id, name, invite_code) VALUES
+        ('daaa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'DB12 Home', 'DB12HOMECODE0001');
+
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'daaa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'admin'
+    WHERE id = 'da000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'daaa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'member'
+    WHERE id = 'da000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002';
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'daaa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'member'
+    WHERE id = 'da000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003';
+
+    -- make the first member unambiguously the longest-standing one
+    UPDATE public.household_memberships SET created_at = now() - interval '30 days'
+    WHERE user_id = 'da000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002';
+
+    INSERT INTO public.accounts (id, household_id, owner_user_id, name, account_type, balance, is_shared_pool) VALUES
+        ('daac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'daaa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'da000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Admin personal', 'bank', 10, false),
+        ('daac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', 'daaa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'da000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Family pool', 'shared_pool', 900, true);
+
+    -- FABLE-DB-02: the admin created two invites; one is claimed below.
+    INSERT INTO public.household_invites (id, household_id, invite_code, role, created_by, expires_at) VALUES
+        ('dae10000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'daaa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'DB12OPEN', 'family_member',
+         'da000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', now() + interval '7 days'),
+        ('dae10000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', 'daaa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'DB12USED', 'family_member',
+         'da000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', now() + interval '7 days');
+END $$;
+
+-- The fourth user claims DB12USED through the RPC, as the app does.
+SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{"sub": "da000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004", "role": "authenticated"}', true);
+SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated;
+SELECT public.claim_household_role_invite('DB12USED') ->> 'success' AS db12_invite_claimed;
+RESET ROLE;
+SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '', true);
+
+-- 1. Demoting/removing the sole admin by other means is still blocked (BUG-03 intact)
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_blocked boolean := false;
+BEGIN
+    BEGIN
+        DELETE FROM public.household_memberships
+        WHERE user_id = 'da000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+    EXCEPTION WHEN raise_exception THEN
+        v_blocked := true;
+    END;
+    IF NOT v_blocked THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'REGRESSION: sole admin membership deleted while members remain';
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: last-admin protection still blocks direct removal.';
+END $$;
+
+-- 2. Deleting the sole admin's account succeeds and hands the household over
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_role text;
+    v_user_role text;
+    v_pool record;
+BEGIN
+    BEGIN
+        DELETE FROM auth.users WHERE id = 'da000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (DB-12): deleting the sole admin''s account failed: %', SQLERRM;
+    END;
+
+    SELECT role INTO v_role FROM public.household_memberships
+    WHERE household_id = 'daaa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
+      AND user_id = 'da000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002';
+    SELECT role INTO v_user_role FROM public.users WHERE id = 'da000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002';
+    IF v_role IS DISTINCT FROM 'admin' OR v_user_role IS DISTINCT FROM 'admin' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (DB-12): longest-standing member not promoted (membership %, users.role %)', v_role, v_user_role;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF (SELECT role FROM public.household_memberships
+        WHERE user_id = 'da000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003') IS DISTINCT FROM 'member' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (DB-12): more than one member promoted';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT * INTO v_pool FROM public.accounts WHERE id = 'daac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002';
+    IF v_pool.id IS NULL OR v_pool.owner_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM 'da000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'::uuid
+       OR v_pool.balance <> 900 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (DB-12): shared pool lost or not handed to the new admin (%)', row_to_json(v_pool);
+    END IF;
+
+    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts WHERE id = 'daac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (DB-12): deleted user''s personal account still exists';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- FABLE-DB-02: the admin's invites belong to the household and stay.
+    IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.household_invites
+        WHERE id IN ('dae10000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'dae10000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002')
+          AND created_by IS NULL) <> 2 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (FABLE-DB-02): the deleted creator''s invites were lost or still reference him';
+    END IF;
+
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: sole admin account deletion promotes successor and preserves shared pools.';
+END $$;
+
+-- 3. FABLE-DB-02: the user who claimed an invite can delete their account; the
+--    spent invite goes with them (never re-opened), the open one stays.
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    IF (SELECT used_by FROM public.household_invites WHERE invite_code = 'DB12USED')
+       IS DISTINCT FROM 'da000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004'::uuid THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'setup: DB12USED was not claimed by the invitee';
+    END IF;
+
+    BEGIN
+        DELETE FROM auth.users WHERE id = 'da000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004';
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (FABLE-DB-02): deleting the account of an invite claimer failed: %', SQLERRM;
+    END;
+
+    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_invites WHERE invite_code = 'DB12USED') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (FABLE-DB-02): the spent invite survived its claimer (it would become claimable again)';
+    END IF;
+    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_invites WHERE invite_code = 'DB12OPEN' AND used_by IS NULL) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (FABLE-DB-02): an unrelated open invite was removed';
+    END IF;
+    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships WHERE user_id = 'da000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'deleted invitee still has a membership';
+    END IF;
+
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: FABLE-DB-02 invite creator and claimer can delete their accounts.';
+END $$;
+
+ROLLBACK;
diff --git a/supabase/tests/17_audit_rls_performance.sql b/supabase/tests/17_audit_rls_performance.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..01ad935
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/tests/17_audit_rls_performance.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,97 @@
+-- ============================================================================
+-- Test 17 (audit DB-13): RLS evaluation cost and foreign-key index coverage
+--
+-- Policies call auth.uid() / get_auth_user_household_id() / get_auth_user_role()
+-- directly, so Postgres evaluates them per row (transactions_select_household
+-- re-parses the JWT claims for every row: ~50 ms for 50k rows). Wrapping them
+-- in a scalar sub-select turns them into a single InitPlan (Supabase linter
+-- rule auth_rls_initplan). Several FKs (incl. user_id columns hit by the
+-- account-deletion cascade) and the invite lockout lookup had no index.
+-- ============================================================================
+\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
+
+BEGIN;
+
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_list text;
+BEGIN
+    -- 1. Every auth/helper call inside a policy expression must be wrapped in (SELECT ...)
+    SELECT string_agg(schemaname || '.' || tablename || ':' || policyname, ', ') INTO v_list
+    FROM (
+        SELECT schemaname, tablename, policyname,
+               coalesce(qual, '') || ' ' || coalesce(with_check, '') AS expr
+        FROM pg_policies
+        WHERE schemaname IN ('public', 'storage')
+    ) p
+    WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM regexp_matches(expr, '(auth\.uid\(\)|get_auth_user_household_id\(\)|get_auth_user_role\(\))', 'g'))
+       <> (SELECT count(*) FROM regexp_matches(expr, 'SELECT (auth\.uid\(\)|get_auth_user_household_id\(\)|get_auth_user_role\(\))', 'g'));
+    IF v_list IS NOT NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERF (DB-13): policies evaluate auth helpers per row (wrap in SELECT): %', v_list;
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: all policy auth/helper calls are InitPlan-wrapped.';
+
+    -- 2. Every foreign key has an index with the FK columns as leading key
+    SELECT string_agg(c.conrelid::regclass::text || '.' || c.conname, ', ') INTO v_list
+    FROM pg_constraint c
+    WHERE c.contype = 'f'
+      AND c.connamespace = 'public'::regnamespace
+      AND NOT EXISTS (
+          SELECT 1 FROM pg_index i
+          WHERE i.indrelid = c.conrelid
+            AND (i.indkey::int2[])[0:cardinality(c.conkey) - 1] = c.conkey
+      );
+    IF v_list IS NOT NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERF (DB-13): foreign keys without a supporting index: %', v_list;
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: every foreign key has a supporting index.';
+
+    -- 3. Invite lockout lookup (user_id, attempted_at) is indexed
+    IF NOT EXISTS (
+        SELECT 1 FROM pg_index i
+        WHERE i.indrelid = 'public.invite_attempt_log'::regclass
+          AND (i.indkey::int2[])[0:1] = ARRAY[
+              (SELECT attnum FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid = 'public.invite_attempt_log'::regclass AND attname = 'user_id'),
+              (SELECT attnum FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid = 'public.invite_attempt_log'::regclass AND attname = 'attempted_at')
+          ]::int2[]
+    ) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'PERF (DB-13): invite_attempt_log has no (user_id, attempted_at) index';
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: invite lockout lookup is indexed.';
+END $$;
+
+-- 4. Behaviour unchanged: a member still sees exactly their household's rows
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    INSERT INTO auth.users (id, email) VALUES
+        ('db000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'db13-a@test.local'),
+        ('db000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', 'db13-b@test.local');
+    INSERT INTO public.households (id, name, invite_code) VALUES
+        ('dbaa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'DB13 A', 'DB13ACODE0000001'),
+        ('dbbb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'DB13 B', 'DB13BCODE0000001');
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'dbaa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'admin'
+    WHERE id = 'db000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'dbbb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'admin'
+    WHERE id = 'db000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002';
+    INSERT INTO public.transactions (household_id, amount, category_code, timestamp)
+    SELECT 'dbaa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 1, 'OPEX-GROCERY', now() FROM generate_series(1, 3);
+    INSERT INTO public.transactions (household_id, amount, category_code, timestamp)
+    SELECT 'dbbb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 1, 'OPEX-GROCERY', now() FROM generate_series(1, 5);
+END $$;
+
+SET ROLE authenticated;
+SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{"sub": "db000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001", "role": "authenticated"}', true);
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_cnt int;
+BEGIN
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_cnt FROM public.transactions
+    WHERE household_id IN ('dbaa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'dbbb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001');
+    IF v_cnt <> 3 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'RLS behaviour changed: expected 3 visible transactions, saw %', v_cnt;
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: wrapped policies keep household isolation.';
+END $$;
+RESET ROLE;
+
+ROLLBACK;
diff --git a/supabase/tests/18_remove_sms_artifacts.sql b/supabase/tests/18_remove_sms_artifacts.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..54f181e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/tests/18_remove_sms_artifacts.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,129 @@
+-- ============================================================================
+-- Test 18 (audit API-25, zero-SMS policy): no SMS artefacts in the schema
+--
+-- 20260925/20260930 created transactions.source with DEFAULT 'sms' and a
+-- CHECK that allowed 'sms', so rows were labelled as SMS-sourced by default.
+-- 20261020200000_remove_sms_artifacts.sql relabels history and removes the
+-- SMS channel. This test fails if an SMS channel, an SMS-only object or an
+-- SMS-sourced row reappears.
+-- ============================================================================
+\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
+
+BEGIN;
+
+-- 1. Schema: default is 'manual', CHECK has no 'sms', no SMS-named objects.
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_default text;
+    v_check text;
+    v_objects text;
+BEGIN
+    SELECT column_default INTO v_default
+    FROM information_schema.columns
+    WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'transactions' AND column_name = 'source';
+    IF v_default IS DISTINCT FROM '''manual''::text' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (API-25): transactions.source default is %, expected manual', v_default;
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT string_agg(pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid), ' ') INTO v_check
+    FROM pg_constraint c
+    JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.conrelid AND a.attnum = ANY (c.conkey)
+    WHERE c.conrelid = 'public.transactions'::regclass AND c.contype = 'c' AND a.attname = 'source';
+    IF v_check IS NULL OR v_check ILIKE '%sms%' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (API-25): transactions.source CHECK still allows sms (or is missing): %', v_check;
+    END IF;
+
+    -- raw_sms is the documented legacy name of the audit-note column; nothing else may mention SMS.
+    SELECT string_agg(obj, ', ') INTO v_objects FROM (
+        SELECT 'relation ' || c.relname AS obj
+        FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
+        WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relname ILIKE '%sms%'
+        UNION ALL
+        SELECT 'function ' || p.proname
+        FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
+        WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND (p.proname ILIKE '%sms%' OR p.prosrc ILIKE '%sms%')
+        UNION ALL
+        SELECT 'trigger ' || t.tgname
+        FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
+        WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND t.tgname ILIKE '%sms%'
+        UNION ALL
+        SELECT 'column ' || table_name || '.' || column_name
+        FROM information_schema.columns
+        WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND column_name ILIKE '%sms%'
+          AND NOT (table_name = 'transactions' AND column_name = 'raw_sms')
+    ) s;
+    IF v_objects IS NOT NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (API-25): SMS objects present: %', v_objects;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF col_description('public.transactions'::regclass,
+           (SELECT attnum FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid = 'public.transactions'::regclass AND attname = 'raw_sms'))
+       NOT ILIKE '%never reads SMS%' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (API-25): transactions.raw_sms is still documented as SMS text';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT string_agg(d.objoid::regclass::text || COALESCE('.' || a.attname, ''), ', ') INTO v_objects
+    FROM pg_description d
+    JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = d.objoid AND d.classoid = 'pg_class'::regclass
+    JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace AND n.nspname = 'public'
+    LEFT JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = d.objoid AND a.attnum = d.objsubid AND d.objsubid > 0
+    WHERE d.description ILIKE '%sms%' AND d.description NOT ILIKE '%never reads SMS%';
+    IF v_objects IS NOT NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (API-25): schema comments still describe SMS processing: %', v_objects;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.transactions WHERE source = 'sms') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (API-25): SMS-sourced transactions remain after relabel';
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: no SMS channel, SMS objects or SMS-labelled rows in the schema.';
+END $$;
+
+-- 2. A member cannot create an SMS-sourced row; an insert without a source is 'manual'.
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    INSERT INTO auth.users (id, email) VALUES ('e1800000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'sms18-member@test.local');
+    INSERT INTO public.households (id, name, invite_code, payday_day)
+    VALUES ('e18a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'SMS18 Home', 'SMS18HOMECODE001', 27);
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'e18a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'member'
+    WHERE id = 'e1800000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+END $$;
+
+SET ROLE authenticated;
+SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{"sub": "e1800000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001", "role": "authenticated"}', true);
+
+INSERT INTO public.transactions (id, household_id, user_id, amount, category_code, timestamp)
+VALUES ('e18e0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e18a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
+        'e1800000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 25, 'OPEX-GROCERY', '2026-11-05 12:00:00+03');
+
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    BEGIN
+        INSERT INTO public.transactions (household_id, user_id, amount, category_code, timestamp, source)
+        VALUES ('e18a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1800000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
+                10, 'OPEX-GROCERY', '2026-11-05 12:00:00+03', 'sms');
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (API-25): an sms-sourced transaction was accepted';
+    EXCEPTION WHEN check_violation THEN
+        NULL;
+    END;
+
+    BEGIN
+        UPDATE public.transactions SET source = 'sms' WHERE id = 'e18e0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (API-25): a transaction was relabelled as sms';
+    EXCEPTION WHEN check_violation THEN
+        NULL;
+    END;
+END $$;
+RESET ROLE;
+
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_source text;
+BEGIN
+    SELECT source INTO v_source FROM public.transactions WHERE id = 'e18e0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+    IF v_source IS DISTINCT FROM 'manual' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (API-25): insert without source stored %, expected manual', v_source;
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: new rows cannot be SMS-sourced; unlabelled inserts are manual.';
+END $$;
+
+ROLLBACK;
diff --git a/supabase/tests/19_nafaqah_allowance_and_reimbursements.sql b/supabase/tests/19_nafaqah_allowance_and_reimbursements.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..aea7c7b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/tests/19_nafaqah_allowance_and_reimbursements.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,500 @@
+-- ============================================================================
+-- Test 18 (UI-24 owner decision): Islamic family Nafaqah in the database
+--
+-- Rules (see .agents/rules/02-saudi-fintech-and-islamic-compliance.md §3):
+--   1. Shared family expenses are the husband's Nafaqah: never split 50/50.
+--   2. Wife pays from her own money for something shared (household / children)
+--      -> transaction classified 'wife_reimbursable' -> the husband owes her;
+--      reimbursements (partial or full) reduce the debt, never below zero.
+--   3. A personal purchase for the wife -> 'wife_personal' -> charged to her
+--      personal allowance (member_allowances, per salary cycle_key); overspend
+--      shows as negative remaining and is not blocked.
+--   4. Husband-paid shared expenses carry no class and create no debt.
+-- Integrity: classification must name a spouse member of the transaction's
+-- household; allowance amounts are set only by the husband or a household
+-- admin other than the wife herself; reimbursements go only through the RPC,
+-- which rejects overpayment; money is numeric(14,2) with positive amounts.
+-- ============================================================================
+\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
+
+BEGIN;
+
+-- Fixtures ------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- Family household F: husband H (admin, provider), wife W (member, spouse),
+-- adult child K (member, family_member).
+-- Other family household G: admin O (provider) - must never reach F.
+-- Roommate household R: P1 (admin, peer), P2 (member, peer).
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    INSERT INTO auth.users (id, email) VALUES
+        ('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a', 'naf-husband@test.local'),
+        ('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', 'naf-wife@test.local'),
+        ('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000c', 'naf-child@test.local'),
+        ('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000d', 'naf-outsider@test.local'),
+        ('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000e1', 'naf-peer1@test.local'),
+        ('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000e2', 'naf-peer2@test.local');
+
+    INSERT INTO public.households (id, name, invite_code) VALUES
+        ('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Nafaqah Family', 'NAFFAMILYCODE001'),
+        ('e1bb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Other Family', 'NAFOTHERCODE0001'),
+        ('e1cc0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Roommates', 'NAFROOMCODE00001');
+    -- Roommate household (household_type, migration 20261020900000).
+    UPDATE public.households SET household_type = 'roommates' WHERE id = 'e1cc0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'admin', financial_role = 'provider'
+    WHERE id = 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a';
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'member', financial_role = 'spouse'
+    WHERE id = 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b';
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'member', financial_role = 'family_member'
+    WHERE id = 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000c';
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'e1bb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'admin', financial_role = 'provider'
+    WHERE id = 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000d';
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'e1cc0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'admin', financial_role = 'peer'
+    WHERE id = 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000e1';
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'e1cc0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'member', financial_role = 'peer'
+    WHERE id = 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000e2';
+END $$;
+
+-- 1. Catalog: new objects exist, RLS on, no direct client writes, anon locked out
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
+                   WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'transactions' AND column_name = 'nafaqah_class') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'MISSING: transactions.nafaqah_class';
+    END IF;
+    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
+                   WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'transactions' AND column_name = 'nafaqah_spouse_id') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'MISSING: transactions.nafaqah_spouse_id';
+    END IF;
+    IF NOT (SELECT relrowsecurity FROM pg_class WHERE oid = 'public.member_allowances'::regclass) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'member_allowances has RLS disabled';
+    END IF;
+    IF NOT (SELECT relrowsecurity FROM pg_class WHERE oid = 'public.spouse_reimbursements'::regclass) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'spouse_reimbursements has RLS disabled';
+    END IF;
+    IF (SELECT format_type(atttypid, atttypmod) FROM pg_attribute
+        WHERE attrelid = 'public.spouse_reimbursements'::regclass AND attname = 'amount') <> 'numeric(14,2)' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'spouse_reimbursements.amount must be numeric(14,2)';
+    END IF;
+    IF (SELECT format_type(atttypid, atttypmod) FROM pg_attribute
+        WHERE attrelid = 'public.member_allowances'::regclass AND attname = 'amount') <> 'numeric(14,2)' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'member_allowances.amount must be numeric(14,2)';
+    END IF;
+    IF has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.spouse_reimbursements', 'INSERT')
+       OR has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.spouse_reimbursements', 'UPDATE')
+       OR has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.spouse_reimbursements', 'DELETE') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: clients can write spouse_reimbursements directly';
+    END IF;
+    IF has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.member_allowances', 'INSERT')
+       OR has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.member_allowances', 'UPDATE')
+       OR has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.member_allowances', 'DELETE') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: clients can write member_allowances directly';
+    END IF;
+    IF has_table_privilege('anon', 'public.spouse_reimbursements', 'SELECT')
+       OR has_table_privilege('anon', 'public.member_allowances', 'SELECT') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: anon can read Nafaqah ledgers';
+    END IF;
+    IF has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.record_spouse_reimbursement(uuid, uuid, numeric, text, text, uuid)', 'EXECUTE')
+       OR has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.set_member_allowance(uuid, uuid, numeric, text, uuid)', 'EXECUTE')
+       OR has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.get_member_allowance_status(uuid, uuid, text, uuid)', 'EXECUTE')
+       OR has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.get_spouse_reimbursement_balance(uuid, uuid, uuid)', 'EXECUTE') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: anon can execute Nafaqah RPCs';
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: Nafaqah catalog objects exist with RLS, numeric(14,2) money and RPC-only writes.';
+END $$;
+
+-- Helper: run SQL as a given authenticated user, return SQLSTATE ('00000' on success)
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.as_user(p_sub text, p_sql text)
+RETURNS text
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', p_sub, 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+    EXECUTE 'SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated';
+    BEGIN
+        EXECUTE p_sql;
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+        EXECUTE 'RESET ROLE';
+        RETURN SQLSTATE;
+    END;
+    EXECUTE 'RESET ROLE';
+    RETURN '00000';
+END;
+$$;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION pg_temp.as_user(text, text) TO authenticated;
+
+-- 2. Classification integrity (trigger binds service-role writes too)
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_state text;
+BEGIN
+    -- valid: wife-paid shared expense in the family household
+    INSERT INTO public.transactions (id, household_id, amount, merchant, category_code, timestamp, source, nafaqah_class, nafaqah_spouse_id)
+    VALUES ('e1f00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 300.00, 'Panda', 'OPEX-GROCERY',
+            '2026-11-10 12:00+03', 'manual', 'wife_reimbursable', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b');
+
+    -- the husband is not a spouse: rejected
+    v_state := 'ok';
+    BEGIN
+        INSERT INTO public.transactions (household_id, amount, merchant, category_code, timestamp, source, nafaqah_class, nafaqah_spouse_id)
+        VALUES ('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 10, 'X', 'OPEX-MISC', now(), 'manual', 'wife_reimbursable', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a');
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN v_state := SQLSTATE;
+    END;
+    IF v_state = 'ok' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG: non-spouse accepted as nafaqah_spouse_id'; END IF;
+
+    -- the wife of household F cannot be attached to a transaction of household G
+    v_state := 'ok';
+    BEGIN
+        INSERT INTO public.transactions (household_id, amount, merchant, category_code, timestamp, source, nafaqah_class, nafaqah_spouse_id)
+        VALUES ('e1bb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 10, 'X', 'OPEX-MISC', now(), 'manual', 'wife_personal', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b');
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN v_state := SQLSTATE;
+    END;
+    IF v_state = 'ok' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: cross-household spouse attached to a transaction'; END IF;
+
+    -- roommate households have no spouse: a peer can never be a Nafaqah creditor
+    v_state := 'ok';
+    BEGIN
+        INSERT INTO public.transactions (household_id, amount, merchant, category_code, timestamp, source, nafaqah_class, nafaqah_spouse_id)
+        VALUES ('e1cc0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 10, 'X', 'OPEX-MISC', now(), 'manual', 'wife_reimbursable', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000e2');
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN v_state := SQLSTATE;
+    END;
+    IF v_state = 'ok' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG: roommate classified as wife'; END IF;
+
+    -- class without spouse and spouse without class are both rejected
+    v_state := 'ok';
+    BEGIN
+        INSERT INTO public.transactions (household_id, amount, merchant, category_code, timestamp, source, nafaqah_class)
+        VALUES ('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 10, 'X', 'OPEX-MISC', now(), 'manual', 'wife_personal');
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN v_state := SQLSTATE;
+    END;
+    IF v_state = 'ok' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG: nafaqah_class accepted without a spouse'; END IF;
+    v_state := 'ok';
+    BEGIN
+        INSERT INTO public.transactions (household_id, amount, merchant, category_code, timestamp, source, nafaqah_spouse_id)
+        VALUES ('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 10, 'X', 'OPEX-MISC', now(), 'manual', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b');
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN v_state := SQLSTATE;
+    END;
+    IF v_state = 'ok' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG: nafaqah_spouse_id accepted without a class'; END IF;
+
+    -- unknown class value
+    v_state := 'ok';
+    BEGIN
+        INSERT INTO public.transactions (household_id, amount, merchant, category_code, timestamp, source, nafaqah_class, nafaqah_spouse_id)
+        VALUES ('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 10, 'X', 'OPEX-MISC', now(), 'manual', 'split_50_50', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b');
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN v_state := SQLSTATE;
+    END;
+    IF v_state <> '23514' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG: unknown nafaqah_class not rejected by CHECK (got %)', v_state; END IF;
+
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: Nafaqah classification requires a spouse member of the same household.';
+END $$;
+
+-- More fixtures: second reimbursable expense (children), husband-paid shared expense,
+-- personal purchases in two cycles.
+INSERT INTO public.transactions (id, household_id, amount, merchant, category_code, timestamp, source, nafaqah_class, nafaqah_spouse_id) VALUES
+    ('e1f00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', 'e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 200.50, 'Nahdi (kids)', 'OPEX-HEALTH', '2026-11-12 12:00+03', 'manual', 'wife_reimbursable', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b'),
+    ('e1f00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003', 'e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 400.00, 'Abaya shop', 'OPEX-SHOPPING', '2026-11-05 12:00+03', 'manual', 'wife_personal', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b'),
+    ('e1f00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004', 'e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 1300.00, 'Perfume', 'OPEX-SHOPPING', '2026-11-20 12:00+03', 'manual', 'wife_personal', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b'),
+    ('e1f00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000005', 'e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 99.00, 'Salon (next cycle)', 'OPEX-SHOPPING', '2026-12-01 12:00+03', 'manual', 'wife_personal', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b');
+INSERT INTO public.transactions (id, household_id, amount, merchant, category_code, timestamp, source) VALUES
+    ('e1f00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000006', 'e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 950.00, 'Rent share (husband)', 'OPEX-UTILITIES', '2026-11-03 12:00+03', 'manual');
+
+-- 3. Clients cannot write the ledgers directly
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_state text;
+BEGIN
+    v_state := pg_temp.as_user('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b',
+        $q$INSERT INTO public.spouse_reimbursements (household_id, wife_user_id, amount) VALUES ('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', 1)$q$);
+    IF v_state = '00000' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: direct reimbursement insert accepted'; END IF;
+    v_state := pg_temp.as_user('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a',
+        $q$INSERT INTO public.member_allowances (household_id, member_user_id, cycle_key, amount) VALUES ('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', '2026-11', 5)$q$);
+    IF v_state = '00000' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: direct allowance insert accepted'; END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: Nafaqah ledgers are written only through RPCs.';
+END $$;
+
+-- 4. Allowance authorization and validation
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_state text;
+    v_amount numeric;
+BEGIN
+    -- the wife cannot set her own allowance
+    v_state := pg_temp.as_user('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b',
+        $q$SELECT public.set_member_allowance('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', 1500, '2026-11')$q$);
+    IF v_state = '00000' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: wife set her own allowance'; END IF;
+    -- a non-admin, non-husband member cannot set it
+    v_state := pg_temp.as_user('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000c',
+        $q$SELECT public.set_member_allowance('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', 1500, '2026-11')$q$);
+    IF v_state = '00000' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: ordinary member set the wife allowance'; END IF;
+    -- another household's admin cannot set it
+    v_state := pg_temp.as_user('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000d',
+        $q$SELECT public.set_member_allowance('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', 1500, '2026-11')$q$);
+    IF v_state = '00000' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: foreign admin set the wife allowance'; END IF;
+    -- allowances exist only for spouse members
+    v_state := pg_temp.as_user('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a',
+        $q$SELECT public.set_member_allowance('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000c', 100, '2026-11')$q$);
+    IF v_state = '00000' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG: allowance set for a non-spouse member'; END IF;
+    -- negative, sub-halala and malformed cycle keys are rejected
+    v_state := pg_temp.as_user('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a',
+        $q$SELECT public.set_member_allowance('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', -1, '2026-11')$q$);
+    IF v_state = '00000' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG: negative allowance accepted'; END IF;
+    v_state := pg_temp.as_user('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a',
+        $q$SELECT public.set_member_allowance('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', 10.005, '2026-11')$q$);
+    IF v_state = '00000' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG: sub-halala allowance accepted'; END IF;
+    v_state := pg_temp.as_user('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a',
+        $q$SELECT public.set_member_allowance('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', 10, '2026-13')$q$);
+    IF v_state = '00000' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG: malformed cycle_key accepted'; END IF;
+
+    -- the husband sets it, then updates it (upsert, one row per cycle)
+    v_state := pg_temp.as_user('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a',
+        $q$SELECT public.set_member_allowance('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', 1000, '2026-11')$q$);
+    IF v_state <> '00000' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Husband could not set allowance (%)', v_state; END IF;
+    v_state := pg_temp.as_user('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a',
+        $q$SELECT public.set_member_allowance('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', 1500, '2026-11')$q$);
+    IF v_state <> '00000' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Husband could not update allowance (%)', v_state; END IF;
+    SELECT amount INTO v_amount FROM public.member_allowances
+    WHERE household_id = 'e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND member_user_id = 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b' AND cycle_key = '2026-11';
+    IF v_amount IS DISTINCT FROM 1500.00 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.member_allowances WHERE member_user_id = 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b') <> 1 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Allowance upsert wrong: amount %', v_amount;
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: only the husband/admin sets the wife allowance; amounts and cycle keys are validated.';
+END $$;
+
+-- 5. Allowance status: personal purchases of the cycle only; overspend is negative, not blocked
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_status jsonb;
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+    SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated;
+    v_status := public.get_member_allowance_status('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', '2026-11');
+    RESET ROLE;
+    IF (v_status->>'allocated')::numeric <> 1500.00
+       OR (v_status->>'spent')::numeric <> 1700.00
+       OR (v_status->>'remaining')::numeric <> -200.00
+       OR (v_status->>'is_set')::boolean IS NOT TRUE THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Allowance status wrong: %', v_status;
+    END IF;
+
+    -- next cycle has no allocation yet: the 99.00 purchase still shows (remaining -99)
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a', 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+    SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated;
+    v_status := public.get_member_allowance_status('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', '2026-12');
+    RESET ROLE;
+    IF (v_status->>'allocated')::numeric <> 0 OR (v_status->>'spent')::numeric <> 99.00
+       OR (v_status->>'remaining')::numeric <> -99.00 OR (v_status->>'is_set')::boolean IS NOT FALSE THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Next-cycle allowance status wrong: %', v_status;
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: allowance spent/remaining per cycle; overspend reported as negative remaining.';
+END $$;
+
+-- 6. Reimbursement ledger: balance, partial, overpayment rejected, full, authorization
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_state text;
+    v_bal jsonb;
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+    SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated;
+    v_bal := public.get_spouse_reimbursement_balance('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b');
+    RESET ROLE;
+    -- 300.00 + 200.50 wife-paid shared; husband-paid rent and personal purchases are not debt
+    IF (v_bal->>'gross_advanced')::numeric <> 500.50 OR (v_bal->>'outstanding')::numeric <> 500.50 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Initial balance wrong: %', v_bal;
+    END IF;
+
+    -- husband pays back 200 (partial)
+    v_state := pg_temp.as_user('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a',
+        $q$SELECT public.record_spouse_reimbursement('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', 200, 'stc_pay', 'partial')$q$);
+    IF v_state <> '00000' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Partial reimbursement failed (%)', v_state; END IF;
+
+    -- overpayment is rejected and changes nothing
+    v_state := pg_temp.as_user('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a',
+        $q$SELECT public.record_spouse_reimbursement('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', 400, 'cash', NULL)$q$);
+    IF v_state <> '22023' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Overpayment not rejected with 22023 (got %)', v_state; END IF;
+
+    -- ai_service maps the refusal by SQLSTATE 22023 + HINT 'overpayment' (PostgREST JSON code/hint)
+    DECLARE
+        v_code text;
+        v_hint text;
+    BEGIN
+        PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a', 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+        SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated;
+        PERFORM public.record_spouse_reimbursement('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', 400, 'cash', NULL);
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG: overpayment accepted';
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+        GET STACKED DIAGNOSTICS v_code = RETURNED_SQLSTATE, v_hint = PG_EXCEPTION_HINT;
+        IF v_code <> '22023' OR v_hint IS DISTINCT FROM 'overpayment' THEN
+            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Overpayment refusal must carry SQLSTATE 22023 and HINT overpayment (got %, %)', v_code, v_hint;
+        END IF;
+    END;
+    RESET ROLE;
+
+    -- zero / negative / sub-halala / unknown method rejected
+    v_state := pg_temp.as_user('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a',
+        $q$SELECT public.record_spouse_reimbursement('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', 0, 'cash', NULL)$q$);
+    IF v_state = '00000' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG: zero reimbursement accepted'; END IF;
+    v_state := pg_temp.as_user('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a',
+        $q$SELECT public.record_spouse_reimbursement('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', 0.005, 'cash', NULL)$q$);
+    IF v_state = '00000' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG: sub-halala reimbursement accepted'; END IF;
+    v_state := pg_temp.as_user('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a',
+        $q$SELECT public.record_spouse_reimbursement('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', 1, 'bitcoin', NULL)$q$);
+    IF v_state = '00000' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG: unknown payment method accepted'; END IF;
+
+    -- an ordinary member and a foreign admin cannot record repayments
+    v_state := pg_temp.as_user('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000c',
+        $q$SELECT public.record_spouse_reimbursement('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', 1, 'cash', NULL)$q$);
+    IF v_state = '00000' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: ordinary member recorded a reimbursement'; END IF;
+    v_state := pg_temp.as_user('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000d',
+        $q$SELECT public.record_spouse_reimbursement('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', 1, 'cash', NULL)$q$);
+    IF v_state = '00000' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: foreign admin recorded a reimbursement'; END IF;
+    -- a roommate is never a Nafaqah creditor
+    v_state := pg_temp.as_user('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000e1',
+        $q$SELECT public.record_spouse_reimbursement('e1cc0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000e2', 1, 'cash', NULL)$q$);
+    IF v_state = '00000' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG: roommate reimbursement recorded in Nafaqah ledger'; END IF;
+    -- a foreign user cannot read the balance either
+    v_state := pg_temp.as_user('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000d',
+        $q$SELECT public.get_spouse_reimbursement_balance('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b')$q$);
+    IF v_state = '00000' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: foreign user read the reimbursement balance'; END IF;
+    v_state := pg_temp.as_user('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000d',
+        $q$SELECT public.get_member_allowance_status('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', '2026-11')$q$);
+    IF v_state = '00000' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: foreign user read the allowance status'; END IF;
+
+    -- the wife confirms receipt of the remaining 300.50 (full settlement)
+    v_state := pg_temp.as_user('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b',
+        $q$SELECT public.record_spouse_reimbursement('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', 300.50, 'bank_transfer', 'rest')$q$);
+    IF v_state <> '00000' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Final reimbursement failed (%)', v_state; END IF;
+
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a', 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+    SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated;
+    v_bal := public.get_spouse_reimbursement_balance('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b');
+    RESET ROLE;
+    IF (v_bal->>'reimbursed')::numeric <> 500.50 OR (v_bal->>'outstanding')::numeric <> 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Final balance wrong: %', v_bal;
+    END IF;
+
+    v_state := pg_temp.as_user('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a',
+        $q$SELECT public.record_spouse_reimbursement('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', 0.01, 'cash', NULL)$q$);
+    IF v_state <> '22023' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Reimbursement after full settlement not rejected (got %)', v_state; END IF;
+
+    IF (SELECT paid_by_user_id FROM public.spouse_reimbursements WHERE notes = 'rest') IS DISTINCT FROM 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a'::uuid
+       OR (SELECT recorded_by FROM public.spouse_reimbursements WHERE notes = 'rest') IS DISTINCT FROM 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b'::uuid THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Reimbursement payer/recorder not attributed correctly';
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: wife reimbursement debt: partial and full repayments, overpayment rejected, household-scoped.';
+END $$;
+
+-- 7. Household isolation of ledger reads (RLS)
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_count int;
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000d', 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+    SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated;
+    SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM public.spouse_reimbursements) + (SELECT count(*) FROM public.member_allowances) INTO v_count;
+    RESET ROLE;
+    IF v_count <> 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: foreign user sees % Nafaqah ledger rows', v_count; END IF;
+
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+    SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated;
+    SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM public.spouse_reimbursements) + (SELECT count(*) FROM public.member_allowances) INTO v_count;
+    RESET ROLE;
+    IF v_count <> 3 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Wife should see her 2 reimbursements and 1 allowance, saw %', v_count; END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: Nafaqah ledgers are readable only inside the household.';
+END $$;
+
+-- 8. Service role (ai_service) acts for a verified user; it cannot act anonymously
+SET LOCAL ROLE service_role;
+SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{"role": "service_role"}', true);
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_state text := 'ok';
+    v_status jsonb;
+BEGIN
+    v_status := public.set_member_allowance('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', 800, '2026-12',
+                                            'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a');
+    IF (v_status->>'allocated')::numeric <> 800 OR (v_status->>'remaining')::numeric <> 701.00 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'service-role allowance set wrong: %', v_status;
+    END IF;
+    BEGIN
+        PERFORM public.set_member_allowance('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', 800, '2026-12');
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN v_state := SQLSTATE;
+    END;
+    IF v_state = 'ok' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: service role set allowance without an actor'; END IF;
+    v_state := 'ok';
+    BEGIN
+        PERFORM public.set_member_allowance('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', 800, '2026-12',
+                                            'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b');
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN v_state := SQLSTATE;
+    END;
+    IF v_state = 'ok' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: service role let the wife set her own allowance'; END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: service role acts only on behalf of an authorised actor.';
+END $$;
+RESET ROLE;
+
+-- 9. An authenticated user cannot impersonate another actor
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_state text;
+BEGIN
+    v_state := pg_temp.as_user('e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b',
+        $q$SELECT public.set_member_allowance('e1aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b', 5000, '2026-12', 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a')$q$);
+    IF v_state <> '42501' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: actor impersonation not rejected (got %)', v_state; END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: p_actor_user_id cannot differ from the JWT subject.';
+END $$;
+
+-- 10. Deleting the wife's account cleans her ledgers and declassifies her transactions
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    DELETE FROM auth.users WHERE id = 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b';
+    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.spouse_reimbursements WHERE wife_user_id = 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b')
+       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.member_allowances WHERE member_user_id = 'e1000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000b') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Wife ledgers survived account deletion';
+    END IF;
+    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.transactions WHERE id = 'e1f00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND (nafaqah_class IS NOT NULL OR nafaqah_spouse_id IS NOT NULL)) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Transactions kept a Nafaqah class for a deleted spouse';
+    END IF;
+    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.transactions WHERE id = 'e1f00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Household expense history was deleted with the spouse account';
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: spouse account deletion keeps household history and drops her ledgers.';
+END $$;
+
+-- 11. Every refusal the ai_service maps carries an explicit SQLSTATE (PL/pgSQL defaults to
+--     P0001, which nafaqah_service._map_db_error / household_permissions._map_rpc_error
+--     would not recognise).
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    r record;
+    v_chunk text;
+    v_checked int := 0;
+BEGIN
+    FOR r IN
+        SELECT p.proname, p.prosrc
+        FROM pg_proc p
+        JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
+        WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
+          AND p.proname IN (
+              'nafaqah_resolve_actor', 'nafaqah_require_member', 'get_member_allowance_status',
+              'set_member_allowance', 'get_spouse_reimbursement_balance', 'record_spouse_reimbursement',
+              'validate_transaction_nafaqah_class', 'household_resolve_actor', 'household_require_admin',
+              'promote_member_to_admin', 'revoke_admin', 'transfer_primary_admin',
+              'protect_primary_admin_membership', 'get_household_members')
+    LOOP
+        -- string literals are blanked first: messages may contain ';'
+        FOREACH v_chunk IN ARRAY (regexp_split_to_array(
+            regexp_replace(r.prosrc, '''([^'']|'''')*''', '''''', 'g'), 'RAISE EXCEPTION'))[2:]
+        LOOP
+            v_checked := v_checked + 1;
+            IF split_part(v_chunk, ';', 1) !~ 'ERRCODE' THEN
+                RAISE EXCEPTION 'RAISE without ERRCODE in %: %', r.proname, left(split_part(v_chunk, ';', 1), 120);
+            END IF;
+        END LOOP;
+    END LOOP;
+    IF v_checked < 20 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expected to inspect the Nafaqah and role RPC refusals, inspected only %', v_checked;
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: % mapped RPC refusals set an explicit SQLSTATE.', v_checked;
+END $$;
+
+ROLLBACK;
diff --git a/supabase/tests/20_admin_permissions_and_co_admins.sql b/supabase/tests/20_admin_permissions_and_co_admins.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..d4ca63e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/tests/20_admin_permissions_and_co_admins.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,657 @@
+-- ============================================================================
+-- Test 20 (owner decision on DB-16 / DB-18): admin permissions, co-admins and
+-- the household's primary admin, in roommate and family households.
+--
+--   * A member creates transactions and edits/deletes only their own; only an
+--     admin edits/deletes another member's. The creator is bound at insert and
+--     immutable.
+--   * Only an admin moves money out of a shared pool; members keep moving
+--     money between their own personal accounts.
+--   * Admins promote/revoke co-admins. Co-admins cannot demote or remove the
+--     primary admin; only the primary admin transfers primary ownership. The
+--     last-admin protection (BUG-03 / DB-12) keeps working.
+--   * Family Nafaqah: any admin (co-admins included, never the wife herself)
+--     sets the wife's allowance; the husband resolves to the primary admin.
+-- ============================================================================
+\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
+
+BEGIN;
+
+-- Fixtures ------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- Roommates R: P (primary admin), C (member, promoted later), M (member).
+-- Family F: H (husband, primary admin), W (wife, member), K (adult child, member),
+--           U (uncle/provider, member - promoted to co-admin later).
+-- Outsider household X: O (admin).
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    INSERT INTO auth.users (id, email) VALUES
+        ('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1', 'perm-p@test.local'),

+-- Helpers: run SQL as an authenticated user / as the service role; return SQLSTATE.
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.as_user(p_sub text, p_sql text)
+RETURNS text
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', p_sub, 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+    EXECUTE 'SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated';
+    BEGIN
+        EXECUTE p_sql;
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+        EXECUTE 'RESET ROLE';
+        PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', '', true);
+        RETURN SQLSTATE;
+    END;
+    EXECUTE 'RESET ROLE';
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', '', true);
+    RETURN '00000';
+END;
+$$;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION pg_temp.as_user(text, text) TO authenticated;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.as_service(p_sql text)
+RETURNS text
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{"role": "service_role"}', true);
+    EXECUTE 'SET LOCAL ROLE service_role';
+    BEGIN
+        EXECUTE p_sql;
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+        EXECUTE 'RESET ROLE';
+        PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', '', true);
+        RETURN SQLSTATE;
+    END;
+    EXECUTE 'RESET ROLE';
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', '', true);
+    RETURN '00000';
+END;
+$$;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION pg_temp.as_service(text) TO service_role;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.expect(p_label text, p_got text, p_want text)
+RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+    IF p_got IS DISTINCT FROM p_want THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'FAILED (%): got SQLSTATE %, expected %', p_label, p_got, p_want;
+    END IF;
+END;
+$$;
+
+-- 1. Catalog: primary admin column, no client path to roles, hardened RPCs ----
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_list text;
+BEGIN
+    IF (SELECT owner_user_id FROM public.households WHERE id = 'f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001')
+       IS DISTINCT FROM 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1'::uuid THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'FAILED: roommate household primary admin is not its first admin';
+    END IF;
+    IF (SELECT owner_user_id FROM public.households WHERE id = 'f2bb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001')
+       IS DISTINCT FROM 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b1'::uuid THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'FAILED: family household primary admin is not the husband';
+    END IF;
+    IF EXISTS (
+        SELECT 1 FROM public.households h
+        WHERE h.owner_user_id IS NULL
+          AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships m WHERE m.household_id = h.id AND m.role = 'admin')
+    ) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'FAILED: a household with admins has no primary admin';
+    END IF;
+
+    IF has_column_privilege('authenticated', 'public.households', 'owner_user_id', 'UPDATE') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: clients can rewrite households.owner_user_id';
+    END IF;
+    IF NOT has_column_privilege('authenticated', 'public.households', 'name', 'UPDATE')
+       OR NOT has_column_privilege('authenticated', 'public.households', 'payday_day', 'UPDATE') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'REGRESSION: admins lost UPDATE on household settings columns';
+    END IF;
+    IF has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.household_memberships', 'INSERT')
+       OR has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.household_memberships', 'UPDATE')
+       OR has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.household_memberships', 'DELETE') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: clients can write household_memberships directly';
+    END IF;
+    IF has_column_privilege('authenticated', 'public.users', 'role', 'UPDATE')
+       OR has_column_privilege('authenticated', 'public.users', 'household_id', 'UPDATE') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: clients can rewrite users.role / users.household_id';
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT string_agg(p.proname, ', ') INTO v_list
+    FROM pg_proc p
+    WHERE p.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace
+      AND p.proname IN ('get_household_members', 'promote_member_to_admin', 'revoke_admin',
+                        'transfer_primary_admin', 'household_resolve_actor', 'household_member_role',
+                        'household_primary_admin_id', 'household_apply_role', 'household_require_admin',
+                        'protect_primary_admin_membership', 'maintain_household_primary_admin',
+                        'bind_transaction_creator', 'enforce_transaction_write_permission',
+                        'transfer_between_accounts', 'set_member_role', 'remove_member', 'get_user_households',
+                        'transaction_account_matches', 'transaction_personal_account_writable',
+                        'update_account_balance_on_transaction')
+      AND (NOT p.prosecdef OR NOT EXISTS (
+          SELECT 1 FROM unnest(p.proconfig) c WHERE c LIKE 'search_path=%'
+      ));
+    IF v_list IS NOT NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: definer functions without pinned search_path: %', v_list;
+    END IF;
+
+    IF has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.promote_member_to_admin(uuid, uuid, uuid)', 'EXECUTE')
+       OR has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.revoke_admin(uuid, uuid, uuid)', 'EXECUTE')
+       OR has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.transfer_primary_admin(uuid, uuid, uuid)', 'EXECUTE')
+       OR has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.get_household_members(uuid, uuid)', 'EXECUTE')
+       OR has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.get_user_households()', 'EXECUTE') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: anon can execute role-management RPCs';
+    END IF;
+    IF has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.household_apply_role(uuid, uuid, text)', 'EXECUTE')
+       OR has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.household_resolve_actor(uuid)', 'EXECUTE')
+       OR has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.household_require_admin(uuid, uuid)', 'EXECUTE') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: clients can call internal role helpers';
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: primary admin backfilled; roles, owner and memberships have no client write path; RPCs hardened.';
+END $$;
+
+-- 2. Direct table writes cannot change roles or the primary admin --------------
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('admin updates membership role directly',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1',
+            $q$UPDATE public.household_memberships SET role = 'admin' WHERE user_id = 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3'$q$),
+        '42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('member promotes self via users.role',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3',
+            $q$UPDATE public.users SET role = 'admin' WHERE id = 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3'$q$),
+        '42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('admin rewrites owner_user_id',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1',
+            $q$UPDATE public.households SET owner_user_id = 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3' WHERE id = 'f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'$q$),
+        '42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('admin still updates household settings',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1',
+            $q$UPDATE public.households SET payday_day = 25 WHERE id = 'f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'$q$),
+        '00000');
+    IF (SELECT payday_day FROM public.households WHERE id = 'f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001') <> 25 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'REGRESSION: admin household settings update had no effect';
+    END IF;
+    IF (SELECT role FROM public.household_memberships WHERE user_id = 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3') <> 'member' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: a role changed through a direct write';
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: roles and the primary admin change only through the RPCs.';
+END $$;
+
+-- 3. Transaction creator binding (DB-18) ----------------------------------------
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    -- Older builds omit user_id: the creator is filled in from the JWT.
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('member inserts without user_id',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3',
+            $q$INSERT INTO public.transactions (id, household_id, amount, merchant, category_code, timestamp)
