+       IS DISTINCT FROM 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3'::uuid THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'FAILED: creator not bound to the caller on insert';
+    END IF;
+
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('member inserts as another member',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3',
+            $q$INSERT INTO public.transactions (household_id, user_id, amount, merchant, category_code, timestamp)
+               VALUES ('f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1', 9, 'Spoof', 'OPEX-GROCERY', now())$q$),
+        '42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('admin inserts as another member',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1',
+            $q$INSERT INTO public.transactions (household_id, user_id, amount, merchant, category_code, timestamp)
+               VALUES ('f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3', 9, 'Spoof', 'OPEX-GROCERY', now())$q$),
+        '42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('member inserts into another household',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3',
+            $q$INSERT INTO public.transactions (household_id, amount, merchant, category_code, timestamp)
+               VALUES ('f2cc0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 9, 'X', 'OPEX-GROCERY', now())$q$),
+        '42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('member changes the creator of own transaction',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3',
+            $q$UPDATE public.transactions SET user_id = 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1' WHERE id = 'f2e00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003'$q$),
+        '42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('admin reattributes a member transaction',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1',
+            $q$UPDATE public.transactions SET user_id = 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1' WHERE id = 'f2e00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003'$q$),
+        '42501');
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: the creator is bound at insert (older builds keep working) and never changes.';
+END $$;
+
+-- 4. Owner-or-admin edits and deletes (roommates) ---------------------------------
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('member edits own',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3',
+            $q$UPDATE public.transactions SET merchant = 'Snacks (fixed)' WHERE id = 'f2e00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003'$q$),
+        '00000');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('member edits admin transaction',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3',
+            $q$UPDATE public.transactions SET amount = 1 WHERE id = 'f2e00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'$q$),
+        '42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('member deletes admin transaction',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3',
+            $q$DELETE FROM public.transactions WHERE id = 'f2e00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'$q$),
+        '42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('member edits another member transaction',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2',
+            $q$UPDATE public.transactions SET amount = 1 WHERE id = 'f2e00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003'$q$),
+        '42501');
+    IF (SELECT amount FROM public.transactions WHERE id = 'f2e00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001') <> 120
+       OR (SELECT amount FROM public.transactions WHERE id = 'f2e00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003') <> 15 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (DB-18): a member changed another member''s transaction';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Admin edits a member's transaction that sits on the member's personal account.
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('admin edits member transaction on member account',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1',
+            $q$UPDATE public.transactions SET amount = 45 WHERE id = 'f2e00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'$q$),
+        '00000');
+    IF (SELECT balance FROM public.accounts WHERE id = 'f2ac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002') <> 455 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'FAILED: account balance not adjusted by the admin edit (got %)',
+            (SELECT balance FROM public.accounts WHERE id = 'f2ac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002');
+    END IF;
+    -- ... but cannot move it onto the admin's own personal account.
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('admin moves member transaction to own account',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1',
+            $q$UPDATE public.transactions SET account_id = 'f2ac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000005' WHERE id = 'f2e00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'$q$),
+        '42501');
+
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('admin deletes member transaction',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1',
+            $q$DELETE FROM public.transactions WHERE id = 'f2e00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003'$q$),
+        '00000');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('member deletes own',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3',
+            $q$DELETE FROM public.transactions WHERE id = 'f2e00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000010'$q$),
+        '00000');
+    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.transactions WHERE id IN ('f2e00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003', 'f2e00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000010')) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'FAILED: permitted deletes did not delete';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Another household's admin sees nothing to change.
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('outsider admin edits',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c1',
+            $q$UPDATE public.transactions SET amount = 1 WHERE id = 'f2e00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'$q$),
+        '00000');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('outsider admin deletes',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c1',
+            $q$DELETE FROM public.transactions WHERE id = 'f2e00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'$q$),
+        '00000');
+    IF (SELECT amount FROM public.transactions WHERE id = 'f2e00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001') IS DISTINCT FROM 120 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: another household changed this household''s transaction';
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: members edit/delete only their own transactions; admins any in their household.';
+END $$;
+

+
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('primary admin promotes C',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1',
+            $q$SELECT public.promote_member_to_admin('f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2')$q$),
+        '00000');
+    IF (SELECT role FROM public.household_memberships WHERE user_id = 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2') <> 'admin'
+       OR (SELECT role FROM public.users WHERE id = 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2') <> 'admin' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'FAILED: promotion not applied to membership and users.role';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- The co-admin can do what admins do...
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('co-admin edits member transaction',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2',
+            $q$UPDATE public.transactions SET merchant = 'Groceries (checked)' WHERE id = 'f2e00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'$q$),
+        '00000');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('co-admin moves pool money',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2',
+            $q$SELECT public.transfer_between_accounts('f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
+                'f2ac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2ac0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000005', 10, 0, NULL)$q$),
+        '00000');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('co-admin promotes M',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2',
+            $q$SELECT public.promote_member_to_admin('f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3')$q$),
+        '00000');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('co-admin revokes M',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2',
+            $q$SELECT public.revoke_admin('f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3')$q$),
+        '00000');
+    IF (SELECT role FROM public.household_memberships WHERE user_id = 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3') <> 'member' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'FAILED: revoke_admin did not demote M';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- ... except touch the primary admin.
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('co-admin revokes primary admin',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2',
+            $q$SELECT public.revoke_admin('f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1')$q$),
+        '42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('co-admin demotes primary via set_member_role',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2',
+            $q$SELECT public.set_member_role('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1', 'member')$q$),
+        '42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('co-admin removes primary via remove_member',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2',
+            $q$SELECT public.remove_member('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1')$q$),
+        '42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('co-admin transfers primary admin',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2',
+            $q$SELECT public.transfer_primary_admin('f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2')$q$),
+        '42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('primary admin demotes self',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1',
+            $q$SELECT public.revoke_admin('f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1')$q$),
+        '42501');
+    IF (SELECT role FROM public.household_memberships WHERE user_id = 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1') <> 'admin'
+       OR (SELECT owner_user_id FROM public.households WHERE id = 'f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001')
+          IS DISTINCT FROM 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1'::uuid THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: the primary admin was demoted or replaced';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- A co-admin may step down.
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('co-admin revokes self',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2',
+            $q$SELECT public.revoke_admin('f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2')$q$),
+        '00000');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('former co-admin edits member transaction',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2',
+            $q$UPDATE public.transactions SET amount = 2 WHERE id = 'f2e00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'$q$),
+        '42501');
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: admins manage co-admins; co-admins cannot demote, remove or replace the primary admin.';
+END $$;
+
+-- 7. Transfer of primary admin ----------------------------------------------------
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('primary admin transfers to self',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1',
+            $q$SELECT public.transfer_primary_admin('f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1')$q$),
+        '22023');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('primary admin transfers to an outsider',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1',
+            $q$SELECT public.transfer_primary_admin('f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c1')$q$),
+        'P0002');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('primary admin transfers to member M',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1',
+            $q$SELECT public.transfer_primary_admin('f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3')$q$),
+        '00000');
+    IF (SELECT owner_user_id FROM public.households WHERE id = 'f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001')
+       IS DISTINCT FROM 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3'::uuid
+       OR (SELECT role FROM public.household_memberships WHERE user_id = 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3') <> 'admin'
+       OR (SELECT role FROM public.household_memberships WHERE user_id = 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1') <> 'admin' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'FAILED: primary admin transfer did not make M primary while P stays admin';
+    END IF;
+    -- P is now a co-admin: the new primary admin is protected from them.
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('former primary revokes new primary',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1',
+            $q$SELECT public.revoke_admin('f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3')$q$),
+        '42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('new primary revokes former primary',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3',
+            $q$SELECT public.revoke_admin('f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1')$q$),
+        '00000');
+    -- get_user_households() reports the primary flag; members list orders primary first.
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3', 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+    IF NOT (SELECT is_primary FROM public.get_user_households() WHERE household_id = 'f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'FAILED: get_user_households() does not flag the primary admin';
+    END IF;
+    IF (SELECT user_id FROM public.get_household_members('f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001') LIMIT 1)
+       IS DISTINCT FROM 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3'::uuid THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'FAILED: get_household_members() does not list the primary admin first';
+    END IF;
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', '', true);
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('outsider lists members',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c1',
+            $q$SELECT count(*) FROM public.get_household_members('f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001')$q$),
+        '42501');
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: only the primary admin transfers primary admin; the new primary is protected.';
+END $$;
+
+-- 8. Service role acts only for the verified user ---------------------------------
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('service role as member promotes',
+        pg_temp.as_service(
+            $q$SELECT public.promote_member_to_admin('f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1')$q$),
+        '42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('service role without actor',
+        pg_temp.as_service(
+            $q$SELECT public.promote_member_to_admin('f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2')$q$),
+        '42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('service role as primary admin promotes',
+        pg_temp.as_service(
+            $q$SELECT public.promote_member_to_admin('f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3')$q$),
+        '00000');
+    IF (SELECT role FROM public.household_memberships WHERE user_id = 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2') <> 'admin' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'FAILED: service-role promotion for the verified primary admin not applied';
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: the service role acts only on behalf of an authorised actor.';
+END $$;
+
+-- 9. Last-admin protection and primary handover ------------------------------------
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    -- Outsider household: O is the sole (and primary) admin of a one-person household.
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('sole admin demotes self',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c1',
+            $q$SELECT public.revoke_admin('f2cc0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c1')$q$),
+        '42501');
+
+    -- Roommates: M (primary) leaves while P is no longer admin but C is: C becomes primary.
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('primary admin leaves',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3', $q$SELECT public.leave_household()$q$),
+        '00000');
+    IF (SELECT owner_user_id FROM public.households WHERE id = 'f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001')
+       IS DISTINCT FROM 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2'::uuid THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'FAILED: primary admin did not pass to the remaining admin (got %)',
+            (SELECT owner_user_id FROM public.households WHERE id = 'f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001');
+    END IF;
+
+    -- C is now the sole admin with P remaining: last-admin protection holds.
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('sole admin leaves with members remaining',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2', $q$SELECT public.leave_household()$q$),
+        'P0001');
+
+    -- Deleting the sole primary admin's account (in their own session, as in-app
+    -- account deletion) hands the household to P (DB-12); the cascade that clears
+    -- them from transactions is not blocked by the creator/edit rules.
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2', 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+    DELETE FROM auth.users WHERE id = 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2';
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', '', true);
+    IF (SELECT owner_user_id FROM public.households WHERE id = 'f2aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001')
+       IS DISTINCT FROM 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1'::uuid
+       OR (SELECT role FROM public.household_memberships WHERE user_id = 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1') <> 'admin' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'FAILED: account deletion did not hand primary admin to the successor';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- A deleted account's transactions stay, unattributed (ON DELETE SET NULL is allowed).
+    IF (SELECT user_id FROM public.transactions WHERE id = 'f2e00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000006') IS NOT NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'FAILED: deleted creator not cleared from transaction';
+    END IF;
+    -- Unattributed transactions are admin-only.
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('admin edits unattributed transaction',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1',
+            $q$UPDATE public.transactions SET merchant = 'Internet (legacy)' WHERE id = 'f2e00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000006'$q$),
+        '00000');
+
+    -- Deleting a whole household still cascades cleanly.
+    DELETE FROM public.households WHERE id = 'f2cc0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: last-admin protection, primary handover on leave and account deletion, household delete.';
+END $$;
+
+-- 10. Family mode: same rules, Nafaqah keeps working with co-admins -----------------
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_status jsonb;
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('wife edits own expense',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b2',
+            $q$UPDATE public.transactions SET merchant = 'Pharmacy (vitamins)' WHERE id = 'f2e00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000005'$q$),
+        '00000');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('wife edits husband expense',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b2',
+            $q$UPDATE public.transactions SET amount = 1 WHERE id = 'f2e00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004'$q$),
+        '42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('child deletes wife expense',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b3',
+            $q$DELETE FROM public.transactions WHERE id = 'f2e00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000005'$q$),
+        '42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('husband (admin) edits wife expense',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b1',
+            $q$UPDATE public.transactions SET category_code = 'OPEX-MISC' WHERE id = 'f2e00000-0000-0000-0000-000000000005'$q$),
+        '00000');
+
+    IF public.nafaqah_husband_id('f2bb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001') IS DISTINCT FROM 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b1'::uuid THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'FAILED: husband is not resolved to the primary admin';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Uncle U (provider, member) cannot set the allowance; as a co-admin he can.
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('member provider sets allowance',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b4',
+            $q$SELECT public.set_member_allowance('f2bb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b2', 500, '2026-11')$q$),
+        '42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('husband promotes U',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b1',
+            $q$SELECT public.promote_member_to_admin('f2bb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b4')$q$),
+        '00000');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('co-admin sets allowance',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b4',
+            $q$SELECT public.set_member_allowance('f2bb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b2', 500, '2026-11')$q$),
+        '00000');
+    -- Making the wife a co-admin never lets her set her own allowance.
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('husband promotes wife',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b1',
+            $q$SELECT public.promote_member_to_admin('f2bb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b2')$q$),
+        '00000');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('wife co-admin sets own allowance',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b2',
+            $q$SELECT public.set_member_allowance('f2bb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b2', 9000, '2026-11')$q$),
+        '42501');
+    -- Co-admin wife cannot demote the husband (primary admin).
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('wife co-admin revokes husband',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b2',
+            $q$SELECT public.revoke_admin('f2bb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b1')$q$),
+        '42501');
+    -- The husband stays the Nafaqah provider even with a second provider admin.
+    IF public.nafaqah_husband_id('f2bb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001') IS DISTINCT FROM 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b1'::uuid THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'FAILED: a co-admin displaced the husband as Nafaqah provider';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- The wife still reads her own allowance.
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b2', 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+    SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated;
+    v_status := public.get_member_allowance_status('f2bb0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b2', '2026-11', NULL);
+    RESET ROLE;
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', '', true);
+    IF (v_status ->> 'allocated')::numeric <> 500 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'FAILED: wife cannot read her allowance (got %)', v_status;
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: family mode follows the same admin rules; Nafaqah allowance respects co-admins.';
+END $$;
+
+ROLLBACK;
diff --git a/supabase/tests/21_review_backend_contracts.sql b/supabase/tests/21_review_backend_contracts.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..80de3d0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/tests/21_review_backend_contracts.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,198 @@
+-- ============================================================================
+-- Test 21 (final backend review, docs/review/audit/final_review_backend.md)
+--
+--   FR-B-04  users.financial_role decides who is the wife (Nafaqah creditor),
+--            who is the husband and whether a household is a family at all
+--            (20261020300000 / 20261020400000). Members must not be able to
+--            change it on their own row: only the invite RPCs (SECURITY
+--            DEFINER) set it. display_name and payday_day stay editable.
+--   FR-B-01  The roommate settlement row written by ai_service
+--            (supabase_client.record_household_reimbursement) uses only
+--            columns that exist on public.transactions, passes every trigger
+--            as the service role and never touches a budget. The previous
+--            payload (paid_by / notes columns, category OPEX-SETTLEMENT) is
+--            rejected by the schema.
+-- ============================================================================
+\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
+
+BEGIN;
+
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    INSERT INTO auth.users (id, email) VALUES
+        ('f2100000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1', 'rev-a@test.local'),
+        ('f2100000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2', 'rev-b@test.local'),
+        ('f2100000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b1', 'rev-h@test.local'),
+        ('f2100000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b2', 'rev-w@test.local');
+
+    INSERT INTO public.households (id, name, invite_code) VALUES
+        ('f21a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Review Roommates', 'REVROOMCODE00001'),
+        ('f21b0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Review Family', 'REVFAMCODE000001');
+    -- Roommate household (household_type, migration 20261020900000).
+    UPDATE public.households SET household_type = 'roommates' WHERE id = 'f21a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'f21a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'admin', financial_role = 'peer'
+    WHERE id = 'f2100000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1';
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'f21a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'member', financial_role = 'peer'
+    WHERE id = 'f2100000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2';
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'f21b0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'admin', financial_role = 'provider'
+    WHERE id = 'f2100000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b1';
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'f21b0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'member', financial_role = 'spouse'
+    WHERE id = 'f2100000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b2';
+
+    INSERT INTO public.budgets (household_id, month, cycle_key, category_code, allocated_amount, spent_amount)
+    VALUES ('f21a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', date_trunc('month', now())::date,
+            (SELECT cycle_key FROM public.get_saudi_cycle_for_timestamp(now(), 27)), 'OPEX-MISC', 500, 0);
+END $$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.as_user(p_sub text, p_sql text)
+RETURNS text
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', p_sub, 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+    EXECUTE 'SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated';
+    BEGIN
+        EXECUTE p_sql;
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+        EXECUTE 'RESET ROLE';
+        PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', '', true);
+        RETURN SQLSTATE;
+    END;
+    EXECUTE 'RESET ROLE';
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', '', true);
+    RETURN '00000';
+END;
+$$;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION pg_temp.as_user(text, text) TO authenticated;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.as_service(p_sql text)
+RETURNS text
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{"role": "service_role"}', true);
+    EXECUTE 'SET LOCAL ROLE service_role';
+    BEGIN
+        EXECUTE p_sql;
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+        EXECUTE 'RESET ROLE';
+        PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', '', true);
+        RETURN SQLSTATE;
+    END;
+    EXECUTE 'RESET ROLE';
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', '', true);
+    RETURN '00000';
+END;
+$$;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION pg_temp.as_service(text) TO service_role;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.expect(p_label text, p_got text, p_want text)
+RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+    IF p_got IS DISTINCT FROM p_want THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION '%: got SQLSTATE %, expected %', p_label, p_got, p_want;
+    END IF;
+END;
+$$;
+
+-- FR-B-04 --------------------------------------------------------------------
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_role text;
+BEGIN
+    -- A roommate cannot make themselves a "wife" (would turn the household into a family and
+    -- let them raise Nafaqah debts against the provider).
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('roommate sets own financial_role',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2100000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2',
+            $q$UPDATE public.users SET financial_role = 'spouse' WHERE id = 'f2100000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2'$q$),
+        '42501');
+    -- The wife cannot drop out of her own reimbursement ledger, the husband cannot swap roles.
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('wife sets own financial_role',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2100000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b2',
+            $q$UPDATE public.users SET financial_role = 'provider' WHERE id = 'f2100000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b2'$q$),
+        '42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('husband sets own financial_role',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2100000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b1',
+            $q$UPDATE public.users SET financial_role = 'spouse' WHERE id = 'f2100000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b1'$q$),
+        '42501');
+
+    SELECT financial_role INTO v_role FROM public.users WHERE id = 'f2100000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2';
+    IF v_role IS DISTINCT FROM 'peer' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (FR-B-04): roommate financial_role is now %', v_role;
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Profile fields stay editable on the own row.
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('own display_name',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2100000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2',
+            $q$UPDATE public.users SET display_name = 'Renamed' WHERE id = 'f2100000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2'$q$),
+        '00000');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('own payday_day',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2100000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2',
+            $q$UPDATE public.users SET payday_day = 25 WHERE id = 'f2100000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2'$q$),
+        '00000');
+
+    IF has_column_privilege('authenticated', 'public.users', 'financial_role', 'UPDATE')
+       OR has_column_privilege('anon', 'public.users', 'financial_role', 'UPDATE') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (FR-B-04): a client role can still UPDATE users.financial_role';
+    END IF;
+
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: users.financial_role is not client-writable; profile fields still are.';
+END $$;
+
+-- FR-B-01 --------------------------------------------------------------------
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_spent numeric;
+    v_row public.transactions%ROWTYPE;
+BEGIN
+    -- The payload ai_service sends today (service role, creator = verified caller).
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('settlement row as written by ai_service',
+        pg_temp.as_service($q$
+            INSERT INTO public.transactions (
+                id, household_id, user_id, amount, currency, merchant, category_code,
+                beneficiary_type, beneficiary_id, settlement_target_id, is_settlement, source, raw_sms, timestamp)
+            VALUES (
+                'f21c0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f21a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
+                'f2100000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2', '30.00', 'SAR', 'Settlement Reimbursement (STC_PAY)', NULL,
+                'individual', 'f2100000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1', 'f2100000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1', true,
+                'manual',
+                'Settlement | PaidBy: f2100000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2 | Recipient: f2100000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1 | Method: STC_PAY',
+                now())
+        $q$),
+        '00000');
+
+    SELECT * INTO v_row FROM public.transactions WHERE id = 'f21c0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+    IF v_row.amount IS DISTINCT FROM 30.00 OR v_row.cycle_key IS NULL OR v_row.is_settlement IS NOT TRUE THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'settlement row stored wrongly: amount %, cycle_key %, is_settlement %',
+            v_row.amount, v_row.cycle_key, v_row.is_settlement;
+    END IF;
+
+    SELECT spent_amount INTO v_spent FROM public.budgets
+    WHERE household_id = 'f21a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND category_code = 'OPEX-MISC';
+    IF v_spent <> 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'a settlement was counted as spending (OPEX-MISC spent = %)', v_spent;
+    END IF;
+
+    -- The previous payload could never be stored.
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('old payload: paid_by / notes columns',
+        pg_temp.as_service($q$
+            INSERT INTO public.transactions (household_id, user_id, amount, merchant, paid_by, notes, timestamp)
+            VALUES ('f21a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2100000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2', 30,
+                    'Settlement', 'f2100000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2', 'x', now())
+        $q$),
+        '42703');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('old payload: OPEX-SETTLEMENT category',
+        pg_temp.as_service($q$
+            INSERT INTO public.transactions (household_id, user_id, amount, merchant, category_code, is_settlement, timestamp)
+            VALUES ('f21a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2100000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2', 30,
+                    'Settlement', 'OPEX-SETTLEMENT', true, now())
+        $q$),
+        '23503');
+
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: the roommate settlement row fits the real schema and never counts as spending.';
+END $$;
+
+ROLLBACK;
diff --git a/supabase/tests/22_e2e_helper_rpcs_and_sub_category_visibility.sql b/supabase/tests/22_e2e_helper_rpcs_and_sub_category_visibility.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..806a9fb
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/tests/22_e2e_helper_rpcs_and_sub_category_visibility.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,306 @@
+-- ============================================================================
+-- Test 22 (real-stack e2e follow-ups, docs/review/audit/e2e_results.md)
+--
+--   E2E-04  household_primary_admin_id(uuid), nafaqah_husband_id(uuid) and
+--           nafaqah_is_spouse_member(uuid, uuid) are SECURITY DEFINER helpers
+--           with no membership check. They must not be callable by clients
+--           (they leaked another household's admin / husband id and answered
+--           "is X the wife of household H" for any household), while every
+--           SECURITY DEFINER function and trigger that uses them keeps working
+--           for authenticated callers.
+--   E2E-05  cost_control_sub_categories has no household_id. A row is readable
+--           only when its parent category is: a global code, or a code of the
+--           caller's active household (same rule as cost_control_codes_select).
+--           Clients cannot write the table; anon cannot read it.
+--
+-- Migration: 20261020600000_e2e_helper_rpcs_and_sub_category_visibility.sql
+-- ============================================================================
+\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
+
+BEGIN;
+
+-- Fixtures ------------------------------------------------------------------
+-- Family household X: husband H (admin, provider), wife W (member, spouse).
+-- Roommate household Y: admin P (peer), member Q (peer).
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    INSERT INTO auth.users (id, email) VALUES
+        ('f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1', 'e2e22-h@test.local'),
+        ('f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2', 'e2e22-w@test.local'),
+        ('f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b1', 'e2e22-p@test.local'),
+        ('f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b2', 'e2e22-q@test.local');
+
+    INSERT INTO public.households (id, name, invite_code) VALUES
+        ('f22a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'E2E22 Family', 'E2E22FAMCODE0001'),
+        ('f22b0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'E2E22 Flat', 'E2E22FLATCODE001');
+    -- Roommate household (household_type, migration 20261020900000).
+    UPDATE public.households SET household_type = 'roommates' WHERE id = 'f22b0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'f22a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'admin', financial_role = 'provider'
+    WHERE id = 'f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1';
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'f22a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'member', financial_role = 'spouse'
+    WHERE id = 'f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2';
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'f22b0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'admin', financial_role = 'peer'
+    WHERE id = 'f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b1';
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'f22b0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'member', financial_role = 'peer'
+    WHERE id = 'f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b2';
+
+    INSERT INTO public.cost_control_codes (household_id, code, category, keywords, is_system) VALUES
+        ('f22a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'CUSTOM-E2E22X', 'X only', '{}', false),
+        ('f22b0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'CUSTOM-E2E22Y', 'Y only', '{}', false);
+    INSERT INTO public.cost_control_sub_categories (parent_code, sub_code, name_en, name_ar) VALUES
+        ('CUSTOM-E2E22X', 'x-sub', 'X private', 'X'),
+        ('CUSTOM-E2E22Y', 'y-sub', 'Y private', 'Y');
+
+    -- Fixture sanity (as the owner): the helpers still answer for internal callers.
+    IF public.household_primary_admin_id('f22a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001')
+       IS DISTINCT FROM 'f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1'::uuid THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'fixture: X has no primary admin';
+    END IF;
+    IF public.nafaqah_husband_id('f22a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001')
+       IS DISTINCT FROM 'f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1'::uuid THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'fixture: X has no husband';
+    END IF;
+    IF NOT public.nafaqah_is_spouse_member('f22a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'fixture: W is not the wife of X';
+    END IF;
+END $$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.as_user(p_sub text, p_sql text)
+RETURNS text
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', p_sub, 'role', 'authenticated')::text, true);
+    EXECUTE 'SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated';
+    BEGIN
+        EXECUTE p_sql;
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+        EXECUTE 'RESET ROLE';
+        PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', '', true);
+        RETURN SQLSTATE;
+    END;
+    EXECUTE 'RESET ROLE';
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', '', true);
+    RETURN '00000';
+END;
+$$;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION pg_temp.as_user(text, text) TO authenticated;
+
+-- Runs a scalar count query as a user; NULL when the query itself is refused.
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.count_as(p_role text, p_sub text, p_sql text)
+RETURNS bigint
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v bigint;
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', json_build_object('sub', p_sub, 'role', p_role)::text, true);
+    EXECUTE format('SET LOCAL ROLE %I', p_role);
+    BEGIN
+        EXECUTE p_sql INTO v;
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+        v := NULL;
+    END;
+    EXECUTE 'RESET ROLE';
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', '', true);
+    RETURN v;
+END;
+$$;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION pg_temp.count_as(text, text, text) TO authenticated, anon;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.expect(p_label text, p_got text, p_want text)
+RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+    IF p_got IS DISTINCT FROM p_want THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION '%: got SQLSTATE %, expected %', p_label, p_got, p_want;
+    END IF;
+END;
+$$;
+
+-- E2E-04: the helpers are not client-callable ---------------------------------
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_fn text;
+BEGIN
+    FOREACH v_fn IN ARRAY ARRAY['public.household_primary_admin_id(uuid)', 'public.nafaqah_husband_id(uuid)',
+                                'public.nafaqah_is_spouse_member(uuid, uuid)'] LOOP
+        IF has_function_privilege('authenticated', v_fn, 'EXECUTE')
+           OR has_function_privilege('anon', v_fn, 'EXECUTE') THEN
+            RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (E2E-04): % is client-callable', v_fn;
+        END IF;
+        IF NOT has_function_privilege('service_role', v_fn, 'EXECUTE') THEN
+            RAISE EXCEPTION 'E2E-04: service_role lost EXECUTE on %', v_fn;
+        END IF;
+    END LOOP;
+
+    -- An outsider (roommate P) probing the family household X.
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('outsider reads X primary admin',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b1',
+            $q$SELECT public.household_primary_admin_id('f22a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001')$q$), '42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('outsider reads X husband',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b1',
+            $q$SELECT public.nafaqah_husband_id('f22a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001')$q$), '42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('outsider probes X wife',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b1',
+            $q$SELECT public.nafaqah_is_spouse_member('f22a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2')$q$),
+        '42501');
+    -- Members do not need them either (the app never calls them).
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('member calls helper',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2',
+            $q$SELECT public.nafaqah_husband_id('f22a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001')$q$), '42501');
+
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: E2E-04 helpers are not client-callable; service_role keeps them.';
+END $$;
+
+-- E2E-04: every definer caller keeps working for authenticated users ----------
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_primary boolean;
+    v_count bigint;
+BEGIN
+    -- household_primary_admin_id via get_household_members (members see who is primary).
+    v_count := pg_temp.count_as('authenticated', 'f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2',
+        $q$SELECT count(*) FROM public.get_household_members('f22a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', NULL)
+           WHERE is_primary AND user_id = 'f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1'$q$);
+    IF v_count IS DISTINCT FROM 1 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'REGRESSION (E2E-04): get_household_members fails for a member (%)', v_count;
+    END IF;
+
+    -- nafaqah_is_spouse_member via the validate_transaction_nafaqah_class trigger: the wife
+    -- records a shared expense she paid, as herself through RLS.
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('wife inserts a wife_reimbursable expense',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2',
+            $q$INSERT INTO public.transactions (household_id, user_id, amount, merchant, category_code, timestamp, source, nafaqah_class, nafaqah_spouse_id)
+               VALUES ('f22a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2', 120.50, 'Panda', 'OPEX-GROCERY',
+                       now(), 'manual', 'wife_reimbursable', 'f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2')$q$),
+        '00000');
+    -- ...and the trigger still refuses a class naming a non-spouse.
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('class naming the husband',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1',
+            $q$INSERT INTO public.transactions (household_id, user_id, amount, merchant, category_code, timestamp, source, nafaqah_class, nafaqah_spouse_id)
+               VALUES ('f22a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1', 10, 'Panda', 'OPEX-GROCERY',
+                       now(), 'manual', 'wife_reimbursable', 'f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1')$q$),
+        '23503');
+
+    -- nafaqah_husband_id + nafaqah_is_spouse_member via the Nafaqah RPCs.
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('husband reads the reimbursement balance',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1',
+            $q$SELECT public.get_spouse_reimbursement_balance('f22a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2', NULL)$q$),
+        '00000');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('husband sets the wife allowance',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1',
+            $q$SELECT public.set_member_allowance('f22a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2', 250, NULL, NULL)$q$),
+        '00000');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('wife reads her allowance status',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2',
+            $q$SELECT public.get_member_allowance_status('f22a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2', NULL, NULL)$q$),
+        '00000');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('husband records a repayment',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1',
+            $q$SELECT public.record_spouse_reimbursement('f22a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2', 20.50, 'cash', NULL)$q$),
+        '00000');
+    -- The outsider is still refused by the RPCs' own checks, not by a missing helper.
+    IF pg_temp.as_user('f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b1',
+            $q$SELECT public.get_spouse_reimbursement_balance('f22a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2', NULL)$q$)
+       = '00000' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY: outsider read the reimbursement balance';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- household_primary_admin_id via protect_primary_admin_membership / revoke_admin: the
+    -- primary admin still cannot be demoted, through the RPC as a co-member.
+    SELECT (m.user_id = public.household_primary_admin_id(m.household_id)) INTO v_primary
+    FROM public.household_memberships m
+    WHERE m.household_id = 'f22a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND m.user_id = 'f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1';
+    IF NOT v_primary THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'fixture: H is not primary';
+    END IF;
+    IF pg_temp.as_user('f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1',
+            $q$SELECT public.revoke_admin('f22a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1', NULL)$q$)
+       = '00000' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'REGRESSION: the primary admin was demoted';
+    END IF;
+    IF (SELECT role FROM public.household_memberships
+        WHERE household_id = 'f22a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND user_id = 'f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1') <> 'admin' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'REGRESSION: primary admin membership changed';
+    END IF;
+
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: definer RPCs and triggers that use the helpers still work for members.';
+END $$;
+
+-- E2E-05: sub-categories follow their parent category's visibility ------------
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v bigint;
+BEGIN
+    -- The wife (household X) sees system and X's own sub-categories, never Y's.
+    v := pg_temp.count_as('authenticated', 'f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2',
+        $q$SELECT count(*) FROM public.cost_control_sub_categories WHERE parent_code = 'CUSTOM-E2E22Y'$q$);
+    IF v IS DISTINCT FROM 0 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (E2E-05): X member reads Y custom sub-categories (%)', v;
+    END IF;
+    v := pg_temp.count_as('authenticated', 'f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2',
+        $q$SELECT count(*) FROM public.cost_control_sub_categories WHERE parent_code = 'CUSTOM-E2E22X'$q$);
+    IF v IS DISTINCT FROM 1 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'REGRESSION (E2E-05): X member cannot read X custom sub-categories (%)', v;
+    END IF;
+    v := pg_temp.count_as('authenticated', 'f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2',
+        $q$SELECT count(*) FROM public.cost_control_sub_categories WHERE parent_code = 'OPEX-DINING'$q$);
+    IF v IS NULL OR v < 1 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'REGRESSION (E2E-05): system sub-categories are hidden (%)', v;
+    END IF;
+    -- A whole-table read shows exactly the visible rows.
+    v := pg_temp.count_as('authenticated', 'f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b2',
+        $q$SELECT count(*) FROM public.cost_control_sub_categories WHERE parent_code LIKE 'CUSTOM-E2E22%'$q$);
+    IF v IS DISTINCT FROM 1 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'E2E-05: Y member should see only Y custom sub-category (got %)', v;
+    END IF;
+
+    -- Clients cannot write definitions (ai_service writes them with the service role).
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('admin inserts a sub-category directly',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b1',
+            $q$INSERT INTO public.cost_control_sub_categories (parent_code, sub_code, name_en, name_ar)
+               VALUES ('OPEX-DINING', 'planted', 'Planted', 'Planted')$q$), '42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('admin renames another household''s sub-category',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b1',
+            $q$UPDATE public.cost_control_sub_categories SET name_en = 'pwned' WHERE parent_code = 'CUSTOM-E2E22X'$q$), '42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('admin deletes sub-categories',
+        pg_temp.as_user('f2200000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b1',
+            $q$DELETE FROM public.cost_control_sub_categories WHERE parent_code = 'CUSTOM-E2E22Y'$q$), '42501');
+    IF has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.cost_control_sub_categories', 'INSERT')
+       OR has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.cost_control_sub_categories', 'UPDATE')
+       OR has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.cost_control_sub_categories', 'DELETE')
+       OR has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.cost_control_sub_categories', 'TRUNCATE')
+       OR has_table_privilege('anon', 'public.cost_control_sub_categories', 'SELECT') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (E2E-05): client privileges remain on cost_control_sub_categories';
+    END IF;
+    IF NOT has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.cost_control_sub_categories', 'SELECT') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'REGRESSION (E2E-05): the app can no longer read sub-categories';
+    END IF;
+    v := pg_temp.count_as('anon', NULL, $q$SELECT count(*) FROM public.cost_control_sub_categories$q$);
+    IF v IS NOT NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (E2E-05): anon reads sub-categories (%)', v;
+    END IF;
+    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies
+               WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'cost_control_sub_categories'
+                 AND (qual = 'true' OR cmd <> 'SELECT')) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (E2E-05): permissive or write policy on cost_control_sub_categories';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- The service role (ai_service) still reads and writes every row.
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', '{"role": "service_role"}', true);
+    SET LOCAL ROLE service_role;
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v FROM public.cost_control_sub_categories WHERE parent_code LIKE 'CUSTOM-E2E22%';
+    UPDATE public.cost_control_sub_categories SET name_ar = 'X2' WHERE parent_code = 'CUSTOM-E2E22X';
+    RESET ROLE;
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', '', true);
+    IF v <> 2 THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'REGRESSION (E2E-05): service role sees % of 2 rows', v;
+    END IF;
+
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: E2E-05 sub-categories are visible only with their parent category; clients cannot write them.';
+END $$;
+
+ROLLBACK;
diff --git a/supabase/tests/23_fable_db_hardening.sql b/supabase/tests/23_fable_db_hardening.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..7c814a9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/tests/23_fable_db_hardening.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,383 @@
+-- ============================================================================
+-- Test 23 (independent Fable review, docs/review/audit/fable_review.md §B)
+-- Migration: 20261020700000_fable_db_hardening.sql
+--
+--   FABLE-DB-02  invite creator / claimer can delete their account
+--                (created_by ON DELETE SET NULL, used_by ON DELETE CASCADE;
+--                a spent invite is never re-opened)
+--   FABLE-DB-04  reallocate_budget refuses callers without JWT subject unless
+--                they are the service role
+--   FABLE-DB-05  nafaqah_current_cycle_key / generate_secure_invite_code are
+--                not client RPCs; the definer RPCs using them still work
+--   FABLE-DB-06  households: clients update only name, payday_day,
+--                monthly_income, rollover_rule
+--   FABLE-DB-07  household_dependents.linked_user_id is not client-writable;
+--                the targeted invite claim still links
+--   FABLE-DB-08  no TRUNCATE / TRIGGER for clients, no anon DML
+--   FABLE-DB-09  users.financial_role is not client-insertable
+-- ============================================================================
+\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
+
+BEGIN;
+
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    INSERT INTO auth.users (id, email) VALUES
+        ('f2300000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1', 'f23-h@test.local'),   -- H husband, primary admin of F
+        ('f2300000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2', 'f23-w@test.local'),   -- W wife, claims the spouse invite
+        ('f2300000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3', 'f23-k@test.local'),   -- K plain member of F
+        ('f2300000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000b1', 'f23-o@test.local'),   -- O admin of another household X
+        ('f2300000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c1', 'f23-n@test.local');   -- N new user without a profile row
+
+    INSERT INTO public.households (id, name, invite_code, payday_day) VALUES
+        ('f23a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'F23 Family', 'F23FAMILYCODE001', 27),

+-- Run p_sql as p_role with the given JWT claims ('' = none); return the SQLSTATE.
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.run_as(p_role text, p_claims text, p_sql text)
+RETURNS text
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_state text := '00000';
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', p_claims, true);
+    EXECUTE format('SET LOCAL ROLE %I', p_role);
+    BEGIN
+        EXECUTE p_sql;
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+        v_state := SQLSTATE;
+    END;
+    EXECUTE 'RESET ROLE';
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', '', true);
+    RETURN v_state;
+END;
+$$;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION pg_temp.run_as(text, text, text) TO PUBLIC;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.as_user(p_sub text, p_sql text)
+RETURNS text
+LANGUAGE sql
+AS $$
+    SELECT pg_temp.run_as('authenticated', json_build_object('sub', p_sub, 'role', 'authenticated')::text, p_sql);
+$$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.expect(p_label text, p_got text, p_want text)
+RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+    IF p_got IS DISTINCT FROM p_want THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION '%: got SQLSTATE %, expected %', p_label, p_got, p_want;
+    END IF;
+END;
+$$;
+

+-- FABLE-DB-08: no TRUNCATE / TRIGGER for clients, no anon DML ----------------------
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_bad text;
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('authenticated TRUNCATE transactions',
+        pg_temp.run_as('authenticated', '', $q$TRUNCATE public.transactions CASCADE$q$),
+        '42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('authenticated TRUNCATE household_invites',
+        pg_temp.run_as('authenticated', '', $q$TRUNCATE public.household_invites$q$),
+        '42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('anon INSERT invite_attempt_log',
+        pg_temp.run_as('anon', '{"role": "anon"}',
+            $q$INSERT INTO public.invite_attempt_log DEFAULT VALUES$q$),
+        '42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('anon DELETE users',
+        pg_temp.run_as('anon', '{"role": "anon"}', $q$DELETE FROM public.users$q$),
+        '42501');
+
+    SELECT string_agg(c.relname, ', ' ORDER BY c.relname) INTO v_bad
+    FROM pg_class c
+    WHERE c.relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p')
+      AND (has_table_privilege('anon', c.oid, 'TRUNCATE')
+           OR has_table_privilege('authenticated', c.oid, 'TRUNCATE')
+           OR has_table_privilege('authenticated', c.oid, 'TRIGGER')
+           OR has_table_privilege('anon', c.oid, 'TRIGGER')
+           OR has_table_privilege('authenticated', c.oid, 'REFERENCES')
+           OR has_any_column_privilege('anon', c.oid, 'INSERT')
+           OR has_any_column_privilege('anon', c.oid, 'UPDATE')
+           OR has_table_privilege('anon', c.oid, 'DELETE'));
+    IF v_bad IS NOT NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'VULNERABILITY (FABLE-DB-08): TRUNCATE/TRIGGER/REFERENCES or anon DML on %', v_bad;
+    END IF;
+
+    -- What clients really use is still there.
+    IF NOT has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.transactions', 'INSERT')
+       OR NOT has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.transactions', 'UPDATE')
+       OR NOT has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.transactions', 'DELETE')
+       OR NOT has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.budgets', 'UPDATE')
+       OR NOT has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.accounts', 'INSERT')
+       OR NOT has_table_privilege('service_role', 'public.transactions', 'TRUNCATE') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'REGRESSION (FABLE-DB-08): a privilege clients or the service role use was revoked';
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: FABLE-DB-08 no client TRUNCATE/TRIGGER/REFERENCES, no anon DML; client DML intact.';
+END $$;
+
+-- FABLE-DB-02: invite creator and claimer can delete their account ----------------
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_fk text;
+BEGIN
+    SELECT string_agg(a.attname || ':' || c.confdeltype::text, ',' ORDER BY a.attname) INTO v_fk
+    FROM pg_constraint c
+    JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.conrelid AND a.attnum = c.conkey[1]
+    WHERE c.conrelid = 'public.household_invites'::regclass AND c.contype = 'f'
+      AND a.attname IN ('created_by', 'used_by');
+    IF v_fk IS DISTINCT FROM 'created_by:n,used_by:c' THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (FABLE-DB-02): household_invites FKs are % (want created_by SET NULL, used_by CASCADE)', v_fk;
+    END IF;
+
+    -- W claimed F23WIFE1 above: deleting her account removes the spent invite
+    -- (it is NOT re-opened) and unlinks the manual member.
+    BEGIN
+        DELETE FROM auth.users WHERE id = 'f2300000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2';
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (FABLE-DB-02): deleting the invite claimer failed: %', SQLERRM;
+    END;
+    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_invites WHERE invite_code = 'F23WIFE1') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (FABLE-DB-02): the claimed invite survived its claimer (would be re-claimable)';
+    END IF;
+    IF (SELECT linked_user_id FROM public.household_dependents WHERE id = 'f23d0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001') IS NOT NULL THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'manual member still linked to a deleted user';
+    END IF;
+
+    -- H created both invites: deleting his account keeps the open invite (household-owned).
+    BEGIN
+        DELETE FROM auth.users WHERE id = 'f2300000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1';
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (FABLE-DB-02): deleting the invite creator failed: %', SQLERRM;
+    END;
+    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.household_invites
+                   WHERE invite_code = 'F23PEER1' AND created_by IS NULL AND used_by IS NULL) THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'BUG (FABLE-DB-02): the open invite of a deleted creator was lost or not unlinked';
+    END IF;
+    IF (SELECT owner_user_id FROM public.households WHERE id = 'f23a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001')
+       IS DISTINCT FROM 'f2300000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a3'::uuid THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'primary admin not handed over to the remaining member';
+    END IF;
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: FABLE-DB-02 invite creator and claimer can delete their accounts; spent invites are not re-opened.';
+END $$;
+
+ROLLBACK;

+--   installment_count; a paid-up plan is returned unchanged; another

+--   service role may execute it; SECURITY DEFINER with a pinned search_path.
+-- ============================================================================
+\set ON_ERROR_STOP on

+        ('f24a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Installments A', 'INSTCODEA0000001'),
+        ('f24b0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Installments B', 'INSTCODEB0000001');

+    WHERE id = 'f2400000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1';
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'f24a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'member'
+    WHERE id = 'f2400000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a2';

+    WHERE id = 'f2400000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000c1';

+                                          monthly_amount, paid_installments)

+            300, 3, 100, 1);
