+    PERFORM public.recompute_budget_spent('26aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', ARRAY['2026-11']);
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('recompute agrees', (SELECT spent_amount::text FROM public.budgets
+        WHERE household_id = '26aa0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND category_code = 'OPEX-DINING'), '60.00');
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED (FABLE2-DB-05): budget triggers skip settlement rows, like the recompute.';
+END $$;
+
+ROLLBACK;
diff --git a/supabase/tests/27_taxonomy_and_bnpl.sql b/supabase/tests/27_taxonomy_and_bnpl.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..eb6a1f2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/tests/27_taxonomy_and_bnpl.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,291 @@
+-- ============================================================================
+-- Test 27 (product review R4 + R10, migration 20261021000000)
+--
+--   A. Eight new system categories with system sub-categories (en/ar names,
+--      keywords >= 3 chars), visible to every household through RLS; the old
+--      OPEX-UTILITIES/housing_rent row is untouched and a new housing_rent
+--      exists under OPEX-HOUSING; no household setting / budget is created;
+--      no top-level keyword of a new code overlaps a keyword of the ten seeded
+--      codes (so no existing merchant changes category).
+--   B. installment_plans.frequency (monthly | biweekly, default monthly) and
+--      the derived next_due_at; pay_installment_plan advances it by 14 days /
+--      1 month from the start_date anchor and keeps the ACTIVE-only rule and
+--      its grants; clients cannot write frequency / next_due_at.
+-- Fails before the migration (columns / categories missing).
+-- ============================================================================
+\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
+
+BEGIN;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.expect(p_label text, p_got text, p_want text)
+RETURNS void
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+AS $$
+BEGIN
+    IF p_got IS DISTINCT FROM p_want THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION '%: got %, expected %', p_label, p_got, p_want;
+    END IF;
+END;
+$$;
+
+CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.as_role(p_role text, p_claims text, p_sql text)
+RETURNS text
+LANGUAGE plpgsql
+AS $$
+DECLARE
+    v_out text;
+BEGIN
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', p_claims, true);
+    EXECUTE format('SET LOCAL ROLE %I', p_role);
+    BEGIN
+        EXECUTE p_sql INTO v_out;
+    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
+        EXECUTE 'RESET ROLE';
+        PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', '', true);
+        RETURN 'ERR ' || SQLSTATE;
+    END;
+    EXECUTE 'RESET ROLE';
+    PERFORM set_config('request.jwt.claims', '', true);
+    RETURN coalesce(v_out, 'NULL');
+END;
+$$;
+GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION pg_temp.as_role(text, text, text) TO authenticated, anon, service_role;
+
+-- A. Taxonomy -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v_n int;
+    v_bad text;
+BEGIN
+    SELECT string_agg(code || '=' || category, ',' ORDER BY code) INTO v_bad
+    FROM public.cost_control_codes
+    WHERE household_id IS NULL AND is_system AND NOT is_flexible
+      AND code IN ('OPEX-HOUSING', 'OPEX-EDUCATION', 'OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP', 'OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT',
+                   'OPEX-CHARITY', 'OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'OPEX-INSURANCE', 'OPEX-REMITTANCE');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('new system categories', v_bad,
+        'OPEX-CHARITY=Charity & Zakat,OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP=Domestic Help,OPEX-EDUCATION=School Costs,'
+        'OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT=Family Support,OPEX-HOUSING=Housing & Rent,OPEX-INSURANCE=Insurance,'
+        'OPEX-REMITTANCE=Remittances Abroad,OPEX-TRANSPORT=Car & Transport');
+
+    SELECT string_agg(parent_code || ':' || n, ',' ORDER BY parent_code) INTO v_bad
+    FROM (SELECT parent_code, count(*) AS n FROM public.cost_control_sub_categories
+          WHERE parent_code IN ('OPEX-HOUSING', 'OPEX-EDUCATION', 'OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP', 'OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT',
+                                'OPEX-CHARITY', 'OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'OPEX-INSURANCE', 'OPEX-REMITTANCE')
+            AND name_en <> '' AND name_ar <> '' AND cardinality(keywords) >= 2
+          GROUP BY parent_code) s;
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('sub-categories per new parent', v_bad,
+        'OPEX-CHARITY:2,OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP:3,OPEX-EDUCATION:4,OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT:2,OPEX-HOUSING:3,'
+        'OPEX-INSURANCE:3,OPEX-REMITTANCE:2,OPEX-TRANSPORT:4');
+
+    -- Every keyword of the new definitions is at least 3 characters (the matcher ignores shorter ones).
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM (
+        SELECT k FROM public.cost_control_codes c, unnest(c.keywords) k
+        WHERE c.household_id IS NULL AND c.code IN ('OPEX-HOUSING', 'OPEX-EDUCATION', 'OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP',
+              'OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT', 'OPEX-CHARITY', 'OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'OPEX-INSURANCE', 'OPEX-REMITTANCE')
+        UNION ALL
+        SELECT k FROM public.cost_control_sub_categories s, unnest(s.keywords) k
+        WHERE s.parent_code IN ('OPEX-HOUSING', 'OPEX-EDUCATION', 'OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP', 'OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT',
+              'OPEX-CHARITY', 'OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'OPEX-INSURANCE', 'OPEX-REMITTANCE')) x
+    WHERE char_length(btrim(k)) < 3 OR k <> lower(k);
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('short or upper-case keywords', v_n::text, '0');
+
+    -- Arabic and English keywords on every new code.
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.cost_control_codes c
+    WHERE c.household_id IS NULL AND c.code IN ('OPEX-HOUSING', 'OPEX-EDUCATION', 'OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP',
+          'OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT', 'OPEX-CHARITY', 'OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'OPEX-INSURANCE', 'OPEX-REMITTANCE')
+      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(c.keywords) k WHERE k ~ '[a-z]')
+      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(c.keywords) k WHERE k ~ '[؀-ۿ]');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('codes with Arabic and English keywords', v_n::text, '8');
+
+    -- No top-level keyword of a new code overlaps a keyword of the ten seeded codes, in the
+    -- matcher's terms (supabase_client.match_category: keywords < 4 chars match as whole
+    -- words, longer ones as substrings in either direction).
+    SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT n.k || '~' || o.k || '(' || o.code || ')', ', ') INTO v_bad
+    FROM (SELECT lower(btrim(k)) AS k FROM public.cost_control_codes c, unnest(c.keywords) k
+          WHERE c.household_id IS NULL AND c.code IN ('OPEX-HOUSING', 'OPEX-EDUCATION', 'OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP',
+                'OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT', 'OPEX-CHARITY', 'OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'OPEX-INSURANCE', 'OPEX-REMITTANCE')) n,
+         (SELECT c.code, lower(btrim(k)) AS k FROM public.cost_control_codes c, unnest(c.keywords) k
+          WHERE c.household_id IS NULL AND c.code IN ('OPEX-GROCERY', 'OPEX-DINING', 'OPEX-FUEL', 'OPEX-UTILITIES',
+                'OPEX-SHOPPING', 'OPEX-ENTERTAINMENT', 'OPEX-HEALTH', 'CAPEX-EDUCATION', 'OPEX-GOV', 'OPEX-MISC')) o
+    WHERE n.k = o.k
+       OR (char_length(o.k) < 4 AND n.k ~ ('(^|[^[:alnum:]_])' || regexp_replace(o.k, '([^[:alnum:]_ ])', '\\\1', 'g') || '($|[^[:alnum:]_])'))
+       OR (char_length(n.k) < 4 AND o.k ~ ('(^|[^[:alnum:]_])' || regexp_replace(n.k, '([^[:alnum:]_ ])', '\\\1', 'g') || '($|[^[:alnum:]_])'))
+       OR (char_length(o.k) >= 4 AND char_length(n.k) >= 4 AND (strpos(n.k, o.k) > 0 OR strpos(o.k, n.k) > 0));
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('keyword overlaps with seeded codes', v_bad, NULL);
+
+    -- housing_rent: the old row is untouched, a new one lives under OPEX-HOUSING.
+    SELECT string_agg(parent_code || '/' || name_en || '/' || name_ar, ',' ORDER BY parent_code) INTO v_bad
+    FROM public.cost_control_sub_categories WHERE sub_code = 'housing_rent';
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('housing_rent rows', v_bad,
+        'OPEX-HOUSING/Housing Rent/إيجار السكن,OPEX-UTILITIES/Housing Rent/إيجار السكن');
+
+    -- The migration creates no per-household state.
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.household_category_settings
+    WHERE category_code LIKE 'OPEX-%' AND category_code IN ('OPEX-HOUSING', 'OPEX-EDUCATION', 'OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP',
+          'OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT', 'OPEX-CHARITY', 'OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'OPEX-INSURANCE', 'OPEX-REMITTANCE');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('household settings for the new codes', v_n::text, '0');
+    SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM public.budgets
+    WHERE category_code IN ('OPEX-HOUSING', 'OPEX-EDUCATION', 'OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP',
+          'OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT', 'OPEX-CHARITY', 'OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'OPEX-INSURANCE', 'OPEX-REMITTANCE');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('budgets for the new codes', v_n::text, '0');
+END $$;
+
+-- Fixture: one household with an admin.
+DO $$
+BEGIN
+    INSERT INTO auth.users (id, email) VALUES
+        ('f2700000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1', 'tax-a@test.local');
+    INSERT INTO public.households (id, name, invite_code) VALUES
+        ('f27a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Taxonomy A', 'TAXCODEA00000001');
+    UPDATE public.users SET household_id = 'f27a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', role = 'admin'
+    WHERE id = 'f2700000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1';
+END $$;
+
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    c_admin constant text := '{"sub": "f2700000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1", "role": "authenticated"}';
+BEGIN
+    -- Visible through RLS to a household member, sub-categories included.
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('member sees the new codes',
+        pg_temp.as_role('authenticated', c_admin,
+            $q$SELECT count(*)::text FROM public.cost_control_codes
+               WHERE code IN ('OPEX-HOUSING', 'OPEX-EDUCATION', 'OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP', 'OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT',
+                              'OPEX-CHARITY', 'OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'OPEX-INSURANCE', 'OPEX-REMITTANCE')$q$), '8');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('member sees the new sub-categories',
+        pg_temp.as_role('authenticated', c_admin,
+            $q$SELECT count(*)::text FROM public.cost_control_sub_categories
+               WHERE parent_code IN ('OPEX-HOUSING', 'OPEX-EDUCATION', 'OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP', 'OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT',
+                                     'OPEX-CHARITY', 'OPEX-TRANSPORT', 'OPEX-INSURANCE', 'OPEX-REMITTANCE')$q$), '23');
+    -- System rows stay read-only for clients.
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('client cannot rewrite a system code',
+        pg_temp.as_role('authenticated', c_admin,
+            $q$WITH u AS (UPDATE public.cost_control_codes SET category = 'x' WHERE code = 'OPEX-HOUSING' RETURNING 1)
+               SELECT count(*)::text FROM u$q$), '0');
+
+    -- A transaction can use a new category and sub-category.
+    INSERT INTO public.transactions (household_id, merchant, amount, category_code, sub_category, source, timestamp)
+    VALUES ('f27a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Ejar', 3000, 'OPEX-HOUSING', 'housing_rent', 'manual',
+            '2026-10-05 10:00:00+03');
+END $$;
+
+-- B. BNPL schedule --------------------------------------------------------------------
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+    v text;
+    v_paid int;
+    v_status text;
+    v_due date;
+BEGIN
+    -- Column shape.
+    SELECT data_type || '/' || is_nullable || '/' || column_default INTO v
+    FROM information_schema.columns
+    WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'installment_plans' AND column_name = 'frequency';
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('frequency column', v, 'text/NO/''monthly''::text');
+    SELECT data_type || '/' || is_nullable INTO v
+    FROM information_schema.columns
+    WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'installment_plans' AND column_name = 'next_due_at';
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('next_due_at column', v, 'date/YES');
+
+    -- Default monthly; next_due_at derived even when an insert names another value.
+    INSERT INTO public.installment_plans (id, household_id, merchant, provider, total_amount, installment_count,
+                                          monthly_amount, paid_installments, start_date, next_due_at)
+    VALUES ('f27d0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f27a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Bank TV', 'Bank',
+            1200, 3, 400, 1, '2026-01-31', '2030-01-01');
+    SELECT frequency || '/' || next_due_at INTO v FROM public.installment_plans
+    WHERE id = 'f27d0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('monthly default, derived next due (end-of-month clamp)', v, 'monthly/2026-02-28');
+
+    INSERT INTO public.installment_plans (id, household_id, merchant, provider, total_amount, installment_count,
+                                          monthly_amount, paid_installments, start_date, frequency)
+    VALUES ('f27d0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', 'f27a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Noon', 'Tabby',
+            400, 4, 100, 1, '2026-10-01', 'biweekly');
+    SELECT next_due_at::text INTO v FROM public.installment_plans WHERE id = 'f27d0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002';
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('biweekly next due', v, '2026-10-15');
+
+    -- CHECK on frequency.
+    BEGIN
+        UPDATE public.installment_plans SET frequency = 'weekly' WHERE id = 'f27d0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002';
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'frequency weekly was accepted';
+    EXCEPTION WHEN check_violation THEN NULL;
+    END;
+
+    -- Biweekly payments: 2026-10-15 -> 10-29 -> 11-12 -> NULL (COMPLETED).
+    SELECT paid_installments, status, next_due_at INTO v_paid, v_status, v_due
+    FROM public.pay_installment_plan('f27d0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002',
+        'f27a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2700000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('biweekly payment 2', v_paid || '/' || v_status || '/' || v_due, '2/ACTIVE/2026-10-29');
+    SELECT paid_installments, status, next_due_at INTO v_paid, v_status, v_due
+    FROM public.pay_installment_plan('f27d0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002',
+        'f27a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2700000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('biweekly payment 3', v_paid || '/' || v_status || '/' || v_due, '3/ACTIVE/2026-11-12');
+    SELECT paid_installments, status, coalesce(next_due_at::text, 'NULL') INTO v_paid, v_status, v
+    FROM public.pay_installment_plan('f27d0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002',
+        'f27a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2700000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('biweekly payment 4', v_paid || '/' || v_status || '/' || v, '4/COMPLETED/NULL');
+    SELECT paid_installments, status, coalesce(next_due_at::text, 'NULL') INTO v_paid, v_status, v
+    FROM public.pay_installment_plan('f27d0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002',
+        'f27a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2700000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('paid-up plan unchanged', v_paid || '/' || v_status || '/' || v, '4/COMPLETED/NULL');
+
+    -- Monthly payments anchored on start_date: 31 Jan -> 28 Feb -> 31 Mar (no drift) -> NULL.
+    SELECT next_due_at::text INTO v
+    FROM public.pay_installment_plan('f27d0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
+        'f27a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2700000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('monthly payment 2', v, '2026-03-31');
+    SELECT coalesce(next_due_at::text, 'NULL') || '/' || status INTO v
+    FROM public.pay_installment_plan('f27d0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
+        'f27a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2700000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('monthly payment 3', v, 'NULL/COMPLETED');
+
+    -- ACTIVE-only rule (20261020900000) kept: a CANCELLED plan takes no payment.
+    INSERT INTO public.installment_plans (id, household_id, merchant, provider, total_amount, installment_count,
+                                          monthly_amount, paid_installments, start_date, status, frequency)
+    VALUES ('f27d0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003', 'f27a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Shein', 'Tamara',
+            200, 4, 50, 1, '2026-10-01', 'CANCELLED', 'biweekly');
+    SELECT coalesce(next_due_at::text, 'NULL') INTO v FROM public.installment_plans
+    WHERE id = 'f27d0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003';
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('cancelled plan has no next due', v, 'NULL');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('cancelled plan payment',
+        pg_temp.as_role('service_role', '{"role": "service_role"}',
+            $q$SELECT paid_installments::text FROM public.pay_installment_plan('f27d0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003',
+                'f27a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2700000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1')$q$),
+        'ERR 22023');
+
+    -- A schedule change recomputes next_due_at.
+    UPDATE public.installment_plans SET status = 'ACTIVE', start_date = '2026-11-01'
+    WHERE id = 'f27d0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003';
+    SELECT next_due_at::text INTO v FROM public.installment_plans WHERE id = 'f27d0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003';
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('rescheduled plan', v, '2026-11-15');
+
+    -- Grants: service_role only on the RPC; clients cannot write frequency / next_due_at.
+    IF has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.pay_installment_plan(uuid, uuid, uuid)', 'EXECUTE')
+       OR has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.pay_installment_plan(uuid, uuid, uuid)', 'EXECUTE')
+       OR NOT has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.pay_installment_plan(uuid, uuid, uuid)', 'EXECUTE') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'pay_installment_plan grants changed';
+    END IF;
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('client UPDATE of next_due_at',
+        pg_temp.as_role('authenticated', '{"sub": "f2700000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1", "role": "authenticated"}',
+            $q$WITH u AS (UPDATE public.installment_plans SET next_due_at = '2030-01-01'
+                          WHERE id = 'f27d0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003' RETURNING 1)
+               SELECT count(*)::text FROM u$q$), 'ERR 42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('client UPDATE of frequency',
+        pg_temp.as_role('authenticated', '{"sub": "f2700000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1", "role": "authenticated"}',
+            $q$WITH u AS (UPDATE public.installment_plans SET frequency = 'monthly'
+                          WHERE id = 'f27d0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003' RETURNING 1)
+               SELECT count(*)::text FROM u$q$), 'ERR 42501');
+    PERFORM pg_temp.expect('client calls the RPC',
+        pg_temp.as_role('authenticated', '{"sub": "f2700000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1", "role": "authenticated"}',
+            $q$SELECT paid_installments::text FROM public.pay_installment_plan('f27d0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003',
+                'f27a0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'f2700000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1')$q$),
+        'ERR 42501');
+    -- The helper is a pure function clients may use; the trigger function is internal.
+    IF has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.installment_next_due_at(date, text, integer, integer, text)', 'EXECUTE')
+       OR has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.installment_plans_schedule()', 'EXECUTE')
+       OR has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.installment_plans_schedule()', 'EXECUTE') THEN
+        RAISE EXCEPTION 'schedule function grants are wrong';
+    END IF;
+
+    RAISE NOTICE 'PASSED: Saudi taxonomy present and isolated; BNPL frequency / next_due_at derived and advanced by pay_installment_plan.';
+END $$;
+
+ROLLBACK;
diff --git a/supabase/tests/run_tests.py b/supabase/tests/run_tests.py
index 5c297e2..02cdea8 100644
--- a/supabase/tests/run_tests.py
+++ b/supabase/tests/run_tests.py
@@ -1,62 +1,206 @@
 #!/usr/bin/env python3
-"""Database test runner for Supabase local Docker / CI."""
+"""Database test runner for a local Docker Postgres or a plain local Postgres (run by hand before each release; the project has no CI).
 
+Default behaviour (unchanged): run every ``NN_*.sql`` test file through
+``docker exec -i budget_tracker_review_pg psql`` against ``$DB_NAME``
+(default ``live_rebuilt_round5``).
+
+Plain-psql mode (no Docker needed)::
+
+    # Rebuild a throwaway database from scratch and run all tests against it
+    PGHOST=localhost PGPORT=54329 PGUSER=postgres \\
+        python3 supabase/tests/run_tests.py --psql --rebuild --db bt_audit_tests
+
+``--psql`` (or ``BT_DB_TEST_MODE=psql``) talks to the server with the local
+``psql`` binary using the standard libpq environment variables (PGHOST,
+PGPORT, PGUSER, PGPASSWORD). ``--rebuild`` drops and recreates the database,
+then applies ``00_local_supabase_stubs.sql`` (platform stubs), ``schema.sql``,
+``seed.sql`` (system categories that migrations reference) and every migration in replay order (see ``migration_replay_order``) before
+running the tests. Never point ``--rebuild`` at a real Supabase project.
+
+Without ``--rebuild`` the tests run against the existing database named by
+``--db``. Pre-flight against a local replica of live (never live itself)::
+
+    # Expected live baseline: the chain as it stood before PREFIX
+    python3 supabase/tests/run_tests.py --psql --rebuild --stop-before 20261020005000 \\
+        --no-tests --db bt_repo_baseline
+    # Apply the pending migrations (filename >= PREFIX) to an existing local
+    # replica, then run the suite against it
+    python3 supabase/tests/run_tests.py --psql --apply-from 20261020005000 --db bt_live_replica
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import glob
 import os
-import sys
+import re
 import subprocess
-import glob
+import sys
 
 if hasattr(sys.stdout, "reconfigure"):
     sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
 if hasattr(sys.stderr, "reconfigure"):
     sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
 
-def run_sql_file(file_path, db_name="live_rebuilt_round5", host="localhost", port="54329", user="postgres"):
-    print(f"\n--- Running: {os.path.basename(file_path)} ---")
-    
-    # We execute via docker exec if container is available, else via psql directly
-    cmd = [
-        "docker", "exec", "-i", "budget_tracker_review_pg",
-        "psql", "-U", user, "-d", db_name, "-v", "ON_ERROR_STOP=1"
+TEST_DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
+SUPABASE_DIR = os.path.dirname(TEST_DIR)
+STUBS_FILE = os.path.join(TEST_DIR, "00_local_supabase_stubs.sql")
+DOCKER_CONTAINER = "budget_tracker_review_pg"
+
+# Files whose shipped version prefix sorts before a migration they depend on.
+# `20261018_membership_sync_and_shared_account_policies.sql` creates a policy on
+# `public.accounts`, which is created by
+# `20261018_multi_source_income_and_accounts.sql` (same version prefix, later
+# alphabetically). Replay must apply the dependency first.
+REPLAY_DEPENDENCIES = {
+    "20261018_membership_sync_and_shared_account_policies.sql": [
+        "20261018_multi_source_income_and_accounts.sql",
+    ],
+}
+
+
+def migration_replay_order(migration_dir):
+    """Return migration paths sorted by filename, honouring REPLAY_DEPENDENCIES."""
+    names = sorted(os.path.basename(p) for p in glob.glob(os.path.join(migration_dir, "*.sql")))
+    ordered = []
+    placed = set()
+
+    def place(name):

+def rebuild_database(db_name, stop_before=None):
+    """Drop/recreate db_name and replay stubs + schema + migrations (psql mode only).
+
+    ``stop_before``: replay only migrations whose filename sorts before this
+    prefix (e.g. ``20261020`` rebuilds the chain as it was before that day).
+    """
+    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_]+", db_name):
+        raise SystemExit(f"Refusing to rebuild database with unsafe name: {db_name!r}")
+
+    for cmd in (["dropdb", "--if-exists", db_name], ["createdb", db_name]):
+        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
+        if proc.returncode != 0:
+            raise SystemExit(f"{' '.join(cmd)} failed: {proc.stderr.strip()}")
+
+    steps = [
+        STUBS_FILE,
+        os.path.join(SUPABASE_DIR, "schema.sql"),
+        os.path.join(SUPABASE_DIR, "seed.sql"),
+    ]
+    migrations = migration_replay_order(os.path.join(SUPABASE_DIR, "migrations"))
+    if stop_before:
+        migrations = [m for m in migrations if os.path.basename(m) < stop_before]
+    steps += migrations
+    print(f"Rebuilding {db_name}: {len(steps)} files (stubs, schema.sql, seed.sql, migrations)")
+    for step in steps:
+        if not run_sql_file(step, db_name=db_name, use_psql=True, quiet=True):
+            raise SystemExit(f"Rebuild failed while applying {os.path.relpath(step, SUPABASE_DIR)}")
+    print("Rebuild complete.")
+
+
+def apply_pending_migrations(db_name, apply_from, use_psql):
+    """Apply migrations whose filename sorts at or after ``apply_from`` to an existing database."""
+    migrations = [m for m in migration_replay_order(os.path.join(SUPABASE_DIR, "migrations"))
+                  if os.path.basename(m) >= apply_from]
+    print(f"Applying {len(migrations)} pending migration(s) to {db_name}")
+    for m in migrations:
+        print(f"  {os.path.basename(m)}")
+        if not run_sql_file(m, db_name=db_name, use_psql=use_psql, quiet=True):
+            raise SystemExit(f"Migration failed: {os.path.basename(m)}")
+    print("Pending migrations applied.")
+

index 0000000..df53ee3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/e2e/README.md
@@ -0,0 +1,81 @@
+# Real-stack end-to-end tests
+
+These tests drive the **actual** backend: the `ai_service` FastAPI app talks over HTTP to a
+**real PostgREST** in front of a local Postgres built from `supabase/schema.sql`, `seed.sql` and
+every migration. Users are simulated with locally signed JWTs. Only the LLM (`litellm`) and the
+e-mail provider endpoint are faked. Nothing contacts a hosted Supabase project, Railway, an LLM
+API or an e-mail provider: a socket guard fails the run on any non-loopback connection.
+
+```
+pytest ──HTTP──▶ ai_service (uvicorn, real app, in-process thread, 127.0.0.1:<port>)
+                     │ supabase-py, service_role JWT
+pytest ──HTTP──▶ gateway (127.0.0.1:<port>)      /rest/v1/*  → PostgREST (byte-for-byte proxy)
+  (user JWTs)        │                            /storage/v1 → in-memory stub
+                     │                            /__resend   → captured e-mails (fake Resend)
+                     ▼
+                PostgREST 12.2.3 (official static binary) ──▶ Postgres 16 `bt_e2e`
+```
+
+The suite is opt-in and is never collected by the hermetic `ai_service` suite
+(`ai_service/pytest.ini` only collects `ai_service/tests`). Without `BT_E2E=1` every test here is
+skipped.
+
+## Requirements
+
+- Postgres 16 reachable with trust auth (defaults: `localhost:54329`, user `postgres`). The
+  fixture drops and recreates the database `bt_e2e` (override with `BT_E2E_DB`) using
+  `supabase/tests/run_tests.py --psql --rebuild --no-tests`, which applies
+  `supabase/tests/00_local_supabase_stubs.sql` (auth/storage schemas, `anon`/`authenticated`/
+  `service_role` roles, `auth.uid()`/`auth.jwt()` reading `request.jwt.claims` exactly as
+  PostgREST sets them). **Never point it at a hosted database.**
+- It creates a cluster-wide login role `bt_e2e_authenticator` (NOINHERIT, granted `anon`,
+  `authenticated`, `service_role`) for PostgREST to connect as, like Supabase's `authenticator`.
+- PostgREST binary: `BT_E2E_POSTGREST_BIN`, else `postgrest` on `PATH`, else it is downloaded by
+  `scripts/fetch_postgrest.sh` (GitHub release asset, cached under `~/.cache/bt-e2e/`).
+- Python 3.11+ with `pip install -r tests/e2e/requirements.txt` (the ai_service requirements
+  plus `psycopg[binary]`).
+
+## Running
+
+```bash
+python3 -m venv ~/.venvs/bt-e2e && ~/.venvs/bt-e2e/bin/pip install -r tests/e2e/requirements.txt
+cd tests/e2e
+BT_E2E=1 PGHOST=localhost PGPORT=54329 ~/.venvs/bt-e2e/bin/python -m pytest -v
+```
+
+Useful variables:
+
+| Variable | Meaning |
+|---|---|
+| `BT_E2E=1` | required; otherwise everything is skipped |
+| `BT_E2E_SKIP_REBUILD=1` | reuse the existing `bt_e2e` database (faster iteration) |
+| `BT_E2E_POSTGREST_BIN` | path to a PostgREST binary |
+| `BT_E2E_PGHOST` / `BT_E2E_PGPORT` / `BT_E2E_PGUSER` / `BT_E2E_DB` | database location |
+
+A full run (rebuild included) takes about two minutes.
+
+## How the app is configured
+
+`e2e_harness/app_loader.py` sets the environment before importing `main`:
+`SUPABASE_URL` = the gateway, `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY` = a locally signed `service_role` JWT,
+`SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET` = the shared HS256 test secret (also PostgREST's `jwt-secret`),
+`ENV=development`, `REDIS_URL` empty (in-memory limiter + database quota), every provider key
+empty, `LITELLM_LOCAL_MODEL_COST_MAP=True` (litellm otherwise downloads its price map at import).
+`dotenv.load_dotenv` is disabled so a developer `.env` is never read. The app keeps no local
+files (the JSON / in-memory fallbacks were removed; the database is the only store).
+
+## Layout
+
+| File | Scenario |
+|---|---|
+| `test_01_households_and_invites.py` | family and roommate households joined by invite code; single-use codes; brute-force lockout → 429 (API and PostgREST RPC); forged/expired/wrong-issuer tokens rejected |
+| `test_02_expense_commits_and_cycles.py` | chat commits by every member (LLM mocked), heuristic fallback, ZATCA QR receipt with Nafaqah class and fingerprint de-duplication, `cycle_key` for payday 27 and payday 10 around month boundaries and Riyadh midnight |
+| `test_03_nafaqah_and_settlement.py` | wife advance → husband owes; partial/full repayment; overpayment 409 (API and DB); allowance spent/remaining; wife cannot set her allowance; family settlement = ledger, never 50/50; roommate settlement paths |
+| `test_04_permissions.py` | own vs other's transactions (API and PostgREST), admin overrides, shared-pool withdrawal admin-only, co-admin promotion, primary-admin protection and transfer |
+| `test_05_idor_sweep.py` | every household-scoped API route and the PostgREST tables/RPCs called by household A with household B's ids |
+| `test_06_quota_and_inquiries.py` | persistent DB quota (no Redis) for chat and receipts; inquiries 503 without a provider, 200 with the fake Resend, 502 on provider failure, per-IP limit |
+| `test_07_money_integrity.py` | DB-06 sub-halala rejection; budgets.spent_amount == Σ transactions per (category, cycle) and account balance == ledger after a long mixed sequence |
+
+Tests that expose an application bug are marked `xfail(strict=True)` with the bug description
+(IDs `E2E-xx`); when the bug is fixed the test XPASSes and the strict marker fails the run so the
+marker gets removed. Results and reproduction steps: `docs/review/audit/e2e_results.md`.

+"""
+Session fixtures for the real-stack e2e suite.
+
+Opt-in: nothing runs unless BT_E2E=1 (the stack rebuilds a local database and starts servers).
+BT_E2E_SKIP_REBUILD=1 reuses an existing ``bt_e2e`` database instead of rebuilding it.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+import shutil
+
+import pytest
+
+from e2e_harness import sandbox
+
+E2E_ENABLED = os.environ.get("BT_E2E") == "1"
+
+
+def pytest_collection_modifyitems(config, items):
+    skip = pytest.mark.skip(reason="real-stack e2e suite: set BT_E2E=1 to run (see tests/e2e/README.md)")
+    for item in items:
+        item.add_marker(pytest.mark.e2e)
+        if not E2E_ENABLED:
+            item.add_marker(skip)
+
+
+class Stack:
+    def __init__(self):
+        from e2e_harness import stack as st
+
+        self.workdir = st.make_workdir()
+        sandbox.install_network_guard()
+        if os.environ.get("BT_E2E_SKIP_REBUILD") != "1":
+            st.rebuild_database()
+        st.prepare_authenticator()
+        self.postgrest = st.PostgREST(self.workdir)
+        self.postgrest.start()
+        self.gateway = st.Gateway(self.postgrest.port)
+        self.gateway.start()
+
+        from e2e_harness import app_loader
+
+        app_loader.configure_env(self.gateway.url)
+        self.llm = sandbox.FakeLLM()
+        self.llm.install()
+        self.app = app_loader.load_app(self.workdir / "ai_data")
+        import mail_service
+
+        mail_service.RESEND_ENDPOINT = f"{self.gateway.url}/__resend/emails"
+        self.server = st.AppServer()
+        self.server.start(self.app)
+
+    def stop(self):
+        self.server.stop()
+        self.gateway.stop()
+        self.postgrest.stop()
+        shutil.rmtree(self.workdir, ignore_errors=True)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="session")
+def stack():
+    if not E2E_ENABLED:
+        pytest.skip("BT_E2E=1 not set")
+    s = Stack()
+    yield s
+    s.stop()
+    assert not sandbox.blocked_connections(), f"outbound connections attempted: {sandbox.blocked_connections()}"
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def llm(stack):
+    stack.llm.clear()
+    stack.llm.calls.clear()
+    yield stack.llm
+    stack.llm.clear()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def world(stack, llm):
+    from e2e_harness.actors import World
+    from rate_limiter import reset_rate_limiters
+
+    reset_rate_limiters()
+    w = World(stack.server.url, stack.gateway.url)
+    yield w
+    w.close()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def db(world):
+    return world.db

@@ -0,0 +1,159 @@
+"""Simulated users and households driven through the public HTTP surfaces."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import uuid
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import httpx
+import psycopg
+from psycopg.rows import dict_row
+
+from . import config
+from .tokens import anon_key, user_token
+
+
+class DB:
+    """Superuser access to the e2e database for fixtures (auth signup) and assertions only."""
+
+    def query(self, sql: str, params: Any = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+        with psycopg.connect(config.pg_dsn(), autocommit=True, row_factory=dict_row) as conn:
+            cur = conn.execute(sql, params)
+            return cur.fetchall() if cur.description else []
+
+    def one(self, sql: str, params: Any = None) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
+        rows = self.query(sql, params)
+        return rows[0] if rows else None
+
+    def scalar(self, sql: str, params: Any = None) -> Any:
+        row = self.one(sql, params)
+        return next(iter(row.values())) if row else None
+
+
+@dataclass
+class User:
+    id: str
+    email: str
+    display_name: str
+    token: str
+    api: httpx.Client
+    rest: httpx.Client
+
+    def rpc(self, name: str, params: Optional[dict] = None) -> httpx.Response:
+        """Call a Postgres function through PostgREST as this user (what the Flutter app does)."""
+        return self.rest.post(f"/rpc/{name}", json=params or {})
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Household:
+    id: str
+    name: str
+    admin: User
+    members: List[User] = field(default_factory=list)
+
+    @property
+    def everyone(self) -> List[User]:
+        return [self.admin, *self.members]
+
+
+class World:
+    def __init__(self, app_url: str, gateway_url: str):
+        self.app_url = app_url
+        self.gateway_url = gateway_url
+        self.db = DB()
+        self._clients: List[httpx.Client] = []
+
+    # ── clients ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+    def _client(self, base_url: str, headers: Dict[str, str]) -> httpx.Client:
+        client = httpx.Client(base_url=base_url, headers=headers, timeout=60.0, trust_env=False)
+        self._clients.append(client)
+        return client
+
+    def anonymous_api(self, **headers) -> httpx.Client:
+        return self._client(self.app_url, dict(headers))
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        for c in self._clients:
+            c.close()
+
+    # ── users ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+    def signup(self, display_name: str, financial_role: Optional[str] = None) -> User:
+        """GoTrue signup equivalent: an auth.users row (the trigger creates public.users)."""
+        uid = str(uuid.uuid4())
+        email = f"{display_name.lower().replace(' ', '.')}.{uid[:6]}@e2e.test"
+        self.db.query(
+            "INSERT INTO auth.users (id, email, raw_user_meta_data) VALUES (%s, %s, jsonb_build_object('display_name', %s::text))",
+            (uid, email, display_name),
+        )
+        if financial_role:
+            self.db.query("UPDATE public.users SET financial_role = %s WHERE id = %s", (financial_role, uid))
+        token = user_token(self.gateway_url, uid, email)
+        api = self._client(self.app_url, {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"})
+        rest = self._client(
+            f"{self.gateway_url}/rest/v1",
+            {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "apikey": anon_key(), "Content-Type": "application/json"},
+        )
+        return User(id=uid, email=email, display_name=display_name, token=token, api=api, rest=rest)
+
+    def token_for(self, user: User, **extra) -> str:
+        return user_token(self.gateway_url, user.id, user.email, **extra)
+
+    # ── households ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+    def create_household(self, admin: User, name: str, household_type: Optional[str] = None) -> Household:
+        """create_household_and_claim as the app calls it; no type = the released app's {p_name} call (family)."""
+        params = {"p_name": name}
+        if household_type:
+            params["p_household_type"] = household_type
+        res = admin.rpc("create_household_and_claim", params)
+        assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+        return Household(id=res.json()["id"], name=name, admin=admin)
+
+    def invite(self, inviter: User, household: Household, role: str = "peer") -> str:
+        res = inviter.api.post(f"/households/{household.id}/invites", json={"role": role})
+        assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+        return res.json()["invite_code"]
+
+    def join(self, user: User, household: Household, invite_code: str) -> dict:
+        res = user.api.post(f"/households/invites/{invite_code}/claim")
+        assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+        household.members.append(user)
+        return res.json()
+
+    def family(self, tag: str = "") -> Household:
+        """Husband (primary admin, provider) + wife (member, spouse) joined by a spouse invite."""
+        husband = self.signup(f"Husband{tag}")
+        wife = self.signup(f"Wife{tag}")
+        hh = self.create_household(husband, f"Family {tag or uuid.uuid4().hex[:4]}")
+        self.join(wife, hh, self.invite(husband, hh, "spouse"))
+        return hh
+
+    def roommates(self, tag: str = "", n_members: int = 2) -> Household:
+        admin = self.signup(f"RoomAdmin{tag}")
+        hh = self.create_household(admin, f"Flat {tag or uuid.uuid4().hex[:4]}", household_type="roommates")
+        for i in range(n_members):
+            mate = self.signup(f"Roommate{i + 1}{tag}")
+            self.join(mate, hh, self.invite(admin, hh, "peer"))
+        return hh
+
+    # ── chat commit helper ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
+    def chat_commit(self, user: User, household: Household, llm, *, merchant: str, amount: float,
+                    category_code: str = "OPEX-DINING", paid_by: str = "me", beneficiary: str = "both",
+                    extra_body: Optional[dict] = None, occurred_at: Optional[str] = None,
+                    headers: Optional[dict] = None) -> httpx.Response:
+        llm.queue_json({
+            "is_transaction": True,
+            "merchant": merchant,
+            "total_amount": amount,
+            "currency": "SAR",
+            "category_code": category_code,
+            "spent_by": "me",
+            "paid_by": paid_by,
+            "beneficiary": beneficiary,
+            "items": [{"name": merchant, "quantity": 1, "price": amount}],
+        })
+        body = {"household_id": household.id, "message": f"{merchant} {amount} SAR", "allow_duplicate": True}
+        if occurred_at:
+            body["client_occurred_at"] = occurred_at
+        body.update(extra_body or {})
+        return user.api.post("/agent/chat-transaction", json=body, headers=headers or {})

--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/e2e/e2e_harness/app_loader.py
@@ -0,0 +1,51 @@
+"""Import the real ai_service app against the local stack (env is set before any app import)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from . import config
+from .tokens import service_role_key
+
+# Variables that could make the app reach a real provider; forced empty so load_dotenv() (which
+# never overrides an existing variable) cannot fill them from a stray .env file either.
+_FORCED_EMPTY = (
+    "SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY", "REDIS_URL", "GEMINI_API_KEY", "GOOGLE_API_KEY", "OPENAI_API_KEY",
+    "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", "RESEND_API_KEY", "SMTP_HOST", "SMTP_PORT", "SMTP_USERNAME", "SMTP_PASSWORD",
+    "APP_AUTH_TOKEN", "WEBHOOK_SECRET", "TRUSTED_PROXY_IPS", "ALLOWED_ORIGINS",
+)
+
+
+def configure_env(gateway_url: str) -> None:
+    for var in _FORCED_EMPTY:
+        os.environ[var] = ""
+    os.environ.update({
+        "SUPABASE_URL": gateway_url,
+        "SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY": service_role_key(),
+        "SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET": config.JWT_SECRET,
+        "ENV": "development",
+        "LITELLM_MODEL": "e2e/fake-model",
+        "MAIL_FROM": "Budget Tracker E2E <noreply@e2e.test>",
+        "CONTACT_RECIPIENT_EMAIL": "inbox@e2e.test",
+    })
+
+
+def load_app(data_dir: Path):
+    """
+    Import ``main``. ``data_dir`` is a scratch directory for the app (it keeps no local files since
+    the JSON fallbacks were removed; the database is the only store).
+    """
+    ai_dir = str(config.AI_SERVICE_DIR)
+    if ai_dir not in sys.path:
+        sys.path.insert(0, ai_dir)
+    import dotenv
+
+    dotenv.load_dotenv = lambda *a, **k: False  # never read a developer .env during e2e
+
+    data_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+    import main
+
+    return main.app
diff --git a/tests/e2e/e2e_harness/config.py b/tests/e2e/e2e_harness/config.py

@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+"""Static configuration of the e2e stack (everything local; nothing points at a hosted service)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+
+REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+AI_SERVICE_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "ai_service"
+SUPABASE_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "supabase"
+RUN_TESTS = SUPABASE_DIR / "tests" / "run_tests.py"
+FETCH_POSTGREST = REPO_ROOT / "tests" / "e2e" / "scripts" / "fetch_postgrest.sh"
+
+PGHOST = os.environ.get("BT_E2E_PGHOST", os.environ.get("PGHOST", "localhost"))
+PGPORT = int(os.environ.get("BT_E2E_PGPORT", os.environ.get("PGPORT", "54329")))
+PGUSER = os.environ.get("BT_E2E_PGUSER", "postgres")
+DB_NAME = os.environ.get("BT_E2E_DB", "bt_e2e")
+
+# Login role PostgREST connects as (switches to anon/authenticated/service_role per request,
+# exactly like Supabase's `authenticator`). A dedicated role so the shared stub role is untouched.
+AUTHENTICATOR_ROLE = "bt_e2e_authenticator"
+
+# HS256 test secret shared by PostgREST (jwt-secret) and ai_service (SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET).
+JWT_SECRET = "bt-e2e-local-test-secret-not-for-production-0123456789"
+
+LOCAL_HOSTS = ("127.0.0.1", "::1", "localhost")
+
+
+def pg_dsn(dbname: str = DB_NAME, user: str = PGUSER) -> str:
+    return f"host={PGHOST} port={PGPORT} user={user} dbname={dbname}"
diff --git a/tests/e2e/e2e_harness/sandbox.py b/tests/e2e/e2e_harness/sandbox.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1363718
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/e2e/e2e_harness/sandbox.py
@@ -0,0 +1,100 @@
+"""
+Process-level safety net and fakes for the e2e run.
+
+* ``install_network_guard``: every outbound TCP connect from this process must target a loopback
+  address. A stray call to a hosted Supabase project, an LLM API or an e-mail provider fails
+  loudly instead of leaving the machine. (libpq connections are made in C and go to localhost.)
+* ``FakeLLM``: replaces ``litellm.completion`` / ``litellm.acompletion``. Tests queue the JSON the
+  model would return; with an empty queue the call raises, which makes the app use its
+  documented heuristic fallback.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ipaddress
+import json
+import os
+import socket
+import threading
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from typing import Any, List
+
+_original_connect = socket.socket.connect
+_original_connect_ex = socket.socket.connect_ex
+_blocked: List[str] = []
+
+
+def _is_loopback(address: Any) -> bool:
+    if isinstance(address, (str, bytes)):  # AF_UNIX path
+        return True
+    host = address[0] if isinstance(address, tuple) and address else ""
+    if host in ("localhost",):
+        return True
+    try:
+        return ipaddress.ip_address(host).is_loopback
+    except ValueError:
+        return False
+
+
+def _guarded_connect(self, address):
+    if self.family in (socket.AF_INET, socket.AF_INET6) and not _is_loopback(address):
+        _blocked.append(repr(address))
+        raise ConnectionRefusedError(f"e2e network guard: outbound connection to {address!r} blocked")
+    return _original_connect(self, address)
+
+
+def _guarded_connect_ex(self, address):
+    if self.family in (socket.AF_INET, socket.AF_INET6) and not _is_loopback(address):
+        _blocked.append(repr(address))
+        return 111  # ECONNREFUSED
+    return _original_connect_ex(self, address)
+
+
+def install_network_guard() -> None:
+    for var in ("HTTP_PROXY", "HTTPS_PROXY", "ALL_PROXY", "http_proxy", "https_proxy", "all_proxy"):
+        os.environ.pop(var, None)
+    os.environ["NO_PROXY"] = os.environ["no_proxy"] = "127.0.0.1,localhost,::1"
+    # litellm downloads its model price map from GitHub at import time unless told not to.
+    os.environ["LITELLM_LOCAL_MODEL_COST_MAP"] = "True"
+    socket.socket.connect = _guarded_connect
+    socket.socket.connect_ex = _guarded_connect_ex
+
+
+def blocked_connections() -> List[str]:
+    return list(_blocked)
+
+
+class FakeLLM:
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self._queue: List[Any] = []
+        self.calls: List[dict] = []
+        self._lock = threading.Lock()
+
+    def queue_json(self, payload: dict) -> None:
+        with self._lock:
+            self._queue.append(payload)
+
+    def clear(self) -> None:
+        with self._lock:
+            self._queue.clear()
+
+    def _next(self, kwargs: dict):
+        with self._lock:
+            self.calls.append({"model": kwargs.get("model"), "messages": kwargs.get("messages")})
+            if not self._queue:
+                raise RuntimeError("e2e FakeLLM: no response queued (LLM disabled)")
+            payload = self._queue.pop(0)
+        content = payload if isinstance(payload, str) else json.dumps(payload)
+        return SimpleNamespace(choices=[SimpleNamespace(message=SimpleNamespace(content=content))])
+
+    def completion(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        return self._next(kwargs)
+
+    async def acompletion(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        return self._next(kwargs)
+
+    def install(self) -> None:
+        import litellm
+
+        litellm.completion = self.completion
+        litellm.acompletion = self.acompletion
diff --git a/tests/e2e/e2e_harness/stack.py b/tests/e2e/e2e_harness/stack.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..545026d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/e2e/e2e_harness/stack.py
@@ -0,0 +1,291 @@
+"""
+Bring up the e2e stack:
+
+    pytest ──HTTP──▶ ai_service (uvicorn, real FastAPI app, in-process thread)
+                          │ supabase-py (service_role JWT)
+                          ▼
+    pytest ──HTTP──▶ gateway (/rest/v1 → PostgREST, /storage/v1 stub, /__resend sink)
+                          ▼
+                     PostgREST 12 (real binary) ──▶ Postgres 16 (schema + all migrations)
+
+Only the LLM (litellm) and the e-mail provider endpoint are faked; storage-api is stubbed
+because it is not used by any scenario except image receipts (which are not exercised).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import http.client
+import json
+import os
+import shutil
+import socket
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import threading
+import time
+import urllib.parse
+from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Dict, List, Optional
+
+import psycopg
+
+from . import config
+
+
+def free_port() -> int:
+    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:
+        s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
+        return s.getsockname()[1]
+
+
+def wait_for_port(port: int, timeout: float = 30.0) -> None:
+    deadline = time.time() + timeout
+    while time.time() < deadline:
+        try:
+            with socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", port), timeout=0.5):
+                return
+        except OSError:
+            time.sleep(0.1)
+    raise RuntimeError(f"port {port} did not open within {timeout}s")
+
+
+# ─── Database ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def rebuild_database() -> None:
+    """Drop/recreate the e2e DB from stubs + schema.sql + seed.sql + every migration."""
+    env = dict(os.environ, PGHOST=config.PGHOST, PGPORT=str(config.PGPORT), PGUSER=config.PGUSER)
+    proc = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, str(config.RUN_TESTS), "--psql", "--rebuild", "--db", config.DB_NAME, "--no-tests"],
+        env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=900,
+    )
+    if proc.returncode != 0:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"DB rebuild failed:\n{proc.stdout}\n{proc.stderr}")
+
+
+def prepare_authenticator() -> None:
+    """Create the PostgREST login role (cluster-wide, idempotent) with Supabase's role grants."""
+    with psycopg.connect(config.pg_dsn(), autocommit=True) as conn:
+        conn.execute(
+            f"""
+            DO $$
+            BEGIN
+                IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = '{config.AUTHENTICATOR_ROLE}') THEN
+                    CREATE ROLE {config.AUTHENTICATOR_ROLE} LOGIN NOINHERIT;
+                END IF;
+            END $$;
+            """
+        )
+        conn.execute(f"GRANT anon, authenticated, service_role TO {config.AUTHENTICATOR_ROLE}")
+        conn.execute(f"GRANT CONNECT ON DATABASE {config.DB_NAME} TO {config.AUTHENTICATOR_ROLE}")
+
+
+# ─── PostgREST ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def locate_postgrest() -> str:
+    explicit = os.environ.get("BT_E2E_POSTGREST_BIN")
+    if explicit:
+        return explicit
+    found = shutil.which("postgrest")
+    if found:
+        return found
+    proc = subprocess.run([str(config.FETCH_POSTGREST)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
+    if proc.returncode != 0:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"PostgREST binary not found and download failed:\n{proc.stderr}")
+    return proc.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1]
+
+
+class PostgREST:
+    def __init__(self, workdir: Path):
+        self.port = free_port()
+        self.binary = locate_postgrest()
+        self.conf = workdir / "postgrest.conf"
+        self.log = workdir / "postgrest.log"
+        self.proc: Optional[subprocess.Popen] = None
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        self.conf.write_text(
+            "\n".join([
+                f'db-uri = "postgres://{config.AUTHENTICATOR_ROLE}@{config.PGHOST}:{config.PGPORT}/{config.DB_NAME}"',
+                'db-schemas = "public"',
+                'db-anon-role = "anon"',
+                'db-extra-search-path = "public, extensions"',
+                f'jwt-secret = "{config.JWT_SECRET}"',
+                'jwt-secret-is-base64 = false',
+                'server-host = "127.0.0.1"',
+                f"server-port = {self.port}",
+                "db-pool = 10",
+                "db-channel-enabled = false",
+                'log-level = "warn"',
+            ]) + "\n"
+        )
+        self._log_fh = open(self.log, "wb")
+        self.proc = subprocess.Popen([self.binary, str(self.conf)], stdout=self._log_fh, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
+        deadline = time.time() + 30
+        while time.time() < deadline:
+            if self.proc.poll() is not None:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"PostgREST exited: {self.log.read_text()}")
+            try:
+                conn = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", self.port, timeout=1)
+                conn.request("GET", "/")
+                if conn.getresponse().status in (200, 401):
+                    return
+            except OSError:
+                pass
+            time.sleep(0.2)
+        raise RuntimeError(f"PostgREST did not become ready: {self.log.read_text()}")
+
+    def stop(self) -> None:
+        if self.proc and self.proc.poll() is None:
+            self.proc.terminate()
+            try:
+                self.proc.wait(timeout=10)
+            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+                self.proc.kill()
+        if getattr(self, "_log_fh", None):
+            self._log_fh.close()
+
+
+# ─── Gateway (Supabase-style URL layout in front of PostgREST) ───────────────
+
+_HOP = {"connection", "keep-alive", "proxy-authenticate", "proxy-authorization", "te", "trailers",
+        "transfer-encoding", "upgrade", "host", "content-length"}
+
+
+class Gateway:
+    """
+    Kong stand-in: ``/rest/v1/*`` is proxied byte-for-byte to PostgREST; ``/storage/v1/*`` is a
+    minimal in-memory object store; ``/__resend/emails`` captures e-mails the app would send via
+    Resend; ``/auth/v1/.well-known/jwks.json`` serves an empty key set (HS256 only).
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, postgrest_port: int):
+        self.port = free_port()
+        self.postgrest_port = postgrest_port
+        self.storage: Dict[str, bytes] = {}
+        self.emails: List[dict] = []
+        self.resend_status = 200
+        self.rest_log: List[tuple] = []
+        gateway = self
+
+        class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+            protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
+
+            def log_message(self, *args):  # quiet
+                pass
+
+            def _body(self) -> bytes:
+                length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
+                return self.rfile.read(length) if length else b""
+
+            def _send(self, status: int, payload, headers: Optional[dict] = None) -> None:
+                data = payload if isinstance(payload, bytes) else json.dumps(payload).encode()
+                self.send_response(status)
+                self.send_header("Content-Type", (headers or {}).pop("Content-Type", "application/json"))
+                for k, v in (headers or {}).items():
+                    self.send_header(k, v)
+                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
+                self.end_headers()
+                self.wfile.write(data)
+
+            def _proxy(self) -> None:
+                body = self._body()
+                path = self.path[len("/rest/v1"):] or "/"
+                conn = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", gateway.postgrest_port, timeout=60)
+                headers = {k: v for k, v in self.headers.items() if k.lower() not in _HOP}
+                if body:
+                    headers["Content-Length"] = str(len(body))
+                conn.request(self.command, path, body=body or None, headers=headers)
+                resp = conn.getresponse()
+                data = resp.read()
+                gateway.rest_log.append((self.command, path, resp.status))
+                self.send_response(resp.status)
+                for k, v in resp.getheaders():
+                    if k.lower() not in _HOP:
+                        self.send_header(k, v)
+                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
+                self.end_headers()
+                if self.command != "HEAD":
+                    self.wfile.write(data)
+                conn.close()
+
+            def _storage(self) -> None:
+                body = self._body()
+                parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(self.path)
+                key = parsed.path[len("/storage/v1/object/"):]
+                if self.command in ("POST", "PUT") and parsed.path.startswith("/storage/v1/object/"):
+                    gateway.storage[key] = body
+                    self._send(200, {"Key": key, "Id": key})
+                elif self.command == "GET" and key in gateway.storage:
+                    self._send(200, gateway.storage[key], {"Content-Type": "application/octet-stream"})
+                else:
+                    self._send(404, {"statusCode": "404", "error": "not_found", "message": "Object not found"})
+
+            def _dispatch(self) -> None:
+                if self.path.startswith("/rest/v1"):
+                    return self._proxy()
+                if self.path.startswith("/storage/v1/"):
+                    return self._storage()
+                if self.path.startswith("/__resend/emails") and self.command == "POST":
+                    payload = json.loads(self._body() or b"{}")
+                    payload["_authorization"] = self.headers.get("Authorization")
+                    gateway.emails.append(payload)
+                    return self._send(gateway.resend_status, {"id": f"e2e-{len(gateway.emails)}"})
+                if self.path.startswith("/auth/v1/.well-known/jwks.json"):
+                    return self._send(200, {"keys": []})
+                self._body()
+                self._send(404, {"message": "not routed by e2e gateway"})
+
+            do_GET = do_POST = do_PATCH = do_PUT = do_DELETE = do_HEAD = do_OPTIONS = _dispatch
+
+        self.server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", self.port), Handler)
+        self.server.daemon_threads = True
+        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, name="e2e-gateway", daemon=True)
+
+    @property
+    def url(self) -> str:
+        return f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}"
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        self.thread.start()
+        wait_for_port(self.port)
+
+    def stop(self) -> None:
+        self.server.shutdown()
+        self.server.server_close()
+
+
+# ─── ai_service ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+class AppServer:
+    """The real FastAPI app served by uvicorn on a loopback port inside the test process."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.port = free_port()
+        self.server = None
+        self.thread: Optional[threading.Thread] = None
+
+    @property
+    def url(self) -> str:
+        return f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}"
+
+    def start(self, app) -> None:
+        import uvicorn
+
+        cfg = uvicorn.Config(app, host="127.0.0.1", port=self.port, log_level="warning", lifespan="off",
+                             access_log=False)
+        self.server = uvicorn.Server(cfg)
+        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.run, name="e2e-ai-service", daemon=True)
+        self.thread.start()
+        wait_for_port(self.port)
+
+    def stop(self) -> None:
+        if self.server:
+            self.server.should_exit = True
+        if self.thread:
+            self.thread.join(timeout=10)
+
+
+def make_workdir() -> Path:
+    return Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="bt-e2e-"))
diff --git a/tests/e2e/e2e_harness/tokens.py b/tests/e2e/e2e_harness/tokens.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b5382f3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/e2e/e2e_harness/tokens.py
@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+"""Locally signed Supabase-shaped JWTs (HS256 with the e2e test secret)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import time
+from typing import Optional
+
+from jose import jwt
+
+from .config import JWT_SECRET
+
+
+def user_token(supabase_url: str, user_id: str, email: Optional[str] = None, ttl: int = 3600, **extra) -> str:
+    """A GoTrue-style access token for an authenticated user."""
+    now = int(time.time())
+    claims = {
+        "sub": user_id,
+        "aud": "authenticated",
+        "role": "authenticated",
+        "iss": f"{supabase_url.rstrip('/')}/auth/v1",
+        "iat": now,
+        "exp": now + ttl,
+        "email": email or f"{user_id[:8]}@e2e.test",
+        "aal": "aal1",
+        "session_id": user_id,
+        "is_anonymous": False,
+    }
+    claims.update(extra)
+    return jwt.encode(claims, JWT_SECRET, algorithm="HS256")
+
+
+def service_role_key() -> str:
+    """Legacy-style service_role API key (what SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY holds on Railway)."""
+    now = int(time.time())
+    return jwt.encode(
+        {"iss": "supabase", "role": "service_role", "iat": now, "exp": now + 10 * 365 * 86400},
+        JWT_SECRET,
+        algorithm="HS256",
+    )
+
+
+def anon_key() -> str:
+    now = int(time.time())
+    return jwt.encode(
+        {"iss": "supabase", "role": "anon", "iat": now, "exp": now + 10 * 365 * 86400},
+        JWT_SECRET,
+        algorithm="HS256",
+    )
diff --git a/tests/e2e/e2e_harness/zatca.py b/tests/e2e/e2e_harness/zatca.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..10868bc
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/e2e/e2e_harness/zatca.py
@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+"""Build ZATCA (Phase 1/2) Base64 TLV QR payloads like a Saudi POS prints them."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import base64
+
+
+def tlv_qr(seller: str, vat_number: str, timestamp: str, total: str, vat: str) -> str:
+    out = b""
+    for tag, value in enumerate((seller, vat_number, timestamp, total, vat), start=1):
+        raw = value.encode("utf-8")
+        out += bytes([tag, len(raw)]) + raw
+    return base64.b64encode(out).decode("ascii")

+[pytest]
+# Real-stack end-to-end suite (local Postgres + PostgREST + ai_service). Not part of the hermetic
+# ai_service suite (ai_service/pytest.ini only collects ai_service/tests). Run with BT_E2E=1;
+# see README.md.
+testpaths = .
+markers =
+    e2e: end-to-end test against the local Postgres + PostgREST + ai_service stack
+addopts = -p no:cacheprovider -ra
+filterwarnings =
+    ignore::DeprecationWarning
