new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1e7a22b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/e2e/requirements.txt
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+# Real-stack e2e suite: the ai_service runtime plus a Postgres driver for fixtures/assertions.
+-r ../../ai_service/requirements.txt
+psycopg[binary]>=3.1
diff --git a/tests/e2e/scripts/fetch_postgrest.sh b/tests/e2e/scripts/fetch_postgrest.sh
new file mode 100755
index 0000000..f053df4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/e2e/scripts/fetch_postgrest.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Download the official PostgREST static Linux binary used by the e2e suite.
+#
+#   tests/e2e/scripts/fetch_postgrest.sh [DEST_DIR]
+#
+# Prints the absolute path of the binary on success. The version matches the PostgREST 12.x
+# line hosted Supabase projects run. Override with POSTGREST_VERSION=v12.2.x.
+set -euo pipefail
+
+VERSION="${POSTGREST_VERSION:-v12.2.3}"
+DEST="${1:-${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/bt-e2e/postgrest-${VERSION}}"
+ASSET="postgrest-${VERSION}-linux-static-x64.tar.xz"
+URL="https://github.com/PostgREST/postgrest/releases/download/${VERSION}/${ASSET}"
+
+mkdir -p "$DEST"
+if [[ ! -x "$DEST/postgrest" ]]; then
+    curl -sSfL --retry 3 --max-time 300 -o "$DEST/$ASSET" "$URL"
+    tar -xJf "$DEST/$ASSET" -C "$DEST" postgrest
+    rm -f "$DEST/$ASSET"
+    chmod +x "$DEST/postgrest"
+fi
+"$DEST/postgrest" --version >&2
+echo "$DEST/postgrest"
diff --git a/tests/e2e/test_01_households_and_invites.py b/tests/e2e/test_01_households_and_invites.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a883844
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/e2e/test_01_households_and_invites.py
@@ -0,0 +1,105 @@
+"""Scenario 1: households are created, joined by invite code, and invite brute force is locked out."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+
+def test_stack_smoke(stack, world):
+    # PostgREST is real: the service role reads the seeded system categories through it.
+    assert world.anonymous_api().get("/health").status_code == 200
+    user = world.signup("Smoke")
+    res = user.rest.get("/users", params={"select": "id,display_name"})
+    assert res.status_code == 200
+    assert res.json() == [{"id": user.id, "display_name": "Smoke"}]  # RLS: own row only
+
+
+def test_family_household_join_via_spouse_invite(world, db):
+    hh = world.family("F1")
+    husband, wife = hh.admin, hh.members[0]
+
+    members = husband.api.get(f"/households/{hh.id}/members")
+    assert members.status_code == 200, members.text
+    body = members.json()
+    assert body["primary_admin_user_id"] == husband.id
+    roles = {m["user_id"]: (m["role"], m["financial_role"]) for m in body["members"]}
+    assert roles == {husband.id: ("admin", "provider"), wife.id: ("member", "spouse")}
+
+    # The wife sees the same household; her active household switched to it.
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT household_id::text FROM public.users WHERE id = %s", (wife.id,)) == hh.id
+    wife_view = wife.api.get(f"/households/{hh.id}/members")
+    assert wife_view.status_code == 200
+    assert wife_view.json()["caller_role"] == "member"
+
+    # The family is recognised as a Nafaqah household.
+    summary = wife.api.get(f"/households/{hh.id}/nafaqah")
+    assert summary.status_code == 200, summary.text
+
+
+def test_roommate_household_join_and_invite_single_use(world, db):
+    hh = world.roommates("R1", n_members=2)
+    admin = hh.admin
+    body = admin.api.get(f"/households/{hh.id}/members").json()
+    assert {m["user_id"] for m in body["members"]} == {u.id for u in hh.everyone}
+    assert sorted(m["role"] for m in body["members"]) == ["admin", "member", "member"]
+    assert {m["financial_role"] for m in body["members"] if m["role"] == "member"} == {"peer"}
+
+    # Invite metadata is public but minimal; a used code is invalid and cannot be re-claimed.
+    code = world.invite(admin, hh, "peer")
+    info = world.anonymous_api().get(f"/households/invites/{code}")
+    assert info.status_code == 200
+    assert info.json()["is_valid"] is True and "household_id" not in info.json()
+    joiner = world.signup("LateMate")
+    world.join(joiner, hh, code)
+    assert world.anonymous_api().get(f"/households/invites/{code}").json()["is_valid"] is False
+    other = world.signup("Squatter")
+    again = other.api.post(f"/households/invites/{code}/claim")
+    assert again.status_code == 400
+
+    # Only an admin may mint invites.
+    member = hh.members[0]
+    assert member.api.post(f"/households/{hh.id}/invites", json={"role": "peer"}).status_code == 403
+
+
+def test_invite_brute_force_lockout_returns_429(world, db):
+    hh = world.roommates("R2", n_members=0)
+    attacker = world.signup("Guesser")
+    statuses = [attacker.api.post(f"/households/invites/WRONG{i:011d}/claim").status_code for i in range(5)]
+    assert statuses == [400] * 5
+    locked = attacker.api.post(f"/households/invites/WRONG99999999999/claim")
+    assert locked.status_code == 429, locked.text
+    assert locked.headers.get("Retry-After") == "900"
+
+    # Even the correct code is refused while locked out.
+    good = world.invite(hh.admin, hh, "peer")
+    assert attacker.api.post(f"/households/invites/{good}/claim").status_code == 429
+    assert db.scalar(
+        "SELECT count(*) FROM public.household_memberships WHERE household_id = %s AND user_id = %s",
+        (hh.id, attacker.id),
+    ) == 0
+
+    # The same lockout guards the direct PostgREST join RPC used by the app.
+    direct = attacker.rpc("join_household_by_code", {"p_invite_code": good})
+    assert direct.status_code >= 400
+    assert db.scalar(
+        "SELECT count(*) FROM public.household_memberships WHERE household_id = %s AND user_id = %s",
+        (hh.id, attacker.id),
+    ) == 0
+
+
+def test_forged_expired_and_wrong_role_tokens_are_rejected(world, stack):
+    import httpx
+    from jose import jwt as jose_jwt
+
+    from e2e_harness.tokens import service_role_key, user_token
+
+    hh = world.roommates("T1", n_members=0)
+    user = hh.admin
+    forged = jose_jwt.encode(jose_jwt.get_unverified_claims(user.token), "not-the-secret", algorithm="HS256")
+    expired = user_token(stack.gateway.url, user.id, user.email, ttl=-3600)
+    wrong_iss = user_token("https://evil.example", user.id, user.email)
+    for token in (forged, expired, wrong_iss, service_role_key()):
+        api = world.anonymous_api(Authorization=f"Bearer {token}")
+        assert api.get(f"/households/{hh.id}/members").status_code == 401
+    # PostgREST verifies the same secret: a forged token never reaches the database as the user.
+    res = httpx.get(f"{stack.gateway.url}/rest/v1/households", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {forged}"},
+                    trust_env=False)
+    assert res.status_code == 401
diff --git a/tests/e2e/test_02_expense_commits_and_cycles.py b/tests/e2e/test_02_expense_commits_and_cycles.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..683d8d4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/e2e/test_02_expense_commits_and_cycles.py
@@ -0,0 +1,200 @@
+"""
+Scenario 2: chat expense commits (LLM mocked) by every member, a ZATCA QR receipt commit (no LLM)
+with a Nafaqah class, and cycle_key attribution for a 27th payday and a custom 10th payday around
+month boundaries and Riyadh midnight.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import uuid
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+
+import pytest
+
+from e2e_harness.zatca import tlv_qr
+
+
+def _tx(db, tx_id):
+    return db.one(
+        "SELECT household_id::text, user_id::text, amount, source, category_code, cycle_key, nafaqah_class,"
+        " nafaqah_spouse_id::text, qr_code_raw, dedup_fingerprint, timestamp FROM public.transactions WHERE id = %s",
+        (tx_id,),
+    )
+
+
+def test_chat_commit_by_every_member_of_both_households(world, db, llm):
+    family = world.family("C1")
+    flat = world.roommates("C1", n_members=2)
+    for hh in (family, flat):
+        for i, user in enumerate(hh.everyone):
+            res = world.chat_commit(user, hh, llm, merchant=f"Albaik {user.display_name}", amount=23.5 + i)
+            assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+            body = res.json()
+            assert body["status"] == "success", body
+            row = _tx(db, body["transaction_id"])
+            assert row["household_id"] == hh.id
+            assert row["user_id"] == user.id, "creator must be the JWT subject"
+            assert float(row["amount"]) == 23.5 + i
+            assert row["source"] == "chat"
+            assert row["cycle_key"] == body.get("cycle_key", row["cycle_key"])
+    # The mocked LLM was the only model contacted, once per commit.
+    assert len(llm.calls) == 5
+    assert all(c["model"] == "e2e/fake-model" for c in llm.calls)
+
+    # Family attribution: the wife paying for the household is her advance; the husband's is not.
+    wife = family.members[0]
+    rows = db.query(
+        "SELECT user_id::text, nafaqah_class, nafaqah_spouse_id::text FROM public.transactions WHERE household_id = %s",
+        (family.id,),
+    )
+    by_user = {r["user_id"]: r for r in rows}
+    assert by_user[wife.id]["nafaqah_class"] == "wife_reimbursable"
+    assert by_user[wife.id]["nafaqah_spouse_id"] == wife.id
+    assert by_user[family.admin.id]["nafaqah_class"] is None
+    # Roommates are never classified.
+    assert db.scalar(
+        "SELECT count(*) FROM public.transactions WHERE household_id = %s AND nafaqah_class IS NOT NULL", (flat.id,)
+    ) == 0
+
+
+def test_chat_heuristic_fallback_when_llm_unavailable(world, db, llm):
+    flat = world.roommates("C2", n_members=0)
+    res = flat.admin.api.post(
+        "/agent/chat-transaction",
+        json={"household_id": flat.id, "message": "Starbucks coffee 18 SAR", "allow_duplicate": True},
+    )
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    body = res.json()
+    assert body["status"] == "success" and body["amount"] == 18.0
+    assert _tx(db, body["transaction_id"])["user_id"] == flat.admin.id
+
+
+def test_zatca_qr_receipt_commit_with_nafaqah_class(world, db, llm):
+    family = world.family("Q1")
+    wife = family.members[0]
+    vat_no = "3" + uuid.uuid4().int.__str__()[:13] + "3"
+    qr = tlv_qr("Panda Retail Co", vat_no, "2026-10-19T18:30:00Z", "115.00", "15.00")
+
+    preview = wife.api.post(
+        "/agent/scan-receipt",
+        json={"household_id": family.id, "qr_code_raw": qr, "preview_only": True, "nafaqah_class": "wife_personal"},
+    )
+    assert preview.status_code == 200, preview.text
+    p = preview.json()
+    assert p["status"] == "preview" and p["amount"] == 115.0 and p["vat_amount"] == 15.0
+    assert p["household_mode"] == "family_nafaqah" and p["nafaqah_class"] == "wife_personal"
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT count(*) FROM public.transactions WHERE household_id = %s", (family.id,)) == 0
+
+    commit = wife.api.post(
+        "/agent/scan-receipt",
+        json={"household_id": family.id, "qr_code_raw": qr, "nafaqah_class": "wife_personal"},
+        headers={"Idempotency-Key": f"qr-{uuid.uuid4().hex}"},
+    )
+    assert commit.status_code == 200, commit.text
+    c = commit.json()
+    assert c["status"] == "success", c
+    row = _tx(db, c["transaction_id"])
+    assert row["user_id"] == wife.id and row["source"] == "receipt_scan"
+    assert float(row["amount"]) == 115.0
+    assert row["nafaqah_class"] == "wife_personal" and row["nafaqah_spouse_id"] == wife.id
+    assert row["qr_code_raw"] == qr and row["dedup_fingerprint"]
+    assert llm.calls == [], "a QR-only receipt must not call the LLM"
+
+    # Scanning the same invoice again is caught by the ZATCA fingerprint.
+    again = wife.api.post("/agent/scan-receipt", json={"household_id": family.id, "qr_code_raw": qr})
+    assert again.status_code == 200
+    assert again.json()["status"] == "duplicate_candidate"
+    assert again.json()["candidate_transaction_id"] == c["transaction_id"]
+
+    # A wife cannot mislabel her household advance with a class that contradicts the attribution.
+    bad = wife.api.post(
+        "/agent/scan-receipt",
+        json={"household_id": family.id, "qr_code_raw": tlv_qr("Danube", vat_no, "2026-10-19T19:00:00Z", "40.00", "5.22"),
+              "paid_by": "me", "beneficiary": "both", "nafaqah_class": "wife_personal"},
+    )
+    assert bad.status_code == 422, bad.text
+
+
+# ── cycle_key attribution ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def _iso(dt: datetime) -> str:
+    return dt.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
+
+
+CYCLE_CASES_27 = [
+    # (UTC instant, Riyadh local wall time, expected cycle_key for payday 27)
+    (datetime(2026, 9, 26, 20, 59, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc), "Sep 26 23:59", "2026-09"),
+    (datetime(2026, 9, 26, 21, 0, 30, tzinfo=timezone.utc), "Sep 27 00:00:30 (UTC still Sep 26)", "2026-10"),
+    (datetime(2026, 8, 31, 21, 30, tzinfo=timezone.utc), "Sep 1 00:30 (UTC still Aug 31)", "2026-09"),
+    (datetime(2026, 10, 1, 9, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc), "Oct 1 12:00", "2026-10"),
+]
+
+CYCLE_CASES_10 = [
+    (datetime(2026, 10, 9, 20, 59, tzinfo=timezone.utc), "Oct 9 23:59", "2026-09"),
+    (datetime(2026, 10, 9, 21, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc), "Oct 10 00:01 (UTC still Oct 9)", "2026-10"),
+    (datetime(2026, 9, 30, 21, 30, tzinfo=timezone.utc), "Oct 1 00:30 (UTC still Sep 30)", "2026-09"),
+    (datetime(2026, 9, 10, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc), "Sep 10 03:00", "2026-09"),
+    (datetime(2026, 9, 9, 20, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc), "Sep 9 23:00", "2026-08"),
+]
+
+
+def _seed_cycle_budgets(db, household_id, category, cycles):
+    for ck in cycles:
+        db.query(
+            "INSERT INTO public.budgets (household_id, month, category_code, allocated_amount, cycle_key)"
+            " VALUES (%s, (%s || '-01')::date, %s, 5000, %s)",
+            (household_id, ck, category, ck),
+        )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("payday,cases", [(27, CYCLE_CASES_27), (10, CYCLE_CASES_10)], ids=["payday27", "payday10"])
+def test_cycle_key_for_payday_around_boundaries(world, db, llm, payday, cases):
+    flat = world.roommates(f"P{payday}", n_members=1)
+    admin, member = flat.admin, flat.members[0]
+    if payday != 27:
+        assert member.api.put(f"/households/{flat.id}/payday", json={"payday_day": payday}).status_code == 403
+        res = admin.api.put(f"/households/{flat.id}/payday", json={"payday_day": payday})
+        assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    assert admin.api.get(f"/households/{flat.id}/payday").json()["payday_day"] == payday
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT payday_day FROM public.households WHERE id = %s", (flat.id,)) == payday
+
+    category = "OPEX-DINING"
+    _seed_cycle_budgets(db, flat.id, category, sorted({c[2] for c in cases}))
+
+    for instant, wall, expected in cases:
+        res = world.chat_commit(member, flat, llm, merchant=f"Cafe {wall}", amount=10, category_code=category,
+                                occurred_at=_iso(instant))
+        assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+        row = _tx(db, res.json()["transaction_id"])
+        assert row["cycle_key"] == expected, f"{wall} Riyadh with payday {payday}"
+        assert row["timestamp"] == instant
+
+    # Each cycle budget was charged exactly its own transactions.
+    budgets = db.query(
+        "SELECT cycle_key, spent_amount FROM public.budgets WHERE household_id = %s AND category_code = %s",
+        (flat.id, category),
+    )
+    expected_spent = {}
+    for _, _, ck in cases:
+        expected_spent[ck] = expected_spent.get(ck, 0) + 10
+    assert {b["cycle_key"]: float(b["spent_amount"]) for b in budgets} == expected_spent
+
+
+def test_occurred_at_window_is_enforced(world, llm):
+    flat = world.roommates("P3", n_members=0)
+    future = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(hours=1)
+    res = world.chat_commit(flat.admin, flat, llm, merchant="Future", amount=5, occurred_at=_iso(future))
+    assert res.status_code == 400
+    too_old = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(days=120)
+    res = world.chat_commit(flat.admin, flat, llm, merchant="Old", amount=5, occurred_at=_iso(too_old))
+    assert res.status_code == 400
+
+
+def test_unknown_category_override_is_a_client_error(world, db, llm):
+    # E2E-03 (fixed): an unknown category_code override answers 422 with a fixed message.
+    flat = world.roommates("C3", n_members=0)
+    res = world.chat_commit(flat.admin, flat, llm, merchant="Mystery", amount=12, category_code="OPEX-NOPE",
+                            extra_body={"category_code": "OPEX-NOPE"})
+    assert res.status_code == 422, (res.status_code, res.text)
+    assert "23503" not in res.text and "taxonomy" not in res.text
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT count(*) FROM public.transactions WHERE household_id = %s", (flat.id,)) == 0
diff --git a/tests/e2e/test_03_nafaqah_and_settlement.py b/tests/e2e/test_03_nafaqah_and_settlement.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..04e93e1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/e2e/test_03_nafaqah_and_settlement.py
@@ -0,0 +1,178 @@
+"""
+Scenario 3: Islamic Nafaqah end to end. A wife-paid shared expense is a debt the husband owes her;
+partial and full reimbursement; overpayment → 409 (API and database); the wife's personal spend is
+charged to her allowance (spent/remaining); she cannot set her own allowance; the settlement
+endpoints in family mode reflect the ledger and never split 50/50. Also the roommate settlement
+paths that share these endpoints.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pytest
+
+
+def _ledger(user, hh):
+    res = user.api.get(f"/households/{hh.id}/nafaqah/reimbursements")
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    return res.json()
+
+
+def test_wife_advance_partial_full_and_overpayment(world, db, llm):
+    hh = world.family("N1")
+    husband, wife = hh.admin, hh.members[0]
+
+    # Wife pays 300 for the household (shared) and 45.50 for groceries: both her advances.
+    for merchant, amount in (("Carrefour Family Shop", 300), ("Tamimi Markets", 45.5)):
+        res = world.chat_commit(wife, hh, llm, merchant=merchant, amount=amount, category_code="OPEX-GROCERY",
+                                paid_by="me", beneficiary="both")
+        assert res.status_code == 200 and res.json()["nafaqah_class"] == "wife_reimbursable", res.text
+    # The husband's own spending creates no debt.
+    res = world.chat_commit(husband, hh, llm, merchant="Danube", amount=500, category_code="OPEX-GROCERY")
+    assert res.json()["nafaqah_class"] is None
+
+    ledger = _ledger(husband, hh)
+    assert ledger["wife_user_id"] == wife.id and ledger["husband_user_id"] == husband.id
+    assert ledger["balance"] == {"gross_advanced": 345.5, "reimbursed": 0.0, "outstanding": 345.5, "overpaid": 0.0}
+    # The wife sees the same balance (husband owes her).
+    assert _ledger(wife, hh)["balance"]["outstanding"] == 345.5
+
+    # Partial repayment by the husband.
+    part = husband.api.post(f"/households/{hh.id}/nafaqah/reimbursements",
+                            json={"amount": 100.25, "payment_method": "stc_pay", "notes": "part 1"})
+    assert part.status_code == 200, part.text
+    assert part.json()["outstanding_before"] == 345.5 and part.json()["outstanding_after"] == 245.25
+
+    # Overpayment is refused with 409 and the outstanding amount, and nothing is recorded.
+    over = husband.api.post(f"/households/{hh.id}/nafaqah/reimbursements", json={"amount": 245.26})
+    assert over.status_code == 409, over.text
+    assert over.json()["detail"]["code"] == "overpayment" and over.json()["detail"]["outstanding"] == 245.25
+    # The database re-checks overpayment independently of the API (direct PostgREST RPC).
+    direct = husband.rpc("record_spouse_reimbursement", {
+        "p_household_id": hh.id, "p_wife_user_id": wife.id, "p_amount": "245.26",
+        "p_payment_method": "cash", "p_notes": None, "p_actor_user_id": husband.id,
+    })
+    assert direct.status_code >= 400 and "outstanding" in direct.text.lower(), direct.text
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT count(*) FROM public.spouse_reimbursements WHERE household_id = %s", (hh.id,)) == 1
+
+    # The generic reimbursement endpoint routes family repayments to the same ledger.
+    full = husband.api.post(f"/households/{hh.id}/reimbursements", json={
+        "household_id": hh.id, "payer_id": husband.id, "recipient_id": wife.id, "amount": 245.25,
+        "payment_method": "cash",
+    })
+    assert full.status_code == 200, full.text
+    assert full.json()["mode"] == "family_nafaqah" and full.json()["outstanding_after"] == 0.0
+    assert _ledger(wife, hh)["balance"] == {"gross_advanced": 345.5, "reimbursed": 345.5, "outstanding": 0.0,
+                                            "overpaid": 0.0}
+    # Settled: any further repayment is an overpayment, also through the generic endpoint.
+    again = husband.api.post(f"/households/{hh.id}/reimbursements", json={
+        "household_id": hh.id, "payer_id": husband.id, "recipient_id": wife.id, "amount": 0.01})
+    assert again.status_code == 409
+    # A "wife pays husband" settlement does not exist in a family.
+    reverse = wife.api.post(f"/households/{hh.id}/reimbursements", json={
+        "household_id": hh.id, "payer_id": wife.id, "recipient_id": husband.id, "amount": 10})
+    assert reverse.status_code == 409
+    history = _ledger(husband, hh)["history"]
+    assert sorted(h["type"] for h in history) == ["advance", "advance", "reimbursement", "reimbursement"]
+
+
+def test_wife_personal_allowance_spent_and_remaining(world, db, llm):
+    hh = world.family("N2")
+    husband, wife = hh.admin, hh.members[0]
+
+    # Only the husband/admin sets it; the wife is refused via API and via the RPC directly.
+    own = wife.api.put(f"/households/{hh.id}/nafaqah/allowance", json={"amount": 9999})
+    assert own.status_code == 403, own.text
+    direct = wife.rpc("set_member_allowance", {
+        "p_household_id": hh.id, "p_member_user_id": wife.id, "p_amount": "9999", "p_cycle_key": None,
+        "p_actor_user_id": wife.id,
+    })
+    assert direct.status_code >= 400, direct.text
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT count(*) FROM public.member_allowances WHERE household_id = %s", (hh.id,)) == 0
+
+    setres = husband.api.put(f"/households/{hh.id}/nafaqah/allowance", json={"amount": 500})
+    assert setres.status_code == 200, setres.text
+    cycle = setres.json()["cycle_key"]
+    assert setres.json()["allocated"] == 500.0 and setres.json()["spent"] == 0.0
+
+    # Wife's personal purchases (paid by her, for her) are charged to the allowance.
+    for merchant, amount in (("Zara Riyadh Park", 120), ("Nahdi Pharmacy", 30.75)):
+        res = world.chat_commit(wife, hh, llm, merchant=merchant, amount=amount, category_code="OPEX-SHOPPING",
+                                paid_by="me", beneficiary="me")
+        assert res.status_code == 200 and res.json()["nafaqah_class"] == "wife_personal", res.text
+    # A shared advance is NOT allowance spending.
+    world.chat_commit(wife, hh, llm, merchant="Lulu", amount=60, category_code="OPEX-GROCERY")
+
+    allowance = wife.api.get(f"/households/{hh.id}/nafaqah/allowance").json()
+    assert allowance["cycle_key"] == cycle
+    assert (allowance["allocated"], allowance["spent"], allowance["remaining"]) == (500.0, 150.75, 349.25)
+    assert allowance["transaction_count"] == 2
+
+    # Overspend is reported, not blocked.
+    world.chat_commit(wife, hh, llm, merchant="Abaya House", amount=400, category_code="OPEX-SHOPPING",
+                      paid_by="me", beneficiary="me")
+    allowance = husband.api.get(f"/households/{hh.id}/nafaqah/allowance").json()
+    assert allowance["remaining"] == -50.75
+
+    summary = wife.api.get(f"/households/{hh.id}/nafaqah").json()
+    assert summary["caller_role"] == "wife" and summary["can_set_allowance"] is False
+    assert summary["wives"][0]["reimbursement"]["outstanding"] == 60.0
+    assert summary["wives"][0]["allowance"]["spent"] == 550.75
+
+
+def test_family_settlement_reflects_ledger_never_fifty_fifty(world, db, llm):
+    hh = world.family("N3")
+    husband, wife = hh.admin, hh.members[0]
+    world.chat_commit(wife, hh, llm, merchant="Othaim", amount=200, category_code="OPEX-GROCERY")
+    world.chat_commit(husband, hh, llm, merchant="Panda", amount=1000, category_code="OPEX-GROCERY")
+    husband.api.post(f"/households/{hh.id}/nafaqah/reimbursements", json={"amount": 50})
+
+    # ?split_ratio is ignored for families; the debt is exactly the ledger outstanding (150).
+    for user, expect_who in ((husband, "me_owes_partner"), (wife, "partner_owes_me")):
+        res = user.api.get(f"/households/{hh.id}/settlement", params={"split_ratio": 0.5})
+        assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+        s = res.json()
+        assert s["mode"] == "family_nafaqah"
+        assert s["settlement_amount"] == 150.0 and s["who_owes"] == expect_who
+        assert s["nafaqah"]["outstanding"] == 150.0
+        # No spousal split of the husband's 1000 or the wife's 200.
+        assert s["settlement_amount"] not in (600.0, 400.0, 500.0, 100.0)
+
+    v2 = husband.api.get(f"/households/{hh.id}/settlement-v2")
+    assert v2.status_code == 200, v2.text
+    fam = v2.json()["family_summary"]
+    assert v2.json()["mode"] == "family_nafaqah"
+    assert fam["wife_reimbursement_owed"] == 150.0 and fam["reimbursed_total"] == 50.0
+    assert fam["gross_wife_advances"] == 200.0 and fam["status"] == "reimbursement_pending"
+
+
+# ── Roommates (same endpoints, shared_split / multi_roommate modes) ─────────────
+
+def test_roommate_settlement_reimbursement_is_recorded(world, db, llm):
+    hh = world.roommates("N4", n_members=2)
+    a, b = hh.members
+    res = a.api.post(f"/households/{hh.id}/reimbursements", json={
+        "household_id": hh.id, "payer_id": a.id, "recipient_id": b.id, "amount": 75, "payment_method": "stc_pay"})
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT count(*) FROM public.transactions WHERE household_id = %s AND is_settlement", (hh.id,)) == 1
+
+
+def test_roommate_settlement_permissions(world, db):
+    hh = world.roommates("N5", n_members=2)
+    a, b = hh.members
+    # A third party (not payer, not recipient, not admin) cannot record someone else's settlement.
+    res = b.api.post(f"/households/{hh.id}/reimbursements", json={
+        "household_id": hh.id, "payer_id": a.id, "recipient_id": hh.admin.id, "amount": 10})
+    assert res.status_code == 403, res.text
+
+
+def test_roommate_multi_party_settlement_reports_debts(world, db, llm):
+    hh = world.roommates("N6", n_members=2)
+    payer = hh.members[0]
+    res = world.chat_commit(payer, hh, llm, merchant="Electricity SEC", amount=300, category_code="OPEX-UTILITIES")
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    v2 = payer.api.get(f"/households/{hh.id}/settlement-v2")
+    assert v2.status_code == 200, v2.text
+    body = v2.json()
+    assert body["mode"] == "multi_roommate"
+    owed_to_payer = sum(d["amount"] for d in body["simplified_debts"] if d["to_id"] == payer.id)
+    assert owed_to_payer == 200.0
diff --git a/tests/e2e/test_04_permissions.py b/tests/e2e/test_04_permissions.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5ad6793
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/e2e/test_04_permissions.py
@@ -0,0 +1,214 @@
+"""
+Scenario 4: roles and permissions (DB-16 / DB-18) through the API and directly through PostgREST
+with the member's own JWT (what the Flutter app does for edits and deletes).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+import pytest
+
+
+def _commit(world, llm, user, hh, merchant, amount=50.0):
+    res = world.chat_commit(user, hh, llm, merchant=merchant, amount=amount, category_code="OPEX-DINING")
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    return res.json()["transaction_id"]
+
+
+def _patch_tx(user, tx_id, **fields):
+    return user.rest.patch(f"/transactions?id=eq.{tx_id}", json=fields, headers={"Prefer": "return=representation"})
+
+
+def test_transaction_edit_and_delete_permissions(world, db, llm):
+    hh = world.roommates("E1", n_members=2)
+    admin, alice, bob = hh.admin, hh.members[0], hh.members[1]
+    alice_tx = _commit(world, llm, alice, hh, "Kudu Alice")
+    bob_tx = _commit(world, llm, bob, hh, "Kudu Bob")
+
+    # Member edits own transaction directly through PostgREST: OK.
+    own = _patch_tx(alice, alice_tx, merchant="Kudu Alice (edited)", amount=55)
+    assert own.status_code == 200, own.text
+    assert own.json()[0]["merchant"] == "Kudu Alice (edited)"
+
+    # Member edits / deletes someone else's: 403 from the database, row untouched.
+    other = _patch_tx(alice, bob_tx, amount=1)
+    assert other.status_code == 403, other.text
+    gone = alice.rest.delete(f"/transactions?id=eq.{bob_tx}")
+    assert gone.status_code == 403, gone.text
+    assert float(db.scalar("SELECT amount FROM public.transactions WHERE id = %s", (bob_tx,))) == 50.0
+    # Re-assigning the creator to dodge the rule is refused too.
+    steal = _patch_tx(alice, bob_tx, user_id=alice.id)
+    assert steal.status_code == 403
+
+    # Through the API: linking another member's transaction to an installment plan is an edit.
+    plan = {"household_id": hh.id, "provider": "tabby", "merchant": "Jarir", "total_amount": 400,
+            "installment_count": 4, "original_transaction_id": bob_tx}
+    api_other = alice.api.post("/budgets/installments", json=plan)
+    assert api_other.status_code == 403, api_other.text
+    api_own = alice.api.post("/budgets/installments", json={
+        **plan, "original_transaction_id": alice_tx, "adjust_original_transaction": False})
+    assert api_own.status_code == 200, api_own.text
+    # Enriching another member's transaction by chat is an edit as well.
+    world_llm_items = {"is_transaction": True, "merchant": "Kudu Bob", "total_amount": 50, "items": [
+        {"name": "Burger", "quantity": 1, "price": 50}]}
+    llm.queue_json(world_llm_items)
+    enrich = alice.api.post("/agent/chat-transaction", json={
+        "household_id": hh.id, "message": "add items", "enrich_tx_id": bob_tx})
+    assert enrich.status_code == 403, enrich.text
+
+    # Admin edits and deletes anyone's.
+    admin_edit = _patch_tx(admin, bob_tx, merchant="Kudu Bob (admin fix)")
+    assert admin_edit.status_code == 200 and admin_edit.json(), admin_edit.text
+    admin_del = admin.rest.delete(f"/transactions?id=eq.{alice_tx}", headers={"Prefer": "return=representation"})
+    assert admin_del.status_code == 200 and len(admin_del.json()) == 1
+    # A member deletes their own.
+    own_del = bob.rest.delete(f"/transactions?id=eq.{bob_tx}", headers={"Prefer": "return=representation"})
+    assert own_del.status_code == 200 and len(own_del.json()) == 1
+
+
+def _account(user, hh, name, *, shared: bool) -> str:
+    res = user.rest.post("/accounts", json={
+        "household_id": hh.id, "owner_user_id": user.id, "name": name,
+        "account_type": "shared_pool" if shared else "bank", "is_shared_pool": shared,
+    }, headers={"Prefer": "return=representation"})
+    assert res.status_code == 201, res.text
+    return res.json()[0]["id"]
+
+
+def _income(user, hh, account_id, amount) -> None:
+    res = user.rpc("record_income", {
+        "p_household_id": hh.id, "p_account_id": account_id, "p_cycle_key": None, "p_source_type": "salary",
+        "p_title": "Salary", "p_base_amount": amount,
+    })
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+
+
+def _transfer(user, hh, src, dst, amount, fee=0) -> "object":
+    return user.rpc("transfer_between_accounts", {
+        "p_household_id": hh.id, "p_from_account_id": src, "p_to_account_id": dst, "p_amount": amount, "p_fee": fee,
+    })
+
+
+def test_shared_pool_withdrawal_admin_only(world, db):
+    hh = world.roommates("E2", n_members=1)
+    admin, member = hh.admin, hh.members[0]
+    # Only an admin can create the shared pool.
+    denied_pool = member.rest.post("/accounts", json={
+        "household_id": hh.id, "owner_user_id": member.id, "name": "Pool?", "account_type": "shared_pool",
+        "is_shared_pool": True})
+    assert denied_pool.status_code in (401, 403), denied_pool.text
+    pool = _account(admin, hh, "House pool", shared=True)
+    member_wallet = _account(member, hh, "Member STC Pay", shared=False)
+    admin_wallet = _account(admin, hh, "Admin bank", shared=False)
+    _income(member, hh, pool, 1000)  # anyone may pay INTO the pool
+
+    withdraw = _transfer(member, hh, pool, member_wallet, 100)
+    assert withdraw.status_code == 403, withdraw.text
+    assert "shared pool" in withdraw.text
+    assert float(db.scalar("SELECT balance FROM public.accounts WHERE id = %s", (pool,))) == 1000.0
+
+    ok = _transfer(admin, hh, pool, admin_wallet, 100, fee=1.5)
+    assert ok.status_code == 200, ok.text
+    balances = {r["id"]: float(r["balance"]) for r in db.query(
+        "SELECT id::text, balance FROM public.accounts WHERE household_id = %s", (hh.id,))}
+    assert balances == {pool: 898.5, admin_wallet: 100.0, member_wallet: 0.0}
+
+    # Nobody moves money out of another member's personal account.
+    _income(member, hh, member_wallet, 50)
+    assert _transfer(admin, hh, member_wallet, admin_wallet, 10).status_code == 403
+
+
+def _members(user, hh):
+    res = user.api.get(f"/households/{hh.id}/members")
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    return res.json()
+
+
+def _role(user, hh, target_id) -> Optional[str]:
+    return {m["user_id"]: m["role"] for m in _members(user, hh)["members"]}.get(target_id)
+
+
+def test_co_admin_promotion_protection_and_primary_transfer(world, db, llm):
+    hh = world.roommates("E3", n_members=2)
+    primary, co, plain = hh.admin, hh.members[0], hh.members[1]
+
+    # A member cannot promote anyone.
+    assert plain.api.post(f"/households/{hh.id}/members/{plain.id}/admin").status_code == 403
+
+    promoted = primary.api.post(f"/households/{hh.id}/members/{co.id}/admin")
+    assert promoted.status_code == 200, promoted.text
+    assert _role(primary, hh, co.id) == "admin"
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT role FROM public.users WHERE id = %s", (co.id,)) == "admin"
+
+    # The co-admin now has admin rights in the database too (edits another member's tx via PostgREST).
+    plain_tx = _commit(world, llm, plain, hh, "Shawarmer")
+    assert _patch_tx(co, plain_tx, merchant="Shawarmer (co-admin)").status_code == 200
+
+    # A co-admin cannot demote the primary admin: API, RPC and raw table write all refuse.
+    demote = co.api.delete(f"/households/{hh.id}/members/{primary.id}/admin")
+    assert demote.status_code == 403, demote.text
+    rpc = co.rpc("revoke_admin", {"p_household_id": hh.id, "p_user_id": primary.id, "p_actor_user_id": co.id})
+    assert rpc.status_code >= 400, rpc.text
+    raw = co.rest.patch(f"/household_memberships?household_id=eq.{hh.id}&user_id=eq.{primary.id}",
+                        json={"role": "member"}, headers={"Prefer": "return=representation"})
+    assert raw.status_code in (401, 403) or raw.json() == [], raw.text
+    assert _role(primary, hh, primary.id) == "admin"
+    # ...nor transfer primary ownership.
+    steal = co.api.post(f"/households/{hh.id}/primary-admin", json={"new_primary_user_id": co.id})
+    assert steal.status_code == 403
+    # A co-admin may promote others (any admin can).
+    assert co.api.post(f"/households/{hh.id}/members/{plain.id}/admin").status_code == 200
+    assert co.api.delete(f"/households/{hh.id}/members/{plain.id}/admin").status_code == 200
+    assert _role(primary, hh, plain.id) == "member"
+
+    # Primary transfers ownership to the co-admin.
+    transfer = primary.api.post(f"/households/{hh.id}/primary-admin", json={"new_primary_user_id": co.id})
+    assert transfer.status_code == 200, transfer.text
+    view = _members(co, hh)
+    assert view["primary_admin_user_id"] == co.id and view["caller_is_primary"] is True
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT owner_user_id::text FROM public.households WHERE id = %s", (hh.id,)) == co.id
+    # The former primary is now an ordinary co-admin: the new primary can demote them...
+    assert co.api.delete(f"/households/{hh.id}/members/{primary.id}/admin").status_code == 200
+    assert _role(co, hh, primary.id) == "member"
+    # ...and the sole remaining admin cannot be demoted.
+    last = co.api.delete(f"/households/{hh.id}/members/{co.id}/admin")
+    assert last.status_code in (403, 409), last.text
+    assert _role(co, hh, co.id) == "admin"
+
+
+def test_member_cannot_administer_budgets_through_the_api(world, db):
+    hh = world.roommates("E4", n_members=1)
+    admin, member = hh.admin, hh.members[0]
+    created = admin.api.post("/budgets/categories", json={"household_id": hh.id, "code": "OPEX-DINING",
+                                                          "category": "Dining", "allocated_amount": 900})
+    assert created.status_code == 200, created.text
+    # Direct PostgREST: the member is refused by RLS.
+    rls = member.rest.patch(f"/budgets?household_id=eq.{hh.id}&category_code=eq.OPEX-DINING",
+                            json={"allocated_amount": 1}, headers={"Prefer": "return=representation"})
+    assert rls.status_code in (401, 403) or rls.json() == []
+    toggle = member.api.post(f"/households/{hh.id}/categories/toggle",
+                             json={"category_code": "OPEX-DINING", "is_active": False})
+    assert toggle.status_code == 403
+    # The same changes through the other API routes must be refused as well.
+    realloc = member.api.post("/budgets/categories", json={"household_id": hh.id, "code": "OPEX-DINING",
+                                                           "category": "Dining", "allocated_amount": 1})
+    archive = member.api.delete("/budgets/categories/OPEX-DINING", params={"household_id": hh.id})
+    assert (realloc.status_code, archive.status_code) == (403, 403), (realloc.text, archive.text)
+    row = db.one("SELECT allocated_amount, is_active FROM public.budgets WHERE household_id = %s"
+                 " AND category_code = 'OPEX-DINING'", (hh.id,))
+    assert (float(row["allocated_amount"]), row["is_active"]) == (900.0, True)
+
+
+def test_member_cannot_self_assign_financial_role(world, db, llm):
+    hh = world.roommates("E5", n_members=1)
+    admin, mate = hh.admin, hh.members[0]
+    mate.rest.patch(f"/users?id=eq.{mate.id}", json={"financial_role": "spouse"})
+    # Impact first (so a failure shows it): the flat must stay a roommate household...
+    commit = world.chat_commit(mate, hh, llm, merchant="Pizza Hut", amount=90)
+    summary = admin.api.get(f"/households/{hh.id}/nafaqah").json()
+    settlement = admin.api.get(f"/households/{hh.id}/settlement").json()
+    assert (commit.json().get("nafaqah_class"), summary["mode"], settlement["mode"]) == (
+        None, "not_family", "shared_split")
+    # ...and the role itself must not be self-assignable.
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT financial_role FROM public.users WHERE id = %s", (mate.id,)) == "peer"
diff --git a/tests/e2e/test_05_idor_sweep.py b/tests/e2e/test_05_idor_sweep.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..34c49d1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/e2e/test_05_idor_sweep.py
@@ -0,0 +1,314 @@
+"""
+Scenario 5: IDOR sweep. Every household-scoped API route is called by members (admin and plain
+member) of household A with household B's id (or a B-owned object id): the answer must be 403/404
+and must never carry B's data. The same is checked for the PostgREST surface (tables + RPCs).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import uuid
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Callable, List
+
+import pytest
+
+from e2e_harness.zatca import tlv_qr
+
+SECRET = "SECRETB"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Victim:
+    hh: object
+    husband: object
+    wife: object
+    tx_id: str
+    dep_id: str
+    plan_id: str
+    custom_code: str
+    secrets: List[str]
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def victim(world, db, llm) -> Victim:
+    hh = world.family("V")
+    husband, wife = hh.admin, hh.members[0]
+    res = world.chat_commit(wife, hh, llm, merchant=f"{SECRET} Boutique", amount=777.77, category_code="OPEX-SHOPPING")
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    tx_id = res.json()["transaction_id"]
+    dep = husband.api.post(f"/households/{hh.id}/dependents", json={"name": f"{SECRET}Kid", "monthly_allowance": 50})
+    assert dep.status_code == 200, dep.text
+    dep_id = dep.json()["dependent"]["id"]
+    plan = husband.api.post("/budgets/installments", json={
+        "household_id": hh.id, "merchant": f"{SECRET} Jarir", "provider": "Tamara", "total_amount": 1200,
+        "installment_count": 4})
+    assert plan.status_code == 200, plan.text
+    custom_code = f"CUSTOM-B{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6].upper()}"
+    cat = husband.api.post(f"/households/{hh.id}/categories/custom", json={
+        "code": custom_code, "category": f"{SECRET} Category", "allocated_amount": 100})
+    assert cat.status_code == 200, cat.text
+    sub = husband.api.post("/budgets/sub-categories", json={
+        "household_id": hh.id, "parent_code": custom_code, "name_en": f"{SECRET} Sub", "allocated_amount": 10})
+    assert sub.status_code == 200, sub.text
+    assert husband.api.put(f"/households/{hh.id}/nafaqah/allowance", json={"amount": 321}).status_code == 200
+    return Victim(hh=hh, husband=husband, wife=wife, tx_id=tx_id, dep_id=dep_id, plan_id=plan.json()["id"],
+                  custom_code=custom_code, secrets=[SECRET, husband.id, wife.id, hh.name, "777.77"])
+
+
+def _routes(v: Victim, own_hh_id: str) -> List[tuple]:
+    B = v.hh.id
+    qr = tlv_qr("Panda", "300000000000003", "2026-10-19T10:00:00Z", "11.50", "1.50")
+    return [
+        # analytics
+        ("GET", "/analytics/price-history", {"params": {"household_id": B}}),
+        ("POST", "/analytics/shopping-basket-optimize", {"json": {"household_id": B, "items": ["milk"]}}),
+        # budgets
+        ("GET", "/budgets/salary-cycle-forecast", {"params": {"household_id": B}}),
+        ("GET", "/budgets/cycles", {"params": {"household_id": B}}),
+        ("GET", "/budgets/recurring-bills", {"params": {"household_id": B}}),
+        ("POST", "/budgets/recurring-bills/toggle", {"json": {"household_id": B, "category_code": "OPEX-UTILITIES",
+                                                               "sub_code": "electricity", "is_recurring": True}}),
+        ("GET", "/budgets/recurring-bills/candidates", {"params": {"household_id": B}}),
+        ("GET", "/budgets/installments", {"params": {"household_id": B}}),
+        ("POST", "/budgets/installments", {"json": {"household_id": B, "merchant": "x", "total_amount": 10}}),
+        ("POST", f"/budgets/installments/{v.plan_id}/pay", {}),
+        ("POST", "/budgets/recalculate", {"params": {"household_id": B}}),
+        ("GET", "/budgets/breakdown", {"params": {"household_id": B}}),
+        ("POST", "/budgets/categories", {"json": {"household_id": B, "code": "OPEX-DINING", "category": "Dining",
+                                                  "allocated_amount": 1}}),
+        ("POST", "/budgets/sub-allocations", {"json": {"household_id": B, "category_code": v.custom_code,
+                                                       "sub_allocations": {"x": 1}}}),
+        ("POST", "/budgets/sub-categories", {"json": {"household_id": B, "parent_code": v.custom_code,
+                                                      "name_en": "Injected"}}),
+        ("PATCH", "/budgets/sub-categories", {"json": {"parent_code": v.custom_code, "sub_code": f"sub-{SECRET.lower()}-sub",
+                                                       "name_en": "Renamed by A"}}),
+        ("DELETE", "/budgets/sub-categories", {"params": {"household_id": B, "parent_code": v.custom_code,
+                                                          "sub_code": f"sub-{SECRET.lower()}-sub"}}),
+        ("DELETE", f"/budgets/categories/{v.custom_code}", {"params": {"household_id": B}}),
+        ("POST", "/budgets/simulate-affordability", {"json": {"household_id": B, "target_amount": 10}}),
+        # chat / receipts
+        ("POST", "/agent/chat-transaction", {"json": {"household_id": B, "message": "coffee 5 SAR"}}),
+        ("POST", "/agent/chat-transaction", {"json": {"household_id": B, "message": "coffee 5 SAR", "preview_only": True}}),
+        ("POST", "/agent/scan-receipt", {"json": {"household_id": B, "qr_code_raw": qr}}),
+        ("POST", "/agent/scan-receipt", {"json": {"household_id": B, "qr_code_raw": qr, "preview_only": True}}),
+        # households
+        ("GET", f"/households/{B}/payday", {}),
+        ("PUT", f"/households/{B}/payday", {"json": {"payday_day": 1}}),
+        ("GET", f"/households/{B}/income", {}),
+        ("PUT", f"/households/{B}/income", {"json": {"monthly_income": 1}}),
+        ("GET", f"/households/{B}/rollover-rule", {}),
+        ("PUT", f"/households/{B}/rollover-rule", {"json": {"rollover_rule": "fresh_start"}}),
+        ("GET", f"/households/{B}/savings-summary", {}),
+        ("POST", f"/households/{B}/invites", {"json": {"role": "spouse"}}),
+        ("POST", f"/households/{B}/reimbursements", {"json": {"household_id": B, "payer_id": v.husband.id,
+                                                              "recipient_id": v.wife.id, "amount": 1}}),
+        ("GET", f"/households/{B}/dependents", {}),
+        ("POST", f"/households/{B}/dependents", {"json": {"name": "Injected"}}),
+        ("DELETE", f"/households/{B}/dependents/{v.dep_id}", {}),
+        ("GET", f"/households/{B}/settlement", {}),
+        ("GET", f"/households/{B}/settlement-v2", {}),
+        ("GET", f"/households/{B}/categories", {}),
+        ("POST", f"/households/{B}/categories/toggle", {"json": {"category_code": "OPEX-DINING", "is_active": False}}),
+        ("POST", f"/households/{B}/categories/custom", {"json": {"code": "INJ-1", "category": "Injected"}}),
+        ("GET", f"/households/{B}/members", {}),
+        ("POST", f"/households/{B}/members/{v.wife.id}/admin", {}),
+        ("DELETE", f"/households/{B}/members/{v.husband.id}/admin", {}),
+        ("POST", f"/households/{B}/primary-admin", {"json": {"new_primary_user_id": v.wife.id}}),
+        # nafaqah
+        ("GET", f"/households/{B}/nafaqah", {}),
+        ("GET", f"/households/{B}/nafaqah/reimbursements", {}),
+        ("POST", f"/households/{B}/nafaqah/reimbursements", {"json": {"amount": 1}}),
+        ("GET", f"/households/{B}/nafaqah/allowance", {}),
+        ("PUT", f"/households/{B}/nafaqah/allowance", {"json": {"amount": 1}}),
+        # reports / support
+        ("GET", "/reports/statement-pdf", {"params": {"household_id": B}}),
+        ("POST", "/agent/support-chat", {"json": {"message": "hi", "household_id": B}}),
+        ("POST", "/support/chat", {"json": {"message": "hi", "household_id": B}}),
+        # A's own household id, B's object ids
+        ("POST", f"/households/{own_hh_id}/members/{v.wife.id}/admin", {}),
+        ("POST", f"/households/{own_hh_id}/primary-admin", {"json": {"new_primary_user_id": v.wife.id}}),
+        ("POST", "/budgets/installments", {"json": {"household_id": own_hh_id, "merchant": "x", "total_amount": 10,
+                                                    "original_transaction_id": v.tx_id}}),
+    ]
+
+
+def _snapshot(db, v: Victim) -> dict:
+    return {
+        "tx": db.one("SELECT amount, merchant, items::text, category_code FROM public.transactions WHERE id = %s", (v.tx_id,)),
+        "deps": db.scalar("SELECT count(*) FROM public.household_dependents WHERE household_id = %s", (v.hh.id,)),
+        "plan": db.one("SELECT paid_installments FROM public.installment_plans WHERE id = %s", (v.plan_id,)),
+        "hh": db.one("SELECT payday_day, monthly_income, rollover_rule, owner_user_id FROM public.households WHERE id = %s",
+                     (v.hh.id,)),
+        "members": db.query("SELECT user_id::text, role FROM public.household_memberships WHERE household_id = %s ORDER BY 1",
+                            (v.hh.id,)),
+        "invites": db.scalar("SELECT count(*) FROM public.household_invites WHERE household_id = %s", (v.hh.id,)),
+        "subs": db.query("SELECT sub_code, name_en FROM public.cost_control_sub_categories WHERE parent_code = %s ORDER BY 1",
+                         (v.custom_code,)),
+        "budgets": db.query("SELECT category_code, allocated_amount, is_active, sub_allocations::text FROM public.budgets"
+                            " WHERE household_id = %s ORDER BY 1", (v.hh.id,)),
+        "settings": db.query("SELECT * FROM public.household_category_settings WHERE household_id = %s", (v.hh.id,)),
+        "txs": db.scalar("SELECT count(*) FROM public.transactions WHERE household_id = %s", (v.hh.id,)),
+        "allow": db.query("SELECT amount FROM public.member_allowances WHERE household_id = %s", (v.hh.id,)),
+        "reimb": db.scalar("SELECT count(*) FROM public.spouse_reimbursements WHERE household_id = %s", (v.hh.id,)),
+        "codes": db.scalar("SELECT count(*) FROM public.cost_control_codes WHERE household_id = %s", (v.hh.id,)),
+    }
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("attacker_kind", ["admin", "member"])
+def test_api_idor_sweep(world, db, llm, victim, attacker_kind):
+    a_hh = world.roommates(f"A{attacker_kind}", n_members=1)
+    attacker = a_hh.admin if attacker_kind == "admin" else a_hh.members[0]
+    before = _snapshot(db, victim)
+    failures = []
+    for method, path, kwargs in _routes(victim, a_hh.id):
+        llm.queue_json({"is_transaction": True, "merchant": "coffee", "total_amount": 5, "items": []})
+        res = attacker.api.request(method, path, **kwargs)
+        llm.clear()
+        leaked = [s for s in victim.secrets if s in res.text]
+        if res.status_code not in (403, 404) or leaked:
+            failures.append(f"{method} {path} -> {res.status_code} leaked={leaked} body={res.text[:160]}")
+    assert not failures, "\n".join(failures)
+    assert _snapshot(db, victim) == before, "household B was modified by household A"
+
+
+def test_api_cross_household_object_refs_do_not_touch_b(world, db, llm, victim):
+    a_hh = world.roommates("AX", n_members=0)
+    attacker = a_hh.admin
+    before = _snapshot(db, victim)
+    # Own household id in the path, B's dependent id: B's dependent survives.
+    attacker.api.delete(f"/households/{a_hh.id}/dependents/{victim.dep_id}")
+    # Enrich B's transaction while claiming A's household: refused / not found, B untouched.
+    llm.queue_json({"is_transaction": True, "merchant": "x", "total_amount": 1, "items": [
+        {"name": "INJECTED", "quantity": 1, "price": 1}]})
+    chat = attacker.api.post("/agent/chat-transaction", json={
+        "household_id": a_hh.id, "message": "x 1 SAR", "enrich_tx_id": victim.tx_id})
+    assert chat.status_code in (200, 403, 404) and chat.json().get("status") != "enriched", chat.text
+    scan = attacker.api.post("/agent/scan-receipt", json={
+        "household_id": a_hh.id, "enrich_tx_id": victim.tx_id,
+        "qr_code_raw": tlv_qr("INJECTED", "300000000000003", "2026-10-19T10:00:00Z", "9.00", "1.17")})
+    assert scan.status_code in (200, 403, 404) and scan.json().get("status") != "enriched", scan.text
+    # A receipt path in B's storage folder is rejected.
+    bad_path = attacker.api.post("/agent/scan-receipt", json={
+        "household_id": a_hh.id, "receipt_url": f"{victim.hh.id}/stolen.jpg", "preview_only": True,
+        "qr_code_raw": tlv_qr("Panda", "300000000000003", "2026-10-19T10:00:00Z", "9.00", "1.17")})
+    assert bad_path.status_code in (200, 400, 403) and bad_path.json().get("status") in (None, "error"), bad_path.text
+    assert _snapshot(db, victim) == before
+
+
+def test_postgrest_idor_sweep(world, db, llm, victim):
+    a_hh = world.roommates("AP", n_members=1)
+    B = victim.hh.id
+    for attacker in a_hh.everyone:
+        # Tables: RLS hides B's rows entirely.
+        for table in ("transactions", "households", "household_memberships", "budgets", "household_dependents",
+                      "household_invites", "member_allowances", "spouse_reimbursements", "installment_plans",
+                      "accounts", "income_records", "account_transfers", "household_category_settings"):
+            res = attacker.rest.get(f"/{table}", params={"household_id": f"eq.{B}"} if table != "households"
+                                    else {"id": f"eq.{B}"})
+            assert res.status_code in (200, 401, 403, 404), (table, res.status_code, res.text)
+            if res.status_code == 200:
+                assert res.json() == [], (table, res.text)
+        users = attacker.rest.get("/users", params={"id": f"in.({victim.husband.id},{victim.wife.id})"})
+        assert users.status_code in (200, 403) and (users.status_code == 403 or users.json() == []), users.text
+        # Writes into B are refused.
+        ins = attacker.rest.post("/transactions", json={
+            "household_id": B, "user_id": attacker.id, "amount": 1, "timestamp": "2026-10-19T10:00:00Z",
+            "merchant": "INJECTED", "category_code": "OPEX-DINING"})
+        assert ins.status_code in (401, 403), ins.text
+        upd = attacker.rest.patch(f"/transactions?id=eq.{victim.tx_id}", json={"amount": 1},
+                                  headers={"Prefer": "return=representation"})
+        assert upd.status_code in (401, 403) or upd.json() == [], upd.text
+        dele = attacker.rest.delete(f"/transactions?id=eq.{victim.tx_id}", headers={"Prefer": "return=representation"})
+        assert dele.status_code in (401, 403) or dele.json() == [], dele.text
+        # Household-scoped RPCs with B's id (and spoofed actor ids) are refused.
+        for name, params in (
+            ("get_household_members", {"p_household_id": B, "p_actor_user_id": None}),
+            ("get_household_members", {"p_household_id": B, "p_actor_user_id": victim.husband.id}),
+            ("get_spouse_reimbursement_balance", {"p_household_id": B, "p_wife_user_id": victim.wife.id,
+                                                  "p_actor_user_id": victim.husband.id}),
+            ("get_member_allowance_status", {"p_household_id": B, "p_member_user_id": victim.wife.id,
+                                             "p_cycle_key": None, "p_actor_user_id": victim.husband.id}),
+            ("set_member_allowance", {"p_household_id": B, "p_member_user_id": victim.wife.id, "p_amount": "1",
+                                      "p_cycle_key": None, "p_actor_user_id": victim.husband.id}),
+            ("record_spouse_reimbursement", {"p_household_id": B, "p_wife_user_id": victim.wife.id, "p_amount": "1",
+                                             "p_payment_method": "cash", "p_notes": None,
+                                             "p_actor_user_id": victim.husband.id}),
+            ("promote_member_to_admin", {"p_household_id": B, "p_user_id": victim.wife.id,
+                                         "p_actor_user_id": victim.husband.id}),
+            ("revoke_admin", {"p_household_id": B, "p_user_id": victim.husband.id, "p_actor_user_id": None}),
+            ("transfer_primary_admin", {"p_household_id": B, "p_new_primary_user_id": attacker.id,
+                                        "p_actor_user_id": victim.husband.id}),
+            ("switch_active_household", {"p_household_id": B}),
+            ("transfer_between_accounts", {"p_household_id": B, "p_from_account_id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
+                                           "p_to_account_id": str(uuid.uuid4()), "p_amount": 1, "p_fee": 0}),
+            ("reallocate_budget", {"p_from_id": str(uuid.uuid4()), "p_to_id": str(uuid.uuid4()), "p_amount": 1}),
+        ):
+            res = attacker.rpc(name, params)
+            leaked = [s for s in victim.secrets if s in res.text]
+            assert res.status_code >= 400 and not leaked, (name, res.status_code, res.text)
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT count(*) FROM public.spouse_reimbursements WHERE household_id = %s", (B,)) == 0
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT owner_user_id::text FROM public.households WHERE id = %s", (B,)) == victim.husband.id
+
+
+def test_postgrest_helper_rpcs_do_not_leak_other_household_members(world, victim):
+    # E2E-04 (fixed by migration 20261020600000): the internal helpers are not client-callable;
+    # the SECURITY DEFINER RPCs and triggers that use them keep working (test_03, test_04).
+    outsider = world.signup("Outsider")
+    for name, params in (
+        ("household_primary_admin_id", {"p_household_id": victim.hh.id}),
+        ("nafaqah_husband_id", {"p_household_id": victim.hh.id}),
+    ):
+        res = outsider.rpc(name, params)
+        assert res.status_code >= 400 or victim.husband.id not in res.text, (name, res.text)
+    oracle = outsider.rpc("nafaqah_is_spouse_member", {"p_household_id": victim.hh.id, "p_user_id": victim.wife.id})
+    assert oracle.status_code >= 400 or oracle.json() is not True, oracle.text
+
+
+def test_sub_categories_of_other_household_are_not_listed(world, victim):
+    # E2E-05 listing (fixed): the API lists only sub-categories of system categories and of the
+    # caller's own custom categories; migration 20261020600000 applies the same rule to direct
+    # PostgREST reads of cost_control_sub_categories.
+    a_hh = world.roommates("AS", n_members=1)
+    attacker = a_hh.members[0]  # a plain member, not even an admin
+    peek = attacker.api.get("/budgets/sub-categories", params={"parent_code": victim.custom_code})
+    assert peek.status_code in (403, 404) or SECRET not in peek.text, peek.text
+    peek = attacker.api.get("/budgets/sub-categories", params={"parent_code": victim.custom_code,
+                                                               "household_id": victim.hh.id})
+    assert peek.status_code == 403 and SECRET not in peek.text, peek.text
+    direct = attacker.rest.get("/cost_control_sub_categories", params={"parent_code": f"eq.{victim.custom_code}"})
+    assert direct.status_code == 200 and direct.json() == [], direct.text
+    # The owner household and system categories are unaffected.
+    own = victim.wife.api.get("/budgets/sub-categories", params={"parent_code": victim.custom_code})
+    assert own.status_code == 200 and SECRET in own.text, own.text
+    own_direct = victim.wife.rest.get("/cost_control_sub_categories", params={"parent_code": f"eq.{victim.custom_code}"})
+    assert own_direct.status_code == 200 and SECRET in own_direct.text, own_direct.text
+    system = attacker.api.get("/budgets/sub-categories", params={"parent_code": "OPEX-DINING"})
+    assert system.status_code == 200 and system.json()["sub_categories"], system.text
+    system_direct = attacker.rest.get("/cost_control_sub_categories", params={"parent_code": "eq.OPEX-DINING"})
+    assert system_direct.status_code == 200 and system_direct.json(), system_direct.text
+
+
+def test_sub_category_cannot_be_planted_into_other_households(world, victim):
+    a_hh = world.roommates("AT", n_members=1)
+    attacker = a_hh.members[0]
+    marker = f"Planted by A {uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}"
+    for parent in ("OPEX-DINING", victim.custom_code):
+        attacker.api.post("/budgets/sub-categories", json={
+            "household_id": a_hh.id, "parent_code": parent, "name_en": marker})
+        b_view = victim.husband.api.get("/budgets/sub-categories", params={"parent_code": parent})
+        assert marker not in b_view.text, (parent, b_view.text)
+
+
+def test_admin_cannot_add_sub_categories_under_another_households_category(world, victim):
+    # E2E-05 creation: even an admin of A may only extend system categories or A's own custom
+    # categories; B's custom category is refused like an unknown code, and no row appears.
+    a_hh = world.roommates("AU", n_members=0)
+    marker = f"Admin plant {uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}"
+    res = a_hh.admin.api.post("/budgets/sub-categories", json={
+        "household_id": a_hh.id, "parent_code": victim.custom_code, "name_en": marker})
+    assert res.status_code == 403, res.text
+    res = a_hh.admin.api.post("/budgets/sub-categories", json={
+        "household_id": a_hh.id, "parent_code": "CUSTOM-DOES-NOT-EXIST", "name_en": marker})
+    assert res.status_code == 403, res.text
+    b_view = victim.husband.api.get("/budgets/sub-categories", params={"parent_code": victim.custom_code})
+    assert marker not in b_view.text, b_view.text
