+"""
+Scenario 6: persistent quota / rate limiting with the database quota (no Redis), and the inquiry
+endpoints with the mail provider absent (503) or present (a local fake of the Resend API).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+import time
+
+import pytest
+
+from e2e_harness.zatca import tlv_qr
+
+
+def _away_from_window_edge(window: int, margin: float = 45.0) -> None:
+    """consume_quota uses fixed windows aligned to the epoch; don't straddle a boundary."""
+    left = window - (time.time() % window)
+    if left < margin:
+        time.sleep(left + 1)
+
+
+def test_chat_quota_is_persistent_in_database(world, db, llm):
+    from rate_limiter import reset_rate_limiters
+
+    flat = world.roommates("Q1", n_members=0)
+    user = flat.admin
+    _away_from_window_edge(600)
+    body = {"household_id": flat.id, "message": "Shawarma 12 SAR", "preview_only": True}
+    statuses = [user.api.post("/agent/chat-transaction", json=body).status_code for _ in range(30)]
+    assert statuses == [200] * 30
+    over = user.api.post("/agent/chat-transaction", json=body)
+    assert over.status_code == 429, over.text
+    assert over.headers.get("Retry-After")
+    row = db.one("SELECT count FROM public.api_quota WHERE user_id = %s AND bucket = 'chat_transaction'", (user.id,))
+    assert row["count"] == 31
+
+    # Another app instance (fresh in-memory limiter, no Redis) still refuses: the DB is authoritative.
+    reset_rate_limiters()
+    again = user.api.post("/agent/chat-transaction", json=body)
+    assert again.status_code == 429 and "chat_transaction" in again.text
+
+    # Quotas are per verified user: a second member of the same household is unaffected.
+    mate = world.signup("QuotaMate")
+    world.join(mate, flat, world.invite(user, flat, "peer"))
+    assert mate.api.post("/agent/chat-transaction", json=body).status_code == 200
+
+    # Clients cannot reset or probe quotas through PostgREST (service-role-only functions/table).
+    assert user.rpc("consume_quota", {"p_user_id": user.id, "p_bucket": "chat_transaction", "p_limit": 9999,
+                                      "p_window_seconds": 1}).status_code in (401, 403, 404)
+    wipe = user.rest.delete(f"/api_quota?user_id=eq.{user.id}")
+    assert wipe.status_code in (401, 403, 404) or db.scalar(
+        "SELECT count(*) FROM public.api_quota WHERE user_id = %s", (user.id,)) == 1
+
+
+def test_receipt_scan_quota(world, db, llm):
+    flat = world.roommates("Q2", n_members=0)
+    user = flat.admin
+    _away_from_window_edge(600)
+    qr = tlv_qr("Panda", "300000000000003", "2026-10-19T10:00:00Z", "20.00", "2.61")
+    body = {"household_id": flat.id, "qr_code_raw": qr, "preview_only": True}
+    statuses = [user.api.post("/agent/scan-receipt", json=body).status_code for _ in range(10)]
+    assert statuses == [200] * 10
+    assert user.api.post("/agent/scan-receipt", json=body).status_code == 429
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT count FROM public.api_quota WHERE user_id = %s AND bucket = 'scan_receipt'",
+                     (user.id,)) == 11
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def resend(stack, monkeypatch):
+    """Configure the Resend provider against the gateway's local capture endpoint."""
+    monkeypatch.setenv("RESEND_API_KEY", "re_e2e_fake_key")
+    stack.gateway.emails.clear()
+    stack.gateway.resend_status = 200
+    yield stack.gateway
+    stack.gateway.resend_status = 200
+
+
+def _public(world, client_ip=None, **overrides):
+    payload = {"type": "contact", "email": "visitor@example.com", "name": "Visitor", "message": "Hello there",
+               "locale": "ar", "source": "web"}
+    payload.update(overrides)
+    # X-Forwarded-For names the client when proxy headers are trusted (TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS).
+    headers = {"X-Forwarded-For": client_ip} if client_ip else {}
+    return world.anonymous_api(**headers).post("/public/inquiries", json=payload)
+
+
+def test_inquiries_without_mail_provider_answer_503(world, stack):
+    assert not os.environ.get("RESEND_API_KEY") and not os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST")
+    res = _public(world)
+    assert res.status_code == 503, res.text
+    user = world.signup("Asker")
+    app = user.api.post("/support/inquiries", json={"message": "Need help"})
+    assert app.status_code == 503, app.text
+    assert stack.gateway.emails == []
+
+
+def test_inquiries_with_mocked_provider(world, resend):
+    res = _public(world, type="vip_early_access", message=None, email="VIP.Person@Example.COM")
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    assert res.json()["status"] == "sent"
+    assert len(resend.emails) == 1
+    mail = resend.emails[0]
+    assert mail["to"] == ["inbox@e2e.test"] and mail["reply_to"] == "VIP.Person@example.com"
+    assert mail["_authorization"] == "Bearer re_e2e_fake_key"
+    assert "VIP early access" in mail["subject"]
+
+    # Honeypot: answered like a success, nothing sent.
+    bot = _public(world, company_website="http://spam.example")
+    assert bot.status_code == 200 and len(resend.emails) == 1
+
+    # In-app support: identity comes from the verified JWT only.
+    user = world.signup("Helpme")
+    app = user.api.post("/support/inquiries", json={"message": "Crash on receipts", "locale": "en"})
+    assert app.status_code == 200, app.text
+    body = resend.emails[-1]["text"]
+    assert f"Verified user ID: {user.id}" in body and user.email in body
+    spoof = user.api.post("/support/inquiries", json={"message": "x", "user_id": "someone-else"})
+    assert spoof.status_code == 422
+    assert world.anonymous_api().post("/support/inquiries", json={"message": "x"}).status_code == 401
+
+    # Provider failure is reported (502), never a fake success.
+    resend.resend_status = 500
+    failed = _public(world, email="other@example.com")
+    assert failed.status_code == 502, failed.text
+
+
+def test_public_inquiry_per_ip_limit(world, resend, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS", "1")  # as on Railway (RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT)
+    statuses = [_public(world, "203.0.113.70", email=f"p{i}@example.com").status_code for i in range(5)]
+    assert statuses == [200] * 5
+    limited = _public(world, "203.0.113.70", email="p6@example.com")
+    assert limited.status_code == 429
+    assert len(resend.emails) == 5
+    # FABLE-API-03: the limit is the client's, not everyone's behind the same proxy.
+    assert _public(world, "203.0.113.71", email="p7@example.com").status_code == 200
+    assert _public(world, email="p8@example.com").status_code == 200  # no client address: no per-IP bucket
diff --git a/tests/e2e/test_07_money_integrity.py b/tests/e2e/test_07_money_integrity.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..f6889d8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/e2e/test_07_money_integrity.py
@@ -0,0 +1,201 @@
+"""
+Scenario 7: money integrity. Sub-halala transfers/income are rejected (DB-06) and never mint money;
+after a long mixed sequence of API and PostgREST operations, budgets.spent_amount equals the sum of
+the household's transactions per (category, cycle) and every account balance equals its ledger
+(income - debits - transfers out - fees + transfers in).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+from e2e_harness.zatca import tlv_qr
+
+
+def _account(user, hh, name, *, shared=False):
+    res = user.rest.post("/accounts", json={
+        "household_id": hh.id, "owner_user_id": user.id, "name": name,
+        "account_type": "shared_pool" if shared else "bank", "is_shared_pool": shared,
+    }, headers={"Prefer": "return=representation"})
+    assert res.status_code == 201, res.text
+    return res.json()[0]["id"]
+
+
+def _income(user, hh, account_id, amount, **extra):
+    return user.rpc("record_income", {
+        "p_household_id": hh.id, "p_account_id": account_id, "p_cycle_key": None, "p_source_type": "salary",
+        "p_title": "Salary", "p_base_amount": amount, **extra,
+    })
+
+
+def _transfer(user, hh, src, dst, amount, fee=0):
+    return user.rpc("transfer_between_accounts", {
+        "p_household_id": hh.id, "p_from_account_id": src, "p_to_account_id": dst, "p_amount": amount, "p_fee": fee,
+    })
+
+
+def _balances(db, hh):
+    return {r["id"]: Decimal(r["balance"]) for r in db.query(
+        "SELECT id::text, balance FROM public.accounts WHERE household_id = %s", (hh.id,))}
+
+
+def _ledger_mismatches(db, hh):
+    rows = db.query(
+        """
+        SELECT a.id::text, a.name, a.balance,
+               COALESCE((SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM public.income_records i WHERE i.account_id = a.id), 0)
+             - COALESCE((SELECT sum(amount) FROM public.transactions t WHERE t.account_id = a.id), 0)
+             - COALESCE((SELECT sum(amount + fee) FROM public.account_transfers f WHERE f.from_account_id = a.id), 0)
+             + COALESCE((SELECT sum(amount) FROM public.account_transfers f WHERE f.to_account_id = a.id), 0)
+               AS ledger
+        FROM public.accounts a WHERE a.household_id = %s
+        """,
+        (hh.id,),
+    )
+    return [(r["name"], r["balance"], r["ledger"]) for r in rows if r["balance"] != r["ledger"]]
+
+
+def _budget_mismatches(db, hh):
+    rows = db.query(
+        """
+        SELECT b.category_code, b.cycle_key, b.spent_amount,
+               COALESCE((SELECT sum(t.amount) FROM public.transactions t
+                         WHERE t.household_id = b.household_id AND t.category_code = b.category_code
+                           AND t.cycle_key = b.cycle_key), 0) AS tx_sum
+        FROM public.budgets b WHERE b.household_id = %s AND b.cycle_key IS NOT NULL
+        """,
+        (hh.id,),
+    )
+    return [(r["category_code"], r["cycle_key"], r["spent_amount"], r["tx_sum"]) for r in rows
+            if r["spent_amount"] != r["tx_sum"]]
+
+
+def test_sub_halala_transfers_and_income_are_rejected(world, db):
+    hh = world.roommates("M1", n_members=0)
+    admin = hh.admin
+    a1 = _account(admin, hh, "Al Rajhi")
+    a2 = _account(admin, hh, "STC Pay")
+    assert _income(admin, hh, a1, 100).status_code == 200
+
+    for amount, fee in ((1.005, 0), ("1.005", 0), (1, 0.001), (0.001, 0)):
+        res = _transfer(admin, hh, a1, a2, amount, fee)
+        assert res.status_code == 400, (amount, fee, res.text)
+        assert "2 decimal" in res.text
+    assert _income(admin, hh, a1, 1.005).status_code == 400
+    assert _income(admin, hh, a1, 10, p_deductions=-5).status_code == 400
+    assert _balances(db, hh) == {a1: Decimal("100.00"), a2: Decimal("0.00")}
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT count(*) FROM public.account_transfers WHERE household_id = %s", (hh.id,)) == 0
+
+    ok = _transfer(admin, hh, a1, a2, 1.01, 0.25)
+    assert ok.status_code == 200, ok.text
+    assert _balances(db, hh) == {a1: Decimal("98.74"), a2: Decimal("1.01")}
+    # Money is conserved except for the recorded fee.
+    assert sum(_balances(db, hh).values()) + Decimal("0.25") == Decimal("100.00")
+    # Overdraft is refused.
+    assert _transfer(admin, hh, a2, a1, 5).status_code >= 400
+
+    # API side: a 3-decimal Nafaqah repayment / allowance is a validation error, not silently rounded.
+    fam = world.family("M1")
+    res = fam.admin.api.put(f"/households/{fam.id}/nafaqah/allowance", json={"amount": 10.005})
+    assert res.status_code == 422, res.text
+
+
+def test_chat_amount_precision_is_consistent(world, db, llm):
+    hh = world.roommates("M2", n_members=0)
+    res = world.chat_commit(hh.admin, hh, llm, merchant="Herfy", amount=10.005)
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    stored = db.scalar("SELECT amount FROM public.transactions WHERE id = %s", (res.json()["transaction_id"],))
+    assert stored == Decimal(str(res.json()["amount"])), "API response and stored amount disagree"
+    assert stored == stored.quantize(Decimal("0.01"))
+
+
+def test_totals_consistent_after_operation_sequence(world, db, llm):
+    hh = world.roommates("M3", n_members=2)
+    admin, alice, bob = hh.admin, hh.members[0], hh.members[1]
+
+    # Budgets for the current cycle (admin, through the API).
+    for code, amount in (("OPEX-DINING", 800), ("OPEX-GROCERY", 1500), ("OPEX-MISC", 300)):
+        r = admin.api.post("/budgets/categories", json={"household_id": hh.id, "code": code, "category": code,
+                                                         "allocated_amount": amount})
+        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+
+    # Accounts and income.
+    pool = _account(admin, hh, "House pool", shared=True)
+    admin_bank = _account(admin, hh, "Admin bank")
+    alice_wallet = _account(alice, hh, "Alice STC Pay")
+    bob_wallet = _account(bob, hh, "Bob Urpay")
+    assert _income(admin, hh, admin_bank, 9000).status_code == 200
+    assert _income(alice, hh, alice_wallet, 4000.50).status_code == 200
+    assert _income(bob, hh, bob_wallet, 3500).status_code == 200
+    assert _income(alice, hh, pool, 1200).status_code == 200
+    assert _income(bob, hh, pool, 1200).status_code == 200
+    assert _transfer(admin, hh, admin_bank, pool, 1200, 1.15).status_code == 200
+
+    checks = []
+
+    def check(label):
+        checks.append((label, _budget_mismatches(db, hh), _ledger_mismatches(db, hh)))
+
+    # 1. Chat commits by everyone (no account) and a ZATCA receipt.
+    for user, merchant, amount, cat in ((alice, "Albaik", 31.5, "OPEX-DINING"), (bob, "Panda", 212.35, "OPEX-GROCERY"),
+                                        (admin, "Kudu", 44, "OPEX-DINING")):
+        assert world.chat_commit(user, hh, llm, merchant=merchant, amount=amount, category_code=cat).status_code == 200
+    qr = tlv_qr("Othaim Markets", "310000000000003", "2026-10-19T12:00:00Z", "57.50", "7.50")
+    scan = bob.api.post("/agent/scan-receipt", json={"household_id": hh.id, "qr_code_raw": qr})
+    assert scan.status_code == 200 and scan.json()["status"] == "success", scan.text
+    check("after chat + receipt")
+
+    # 2. Direct PostgREST inserts debiting accounts (what the app does for manual entries).
+    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+
+    def manual(user, account, amount, cat, when=None, merchant="Manual"):
+        r = user.rest.post("/transactions", json={
+            "household_id": hh.id, "user_id": user.id, "amount": amount, "merchant": merchant,
+            "category_code": cat, "timestamp": (when or now).isoformat(), "source": "manual", "account_id": account,
+        }, headers={"Prefer": "return=representation"})
+        assert r.status_code == 201, r.text
+        return r.json()[0]["id"]
+
+    t_pool = manual(alice, pool, 400, "OPEX-GROCERY", merchant="Pool groceries")
+    t_alice = manual(alice, alice_wallet, 99.99, "OPEX-DINING")
+    t_bob = manual(bob, bob_wallet, 15.25, "OPEX-MISC")
+    t_admin = manual(admin, admin_bank, 250, "OPEX-GROCERY")
+    check("after manual inserts")
+
+    # 3. Edits: amount, category, account, and a timestamp that moves the row to the previous cycle.
+    def patch(user, tx, **fields):
+        r = user.rest.patch(f"/transactions?id=eq.{tx}", json=fields, headers={"Prefer": "return=representation"})
+        assert r.status_code == 200 and r.json(), r.text
+
+    patch(alice, t_alice, amount=120.10)
+    patch(alice, t_alice, category_code="OPEX-MISC")
+    patch(bob, t_bob, account_id=None)
+    patch(bob, t_bob, account_id=bob_wallet, amount=16)
+    patch(admin, t_pool, amount=380.40)  # admin edits a member's pool expense
+    prev_cycle_day = now - timedelta(days=35)
+    patch(admin, t_admin, timestamp=prev_cycle_day.isoformat())
+    check("after edits")
+
+    # 4. Deletes and transfers.
+    r = admin.rest.delete(f"/transactions?id=eq.{t_bob}", headers={"Prefer": "return=representation"})
+    assert r.status_code == 200 and r.json(), r.text
+    assert _transfer(alice, hh, alice_wallet, bob_wallet, 250.75, 0.5).status_code == 200
+    assert _transfer(admin, hh, pool, admin_bank, 100).status_code == 200
+    check("after delete + transfers")
+
+    # 5. API recalculation must agree with the triggers (no drift either way).
+    assert admin.api.post("/budgets/recalculate", params={"household_id": hh.id}).status_code == 200
+    check("after /budgets/recalculate")
+
+    failures = [(label, b, l) for label, b, l in checks if b or l]
+    assert not failures, "\n".join(f"{label}: budgets={b} ledger={l}" for label, b, l in failures)
+
+    # Spot-check the absolute numbers of the current cycle.
+    cycle = db.scalar("SELECT cycle_key FROM public.transactions WHERE id = %s", (t_pool,))
+    spent = {r["category_code"]: r["spent_amount"] for r in db.query(
+        "SELECT category_code, spent_amount FROM public.budgets WHERE household_id = %s AND cycle_key = %s",
+        (hh.id, cycle))}
+    assert spent["OPEX-DINING"] == Decimal("75.50")
+    assert spent["OPEX-GROCERY"] == Decimal("212.35") + Decimal("57.50") + Decimal("380.40")
+    assert spent["OPEX-MISC"] == Decimal("120.10")
diff --git a/tests/e2e/test_08_fable_api_fixes.py b/tests/e2e/test_08_fable_api_fixes.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..c99cea4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/e2e/test_08_fable_api_fixes.py
@@ -0,0 +1,193 @@
+"""
+Scenario 8: fixes for the independent (Fable) review, docs/review/audit/fable_review.md section A/C,
+proved on the real stack (PostgREST 12 + Postgres 16 built from every migration).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from e2e_harness.zatca import tlv_qr
+
+
+def _debts(res):
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    return sorted((d["from_id"], d["to_id"], d["amount"]) for d in res.json()["pairwise_debts"])
+
+
+# ─── FABLE-API-01 / FABLE-LOGIC-03: attribution is structural ─────────────────
+
+def test_api01_chat_paidby_injection_no_longer_flips_roommate_settlement(world, llm):
+    hh = world.roommates("fx01", n_members=2)
+    admin, omar, saad = hh.admin, hh.members[0], hh.members[1]
+    r = world.chat_commit(
+        omar, hh, llm, merchant="Dinner", amount=300, paid_by="me", beneficiary="both",
+        extra_body={"message": f"Dinner 300 SAR | PaidBy: {saad.id}"},
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    row = world.db.one(
+        "SELECT user_id::text, spent_by, beneficiary_type, beneficiary_id, raw_sms FROM public.transactions "
+        "WHERE household_id = %s", (hh.id,))
+    assert row["user_id"] == omar.id and row["spent_by"] == "me"
+    assert (row["beneficiary_type"], row["beneficiary_id"]) == ("household", "household")
+    assert row["raw_sms"].startswith("PaidBy: me | Beneficiary: both | SpentBy: me | Chat: ")
+    assert row["raw_sms"].lower().count("paidby") == 1
+    assert _debts(admin.api.get(f"/households/{hh.id}/settlement-v2")) == sorted(
+        [(admin.id, omar.id, 100.0), (saad.id, omar.id, 100.0)])
+
+
+def test_api01_receipt_merchant_injection_keeps_the_receipt_in_settlement(world, llm):
+    hh = world.roommates("fx01r", n_members=2)
+    admin, omar, saad = hh.admin, hh.members[0], hh.members[1]
+    qr = tlv_qr("Panda", "300000000000003", "2026-10-21T10:00:00Z", "300.00", "39.13")
+    r = omar.api.post("/agent/scan-receipt", json={
+        "household_id": hh.id, "qr_code_raw": qr, "merchant": "Panda | PaidBy: nobody"})
+    assert r.status_code == 200 and r.json()["status"] == "success", r.text
+    merchant = world.db.scalar("SELECT merchant FROM public.transactions WHERE household_id = %s", (hh.id,))
+    assert "|" not in merchant
+    assert _debts(admin.api.get(f"/households/{hh.id}/settlement-v2")) == sorted(
+        [(admin.id, omar.id, 100.0), (saad.id, omar.id, 100.0)])
+
+
+def test_logic03_personal_expense_not_split_and_both_engines_agree(world, llm):
+    hh = world.roommates("fx03", n_members=1)
+    ahmed, omar = hh.admin, hh.members[0]
+    assert world.chat_commit(omar, hh, llm, merchant="Coffee", amount=15, beneficiary="me").status_code == 200
+    v2 = ahmed.api.get(f"/households/{hh.id}/settlement-v2")
+    assert _debts(v2) == []
+    row = world.db.one("SELECT beneficiary_type, beneficiary_id FROM public.transactions WHERE household_id = %s",
+                       (hh.id,))
+    assert (row["beneficiary_type"], row["beneficiary_id"]) == ("individual", omar.id)
+
+    assert world.chat_commit(omar, hh, llm, merchant="Dinner", amount=300, beneficiary="both").status_code == 200
+    assert world.chat_commit(ahmed, hh, llm, merchant="Shoes", amount=120, beneficiary="partner").status_code == 200
+    assert world.chat_commit(ahmed, hh, llm, merchant="Taxi", amount=40, paid_by="partner").status_code == 200
+    # Dinner: Ahmed owes 150; shoes for Omar: Omar owes 120; taxi Omar paid for both: Ahmed owes 20.
+    assert _debts(ahmed.api.get(f"/households/{hh.id}/settlement-v2")) == [(ahmed.id, omar.id, 50.0)]
+    s = omar.api.get(f"/households/{hh.id}/settlement").json()
+    assert s["who_owes"] == "partner_owes_me" and s["settlement_amount"] == 50.0, s
+    assert s["me_personal_total"] == 15.0
+
+
+# ─── FABLE-API-04 / 05 / 08: sub-category definitions ─────────────────────────
+
+def test_api04_no_planting_under_system_categories_and_no_cross_household_matching(world, llm):
+    a = world.roommates("fx04a", n_members=0)
+    b = world.roommates("fx04b", n_members=0)
+    r = a.admin.api.post("/budgets/sub-categories", json={
+        "household_id": a.id, "parent_code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "name_en": "e", "sub_code": "sub-planted-by-a"})
+    assert r.status_code == 403, r.text
+    # A definition planted before the fix (as on live) is ignored when matching B's receipt.
+    world.db.query(
+        "INSERT INTO public.cost_control_sub_categories (parent_code, sub_code, name_en, name_ar, keywords) "
+        "VALUES ('OPEX-GROCERY', 'sub-planted-old', 'e', 'e', ARRAY['e']) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING")
+    try:
+        qr = tlv_qr("Panda", "300000000000003", "2026-10-21T10:00:00Z", "115.00", "15.00")
+        r = b.admin.api.post("/agent/scan-receipt", json={"household_id": b.id, "qr_code_raw": qr})
+        assert r.status_code == 200 and r.json()["status"] == "success", r.text
+        tx = world.db.one("SELECT category_code, sub_category FROM public.transactions WHERE household_id = %s", (b.id,))
+        assert tx["category_code"] == "OPEX-GROCERY" and tx["sub_category"] != "sub-planted-old", tx
+    finally:
+        world.db.query("DELETE FROM public.cost_control_sub_categories WHERE sub_code = 'sub-planted-old'")
+
+
+def test_api05_api08_colliding_custom_code_rename_refused_with_one_message(world, llm):
+    a = world.roommates("fx05a", n_members=0)
+    b = world.roommates("fx05b", n_members=0)
+    for hh in (b, a):
+        r = hh.admin.api.post(f"/households/{hh.id}/categories/custom", json={"code": "RENTFX", "category": "Rent"})
+        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    r = b.admin.api.post("/budgets/sub-categories", json={
+        "household_id": b.id, "parent_code": "CUSTOM-RENTFX", "name_en": "Villa Riyadh", "sub_code": "villa"})
+    assert r.status_code == 403, r.text  # two owners: nobody may define under the shared code
+    answers = [a.admin.api.patch("/budgets/sub-categories", json={
+        "parent_code": code, "sub_code": "villa", "name_en": "PWNED by A"}) for code in
+        ("CUSTOM-RENTFX", "CUSTOM-NOPE-FX", "OPEX-GROCERY")]
+    assert {x.status_code for x in answers} == {403}
+    assert len({x.json()["detail"] for x in answers}) == 1
+
+
+# ─── FABLE-API-07: sub_allocations metadata ───────────────────────────────────
+
+def test_api07_recurring_config_survives_sub_category_admin(world, llm):
+    hh = world.roommates("fx07", n_members=1)
+    admin, member = hh.admin, hh.members[0]
+    r = admin.api.post("/budgets/sub-allocations", json={
+        "household_id": hh.id, "category_code": "OPEX-UTILITIES",
+        "sub_allocations": {"electricity_sec": 300, "fiber_internet": 250}})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    r = member.api.post("/budgets/recurring-bills/toggle", json={
+        "household_id": hh.id, "category_code": "OPEX-UTILITIES", "sub_code": "electricity_sec",
+        "is_recurring": True, "due_day": 5})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    r = admin.api.post("/budgets/sub-categories", json={
+        "household_id": hh.id, "parent_code": "OPEX-UTILITIES", "name_en": "Water", "sub_code": "water_municipal",
+        "allocated_amount": 120})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    r = admin.api.delete("/budgets/sub-categories", params={
+        "household_id": hh.id, "parent_code": "OPEX-UTILITIES", "sub_code": "fiber_internet"})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    r = admin.api.post("/budgets/sub-allocations", json={
+        "household_id": hh.id, "category_code": "OPEX-UTILITIES",
+        "sub_allocations": {"electricity_sec": 300, "water_municipal": 120}})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    row = world.db.one("SELECT allocated_amount, sub_allocations FROM public.budgets "
+                       "WHERE household_id = %s AND category_code = 'OPEX-UTILITIES'", (hh.id,))
+    assert float(row["allocated_amount"]) == 420.0
+    assert row["sub_allocations"]["_recurring_config"]["electricity_sec"]["due_day"] == 5
+
+
+# ─── FABLE-API-09 / FABLE-API-10: installments ────────────────────────────────
+
+def test_api09_invalid_start_date_is_refused_and_transaction_untouched(world, llm):
+    hh = world.roommates("fx09", n_members=0)
+    r = world.chat_commit(hh.admin, hh, llm, merchant="Jarir", amount=1200)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    tx_id = r.json()["transaction_id"]
+    r = hh.admin.api.post("/budgets/installments", json={
+        "household_id": hh.id, "merchant": "Jarir", "provider": "Tamara", "total_amount": 1200,
+        "installment_count": 4, "start_date": "not-a-date", "original_transaction_id": tx_id})
+    assert r.status_code == 422, r.text
+    assert world.db.scalar("SELECT count(*) FROM public.installment_plans WHERE household_id = %s", (hh.id,)) == 0
+    assert float(world.db.scalar("SELECT amount FROM public.transactions WHERE id = %s", (tx_id,))) == 1200.0
+    assert hh.admin.api.get("/budgets/installments", params={"household_id": hh.id}).json()["plans"] == []
+
+
+def test_api10_concurrent_payments_each_count_once(world, llm):
+    from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
+
+    hh = world.roommates("fx10", n_members=1)
+    r = hh.admin.api.post("/budgets/installments", json={
+        "household_id": hh.id, "merchant": "Extra", "provider": "Tabby", "total_amount": 1200,
+        "installment_count": 12, "start_date": "2026-11-01"})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    plan_id = r.json()["id"]
+    payers = [hh.admin, hh.members[0]] * 6  # 12 concurrent payments on a plan with 11 left
+    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=12) as pool:
+        results = list(pool.map(lambda u: u.api.post(f"/budgets/installments/{plan_id}/pay"), payers))
+    assert all(x.status_code == 200 for x in results), [x.text for x in results if x.status_code != 200]
+    row = world.db.one("SELECT paid_installments, status FROM public.installment_plans WHERE id = %s", (plan_id,))
+    assert row["paid_installments"] == 12 and row["status"] == "COMPLETED", row
+    assert sorted(x.json()["paid_installments"] for x in results) == list(range(2, 13)) + [12]
+
+
+# ─── FABLE-API-06: bounded free text ──────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def test_api06_oversized_overrides_refused_and_junk_qr_not_persisted(world, llm):
+    import base64
+
+    hh = world.roommates("fx06", n_members=0)
+    png = base64.b64encode(base64.b64decode(
+        "iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mNkYPhfDwAChwGA60e6kgAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=="
+    )).decode()
+    for extra in ({"qr_code_raw": "Q" * 300_000}, {"merchant": "X" * 100_000}):
+        r = hh.admin.api.post("/agent/scan-receipt", json={"household_id": hh.id, "images_base64": [png], **extra})
+        assert r.status_code == 422, r.text[:200]
+    llm.queue_json({"merchant": "Tamimi", "total_amount": 55.5, "category_code": "OPEX-GROCERY",
+                    "items": [{"name": "milk", "quantity": 1, "price": 55.5}]})
+    r = hh.admin.api.post("/agent/scan-receipt", json={
+        "household_id": hh.id, "images_base64": [png], "qr_code_raw": "Q" * 4000, "merchant": "M" * 120})
+    assert r.status_code == 200 and r.json()["status"] == "success", r.text[:300]
+    row = world.db.one("SELECT qr_code_raw, length(merchant) AS m FROM public.transactions WHERE household_id = %s",
+                       (hh.id,))
+    assert row["qr_code_raw"] is None and row["m"] == 120
+    r = world.chat_commit(hh.admin, hh, llm, merchant="Coffee", amount=16, extra_body={"beneficiary": "B" * 61})
+    assert r.status_code == 422, r.text[:200]
diff --git a/tests/e2e/test_08_household_roles_and_nafaqah_integrity.py b/tests/e2e/test_08_household_roles_and_nafaqah_integrity.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..9f60d19
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/e2e/test_08_household_roles_and_nafaqah_integrity.py
@@ -0,0 +1,146 @@
+"""
+Scenario 8 (Fable review, migration 20261020800000): household roles and Nafaqah integrity on the
+real stack.
+
+- A wife who joins a roommate flat stays the wife of her family; the flat stays roommates.
+- An existing member cannot claim the spouse invite meant for someone else.
+- The husband is the explicit provider: a son who created the household is the default, an admin
+  changes it through PUT /households/{id}/nafaqah/provider.
+- Editing/deleting a wife advance after a repayment is refused by the database (PostgREST 22023,
+  hint ledger_would_be_overpaid) and the ledger stays exact.
+- wife_personal purchases never reach the category budget.
+- Changing the payday through the API re-keys the open cycle.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+
+def _summary(user, hh):
+    res = user.api.get(f"/households/{hh.id}/nafaqah")
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    return res.json()
+
+
+def test_wife_joining_a_flat_keeps_family_and_flat_apart(world, db, llm):
+    family = world.family("R8a")
+    husband, wife = family.admin, family.members[0]
+    flat = world.roommates("R8a", n_members=1)
+    world.join(wife, flat, world.invite(flat.admin, flat, "peer"))
+
+    roles = {m["user_id"]: m["financial_role"] for m in flat.admin.api.get(f"/households/{flat.id}/members").json()["members"]}
+    assert roles[wife.id] == "peer"
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT financial_role FROM public.household_memberships WHERE household_id = %s AND user_id = %s",
+                     (family.id, wife.id)) == "spouse"
+
+    summary = _summary(husband, family)
+    assert summary["mode"] == "family_nafaqah" and summary["husband"]["id"] == husband.id
+    assert [w["id"] for w in summary["wives"]] == [wife.id]
+    assert flat.admin.api.get(f"/households/{flat.id}/settlement-v2").json()["mode"] == "multi_roommate"
+    assert _summary(flat.admin, flat)["mode"] == "not_family"
+
+
+def test_member_cannot_claim_the_spouse_invite(world, db):
+    family = world.family("R8b")
+    husband = family.admin
+    son = world.signup("SonR8b")
+    world.join(son, family, world.invite(husband, family, "family_member"))
+    code = world.invite(husband, family, "spouse")
+
+    # Members cannot even read invite codes through PostgREST.
+    assert son.rest.get("/household_invites", params={"select": "invite_code"}).json() == []
+    taken = son.api.post(f"/households/invites/{code}/claim")
+    assert taken.status_code == 400, taken.text
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT used_by FROM public.household_invites WHERE invite_code = %s", (code,)) is None
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT financial_role FROM public.household_memberships WHERE household_id = %s AND user_id = %s",
+                     (family.id, son.id)) == "family_member"
+    # The real invitee still can.
+    second = world.signup("SecondWifeR8b")
+    world.join(second, family, code)
+
+
+def test_son_created_household_provider_is_explicit_and_changeable(world, db):
+    son = world.signup("SonR8c")
+    hh = world.create_household(son, "Son house R8c")
+    wife = world.signup("WifeR8c")
+    world.join(wife, hh, world.invite(son, hh, "spouse"))
+    father = world.signup("FatherR8c")
+    code = db.scalar("SELECT invite_code FROM public.households WHERE id = %s", (hh.id,))
+    joined = father.rpc("join_household_by_code", {"p_invite_code": code})
+    assert joined.status_code == 200 and "error" not in joined.json(), joined.text
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT financial_role FROM public.household_memberships WHERE household_id = %s AND user_id = %s",
+                     (hh.id, father.id)) == "family_member"
+
+    assert _summary(son, hh)["husband"]["id"] == son.id  # default: the primary admin
+    assert father.api.put(f"/households/{hh.id}/nafaqah/provider", json={"user_id": father.id}).status_code == 403
+    assert son.api.put(f"/households/{hh.id}/nafaqah/provider", json={"user_id": wife.id}).status_code == 422
+    res = son.api.put(f"/households/{hh.id}/nafaqah/provider", json={"user_id": father.id})
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    assert res.json()["summary"]["husband"]["id"] == father.id
+    members = son.api.get(f"/households/{hh.id}/members").json()
+    assert members["nafaqah_provider_user_id"] == father.id
+    # Clients cannot write the column directly.
+    son.rest.patch(f"/households?id=eq.{hh.id}", json={"nafaqah_provider_user_id": son.id})
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT nafaqah_provider_user_id::text FROM public.households WHERE id = %s", (hh.id,)) == father.id
+
+
+def test_editing_a_repaid_advance_is_refused(world, db, llm):
+    family = world.family("R8d")
+    husband, wife = family.admin, family.members[0]
+    res = world.chat_commit(wife, family, llm, merchant="Panda R8d", amount=300, category_code="OPEX-GROCERY",
+                            paid_by="me", beneficiary="both")
+    assert res.status_code == 200 and res.json()["nafaqah_class"] == "wife_reimbursable", res.text
+    tx_id = res.json()["transaction_id"]
+    paid = husband.api.post(f"/households/{family.id}/nafaqah/reimbursements", json={"amount": 200})
+    assert paid.status_code == 200, paid.text
+
+    for user, call in (
+        (wife, lambda u: u.rest.patch(f"/transactions?id=eq.{tx_id}", json={"amount": 100})),
+        (husband, lambda u: u.rest.patch(f"/transactions?id=eq.{tx_id}",
+                                         json={"nafaqah_class": None, "nafaqah_spouse_id": None})),
+        (husband, lambda u: u.rest.delete(f"/transactions?id=eq.{tx_id}")),
+    ):
+        refused = call(user)
+        assert refused.status_code == 400, refused.text
+        assert refused.json()["code"] == "22023" and refused.json()["hint"] == "ledger_would_be_overpaid"
+    assert float(db.scalar("SELECT amount FROM public.transactions WHERE id = %s", (tx_id,))) == 300.0
+    balance = _summary(wife, family)["wives"][0]["reimbursement"]
+    assert balance == {"gross_advanced": 300.0, "reimbursed": 200.0, "outstanding": 100.0, "overpaid": 0.0}
+
+    ok = wife.rest.patch(f"/transactions?id=eq.{tx_id}", json={"amount": 200})
+    assert ok.status_code in (200, 204), ok.text
+
+
+def test_wife_personal_is_not_in_the_category_budget(world, db, llm):
+    family = world.family("R8e")
+    wife = family.members[0]
+    cycle = db.scalar("SELECT cycle_key FROM public.get_saudi_cycle_for_timestamp(now(), 27)")
+    db.query("INSERT INTO public.budgets (household_id, month, category_code, allocated_amount, cycle_key)"
+             " VALUES (%s, (%s || '-01')::date, 'OPEX-SHOPPING', 1000, %s)", (family.id, cycle, cycle))
+    res = world.chat_commit(wife, family, llm, merchant="Abaya R8e", amount=400, category_code="OPEX-SHOPPING",
+                            paid_by="me", beneficiary="me")
+    assert res.json()["nafaqah_class"] == "wife_personal", res.text
+    world.chat_commit(family.admin, family, llm, merchant="Towels R8e", amount=100, category_code="OPEX-SHOPPING")
+    spent = db.scalar("SELECT spent_amount FROM public.budgets WHERE household_id = %s AND category_code = 'OPEX-SHOPPING'",
+                      (family.id,))
+    assert float(spent) == 100.0
+    assert _summary(wife, family)["wives"][0]["allowance"]["spent"] == 400.0
+
+
+def test_payday_change_rekeys_the_open_cycle(world, db, llm):
+    flat = world.roommates("R8f", n_members=1)
+    admin = flat.admin
+    for i in range(3):
+        world.chat_commit(admin, flat, llm, merchant=f"Cafe R8f {i}", amount=10, category_code="OPEX-DINING")
+    db.query("UPDATE public.transactions SET timestamp = now() + make_interval(days => (12 * n.i)::int)"
+             " FROM (SELECT id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY id) AS i FROM public.transactions WHERE household_id = %s) n"
+             " WHERE public.transactions.id = n.id", (flat.id,))
+    # Under payday 10 at least one of these dates (0, 12, 24 days ahead) belongs to another key.
+    changing = db.scalar(
+        "SELECT count(*) FROM public.transactions t WHERE t.household_id = %s AND t.cycle_key IS DISTINCT FROM"
+        " (SELECT c.cycle_key FROM public.get_saudi_cycle_for_timestamp(t.timestamp, 10) c)", (flat.id,))
+    assert changing > 0
+    assert admin.api.put(f"/households/{flat.id}/payday", json={"payday_day": 10}).status_code == 200
+    stale = db.scalar(
+        "SELECT count(*) FROM public.transactions t WHERE t.household_id = %s AND t.cycle_key IS DISTINCT FROM"
+        " (SELECT c.cycle_key FROM public.get_saudi_cycle_for_timestamp(t.timestamp, 10) c)", (flat.id,))
+    assert stale == 0
diff --git a/tests/e2e/test_09_fable2_api_fixes.py b/tests/e2e/test_09_fable2_api_fixes.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ee5241f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/e2e/test_09_fable2_api_fixes.py
@@ -0,0 +1,213 @@
+"""
+Scenario 9: fixes for the second Fable review round (backend), proved on the real stack
+(PostgREST 12 + Postgres 16 built from every migration): FABLE2-API-01..06, FABLE2-LOGIC-01, O4.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import re
+import uuid
+
+from e2e_harness.zatca import tlv_qr
+
+REPR = {"Prefer": "return=representation"}
+
+
+def _debts(res):
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    return sorted((d["from_id"], d["to_id"], float(d["amount"])) for d in res.json()["pairwise_debts"])
+
+
+# ─── FABLE2-API-01: a family without a provider → 409 no_provider ─────────────
+
+def test_api01_wife_chat_commit_without_provider_is_409_no_provider(world, db, llm):
+    family = world.family("F9a1")
+    wife = family.members[0]
+    db.query("UPDATE public.households SET nafaqah_provider_user_id = NULL WHERE id = %s", (family.id,))
+    res = world.chat_commit(wife, family, llm, merchant="Panda", amount=300, category_code="OPEX-GROCERY",
+                            paid_by="me", beneficiary="both")
+    assert res.status_code == 409, res.text
+    assert res.json()["detail"]["code"] == "no_provider" and res.json()["detail"]["message"]
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT count(*) FROM public.transactions WHERE household_id = %s", (family.id,)) == 0
+
+
+def test_api01_wife_receipt_commit_without_provider_is_409_no_provider(world, db):
+    family = world.family("F9a1r")
+    wife = family.members[0]
+    db.query("UPDATE public.households SET nafaqah_provider_user_id = NULL WHERE id = %s", (family.id,))
+    qr = tlv_qr("Panda", "300000000000003", "2026-10-21T10:00:00Z", "300.00", "39.13")
+    res = wife.api.post("/agent/scan-receipt", json={"household_id": family.id, "qr_code_raw": qr,
+                                                     "paid_by": "me", "beneficiary": "both"})
+    assert res.status_code == 409, res.text
+    assert res.json()["detail"]["code"] == "no_provider"
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT count(*) FROM public.transactions WHERE household_id = %s", (family.id,)) == 0
+
+
+def test_api01_husband_expense_without_provider_is_still_recorded(world, db, llm):
+    """No class, no provider needed: only classified wife expenses are refused."""
+    family = world.family("F9a1h")
+    db.query("UPDATE public.households SET nafaqah_provider_user_id = NULL WHERE id = %s", (family.id,))
+    res = world.chat_commit(family.admin, family, llm, merchant="Dinner", amount=90, paid_by="me",
+                            beneficiary="both")
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    assert res.json()["nafaqah_class"] is None
+
+
+# ─── FABLE2-LOGIC-01: rows re-saved by the old edit sheet ─────────────────────
+
+def _edit_like_the_old_app(user, tx_id, raw, paid_by, beneficiary, merchant="Groceries"):
+    """edit_transaction_sheet.dart at 84e264f: structured attempt (fails), then the raw_sms fallback."""
+    if beneficiary == "both":
+        spent_by = "both"
+    elif paid_by == beneficiary:
+        spent_by = paid_by
+    else:
+        spent_by = beneficiary
+    clean = re.sub(r"\|\s*SpentBy:\s*(me|partner|both)", "", raw, flags=re.I)
+    clean = re.sub(r"\|\s*PaidBy:\s*(me|partner)", "", clean, flags=re.I)
+    clean = re.sub(r"\|\s*Beneficiary:\s*([^\s\|]+)", "", clean, flags=re.I)
+    clean = re.sub(r"\|\s*SubCategory:\s*([^\s\|]+)", "", clean, flags=re.I).strip()
+    new_raw = f"{clean} | PaidBy: {paid_by} | Beneficiary: {beneficiary} | SubCategory:  | SpentBy: {spent_by}"
+    first = user.rest.patch(f"/transactions?id=eq.{tx_id}", json={
+        "merchant": merchant, "paid_by": paid_by, "beneficiary": beneficiary, "spent_by": spent_by}, headers=REPR)
+    assert first.status_code >= 400, first.text  # paid_by / beneficiary are not columns
+    second = user.rest.patch(f"/transactions?id=eq.{tx_id}", json={
+        "merchant": merchant, "raw_sms": new_raw, "spent_by": spent_by}, headers=REPR)
+    assert second.status_code == 200, second.text
+    return second.json()[0]
+
+
+def test_logic01_old_app_edit_of_a_chat_row_keeps_the_payer(world, db, llm):
+    flat = world.roommates("F9l1", n_members=1)
+    ahmed, omar = flat.admin, flat.members[0]
+    res = world.chat_commit(omar, flat, llm, merchant="Groceries", amount=200, paid_by="partner", beneficiary="both")
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    tx_id = res.json()["transaction_id"]
+    row = db.one("SELECT raw_sms FROM public.transactions WHERE id = %s", (tx_id,))
+    edited = _edit_like_the_old_app(omar, tx_id, row["raw_sms"], paid_by="partner", beneficiary="both")
+    assert edited["spent_by"] == "both"
+    v1 = omar.api.get(f"/households/{flat.id}/settlement").json()
+    assert v1["who_owes"] == "me_owes_partner" and v1["settlement_amount"] == 100.0, v1
+    assert _debts(omar.api.get(f"/households/{flat.id}/settlement-v2")) == [(omar.id, ahmed.id, 100.0)]
+
+
+def test_logic01_old_app_edit_of_a_manual_row_keeps_the_new_payer(world, db):
+    flat = world.roommates("F9l1m", n_members=1)
+    ahmed, omar = flat.admin, flat.members[0]
+    row = {  # buildManualExpenseRow(), roommate mode: Omar paid 200 for all
+        "id": str(uuid.uuid4()), "household_id": flat.id, "user_id": omar.id, "amount": 200, "currency": "SAR",
+        "merchant": "Groceries", "category_code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "spent_by": "both", "beneficiary_type": "all_peers",
+        "beneficiary_id": "all_peers", "account_id": None, "source": "manual", "timestamp": "2026-10-21T10:00:00Z",
+        "raw_sms": f"Manual: Groceries | PaidBy: {omar.id} | Beneficiary: all_peers | SpentBy: both",
+        "items": [{"name": "Groceries", "price": 200, "quantity": 1}],
+    }
+    assert omar.rest.post("/transactions", json=row, headers=REPR).status_code == 201
+    assert _debts(omar.api.get(f"/households/{flat.id}/settlement-v2")) == [(ahmed.id, omar.id, 100.0)]
+    # Old sheet: "partner paid, for both" → Ahmed paid the shared 200.
+    _edit_like_the_old_app(omar, row["id"], row["raw_sms"], paid_by="partner", beneficiary="both")
+    assert _debts(omar.api.get(f"/households/{flat.id}/settlement-v2")) == [(omar.id, ahmed.id, 100.0)]
+
+
+# ─── FABLE2-API-02: recurring toggle bounded to known sub-budgets ─────────────
+
+def test_api02_recurring_toggle_refuses_unknown_and_oversized_codes(world, db):
+    flat = world.roommates("F9a2", n_members=1)
+    admin, member = flat.admin, flat.members[0]
+    r = admin.api.post("/budgets/sub-allocations", json={"household_id": flat.id, "category_code": "OPEX-UTILITIES",
+                                                         "sub_allocations": {"electricity_sec": 300}})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    url = "/budgets/recurring-bills/toggle"
+    for sub in ("S" * 500_000, "not_a_sub", "_recurring_config"):
+        r = member.api.post(url, json={"household_id": flat.id, "category_code": "OPEX-UTILITIES", "sub_code": sub,
+                                       "is_recurring": True})
+        assert r.status_code == 422, (sub[:20], r.status_code, r.text[:200])
+    r = member.api.post(url, json={"household_id": flat.id, "category_code": "X" * 100_000, "sub_code": "y",
+                                   "is_recurring": True})
+    assert r.status_code == 422
+    r = member.api.post(url, json={"household_id": flat.id, "category_code": "OPEX-UTILITIES",
+                                   "sub_code": "electricity_sec", "is_recurring": True, "due_day": 5})
+    assert r.status_code == 200 and r.json()["status"] == "success", r.text
+    size = db.scalar("SELECT octet_length(sub_allocations::text) FROM public.budgets WHERE household_id = %s "
+                     "AND category_code = 'OPEX-UTILITIES'", (flat.id,))
+    assert size < 1000
+
+
+# ─── FABLE2-API-04 / O4: roommate settlement money ────────────────────────────
+
+def test_api04_sub_halala_roommate_settlement_is_422(world, db):
+    flat = world.roommates("F9a4", n_members=1)
+    ahmed, omar = flat.admin, flat.members[0]
+    url = f"/households/{flat.id}/reimbursements"
+    body = {"household_id": flat.id, "payer_id": omar.id, "recipient_id": ahmed.id}
+    assert omar.api.post(url, json={**body, "amount": 10.005}).status_code == 422
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT count(*) FROM public.transactions WHERE household_id = %s", (flat.id,)) == 0
+    r = omar.api.post(url, json={**body, "amount": 10.01})
+    assert r.status_code == 200 and r.json()["amount"] == 10.01, r.text
+    assert str(db.scalar("SELECT amount FROM public.transactions WHERE household_id = %s AND is_settlement",
+                         (flat.id,))) == "10.01"
+
+
+def test_o4_v1_small_roommate_balance_is_not_settled(world, db, llm):
+    flat = world.roommates("F9o4", n_members=1)
+    ahmed, omar = flat.admin, flat.members[0]
+    assert world.chat_commit(omar, flat, llm, merchant="Gum", amount=0.30, beneficiary="both").status_code == 200
+    v1 = omar.api.get(f"/households/{flat.id}/settlement").json()
+    assert v1["who_owes"] == "partner_owes_me" and v1["settlement_amount"] == 0.15, v1
+    assert _debts(omar.api.get(f"/households/{flat.id}/settlement-v2")) == [(ahmed.id, omar.id, 0.15)]
+
+
+# ─── FABLE2-API-05: installment over a repaid wife advance ────────────────────
+
+def test_api05_installment_on_repaid_advance_is_409_and_leaves_no_plan(world, db, llm):
+    family = world.family("F9a5")
+    husband, wife = family.admin, family.members[0]
+    res = world.chat_commit(wife, family, llm, merchant="Extra", amount=300, category_code="OPEX-SHOPPING",
+                            paid_by="me", beneficiary="both")
+    assert res.status_code == 200 and res.json()["nafaqah_class"] == "wife_reimbursable", res.text
+    tx_id = res.json()["transaction_id"]
+    r = husband.api.post(f"/households/{family.id}/nafaqah/reimbursements", json={"amount": 200})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    plan = wife.api.post("/budgets/installments", json={"household_id": family.id, "merchant": "Extra",
+                                                        "total_amount": 300, "installment_count": 4,
+                                                        "original_transaction_id": tx_id})
+    assert plan.status_code == 409, plan.text
+    assert plan.json()["detail"]["code"] == "ledger_would_be_overpaid"
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT count(*) FROM public.installment_plans WHERE original_transaction_id = %s",
+                     (tx_id,)) == 0
+    assert float(db.scalar("SELECT amount FROM public.transactions WHERE id = %s", (tx_id,))) == 300.0
+
+
+def test_api05_installment_on_unrepaid_advance_still_works(world, db, llm):
+    family = world.family("F9a5b")
+    wife = family.members[0]
+    res = world.chat_commit(wife, family, llm, merchant="Fridge", amount=2000, category_code="OPEX-SHOPPING",
+                            paid_by="me", beneficiary="both")
+    tx_id = res.json()["transaction_id"]
+    plan = wife.api.post("/budgets/installments", json={"household_id": family.id, "merchant": "Fridge",
+                                                        "total_amount": 2000, "installment_count": 4,
+                                                        "original_transaction_id": tx_id})
+    assert plan.status_code == 200, plan.text
+    assert float(db.scalar("SELECT amount FROM public.transactions WHERE id = %s", (tx_id,))) == 500.0
+
+
+# ─── FABLE2-API-06: invite target validated before the insert ─────────────────
+
+def test_api06_invite_target_must_be_a_dependent_of_this_household(world, db):
+    # Family household: spouse / family_member invites fit its type (owner decision D1).
+    a = world.family("F9a6a")
+    b = world.family("F9a6b")
+    dep = b.admin.api.post(f"/households/{b.id}/dependents", json={"name": "Secret Kid"})
+    assert dep.status_code == 200, dep.text
+    foreign = dep.json()["dependent"]["id"]
+    r = a.admin.api.post(f"/households/{a.id}/invites", json={"role": "spouse", "target_member_id": foreign})
+    assert r.status_code == 404, r.text
+    assert "Secret Kid" not in r.text
+    r = a.admin.api.post(f"/households/{a.id}/invites", json={"role": "spouse", "target_member_id": "nope"})
+    assert r.status_code == 400, r.text
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT count(*) FROM public.household_invites WHERE household_id = %s "
+                     "AND target_member_id IS NOT NULL", (a.id,)) == 0
+    own = a.admin.api.post(f"/households/{a.id}/dependents", json={"name": "Own Kid"}).json()["dependent"]["id"]
+    r = a.admin.api.post(f"/households/{a.id}/invites", json={"role": "family_member", "target_member_id": own})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    ins = a.admin.api.get(f"/households/invites/{r.json()['invite_code']}").json()
+    assert ins["target_member_name"] == "Own Kid"
diff --git a/tests/e2e/test_09_household_type_and_round2.py b/tests/e2e/test_09_household_type_and_round2.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..0ba513c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/e2e/test_09_household_type_and_round2.py
@@ -0,0 +1,163 @@
+"""
+Scenario 9 (owner decisions D1-D3, migration 20261020900000) on the real stack.
+
+- D1: a flat created as 'roommates' and joined by the static code settles as roommates (peers,
+  multi_roommate, pairwise debts); the released app's {p_name} call still creates a family; an
+  admin switches the type and sets financial roles through the API; mismatched invites are refused.
+- D2: an adult son can classify nothing (API 403 with a code; PostgREST insert refused by the
+  database), the wife and the provider can.
+- D3: when the wife leaves, her ledger in that household is gone and her expenses are ordinary
+  (a former wife_personal purchase now counts in the category budget).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+
+def _static_join(world, db, user, hh):
+    code = db.scalar("SELECT invite_code FROM public.households WHERE id = %s", (hh.id,))
+    res = user.rpc("join_household_by_code", {"p_invite_code": code})
+    assert res.status_code == 200 and "error" not in res.json(), res.text
+    hh.members.append(user)
+
+
+def test_static_code_flat_settles_as_roommates(world, db, llm):
+    admin = world.signup("FlatAdminR9a")
+    flat = world.create_household(admin, "Flat R9a", household_type="roommates")
+    mate1, mate2 = world.signup("Mate1R9a"), world.signup("Mate2R9a")
+    _static_join(world, db, mate1, flat)
+    _static_join(world, db, mate2, flat)
+
+    members = admin.api.get(f"/households/{flat.id}/members").json()
+    assert members["household_type"] == "roommates"
+    assert {m["financial_role"] for m in members["members"]} == {"peer"}
+    assert members["nafaqah_provider_user_id"] is None
+
+    res = world.chat_commit(admin, flat, llm, merchant="Dinner R9a", amount=300, category_code="OPEX-DINING",
+                            paid_by="me", beneficiary="both")
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    assert res.json().get("nafaqah_class") is None
+    settlement = admin.api.get(f"/households/{flat.id}/settlement-v2").json()
+    assert settlement["mode"] == "multi_roommate", settlement
+    owed = {(d["from_id"], d["to_id"]): d["amount"] for d in settlement["simplified_debts"]}
+    assert owed == {(mate1.id, admin.id): 100.0, (mate2.id, admin.id): 100.0}, settlement
+
+    # A spouse invite does not fit a flat: refused when created and when claimed.
+    refused = admin.api.post(f"/households/{flat.id}/invites", json={"role": "spouse"})
+    assert refused.status_code == 409 and refused.json()["detail"]["code"] == "invite_role_mismatch"
+    db.query("INSERT INTO public.household_invites (household_id, invite_code, role, created_by, expires_at)"
+             " VALUES (%s, 'R9AWIFE1', 'spouse', %s, now() + interval '1 day')", (flat.id, admin.id))
+    outsider = world.signup("OutsiderR9a")
+    claim = outsider.rpc("claim_household_role_invite", {"p_invite_code": "R9AWIFE1"})
+    assert claim.status_code == 200 and claim.json()["code"] == "invite_role_mismatch", claim.text
+    # No Nafaqah provider in a flat.
+    provider = admin.api.put(f"/households/{flat.id}/nafaqah/provider", json={"user_id": mate1.id})
+    assert provider.status_code == 409 and provider.json()["detail"]["code"] == "not_family"
+
+
+def test_old_app_call_shape_creates_a_family_and_admins_manage_type_and_roles(world, db):
+    owner = world.signup("OwnerR9b")
+    hh = world.create_household(owner, "Home R9b")  # {p_name} only, like the released app
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT household_type FROM public.households WHERE id = %s", (hh.id,)) == "family"
+    kid = world.signup("KidR9b")
+    _static_join(world, db, kid, hh)
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT financial_role FROM public.household_memberships WHERE household_id = %s AND user_id = %s",
+                     (hh.id, kid.id)) == "family_member"
+
+    # Members cannot change the type or roles.
+    assert kid.api.put(f"/households/{hh.id}/type", json={"household_type": "roommates"}).status_code == 403
+    assert kid.api.put(f"/households/{hh.id}/members/{kid.id}/financial-role",
+                       json={"financial_role": "dependent"}).status_code == 403
+
+    res = owner.api.put(f"/households/{hh.id}/members/{kid.id}/financial-role", json={"financial_role": "dependent"})
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    assert res.json() == {"status": "success", "household_id": hh.id, "user_id": kid.id, "financial_role": "dependent"}
+    bad = owner.api.put(f"/households/{hh.id}/members/{kid.id}/financial-role", json={"financial_role": "peer"})
+    assert bad.status_code == 422 and bad.json()["detail"]["code"] == "financial_role_not_allowed"
+    spouse_provider = owner.api.put(f"/households/{hh.id}/members/{owner.id}/financial-role",
+                                    json={"financial_role": "spouse"})
+    assert spouse_provider.status_code == 409 and spouse_provider.json()["detail"]["code"] == "provider_is_spouse"
+
+    # No wife yet: the family can become roommates (everyone a peer) and back.
+    res = owner.api.put(f"/households/{hh.id}/type", json={"household_type": "roommates"})
+    assert res.status_code == 200 and res.json() == {"status": "success", "household_id": hh.id, "household_type": "roommates"}
+    members = owner.api.get(f"/households/{hh.id}/members").json()
+    assert members["household_type"] == "roommates" and {m["financial_role"] for m in members["members"]} == {"peer"}
+    res = owner.api.put(f"/households/{hh.id}/type", json={"household_type": "family"})
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    members = owner.api.get(f"/households/{hh.id}/members").json()
+    assert members["nafaqah_provider_user_id"] == owner.id
+    roles = {m["user_id"]: m["financial_role"] for m in members["members"]}
+    assert roles == {owner.id: "provider", kid.id: "family_member"}
+
+    # With a wife, family -> roommates is refused.
+    wife = world.signup("WifeR9b")
+    world.join(wife, hh, world.invite(owner, hh, "spouse"))
+    blocked = owner.api.put(f"/households/{hh.id}/type", json={"household_type": "roommates"})
+    assert blocked.status_code == 409 and blocked.json()["detail"]["code"] == "type_change_blocked"
+    # Clients cannot write the column directly.
+    owner.rest.patch(f"/households?id=eq.{hh.id}", json={"household_type": "roommates"})
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT household_type FROM public.households WHERE id = %s", (hh.id,)) == "family"
+
+
+def test_son_cannot_classify_but_wife_and_provider_can(world, db, llm):
+    family = world.family("R9c")
+    husband, wife = family.admin, family.members[0]
+    son = world.signup("SonR9c")
+    _static_join(world, db, son, family)
+
+    refused = world.chat_commit(son, family, llm, merchant="Bakery R9c", amount=40, category_code="OPEX-GROCERY",
+                                extra_body={"nafaqah_class": "wife_reimbursable", "nafaqah_spouse_id": wife.id})
+    assert refused.status_code == 403, refused.text
+    assert refused.json()["detail"]["code"] == "nafaqah_classification_forbidden"
+
+    # The app's direct write is refused by the database (D2).
+    direct = son.rest.post("/transactions", json={
+        "household_id": family.id, "user_id": son.id, "amount": 40, "merchant": "Direct R9c",
+        "category_code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "timestamp": "2026-10-20T10:00:00+03:00",
+        "nafaqah_class": "wife_reimbursable", "nafaqah_spouse_id": wife.id,
+    })
+    assert direct.status_code == 403 and direct.json()["hint"] == "nafaqah_class_not_allowed", direct.text
+
+    ok = world.chat_commit(son, family, llm, merchant="Bakery plain R9c", amount=40, category_code="OPEX-GROCERY")
+    assert ok.status_code == 200 and ok.json().get("nafaqah_class") is None, ok.text
+    by_wife = world.chat_commit(wife, family, llm, merchant="Panda R9c", amount=120, category_code="OPEX-GROCERY",
+                                paid_by="me", beneficiary="both")
+    assert by_wife.json()["nafaqah_class"] == "wife_reimbursable", by_wife.text
+    by_husband = world.chat_commit(husband, family, llm, merchant="Gift R9c", amount=80, category_code="OPEX-SHOPPING",
+                                   paid_by="partner", beneficiary="partner")
+    assert by_husband.json()["nafaqah_class"] == "wife_personal", by_husband.text
+
+
+def test_wife_leaves_and_her_ledger_goes_with_her(world, db, llm):
+    family = world.family("R9d")
+    husband, wife = family.admin, family.members[0]
+    cycle = db.scalar("SELECT cycle_key FROM public.get_saudi_cycle_for_timestamp(now(), 27)")
+    db.query("INSERT INTO public.budgets (household_id, month, category_code, allocated_amount, cycle_key)"
+             " VALUES (%s, (%s || '-01')::date, 'OPEX-SHOPPING', 1000, %s)", (family.id, cycle, cycle))
+
+    adv = world.chat_commit(wife, family, llm, merchant="Panda R9d", amount=300, category_code="OPEX-GROCERY",
+                            paid_by="me", beneficiary="both")
+    assert adv.json()["nafaqah_class"] == "wife_reimbursable", adv.text
+    personal = world.chat_commit(wife, family, llm, merchant="Abaya R9d", amount=250, category_code="OPEX-SHOPPING",
+                                 paid_by="me", beneficiary="me")
+    assert personal.json()["nafaqah_class"] == "wife_personal", personal.text
+    assert husband.api.post(f"/households/{family.id}/nafaqah/reimbursements", json={"amount": 100}).status_code == 200
+    assert husband.api.put(f"/households/{family.id}/nafaqah/allowance",
+                           json={"amount": 500}).status_code == 200
+    spent = db.scalar("SELECT spent_amount FROM public.budgets WHERE household_id = %s AND category_code = 'OPEX-SHOPPING'",
+                      (family.id,))
+    assert float(spent) == 0.0
+
+    left = wife.rpc("leave_household")
+    assert left.status_code == 200 and left.json()["success"] is True, left.text
+
+    ids = (adv.json()["transaction_id"], personal.json()["transaction_id"])
+    rows = db.query("SELECT nafaqah_class, nafaqah_spouse_id FROM public.transactions WHERE id = ANY(%s::uuid[])", (list(ids),))
+    assert len(rows) == 2 and all(r["nafaqah_class"] is None and r["nafaqah_spouse_id"] is None for r in rows)
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT count(*) FROM public.spouse_reimbursements WHERE household_id = %s", (family.id,)) == 0
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT count(*) FROM public.member_allowances WHERE household_id = %s", (family.id,)) == 0
+    spent = db.scalar("SELECT spent_amount FROM public.budgets WHERE household_id = %s AND category_code = 'OPEX-SHOPPING'",
+                      (family.id,))
+    assert float(spent) == 250.0  # the former personal purchase is an ordinary expense now
+    summary = husband.api.get(f"/households/{family.id}/nafaqah").json()
+    assert summary["mode"] == "not_family" and summary["wives"] == []
diff --git a/tests/e2e/test_10_product_single_llm_call.py b/tests/e2e/test_10_product_single_llm_call.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8cc99a4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/e2e/test_10_product_single_llm_call.py
@@ -0,0 +1,114 @@
+"""
+Product review (2026-10-21) R6 / R9 / 3.3 on the real stack (PostgREST + local Postgres; only the
+LLM and Storage are faked):
+
+* a chat or receipt commit that sends back the preview's ``preview_token`` makes no LLM call;
+* a tampered token is 422 ``invalid_preview_token``;
+* a receipt photo reaches Storage only after the transaction row exists, and the row links it;
+* ``budgets.spent_amount`` follows inserts through the database triggers alone, and
+  ``POST /budgets/recalculate`` repairs a cycle through ``recompute_budget_spent`` (service role).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import base64
+import io
+import json
+import uuid
+
+from PIL import Image
+
+CHAT_PARSE = {
+    "is_transaction": True, "merchant": "Albaik", "total_amount": 46.0, "currency": "SAR",
+    "category_code": "OPEX-DINING", "sub_category": "restaurants_dinners", "paid_by": "me", "beneficiary": "both",
+    "items": [{"name": "Broast", "quantity": 2, "price": 46.0}],
+}
+RECEIPT_PARSE = {
+    "merchant": "Danube", "total_amount": 82.5, "vat_amount": 10.76, "currency": "SAR", "date": None,
+    "category_code": "OPEX-GROCERY", "zatca_qr_raw": None, "confidence": "high",
+    "items": [{"name": "Milk", "quantity": 2, "price": 12.5}, {"name": "Rice 5kg", "quantity": 1, "price": 70.0}],
+}
+
+
+def _jpeg() -> str:
+    buf = io.BytesIO()
+    Image.new("RGB", (40, 60), (250, 250, 250)).save(buf, "JPEG")
+    return base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode()
+
+
+def _current_cycle(db) -> str:
+    return db.scalar("SELECT cycle_key FROM public.get_saudi_cycle_for_timestamp(now(), 27)")
+
+
+def test_chat_preview_then_commit_is_one_llm_call_and_triggers_keep_the_budget(world, db, llm):
+    flat = world.roommates("P10a", n_members=1)
+    user = flat.admin
+    key = _current_cycle(db)
+    db.query(
+        "INSERT INTO public.budgets (household_id, category_code, month, cycle_key, allocated_amount, spent_amount)"
+        " VALUES (%s, 'OPEX-DINING', to_date(%s || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), %s, 500, 0)",
+        (flat.id, key, key),
+    )
+    llm.queue_json(CHAT_PARSE)
+    body = {"household_id": flat.id, "message": "Albaik broast 46 riyal", "allow_duplicate": True}
+    preview = user.api.post("/agent/chat-transaction", json={**body, "preview_only": True})
+    assert preview.status_code == 200, preview.text
+    token = preview.json()["preview_token"]
+    assert len(llm.calls) == 1
+
+    forged = token.split(".")
+    claims = json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(forged[2] + "=" * (-len(forged[2]) % 4)))
+    claims["p"]["total_amount"] = 1.0
+    forged[2] = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(claims).encode()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
+    bad = user.api.post("/agent/chat-transaction", json={**body, "preview_token": ".".join(forged)})
+    assert bad.status_code == 422 and bad.json()["detail"] == {"code": "invalid_preview_token"}
+
+    commit = user.api.post(
+        "/agent/chat-transaction", json={**body, "preview_token": token},
+        headers={"Idempotency-Key": f"p10-{uuid.uuid4().hex}"},
+    )
+    assert commit.status_code == 200, commit.text
+    assert commit.json()["status"] == "success"
+    assert len(llm.calls) == 1, "the commit must not call the LLM again"
+    row = db.one("SELECT amount, merchant, category_code, user_id::text FROM public.transactions WHERE id = %s",
+                 (commit.json()["transaction_id"],))
+    assert float(row["amount"]) == 46.0 and row["merchant"] == "Albaik" and row["user_id"] == user.id
+
+    spent = db.scalar("SELECT spent_amount FROM public.budgets WHERE household_id = %s AND cycle_key = %s", (flat.id, key))
+    assert float(spent) == 46.0  # trigger only (the API no longer recalculates per insert)
+
+    db.query("UPDATE public.budgets SET spent_amount = 999 WHERE household_id = %s AND cycle_key = %s", (flat.id, key))
+    fix = user.api.post(f"/budgets/recalculate?household_id={flat.id}&cycle_key={key}")
+    assert fix.status_code == 200, fix.text
+    spent = db.scalar("SELECT spent_amount FROM public.budgets WHERE household_id = %s AND cycle_key = %s", (flat.id, key))
+    assert float(spent) == 46.0  # recompute_budget_spent through PostgREST as service_role
+
+
+def test_receipt_preview_then_commit_is_one_vision_call_and_uploads_after_insert(world, db, llm, stack):
+    flat = world.roommates("P10b", n_members=1)
+    user = flat.admin
+    photo = _jpeg()
+    llm.queue_json(RECEIPT_PARSE)
+    before = set(stack.gateway.storage)
+    preview = user.api.post("/agent/scan-receipt", json={
+        "household_id": flat.id, "images_base64": [photo], "preview_only": True,
+    })
+    assert preview.status_code == 200, preview.text
+    p = preview.json()
+    assert p["status"] == "preview" and p["preview_token"]
+    assert set(stack.gateway.storage) == before, "a preview uploads nothing"
+
+    commit = user.api.post("/agent/scan-receipt", json={
+        "household_id": flat.id, "images_base64": [photo], "preview_token": p["preview_token"],
+        "merchant": "Danube Hittin", "allow_duplicate": True,
+    }, headers={"Idempotency-Key": f"p10r-{uuid.uuid4().hex}"})
+    assert commit.status_code == 200, commit.text
+    c = commit.json()
+    assert c["status"] == "success", c
+    assert len(llm.calls) == 1, "the commit must not call the vision model again"
+    row = db.one("SELECT amount, merchant, receipt_url, items FROM public.transactions WHERE id = %s",
+                 (c["transaction_id"],))
+    assert float(row["amount"]) == 82.5 and row["merchant"] == "Danube Hittin"
+    assert row["receipt_url"] and row["receipt_url"].startswith(f"{flat.id}/")
+    assert row["receipt_url"] == c["receipt_url"]
+    assert any(k.endswith(row["receipt_url"]) for k in set(stack.gateway.storage) - before)
diff --git a/tests/e2e/test_10_taxonomy_and_bnpl.py b/tests/e2e/test_10_taxonomy_and_bnpl.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..d270ec3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/e2e/test_10_taxonomy_and_bnpl.py
@@ -0,0 +1,118 @@
+"""
+Scenario 10: Saudi taxonomy (product review R4) and the BNPL payment schedule (R10), migration
+20261021000000, proved on the real stack (PostgREST 12 + Postgres 16 built from every migration).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+NEW_CODES = {"OPEX-HOUSING", "OPEX-EDUCATION", "OPEX-DOMESTIC-HELP", "OPEX-FAMILY-SUPPORT",
+             "OPEX-CHARITY", "OPEX-TRANSPORT", "OPEX-INSURANCE", "OPEX-REMITTANCE"}
+
+
+# ─── R10: frequency + next_due_at ─────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def test_tabby_pay_in_4_is_biweekly_and_payments_advance_next_due(world, db):
+    hh = world.roommates("bn1", n_members=1)
+    r = hh.admin.api.post("/budgets/installments", json={
+        "household_id": hh.id, "merchant": "Noon", "provider": "Tabby", "total_amount": 999.99,
+        "start_date": "2026-10-01"})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    plan = r.json()
+    assert (plan["frequency"], plan["next_due_at"], plan["monthly_amount"]) == ("biweekly", "2026-10-15", 250.0)
+    row = db.one("SELECT frequency, next_due_at::text AS due, installment_count FROM public.installment_plans "
+                 "WHERE id = %s", (plan["id"],))
+    assert row == {"frequency": "biweekly", "due": "2026-10-15", "installment_count": 4}
+
+    listed = hh.members[0].api.get("/budgets/installments", params={"household_id": hh.id}).json()["plans"]
+    assert [(p["id"], p["frequency"], p["next_due_at"]) for p in listed] == [(plan["id"], "biweekly", "2026-10-15")]
+
+    dues = []
+    for payer in (hh.admin, hh.members[0], hh.admin):
+        res = payer.api.post(f"/budgets/installments/{plan['id']}/pay")
+        assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+        dues.append(res.json()["next_due_at"])
+    assert dues == ["2026-10-29", "2026-11-12", None]
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT status FROM public.installment_plans WHERE id = %s", (plan["id"],)) == "COMPLETED"
+
+
+def test_bank_plan_is_monthly_from_the_anchor(world, db):
+    hh = world.roommates("bn2", n_members=0)
+    r = hh.admin.api.post("/budgets/installments", json={
+        "household_id": hh.id, "merchant": "Jarir", "provider": "Bank", "total_amount": 1000,
+        "installment_count": 3, "start_date": "2026-01-31"})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert (r.json()["frequency"], r.json()["next_due_at"]) == ("monthly", "2026-02-28")
+    res = hh.admin.api.post(f"/budgets/installments/{r.json()['id']}/pay")
+    assert res.status_code == 200 and res.json()["next_due_at"] == "2026-03-31", res.text
+    # Explicit frequency wins over the provider default; unknown values are refused.
+    r = hh.admin.api.post("/budgets/installments", json={
+        "household_id": hh.id, "merchant": "Shein", "provider": "Tamara", "total_amount": 300,
+        "installment_count": 3, "frequency": "monthly", "start_date": "2026-10-05"})
+    assert r.status_code == 200 and r.json()["next_due_at"] == "2026-11-05", r.text
+    r = hh.admin.api.post("/budgets/installments", json={
+        "household_id": hh.id, "merchant": "Shein", "total_amount": 300, "frequency": "weekly"})
+    assert r.status_code == 422, r.text
+
+
+def test_clients_cannot_forge_the_schedule(world, db):
+    hh = world.roommates("bn3", n_members=0)
+    res = hh.admin.rest.post("/installment_plans", headers={"Prefer": "return=representation"}, json={
+        "household_id": hh.id, "merchant": "Direct", "provider": "Tabby", "total_amount": 400,
+        "installment_count": 4, "monthly_amount": 100, "paid_installments": 1, "start_date": "2026-10-01",
+        "frequency": "biweekly", "next_due_at": "2030-01-01"})
+    assert res.status_code == 201, res.text
+    plan = res.json()[0]
+    assert plan["next_due_at"] == "2026-10-15"  # derived by the trigger, not taken from the client
+    for patch in ({"next_due_at": "2030-01-01"}, {"frequency": "monthly"}, {"paid_installments": 4}):
+        res = hh.admin.rest.patch(f"/installment_plans?id=eq.{plan['id']}", json=patch)
+        assert res.status_code in (401, 403), (patch, res.status_code, res.text)
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT next_due_at::text FROM public.installment_plans WHERE id = %s", (plan["id"],)) == "2026-10-15"
+
+
+def test_legacy_notes_are_not_reconstructed_into_plans(world, db, llm):
+    hh = world.roommates("bn4", n_members=0)
+    r = world.chat_commit(hh.admin, hh, llm, merchant="eXtra", amount=300)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    db.query("UPDATE public.transactions SET raw_sms = raw_sms || %s WHERE id = %s",
+             (" [Financed via Tamara: Installment 1 of 4. Full price: SAR 1,200.00]", r.json()["transaction_id"]))
+    assert hh.admin.api.get("/budgets/installments", params={"household_id": hh.id}).json()["plans"] == []
+
+
+# ─── R4: taxonomy ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+def test_new_categories_are_available_not_budgeted_until_added(world, db):
+    hh = world.roommates("tx1", n_members=1)
+    cats = hh.members[0].api.get(f"/households/{hh.id}/categories")
+    assert cats.status_code == 200, cats.text
+    inactive = {c["code"]: c["category"] for c in cats.json()["inactive"]}
+    assert NEW_CODES <= set(inactive), inactive
+    assert inactive["OPEX-HOUSING"] == "Housing & Rent" and inactive["OPEX-CHARITY"] == "Charity & Zakat"
+    assert not NEW_CODES & {c["code"] for c in cats.json()["active"]}
+
+    subs = hh.members[0].api.get("/budgets/sub-categories", params={"parent_code": "OPEX-HOUSING",
+                                                                     "household_id": hh.id})
+    assert subs.status_code == 200, subs.text
+    names = {s["sub_code"]: (s["name_en"], s["name_ar"]) for s in subs.json()["sub_categories"]}
+    assert names == {"housing_rent": ("Housing Rent", "إيجار السكن"),
+                     "annual_rent": ("Annual / Semi-annual Rent", "الإيجار السنوي ونصف السنوي"),
+                     "housing_services": ("Building Services & Home Repairs", "خدمات السكن والصيانة")}
+
+    # The admin adds a budget: the category becomes active, the system definition is untouched.
+    res = hh.admin.api.post("/budgets/categories", json={
+        "household_id": hh.id, "code": "OPEX-HOUSING", "category": "My rent", "allocated_amount": 3000})
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    active = {c["code"] for c in hh.admin.api.get(f"/households/{hh.id}/categories").json()["active"]}
+    assert "OPEX-HOUSING" in active
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT category FROM public.cost_control_codes WHERE code = 'OPEX-HOUSING' "
+                     "AND household_id IS NULL") == "Housing & Rent"
+    assert db.scalar("SELECT count(*) FROM public.cost_control_codes WHERE code = 'OPEX-HOUSING'") == 1
+
+
+def test_rent_expense_lands_in_the_new_housing_sub_category(world, db, llm):
+    hh = world.roommates("tx2", n_members=0)
+    res = world.chat_commit(hh.admin, hh, llm, merchant="Ejar", amount=2500, category_code="OPEX-HOUSING")
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    row = db.one("SELECT category_code, sub_category FROM public.transactions WHERE id = %s",
+                 (res.json()["transaction_id"],))
+    assert row["category_code"] == "OPEX-HOUSING"
+    assert row["sub_category"] == "housing_rent", row

index d6af7e3..e9edbff 100644
--- a/web_app/README.md
+++ b/web_app/README.md
@@ -1,32 +1,31 @@
-# React + TypeScript + Vite
+# Budget Tracker — Web App
 
-This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some Oxlint rules.
+React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + TailwindCSS landing page (Daylight Coastal theme, Arabic RTL and
+English, payday simulator, VIP early-access form). The only backend call is the anonymous
+`POST /public/inquiries` (see [`src/lib/inquiries.ts`](src/lib/inquiries.ts)).
 
-Currently, two official plugins are available:
+## Develop
 
-- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react) uses [Oxc](https://oxc.rs)
-- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/)
-
-## React Compiler
+```bash
+npm ci
+npm run dev       # Vite dev server
+npm run lint      # oxlint
+npm run build     # tsc -b && vite build → dist/
+```
 
-The React Compiler is not enabled on this template because of its impact on dev & build performances. To add it, see [this documentation](https://react.dev/learn/react-compiler/installation).
+There are no unit tests; lint and the type-checked build are the checks.
 
-## Expanding the Oxlint configuration
+## Configuration (`.env`, see [`.env.example`](.env.example))
 
-If you are developing a production application, we recommend enabling type-aware lint rules by installing `oxlint-tsgolint` and editing `.oxlintrc.json`:
+| Variable | Effect |
+|---|---|
+| `VITE_API_BASE_URL` unset | Form posts to `https://budget.fmsco.com.sa` |
+| `VITE_API_BASE_URL=` (empty) | Same origin: use this for the build served by `ai_service` |
+| `VITE_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000` | Local backend (its CORS defaults allow ports 3000, 5173 and 8080) |
 
-```json
-{
-  "$schema": "./node_modules/oxlint/configuration_schema.json",
-  "plugins": ["react", "typescript", "oxc"],
-  "options": {
-    "typeAware": true
-  },
-  "rules": {
-    "react/rules-of-hooks": "error",
-    "react/only-export-components": ["warn", { "allowConstantExport": true }]
-  }
-}
-```
+## Publish
 
-See the [Oxlint rules documentation](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/linter/rules) for the full list of rules and categories.
+The production page at `/` is this app's build committed in `ai_service/static/`. After changing
+`web_app/`, rebuild with `VITE_API_BASE_URL=` and copy `dist/index.html` and `dist/assets/` there
+(exact commands in the root [`README.md`](../README.md#contact-support-and-vip-early-access-email)).
+Translations live in `src/i18n/translations.ts`.
