-.counter {
-  font-size: 16px;
-  padding: 5px 10px;
-  border-radius: 5px;
-  color: var(--accent);
-  background: var(--accent-bg);
-  border: 2px solid transparent;
-  transition: border-color 0.3s;
-  margin-bottom: 24px;
-
-  &:hover {
-    border-color: var(--accent-border);
-  }
-  &:focus-visible {
-    outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
-    outline-offset: 2px;
-  }
-}
-
-.hero {
-  position: relative;
-
-  .base,
-  .framework,
-  .vite {
-    inset-inline: 0;
-    margin: 0 auto;
-  }
-
-  .base {
-    width: 170px;
-    position: relative;
-    z-index: 0;
-  }
-
-  .framework,
-  .vite {
-    position: absolute;
-  }
-
-  .framework {
-    z-index: 1;
-    top: 34px;
-    height: 28px;
-    transform: perspective(2000px) rotateZ(300deg) rotateX(44deg) rotateY(39deg)
-      scale(1.4);
-  }
-
-  .vite {
-    z-index: 0;
-    top: 107px;
-    height: 26px;
-    width: auto;
-    transform: perspective(2000px) rotateZ(300deg) rotateX(40deg) rotateY(39deg)
-      scale(0.8);
-  }
-}
-
-#center {
-  display: flex;
-  flex-direction: column;
-  gap: 25px;
-  place-content: center;
-  place-items: center;
-  flex-grow: 1;
-
-  @media (max-width: 1024px) {
-    padding: 32px 20px 24px;
-    gap: 18px;
-  }
-}
-
-#next-steps {
-  display: flex;
-  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
-  text-align: left;
-
-  & > div {
-    flex: 1 1 0;
-    padding: 32px;
-    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
-      padding: 24px 20px;
-    }
-  }
-
-  .icon {
-    margin-bottom: 16px;
-    width: 22px;
-    height: 22px;
-  }
-
-  @media (max-width: 1024px) {
-    flex-direction: column;
-    text-align: center;
-  }
-}
-
-#docs {
-  border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
-
-  @media (max-width: 1024px) {
-    border-right: none;
-    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
-  }
-}
-
-#next-steps ul {
-  list-style: none;
-  padding: 0;
-  display: flex;
-  gap: 8px;
-  margin: 32px 0 0;
-
-  .logo {
-    height: 18px;
-  }
-
-  a {
-    color: var(--text-h);
-    font-size: 16px;
-    border-radius: 6px;
-    background: var(--social-bg);
-    display: flex;
-    padding: 6px 12px;
-    align-items: center;
-    gap: 8px;
-    text-decoration: none;
-    transition: box-shadow 0.3s;
-
-    &:hover {
-      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
-    }
-    .button-icon {
-      height: 18px;
-      width: 18px;
-    }
-  }
-
-  @media (max-width: 1024px) {
-    margin-top: 20px;
-    flex-wrap: wrap;
-    justify-content: center;
-
-    li {
-      flex: 1 1 calc(50% - 8px);
-    }
-
-    a {
-      width: 100%;
-      justify-content: center;
-      box-sizing: border-box;
-    }
-  }
-}
-
-#spacer {
-  height: 88px;
-  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
-  @media (max-width: 1024px) {
-    height: 48px;
-  }
-}
-
-.ticks {
-  position: relative;
-  width: 100%;
-
-  &::before,
-  &::after {
-    content: '';
-    position: absolute;
-    top: -4.5px;
-    border: 5px solid transparent;
-  }
-
-  &::before {
-    left: 0;
-    border-left-color: var(--border);
-  }
-  &::after {
-    right: 0;
-    border-right-color: var(--border);
-  }
-}

+      <h2 id="features-title" className="text-3xl font-bold text-ink sm:text-4xl">
+        {dict.features.title}
+      </h2>
+      <p className="mt-3 text-muted">{dict.features.subtitle}</p>
+    </div>
+    <ul className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
+      {dict.features.items.map((item) => (
+        <li key={item.title} className="rounded-2xl border border-line bg-white p-6 text-start">
+          <span className="mb-4 inline-flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-teal-soft text-teal">
+            <Icon name={item.icon} />
+          </span>
+          <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-ink">{item.title}</h3>
+          <p className="mt-2 leading-relaxed text-muted">{item.desc}</p>
+          {item.icon === 'scale' && (
+            <a href="#nafaqah" className="mt-3 inline-block font-semibold text-teal underline-offset-4 hover:underline">
+              {dict.features.nafaqahLink}
+            </a>
+          )}
+        </li>
+      ))}
+    </ul>
+  </section>
+);

@@ -0,0 +1,90 @@
+import React from 'react';
+import type { IconName } from '../i18n/translations';
+
+// Small inline stroke icons (no icon font to download, nothing read aloud by screen readers).
+const PATHS: Record<IconName, React.ReactNode> = {
+  calendar: (
+    <>
+      <rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="18" rx="2" />
+      <path d="M16 2v4M8 2v4M3 10h18" />
+    </>
+  ),
+  mic: (
+    <>
+      <path d="M12 2a3 3 0 0 0-3 3v7a3 3 0 0 0 6 0V5a3 3 0 0 0-3-3Z" />
+      <path d="M19 10v2a7 7 0 0 1-14 0v-2M12 19v3" />
+    </>
+  ),
+  receipt: (
+    <>
+      <path d="M4 2v20l2-1 2 1 2-1 2 1 2-1 2 1 2-1 2 1V2l-2 1-2-1-2 1-2-1-2 1-2-1-2 1Z" />
+      <path d="M8 8h8M8 12h8M8 16h5" />
+    </>
+  ),
+  scale: (
+    <>
+      <path d="m16 16 3-8 3 8c-.87.65-1.92 1-3 1s-2.13-.35-3-1Z" />
+      <path d="m2 16 3-8 3 8c-.87.65-1.92 1-3 1s-2.13-.35-3-1Z" />
+      <path d="M7 21h10M12 3v18M3 7h2c2 0 5-1 7-2 2 1 5 2 7 2h2" />
+    </>
+  ),
+  users: (
+    <>
+      <path d="M16 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H6a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2" />
+      <circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4" />
+      <path d="M22 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.87M16 3.13a4 4 0 0 1 0 7.75" />
+    </>
+  ),
+  shield: (
+    <>
+      <path d="M12 22s8-4 8-10V5l-8-3-8 3v7c0 6 8 10 8 10Z" />
+      <path d="m9 12 2 2 4-4" />
+    </>
+  ),
+  lock: (
+    <>
+      <rect x="3" y="11" width="18" height="11" rx="2" />
+      <path d="M7 11V7a5 5 0 0 1 10 0v4" />
+    </>
+  ),
+  sparkles: (
+    <>
+      <path d="m12 3 1.9 5.1L19 10l-5.1 1.9L12 17l-1.9-5.1L5 10l5.1-1.9Z" />
+      <path d="m19 15 .8 2.2L22 18l-2.2.8L19 21l-.8-2.2L16 18l2.2-.8Z" />
+    </>
+  ),
+  noSms: (
+    <>
+      <path d="M21 15a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7l-4 4V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2Z" />
+      <path d="m4 4 16 16" />
+    </>
+  ),
+  chevron: <path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6" />,
+  mail: (
+    <>
+      <rect x="2" y="4" width="20" height="16" rx="2" />
+      <path d="m22 7-10 6L2 7" />
+    </>
+  ),
+};
+
+interface IconProps {
+  name: IconName;
+  className?: string;
+}
+
+export const Icon: React.FC<IconProps> = ({ name, className = 'w-6 h-6' }) => (
+  <svg
+    aria-hidden="true"
+    focusable="false"
+    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
+    fill="none"
+    stroke="currentColor"
+    strokeWidth={1.8}
+    strokeLinecap="round"
+    strokeLinejoin="round"
+    className={className}
+  >
+    {PATHS[name]}
+  </svg>
+);

@@ -0,0 +1,77 @@
+import React from 'react';
+import type { NafaqahCase, TranslationDictionary } from '../i18n/translations';
+import { formatMoney } from '../lib/format';
+
+interface NafaqahProps {
+  dict: TranslationDictionary;
+}
+
+const TONES: Record<NafaqahCase['tone'], string> = {
+  neutral: 'border-line bg-white',
+  debt: 'border-[#f0d9b0] bg-sand-soft',
+  allowance: 'border-[#d6dbff] bg-lilac-soft',
+};
+
+const RESULT_TONES: Record<NafaqahCase['tone'], string> = {
+  neutral: 'text-muted',
+  debt: 'text-sand-ink',
+  allowance: 'text-lilac-ink',
+};
+
+export const Nafaqah: React.FC<NafaqahProps> = ({ dict }) => {
+  const t = dict.nafaqah;
+  return (
+    <section id="nafaqah" aria-labelledby="nafaqah-title" className="border-y border-line bg-white">
+      <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 py-16 sm:px-6 md:py-20">
+        <div className="mx-auto max-w-3xl text-center">
+          <p className="text-sm font-bold text-teal">{t.badge}</p>
+          <h2 id="nafaqah-title" className="mt-2 text-3xl font-bold text-ink sm:text-4xl">
+            {t.title}
+          </h2>
+          <p className="mt-4 leading-relaxed text-muted">{t.intro}</p>
+        </div>
+
+        <ol className="mt-10 grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-3">
+          {t.cases.map((item, idx) => (
+            <li key={item.who} className={`rounded-2xl border p-6 text-start ${TONES[item.tone]}`}>
+              <span
+                aria-hidden="true"
+                className="mb-3 inline-flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-ink text-sm font-bold text-white"
+              >
+                {idx + 1}
+              </span>
+              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-ink">{item.who}</h3>
+              <p className={`mt-2 font-medium leading-relaxed ${RESULT_TONES[item.tone]}`}>{item.result}</p>
+            </li>
+          ))}
+        </ol>
+
+        <div className="mx-auto mt-10 max-w-xl rounded-2xl border border-line bg-bg p-5 sm:p-6">
+          <table className="w-full text-start text-sm">
+            <caption className="mb-3 text-start text-base font-bold text-ink">{t.exampleTitle}</caption>
+            <tbody>
+              {t.exampleRows.map((row) => (
+                <tr key={row.label} className={row.total ? 'border-t-2 border-ink/20' : 'border-t border-line'}>
+                  <th
+                    scope="row"
+                    className={`py-2.5 pe-3 text-start ${row.total ? 'font-bold text-ink' : 'font-normal text-muted'}`}
+                  >
+                    {row.label}
+                  </th>
+                  <td
+                    className={`whitespace-nowrap py-2.5 text-end font-bold ${
+                      row.total ? 'text-sand-ink' : row.negative ? 'text-teal' : 'text-ink'
+                    }`}
+                  >
+                    <bdi>{(row.negative ? '− ' : '') + formatMoney(row.amount, dict.money)}</bdi>
+                  </td>
+                </tr>
+              ))}
+            </tbody>
+          </table>
+        </div>
+        <p className="mx-auto mt-4 max-w-xl text-center text-sm leading-relaxed text-muted">{t.footnote}</p>
+      </div>
+    </section>
+  );
+};
diff --git a/web_app/src/components/PaydayDemo.tsx b/web_app/src/components/PaydayDemo.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..008682d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/web_app/src/components/PaydayDemo.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,85 @@
+import React, { useId, useState } from 'react';
+import type { Language, TranslationDictionary } from '../i18n/translations';
+import { cycleFor, formatDayMonth, riyadhToday } from '../lib/cycle';
+import { formatMoney, plural } from '../lib/format';
+
+interface PaydayDemoProps {
+  dict: TranslationDictionary;
+  lang: Language;
+}
+
+const SAMPLE_BUDGET = 6000;
+const DAYS = Array.from({ length: 31 }, (_, i) => i + 1);
+
+/** Illustrative salary-cycle card: real cycle dates for the chosen payday, sample amounts. */
+export const PaydayDemo: React.FC<PaydayDemoProps> = ({ dict, lang }) => {
+  const [payday, setPayday] = useState(27);
+  const [today] = useState(riyadhToday);
+  const selectId = useId();
+  const t = dict.demo;
+
+  const cycle = cycleFor(today, payday);
+  // Sample spending that tracks how far into the cycle we are.
+  const spent = Math.round((SAMPLE_BUDGET * 0.93 * cycle.elapsed) / cycle.length / 10) * 10;
+  const left = SAMPLE_BUDGET - spent;
+  const daily = Math.floor(left / cycle.daysLeft);
+  const percentSpent = Math.round((spent / SAMPLE_BUDGET) * 100);
+  const range = `${formatDayMonth(cycle.start, dict.money.dateLocale)} – ${formatDayMonth(cycle.end, dict.money.dateLocale)}`;
+
+  return (
+    <div className="w-full max-w-sm rounded-3xl border border-line bg-white p-5 shadow-[0_24px_60px_-20px_rgba(0,75,87,0.35)] sm:p-6">
+      <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
+        <span className="rounded-full bg-teal-soft px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-teal-dark">{t.label}</span>
+        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
+          <label htmlFor={selectId} className="text-xs font-medium text-muted">
+            {t.paydayLabel}
+          </label>
+          <select
+            id={selectId}
+            value={payday}
+            onChange={(e) => setPayday(Number(e.target.value))}
+            className="rounded-lg border border-line bg-bg px-2 py-1.5 text-sm font-bold text-ink"
+          >
+            {DAYS.map((d) => (
+              <option key={d} value={d}>
+                {d}
+              </option>
+            ))}
+          </select>
+        </div>
+      </div>
+
+      <div aria-live="polite">
+        <p className="text-sm text-muted">{t.daysLeftLabel}</p>
+        <p className="mt-1 text-4xl font-bold text-ink">{plural(t.daysLeft, cycle.daysLeft, lang)}</p>
+        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted">
+          {t.cycleLabel}: <span className="font-medium text-ink">{range}</span>
+        </p>
+
+        <div className="mt-5 h-2.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-teal-soft" aria-hidden="true">
+          <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-teal" style={{ width: `${percentSpent}%` }} />
+        </div>
+
+        <dl className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-center">
+          {[
+            { label: t.budgetLabel, value: SAMPLE_BUDGET },
+            { label: t.spentLabel, value: spent },
+            { label: t.leftLabel, value: left },
+          ].map((item) => (
+            <div key={item.label} className="rounded-xl bg-bg px-1 py-2">
+              <dt className="text-[11px] text-muted">{item.label}</dt>
+              <dd className="mt-0.5 text-sm font-bold text-ink">{formatMoney(item.value, dict.money)}</dd>
+            </div>
+          ))}
+        </dl>
+
+        <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-xl bg-teal px-4 py-3 text-white">
+          <span className="text-xs font-medium">{t.dailyLabel}</span>
+          <span className="whitespace-nowrap text-base font-bold">{formatMoney(daily, dict.money)}</span>
+        </div>
+      </div>
+
+      <p className="mt-3 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted">{t.sample}</p>
+    </div>
+  );
+};

diff --git a/web_app/src/lib/cycle.ts b/web_app/src/lib/cycle.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..266264c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/web_app/src/lib/cycle.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,80 @@
+// Salary-cycle arithmetic for the landing page example, matching the app's rule
+// (.agents/rules/02): a cycle runs from the household payday to the day before the next
+// payday on the Asia/Riyadh calendar; a payday past the month's end is clamped to its last day.
+
+export interface CalendarDate {
+  year: number;
+  /** 1–12 */
+  month: number;
+  day: number;
+}
+
+export interface CycleInfo {
+  start: CalendarDate;
+  end: CalendarDate;
+  nextPayday: CalendarDate;
+  /** Whole days from today until the next payday (at least 1). */
+  daysLeft: number;
+  /** Days in the cycle. */
+  length: number;
+  /** Days already elapsed in the cycle, today included. */
+  elapsed: number;
+}
+
+const DAY_MS = 86_400_000;
+
+function daysInMonth(year: number, month: number): number {
+  return new Date(Date.UTC(year, month, 0)).getUTCDate();
+}
+
+function paydayIn(year: number, month: number, payday: number): CalendarDate {
+  // Normalise month overflow (0 → December of the previous year, 13 → January of the next).
+  const normalised = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, 1));
+  const y = normalised.getUTCFullYear();
+  const m = normalised.getUTCMonth() + 1;
+  return { year: y, month: m, day: Math.min(payday, daysInMonth(y, m)) };
+}
+
+function toUtc(d: CalendarDate): number {
+  return Date.UTC(d.year, d.month - 1, d.day);
+}
+
+function fromUtc(ms: number): CalendarDate {
+  const d = new Date(ms);
+  return { year: d.getUTCFullYear(), month: d.getUTCMonth() + 1, day: d.getUTCDate() };
+}
+
+/** Today's date in Riyadh, independent of the visitor's time zone. */
+export function riyadhToday(now: Date = new Date()): CalendarDate {
+  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
+    timeZone: 'Asia/Riyadh',
+    year: 'numeric',
+    month: '2-digit',
+    day: '2-digit',
+  }).formatToParts(now);
+  const get = (type: string) => Number(parts.find((p) => p.type === type)?.value);
+  return { year: get('year'), month: get('month'), day: get('day') };
+}
+
+export function cycleFor(today: CalendarDate, payday: number): CycleInfo {
+  const thisMonth = paydayIn(today.year, today.month, payday);
+  const started = today.day >= thisMonth.day;
+  const start = started ? thisMonth : paydayIn(today.year, today.month - 1, payday);
+  const nextPayday = started ? paydayIn(today.year, today.month + 1, payday) : thisMonth;
+  const t = toUtc(today);
+  const next = toUtc(nextPayday);
+  return {
+    start,
+    end: fromUtc(next - DAY_MS),
+    nextPayday,
+    daysLeft: Math.round((next - t) / DAY_MS),
+    length: Math.round((next - toUtc(start)) / DAY_MS),
+    elapsed: Math.round((t - toUtc(start)) / DAY_MS) + 1,
+  };
+}
+
+export function formatDayMonth(d: CalendarDate, locale: string): string {
+  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', timeZone: 'UTC' }).format(
+    new Date(toUtc(d)),
+  );
+}
diff --git a/web_app/src/lib/format.ts b/web_app/src/lib/format.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..6177f3d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/web_app/src/lib/format.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+import type { PluralForms, TranslationDictionary } from '../i18n/translations';
+
+const numberFormat = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: 0 });
+
+/** "1,840 ر.س" in Arabic (unit after the number), "SAR 1,840" in English. Western digits. */
+export function formatMoney(amount: number, money: TranslationDictionary['money']): string {
+  const value = numberFormat.format(amount);
+  return money.unitAfter ? `${value} ${money.unit}` : `${money.unit} ${value}`;
+}
+
+export function plural(forms: PluralForms, count: number, lang: string): string {
+  const form = forms[new Intl.PluralRules(lang).select(count)] ?? forms.other;
+  return form.replace('{val}', numberFormat.format(count));
+}
diff --git a/web_app/src/lib/inquiries.ts b/web_app/src/lib/inquiries.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..cefd03f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/web_app/src/lib/inquiries.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,54 @@
+// Client for the backend inquiry endpoint (POST /public/inquiries), which emails VIP
+// early-access and support requests to the developer. Success is reported only when the
+// server answers 2xx, i.e. after the email provider accepted the message.
+
+export type InquiryType = 'vip_early_access' | 'support' | 'contact';
+
+export interface InquiryPayload {
+  type: InquiryType;
+  email: string;
+  name?: string;
+  message?: string;
+  locale?: string;
+  source: 'web' | 'landing';
+  /** Honeypot: must stay empty for real visitors. */
+  company_website?: string;
+}
+
+export type InquiryOutcome = 'sent' | 'invalid' | 'rate_limited' | 'unavailable' | 'network';
+
+const DEFAULT_API_BASE_URL = 'https://budget.fmsco.com.sa';
+
+/** Public contact address shown on the page (also the mailbox the inquiries are sent from). */
+export const CONTACT_EMAIL = 'fmscoinfo@fmsco.com.sa';
+
+/**
+ * VITE_API_BASE_URL selects the backend. Unset → the production API; an empty string →
+ * same origin (used when the build is served by the FastAPI service itself).
+ */
+export function inquiryEndpoint(): string {
+  const configured = import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL as string | undefined;
+  const base = (configured ?? DEFAULT_API_BASE_URL).trim().replace(/\/+$/, '');
+  return `${base}/public/inquiries`;
+}
+
+export async function submitInquiry(
+  payload: InquiryPayload,
+  fetchImpl: typeof fetch = fetch,
+): Promise<InquiryOutcome> {
+  let response: Response;
+  try {
+    response = await fetchImpl(inquiryEndpoint(), {
+      method: 'POST',
+      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json' },
+      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
+      credentials: 'omit',
+    });
+  } catch {
+    return 'network';
+  }
+  if (response.ok) return 'sent';
+  if (response.status === 422) return 'invalid';
+  if (response.status === 429) return 'rate_limited';
+  return 'unavailable';
+}
